example.en: The weather on the island alternates between heavy rain and bright sunshine, so visitors should always pack an umbrella.
example.zh: 這座島的天氣時而大雨、時而豔陽，所以遊客一定要帶把傘。

listen.en: The club meets on alternate Fridays in the library.
listen.zh: 這個社團每隔一週的星期五在圖書館聚會。

chinese.en: The course alternates lectures with small group discussions to keep students engaged.
chinese.zh: 這門課交替安排講課與小組討論，讓學生保持投入。

english.en: Many workers now alternate between working from home and going to the office.
english.zh: 現在許多上班族在居家工作和進辦公室之間輪替。

speak.en: I usually alternate between coffee and tea, depending on my mood.
speak.zh: 我通常看心情，有時喝咖啡、有時喝茶。

write.en: To reduce traffic, the city lets cars with odd and even plates drive on alternate days.
write.zh: 為了減少車流，這座城市讓單號和雙號車牌的車輛隔日輪流上路。

example.en: Scientists rely on precise measurements of sea temperature to track how quickly the oceans are warming.
example.zh: 科學家仰賴精確的海水溫度測量數據，來追蹤海洋暖化的速度。

listen.en: Please check the measurements before you buy the sofa.
listen.zh: 買沙發之前請先確認尺寸。

chinese.en: In the experiment, each student had to record three measurements and calculate the average.
chinese.zh: 在這項實驗中，每位學生都必須記錄三次測量結果並算出平均值。

english.en: The metre is the standard unit of measurement for length.
english.zh: 公尺是長度的標準測量單位。

speak.en: I'm terrible at baking because I never follow the measurements exactly.
speak.zh: 我很不會烤點心，因為我從來不照份量精準操作。

write.en: Accurate measurement of air pollution helps the government decide when to issue health warnings.
write.zh: 準確測量空氣污染，有助於政府判斷何時該發布健康警示。

example.en: Grandma never wrote her recipes down, so nobody in the family can make her famous soup quite the same way.
example.zh: 奶奶從來沒把她的食譜寫下來，所以家裡沒有人能把她拿手的湯煮得一模一樣。

listen.en: This recipe is quick, cheap and easy to follow.
listen.zh: 這份食譜快速、便宜又容易照著做。

chinese.en: Working long hours without enough sleep is a recipe for serious health problems.
chinese.zh: 長時間工作又睡眠不足，遲早會引發嚴重的健康問題。

english.en: She found a recipe for vegetable curry on a cooking website.
english.zh: 她在一個烹飪網站上找到一份蔬菜咖哩的食譜。

speak.en: To be honest, I can't cook anything without a recipe.
speak.zh: 老實說，沒有食譜的話我什麼都不會煮。

write.en: Many experts argue that clear goals and teamwork are the recipe for a successful company.
write.zh: 許多專家認為，明確的目標加上團隊合作，就是公司成功的祕訣。

example.en: Because the survey was anonymous, employees felt free to criticise their managers without worrying about being punished.
example.zh: 因為問卷是匿名的，員工可以放心批評主管，不必擔心受到懲罰。

listen.en: She received an anonymous letter at her office.
listen.zh: 她在辦公室收到一封匿名信。

chinese.en: Many people post rude comments online because they feel anonymous behind their screens.
chinese.zh: 許多人在網路上發表無禮的留言，因為他們覺得躲在螢幕後面沒人知道自己是誰。

english.en: The police received an anonymous phone call about the stolen car.
english.zh: 警方接到一通有關那輛失竊汽車的匿名電話。

speak.en: I prefer anonymous feedback because people tend to be more honest.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡匿名回饋，因為大家通常會比較誠實。

write.en: The hotel room felt cold and anonymous, with no pictures on the walls.
write.zh: 那間飯店房間感覺冷冰冰又毫無特色，牆上連一幅畫都沒有。

example.en: Before undertaking such a long journey across the desert, the travellers spent months preparing equipment and studying maps.
example.zh: 在展開這樣一趟橫越沙漠的長途旅程之前，這群旅人花了好幾個月準備裝備、研究地圖。

listen.en: She undertook the difficult task without a single complaint.
listen.zh: 她毫無怨言地接下了這項艱難的任務。

chinese.en: The company has undertaken to reduce its plastic packaging over the next five years.
chinese.zh: 這家公司已承諾在未來五年內減少塑膠包裝。

english.en: Few people are willing to undertake such a risky project.
english.zh: 很少人願意承接這麼有風險的計畫。

speak.en: I'd never undertake a renovation like that without professional help.
speak.zh: 要是沒有專業人士幫忙，我絕對不會自己進行那樣的裝修。

write.en: Governments should undertake a full review of public transport before raising ticket prices.
write.zh: 政府在調漲票價之前，應該先全面檢討大眾運輸系統。

example.en: The documentary charts the rise of the small company, from a garage workshop to a global brand.
example.zh: 這部紀錄片記錄了這家小公司的崛起歷程，從車庫裡的工作室一路成為國際品牌。

listen.en: Her new song went straight to the top of the charts.
listen.zh: 她的新歌一推出就直接衝上排行榜冠軍。

chinese.en: The teacher asked us to chart our reading progress on a wall poster.
chinese.zh: 老師要我們把閱讀進度記錄在牆上的海報上。

english.en: According to the pie chart, most students walk to school.
english.zh: 根據這張圓餅圖，大多數學生走路上學。

speak.en: I like keeping a chart of my workouts to stay motivated.
speak.zh: 我喜歡把運動紀錄做成表格，讓自己保持動力。

write.en: Nurses carefully charted the patient's temperature every hour after the long operation.
write.zh: 長時間的手術結束後，護理師每小時仔細記錄病人的體溫。

example.en: After years of eating fast food, cooking fresh meals at home was a revelation; he felt healthier within weeks.
example.zh: 吃了多年速食之後，在家煮新鮮的飯菜讓他大開眼界，短短幾週就覺得身體變健康了。

listen.en: The revelation that he had lied shocked everyone.
listen.zh: 他說謊的事被揭穿，讓大家都很震驚。

chinese.en: It came as a revelation to me that learning grammar could actually be fun.
chinese.zh: 我驚訝地發現，原來學文法也可以很有趣。

english.en: The revelation about the data leak made customers very angry.
english.zh: 資料外洩的消息曝光後，顧客非常憤怒。

speak.en: Honestly, living abroad for a year was a real revelation for me.
speak.zh: 老實說，在國外住了一年真的讓我大開眼界。

write.en: Recent revelations about microplastics in drinking water have led many families to buy filters.
write.zh: 近來飲用水含有塑膠微粒的消息曝光，促使許多家庭購買濾水器。

example.en: Consumers have grown weary of endless advertising, so many now pay extra for ad-free streaming services.
example.zh: 消費者已經厭倦了無止盡的廣告，所以現在很多人願意多付錢使用無廣告的串流服務。

listen.en: She gave a weary smile and kept working.
listen.zh: 她疲倦地笑了笑，繼續工作。

chinese.en: Many students become weary of studying when they cannot see any real progress.
chinese.zh: 許多學生看不到實際的進步時，就會對讀書感到厭倦。

english.en: The nurses were weary after working twelve hours without a break.
english.zh: 護理師們連續工作十二小時沒休息，都累壞了。

speak.en: I'm a bit weary of social media these days, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我最近有點厭倦社群媒體了。

write.en: Local residents are weary of the constant noise from the construction site next door.
write.zh: 當地居民受夠了隔壁工地不斷傳來的噪音。

example.en: The marble used in the palace was quarried from mountains hundreds of kilometres away and carried by river.
example.zh: 宮殿所用的大理石是從數百公里外的山區開採出來，再經由河運送來的。

listen.en: Local people complained about noise and dust from the nearby quarry.
listen.zh: 當地居民抱怨附近採石場的噪音和粉塵。

chinese.en: The hawk circled high above the field, watching its quarry move through the grass.
chinese.zh: 老鷹在田野上空高高盤旋，盯著牠的獵物在草叢間移動。

english.en: Environmental groups are opposing plans to open a new quarry.
english.zh: 環保團體反對開設新採石場的計畫。

speak.en: There's a quarry near my hometown, so the roads are always full of trucks.
speak.zh: 我老家附近有一座採石場，所以路上總是有很多卡車。

write.en: After a long search, the journalist finally tracked down his quarry at a small café in Paris.
write.zh: 經過漫長的搜尋，那名記者終於在巴黎一家小咖啡館找到了他追查的對象。

example.en: Children often behave differently in unfamiliar surroundings, so teachers should give new pupils time to settle in.
example.zh: 孩子在陌生的環境裡常常表現得不太一樣，所以老師應該給新同學一些時間適應。

listen.en: Always be aware of your surroundings when walking alone at night.
listen.zh: 晚上獨自走路時，一定要留意周遭的狀況。

chinese.en: Working in pleasant surroundings can make employees more productive and less stressed.
chinese.zh: 在舒適的環境中工作，能讓員工更有效率、壓力也更小。

english.en: Animals in zoos should live in surroundings similar to their natural habitats.
english.zh: 動物園裡的動物應該生活在接近其自然棲地的環境中。

speak.en: I study better in quiet surroundings, like a library or a café.
speak.zh: 我在安靜的環境裡比較讀得下書，像是圖書館或咖啡廳。

write.en: Elderly people often prefer to stay in familiar surroundings rather than move into care homes.
write.zh: 長者往往寧願待在熟悉的環境，也不想搬進安養機構。

example.en: The farmhouse had thick stone walls and a slate roof that kept it cool during the hot summer months.
example.zh: 這棟農舍有厚實的石牆和石板屋頂，讓屋內在炎熱的夏季保持涼爽。

listen.en: In the past, children wrote their lessons on small slates.
listen.zh: 以前的孩子會把功課寫在小石板上。

chinese.en: The film was slated by critics but still became a huge success at the box office.
chinese.zh: 這部電影被影評人狠狠批評，票房卻依然大賣。

english.en: The final meeting about the project has been slated for Friday morning.
english.zh: 這個專案的最後一次會議已排定在星期五早上。

speak.en: I think everyone deserves a clean slate after making a mistake.
speak.zh: 我覺得每個人犯錯之後，都應該有重新開始的機會。

write.en: Several new shopping centres are slated for construction on the edge of the city.
write.zh: 市郊預計將興建好幾座新的購物中心。

example.en: Traditional festivals in Taiwan follow the lunar calendar, so the date of Lunar New Year changes every year.
example.zh: 臺灣的傳統節日依照農曆，所以農曆新年的日期每年都不一樣。

listen.en: Let me check my calendar and get back to you.
listen.zh: 我查一下行事曆再回覆你。

chinese.en: The new school calendar gives students a shorter summer holiday but a longer winter break.
chinese.zh: 新的學年行事曆讓學生的暑假變短，但寒假變長。

english.en: My calendar is completely full this week because of meetings.
english.zh: 因為要開會，我這週的行事曆完全排滿了。

speak.en: I use the calendar on my phone to plan almost everything.
speak.zh: 我幾乎所有事情都用手機裡的行事曆來安排。

write.en: The company's sales figures are reported by calendar year rather than by financial year.
write.zh: 這家公司的銷售數字是以曆年計算，而不是以會計年度計算。

example.en: The actors rehearsed in full costume for the first time, which helped them feel like real characters from the eighteenth century.
example.zh: 演員們第一次穿上全套戲服排練，這讓他們覺得自己真的成了十八世紀的人物。

listen.en: The dancers wore colourful costumes during the festival parade.
listen.zh: 舞者們在節慶遊行中穿著色彩繽紛的服裝。

chinese.en: Visitors can rent traditional costumes and take photos in the old part of town.
chinese.zh: 遊客可以租借傳統服飾，在老城區拍照留念。

english.en: She designed and made all the costumes for the school play.
english.zh: 她為學校的話劇設計並製作了所有的戲服。

speak.en: I'm not really into costume parties, but they can be fun.
speak.zh: 我其實不太喜歡變裝派對，不過有時候也蠻好玩的。

write.en: Wearing a costume at work might seem strange, but theme park staff do it every day.
write.zh: 上班穿戲服聽起來或許很奇怪，但主題樂園的員工每天都這麼做。

example.en: Instead of a traditional exam, students are assessed through a portfolio of essays, projects and reflections collected throughout the year.
example.zh: 學生不是靠傳統考試評量，而是透過一整年累積的文章、專題和心得反思所組成的學習歷程檔案來評分。

listen.en: Please bring your portfolio to the job interview.
listen.zh: 面試時請帶著你的作品集。

chinese.en: Experts recommend keeping a diverse investment portfolio to reduce the risk of losing money.
chinese.zh: 專家建議維持多元的投資組合，以降低虧損的風險。

english.en: Many designers share their portfolios online to attract new clients.
english.zh: 許多設計師把作品集放在網路上，以吸引新客戶。

speak.en: My portfolio is mostly photos I took while travelling.
speak.zh: 我的作品集大多是我旅行時拍的照片。

write.en: The company has expanded its product portfolio to include electric bikes and scooters.
write.zh: 這家公司擴大了產品線，納入電動自行車和電動機車。

example.en: The bridge collapsed only months after opening, and engineers now call it a textbook example of poor planning.
example.zh: 那座橋啟用才幾個月就倒塌了，工程師現在把它視為規劃不當的典型例子。

listen.en: I left my textbook on the bus this morning.
listen.zh: 我今天早上把課本忘在公車上了。

chinese.en: Some teachers rely too heavily on textbooks instead of encouraging students to think critically.
chinese.zh: 有些老師過度依賴課本，而沒有鼓勵學生進行批判性思考。

english.en: In many schools, digital textbooks are replacing heavy printed ones.
english.zh: 在許多學校，電子課本正逐漸取代厚重的紙本課本。

speak.en: Honestly, I learned more from films than from my English textbook.
speak.zh: 老實說，我從電影學到的英文比從英文課本學到的還多。

write.en: The goalkeeper made a textbook save, diving low to stop the ball.
write.zh: 守門員做出教科書等級的撲救，壓低身體飛撲擋下了球。

example.en: According to the graph, people in higher income brackets spend a larger share of their money on travel.
example.zh: 根據這張圖，收入級距較高的人把較大比例的錢花在旅遊上。

listen.en: Write your answer and put the page number in brackets.
listen.zh: 寫下你的答案，並把頁碼標在括號裡。

chinese.en: He fixed a metal bracket to the wall to support the heavy bookshelf.
chinese.zh: 他在牆上裝了一個金屬托架來支撐沉重的書架。

english.en: A pay rise moved her into a higher tax bracket.
english.zh: 加薪讓她進入了更高的稅率級距。

speak.en: I always forget to close the bracket when I'm writing code.
speak.zh: 我寫程式的時候老是忘記把括號關起來。

write.en: Critics argue that it is unfair to bracket all teenagers together as lazy and selfish.
write.zh: 批評者認為，把所有青少年都歸類為懶惰又自私是不公平的。

example.en: The castle stands on a steep hill above the river, which made it easy for soldiers to spot approaching enemies.
example.zh: 這座城堡矗立在河邊的陡峭山丘上，讓守城的士兵能輕易發現逼近的敵人。

listen.en: The children built a castle out of sand.
listen.zh: 孩子們用沙子堆了一座城堡。

chinese.en: The old castle has been turned into a hotel, attracting tourists from around the world.
chinese.zh: 這座古堡已經改建成飯店，吸引了來自世界各地的遊客。

english.en: The government spends a lot of money repairing old castles.
english.zh: 政府花了很多錢修復古老的城堡。

speak.en: When I was little, I dreamed of living in a castle.
speak.zh: 我小時候夢想住在城堡裡。

write.en: Stop building castles in the air and make a realistic study plan.
write.zh: 別再做不切實際的白日夢了，好好擬一份實際可行的讀書計畫吧。

example.en: After months of failed job applications, he began to despair of ever finding work in his field.
example.zh: 求職接連失敗好幾個月後，他開始對在本行找到工作不抱希望。

listen.en: Don't despair; there are still plenty of options left.
listen.zh: 別灰心，還有很多選擇。

chinese.en: To my parents' despair, I decided to quit law school and become a musician.
chinese.zh: 我決定放棄法律系去當音樂人，讓我爸媽感到絕望透頂。

english.en: Many farmers feel a sense of despair after years of drought.
english.zh: 經歷多年乾旱之後，許多農民感到絕望。

speak.en: My teachers used to despair of my terrible handwriting.
speak.zh: 我以前的老師們對我那手爛字完全不抱希望。

write.en: Soaring house prices in big cities have driven many young couples to despair.
write.zh: 大城市房價飆漲，讓許多年輕夫妻陷入絕望。

example.en: When the manager started cycling to work, many colleagues did likewise, and the car park was soon half empty.
example.zh: 經理開始騎腳踏車上班後，許多同事也跟著這麼做，停車場很快就空了一半。

listen.en: 'Have a great weekend.' 'Likewise, see you on Monday.'
listen.zh: 「週末愉快。」「你也是，星期一見。」

chinese.en: Students should respect their teachers, and teachers should likewise listen to their students.
chinese.zh: 學生應該尊重老師；同樣地，老師也應該傾聽學生的聲音。

english.en: My father gets up early every day, and my brother does likewise.
english.zh: 我爸爸每天都早起，我哥哥也一樣。

speak.en: If my friends are honest with me, I try to do likewise.
speak.zh: 朋友對我坦誠，我也會盡量用同樣的方式對待他們。

write.en: Taiwan has banned plastic straws in many restaurants, and other countries have acted likewise.
write.zh: 臺灣已在許多餐廳禁用塑膠吸管，其他國家也採取了同樣的做法。

example.en: Because the local currency lost much of its value, imported goods such as phones became extremely expensive.
example.zh: 由於當地貨幣大幅貶值，手機等進口商品變得非常昂貴。

listen.en: The euro is the currency used in many European countries.
listen.zh: 歐元是許多歐洲國家使用的貨幣。

chinese.en: Some people believe digital currencies will eventually replace cash in everyday shopping.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為數位貨幣終究會在日常購物中取代現金。

english.en: Remember to bring some local currency for taxis and street food.
english.zh: 記得帶一些當地貨幣，好搭計程車和買路邊小吃。

speak.en: I always get confused by currency conversions when I travel abroad.
speak.zh: 我出國旅行時總是被貨幣換算搞得一頭霧水。

write.en: The idea of a four-day working week has gained currency among younger employees.
write.zh: 一週只上四天班的想法，在年輕上班族之間愈來愈受到認同。

example.en: Although the rumour about the school closing turned out to be false, many worried parents had already called the principal.
example.zh: 雖然學校要關閉的傳聞後來證實是假的，但許多擔心的家長早已打電話給校長。

listen.en: Please do not believe every rumour you read online.
listen.zh: 請不要相信你在網路上看到的每一則謠言。

chinese.en: Rumour has it that the popular café on the corner will close next month.
chinese.zh: 聽說街角那間很受歡迎的咖啡廳下個月要關門了。

english.en: The company quickly denied the rumours that it was planning job cuts.
english.zh: 公司很快就否認了它正打算裁員的傳聞。

speak.en: It's rumoured that our town is getting a new train station.
speak.zh: 聽說我們鎮上要蓋一座新的火車站。

write.en: Health officials warned that false rumours on social media could stop people from getting vaccinated.
write.zh: 衛生官員警告，社群媒體上的不實謠言可能讓民眾不去接種疫苗。

example.en: Divers carry an oxygen cylinder on their backs, which supplies the air they need to breathe underwater.
example.zh: 潛水員背著氧氣瓶，提供他們在水中呼吸所需的空氣。

listen.en: Roll the paper into a cylinder and tape it.
listen.zh: 把紙捲成圓筒狀，再用膠帶黏好。

chinese.en: In maths class, we learned how to calculate the volume of a cylinder.
chinese.zh: 在數學課上，我們學了如何計算圓柱體的體積。

english.en: The gas cylinder should be stored in a cool, dry place.
english.zh: 瓦斯桶應該存放在陰涼乾燥的地方。

speak.en: After a good breakfast, I feel like I'm firing on all cylinders.
speak.zh: 吃完一頓豐盛的早餐後，我覺得自己火力全開。

write.en: A car engine with more cylinders usually produces more power but uses more fuel.
write.zh: 汽缸數較多的汽車引擎通常馬力較大，但也比較耗油。

example.en: Every weekday morning, thousands of commuters crowd onto buses and trains to travel from the suburbs to their offices downtown.
example.zh: 每個平日早上，成千上萬的通勤族擠上公車和火車，從郊區前往市中心的辦公室。

listen.en: Many commuters read or listen to music on the train.
listen.zh: 許多通勤族在火車上看書或聽音樂。

chinese.en: The new bike lanes have made cycling a popular choice for city commuters.
chinese.zh: 新的自行車道讓騎單車成為都市通勤族的熱門選擇。

english.en: Rising fuel prices have encouraged many commuters to take public transport.
english.zh: 油價上漲促使許多通勤者改搭大眾運輸。

speak.en: I used to be a commuter, but now I mostly work from home.
speak.zh: 我以前是通勤族，但現在大多在家工作。

write.en: Students who are commuters often find it hard to join evening club activities.
write.zh: 通勤上學的學生往往很難參加晚上的社團活動。

example.en: In a wolf pack, there is a strict hierarchy: the leader eats first, while the others wait their turn.
example.zh: 狼群中有嚴格的等級制度：首領先吃，其他狼則要等著輪到自己。

listen.en: She worked hard to move up the company hierarchy.
listen.zh: 她努力工作，想在公司裡往上爬。

chinese.en: Some schools have a clear hierarchy, where senior students expect respect from younger ones.
chinese.zh: 有些學校的階級分明，高年級學生會期待學弟妹尊重他們。

english.en: Young employees often find it hard to question the hierarchy.
english.zh: 年輕員工常常覺得很難挑戰公司的層級制度。

speak.en: To be honest, I prefer working in teams without much hierarchy.
speak.zh: 老實說，我比較喜歡在沒什麼上下階級的團隊裡工作。

write.en: When planning an essay, create a hierarchy of ideas, from the main point to supporting details.
write.zh: 規劃文章時，要把想法分出層次，從主要論點到支持細節。

example.en: The storm destroyed the bridge, and the subsequent repairs took nearly a year to complete.
example.zh: 暴風雨摧毀了那座橋，隨後的修復工程花了將近一年才完成。

listen.en: House prices rose sharply in the subsequent years.
listen.zh: 房價在接下來幾年大幅上漲。

chinese.en: The graph shows that sales fell in March but recovered in subsequent months.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，銷售額在三月下滑，但在之後幾個月回升。

english.en: The subsequent investigation found that nobody was to blame for the accident.
english.zh: 後續的調查發現，這起事故不能怪罪任何人。

speak.en: I failed my first driving test, but passed on a subsequent attempt.
speak.zh: 我第一次考駕照沒過，但之後再考就過了。

write.en: Subsequent to the merger, several employees were asked to move to the new office.
write.zh: 公司合併之後，有幾名員工被要求搬到新辦公室。

example.en: The library has a scheme whereby students can borrow laptops for free, which helps those who cannot afford one.
example.zh: 圖書館有一項方案，讓學生可以免費借用筆電，幫助那些買不起的人。

listen.en: We agreed on a plan whereby the cost is shared.
listen.zh: 我們談好一個分攤費用的計畫。

chinese.en: Photosynthesis is the process whereby plants use sunlight to produce their own food.
chinese.zh: 光合作用是植物利用陽光製造自身養分的過程。

english.en: We have an arrangement whereby my sister cooks and I clean.
english.zh: 我們有個約定：我姊姊負責煮飯，我負責打掃。

speak.en: My company has a policy whereby we can work from home on Fridays.
speak.zh: 我們公司有一項政策，讓我們星期五可以在家工作。

write.en: Some countries use a points system whereby skilled migrants are more likely to receive visas.
write.zh: 有些國家採用積分制度，讓具備專業技能的移民更容易取得簽證。

example.en: Instead of buying an expensive sports car, she made the sensible decision to save her money for a house.
example.zh: 她沒有買昂貴的跑車，而是做了明智的決定，把錢存起來買房子。

listen.en: Wear sensible shoes because we will walk a lot today.
listen.zh: 穿雙好走的鞋，因為我們今天會走很多路。

chinese.en: The most sensible approach is to reduce car use rather than build more roads.
chinese.zh: 最明智的做法是減少使用汽車，而不是興建更多道路。

english.en: My teacher gave me some sensible advice about choosing a university.
english.zh: 老師給了我一些關於選大學的中肯建議。

speak.en: I think it's sensible to have some savings for emergencies.
speak.zh: 我覺得存一些緊急預備金是很明智的。

write.en: The manager set a sensible deadline so the team would not have to work overtime.
write.zh: 經理訂了一個合理的截止期限，讓團隊不必加班。

example.en: Because of coastal erosion, the cliff edge has moved closer to the village, and some houses are now at risk.
example.zh: 由於海岸侵蝕，懸崖邊緣離村莊越來越近，有些房子現在岌岌可危。

listen.en: Wind and rain cause erosion of the rocks over time.
listen.zh: 風和雨會隨著時間侵蝕岩石。

chinese.en: Constant price rises have led to a steady erosion of people's savings.
chinese.zh: 物價不斷上漲，使人們的儲蓄逐漸縮水。

english.en: Repeated scandals caused a serious erosion of public trust in the company.
english.zh: 一再發生的醜聞讓大眾對這家公司的信任嚴重流失。

speak.en: We learned about erosion in geography class, and it was actually fascinating.
speak.zh: 我們在地理課學過侵蝕作用，其實滿有趣的。

write.en: Sugary drinks can lead to the erosion of tooth enamel if you drink them often.
write.zh: 如果常喝含糖飲料，可能會導致牙齒琺瑯質受到侵蝕。

example.en: The arrival of smartphones completely changed the way people shop, communicate and even find their way around cities.
example.zh: 智慧型手機的出現徹底改變了人們購物、溝通，甚至在城市裡認路的方式。

listen.en: We waited for her arrival at the busy airport.
listen.zh: 我們在繁忙的機場等她抵達。

chinese.en: The train's arrival was delayed because of heavy snow on the tracks.
chinese.zh: 由於鐵軌上積了大雪，火車延誤抵達。

english.en: Please tell us your expected arrival time before the trip.
english.zh: 請在出發前告訴我們你預計的抵達時間。

speak.en: There's a new arrival in our family, my baby nephew.
speak.zh: 我們家多了一位新成員，就是我剛出生的小外甥。

write.en: Since the arrival of online courses, students can study at their own pace.
write.zh: 自從線上課程出現後，學生可以依照自己的步調學習。

example.en: After fixing his bike chain, his hands were covered in black grease, so he scrubbed them with soap.
example.zh: 修好腳踏車鏈條後，他滿手都是黑色油污，所以用肥皂用力搓洗。

listen.en: This soap removes grease from pots and pans easily.
listen.zh: 這種清潔劑能輕鬆去除鍋碗上的油污。

chinese.en: Fast food is often full of grease and salt, which is bad for your heart.
chinese.zh: 速食常常充滿油脂和鹽分，對心臟不好。

english.en: The mechanic greased the wheels to stop them from squeaking.
english.zh: 技師幫輪子上油，讓它們不再吱吱作響。

speak.en: Honestly, cleaning the kitchen properly takes a bit of elbow grease.
speak.zh: 說真的，要把廚房徹底打掃乾淨得花點力氣。

write.en: Restaurants must not pour cooking grease down the drain because it blocks the city's pipes.
write.zh: 餐廳不可以把烹飪廢油倒進排水孔，因為會堵塞城市的管線。

example.en: The old fisherman had a thick grey beard that almost reached his chest, making him look like a wizard.
example.zh: 那位老漁夫留著幾乎垂到胸口的濃密灰鬍子，看起來像個巫師。

listen.en: He shaved off his beard before the job interview.
listen.zh: 他在工作面試前把鬍子刮掉了。

chinese.en: Some companies used to ban beards, but most workplaces are more relaxed now.
chinese.zh: 有些公司過去禁止員工留鬍子，但現在大多數職場都比較寬鬆了。

english.en: He trims his beard every morning before going to work.
english.zh: 他每天早上上班前都會修剪鬍子。

speak.en: Honestly, I think a short beard makes him look more mature.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得留短鬍子讓他看起來更成熟。

write.en: In the play, the young actor wore a fake beard to look like an old king.
write.zh: 在這齣戲裡，那位年輕演員戴上假鬍子，扮成一位老國王。

example.en: Because there was not enough evidence, the jury decided that the defendant was innocent and he was released.
example.zh: 由於證據不足，陪審團認定被告無罪，他因此獲釋。

listen.en: The defendant's lawyer asked the judge for more time.
listen.zh: 被告的律師請求法官給予更多時間。

chinese.en: Every defendant has the right to a fair trial and a lawyer.
chinese.zh: 每位被告都有權接受公平審判並委任律師。

english.en: The defendant was found guilty of stealing money from the company.
english.zh: 被告被判從公司竊取金錢的罪名成立。

speak.en: I watched a court drama where the defendant was actually the hero.
speak.zh: 我看了一部法庭劇，裡面的被告其實才是英雄。

write.en: In our law class, each student played either the defendant or a witness in a mock trial.
write.zh: 在法律課的模擬法庭中，每位學生都扮演被告或證人。

example.en: Don't be upset, he was only teasing; he actually thinks your new haircut looks great.
example.zh: 別難過，他只是在開玩笑；其實他覺得你的新髮型很好看。

listen.en: The children teased the puppy with a ball.
listen.zh: 孩子們拿著球逗小狗玩。

chinese.en: Students who are teased at school may lose confidence and stop speaking up in class.
chinese.zh: 在學校被取笑的學生可能會失去自信，在課堂上不再發言。

english.en: My colleagues teased me when I came to work in a suit.
english.zh: 我穿西裝來上班時，同事們都取笑我。

speak.en: Don't take it seriously, she's just a big tease.
speak.zh: 別當真，她就是很愛開玩笑。

write.en: Parents should teach children the difference between friendly teasing and hurtful bullying.
write.zh: 父母應該教孩子分辨善意的玩笑和傷人的霸凌。

example.en: Sales have dropped for three consecutive months, so the company is planning a new advertising campaign.
example.zh: 銷售額已連續三個月下滑，因此公司正在規劃新的廣告活動。

listen.en: The team has won several consecutive games this season.
listen.zh: 這支隊伍本季已經連贏好幾場比賽。

chinese.en: This is the second consecutive year that the city has hosted the festival.
chinese.zh: 這是這座城市連續第二年主辦這個節慶。

english.en: She has stayed late at the office for four consecutive nights.
english.zh: 她已經連續四個晚上留在辦公室加班了。

speak.en: I once studied for ten consecutive hours, and I was exhausted.
speak.zh: 我曾經連續讀了十個小時的書，累壞了。

write.en: Unemployment has fallen for several consecutive quarters, according to the latest government report.
write.zh: 根據政府最新報告，失業率已經連續好幾季下降。

example.en: Although the old cinema was losing money, sentiment among local residents was so strong that the council decided to save it.
example.zh: 雖然那家老電影院一直虧錢，但當地居民的感情太深，市議會決定保留它。

listen.en: I share your sentiment about the new library.
listen.zh: 我和你對新圖書館的看法一樣。

chinese.en: Consumer sentiment improved last month as more people felt confident about their jobs.
chinese.zh: 上個月消費者信心回升，因為更多人對自己的工作感到有把握。

english.en: There is a growing sentiment that university education should be free for everyone.
english.zh: 越來越多人認為大學教育應該全面免費。

speak.en: Sadly, I think there's really no room for sentiment in business.
speak.zh: 很遺憾，我覺得在商場上真的容不下感情用事。

write.en: The farewell card expressed the warm sentiments of everyone in our department.
write.zh: 這張送別卡片表達了我們部門每個人的溫暖心意。

example.en: Electric cars use large batteries that can be charged at home overnight, so drivers rarely need petrol stations.
example.zh: 電動車使用大型電池，可以整晚在家充電，所以駕駛很少需要去加油站。

listen.en: Remember to charge the battery before you leave home.
listen.zh: 出門前記得先把電池充飽。

chinese.en: Old batteries should be recycled because they contain chemicals that harm the soil.
chinese.zh: 廢電池應該回收，因為裡面含有會危害土壤的化學物質。

english.en: I chose this laptop because it has a long battery life.
english.zh: 我選這台筆電，是因為它的電池續航力很長。

speak.en: My car wouldn't start this morning because the battery was flat.
speak.zh: 我的車今天早上發不動，因為電瓶沒電了。

write.en: Before the surgery, the patient had to go through a battery of medical tests.
write.zh: 手術前，病人必須接受一連串的醫學檢查。

example.en: The journalist was sent on assignment to cover the floods, so she spent two weeks reporting from the affected villages.
example.zh: 那位記者被派去採訪水災，因此她在受災村莊報導了兩個星期。

listen.en: Our teacher gave us a difficult reading assignment.
listen.zh: 老師給了我們一份很難的閱讀作業。

chinese.en: Group assignments teach students how to share work and solve problems together.
chinese.zh: 小組作業教導學生如何分工合作、一起解決問題。

english.en: I stayed up late last night to finish my English assignment.
english.zh: 我昨晚熬夜完成英文作業。

speak.en: Honestly, I find written assignments more stressful than exams.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得書面報告比考試更有壓力。

write.en: My first assignment at the new company was to organise a client meeting.
write.zh: 我在新公司的第一個任務是籌辦一場客戶會議。

example.en: After staring at the computer screen all day, her eyes were strained and she had a headache.
example.zh: 盯著電腦螢幕一整天後，她的眼睛疲勞，頭也痛了起來。

listen.en: I strained my back lifting a heavy box.
listen.zh: 我搬重箱子時拉傷了背。

chinese.en: The old bridge began to crack under the strain of heavy traffic.
chinese.zh: 這座老橋在繁重車流的壓力下開始出現裂縫。

english.en: Nurses work under a lot of strain during flu season.
english.zh: 流感季節期間，護理師要承受很大的壓力。

speak.en: Sitting at the back, I had to strain to hear the speaker.
speak.zh: 我坐在後面，必須很費力才聽得到講者說話。

write.en: Strain the pasta carefully, then stir in the tomato sauce and fresh basil.
write.zh: 把義大利麵小心瀝乾，再拌入番茄醬汁和新鮮羅勒。

example.en: Space is at a premium in small city flats, so many people buy furniture that folds away when not needed.
example.zh: 在都市的小公寓裡空間非常寶貴，所以很多人會買不用時可以收起來的家具。

listen.en: Customers will pay a premium for fresh local food.
listen.zh: 顧客願意多花錢買新鮮的在地食材。

chinese.en: The airline charges a premium for seats with extra legroom near the front.
chinese.zh: 這家航空公司對靠近前方、腿部空間較大的座位額外收費。

english.en: This shop only sells premium coffee beans from small farms.
english.zh: 這家店只賣來自小農場的高級咖啡豆。

speak.en: I don't think premium brands are always worth the extra money.
speak.zh: 我不覺得高價品牌總是值得多花那些錢。

write.en: The company pays staff a premium for working on weekends and public holidays.
write.zh: 員工在週末和國定假日上班，公司會額外加給。

example.en: In the fog, we could only see the dark outline of the mountains, but no trees or houses.
example.zh: 在霧中，我們只看得到山的黑色輪廓，看不見樹木或房屋。

listen.en: The manager outlined the plan for next year.
listen.zh: 經理概述了明年的計畫。

chinese.en: The report outlines several ways to reduce traffic in the city centre.
chinese.zh: 這份報告概述了幾種減少市中心車流量的方法。

english.en: Our teacher gave us an outline of the course on the first day.
english.zh: 老師在第一天給了我們這門課的課程大綱。

speak.en: Let me briefly outline what I usually do on weekends.
speak.zh: 讓我簡單說一下我週末通常都做些什麼。

write.en: The architect drew the outline of the new building on a large sheet of paper.
write.zh: 建築師在一大張紙上畫出新大樓的輪廓。

example.en: The novel explores the morality of a doctor who lies to his patients in order to protect them from bad news.
example.zh: 這本小說探討一位醫生為了讓病人免於壞消息而對他們說謊，這樣做是否合乎道德。

listen.en: Her sense of morality is stronger than her ambition.
listen.zh: 她的道德感比她的野心更強烈。

chinese.en: Some critics question the morality of using animals to test new beauty products.
chinese.zh: 有些批評者質疑用動物測試新美妝產品是否合乎道德。

english.en: Ideas about public morality often change as a society develops over time.
english.zh: 隨著社會發展，人們對公共道德的看法往往會改變。

speak.en: Honestly, I think morality matters more than money in business.
speak.zh: 說真的，我覺得做生意時道德比金錢更重要。

write.en: At work, personal morality is tested when nobody is watching what you do.
write.zh: 在職場上，個人道德會在沒有人注意你在做什麼時受到考驗。

example.en: Before the meeting, the manager circulated a short report so that everyone could read it in advance.
example.zh: 開會前，經理先傳閱了一份簡短的報告，讓大家可以事先閱讀。

listen.en: Open the windows so fresh air can circulate.
listen.zh: 把窗戶打開，讓新鮮空氣可以流通。

chinese.en: False rumours about the company circulated quickly on social media after the announcement.
chinese.zh: 公告發布後，關於這家公司的不實謠言在社群媒體上迅速流傳。

english.en: The teacher circulated a list for students to sign up.
english.zh: 老師傳了一張名單讓學生登記報名。

speak.en: At parties, I usually circulate and chat with different people.
speak.zh: 在派對上，我通常會到處走動，和不同的人聊天。

write.en: When money circulates within a local community, small businesses are more likely to survive.
write.zh: 當資金在地方社區內流通時，小型商家比較有機會生存下去。

example.en: Experienced nurses often rely on intuition, noticing small changes in a patient before any test shows a problem.
example.zh: 經驗豐富的護理師常常仰賴直覺，在任何檢查發現問題之前，就察覺病人的細微變化。

listen.en: Sometimes you just have to trust your intuition.
listen.zh: 有時候你就是得相信自己的直覺。

chinese.en: Good managers combine data with intuition when they make important decisions about hiring.
chinese.zh: 優秀的主管在做重要的聘用決策時，會結合數據與直覺。

english.en: My intuition told me not to accept the job offer.
english.zh: 我的直覺告訴我不要接受那份工作。

speak.en: I chose my major based on intuition rather than careful planning.
speak.zh: 我選主修是憑直覺，而不是經過仔細規劃。

write.en: Scientists sometimes follow an intuition for years before they find evidence to support it.
write.zh: 科學家有時會順著一個直覺研究好幾年，才找到支持它的證據。

example.en: After running in the extreme heat without drinking any water, the runner collapsed just before the finish line.
example.zh: 那名跑者在酷熱中奔跑卻完全沒喝水，就在終點線前昏倒了。

listen.en: The company is on the verge of collapse.
listen.zh: 這家公司瀕臨倒閉。

chinese.en: The collapse of the housing market left many young families in serious debt.
chinese.zh: 房市崩盤讓許多年輕家庭背上沉重的債務。

english.en: Oil prices collapsed when global demand fell sharply last year.
english.zh: 去年全球需求大幅下滑時，油價隨之暴跌。

speak.en: After finals week, I just collapsed on my bed and slept.
speak.zh: 期末考週結束後，我直接倒在床上睡著了。

write.en: Without regular maintenance, public transport systems can collapse under the pressure of growing populations.
write.zh: 如果缺乏定期維護，大眾運輸系統可能會在人口成長的壓力下崩潰。

example.en: The volunteers proved instrumental in the rescue effort, guiding families to safety and handing out food and blankets.
example.zh: 志工在救援行動中發揮了關鍵作用，他們引導家庭到安全的地方，並發放食物和毛毯。

listen.en: I prefer instrumental music when I study at night.
listen.zh: 我晚上讀書時比較喜歡聽純音樂。

chinese.en: Social media played an instrumental role in spreading awareness of the environmental campaign.
chinese.zh: 社群媒體在提高這項環保運動的知名度上扮演了關鍵角色。

english.en: My English teacher was instrumental in helping me get into university.
english.zh: 我的英文老師在幫助我考上大學這件事上功不可沒。

speak.en: The band played a beautiful instrumental piece at my cousin's wedding.
speak.zh: 樂團在我表哥的婚禮上演奏了一首很美的器樂曲。

write.en: New technology has been instrumental in reducing the cost of renewable energy.
write.zh: 新科技在降低再生能源成本上發揮了關鍵作用。

example.en: Each passenger may bring a maximum of two bags, so anything extra must be checked in at the counter for a fee.
example.zh: 每位乘客最多可攜帶兩件行李，多出來的必須在櫃檯付費託運。

listen.en: The hall was filled to its maximum capacity tonight.
listen.zh: 今晚禮堂已經坐滿，達到最大容納人數。

chinese.en: To get the maximum benefit from exercise, you should combine it with a healthy diet.
chinese.zh: 想要從運動中獲得最大的好處，你應該搭配健康的飲食。

english.en: The temperature in Taipei reached a maximum of thirty-five degrees yesterday.
english.zh: 昨天臺北的氣溫最高達到三十五度。

speak.en: I push myself to the maximum when I train for a race.
speak.zh: 我為比賽訓練時，會把自己逼到極限。

write.en: Many countries set maximum working hours to protect the health of employees.
write.zh: 許多國家規定最高工時，以保護勞工的健康。

example.en: Although the town was once poor, it now thrives on tourism, with new cafes and hotels opening every year.
example.zh: 雖然這個小鎮過去很貧窮，但現在靠觀光業蓬勃發展，每年都有新的咖啡廳和旅館開幕。

listen.en: Some people really thrive on pressure and tight deadlines.
listen.zh: 有些人在壓力和緊迫的期限下反而表現得特別好。

chinese.en: Children tend to thrive when they feel safe, loved and encouraged at home.
chinese.zh: 孩子在家中感到安全、被愛和被鼓勵時，往往能健全成長。

english.en: Small businesses thrived in the area after the new station opened.
english.zh: 新車站啟用後，這一區的小店家生意興隆。

speak.en: I think I thrive more in a team than when I work alone.
speak.zh: 我覺得比起自己一個人工作，我在團隊裡表現得更好。

write.en: Wildlife has begun to thrive again since the river was cleaned up.
write.zh: 自從這條河被整治乾淨後，野生動物又開始繁衍興盛。

example.en: Before tractors became common, farmers relied on horses and oxen to pull heavy ploughs through the soil.
example.zh: 在曳引機普及以前，農夫靠馬和牛拉著沉重的犁來翻土。

listen.en: A slow tractor was blocking the narrow country road.
listen.zh: 一輛慢吞吞的曳引機擋住了狹窄的鄉間小路。

chinese.en: Modern tractors use GPS so that farmers can plant crops in perfectly straight lines.
chinese.zh: 現代的曳引機會使用衛星定位，讓農夫能把作物種得筆直整齊。

english.en: My grandfather taught me how to drive a tractor on his farm.
english.zh: 我爺爺在他的農場教我怎麼開曳引機。

speak.en: As a kid, I loved riding on my uncle's tractor.
speak.zh: 小時候，我很喜歡坐在叔叔的曳引機上。

write.en: Government subsidies help small farmers buy tractors and other machinery they could not otherwise afford.
write.zh: 政府補助幫助小農購買原本負擔不起的曳引機和其他農業機具。

example.en: The tension slowly builds throughout the novel and finally reaches its climax when the hidden letter is discovered.
example.zh: 緊張感在整本小說中慢慢累積，最後在那封藏起來的信被發現時達到高潮。

listen.en: The crowd cheered loudly at the climax of the concert.
listen.zh: 在演唱會的高潮時刻，觀眾大聲歡呼。

chinese.en: Winning the national award was the climax of her long career as a science teacher.
chinese.zh: 獲得全國性的獎項是她漫長的自然科教師生涯中的巔峰。

english.en: The debate came to a climax when both sides started shouting.
english.zh: 雙方開始大吼時，辯論達到了最高潮。

speak.en: For me, the real climax of the trip was watching the sunrise.
speak.zh: 對我來說，這趟旅行真正的高潮是看日出。

write.en: Talks over the new trade agreement are expected to reach a climax next week.
write.zh: 新貿易協定的談判預計將在下週進入最關鍵的階段。

example.en: We don't know the exact cost yet, but the builder gave us a rough estimate based on similar projects.
example.zh: 我們還不知道確切的費用，但包商根據類似的工程給了我們一個粗略的估價。

listen.en: I had a really rough day at work today.
listen.zh: 我今天上班過得非常不順。

chinese.en: The sea was too rough for the small boats, so the island tour was cancelled.
chinese.zh: 海浪太大，小船無法出海，所以環島行程取消了。

english.en: Can you give me a rough idea of what the job involves?
english.zh: 你可以大概跟我說一下這份工作要做些什麼嗎？

speak.en: My first year at university was pretty rough, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我大一那年過得滿辛苦的。

write.en: In many big cities, rising rents have forced more people to sleep rough.
write.zh: 在許多大城市，房租不斷上漲，迫使更多人露宿街頭。

example.en: Because of strong opposition from local residents, the city council decided to scrap its plan to build a car park.
example.zh: 由於當地居民強烈反對，市議會決定取消興建停車場的計畫。

listen.en: We feed our kitchen scraps to the chickens.
listen.zh: 我們把廚餘拿去餵雞。

chinese.en: The old ship was sold for scrap after it had been out of service for years.
chinese.zh: 那艘舊船停止服役多年後，被當作廢鐵賣掉了。

english.en: The company scrapped the new uniform policy after many complaints.
english.zh: 在接到許多抱怨後，公司取消了新的制服規定。

speak.en: I scrapped my first draft and started the essay again.
speak.zh: 我把初稿整個丟掉，重新開始寫這篇文章。

write.en: Recycling scrap metal saves energy and reduces the need for new mining.
write.zh: 回收廢金屬可以節省能源，並減少開採新礦的需求。

example.en: Some insects survive pesticides because a random mutation in their genes protects them, and they pass it to their offspring.
example.zh: 有些昆蟲能在殺蟲劑下存活，是因為基因中的隨機突變保護了牠們，而牠們會把這種突變遺傳給後代。

listen.en: This rare mutation changes the colour of the flower.
listen.zh: 這種罕見的突變會改變花朵的顏色。

chinese.en: Exposure to strong radiation can cause mutations that may lead to serious diseases.
chinese.zh: 暴露在強烈輻射下可能引起突變，進而導致嚴重的疾病。

english.en: The doctor explained that her illness was caused by a genetic mutation.
english.zh: 醫生解釋說，她的病是由基因突變引起的。

speak.en: I find it amazing how one tiny mutation can change a species.
speak.zh: 我覺得很神奇，一個微小的突變竟然能改變一個物種。

write.en: Over centuries, the language underwent a gradual mutation as it absorbed words from its neighbours.
write.zh: 幾個世紀以來，這種語言吸收了鄰近語言的詞彙，逐漸產生了變化。

example.en: According to recent statistics, cycling to work has become more popular since the city built safer bike lanes.
example.zh: 根據最新的統計數據，自從市政府興建了更安全的自行車道，騎腳踏車上班變得更普遍了。

listen.en: Statistics is a useful subject for business students.
listen.zh: 對商科學生來說，統計學是一門很實用的科目。

chinese.en: The government publishes crime statistics every year to help the public understand safety trends.
chinese.zh: 政府每年公布犯罪統計數據，幫助民眾了解治安趨勢。

english.en: These statistics suggest that online shopping is growing very fast.
english.zh: 這些統計數據顯示，網路購物正在快速成長。

speak.en: I struggled with statistics at university, but now I use it daily.
speak.zh: 我在大學時讀統計學很吃力，但現在每天都會用到。

write.en: Statistics can be misleading if they are taken out of context or presented selectively.
write.zh: 統計數據如果被斷章取義或選擇性呈現，就可能誤導人。

example.en: The artist uses dark colours and empty spaces to convey a sense of loneliness that many viewers find moving.
example.zh: 這位藝術家運用深沉的色彩和留白，傳達出一種讓許多觀眾深受感動的孤寂感。

listen.en: Please convey my warm thanks to your parents.
listen.zh: 請代我向你的父母致上誠摯的謝意。

chinese.en: Pipes convey hot water from the boiler to every room in the building.
chinese.zh: 管線把熱水從鍋爐輸送到大樓的每個房間。

english.en: Good teachers can convey difficult ideas in very simple words.
english.zh: 好老師能用很簡單的話傳達困難的概念。

speak.en: I think body language conveys more than words in an interview.
speak.zh: 我覺得在面試中，肢體語言傳達的訊息比言語還多。

write.en: Public health campaigns must convey clear messages that everyone, including the elderly, can understand.
write.zh: 公共衛生宣導必須傳達清楚的訊息，讓包括長者在內的所有人都能理解。

example.en: After their parents died in an accident, their aunt became their legal guardian and raised them as her own.
example.zh: 他們的父母在一場意外中過世後，阿姨成了他們的法定監護人，把他們當作自己的孩子撫養長大。

listen.en: Museums act as guardians of our shared history.
listen.zh: 博物館扮演著守護我們共同歷史的角色。

chinese.en: The court appointed a guardian to manage the child's money until she becomes an adult.
chinese.zh: 法院指定了一位監護人，在孩子成年之前代為管理她的財產。

english.en: My grandmother was my guardian while my parents worked abroad.
english.zh: 我父母在國外工作的時候，奶奶是我的監護人。

speak.en: My older brother has always been like a guardian to me.
speak.zh: 我哥哥一直像是我的守護者。

write.en: Local farmers see themselves as guardians of the land for future generations.
write.zh: 當地農民認為自己是在為後代子孫守護這片土地。

example.en: Although she was shy in class, she was a brilliant mathematician who later solved problems her professors could not.
example.zh: 雖然她在課堂上很害羞，卻是一位才華洋溢的數學家，後來還解出了連她的教授們都解不出的難題。

listen.en: The sky was a brilliant blue this morning.
listen.zh: 今天早上天空藍得耀眼。

chinese.en: He is brilliant at explaining complex topics, which makes him a popular lecturer.
chinese.zh: 他很擅長解說複雜的主題，因此是很受歡迎的講師。

english.en: She had a brilliant career as a lawyer before starting her company.
english.zh: 她在自己創業之前，有過一段很輝煌的律師生涯。

speak.en: I think the public transport here is brilliant, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得這裡的大眾運輸非常棒。

write.en: The city's festival of lights attracts thousands of tourists with its brilliant displays every winter.
write.zh: 這座城市的燈節每年冬天都以燦爛奪目的燈光展演吸引成千上萬的遊客。

example.en: As house prices in the city centre rose sharply, many families moved to towns on the edge of the metropolitan region.
example.zh: 隨著市中心的房價急遽上漲，許多家庭搬到了都會區邊緣的城鎮。

listen.en: Traffic in metropolitan areas gets worse every year.
listen.zh: 都會區的交通一年比一年糟。

chinese.en: Large metropolitan cities offer many job opportunities, but living there can be stressful and expensive.
chinese.zh: 大型都會城市提供許多工作機會，但住在那裡可能壓力大、開銷高。

english.en: Taipei and its neighbouring cities form a large metropolitan area.
english.zh: 臺北和鄰近的城市構成了一個大型都會區。

speak.en: I grew up in a small town, so metropolitan life was a shock.
speak.zh: 我在小鎮長大，所以剛開始過大都市生活時很不習慣。

write.en: Governments should invest in rail links between metropolitan centres and rural communities.
write.zh: 政府應該投資興建連接都會中心與鄉村社區的鐵路。

example.en: I only heard fragments of their conversation through the wall, so I couldn't tell what they were arguing about.
example.zh: 我隔著牆只聽到他們對話的片段，所以聽不出他們在吵什麼。

listen.en: Be careful, there are glass fragments on the floor.
listen.zh: 小心，地上有玻璃碎片。

chinese.en: Social media has fragmented the audience, so fewer people watch the same programmes.
chinese.zh: 社群媒體讓觀眾變得分散，因此收看相同節目的人越來越少。

english.en: The plate hit the floor and broke into tiny fragments.
english.zh: 盤子掉到地上，摔成了小碎片。

speak.en: Honestly, I can only remember fragments of my early childhood.
speak.zh: 說真的，我只記得童年早期的一些片段。

write.en: Long working hours can fragment family life, leaving little time for shared meals.
write.zh: 過長的工時可能讓家庭生活變得支離破碎，幾乎沒有時間一起吃飯。

example.en: When the bacteria invade the body, white blood cells quickly rush to the area to fight the infection.
example.zh: 細菌入侵人體時，白血球會迅速趕到該部位對抗感染。

listen.en: Weeds invaded the garden while we were away.
listen.zh: 我們不在家的時候，雜草長滿了整個花園。

chinese.en: In the past, many coastal towns built walls to stop foreign armies from invading.
chinese.zh: 過去，許多沿海城鎮築起城牆，以阻止外國軍隊入侵。

english.en: Every summer, tourists invade the small beach town near my home.
english.zh: 每年夏天，觀光客都會大批湧入我家附近那個海邊小鎮。

speak.en: I hate it when my phone invades my free time with work emails.
speak.zh: 我很討厭手機用工作信件侵占我的休閒時間。

write.en: Non-native plants can quickly invade local ecosystems and push out native species.
write.zh: 外來植物可能迅速入侵當地生態系，排擠原生物種。

example.en: Many experts see the decision to cut funding for public libraries as a backward step for education in the region.
example.zh: 許多專家認為刪減公共圖書館經費的決定，是該地區教育的一大倒退。

listen.en: She walked backward slowly to take a better photo.
listen.zh: 她慢慢往後退，想拍出更好的照片。

chinese.en: The old farming methods seemed backward, but they actually protected the soil very well.
chinese.zh: 那些傳統的耕作方法看起來很落後，但其實把土壤保護得很好。

english.en: Can you say the alphabet backward without making a mistake?
english.zh: 你能把英文字母倒著背一遍而且不出錯嗎？

speak.en: I hate riding backward on the train because it makes me dizzy.
speak.zh: 我很討厭在火車上倒著坐，因為會讓我頭暈。

write.en: The old couple paced backward and forward in the hospital corridor, waiting for news.
write.zh: 那對老夫妻在醫院走廊上來回踱步，等待消息。

example.en: Profit margins in the restaurant industry are thin, so even a small rise in rent can push owners out of business.
example.zh: 餐飲業的利潤率很低，所以就算房租只小幅上漲，也可能逼得業者關門大吉。

listen.en: Please write your comments in the margin of the page.
listen.zh: 請把你的意見寫在這一頁的頁邊空白處。

chinese.en: The survey has a margin of error, so the results should be read with caution.
chinese.zh: 這項調查有誤差範圍，因此解讀結果時應該謹慎。

english.en: Many elderly people still live on the margins of modern society.
english.zh: 許多長者至今仍生活在現代社會的邊緣。

speak.en: Honestly, I passed the driving test by a very small margin.
speak.zh: 老實說，我是以非常些微的差距通過駕照考試的。

write.en: Our tight schedule leaves little margin for error, so every task must start on time.
write.zh: 我們的時程很緊，幾乎沒有犯錯的空間，所以每項工作都必須準時開始。

example.en: Thick smoke from the factory fire filled the street, and several residents began coughing and choking as they ran outside.
example.zh: 工廠火災的濃煙瀰漫整條街，好幾位居民一邊往外跑，一邊咳嗽、喘不過氣。

listen.en: She choked back tears as she said goodbye.
listen.zh: 她說再見時強忍著淚水。

chinese.en: The city centre is choked with traffic every weekday morning during rush hour.
chinese.zh: 每個平日早上的尖峰時段，市中心都塞滿了車。

english.en: Always cut grapes in half so small children do not choke.
english.zh: 一定要把葡萄切半，小孩子才不會噎到。

speak.en: I got a bit choked up when I gave my wedding speech.
speak.zh: 我在婚禮上致詞時有點哽咽。

write.en: Weeds have choked the small pond behind our school, so the fish cannot survive.
write.zh: 雜草已經堵塞了學校後面的小池塘，魚都活不下去了。

example.en: Pandas rarely breed in captivity, so zoos often work with scientists to help the animals reproduce successfully.
example.zh: 貓熊在人工飼養下很少繁殖，所以動物園常和科學家合作，幫助牠們順利繁衍。

listen.en: These birds return to the island every spring to breed.
listen.zh: 這些鳥每年春天都會回到島上繁殖。

chinese.en: Unfair treatment at work can breed resentment among employees and lower their motivation.
chinese.zh: 職場上的不公平待遇可能讓員工心生怨恨，並降低他們的工作動力。

english.en: My uncle breeds horses on a small farm in the countryside.
english.zh: 我叔叔在鄉下的一座小農場養馬。

speak.en: I'd love a dog, but I'm not sure which breed suits me.
speak.zh: 我很想養狗，但不確定哪個品種適合我。

write.en: The startup belongs to a new breed of companies that value flexibility over long hours.
write.zh: 這家新創公司屬於新一代的企業，重視彈性勝過長時間工作。

example.en: The perfume of jasmine drifted through the open window, filling the whole room with a sweet, gentle fragrance.
example.zh: 茉莉花的香氣從敞開的窗戶飄進來，讓整個房間充滿甜美柔和的芬芳。

listen.en: He bought his mother a bottle of perfume for her birthday.
listen.zh: 他買了一瓶香水送媽媽當生日禮物。

chinese.en: Many passengers find strong perfume unpleasant in crowded trains and buses during rush hour.
chinese.zh: 許多乘客覺得，在尖峰時段擁擠的火車和公車上，濃烈的香水味令人不舒服。

english.en: Please don't wear perfume when you visit the hospital ward.
english.zh: 去醫院病房探病時請不要擦香水。

speak.en: I don't usually wear perfume, except on really special occasions.
speak.zh: 我平常不太擦香水，除非是真的很特別的場合。

write.en: Luxury brands spend huge amounts on advertising to sell perfume to young consumers.
write.zh: 精品品牌花大筆錢打廣告，把香水賣給年輕消費者。

example.en: After the singer's debut album sold millions of copies, record companies competed fiercely to sign her next contract.
example.zh: 這位歌手的首張專輯賣出數百萬張後，各家唱片公司激烈競爭，搶著和她簽下一份合約。

listen.en: My grandmother keeps all our old photos in an album.
listen.zh: 我奶奶把我們所有的舊照片都收在一本相簿裡。

chinese.en: Many musicians now release singles online instead of spending years on a full album.
chinese.zh: 現在許多音樂人在網路上發行單曲，而不是花好幾年製作一整張專輯。

english.en: This is my favorite album, and I listen to it every day.
english.zh: 這是我最喜歡的專輯，我每天都會聽。

speak.en: I still listen to the albums I loved as a teenager.
speak.zh: 我到現在還會聽青少年時期最愛的那些專輯。

write.en: Our class made a digital album to celebrate our teacher's retirement last summer.
write.zh: 我們班去年夏天製作了一本數位相簿，慶祝老師退休。

example.en: Because so few young people want to farm, rural villages struggle to recruit workers during the busy harvest season.
example.zh: 因為願意務農的年輕人太少，鄉下村莊在忙碌的收成季很難招募到工人。

listen.en: The club is recruiting new members for the coming year.
listen.zh: 社團正在為明年招募新成員。

chinese.en: Universities are trying to recruit more international students to make up for falling local enrollment.
chinese.zh: 各大學正努力招收更多國際學生，以彌補本地學生人數的下滑。

english.en: Our charity recruited volunteers to clean the beach last weekend.
english.zh: 我們的慈善機構上週末招募志工去淨灘。

speak.en: I was recruited straight after graduation, which was really lucky.
speak.zh: 我一畢業就被錄用了，真的很幸運。

write.en: Every new recruit spends the first week shadowing an experienced colleague in the office.
write.zh: 每位新進員工第一週都會在辦公室跟著一位資深同事見習。

example.en: Scientists have long been puzzled by why some birds migrate thousands of kilometres while others stay in one place.
example.zh: 為什麼有些鳥會遷徙數千公里，有些卻待在原地，這個問題長久以來一直讓科學家困惑不解。

listen.en: The teacher's question puzzled everyone in the classroom.
listen.zh: 老師的問題讓教室裡的每個人都很困惑。

chinese.en: Why such a popular shop suddenly closed remains a puzzle to local residents.
chinese.zh: 這麼受歡迎的店為什麼會突然關門，對當地居民來說仍是個謎。

english.en: I like doing crossword puzzles on the train to work.
english.zh: 我喜歡在搭火車上班時玩填字遊戲。

speak.en: I'm still puzzled about why prices keep rising so quickly.
speak.zh: 我還是想不通為什麼物價一直漲得這麼快。

write.en: The detective sat by the fire, puzzling over the strange letter on his desk.
write.zh: 偵探坐在爐火旁，苦思著桌上那封奇怪的信。

example.en: The job attracted over three hundred applicants, so the manager could only interview those with relevant experience.
example.zh: 這份工作吸引了超過三百名應徵者，所以經理只能面試具有相關經驗的人。

listen.en: The successful applicant will start work next month.
listen.zh: 錄取的應徵者下個月開始上班。

chinese.en: Applicants for the scholarship should explain how they will contribute to their community.
chinese.zh: 申請這項獎學金的人應說明自己將如何回饋社區。

english.en: Many applicants felt nervous while waiting for their job interview.
english.zh: 許多應徵者在等待求職面試時都很緊張。

speak.en: To be honest, I was the youngest applicant at the interview.
speak.zh: 老實說，我是那場面試中最年輕的應徵者。

write.en: The university shortlisted applicants based on their essays rather than their exam scores alone.
write.zh: 這所大學依據申請人的小論文篩選入圍名單，而不只看考試成績。

example.en: Before smartphones, most people could not conceive of carrying a camera, map and music player in one pocket.
example.zh: 在智慧型手機出現之前，大多數人無法想像能把相機、地圖和音樂播放器都放進一個口袋裡。

listen.en: She conceived a clever plan to save more money.
listen.zh: 她想出了一個能存更多錢的聰明計畫。

chinese.en: The museum was originally conceived as a place where children could learn through play.
chinese.zh: 這座博物館最初的構想，是成為一個讓孩子從遊戲中學習的地方。

english.en: I simply cannot conceive of a life without my family and friends.
english.zh: 我實在無法想像沒有家人和朋友的生活。

speak.en: Honestly, I can't conceive of living anywhere other than my hometown.
speak.zh: 老實說，我無法想像住在家鄉以外的任何地方。

write.en: After years of trying, the couple were overjoyed when they finally conceived their first child.
write.zh: 這對夫妻努力了好幾年，終於懷上第一個孩子時，兩人都欣喜若狂。

example.en: A single ant colony may contain thousands of workers, each performing a specific task to keep the nest running.
example.zh: 一個蟻群裡可能有數千隻工蟻，每一隻都負責特定的工作，讓整個蟻巢正常運作。

listen.en: A large colony of seabirds nests on these cliffs.
listen.zh: 一大群海鳥在這些懸崖上築巢。

chinese.en: The town still has many buildings from the time when it was a colony.
chinese.zh: 這座小鎮至今仍保留許多殖民時期留下的建築。

english.en: Bees live in colonies and work together to make honey.
english.zh: 蜜蜂群居生活，並一起合作釀蜜。

speak.en: I visited an old artists' colony by the sea last summer.
speak.zh: 去年夏天我去參觀了海邊一個古老的藝術家聚落。

write.en: Scientists are studying whether humans could one day build a colony on Mars.
write.zh: 科學家正在研究人類未來是否能在火星上建立殖民地。

example.en: The restaurant was closed after inspectors found poor hygiene in its kitchen, including dirty knives and uncovered food.
example.zh: 稽查人員發現這家餐廳的廚房衛生不佳，包括刀具骯髒、食物沒有加蓋，餐廳因此被勒令停業。

listen.en: Children should learn basic hygiene from a very young age.
listen.zh: 孩子應該從很小的時候就學習基本的衛生習慣。

chinese.en: Regular dental checkups and good oral hygiene can prevent many serious health problems.
chinese.zh: 定期看牙醫檢查並保持良好的口腔衛生，可以預防許多嚴重的健康問題。

english.en: Washing your hands is the simplest way to improve hygiene.
english.zh: 洗手是改善衛生最簡單的方法。

speak.en: Since the pandemic, I've become much more careful about hygiene.
speak.zh: 自從疫情以來，我對衛生變得更加注意。

write.en: The government raised food hygiene standards for all night market stalls this year.
write.zh: 政府今年提高了所有夜市攤販的食品衛生標準。

example.en: After joining the debate club, the once shy student became confident enough to speak in front of large audiences.
example.zh: 加入辯論社後，這位曾經害羞的學生變得很有自信，能在一大群聽眾面前說話。

listen.en: I am confident that our team will win tomorrow.
listen.zh: 我有信心我們的隊伍明天會贏。

chinese.en: The manager is confident the new marketing strategy will attract younger customers.
chinese.zh: 經理確信新的行銷策略能吸引更年輕的顧客。

english.en: Living abroad for a year made me more confident and independent.
english.zh: 在國外生活一年，讓我變得更有自信也更獨立。

speak.en: I'm fairly confident speaking English, but writing is still tricky.
speak.zh: 我對說英文還算有自信，但寫作還是有點難。

write.en: Investors remain confident in the local economy despite the recent rise in interest rates.
write.zh: 儘管最近利率上升，投資人仍對本地經濟保有信心。

example.en: When pressure inside the boiler rises too high, a safety valve opens automatically to release the extra steam.
example.zh: 當鍋爐內的壓力過高時，安全閥會自動打開，釋放多餘的蒸汽。

listen.en: Turn the valve slowly to let the water out.
listen.zh: 慢慢轉動閥門，讓水流出來。

chinese.en: My grandfather had surgery to replace a damaged valve in his heart.
chinese.zh: 我爺爺動了手術，更換心臟裡一個受損的瓣膜。

english.en: Remember to close the gas valve before you leave home.
english.zh: 出門前記得關上瓦斯閥。

speak.en: My bike tyre kept going flat because the valve was loose.
speak.zh: 我的腳踏車輪胎一直沒氣，因為氣門鬆了。

write.en: For many workers, weekend hobbies act as a safety valve for daily stress.
write.zh: 對許多上班族來說，週末的嗜好就像是紓解日常壓力的安全閥。

example.en: Many people believe it is wicked to sell fake medicine to sick patients who are desperate for a cure.
example.zh: 許多人認為，把假藥賣給急著求醫的病人，是非常邪惡的行為。

listen.en: The wicked king locked the princess in a tower.
listen.zh: 邪惡的國王把公主關在一座高塔裡。

chinese.en: My aunt has a wicked sense of humour that makes every family dinner fun.
chinese.zh: 我阿姨有一種調皮的幽默感，讓每次家庭聚餐都很有趣。

english.en: He gave me a wicked grin before playing the trick.
english.zh: 他在惡作劇之前對我露出了壞壞的笑容。

speak.en: That concert last night was absolutely wicked, honestly the best ever.
speak.zh: 昨晚那場演唱會真的超讚，老實說是有史以來最棒的。

write.en: Critics called the company's decision to dump waste in the river truly wicked.
write.zh: 評論家認為，這家公司把廢棄物倒進河裡的決定實在惡劣至極。

example.en: Because online orders doubled during the holidays, the warehouse quickly ran low on inventory and customers faced long delays.
example.zh: 由於假期期間網路訂單倍增，倉庫的庫存很快就不足，顧客也面臨很長的延遲。

listen.en: We need to check the inventory before ordering more paper.
listen.zh: 我們在訂更多紙之前，需要先檢查庫存。

chinese.en: Good inventory management helps small businesses avoid wasting money on unsold goods.
chinese.zh: 良好的庫存管理能幫助小型企業，避免把錢浪費在賣不出去的商品上。

english.en: The museum keeps a detailed inventory of all its paintings.
english.zh: 這間博物館為所有畫作建立了一份詳細的清單。

speak.en: At my part-time job, I helped count the inventory every weekend.
speak.zh: 我打工的時候，每個週末都要幫忙盤點庫存。

write.en: Before moving house, I made an inventory of everything in my kitchen cupboards.
write.zh: 搬家之前，我把廚房櫥櫃裡的所有東西列了一份清單。

example.en: After falling sharply in the morning, share prices rallied in the afternoon as investors regained confidence in the market.
example.zh: 股價在早上大幅下跌後，下午隨著投資人對市場恢復信心而反彈。

listen.en: The whole village rallied around the family after the fire.
listen.zh: 火災過後，全村的人都團結起來幫助那一家人。

chinese.en: The coach rallied his tired players, and they scored twice in the final minutes.
chinese.zh: 教練激勵疲憊的球員重振士氣，他們在最後幾分鐘攻進了兩球。

english.en: The students rallied support for a new library on campus.
english.zh: 學生們為在校園裡蓋一座新圖書館爭取支持。

speak.en: When I was ill, my friends really rallied around me.
speak.zh: 我生病的時候，朋友們真的都團結起來支持我。

write.en: The charity hopes to rally local businesses behind its plan to feed homeless people.
write.zh: 這個慈善團體希望號召在地企業，支持它為遊民提供餐食的計畫。

example.en: Compared with our cramped old flat, the new house felt incredibly spacious, with room for a garden and a study.
example.zh: 和我們以前擁擠的舊公寓相比，新房子感覺非常寬敞，還有空間做花園和書房。

listen.en: The hotel room was bright, clean and spacious.
listen.zh: 這間飯店房間明亮、乾淨又寬敞。

chinese.en: The library's spacious reading area attracts students who need a quiet place to study.
chinese.zh: 圖書館寬敞的閱覽區，吸引了需要安靜讀書空間的學生。

english.en: This car looks small from outside but is surprisingly spacious inside.
english.zh: 這輛車從外面看起來很小，裡面卻出乎意料地寬敞。

speak.en: I'd love to live somewhere more spacious, with a proper kitchen.
speak.zh: 我很想住在更寬敞一點、有像樣廚房的地方。

write.en: The city plans to turn the old factory into a spacious public park for families.
write.zh: 市政府計畫把這座舊工廠改造成一座適合家庭的寬敞公園。

example.en: In her sociology class, students examined how family background shapes a person's chances of getting a good education.
example.zh: 在她的社會學課上，學生探討家庭背景如何影響一個人獲得良好教育的機會。

listen.en: My sister has a degree in sociology from a local university.
listen.zh: 我姊姊擁有本地一所大學的社會學學位。

chinese.en: Sociology helps us understand why people behave differently in groups than they do alone.
chinese.zh: 社會學幫助我們了解，為什麼人在群體中的行為會和獨處時不同。

english.en: My cousin is a sociology professor at a big university.
english.zh: 我表哥是一所大型大學的社會學教授。

speak.en: I took a sociology course once, and it was surprisingly fascinating.
speak.zh: 我修過一次社會學課，結果出乎意料地有趣。

write.en: Research in sociology suggests that social media is changing how teenagers form friendships.
write.zh: 社會學研究指出，社群媒體正在改變青少年建立友誼的方式。

example.en: The café handed out free coupons to new customers, hoping they would return and become regular visitors.
example.zh: 這家咖啡店發送免費優惠券給新顧客，希望他們再度光臨並成為常客。

listen.en: Don't forget to bring the coupon when we go shopping.
listen.zh: 我們去購物時別忘了帶優惠券。

chinese.en: Many shoppers compare prices online and search for coupon codes before buying anything.
chinese.zh: 許多消費者在買任何東西之前，都會先上網比價並搜尋優惠碼。

english.en: This coupon gives you a free drink with any meal.
english.zh: 用這張優惠券點任何餐點，都可以免費獲得一杯飲料。

speak.en: I always check for coupons before ordering food online, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，我在網路上點餐前總是會先找找有沒有優惠券。

write.en: The coupon expired yesterday, so the cashier refused to accept it at checkout.
write.zh: 這張優惠券昨天就過期了，所以收銀員結帳時拒收。

example.en: A passing bus drove through a deep puddle and splashed muddy water all over the people waiting at the stop.
example.zh: 一輛公車開過深水坑，把泥水濺得在站牌等車的人全身都是。

listen.en: She splashed cold water on her face to wake up.
listen.zh: 她往臉上潑冷水，讓自己清醒過來。

chinese.en: The young designer made a big splash with her first collection at fashion week.
chinese.zh: 這位年輕設計師在時裝週以首個系列作品引起轟動。

english.en: I splashed out on a new laptop after getting my bonus.
english.zh: 拿到獎金後，我花了一大筆錢買了一台新筆電。

speak.en: A splash of lemon makes this tea taste much better.
speak.zh: 加一點檸檬會讓這杯茶好喝很多。

write.en: The rooftop garden adds a welcome splash of colour to the grey office district.
write.zh: 這座屋頂花園為灰暗的辦公區增添了一抹令人欣喜的色彩。

example.en: Because the hotel had cancelled our booking, they offered us a partial refund rather than the full amount.
example.zh: 因為飯店取消了我們的訂房，他們只退還部分款項，而不是全額退款。

listen.en: From my seat, I only had a partial view of the stage.
listen.zh: 從我的座位只看得到舞台的一部分。

chinese.en: Planting more trees is only a partial solution to the problem of urban air pollution.
chinese.zh: 多種樹只能部分解決都市空氣污染的問題。

english.en: The student gave a partial answer to the teacher's question.
english.zh: 那位學生只回答了老師問題的一部分。

speak.en: To be honest, I'm quite partial to spicy food.
speak.zh: 老實說，我滿偏愛辣的食物。

write.en: A judge who is partial cannot be trusted to deliver a fair verdict.
write.zh: 偏袒某一方的法官，無法讓人信任他能做出公正的判決。

example.en: The software company released an urgent security patch after hackers discovered a weakness in its system.
example.zh: 駭客發現系統漏洞後，那家軟體公司緊急發布了安全性修補程式。

listen.en: There were icy patches on the road this morning.
listen.zh: 今天早上路面上有好幾處結冰。

chinese.en: After a long argument, the two sisters finally patched things up over dinner.
chinese.zh: 大吵一架之後，兩姊妹終於在晚餐時和好了。

english.en: The workers patched the hole in the roof before the rain.
english.zh: 工人們在下雨前補好了屋頂的破洞。

speak.en: Like most couples, we went through a bad patch last year.
speak.zh: 就像大多數情侶一樣，我們去年也經歷過一段低潮。

write.en: The council turned an unused car park into a small patch of green space for residents.
write.zh: 市議會把一座閒置的停車場改成一小片供居民使用的綠地。

example.en: The report used clear graphic displays, such as bar charts and maps, to make the data easier to understand.
example.zh: 這份報告使用清楚的圖像呈現方式，例如長條圖和地圖，讓資料更容易理解。

listen.en: He told us about his food poisoning in graphic detail.
listen.zh: 他鉅細靡遺地跟我們描述他食物中毒的經過。

chinese.en: Some parents worry that films with graphic scenes can upset young children.
chinese.zh: 有些家長擔心，含有露骨畫面的電影會讓年幼的孩子感到不安。

english.en: I'm taking a graphic design course at the community college.
english.zh: 我正在社區大學上平面設計課程。

speak.en: I've always loved reading graphic novels since I was a kid.
speak.zh: 我從小就一直很喜歡看圖像小說。

write.en: Anti-smoking campaigns often put graphic warnings on cigarette packets to discourage people from buying them.
write.zh: 反菸宣導常在香菸包裝上印怵目驚心的警示圖片，以勸阻民眾購買。

example.en: The lecture was packed with so many facts that most students found it hard to absorb everything at once.
example.zh: 那堂課塞滿了大量資訊，大多數學生覺得很難一次全部吸收。

listen.en: He was so absorbed in his book that he missed his stop.
listen.zh: 他看書看得太入迷，結果坐過站了。

chinese.en: Forests and wetlands absorb large amounts of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
chinese.zh: 森林與濕地會從大氣中吸收大量的二氧化碳。

english.en: Use a paper towel to absorb the water on the table.
english.zh: 用紙巾把桌上的水吸乾。

speak.en: Travelling abroad is a great way to absorb a different culture.
speak.zh: 出國旅行是吸收不同文化的好方法。

write.en: The small company was absorbed into a larger firm after years of financial trouble.
write.zh: 那家小公司在經歷多年財務困難後，被一家較大的企業併購了。

example.en: Although she grew up in a small fishing village, she always aspired to study at a famous university abroad.
example.zh: 雖然她在一個小漁村長大，卻一直渴望到國外的知名大學讀書。

listen.en: He aspires to run his own restaurant some day.
listen.zh: 他立志有朝一日要開一家自己的餐廳。

chinese.en: Aspiring writers often send their stories to dozens of publishers before finding success.
chinese.zh: 有志成為作家的人，往往要投稿給數十家出版社才能成功。

english.en: I aspire to work for an international company after graduation.
english.zh: 我立志畢業後到跨國公司工作。

speak.en: I've never really aspired to be rich, just comfortable.
speak.zh: 我從來沒有真的想變得很有錢，只要過得舒適就好。

write.en: A good education system should encourage every child to aspire to something greater.
write.zh: 好的教育制度應該鼓勵每個孩子追求更遠大的目標。

example.en: In the experiment, babies turned their heads toward the sound, showing that they could respond to an auditory stimulus.
example.zh: 在這項實驗中，嬰兒會把頭轉向聲音的來源，顯示他們能對聽覺刺激做出反應。

listen.en: The cat reacted instantly to the sudden stimulus.
listen.zh: 那隻貓對突如其來的刺激立刻做出反應。

chinese.en: Young children need plenty of stimuli, such as colours, sounds and textures, to develop properly.
chinese.zh: 幼兒需要大量的刺激，例如色彩、聲音和觸感，才能好好發展。

english.en: A good teacher can be a powerful stimulus to learning.
english.zh: 一位好老師能大大激發學生的學習動力。

speak.en: For me, a deadline is the best stimulus to actually get things done.
speak.zh: 對我來說，截止期限是讓我真正把事情做完的最佳動力。

write.en: Hosting the international sporting event provided a major stimulus to the city's tourism industry.
write.zh: 舉辦這場國際運動賽事大大帶動了這座城市的觀光產業。

example.en: Rabbits are an alien species in Australia; they were brought in by settlers and quickly damaged the native plants.
example.zh: 兔子在澳洲是外來物種，由移民引進後很快就破壞了當地的原生植物。

listen.en: My little brother believes that aliens live on other planets.
listen.zh: 我弟弟相信其他星球上住著外星人。

chinese.en: When I first moved to London, the busy lifestyle felt totally alien to me.
chinese.zh: 我剛搬到倫敦時，那種忙碌的生活方式讓我覺得非常陌生。

english.en: Scientists have not found any evidence of alien life yet.
english.zh: 科學家目前還沒有找到任何外星生命的證據。

speak.en: I loved that sci-fi film, especially the scenes with the aliens.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡那部科幻片，尤其是有外星人的那幾場戲。

write.en: Divers must be well trained, as the deep ocean is a dark and alien environment.
write.zh: 潛水員必須受過良好訓練，因為深海是個黑暗又陌生的環境。

example.en: Hosting the Olympic Games brought the city international prestige, although the cost left it with heavy debts for years.
example.zh: 舉辦奧運為這座城市帶來國際聲望，但龐大的花費也讓它背負了多年沉重的債務。

listen.en: She chose the job for its prestige, not the money.
listen.zh: 她選擇這份工作是看重它的聲望，而不是薪水。

chinese.en: Some students choose a university based on its prestige rather than the quality of its courses.
chinese.zh: 有些學生選大學是看學校的名氣，而不是課程的品質。

english.en: The company lost a lot of prestige after the scandal.
english.zh: 那家公司在醜聞爆發後聲望大跌。

speak.en: I think people care too much about the prestige of brands.
speak.zh: 我覺得大家太在意品牌的名氣了。

write.en: Winning the national award gave the small bakery a great deal of prestige among food lovers.
write.zh: 贏得全國性獎項讓這家小麵包店在美食愛好者之間聲名大噪。

example.en: Unlike the other countries in the chart, Japan's population stayed static between the two surveys, neither rising nor falling.
example.zh: 和圖表中其他國家不同，日本的人口在兩次調查之間維持不變，既沒有增加也沒有減少。

listen.en: There was so much static that we couldn't hear the radio.
listen.zh: 雜訊太多，我們根本聽不清楚收音機的內容。

chinese.en: Dry winter air causes static electricity, which can give you a small shock.
chinese.zh: 冬天空氣乾燥容易產生靜電，可能會讓你被輕微電到。

english.en: Students quickly get bored in a static classroom with no group activities.
english.zh: 在沒有小組活動、一成不變的課堂上，學生很快就會感到無聊。

speak.en: My salary has been pretty static, but my rent keeps going up.
speak.zh: 我的薪水一直沒什麼變，房租卻不斷上漲。

write.en: Rather than a static image, the website shows a short video of the city at night.
write.zh: 這個網站放的不是靜態圖片，而是一段城市夜景的短片。

example.en: In Taiwan, residents wait on the street for the garbage truck, which plays music so people know it is coming.
example.zh: 在臺灣，居民會在路邊等垃圾車，垃圾車會播放音樂，讓大家知道它來了。

listen.en: Please don't throw your garbage into the river near the park.
listen.zh: 請不要把垃圾丟進公園附近的河裡。

chinese.en: The city is running out of space to bury its garbage, so recycling has become essential.
chinese.zh: 這座城市快沒有空間掩埋垃圾了，因此資源回收變得不可或缺。

english.en: The garbage can in the kitchen is already full again.
english.zh: 廚房的垃圾桶又已經滿了。

speak.en: Don't listen to him, he's just talking complete garbage again.
speak.zh: 別聽他的，他又在胡說八道了。

write.en: The company was criticized for dumping garbage in the forest instead of paying for proper disposal.
write.zh: 那家公司把垃圾傾倒在森林裡，而不是花錢妥善處理，因而遭到批評。

example.en: A relative clause, such as one beginning with 'who' or 'which', gives extra information about a noun.
example.zh: 關係子句，例如以 who 或 which 開頭的子句，是用來補充說明名詞的。

listen.en: Read every clause carefully before you sign the lease.
listen.zh: 簽租約之前，要仔細閱讀每一項條款。

chinese.en: The new law includes a clause that protects workers who report problems in their company.
chinese.zh: 新法律中有一項條款，保護舉報公司內部問題的員工。

english.en: Our English teacher asked us to underline the main clause.
english.zh: 英文老師要我們在主要子句下面畫線。

speak.en: I almost missed a hidden clause about extra fees in my phone contract.
speak.zh: 我差點沒注意到手機合約裡一條關於額外費用的隱藏條款。

write.en: In IELTS writing, using a mix of short and long clauses makes your essays easier to read.
write.zh: 在雅思寫作中，長短子句交錯使用能讓文章更容易閱讀。

example.en: The ancient Greeks built temples on hilltops, where they could be seen from far away by travellers and sailors.
example.zh: 古希臘人把神殿建在山頂上，讓遠方的旅人和水手都能看見。

listen.en: He rubbed his temples because he had a terrible headache.
listen.zh: 他頭痛得厲害，所以一直揉太陽穴。

chinese.en: Many tourists come to the temple fair to enjoy local snacks and traditional performances.
chinese.zh: 許多遊客來到廟會品嘗在地小吃、欣賞傳統表演。

english.en: The temple near my house is always busy on weekends.
english.zh: 我家附近的廟在週末總是人很多。

speak.en: Visiting temples is one of my favourite things to do when travelling.
speak.zh: 旅行時參觀廟宇是我最喜歡做的事情之一。

write.en: The local government spent millions of dollars restoring the old temple after the earthquake.
write.zh: 地震過後，地方政府花了數百萬元修復這座古廟。

example.en: To find the area of a circle, you multiply the radius by itself and then by pi.
example.zh: 要算出圓的面積，就要把半徑自乘，再乘以圓周率。

listen.en: The new radio tower covers a much larger radius.
listen.zh: 新的無線電塔涵蓋的範圍大得多。

chinese.en: The earthquake was felt by people within a radius of two hundred kilometres.
chinese.zh: 方圓兩百公里內的民眾都感受到了這次地震。

english.en: Use a compass to draw a circle with a radius of five centimetres.
english.zh: 用圓規畫一個半徑五公分的圓。

speak.en: Ideally, I'd like everything I need within a small radius of my home.
speak.zh: 理想上，我希望生活所需的一切都在家附近不遠的範圍內。

write.en: The delivery app only shows restaurants within a three-kilometre radius of your location.
write.zh: 這個外送應用程式只會顯示你所在位置方圓三公里內的餐廳。

example.en: The old pilgrim route across northern Spain now attracts hikers who simply enjoy walking long distances through the countryside.
example.zh: 橫越西班牙北部的古老朝聖路線，如今吸引了許多單純喜歡在鄉間長途健行的人。

listen.en: The pilgrims rested at a small inn along the road.
listen.zh: 朝聖者們在路旁的一間小旅店休息。

chinese.en: For many music fans, visiting the singer's hometown makes them feel like pilgrims.
chinese.zh: 對許多樂迷來說，造訪那位歌手的故鄉讓他們覺得自己像是在朝聖。

english.en: The town's hotels are always full of pilgrims during the festival.
english.zh: 節慶期間，鎮上的旅館總是擠滿了朝聖者。

speak.en: I met a pilgrim from France who had walked for months.
speak.zh: 我遇到一位已經走了好幾個月的法國朝聖者。

write.en: Local shops near the shrine earn most of their income from pilgrims buying food and souvenirs.
write.zh: 聖地附近的商店大部分收入來自購買食物與紀念品的朝聖者。

example.en: The museum's new exhibition offers visitors a glimpse into daily life in a fishing village a century ago.
example.zh: 博物館的新展覽讓參觀者一窺百年前漁村的日常生活。

listen.en: I glimpsed a famous actor at the airport yesterday.
listen.zh: 我昨天在機場瞥見一位知名演員。

chinese.en: Internships give students a valuable glimpse of what working life is really like.
chinese.zh: 實習讓學生有寶貴的機會，一窺職場生活的真實樣貌。

english.en: From the train window, she glimpsed the sea for a moment.
english.zh: 她從火車車窗短暫瞥見了大海。

speak.en: I only got a quick glimpse of him, so I'm not sure.
speak.zh: 我只匆匆瞥了他一眼，所以不太確定。

write.en: The latest report gives a rare glimpse of how much energy large data centres consume.
write.zh: 最新的報告難得讓人一窺大型資料中心究竟消耗多少能源。

example.en: With its white beaches, clear water and colourful fish, the small island is a true paradise for divers.
example.zh: 那座小島有白色沙灘、清澈海水和色彩繽紛的魚群，是潛水者真正的天堂。

listen.en: Our garden becomes a little paradise in the spring.
listen.zh: 春天時，我們的花園就變成了一座小小的樂園。

chinese.en: Rapid tourism development has turned the once quiet island paradise into a crowded resort.
chinese.zh: 快速的觀光開發讓這座曾經寧靜的海島天堂變成擁擠的度假勝地。

english.en: For many children, a big toy store is like paradise.
english.zh: 對很多孩子來說，大型玩具店就像天堂一樣。

speak.en: Honestly, Taipei is a paradise for anyone who loves street food.
speak.zh: 說真的，對熱愛街頭小吃的人來說，臺北就是天堂。

write.en: The riverside parks have made the city a paradise for cyclists and joggers.
write.zh: 河濱公園讓這座城市成為單車族與慢跑族的天堂。

example.en: Although the twins look almost identical, they differ in personality: one is outgoing, while the other is very shy.
example.zh: 這對雙胞胎雖然長得幾乎一模一樣，個性卻不同：一個很外向，另一個非常害羞。

listen.en: Our working hours differ, so we rarely eat together.
listen.zh: 我們的上班時間不同，所以很少一起吃飯。

chinese.en: The results of the latest survey differ sharply from those of previous studies.
chinese.zh: 最新調查的結果與先前的研究大不相同。

english.en: Prices of the same product can differ between online and physical stores.
english.zh: 同樣的商品，在網路商店和實體店面的價格可能不同。

speak.en: We sometimes differ on movies, but we've learned to agree to differ.
speak.zh: 我們對電影的看法有時不同，但已經學會尊重彼此的意見。

write.en: Experts still differ over whether homework actually improves young children's performance at school.
write.zh: 專家對於家庭作業是否真的能提升幼童的學業表現，至今仍看法分歧。

example.en: Ceramic tiles are popular in hot countries because they stay cool and are easy to clean.
example.zh: 磁磚在炎熱的國家很受歡迎，因為它們摸起來涼爽，又容易清理。

listen.en: Be careful, that ceramic vase breaks very easily.
listen.zh: 小心，那個陶瓷花瓶很容易破。

chinese.en: The museum displays ceramics from several dynasties, showing how pottery techniques changed over time.
chinese.zh: 博物館展出多個朝代的陶瓷，呈現製陶技術如何隨時代演變。

english.en: I drink coffee from a ceramic mug instead of a paper cup.
english.zh: 我用陶瓷馬克杯喝咖啡，而不是用紙杯。

speak.en: Last summer I took a ceramics class, and it was really relaxing.
speak.zh: 去年夏天我上了陶藝課，覺得很紓壓。

write.en: Engineers are developing ceramic parts that can survive the extreme heat inside jet engines.
write.zh: 工程師正在研發能承受噴射引擎內部極高溫的陶瓷零件。

example.en: After the factory reported lower sales than expected, the company revised its profit forecast downwards for the year.
example.zh: 工廠回報的銷售額低於預期後，公司下修了今年的獲利預測。

listen.en: She spent the whole weekend revising for her exams.
listen.zh: 她整個週末都在複習準備考試。

chinese.en: The government has revised the traffic rules to make roads safer for cyclists.
chinese.zh: 政府修訂了交通規則，讓道路對自行車騎士來說更安全。

english.en: We had to revise our travel plans because of the typhoon.
english.zh: 因為颱風，我們不得不修改旅遊計畫。

speak.en: I think I'll need to revise my opinion about that restaurant.
speak.zh: 我想我得改變對那家餐廳的看法了。

write.en: The publisher released a revised edition of the dictionary with thousands of new words.
write.zh: 出版社發行了這本字典的修訂版，新增了數千個詞彙。

example.en: A red light on the printer kept blinking, which meant it had run out of paper.
example.zh: 印表機上的紅燈一直閃爍，表示它沒紙了。

listen.en: The baby blinked sleepily and then closed her eyes.
listen.zh: 寶寶睏得眨了眨眼，接著就閉上了眼睛。

chinese.en: The summer holiday seemed to pass in the blink of an eye this year.
chinese.zh: 今年的暑假好像一眨眼就過去了。

english.en: The little girl blinked back tears when her balloon flew away.
english.zh: 氣球飛走時，小女孩強忍著淚水。

speak.en: He paid for the expensive dinner without even blinking.
speak.zh: 他連眼睛都不眨一下，就付了那頓昂貴的晚餐。

write.en: Eye doctors advise office workers to blink regularly to prevent their eyes from becoming dry.
write.zh: 眼科醫師建議上班族要經常眨眼，以免眼睛乾澀。

example.en: As more factories moved overseas, the town's influence steadily diminished, and many young people left to find work elsewhere.
example.zh: 隨著越來越多工廠移往海外，這個小鎮的影響力逐漸衰退，許多年輕人也離開到別處找工作。

listen.en: Her interest in the subject never diminished over the years.
listen.zh: 這些年來，她對這門學科的興趣從未減退。

chinese.en: Nothing could diminish the joy she felt on the day of her graduation.
chinese.zh: 什麼都無法減損她畢業那天的喜悅。

english.en: The new policy did not diminish the importance of teachers.
english.zh: 新政策並沒有降低教師的重要性。

speak.en: Honestly, my enthusiasm for running has diminished a bit lately.
speak.zh: 老實說，我最近對跑步的熱情有點減退了。

write.en: Some economists warn that rising prices will diminish the spending power of ordinary families.
write.zh: 有些經濟學家警告，物價上漲會削弱一般家庭的購買力。

example.en: The provisional results suggest the new drug works, but researchers say final figures will not be available until spring.
example.zh: 初步結果顯示這種新藥有效，但研究人員表示要到春天才會有最終數據。

listen.en: These plans are only provisional and may still change.
listen.zh: 這些計畫只是暫定的，還有可能改變。

chinese.en: The two companies reached a provisional agreement after several weeks of difficult talks.
chinese.zh: 經過幾週艱難的談判，兩家公司達成了初步協議。

english.en: The school published a provisional timetable for the new term.
english.zh: 學校公布了新學期的暫定課表。

speak.en: I've made a provisional booking, but I still need to confirm it.
speak.zh: 我先做了暫時預約，但還需要再確認。

write.en: Students can receive a provisional offer from a university before their exam results come out.
write.zh: 學生在考試成績公布前，就可能收到大學的暫定錄取。

example.en: Scientists working at the frontiers of medicine are developing treatments that would have seemed impossible a generation ago.
example.zh: 在醫學最前沿工作的科學家，正在研發上一代人看來根本不可能的療法。

listen.en: The museum tells the story of life on the frontier.
listen.zh: 這間博物館講述了邊疆地區的生活故事。

chinese.en: Artificial intelligence has opened up a new frontier in the way we learn languages.
chinese.zh: 人工智慧為我們學習語言的方式開拓了新的領域。

english.en: The deep ocean remains a frontier that scientists know little about.
english.zh: 深海仍是科學家所知甚少的未知領域。

speak.en: I think online shopping is the new frontier for small local businesses.
speak.zh: 我覺得網路購物是地方小店的新戰場。

write.en: Customs officers checked every vehicle crossing the frontier into the neighbouring country.
write.zh: 海關人員檢查了每一輛越過邊境進入鄰國的車輛。

example.en: Starting a business entails long hours, financial risk and a great deal of patience, so few people succeed straight away.
example.zh: 創業意味著長時間工作、財務風險和極大的耐心，所以很少人能一開始就成功。

listen.en: Moving abroad entails much more than packing your bags.
listen.zh: 移居國外要做的事遠不只是打包行李。

chinese.en: The renovation project would entail closing the main road for several months.
chinese.zh: 這項整修工程將需要封閉主要道路好幾個月。

english.en: Being a nurse often entails working night shifts and weekends.
english.zh: 當護理師常常需要上夜班和週末班。

speak.en: My job entails a lot of travel, which I really enjoy.
speak.zh: 我的工作需要經常出差，而我很喜歡這一點。

write.en: Higher living standards do not necessarily entail greater happiness for everyone in society.
write.zh: 生活水準提高，不一定代表社會上每個人都會更幸福。

example.en: Thanks to cleaner water, better diets and modern medicine, average life expectancy has increased dramatically in most countries.
example.zh: 由於水更乾淨、飲食更好以及現代醫學，大多數國家的平均壽命都大幅提高。

listen.en: There was a sense of expectancy as the curtain rose.
listen.zh: 布幕升起時，現場瀰漫著一股期待的氣氛。

chinese.en: Women generally have a longer life expectancy than men in almost every country.
chinese.zh: 幾乎在每個國家，女性的平均壽命通常都比男性長。

english.en: Doctors say smoking can greatly reduce a person's life expectancy.
english.zh: 醫生說吸菸會大幅縮短一個人的預期壽命。

speak.en: I think life expectancy is going up because people eat better now.
speak.zh: 我覺得平均壽命在提高，是因為現在大家吃得比較好。

write.en: The life expectancy of a pet dog depends largely on its size and breed.
write.zh: 寵物狗的預期壽命很大程度取決於牠的體型和品種。

example.en: Most of the offences in the area are petty crimes, such as shoplifting and minor vandalism, rather than anything more serious.
example.zh: 這一帶的犯罪大多是順手牽羊、輕微破壞公物之類的小案件，而不是更嚴重的罪行。

listen.en: It was petty of him to complain about the bill.
listen.zh: 他為了帳單抱怨，實在太小心眼了。

chinese.en: The team wasted the whole meeting on petty disagreements instead of making decisions.
chinese.zh: 團隊整場會議都浪費在雞毛蒜皮的爭執上，而沒有做出任何決定。

english.en: Don't let petty jealousy ruin a friendship that means so much.
english.zh: 別讓小小的嫉妒毀了這麼珍貴的友誼。

speak.en: Honestly, I think office politics can get really petty sometimes.
speak.zh: 說真的，我覺得辦公室政治有時候真的很斤斤計較。

write.en: The manager keeps a small amount of petty cash for buying office supplies.
write.zh: 經理保留了一小筆零用金，用來購買辦公用品。

example.en: Every year, residents gather by the river to commemorate the flood that destroyed much of the old town.
example.zh: 每年居民都會聚集在河邊，紀念那場摧毀了舊城大半區域的洪水。

listen.en: The concert was held to commemorate the school's anniversary.
listen.zh: 這場音樂會是為了紀念校慶而舉辦的。

chinese.en: A special stamp was issued to commemorate the opening of the new railway line.
chinese.zh: 為了紀念新鐵路線通車，特別發行了一款郵票。

english.en: We planted a tree in the garden to commemorate our grandfather.
english.zh: 我們在花園種了一棵樹來紀念爺爺。

speak.en: In my hometown, a small museum commemorates the people who built the harbour.
speak.zh: 在我的家鄉，有一間小博物館紀念當年興建港口的人們。

write.en: The company commemorated its fiftieth anniversary by donating books to rural schools.
write.zh: 這家公司捐書給偏鄉學校，以紀念創立五十週年。

example.en: The teacher calmly shepherded the frightened children out of the building and onto the playground while the fire alarm rang.
example.zh: 火災警報響起時，老師冷靜地帶著受驚的孩子們離開大樓，到操場集合。

listen.en: A tour guide shepherded us through the crowded market.
listen.zh: 導遊帶著我們穿過擁擠的市場。

chinese.en: In many mountain villages, young shepherds spend the whole summer with their flocks.
chinese.zh: 在許多山村裡，年輕的牧羊人整個夏天都和羊群待在一起。

english.en: Two staff members shepherded the guests into the main hall.
english.zh: 兩名工作人員引導賓客進入大廳。

speak.en: My neighbour has a German shepherd that barks at everyone.
speak.zh: 我鄰居養了一隻德國牧羊犬，看到誰都會叫。

write.en: An experienced mentor can shepherd new employees through their difficult first months at work.
write.zh: 有經驗的導師能帶領新進員工度過剛上班時辛苦的頭幾個月。

example.en: In her quest to understand why bees were disappearing, the biologist spent years observing hives across the countryside.
example.zh: 為了弄清楚蜜蜂為何消失，這位生物學家花了好幾年觀察鄉間各地的蜂巢。

listen.en: Many people move to cities in quest of better jobs.
