listen.zh: 許多人為了尋找更好的工作而搬到城市。

chinese.en: The company's quest for profit should never come at the expense of safety.
chinese.zh: 公司追求利潤，絕不應以犧牲安全為代價。

english.en: His quest for perfection often makes him stay at the office late.
english.zh: 他對完美的追求常讓他在辦公室待到很晚。

speak.en: My trip to Japan was basically a quest for the perfect bowl of ramen.
speak.zh: 我的日本之旅基本上就是在尋找一碗完美的拉麵。

write.en: The explorers embarked on a dangerous quest to reach the source of the river.
write.zh: 探險家們踏上了危險的旅程，想找到這條河的源頭。

example.en: When I tried to open the report, a message said the file was corrupted, so I had to rewrite everything from memory.
example.zh: 我想打開報告時，系統顯示檔案已損毀，所以我只好憑記憶全部重寫。

listen.en: A virus corrupted all the photos on my laptop.
listen.zh: 病毒把我筆電裡的照片全都毀了。

chinese.en: Some people believe that too much power can corrupt even the most honest leaders.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為，過大的權力連最正直的領導者都可能腐化。

english.en: The new law aims to punish corrupt businesses more severely.
english.zh: 新法旨在更嚴厲地懲處腐敗的企業。

speak.en: I think it's really hard to fix a system that's already corrupt.
speak.zh: 我覺得一個已經腐敗的體制真的很難改善。

write.en: Some parents worry that certain video games might corrupt the values of young players.
write.zh: 有些家長擔心某些電玩可能會敗壞年輕玩家的價值觀。

example.en: Minor cases such as unpaid parking fines are usually heard by a magistrate rather than a judge and jury.
example.zh: 像未繳停車罰款這類輕微案件，通常由治安法官審理，而不是由法官和陪審團審理。

listen.en: The magistrate listened carefully before making her decision.
listen.zh: 這位法官在做出裁決前仔細聆聽。

chinese.en: The magistrate ordered the company to pay compensation to the injured worker.
chinese.zh: 法官命令這家公司賠償受傷的員工。

english.en: The magistrate gave the young man a warning instead of a fine.
english.zh: 法官只給了那名年輕人警告，而沒有罰款。

speak.en: My aunt worked as a magistrate, so she has some fascinating stories.
speak.zh: 我阿姨以前當過治安法官，所以她有很多精彩的故事。

write.en: Volunteer magistrates in Britain are ordinary citizens who receive basic legal training.
write.zh: 英國的志願治安法官是接受過基本法律訓練的一般民眾。

example.en: As temperatures rise, the Arctic is warming faster than almost anywhere else on Earth, causing ice sheets to shrink each summer.
example.zh: 隨著氣溫上升，北極暖化的速度幾乎比地球上任何地方都快，使冰層每年夏天都在縮小。

listen.en: We saw the northern lights on our trip to the Arctic.
listen.zh: 我們到北極旅行時看到了北極光。

chinese.en: Scientists are studying how melting Arctic ice affects weather patterns around the world.
chinese.zh: 科學家正在研究北極冰層融化如何影響全球的天氣型態。

english.en: Many Arctic animals have thick fur to survive the cold.
english.zh: 許多北極動物有厚厚的毛皮，才能在嚴寒中生存。

speak.en: Wow, it's absolutely arctic outside today, so wear a warm coat.
speak.zh: 哇，今天外面冷得要命，記得穿件保暖的外套。

write.en: Shipping companies hope the melting ice will open new Arctic routes between Europe and Asia.
write.zh: 航運公司希望冰層融化後，能開闢歐亞之間新的北極航線。

example.en: Coral reefs are extremely fragile ecosystems; even a small rise in water temperature can cause them to lose their colour and die.
example.zh: 珊瑚礁是極為脆弱的生態系統，即使水溫只是稍微上升，也可能使它們白化死亡。

listen.en: After the long illness, her health remained fragile for months.
listen.zh: 那場大病之後，她的身體好幾個月都很虛弱。

chinese.en: The country's economy is still fragile after several years of high unemployment.
chinese.zh: 經過好幾年的高失業率，這個國家的經濟仍然很脆弱。

english.en: Old books are fragile, so the library does not lend them out.
english.zh: 舊書很脆弱，所以圖書館不外借。

speak.en: I always feel a bit fragile after a really stressful week.
speak.zh: 每次經過壓力很大的一週，我都會覺得自己有點脆弱。

write.en: Too many tourists can damage the fragile balance between local communities and nature.
write.zh: 過多的觀光客可能破壞當地社區與自然之間脆弱的平衡。

example.en: For many office workers, smartphones are both a blessing and a curse, because they make it impossible to stop thinking about work.
example.zh: 對許多上班族來說，智慧型手機有利也有弊，因為它讓人根本沒辦法不去想工作。

listen.en: He cursed loudly when he missed the last bus.
listen.zh: 他錯過末班公車時大聲咒罵。

chinese.en: The region has been cursed with droughts that destroy crops almost every summer.
chinese.zh: 這個地區飽受乾旱之苦，幾乎每年夏天農作物都會遭殃。

english.en: The coach told the players not to curse during matches.
english.zh: 教練告訴球員比賽時不要罵髒話。

speak.en: For me, traffic jams are the real curse of living in a big city.
speak.zh: 對我來說，塞車才是住在大城市真正的痛苦。

write.en: In the fairy tale, a wicked witch puts a curse on the young princess.
write.zh: 在童話故事裡，邪惡的女巫對年幼的公主下了詛咒。

example.en: The university introduced smaller seminar groups to enhance the quality of teaching, and student satisfaction rose noticeably the following year.
example.zh: 這所大學改採小班研討課來提升教學品質，隔年學生的滿意度明顯上升。

listen.en: Learning another language can enhance your career prospects.
listen.zh: 學習另一種語言能提升你的職涯發展前景。

chinese.en: Winning the international award has enhanced the company's reputation among customers worldwide.
chinese.zh: 獲得這個國際獎項提升了這家公司在全球顧客心中的聲譽。

english.en: Studies show that regular exercise can enhance memory and concentration.
english.zh: 研究顯示規律運動能增強記憶力和專注力。

speak.en: I use a photo app to enhance the colours in my pictures.
speak.zh: 我會用修圖 App 讓照片的顏色更鮮明。

write.en: Many airports have enhanced their security checks to protect travellers more effectively.
write.zh: 許多機場加強了安全檢查，以更有效地保護旅客。

example.en: Experts cautioned against reading too much into the survey, pointing out that only a small group of people had taken part.
example.zh: 專家提醒不要過度解讀這份調查，並指出只有一小群人參與。

listen.en: My doctor cautioned me against eating too much sugar.
listen.zh: 醫生告誡我不要吃太多糖。

chinese.en: Online reviews should be treated with caution because some of them are fake.
chinese.zh: 網路評論應該謹慎看待，因為其中有些是假的。

english.en: The teacher cautioned the students not to copy from the internet.
english.zh: 老師告誡學生不要抄襲網路上的內容。

speak.en: I'd rather err on the side of caution and take an umbrella.
speak.zh: 我寧可小心一點，還是帶把傘好了。

write.en: Many investors are showing greater caution as the global economy slows down.
write.zh: 隨著全球經濟放緩，許多投資人變得更加謹慎。

example.en: When water is heated, its molecules move faster and spread further apart, eventually escaping into the air as steam.
example.zh: 水被加熱時，分子移動得更快、彼此距離拉大，最後以水蒸氣的形式散到空氣中。

listen.en: Everything around us is made of tiny molecules.
listen.zh: 我們周遭的一切都是由微小的分子構成的。

chinese.en: Researchers have designed a new molecule that could help treat certain types of cancer.
chinese.zh: 研究人員設計出一種新分子，可能有助於治療某些類型的癌症。

english.en: Our chemistry teacher built a model of a molecule with plastic balls.
english.zh: 我們的化學老師用塑膠球做了一個分子模型。

speak.en: I never really understood molecules until I watched a few science videos online.
speak.zh: 直到在網路上看了幾支科學影片，我才真正搞懂分子是什麼。

write.en: Plastic contains long chains of molecules that take centuries to break down in nature.
write.zh: 塑膠含有長鏈分子，在自然界中需要好幾百年才能分解。

example.en: The village sits on top of steep cliffs, and from the cliff path walkers can watch seabirds diving into the waves.
example.zh: 這座村莊位於陡峭的懸崖頂上，健行者可以從崖邊步道看到海鳥俯衝入浪。

listen.en: We had a picnic on the grass above the cliffs.
listen.zh: 我們在懸崖上方的草地上野餐。

chinese.en: Sales of the old model fell off a cliff after the new phone was released.
chinese.zh: 新手機上市後，舊機型的銷量便一落千丈。

english.en: The hotel was built on a cliff overlooking the sea.
english.zh: 那間飯店蓋在一座俯瞰大海的懸崖上。

speak.en: Climbing that cliff was the scariest thing I've ever done.
speak.zh: 攀爬那座懸崖是我做過最可怕的事。

write.en: Rising sea levels are slowly eroding the cliffs along this part of the coast.
write.zh: 海平面上升正慢慢侵蝕這段海岸的懸崖。

example.en: As autumn arrived, dry leaves fluttered down from the trees and covered the path in shades of red and gold.
example.zh: 秋天來臨時，乾枯的葉子從樹上飄落，把小徑鋪成一片紅色與金色。

listen.en: A small butterfly fluttered past the open window.
listen.zh: 一隻小蝴蝶從敞開的窗前翩翩飛過。

chinese.en: There was a flutter of excitement in the classroom when the results were announced.
chinese.zh: 成績公布時，教室裡掀起一陣興奮。

english.en: My heart fluttered when I saw my name on the list.
english.zh: 看到名單上有我的名字時，我的心怦怦跳。

speak.en: I still get a little flutter of nerves before every presentation.
speak.zh: 每次上台報告前，我還是會有點緊張。

write.en: The baby bird fluttered its wings but was not yet strong enough to fly.
write.zh: 雛鳥拍了拍翅膀，但還沒有強壯到能飛起來。

example.en: After the big holiday dinner, everyone lay on the sofa with full bellies, too tired to clear the table.
example.zh: 吃完豐盛的節日大餐後，大家挺著飽飽的肚子躺在沙發上，累到不想收拾餐桌。

listen.en: The baby laughed when her father tickled her belly.
listen.zh: 爸爸搔她肚子癢時，小寶寶咯咯笑了起來。

chinese.en: Children who go to school on an empty belly often find it hard to concentrate.
chinese.zh: 空著肚子上學的孩子往往很難專心。

english.en: Doctors say too much fat around the belly is bad for your heart.
english.zh: 醫生說腹部脂肪過多對心臟不好。

speak.en: That comedy show gave me a real belly laugh last night.
speak.zh: 昨晚那場喜劇表演讓我笑到肚子痛。

write.en: Workers who sit at desks all day often complain about a growing belly.
write.zh: 整天坐辦公桌的上班族常抱怨肚子越來越大。

example.en: Although the small bakery could not rival the supermarket on price, its fresh bread attracted loyal customers every morning.
example.zh: 雖然這家小麵包店在價格上比不過超市，但它的新鮮麵包每天早上都吸引忠實顧客上門。

listen.en: Our team finally beat its biggest rival last weekend.
listen.zh: 我們的隊伍上週末終於擊敗了最大的對手。

chinese.en: Students from rival schools worked together on a science project to clean up the river.
chinese.zh: 來自互相競爭學校的學生一起合作，進行一項清理河川的科學專題。

english.en: The quality of this local coffee can rival that of famous brands.
english.zh: 這款本地咖啡的品質足以媲美知名品牌。

speak.en: My brother and I were friendly rivals when we played tennis.
speak.zh: 我和哥哥打網球時是友好的競爭對手。

write.en: Online learning platforms now rival traditional universities in their ability to attract adult students.
write.zh: 線上學習平台如今在吸引成人學生的能力上，已足以和傳統大學匹敵。

example.en: The council decided that the advantages of the new bus lane outweighed the complaints from local drivers about traffic.
example.zh: 市議會認為新公車專用道帶來的好處，比當地駕駛對交通的抱怨更重要。

listen.en: The risks of this plan clearly outweigh the rewards.
listen.zh: 這個計畫的風險顯然大於回報。

chinese.en: Some students feel that the stress of exams outweighs what they actually learn from them.
chinese.zh: 有些學生覺得考試帶來的壓力，比他們真正從中學到的東西還多。

english.en: In my opinion, the advantages of working from home outweigh the disadvantages.
english.zh: 我認為在家工作的優點多於缺點。

speak.en: Honestly, I think the convenience of city life outweighs the noise.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得城市生活的便利勝過它的吵雜。

write.en: The company kept the old factory open because its value to the community outweighed the financial losses.
write.zh: 公司讓舊工廠繼續營運，因為它對社區的價值比財務損失更重要。

example.en: After weeks of stressful deadlines, the design team spent a quiet weekend at a mountain retreat with no internet access.
example.zh: 經過好幾週壓力很大的趕工後，設計團隊在一處沒有網路的山中靜修地度過了一個安靜的週末。

listen.en: The glaciers are retreating faster than scientists expected.
listen.zh: 冰河退縮的速度比科學家預期的更快。

chinese.en: When the discussion became heated, he retreated into silence and stared at his notes.
chinese.zh: 討論變得激烈時，他便沉默不語，只盯著自己的筆記。

english.en: My grandparents' farmhouse is a peaceful retreat from the busy city.
english.zh: 我祖父母的農舍是遠離繁忙城市的寧靜去處。

speak.en: Whenever I feel stressed, I retreat to my room and read.
speak.zh: 每當我感到有壓力時，我就會躲回房間看書。

write.en: Facing strong public criticism, the company made a quick retreat from its plan to raise prices.
write.zh: 面對強烈的輿論批評，公司很快就放棄了漲價的計畫。

example.en: Every autumn, families visit the orchard to pick ripe pears straight from the trees and buy homemade jam.
example.zh: 每年秋天，許多家庭都會到這座果園直接從樹上摘成熟的梨子，順便買些自製果醬。

listen.en: The orchard was full of blossoms in early spring.
listen.zh: 初春時，果園裡開滿了花。

chinese.en: Many old orchards near the city have been replaced by housing developments over the past decade.
chinese.zh: 過去十年來，城市附近許多老果園都已被住宅開發案取代。

english.en: Our class went on a field trip to a local orchard.
english.zh: 我們班到當地的一座果園進行戶外教學。

speak.en: I'd love to live next to an orchard and grow my own fruit.
speak.zh: 我很想住在果園旁邊，自己種水果。

write.en: Bees play an essential role in orchards because they pollinate the flowers that later become fruit.
write.zh: 蜜蜂在果園中扮演重要角色，因為牠們會為日後結成果實的花朵授粉。

example.en: Before the fire drill began, all the students were told to leave their bags and assemble quietly on the sports field.
example.zh: 消防演練開始前，所有學生都被告知放下書包，安靜地到運動場集合。

listen.en: The cars are assembled in a factory near the coast.
listen.zh: 這些汽車是在海岸附近的一座工廠組裝的。

chinese.en: The manager assembled a small team of experienced engineers to solve the problem quickly.
chinese.zh: 經理召集了一支由資深工程師組成的小團隊，以便盡快解決這個問題。

english.en: A large crowd assembled outside the stadium before the concert.
english.zh: 演唱會開始前，一大群人聚集在體育館外。

speak.en: I'm terrible at assembling furniture, so I always ask my friends for help.
speak.zh: 我很不會組裝家具，所以總是找朋友幫忙。

write.en: Researchers spent months assembling data from hospitals across the country to study sleep patterns.
write.zh: 研究人員花了好幾個月，匯集全國各地醫院的資料來研究睡眠模式。

example.en: The doctor explained that the pain in his back was muscular, not a bone problem, and recommended gentle stretching.
example.zh: 醫生說明他背痛是肌肉引起的，不是骨頭的問題，並建議他做些溫和的伸展。

listen.en: He became more muscular after joining a local gym.
listen.zh: 他加入附近的健身房後，變得更有肌肉了。

chinese.en: Advertisements often show muscular men, which can give teenage boys unrealistic expectations about their bodies.
chinese.zh: 廣告常出現肌肉發達的男性，可能讓青少年男孩對自己的身材產生不切實際的期待。

english.en: Regular strength training helps older adults maintain their muscular strength.
english.zh: 規律的肌力訓練有助於年長者維持肌肉力量。

speak.en: I'm not very muscular, but I'm quite fit because I cycle a lot.
speak.zh: 我不算很有肌肉，但因為常騎腳踏車，體能還不錯。

write.en: The farm used muscular horses to pull heavy carts before tractors became common.
write.zh: 在曳引機普及之前，這座農場都靠強壯的馬匹來拉沉重的貨車。

example.en: Despite limited funding, the small clinic strove to provide high-quality care for elderly patients in remote villages.
example.zh: 儘管經費有限，這間小診所仍盡力為偏遠村落的年長病患提供高品質的照護。

listen.en: She always strives for excellence in everything she does.
listen.zh: 她做每件事都力求卓越。

chinese.en: Many young professionals strive to find a balance between their careers and personal lives.
chinese.zh: 許多年輕上班族努力在事業和個人生活之間取得平衡。

english.en: The government should strive to reduce air pollution in big cities.
english.zh: 政府應該努力減少大城市的空氣污染。

speak.en: I'm striving to improve my English so I can study abroad.
speak.zh: 我正在努力提升英文，好讓自己能出國唸書。

write.en: Having striven for years to become a chef, he finally opened his own restaurant.
write.zh: 他為了成為廚師努力了好多年，終於開了自己的餐廳。

example.en: The bus was so crowded that there was barely room to stand, and many passengers chose to walk instead.
example.zh: 公車擠到幾乎沒有站的空間，許多乘客乾脆改用走的。

listen.en: The old sign was barely visible in the fog.
listen.zh: 那塊舊招牌在霧中幾乎看不見。

chinese.en: Many low-income families earn barely enough to cover rent and basic living costs.
chinese.zh: 許多低收入家庭的收入僅勉強夠付房租和基本生活開銷。

english.en: She had barely sat down when her phone started ringing.
english.zh: 她才剛坐下，手機就響了。

speak.en: To be honest, I barely use social media these days.
speak.zh: 老實說，我最近幾乎不用社群媒體。

write.en: The team barely passed the safety inspection, so the manager ordered extra training for everyone.
write.zh: 這個團隊勉強通過安全檢查，因此主管要求所有人加強訓練。

example.en: The report includes both numerical data, such as sales figures, and comments from customers about their experiences.
example.zh: 這份報告同時包含銷售數字等數據資料，以及顧客對自身使用經驗的意見。

listen.en: Good numerical skills are useful in many jobs.
listen.zh: 良好的數理能力在許多工作中都很有用。

chinese.en: The job application requires candidates to complete a short numerical reasoning test online.
chinese.zh: 這份工作的應徵流程要求應徵者在線上完成一份簡短的數理推理測驗。

english.en: The chart gives a numerical summary of energy use in each country.
english.zh: 這張圖表以數字概述了各國的能源使用情況。

speak.en: I've never been very good at numerical tasks like calculating budgets.
speak.zh: 我一向不太擅長像計算預算這類跟數字有關的事。

write.en: Teachers should give students written feedback rather than just a numerical grade on their essays.
write.zh: 老師應該給學生書面回饋，而不只是在作文上打個分數。

example.en: During the colonial period, the port grew rapidly because ships carried tea and sugar from the island to Europe.
example.zh: 在殖民時期，船隻將茶葉和糖從島上運往歐洲，使這座港口迅速發展。

listen.en: We toured a beautiful colonial mansion near the harbour.
listen.zh: 我們參觀了港口附近一棟漂亮的殖民時期宅邸。

chinese.en: Many former colonies still use legal systems introduced under colonial rule centuries ago.
chinese.zh: 許多前殖民地至今仍沿用數百年前殖民統治時期引進的法律制度。

english.en: My grandfather told me stories about life in colonial times.
english.zh: 我祖父跟我講了許多殖民時代的生活故事。

speak.en: I find it fascinating how colonial history shaped the food we eat today.
speak.zh: 殖民歷史如何影響我們現在的飲食，我覺得很有意思。

write.en: Some economists argue that colonial trade patterns still affect which goods poorer countries export.
write.zh: 有些經濟學家認為，殖民時期的貿易模式至今仍影響較貧窮國家出口哪些商品。

example.en: The teacher simplified the scientific article by replacing technical terms with everyday words so that younger students could follow it.
example.zh: 老師把專業術語換成日常用語來簡化這篇科學文章，讓年紀較小的學生也看得懂。

listen.en: Let me try to simplify the question for you.
listen.zh: 我試著把這個問題講得簡單一點。

chinese.en: The government plans to simplify the tax system so that small businesses save time.
chinese.zh: 政府計畫簡化稅制，讓小型企業能節省時間。

english.en: Moving to a smaller apartment helped us simplify our daily lives.
english.zh: 搬到比較小的公寓，讓我們的日常生活變得更簡單。

speak.en: I think it's best to simplify things when you're explaining ideas to kids.
speak.zh: 我覺得跟小孩解釋事情時，最好把內容簡化。

write.en: By simplifying its menu, the restaurant cut food waste and served customers faster.
write.zh: 這家餐廳精簡菜單後，減少了食物浪費，出餐也更快。

example.en: Because so many people applied for marathon places, the organisers held a ballot to decide fairly who could take part.
example.zh: 由於報名馬拉松的人太多，主辦單位以抽籤方式公平決定誰能參賽。

listen.en: Please fold your ballot before placing it in the box.
listen.zh: 請先把選票摺好，再投入票箱。

chinese.en: Voters in the town can now cast their ballots at the library or community centre.
chinese.zh: 鎮上的選民現在可以到圖書館或社區活動中心投票。

english.en: The workers will hold a ballot on whether to accept the pay offer.
english.zh: 員工將舉行投票，決定是否接受這項加薪方案。

speak.en: In our class, we used a paper ballot to choose the trip destination.
speak.zh: 我們班用紙本投票來決定旅行的目的地。

write.en: Several ballots were declared invalid because voters had marked more than one box.
write.zh: 有幾張選票因為選民圈選了不只一格，而被判定無效。

example.en: The dealer explained that the chair was a valuable antique, made by hand more than two centuries ago.
example.zh: 古董商解釋說，這張椅子是兩百多年前手工製作的珍貴古董。

listen.en: We found an antique clock at the weekend market.
listen.zh: 我們在週末市集找到一座古董時鐘。

chinese.en: Some young people now prefer antique furniture because it is well made and environmentally friendly.
chinese.zh: 現在有些年輕人偏好古董家具，因為做工精良又環保。

english.en: This small antique shop sells old maps, coins and furniture.
english.zh: 這家小古董店販售舊地圖、錢幣和家具。

speak.en: I'm not really into antiques, but I love looking at them in museums.
speak.zh: 我對古董沒什麼興趣，但很喜歡在博物館裡欣賞它們。

write.en: The insurance company asked an expert to estimate the value of the family's antiques.
write.zh: 保險公司請專家估算這家人收藏的古董價值。

example.en: Before the shirts were packed, workers checked each one carefully and removed any with small defects such as loose buttons.
example.zh: 襯衫裝箱前，工人會逐件仔細檢查，挑出鈕扣鬆脫等有小瑕疵的衣服。

listen.en: The engineers quickly found the defect in the software.
listen.zh: 工程師很快就找到了軟體中的缺陷。

chinese.en: Smoking during pregnancy increases the risk of birth defects and other health problems.
chinese.zh: 懷孕期間吸菸會提高新生兒先天缺陷及其他健康問題的風險。

english.en: If the product has a defect, you can return it within a month.
english.zh: 如果產品有瑕疵，你可以在一個月內退貨。

speak.en: My laptop had a screen defect, so the shop replaced it for free.
speak.zh: 我的筆電螢幕有瑕疵，所以店家免費幫我換了一台。

write.en: One major defect of the new policy is that it ignores the needs of rural residents.
write.zh: 這項新政策的一大缺陷，是忽略了鄉村居民的需求。

example.en: Ash from the ancient volcano made the valley so fertile that farmers could harvest crops several times a year.
example.zh: 古老火山噴出的火山灰讓這座山谷十分肥沃，農民一年可以收成好幾次。

listen.en: The river carries fertile mud down to the plains.
listen.zh: 河水把肥沃的泥土帶到下游的平原。

chinese.en: Doctors say women are generally most fertile in their twenties, though this varies widely.
chinese.zh: 醫生表示，女性一般在二十多歲時生育力最好，但個人差異很大。

english.en: My little sister has a fertile imagination and loves writing stories.
english.zh: 我妹妹想像力豐富，很喜歡寫故事。

speak.en: Honestly, I think university is fertile ground for new friendships.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得大學是結交新朋友的好地方。

write.en: Overuse of chemicals can turn fertile farmland into dry, useless land within a few decades.
write.zh: 過度使用化學藥劑，可能在幾十年內讓肥沃的農地變成乾旱、無法耕作的土地。

example.en: The restaurant is famous for its generous portions, so most customers take home what they cannot finish.
example.zh: 這家餐廳以份量大方出名，所以大多數客人都會把吃不完的打包回家。

listen.en: I only read a small portion of the book.
listen.zh: 我只讀了這本書的一小部分。

chinese.en: Reducing portion sizes is a simple way to eat less without feeling hungry.
chinese.zh: 減少每餐的份量，是少吃又不會覺得餓的簡單方法。

english.en: Students spend a significant portion of their time on social media.
english.zh: 學生把相當多的時間花在社群媒體上。

speak.en: I usually cook a big portion of curry and freeze the rest.
speak.zh: 我通常會煮一大份咖哩，再把剩下的冷凍起來。

write.en: Each employee received a portion of the company's annual profits as a year-end bonus.
write.zh: 每位員工都分到公司年度獲利的一部分，作為年終獎金。

example.en: The old cemetery on the hill has become a quiet park where visitors can walk among historic trees and stone monuments.
example.zh: 山丘上的舊墓地已成為一座寧靜的公園，遊客可以漫步在老樹與石碑之間。

listen.en: The cemetery gates are always closed after dark.
listen.zh: 墓園的大門天黑後一律關閉。

chinese.en: Volunteers spent the weekend cleaning the cemetery and repairing several broken headstones.
chinese.zh: 志工們花了整個週末清理墓園，並修復了幾塊破損的墓碑。

english.en: Many tourists visit the famous cemetery to see the graves of artists.
english.zh: 許多觀光客造訪這座著名的墓園，去看藝術家的墳墓。

speak.en: Honestly, I find walking through a cemetery quite peaceful, not scary.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得走在墓園裡很平靜，一點也不可怕。

write.en: Some local governments now encourage tree burials instead of building new cemeteries to save land.
write.zh: 一些地方政府現在鼓勵樹葬，而不是興建新的公墓，以節省土地。

example.en: After months of failed experiments, the young researcher finally had a breakthrough when she changed the temperature of the solution.
example.zh: 經過好幾個月失敗的實驗，這位年輕研究員改變溶液的溫度後，終於有了突破。

listen.en: The long talks ended without any real breakthrough.
listen.zh: 冗長的談判結束了，卻沒有任何實質突破。

chinese.en: Learning to ride a bike without help was a real breakthrough for my nervous son.
chinese.zh: 能自己騎腳踏車，對我那容易緊張的兒子來說是一大突破。

english.en: The invention of the internet was a breakthrough in global communication.
english.zh: 網際網路的發明是全球通訊的一大突破。

speak.en: I made a real breakthrough in English when I stopped using subtitles.
speak.zh: 我不再看字幕之後，英文才真正有了突破。

write.en: The startup's breakthrough battery design could make electric scooters far cheaper to produce.
write.zh: 這家新創公司突破性的電池設計，可能讓電動機車的生產成本大幅降低。

example.en: In the past, women were often kept out of the public sphere, but today they play leading roles in business and science.
example.zh: 過去女性常被排除在公共領域之外，但如今她們在商業和科學界都扮演重要角色。

listen.en: The lamp is shaped like a glowing glass sphere.
listen.zh: 這盞燈的造型像一顆發光的玻璃球。

chinese.en: Artificial intelligence is now changing almost every sphere of daily life, from shopping to healthcare.
chinese.zh: 人工智慧如今正在改變日常生活的幾乎每個層面，從購物到醫療都是如此。

english.en: Children learn to draw a sphere by adding light and shadow.
english.zh: 孩子們透過加上光影來學習畫出球體。

speak.en: I try to keep my work and family spheres completely separate.
speak.zh: 我盡量把工作和家庭這兩個領域完全分開。

write.en: Strong economies often extend their sphere of influence by investing in neighbouring countries.
write.zh: 經濟強國常藉由投資鄰國來擴大自己的影響範圍。

example.en: Scientists warn that insect populations are falling sharply because of pesticides, habitat loss and rising temperatures around the world.
example.zh: 科學家警告，由於農藥、棲地流失和全球氣溫上升，昆蟲數量正急遽減少。

listen.en: Don't forget to bring insect repellent on the hike.
listen.zh: 去健行時別忘了帶防蚊液。

chinese.en: In some countries, insects are farmed as a cheap and sustainable source of protein.
chinese.zh: 在一些國家，昆蟲被當作便宜又永續的蛋白質來源來養殖。

english.en: My little brother collects insects and keeps them in glass jars.
english.zh: 我弟弟收集昆蟲，並把牠們養在玻璃罐裡。

speak.en: I'm honestly scared of insects, especially the big flying ones.
speak.zh: 說真的，我很怕昆蟲，尤其是會飛的大隻蟲子。

write.en: The biology class spent the morning in the park, identifying insects that live under fallen leaves.
write.zh: 生物課的學生在公園待了一整個上午，辨認住在落葉底下的昆蟲。

example.en: Despite his apprehension before the interview, Tom answered every question calmly and left the room smiling.
example.zh: 儘管面試前很忐忑，湯姆仍冷靜地回答每個問題，笑著走出房間。

listen.en: There was clear apprehension in her voice on the phone.
listen.zh: 她在電話裡的聲音明顯帶著不安。

chinese.en: Many residents expressed apprehension over the plan to build a large factory near the river.
chinese.zh: 許多居民對於在河邊興建大型工廠的計畫表示憂慮。

english.en: The students waited for their final exam results with great apprehension.
english.zh: 學生們非常忐忑地等待期末考成績。

speak.en: Honestly, I had a lot of apprehension before my first flight.
speak.zh: 老實說，第一次搭飛機前我非常緊張。

write.en: The police announced the apprehension of a suspect shortly after the shop was robbed.
write.zh: 商店遭搶後不久，警方宣布逮捕了一名嫌犯。

example.en: Trees along the coast act as a natural shield, protecting nearby villages from strong winds and storms.
example.zh: 沿海的樹木形成天然屏障，保護附近村莊免受強風和暴風雨侵襲。

listen.en: Parents cannot shield their children from every problem.
listen.zh: 父母無法讓孩子避開所有的問題。

chinese.en: Sunscreen works as a shield against harmful rays, but it should be reapplied regularly.
chinese.zh: 防曬乳就像一道抵擋有害光線的防護層，但應該定期補擦。

english.en: The factory installed walls to shield workers from the noise.
english.zh: 工廠加裝隔牆，保護工人不受噪音影響。

speak.en: I think living in a small town shielded me from a lot of stress.
speak.zh: 我覺得住在小鎮讓我少受了很多壓力。

write.en: Strong data privacy laws help shield consumers from companies that misuse personal information.
write.zh: 嚴格的資料隱私法有助於保護消費者，免受濫用個人資訊的公司侵害。

example.en: Our new school timetable includes longer lunch breaks, so students have more time to rest and eat properly.
example.zh: 學校的新課表把午休時間拉長，讓學生有更多時間休息、好好吃飯。

listen.en: The bus timetable changes during the summer holidays.
listen.zh: 公車時刻表在暑假期間會調整。

chinese.en: The government has not yet announced a clear timetable for reducing carbon emissions.
chinese.zh: 政府尚未公布減少碳排放的明確時程。

english.en: We are working to a very tight timetable this month.
english.zh: 這個月我們的時程非常緊湊。

speak.en: At university, my timetable was pretty flexible, so I had a part-time job.
speak.zh: 讀大學時我的課表蠻有彈性的，所以我有去打工。

write.en: Heavy rain throughout the spring meant the building project ran well behind its timetable.
write.zh: 整個春天大雨不斷，使這項建案的進度遠遠落後預定時程。

example.en: Scientists are closely monitoring a new variant of the virus that appears to spread more easily among children.
example.zh: 科學家正密切監測一種新的病毒變種株，它似乎更容易在兒童之間傳播。

listen.en: The game has many variants, but the rules are similar.
listen.zh: 這個遊戲有許多變化版本，但規則都很類似。

chinese.en: Colour and color are variant spellings of the same word in British and American English.
chinese.zh: colour 和 color 是同一個字在英式與美式英文中的不同拼法。

english.en: The company sells a cheaper variant of its popular phone.
english.zh: 這家公司販售旗下熱門手機的平價版本。

speak.en: My grandmother makes her own variant of this recipe, and it's amazing.
speak.zh: 我奶奶這道菜有她自己的做法，而且超好吃的。

write.en: Researchers found that people with a certain genetic variant are more likely to develop diabetes.
write.zh: 研究人員發現，帶有某種基因變異的人較容易罹患糖尿病。

example.en: After months of practice without improvement, she finally saw tangible progress when her test scores rose sharply.
example.zh: 練習了好幾個月都不見起色後，她的測驗分數大幅提升，終於看到具體的進步。

listen.en: The police found no tangible evidence linking him to the case.
listen.zh: 警方沒有找到任何能將他與此案連結的具體證據。

chinese.en: Investors want tangible results, not just promises about what the company might achieve.
chinese.zh: 投資人想看到具體成果，而不只是公司可能達成什麼目標的承諾。

english.en: Buildings and equipment are examples of a company's tangible assets.
english.zh: 建築物和設備都是公司有形資產的例子。

speak.en: I like volunteering because you can see a tangible difference straight away.
speak.zh: 我喜歡當志工，因為馬上就能看到實際的改變。

write.en: Fear of failure is not tangible, yet it can stop people from trying new things.
write.zh: 對失敗的恐懼雖然看不見也摸不著，卻可能讓人不敢嘗試新事物。

example.en: The runner smashed the national record by almost a full second, leaving the crowd cheering wildly.
example.zh: 這位跑者以將近一秒之差大破全國紀錄，現場觀眾瘋狂歡呼。

listen.en: A glass fell off the table and smashed on the floor.
listen.zh: 一個玻璃杯從桌上掉下來，在地上摔碎了。

chinese.en: The small film became a smash hit after people started recommending it online.
chinese.zh: 這部小成本電影在網友開始推薦後一炮而紅。

english.en: The car skidded on the wet road and smashed into a wall.
english.zh: 汽車在濕滑的路面上打滑，撞上了一道牆。

speak.en: I accidentally smashed my phone screen last week, so I need a new one.
speak.zh: 我上週不小心把手機螢幕摔破了，所以得換一支新的。

write.en: Police smashed a criminal network that had been selling fake medicine across the region.
write.zh: 警方破獲了一個在整個地區販售假藥的犯罪集團。

example.en: Alligators and many kinds of birds live in the swamp, where the water is shallow and full of plants.
example.zh: 短吻鱷和許多種鳥類棲息在這片沼澤，那裡水淺且長滿了植物。

listen.en: The office was swamped with calls after the announcement.
listen.zh: 公告發布後，辦公室的電話響個不停。

chinese.en: Cheap imported goods have swamped the local market, forcing many small shops to close.
chinese.zh: 廉價進口商品充斥當地市場，迫使許多小商店歇業。

english.en: The huge wave swamped the small boat near the shore.
english.zh: 巨浪在岸邊淹沒了那艘小船。

speak.en: During exam season, I'm usually swamped, so I barely see my friends.
speak.zh: 考試期間我通常忙翻了，幾乎見不到朋友。

write.en: Much of the old swamp was drained in the past century to make room for farmland.
write.zh: 這片古老沼澤的大部分在上個世紀被排乾，改作農地。

example.en: The oil spill was an environmental catastrophe, killing thousands of seabirds and destroying the local fishing industry.
example.zh: 這起漏油事件是一場環境浩劫，造成數千隻海鳥死亡，也摧毀了當地漁業。

listen.en: Quick action by the engineers helped avoid a catastrophe.
listen.zh: 工程師迅速採取行動，避免了一場大災難。

chinese.en: The school trip turned into a catastrophe when the bus broke down in heavy rain.
chinese.zh: 遊覽車在大雨中拋錨，讓這趟校外教學變成一場災難。

english.en: Losing all his savings was a financial catastrophe for him.
english.zh: 失去所有積蓄對他來說是一場財務災難。

speak.en: My first attempt at baking bread was a complete catastrophe, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，我第一次烤麵包完全是一場災難。

write.en: Good planning in hospitals can stop a small mistake from becoming a catastrophe.
write.zh: 醫院若有完善的規劃，就能避免小失誤演變成大災難。

example.en: Contrary to the stereotype of the quiet engineer, Lisa is outgoing and loves giving presentations to large audiences.
example.zh: 和「工程師都很安靜」的刻板印象相反，麗莎個性外向，很喜歡在一大群人面前做簡報。

listen.en: Young people are often stereotyped as lazy and selfish.
listen.zh: 年輕人常被貼上懶惰又自私的標籤。

chinese.en: Travelling abroad helped me realise that many stereotypes about other cultures are simply wrong.
chinese.zh: 出國旅行讓我發現，許多對其他文化的刻板印象根本是錯的。

english.en: We should not stereotype people based on their age or background.
english.zh: 我們不該因為年齡或背景就對人抱持刻板印象。

speak.en: I guess I don't really fit the stereotype of a typical student.
speak.zh: 我想我不太符合一般人對學生的刻板印象。

write.en: Children's books that show girls as scientists can help challenge old stereotypes.
write.zh: 把女孩描繪成科學家的童書，有助於打破過時的刻板印象。

example.en: During heavy storms, coastal wetlands absorb large amounts of water, which reduces flooding in nearby towns.
example.zh: 暴風雨期間，沿海濕地能吸收大量的水，減少附近城鎮淹水。

listen.en: We walked along a wooden path through the wetland.
listen.zh: 我們沿著木棧道走過濕地。

chinese.en: Large areas of wetland have been drained to build factories and housing estates.
chinese.zh: 大片濕地被抽乾，用來興建工廠和住宅區。

english.en: The city plans to restore the wetland next to the river.
english.zh: 市政府計畫復育河邊的那片濕地。

speak.en: There's a wetland park near my home where I often go birdwatching.
speak.zh: 我家附近有一座濕地公園，我常去那裡賞鳥。

write.en: Students collected water samples from the wetland to study how pollution affects plant life.
write.zh: 學生從濕地採集水樣，研究汙染如何影響植物生長。

example.en: When she returned from her summer job at the beach, her brown hair had turned almost blonde from the sun.
example.zh: 她在海邊打完暑期工回來時，原本的棕髮被太陽曬得幾乎變成金色。

listen.en: She decided to dye her hair blonde for the summer.
listen.zh: 她決定在夏天把頭髮染成金色。

chinese.en: The police are looking for a tall woman with short blonde hair and a red coat.
chinese.zh: 警方正在尋找一名留著金色短髮、穿紅色大衣的高個子女子。

english.en: Most of the children in the village have fair skin and blonde hair.
english.zh: 那個村子裡的孩子大多皮膚白皙、頭髮金黃。

speak.en: I once went blonde, but honestly it didn't really suit me.
speak.zh: 我曾經把頭髮染成金色，但老實說不太適合我。

write.en: The hotel's light blonde wood furniture makes the rooms feel bright and spacious.
write.zh: 飯店的淺色原木家具讓房間顯得明亮又寬敞。

example.en: Because the houses are built close to the river, they are highly susceptible to flooding during the rainy season.
example.zh: 由於這些房子蓋得離河很近，雨季時極容易淹水。

listen.en: Teenagers are often susceptible to pressure from their friends.
listen.zh: 青少年常常容易受到朋友的壓力影響。

chinese.en: Older computers without regular updates are particularly susceptible to viruses and online attacks.
chinese.zh: 沒有定期更新的舊電腦特別容易受到病毒和網路攻擊。

english.en: People who sleep too little are more susceptible to stress.
english.zh: 睡眠不足的人比較容易感到壓力。

speak.en: I'm quite susceptible to colds, so I always carry a jacket.
speak.zh: 我很容易感冒，所以總是會帶件外套。

write.en: Consumers who shop late at night may be more susceptible to clever advertising.
write.zh: 深夜購物的消費者可能更容易受到巧妙廣告的影響。

example.en: Hundreds of people became ill after eating salad that had been contaminated with bacteria at the farm.
example.zh: 數百人吃了在農場就遭細菌汙染的沙拉後生病了。

listen.en: The lab staff wear gloves to avoid contaminating the samples.
listen.zh: 實驗室人員戴手套，避免汙染樣本。

chinese.en: Plastic waste can break down into tiny pieces that contaminate soil and drinking water.
chinese.zh: 塑膠廢棄物會分解成微小碎片，汙染土壤和飲用水。

english.en: The well water in the village was contaminated after the flood.
english.zh: 洪水過後，村裡的井水受到了汙染。

speak.en: I use separate cutting boards so raw meat doesn't contaminate the vegetables.
speak.zh: 我會分開使用砧板，以免生肉汙染到蔬菜。

write.en: Critics argue that personal bias can contaminate the results of otherwise careful research.
write.zh: 批評者認為，個人偏見可能會使原本嚴謹的研究結果失真。

example.en: The magazine's editorial team spent weeks checking every fact before the special report was finally printed.
example.zh: 這本雜誌的編輯團隊花了好幾週查核每一項事實，這份特別報導才終於付印。

listen.en: I read the editorial in this morning's paper.
listen.zh: 我讀了今天早報的社論。

chinese.en: A good editorial presents a clear argument and supports it with reliable evidence.
chinese.zh: 一篇好的社論會提出清楚的論點，並以可靠的證據支持。

english.en: The editorial argued that the city needs more public parks.
english.zh: 這篇社論主張城市需要更多公園綠地。

speak.en: I sometimes read editorials to see different opinions on current issues.
speak.zh: 我有時會讀社論，看看大家對時事有哪些不同看法。

write.en: Journalists insist that advertisers should never be allowed to influence editorial decisions.
write.zh: 記者們堅持，絕不能讓廣告主影響編輯決策。

example.en: The rapid loss of coral reefs has caused alarm among scientists, who fear many species may disappear.
example.zh: 珊瑚礁快速消失引起科學家的憂慮，他們擔心許多物種可能會滅絕。

listen.en: Everyone left the building when the fire alarm went off.
listen.zh: 火災警報響起時，所有人都離開了大樓。

chinese.en: The sudden rise in food prices has alarmed many families on low incomes.
chinese.zh: 食物價格突然上漲，讓許多低收入家庭憂心忡忡。

english.en: A neighbour noticed the smoke and quickly raised the alarm.
english.zh: 一位鄰居發現冒煙，立刻發出警報。

speak.en: Please don't be alarmed, it's only a small change to the plan.
speak.zh: 請別驚慌，這只是計畫上的小小調整。

write.en: Teachers should not alarm students by talking about exams as if their whole future depends on them.
write.zh: 老師不應該把考試講得好像會決定學生的一生，讓學生驚慌失措。

example.en: As the glacier recedes each year, it leaves behind bare rock where thick ice once covered the valley.
example.zh: 冰河逐年消退，在曾被厚冰覆蓋的山谷裡留下光禿禿的岩石。

listen.en: The sound of the train slowly receded into the distance.
listen.zh: 火車的聲音漸漸消失在遠方。

chinese.en: As the economy improved, fears of mass unemployment began to recede across the country.
chinese.zh: 隨著經濟好轉，全國各地對大規模失業的擔憂開始減退。

english.en: My father has a receding hairline, but he doesn't mind.
english.zh: 我爸爸的髮線後退了，但他並不在意。

speak.en: After a few days of rest, my headache gradually receded.
speak.zh: 休息幾天後，我的頭痛漸漸消退了。

write.en: Once the exam was over, my worries about the results quickly receded into the background.
write.zh: 考試一結束，我對成績的擔憂很快就被拋到腦後。

example.en: Technology plays a prominent role in modern classrooms, where students use tablets and online tools every day.
example.zh: 科技在現代教室中扮演重要角色，學生每天都使用平板和線上工具。

listen.en: The new library is the most prominent building in town.
listen.zh: 新圖書館是鎮上最顯眼的建築。

chinese.en: The warning was printed in a prominent position on the front of every cigarette packet.
chinese.zh: 每包香菸的正面都在醒目的位置印上了警語。

english.en: Several prominent business leaders attended the climate conference last week.
english.zh: 上週有幾位知名企業領袖出席了氣候會議。

speak.en: My grandfather was quite a prominent person in our village.
speak.zh: 我爺爺在我們村子裡算是蠻有名望的人。

write.en: This desert cat has prominent ears and large eyes that help it hunt at night.
write.zh: 這種沙漠貓耳朵特別突出、眼睛很大，有助於牠在夜間狩獵。

example.en: The graph shows a smooth upward curve, meaning that online sales grew steadily throughout the year.
example.zh: 圖表呈現一條平滑上升的曲線，表示線上銷售全年穩定成長。

listen.en: The narrow path curves gently around the edge of the lake.
listen.zh: 那條窄小的步道沿著湖邊緩緩彎曲。

chinese.en: The architect designed the roof with a gentle curve so that rainwater could run off easily.
chinese.zh: 建築師把屋頂設計成和緩的弧形，讓雨水能輕易流下。

english.en: The road curves sharply to the left just after the bridge.
english.zh: 一過橋，道路就向左急轉彎。

speak.en: My new job has quite a learning curve, but I'm enjoying it.
speak.zh: 我的新工作要學的東西不少，但我做得很開心。

write.en: Her lips curved into a smile when she heard that she had passed the exam.
write.zh: 聽到自己考試及格時，她的嘴角揚起了微笑。

example.en: What seemed like a trivial error in the code eventually caused the entire banking system to crash.
example.zh: 程式碼中一個看似微不足道的錯誤，最後竟導致整個銀行系統當機。

listen.en: The problem may seem trivial, but it worries me.
listen.zh: 這個問題看起來也許微不足道，但它讓我很擔心。

chinese.en: Climate change is far from a trivial issue; it affects food supplies and public health.
chinese.zh: 氣候變遷絕非小事，它影響糧食供應和公共衛生。

english.en: The manager spent the whole meeting discussing trivial details of the plan.
english.zh: 經理整場會議都在討論這項計畫的枝微末節。

speak.en: I used to worry about trivial stuff, but now I'm more relaxed.
speak.zh: 我以前會為了小事煩惱，但現在比較放得開了。

write.en: Some parents see online games as a trivial hobby, yet many teenagers learn teamwork through them.
write.zh: 有些家長認為線上遊戲只是無足輕重的嗜好，但許多青少年卻從中學會團隊合作。

example.en: From the top of the mountain, we enjoyed an impressive view of the whole valley and the sea beyond.
example.zh: 從山頂上，我們欣賞到整座山谷和遠方大海的壯觀景色。

listen.en: Her speech at the graduation ceremony was truly impressive.
listen.zh: 她在畢業典禮上的演講真的很精彩。

chinese.en: The country has made impressive progress in reducing poverty over the past decade.
chinese.zh: 這個國家在過去十年間減少貧窮的成果相當驚人。

english.en: His knowledge of history is really impressive for his age.
english.zh: 以他的年紀來說，他的歷史知識真的很驚人。

speak.en: To be honest, the food there was pretty impressive for the price.
speak.zh: 老實說，以那個價格來說，那裡的食物相當不錯。

write.en: The museum houses an impressive collection of ancient pottery from across Asia.
write.zh: 這座博物館收藏了來自亞洲各地、數量可觀的古代陶器。

example.en: After hours of waiting for the exam results, she finally heaved a sigh of relief when she saw she had passed.
example.zh: 等了好幾個小時的考試成績，看到自己及格時，她終於鬆了一口氣。

listen.en: With a final heave, we pushed the car out of the mud.
listen.zh: 我們最後用力一推，把車子推出了泥巴。

chinese.en: The fishermen heaved the heavy nets out of the water as the storm approached.
chinese.zh: 暴風雨逼近時，漁夫們使勁把沉重的漁網從水裡拉上來。

english.en: He heaved his suitcase onto the luggage rack on the train.
english.zh: 他用力把行李箱舉上火車的行李架。

speak.en: Honestly, I heaved a huge sigh of relief when the interview was over.
speak.zh: 說真的，面試結束時我大大地鬆了一口氣。

write.en: During the rough crossing, the deck heaved beneath our feet and several passengers felt seasick.
write.zh: 在風浪很大的航程中，甲板在我們腳下起伏不停，好幾位乘客都暈船了。

example.en: Tourists come from all over the world to admire the Gothic architecture of the old castle and its towering walls.
example.zh: 遊客從世界各地前來，欣賞這座古堡的哥德式建築和高聳的城牆。

listen.en: My cousin decided to study architecture at university.
listen.zh: 我表哥決定在大學念建築。

chinese.en: Many people feel that the architecture of new housing estates lacks character.
chinese.zh: 許多人覺得新建住宅社區的建築缺乏特色。

english.en: I am very interested in the traditional architecture of this city.
english.zh: 我對這座城市的傳統建築很感興趣。

speak.en: I'm not an expert, but I really love the architecture in old towns.
speak.zh: 我不是專家，但我真的很喜歡老城鎮裡的建築。

write.en: The engineers redesigned the system's architecture so that it could handle far more users.
write.zh: 工程師重新設計了系統架構，讓它能承載更多使用者。

example.en: The brand's simple slogan, printed on every bottle, was so memorable that children were soon repeating it at school.
example.zh: 那個品牌印在每個瓶子上的簡單標語非常好記，沒多久孩子們就在學校裡琅琅上口。

listen.en: Our class needs a short slogan for the sports day.
listen.zh: 我們班需要一句運動會用的簡短口號。

chinese.en: The government launched a road safety campaign with the slogan 'Slow down, save lives'.
chinese.zh: 政府推出一項交通安全宣導活動，標語是「放慢速度，拯救生命」。

english.en: The coffee shop's new slogan is easy to remember at a glance.
english.zh: 那家咖啡店的新標語讓人看一眼就記得。

speak.en: To be honest, I rarely notice slogans on billboards when I'm driving.
speak.zh: 老實說，我開車時很少注意到廣告看板上的標語。

write.en: Fans chanted the team's slogan as the players walked onto the field.
write.zh: 球員走進場內時，球迷齊聲高喊球隊的口號。

example.en: She had no talent for music at first, but through sheer determination and daily practice, she became an excellent pianist.
example.zh: 她起初沒什麼音樂天分，但憑著堅定的決心和每天練習，成了一位出色的鋼琴家。

listen.en: We found the little café by sheer chance.
listen.zh: 我們完全是碰巧找到那家小咖啡館的。

chinese.en: The path ends at a sheer cliff, so hikers should stay behind the fence.
chinese.zh: 步道盡頭是陡峭的懸崖，所以登山客應該待在圍欄後面。

english.en: He passed his driving test through sheer luck rather than skill.
english.zh: 他通過駕照考試純粹是靠運氣，而不是技術。

speak.en: The sheer number of tourists in summer can be pretty overwhelming.
speak.zh: 夏天光是遊客的數量就多到讓人吃不消。

write.en: She wore a sheer silk scarf that was perfect for a warm evening.
write.zh: 她圍了一條薄透的絲巾，很適合溫暖的傍晚。

example.en: Although the chef was internationally renowned, she still visited the local market every morning to choose ingredients herself.
example.zh: 這位主廚雖然享譽國際，仍然每天早上親自到當地市場挑選食材。

listen.en: Our university invited a renowned scientist to give a talk.
listen.zh: 我們大學邀請了一位知名科學家來演講。

chinese.en: The museum is renowned as one of the best places to learn about local history.
chinese.zh: 這間博物館是公認認識在地歷史最好的地方之一。

english.en: This small restaurant is renowned for its beef noodle soup.
english.zh: 這家小餐廳以牛肉麵聞名。

speak.en: My hometown isn't really renowned for anything, but I love it.
speak.zh: 我的家鄉其實沒什麼出名的，但我很愛它。

write.en: The company hired a world-renowned architect to design its new headquarters in the city centre.
write.zh: 這家公司聘請了一位世界知名的建築師，設計它位於市中心的新總部。

example.en: After the startup attracted millions of users, investors raised its valuation, believing the company would soon be worth far more.
example.zh: 這家新創公司吸引了數百萬名使用者後，投資人調高了它的估值，認為公司很快會更值錢。

listen.en: We need an expert valuation of these old paintings.
listen.zh: 我們需要專家為這些老畫作估價。

chinese.en: The valuation of the land was much lower than the family had expected.
chinese.zh: 這塊地的估價比這家人預期的低很多。

english.en: We asked a professional to do a valuation of the ring.
english.zh: 我們請了專業人士為這枚戒指估價。

speak.en: I'd never sell my grandmother's piano, no matter what the valuation was.
speak.zh: 不管估價多少，我都絕對不會賣掉我奶奶的鋼琴。

write.en: Some economists warn that high valuations of tech companies may not reflect their real profits.
write.zh: 有些經濟學家警告，科技公司的高估值未必反映它們真正的獲利。

example.en: Heavy rain upset our plans for a picnic, so we spent the afternoon watching films at home instead.
example.zh: 一場大雨打亂了我們的野餐計畫，所以我們改成整個下午在家看電影。

listen.en: Please don't get upset about one bad test result.
listen.zh: 請不要因為一次考不好就難過。

chinese.en: Building a dam here could upset the natural balance of the river ecosystem.
chinese.zh: 在這裡興建水壩，可能會破壞河川生態系的自然平衡。

english.en: I didn't mean to upset you with what I said yesterday.
english.zh: 我昨天說那些話，不是故意要讓你難過。

speak.en: I get a bit upset when people are late without letting me know.
speak.zh: 別人遲到又沒先跟我說，我會有點不高興。

write.en: Eating too much spicy food late at night can give you an upset stomach.
write.zh: 深夜吃太多辣的東西，可能會讓你腸胃不適。

example.en: When you breathe out slowly, your lungs expel air and your body naturally begins to relax.
example.zh: 當你慢慢吐氣時，肺部會排出空氣，身體也會自然開始放鬆。

listen.en: The club decided to expel members who broke the rules.
listen.zh: 社團決定開除違反規定的成員。

chinese.en: The factory was fined for expelling polluted water into the nearby river.
chinese.zh: 這間工廠因為把污水排進附近的河川而被罰款。

english.en: Students who cheat in exams may be expelled from the university.
english.zh: 考試作弊的學生可能會被大學退學。

speak.en: Honestly, I think expelling students should always be the very last resort.
speak.zh: 老實說，我認為開除學生應該永遠是最後不得已的手段。

write.en: A good ventilation system expels stale air and keeps the office fresh.
write.zh: 良好的通風系統能排出混濁的空氣，讓辦公室保持清新。

example.en: After a long journey with two delays, we finally reached our destination just before midnight and went straight to bed.
example.zh: 經過兩次延誤的漫長旅程後，我們終於在午夜前抵達目的地，然後直接上床睡覺。

listen.en: Please check the destination on the bus before you get on.
listen.zh: 上車前請先確認公車的目的地。

chinese.en: Online reviews strongly influence which holiday destinations young people choose each year.
chinese.zh: 網路評價大大影響年輕人每年選擇的度假地點。

english.en: Our next destination is a quiet little town by the sea.
english.zh: 我們的下一個目的地是一座安靜的海邊小鎮。

speak.en: My dream destination is Iceland, mainly because I want to see the northern lights.
speak.zh: 我夢想中的旅遊地點是冰島，主要是因為我想看北極光。

write.en: Some cities limit cruise ships because too many visitors can damage the character of a destination.
write.zh: 有些城市限制郵輪靠港，因為遊客太多可能會破壞一個旅遊地的特色。

example.en: Before take-off, the flight attendant asked passengers to return their seats to the upright position and fasten their belts.
example.zh: 起飛前，空服員請乘客將椅背豎直並繫好安全帶。

listen.en: Keep the bottle upright so the juice doesn't leak.
listen.zh: 瓶子要保持直立，果汁才不會漏出來。

chinese.en: He was known as an upright official who never accepted gifts from anyone.
chinese.zh: 他是出了名的清廉官員，從不收任何人的禮物。

english.en: Remember to sit upright when you work at a computer for hours.
english.zh: 長時間用電腦工作時，記得要坐直。

speak.en: I've got an old upright piano at home that nobody really plays.
speak.zh: 我家有一台舊的直立式鋼琴，其實沒什麼人在彈。

write.en: Strong winds knocked over the bins, so I had to set them upright again.
write.zh: 強風把垃圾桶吹倒了，所以我只好再把它們扶正。

example.en: Because the old bus service was so unpredictable, many residents switched to the metro, which is far more reliable.
example.zh: 因為舊的公車服務很難預料，許多居民改搭可靠得多的捷運。

listen.en: My old car is slow, but it is very reliable.
listen.zh: 我的舊車開起來很慢，但非常可靠。

chinese.en: Scientists need reliable data before they can draw any firm conclusions about climate.
chinese.zh: 科學家需要可靠的數據，才能對氣候下任何確切的結論。

english.en: She is a very reliable colleague who always finishes work on time.
english.zh: 她是一位非常可靠的同事，總是準時完成工作。

speak.en: I'd say my best friend is the most reliable person I know.
speak.zh: 我會說我最好的朋友是我認識的人當中最可靠的。

write.en: Small businesses in rural areas often struggle without a reliable internet connection.
write.zh: 鄉下地區的小型企業常因為缺乏穩定的網路連線而經營困難。

example.en: When I finally got home from my week-long trip, a huge pile of dirty laundry was waiting for me in the basket.
example.zh: 結束一週的旅行終於回到家時，籃子裡有一大堆髒衣服在等著我。

listen.en: Could you help me hang out the laundry, please?
listen.zh: 可以請你幫我晾衣服嗎？

chinese.en: Many students living in dormitories share a laundry room on the ground floor.
chinese.zh: 許多住宿舍的學生共用一樓的洗衣間。

english.en: During the rainy season, it is hard to dry the laundry.
english.zh: 雨季的時候，洗好的衣服很難晾乾。

speak.en: To be honest, laundry is the household chore I hate the most.
speak.zh: 老實說，洗衣服是我最討厭的家事。

write.en: The hotel offers a laundry service, so guests don't need to pack many clothes.
write.zh: 這家飯店提供洗衣服務，所以房客不需要帶很多衣服。

example.en: The tourist submarine slowly sank beneath the waves, giving passengers a clear view of the colourful fish and coral outside.
example.zh: 觀光潛艇緩緩沉入海面下，讓乘客清楚看到窗外色彩繽紛的魚群和珊瑚。

listen.en: The submarine stayed deep underwater for several weeks.
listen.zh: 那艘潛艇在深海中停留了好幾個星期。

chinese.en: Most of the world's internet traffic travels through submarine cables on the seabed.
chinese.zh: 全球大部分的網路流量都經由海床上的海底電纜傳輸。

english.en: As a child, I dreamed of travelling in a submarine one day.
english.zh: 我小時候夢想有一天能搭潛水艇旅行。

speak.en: I'd love to try a submarine tour, but I'm a bit claustrophobic.
speak.zh: 我很想試試搭潛水艇觀光，可是我有點幽閉恐懼症。

write.en: Life on a submarine can be stressful because crew members rarely see daylight for months.
write.zh: 在潛艇上生活可能壓力很大，因為船員常常好幾個月都看不到陽光。

example.en: During the long drought, reservoirs dropped to record lows and residents were told to limit their water use.
example.zh: 在這場漫長的乾旱期間，水庫水位降到歷史新低，居民也被要求節約用水。

listen.en: Farmers are worried that the drought will ruin their crops.
listen.zh: 農民擔心這場乾旱會毀掉他們的作物。

chinese.en: Climate change is making droughts more frequent and more intense in many parts of the world.
chinese.zh: 氣候變遷正讓世界許多地區的乾旱變得更頻繁、更嚴重。

english.en: The drought has caused serious water shortages in many parts of the island.
english.zh: 這場乾旱已經在島上許多地方造成嚴重缺水。

speak.en: Where I live, we had a drought last summer, so showers were short.
speak.zh: 我住的地方去年夏天鬧旱災，所以大家洗澡都洗很快。

write.en: Some farmers now grow drought-resistant crops to protect their income in dry years.
write.zh: 有些農民現在改種耐旱作物，以便在乾旱的年頭保住收入。

example.en: As I rushed around the corner, I collided with a waiter and his tray of drinks went flying everywhere.
example.zh: 我匆忙轉過街角時撞上了一名服務生，他托盤上的飲料灑得到處都是。

listen.en: The players collided while they were chasing the ball.
listen.zh: 球員們在追球時撞在一起。

chinese.en: When personal freedom collides with public safety, governments must find a careful balance.
chinese.zh: 當個人自由和公共安全發生衝突時，政府必須審慎取得平衡。

english.en: The two fishing boats collided in thick fog near the harbour.
english.zh: 那兩艘漁船在港口附近的濃霧中相撞了。

speak.en: In my family, my parents' opinions often collide when it comes to money.
speak.zh: 在我家，只要談到錢，我爸媽的意見就常常不合。

write.en: In the film, two very different cultures collide when a city girl moves to a farm.
write.zh: 在這部電影裡，一個城市女孩搬到農場後，兩種截然不同的文化發生了碰撞。

example.en: Drinking alcohol impairs your judgment, which is why people who have been drinking should never get behind the wheel.
example.zh: 喝酒會影響判斷力，所以喝過酒的人絕對不應該開車。

listen.en: Loud music can impair your hearing over time.
listen.zh: 長期聽大聲的音樂會損害你的聽力。

chinese.en: The new app helps visually impaired users read menus and street signs.
chinese.zh: 這款新應用程式能幫助視障使用者閱讀菜單和路標。

english.en: Staring at screens for long periods may impair your eyesight.
english.zh: 長時間盯著螢幕可能會損害你的視力。

speak.en: When I'm stressed, I find it really impairs my memory.
speak.zh: 我發現壓力一大，記憶力就會變得很差。

write.en: Air pollution can impair children's lung development, according to several recent studies.
write.zh: 根據幾項最新研究，空氣污染可能會妨礙兒童的肺部發育。

example.en: The visa allows you to work in the country, but the duration of your stay cannot exceed one year.
example.zh: 這種簽證允許你在該國工作，但停留期間不得超過一年。

listen.en: The duration of the course depends on your level.
listen.zh: 課程的長短取決於你的程度。

chinese.en: Researchers measured the duration of each phone call to study how people communicate.
chinese.zh: 研究人員測量每通電話的通話時間，以研究人們的溝通方式。

english.en: The film was shorter in duration than I had expected.
english.zh: 這部電影的片長比我預期的還短。

speak.en: I can handle long flights if I sleep for most of the duration.
speak.zh: 如果大部分時間都能睡覺，長途飛行我還撐得住。

write.en: Experts say the duration of exercise matters less than doing it regularly.
write.zh: 專家表示，運動時間的長短不如規律運動來得重要。

example.en: The results did not support our original hypothesis, so we had to rethink why the plants grew faster in shade.
example.zh: 實驗結果並不支持我們原本的假設，所以我們得重新思考植物為什麼在陰暗處長得比較快。

listen.en: Her hypothesis was that students learn better in the morning.
listen.zh: 她的假設是學生在早上學習效果比較好。

chinese.en: There is growing evidence for the hypothesis that regular exercise protects the brain.
chinese.zh: 越來越多證據支持規律運動能保護大腦的這項假說。

english.en: We need to collect more data before we can prove this hypothesis.
english.zh: 我們必須先收集更多資料，才能證明這個假設。

speak.en: My hypothesis is that people are happier when they spend less time online.
speak.zh: 我的假設是，人們少花點時間上網會比較快樂。

write.en: Detectives often work with several hypotheses until the evidence points clearly in one direction.
write.zh: 偵探常會同時考慮好幾種假設，直到證據明確指向其中一個方向。

example.en: The coach's angry comments were widely condemned, and he later apologised to the referee and the opposing team.
example.zh: 教練憤怒的發言遭到各界譴責，他後來向裁判和對手球隊道歉。

listen.en: Teachers should condemn bullying whenever they see it.
listen.zh: 老師只要看到霸凌就應該加以譴責。

chinese.en: Without a good education, many children may be condemned to a life of poverty.
chinese.zh: 如果沒有良好的教育，許多孩子可能注定一輩子過著貧困的生活。

english.en: Everyone condemned the driver for his dangerous behaviour on the motorway.
english.zh: 大家都譴責那名駕駛在高速公路上的危險行為。

speak.en: I think we should condemn cruelty to animals, whatever the reason.
speak.zh: 我認為不管理由是什麼，我們都應該譴責虐待動物的行為。

write.en: The old building was condemned as unsafe and will be demolished next spring.
write.zh: 那棟老建築被認定為危樓，明年春天將會拆除。

example.en: My brother lost his job and slept on our couch for a month while he looked for a new apartment.
example.zh: 我哥哥失業了，在找新住處的那一個月都睡在我們家的沙發上。

listen.en: The cat is sleeping on the couch again.
listen.zh: 貓又在沙發上睡覺了。

chinese.en: Health experts warn that spending whole weekends on the couch is bad for our hearts.
chinese.zh: 健康專家警告，整個週末都窩在沙發上對心臟有害。

english.en: We want to buy a new couch that is more comfortable.
english.zh: 我們想買一張比較舒適的新沙發。

speak.en: On weekends, I'm a bit of a couch potato, honestly.
speak.zh: 說真的，我週末有點像個沙發馬鈴薯，整天窩著不動。

write.en: The office installed a few couches in the break room so staff could relax.
write.zh: 公司在休息室擺了幾張沙發，讓員工可以放鬆一下。

example.en: Despite years of practice, her inability to speak confidently in public kept her from applying for promotion.
example.zh: 儘管練習多年，她仍無法自信地在公開場合說話，因此一直沒有申請升遷。

listen.en: The patient's inability to sleep worried his doctor.
listen.zh: 這位病人無法入睡，讓他的醫生很擔心。

chinese.en: Many small businesses closed because of their inability to pay rising rents.
chinese.zh: 許多小商家因為付不起不斷上漲的租金而歇業。

english.en: Her inability to say no often makes her extremely busy.
english.zh: 她不懂得拒絕，常常讓自己忙得不得了。

speak.en: Honestly, my inability to cook is a bit embarrassing.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不會做菜這件事有點丟臉。

write.en: Many students say constant phone notifications explain their inability to concentrate in class.
write.zh: 許多學生說，手機通知響個不停是他們上課無法專心的原因。

example.en: The neighbour's dog looked friendly, but it turned vicious whenever strangers came near the gate.
example.zh: 鄰居的狗看起來很友善，但只要有陌生人靠近大門，就會變得很兇。

listen.en: Someone spread vicious rumours about her on social media.
listen.zh: 有人在社群媒體上散播關於她的惡毒謠言。

chinese.en: Critics wrote vicious reviews of the film, yet audiences absolutely loved it.
chinese.zh: 影評人對這部電影寫下尖酸刻薄的評論，觀眾卻非常喜愛。

english.en: The manager made a vicious comment about my report in the meeting.
english.zh: 經理在會議上對我的報告說了很刻薄的話。

speak.en: It's a vicious circle: I'm tired, so I skip the gym and feel worse.
speak.zh: 這是個惡性循環：我很累就不去健身房，結果感覺更糟。

write.en: Rising debt and falling income can trap families in a vicious cycle of poverty.
write.zh: 債務增加、收入減少，可能讓家庭陷入貧窮的惡性循環。

example.en: We booked a small hotel room overlooking the harbour, so we could watch the boats every morning.
example.zh: 我們訂了一間俯瞰港口的小飯店房間，這樣每天早上都能看船。

listen.en: The teacher decided to overlook his late homework this time.
listen.zh: 老師決定這次不追究他遲交作業。

chinese.en: Policymakers often overlook the needs of elderly people living alone in rural areas.
chinese.zh: 決策者常常忽略鄉下獨居長者的需求。

english.en: The report overlooked several important problems with the new system.
english.zh: 這份報告忽略了新系統的幾個重要問題。

speak.en: I think people often overlook how important sleep really is.
speak.zh: 我覺得大家常常忽略睡眠到底有多重要。

write.en: She was overlooked for promotion despite having more experience than anyone else on the team.
write.zh: 儘管她比團隊裡任何人都資深，升遷時卻還是被略過了。

example.en: At first, the new students were intimidated by the large campus, but they soon found their way around.
example.zh: 一開始，新生被偌大的校園嚇到，但他們很快就摸清了方向。

listen.en: Many learners feel intimidated when they speak with native speakers.
listen.zh: 許多學習者和母語人士說話時會感到膽怯。

chinese.en: Some companies try to intimidate employees into working longer hours without extra pay.
chinese.zh: 有些公司試圖威嚇員工，逼他們延長工時卻不加薪。

english.en: The interviewer's serious expression really intimidated me at the beginning.
english.zh: 一開始，面試官嚴肅的表情真的把我嚇到了。

speak.en: Honestly, big parties used to intimidate me when I was younger.
speak.zh: 老實說，我年紀小一點的時候，大型派對常讓我很怯場。

write.en: Laws should protect witnesses so that criminals cannot intimidate them into staying silent.
write.zh: 法律應該保護證人，讓罪犯無法恐嚇他們、逼他們噤聲。

example.en: The river was polluted by a toxic cocktail of chemicals that factories had dumped into it for decades.
example.zh: 這條河被工廠數十年來傾倒的各種有毒化學物質汙染了。

listen.en: We were invited to a cocktail party after the conference.
listen.zh: 會議結束後，我們受邀參加一場雞尾酒會。

chinese.en: Doctors warn that a cocktail of stress, poor diet and little sleep damages your health.
chinese.zh: 醫生警告，壓力、飲食不良加上睡眠不足，會損害你的健康。

english.en: This bar also serves alcohol-free cocktails for people who are driving.
english.zh: 這家酒吧也為開車的人提供無酒精雞尾酒。

speak.en: I'm not a big drinker, but I enjoy a cocktail occasionally.
speak.zh: 我不太喝酒，但偶爾會喝杯雞尾酒。

write.en: The city's success comes from a rich cocktail of cultures, languages and traditions.
write.zh: 這座城市的成功，來自多元文化、語言與傳統的豐富交融。

example.en: After the fall, her ankle was swollen and tender, so the nurse advised her to rest it.
example.zh: 跌倒後她的腳踝又腫又一碰就痛，所以護理師建議她讓腳多休息。

listen.en: The mother gave her baby a tender kiss.
listen.zh: 媽媽溫柔地親了她的寶寶一下。

chinese.en: The city council has put the new bridge project out to tender this month.
chinese.zh: 市議會本月已將新橋工程公開招標。

english.en: Several local construction companies are competing to win the tender.
english.zh: 幾家本地營造公司正在競爭這個標案。

speak.en: My grandmother always speaks to her plants in a tender voice.
speak.zh: 我奶奶總是用溫柔的聲音跟她的植物說話。

write.en: These days, many children in Taiwan start learning English at a tender age.
write.zh: 現在臺灣有許多孩子年紀很小就開始學英文。

example.en: The company installed a new suite of software, including tools for email, spreadsheets and video calls.
example.zh: 公司安裝了一套新的軟體，包括電子郵件、試算表和視訊通話的工具。

listen.en: The couple booked the honeymoon suite for their wedding night.
listen.zh: 這對新人為新婚之夜訂了蜜月套房。

chinese.en: All the visiting delegates were given private suites at the conference hotel.
chinese.zh: 所有來訪的代表都被安排住進會議飯店的獨立套房。

english.en: The orchestra played a short suite by a French composer.
english.zh: 樂團演奏了一首法國作曲家的短篇組曲。

speak.en: Honestly, the best thing about my flat is the en suite bathroom.
speak.zh: 老實說，我住的公寓最棒的地方就是房間有獨立衛浴。

write.en: The office building offers a suite of meeting rooms that local start-ups can rent.
write.zh: 這棟辦公大樓提供一整套會議室，讓本地新創公司租用。

example.en: After his diagnosis of a terminal illness, he decided to spend his remaining months travelling with his family.
example.zh: 被診斷出末期疾病後，他決定用剩下的幾個月和家人一起旅行。

listen.en: The bus terminal is just across the road from the station.
listen.zh: 客運總站就在車站的馬路對面。

chinese.en: Passengers waited in the crowded terminal for hours after storms delayed their flights.
chinese.zh: 暴風雨導致班機延誤後，旅客在擁擠的航廈裡等了好幾個小時。

english.en: The library has several computer terminals for students to use.
english.zh: 圖書館有幾台電腦終端機供學生使用。

speak.en: I actually enjoy wandering around airport terminals before a long flight.
speak.zh: 其實我很喜歡在長途飛行前，在機場航廈裡閒逛。

write.en: Some economists believe the small town's traditional industries are now in terminal decline.
write.zh: 有些經濟學家認為，這個小鎮的傳統產業已經走向無法挽回的衰退。

example.en: She is an engineer by profession, although she spends most of her weekends painting landscapes.
example.zh: 她的職業是工程師，不過大部分週末都在畫風景畫。

listen.en: The medical profession has changed a lot in recent years.
listen.zh: 醫療界近年來改變了很多。

chinese.en: Nursing is still a profession where workers are underpaid despite their long hours.
chinese.zh: 護理仍是一個工時很長、薪水卻偏低的職業。

english.en: He left the legal profession to open a small café.
english.zh: 他離開法律界，開了一家小咖啡店。

speak.en: I'd like to choose a profession that lets me help people.
speak.zh: 我想選一個能讓我幫助別人的職業。

write.en: More young people are entering professions related to technology than ever before.
write.zh: 投入科技相關職業的年輕人比以往任何時候都多。

example.en: After years of tension, the neighbouring countries signed a trade agreement to strengthen economic ties.
example.zh: 經過多年的緊張關係，這些鄰國簽署貿易協定，以加強經濟往來。

listen.en: Travelling abroad together really strengthened our friendship last summer.
listen.zh: 去年夏天一起出國旅行，真的讓我們的友誼更深厚了。

chinese.en: The school plans to strengthen its English programme by hiring more native speakers.
chinese.zh: 學校計畫聘請更多母語人士，以加強英語課程。

english.en: The company wants to strengthen its position in the Asian market.
english.zh: 這家公司想鞏固它在亞洲市場的地位。

speak.en: I think volunteering really strengthens people's sense of community.
speak.zh: 我覺得當志工真的能增強人們的社區意識。

write.en: The new evidence has strengthened the case for banning plastic bags in supermarkets.
write.zh: 新證據讓超市禁用塑膠袋的主張更有說服力。

example.en: Because she is lactose intolerant, she avoids dairy and drinks soy milk with her breakfast instead.
example.zh: 因為她有乳糖不耐症，所以不吃乳製品，早餐改喝豆漿。

listen.en: My uncle runs a small dairy farm in the countryside.
listen.zh: 我叔叔在鄉下經營一座小型酪農場。

chinese.en: The dairy industry produces a large share of the country's greenhouse gas emissions.
chinese.zh: 酪農業產生了該國很大一部分的溫室氣體排放。

english.en: This café offers several dairy-free desserts for customers who are vegan.
english.zh: 這家咖啡店為吃全素的顧客提供幾款不含乳製品的甜點。

speak.en: I tried cutting out dairy for a month, and I felt great.
speak.zh: 我試過一個月不吃乳製品，結果感覺很好。

write.en: Students on the field trip learned how milk is processed at a modern dairy.
write.zh: 參加戶外教學的學生在一座現代化乳品廠了解牛奶是如何加工的。

example.en: Scientists are still trying to find out where the virus originated and how it spread so quickly.
example.zh: 科學家仍在設法查明這種病毒起源於何處，以及它為何傳播得這麼快。

listen.en: The idea for the project originated with a student.
listen.zh: 這個專案的構想最初是由一名學生提出的。

chinese.en: Most complaints originated from customers who had waited too long for delivery.
chinese.zh: 大部分投訴來自等貨等太久的顧客。

english.en: This style of music originated in the southern United States.
english.zh: 這種音樂風格起源於美國南部。

speak.en: I'm not sure where this festival originated, but it's really fun.
speak.zh: 我不太確定這個節日起源於哪裡，但真的很好玩。

write.en: Many common English words originated from Latin and were later changed by everyday use.
write.zh: 許多常見的英文單字源自拉丁文，後來在日常使用中逐漸改變。

example.en: Heavy rain curtailed the outdoor concert, and the band had to stop playing after just a few songs.
example.zh: 大雨讓戶外演唱會提早結束，樂團只表演了幾首歌就得停下來。

listen.en: My doctor told me to curtail my sugar intake.
listen.zh: 醫生叫我減少糖的攝取量。

chinese.en: New rules curtail the use of mobile phones during lessons at many schools.
chinese.zh: 許多學校的新規定限制上課期間使用手機。

english.en: Our family holiday was curtailed because my father suddenly got sick.
english.zh: 因為我爸爸突然生病，我們的家庭旅行只好提早結束。

speak.en: I've had to curtail my social life since starting this job.
speak.zh: 自從開始這份工作，我只好減少社交活動。

write.en: Some critics argue that strict internet laws could seriously curtail freedom of expression.
write.zh: 有些批評者認為，嚴格的網路法規可能會嚴重限制言論自由。

example.en: When the email asked for her bank password, she became suspicious and contacted the bank directly.
example.zh: 當那封電子郵件要她提供銀行密碼時，她起了疑心，於是直接聯絡銀行。

listen.en: My cat is suspicious of anyone she doesn't know.
listen.zh: 我的貓對任何陌生人都很有戒心。

chinese.en: Many consumers are suspicious of products that promise quick and easy weight loss.
chinese.zh: 許多消費者對標榜輕鬆快速減重的產品抱持懷疑。

english.en: The teacher was suspicious when every student got the same answer.
english.zh: 每個學生都寫出一樣的答案時，老師起了疑心。

speak.en: To be honest, I'm a bit suspicious of online reviews.
speak.zh: 老實說，我對網路評論有點存疑。

write.en: Auditors found several suspicious payments in the company's accounts during the last quarter.
write.zh: 稽核人員在公司上一季的帳目中發現幾筆可疑的款項。

example.en: The rules were confusing, so the manager sent an email to clarify who could work from home.
example.zh: 規定讓人很困惑，所以經理寄了一封電子郵件，釐清誰可以在家工作。

listen.en: The teacher clarified the instructions before the test began.
listen.zh: 考試開始前，老師把作答說明講清楚了。

chinese.en: The government issued a statement to clarify its position on the new tax.
chinese.zh: 政府發表聲明，釐清它對新稅制的立場。

english.en: Writing my ideas down on paper helps me clarify my thinking.
english.zh: 把想法寫在紙上能幫助我釐清思緒。

speak.en: Sorry, can I just clarify something before we move on?
speak.zh: 不好意思，在繼續之前我可以先確認一件事嗎？

write.en: Scientists have yet to clarify the link between screen time and sleep problems in children.
write.zh: 科學家尚未釐清兒童使用螢幕的時間與睡眠問題之間的關聯。

example.en: In many cultures, sharing a meal after a wedding is an important ritual that brings both families together.
example.zh: 在許多文化中，婚禮後一起用餐是讓雙方家庭團聚的重要儀式。

listen.en: Reading a story is part of our bedtime ritual.
listen.zh: 念故事是我們睡前固定儀式的一部分。

chinese.en: The team performs the same ritual in the locker room before every match.
chinese.zh: 每場比賽前，球隊都會在更衣室進行同樣的儀式。

english.en: The festival includes a ritual dance performed by local villagers.
english.zh: 這個節慶包含由當地村民表演的儀式舞蹈。

speak.en: Sunday lunch with my grandparents is kind of a family ritual.
speak.zh: 星期天和爺爺奶奶一起吃午餐，算是我們家的固定儀式。

write.en: For many graduates, throwing their caps in the air is a cherished ritual.
write.zh: 對許多畢業生來說，把學士帽拋向空中是一項珍貴的儀式。

example.en: After years of sitting at a desk, he developed chronic back pain that made long flights unbearable.
example.zh: 久坐辦公桌多年後，他患上慢性背痛，長途飛行變得難以忍受。

listen.en: Many rural hospitals face a chronic shortage of nurses.
listen.zh: 許多鄉村醫院長期面臨護理人員短缺的問題。

chinese.en: Chronic stress at work can gradually damage both your physical and mental health.
chinese.zh: 工作上的長期壓力會逐漸損害你的身心健康。

english.en: The city has had a chronic problem with traffic jams for years.
english.zh: 這座城市多年來一直有長期的塞車問題。

speak.en: Honestly, I'm a chronic procrastinator, especially when it comes to homework.
speak.zh: 老實說，我是個習慣性拖延的人，尤其是寫作業的時候。

write.en: Schools should teach children healthy eating habits to reduce chronic illness later in life.
write.zh: 學校應該教導孩子健康的飲食習慣，以降低日後罹患慢性病的機率。

example.en: Instead of judging the idea by who suggested it, the committee decided to consider it on its merits.
example.zh: 委員會決定不看提案人是誰，而是就這個構想本身的優劣來考量。

listen.en: His suggestion merits serious attention from the whole team.
listen.zh: 他的建議值得整個團隊認真看待。

chinese.en: Many people believe scholarships should be awarded based on merit rather than family background.
chinese.zh: 許多人認為獎學金應該依據個人表現頒發，而不是看家庭背景。

english.en: This essay discusses the merits and drawbacks of studying abroad.
english.zh: 這篇文章探討出國留學的優缺點。

speak.en: I think there's some merit in learning to cook at school.
speak.zh: 我覺得在學校學做菜有一定的價值。

write.en: The film has little artistic merit, but it is still very entertaining.
write.zh: 這部電影沒什麼藝術價值，但還是很有娛樂性。

example.en: Old houses may look charming, but they often need expensive maintenance, such as fixing roofs and pipes.
example.zh: 老房子看起來或許很有味道，但常需要昂貴的維修，像是修屋頂和水管。

listen.en: The website is down for maintenance until later tonight.
listen.zh: 網站正在維護中，要到今晚稍晚才會恢復。

chinese.en: The city spends a large part of its budget on the maintenance of public roads.
chinese.zh: 這座城市將很大一部分預算花在公共道路的維護上。

english.en: Regular maintenance can help your old car last a lot longer.
english.zh: 定期保養可以讓你的舊車用得更久。

speak.en: I prefer low-maintenance plants because I always forget to water them.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡好照顧的植物，因為我老是忘記澆水。

write.en: The school hired an extra maintenance worker to look after the gardens and classrooms.
write.zh: 學校多聘了一名維修人員來照顧花園和教室。

example.en: Before the surgery, the doctor explained the risks carefully and asked the patient to sign a consent form.
example.zh: 手術前，醫生仔細說明風險，並請病人簽署同意書。

listen.en: Her parents finally consented to her plan to study abroad.
listen.zh: 她的父母終於同意她出國留學的計畫。

chinese.en: Younger students need written consent from a parent before joining the school trip.
chinese.zh: 年紀較小的學生參加校外旅行前，需要家長的書面同意。

english.en: The manager consented to my request for a week off.
english.zh: 經理同意了我請一週假的申請。

speak.en: I always ask for consent before taking photos of strangers.
speak.zh: 我拍陌生人之前，一定會先徵求對方同意。

write.en: By ticking this box, you give your consent for us to store your data.
write.zh: 勾選此方框，即表示你同意我們儲存你的資料。

example.en: The wallpaper featured a delicate floral motif, with small roses repeated across every wall of the room.
example.zh: 壁紙上有細緻的花卉圖案，一朵朵小玫瑰在房間的每面牆上重複出現。

listen.en: The dragon is a common motif in Chinese art.
listen.zh: 龍是中華藝術中常見的圖案。

chinese.en: In her lecture, the professor traced the motif of exile through several modern poems.
chinese.zh: 教授在課堂上追溯了「流亡」這個主題在幾首現代詩中的發展。

english.en: The designer used a simple leaf motif on all the cups.
english.zh: 設計師在所有杯子上都用了簡單的葉子圖案。

speak.en: I love how the same musical motif keeps coming back in the film.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡同一段音樂主題在電影裡一再出現。

write.en: The company's new logo combines a mountain motif with clean, modern lettering.
write.zh: 公司的新標誌結合了山形圖案與簡潔現代的字體。

example.en: After months of research, the team finally submitted its proposal to the city council for approval.
example.zh: 經過數月研究，團隊終於把提案送交市議會審核。

listen.en: Please submit your application form by Friday afternoon.
listen.zh: 請在星期五下午前提交申請表。

chinese.en: The small company refused to submit to pressure from its larger competitors.
chinese.zh: 這家小公司不肯向大型競爭對手的壓力低頭。

english.en: I submitted my monthly report to my manager this morning.
english.zh: 我今天早上把月報交給主管了。

speak.en: Honestly, I always submit my work at the very last minute.
speak.zh: 老實說，我總是拖到最後一刻才交作業。

write.en: Visitors who wish to enter the building must submit to a brief security check.
write.zh: 想進入大樓的訪客必須接受簡短的安全檢查。

example.en: The old dormitory had no air conditioning, so students often studied in the library until it closed.
example.zh: 舊宿舍沒有冷氣，所以學生常待在圖書館讀書，直到閉館。

listen.en: My dormitory room is small but very quiet.
listen.zh: 我的宿舍房間很小，但非常安靜。

chinese.en: The university plans to build a new dormitory to ease the shortage of student housing.
chinese.zh: 這所大學計畫興建新宿舍，以緩解學生住處不足的問題。

english.en: Living in a dormitory helped me make new friends quickly.
english.zh: 住宿舍讓我很快就交到新朋友。

speak.en: To be honest, sharing a dormitory with strangers was hard at first.
speak.zh: 老實說，一開始要和陌生人同住宿舍真的很難適應。

write.en: The factory provides a dormitory for workers who come from distant villages.
write.zh: 工廠為來自偏遠村莊的員工提供宿舍。

example.en: Without a major sponsor to cover the costs, the festival organisers had to cancel several outdoor concerts.
example.zh: 由於沒有大型贊助商負擔費用，音樂節主辦單位只好取消好幾場戶外演唱會。

listen.en: The football team is looking for a new sponsor.
listen.zh: 這支足球隊正在尋找新的贊助商。

chinese.en: The research project is sponsored by a government agency that supports renewable energy.
chinese.zh: 這項研究計畫由一個支持再生能源的政府機構贊助。

english.en: My company sponsors a few students to study abroad every year.
english.zh: 我的公司每年資助幾名學生出國留學。

speak.en: I think big brands sponsor sports events mainly to build their image.
speak.zh: 我認為大品牌贊助體育賽事主要是為了建立形象。

write.en: Our family has sponsored a child in Kenya for years, paying for her school fees.
write.zh: 我們家多年來一直資助一名肯亞的孩子，替她支付學費。

example.en: Only when the doctor explained the test results did the family understand the gravity of his illness.
example.zh: 直到醫生解釋檢查結果，家人才明白他病情的嚴重性。

listen.en: Without gravity, water would float around the room.
listen.zh: 如果沒有重力，水會在房間裡飄來飄去。

chinese.en: The manager stressed the gravity of the error and asked everyone to double-check their work.
chinese.zh: 經理強調這個錯誤的嚴重性，並要求大家仔細複查自己的工作。

english.en: The ball fell back to the ground because of gravity.
english.zh: 因為重力，球又掉回地面。

speak.en: I don't think people realise the gravity of climate change yet.
speak.zh: 我覺得大家還沒意識到氣候變遷有多嚴重。

write.en: Tall vehicles have a high centre of gravity, so they can tip over easily.
write.zh: 車身高的車輛重心較高，所以容易翻覆。

example.en: Unlike postgraduates, undergraduates usually attend large lectures and follow a fixed timetable set by the department.
example.zh: 和研究生不同，大學部學生通常上大班課程，並依照系上排定的固定課表。

listen.en: He finished his undergraduate degree and then found a job.
listen.zh: 他讀完大學學位後就找到了工作。

chinese.en: The survey shows that many undergraduates work part-time to help pay their living expenses.
chinese.zh: 調查顯示，許多大學生打工來分擔生活開銷。

english.en: This course is open to all undergraduate students at the university.
english.zh: 這門課開放給這所大學所有的大學部學生。

speak.en: Looking back, my undergraduate years were the best time of my life.
speak.zh: 回想起來，大學那幾年是我人生中最美好的時光。

write.en: The lab hires undergraduate assistants to help collect data during the summer holiday.
write.zh: 實驗室在暑假期間僱用大學部學生當助理，協助蒐集資料。

example.en: The restaurant's wine cellar holds hundreds of bottles, stored at a steady temperature away from sunlight.
example.zh: 這家餐廳的酒窖存放了數百瓶酒，保存在不見陽光的恆溫環境中。

listen.en: Grandpa went down to the cellar to find a ladder.
listen.zh: 爺爺下到地窖去找梯子。

chinese.en: During the storm, the family sheltered in the cellar until the strong winds had passed.
chinese.zh: 暴風雨期間，一家人躲在地窖裡，直到強風過去。

english.en: The old house has a damp cellar full of boxes.
english.zh: 那棟老房子有一間堆滿箱子的潮濕地窖。

speak.en: Honestly, I'd be too scared to go into that dark cellar alone.
speak.zh: 說真的，我不敢一個人走進那個黑漆漆的地窖。

write.en: Many old pubs in Britain keep their beer barrels in cellars beneath the bar.
write.zh: 英國許多老酒吧把啤酒桶存放在吧檯下方的地窖裡。

example.en: When the temperature rises too high, the enzyme changes shape and can no longer speed up the reaction.
example.zh: 溫度一旦過高，酶就會改變形狀，無法再加速反應。

listen.en: Some laundry powders contain enzymes that remove stains.
listen.zh: 有些洗衣粉含有能去除污漬的酵素。

chinese.en: People who lack a certain enzyme cannot properly digest the sugar found in milk.
chinese.zh: 缺乏某種酵素的人無法正常消化牛奶中的糖分。

english.en: The stomach produces enzymes that help our bodies digest protein.
english.zh: 胃會分泌幫助身體消化蛋白質的酵素。

speak.en: I've heard pineapple contains an enzyme that makes meat more tender.
speak.zh: 我聽說鳳梨含有一種能讓肉變嫩的酵素。

write.en: Scientists are developing enzymes that can break down plastic waste much faster than natural processes.
write.zh: 科學家正在研發酵素，能比自然過程更快分解塑膠廢棄物。

example.en: The chart shows that the vast majority of households now own a smartphone, while only a few do not.
example.zh: 圖表顯示，現在絕大多數家庭都有智慧型手機，只有少數沒有。

listen.en: The proposal was passed by a large majority at the meeting.
listen.zh: 這項提案在會議上以壓倒性多數通過。

chinese.en: In many cities, the majority of young adults cannot afford to buy their own homes.
chinese.zh: 在許多城市，大多數年輕人都買不起自己的房子。

english.en: The majority of my classmates take the bus to school.
english.zh: 我大多數的同學都搭公車上學。

speak.en: I'd say the majority of people my age shop online regularly.
speak.zh: 我會說我這個年紀的人大多數都常常網購。

write.en: Women are in the majority in the nursing profession, though this is slowly changing.
write.zh: 護理業以女性占多數，不過這個情況正在慢慢改變。

example.en: Online banking was a major innovation, allowing customers to pay bills without ever visiting a branch.
example.zh: 網路銀行是一項重大創新，讓顧客完全不必到分行就能繳費。

listen.en: Our teacher always rewards innovation in group projects.
listen.zh: 我們老師總是會獎勵分組作業中的創新表現。

chinese.en: Rapid innovation in battery technology has made electric cars far more practical than before.
chinese.zh: 電池技術的快速創新，讓電動車比以前實用許多。

english.en: The smartphone is one of the greatest innovations of our time.
english.zh: 智慧型手機是我們這個時代最偉大的發明之一。

speak.en: I think innovation matters more than size for most companies today.
speak.zh: 我認為對現今大多數公司來說，創新比規模更重要。

write.en: The hospital's latest innovation lets patients check in using a simple app on their phones.
write.zh: 這家醫院最新的創新做法，讓病患用手機上的簡單應用程式就能完成報到。

example.en: Because the bonus depended on sales, staff had a strong incentive to keep customers happy and coming back.
example.zh: 因為獎金取決於業績，員工很有動力讓顧客滿意並再度上門。

listen.en: Free coffee is a nice incentive to arrive early.
listen.zh: 免費咖啡是讓人早點到的好誘因。

chinese.en: The city offers tax incentives to companies that install solar panels on their buildings.
chinese.zh: 市政府提供租稅優惠給在建築物上安裝太陽能板的公司。

english.en: Good grades are an incentive for students to study harder.
english.zh: 好成績是激勵學生更用功的誘因。

speak.en: Without any real incentive, I find it hard to exercise regularly.
speak.zh: 如果沒有實際的誘因，我很難規律運動。

write.en: If recycling earned people small cash rewards, there would be more incentive to sort rubbish.
write.zh: 如果做資源回收能拿到小額現金獎勵，大家就更有動力做垃圾分類。

example.en: Much of the airport was built on land reclaimed from the sea, an area that used to be shallow water.
example.zh: 這座機場大部分蓋在填海造出的土地上，那一帶過去原本是淺海。

listen.en: The furniture is made from reclaimed wood from old barns.
listen.zh: 這些家具是用老穀倉拆下的回收木材做成的。

chinese.en: After years of injuries, the runner finally reclaimed her title as national champion.
chinese.zh: 經過多年傷病困擾，這位跑者終於奪回全國冠軍的頭銜。

english.en: Local residents want to reclaim the street for children to play.
english.zh: 當地居民希望收回這條街道，讓孩子可以在那裡玩耍。

speak.en: I'm trying to reclaim my weekends by not checking work emails.
speak.zh: 我正試著不看工作郵件，把週末時間找回來。

write.en: Over time, nature slowly reclaimed the abandoned village, covering the houses with vines and trees.
write.zh: 隨著時間過去，大自然慢慢收復了這座廢棄的村莊，藤蔓和樹木覆蓋了房屋。

example.en: Her early prejudice against city life faded once she moved there and discovered its parks and friendly neighbours.
example.zh: 她搬到城市後發現那裡有公園和友善的鄰居，原本對都市生活的成見也就漸漸消失了。

listen.en: We should judge people by their actions, not by prejudice.
listen.zh: 我們應該根據行為來評判一個人，而不是憑偏見。

chinese.en: Education and travel can help young people overcome prejudice against other cultures.
chinese.zh: 教育和旅行能幫助年輕人克服對其他文化的偏見。

english.en: I had a prejudice against online courses until I took one.
english.zh: 在我實際上過線上課程之前，我一直對它有偏見。

speak.en: Honestly, I think everyone has some prejudices, even if they deny it.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得每個人多少都有些偏見，就算他們不承認。

write.en: The company trains its interviewers to recognise their own prejudices before hiring new staff.
write.zh: 這家公司在招募新員工前，會先訓練面試官察覺自己的偏見。

example.en: After years of struggling, the small shop finally succumbed to rising rents and closed its doors last month.
example.zh: 經過多年苦撐，這家小店終究不敵租金上漲，上個月關門了。

listen.en: Many students succumb to stress during the exam period.
listen.zh: 許多學生在考試期間被壓力壓垮。

chinese.en: Several old trees in the park succumbed to disease and had to be cut down.
chinese.zh: 公園裡有幾棵老樹因病害而枯死，只好砍除。

english.en: He finally succumbed to pressure from his friends and joined the gym.
english.zh: 他最後還是敵不過朋友的壓力，加入了健身房。

speak.en: I always succumb to late-night snacks when I'm studying for exams.
speak.zh: 我準備考試的時候，總是抵擋不了宵夜的誘惑。

write.en: The elderly patient succumbed to pneumonia despite the efforts of the medical team.
write.zh: 儘管醫療團隊全力搶救，這位年長病患仍因肺炎不治。

example.en: When the car suddenly stopped in front of her, her instinct was to brake hard and grip the wheel.
example.zh: 前方的車突然停下時，她的本能反應是用力踩煞車並緊握方向盤。

listen.en: My instinct told me something was wrong with the deal.
listen.zh: 我的直覺告訴我這筆交易有問題。

chinese.en: Good teachers seem to have a natural instinct for knowing when students are confused.
chinese.zh: 好老師似乎天生就有一種直覺，知道學生什麼時候聽不懂。

english.en: Most parents have a strong instinct to protect their children.
english.zh: 大多數父母都有保護孩子的強烈本能。

speak.en: When I choose a restaurant, I usually just trust my instincts.
speak.zh: 我選餐廳時通常就憑直覺。

write.en: Investors who follow their gut instinct rather than research often regret their decisions later.
write.zh: 只憑直覺而不做研究的投資人，事後往往會後悔自己的決定。

example.en: Although the mistake cost the company a valuable client, the manager forgave him because he admitted it honestly.
example.zh: 雖然這個錯誤讓公司失去一位重要客戶，但因為他誠實承認，經理還是原諒了他。

listen.en: Please forgive me for arriving so late this evening.
listen.zh: 今晚這麼晚才到，請原諒我。

chinese.en: Some charities ask wealthy nations to forgive the debts of the poorest countries.
chinese.zh: 有些慈善團體呼籲富裕國家免除最貧窮國家的債務。

english.en: I will never forgive myself if I miss her wedding.
english.zh: 如果錯過她的婚禮，我永遠不會原諒自己。

speak.en: Forgive me, but I don't think that's quite right.
speak.zh: 不好意思，但我覺得那樣說不太對。
