write.en: You could be forgiven for thinking the café was closed, since the lights were off.
write.zh: 燈都關著，難怪你會以為那家咖啡廳沒開。

example.en: The struggling football club received a large injection of cash from new owners, allowing it to sign better players.
example.zh: 這家經營困難的足球俱樂部獲得新老闆挹注大筆資金，得以簽下更好的球員。

listen.en: Many children are afraid of having an injection.
listen.zh: 很多小孩都很怕打針。

chinese.en: Elderly people are advised to get a flu injection before winter begins.
chinese.zh: 建議長者在入冬前施打流感疫苗。

english.en: The doctor said I needed an injection to stop the pain.
english.zh: 醫生說我需要打一針止痛。

speak.en: I don't mind injections, but I can't watch the needle go in.
speak.zh: 我不怕打針，但我不敢看針頭刺進去。

write.en: The new factory brought a much-needed injection of investment into the rural area.
write.zh: 這座新工廠為鄉村地區帶來急需的投資挹注。

example.en: The weather service issued an urgent bulletin warning residents to stay indoors as the typhoon approached the coast.
example.zh: 隨著颱風逼近沿海，氣象單位發布緊急公告，提醒居民待在室內。

listen.en: We heard the news on the evening bulletin.
listen.zh: 我們是在晚間新聞快報聽到這個消息的。

chinese.en: The club sends a monthly bulletin to members with updates on events and activities.
chinese.zh: 這個社團每月寄給會員一份通訊刊物，報告各項活動的最新消息。

english.en: I read about the job opening in the company bulletin.
english.zh: 我是在公司的內部刊物上看到這個職缺的。

speak.en: I usually catch the news bulletin on the radio while driving.
speak.zh: 我通常邊開車邊聽收音機的新聞快報。

write.en: The hospital released a brief bulletin on the patient's condition after the surgery.
write.zh: 手術後，醫院發布了一份關於病患狀況的簡短公告。

example.en: Although she strongly disagreed with the plan, she refrained from commenting until she had read the full report.
example.zh: 雖然她非常不贊同這項計畫，但在讀完整份報告前，她都忍住沒有發表意見。

listen.en: Please refrain from using your phone during the lecture.
listen.zh: 上課期間請勿使用手機。

chinese.en: 'There's never enough time' is a common refrain among busy parents with young children.
chinese.zh: 「時間永遠不夠用」是家有幼兒的忙碌父母常掛在嘴邊的話。

english.en: I tried to refrain from eating sweets for a whole month.
english.zh: 我試著整整一個月不吃甜食。

speak.en: Everyone in the crowd sang along to the catchy refrain.
speak.zh: 現場觀眾都跟著唱那段朗朗上口的副歌。

write.en: Doctors advise patients to refrain from heavy exercise for several days after the surgery.
write.zh: 醫生建議病患在手術後幾天內避免劇烈運動。

example.en: The small gallery on the corner sells works by local artists and changes its exhibition every few weeks.
example.zh: 街角那家小畫廊販售在地藝術家的作品，每隔幾週就更換展覽。

listen.en: The gallery is free to enter on Sunday mornings.
listen.zh: 這間美術館週日上午免費入場。

chinese.en: Visitors can watch the debate from the public gallery above the main hall.
chinese.zh: 訪客可以從主廳上方的旁聽席觀看辯論。

english.en: My sister works at a gallery that sells modern art.
english.zh: 我姊姊在一家販售現代藝術作品的畫廊工作。

speak.en: I'm not really into art, so I rarely visit galleries.
speak.zh: 我對藝術不太感興趣，所以很少去美術館。

write.en: You can view all the photos from the trip in the online gallery.
write.zh: 你可以在線上相簿瀏覽這趟旅行的所有照片。

example.en: Because space in Taipei apartments is limited, many families prefer compact appliances that can be stored in a cupboard.
example.zh: 由於臺北的公寓空間有限，許多家庭偏好可以收進櫃子裡的小型家電。

listen.en: This compact camera easily fits inside my jacket pocket.
listen.zh: 這台小巧的相機輕鬆就能放進我的外套口袋。

chinese.en: Heavy machines were used to compact the soil before the new road was built.
chinese.zh: 新道路興建之前，先用重型機具把土壤壓實。

english.en: Compact cities make it easier for residents to walk to work.
english.zh: 緊湊型城市讓居民更容易走路上班。

speak.en: I prefer a compact car because parking downtown is a nightmare.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡小型車，因為在市中心停車簡直是惡夢。

write.en: The rubbish is compacted at the transfer station so that each truck can carry more waste.
write.zh: 垃圾在轉運站被壓縮，讓每輛車能載運更多廢棄物。

example.en: In the chart, imported goods constitute the largest share of spending, far ahead of locally produced items.
example.zh: 在這張圖表中，進口商品占支出的比例最高，遠遠超過本地生產的商品。

listen.en: Failing to report the accident could constitute a serious offence.
listen.zh: 未通報這起事故可能構成嚴重的違法行為。

chinese.en: Rising sea levels constitute a real threat to low-lying coastal communities around the world.
chinese.zh: 海平面上升對世界各地低窪的沿海社區構成了真正的威脅。

english.en: Young people constitute a large proportion of online shoppers today.
english.zh: 如今年輕人占網路購物者的很大比例。

speak.en: Honestly, a quick chat by the coffee machine doesn't constitute a meeting.
speak.zh: 老實說，在咖啡機旁邊隨便聊兩句不算是開會。

write.en: A group of strangers who never practise together hardly constitutes a real team.
write.zh: 一群從不一起練習的陌生人，很難稱得上是一支真正的隊伍。

example.en: With the deadline only a day away, it was imperative for the team to finish testing before midnight.
example.zh: 距離截止日只剩一天，團隊必須在午夜前完成測試。

listen.en: It is imperative to back up your files regularly.
listen.zh: 定期備份檔案是絕對必要的。

chinese.en: Reducing carbon emissions has become an economic as well as an environmental imperative.
chinese.zh: 減少碳排放已不只是環境上的當務之急，也是經濟上的必要之舉。

english.en: It is imperative that we protect our drinking water sources.
english.zh: 我們務必要保護飲用水源。

speak.en: In a job like mine, staying calm under pressure is imperative.
speak.zh: 在我這種工作裡，在壓力下保持冷靜是絕對必要的。

write.en: Teachers often explain that sentences like "Close the door" use the imperative.
write.zh: 老師常會說明，像「把門關上」這類句子使用的是祈使語氣。

example.en: Before the automobile became widespread, most people lived close enough to walk or cycle to their workplace.
example.zh: 在汽車普及之前，大多數人住得離工作地點夠近，可以走路或騎腳踏車上班。

listen.en: My grandfather worked in an automobile factory for decades.
listen.zh: 我祖父在一家汽車工廠工作了幾十年。

chinese.en: Exhaust from automobiles remains a major source of air pollution in large cities.
chinese.zh: 汽車廢氣仍是大城市空氣汙染的主要來源。

english.en: The automobile industry employs thousands of workers in this region.
english.zh: 汽車產業在這個地區雇用了數千名員工。

speak.en: To be fair, I think automobiles have made us a bit lazy.
speak.zh: 說句公道話，我覺得汽車讓我們變得有點懶惰。

write.en: The museum displays early automobiles that look more like horse carriages than modern cars.
write.zh: 這間博物館展出早期的汽車，外觀看起來比較像馬車，而不像現代汽車。

example.en: Rather than memorising facts, the course trains students to take an analytical approach to complex problems.
example.zh: 這門課不是要學生死背事實，而是訓練他們用分析的方式處理複雜的問題。

listen.en: She has a very analytical mind and loves puzzles.
listen.zh: 她很有分析頭腦，而且很喜歡解謎。

chinese.en: The report offers an analytical overview of how housing prices have changed recently.
chinese.zh: 這份報告針對近來房價的變化提供了分析性的概述。

english.en: Reading widely can help children develop analytical thinking from an early age.
english.zh: 廣泛閱讀可以幫助孩子從小培養分析思考能力。

speak.en: I'm quite analytical, so I always compare prices before buying.
speak.zh: 我是個蠻會分析的人，所以買東西前一定會比價。

write.en: Doctors need both analytical ability and empathy when diagnosing patients with unusual symptoms.
write.zh: 醫生在診斷症狀特殊的病人時，需要兼具分析能力與同理心。

example.en: Local cafés face stiff competition from international chains that can afford lower prices and bigger advertising budgets.
example.zh: 當地咖啡館面臨國際連鎖品牌的激烈競爭，因為對方負擔得起更低的價格和更多的廣告預算。

listen.en: My legs felt stiff after the long hike yesterday.
listen.zh: 昨天長途健行後，我的雙腿覺得很僵硬。

chinese.en: The new law introduces stiff penalties for drivers caught using their phones.
chinese.zh: 新法對開車時被抓到使用手機的駕駛人祭出重罰。

english.en: This new pair of leather shoes still feels a little stiff.
english.zh: 這雙新皮鞋穿起來還是有點硬。

speak.en: At first the interview felt stiff, but then we both relaxed.
speak.zh: 一開始面試的氣氛有點拘謹，但後來我們都放鬆了。

write.en: A stiff breeze was blowing off the sea as we walked along the harbour.
write.zh: 我們沿著港口散步時，海上吹來一陣強勁的風。

example.en: The renovation was completed at considerable cost, but visitors agree the restored theatre looks magnificent.
example.zh: 這次整修花了相當高的成本，但參觀者都認同修復後的劇院看起來十分壯觀。

listen.en: The proposal has attracted considerable attention from local residents.
listen.zh: 這項提案引起當地居民相當大的關注。

chinese.en: There is considerable evidence that regular exercise improves both mood and memory.
chinese.zh: 有相當多的證據顯示，規律運動能同時改善情緒和記憶力。

english.en: She spent a considerable sum of money on her daughter's education.
english.zh: 她在女兒的教育上花了一大筆錢。

speak.en: To be honest, I've put considerable effort into improving my pronunciation.
speak.zh: 老實說，我花了不少心力改善我的發音。

write.en: Online shopping has caused considerable damage to small family-run stores in rural towns.
write.zh: 網路購物對鄉間小鎮的家庭式小商店造成了相當大的衝擊。

example.en: After months of growing it, he finally shaved off his beard because it felt too hot in summer.
example.zh: 留了好幾個月之後，他終於把鬍子剃掉了，因為夏天實在太熱。

listen.en: He forgot to shave and looked tired at the meeting.
listen.zh: 他忘了刮鬍子，開會時看起來很疲憊。

chinese.en: The new train line will shave almost twenty minutes off the journey to the airport.
chinese.zh: 新的鐵路路線將使前往機場的車程縮短將近二十分鐘。

english.en: Some swimmers shave their arms and legs before a big race.
english.zh: 有些游泳選手會在大型比賽前剃掉手臂和腿上的毛。

speak.en: That was a close shave! The bus nearly hit my bike.
speak.zh: 剛才真是千鈞一髮！公車差點撞上我的腳踏車。

write.en: The company shaved its marketing budget slightly to avoid laying off staff.
write.zh: 公司稍微刪減了行銷預算，以避免裁員。

example.en: The new shopping mall is a concrete monster that blocks the mountain view residents used to enjoy.
example.zh: 新的購物中心是一座混凝土龐然大物，擋住了居民以前能欣賞到的山景。

listen.en: My little brother is scared of the monster under his bed.
listen.zh: 我弟弟很怕床底下的怪物。

chinese.en: Critics argue that social media has become a monster that nobody can fully control.
chinese.zh: 批評者認為，社群媒體已經變成一頭沒有人能完全掌控的怪獸。

english.en: The film tells the story of a friendly monster living in the forest.
english.zh: 這部電影講述一隻住在森林裡的友善怪物的故事。

speak.en: My nephew is adorable, but he turns into a little monster at bedtime.
speak.zh: 我姪子很可愛，但一到睡覺時間就變成小惡魔。

write.en: Ancient sailors told stories of sea monsters to explain storms and shipwrecks.
write.zh: 古代水手會講海怪的故事，來解釋暴風雨和船難。

example.en: Many airlines now let passengers pay a small fee to offset the carbon emissions from their flights.
example.zh: 許多航空公司現在讓乘客支付一小筆費用，來抵銷航班所產生的碳排放。

listen.en: I sold my old desk to help offset moving costs.
listen.zh: 我賣掉舊書桌，好彌補一些搬家的費用。

chinese.en: The drop in tourism was partly offset by an increase in local spending.
chinese.zh: 觀光客減少的影響，有一部分被本地消費的增加所抵銷。

english.en: Planting trees can help offset the effects of air pollution.
english.zh: 種樹有助於抵銷空氣汙染的影響。

speak.en: I walk to work to offset all the snacks I eat.
speak.zh: 我走路上班，來抵銷我吃下的那些零食。

write.en: The company bought carbon offsets, but critics say it should simply cut emissions.
write.zh: 這家公司購買了碳抵換額度，但批評者認為它應該直接減少排放。

example.en: Despite years of public campaigns, the belief that vaccines are dangerous persists in some communities.
example.zh: 儘管多年來有各種公共宣導，認為疫苗很危險的觀念仍存在於一些社群中。

listen.en: Heavy rain is expected to persist throughout the weekend.
listen.zh: 預計大雨會持續整個週末。

chinese.en: He persisted in asking the same question even after the teacher had answered it.
chinese.zh: 即使老師已經回答過了，他還是執意一直問同樣的問題。

english.en: Unfortunately, gender inequality still persists in many workplaces around the world.
english.zh: 遺憾的是，性別不平等仍存在於世界各地的許多職場中。

speak.en: I wanted to quit guitar, but I persisted with it.
speak.zh: 我本來想放棄吉他，但還是堅持下去了。

write.en: The startup persisted through several failed launches before its app finally became popular.
write.zh: 這家新創公司歷經幾次產品發表失敗仍堅持下去，最後它的應用程式終於走紅。

example.en: The author dedicated the novel to her grandmother, who had taught her to love stories as a child.
example.zh: 作者把這本小說獻給她的祖母，因為祖母在她小時候教會她熱愛故事。

listen.en: The museum dedicates an entire floor to local artists.
listen.zh: 這間博物館用一整層樓專門展出本地藝術家的作品。

chinese.en: The government has dedicated more funding to mental health services for teenagers.
chinese.zh: 政府已撥出更多經費投入青少年的心理健康服務。

english.en: I dedicate every Sunday morning to reviewing my English vocabulary.
english.zh: 我把每個星期天早上都用來複習英文單字。

speak.en: If I could, I'd dedicate more time to painting and gardening.
speak.zh: 如果可以的話，我想花更多時間在畫畫和園藝上。

write.en: The new park was dedicated to the firefighters who protected the town during the floods.
write.zh: 這座新公園是為了紀念在水災期間守護小鎮的消防員而建的。

example.en: Before agreeing to the repairs, we asked the mechanic for a written estimate of the total cost.
example.zh: 在同意維修之前，我們請技師提供總費用的書面估價單。

listen.en: Can you estimate how long the journey will take?
listen.zh: 你能估計一下這趟路程要多久嗎？

chinese.en: It is estimated that millions of tonnes of plastic enter the ocean every year.
chinese.zh: 據估計，每年有數百萬噸的塑膠流入海洋。

english.en: By a rough estimate, the party will cost about five hundred dollars.
english.zh: 粗略估計，這場派對大約要花五百美元。

speak.en: I'd estimate I spend about three hours a day on my phone.
speak.zh: 我估計自己一天大概花三個小時在手機上。

write.en: The city's population is estimated to double by the middle of the century.
write.zh: 這座城市的人口預估到本世紀中葉將會倍增。

example.en: As the heatwave continued, electricity demand soared, and the power company urged households to save energy.
example.zh: 隨著熱浪持續，用電需求急遽上升，電力公司呼籲家家戶戶節約用電。

listen.en: An eagle soared high above the quiet green valley.
listen.zh: 一隻老鷹在寧靜翠綠的山谷上空高高翱翔。

chinese.en: The line graph shows that online sales soared between 2015 and 2020.
chinese.zh: 這張折線圖顯示，網路銷售額在2015年到2020年間急遽上升。

english.en: The number of tourists soared after the film was released.
english.zh: 這部電影上映後，觀光客人數急遽增加。

speak.en: My confidence really soared after I passed my driving test.
speak.zh: 通過駕照考試後，我的自信心大增。

write.en: Soaring rents are pushing many young people out of the city centre.
write.zh: 不斷飆漲的房租正把許多年輕人逼離市中心。

example.en: Scientists warn that several species of frog are on the verge of extinction because their wetlands are disappearing.
example.zh: 科學家警告，由於棲息的溼地正在消失，好幾種青蛙已瀕臨絕種。

listen.en: She was on the verge of tears after hearing the news.
listen.zh: 聽到這個消息後，她幾乎要哭出來了。

chinese.en: His comments during the meeting verged on rudeness, and several colleagues looked uncomfortable.
chinese.zh: 他在會議中的發言近乎無禮，好幾位同事看起來都很不自在。

english.en: The team is on the verge of a major scientific breakthrough.
english.zh: 這個團隊即將取得重大的科學突破。

speak.en: By Friday afternoon, I'm usually on the verge of exhaustion.
speak.zh: 到了星期五下午，我通常已經快累垮了。

write.en: The driver pulled onto the grass verge to let the ambulance pass.
write.zh: 駕駛把車開到路邊的草地上，讓救護車通過。

example.en: Although cyclists are still a minority on the roads, their numbers have grown as the city adds more bike lanes.
example.zh: 雖然騎腳踏車的人在路上仍屬少數，但隨著城市增設更多自行車道，人數已逐漸增加。

listen.en: People who prefer tea are in the minority here.
listen.zh: 在這裡，偏好喝茶的人是少數。

chinese.en: Schools should make sure that children from minority groups receive equal opportunities.
chinese.zh: 學校應該確保來自少數族群的孩子獲得平等的機會。

english.en: Many minority languages are disappearing because young people no longer speak them.
english.zh: 許多少數族群的語言正在消失，因為年輕人已經不再說這些語言了。

speak.en: I think only a minority of people actually enjoy public speaking.
speak.zh: 我覺得真正喜歡公開演講的人只是少數。

write.en: The board approved the plan, although a vocal minority strongly opposed it.
write.zh: 董事會通過了這項計畫，儘管有一小群人大聲表達強烈反對。

example.en: Last-minute talks between the union and management averted a strike that would have shut down the city's buses.
example.zh: 工會與資方在最後一刻的協商，避免了一場將使全市公車停擺的罷工。

listen.en: He averted his eyes when the nurse took his blood.
listen.zh: 護理師幫他抽血時，他把視線移開了。

chinese.en: Experts believe that a global food crisis can still be averted if countries cooperate.
chinese.zh: 專家認為，只要各國合作，全球糧食危機仍然可以避免。

english.en: Regular health checks can help avert many serious medical problems.
english.zh: 定期健康檢查有助於避免許多嚴重的醫療問題。

speak.en: We narrowly averted disaster when the oven caught fire last night.
speak.zh: 昨晚烤箱著火時，我們差點釀成大禍。

write.en: Better planning could have averted the traffic chaos during the holiday weekend.
write.zh: 如果規劃得更好，連假期間的交通大亂本來是可以避免的。

example.en: The chart reveals a steep decline in newspaper sales, while the number of online readers rose steadily.
example.zh: 圖表顯示報紙銷量急遽下滑，而線上讀者人數則穩定成長。

listen.en: The ticket prices at that concert were far too steep.
listen.zh: 那場演唱會的票價實在太貴了。

chinese.en: Kyoto is a city steeped in history, with ancient temples on almost every street.
chinese.zh: 京都是一座充滿歷史的城市，幾乎每條街上都有古老的寺廟。

english.en: There has been a steep rise in the cost of electricity.
english.zh: 電費出現了急遽的上漲。

speak.en: Cycling up that steep hill every morning keeps me really fit.
speak.zh: 每天早上騎腳踏車爬那座陡坡，讓我保持很好的體能。

write.en: Steep the tea leaves in hot water for a few minutes before serving.
write.zh: 上桌前，先把茶葉放在熱水中浸泡幾分鐘。

example.en: Because the project was running late, the manager allocated extra staff to the testing team for the final week.
example.zh: 由於專案進度落後，經理在最後一週調派了額外人力給測試團隊。

listen.en: Each student is allocated a locker at the start of term.
listen.zh: 每位學生在學期開始時都會分配到一個置物櫃。

chinese.en: Many people argue that schools should allocate more time to physical education.
chinese.zh: 許多人主張學校應該分配更多時間給體育課。

english.en: I try to allocate an hour every evening for reading novels.
english.zh: 我盡量每天晚上撥出一小時來讀小說。

speak.en: We allocated the chores fairly, so nobody complains anymore.
speak.zh: 我們公平分配了家事，所以現在沒有人再抱怨了。

write.en: On the shuttle bus, seats are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
write.zh: 接駁車的座位採先到先坐的方式分配。

example.en: Elderly people with weak bones are more likely to suffer a hip fracture after even a minor fall.
example.zh: 骨骼脆弱的長者即使只是輕微跌倒，也比較容易發生髖部骨折。

listen.en: The doctor said the X-ray showed a small fracture.
listen.zh: 醫生說X光片顯示有一處小骨折。

chinese.en: Runners who increase their training too quickly risk developing stress fractures in their feet.
chinese.zh: 訓練量增加太快的跑者，雙腳可能會出現疲勞性骨折。

english.en: The earthquake fractured several water pipes beneath the main road.
english.zh: 地震震裂了主要道路下方的好幾條水管。

speak.en: I fractured my ankle playing basketball, so I'm on crutches.
speak.zh: 我打籃球時腳踝骨折，所以現在得撐拐杖。

write.en: Years of arguments over money have badly fractured the once-close family.
write.zh: 多年來為了錢的爭吵，讓這個原本親密的家庭嚴重分裂。

example.en: Instead of staying in the city, the tour group took a short excursion to a quiet fishing village along the coast.
example.zh: 旅行團沒有待在市區，而是到沿岸一個寧靜的漁村做了一趟短程遊覽。

listen.en: The hotel offers free excursions to the nearby hot springs.
listen.zh: 這間飯店提供到附近溫泉的免費短途旅遊。

chinese.en: Field excursions give students a chance to see how classroom theory applies in real life.
chinese.zh: 戶外考察讓學生有機會看到課堂上的理論如何應用在真實生活中。

english.en: We booked a day excursion to the mountains during our holiday.
english.zh: 我們在假期中預訂了一趟到山區的一日遊。

speak.en: My favourite childhood memory is a weekend excursion to the beach with my grandparents.
speak.zh: 我最喜歡的童年回憶是和祖父母去海邊的一次週末出遊。

write.en: The company organised a team-building excursion to help new employees get to know their colleagues.
write.zh: 公司安排了一趟團隊建立的出遊，幫助新進員工認識同事。

example.en: The bathroom fixtures, including the sink, toilet and shower, were all installed when the building was renovated.
example.zh: 浴室的固定設備，包括洗手台、馬桶和淋浴設備，都是大樓翻修時安裝的。

listen.en: The old bookshop has become a fixture of our neighbourhood.
listen.zh: 那家老書店已經成為我們社區不可或缺的一部分。

chinese.en: The football club has announced its fixtures for the coming season, starting in late August.
chinese.zh: 這支足球俱樂部公布了下個賽季的賽程，將於八月下旬開打。

english.en: The rent includes all fixtures and fittings in the flat.
english.zh: 房租包含公寓裡所有的固定裝置與配備。

speak.en: My grandmother was a fixture at the local market every morning.
speak.zh: 我奶奶以前每天早上都會固定出現在當地市場。

write.en: Online meetings have become a permanent fixture of working life since the pandemic.
write.zh: 自疫情以來，線上會議已經成為職場生活中固定不變的一部分。

example.en: Car sales fell sharply at first, but the trend reversed later in the year as fuel prices dropped.
example.zh: 汽車銷量一開始大幅下滑，但隨著油價下跌，這個趨勢在那年稍晚出現反轉。

listen.en: Many young people like to follow the latest fashion trends.
listen.zh: 許多年輕人喜歡追隨最新的流行趨勢。

chinese.en: There is a growing trend towards working from home among employees in the technology sector.
chinese.zh: 在科技業的員工之間，居家工作的趨勢越來越明顯。

english.en: House prices in the capital have trended upwards in recent years.
english.zh: 近年來首都的房價持續呈上漲趨勢。

speak.en: I don't really care about trends; I just wear what's comfortable.
speak.zh: 我其實不太在乎流行，我只穿舒服的衣服。

write.en: The video started trending on social media within hours of being posted.
write.zh: 那支影片發布後幾小時內就登上了社群媒體的熱門排行。

example.en: Because her maths grades kept slipping, her parents arranged private tuition with a retired teacher twice a week.
example.zh: 因為她的數學成績一直下滑，父母幫她安排了一位退休老師，每週上兩次家教課。

listen.en: The university has decided to raise tuition again next year.
listen.zh: 這所大學決定明年再次調漲學費。

chinese.en: Some countries offer free university tuition, while others expect students to take out large loans.
chinese.zh: 有些國家的大學免學費，有些國家則要學生自己背負大筆貸款。

english.en: Tuition at private schools has become too expensive for many families.
english.zh: 私立學校的學費對許多家庭來說已經太貴了。

speak.en: To be honest, I learned more from online videos than from expensive tuition.
speak.zh: 老實說，我從網路影片學到的比昂貴的補習還多。

write.en: The company covers tuition for employees who take evening courses related to their jobs.
write.zh: 公司會替修讀與工作相關夜間課程的員工支付學費。

example.en: The campus has its own library, sports centre, health clinic and supermarket, so students rarely need to leave.
example.zh: 校園裡有自己的圖書館、運動中心、診所和超市，所以學生很少需要外出。

listen.en: We walked around the campus before the lecture started.
listen.zh: 上課前我們在校園裡逛了一圈。

chinese.en: Renting a room off campus is often cheaper, but the daily commute can be exhausting.
chinese.zh: 在校外租房間通常比較便宜，但每天通勤可能會很累人。

english.en: Students are not allowed to smoke anywhere on the university campus.
english.zh: 學生不得在大學校園內的任何地方吸菸。

speak.en: Honestly, campus life was the best part of my university years.
speak.zh: 老實說，校園生活是我大學時期最棒的部分。

write.en: The tech company built a huge campus with gardens, gyms and free cafés for its staff.
write.zh: 這家科技公司為員工打造了一座大型園區，裡面有花園、健身房和免費咖啡廳。

example.en: Farmers dug deep ditches around the fields to improve drainage, so that water would not collect around the roots.
example.zh: 農民在田地四周挖了深溝來改善排水，讓水不會積在作物根部周圍。

listen.en: The city plans to upgrade its old drainage system soon.
listen.zh: 這座城市計畫近期升級老舊的排水系統。

chinese.en: Rapid urban development has covered soil with concrete, putting pressure on drainage networks during storms.
chinese.zh: 快速的都市開發讓土壤被水泥覆蓋，使排水系統在暴風雨期間承受很大壓力。

english.en: This plant needs soil with good drainage to grow well.
english.zh: 這種植物需要排水良好的土壤才能長得好。

speak.en: Our basement keeps flooding, so we finally fixed the drainage.
speak.zh: 我們家地下室一直淹水，所以我們終於把排水修好了。

write.en: Engineers blamed the blocked drainage pipes for the flooding at the train station.
write.zh: 工程師認為火車站淹水是排水管堵塞造成的。

example.en: Repeated delays in funding frustrated the scientists' efforts to finish the research before the deadline.
example.zh: 經費一再延遲，使科學家們想在期限前完成研究的努力受阻。

listen.en: I felt frustrated because the train was late again.
listen.zh: 火車又誤點了，我覺得很沮喪。

chinese.en: Students often feel frustrated when they study hard but their test scores do not improve.
chinese.zh: 學生努力讀書成績卻沒有進步時，常常會感到很挫折。

english.en: Learning a new language can be frustrating at the beginning.
english.zh: 剛開始學一種新語言可能會讓人很挫折。

speak.en: What really frustrates me is slow internet when I'm working from home.
speak.zh: 真正讓我抓狂的是在家工作時網路很慢。

write.en: Bad weather frustrated our plans to climb the mountain over the long weekend.
write.zh: 壞天氣讓我們連假爬山的計畫泡湯了。

example.en: Economists had forecast steady growth, but the sudden rise in energy prices slowed the economy instead.
example.zh: 經濟學家原本預測經濟會穩定成長，但能源價格突然上漲，反而拖慢了經濟。

listen.en: The forecast says the storm will reach the coast tonight.
listen.zh: 預報說暴風雨今晚會抵達沿海地區。

chinese.en: The number of international visitors is forecast to double over the next decade.
chinese.zh: 預計未來十年國際旅客人數將成長一倍。

english.en: Our manager forecasts much higher sales during the holiday season.
english.zh: 我們經理預測假期期間的銷售額會高出許多。

speak.en: I always check the forecast before planning a day out.
speak.zh: 我在規劃出遊前一定會先看天氣預報。

write.en: The company revised its annual profit forecast after losing a major client.
write.zh: 公司失去一位大客戶後，修正了年度獲利預測。

example.en: The survey found that households with young children spend a larger share of their income on food and housing.
example.zh: 調查發現，有年幼子女的家庭把較高比例的收入花在食物和住房上。

listen.en: Washing machines are now common household appliances in most homes.
listen.zh: 洗衣機現在是大多數家庭常見的家電。

chinese.en: The number of single-person households has risen sharply as more young people choose to live alone.
chinese.zh: 隨著越來越多年輕人選擇獨居，單人戶的數量急遽增加。

english.en: Doing household chores with parents can teach children a sense of responsibility.
english.zh: 和父母一起做家事可以培養孩子的責任感。

speak.en: That brand is a household name in Taiwan; everyone's heard of it.
speak.zh: 那個品牌在臺灣家喻戶曉，大家都聽過。

write.en: Rising electricity bills are putting pressure on low-income households across the country.
write.zh: 不斷上漲的電費讓全國的低收入家庭承受壓力。

example.en: In the summer months, demand for electricity often exceeds supply, which can lead to power cuts in some areas.
example.zh: 在夏季月份，用電需求常常超過供應，可能導致部分地區停電。

listen.en: The final cost of the project exceeded our budget.
listen.zh: 這個專案的最終成本超出了我們的預算。

chinese.en: In the final year shown, coal consumption exceeded that of natural gas for the first time.
chinese.zh: 在圖表所示的最後一年，煤炭的消耗量首度超過天然氣。

english.en: The new film's ticket sales have far exceeded everyone's expectations.
english.zh: 這部新電影的票房遠遠超出了所有人的預期。

speak.en: The trip really exceeded my expectations; the food was amazing.
speak.zh: 這趟旅行真的超乎我的預期，食物超好吃。

write.en: Passengers whose luggage exceeds the weight limit must pay an extra fee at check-in.
write.zh: 行李超過重量限制的旅客必須在報到時支付額外費用。

example.en: Despite the heavy rain, attendance at the outdoor concert was higher than the organisers had expected.
example.zh: 儘管下著大雨，戶外音樂會的出席人數仍高於主辦單位的預期。

listen.en: The teacher takes attendance at the start of every class.
listen.zh: 老師每堂課一開始都會點名。

chinese.en: Museum attendance dropped dramatically during the pandemic but has slowly recovered since then.
chinese.zh: 博物館的參觀人數在疫情期間大幅下滑，但之後已慢慢回升。

english.en: The company rewards employees who have perfect attendance all year.
english.zh: 公司會獎勵全年全勤的員工。

speak.en: My attendance wasn't great at university because I worked part-time.
speak.zh: 我大學時出席率不太好，因為我在打工。

write.en: Free school meals have been shown to improve attendance in poorer communities.
write.zh: 研究顯示，免費營養午餐能提高較貧困社區學生的出席率。

example.en: Because so few adults in the village could read or write, the government opened free literacy classes in the evenings.
example.zh: 因為村裡會讀寫的成年人很少，政府在晚上開設了免費的識字班。

listen.en: Media literacy helps young people recognise fake news online.
listen.zh: 媒體素養能幫助年輕人辨識網路上的假新聞。

chinese.en: The country's literacy rate has improved greatly since primary education became free and compulsory.
chinese.zh: 自從初等教育改為免費義務教育後，這個國家的識字率大幅提升。

english.en: Financial literacy should be taught to all teenagers at school.
english.zh: 學校應該教所有青少年理財素養。

speak.en: These days, digital literacy is just as important as reading and writing.
speak.zh: 現在數位素養和讀寫能力一樣重要。

write.en: Our company offers training to improve the computer literacy of older staff members.
write.zh: 我們公司提供培訓課程，提升年長員工的電腦能力。

example.en: The newspaper devoted its entire front page to the flood, with photos of damaged homes and interviews with residents.
example.zh: 報紙用整個頭版報導這場水災，刊登了受損房屋的照片和居民訪談。

listen.en: He devoted his whole career to protecting the environment.
listen.zh: 他把整個職涯都奉獻給環境保護。

chinese.en: The school plans to devote more class time to practical skills such as cooking and budgeting.
chinese.zh: 學校計畫把更多上課時間用在烹飪和理財規劃等實用技能上。

english.en: I want to devote more time to learning English this year.
english.zh: 我今年想花更多時間學英文。

speak.en: My parents devoted themselves to raising us, so I really appreciate them.
speak.zh: 我爸媽全心全意把我們養大，所以我真的很感謝他們。

write.en: Governments should devote greater resources to mental health services for young people.
write.zh: 政府應該投入更多資源在青少年的心理健康服務上。

example.en: The new medicine had only a marginal effect on patients' symptoms, so doctors decided it was not worth the high cost.
example.zh: 這種新藥對患者症狀只有微小的效果，所以醫師認為不值得花那麼高的費用。

listen.en: The difference between these phones is really marginal.
listen.zh: 這幾支手機之間的差異其實很小。

chinese.en: Small farmers often play a marginal role in decisions about national agricultural policy.
chinese.zh: 小農在國家農業政策的決策中往往只扮演邊緣角色。

english.en: Studying longer hours brought only marginal improvements in my grades.
english.zh: 延長讀書時間只讓我的成績些微進步。

speak.en: For me, the price difference is marginal, so I'll choose the nicer one.
speak.zh: 對我來說價差很小，所以我會選比較好看的那個。

write.en: Charities in the city focus on helping marginal communities gain access to education and healthcare.
write.zh: 這座城市的慈善團體致力於幫助邊緣社群獲得教育與醫療資源。

example.en: Police detained two men for questioning after several shops in the area were broken into overnight.
example.zh: 這一帶有幾家商店在夜裡遭人闖入後，警方拘留了兩名男子進行訊問。

listen.en: Customs officers detained the package for a security check.
listen.zh: 海關人員扣留了這個包裹進行安全檢查。

chinese.en: Under the law, suspects cannot be detained for long periods without being charged with a crime.
chinese.zh: 依照法律，嫌疑人在未被起訴的情況下不能被長時間拘留。

english.en: Sorry I'm late; I was detained by an urgent phone call.
english.zh: 抱歉我遲到了，我被一通緊急電話耽擱了。

speak.en: I won't detain you long; I just have a quick question.
speak.zh: 我不會耽誤你太久，只是有個簡單的問題。

write.en: The ship was detained in port for a week after inspectors found safety problems.
write.zh: 檢查人員發現安全問題後，這艘船被扣留在港口一週。

example.en: As the small boat rocked violently in the storm, the passengers clung to the rails, frozen with terror.
example.zh: 小船在暴風雨中劇烈搖晃，乘客們緊抓著欄杆，嚇得動彈不得。

listen.en: She has always had a terror of speaking in public.
listen.zh: 她一直非常害怕在公開場合說話。

chinese.en: For many students, the terror of failing an important exam is worse than the exam itself.
chinese.zh: 對許多學生來說，害怕重要考試不及格的恐懼比考試本身更可怕。

english.en: The dog ran away in terror when it heard the fireworks.
english.zh: 那隻狗聽到煙火聲就嚇得逃走了。

speak.en: My little nephew is a real terror; he never sits still.
speak.zh: 我的小姪子真是個小搗蛋，一刻都坐不住。

write.en: Residents near the volcano lived in terror of another eruption for months.
write.zh: 火山附近的居民好幾個月都活在再次噴發的恐懼中。

example.en: Many investors buy gold as a hedge against inflation, because its value tends to rise when money loses purchasing power.
example.zh: 許多投資人買黃金來防範通膨，因為在貨幣購買力下降時，黃金的價值往往會上升。

listen.en: A thick hedge separates our house from the busy road.
listen.zh: 一道茂密的樹籬把我們家和繁忙的馬路隔開。

chinese.en: When reporters asked about the job cuts, the company spokesperson hedged and avoided giving a clear answer.
chinese.zh: 記者詢問裁員一事時，公司發言人含糊其辭，避免給出明確的答案。

english.en: I applied to several universities just to hedge my bets.
english.zh: 我申請了好幾所大學，就是為了分散風險。

speak.en: I'd love a garden with flowers and a neat hedge around it.
speak.zh: 我很想要一個種滿花、四周圍著整齊樹籬的花園。

write.en: Hedges along farm fields provide important shelter for birds, insects and small animals.
write.zh: 農田邊的樹籬為鳥類、昆蟲和小型動物提供重要的棲身之所。

example.en: Rainfall in the region was well below average last year, so farmers struggled to grow enough rice.
example.zh: 這個地區去年的降雨量遠低於平均，所以農民很難種出足夠的稻米。

listen.en: My test score was just above the class average.
listen.zh: 我的考試成績只比班上平均高一點。

chinese.en: The average age of first-time mothers has risen steadily over the past few decades.
chinese.zh: 過去幾十年來，初次生育的母親平均年齡穩定上升。

english.en: The average worker in this city spends an hour commuting.
english.zh: 這座城市的一般上班族要花一小時通勤。

speak.en: I'd say I'm an average cook; nothing fancy, but it's edible.
speak.zh: 我覺得我的廚藝普普通通，不算高級，但還能吃。

write.en: Our team's sales averaged about fifty thousand dollars a month during the summer.
write.zh: 我們團隊夏季的業績平均每月約五萬美元。

example.en: Large areas of rainforest are cut down every year, as global demand for timber and farmland continues to grow.
example.zh: 隨著全球對木材和農地的需求持續增加，每年都有大片雨林遭到砍伐。

listen.en: These dining chairs are made from recycled timber and metal.
listen.zh: 這些餐椅是用回收木材和金屬做成的。

chinese.en: The timber industry provides many jobs in the region, but it also threatens wildlife habitats.
chinese.zh: 木材業為這個地區提供許多工作機會，但也威脅到野生動物的棲息地。

english.en: Builders are using more timber because it is a renewable material.
english.zh: 建築業者越來越常使用木材，因為它是可再生的材料。

speak.en: I love cabins with timber walls; they feel so warm and cosy.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡木牆的小木屋，感覺好溫暖、好舒適。

write.en: Our design class studied how timber buildings can reduce a city's carbon emissions.
write.zh: 我們的設計課研究了木構建築如何能減少城市的碳排放。

example.en: The dotted line on the graph is only a projection, based on the assumption that current trends will continue.
example.zh: 圖表上的虛線只是推估值，前提是假設目前的趨勢會持續下去。

listen.en: The teacher showed a projection of the map on the wall.
listen.zh: 老師把地圖投影在牆上給大家看。

chinese.en: Our sales projections for next year were too optimistic, so we had to cut the budget.
chinese.zh: 我們對明年的銷售預估太樂觀了，所以只好刪減預算。

english.en: According to projections, sea levels will continue to rise this century.
english.zh: 根據推估，本世紀海平面將持續上升。

speak.en: Watching films on a big projection screen at home is so much fun.
speak.zh: 在家用大投影幕看電影超好玩的。

write.en: Experts warn that projections of future water demand must account for climate change.
write.zh: 專家警告，對未來用水需求的推估必須把氣候變遷納入考量。

example.en: At first the local food tasted weird to me, but after a few weeks I actually started to crave it.
example.zh: 一開始我覺得當地食物味道很怪，但過了幾個星期，我反而開始很想吃。

listen.en: It feels weird to be back at my old school.
listen.zh: 回到以前的學校，感覺好奇怪。

chinese.en: My colleagues thought it was weird that I walked to the office every day.
chinese.zh: 同事覺得我每天走路上班很奇怪。

english.en: It is weird that the shop is closed on a Saturday.
english.zh: 這家店星期六竟然沒開門，真奇怪。

speak.en: Honestly, I had a really weird dream about my exam last night.
speak.zh: 老實說，我昨晚做了一個跟考試有關、超怪的夢。

write.en: Some critics found the film's ending weird, while younger audiences loved its unexpected twists.
write.zh: 有些影評覺得這部電影的結局很怪，年輕觀眾卻很喜歡它出人意料的轉折。

example.en: Before the railway was electrified, a heavy diesel locomotive was needed to haul the coal wagons up the steep hill.
example.zh: 鐵路電氣化之前，得靠一輛笨重的柴油火車頭，才能把運煤車廂拉上陡坡。

listen.en: The children waved as the locomotive passed the station.
listen.zh: 火車頭駛過車站時，孩子們揮手致意。

chinese.en: Our history teacher explained how the steam locomotive changed travel and trade forever.
chinese.zh: 歷史老師向我們說明蒸汽火車頭如何徹底改變了旅行與貿易。

english.en: The museum displays a beautifully restored locomotive from the last century.
english.zh: 博物館展示一輛上個世紀、修復得很漂亮的火車頭。

speak.en: I've always loved locomotives, ever since my grandpa took me to the railway museum.
speak.zh: 自從爺爺帶我去鐵道博物館，我就一直很喜歡火車頭。

write.en: Many economists see exports as the locomotive of the country's economic growth.
write.zh: 許多經濟學家把出口視為這個國家經濟成長的火車頭。

example.en: Tuition fees are paid per semester, so students who drop out halfway may still owe money for the full term.
example.zh: 學費是按學期繳的，所以中途休學的學生可能還是得付整個學期的錢。

listen.en: The new semester starts at the beginning of September.
listen.zh: 新學期在九月初開始。

chinese.en: She spent a semester abroad in Germany and came back far more confident.
chinese.zh: 她到德國交換了一學期，回來後自信多了。

english.en: I have to hand in this report before the semester ends.
english.zh: 我必須在學期結束前交這份報告。

speak.en: To be honest, my first semester at university was pretty stressful.
speak.zh: 老實說，我大學第一個學期壓力滿大的。

write.en: Our company hires part-time interns from the nearby university at the start of every semester.
write.zh: 我們公司每學期初都會從附近的大學招募兼職實習生。

example.en: The graph shows a rapid increase in online sales after the lockdown, followed by a gradual decline.
example.zh: 圖表顯示，封城後網路銷售額急遽增加，之後才逐漸下滑。

listen.en: Doctors were impressed by her rapid recovery after surgery.
listen.zh: 她術後迅速康復，讓醫生印象深刻。

chinese.en: Rapid changes in technology mean workers must keep learning new skills throughout their careers.
chinese.zh: 科技變化迅速，代表勞工在整個職涯中都必須不斷學習新技能。

english.en: The rapid spread of the rumour surprised everyone at school.
english.zh: 那則謠言在學校迅速傳開，讓大家都很驚訝。

speak.en: I think the rapid pace of city life can be quite exhausting.
speak.zh: 我覺得都市生活的步調太快，有時會讓人很疲憊。

write.en: Our project team made rapid progress once we started holding short meetings every morning.
write.zh: 我們專案團隊開始每天早上開簡短會議後，進展就快多了。

example.en: The hotel room had a small balcony overlooking the harbour, where we could watch the boats come in at sunset.
example.zh: 飯店房間有個可以俯瞰港口的小陽台，我們能在那裡看著船隻在夕陽下進港。

listen.en: My mother grows tomatoes and herbs on her balcony.
listen.zh: 我媽媽在陽台種番茄和香草。

chinese.en: Many apartment buildings in Taipei have balconies enclosed with metal bars for safety.
chinese.zh: 臺北許多公寓的陽台都為了安全加裝了鐵窗。

english.en: Our office has a balcony where staff can relax during breaks.
english.zh: 我們辦公室有個陽台，員工休息時可以在那裡放鬆。

speak.en: My dream flat would definitely have a big balcony with a view.
speak.zh: 我理想中的公寓一定要有一個看得到風景的大陽台。

write.en: We booked balcony seats for the concert, so we could see the whole stage clearly.
write.zh: 我們訂了音樂會的樓上座位，所以能清楚看到整個舞台。

example.en: The engineers modified the original design, adding wider doors so that wheelchair users could enter the building easily.
example.zh: 工程師修改了原本的設計，把門加寬，讓輪椅使用者能輕鬆進出大樓。

listen.en: The teacher slightly modified the rules of the game.
listen.zh: 老師稍微修改了遊戲規則。

chinese.en: Many consumers in Europe are still reluctant to buy genetically modified food products.
chinese.zh: 許多歐洲消費者仍然不太願意購買基因改造食品。

english.en: I modified my essay after reading my teacher's helpful comments.
english.zh: 看完老師很有幫助的評語後，我修改了我的作文。

speak.en: I've modified my diet a bit, so I eat less sugar now.
speak.zh: 我稍微調整了飲食，所以現在吃比較少糖。

write.en: In English grammar, adverbs can modify verbs, adjectives and sometimes even whole sentences.
write.zh: 在英文文法中，副詞可以修飾動詞、形容詞，有時甚至能修飾整個句子。

example.en: The budget for road building dwarfs spending on public transport, which receives less than a tenth of the money.
example.zh: 道路建設的預算遠遠超過大眾運輸的支出，後者拿到的經費還不到十分之一。

listen.en: Their tiny boat was dwarfed by the huge cruise ship.
listen.zh: 他們的小船在巨大的郵輪旁顯得非常渺小。

chinese.en: Children love the fairy tale about the princess who lives with a group of friendly dwarfs.
chinese.zh: 孩子們很喜歡那個公主和一群友善小矮人一起生活的童話故事。

english.en: Scientists now classify Pluto as a dwarf planet rather than a planet.
english.zh: 科學家現在把冥王星歸類為矮行星，而不是行星。

speak.en: Standing next to those giant trees, I felt completely dwarfed.
speak.zh: 站在那些巨大的樹旁邊，我覺得自己好渺小。

write.en: Our small startup's marketing budget is dwarfed by those of the big tech companies.
write.zh: 我們這家小型新創公司的行銷預算，和大型科技公司比起來根本微不足道。

example.en: Because the plant only grows in one particular locality near the coast, botanists are trying to protect its habitat.
example.zh: 由於這種植物只生長在沿海某個特定地區，植物學家正努力保護它的棲地。

listen.en: There are very few good schools in this locality.
listen.zh: 這個地區的好學校非常少。

chinese.en: The council plans to build more cycle paths in the immediate locality of the station.
chinese.zh: 地方政府打算在車站周邊增建更多自行車道。

english.en: House prices vary greatly from one locality to another.
english.zh: 房價因地區不同而有很大差異。

speak.en: What I like about this locality is that everything's within walking distance.
speak.zh: 我喜歡這一帶的原因是，需要的東西走路就能到。

write.en: Researchers compared air quality data collected from several industrial localities across the region.
write.zh: 研究人員比較了從該區域數個工業地區收集到的空氣品質資料。

example.en: The accountant noticed a discrepancy in the figures: the receipts added up to far less than the amount recorded.
example.zh: 會計師發現數字有出入：收據加總起來遠少於帳上記錄的金額。

listen.en: Can you explain the discrepancy between these figures?
listen.zh: 你能解釋這些數字之間的差異嗎？

chinese.en: The chart reveals a striking discrepancy between the salaries of male and female workers.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示男性與女性員工的薪資有明顯落差。

english.en: The police found several discrepancies in the witness's version of events.
english.zh: 警方發現證人的說法有好幾處前後不一。

speak.en: I noticed a big discrepancy between the price online and in the store.
speak.zh: 我發現網路上的價格和店裡的價格差很多。

write.en: Teachers worry about the growing discrepancy between students' exam results and their practical skills.
write.zh: 老師們擔心學生的考試成績和實際能力之間的落差越來越大。

example.en: The driver sustained serious injuries in the crash and had to stay in hospital for weeks.
example.zh: 那名駕駛在車禍中受了重傷，必須住院好幾個星期。

listen.en: It is hard to sustain interest in a long lecture.
listen.zh: 冗長的課很難讓人一直保持興趣。

chinese.en: Without enough rainfall, the land cannot sustain the crops that farmers depend on.
chinese.zh: 沒有足夠的雨量，這片土地就養不活農民賴以維生的作物。

english.en: Exercise helps me sustain my energy throughout the working day.
english.zh: 運動幫助我在整個工作日都保持精力。

speak.en: I find it really hard to sustain a healthy diet when I'm busy.
speak.zh: 我發現忙的時候真的很難維持健康的飲食。

write.en: Many coastal towns sustained heavy damage when the storm hit last autumn.
write.zh: 去年秋天暴風雨來襲時，許多沿海城鎮受到嚴重損害。

example.en: My brother is a real coffee addict; he gets a headache if he skips his morning cup.
example.zh: 我哥是重度咖啡控，早上沒喝那杯咖啡就會頭痛。

listen.en: He admitted that he had become a shopping addict.
listen.zh: 他承認自己已經變成購物狂了。

chinese.en: Experts argue that gambling addicts need medical treatment rather than simple punishment.
chinese.zh: 專家主張，賭博成癮者需要的是醫療，而不是單純的懲罰。

english.en: My younger sister has become a real social media addict lately.
english.zh: 我妹妹最近真的對社群媒體上癮了。

speak.en: I'll admit I'm a bit of a TV addict at weekends.
speak.zh: 我承認我週末有點沉迷電視。

write.en: Some employees are so addicted to work that they check emails even on holiday.
write.zh: 有些員工工作成癮，連放假都在收信。

example.en: Hosting an international tournament can boost tourism, but the stadiums built for it are often left empty afterwards.
example.zh: 舉辦國際賽事可以帶動觀光，但為此興建的體育場事後常常閒置。

listen.en: She was knocked out early in the tennis tournament.
listen.zh: 她在網球錦標賽中很早就被淘汰了。

chinese.en: Thousands of fans travelled abroad to watch their national team play in the tournament.
chinese.zh: 數千名球迷出國觀看國家隊在錦標賽中出賽。

english.en: My company organises a badminton tournament for its staff every spring.
english.zh: 我們公司每年春天都會為員工舉辦羽球比賽。

speak.en: I entered a chess tournament once, but I lost every game.
speak.zh: 我參加過一次西洋棋比賽，結果每一局都輸。

write.en: The online gaming tournament attracted millions of viewers, showing how popular esports have become.
write.zh: 這場線上電競比賽吸引了數百萬名觀眾，可見電競已經變得多麼受歡迎。

example.en: Working two jobs, Mark could only snatch a few hours of sleep before heading back to the restaurant.
example.zh: 馬克身兼兩份工作，只能抓緊時間睡幾個小時，就又得回餐廳上班。

listen.en: The little boy snatched the toy from his sister.
listen.zh: 小男孩從姊姊手中搶走了玩具。

chinese.en: The visiting team snatched victory in the final minute of the match.
chinese.zh: 客隊在比賽最後一分鐘搶下勝利。

english.en: I snatched a quick lunch between my morning and afternoon classes.
english.zh: 我在上午和下午的課之間匆匆吃了午餐。

speak.en: Someone tried to snatch my phone when I was travelling in Europe.
speak.zh: 我在歐洲旅行時，有人想搶我的手機。

write.en: During the busy conference, I managed to snatch a few words with the keynote speaker.
write.zh: 在忙碌的研討會中，我好不容易抓到機會和主講人說了幾句話。

example.en: Although some months showed small drops, the overall trend in visitor numbers was clearly upward.
example.zh: 雖然有幾個月略微下滑，但遊客人數的整體趨勢明顯向上。

listen.en: Overall, I really enjoyed my time at university.
listen.zh: 整體來說，我很享受大學時光。

chinese.en: Overall, the proportion of people working from home rose sharply over the period.
chinese.zh: 整體而言，在家工作的人口比例在這段期間急遽上升。

english.en: Our team's overall performance has improved a lot this year.
english.zh: 我們團隊今年的整體表現進步很多。

speak.en: It rained quite a bit, but overall it was a great holiday.
speak.zh: 雖然下了不少雨，但整體來說是個很棒的假期。

write.en: The government's overall aim is to reduce traffic congestion in the city centre.
write.zh: 政府的整體目標是減少市中心的交通壅塞。

example.en: Universities should support the pursuit of knowledge for its own sake, not just research that brings in money.
example.zh: 大學應該支持純粹為了求知而做的研究，而不只是能帶來收入的研究。

listen.en: The thief ran off, with the police in hot pursuit.
listen.zh: 小偷拔腿就跑，警察在後面緊追不捨。

chinese.en: Students were encouraged to balance their studies with sports and other outdoor pursuits.
chinese.zh: 學校鼓勵學生在課業之外，也兼顧運動和其他戶外活動。

english.en: My grandfather spends most of his time on leisure pursuits like fishing and gardening.
english.zh: 我爺爺大部分時間都花在釣魚、園藝等休閒活動上。

speak.en: For me, the pursuit of happiness matters more than making lots of money.
speak.zh: 對我來說，追求快樂比賺很多錢更重要。

write.en: The company's relentless pursuit of profit led to serious cuts in staff training.
write.zh: 這家公司一味追求利潤，導致員工訓練經費被大幅刪減。

example.en: Even after losing the final, the young player shook hands with her opponent and accepted defeat with dignity.
example.zh: 即使在決賽落敗，那位年輕選手仍和對手握手，很有風度地接受失敗。

listen.en: Older people should be able to live with dignity.
listen.zh: 年長者應該能夠有尊嚴地生活。

chinese.en: Low wages and poor working conditions can rob workers of their dignity.
chinese.zh: 低薪和惡劣的工作環境可能會剝奪勞工的尊嚴。

english.en: He kept his dignity even when the audience laughed at him.
english.zh: 即使觀眾嘲笑他，他依然保持尊嚴。

speak.en: Honestly, falling over on stage wasn't great for my dignity.
speak.zh: 老實說，在台上跌倒真的讓我有點顏面掃地。

write.en: The new care home was carefully designed to protect the privacy and dignity of its residents.
write.zh: 這間新的安養院經過精心設計，以保護住民的隱私與尊嚴。

example.en: Piles of old newspapers blocking the stairs are a fire hazard, so the landlord asked tenants to clear them away.
example.zh: 堆在樓梯間的舊報紙有引發火災的危險，所以房東要求房客清掉。

listen.en: Wet floors can be a real hazard for older people.
listen.zh: 濕滑的地板對年長者來說可能非常危險。

chinese.en: Workers must wear protective clothing to reduce exposure to chemical hazards in the factory.
chinese.zh: 工人必須穿戴防護衣，以減少在工廠接觸有害化學物質的機會。

english.en: I wouldn't like to hazard a guess about the final score.
english.zh: 我不想貿然猜測最後的比數。

speak.en: Honestly, the potholes on my street are a real hazard for cyclists.
speak.zh: 老實說，我家那條街上的坑洞對騎腳踏車的人來說很危險。

write.en: Coastal communities face growing natural hazards such as flooding and erosion as sea levels rise.
write.zh: 隨著海平面上升，沿海社區面臨越來越多洪水、海岸侵蝕等天然災害。

example.en: Unlike lectures, our weekly seminars involve only a handful of students, and everyone is expected to join the discussion.
example.zh: 跟大堂課不同，我們每週的討論課只有少數幾個學生，而且每個人都要參與討論。

listen.en: Please bring your reading notes to the seminar.
listen.zh: 請帶你的閱讀筆記來上討論課。

chinese.en: The company sends new managers to a leadership seminar during their first month.
chinese.zh: 公司會在新任主管上任第一個月，派他們去參加領導力研習會。

english.en: Our professor asked me to lead the seminar next week.
english.zh: 教授請我主持下週的討論課。

speak.en: I usually feel a bit nervous before speaking up in seminars.
speak.zh: 在討論課上發言前，我通常會有點緊張。

write.en: The city government held a free seminar to teach residents how to prepare for earthquakes.
write.zh: 市政府舉辦了一場免費講座，教市民如何做好防震準備。

example.en: Thanks to cheaper flights, the cost of travelling abroad has nearly halved, so more families now holiday overseas.
example.zh: 由於機票變便宜，出國旅遊的費用幾乎減半，因此現在有更多家庭出國度假。

listen.en: She halved the sandwich and gave a piece to her brother.
listen.zh: 她把三明治對半切，分一塊給弟弟。

chinese.en: According to the chart, the number of smokers halved over the twenty-year period.
chinese.zh: 根據圖表，吸菸人數在這二十年間減少了一半。

english.en: You can halve the recipe if you are only cooking for yourself.
english.zh: 如果你只煮給自己吃，可以把食譜的份量減半。

speak.en: I've halved the amount of time I spend on my phone.
speak.zh: 我已經把滑手機的時間減少了一半。

write.en: The school plans to halve class sizes so that teachers can give each student more attention.
write.zh: 學校計畫將班級人數減半，讓老師能更照顧到每位學生。

example.en: The idea sounded brilliant in the meeting, but it was poorly executed, so customers never understood what the new app was for.
example.zh: 這個點子在會議上聽起來很棒，但執行得很差，所以顧客始終搞不懂這個新 App 是做什麼用的。

listen.en: The computer executes each command in the correct order.
listen.zh: 電腦會依照正確的順序執行每一道指令。

chinese.en: Governments often have good policies on paper but fail to execute them effectively.
chinese.zh: 政府的政策常常紙上看起來很好，卻無法有效執行。

english.en: The young gymnast executed a difficult jump with perfect balance.
english.zh: 那位年輕的體操選手以完美的平衡完成了一個高難度跳躍。

speak.en: Planning a group trip is easy, but executing it is another story.
speak.zh: 規劃團體旅行很簡單，但真正執行起來又是另一回事。

write.en: Our coach told us that a simple strategy, well executed, beats a clever one done badly.
write.zh: 教練告訴我們，執行到位的簡單策略，勝過執行不佳的聰明策略。

example.en: Although the twins are identical, their friends can easily tell them apart by the way they laugh.
example.zh: 雖然這對雙胞胎長得一模一樣，朋友們還是能從他們的笑聲輕易分辨出誰是誰。

listen.en: My answer was almost identical to the model answer in the textbook.
listen.zh: 我的答案和課本裡的範例答案幾乎完全相同。

chinese.en: Scientists repeated the experiment under identical conditions to make sure the results were reliable.
chinese.zh: 科學家在完全相同的條件下重複實驗，以確保結果可靠。

english.en: Her new phone is identical to mine, except for the colour.
english.zh: 她的新手機除了顏色以外，和我的一模一樣。

speak.en: Honestly, a lot of chain restaurants feel identical to me these days.
speak.zh: 老實說，現在很多連鎖餐廳在我看來都一模一樣。

write.en: Many new apartment buildings in the city share almost identical designs, which makes neighbourhoods look dull.
write.zh: 這座城市許多新公寓大樓的設計幾乎完全相同，讓街區看起來很單調。

example.en: Since the factory closed, the river has become cleaner, and wildlife such as otters and herons has returned.
example.zh: 自從工廠關閉後，河水變得比較乾淨，水獺和蒼鷺等野生動物也回來了。

listen.en: We saw a lot of wildlife on our walk this morning.
listen.zh: 我們今天早上散步時看到很多野生動物。

chinese.en: Building a new highway through the forest could seriously damage the habitat of local wildlife.
chinese.zh: 在森林裡興建新的公路，可能會嚴重破壞當地野生動物的棲息地。

english.en: The government should do more to protect wildlife from pollution.
english.zh: 政府應該更努力保護野生動物免受汙染。

speak.en: I love watching wildlife documentaries, especially the ones about the ocean.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡看野生動物紀錄片，尤其是關於海洋的。

write.en: Volunteers at the wildlife centre care for injured birds until they are strong enough to fly.
write.zh: 野生動物救援中心的志工會照顧受傷的鳥，直到牠們強壯到能夠飛翔。

example.en: Psychology and economics are separate disciplines, yet researchers increasingly combine methods from both fields.
example.zh: 心理學和經濟學是不同的學科，但研究人員越來越常結合這兩個領域的研究方法。

listen.en: The new teacher struggled to maintain discipline in the classroom.
listen.zh: 那位新老師很難維持課堂秩序。

chinese.en: The company disciplined two employees for sharing confidential information with a competitor.
chinese.zh: 公司懲處了兩名把機密資訊洩漏給競爭對手的員工。

english.en: Working from home takes discipline, because nobody checks what you are doing.
english.zh: 在家工作需要自律，因為沒有人會檢查你在做什麼。

speak.en: I wish I had more discipline when it comes to exercising.
speak.zh: 說到運動，我真希望自己能更自律一點。

write.en: Some parents believe children should be disciplined calmly rather than shouted at.
write.zh: 有些家長認為管教孩子應該心平氣和，而不是對他們大吼大叫。

example.en: The doctor said it was just a routine check-up and that there was nothing to worry about.
example.zh: 醫生說這只是例行檢查，沒有什麼好擔心的。

listen.en: My morning routine changed completely after the baby arrived.
listen.zh: 寶寶出生後，我早上的作息完全改變了。

chinese.en: Many office workers find that their routine becomes boring after a few years in the same job.
chinese.zh: 許多上班族發現，在同一份工作待了幾年後，日常例行公事會變得很無聊。

english.en: Students should develop a study routine before the exam period starts.
english.zh: 學生應該在考試期開始前，建立固定的讀書習慣。

speak.en: To be honest, I'm not very good at sticking to a routine.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不太擅長維持固定的作息。

write.en: At the factory, safety inspections have become so routine that some staff barely pay attention.
write.zh: 在這間工廠裡，安全檢查已經變得太例行公事，有些員工幾乎不再注意。

example.en: The previous tenants left the flat in a terrible state, so the owner had to repaint every room.
example.zh: 前任房客把公寓弄得一團糟，所以屋主只好把每個房間都重新粉刷。

listen.en: The new tenants upstairs seem friendly and very quiet.
listen.zh: 樓上的新房客看起來很友善，也很安靜。

chinese.en: In many cities, tenants are struggling because rents are rising faster than wages.
chinese.zh: 在許多城市，房租漲得比薪水還快，讓租屋族生活很辛苦。

english.en: As a tenant, you have the right to ask for repairs.
english.zh: 身為房客，你有權要求維修。

speak.en: I've been a tenant for years, so I'd love to own a place.
speak.zh: 我已經租屋好多年了，所以很想擁有自己的房子。

write.en: The shopping mall is looking for new tenants after several stores closed during the pandemic.
write.zh: 疫情期間有好幾家店倒閉後，這間購物中心正在尋找新的承租商家。

example.en: Because so many students wanted to enrol, the university opened a waiting list for the popular design programme.
example.zh: 由於想註冊的學生太多，大學為這個熱門的設計學程開放了候補名單。

listen.en: My brother enrolled at a university near the coast.
listen.zh: 我哥哥進了一所靠近海邊的大學就讀。

chinese.en: Parents in rural areas are often unable to enrol their children in good schools.
chinese.zh: 偏鄉地區的家長往往無法讓孩子進入好學校就讀。

english.en: I have enrolled on a cooking course at the community centre.
english.zh: 我報名了社區活動中心的烹飪課。

speak.en: I'm thinking of enrolling in a yoga class after work.
speak.zh: 我在考慮下班後去報名瑜伽課。

write.en: The company automatically enrols new staff in its pension scheme unless they choose to opt out.
write.zh: 除非新進員工選擇退出，否則公司會自動幫他們加入退休金計畫。

example.en: Medical students must learn a huge amount of technical vocabulary, including the names of hundreds of bones and muscles.
example.zh: 醫學系學生必須學大量的專業詞彙，包括數百塊骨頭和肌肉的名稱。

listen.en: Her vocabulary is really impressive for a young child.
listen.zh: 以年幼的孩子來說，她的詞彙量真的很驚人。

chinese.en: Using a wider range of vocabulary in your essays can help you achieve a higher score.
chinese.zh: 在作文中使用更多樣的詞彙，能幫助你拿到更高的分數。

english.en: I write down new vocabulary in a small notebook every day.
english.zh: 我每天都把新學的單字寫在一本小筆記本裡。

speak.en: Watching films without subtitles has really improved my vocabulary.
speak.zh: 看沒有字幕的電影真的讓我的字彙量進步很多。

write.en: Young children who are read to every night tend to develop a richer vocabulary than their peers.
write.zh: 每晚聽大人唸故事的幼童，詞彙量往往比同齡孩子更豐富。

example.en: The film features spectacular fight scenes, so the lead actor spent months training with martial arts experts.
example.zh: 這部電影有許多精彩的打鬥場面，所以男主角花了好幾個月跟武術專家一起訓練。

listen.en: Many people learn martial arts to stay fit and build confidence.
listen.zh: 很多人學武術是為了保持身材和建立自信。

chinese.en: Under martial law, citizens were not allowed to gather in public after dark.
chinese.zh: 在戒嚴令之下，民眾天黑後不准在公共場所聚集。

english.en: Martial arts can teach young people self-defence as well as self-control.
english.zh: 武術可以教年輕人防身，也能培養自制力。

speak.en: I've always wanted to try a martial art like judo or karate.
speak.zh: 我一直很想試試柔道或空手道之類的武術。

write.en: The band played stirring martial music as the soldiers marched past the crowd.
write.zh: 士兵們行經群眾時，樂隊演奏著激昂的軍樂。

example.en: Unemployment has been creeping up for months, and economists now fear that a recession may be coming.
example.zh: 失業率幾個月來一直緩慢攀升，經濟學家現在擔心經濟衰退可能即將來臨。

listen.en: The traffic crept along the narrow road in the rain.
listen.zh: 車流在雨中沿著狹窄的道路緩慢前進。

chinese.en: When you are tired, careless mistakes can easily creep into your writing.
chinese.zh: 人在疲倦的時候，文章裡很容易不知不覺出現粗心的錯誤。

english.en: The cat crept towards the bird without making a sound.
english.zh: 那隻貓悄悄地靠近那隻鳥，一點聲音也沒有。

speak.en: Exam season always seems to creep up on me.
speak.zh: 考試季好像總是在我不知不覺中就到了。

write.en: Ivy had crept over the old stone walls of the abandoned factory.
write.zh: 常春藤早已爬滿那座廢棄工廠的老舊石牆。

example.en: The professor lectures on marine biology and often takes her students to the coast for fieldwork.
example.zh: 這位教授教授海洋生物學，常常帶學生到海邊做田野調查。

listen.en: I missed the morning lecture because my bus was late.
listen.zh: 因為公車誤點，我錯過了早上的課。

chinese.en: Hundreds of people attended the public lecture on climate change at the city library.
chinese.zh: 數百人參加了在市立圖書館舉辦的氣候變遷公開講座。

english.en: My parents always lecture me about spending too much money.
english.zh: 我爸媽總是對我說教，說我花太多錢。

speak.en: Some lectures are recorded, so I can watch them again at home.
speak.zh: 有些課會錄影，所以我可以在家重看。

write.en: The lecture theatre was packed because the guest speaker was a well-known scientist.
write.zh: 因為演講嘉賓是一位知名科學家，演講廳擠得水洩不通。

example.en: When peaceful negotiations failed, the workers resorted to a strike to force the company to raise wages.
example.zh: 和平協商失敗後，工人們只好以罷工逼公司調漲薪資。

listen.en: We should only call a plumber as a last resort.
listen.zh: 我們應該把找水電工當作最後的手段。

chinese.en: Some parents resort to bribing their children with sweets to make them behave.
chinese.zh: 有些家長會用糖果收買孩子，讓他們乖乖聽話。

english.en: This ski resort is always crowded during the winter holidays.
english.zh: 這座滑雪度假村在寒假期間總是人擠人。

speak.en: I'd never resort to cheating, even if the exam was really hard.
speak.zh: 就算考試真的很難，我也絕對不會靠作弊。

write.en: Without enough affordable housing, many young people resort to living with their parents into their thirties.
write.zh: 由於缺乏負擔得起的住宅，許多年輕人到了三十幾歲還不得不和父母同住。

example.en: The architect said the building's curved roof was inspired by the shape of waves breaking on the shore.
example.zh: 建築師說，這棟建築的弧形屋頂靈感來自海浪拍打岸邊的形狀。

listen.en: A good teacher can inspire students to love learning.
listen.zh: 好老師能激勵學生熱愛學習。

chinese.en: The athletes' success has inspired a whole generation of young people to take up sport.
chinese.zh: 這些運動員的成功，激勵了整整一代年輕人投入運動。

english.en: The new manager does not inspire much confidence in the staff.
english.zh: 新經理並沒有讓員工產生太大的信心。

speak.en: Travelling abroad always inspires me to try new things.
speak.zh: 出國旅行總是激勵我去嘗試新事物。

write.en: The novel inspired several films, but none of them captured the beauty of the original story.
write.zh: 這部小說啟發了好幾部電影，但沒有一部拍出原著故事的美。

example.en: The shelves in her living room are covered with small ornaments that she has collected from markets around the world.
example.zh: 她客廳的架子上擺滿了她從世界各地市集收集來的小擺飾。

listen.en: Please be careful with that ornament, because it breaks easily.
listen.zh: 請小心那個擺飾，它很容易破。

chinese.en: The museum displays ancient gold ornaments that were discovered in a royal tomb.
chinese.zh: 這間博物館展出從一座王室陵墓出土的古代黃金飾品。

english.en: My aunt bought a small garden ornament shaped like a frog.
english.zh: 我阿姨買了一個青蛙造型的小型庭院擺飾。

speak.en: I don't really like ornaments; I prefer a clean, simple room.
speak.zh: 我不太喜歡擺飾，我比較喜歡乾淨簡單的房間。

write.en: The hotel's ceilings feature plaster ornaments that are now protected as part of the city's heritage.
write.zh: 這間飯店天花板上的灰泥裝飾，如今已被列為城市文化資產加以保護。

example.en: Even the mightiest companies can collapse quickly if they fail to keep up with changing technology.
example.zh: 即使是最強大的企業，如果跟不上科技的變化，也可能很快垮台。

listen.en: The crowd let out a mighty roar when the team scored.
listen.zh: 球隊得分時，觀眾發出震耳欲聾的歡呼聲。

chinese.en: Standing at the foot of the mighty mountain, the climbers felt small and humble.
chinese.zh: 站在雄偉的山腳下，登山客們覺得自己既渺小又謙卑。

english.en: A mighty oak tree stands in the middle of the park.
english.zh: 公園中央矗立著一棵高大雄偉的橡樹。

speak.en: Watching the mighty waves crash against the rocks was amazing.
speak.zh: 看著巨浪拍打岩石的景象真的很震撼。

write.en: Small local shops are struggling to compete with mighty online retailers that offer lower prices.
write.zh: 在地小商店很難和價格更低的大型網路零售商競爭。

example.en: Before choosing a course, check the syllabus carefully, since it lists every topic, reading, and assignment for the semester.
example.zh: 選課前要仔細看教學大綱，因為上面列出了整學期的每個主題、閱讀資料和作業。

listen.en: Is this chapter on the syllabus for the final exam?
listen.zh: 這一章在期末考的範圍內嗎？

chinese.en: The school has updated its science syllabus to include more lessons on climate change.
chinese.zh: 學校更新了自然科的教學大綱，加入更多關於氣候變遷的課程。

english.en: The training syllabus for new staff includes customer service and safety.
english.zh: 新進員工的訓練大綱包含客戶服務和安全規範。

speak.en: Honestly, the syllabus was so packed that we never had time to relax.
speak.zh: 老實說，課程內容排得太滿，我們根本沒時間放鬆。

write.en: Some educators argue that national syllabuses should leave teachers more freedom to choose their own materials.
write.zh: 有些教育工作者主張，全國統一的課程大綱應該給老師更多自行選擇教材的空間。

example.en: Scientists used powerful optical instruments to observe tiny particles that are invisible to the naked eye.
example.zh: 科學家使用高倍率的光學儀器，觀察肉眼看不見的微小粒子。

listen.en: This camera has a powerful optical zoom for wildlife photography.
listen.zh: 這台相機有強大的光學變焦，適合拍攝野生動物。

chinese.en: The company manufactures high-quality optical lenses for cameras, smartphones and medical devices.
chinese.zh: 這家公司為相機、智慧型手機和醫療器材製造高品質的光學鏡片。

english.en: My grandfather bought new glasses at an optical shop near the station.
english.zh: 我爺爺在車站附近的眼鏡行買了新眼鏡。

speak.en: I find optical illusions fascinating, because they show how easily our brains are fooled.
speak.zh: 我覺得視覺錯覺很有趣，因為它們顯示我們的大腦有多容易被騙。

write.en: The government plans to expand the optical fibre network so rural areas can enjoy fast internet.
write.zh: 政府計畫擴建光纖網路，讓偏鄉地區也能享有高速網路。

example.en: The new library was designed to blend into the surrounding forest, with wooden walls and a grass-covered roof.
example.zh: 這座新圖書館採用木牆和綠草覆蓋的屋頂，設計上要融入周圍的森林。

listen.en: It took me a while to blend in at my new school.
listen.zh: 我花了一段時間才融入新學校。

chinese.en: Many successful companies blend traditional craftsmanship with modern technology to create unique products.
chinese.zh: 許多成功的企業結合傳統工藝與現代科技，創造出獨特的產品。

english.en: This tea is a blend of green tea and dried flowers.
english.zh: 這款茶混合了綠茶和乾燥花。

speak.en: I love music that blends different styles, like jazz and hip-hop.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡融合不同風格的音樂，像是爵士和嘻哈。

write.en: Online courses that offer a blend of video lessons and live discussions are becoming more popular.
write.zh: 結合影片教學和即時討論的線上課程越來越受歡迎。

example.en: After paying the mortgage, utilities and childcare each month, the couple had very little money left for savings.
example.zh: 每個月付完房貸、水電費和托育費之後，這對夫妻幾乎沒剩什麼錢可以存。

listen.en: My parents finally paid off their mortgage last year.
listen.zh: 我爸媽去年終於還清了房貸。

chinese.en: Rising interest rates have made mortgage payments much harder for young families to afford.
chinese.zh: 利率上升讓年輕家庭更難負擔房貸。

english.en: The bank refused his mortgage application because his income was too low.
english.zh: 銀行拒絕了他的房貸申請，因為他的收入太低。

speak.en: I'd rather rent than spend the next thirty years paying off a mortgage.
speak.zh: 我寧願租房，也不想在接下來三十年都在繳房貸。

write.en: To keep the family business running, she mortgaged her house and borrowed from relatives.
write.zh: 為了讓家族事業繼續經營下去，她把房子拿去抵押，還向親戚借錢。

example.en: The study found no significant difference between the two groups, suggesting that the new drug was not more effective.
example.zh: 研究發現兩組之間沒有顯著差異，顯示新藥並沒有比較有效。

listen.en: Parents play a significant role in shaping children's habits.
listen.zh: 父母在孩子習慣的養成上扮演重要的角色。

chinese.en: The old bridge is historically significant, so the council has decided to restore it rather than demolish it.
chinese.zh: 這座老橋具有重要的歷史意義，所以市議會決定修復它而不是拆除。

english.en: Tourism brings a significant amount of money to the island.
english.zh: 觀光業為這座島帶來可觀的收入。

speak.en: Moving abroad was probably the most significant decision I've ever made.
speak.zh: 出國生活大概是我這輩子做過最重大的決定。

write.en: Working from home has had a significant impact on how city centres are used.
write.zh: 居家工作對市中心的使用方式產生了重大影響。

example.en: Members of parliament spent hours debating the budget, but they could not agree on how much to spend on healthcare.
example.zh: 國會議員花了好幾個小時辯論預算，卻無法就醫療支出的金額達成共識。

listen.en: Our class visited the parliament building on a school trip.
listen.zh: 我們班校外教學時參觀了國會大樓。

chinese.en: The proposal to lower the voting age will be discussed in parliament next month.
chinese.zh: 降低投票年齡的提案下個月將在國會討論。

english.en: Citizens can now watch debates in parliament live online.
english.zh: 民眾現在可以在網路上觀看國會辯論的直播。

speak.en: I think more young people should consider running for parliament.
speak.zh: 我覺得應該有更多年輕人考慮參選國會議員。

write.en: Environmental groups are urging parliament to introduce stricter rules on plastic packaging.
write.zh: 環保團體正敦促國會針對塑膠包裝制定更嚴格的規範。

example.en: Delegates from more than forty countries gathered in Geneva to discuss new rules on plastic waste.
example.zh: 來自四十多個國家的代表齊聚日內瓦，討論塑膠廢棄物的新規範。

listen.en: She finally learned to delegate some of her work.
listen.zh: 她終於學會把一部分工作交給別人。

chinese.en: When the project grew too large, the team leader delegated the research to two junior colleagues.
chinese.zh: 專案規模變得太大時，組長把研究工作交給兩位資淺的同事。

english.en: Parents should delegate some simple household chores to their children.
english.zh: 父母應該把一些簡單的家事交給孩子做。

speak.en: Honestly, I find it hard to delegate because I like being in control.
speak.zh: 老實說，我很難把事情交給別人，因為我喜歡掌控一切。

write.en: The board delegated authority to the regional office to approve small budgets.
write.zh: 董事會授權區域辦公室核准小額預算。

example.en: Instead of answering the difficult question, the spokesperson gave a shrug and quickly changed the subject.
example.zh: 發言人沒有回答那個棘手的問題，只是聳聳肩，很快就轉移了話題。

listen.en: She shrugged and said she didn't really mind.
listen.zh: 她聳聳肩，說她其實不在意。

chinese.en: The young athlete shrugged off her early injury and went on to win the final.
chinese.zh: 那位年輕選手不受先前傷勢影響，最後贏得了決賽。

english.en: He shrugged off the criticism and kept working on his plan.
english.zh: 他不理會批評，繼續進行他的計畫。

speak.en: If someone is rude to me, I usually just shrug it off.
speak.zh: 如果有人對我沒禮貌，我通常就不放在心上。

write.en: Many students shrug when asked about their career plans, because they simply haven't decided yet.
write.zh: 很多學生被問到職涯規劃時只會聳聳肩，因為他們根本還沒決定。

example.en: After failing to find work, he enrolled at a local college and earned a diploma in nursing within two years.
example.zh: 他找不到工作後，到當地一所學院就讀，並在兩年內取得護理文憑。

listen.en: You need a high school diploma to apply for this job.
listen.zh: 應徵這份工作需要高中畢業證書。

chinese.en: Many employers now value practical skills more than a diploma from a famous university.
chinese.zh: 現在許多雇主看重實務技能，勝過名校的文憑。

english.en: My grandmother keeps my diploma in a frame in her living room.
english.zh: 我奶奶把我的畢業證書裱框放在她家客廳。

speak.en: Getting my diploma was one of the proudest moments of my life.
speak.zh: 拿到畢業證書是我人生中最驕傲的時刻之一。

write.en: The government offers free evening classes so that adults can finish their diplomas while working.
write.zh: 政府提供免費夜間課程，讓成人能一邊工作一邊完成學業、取得文憑。

example.en: Unlike the older members, who preferred quiet negotiation, the younger activists were openly militant and organized frequent street protests.
example.zh: 年長成員偏好低調協商，年輕的運動人士則公開表現激進，經常發起街頭抗議。

listen.en: My uncle has become quite militant about recycling.
listen.zh: 我叔叔對資源回收的態度變得相當激進。

chinese.en: The farmers became increasingly militant when the factory continued to pollute their water supply.
chinese.zh: 由於工廠持續汙染水源，農民的態度變得越來越激進。

english.en: Some militant environmental groups block roads to attract public attention.
english.zh: 一些激進的環保團體會封鎖道路來吸引大眾關注。

speak.en: I wouldn't call myself militant, but I do care about animal rights.
speak.zh: 我不會說自己很激進，但我確實關心動物權益。

write.en: A small number of militants within the movement damaged its reputation with the wider public.
write.zh: 運動中少數激進分子損害了它在一般大眾心中的形象。

example.en: The union used the threat of a strike as a lever to persuade management to improve working conditions.
example.zh: 工會以罷工為籌碼，說服資方改善工作環境。

listen.en: He used a long metal bar to lever the lid open.
listen.zh: 他用一根長鐵棒把蓋子撬開。

chinese.en: Tax incentives are a powerful lever for encouraging companies to invest in clean energy.
chinese.zh: 租稅優惠是鼓勵企業投資潔淨能源的有力手段。

english.en: A simple lever allows a child to lift a surprisingly heavy object.
english.zh: 一根簡單的槓桿就能讓小孩舉起重得驚人的物體。

speak.en: My first car had a stiff gear lever, so changing gears was tiring.
speak.zh: 我的第一台車排檔桿很緊，所以換檔很累。

write.en: The teacher levered the old window open so fresh air could enter the classroom.
write.zh: 老師把那扇老舊的窗戶撬開，讓新鮮空氣能流進教室。

example.en: High blood pressure is often called a silent killer because most people have no symptoms until serious damage is done.
example.zh: 高血壓常被稱為「無聲殺手」，因為大多數人在身體受到嚴重傷害前都沒有任何症狀。

listen.en: Air pollution has become a major killer in big cities.
listen.zh: 空氣汙染已成為大城市的主要致命因素。

chinese.en: Road accidents are a leading killer of young people, so safety must be taught early.
chinese.zh: 交通事故是年輕人主要的死因之一，所以安全觀念必須及早教導。

english.en: The detective in the novel finally discovered who the killer was.
english.zh: 小說裡的偵探終於查出兇手是誰。

speak.en: Honestly, stress is a real killer, so I try to exercise every day.
speak.zh: 說真的，壓力真的會要人命，所以我盡量每天運動。

write.en: Smoking was once the top killer in the region, but strict laws have reduced its impact sharply.
write.zh: 吸菸曾是該地區最主要的死因，但嚴格的法規已大幅降低它的影響。

example.en: After several complaints from parents, the school instituted a new policy banning mobile phones during lessons.
example.zh: 接到幾位家長的抱怨後，學校制定新規定，禁止上課時使用手機。

listen.en: My brother is studying at an institute of technology.
listen.zh: 我哥哥正在一所理工學院就讀。

chinese.en: The city instituted a recycling scheme last year, and household waste has fallen ever since.
chinese.zh: 市政府去年開始實施資源回收計畫，此後家庭垃圾量就一直減少。

english.en: The company instituted flexible working hours to keep its staff happy.
english.zh: 公司實施彈性工時，好讓員工保持愉快。

speak.en: I'd love to work at a research institute after I graduate.
speak.zh: 我畢業後很想到研究機構工作。

write.en: The institute offers short language courses for adults who want to work overseas.
write.zh: 這所學院為想出國工作的成人開設短期語言課程。

example.en: The graph shows a sharp rise in online shopping in 2020, followed by a gradual decline.
example.zh: 圖表顯示網路購物在2020年急劇上升，隨後逐漸下滑。

listen.en: My grandfather is quite old, but his mind is still very sharp.
listen.zh: 我爺爺年紀很大了，但頭腦依然非常敏銳。

chinese.en: The sharp increase in housing prices has made it difficult for young couples to buy a home.
chinese.zh: 房價急劇上漲，使年輕夫妻很難買得起房子。

english.en: The class must be ready to leave at eight o'clock sharp.
english.zh: 全班必須在八點整準備好出發。

speak.en: Our new manager is really sharp; she notices every little detail.
speak.zh: 我們的新經理非常精明，任何小細節她都會注意到。

write.en: There is a sharp contrast between the busy city centre and the quiet villages nearby.
write.zh: 熱鬧的市中心和附近寧靜的村莊形成強烈對比。

example.en: The coach warned that the match would go ahead regardless of the weather, so players should bring raincoats.
example.zh: 教練提醒，無論天氣如何，比賽都會照常進行，所以球員應該帶雨衣。

listen.en: Her parents disagreed, but she chose the course regardless.
listen.zh: 她父母不贊成，但她還是選了那門課程。

chinese.en: Regardless of whether you pass the exam, the experience of preparing for it is valuable.
chinese.zh: 不論你是否通過考試，準備考試的過程本身就很有價值。

english.en: The museum is free for all visitors regardless of age.
english.zh: 這間博物館對所有訪客免費，不分年齡。

speak.en: I think I'd still travel abroad regardless of the cost.
speak.zh: 我覺得不管花多少錢，我還是會出國旅行。

write.en: The company promotes staff based on performance, regardless of how long they have worked there.
write.zh: 這家公司依據表現升遷員工，不管他們在公司待了多久。

example.en: The airport, once used only by the air force, now handles civilian flights to several nearby islands.
example.zh: 這座機場過去只供空軍使用，現在則有飛往附近幾座島嶼的民航班機。

listen.en: Soldiers and civilians worked together to clear the flooded streets.
listen.zh: 軍人和平民一起清理淹水的街道。

chinese.en: Many technologies we use every day, such as GPS, were first developed for military rather than civilian purposes.
chinese.zh: 我們日常使用的許多科技，例如 GPS，最初都是為了軍事而非民用目的而開發的。

english.en: The museum tells the story of ordinary civilians during the war.
english.zh: 這間博物館講述戰爭期間一般平民的故事。

speak.en: Actually, my cousin works as a civilian employee at a naval base.
speak.zh: 其實我表哥在海軍基地擔任文職人員。

write.en: International rules require all sides in a conflict to protect civilians and hospitals.
write.zh: 國際規範要求衝突各方都必須保護平民與醫院。

example.en: Rather than going to university, Amy chose a vocational school where she learned practical skills like plumbing and electrical work.
example.zh: 艾咪沒有念大學，而是選擇技職學校，學習水電等實用技能。

listen.en: My sister is taking a vocational course in hairdressing.
listen.zh: 我妹妹正在上美髮職業訓練課程。

chinese.en: Some parents still believe that vocational education is less valuable than an academic degree.
chinese.zh: 有些家長仍然認為技職教育的價值不如一般大學學位。

english.en: Vocational skills such as cooking and repairing cars are always in demand.
english.zh: 像烹飪和修車這類職業技能一直都很有需求。

speak.en: I think vocational courses should get more respect than they do now.
speak.zh: 我認為職業訓練課程應該得到比現在更多的尊重。

write.en: The hotel accepts vocational qualifications as well as university degrees when hiring kitchen staff.
write.zh: 這家飯店在招募廚房人員時，除了大學學位也承認職業證照。

example.en: In 2010, the proportions of households owning a car and a bicycle were 45% and 70%, respectively.
example.zh: 2010年，擁有汽車和腳踏車的家庭比例分別為45%和70%。

listen.en: My brother and sister study law and medicine respectively.
listen.zh: 我哥哥和姊姊分別讀法律和醫學。

chinese.en: Last year, sales of electric and petrol cars rose by 30% and 2% respectively.
chinese.zh: 去年電動車和汽油車的銷量分別成長了30%和2%。

english.en: The first and second prizes went to Anna and Ben respectively.
english.zh: 第一名和第二名分別由安娜和班恩獲得。

speak.en: My two best friends live in Japan and Canada, respectively.
speak.zh: 我兩個最好的朋友分別住在日本和加拿大。

write.en: The two universities were founded in 1911 and 1928 respectively, and they remain rivals today.
write.zh: 這兩所大學分別創立於1911年和1928年，至今仍是競爭對手。

example.en: The fishing boat sent out a distress signal after its engine failed, and the coast guard rescued the crew within hours.
example.zh: 漁船引擎故障後發出求救訊號，海巡在幾小時內救出了船員。

listen.en: She was clearly in distress when she lost her passport.
listen.zh: 她弄丟護照時顯然非常慌張難過。

chinese.en: Long working hours and constant pressure can lead to serious emotional distress among young employees.
chinese.zh: 長時間工作和持續的壓力，可能導致年輕員工出現嚴重的情緒困擾。

english.en: The news about the factory closing distressed many local families.
english.zh: 工廠關閉的消息讓許多當地家庭感到憂心。

speak.en: It really distresses me to see students so stressed before exams.
speak.zh: 看到學生考試前壓力那麼大，真的讓我很難過。

write.en: Teachers are trained to notice signs of distress in children who are being bullied.
write.zh: 老師受過訓練，能察覺被霸凌的孩子所表現出的痛苦徵兆。

example.en: Critics argue that the curriculum focuses too much on memorising facts and too little on creative thinking.
example.zh: 批評者認為，這套課程太重視背誦，太不重視創意思考。

listen.en: Is music still part of the school curriculum?
listen.zh: 音樂還在學校的課程裡嗎？

chinese.en: The new curriculum gives students more time for group projects and outdoor learning.
chinese.zh: 新課綱讓學生有更多時間做小組專題和戶外學習。

english.en: Our university is reviewing its curriculum to include more practical training.
english.zh: 我們大學正在檢討課程，以納入更多實務訓練。

speak.en: I wish financial skills had been on the curriculum when I was at school.
speak.zh: 真希望我念書時，學校課程裡有教理財技能。

write.en: The company designed a training curriculum to help new employees learn its software quickly.
write.zh: 公司設計了一套培訓課程，幫助新進員工快速學會使用公司的軟體。

example.en: Unemployment reached a peak of 12% in 2009 before gradually falling as the economy recovered.
example.zh: 失業率在2009年達到12%的高峰，之後隨著經濟復甦逐漸下降。

listen.en: The trains are always very crowded during peak hours.
listen.zh: 尖峰時段的火車總是非常擁擠。

chinese.en: Hotel prices are much higher in peak season, so we usually travel in autumn.
chinese.zh: 旅遊旺季時飯店價格高出許多，所以我們通常在秋天出遊。

english.en: From the peak of the mountain, we could see the whole city.
english.zh: 從山頂上，我們可以看到整座城市。

speak.en: I think most athletes reach their peak in their late twenties.
speak.zh: 我覺得大部分運動員在快三十歲時達到巔峰。

write.en: At the peak of her career, the scientist led a team of over fifty researchers.
write.zh: 在事業巔峰時期，這位科學家領導一支超過五十人的研究團隊。

example.en: Although the region has a moderate climate, with mild winters and warm summers, sudden storms still occur from time to time.
example.zh: 雖然這個地區氣候溫和，冬天不冷、夏天溫暖，但偶爾仍會有突如其來的暴風雨。

listen.en: Prices have risen at a moderate rate this year.
listen.zh: 今年物價以溫和的速度上漲。

chinese.en: The teacher moderated the class debate and made sure everyone had a chance to speak.
chinese.zh: 老師主持班上的辯論，確保每個人都有發言的機會。

english.en: Drinking coffee in moderate amounts is generally safe for adults.
english.zh: 適量喝咖啡對成年人來說大致上是安全的。

speak.en: Honestly, I only spend a moderate amount of time on social media.
speak.zh: 說實在的，我花在社群媒體上的時間還算適中。

write.en: The company moderated its growth targets after sales slowed during the winter.
write.zh: 冬季銷售放緩後，公司調降了成長目標。

example.en: Most universities now run assignments through software that compares them with online sources to detect plagiarism.
example.zh: 現在大多數大學都會用軟體比對作業和網路資料，藉此偵測抄襲。

listen.en: The famous singer was accused of plagiarism last year.
listen.zh: 那位知名歌手去年被指控抄襲。

chinese.en: Copying a few sentences without citing the source is still considered plagiarism in academic writing.
chinese.zh: 在學術寫作中，就算只抄了幾句話而沒有註明出處，仍然算是抄襲。

english.en: Our teacher explained how to quote sources properly to avoid plagiarism.
english.zh: 我們老師解釋了如何正確引用資料以避免抄襲。

speak.en: I think AI tools make plagiarism much harder for teachers to spot.
speak.zh: 我覺得 AI 工具讓老師更難發現抄襲。

write.en: The design company accused a competitor of plagiarism after seeing an almost identical logo.
write.zh: 這家設計公司看到幾乎一模一樣的標誌後，指控競爭對手抄襲。

example.en: The patient was rushed to hospital last night, but doctors say her condition is now stable.
example.zh: 那名病患昨晚被緊急送醫，但醫生說她目前情況穩定。

listen.en: Make sure the ladder is stable before you climb it.
listen.zh: 爬梯子之前，要先確定梯子很穩。

chinese.en: The proportion of people working from home remained stable between 2015 and 2019.
chinese.zh: 2015年到2019年間，在家工作的人口比例維持穩定。

english.en: Children need a stable home environment to grow up happily.
english.zh: 孩子需要穩定的家庭環境才能快樂成長。

speak.en: I'd prefer a stable income to a high salary with no security.
speak.zh: 比起沒有保障的高薪，我寧願要一份穩定的收入。

write.en: Engineers tested whether the old bridge was still stable enough for heavy trucks.
write.zh: 工程師檢測那座老舊的橋是否仍足夠穩固，能讓重型卡車通行。

example.en: Many working parents struggle to find an affordable kindergarten near their office, so grandparents often help with childcare.
example.zh: 許多上班族家長很難在公司附近找到負擔得起的幼兒園，所以常由祖父母幫忙照顧孩子。

listen.en: My aunt works as a kindergarten teacher in the city.
listen.zh: 我阿姨在市區當幼兒園老師。

chinese.en: Some experts believe children in kindergarten should learn through play rather than formal lessons.
chinese.zh: 有些專家認為，幼兒園的孩子應該從遊戲中學習，而不是上正式的課程。

english.en: The government plans to make kindergarten free for all families.
english.zh: 政府計畫讓所有家庭的孩子都能免費上幼兒園。

speak.en: I still remember crying on my first day of kindergarten.
speak.zh: 我還記得上幼兒園第一天時哭了。

write.en: The new housing development will include a park, a clinic and a kindergarten for residents.
write.zh: 新的住宅開發案將為住戶設置公園、診所和幼兒園。

example.en: Once the plane reached its cruising altitude, the seatbelt sign was switched off and passengers could move around.
example.zh: 飛機一到達巡航高度，安全帶指示燈就熄滅了，乘客可以自由走動。

listen.en: We cruised slowly along the river and watched the sunset.
listen.zh: 我們沿著河流緩緩航行，欣賞夕陽。

chinese.en: Cruise ships bring tourists to the island, but they also create serious pollution problems.
chinese.zh: 郵輪為島上帶來觀光客，但也造成嚴重的汙染問題。

english.en: Our team cruised to victory after scoring early in the game.
english.zh: 我們隊在比賽初期就得分，之後輕鬆贏得勝利。

speak.en: I'd love to take a cruise someday, but I get seasick easily.
speak.zh: 我很想有一天去搭郵輪旅行，但我很容易暈船。

write.en: Taxis cruise the city centre at night, looking for passengers leaving bars and restaurants.
write.zh: 計程車晚上在市中心四處繞，尋找從酒吧和餐廳出來的乘客。

example.en: After the landlord raised the rent yet again, several tenants decided to move out and share a cheaper flat.
example.zh: 房東又一次調漲房租後，好幾位房客決定搬出去，合租一間比較便宜的公寓。

listen.en: Please tell the landlord that the kitchen sink is leaking.
listen.zh: 請告訴房東廚房的水槽在漏水。

chinese.en: Many students in big cities rent rooms from private landlords rather than living in dormitories.
chinese.zh: 大城市裡許多學生向私人房東租房間，而不是住宿舍。

english.en: The landlord asked us to pay a deposit before moving in.
english.zh: 房東要求我們在搬進去之前先付押金。

speak.en: Honestly, my landlord is pretty easygoing as long as I pay on time.
speak.zh: 老實說，只要我準時付房租，我的房東其實滿好相處的。

write.en: The new law requires landlords to keep their rental properties safe and in good repair.
write.zh: 新法規定房東必須讓出租的房屋保持安全、維修良好。

example.en: Some patients develop a tolerance to painkillers over time, which means the same dose gradually becomes less effective.
example.zh: 有些病人久了會對止痛藥產生耐受性，也就是同樣的劑量會漸漸變得沒那麼有效。

listen.en: My father has very little tolerance for loud music.
listen.zh: 我爸爸很受不了大聲的音樂。

chinese.en: Schools should promote tolerance so that students learn to respect classmates from different backgrounds.
chinese.zh: 學校應該提倡包容，讓學生學會尊重來自不同背景的同學。

english.en: The company has a zero tolerance policy on workplace bullying.
english.zh: 這家公司對職場霸凌採取零容忍政策。

speak.en: I've got a pretty low tolerance for spicy food, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不太能吃辣。

write.en: Working in a busy restaurant kitchen requires a high tolerance for heat and pressure.
write.zh: 在忙碌的餐廳廚房工作，必須非常耐熱又抗壓。

example.en: When asked why the project was delayed, the manager was not very forthcoming and quickly changed the subject.
example.zh: 被問到專案為什麼延誤時，經理不太願意多說，很快就轉移了話題。

listen.en: Details of the forthcoming trip will be sent by email.
listen.zh: 這趟即將出發的旅行，詳細資訊會以電子郵件寄送。

chinese.en: The charity had hoped for government support, but no funding was forthcoming this year.
chinese.zh: 這個慈善機構原本希望得到政府支持，但今年一直沒有等到任何經費。
