english.en: The author's forthcoming novel is set in a small fishing village.
english.zh: 這位作家即將出版的小說以一個小漁村為背景。

speak.en: She's usually quite forthcoming about her plans, so just ask her.
speak.zh: 她通常很願意分享自己的計畫，你直接問她就好。

write.en: Students are encouraged to prepare early for the forthcoming exams rather than cramming the night before.
write.zh: 學校鼓勵學生及早準備即將到來的考試，不要考前一晚才臨時抱佛腳。

example.en: The football player was sent off after he swore at the referee in front of a huge crowd.
example.zh: 那名足球員當著滿場觀眾對裁判罵髒話，結果被罰下場。

listen.en: Please don't swear in front of the children.
listen.zh: 請不要在孩子面前說髒話。

chinese.en: Before giving evidence, every witness must swear to tell the truth in court.
chinese.zh: 每位證人作證前，都必須在法庭上宣誓會說實話。

english.en: I swear I locked the door before we left this morning.
english.zh: 我發誓今天早上我們出門前我有鎖門。

speak.en: I could have sworn I saved the file, but it's gone.
speak.zh: 我明明記得有存檔，結果檔案不見了。

write.en: Newly qualified doctors swear an oath to put their patients' wellbeing first.
write.zh: 剛取得資格的醫師會宣誓以病人的福祉為優先。

example.en: Because the director was ill, her assistant accepted the award on her behalf at the ceremony last night.
example.zh: 由於導演生病，昨晚的頒獎典禮上由她的助理代為領獎。

listen.en: Thank you on behalf of everyone in our class.
listen.zh: 我代表全班同學向你道謝。

chinese.en: Volunteers collected donations on behalf of families who lost their homes in the flood.
chinese.zh: 志工們為在水災中失去家園的家庭募集捐款。

english.en: The lawyer will speak on behalf of her client tomorrow.
english.zh: 律師明天會代表她的當事人發言。

speak.en: Don't worry, I'll call the restaurant on your behalf.
speak.zh: 別擔心，我幫你打電話給餐廳。

write.en: Environmental groups often campaign on behalf of wildlife that cannot speak for itself.
write.zh: 環保團體常為無法替自己發聲的野生動物發起倡議。

example.en: Although he had no formal qualifications, his years of practical experience made him the best candidate for the position.
example.zh: 雖然他沒有正式的學歷證照，但多年的實務經驗讓他成為這個職位的最佳人選。

listen.en: You need a teaching qualification to work in public schools.
listen.zh: 要在公立學校工作，你需要有教師資格。

chinese.en: Employers increasingly value practical skills as much as academic qualifications when hiring graduates.
chinese.zh: 雇主在招募畢業生時，越來越重視實務技能，程度不亞於學歷。

english.en: Fluent English is an essential qualification for this marketing job.
english.zh: 流利的英文是這份行銷工作的必備條件。

speak.en: I'd like to gain a few more qualifications before changing careers.
speak.zh: 我想在轉換跑道前多拿幾張證照。

write.en: The committee supported the plan, but with the qualification that costs must stay within budget.
write.zh: 委員會支持這項計畫，但附帶一個條件：費用必須控制在預算之內。

example.en: I heard a soft click as the door locked behind me, and realised I had left my keys inside.
example.zh: 門在我身後鎖上時，我聽到輕輕「喀」的一聲，才發現鑰匙忘在裡面了。

listen.en: We clicked as soon as we met at university.
listen.zh: 我們在大學一認識就一拍即合。

chinese.en: With online banking, customers can pay their bills at the click of a button.
chinese.zh: 有了網路銀行，客戶只要按一下按鈕就能繳帳單。

english.en: Many people click on advertisements without really thinking about it.
english.zh: 很多人沒有多想就點了廣告。

speak.en: It finally clicked when my teacher explained it with a simple example.
speak.zh: 老師用一個簡單的例子解釋後，我終於恍然大悟。

write.en: The last panel clicked into place, and the bookshelf was ready to use.
write.zh: 最後一塊板子「喀」一聲卡進定位，書櫃就可以用了。

example.en: Fans publicly denounced the club's decision to sharply raise ticket prices, calling it a betrayal of loyal supporters.
example.zh: 球迷公開抨擊球隊大幅調漲票價的決定，說這是背叛忠實支持者。

listen.en: The teachers denounced the plan to close the library.
listen.zh: 老師們公開抨擊關閉圖書館的計畫。

chinese.en: Many scientists denounced the study, pointing out serious flaws in how the data was collected.
chinese.zh: 許多科學家抨擊這項研究，指出它的資料蒐集方式有嚴重缺失。

english.en: Animal rights groups denounced the use of wild animals in circuses.
english.zh: 動物權團體譴責馬戲團使用野生動物。

speak.en: People were quick to denounce the company after the scandal broke.
speak.zh: 醜聞一爆出來，大家馬上就紛紛譴責這家公司。

write.en: The factory was widely denounced for dumping waste into the river near the village.
write.zh: 這家工廠因為把廢棄物倒進村莊附近的河裡，遭到各界譴責。

example.en: Doctors warn that obesity has become an epidemic in many wealthy countries, largely because of poor diets and inactive lifestyles.
example.zh: 醫生警告，肥胖在許多富裕國家已成為一種流行病，主要原因是飲食不良和缺乏運動的生活方式。

listen.en: The government acted quickly to stop the epidemic from spreading.
listen.zh: 政府迅速採取行動，防止疫情擴散。

chinese.en: Some experts describe loneliness among elderly people as a silent epidemic in modern cities.
chinese.zh: 有些專家把長者的孤獨感形容為現代城市中一種無聲的流行病。

english.en: Supplying clean water helped prevent an epidemic after the earthquake.
english.zh: 地震後供應乾淨的水，有助於防止疫情爆發。

speak.en: Phone addiction is almost an epidemic among teenagers these days.
speak.zh: 現在手機成癮在青少年之間幾乎像流行病一樣普遍。

write.en: Within weeks, cases of the disease had reached epidemic proportions across the region.
write.zh: 短短幾週內，這種疾病的病例在整個地區已達到大規模流行的程度。

example.en: Unemployment figures fell slightly last quarter, suggesting that the economy is slowly recovering from the recession.
example.zh: 上一季的失業數據略為下降，顯示經濟正從衰退中慢慢復甦。

listen.en: I still can't figure out how this machine works.
listen.zh: 我還是搞不懂這台機器怎麼運作。

chinese.en: As a well-known public figure, she has to be careful about what she posts online.
chinese.zh: 身為知名的公眾人物，她在網路上發文必須很小心。

english.en: I saw a tall figure standing near the gate in the dark.
english.zh: 我看到一個高高的身影在黑暗中站在大門附近。

speak.en: I figured it would rain, so I brought an umbrella.
speak.zh: 我猜會下雨，所以帶了傘。

write.en: Many students figure that a part-time job will help them gain useful experience.
write.zh: 許多學生認為打工能幫助他們累積有用的經驗。

example.en: With fuel prices rising every month, an increase in airline ticket prices now seems almost inevitable.
example.zh: 燃料價格每個月都在上漲，機票漲價現在看來幾乎是無法避免的。

listen.en: It was inevitable that the old cinema would close.
listen.zh: 那家老電影院關門是遲早的事。

chinese.en: Some people believe that job losses are an inevitable consequence of greater automation.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為，失業是自動化程度提高所帶來的必然結果。

english.en: Traffic delays are almost inevitable during the busy holiday season.
english.zh: 在繁忙的連假期間，交通延誤幾乎無法避免。

speak.en: I avoided the dentist for ages, but eventually I had to accept the inevitable.
speak.zh: 我好久都不去看牙醫，但最後還是只能面對躲不掉的事。

write.en: As cities grow, conflict between developers and local residents is perhaps inevitable.
write.zh: 隨著城市發展，建商和當地居民之間的衝突或許在所難免。

example.en: The hotel manager apologized for the noise and assured us that we would be moved to a quieter room immediately.
example.zh: 飯店經理為噪音道歉，並向我們保證會馬上幫我們換到比較安靜的房間。

listen.en: I can assure you that your bag is safe with us.
listen.zh: 我可以向你保證，你的包包放在我們這裡很安全。

chinese.en: The university has assured students that tuition fees will not rise next year.
chinese.zh: 大學已向學生保證，明年學費不會調漲。

english.en: Her strong performance in the final match assured her a place on the national team.
english.zh: 她在決賽中的出色表現，確保了她在國家隊的一席之地。

speak.en: Don't panic, I assure you everything is under control.
speak.zh: 別慌，我向你保證一切都在掌控之中。

write.en: Officials assured residents of their safety after the chemical leak was contained.
write.zh: 化學物質外洩獲得控制後，官員向居民保證他們很安全。

example.en: The film ends with a dramatic scene in which the hero escapes from a burning building at the last second.
example.zh: 這部電影以一幕驚險的場景收尾，主角在最後一刻逃出失火的大樓。

listen.en: Don't be so dramatic, it's only a small scratch.
listen.zh: 別那麼誇張，只是一點小擦傷而已。

chinese.en: The new metro line has brought dramatic changes to the quiet neighbourhood around the station.
chinese.zh: 新的捷運線為車站周邊原本寧靜的社區帶來劇烈的改變。

english.en: The coastline here has some of the most dramatic scenery in the country.
english.zh: 這裡的海岸線有全國數一數二壯觀的景色。

speak.en: My hometown has gone through a pretty dramatic transformation in recent years.
speak.zh: 我的家鄉這幾年經歷了相當大的轉變。

write.en: She studied dramatic arts at university before becoming a drama teacher at a local high school.
write.zh: 她大學主修戲劇藝術，後來在當地一所高中當戲劇老師。

example.en: Many language learners hit a plateau after the first year, when progress suddenly feels much slower than before.
example.zh: 許多語言學習者在第一年後會碰到撞牆期，這時進步會突然感覺比以前慢很多。

listen.en: The village sits on a high plateau surrounded by mountains.
listen.zh: 這座村莊位於群山環繞的高原上。

chinese.en: According to the chart, smartphone sales stayed on a plateau for several years before declining.
chinese.zh: 根據圖表，智慧型手機的銷量持平了好幾年，之後才開始下滑。

english.en: My weight loss reached a plateau after a few months.
english.zh: 我的減重在幾個月後進入停滯期。

speak.en: I think my running has hit a plateau, so I need a new routine.
speak.zh: 我覺得我的跑步遇到瓶頸了，所以需要換個新的訓練方式。

write.en: Economists expect the unemployment rate to remain on a plateau until the new policies take effect.
write.zh: 經濟學家預期，在新政策生效之前，失業率會維持持平。

example.en: Regular check-ups allow doctors to detect serious illnesses before any obvious symptoms appear, which makes treatment far more effective.
example.zh: 定期健康檢查能讓醫生在明顯症狀出現前就發現重大疾病，讓治療有效得多。

listen.en: I detected a hint of sadness in her voice.
listen.zh: 我察覺到她的聲音裡帶著一絲悲傷。

chinese.en: Small amounts of plastic have been detected in tap water samples from several cities.
chinese.zh: 在多個城市的自來水樣本中，都檢測出少量的塑膠。

english.en: The software can automatically detect spelling mistakes in your essay.
english.zh: 這套軟體能自動偵測你作文中的拼字錯誤。

speak.en: Dogs can detect smells that humans can't even notice.
speak.zh: 狗能察覺到人類根本聞不到的氣味。

write.en: Security cameras at the station detected a man acting suspiciously near the ticket machines.
write.zh: 車站的監視器偵測到一名男子在售票機附近行跡可疑。

example.en: The novel is not just an entertaining story; it is also a sharp commentary on how social media shapes young people's lives.
example.zh: 這本小說不只是有趣的故事，也是對社群媒體如何影響年輕人生活的犀利評論。

listen.en: My brother gave a running commentary while we watched the film.
listen.zh: 我們看電影的時候，我哥哥一直在旁邊講個不停。

chinese.en: The museum's audio guide offers commentary on each painting in several different languages.
chinese.zh: 博物館的語音導覽以多種語言為每一幅畫提供解說。

english.en: The textbook includes a short commentary to explain each poem.
english.zh: 這本課本附有簡短的評註來解說每首詩。

speak.en: Honestly, the commentary is half the fun of watching sports on TV.
speak.zh: 說真的，看電視轉播的運動比賽，一半的樂趣來自解說。

write.en: Online news sites increasingly mix factual reporting with personal commentary, which can confuse readers.
write.zh: 網路新聞網站越來越常把事實報導和個人評論混在一起，可能會讓讀者混淆。

example.en: Competition is fierce because thousands of students take the university entrance exam each year, but only a small number are accepted.
example.zh: 競爭非常激烈，因為每年有成千上萬名學生參加大學入學考試，但只有少數人能錄取。

listen.en: The entrance to the car park is behind the supermarket.
listen.zh: 停車場的入口在超市後面。

chinese.en: The national park charges a small entrance fee to help pay for trail maintenance.
chinese.zh: 這座國家公園收取少許入園費，用來支付步道維護的費用。

english.en: The bride made a grand entrance as everyone stood up.
english.zh: 新娘隆重登場時，所有人都站了起來。

speak.en: There's a nice little café right by the entrance to my building.
speak.zh: 我住的那棟大樓門口旁邊有一間很不錯的小咖啡館。

write.en: Many old buildings still lack a wheelchair-accessible entrance, which makes life difficult for disabled visitors.
write.zh: 許多老建築仍缺乏無障礙入口，讓身障訪客十分不便。

example.en: The smell of fresh bread mingled with the scent of coffee, drawing customers into the little bakery on the corner.
example.zh: 新鮮麵包的香氣和咖啡香交織在一起，把顧客吸引進街角的小麵包店。

listen.en: I find it hard to mingle at large parties.
listen.zh: 我覺得在大型派對上很難和別人打成一片。

chinese.en: International students are encouraged to mingle with local students to improve their language skills.
chinese.zh: 校方鼓勵國際學生多和本地學生交流，以提升語言能力。

english.en: Tourists mingled with local shoppers at the busy night market.
english.zh: 遊客和當地的購物人潮在熱鬧的夜市裡混在一起。

speak.en: Networking events are great if you're comfortable mingling with strangers.
speak.zh: 如果你能自在地和陌生人交際，參加人脈交流活動是很棒的事。

write.en: As she read the letter, feelings of relief and sadness mingled in her mind.
write.zh: 讀著那封信，她心中交織著如釋重負與悲傷的情緒。

example.en: Thanks to online sales, the small company managed to triple its profits within just a few years of launching.
example.zh: 靠著網路銷售，這家小公司在創立短短幾年內就讓獲利成長為三倍。

listen.en: Bike use in our city has tripled over recent years.
listen.zh: 近年來，我們城市的自行車使用量增加為原來的三倍。

chinese.en: The new building is triple the size of the old library, with far more study space.
chinese.zh: 新大樓的面積是舊圖書館的三倍，自習空間也多了很多。

english.en: The hotel charges triple the normal rate during the festival.
english.zh: 這家飯店在節慶期間收取平常三倍的房價。

speak.en: I ordered a triple espresso because I barely slept last night.
speak.zh: 我點了一杯三倍濃縮咖啡，因為我昨晚幾乎沒睡。

write.en: According to the graph, the number of international visitors more than tripled over the period shown.
write.zh: 根據圖表，國際旅客人數在這段期間內增加為原本的三倍以上。

example.en: Although the story sounded unbelievable, there was a grain of truth in it, since part of it really happened.
example.zh: 雖然那個故事聽起來令人難以置信，但其中有幾分真實，因為有部分情節真的發生過。

listen.en: I found a grain of sand in my salad.
listen.zh: 我在我的沙拉裡發現一粒沙子。

chinese.en: Doctors recommend eating more whole grains, such as brown rice and oats, instead of white bread.
chinese.zh: 醫生建議多吃全穀類，例如糙米和燕麥，來取代白麵包。

english.en: Farmers stored the grain in large barns for the winter.
english.zh: 農夫把穀物存放在大穀倉裡過冬。

speak.en: Waking up early really goes against the grain for me.
speak.zh: 早起對我來說真的很違反本性。

write.en: Rising temperatures could reduce grain production in many regions, threatening global food security.
write.zh: 氣溫上升可能使許多地區的穀物產量減少，威脅全球糧食安全。

example.en: Children who are read to every night often show faster cognitive development, especially in language and memory.
example.zh: 每晚聽大人唸故事的孩子，認知發展往往比較快，尤其是在語言和記憶方面。

listen.en: Lack of sleep can affect your cognitive abilities.
listen.zh: 睡眠不足會影響你的認知能力。

chinese.en: Scientists are studying whether playing video games has any long-term cognitive benefits.
chinese.zh: 科學家正在研究打電玩是否對認知有任何長期的好處。

english.en: Many experts believe that learning a second language helps cognitive development.
english.zh: 許多專家認為，學習第二外語有助於認知發展。

speak.en: I think puzzles are a fun way to keep your cognitive skills sharp.
speak.zh: 我覺得解謎遊戲是讓認知能力保持敏銳的有趣方法。

write.en: Working long night shifts may lead to cognitive decline if workers never get enough rest.
write.zh: 長期上大夜班的員工如果一直得不到充分休息，可能會導致認知能力衰退。

example.en: Despite relentless criticism from the media, the coach refused to change his strategy and kept training the team his way.
example.zh: 儘管媒體不斷猛烈批評，教練仍拒絕改變策略，堅持用自己的方式訓練球隊。

listen.en: She was relentless in her search for the truth.
listen.zh: 她鍥而不捨地追查真相。

chinese.en: Many office workers struggle to cope with the relentless pace of modern city life.
chinese.zh: 許多上班族難以適應現代都市生活永不停歇的步調。

english.en: The students felt exhausted by the relentless pressure of exams.
english.zh: 學生被考試無止盡的壓力弄得筋疲力盡。

speak.en: Honestly, the heat in Taipei this summer has been relentless.
speak.zh: 老實說，臺北今年夏天的高溫一直沒有停歇。

write.en: Her relentless pursuit of excellence eventually earned her a place at a top university.
write.zh: 她不斷追求卓越，最後終於進入頂尖大學就讀。

example.en: As the boat sped across the bay, a cold spray of seawater hit our faces and soaked our jackets.
example.zh: 船快速駛過海灣時，冰冷的海水水花打在我們臉上，把外套都弄溼了。

listen.en: Please spray some water on the plants before you leave.
listen.zh: 你出門前請在植物上噴點水。

chinese.en: Many cities now spray disinfectant in public areas to reduce the spread of disease.
chinese.zh: 現在許多城市會在公共區域噴灑消毒劑，以減少疾病傳播。

english.en: Someone sprayed paint all over the wall of our school.
english.zh: 有人在我們學校的牆上到處噴漆。

speak.en: I always carry a bottle of insect spray when I go hiking.
speak.zh: 我去爬山時總會帶一瓶防蚊噴霧。

write.en: The cleaning staff spray the office desks with alcohol every evening after work.
write.zh: 清潔人員每天下班後都會在辦公桌上噴酒精。

example.en: When people are frightened, their bodies produce a physiological response: their muscles tense and their breathing becomes rapid.
example.zh: 人受到驚嚇時，身體會產生生理反應：肌肉緊繃，呼吸變得急促。

listen.en: Food and sleep are basic physiological needs for everyone.
listen.zh: 食物和睡眠是每個人基本的生理需求。

chinese.en: Researchers measured the physiological effects of long flights on pilots and cabin crew.
chinese.zh: 研究人員測量了長途飛行對機師和空服員的生理影響。

english.en: Some students experience physiological symptoms such as headaches before important exams.
english.zh: 有些學生在重要考試前會出現頭痛之類的生理症狀。

speak.en: I didn't realize jet lag had such strong physiological effects.
speak.zh: 我沒想到時差會造成這麼強烈的生理影響。

write.en: Doctors stress that addiction has both physiological and psychological causes that need treatment.
write.zh: 醫師強調，成癮有生理和心理兩方面的成因，都需要治療。

example.en: After the singer announced her concert, ticket sales surged, and the website crashed within minutes because of the heavy traffic.
example.zh: 那位歌手宣布開演唱會後，門票銷量暴增，網站因流量過大，幾分鐘內就當機了。

listen.en: The crowd surged forward as the gates opened.
listen.zh: 大門一開，人群就往前湧去。

chinese.en: According to the chart, the number of international students surged after the new policy.
chinese.zh: 根據圖表，新政策實施後，國際學生人數急遽增加。

english.en: She felt a sudden surge of anger when she read the message.
english.zh: 她讀到那則訊息時，突然一股怒氣湧上心頭。

speak.en: Online shopping really surged when everyone had to stay at home.
speak.zh: 大家都得待在家的時候，網購真的暴增。

write.en: A power surge during the storm damaged several computers in our office.
write.zh: 暴風雨期間發生突波，損壞了我們辦公室好幾台電腦。

example.en: Many academics argue that universities should focus more on research, while others believe teaching deserves equal attention.
example.zh: 許多學者主張大學應更重視研究，但也有人認為教學應該受到同等的重視。

listen.en: The academic year usually starts in September.
listen.zh: 學年通常從九月開始。

chinese.en: Students are expected to follow the rules of academic writing in their essays.
chinese.zh: 學生寫報告時，應遵守學術寫作的規範。

english.en: Academic qualifications are not the only thing employers look for.
english.zh: 學歷不是雇主唯一看重的條件。

speak.en: I wasn't very academic at school, but I loved sports.
speak.zh: 我以前在學校不太會讀書，但很熱愛運動。

write.en: The government plans to reduce academic pressure on high school students by changing the exam system.
write.zh: 政府計畫透過改革考試制度，減輕高中生的課業壓力。

example.en: Archaeologists found pieces of ancient pottery buried near the river, suggesting that people lived there long ago.
example.zh: 考古學家在河邊挖到古代陶器的碎片，顯示很久以前就有人在那裡生活。

listen.en: My grandmother keeps her pottery on a wooden shelf.
listen.zh: 我奶奶把她的陶器放在木頭架子上。

chinese.en: Yingge is famous for its pottery, which attracts many tourists every weekend.
chinese.zh: 鶯歌以陶瓷聞名，每個週末都吸引許多觀光客。

english.en: Making pottery helps me relax after a busy week at work.
english.zh: 忙了一週的工作後，做陶藝能幫助我放鬆。

speak.en: I'd love to try pottery, but I'm not very good with my hands.
speak.zh: 我很想試試做陶藝，但我的手不太巧。

write.en: The local government supports traditional crafts such as pottery to preserve the town's cultural heritage.
write.zh: 地方政府支持陶藝等傳統工藝，以保存小鎮的文化遺產。

example.en: When the manager announced that everyone would get an extra day off, a murmur of approval spread through the meeting room.
example.zh: 經理宣布大家可以多放一天假時，會議室裡響起一片低聲贊同。

listen.en: I could hear the gentle murmur of the stream.
listen.zh: 我聽得到溪水輕柔的潺潺聲。

chinese.en: The students murmured to each other while the teacher was writing on the board.
chinese.zh: 老師在黑板上寫字時，學生們彼此竊竊私語。

english.en: She murmured something in her sleep, but I couldn't understand it.
english.zh: 她在睡夢中喃喃說了些什麼，但我聽不懂。

speak.en: I love falling asleep to the murmur of rain outside.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡聽著窗外細細的雨聲入睡。

write.en: The new tax was accepted without a murmur, which surprised many economists.
write.zh: 新稅制沒有引起任何怨言就被接受了，令許多經濟學家感到意外。

example.en: Working night shifts can disturb your body's natural rhythm, making it hard to sleep well even on days off.
example.zh: 上夜班可能打亂身體的自然規律，讓你連休假日都很難睡好。

listen.en: My little sister has a great sense of rhythm.
listen.zh: 我妹妹很有節奏感。

chinese.en: Learning the rhythm of English sentences can make your speaking sound more natural.
chinese.zh: 掌握英文句子的節奏，能讓你的口說聽起來更自然。

english.en: It took me a few weeks to get used to the rhythm of university life.
english.zh: 我花了幾個星期才適應大學生活的步調。

speak.en: Living in the countryside, I enjoy the slower rhythm of life.
speak.zh: 住在鄉下，我很享受比較慢的生活節奏。

write.en: Doctors use a monitor to check whether the patient's heart rhythm is normal.
write.zh: 醫師用監測儀檢查病人的心律是否正常。

example.en: Unemployment fell steadily throughout the decade, while wages slowly rose, which suggested the economy was in good shape.
example.zh: 這十年間失業率穩定下降，薪資則緩慢上升，顯示經濟狀況良好。

listen.en: Her English has improved steadily over the past year.
listen.zh: 她的英文在過去這一年穩定進步。

chinese.en: The chart shows that online sales grew steadily, while store sales remained flat.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，網路銷售額穩定成長，而實體店面的銷售額則持平。

english.en: He held the ladder steadily while his father fixed the light.
english.zh: 他穩穩扶著梯子，讓爸爸修電燈。

speak.en: I've been saving steadily, so I can finally afford a trip abroad.
speak.zh: 我一直穩定地存錢，所以終於負擔得起出國旅行了。

write.en: The patient's condition is improving steadily, and she may be able to leave hospital soon.
write.zh: 病人的狀況正穩定好轉，她可能很快就能出院。

example.en: Residents were told to leave their homes immediately, as the hurricane was expected to bring strong winds and heavy flooding.
example.zh: 由於預計颶風將帶來強風和嚴重水災，居民被要求立即撤離家園。

listen.en: Our flight was cancelled because of the hurricane.
listen.zh: 我們的班機因為颶風取消了。

chinese.en: Scientists warn that climate change may make hurricanes stronger and more frequent.
chinese.zh: 科學家警告，氣候變遷可能使颶風變得更強、更頻繁。

english.en: Many tourists avoid traveling to the Caribbean during hurricane season.
english.zh: 許多觀光客會避免在颶風季節到加勒比海旅遊。

speak.en: I've never experienced a hurricane, but typhoons here can be scary too.
speak.zh: 我沒經歷過颶風，不過這裡的颱風也可能很嚇人。

write.en: The company had to close its factory for weeks after the hurricane damaged the power lines.
write.zh: 颶風損壞了電線，那家公司的工廠因此停工了好幾個星期。

example.en: Wearing a seat belt is compulsory in this country, and drivers who ignore the rule can receive a heavy fine.
example.zh: 在這個國家，繫安全帶是強制規定，不遵守的駕駛可能會被重罰。

listen.en: Physical education is a compulsory subject at our school.
listen.zh: 體育是我們學校的必修科目。

chinese.en: Many factories have now made safety training compulsory for all new employees.
chinese.zh: 現在許多工廠都規定所有新進員工必須接受安全訓練。

english.en: Attendance at the weekly meeting is compulsory for all staff.
english.zh: 所有員工都必須出席每週的會議。

speak.en: I think cooking classes should be compulsory in high schools.
speak.zh: 我覺得高中應該把烹飪課列為必修。

write.en: Should community service be compulsory for university students, or should it remain voluntary?
write.zh: 大學生的社區服務應該是強制的，還是應該維持自願參加？

example.en: The proportion of elderly residents in rural areas has increased, as many young adults have moved to the cities for work.
example.zh: 由於許多年輕人搬到城市工作，鄉村地區高齡居民的比例增加了。

listen.en: Your salary should rise in proportion to your experience.
listen.zh: 你的薪水應該隨著經驗成比例增加。

chinese.en: The chart compares the proportion of men and women who exercise regularly.
chinese.zh: 這張圖表比較了規律運動的男性與女性所占的比例。

english.en: Only a small proportion of the students passed the final exam.
english.zh: 只有一小部分學生通過了期末考。

speak.en: I think people sometimes blow small problems out of proportion.
speak.zh: 我覺得大家有時候會把小問題過度誇大。

write.en: The architect paid close attention to the proportions of the building to make it look elegant.
write.zh: 建築師非常注重建築物各部分的比例，好讓它看起來優雅。

example.en: Tourists gathered around the fountain to throw coins into the water, hoping their wishes would come true.
example.zh: 遊客聚集在噴泉旁，把硬幣丟進水裡，希望願望能夠成真。

listen.en: Let's meet by the fountain outside the library.
listen.zh: 我們在圖書館外面的噴水池旁碰面吧。

chinese.en: The school installed new drinking fountains so students could refill their own bottles.
chinese.zh: 學校裝設了新的飲水機，讓學生可以用自己的水壺裝水。

english.en: The old fountain in the park was turned off to save water.
english.zh: 為了節約用水，公園裡的老噴泉被關掉了。

speak.en: There's a lovely fountain near my office where I often eat lunch.
speak.zh: 我公司附近有個很漂亮的噴泉，我常在那裡吃午餐。

write.en: The city government plans to build a musical fountain to attract more visitors to the riverside.
write.zh: 市政府計畫興建一座音樂噴泉，吸引更多遊客到河濱。

example.en: As the repair bills continued to mount, the family finally decided to sell their old car and buy a new one.
example.zh: 隨著修車費用不斷增加，這家人最後決定賣掉舊車，換一台新車。

listen.en: She mounted her bike and rode off down the street.
listen.zh: 她跨上腳踏車，沿著街道騎走了。

chinese.en: The museum is mounting an exhibition of photographs taken by local students.
chinese.zh: 博物館正在籌辦一場當地學生攝影作品的展覽。

english.en: The workers mounted the new TV on the living room wall.
english.zh: 工人把新電視裝在客廳的牆上。

speak.en: My worries started to mount as the exam got closer.
speak.zh: 考試越來越近，我的擔憂也開始越積越多。

write.en: Environmental groups mounted a campaign to stop the construction of a new airport.
write.zh: 環保團體發起運動，阻止新機場的興建。

example.en: After shouting at her colleague in the meeting, she was so ashamed that she apologized to him the next morning.
example.zh: 她在會議上對同事大吼之後，覺得非常羞愧，隔天早上就向他道歉了。

listen.en: There is nothing to be ashamed of in asking for help.
listen.zh: 開口求助沒有什麼好丟臉的。

chinese.en: Many people are ashamed to admit that they cannot manage their own money.
chinese.zh: 很多人不好意思承認自己不會理財。

english.en: I was ashamed of my messy room when my friends visited.
english.zh: 朋友來訪時，我對自己凌亂的房間感到很不好意思。

speak.en: I'm a bit ashamed to say I've never read a whole book in English.
speak.zh: 說來有點丟臉，我從來沒讀完過一整本英文書。

write.en: Society should make sure that people with mental illness do not feel ashamed to seek treatment.
write.zh: 社會應該確保有心理疾病的人不會因為羞愧而不敢就醫。

example.en: The drought was exacerbated by unusually high temperatures, which dried up rivers and left farmers without enough water for their crops.
example.zh: 異常的高溫讓旱情更加嚴重，河川乾涸，農民沒有足夠的水灌溉作物。

listen.en: Scratching the rash will only exacerbate the itching.
listen.zh: 抓疹子只會讓它更癢。

chinese.en: Working late every night exacerbated his back pain and made it hard to concentrate.
chinese.zh: 每晚加班讓他的背痛更加嚴重，也讓他難以專心。

english.en: Poor sleep during exam season can exacerbate anxiety in university students.
english.zh: 考試期間睡不好會加劇大學生的焦慮。

speak.en: Honestly, social media tends to exacerbate my stress rather than relieve it.
speak.zh: 老實說，社群媒體往往加重我的壓力，而不是幫我紓壓。

write.en: Rising housing prices have exacerbated the gap between rich and poor families.
write.zh: 房價上漲加劇了富裕家庭和貧困家庭之間的差距。

example.en: The number of visitors to the museum fluctuated throughout the year, peaking in summer and dropping sharply in winter.
example.zh: 博物館的參觀人數全年起伏不定，夏天達到高峰，冬天則大幅下降。

listen.en: His mood seems to fluctuate from day to day.
listen.zh: 他的心情似乎每天都起伏不定。

chinese.en: The graph shows that oil prices fluctuated between sixty and ninety dollars per barrel.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，油價在每桶六十到九十美元之間波動。

english.en: My weight tends to fluctuate when I'm busy at work.
english.zh: 我工作忙碌時，體重往往會起伏不定。

speak.en: The temperature here fluctuates a lot, so I always bring a jacket.
speak.zh: 這裡的氣溫變化很大，所以我總是會帶件外套。

write.en: Students' motivation can fluctuate during the semester, so teachers should vary their activities.
write.zh: 學生的學習動機在學期中可能起伏不定，所以老師應該變化課堂活動。

example.en: When their parents became seriously ill, the children lived with a foster family for several years.
example.zh: 父母重病期間，孩子們在寄養家庭住了好幾年。

listen.en: The couple decided to foster a child last year.
listen.zh: 那對夫妻去年決定寄養一個孩子。

chinese.en: Team sports can foster cooperation and a strong sense of responsibility among teenagers.
chinese.zh: 團隊運動能培養青少年的合作精神和強烈的責任感。

english.en: Our company holds monthly events to foster good relationships among staff.
english.zh: 我們公司每個月舉辦活動，促進員工之間的良好關係。

speak.en: I think reading with kids helps foster a love of books.
speak.zh: 我覺得陪孩子閱讀有助於培養他們對書的熱愛。

write.en: Public libraries and parks can foster a sense of community in crowded cities.
write.zh: 公共圖書館和公園能在擁擠的城市中培養社區意識。

example.en: The audit revealed that the charity had spent far more on office costs than on helping the people it served.
example.zh: 審計結果顯示，這個慈善機構花在行政開銷上的錢，遠比用來幫助服務對象的錢還多。

listen.en: Our accounts will be audited at the end of the month.
listen.zh: 我們的帳目會在月底接受查核。

chinese.en: The school conducted an energy audit to find out where electricity was being wasted.
chinese.zh: 學校進行了一次能源使用評估，找出哪些地方在浪費電。

english.en: The government audits public hospitals to make sure money is used properly.
english.zh: 政府會稽核公立醫院，確保經費運用得當。

speak.en: I was so nervous during my first audit at work.
speak.zh: 我第一次在工作上遇到稽核時超緊張的。

write.en: After the safety audit, the factory replaced its old machines and retrained its workers.
write.zh: 安全稽核結束後，工廠汰換了老舊機器，並重新訓練員工。

example.en: Because the island depends on ships for almost everything, maritime law is a popular subject at its university.
example.zh: 由於這座島幾乎所有物資都仰賴船運，海事法是當地大學很熱門的科目。

listen.en: We visited the maritime museum near the old harbour.
listen.zh: 我們參觀了舊港口附近的海事博物館。

chinese.en: Britain's maritime climate brings mild winters, cool summers and frequent rain throughout the year.
chinese.zh: 英國的海洋性氣候帶來溫和的冬天、涼爽的夏天，而且一年到頭經常下雨。

english.en: Many young people are no longer interested in maritime careers.
english.zh: 許多年輕人對海事相關的職業不再感興趣。

speak.en: My hometown has a long maritime history, so seafood is everywhere.
speak.zh: 我的家鄉有悠久的航海歷史，所以到處都是海鮮。

write.en: Neighbouring countries signed an agreement to share maritime safety information and rescue resources.
write.zh: 鄰近國家簽署協議，共享海上安全資訊與救援資源。

example.en: The lawyers kept raising new objections, which only prolonged the trial and frustrated everyone waiting for a verdict.
example.zh: 律師們不斷提出新的異議，結果只是拖長了審判，讓每個等待判決的人都很沮喪。

listen.en: Arguing about small details will only prolong the meeting.
listen.zh: 為小細節爭論只會讓會議拖得更久。

chinese.en: Prolonged exposure to loud music through headphones can permanently damage young people's hearing.
chinese.zh: 長時間透過耳機聽大聲的音樂，可能對年輕人的聽力造成永久傷害。

english.en: The cold weather prolonged the construction of the new bridge.
english.zh: 寒冷的天氣拖長了新橋的施工期。

speak.en: I didn't want to prolong the conversation, so I said goodbye.
speak.zh: 我不想讓對話拖太久，所以就道別了。

write.en: Some companies use special packaging to prolong the shelf life of fresh food.
write.zh: 有些公司使用特殊包裝來延長生鮮食品的保存期限。

example.en: The chart shows that approximately 40% of households owned a car in 1990, rising to nearly 70% by 2020.
example.zh: 圖表顯示，1990年約有40%的家庭擁有汽車，到了2020年上升到將近70%。

listen.en: Both bedrooms in the flat are approximately the same size.
listen.zh: 這間公寓的兩間臥室大小差不多。

chinese.en: The flight was delayed, so we landed at approximately midnight local time.
chinese.zh: 班機延誤，所以我們大約在當地時間午夜降落。

english.en: Approximately half of the students at this university live on campus.
english.zh: 這所大學大約一半的學生住在校內。

speak.en: It takes approximately twenty minutes to walk from my home to work.
speak.zh: 從我家走路到公司大約要二十分鐘。

write.en: The recipe makes approximately twelve cookies, depending on how large you make them.
write.zh: 這個食譜大約可以做十二片餅乾，視你做的大小而定。

example.en: Critics called the plan ridiculous, pointing out that it would cost far more than it could ever save.
example.zh: 批評者認為這項計畫很荒謬，並指出它的成本遠超過它可能省下的錢。

listen.en: I felt ridiculous wearing that costume at the party.
listen.zh: 我在派對上穿那套戲服，覺得自己很可笑。

chinese.en: The rules at my old school were so strict that some of them seemed ridiculous.
chinese.zh: 我以前學校的規定非常嚴格，有些甚至顯得很荒謬。

english.en: My boss gave me a ridiculous deadline for the report.
english.zh: 我老闆給了我一個離譜的報告期限。

speak.en: Honestly, I think spending hours queuing for a new phone is ridiculous.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得為了一支新手機排好幾個小時的隊很荒謬。

write.en: The idea that young people are lazy simply because they use technology is ridiculous.
write.zh: 認為年輕人只因為使用科技就很懶惰，這種想法很荒謬。

example.en: The library keeps the ancient manuscripts in a dark, cool room because light and heat can damage the fragile paper.
example.zh: 圖書館把古代手稿存放在陰暗涼爽的房間，因為光線和高溫會損害脆弱的紙張。

listen.en: The editor returned my manuscript with many helpful comments.
listen.zh: 編輯把我的稿子退回來，附上許多實用的意見。

chinese.en: Researchers must revise their manuscripts carefully before submitting them to an academic journal.
chinese.zh: 研究人員在投稿到學術期刊之前，必須仔細修改他們的稿件。

english.en: The original manuscript was discovered in an old wooden box.
english.zh: 那份原始手稿是在一個舊木箱裡被發現的。

speak.en: I'd love to see the handwritten manuscript of my favourite book.
speak.zh: 我很想看看我最喜歡的那本書的手寫原稿。

write.en: Digitising historical manuscripts allows scholars around the world to study them online for free.
write.zh: 將歷史手稿數位化，讓世界各地的學者都能免費在網路上研究。

example.en: The author's central thesis is that cities should be designed for people rather than cars, and every chapter supports this idea.
example.zh: 作者的核心論點是，城市應該為人而設計，而不是為汽車，書中每一章都支持這個觀點。

listen.en: My supervisor helped me choose a topic for my thesis.
listen.zh: 我的指導教授幫我選定了論文題目。

chinese.en: A good essay begins with a clear thesis statement that tells readers what you will argue.
chinese.zh: 一篇好文章開頭會有清楚的論點陳述，告訴讀者你要論證什麼。

english.en: She must submit her thesis before the end of June.
english.zh: 她必須在六月底前繳交論文。

speak.en: Writing my thesis was stressful, but I learned a lot from it.
speak.zh: 寫論文壓力很大，但我從中學到很多。

write.en: Recent research has challenged the popular thesis that technology always makes people less social.
write.zh: 近期研究挑戰了「科技總是讓人變得較不善交際」這個普遍的論點。

example.en: Once a shy child, she bloomed into a confident young woman after joining the drama club at university.
example.zh: 她小時候很害羞，上大學加入戲劇社後，蛻變成一位自信的年輕女性。

listen.en: The roses in our garden are in full bloom.
listen.zh: 我們花園裡的玫瑰正盛開。

chinese.en: Warmer winters are causing some plants to bloom earlier than they did in the past.
chinese.zh: 冬天變暖，導致有些植物比過去更早開花。

english.en: This plant only blooms once a year, usually in summer.
english.zh: 這種植物一年只開一次花，通常在夏天。

speak.en: I love walking around campus when the trees come into bloom.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡在樹木開花的時候在校園裡散步。

write.en: With the right support, local arts can bloom even in small rural towns.
write.zh: 只要有適當的支持，地方藝術即使在小鄉鎮也能蓬勃發展。

example.en: As a veteran of the hotel industry with decades of experience, Mr Lin knows exactly how to handle difficult guests.
example.zh: 林先生是在飯店業工作數十年的老手，非常清楚如何應付難纏的客人。

listen.en: Our coach is a veteran player who knows the game well.
listen.zh: 我們的教練是一位資深球員，對這項運動非常了解。

chinese.en: The government offers free medical care and housing support to veterans who served overseas.
chinese.zh: 政府為曾在海外服役的退伍軍人提供免費醫療與住宅補貼。

english.en: The new teacher often asks a veteran colleague for advice.
english.zh: 那位新老師常向一位資深同事請教。

speak.en: My grandfather is a navy veteran, and he loves telling stories.
speak.zh: 我爺爺是海軍退伍軍人，他很喜歡說故事。

write.en: Companies should value veteran employees instead of replacing them with younger, cheaper workers.
write.zh: 公司應該重視資深員工，而不是用更年輕、更便宜的人力取代他們。

example.en: Our flat is very handy for the station, so I can walk there in five minutes and never worry about traffic.
example.zh: 我們的公寓離車站很近，走路五分鐘就到，完全不用擔心塞車。

listen.en: Keep your umbrella handy because it might rain later.
listen.zh: 把雨傘放在手邊，因為晚點可能會下雨。

chinese.en: This app has a handy feature that reminds you to drink water throughout the day.
chinese.zh: 這個應用程式有個很方便的功能，會提醒你整天都要喝水。

english.en: My colleague is very handy with computers and often helps me.
english.zh: 我同事很擅長使用電腦，常常幫我的忙。

speak.en: Learning a few basic phrases is really handy when you travel abroad.
speak.zh: 出國旅行時，學幾句基本用語真的很實用。

write.en: Free Wi-Fi in public spaces is handy for tourists and remote workers.
write.zh: 公共場所的免費Wi-Fi對觀光客和遠距工作者來說很方便。

example.en: Because the concert overlapped with my final exam, I had to sell my ticket to a friend.
example.zh: 因為演唱會和我的期末考撞期，我只好把票賣給朋友。

listen.en: Our working hours overlap, so we can share a ride.
listen.zh: 我們的上班時間有重疊，所以可以共乘。

chinese.en: There is considerable overlap between the duties of the marketing and sales departments.
chinese.zh: 行銷部門與業務部門的職責有相當多重疊。

english.en: Arrange the paper sheets so that their edges slightly overlap.
english.zh: 把這些紙張排好，讓它們的邊緣稍微重疊。

speak.en: My hobbies and my job overlap quite a bit, which I really enjoy.
speak.zh: 我的興趣和工作有不少重疊的地方，我很喜歡這一點。

write.en: When several government agencies have overlapping responsibilities, public money is often wasted.
write.zh: 當多個政府機關的職責重疊時，公帑往往會被浪費。

example.en: Adolescence is a period of rapid physical and emotional change, when children gradually become independent adults.
example.zh: 青春期是身心快速變化的階段，孩子會在這段期間逐漸成為獨立的大人。

listen.en: She spent most of her adolescence living with her grandparents.
listen.zh: 她青春期大多和祖父母住在一起。

chinese.en: Sleep patterns change in adolescence, which is why many teenagers find early mornings difficult.
chinese.zh: 青春期的睡眠模式會改變，這就是為什麼許多青少年很難早起。

english.en: Having good friends is especially important for students during adolescence.
english.zh: 擁有好朋友對青春期的學生特別重要。

speak.en: Looking back, my adolescence was full of music and football.
speak.zh: 回想起來，我的青春期充滿了音樂和足球。

write.en: Schools should offer counselling services to help students cope with the pressures of adolescence.
write.zh: 學校應該提供輔導服務，幫助學生面對青春期的種種壓力。

example.en: Security cameras were installed in the car park to deter thieves, and break-ins dropped sharply within months.
example.zh: 停車場裝設了監視器來嚇阻小偷，幾個月內闖入案件就大幅減少。

listen.en: The bad weather did not deter the runners from finishing.
listen.zh: 惡劣的天氣並沒有讓跑者放棄完成比賽。

chinese.en: High tuition fees may deter many talented but poorer students from applying to university.
chinese.zh: 高昂的學費可能讓許多有才華但家境較差的學生不敢申請大學。

english.en: Don't let a single failure deter you from trying again.
english.zh: 別讓一次失敗阻止你再次嘗試。

speak.en: Honestly, the long queue almost deterred me from going inside.
speak.zh: 老實說，大排長龍差點讓我打消進去的念頭。

write.en: Some experts doubt whether harsher punishments really deter people from committing crimes.
write.zh: 有些專家懷疑，更嚴厲的懲罰是否真的能遏止人們犯罪。

example.en: During the online meeting, nobody could hear Tom because he had forgotten to switch on his microphone.
example.zh: 線上會議時，大家都聽不到湯姆說話，因為他忘了打開麥克風。

listen.en: The singer picked up the microphone and smiled at the crowd.
listen.zh: 歌手拿起麥克風，對著觀眾微笑。

chinese.en: Smart speakers use sensitive microphones, which raises concerns about privacy in people's homes.
chinese.zh: 智慧音箱使用高靈敏度的麥克風，這引發了人們對居家隱私的擔憂。

english.en: The teacher used a wireless microphone in the large lecture hall.
english.zh: 老師在大型演講廳裡使用無線麥克風。

speak.en: I get really nervous whenever someone hands me a microphone.
speak.zh: 每次有人把麥克風遞給我，我就會非常緊張。

write.en: The reporter pushed her microphone towards the coach, hoping for a quick comment.
write.zh: 記者把麥克風遞向教練，希望他能簡短回應幾句。

example.en: As the river kept rising after days of heavy rain, officials ordered residents of low-lying areas to evacuate immediately.
example.zh: 連日大雨後河水持續上漲，官員下令低窪地區的居民立即撤離。

listen.en: The hotel guests were evacuated safely during the storm.
listen.zh: 暴風雨期間，飯店房客都被安全疏散。

chinese.en: Schools regularly hold drills to teach students how to evacuate calmly in an earthquake.
chinese.zh: 學校定期舉辦演練，教導學生在地震時如何冷靜疏散。

english.en: The police evacuated the station after finding a suspicious bag.
english.zh: 警方發現一個可疑的袋子後，疏散了車站。

speak.en: We had to evacuate our flat once because of a gas leak.
speak.zh: 我們曾經因為瓦斯外洩而必須撤離公寓。

write.en: Coastal towns need clear plans for evacuating elderly residents before a typhoon arrives.
write.zh: 沿海城鎮需要有明確的計畫，在颱風來襲前疏散年長居民。

example.en: According to the graph, the number of visitors plummeted from 80,000 in March to just 5,000 in April.
example.zh: 根據圖表，遊客人數從三月的八萬人驟降到四月的僅僅五千人。

listen.en: Temperatures plummeted overnight, and the roads turned icy.
listen.zh: 氣溫一夜之間驟降，道路都結冰了。

chinese.en: The company's share price plummeted when investors learned about the failed product launch.
chinese.zh: 投資人得知新產品上市失敗後，這家公司的股價暴跌。

english.en: In many areas, bird populations have plummeted because of habitat loss.
english.zh: 在許多地區，鳥類數量因為棲地消失而急遽下降。

speak.en: My motivation plummeted when I realised how much work was left.
speak.zh: 當我發現還剩下多少工作時，我的動力一下子跌到谷底。

write.en: Student attendance tends to plummet in the final weeks before the summer holidays.
write.zh: 在暑假前的最後幾週，學生出席率往往會大幅下降。

example.en: Before travelling to some tropical countries, visitors may need a vaccine to protect them from diseases carried by mosquitoes.
example.zh: 前往某些熱帶國家之前，旅客可能需要接種疫苗，以預防蚊子傳播的疾病。

listen.en: I got my flu vaccine at the local clinic.
listen.zh: 我在附近的診所打了流感疫苗。

chinese.en: Free vaccines are provided for young children and elderly people at public health centres.
chinese.zh: 公立衛生所為幼童和長者提供免費疫苗。

english.en: Dog owners should take their pets for a rabies vaccine every year.
english.zh: 養狗的人應該每年帶寵物去打狂犬病疫苗。

speak.en: My arm felt a bit sore after the vaccine, but nothing serious.
speak.zh: 打完疫苗後我的手臂有點痠痛，但沒什麼大礙。

write.en: Working in a vaccine laboratory requires strict attention to safety and hygiene.
write.zh: 在疫苗實驗室工作，必須嚴格注意安全與衛生。

example.en: When floods cut off the mountain village, planes parachuted food and medicine to the stranded residents.
example.zh: 洪水使山村對外交通中斷時，飛機用降落傘把食物和藥品空投給受困的居民。

listen.en: My brother wants to try a parachute jump this summer.
listen.zh: 我哥哥今年夏天想嘗試跳傘。

chinese.en: Every parachute is checked carefully by trained staff before it is packed for a jump.
chinese.zh: 每頂降落傘在打包準備跳傘前，都會由受過訓練的人員仔細檢查。

english.en: The children played with a colourful parachute in the school gym.
english.zh: 孩子們在學校體育館裡玩一頂彩色降落傘。

speak.en: I'd never parachute out of a plane, because I'm terrified of heights.
speak.zh: 我絕對不會從飛機上跳傘，因為我超怕高的。

write.en: Companies sometimes parachute outside managers into struggling departments instead of promoting existing staff.
write.zh: 公司有時會從外部空降主管到經營困難的部門，而不是拔擢現有員工。

example.en: The deer was startled by the sound of our car and quickly disappeared into the thick forest.
example.zh: 那隻鹿被我們車子的聲音嚇到，很快就消失在茂密的森林裡。

listen.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you in the dark.
listen.zh: 抱歉，我不是故意在黑暗中嚇你的。

chinese.en: Researchers were startled to find high levels of plastic in the drinking water samples.
chinese.zh: 研究人員驚訝地發現，飲用水樣本中含有大量塑膠。

english.en: The sudden thunder startled the baby, and she began to cry.
english.zh: 突如其來的雷聲把寶寶嚇了一跳，她開始哭了起來。

speak.en: My cat gets startled by every little noise in the house.
speak.zh: 我的貓對家裡每個小聲響都會受到驚嚇。

write.en: My manager startled everyone at the meeting by announcing that she was leaving the company.
write.zh: 我的主管在會議上宣布她要離職，讓所有人大吃一驚。

example.en: The graph shows that rice prices more than doubled between 2010 and 2020, while wages rose only slightly.
example.zh: 圖表顯示，2010年到2020年間米價漲了一倍以上，而薪資只略微上升。

listen.en: The hotel charges double during the holiday season.
listen.zh: 這家飯店在旺季收費加倍。

chinese.en: My sister booked a double room so we could share it during the trip.
chinese.zh: 我姊姊訂了一間雙人房，這樣旅途中我們可以同住。

english.en: The price of eggs in our supermarket has doubled since last year.
english.zh: 我們超市的蛋價比去年漲了一倍。

speak.en: I usually order a double espresso to stay awake in the morning.
speak.zh: 我早上通常點一杯雙份濃縮咖啡來提神。

write.en: Exercising outdoors has a double benefit: it improves fitness and reduces stress.
write.zh: 在戶外運動有雙重好處：既能增強體能，又能減輕壓力。

example.en: Small farmers are at the mercy of the weather, so a single storm can destroy a whole year's income.
example.zh: 小農只能任由天氣擺布，一場暴風雨就可能毀掉整年的收入。

listen.en: The players begged the coach for mercy after training.
listen.zh: 練習結束後，球員們向教練求饒。

chinese.en: Out of mercy, the landlord allowed the struggling family to pay their rent late.
chinese.zh: 房東出於憐憫，允許這個經濟困難的家庭晚點繳房租。

english.en: Our maths teacher showed us no mercy and gave us extra homework.
english.zh: 我們的數學老師毫不留情，給了我們額外的作業。

speak.en: It was a mercy that nobody got hurt in the accident.
speak.zh: 幸好這場意外沒有人受傷。

write.en: Many people believe that the justice system should balance punishment with mercy.
write.zh: 許多人認為司法制度應該在懲罰與寬恕之間取得平衡。

example.en: After weeks of stress, she lost her appetite and could barely finish half a sandwich at lunch.
example.zh: 經過幾週的壓力，她食慾全失，午餐連半個三明治都幾乎吃不完。

listen.en: Don't eat snacks now or you'll spoil your appetite.
listen.zh: 現在別吃零食，不然待會會吃不下正餐。

chinese.en: Young people today seem to have a huge appetite for short online videos.
chinese.zh: 現在的年輕人似乎對網路短影音有很大的胃口。

english.en: The medicine made him lose his appetite for several days.
english.zh: 這種藥讓他好幾天都沒有食慾。

speak.en: Honestly, I always have a good appetite when I'm travelling.
speak.zh: 老實說，我旅行的時候胃口總是很好。

write.en: Investors have shown a strong appetite for green energy projects this year.
write.zh: 今年投資人對綠能計畫展現出濃厚的興趣。

example.en: Although the salary was attractive, he was reluctant to accept the job because it meant moving abroad.
example.zh: 雖然薪水很吸引人，但他不太願意接下這份工作，因為那代表要搬到國外。

listen.en: My grandmother is reluctant to use a smartphone.
listen.zh: 我奶奶不太願意使用智慧型手機。

chinese.en: Some companies remain reluctant to let employees work from home on a regular basis.
chinese.zh: 有些公司仍然不太願意讓員工固定在家工作。

english.en: She was reluctant to lend her new car to anyone.
english.zh: 她不願意把新車借給任何人。

speak.en: To be honest, I was a bit reluctant to join the drama club.
speak.zh: 老實說，我當時有點不想加入戲劇社。

write.en: Residents gave their reluctant agreement to the plan after the council promised more parking spaces.
write.zh: 市議會承諾增加停車位後，居民才勉強同意這項計畫。

example.en: Finding accommodation in London is difficult, as rents are high and suitable flats are snapped up within days.
example.zh: 在倫敦找住處很困難，因為租金高，合適的公寓幾天內就會被搶光。

listen.en: We still need to book accommodation for our summer trip.
listen.zh: 我們還需要為暑假旅行訂住宿。

chinese.en: The festival attracted so many visitors that hotels could not provide enough accommodation.
chinese.zh: 這個節慶吸引了大量遊客，飯店無法提供足夠的住房。

english.en: The price of the tour already includes meals and accommodation.
english.zh: 這個行程的價格已經包含餐點和住宿。

speak.en: I'm living in rented accommodation near my office at the moment.
speak.zh: 我目前住在公司附近租來的房子。

write.en: After the flood, the council moved several families into temporary accommodation until their homes were repaired.
write.zh: 水災過後，市政府把幾戶人家安置到臨時住所，直到他們的房子修好為止。

example.en: The two designs look identical at first, but there is a slight difference in the shape of the handles.
example.zh: 這兩款設計乍看一模一樣，但把手的形狀有些微差異。

listen.en: I woke up with a slight headache this morning.
listen.zh: 我今天早上醒來時有點頭痛。

chinese.en: She was a slight woman, but she carried the heavy boxes up the stairs easily.
chinese.zh: 她身材瘦小，卻輕輕鬆鬆就把那些重箱子搬上樓。

english.en: There is only a slight chance of rain tomorrow afternoon.
english.zh: 明天下午下雨的機率很低。

speak.en: Honestly, I'm not worried about the exam in the slightest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我一點也不擔心這次考試。

write.en: Even a slight change in ocean temperature can seriously affect coral reefs.
write.zh: 即使海水溫度只有些微變化，也可能嚴重影響珊瑚礁。

example.en: To protect the wildlife, visitors are asked to keep noise to a minimum and stay on the marked paths.
example.zh: 為了保護野生動物，遊客被要求把噪音降到最低，並走在標示的步道上。

listen.en: The government plans to raise the minimum wage again.
listen.zh: 政府計畫再次調漲最低工資。

chinese.en: You should spend a minimum of thirty minutes on each writing task.
chinese.zh: 每一篇寫作題你至少應該花三十分鐘。

english.en: The minimum age for getting a driving license here is eighteen.
english.zh: 這裡考駕照的最低年齡是十八歲。

speak.en: I try to do the bare minimum of housework on weekends.
speak.zh: 週末我盡量只做最基本的家事。

write.en: At a minimum, every school should provide students with clean drinking water and safe classrooms.
write.zh: 每所學校至少應該為學生提供乾淨的飲用水和安全的教室。

example.en: The small coastal town boasts clean beaches, fresh seafood and some of the friendliest people in the country.
example.zh: 這座海邊小鎮擁有乾淨的海灘、新鮮的海鮮，還有全國數一數二友善的居民。

listen.en: Our neighbor often boasts of his cooking skills.
listen.zh: 我們的鄰居常誇耀自己的廚藝。

chinese.en: The company boasted that its new phone had the longest battery life on the market.
chinese.zh: 這家公司誇口說，他們的新手機是市面上電池續航力最長的。

english.en: My cousin is always boasting about his expensive new car.
english.zh: 我表哥老是在炫耀他那輛昂貴的新車。

speak.en: My hometown doesn't boast any famous sights, but it's peaceful.
speak.zh: 我的家鄉沒有什麼著名景點，但很寧靜。

write.en: The new library boasts a rooftop garden where students can read in the sunshine.
write.zh: 新圖書館有座屋頂花園，學生可以在陽光下閱讀。

example.en: As more people shop online, many traditional department stores have gone into decline and some have closed completely.
example.zh: 隨著越來越多人上網購物，許多傳統百貨公司逐漸沒落，有些甚至已經完全歇業。

listen.en: She politely declined the invitation to the party.
listen.zh: 她客氣地婉拒了派對的邀請。

chinese.en: The chart shows a sharp decline in the use of coal after the new policy.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，新政策實施後，煤炭的使用量大幅下降。

english.en: The spokesperson declined to comment on the rumors about the merger.
english.zh: 發言人拒絕對合併的傳聞發表評論。

speak.en: I think reading habits have declined because everyone's on their phones.
speak.zh: 我覺得大家的閱讀習慣衰退了，因為每個人都在滑手機。

write.en: Birth rates in many developed countries continue to decline, which puts pressure on pension systems.
write.zh: 許多已開發國家的出生率持續下滑，對退休金制度造成壓力。

example.en: In some engineering departments, the gender ratio is still uneven, with men outnumbering women by about four to one.
example.zh: 在某些工程科系，性別比例仍然失衡，男性人數大約是女性的四倍。

listen.en: The recipe uses a simple ratio of flour to water.
listen.zh: 這道食譜的麵粉和水比例很簡單。

chinese.en: Mix the paint and water in a ratio of two to one before you start.
chinese.zh: 開始之前，先把油漆和水以二比一的比例混合。

english.en: The table compares the ratio of urban to rural residents in each region.
english.zh: 這張表比較了各地區城市與鄉村居民的比例。

speak.en: I think a lower student-teacher ratio really helps kids learn.
speak.zh: 我覺得較低的師生比真的能幫助孩子學習。

write.en: As the population ages, the ratio of workers to retirees is falling sharply.
write.zh: 隨著人口老化，勞動人口與退休人口的比例正急遽下降。

example.en: When the singer arrived at the airport, the terminal was under siege from hundreds of excited fans holding signs.
example.zh: 那位歌手抵達機場時，航廈被數百名舉著牌子的興奮粉絲團團包圍。

listen.en: The castle was under siege for many months.
listen.zh: 這座城堡被圍困了好幾個月。

chinese.en: During the flu season, local clinics felt under siege as patients filled every waiting room.
chinese.zh: 流感季期間，病患擠滿了每間候診室，地方診所彷彿被團團圍住。

english.en: The army laid siege to the city for several weeks.
english.zh: 軍隊圍攻這座城市長達好幾週。

speak.en: Honestly, my inbox feels like it's under siege every Monday.
speak.zh: 說真的，每到星期一，我的收件匣就像被郵件圍攻一樣。

write.en: Under constant criticism, the management developed a siege mentality and stopped listening to staff.
write.zh: 在不斷的批評聲中，管理階層產生了防衛心態，不再傾聽員工的意見。

example.en: At Oxford, each student meets a personal tutor every week to discuss essays and get detailed feedback.
example.zh: 在牛津大學，每位學生每週都會和個人導師見面，討論論文並獲得詳細的回饋。

listen.en: He tutors high school students in English after work.
listen.zh: 他下班後幫高中生上英文家教。

chinese.en: Many university students earn extra money by tutoring children in the evenings.
chinese.zh: 許多大學生晚上靠幫小朋友上家教賺外快。

english.en: My tutor helped me improve my writing in two months.
english.zh: 我的家教在兩個月內幫我提升了寫作能力。

speak.en: I actually had an online tutor when I was preparing for IELTS.
speak.zh: 其實我準備雅思的時候有請線上家教。

write.en: Some experts worry that expensive tutoring gives wealthy families an unfair advantage in education.
write.zh: 有些專家擔心，昂貴的家教讓富裕家庭在教育上享有不公平的優勢。

example.en: After losing its biggest client, the small company was on the brink of collapse until a new investor stepped in.
example.zh: 失去最大的客戶後，這家小公司一度瀕臨倒閉，直到一位新投資人出手相助。

listen.en: The team was on the brink of winning the final.
listen.zh: 這支隊伍差一點就要贏得決賽。

chinese.en: Years of overwork had pushed him to the brink of a serious breakdown.
chinese.zh: 多年的過勞讓他瀕臨嚴重崩潰的邊緣。

english.en: Careful conservation work brought the rare bird back from the brink.
english.zh: 細心的保育工作讓這種珍稀鳥類擺脫了滅絕危機。

speak.en: I was on the brink of giving up, but my friends encouraged me.
speak.zh: 我當時差點就要放棄了，但朋友們鼓勵了我。

write.en: The two countries stepped back from the brink and agreed to restart trade talks.
write.zh: 兩國從危機邊緣退了一步，同意重啟貿易談判。

example.en: Oil is added to the engine to reduce friction between the moving parts, which helps prevent overheating and damage.
example.zh: 引擎裡加入機油可以減少運轉零件之間的摩擦，有助於防止過熱和損壞。

listen.en: There has always been some friction between my sisters.
listen.zh: 我的姊妹之間一直有些摩擦。

chinese.en: Differences in working style are a common source of friction in international teams.
chinese.zh: 工作風格的差異是跨國團隊中常見的摩擦來源。

english.en: Rubbing your hands together creates friction and makes them warm.
english.zh: 雙手互相搓揉會產生摩擦，讓手變暖。

speak.en: I try to avoid friction with my coworkers by communicating clearly.
speak.zh: 我會盡量把話說清楚，避免和同事起摩擦。

write.en: The new tax on imports has created friction between the neighboring countries.
write.zh: 這項新的進口稅已在鄰近國家之間造成摩擦。

example.en: The hotel looked lovely online, but the room was awful, with dirty sheets and a broken shower.
example.zh: 這家旅館在網路上看起來很漂亮，但房間糟透了，床單很髒，淋浴設備也壞了。

listen.en: I feel awful about forgetting your birthday last week.
listen.zh: 上週忘了你的生日，我真的很過意不去。

chinese.en: It takes an awful lot of patience to teach young children to read.
chinese.zh: 教小孩子識字需要非常多的耐心。

english.en: The traffic in the city center is awful during rush hour.
english.zh: 市中心在尖峰時段的交通非常糟糕。

speak.en: Honestly, the food at that restaurant was absolutely awful.
speak.zh: 說真的，那家餐廳的東西真的超難吃。

write.en: Workers in some factories still face awful conditions, such as long hours and poor ventilation.
write.zh: 有些工廠的工人仍面臨惡劣的工作環境，例如工時過長和通風不良。

example.en: After the factory installed new machines, productivity rose sharply, and workers could finish the same orders in half the time.
example.zh: 工廠裝設新機器後，生產力大幅提升，工人只要一半的時間就能完成同樣的訂單。

listen.en: Working from home has boosted my productivity a lot.
listen.zh: 在家工作大幅提升了我的效率。

chinese.en: Some managers believe that open-plan offices reduce productivity because of constant noise.
chinese.zh: 有些主管認為開放式辦公室因為持續不斷的噪音而降低生產力。

english.en: Lack of sleep can seriously affect students' productivity at school.
english.zh: 睡眠不足會嚴重影響學生在學校的效率。

speak.en: My productivity drops a lot if I check my phone constantly.
speak.zh: 如果我一直看手機，效率就會大幅下降。

write.en: Investing in staff training is one of the most effective ways to raise national productivity.
write.zh: 投資員工培訓是提升國家生產力最有效的方法之一。

example.en: Learning a language is a gradual process, so you shouldn't expect to speak fluently after only a few lessons.
example.zh: 學語言是一個循序漸進的過程，所以別期待只上幾堂課就能說得很流利。

listen.en: There has been a gradual change in public opinion.
listen.zh: 民意已經逐漸改變。

chinese.en: The path up the hill has a gentle, gradual slope that suits older walkers.
chinese.zh: 上山的步道坡度和緩，很適合年長的健行者。

english.en: The doctor recommended a gradual return to my normal exercise routine.
english.zh: 醫生建議我逐步恢復平常的運動習慣。

speak.en: I've noticed a gradual improvement in my listening skills lately.
speak.zh: 我最近發現自己的聽力逐漸進步。

write.en: The government favors a gradual reduction in coal use rather than a sudden ban.
write.zh: 政府傾向逐步減少燃煤使用，而不是突然全面禁止。

example.en: Without a full scholarship covering tuition and living costs, he could never have afforded to study abroad.
example.zh: 要是沒有涵蓋學費和生活費的全額獎學金，他根本負擔不起出國念書。

listen.en: I'm applying for a scholarship for my master's degree.
listen.zh: 我正在申請碩士學位的獎學金。

chinese.en: The professor is respected for her careful scholarship on ancient Chinese poetry.
chinese.zh: 這位教授因她對中國古典詩詞的嚴謹研究而備受敬重。

english.en: Many talented athletes attend college in America on sports scholarships.
english.zh: 許多有天分的運動員靠運動獎學金在美國讀大學。

speak.en: Getting that scholarship was honestly the proudest moment of my life.
speak.zh: 說真的，拿到那筆獎學金是我人生中最驕傲的時刻。

write.en: Governments should offer more scholarships to talented students from low-income rural families.
write.zh: 政府應該為來自鄉村低收入家庭的優秀學生提供更多獎學金。

example.en: The village has no hospital, so residents rely on a small clinic that is open only three days a week.
example.zh: 村子裡沒有醫院，所以居民只能依靠一間每週只開三天的小診所。

listen.en: The clinic near my house is closed on Sunday afternoons.
listen.zh: 我家附近的診所星期天下午沒有開。

chinese.en: The university runs a free clinic where students can talk to counselors about stress.
chinese.zh: 這所大學設有免費諮詢門診，學生可以和輔導員聊聊壓力的問題。

english.en: You should go to the clinic if your fever continues.
english.zh: 如果你一直發燒，就應該去診所看看。

speak.en: In Taiwan, most people visit a local clinic for minor illnesses.
speak.zh: 在臺灣，大多數人生小病會去住家附近的診所。

write.en: Mobile clinics can bring basic health care to people living in remote mountain areas.
write.zh: 行動診所能把基本醫療服務帶給住在偏遠山區的民眾。

example.en: Improving maternal health care, such as regular check-ups during pregnancy, can greatly reduce risks to both mothers and babies.
example.zh: 改善孕產婦的醫療照護，例如懷孕期間定期產檢，能大幅降低母親和嬰兒雙方的風險。

listen.en: She showed a strong maternal instinct toward the puppies.
listen.zh: 她對那些小狗展現出強烈的母性本能。

chinese.en: Researchers studied how maternal diet during pregnancy affects a child's later health.
chinese.zh: 研究人員探討母親懷孕期間的飲食如何影響孩子日後的健康。

english.en: Her maternal uncle lives in a small town in the south.
english.zh: 她的舅舅住在南部的一個小鎮。

speak.en: Actually, I'm much closer to relatives on my maternal side.
speak.zh: 其實我和媽媽那邊的親戚比較親近。

write.en: Rates of maternal mortality have fallen dramatically thanks to better hospitals and trained midwives.
write.zh: 多虧醫院設備改善以及受過訓練的助產士，孕產婦死亡率已大幅下降。

example.en: Visitors to the museum can admire ancient gold jewelry that was buried with royal families thousands of years ago.
example.zh: 參觀博物館的民眾可以欣賞數千年前與王室成員一同陪葬的古代金飾。

listen.en: Please remove all jewelry before the medical scan.
listen.zh: 做醫學掃描檢查前，請取下所有首飾。

chinese.en: My aunt makes handmade jewelry from recycled glass and sells it at weekend markets.
chinese.zh: 我阿姨用回收玻璃製作手工飾品，並在週末市集販售。

english.en: He bought his wife a piece of jewelry for their anniversary.
english.zh: 他買了一件首飾送給太太當結婚週年禮物。

speak.en: I'm not really into jewelry, but I always wear this watch.
speak.zh: 我其實不太喜歡首飾，但我總是戴著這支手錶。

write.en: Online jewelry sales have risen rapidly as younger shoppers grow comfortable buying luxury goods.
write.zh: 隨著年輕消費者越來越習慣購買精品，珠寶的網路銷售量迅速成長。

example.en: The graph shows that the percentage of households with internet access rose from about half to nearly all.
example.zh: 圖表顯示，能上網的家庭比例從大約一半上升到幾乎全部。

listen.en: Only a small percentage of students passed the test.
listen.zh: 只有一小部分學生通過了考試。

chinese.en: Interest rates rose by two percentage points, which made mortgages much more expensive.
chinese.zh: 利率上升了兩個百分點，使房貸變得昂貴許多。

english.en: What percentage of your salary do you save each month?
english.zh: 你每個月會存下薪水的百分之多少？

speak.en: I'd guess a huge percentage of my friends play mobile games.
speak.zh: 我猜我朋友當中有很高比例在玩手遊。

write.en: The company donates a fixed percentage of its annual profits to local environmental groups.
write.zh: 這家公司每年都把固定比例的利潤捐給當地的環保團體。

example.en: Shortly after the official announcement, thousands of fans rushed online to buy tickets for the band's farewell tour.
example.zh: 正式消息一公布，成千上萬的歌迷就湧上網搶購樂團告別巡演的門票。

listen.en: Please listen carefully to the following announcement from the station.
listen.zh: 請仔細聆聽以下車站廣播。

chinese.en: The government is expected to make a formal announcement on the new housing policy next week.
chinese.zh: 政府預計下週將正式宣布新的住宅政策。

english.en: The school posted an announcement about the exam schedule online.
english.zh: 學校在網路上公布了考試時間表的公告。

speak.en: I usually ignore the announcements on the train unless something goes wrong.
speak.zh: 除非出了什麼狀況，不然我通常不太注意火車上的廣播。

write.en: Our manager's surprise announcement that the office would close early delighted everyone in the team.
write.zh: 經理突然宣布辦公室要提早下班，讓團隊每個人都很開心。

example.en: After hours of scrubbing, the old copper pots gleamed so brightly that they looked almost brand new.
example.zh: 刷洗了好幾個小時後，那些舊銅鍋亮得幾乎像全新的一樣。

listen.en: Her eyes gleamed with excitement when she opened the gift.
listen.zh: 她打開禮物時，眼睛閃爍著興奮的光芒。

chinese.en: There was a gleam of hope in his eyes when the doctor shared the results.
chinese.zh: 醫生告訴他檢查結果時，他的眼中閃過一絲希望。

english.en: The cleaners made the office windows gleam before the clients arrived.
english.zh: 清潔人員在客戶抵達前把辦公室的窗戶擦得閃閃發亮。

speak.en: I love seeing the city lights gleaming across the river at night.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡晚上看城市的燈光在河對岸閃爍。

write.en: A faint gleam of light appeared at the end of the dark tunnel.
write.zh: 黑暗隧道的盡頭出現了一道微弱的光。

example.en: While millions of families could barely afford food, the company reported obscene profits and gave its directors huge bonuses.
example.zh: 在數百萬個家庭連吃飯都有困難的同時，這家公司卻公布了驚人的獲利，還發給董事們巨額獎金。

listen.en: It seems obscene to throw away so much good food.
listen.zh: 把這麼多好好的食物丟掉，實在太過分了。

chinese.en: Many fans thought the price of the concert tickets was frankly obscene.
chinese.zh: 很多歌迷認為演唱會門票的價格說實話貴得離譜。

english.en: Spending that much money on a single handbag seems obscene to me.
english.zh: 我覺得花那麼多錢買一個包包實在太誇張了。

speak.en: Honestly, the rent in the city centre is getting obscene these days.
speak.zh: 說真的，最近市中心的房租已經貴到離譜了。

write.en: Critics argue that the obscene amount of waste produced by fast fashion harms the planet.
write.zh: 批評者認為，快時尚產生的大量浪費多到驚人，正在傷害地球。

example.en: Because the country's main export is coffee, a poor harvest can seriously damage the national economy and farmers' incomes.
example.zh: 由於這個國家的主要出口品是咖啡，一旦收成不好，就可能嚴重打擊國家經濟和農民收入。

listen.en: The farm exports fresh fruit to markets across Asia.
listen.zh: 這座農場把新鮮水果外銷到亞洲各地的市場。

chinese.en: The chart shows that exports of rice rose steadily over the past decade.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，過去十年稻米出口量穩定成長。

english.en: You can export the data as a spreadsheet with one click.
english.zh: 你只要按一下，就能把資料匯出成試算表。

speak.en: My hometown is famous for exporting high-quality tea to Japan.
speak.zh: 我的家鄉以出口高品質茶葉到日本聞名。

write.en: Strict export controls have made it harder for small firms to sell their products overseas.
write.zh: 嚴格的出口管制讓小公司更難把產品賣到海外。

example.en: The lawyer drafted a new contract, but both sides asked for several changes before they finally agreed to sign it.
example.zh: 律師擬好了一份新合約，但雙方要求修改好幾處後才終於同意簽字。

listen.en: Could you check my draft before I send it?
listen.zh: 我寄出去之前，你可以幫我看一下草稿嗎？

chinese.en: The committee spent months drafting new rules to protect the city's green spaces.
chinese.zh: 委員會花了好幾個月研擬新規定，以保護城市的綠地。

english.en: My teacher gave me useful feedback on my rough draft.
english.zh: 老師針對我的初稿給了我很有用的意見。

speak.en: I usually write a quick draft first and then polish it later.
speak.zh: 我通常會先快速寫個草稿，之後再慢慢修飾。

write.en: The restaurant drafted in extra staff to cope with the busy holiday season.
write.zh: 這家餐廳臨時調派了更多人手，以應付忙碌的假期。

example.en: Following the scandal over the missing funds, the club's chairman announced his resignation and apologised to the members.
example.zh: 在資金短少的醜聞爆發後，俱樂部主席宣布辭職，並向會員道歉。

listen.en: She sent her resignation letter to the boss this morning.
listen.zh: 她今天早上把辭職信寄給了老闆。

chinese.en: He accepted the disappointing news with a quiet sigh of resignation and moved on.
chinese.zh: 他無奈地輕嘆一聲，接受了這個令人失望的消息，然後繼續往前走。

english.en: The company has accepted her resignation and will hire a replacement.
english.zh: 公司已經批准她的辭呈，並會找人接替她。

speak.en: Writing my resignation letter was harder than I ever expected.
speak.zh: 寫辭職信比我想像中難多了。

write.en: A wave of resignations among young nurses has put pressure on public hospitals.
write.zh: 年輕護理師接連離職，讓公立醫院承受很大的壓力。

example.en: At the wedding dinner, the bride's father stood up, raised his glass and proposed a toast to the happy couple.
example.zh: 在婚宴上，新娘的父親站起來舉杯，向這對幸福的新人敬酒祝福。

listen.en: Let's raise our glasses and drink a toast to our team.
listen.zh: 大家舉起杯子，為我們的團隊乾杯吧。

chinese.en: The staff toasted the success of the project at the end-of-year party.
chinese.zh: 員工們在尾牙上舉杯慶祝專案成功。

english.en: Toast the bread lightly before you spread the jam on it.
english.zh: 抹果醬之前，先把麵包稍微烤一下。

speak.en: I usually just grab a piece of toast on my way to class.
speak.zh: 我通常就在去上課的路上隨便拿片吐司吃。

write.en: The young pianist became the toast of the town after her brilliant debut.
write.zh: 那位年輕鋼琴家精彩的首演之後，成了全城熱議的焦點人物。

example.en: Built over two centuries, the cathedral's tall towers and colourful windows attract architecture students from all over Europe.
example.zh: 這座歷時兩個世紀才建成的大教堂，以高聳的塔樓和彩色玻璃窗吸引了來自歐洲各地的建築系學生。

listen.en: The cathedral bells ring loudly every Sunday morning.
listen.zh: 每個星期天早上，大教堂的鐘聲都響亮地敲響。

chinese.en: The city council spent millions restoring the cathedral after it was damaged by fire.
chinese.zh: 大教堂遭火災損毀後，市議會花了數百萬元進行修復。

english.en: Many tourists take photos in front of the famous cathedral.
english.zh: 很多觀光客在那座有名的大教堂前拍照。

speak.en: The most impressive building I've ever seen is a Gothic cathedral.
speak.zh: 我看過最令人驚豔的建築是一座哥德式大教堂。

write.en: The quiet cathedral square is a popular place for students to read and relax.
write.zh: 安靜的大教堂廣場是學生看書、放鬆的熱門地點。

example.en: The itinerary was so packed with museums and tours that we hardly had time to eat or rest.
example.zh: 行程排滿了博物館和導覽，我們幾乎沒有時間吃飯或休息。

listen.en: Please check your itinerary before you leave for the airport.
listen.zh: 出發去機場前，請先確認你的行程表。

chinese.en: The conference itinerary includes a factory visit and a dinner with local business leaders.
chinese.zh: 這次會議的行程包括參觀工廠，以及和當地企業領袖共進晚餐。

english.en: We had to change our itinerary because of the heavy rain.
english.zh: 因為下大雨，我們不得不更改行程。

speak.en: I like to plan a flexible itinerary so I can wander around freely.
speak.zh: 我喜歡安排彈性的行程，這樣就可以自由地到處逛逛。

write.en: The school's itinerary for the field trip left students plenty of free time to explore.
write.zh: 學校這次校外教學的行程留給學生很多自由探索的時間。

example.en: Safety was the foremost concern of the engineers, so the bridge was tested repeatedly before it opened to traffic.
example.zh: 安全是工程師最關心的事，所以這座橋在通車前經過了一再的測試。

listen.en: Your health should be foremost in your mind right now.
listen.zh: 你現在最該放在心上的是自己的健康。

chinese.en: First and foremost, a good teacher must be patient with every student.
chinese.zh: 最重要的是，好老師必須對每個學生都有耐心。

english.en: In my view, protecting the environment should be the government's foremost priority.
english.zh: 我認為保護環境應該是政府的首要任務。

speak.en: For me, family has always been foremost, even above my career.
speak.zh: 對我來說，家人一直是最重要的，甚至比我的事業還重要。

write.en: The museum is home to works by some of the country's foremost painters.
write.zh: 這座博物館收藏了該國幾位最傑出畫家的作品。

example.en: Because her metabolism is so fast, she can eat large meals without gaining weight, which many of her friends envy.
example.zh: 因為她的新陳代謝很快，吃很多也不會變胖，讓很多朋友都很羨慕。

listen.en: Your metabolism usually slows down as you get older.
listen.zh: 隨著年紀增長，新陳代謝通常會變慢。

chinese.en: Scientists are studying how sugar affects the metabolism of children in different countries.
chinese.zh: 科學家正在研究糖分如何影響不同國家兒童的新陳代謝。

english.en: Some people believe skipping breakfast can slow down your metabolism.
english.zh: 有些人認為不吃早餐會讓新陳代謝變慢。

speak.en: I drink lots of green tea because I've heard it boosts metabolism.
speak.zh: 我常喝綠茶，因為聽說它能促進新陳代謝。

write.en: Workers on night shifts may suffer from a disrupted metabolism and related health problems.
write.zh: 上夜班的人可能會出現代謝紊亂和相關的健康問題。

example.en: As the driver accelerated onto the motorway, the old car began to shake and make a strange noise.
example.zh: 駕駛加速開上高速公路時，那輛舊車開始晃動，還發出奇怪的聲音。

listen.en: The train slowly accelerated as it left the station.
listen.zh: 火車駛離車站時慢慢加速。

chinese.en: Rising temperatures are accelerating the melting of glaciers in many mountain regions.
chinese.zh: 氣溫上升正加速許多山區冰川的融化。

english.en: Online learning has accelerated changes in the way students study.
english.zh: 線上學習加快了學生學習方式的改變。

speak.en: I think social media really accelerates the spread of fake news.
speak.zh: 我覺得社群媒體真的會加速假新聞的散播。

write.en: Our team hired extra staff to accelerate the project and meet the tight deadline.
write.zh: 我們團隊多請了人手來加快專案進度，以趕上緊迫的期限。

example.en: Although the volunteers were tired after cleaning the beach all day, their enthusiasm never faded, and they planned another event.
example.zh: 雖然志工們淨灘了一整天很累，熱情卻絲毫不減，還計畫了下一場活動。

listen.en: She spoke about her new job with real enthusiasm.
listen.zh: 她談起新工作時充滿熱忱。

chinese.en: The new manager's lack of enthusiasm quickly spread to the rest of the team.
chinese.zh: 新經理缺乏熱忱的態度很快就影響到團隊其他人。

english.en: My enthusiasm for running grew after I joined a club.
english.zh: 加入社團之後，我對跑步越來越有熱情。

speak.en: I have to admit my enthusiasm for cooking doesn't last very long.
speak.zh: 我得承認，我對下廚的熱情維持不了多久。

write.en: The plan to build a new stadium was greeted with little enthusiasm by local residents.
write.zh: 興建新體育場的計畫並沒有得到當地居民的熱烈支持。

example.en: The smell of bacon frying in the pan woke everyone up, and soon the whole family was waiting in the kitchen.
example.zh: 平底鍋裡煎培根的香味把大家都叫醒了，沒多久全家人就在廚房等著開飯。

listen.en: Could I have a bacon sandwich and a cup of tea?
listen.zh: 可以給我一份培根三明治和一杯茶嗎？

chinese.en: Doctors warn that eating processed meat like bacon every day may harm your health.
chinese.zh: 醫生警告，每天吃培根這類加工肉品可能有害健康。

english.en: This salad tastes better with some crispy bacon on top.
english.zh: 這道沙拉上面加點酥脆的培根會更好吃。

speak.en: I'm trying to eat less bacon, but it smells so good.
speak.zh: 我正在試著少吃培根，可是它聞起來實在太香了。

write.en: As the only earner in the family, my father had to bring home the bacon.
write.zh: 身為家裡唯一有收入的人，我爸爸必須負責賺錢養家。

example.en: The jacket is made from a special fabric that repels water, so it keeps you dry even in heavy rain.
example.zh: 這件外套採用特殊的防水布料，即使下大雨也能讓你保持乾爽。

listen.en: Like poles of a magnet repel each other.
listen.zh: 磁鐵的同極會互相排斥。

chinese.en: Many customers were repelled by the restaurant's rude service and dirty tables.
chinese.zh: 許多客人對這家餐廳無禮的服務和髒亂的桌子感到反感。

english.en: Some plants naturally repel insects, so farmers use fewer chemicals.
english.zh: 有些植物天生就能驅蟲，所以農民用的化學藥劑比較少。

speak.en: Honestly, the smell of that cheese repels me every time.
speak.zh: 說實話，那種起司的味道每次都讓我受不了。

write.en: In the second half, the home team's defence repelled wave after wave of attacks.
write.zh: 下半場，主隊的防守擋下了一波又一波的進攻。

example.en: The singer's comment online triggered a torrent of angry messages, and she had to delete her account for a while.
example.zh: 那位歌手在網路上的發言引發大量憤怒留言，她只好暫時刪除帳號。

listen.en: The rain came down in torrents all afternoon.
listen.zh: 整個下午都下著傾盆大雨。

chinese.en: The new policy unleashed a torrent of complaints from parents and teachers.
chinese.zh: 新政策引來家長和老師排山倒海的抱怨。

english.en: Melting snow turns the river into a torrent every spring.
english.zh: 每年春天，融雪都會讓這條河變成湍急的洪流。

speak.en: When I asked him about his trip, he answered with a torrent of stories.
speak.zh: 我問起他的旅行時，他滔滔不絕地講了一大堆故事。

write.en: Students now face a torrent of information online and must learn to judge its quality.
write.zh: 現在的學生在網路上面對大量資訊，必須學會判斷資訊的品質。

example.en: After the flood damaged their house, the family filed an insurance claim to cover the cost of repairs.
example.zh: 洪水損毀房子後，這家人向保險公司提出理賠申請，以支付修繕費用。

listen.en: Please claim your luggage at the end of the hall.
listen.zh: 請到大廳盡頭領取您的行李。

chinese.en: There is little evidence to support the claim that video games cause aggression.
chinese.zh: 幾乎沒有證據能支持電玩會導致攻擊行為的說法。

english.en: He claimed that he had never received the email from his manager.
english.zh: 他聲稱自己從來沒收到主管寄的那封電子郵件。

speak.en: I don't believe people who claim they never feel stressed.
speak.zh: 我不相信那些說自己從來不會有壓力的人。

write.en: Workers can claim travel expenses if they visit clients outside the city.
write.zh: 員工如果到外縣市拜訪客戶，可以申請差旅費。

example.en: Carbon monoxide is especially dangerous because it has no smell, yet even low levels can be lethal in a closed room.
example.zh: 一氧化碳特別危險，因為它沒有氣味，但在密閉空間裡即使濃度很低也可能致命。

listen.en: Mixing these cleaning products can be lethal, so be careful.
listen.zh: 混用這些清潔劑可能會致命，所以要小心。

chinese.en: Experts warn that heatwaves are becoming more lethal for elderly people living alone.
chinese.zh: 專家警告，熱浪對獨居長者的致命威脅越來越大。

english.en: Driving while very tired can be just as lethal as drunk driving.
english.zh: 疲勞駕駛可能和酒駕一樣致命。

speak.en: Be careful with that chilli sauce, it's absolutely lethal!
speak.zh: 那個辣椒醬要小心，超級辣的！

write.en: The team's lethal combination of speed and skill made them champions this season.
write.zh: 這支隊伍兼具速度與技術，威力驚人，讓他們拿下本季冠軍。

example.en: The mechanic warned that the bike's brakes were badly worn and could fail on a steep hill at any moment.
example.zh: 技師警告說，這輛腳踏車的煞車磨損嚴重，在陡坡上隨時可能失靈。

listen.en: She braked suddenly when the traffic light turned red.
listen.zh: 紅燈亮起時，她突然踩了煞車。

chinese.en: Rising interest rates have put the brakes on the booming housing market.
chinese.zh: 利率上升讓原本火熱的房市踩了煞車。

english.en: Remember to check your brakes before riding down the mountain.
english.zh: 騎車下山前記得先檢查煞車。

speak.en: I had to brake really hard because a scooter cut in front of me.
speak.zh: 因為有台機車突然切到我前面，我只好用力踩煞車。

write.en: Sudden braking on wet roads is a common cause of accidents involving motorcycles.
write.zh: 在濕滑路面上急煞是機車事故的常見原因。

example.en: Once limited to science fiction, artificial intelligence has now entered the domain of everyday life, from phones to cars.
example.zh: 人工智慧過去只出現在科幻小說裡，如今已進入日常生活的各個層面，從手機到汽車都有。

listen.en: Researchers in this domain often share their data openly.
listen.zh: 這個領域的研究人員經常公開分享他們的資料。

chinese.en: Many classic novels are now in the public domain and can be read online for free.
chinese.zh: 許多經典小說現在已屬於公共領域，可以在網路上免費閱讀。

english.en: Our company bought a new domain name for its online shop.
english.zh: 我們公司為網路商店買了一個新的網域名稱。

speak.en: Honestly, maths has never really been my domain; I prefer languages.
speak.zh: 老實說，數學一直不是我擅長的領域，我比較喜歡語言。

write.en: In modern families, childcare should not be seen as solely the domain of mothers.
write.zh: 在現代家庭中，照顧孩子不應該被視為只是媽媽的責任。

example.en: The mechanic spent an hour testing the engine before he could diagnose why the car kept stalling.
example.zh: 技師花了一個小時檢測引擎，才判斷出車子為什麼一直熄火。

listen.en: The doctor diagnosed her illness after a simple blood test.
listen.zh: 醫生在一次簡單的驗血後診斷出她的病。

chinese.en: Early screening programmes help doctors diagnose cancer before patients notice any symptoms.
chinese.zh: 早期篩檢計畫能幫助醫生在病人察覺任何症狀之前診斷出癌症。

english.en: It is difficult to diagnose this disease in young children.
english.zh: 這種疾病在幼童身上很難診斷。

speak.en: When my laptop crashed, a friend helped me diagnose the problem quickly.
speak.zh: 我的筆電當機時，一位朋友幫我很快找出問題所在。

write.en: Consultants were hired to diagnose why the company was losing so many young employees.
write.zh: 公司聘請顧問來找出為何流失這麼多年輕員工。

example.en: Since the bedroom had no wardrobe, he kept all his shirts folded in boxes under the bed.
example.zh: 由於臥室沒有衣櫃，他把所有襯衫折好放在床底下的箱子裡。

listen.en: Please put your clean clothes back in the wardrobe.
listen.zh: 請把你的乾淨衣服放回衣櫃。

chinese.en: Fast fashion encourages people to replace their wardrobe every season instead of buying durable clothes.
chinese.zh: 快時尚鼓勵人們每一季都汰換整批衣物，而不是購買耐穿的衣服。

english.en: I need to buy some warm clothes for my winter wardrobe.
english.zh: 我得買些保暖衣服來充實冬季的衣物。

speak.en: My wardrobe is mostly jeans and T-shirts, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我的衣服大多是牛仔褲和T恤。

write.en: The theatre's wardrobe department spent months sewing costumes for the new musical.
write.zh: 劇院的服裝部花了好幾個月為新的音樂劇縫製戲服。

example.en: After breaking her leg, she was confined to bed for weeks and had to study from home.
example.zh: 她摔斷腿後臥床好幾週，只能在家自學。

listen.en: The problem is not confined to large cities.
listen.zh: 這個問題不只出現在大城市。

chinese.en: Working in a confined space for long hours can make people feel anxious and tired.
chinese.zh: 長時間在狹窄的空間裡工作，會讓人感到焦慮又疲倦。

english.en: The fire was confined to the kitchen, so nobody was hurt.
english.zh: 火勢被控制在廚房內，所以沒有人受傷。

speak.en: I don't like being confined to an office all day.
speak.zh: 我不喜歡整天被關在辦公室裡。

write.en: Students should be encouraged to explore ideas beyond the confines of the textbook.
write.zh: 應該鼓勵學生跳脫課本的框架去探索各種想法。

example.en: Because she was pregnant, the airline asked her to bring a doctor's note confirming it was safe to fly.
example.zh: 因為她懷孕了，航空公司要求她帶醫生證明，確認她可以安全搭機。

listen.en: Pregnant women should avoid drinking too much coffee.
listen.zh: 孕婦應避免喝太多咖啡。

chinese.en: Many companies now offer flexible hours to employees who are pregnant or caring for young children.
chinese.zh: 現在許多公司為懷孕或需要照顧幼兒的員工提供彈性工時。

english.en: She stopped riding her motorbike when she found out she was pregnant.
english.zh: 她發現自己懷孕後，就不再騎機車了。

speak.en: When my mum was pregnant with me, she craved spicy noodles.
speak.zh: 我媽懷我的時候，很想吃辣的麵。

write.en: Our cat became pregnant last spring and gave birth to a litter of kittens.
write.zh: 我們家的貓去年春天懷孕，生了一窩小貓。

example.en: The manager shouted at him in front of all his colleagues, and he left the meeting feeling completely humiliated.
example.zh: 經理當著所有同事的面對他大吼，他離開會議時覺得顏面盡失。

listen.en: She felt humiliated when everyone laughed at her mistake.
listen.zh: 大家嘲笑她的錯誤時，她覺得很丟臉。

chinese.en: Posting embarrassing photos online can humiliate a person and seriously damage their reputation.
chinese.zh: 在網路上張貼令人難堪的照片可能會羞辱一個人，並嚴重損害其名譽。

english.en: The home team suffered a humiliating defeat in the final.
english.zh: 地主隊在決賽中吞下一場丟臉的敗仗。

speak.en: I'd never want to humiliate anyone, even as a joke.
speak.zh: 就算是開玩笑，我也絕不想讓任何人難堪。

write.en: Critics argue that public punishment humiliates offenders rather than helping them change their behaviour.
write.zh: 批評者認為，公開懲罰只會羞辱犯錯者，而不是幫助他們改變行為。

example.en: Tiny particles of cosmic dust fall onto Earth every day, but they are far too small to see.
example.zh: 每天都有微小的宇宙塵埃粒子落到地球上，但它們小到肉眼根本看不見。

listen.en: The museum has a new show about cosmic rays.
listen.zh: 博物館有一個關於宇宙射線的新展覽。

chinese.en: From a cosmic perspective, our planet is just a small dot in a vast universe.
chinese.zh: 從宇宙的角度來看，我們的星球只是浩瀚宇宙中的一個小點。

english.en: The documentary explains how cosmic radiation affects astronauts in space.
english.zh: 這部紀錄片說明宇宙輻射如何影響太空中的太空人。

speak.en: Looking at the stars makes my problems feel tiny on a cosmic scale.
speak.zh: 看著星星，會讓我覺得自己的煩惱在宇宙尺度下微不足道。

write.en: Missing the train by seconds felt like a cosmic joke after such a stressful day.
write.zh: 在這麼累人的一天之後，只差幾秒沒趕上火車，感覺就像老天在開玩笑。

example.en: The doctor told him to take two tablets after each meal until the infection cleared up.
example.zh: 醫生要他每餐飯後吃兩顆藥，直到感染痊癒。

listen.en: He left his tablet charging on the kitchen table.
listen.zh: 他把平板放在廚房餐桌上充電。

chinese.en: Some schools give every pupil a tablet, but critics worry about screen time.
chinese.zh: 有些學校發給每位學生一台平板，但批評者擔心使用螢幕的時間過長。

english.en: I usually take a headache tablet when I work late.
english.zh: 我熬夜工作時通常會吃一顆頭痛藥。

speak.en: I mostly use my tablet for watching videos on the bus.
speak.zh: 我大多用平板在公車上看影片。

write.en: Archaeologists found ancient clay tablets covered in writing that described daily trade.
write.zh: 考古學家發現了古老的泥板，上面刻滿了記載日常交易的文字。

example.en: The sofa looked shabby, with faded fabric and torn cushions, so they finally decided to replace it.
example.zh: 那張沙發看起來很破舊，布料褪色、靠墊也破了，所以他們終於決定換掉它。

listen.en: He wore a shabby jacket to the job interview.
listen.zh: 他穿了一件破舊的夾克去面試。

chinese.en: Many workers felt the company's shabby treatment of temporary staff was deeply unfair.
chinese.zh: 許多員工覺得公司對待臨時員工的方式非常不公平。

english.en: The old library looks shabby, but the books are excellent.
english.zh: 那間舊圖書館看起來很破舊，但裡面的書都很棒。

speak.en: For a first attempt at cooking, that's not too shabby!
speak.zh: 以第一次下廚來說，這樣還不賴！

write.en: The city plans to renovate shabby old housing blocks and turn them into modern homes.
write.zh: 市政府打算翻修老舊破敗的住宅大樓，把它們改建成現代化住宅。

example.en: Shortly after take-off, the cabin crew walked down the aisle offering passengers drinks and snacks.
example.zh: 起飛後不久，空服員沿著走道為乘客提供飲料和點心。

listen.en: Please keep your cabin bag under the seat in front.
listen.zh: 請把您的隨身行李放在前方座位底下。

chinese.en: The ship's cabins were small but clean, and each had a window facing the sea.
chinese.zh: 這艘船的船艙雖小但很乾淨，而且每間都有一扇面海的窗戶。

english.en: The cabin was cold at night, so we lit a fire.
english.zh: 小木屋晚上很冷，所以我們生了火。

speak.en: I'd love to spend a quiet week in a cabin by a lake.
speak.zh: 我很想在湖邊的小木屋安靜地待上一週。

write.en: Airlines are adding more seats to the economy cabin, leaving passengers with less legroom.
write.zh: 航空公司在經濟艙加裝更多座位，讓乘客的腿部空間變得更小。

example.en: The bacteria are not visible to the naked eye, so scientists must use a powerful microscope to study them.
example.zh: 這些細菌肉眼看不見，所以科學家必須用高倍顯微鏡來研究。

listen.en: The crack in the wall was clearly visible.
listen.zh: 牆上的裂縫清晰可見。

chinese.en: The government's new cycling lanes have made a visible difference to traffic in the city centre.
chinese.zh: 政府新設的自行車道讓市中心的交通有了明顯的改變。

english.en: Wear bright clothes so you are visible to drivers at night.
english.zh: 晚上要穿顏色鮮豔的衣服，讓駕駛人看得到你。

speak.en: There's been a visible improvement in my English since I started reading more.
speak.zh: 自從我開始多讀英文之後，我的英文有了明顯的進步。

write.en: Women are becoming more visible in leadership roles across the technology industry.
write.zh: 在整個科技業中，擔任領導職的女性越來越常見。

example.en: Walking into the busy night market was an assault on the senses, with loud music, bright lights and strong smells everywhere.
example.zh: 走進熱鬧的夜市，感官立刻受到強烈衝擊，到處都是震耳的音樂、刺眼的燈光和濃烈的氣味。

listen.en: The noise from the building site assaulted our ears all day.
listen.zh: 工地的噪音整天轟炸我們的耳朵。
