chinese.en: The climbers began their final assault on the summit just before sunrise.
chinese.zh: 登山者在日出前展開最後的攻頂行動。

english.en: The manager faced a verbal assault from angry customers at the meeting.
english.zh: 經理在會議上遭到憤怒顧客的言語攻擊。

speak.en: Honestly, the pop-up ads on some websites are an assault on my eyes.
speak.zh: 老實說，有些網站上的彈出式廣告讓我的眼睛很受折磨。

write.en: Environmental groups called the new highway plan an assault on the island's last wild forest.
write.zh: 環保團體稱這項新公路計畫是對島上最後一片原始森林的破壞。

example.en: Although the rule was never written down, there was an implicit agreement that nobody left the office before the boss.
example.zh: 雖然這條規定從未寫下來，但大家有個默契：老闆還沒走，誰都不能先離開辦公室。

listen.en: She has implicit trust in her oldest friend.
listen.zh: 她毫無保留地信任她最老的朋友。

chinese.en: The idea that hard work leads to success is implicit in many school textbooks.
chinese.zh: 「努力就會成功」的觀念隱含在許多學校教科書中。

english.en: His silence was an implicit admission that he had made a mistake.
english.zh: 他的沉默等於默認自己犯了錯。

speak.en: In my culture, a lot of rules are implicit rather than spoken.
speak.zh: 在我的文化裡，很多規矩是心照不宣，而不是說出口的。

write.en: The essay question contains an implicit assumption that technology always improves people's lives.
write.zh: 這道申論題隱含一個假設，認為科技總能改善人們的生活。

example.en: Plants in the office grew slowly because they only received artificial light from lamps and never saw the sun.
example.zh: 辦公室裡的植物長得很慢，因為它們只照得到燈具的人工光源，從來曬不到太陽。

listen.en: The hotel lobby was decorated with artificial flowers.
listen.zh: 飯店大廳用人造花裝飾。

chinese.en: Artificial intelligence is changing the way companies hire and train new employees.
chinese.zh: 人工智慧正在改變公司招募與培訓新進員工的方式。

english.en: Her smile looked artificial, so I knew she was upset.
english.zh: 她的笑容看起來很假，所以我知道她不高興。

speak.en: I try to avoid drinks with artificial sweeteners these days.
speak.zh: 我最近盡量避免喝含人工甜味劑的飲料。

write.en: The city built an artificial lake to collect rainwater and provide a park for residents.
write.zh: 市政府建造了一座人工湖，用來蓄積雨水，也為居民提供一座公園。

example.en: Crystal chandeliers hung from the ceiling of the ballroom, where couples in elegant dresses and suits danced all night.
example.zh: 舞廳的天花板垂掛著水晶吊燈，身穿華麗禮服和西裝的情侶們整晚翩翩起舞。

listen.en: My grandparents took ballroom dancing lessons last year.
listen.zh: 我的祖父母去年上了國標舞課。

chinese.en: The conference moved to a larger ballroom after more people registered than expected.
chinese.zh: 報名人數超出預期，研討會因此移到更大的宴會廳舉行。

english.en: The old ballroom has been turned into a public library.
english.zh: 那座舊舞廳已經改建成公共圖書館。

speak.en: I've never been inside a real ballroom, but it sounds glamorous.
speak.zh: 我從來沒進過真正的舞廳，但聽起來很華麗。

write.en: Ballroom dancing is a great way for older people to stay active and meet friends.
write.zh: 國標舞是年長者保持活躍、結交朋友的好方法。

example.en: Nobody recognised him at first, because he had shaved off the thick moustache he had worn for years.
example.zh: 一開始沒人認出他，因為他剃掉了留了好多年的濃密八字鬍。

listen.en: The old man had a grey moustache and kind eyes.
listen.zh: 那位老先生留著灰白的八字鬍，眼神很和善。

chinese.en: In many old photographs, the men all wear dark suits and neat moustaches.
chinese.zh: 在許多老照片裡，男士們都穿著深色西裝，留著整齊的八字鬍。

english.en: The children drew a moustache on the poster as a joke.
english.zh: 孩子們開玩笑地在海報上畫了一撇鬍子。

speak.en: Honestly, I don't think a moustache would suit my face.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得八字鬍不適合我的臉型。

write.en: Every November, some men grow moustaches to raise money for men's health charities.
write.zh: 每年十一月，有些男士會蓄鬍來為男性健康慈善團體募款。

example.en: After checking the footprints and the open window, the detective concluded that the thief had escaped through the garden.
example.zh: 檢查過腳印和打開的窗戶後，偵探推斷小偷是從花園逃走的。

listen.en: The concert concluded with a song everyone knew.
listen.zh: 音樂會以一首大家都會唱的歌作結。

chinese.en: The two companies concluded a trade agreement after months of difficult negotiations.
chinese.zh: 經過數個月艱難的談判，兩家公司簽訂了一份貿易協議。

english.en: The teacher concluded the lesson by giving us some homework.
english.zh: 老師最後出了一些作業，結束了這堂課。

speak.en: From my experience, I'd conclude that living alone teaches you independence.
speak.zh: 根據我的經驗，我會說獨自生活能教會你獨立。

write.en: To conclude, governments should invest more in public transport to reduce air pollution.
write.zh: 總而言之，政府應該投入更多經費在大眾運輸上，以減少空氣污染。

example.en: Tempers were running high after the delayed flight was cancelled, and several passengers argued loudly with the staff.
example.zh: 延誤的班機最後被取消，大家情緒都很激動，好幾位乘客大聲和工作人員爭執。

listen.en: Try to keep your temper when customers are rude.
listen.zh: 顧客無禮時，試著忍住脾氣。

chinese.en: Our new manager has a short temper, so everyone is careful about what they say.
chinese.zh: 我們的新經理脾氣很急躁，所以大家說話都很小心。

english.en: She tempered her criticism with some kind words of encouragement.
english.zh: 她在批評中加入一些鼓勵的好話，讓語氣緩和一些。

speak.en: I used to have a terrible temper, but I've calmed down a lot.
speak.zh: 我以前脾氣很差，但現在已經平靜許多。

write.en: Experts warn that the excitement over new technology should be tempered by concerns about privacy.
write.zh: 專家提醒，人們對新科技的熱情應該因隱私疑慮而有所節制。

example.en: The new shopping mall is a monstrous concrete block that towers over the small traditional houses around it.
example.zh: 新的購物中心是一棟巨大的水泥建築，聳立在周圍低矮的傳統房屋之上。

listen.en: Throwing away all that good food is a monstrous waste.
listen.zh: 把那麼多好好的食物丟掉，真是極大的浪費。

chinese.en: Many residents felt it was monstrous that the rent had doubled in just a year.
chinese.zh: 許多居民認為房租在短短一年內漲了一倍，實在太離譜了。

english.en: The children spent all afternoon building a monstrous sandcastle on the beach.
english.zh: 孩子們花了一整個下午在海灘上堆了一座超大的沙堡。

speak.en: The queue for the new bubble tea shop was absolutely monstrous.
speak.zh: 那家新開的珍奶店排隊人潮多得嚇人。

write.en: Critics described the oil spill as a monstrous failure of environmental regulation.
write.zh: 批評者形容這起漏油事件是環境監管上的重大失職。

example.en: Keeping exotic pets like snakes and lizards has become popular, but many owners do not understand their needs.
example.zh: 飼養蛇和蜥蜴等特殊寵物越來越流行，但許多飼主並不了解牠們的需求。

listen.en: They spent their honeymoon on an exotic island.
listen.zh: 他們在一座充滿異國風情的島上度蜜月。

chinese.en: Exotic species introduced by humans can threaten native plants and animals in local ecosystems.
chinese.zh: 由人類引進的外來物種可能威脅當地生態系中的原生動植物。

english.en: This restaurant serves exotic dishes from all over the world.
english.zh: 這家餐廳供應來自世界各地的異國料理。

speak.en: I'd love to travel somewhere exotic, like Morocco or Peru.
speak.zh: 我很想去一些充滿異國情調的地方旅行，像是摩洛哥或秘魯。

write.en: The perfume has an exotic scent that combines vanilla with tropical flowers.
write.zh: 這款香水散發奇特迷人的香氣，結合了香草與熱帶花卉。

example.en: The ancient map intrigued the historians, because it showed islands that did not appear on any other record.
example.zh: 那張古地圖讓歷史學家很感興趣，因為上面畫的島嶼從未出現在其他任何紀錄中。

listen.en: The strange noise in the attic intrigued the children.
listen.zh: 閣樓裡奇怪的聲音引起了孩子們的好奇。

chinese.en: The television drama is full of royal intrigue, secret alliances and family rivalries.
chinese.zh: 這齣電視劇充滿宮廷鬥爭、祕密結盟和家族之間的競爭。

english.en: The interviewers were intrigued by her unusual career path and asked many questions.
english.zh: 面試官對她不尋常的職涯經歷很感興趣，問了很多問題。

speak.en: Honestly, what intrigues me about Japan is its mix of old and new.
speak.zh: 老實說，日本吸引我的地方在於它新舊交融的特色。

write.en: Office intrigue can damage teamwork when colleagues spend more time competing than cooperating.
write.zh: 當同事花在互相競爭的時間比合作還多時，辦公室裡的勾心鬥角會破壞團隊合作。

example.en: Despite years of public debate and fierce disagreement, the controversy over school uniforms shows no sign of ending.
example.zh: 儘管經過多年的公開辯論與激烈分歧，關於學校制服的爭議仍看不到結束的跡象。

listen.en: The decision sparked controversy across the whole country.
listen.zh: 這項決定在全國引發了爭議。

chinese.en: The director's latest film became the subject of controversy before it was even released.
chinese.zh: 這位導演的新片甚至還沒上映，就已經成為爭議的焦點。

english.en: There is still controversy about whether homework helps young children learn.
english.zh: 作業是否有助於幼童學習，至今仍有爭議。

speak.en: I try to avoid controversy when I'm chatting with my coworkers.
speak.zh: 跟同事聊天時，我會盡量避開有爭議的話題。

write.en: The company handled the controversy well by apologizing quickly and explaining its pricing policy.
write.zh: 那家公司迅速道歉並說明定價政策，把這場爭議處理得很好。

example.en: His sleep patterns were so erratic that some nights he slept ten hours and other nights barely two.
example.zh: 他的睡眠非常不規律，有些晚上睡十個小時，有些晚上卻幾乎只睡兩個小時。

listen.en: The bus service in my town is quite erratic.
listen.zh: 我住的鎮上公車班次很不穩定。

chinese.en: Erratic weather this spring has made it difficult for farmers to plan their planting.
chinese.zh: 今年春天天氣變化無常，讓農民很難安排種植時程。

english.en: The patient's heartbeat became erratic, so the nurse called a doctor.
english.zh: 病人的心跳變得不規律，所以護理師叫了醫生來。

speak.en: My Wi-Fi connection at home is really erratic these days.
speak.zh: 我家的無線網路最近真的時好時壞。

write.en: Investors grew nervous as the company's profits followed an erratic pattern over several years.
write.zh: 那家公司的獲利多年來起伏不定，讓投資人越來越緊張。

example.en: Too narrow for cars, the old alley was lined with tiny shops selling tea and snacks.
example.zh: 這條老巷子窄到車子開不進去，兩旁開滿了賣茶飲和小吃的小店。

listen.en: We took a shortcut down a quiet alley.
listen.zh: 我們抄近路走了一條安靜的小巷。

chinese.en: Many visitors to Taipei enjoy exploring the small alleys where local families have lived for decades.
chinese.zh: 許多來臺北的遊客喜歡探索那些在地人家住了幾十年的小巷弄。

english.en: The city plans to install more lights in dark alleys.
english.zh: 市政府計畫在昏暗的巷子裡加裝更多路燈。

speak.en: My favorite noodle shop is in a little alley near my apartment.
speak.zh: 我最喜歡的麵店就在我家公寓附近的一條小巷裡。

write.en: On Friday nights, my friends and I usually meet at the bowling alley downtown.
write.zh: 星期五晚上，我和朋友通常會約在市中心的保齡球館碰面。

example.en: During the hike, we encountered a sudden storm and had to shelter in a cave until it passed.
example.zh: 健行途中我們遇上一場突如其來的暴風雨，只好躲進山洞，等雨停了才離開。

listen.en: She had a chance encounter with an old classmate.
listen.zh: 她偶然巧遇了一位老同學。

chinese.en: The new manager encountered strong resistance when she tried to change the working hours.
chinese.zh: 新經理試圖更改上班時間時，遭到強烈的反彈。

english.en: If you encounter any problems with the software, please contact us.
english.zh: 如果你使用這套軟體時遇到任何問題，請和我們聯絡。

speak.en: My first encounter with sushi was at a friend's birthday party.
speak.zh: 我第一次吃到壽司，是在一個朋友的生日派對上。

write.en: Scientists hope that brief encounters with nature can reduce stress among office workers.
write.zh: 科學家希望，短暫接觸大自然就能減輕上班族的壓力。

example.en: Unlike the quiet village where she grew up, the city felt dynamic, with new businesses opening every month.
example.zh: 和她從小長大的寧靜村莊不同，這座城市充滿活力，每個月都有新店家開張。

listen.en: She has a very dynamic and cheerful personality.
listen.zh: 她的個性非常有活力又開朗。

chinese.en: Adding a new member to a small team can completely change the group dynamic.
chinese.zh: 小團隊加入一位新成員，可能會完全改變成員之間的互動關係。

english.en: Taiwan has a dynamic economy driven largely by technology exports.
english.zh: 臺灣的經濟充滿活力，主要靠科技產品出口帶動。

speak.en: I prefer a dynamic job where every day is a bit different.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡有變化的工作，每天都有點不一樣。

write.en: Online language courses have become more dynamic, with live discussions replacing recorded lectures.
write.zh: 線上語言課程變得更有互動性，直播討論取代了預先錄好的講課。

example.en: The hotel caters for business travelers by offering fast Wi-Fi, meeting rooms and an early breakfast.
example.zh: 這家飯店提供高速網路、會議室和提早供應的早餐，以滿足商務旅客的需求。

listen.en: A local restaurant catered the wedding last weekend.
listen.zh: 上週末的婚宴是由當地一家餐廳負責外燴。

chinese.en: Some television programs simply cater to popular taste instead of offering anything educational.
chinese.zh: 有些電視節目只是一味迎合大眾口味，沒有提供任何有教育意義的內容。

english.en: Our school cafeteria now caters for vegetarian students as well.
english.zh: 我們學校的餐廳現在也有照顧到吃素的學生。

speak.en: Honestly, I think most shopping malls cater mainly to young people.
speak.zh: 說真的，我覺得大部分購物中心主要都是針對年輕人。

write.en: Public parks should be designed to cater to the needs of elderly residents and children.
write.zh: 公園的設計應該要顧及長者和兒童的需求。

example.en: Historians often draw parallels between the two economic crises, pointing out that both began with a housing bubble.
example.zh: 歷史學家常把這兩次經濟危機相提並論，並指出兩者都是從房市泡沫開始的。

listen.en: Draw a line parallel to the edge of the page.
listen.zh: 畫一條和紙張邊緣平行的線。

chinese.en: The rise of online shopping parallels the decline of small shops in many town centers.
chinese.zh: 網購興起的同時，許多市中心的小商店也跟著沒落。

english.en: There are some interesting parallels between learning music and learning a language.
english.zh: 學音樂和學語言之間有一些有趣的相似之處。

speak.en: Funnily enough, my career path runs parallel to my older sister's.
speak.zh: 說來好笑，我的職涯發展跟我姊姊幾乎一模一樣。

write.en: The research team worked on both projects in parallel to save time and money.
write.zh: 研究團隊同時進行這兩個計畫，以節省時間和經費。

example.en: In the novel, the loyal servant turns out to be a traitor who secretly passed letters to the enemy.
example.zh: 在這部小說裡，那位看似忠心的僕人原來是個叛徒，一直偷偷把信件交給敵人。

listen.en: Nobody expected her best friend to be the traitor.
listen.zh: 沒有人料到叛徒竟然是她最好的朋友。

chinese.en: Some employees felt like traitors when they accepted jobs at a competing company.
chinese.zh: 有些員工接受競爭對手公司的工作時，覺得自己像個叛徒。

english.en: He was treated as a traitor after sharing the club's secrets.
english.zh: 他洩漏社團的秘密之後，就被大家當成叛徒。

speak.en: My friends joked that I was a traitor for switching phone brands.
speak.zh: 我換了手機品牌，朋友就開玩笑說我是叛徒。

write.en: Historians still debate whether the general was a traitor or a hero who saved many lives.
write.zh: 歷史學家至今仍在爭論，那位將軍究竟是叛徒，還是拯救了許多人的英雄。

example.en: Because she had bought the ticket and kept the receipt, she was entitled to a full refund when the concert was canceled.
example.zh: 因為她買了票又留著收據，所以演唱會取消時，她有權拿到全額退款。

listen.en: Everyone is entitled to their own opinion, of course.
listen.zh: 當然，每個人都有權利表達自己的看法。

chinese.en: This membership card entitles you to free entry to the museum on weekends.
chinese.zh: 憑這張會員卡，週末可以免費進入博物館。

english.en: Her first novel, entitled Silent Rain, was published last year.
english.zh: 她的第一本小說名為《Silent Rain》，去年出版。

speak.en: I think students should be entitled to a longer lunch break.
speak.zh: 我覺得學生應該有權享有更長的午休時間。

write.en: Taxpayers are entitled to know exactly how the government spends public money.
write.zh: 納稅人有權確切知道政府如何運用公帑。

example.en: Once the main sponsor withdrew its support, the whole festival plan began to crumble and was eventually canceled.
example.zh: 主要贊助商一撤資，整個活動計畫就開始瓦解，最後被迫取消。

listen.en: She crumbled a little cheese over the green salad.
listen.zh: 她在生菜沙拉上撒了一點起司碎。

chinese.en: Many cities are struggling to repair crumbling roads and bridges built decades ago.
chinese.zh: 許多城市正努力修補幾十年前蓋的、已經破損不堪的道路和橋梁。

english.en: The dry cookie crumbled as soon as I picked it up.
english.zh: 那塊乾掉的餅乾我一拿起來就碎了。

speak.en: My confidence just crumbled when I forgot my lines on stage.
speak.zh: 我在臺上忘詞的時候，信心整個崩潰了。

write.en: Their long friendship slowly crumbled after years of misunderstandings and broken promises.
write.zh: 經過多年的誤會和失信，他們長久的友誼慢慢瓦解了。

example.en: After reading the report on plastic waste, many readers felt compelled to change their shopping habits.
example.zh: 看完那篇關於塑膠垃圾的報導後，許多讀者覺得自己不得不改變購物習慣。

listen.en: Nobody can compel you to sign the contract.
listen.zh: 沒有人能強迫你簽這份合約。

chinese.en: The new law compels large companies to publish data on their carbon emissions.
chinese.zh: 新法規要求大型企業必須公布碳排放的數據。

english.en: Rising rents compelled many young people to live with their parents.
english.zh: 房租上漲迫使許多年輕人和父母同住。

speak.en: Honestly, nothing in the world could compel me to go skydiving.
speak.zh: 說真的，再怎樣都沒辦法逼我去玩跳傘。

write.en: Schools should not compel students to choose a career path at such a young age.
write.zh: 學校不應該強迫學生在這麼小的年紀就選定職涯方向。

example.en: Your essay has a good outline, but you need to flesh out each paragraph with clear examples and evidence.
example.zh: 你的文章架構不錯，但每一段都需要用清楚的例子和證據來充實內容。

listen.en: I finally saw my favorite singer in the flesh.
listen.zh: 我終於親眼見到我最喜歡的歌手本人了。

chinese.en: Some fish have firm white flesh that holds together well when grilled.
chinese.zh: 有些魚的白肉很結實，烤的時候不容易散開。

english.en: Peel the apple and cut the flesh into small pieces.
english.zh: 把蘋果削皮，再把果肉切成小塊。

speak.en: My grandparents always say family is about more than flesh and blood.
speak.zh: 我祖父母總是說，家人不只是血緣關係而已。

write.en: Researchers are fleshing out the details of a new public transport plan for rural areas.
write.zh: 研究人員正在為一項鄉村地區的新大眾運輸計畫補充細節。

example.en: Climate change cannot be solved by any single nation; it requires international cooperation on energy and transport.
example.zh: 氣候變遷不是單一國家能解決的，需要各國在能源和交通上進行國際合作。

listen.en: Thank you for your cooperation during the fire drill.
listen.zh: 感謝各位在消防演習時的配合。

chinese.en: The city museum organized the exhibition in cooperation with several local schools.
chinese.zh: 市立博物館與幾所在地學校合作舉辦了這次展覽。

english.en: Good cooperation among team members makes any job much easier.
english.zh: 團隊成員之間合作良好，任何工作都會輕鬆許多。

speak.en: In my family, cooking dinner together really needs everyone's cooperation.
speak.zh: 在我家，一起煮晚餐真的需要每個人互相配合。

write.en: The police asked for the public's cooperation in finding the missing hiker.
write.zh: 警方請求民眾協助尋找那位失蹤的登山客。

example.en: Offering such a tiny pay raise after years of hard work felt like an insult to the experienced staff.
example.zh: 辛苦工作多年卻只加這麼一點薪水，對資深員工來說簡直是一種侮辱。

listen.en: She felt insulted when nobody listened to her idea.
listen.zh: 沒有人聽她的想法，讓她覺得受到冒犯。

chinese.en: The two drivers started shouting insults at each other after the minor accident.
chinese.zh: 發生小擦撞之後，兩位駕駛開始互相叫罵。

english.en: Please don't insult the chef by adding salt before tasting.
english.zh: 請不要還沒嚐就加鹽，這樣很失禮於廚師。

speak.en: Asking a guest to pay for dinner would be an insult in my culture.
speak.zh: 在我們的文化裡，請客人自己付晚餐錢會被視為一種冒犯。

write.en: Online platforms should remove posts that insult people because of their background.
write.zh: 網路平臺應該刪除因背景而侮辱他人的貼文。

example.en: The aquarium's huge glass tunnel lets visitors walk underneath the water while colorful fish swim above their heads.
example.zh: 水族館巨大的玻璃隧道讓遊客能在水底下行走，五顏六色的魚就在頭頂上游來游去。

listen.en: My son wants a small aquarium in his bedroom.
listen.zh: 我兒子想在他房間裡放一個小魚缸。

chinese.en: Some people argue that keeping dolphins in an aquarium is unfair to the animals.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為把海豚養在水族館裡對牠們不公平。

english.en: Remember to clean the aquarium and change the water every week.
english.zh: 記得每個星期都要清洗魚缸、換水。

speak.en: Going to the aquarium is one of my favorite rainy-day activities.
speak.zh: 去水族館是我下雨天最喜歡的活動之一。

write.en: Today, a good aquarium does more than entertain; it also protects endangered marine species.
write.zh: 如今，一座好的水族館不只提供娛樂，也肩負保護瀕危海洋生物的責任。

example.en: The instructions were so complicated, full of technical terms and tiny diagrams, that we gave up assembling the desk.
example.zh: 說明書寫得太複雜，滿是專業術語和小小的圖示，我們最後放棄自己組裝書桌。

listen.en: The plot of the film gets more complicated near the end.
listen.zh: 這部電影的劇情到後面變得越來越複雜。

chinese.en: Their relationship became complicated after they started working in the same office.
chinese.zh: 他們開始在同一間辦公室工作之後，關係就變得複雜了。

english.en: This math problem is too complicated for most young students.
english.zh: 這道數學題對大多數年紀小的學生來說太難了。

speak.en: It's a bit complicated, but I'll try to explain it simply.
speak.zh: 這有點複雜，不過我會試著簡單說明。

write.en: Tax rules have become so complicated that many small businesses hire accountants.
write.zh: 稅務規定變得非常複雜，所以許多小公司都會請會計師處理。

example.en: Using empty bottles as plant pots was a stroke of genius that saved the school garden a lot of money.
example.zh: 用空瓶子當花盆真是神來一筆，替學校花園省下了一大筆錢。

listen.en: You don't have to be a genius to cook well.
listen.zh: 要煮得一手好菜，不一定要是天才。

chinese.en: Many people believe that genius is mostly the result of hard work rather than talent.
chinese.zh: 許多人相信，天才大多來自努力，而不是天賦。

english.en: My uncle is a genius with computers and can fix anything.
english.zh: 我叔叔是電腦天才，什麼都修得好。

speak.en: Honestly, whoever invented bubble tea was a total genius.
speak.zh: 說真的，發明珍珠奶茶的人根本是天才。

write.en: Schools should support creative geniuses instead of forcing every child into the same mold.
write.zh: 學校應該支持有創意的天才，而不是把每個孩子都塞進同一個模子裡。

example.en: The survey results proved unreliable because only a handful of people, mostly the researchers' friends, took part.
example.zh: 這份調查結果後來證明並不可靠，因為只有少數人參與，而且大多是研究人員的朋友。

listen.en: My old car is becoming more and more unreliable.
listen.zh: 我那輛舊車越來越不可靠了。

chinese.en: Public transport in rural areas is often unreliable, so many residents depend on scooters.
chinese.zh: 鄉下的大眾運輸常常不可靠，所以許多居民都靠機車代步。

english.en: Weather forecasts can be quite unreliable when you are in the mountains.
english.zh: 人在山區的時候，天氣預報可能很不準。

speak.en: I stopped working with him because he was so unreliable.
speak.zh: 我不再跟他合作了，因為他實在太不可靠。

write.en: Eyewitness memories can be surprisingly unreliable, especially when people are stressed or frightened.
write.zh: 目擊者的記憶可能出乎意料地不可靠，尤其是在人們緊張或害怕的時候。

example.en: Because standing water allows mosquitoes to breed, residents are asked to empty flower pots and buckets after it rains.
example.zh: 因為積水會讓蚊子孳生，所以居民被要求在下雨後把花盆和水桶裡的水倒掉。

listen.en: Don't forget to use mosquito spray before the hike.
listen.zh: 健行前別忘了噴防蚊液。

chinese.en: Dengue fever is spread by mosquitoes, so southern Taiwan runs cleanup campaigns every summer.
chinese.zh: 登革熱是由蚊子傳播的，所以南臺灣每年夏天都會舉辦清除孳生源的活動。

english.en: We slept under a mosquito net during our trip to the countryside.
english.zh: 我們到鄉下旅行時都睡在蚊帳裡。

speak.en: The worst thing about summer is the mosquitoes, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，夏天最討厭的就是蚊子。

write.en: Scientists are testing new ways to control mosquito populations without using harmful chemicals.
write.zh: 科學家正在測試不使用有害化學藥劑來控制蚊子數量的新方法。

example.en: The new thermometer is far more accurate than the old one, which was often off by several degrees.
example.zh: 新的溫度計比舊的準確得多，舊的那支常常差好幾度。

listen.en: Is this clock accurate, or is it running fast?
listen.zh: 這個時鐘準嗎？還是走快了？

chinese.en: Journalists have a responsibility to give an accurate account of what really happened.
chinese.zh: 記者有責任準確報導事情的真實經過。

english.en: The map on my phone is not always accurate in small towns.
english.zh: 我手機上的地圖在小鎮裡不一定準確。

speak.en: I think that's a pretty accurate description of my personality.
speak.zh: 我覺得那樣形容我的個性還滿準確的。

write.en: Accurate data on air pollution helps governments decide where to plant more trees.
write.zh: 準確的空氣污染數據能幫助政府決定要在哪裡多種樹。

example.en: Although several languages are spoken in the region, English remains predominant in business and higher education.
example.zh: 雖然這個地區通行好幾種語言，但在商業和高等教育中仍以英語為主。

listen.en: Fear was the predominant feeling among the passengers.
listen.zh: 乘客之間最主要的情緒是恐懼。

chinese.en: Cars still play a predominant role in how people travel to work in rural areas.
chinese.zh: 在鄉村地區，汽車仍是人們通勤最主要的交通工具。

english.en: The predominant view among students is that exams are too long.
english.zh: 學生之間的主流看法是考試時間太長。

speak.en: Honestly, rice is the predominant part of my diet.
speak.zh: 老實說，米飯是我飲食中最主要的部分。

write.en: Online shopping has become the predominant way young adults buy clothes.
write.zh: 網購已成為年輕人買衣服最主要的方式。

example.en: Without regular rainfall, the crops began to wither, and farmers feared they would lose the entire harvest.
example.zh: 由於缺乏穩定的降雨，作物開始枯萎，農民擔心整季收成都會泡湯。

listen.en: The leaves had withered in the hot summer sun.
listen.zh: 葉子在炎熱的夏日陽光下枯萎了。

chinese.en: Many small factories withered away after production moved to cheaper countries.
chinese.zh: 生產線移到成本較低的國家後，許多小工廠就逐漸凋零了。

english.en: Her hopes of winning the scholarship began to wither.
english.zh: 她拿到獎學金的希望開始一點一點消失。

speak.en: I'm terrible with plants; they always wither in my flat.
speak.zh: 我很不會養植物，它們在我家總是會枯死。

write.en: Public support for the project withered once the true costs became clear.
write.zh: 一旦真正的成本曝光，大眾對這項計畫的支持便逐漸消退。

example.en: Before modern telescopes, astronomy relied on careful observation of the night sky with the naked eye.
example.zh: 在現代望遠鏡出現之前，天文學靠的是用肉眼仔細觀察夜空。

listen.en: She wants to study astronomy at university next year.
listen.zh: 她明年想在大學念天文學。

chinese.en: Amateur astronomy has become popular thanks to cheap telescopes and phone apps.
chinese.zh: 多虧便宜的望遠鏡和手機應用程式，業餘天文觀測變得很熱門。

english.en: Astronomy helps us understand the origin of the universe.
english.zh: 天文學幫助我們了解宇宙的起源。

speak.en: I've always found astronomy amazing, especially photos of distant galaxies.
speak.zh: 我一直覺得天文學很神奇，尤其是遙遠星系的照片。

write.en: Governments should fund astronomy because space research often leads to useful technology.
write.zh: 政府應該資助天文學，因為太空研究常會帶來實用的技術。

example.en: Kangaroos are indigenous to Australia, which means they are not found naturally anywhere else in the world.
example.zh: 袋鼠是澳洲原生的動物，也就是說世界上其他地方並沒有野生的袋鼠。

listen.en: Many indigenous languages are slowly disappearing today.
listen.zh: 如今許多原住民語言正慢慢消失。

chinese.en: Planting indigenous species in city parks can attract local birds and insects.
chinese.zh: 在都市公園種植原生物種，可以吸引本地的鳥類和昆蟲。

english.en: Schools should teach students about indigenous culture and history.
english.zh: 學校應該教導學生認識原住民的文化與歷史。

speak.en: I really enjoyed learning indigenous songs during my trip to Hualien.
speak.zh: 我在花蓮旅行時學唱原住民歌謠，覺得很開心。

write.en: The company worked with indigenous farmers to grow coffee without harming the forest.
write.zh: 這家公司與原住民農民合作，在不破壞森林的情況下種植咖啡。

example.en: This coastal town is prone to flooding, so many houses are built on raised platforms.
example.zh: 這個沿海小鎮容易淹水，所以很多房子都蓋在墊高的平台上。

listen.en: I'm prone to headaches when I don't sleep enough.
listen.zh: 我睡眠不足時很容易頭痛。

chinese.en: Athletes who skip warm-up exercises are more prone to serious injuries.
chinese.zh: 不做暖身運動的運動員比較容易受重傷。

english.en: People are prone to mistakes when they work under pressure.
english.zh: 人在壓力下工作時很容易出錯。

speak.en: I'm a bit prone to getting lost in big cities.
speak.zh: 我在大城市裡有點容易迷路。

write.en: Earthquake-prone countries need stricter building codes to protect their citizens.
write.zh: 地震頻繁的國家需要更嚴格的建築法規來保護人民。

example.en: The manager did not hesitate at all; she rejected the proposal outright because it was far too expensive.
example.zh: 經理毫不猶豫，因為那份提案太貴了，她直接就否決了。

listen.en: He refused outright to change his travel plans.
listen.zh: 他斷然拒絕更改旅行計畫。

chinese.en: No party won the election outright, so they had to form a coalition.
chinese.zh: 沒有任何政黨在選舉中拿下過半，所以只好組成聯合政府。

english.en: Telling your teacher an outright lie is never a good idea.
english.zh: 對老師撒下明目張膽的謊絕對不是好主意。

speak.en: I didn't say no outright, but I wasn't keen either.
speak.zh: 我沒有直接拒絕，但也不是很有興趣。

write.en: After saving for years, they were finally able to buy the flat outright.
write.zh: 存了好幾年的錢之後，他們終於能一次付清買下那間公寓。

example.en: The graph shows a modest rise in sales over the year, far smaller than the sharp increase predicted.
example.zh: 圖表顯示當年的銷售額小幅上升，遠低於原先預測的大幅成長。

listen.en: They live in a modest house near the river.
listen.zh: 他們住在河邊一間樸素的房子裡。

chinese.en: Even a modest amount of exercise each day can improve your mood.
chinese.zh: 即使每天只做適量的運動，也能改善你的心情。

english.en: My grandfather is a modest man who rarely talks about himself.
english.zh: 我爺爺是個謙虛的人，很少談論自己。

speak.en: Don't be so modest; your presentation was brilliant!
speak.zh: 別這麼謙虛，你的報告超棒的！

write.en: Many graduates start their careers on a modest salary and work their way up.
write.zh: 許多畢業生從不高的薪水起步，再一步步往上爬。

example.en: After the injury, the nurse told him to elevate his ankle on a pillow to reduce the swelling.
example.zh: 受傷後，護理師要他把腳踝墊在枕頭上抬高，好讓腫脹消退。

listen.en: She was elevated to the role of team leader.
listen.zh: 她被提拔為團隊主管。

chinese.en: Tests showed elevated levels of pollution in the river near the factory.
chinese.zh: 檢測顯示，工廠附近河川的污染程度偏高。

english.en: A good soundtrack can elevate an ordinary film.
english.zh: 好的配樂能讓一部普通的電影更上一層樓。

speak.en: Adding fresh herbs really elevates a simple pasta dish.
speak.zh: 加一點新鮮香草，真的能讓簡單的義大利麵升級。

write.en: The government hopes to elevate living standards in remote villages through better roads.
write.zh: 政府希望藉由改善道路，提高偏鄉村落的生活水準。

example.en: Climbers who ignore the weather warnings are flirting with danger, as storms can arrive within minutes.
example.zh: 無視天氣警報的登山客是在玩命，因為暴風雨可能幾分鐘內就來了。

listen.en: He flirted with politics before becoming a lawyer.
listen.zh: 他在成為律師前曾短暫涉足政壇。

chinese.en: The company is flirting with disaster by ignoring customer complaints about safety.
chinese.zh: 這家公司無視顧客對安全的投訴，簡直是在自找麻煩。

english.en: She flirted with the idea of studying abroad last year.
english.zh: 她去年曾考慮過出國念書。

speak.en: Honestly, I flirt with the idea of quitting my job every Monday.
speak.zh: 老實說，每個星期一我都會冒出辭職的念頭。

write.en: Many young investors flirt with risky shares without understanding how the market works.
write.zh: 許多年輕投資人在不了解市場運作的情況下，就去碰高風險的股票。

example.en: Earthquakes happen when huge plates in the Earth's crust suddenly move against each other.
example.zh: 地震發生在地殼中巨大的板塊突然互相錯動的時候。

listen.en: I prefer pizza with a thin and crispy crust.
listen.zh: 我比較喜歡薄脆餅皮的披薩。

chinese.en: A hard crust of ice formed on the lake during the cold night.
chinese.zh: 寒冷的夜裡，湖面結了一層堅硬的冰殼。

english.en: Bake the pie until the crust turns golden brown.
english.zh: 把派烤到外皮變成金黃色。

speak.en: The crust is honestly my favourite part of fresh bread.
speak.zh: 老實說，新鮮麵包的外皮是我最喜歡的部分。

write.en: Scientists drill deep into the crust to study how the planet has changed.
write.zh: 科學家深入鑽探地殼，研究地球如何演變。

example.en: Before hiring a tutor, parents should check his credentials, such as degrees and teaching experience.
example.zh: 聘請家教前，家長應該查核他的資歷，例如學位和教學經驗。

listen.en: Please show your credentials at the front desk.
listen.zh: 請在櫃台出示您的身分證明。

chinese.en: Her academic credentials helped her get a job at a top research institute.
chinese.zh: 她的學術資歷幫助她在頂尖研究機構找到工作。

english.en: Never share your login credentials with anyone online.
english.zh: 絕對不要在網路上把你的帳號密碼告訴任何人。

speak.en: I think experience matters more than credentials in most jobs.
speak.zh: 我認為在大多數工作中，經驗比學歷更重要。

write.en: The chef established her credentials by winning several cooking competitions abroad.
write.zh: 這位主廚靠著在國外贏得多項烹飪比賽，奠定了自己的地位。

example.en: Many parents attach great importance to exam results, sometimes more than to their children's happiness.
example.zh: 許多家長非常重視考試成績，有時甚至勝過孩子的快樂。

listen.en: He attached a small light to his bike.
listen.zh: 他在腳踏車上裝了一個小燈。

chinese.en: After living there for years, she became deeply attached to the small seaside town.
chinese.zh: 在那裡住了多年之後，她對那座海邊小鎮產生了深厚的感情。

english.en: I forgot to attach the photos to my message.
english.zh: 我忘了在訊息裡附上照片。

speak.en: I'm really attached to my old phone, even though it's slow.
speak.zh: 雖然我的舊手機很慢，但我真的很捨不得它。

write.en: The loan seemed generous, but there were several conditions attached to it.
write.zh: 這筆貸款看起來很優惠，但附帶了好幾項條件。

example.en: When commodity prices such as wheat and rice rise sharply, poorer families struggle to buy enough food.
example.zh: 當小麥、稻米等大宗物資價格大幅上漲時，較貧窮的家庭就難以買到足夠的食物。

listen.en: Clean water is becoming a precious commodity in many places.
listen.zh: 在許多地方，乾淨的水正變成珍貴的資源。

chinese.en: The country's economy depends heavily on exporting commodities like coffee and copper.
chinese.zh: 這個國家的經濟高度仰賴出口咖啡和銅等原物料。

english.en: For busy parents, free time is a rare commodity.
english.zh: 對忙碌的父母來說，空閒時間非常難得。

speak.en: These days, I think sleep is my most valuable commodity.
speak.zh: 最近我覺得睡眠是我最寶貴的東西。

write.en: Some critics argue that education should not be treated as a commodity for sale.
write.zh: 有些批評者認為，教育不應該被當成可以買賣的商品。

example.en: The small boat was tossed around on the turbulent sea, and several passengers felt seasick.
example.zh: 小船在洶湧的海上劇烈搖晃，好幾位乘客都暈船了。

listen.en: The flight was turbulent, so nobody could sleep.
listen.zh: 飛行途中氣流很不穩，所以沒人睡得著。

chinese.en: Many people lost their savings during the turbulent years of the financial crisis.
chinese.zh: 在金融危機那段動盪的年頭，許多人失去了積蓄。

english.en: Teenagers often go through a turbulent stage in life.
english.zh: 青少年常會經歷人生中一段不穩定的階段。

speak.en: My first year at university was pretty turbulent, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我大一那年過得挺動盪的。

write.en: The city has a turbulent history, having been rebuilt several times after fires.
write.zh: 這座城市歷史多舛，曾在數次大火後重建。

example.en: Visitors find the old market fascinating because every stall sells something they have never seen before.
example.zh: 遊客覺得這座老市場很迷人，因為每個攤位賣的都是他們從沒見過的東西。

listen.en: Her talk about ancient Egypt was absolutely fascinating.
listen.zh: 她關於古埃及的演講實在太精彩了。

chinese.en: It is fascinating how quickly young children can pick up a second language.
chinese.zh: 小孩子學第二語言的速度之快，真的很令人驚嘆。

english.en: I find the history of my hometown fascinating.
english.zh: 我覺得我家鄉的歷史非常有趣。

speak.en: Travelling is fascinating because you meet people with different ideas.
speak.zh: 旅行很迷人，因為你會遇到想法不同的人。

write.en: The report provides a fascinating insight into how social media shapes our habits.
write.zh: 這份報告提供了一個很有意思的觀點，說明社群媒體如何塑造我們的習慣。

example.en: In spring the meadow is covered with wildflowers, attracting bees and butterflies from miles around.
example.zh: 春天時，草地上開滿野花，吸引方圓好幾公里的蜜蜂和蝴蝶前來。

listen.en: We walked across the meadow to reach the forest.
listen.zh: 我們穿過草地走到森林。

chinese.en: Many traditional meadows have been lost to farming and housing development.
chinese.zh: 許多傳統草地已經因為農業和住宅開發而消失。

english.en: The children ran happily through the green meadow.
english.zh: 孩子們開心地跑過那片綠色草地。

speak.en: Having a picnic in a quiet meadow sounds perfect to me.
speak.zh: 在安靜的草地上野餐，對我來說聽起來很完美。

write.en: The council plans to turn the old car park into a wildflower meadow.
write.zh: 市議會打算把舊停車場改造成一片野花草地。

example.en: Wheat, rice and maize are the main cereal crops that feed most of the world's population.
example.zh: 小麥、稻米和玉米是養活世界大多數人口的主要穀類作物。

listen.en: Many breakfast cereals contain a lot of sugar.
listen.zh: 許多早餐穀片含有大量的糖。

chinese.en: Farmers in the region switched from cereal production to growing fruit and vegetables.
chinese.zh: 這個地區的農民從生產穀物改為種植蔬果。

english.en: Choose a wholegrain cereal if you want a healthier breakfast.
english.zh: 如果你想吃得健康一點，就選全穀類的穀片。

speak.en: I'm too lazy to cook, so I just eat cereal most mornings.
speak.zh: 我懶得煮飯，所以大部分早上都只吃穀片。

write.en: Rising temperatures could reduce cereal yields in many developing countries.
write.zh: 氣溫上升可能會使許多開發中國家的穀物產量減少。

example.en: The brand sells its products through hundreds of retail outlets, as well as on its own website.
example.zh: 這個品牌透過數百個零售據點以及自家官網販售產品。

listen.en: Is there an outlet near the desk for my laptop?
listen.zh: 書桌附近有可以給我筆電用的插座嗎？

chinese.en: Several media outlets reported the story before the company made an official statement.
chinese.zh: 在公司正式發表聲明前，已有好幾家媒體報導了這件事。

english.en: Writing a diary gives me an outlet for my feelings.
english.zh: 寫日記讓我有個抒發情緒的管道。

speak.en: Painting is my main creative outlet after a long day.
speak.zh: 忙了一整天後，畫畫是我主要的創意出口。

write.en: The lake's only outlet is a narrow stream that flows into the sea.
write.zh: 這座湖唯一的出水口是一條流入大海的窄小溪流。

example.en: Bees can differentiate colours, which helps them find the flowers that contain the most nectar.
example.zh: 蜜蜂能辨別顏色，這幫助牠們找到花蜜最多的花朵。

listen.en: Can you differentiate these two similar sounds?
listen.zh: 你能分辨這兩個相似的聲音嗎？

chinese.en: Small cafés must differentiate themselves from large chains by offering a unique atmosphere.
chinese.zh: 小咖啡館必須提供獨特的氛圍，才能和大型連鎖店做出區隔。

english.en: It is important to differentiate facts from opinions.
english.zh: 區分事實和意見是很重要的。

speak.en: Honestly, I can't differentiate between expensive and cheap wine.
speak.zh: 老實說，我分不出貴的和便宜的葡萄酒有什麼差別。

write.en: Good teachers differentiate their lessons to meet the needs of every student.
write.zh: 好老師會依照每位學生的需求，設計不同層次的課程。

example.en: Government expenditure on healthcare rose steadily, while spending on defence remained almost unchanged.
example.zh: 政府的醫療支出穩定上升，而國防支出則幾乎沒有變化。

listen.en: The school must reduce its expenditure on printing.
listen.zh: 學校必須減少在印刷上的花費。

chinese.en: Public expenditure on education should be seen as an investment in the future.
chinese.zh: 政府的教育支出應該被視為對未來的投資。

english.en: Families need to keep track of their monthly expenditure.
english.zh: 家庭需要記錄每個月的支出。

speak.en: My biggest expenditure as a student is definitely rent.
speak.zh: 身為學生，我最大的開銷絕對是房租。

write.en: Finishing the project required a huge expenditure of time and energy.
write.zh: 完成這項計畫耗費了大量的時間和精力。

example.en: The old bridge, rebuilt after the flood, has come to symbolize the town's determination to recover.
example.zh: 這座在水災後重建的老橋，已成為小鎮決心重建家園的象徵。

listen.en: The dove is often used to symbolize peace.
listen.zh: 鴿子常被用來象徵和平。

chinese.en: For many young people, owning a car no longer symbolizes success the way it once did.
chinese.zh: 對許多年輕人來說，擁有一輛車已不再像過去那樣代表成功。

english.en: In the novel, the empty house symbolizes the family's broken relationships.
english.zh: 在這本小說裡，那棟空房子象徵這家人破裂的關係。

speak.en: To me, my grandmother's ring symbolizes love and family history.
speak.zh: 對我來說，祖母的戒指象徵著愛與家族的歷史。

write.en: The company redesigned its logo to symbolize a fresh commitment to sustainable products.
write.zh: 這家公司重新設計標誌，以象徵對永續產品的全新承諾。

example.en: Because the software is updated every few months, the training manual printed last year is already obsolete.
example.zh: 由於這套軟體每隔幾個月就會更新，去年印製的訓練手冊已經過時了。

listen.en: My old phone charger is completely obsolete now.
listen.zh: 我那個舊的手機充電器現在完全不能用了。

chinese.en: Some experts worry that automation will make certain jobs obsolete within a generation.
chinese.zh: 有些專家擔心，自動化會在一個世代內讓某些工作被淘汰。

english.en: Paper maps are becoming obsolete because most people use their phones.
english.zh: 紙本地圖逐漸被淘汰，因為大多數人都用手機。

speak.en: Honestly, I think fax machines are pretty much obsolete these days.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得現在傳真機幾乎已經過時了。

write.en: The factory replaced its obsolete equipment to cut energy costs and improve safety.
write.zh: 這間工廠汰換了老舊設備，以降低能源成本並提升安全性。

example.en: In a market full of overpriced gadgets, the company's honest advertising was a refreshing change for consumers.
example.zh: 在充斥著高價電子產品的市場裡，這家公司誠實的廣告讓消費者耳目一新。

listen.en: The sea breeze felt refreshing on such a hot day.
listen.zh: 在這麼熱的天氣裡，海風吹來讓人覺得很舒爽。

chinese.en: It is refreshing to meet a manager who actually listens to her staff's ideas.
chinese.zh: 遇到一位真正會聽取員工想法的主管，讓人感到很難得。

english.en: A short walk in the park is refreshing after studying all morning.
english.zh: 念了一整個早上的書之後，到公園散散步很提神。

speak.en: I find a quick nap surprisingly refreshing in the afternoon.
speak.zh: 我發現下午小睡一下出乎意料地能恢復精神。

write.en: The teacher's refreshing approach to grammar made even shy students eager to participate.
write.zh: 老師教文法的方式令人耳目一新，連害羞的學生都踴躍參與。

example.en: The city council authorized the construction of a new library, ending years of debate over the site.
example.zh: 市議會批准興建一座新圖書館，結束了多年來關於選址的爭論。

listen.en: Nobody authorized you to change the meeting schedule.
listen.zh: 沒有人授權你更改會議時程。

chinese.en: The school has authorized teachers to use mobile phones in class for research activities.
chinese.zh: 學校已允許老師在課堂上使用手機進行查資料的活動。

english.en: The bank will not authorize the loan without proof of income.
english.zh: 沒有收入證明，銀行不會核准這筆貸款。

speak.en: I'm afraid I'm not authorized to give out that information.
speak.zh: 很抱歉，我沒有權限提供那項資訊。

write.en: Only authorized staff may enter the laboratory, so visitors must wait at reception.
write.zh: 只有經授權的人員才能進入實驗室，所以訪客必須在櫃檯等候。

example.en: Despite rumors of closure, the director publicly affirmed the museum's commitment to staying open and free for everyone.
example.zh: 儘管有關閉的傳言，館長仍公開重申博物館將持續開放並免費供大眾參觀。

listen.en: The coach affirmed his trust in the young players.
listen.zh: 教練表明他對年輕球員的信任。

chinese.en: The court affirmed the earlier decision, so the company must pay the fine.
chinese.zh: 法院維持原判，所以這家公司必須繳交罰款。

english.en: The company affirmed its promise to reduce plastic packaging next year.
english.zh: 這家公司重申明年要減少塑膠包裝的承諾。

speak.en: Good teachers affirm students' efforts, not just their final results.
speak.zh: 好老師會肯定學生的努力，而不只是看最後的成績。

write.en: Volunteering at the shelter affirmed my belief that small actions can make a real difference.
write.zh: 在收容所當志工讓我更加確信，小小的行動也能帶來真正的改變。

example.en: The meeting ended early after a heated clash between residents who wanted a park and those who wanted parking.
example.zh: 想要公園的居民和想要停車場的居民激烈爭執後，會議提早結束了。

listen.en: Those bright colors clash with the calm living room.
listen.zh: 那些鮮豔的顏色和沉穩的客廳不搭。

chinese.en: My exam unfortunately clashes with my sister's wedding, so I may have to reschedule.
chinese.zh: 很不巧，我的考試和姊姊的婚禮撞期，所以我可能得改時間。

english.en: The project was delayed by a clash of opinions within the team.
english.zh: 這個專案因為團隊內部意見衝突而延誤了。

speak.en: My parents and I sometimes clash over how much time I spend online.
speak.zh: 我和爸媽有時會為了我上網的時間而起爭執。

write.en: The festival tries to avoid any clash of dates with the national exam period.
write.zh: 這個節慶活動盡量避免和全國考試期間撞期。

example.en: Released during a difficult summer, the cheerful song quickly became an anthem for young people hoping for change.
example.zh: 這首輕快的歌在艱難的夏天推出，很快就成為渴望改變的年輕人的代表歌曲。

listen.en: Everyone stood up when the anthem began to play.
listen.zh: 頌歌一響起，大家都站了起來。

chinese.en: Each school in the region has its own anthem, which students sing at graduation.
chinese.zh: 這個地區的每所學校都有自己的校歌，學生會在畢業典禮上演唱。

english.en: The athletes listened proudly to their national anthem after winning gold.
english.zh: 運動員贏得金牌後，驕傲地聆聽自己的國歌。

speak.en: That song was basically the anthem of my university years.
speak.zh: 那首歌基本上就是我大學時期的代表歌曲。

write.en: The charity adopted an upbeat pop song as its anthem for the fundraising campaign.
write.zh: 這個慈善團體選了一首輕快的流行歌，作為募款活動的主題曲。

example.en: Experts examined the painting for weeks before confirming it was genuine and not a clever copy.
example.zh: 專家花了好幾週檢驗這幅畫，才確認它是真跡，而不是高明的仿作。

listen.en: His apology sounded genuine to everyone in the room.
listen.zh: 在場的每個人都覺得他的道歉很真誠。

chinese.en: Customers can easily tell whether a company has a genuine concern for the environment.
chinese.zh: 顧客很容易就能看出一家公司是否真心關懷環境。

english.en: Make sure the bag is genuine leather before you buy it.
english.zh: 買之前要確定這個包包是真皮的。

speak.en: I think genuine friendships are built on trust, not money.
speak.zh: 我認為真正的友誼是建立在信任上，而不是金錢。

write.en: The university offers genuine support for international students, from housing advice to language classes.
write.zh: 這所大學為國際學生提供實質的協助，從住宿建議到語言課程都有。

example.en: Researchers found that higher income did not always correlate with greater happiness, especially after basic needs were met.
example.zh: 研究人員發現，收入較高不一定帶來更多幸福感，在基本需求滿足之後尤其如此。

listen.en: Exercise and good mood often correlate with each other.
listen.zh: 運動和好心情往往互有關聯。

chinese.en: The graph shows that rising temperatures correlate with higher electricity use in summer.
chinese.zh: 這張圖顯示，夏季氣溫上升與用電量增加有關。

english.en: Reading habits are strongly correlated with vocabulary size in children.
english.zh: 兒童的閱讀習慣和字彙量有很強的相關性。

speak.en: I think how much you practice correlates with how confident you feel.
speak.zh: 我認為你練習得多少，和你有多少自信是相關的。

write.en: The study attempted to correlate social media use with levels of anxiety among teenagers.
write.zh: 這項研究試圖找出青少年使用社群媒體與焦慮程度之間的關聯。

example.en: Geologists explain that heat from the Earth's mantle slowly moves the plates on which the continents rest.
example.zh: 地質學家解釋，來自地函的熱能會緩慢推動承載各大陸的板塊。

listen.en: A mantle of snow covered the quiet village.
listen.zh: 一層白雪覆蓋了寧靜的村莊。

chinese.en: The young scientist inherited the mantle of her famous mentor and continued his research.
chinese.zh: 這位年輕科學家接下知名恩師的衣缽，延續他的研究。

english.en: She was ready to take up the mantle of team captain.
english.zh: 她已經準備好接下隊長的職責。

speak.en: I'd love to take on the mantle of class representative someday.
speak.zh: 我希望有一天能擔任班代的角色。

write.en: With its new green policies, the city hopes to claim the mantle of Asia's most sustainable capital.
write.zh: 這座城市希望藉由新的環保政策，贏得亞洲最永續首都的地位。

example.en: She gave up a well-paid job in the city, a sacrifice that allowed her to care for her elderly father.
example.zh: 她放棄了城市裡的高薪工作，這份犧牲讓她能照顧年邁的父親。

listen.en: He sacrificed his weekends to finish the project.
listen.zh: 他犧牲了週末來完成這個專案。

chinese.en: Companies should not sacrifice product safety simply to lower their production costs.
chinese.zh: 企業不應該只為了降低生產成本而犧牲產品安全。

english.en: Many students sacrifice sleep in order to prepare for important exams.
english.zh: 許多學生為了準備重要考試而犧牲睡眠。

speak.en: Honestly, I'm not willing to sacrifice my health for a higher salary.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不願意為了更高的薪水而犧牲健康。

write.en: Moving abroad meant making real sacrifices, including missing family celebrations back home.
write.zh: 出國生活代表要做出實際的犧牲，包括錯過家鄉的家族慶祝活動。

example.en: Doctors often advise older women to take calcium supplements, because their bones become weaker and break more easily with age.
example.zh: 醫生常建議年長女性服用鈣片，因為隨著年齡增長，她們的骨骼會變得較脆弱、容易骨折。

listen.en: Leafy green vegetables are also a source of calcium.
listen.zh: 深綠色葉菜也是鈣質的來源。

chinese.en: A lack of calcium in childhood can affect bone growth later in life.
chinese.zh: 童年時期缺乏鈣質，可能會影響日後的骨骼發育。

english.en: Tofu is a cheap and healthy source of calcium for vegetarians.
english.zh: 對素食者來說，豆腐是便宜又健康的鈣質來源。

speak.en: I drink soy milk every morning to get enough calcium.
speak.zh: 我每天早上都喝豆漿來攝取足夠的鈣質。

write.en: Hard water contains high levels of calcium, which can build up inside kettles and pipes.
write.zh: 硬水含有大量鈣質，會在水壺和水管裡形成積垢。

example.en: Instead of discarding old clothes, the community center collects them and turns the fabric into bags and cushions.
example.zh: 社區中心不把舊衣服丟掉，而是回收起來，將布料做成袋子和靠墊。

listen.en: Don't discard the receipt until the item arrives.
listen.zh: 商品送到之前，不要把收據丟掉。

chinese.en: Scientists discarded the theory once new evidence showed it could not explain the results.
chinese.zh: 新證據顯示這個理論無法解釋實驗結果後，科學家便摒棄了它。

english.en: Too many people discard plastic bottles instead of recycling them properly.
english.zh: 太多人把塑膠瓶丟掉，而不是妥善回收。

speak.en: I usually discard the first draft and start again from scratch.
speak.zh: 我通常會丟掉初稿，然後從頭開始寫。

write.en: Factories that discard waste into rivers should face heavy fines from the government.
write.zh: 把廢棄物排入河川的工廠，應該受到政府重罰。

example.en: From an economic perspective, the new airport makes sense, but environmental groups argue it will destroy valuable wetlands.
example.zh: 從經濟角度來看，興建新機場是合理的，但環保團體認為它會破壞珍貴的濕地。

listen.en: Try to see the problem from her perspective.
listen.zh: 試著從她的角度來看這個問題。

chinese.en: Talking to older relatives helped me put my own problems into perspective.
chinese.zh: 和年長的親戚聊天，幫助我更客觀地看待自己的問題。

english.en: Reading history books can give us a wider perspective on current events.
english.zh: 閱讀歷史書可以讓我們用更寬廣的視野看待時事。

speak.en: From my perspective, working from home has more advantages than disadvantages.
speak.zh: 在我看來，在家工作的優點多於缺點。

write.en: The art students practiced drawing buildings in perspective so that the streets looked realistic.
write.zh: 美術系學生練習用透視法畫建築，讓街景看起來更逼真。

example.en: Although the repairs were expensive, the family saw substantial savings on their energy bills within a single winter.
example.zh: 雖然修繕費用很高，這家人光一個冬天就省下了可觀的能源費用。

listen.en: She received a substantial amount of help from her neighbors.
listen.zh: 她從鄰居那裡得到了很多幫助。

chinese.en: There is substantial evidence that air pollution seriously harms children's lung development.
chinese.zh: 有充分的證據顯示，空氣污染會嚴重影響兒童的肺部發育。

english.en: We had a substantial breakfast before starting the long mountain hike.
english.zh: 開始漫長的登山健行之前，我們吃了一頓豐盛的早餐。

speak.en: Honestly, learning a language requires a substantial amount of time and patience.
speak.zh: 老實說，學一門語言需要大量的時間和耐心。

write.en: The university made substantial changes to its admission process after student complaints.
write.zh: 在學生抱怨之後，這所大學對招生程序做了重大的改變。

example.en: Energy-efficient appliances may cost more at first, but they can greatly reduce household electricity bills over time.
example.zh: 節能家電一開始可能比較貴，但長期下來能大幅降低家裡的電費。

listen.en: Please unplug all electrical appliances before you leave.
listen.zh: 離開前請拔掉所有電器的插頭。

chinese.en: The store offers free delivery and installation for large appliances such as refrigerators.
chinese.zh: 這家店為冰箱等大型家電提供免費運送與安裝。

english.en: My grandmother does not know how to use modern appliances.
english.zh: 我的祖母不知道怎麼使用現代家電。

speak.en: The appliance I use most is probably my rice cooker.
speak.zh: 我最常用的家電大概是電鍋。

write.en: Old appliances should be recycled properly because they often contain harmful chemicals.
write.zh: 舊家電應該妥善回收，因為它們常含有有害的化學物質。

example.en: When our regular teacher fell ill, a substitute took over the class and kept us working on the same project.
example.zh: 我們的導師生病時，由代課老師接手這個班，並讓我們繼續進行同一個專題。

listen.en: There is no substitute for hard work and practice.
listen.zh: 努力與練習是無可取代的。

chinese.en: Online meetings can be useful, but they are not a perfect substitute for face-to-face contact.
chinese.zh: 線上會議或許很實用，但無法完全取代面對面的交流。

english.en: The coach substituted a younger player in the second half.
english.zh: 教練在下半場換上了一名較年輕的球員。

speak.en: I sometimes substitute oat milk for regular milk in my coffee.
speak.zh: 我有時會在咖啡裡用燕麥奶代替一般牛奶。

write.en: Many countries are trying to substitute renewable energy for coal and oil.
write.zh: 許多國家正努力以再生能源取代煤炭和石油。

example.en: As the forest was cleared to create pasture for cattle, many native birds lost their nesting areas.
example.zh: 森林被砍伐改成養牛的牧場後，許多原生鳥類失去了築巢的地方。

listen.en: Sheep were resting quietly in the open pasture.
listen.zh: 羊群在開闊的牧場上靜靜地休息。

chinese.en: Farmers move their animals to fresh pasture so the grass has time to grow back.
chinese.zh: 農民把牲畜移到新的草地，讓原本的草有時間重新長回來。

english.en: The horses were let out into the pasture every morning.
english.zh: 每天早上，馬匹都會被放到牧場上。

speak.en: Driving past the pastures in the countryside always makes me feel relaxed.
speak.zh: 開車經過鄉間的牧場總是讓我覺得很放鬆。

write.en: After years in banking, he left for greener pastures and opened a small café.
write.zh: 在銀行業待了多年後，他另謀發展，開了一間小咖啡館。

example.en: Smoking can damage blood vessels, reducing the flow of oxygen to the heart and other organs.
example.zh: 吸菸會損害血管，減少輸送到心臟和其他器官的氧氣。

listen.en: A large cargo vessel slowly entered the port.
listen.zh: 一艘大型貨輪緩緩駛進港口。

chinese.en: The museum displays ancient clay vessels that were once used to store water and grain.
chinese.zh: 博物館展示了古代用來儲存水和穀物的陶製容器。

english.en: Regular exercise helps keep your heart and blood vessels healthy.
english.zh: 規律運動有助於維持心臟和血管的健康。

speak.en: I'd love to travel on a research vessel to Antarctica someday.
speak.zh: 我希望有一天能搭研究船去南極。

write.en: The coast guard rescued all the passengers after their vessel hit rocks near the island.
write.zh: 船隻在島嶼附近觸礁後，海巡人員救起了所有乘客。

example.en: As inflation pushed up the price of rice and cooking oil, many families started shopping at cheaper markets.
example.zh: 隨著通膨推高米和食用油的價格，許多家庭開始到較便宜的市場買東西。

listen.en: Rising inflation worries many young families these days.
listen.zh: 近來不斷上升的通膨讓許多年輕家庭感到憂心。

chinese.en: The central bank raised interest rates in an effort to control inflation.
chinese.zh: 央行為了抑制通貨膨脹而調升利率。

english.en: Inflation has made housing even harder to afford for young people.
english.zh: 通貨膨脹讓年輕人更買不起房子。

speak.en: Because of inflation, eating out has become a lot more expensive.
speak.zh: 因為通膨，外食變得貴很多。

write.en: The graph shows that inflation fell steadily over the decade before rising sharply again.
write.zh: 這張圖顯示，通膨在這十年間持續下降，之後又再度急遽上升。

example.en: After weeks of searching, the company finally found a suitable candidate who had both experience and strong language skills.
example.zh: 找了好幾週之後，公司終於找到一位既有經驗、語言能力又強的合適人選。

listen.en: Is this jacket suitable for a formal dinner?
listen.zh: 這件外套適合穿去正式晚宴嗎？

chinese.en: Many students struggle to find suitable accommodation near the university at a reasonable price.
chinese.zh: 許多學生很難在大學附近找到價格合理又合適的住處。

english.en: This film is not suitable for young children to watch.
english.zh: 這部電影不適合幼童觀看。

speak.en: I think early morning is the most suitable time to study.
speak.zh: 我覺得清晨是最適合讀書的時間。

write.en: Governments should ensure that public buildings are suitable for people with disabilities.
write.zh: 政府應確保公共建築適合身障人士使用。

example.en: To end the long strike, management offered a major concession: workers would get two extra days of annual leave.
example.zh: 為了結束漫長的罷工，資方做出重大讓步：員工的年假多兩天。

listen.en: Students can buy concession tickets at the station.
listen.zh: 學生可以在車站購買優惠票。

chinese.en: The landlord refused to make any concession on the rent, so we decided to move.
chinese.zh: 房東不肯在租金上做任何讓步，所以我們決定搬家。

english.en: She made a small concession and let her son stay up later.
english.zh: 她稍微讓步，讓兒子晚一點睡。

speak.en: Honestly, in a good relationship, both people make concessions sometimes.
speak.zh: 老實說，在好的感情裡，雙方有時都會讓步。

write.en: As a concession to local residents, the factory agreed to reduce noise at night.
write.zh: 為了向當地居民讓步，工廠同意減少夜間噪音。

example.en: The report compared abortion rates across several countries and found that they were closely linked to access to contraception.
example.zh: 這份報告比較了數個國家的人工流產率，發現與避孕措施是否容易取得密切相關。

listen.en: Abortion laws differ greatly from country to country.
listen.zh: 各國的墮胎法規差異很大。

chinese.en: Medical students learn about abortion procedures as part of their training in women's health.
chinese.zh: 醫學生在婦女健康的訓練課程中會學習人工流產手術。

english.en: The nurse answered her questions about abortion calmly and clearly.
english.zh: 護理師冷靜而清楚地回答她關於人工流產的問題。

speak.en: Abortion is a sensitive topic, so I usually avoid discussing it at dinner.
speak.zh: 墮胎是敏感話題，所以我通常不在吃飯時談論。

write.en: Public debate over abortion often involves medical, legal and ethical questions at the same time.
write.zh: 關於墮胎的公共辯論，往往同時牽涉醫學、法律與倫理問題。

example.en: When the new phone arrived, Lisa noticed a small scratch on the screen and asked the shop for a replacement.
example.zh: 新手機送到時，Lisa 發現螢幕上有一道小刮痕，便要求店家換貨。

listen.en: Try not to scratch the mosquito bites on your leg.
listen.zh: 盡量不要抓腿上被蚊子叮的地方。

chinese.en: After the system crashed, the team had to rebuild the entire database from scratch.
chinese.zh: 系統當機後，團隊只好從頭重建整個資料庫。

english.en: He scratched his head and tried to remember her name.
english.zh: 他搔搔頭，努力想起她的名字。

speak.en: I actually learned to cook from scratch when I moved abroad.
speak.zh: 其實我是出國後才從零開始學做菜的。

write.en: This study only scratches the surface of how social media affects teenagers.
write.zh: 這項研究對於社群媒體如何影響青少年，只觸及了皮毛。

example.en: Using a heavy pair of shears, the gardener trimmed the overgrown hedge until it looked neat again.
example.zh: 園丁用一把沉重的大剪刀修剪雜亂的樹籬，直到它恢復整齊。

listen.en: We watched the farmer shear a sheep in minutes.
listen.zh: 我們看著農夫在幾分鐘內就剪完一隻羊的毛。

chinese.en: The strong wind sheared off several branches from the old tree in the park.
chinese.zh: 強風把公園裡那棵老樹的好幾根樹枝吹斷了。

english.en: The wool is sold to factories after the sheep are shorn.
english.zh: 羊剪完毛後，羊毛會賣給工廠。

speak.en: I once tried to shear a sheep on a farm, and it was hard!
speak.zh: 我曾經在農場試著剪羊毛，真的很難！

write.en: Sheep farming communities in New Zealand depend on skilled workers to shear millions of animals.
write.zh: 紐西蘭的養羊社區仰賴熟練的工人為數以百萬計的羊剪毛。

example.en: The jury deliberated for two full days before finally reaching a verdict that everyone in the courtroom had been waiting for.
example.zh: 陪審團商議了整整兩天，終於做出法庭上所有人都在等待的裁決。

listen.en: She spoke in a slow and deliberate voice.
listen.zh: 她用緩慢而從容的語氣說話。

chinese.en: Some advertisers make deliberate attempts to confuse customers about the real price.
chinese.zh: 有些廣告商刻意混淆消費者對實際價格的認知。

english.en: The committee deliberated on the proposal for over an hour.
english.zh: 委員會針對這項提案討論了一個多小時。

speak.en: I don't think he forgot; it seemed pretty deliberate to me.
speak.zh: 我不覺得他是忘了，在我看來那很明顯是故意的。

write.en: Reducing sugar in school meals is a deliberate policy to improve children's health.
write.zh: 減少學校餐點的糖分，是一項為改善兒童健康而刻意推行的政策。

example.en: The builders promised to work quietly, but the drilling still caused serious disturbance to residents who worked from home.
example.zh: 工人承諾會安靜施工，但鑽孔聲仍對在家工作的住戶造成嚴重干擾。

listen.en: Police were called to a disturbance outside the stadium.
listen.zh: 警方接獲通報，前往處理體育場外的騷動。

chinese.en: Shift work can lead to sleep disturbances, which affect both mood and concentration.
chinese.zh: 輪班工作可能導致睡眠障礙，進而影響情緒與專注力。

english.en: The new road will cause little disturbance to local wildlife.
english.zh: 新道路對當地野生動物的干擾很小。

speak.en: I need a room without any disturbance when I'm revising.
speak.zh: 我複習功課的時候，需要一個完全不受打擾的房間。

write.en: Tourists should respect nature and keep disturbance to nesting birds to a minimum.
write.zh: 遊客應尊重自然，盡量減少對築巢鳥類的干擾。

example.en: On the table was a large tray of assorted snacks, from salty crackers to sweet pastries.
example.zh: 桌上擺著一大盤綜合點心，從鹹餅乾到甜糕點都有。

listen.en: She bought a box of assorted chocolates for her mother.
listen.zh: 她買了一盒綜合巧克力送給媽媽。

chinese.en: The drawer was full of assorted cables, chargers and old keys that nobody used.
chinese.zh: 抽屜裡塞滿各式各樣沒人在用的電線、充電器和舊鑰匙。

english.en: The library offers assorted workshops for students during the summer.
english.zh: 圖書館暑假期間為學生開設各式各樣的工作坊。

speak.en: We usually order an assorted platter so everyone can try something.
speak.zh: 我們通常會點一份綜合拼盤，讓大家都能嚐嚐看。

write.en: Charity shops collect assorted second-hand goods and sell them to fund local projects.
write.zh: 慈善二手店收集各式各樣的二手物品，再賣掉來資助在地計畫。

example.en: Using satellite data, rescue teams were able to pinpoint the exact location of the missing hikers within an hour.
example.zh: 搜救隊利用衛星資料，在一小時內精確找出失蹤登山客的位置。

listen.en: It's hard to pinpoint when the problem started.
listen.zh: 很難確切指出問題是從什麼時候開始的。

chinese.en: The survey helped the school pinpoint which subjects students found most difficult.
chinese.zh: 這份問卷幫助學校找出學生覺得最難的科目。

english.en: The doctor could not pinpoint the reason for my headache.
english.zh: 醫生無法確切找出我頭痛的原因。

speak.en: I can't pinpoint exactly why, but I just love that city.
speak.zh: 我說不出確切的原因，但我就是很愛那座城市。

write.en: The player passed the ball with pinpoint accuracy, setting up the winning goal.
write.zh: 那名球員以極精準的傳球，助攻了致勝的一球。

example.en: Children who play with building blocks often develop better spatial awareness, which later helps them with geometry and map reading.
example.zh: 常玩積木的孩子空間感通常較好，這對他們日後學幾何和看地圖都有幫助。

listen.en: Good drivers usually have excellent spatial awareness on the road.
listen.zh: 好的駕駛人在路上通常有很好的空間感。

chinese.en: The map shows the spatial distribution of public libraries across the city.
chinese.zh: 這張地圖顯示全市公共圖書館的空間分布。

english.en: This online test measures your spatial reasoning and problem-solving skills.
english.zh: 這個線上測驗評量你的空間推理與解決問題的能力。

speak.en: I'm terrible at parking because my spatial sense isn't great.
speak.zh: 我停車技術很差，因為我的空間感不太好。

write.en: Urban planners use spatial data to decide where new hospitals should be built.
write.zh: 都市規劃師利用空間資料，決定新醫院該蓋在哪裡。

example.en: Although it was only his first offence, the judge warned him that repeating the mistake would lead to a much heavier fine.
example.zh: 雖然這只是他第一次違法，法官仍警告他若再犯，罰款會重得多。

listen.en: No offence, but I prefer the other design.
listen.zh: 無意冒犯，但我比較喜歡另一個設計。

chinese.en: Dropping litter in public places is an offence that can result in a fine.
chinese.zh: 在公共場所亂丟垃圾是違法行為，可能會被罰款。

english.en: She took offence at his rude comments about her cooking.
english.zh: 她對他批評她廚藝的無禮言論感到不悅。

speak.en: I hope you didn't take offence at what I said earlier.
speak.zh: 希望你沒有因為我剛才說的話而不高興。

write.en: Teenagers who commit minor offences should do community service rather than go to prison.
write.zh: 犯下輕微罪行的青少年應該做社區服務，而不是去坐牢。

example.en: The building directory near the lift shows which company is on each floor, so visitors rarely get lost.
example.zh: 電梯旁的大樓樓層指南標示了每層樓有哪些公司，所以訪客很少迷路。

listen.en: Check the staff directory for her email address.
listen.zh: 查一下員工通訊錄，就能找到她的電子郵件地址。

chinese.en: Save all your project files in the same directory so they are easy to find.
chinese.zh: 把所有專案檔案存在同一個資料夾裡，這樣比較好找。

english.en: The university publishes a directory of student clubs every year.
english.zh: 這所大學每年都會出版一本學生社團名錄。

speak.en: People rarely use printed phone directories anymore; everything's online now.
speak.zh: 現在已經很少人用紙本電話簿了，什麼都在網路上。

write.en: Local governments should keep an updated directory of community health services for residents.
write.zh: 地方政府應為居民維護一份最新的社區醫療服務名錄。

example.en: When Tom reached the baggage carousel, he realised his suitcase had been sent to another city by mistake.
example.zh: Tom 走到行李轉盤時，才發現他的行李箱被誤送到另一個城市。

listen.en: Could you help me lift this heavy suitcase?
listen.zh: 你可以幫我抬這個很重的行李箱嗎？

chinese.en: Students moving into the dormitory often bring a suitcase full of clothes and snacks.
chinese.zh: 搬進宿舍的學生常會帶一個裝滿衣服和零食的行李箱。

english.en: I always unpack my suitcase as soon as I get home.
english.zh: 我一回到家，總是馬上把行李箱裡的東西拿出來。

speak.en: For business trips, I just bring a small suitcase on wheels.
speak.zh: 出差時我只帶一個小型的滾輪行李箱。

write.en: Some sales staff travel so often that they practically live out of a suitcase.
write.zh: 有些業務人員經常出差，幾乎過著拎著行李箱到處跑的生活。

example.en: The old palace, with its painted ceilings and golden mirrors, is a splendid example of eighteenth-century design.
example.zh: 這座古老宮殿有彩繪天花板和金色鏡子，是十八世紀設計的絕佳典範。

listen.en: What a splendid idea for the class trip!
listen.zh: 這個校外教學的點子真是太棒了！

chinese.en: The volunteers did a splendid job organising the charity concert in such a short time.
chinese.zh: 志工們在這麼短的時間內，把慈善音樂會辦得非常出色。

english.en: We had splendid weather during our holiday in the mountains.
english.zh: 我們在山上度假時天氣非常好。

speak.en: The food at my cousin's wedding was absolutely splendid.
speak.zh: 我表哥婚禮上的菜真的超棒。

write.en: Investing in public parks can turn ordinary neighbourhoods into splendid places to live.
write.zh: 投資興建公園，可以讓普通的社區變成很棒的居住地。

example.en: As the exam results day approached, Mia was filled with dread, checking her email every few minutes for news.
example.zh: 隨著放榜日接近，Mia 心中充滿恐懼，每隔幾分鐘就查看一次電子郵件。

listen.en: I dread going back to work after a long holiday.
listen.zh: 長假過後，我很怕回去上班。

chinese.en: Some older people dread the thought of moving away from the neighbourhood they love.
chinese.zh: 有些長者一想到要搬離自己深愛的社區就很害怕。

english.en: He dreaded telling his parents that he had failed the test.
english.zh: 他很怕告訴父母自己考試不及格。

speak.en: I dread to think how much my phone bill will be this month.
speak.zh: 我不敢想像這個月的電話費會有多少。

write.en: Long commutes are something many office workers dread, so remote work has become popular.
write.zh: 漫長的通勤是許多上班族害怕的事，因此遠距工作越來越受歡迎。

example.en: Halfway through her speech, her voice faltered, but she took a deep breath and confidently finished the rest.
example.zh: 演講到一半時她的聲音開始顫抖，但她深吸一口氣，自信地講完剩下的部分。

listen.en: His courage never faltered during the difficult climb.
listen.zh: 在艱難的攀登過程中，他的勇氣從未動搖。

chinese.en: Public support for the new tax began to falter once the details were announced.
chinese.zh: 新稅制的細節公布後，民眾的支持度開始下滑。

english.en: The old man faltered on the stairs, so I helped him.
english.zh: 那位老先生在樓梯上腳步不穩，所以我扶了他一把。

speak.en: My motivation tends to falter around the middle of term.
speak.zh: 我的讀書動力通常到學期中就開始減弱。

write.en: Even when sales faltered, the small company refused to lay off any staff.
write.zh: 即使銷售下滑，這家小公司也拒絕裁員。

example.en: Nurses who work the night shift often struggle to sleep during the day, because their body clock is disrupted.
example.zh: 上夜班的護理師常因生理時鐘被打亂，白天難以入睡。

listen.en: Please help me shift this table closer to the window.
listen.zh: 請幫我把這張桌子挪近窗邊。

chinese.en: The company has shifted its focus from printed books to digital learning products.
chinese.zh: 這家公司已把重心從紙本書轉向數位學習產品。

english.en: Don't shift the blame onto others when you make a mistake.
english.zh: 犯錯時不要把責任推給別人。

speak.en: I work part-time at a café, usually on the weekend shift.
speak.zh: 我在咖啡店打工，通常排週末的班。

write.en: The graph shows a gradual shift towards renewable energy over the past decade.
write.zh: 這張圖表顯示過去十年間逐漸轉向再生能源的趨勢。

example.en: Since buying a home was far too expensive, the young couple decided to rent a small flat near the train station.
example.zh: 由於買房實在太貴，這對年輕夫妻決定在火車站附近租一間小公寓。

listen.en: They rent out their spare room to students.
listen.zh: 他們把家裡的空房間出租給學生。

chinese.en: Rising rents in big cities are forcing many young workers to share flats.
chinese.zh: 大城市房租不斷上漲，迫使許多年輕上班族與人合租。

english.en: You can rent a bike for the day near the park entrance.
english.zh: 你可以在公園入口附近租腳踏車騎一整天。

speak.en: To be honest, I'd rather rent than buy a house at my age.
speak.zh: 說實話，以我這個年紀，我寧願租房也不想買房。

write.en: Governments could introduce rent controls to make housing more affordable for low-income families.
write.zh: 政府可以實施租金管制，讓低收入家庭更負擔得起住房。

example.en: Over the past twenty years, smartphones have completely changed the media landscape, and newspapers have struggled to keep readers.
example.zh: 過去二十年來，智慧型手機徹底改變了媒體生態，報紙一直苦於留住讀者。

listen.en: The painting shows a quiet landscape covered in snow.
listen.zh: 這幅畫描繪一片白雪覆蓋的寧靜風景。

chinese.en: Rapid construction of high-rise buildings has transformed the urban landscape of many Asian cities.
chinese.zh: 高樓大廈快速興建，改變了許多亞洲城市的都市景觀。

english.en: The hotel garden was beautifully landscaped with trees and ponds.
english.zh: 這間飯店的花園以樹木和池塘精心造景。

speak.en: I really love the mountain landscapes along Taiwan's east coast.
speak.zh: 我真的很喜歡臺灣東海岸的山景。

write.en: Well-managed tourism can actually help protect natural landscapes and support local communities.
write.zh: 管理得當的觀光其實能幫助保護自然景觀，並支持在地社區。

example.en: The students showed real enterprise by turning their school recycling project into a business that now sells handmade bags.
example.zh: 這些學生展現了十足的進取心，把學校的回收專題變成一門販售手作包的生意。

listen.en: Running a family enterprise takes patience and hard work.
listen.zh: 經營家族企業需要耐心與努力。

chinese.en: Many state-owned enterprises have been privatised to improve their efficiency and competitiveness.
chinese.zh: 許多國營企業已經民營化，以提升效率與競爭力。

english.en: Building the new library was a joint enterprise between the city and local companies.
english.zh: 興建新圖書館是市政府與在地企業共同合作的計畫。

speak.en: My uncle started his own enterprise selling tea online.
speak.zh: 我叔叔自己創業，在網路上賣茶。

write.en: Schools should encourage enterprise by letting students design and run their own small projects.
write.zh: 學校應讓學生設計並執行自己的小型計畫，以培養進取心。

example.en: Although most of the factory is automated, a few workers still do manual tasks such as packing fragile goods by hand.
example.zh: 雖然工廠大部分都已自動化，仍有少數工人負責手工作業，例如用手包裝易碎商品。

listen.en: The manual explains how to clean the coffee machine.
listen.zh: 說明書上有寫怎麼清潔咖啡機。

chinese.en: Many young people prefer office jobs to manual labour, even when the pay is lower.
chinese.zh: 許多年輕人寧願做辦公室工作，也不想從事體力勞動，即使薪水比較低也一樣。

english.en: My car has a manual gearbox, so it took me longer to learn.
english.zh: 我的車是手排的，所以我花了比較久才學會。

speak.en: Honestly, I never read the manual; I just figure things out myself.
speak.zh: 老實說，我從來不看說明書，都是自己摸索。

write.en: The staff training manual was updated to include the new safety procedures.
write.zh: 員工訓練手冊已經更新，加入了新的安全程序。

example.en: He grew up in a humble village home with no electricity, yet he later became a respected engineer.
example.zh: 他在一個沒有電的簡樸鄉村家庭長大，後來卻成為一位受人敬重的工程師。

listen.en: Winning the award was a humbling experience for me.
listen.zh: 得到這個獎讓我學會了謙卑。

chinese.en: The experienced team was humbled by a group of students in the final round.
chinese.zh: 那支經驗豐富的隊伍在最後一輪被一群學生挫了銳氣。

english.en: In my humble opinion, the city needs more bike lanes.
english.zh: 依我淺見，這座城市需要更多自行車道。

speak.en: My grandparents taught me to stay humble, no matter what happens.
speak.zh: 我的祖父母教我不管發生什麼事都要保持謙虛。

write.en: Good leaders are humble enough to admit their mistakes and learn from them.
write.zh: 好的領導者夠謙虛，願意承認錯誤並從中學習。

example.en: Thick clouds obscured the mountain peak, so the hikers could not see the view they had climbed for.
example.zh: 厚厚的雲層遮住了山頂，登山客看不到他們辛苦爬上來想看的風景。

listen.en: Tall buildings now obscure the view of the river.
listen.zh: 現在高樓擋住了河景。

chinese.en: She found an obscure reference to the village in a library book.
chinese.zh: 她在圖書館的一本書裡找到一段鮮為人知、提到那座村莊的記載。

english.en: The singer was an obscure artist before her song went viral.
english.zh: 這位歌手在她的歌爆紅之前，是個默默無聞的藝人。

speak.en: For some obscure reason, my phone keeps turning itself off.
speak.zh: 不知道什麼原因，我的手機一直自己關機。

write.en: Focusing only on average income can obscure the real gap between rich and poor.
write.zh: 只看平均所得，可能會掩蓋貧富之間真正的差距。

example.en: The museum augmented its small permanent collection with paintings borrowed from private owners for the summer.
example.zh: 這間博物館向私人收藏家借來畫作，在夏季擴充了原本規模不大的常設館藏。

listen.en: The school augmented the library with new science books.
listen.zh: 學校添購了新的科學書籍來充實圖書館。

chinese.en: The government plans to augment public transport services during the holiday season.
chinese.zh: 政府計畫在連假期間加開大眾運輸班次。

english.en: The company hired extra staff to augment its sales team.
english.zh: 公司多聘了一些員工來擴充業務團隊。

speak.en: Honestly, I'd love to augment my salary with some freelance work.
speak.zh: 老實說，我很想接些接案工作來增加收入。

write.en: Augmented reality allows shoppers to see how furniture would look in their homes.
write.zh: 擴增實境讓消費者能看到家具擺在自己家裡會是什麼樣子。

example.en: Instead of throwing away broken laptops, the company recycles their metal parts to make new devices.
example.zh: 這家公司不把壞掉的筆電丟掉，而是回收其中的金屬零件來製造新產品。

listen.en: Please recycle your empty cans in the blue bin.
listen.zh: 請把空罐丟進藍色回收桶。

chinese.en: This jacket is made entirely from recycled plastic collected from the ocean.
chinese.zh: 這件外套完全是用從海洋收集來的回收塑膠製成的。

english.en: Our school recycles used paper to save money and trees.
english.zh: 我們學校回收用過的紙，既省錢又能保護樹木。

speak.en: To be honest, I don't recycle as much as I should.
speak.zh: 說實話，我做資源回收沒有做得很徹底。

write.en: Some writers simply recycle old ideas instead of offering genuinely fresh arguments.
write.zh: 有些作者只是在炒冷飯，而不是提出真正新穎的論點。

example.en: The old video file was accidentally erased, so the team had to film the whole interview again.
example.zh: 那個舊影片檔不小心被刪掉了，所以團隊只好把整段訪談重拍一次。

listen.en: The teacher erased the board after the lesson ended.
listen.zh: 下課後老師把黑板擦乾淨。

chinese.en: Nothing can erase the memories of the summers I spent at my grandmother's house.
chinese.zh: 什麼都抹不去我在外婆家度過的那些夏天的回憶。

english.en: Please do not erase any important data from this computer.
english.zh: 請不要刪除這台電腦裡的任何重要資料。

speak.en: I wish I could erase that embarrassing moment from my memory.
speak.zh: 真希望我能把那個尷尬的時刻從記憶中抹去。

write.en: The new policy aims to erase the unfair difference in pay between men and women.
write.zh: 這項新政策旨在消除男女之間不公平的薪資差距。

example.en: The new café offers competitive prices, charging less than most nearby shops for the same quality of coffee.
example.zh: 這家新咖啡廳價格很有競爭力，同樣品質的咖啡比附近大多數店家都便宜。

listen.en: My brother is very competitive, even when we play cards.
listen.zh: 我哥哥很好勝，連我們玩撲克牌時也一樣。

chinese.en: Getting into a top medical school is highly competitive in many countries.
chinese.zh: 在許多國家，要考進頂尖醫學院競爭非常激烈。

english.en: The company offers a competitive salary and flexible working hours.
english.zh: 這家公司提供具競爭力的薪水和彈性的工作時間。

speak.en: I used to play competitive basketball when I was in high school.
speak.zh: 我高中時曾經打過籃球比賽。

write.en: Countries must invest in education to stay competitive in the global economy.
write.zh: 各國必須投資教育，才能在全球經濟中保持競爭力。

example.en: The electricity bill was already overdue, and the company warned that it would cut off the power soon.
example.zh: 電費帳單已經逾期未繳，電力公司警告很快就要斷電。

listen.en: The train is overdue, so we might miss the meeting.
listen.zh: 火車誤點了，我們可能會趕不上會議。

chinese.en: After years of complaints, changes to the city's bus system are long overdue.
chinese.zh: 民眾抱怨了好幾年，這座城市的公車系統早就該改革了。

english.en: I think I am overdue for a holiday after this busy year.
english.zh: 忙了一整年，我覺得我早該休個假了。

speak.en: Honestly, a proper conversation with my parents is long overdue.
speak.zh: 說真的，我早就該跟爸媽好好談一談了。

write.en: Our team finally received the overdue payment from the client last Friday.
write.zh: 我們團隊上週五終於收到客戶拖欠的款項。

example.en: The soup had a subtle taste of ginger; you could barely notice it, but it made the flavour richer.
example.zh: 這碗湯帶有淡淡的薑味，幾乎吃不出來，卻讓味道更有層次。

listen.en: She gave me a subtle hint about the surprise.
listen.zh: 她不著痕跡地給了我一點關於驚喜的暗示。

chinese.en: Advertisements often use subtle methods to influence what children want to buy.
chinese.zh: 廣告常用不易察覺的手法，影響孩子想買的東西。

english.en: The teacher noticed subtle changes in the quiet student's behaviour.
english.zh: 老師注意到那位安靜學生行為上的細微變化。

speak.en: I prefer subtle colours, like light grey or soft blue.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡淡雅的顏色，像是淺灰色或柔和的藍色。

write.en: Her humour is so subtle that some people miss the joke completely.
write.zh: 她的幽默非常含蓄，有些人完全沒聽出笑點。

example.en: After the accident she was not very mobile, so her family moved her bedroom to the ground floor.
example.zh: 那次意外之後她行動不太方便，所以家人把她的臥室搬到一樓。

listen.en: Please turn off your mobile during the exam.
listen.zh: 考試期間請把手機關機。

chinese.en: A mobile library visits the small villages in the mountains every month.
chinese.zh: 每個月都有一輛行動圖書車開到山區的小村莊。

english.en: Young workers today are more mobile and often change jobs.
english.zh: 現今的年輕上班族流動性較高，常常換工作。

speak.en: I check my mobile far too often, especially before bed.
speak.zh: 我太常看手機了，尤其是睡前。

write.en: Good public education helps people become socially mobile, whatever their family background.
write.zh: 良好的公共教育能幫助人們向上流動，不論他們的家庭背景如何。

example.en: Instead of eating a proper lunch, he just nibbled at a sandwich because he was too nervous about the interview.
example.zh: 他因為太擔心面試，沒好好吃午餐，只小口啃了幾下三明治。

listen.en: Small fish nibbled at my toes in the river.
listen.zh: 河裡的小魚輕輕啃著我的腳趾。

chinese.en: Rising living costs are slowly nibbling away at many families' savings each year.
chinese.zh: 不斷上漲的生活費每年都在一點一點吃掉許多家庭的積蓄。

english.en: I often nibble on nuts while I study in the evening.
english.zh: 我晚上讀書時常常會吃點堅果。

speak.en: Could I have a nibble of your cake? It looks amazing.
speak.zh: 可以讓我吃一小口你的蛋糕嗎？看起來好好吃。

write.en: The guests nibbled on cheese and crackers while waiting for dinner to be served.
write.zh: 客人們一邊吃著起司和餅乾，一邊等晚餐上桌。

example.en: The shop is holding a clearance sale, so all winter coats are half price before the new stock arrives.
example.zh: 這家店正在清倉拍賣，新貨到之前所有冬季大衣都打對折。

listen.en: The plane is waiting for clearance to take off.
listen.zh: 飛機正在等待起飛許可。

chinese.en: The truck could not pass under the bridge because the clearance was too low.
chinese.zh: 這輛卡車過不了那座橋，因為橋下的淨空高度太低。

english.en: The goods are still waiting for customs clearance at the port.
english.zh: 這批貨物還在港口等待清關。

speak.en: I bought these shoes on clearance, so they were really cheap.
speak.zh: 這雙鞋是清倉時買的，所以超便宜。

write.en: Large-scale forest clearance has destroyed the natural homes of many wild animals.
write.zh: 大規模的森林砍伐已經摧毀了許多野生動物的棲息地。

example.en: The company launched an aggressive marketing campaign, putting adverts on every bus and website to win new customers quickly.
example.zh: 這家公司推出強勢的行銷活動，在每輛公車和每個網站都打廣告，想快速吸引新客戶。

listen.en: Some drivers become aggressive when the traffic is bad.
listen.zh: 有些駕駛在塞車時會變得很暴躁。

chinese.en: The doctors chose a more aggressive treatment because the illness was spreading quickly.
chinese.zh: 因為病情惡化得很快，醫生選擇了更積極的治療方式。

english.en: Some parents worry that video games make children more aggressive.
english.zh: 有些家長擔心電玩會讓孩子更有攻擊性。

speak.en: My boss isn't aggressive, but she's very direct about deadlines.
speak.zh: 我的主管並不強勢，但她對截止期限講得很直接。

write.en: The city has set aggressive targets to cut carbon emissions over the next decade.
write.zh: 這座城市訂下了積極的目標，要在未來十年內減少碳排放。

example.en: Every morning at the school assembly, two students hoist the flag while everyone stands quietly and sings.
example.zh: 每天早上朝會時，都有兩位學生負責升旗，其他人則安靜站著唱歌。

listen.en: He hoisted his little sister onto his shoulders.
listen.zh: 他把妹妹舉起來扛在肩膀上。

chinese.en: A crane hoisted the new statue into place in the city square.
chinese.zh: 一台起重機把新雕像吊到市民廣場上的定位。

english.en: The sailors hoisted the sails as they slowly left the harbour.
english.zh: 水手們在緩緩駛離港口時升起了船帆。

speak.en: I had to hoist my suitcase onto the top shelf of the train.
speak.zh: 我得把行李箱舉到火車最上層的行李架上。

write.en: The hospital installed a hoist to help nurses lift patients safely out of bed.
write.zh: 醫院裝設了移位吊架，幫助護理師安全地把病人從床上抬起來。

example.en: Although the manager never showed overt anger, his short emails made it clear that he was unhappy.
example.zh: 雖然經理從未公開發火，但他簡短的電子郵件清楚表明他很不滿。

listen.en: The teacher made no overt criticism of my essay.
listen.zh: 老師並沒有明白批評我的作文。

chinese.en: Overt discrimination is less common today, but hidden bias still exists at work.
chinese.zh: 如今公開的歧視比較少見了，但職場上仍存在隱性偏見。

english.en: The film contains no overt violence, so children can watch it.
english.zh: 這部電影沒有明顯的暴力畫面，所以小孩可以看。

speak.en: He was quite overt about wanting the job, which I respected.
speak.zh: 他毫不掩飾自己想要那份工作，這點我很欣賞。

write.en: Some advertisements are overt, while others try to persuade us without our noticing.
write.zh: 有些廣告很直白，有些則試圖在我們不知不覺中說服我們。

example.en: The workers drilled deep into the rock to find water, as the village had suffered from a long drought.
example.zh: 因為村子經歷了長期乾旱，工人們往岩層深處鑽探，希望找到水源。

listen.en: My neighbour has been using an electric drill all day.
listen.zh: 我鄰居一整天都在用電鑽。

chinese.en: The coach drilled the players on passing until they could do it perfectly.
chinese.zh: 教練反覆訓練球員傳球，直到他們都能做到完美。

english.en: You need a drill to make holes in this wall.
english.zh: 你需要一支電鑽才能在這面牆上打洞。

speak.en: Grammar drills were boring, but they really helped my English.
speak.zh: 文法反覆練習很無聊，但真的對我的英文很有幫助。

write.en: Some environmental groups oppose plans to drill for oil near the coast.
write.zh: 一些環保團體反對在海岸附近鑽探石油的計畫。

example.en: The young researcher has been remarkably prolific, publishing more papers in a few years than most colleagues do in a decade.
example.zh: 這位年輕研究員產量驚人，短短幾年發表的論文比多數同事十年發表的還多。

listen.en: He is a prolific painter whose work hangs in galleries everywhere.
listen.zh: 他是一位多產的畫家，各地畫廊都掛著他的作品。

chinese.en: Wild rabbits are prolific breeders, so their numbers can grow very quickly.
chinese.zh: 野兔的繁殖力很強，所以數量可能增加得非常快。

english.en: The team's top player was a prolific scorer last season.
english.zh: 這支球隊的王牌球員上個球季得分非常多。

speak.en: My favourite podcast host is really prolific; she posts almost every day.
speak.zh: 我最喜歡的 Podcast 主持人很多產，她幾乎每天都更新。

write.en: Social media has made it easier for prolific creators to reach large audiences.
write.zh: 社群媒體讓多產的創作者更容易接觸到廣大觀眾。

example.en: During the interview, she asked several pertinent questions about the role, which showed she had researched the company carefully.
example.zh: 面試時，她針對這個職位問了幾個切中要點的問題，顯示她事先仔細研究過這家公司。

listen.en: His comment was pertinent to our discussion today.
listen.zh: 他的意見和我們今天的討論很有關係。

chinese.en: The report leaves out several facts that are pertinent to the public debate.
chinese.zh: 這份報告遺漏了幾項與公共辯論相關的事實。

english.en: Your essay should only use examples pertinent to the topic.
english.zh: 你的文章應該只使用與主題相關的例子。

speak.en: That's a pertinent point, and I hadn't thought about it before.
speak.zh: 這個論點很中肯，我之前從沒想過。

write.en: Doctors must share all pertinent medical details with patients before any surgery.
write.zh: 醫生在任何手術之前，都必須告知病人所有相關的醫療資訊。

example.en: Thanks to strict conservation efforts, the number of wild tigers in the park has slowly started to rise again.
example.zh: 多虧嚴格的保育工作，公園裡野生老虎的數量已經開始慢慢回升。

listen.en: Energy conservation at home can lower your electricity bill.
listen.zh: 在家節約能源可以降低電費。

chinese.en: The old temple was restored by a conservation team using traditional methods.
chinese.zh: 這座古廟由一支文物修復團隊用傳統工法修復完成。

english.en: Water conservation is especially important during a long dry season.
english.zh: 在漫長的乾季裡，節約用水特別重要。

speak.en: I'd love to volunteer at a wildlife conservation centre someday.
speak.zh: 我希望有一天能到野生動物保育中心當志工。

write.en: Governments should fund more marine conservation areas where fishing is completely banned.
write.zh: 政府應該資助設立更多完全禁止捕魚的海洋保護區。

example.en: Business at the ice cream shop was brisk all afternoon, with a long queue of customers waiting in the heat.
example.zh: 冰淇淋店整個下午生意興隆，大熱天裡排著長長的人龍。

listen.en: A brisk wind blew across the beach this morning.
listen.zh: 今天早上海灘上吹著涼爽的風。

chinese.en: The receptionist answered in a brisk, polite tone and quickly found my booking.
chinese.zh: 櫃檯人員用俐落又有禮的語氣回應，很快就找到了我的訂房紀錄。

english.en: Tickets for the summer concert sold at a brisk pace online.
english.zh: 夏季演唱會的門票在網路上賣得很快。

speak.en: I love a brisk autumn morning; it really wakes me up.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡涼爽的秋天早晨，讓人一下子就清醒了。

write.en: Experts recommend brisk exercise, such as fast walking, for at least half an hour a day.
write.zh: 專家建議每天至少做半小時像快走這樣的輕快運動。
