example.en: Although many doctors were cautious at first, the national medical association eventually endorsed the new vaccine schedule.
example.zh: 雖然許多醫生起初持保留態度，全國醫學會最後還是認可了新的疫苗接種時程。

listen.en: Our manager refused to endorse the idea without more evidence.
listen.zh: 在沒有更多證據之前，我們經理拒絕支持這個想法。

chinese.en: Several famous athletes have been paid large sums to endorse sports drinks.
chinese.zh: 好幾位知名運動員收了高額酬勞為運動飲料代言。

english.en: The teachers fully endorse the school's decision to ban phones.
english.zh: 老師們完全支持學校禁止手機的決定。

speak.en: I wouldn't endorse a product I'd never actually used myself.
speak.zh: 我不會為自己從沒真正用過的產品代言。

write.en: The report was endorsed by experts from three universities before it was published.
write.zh: 這份報告在發表前獲得三所大學的專家背書。

example.en: As soon as the gates opened, fans swarmed into the stadium, rushing to find the best seats near the stage.
example.zh: 大門一開，歌迷就蜂擁進入體育場，搶著找靠近舞台最好的位子。

listen.en: The old town is swarming with tourists every summer.
listen.zh: 每年夏天，老城區都擠滿了觀光客。

chinese.en: Reporters swarmed around the coach after the team's unexpected defeat in the final.
chinese.zh: 球隊在決賽中意外落敗後，記者們把教練團團圍住。

english.en: Swarms of locusts can destroy crops in just a few hours.
english.zh: 成群的蝗蟲能在短短幾小時內摧毀農作物。

speak.en: Every time a new phone comes out, customers swarm the stores.
speak.zh: 每次有新手機上市，顧客就湧進各家店面。

write.en: Small delivery robots may one day swarm the streets of busy cities.
write.zh: 小型送貨機器人有一天可能會成群出現在繁忙城市的街頭。

example.en: After the typhoon passed, the remnants of the storm still brought heavy rain to the eastern coast for two days.
example.zh: 颱風過後，殘餘的暴風系統仍為東部沿海帶來兩天的豪雨。

listen.en: She made a small bag from remnants of old fabric.
listen.zh: 她用舊布剩下的零頭做了一個小袋子。

chinese.en: This traditional festival is one of the few remnants of the village's farming past.
chinese.zh: 這個傳統節慶是村子農業時代少數留下來的痕跡之一。

english.en: The remnants of dinner were still on the table this morning.
english.zh: 今天早上，晚餐的剩菜還留在桌上。

speak.en: My grandparents' old house is the last remnant of my childhood.
speak.zh: 祖父母的老房子是我童年僅存的最後痕跡。

write.en: The company sold off the remnants of its failing electronics business last year.
write.zh: 這家公司去年把經營不善的電子事業剩餘部分賣掉了。

example.en: Ancient artists ground colorful minerals into fine powder and mixed the pigment with oil or egg to make paint.
example.zh: 古代藝術家把色彩鮮豔的礦物磨成細粉，再把色料和油或蛋混合調成顏料。

listen.en: People with less skin pigment burn more easily in the sun.
listen.zh: 皮膚色素較少的人在陽光下比較容易曬傷。

chinese.en: Carrots get their bright orange color from a natural pigment called beta-carotene.
chinese.zh: 胡蘿蔔鮮豔的橘色來自一種叫做β-胡蘿蔔素的天然色素。

english.en: This paint company only uses natural pigments made from plants.
english.zh: 這家油漆公司只使用以植物製成的天然顏料。

speak.en: I prefer lipsticks with strong pigment, so one coat is enough.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡顯色度高的口紅，這樣擦一層就夠了。

write.en: Researchers are developing pigments that reflect sunlight to keep buildings cooler in summer.
write.zh: 研究人員正在開發能反射陽光的顏料，讓建築物在夏天保持較涼爽。

example.en: The sudden silence in the courtroom only heightened the tension as everyone waited nervously for the judge's decision.
example.zh: 法庭裡突如其來的寂靜只讓氣氛更加緊繃，每個人都緊張地等待法官的判決。

listen.en: Security was heightened at the airport during the holiday.
listen.zh: 假期期間，機場加強了安全戒備。

chinese.en: Soft music and candlelight can heighten the romantic mood of a restaurant.
chinese.zh: 輕柔的音樂和燭光能增添餐廳的浪漫氣氛。

english.en: Lack of sleep can heighten the risk of car accidents.
english.zh: 睡眠不足可能會提高發生車禍的風險。

speak.en: Watching horror movies alone at night really heightens my fear.
speak.zh: 晚上一個人看恐怖片真的會讓我更害怕。

write.en: Living abroad for a year greatly heightened my interest in learning about other cultures.
write.zh: 在國外生活一年，大大提升了我認識其他文化的興趣。

example.en: Over millions of years, the river slowly carved a deep canyon through the soft rock of the plateau.
example.zh: 數百萬年來，這條河流慢慢在高原的軟岩中切割出一道深谷。

listen.en: My father always carves the turkey at family dinners.
listen.zh: 家庭聚餐時，總是由我爸爸來切火雞。

chinese.en: Someone had carved their initials into the old tree beside the lake.
chinese.zh: 有人在湖邊那棵老樹上刻了自己名字的縮寫。

english.en: She has carved out a successful career as a travel writer.
english.zh: 她已經闖出一番成功的旅遊作家事業。

speak.en: We usually carve pumpkins together with the kids every Halloween.
speak.zh: 每年萬聖節，我們通常會和孩子一起雕南瓜。

write.en: Small local brands are carving out a niche by selling eco-friendly products online.
write.zh: 本地小品牌透過在網路上販售環保商品，開拓出自己的利基市場。

example.en: The blaze started in a small kitchen on the ground floor but quickly spread to the rest of the building.
example.zh: 火勢從一樓的小廚房開始，但很快就延燒到整棟建築。

listen.en: A warm fire was blazing in the living room.
listen.zh: 客廳裡溫暖的爐火正燒得很旺。

chinese.en: In autumn, the hillsides become a blaze of red and gold leaves.
chinese.zh: 到了秋天，山坡上紅葉與金黃葉交織，一片燦爛奪目。

english.en: The sun was blazing, so we stayed inside all afternoon.
english.zh: 太陽非常毒辣，所以我們整個下午都待在室內。

speak.en: I've never seen a blaze that big; the whole sky turned orange.
speak.zh: 我從沒看過那麼大的火，整片天空都變成橘色。

write.en: The new phone was launched in a blaze of publicity last month.
write.zh: 這款新手機上個月在媒體大肆宣傳下推出。

example.en: The company was fined heavily after investigators discovered it had concealed safety problems from customers for years.
example.zh: 調查人員發現該公司多年來對顧客隱瞞安全問題，公司因此遭到重罰。

listen.en: The cat concealed itself under the bed during the storm.
listen.zh: 暴風雨期間，那隻貓躲在床底下。

chinese.en: The tiny security camera was concealed inside a clock on the bookshelf.
chinese.zh: 那台小型監視器被藏在書架上的一個時鐘裡。

english.en: You should never conceal important health information from your doctor.
english.zh: 你絕對不應該對醫生隱瞞重要的健康資訊。

speak.en: Honestly, I think it's better to tell the truth than to conceal mistakes.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得說實話比掩蓋錯誤好。

write.en: She wore a wide hat to conceal a terrible haircut from her classmates.
write.zh: 她戴了一頂寬邊帽，不讓同學看到她剪壞的髮型。

example.en: Because the concert was cancelled at the last minute, all ticket holders will be refunded within two weeks.
example.zh: 由於演唱會臨時取消，所有持票人將在兩週內獲得退款。

listen.en: The store gave me a full refund without any questions.
listen.zh: 店家二話不說就全額退款給我。

chinese.en: Students who withdraw before the semester begins can get most of their tuition refunded.
chinese.zh: 在學期開始前退學的學生，可以拿回大部分學費。

english.en: The airline refused to refund our tickets after the delay.
english.zh: 班機延誤後，航空公司拒絕退還我們的機票錢。

speak.en: Do you know if this hotel offers refunds for early check-out?
speak.zh: 你知道這家飯店提早退房的話可以退款嗎？

write.en: Many online shops now have a generous refund policy to attract new customers.
write.zh: 現在許多網路商店都提供寬鬆的退款政策來吸引新顧客。

example.en: The consumer price index rose sharply last year, showing that everyday goods had become much more expensive.
example.zh: 去年消費者物價指數大幅上升，顯示日常用品變得貴了許多。

listen.en: The library has indexed all of its old newspapers.
listen.zh: 圖書館已經把所有舊報紙都編好索引了。

chinese.en: The stock market index fell slightly after the news about rising interest rates.
chinese.zh: 升息消息傳出後，股市指數小幅下跌。

english.en: In some countries, pensions are indexed to the cost of living.
english.zh: 在某些國家，退休金會隨生活成本調整。

speak.en: Honestly, the happiness index of a city matters more to me than its size.
speak.zh: 老實說，對我來說一個城市的幸福指數比它的規模更重要。

write.en: Researchers use several social indices to compare quality of life across different countries.
write.zh: 研究人員使用多項社會指標來比較不同國家的生活品質。

example.en: Critics characterized the new policy as unfair, arguing that it would mainly benefit wealthy families rather than ordinary workers.
example.zh: 批評者將這項新政策形容為不公平，認為它主要嘉惠富裕家庭，而非一般勞工。

listen.en: Her early paintings are characterized by bright colors.
listen.zh: 她早期的畫作以明亮的色彩為特色。

chinese.en: Long working hours and high stress often characterize jobs in the tech industry.
chinese.zh: 科技業的工作常有工時長、壓力大的特點。

english.en: In your opinion, what characterizes a really good language teacher?
english.zh: 依你看，一位真正優秀的語言老師有什麼特點？

speak.en: I'd characterize my hometown as quiet but really friendly.
speak.zh: 我會說我的家鄉很安靜，但人非常友善。

write.en: Scientists still struggle to characterize the behavior of this newly discovered virus.
write.zh: 科學家仍難以描述這種新發現病毒的特性。

example.en: After the heavy rain, water poured down the stairs and flooded the basement, ruining boxes of old books.
example.zh: 大雨過後，雨水順著樓梯灌進來淹了地下室，好幾箱舊書都泡壞了。

listen.en: The gym is in the basement of our building.
listen.zh: 健身房在我們大樓的地下室。

chinese.en: Many students rent cheap basement apartments because they cannot afford anything else.
chinese.zh: 許多學生租便宜的地下室公寓，因為他們負擔不起其他房子。

english.en: The supermarket is on the basement level of the department store.
english.zh: 超市在百貨公司的地下樓層。

speak.en: As a kid, I was scared to go down to the basement alone.
speak.zh: 小時候我很怕一個人走下地下室。

write.en: The company started in a small basement office before moving to a modern building downtown.
write.zh: 這家公司最初在一間小小的地下室辦公室起家，後來才搬到市中心的現代化大樓。

example.en: Without stronger protection of their forest habitat, these rare monkeys could be extinct in the wild within a generation.
example.zh: 如果牠們的森林棲地沒有受到更嚴格的保護，這些稀有猴子可能在一個世代內就會在野外絕跡。

listen.en: Many plants could go extinct if the climate keeps warming.
listen.zh: 如果氣候持續暖化，許多植物可能會滅絕。

chinese.en: The town's tallest hill is actually an extinct volcano covered in tea plantations.
chinese.zh: 鎮上最高的山丘其實是一座覆滿茶園的死火山。

english.en: Some traditional crafts are almost extinct because young people don't learn them.
english.zh: 一些傳統工藝因為年輕人不學而幾乎失傳。

speak.en: I think video rental shops are basically extinct now, aren't they?
speak.zh: 我覺得錄影帶出租店現在基本上已經絕跡了，不是嗎？

write.en: Museums use fossils to show visitors what extinct animals may have looked like.
write.zh: 博物館利用化石讓參觀者了解已滅絕的動物可能長什麼樣子。

example.en: The survey results imply that most students prefer online classes, although the researchers warned that the sample was small.
example.zh: 調查結果意味著大多數學生偏好線上課程，不過研究人員提醒樣本數不多。

listen.en: His silence seemed to imply that he agreed with us.
listen.zh: 他的沉默似乎暗示他同意我們的看法。

chinese.en: As the name implies, a smartphone can do far more than make calls.
chinese.zh: 顧名思義，智慧型手機的功能遠不只打電話。

english.en: A higher salary often implies more responsibility and longer hours.
english.zh: 較高的薪水往往意味著更多責任和更長的工時。

speak.en: I didn't mean to imply that your idea was bad.
speak.zh: 我不是在暗示你的點子不好。

write.en: The author never says it directly, but the ending implies the two sisters reconcile.
write.zh: 作者從未直接說明，但結局暗示這對姊妹最後和好了。

example.en: After weeks of stressful exams, the weekend trip to the mountains was a real tonic for the whole class.
example.zh: 經過好幾週壓力沉重的考試，週末的山上之旅讓全班同學都重新振作起來。

listen.en: A good laugh with friends is the best tonic.
listen.zh: 和朋友開懷大笑是最好的提神良方。

chinese.en: The team's surprise victory was a tonic for fans after a disappointing season.
chinese.zh: 在令人失望的球季之後，球隊意外獲勝讓球迷振奮不已。

english.en: I ordered a glass of tonic water with ice and lemon.
english.zh: 我點了一杯加冰塊和檸檬的通寧水。

speak.en: My mom swears that ginger tonic helps her get over colds faster.
speak.zh: 我媽媽堅信薑汁補飲能讓她感冒好得比較快。

write.en: Many economists saw the new trade agreement as a much-needed tonic for local exporters.
write.zh: 許多經濟學家認為新的貿易協定為本地出口商打了一劑急需的強心針。

example.en: The manager's decision to cut everyone's bonus precipitated a wave of resignations, leaving the department badly understaffed.
example.zh: 經理決定刪減所有人的獎金，引發一波離職潮，導致部門嚴重人手不足。

listen.en: A careless comment precipitated a long argument between them.
listen.zh: 一句無心的話引發了他們之間漫長的爭執。

chinese.en: Heavy debts and falling sales eventually precipitated the collapse of the family-owned company.
chinese.zh: 龐大的債務加上銷售下滑，最終導致這家家族企業倒閉。

english.en: The knee injury precipitated her early retirement from professional tennis.
english.zh: 膝傷使她提早從職業網壇退休。

speak.en: I think moving abroad precipitated a lot of changes in my life.
speak.zh: 我覺得出國生活讓我的人生一下子發生了很多改變。

write.en: In the experiment, adding salt to the solution caused the protein to precipitate.
write.zh: 在實驗中，把鹽加入溶液會使蛋白質沉澱。

example.en: Once the government ended the airline's monopoly, several budget carriers entered the market and ticket prices dropped quickly.
example.zh: 政府一結束那家航空公司的壟斷，好幾家廉價航空就進入市場，機票價格也迅速下跌。

listen.en: Nobody has a monopoly on good ideas in this team.
listen.zh: 在這個團隊裡，好點子不是某個人的專利。

chinese.en: Critics argue that tech giants are slowly building monopolies in online advertising.
chinese.zh: 批評者認為科技巨頭正逐步壟斷網路廣告市場。

english.en: A monopoly usually leads to higher prices and poorer service for consumers.
english.zh: 壟斷通常會讓消費者面臨更高的價格和更差的服務。

speak.en: I don't think any single company should have a monopoly on public transport.
speak.zh: 我不認為任何一家公司應該壟斷大眾運輸。

write.en: The state once held a monopoly over the sale of salt in many countries.
write.zh: 過去在許多國家，鹽的販售都由國家專賣。

example.en: Because the landlord's contract with the tenant had expired, both sides had to negotiate a new rental agreement.
example.zh: 由於房東和房客的合約已經到期，雙方必須重新談一份租約。

listen.en: Please check that the milk hasn't expired before you drink it.
listen.zh: 喝牛奶之前，請先確認它有沒有過期。

chinese.en: The special offer expired at midnight, so many shoppers rushed to buy online.
chinese.zh: 這項優惠在午夜截止，所以許多購物者搶著上網下單。

english.en: Our gym membership will expire at the end of this year.
english.zh: 我們的健身房會員資格將在今年年底到期。

speak.en: Oh no, I think my student ID card has already expired.
speak.zh: 糟了，我想我的學生證已經過期了。

write.en: When the company's patent expired, cheaper versions of the medicine appeared on the market.
write.zh: 該公司的專利到期後，市場上就出現了較便宜的同款藥品。

example.en: Young children sometimes find it hard to separate fantasy from reality, especially after watching exciting cartoons.
example.zh: 年幼的孩子有時難以分辨幻想和現實，尤其是在看完刺激的卡通之後。

listen.en: Retiring early is a popular fantasy among office workers.
listen.zh: 提早退休是上班族常有的幻想。

chinese.en: His plan to become rich overnight is pure fantasy, not a realistic goal.
chinese.zh: 他想一夜致富的計畫根本是空想，不是實際的目標。

english.en: Flying cars were once a fantasy, but now they are being tested.
english.zh: 飛行汽車曾經只是幻想，但現在已經在測試了。

speak.en: My childhood fantasy was to travel around the world in a hot-air balloon.
speak.zh: 我小時候的幻想是搭熱氣球環遊世界。

write.en: The promise of free housing for everyone sounds more like fantasy than policy.
write.zh: 人人都有免費住宅的承諾，聽起來比較像空想而不是政策。

example.en: The instructions say the shelf must be screwed firmly to the wall so it won't fall when it's full of books.
example.zh: 說明書上寫著，層架必須用螺絲牢牢固定在牆上，放滿書時才不會掉下來。

listen.en: Remember to screw the lid on tightly after using it.
listen.zh: 用完之後記得把蓋子轉緊。

chinese.en: The engineer found that several screws in the bridge's frame had rusted badly.
chinese.zh: 工程師發現橋梁框架上有幾顆螺絲嚴重生鏽。

english.en: You need to screw the light bulb into the lamp carefully.
english.zh: 你需要小心地把燈泡旋進檯燈裡。

speak.en: I really screwed up my presentation because I forgot my notes.
speak.zh: 我忘了帶筆記，結果報告完全搞砸了。

write.en: Factories now use robots to insert thousands of tiny screws into smartphones every day.
write.zh: 現在工廠每天都用機器人把成千上萬顆小螺絲裝進智慧型手機裡。

example.en: After living in Canada for five years, she finally applied for permanent residence so she could stay.
example.zh: 在加拿大住了五年後，她終於申請了永久居留，好讓自己能留下來。

listen.en: Many new students choose to live in a campus residence.
listen.zh: 許多新生選擇住在校內宿舍。

chinese.en: The mayor's official residence is open to visitors on the first weekend of each month.
chinese.zh: 市長官邸在每個月的第一個週末開放民眾參觀。

english.en: He took up residence in a small town near the coast.
english.zh: 他搬到海邊附近的一個小鎮定居。

speak.en: Honestly, my student residence felt more like home than I expected.
speak.zh: 老實說，我的學生宿舍比我想像中更有家的感覺。

write.en: Proof of residence, such as a utility bill, is required to open a bank account.
write.zh: 開立銀行帳戶需要提供居住證明，例如水電費帳單。

example.en: The report highlights the uneven distribution of wealth, with most resources concentrated in a few large cities.
example.zh: 這份報告凸顯財富分配不均的問題，大部分資源都集中在少數幾個大城市。

listen.en: The old wooden floor in the hallway is uneven.
listen.zh: 走廊上的舊木頭地板高低不平。

chinese.en: The quality of the restaurant's food has been uneven since the new chef arrived.
chinese.zh: 自從新主廚來了之後，這家餐廳的餐點品質就時好時壞。

english.en: Economic growth has been uneven across different regions of the country.
english.zh: 這個國家各地區的經濟成長並不均衡。

speak.en: My progress in English has been a bit uneven, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我的英文進步得有點不穩定。

write.en: The students' uneven performance suggests that some of them need extra support in maths.
write.zh: 學生們表現參差不齊，顯示其中有些人在數學上需要額外協助。

example.en: Doctors were baffled by her symptoms, which did not match any illness they had seen before.
example.zh: 醫生們對她的症狀感到困惑，因為那和他們以前見過的任何疾病都不相符。

listen.en: The last question on the exam baffled most of us.
listen.zh: 考卷上的最後一題難倒了我們大多數人。

chinese.en: What baffles me is why the company ignored such a simple solution for so long.
chinese.zh: 讓我想不通的是，這家公司為什麼那麼久都忽略這麼簡單的解決辦法。

english.en: I was completely baffled by the instructions for the new printer.
english.zh: 新印表機的使用說明讓我完全摸不著頭緒。

speak.en: Honestly, modern art sometimes baffles me, but I still enjoy it.
speak.zh: 老實說，現代藝術有時讓我看不懂，但我還是很喜歡。

write.en: The baffling results forced the researchers to repeat the experiment from the beginning.
write.zh: 令人費解的結果迫使研究人員從頭再做一次實驗。

example.en: The cruise ship could not enter the harbour because every berth was already occupied by cargo vessels.
example.zh: 郵輪無法進港，因為每個泊位都已經被貨船占滿了。

listen.en: Passengers can rest in a cabin berth during the voyage.
listen.zh: 航行期間，乘客可以在艙房的臥鋪休息。

chinese.en: The team secured a berth in the final after a tense match on Saturday.
chinese.zh: 這支隊伍在週六一場緊張的比賽後拿下了決賽的門票。

english.en: The berths on this ferry are narrow but surprisingly comfortable.
english.zh: 這艘渡輪上的臥鋪很窄，但出乎意料地舒服。

speak.en: I usually give that noisy café a wide berth during exam week.
speak.zh: 考試週的時候，我通常會避開那家很吵的咖啡廳。

write.en: Port authorities plan to build two new berths to handle the growing number of container ships.
write.zh: 港務單位計畫興建兩個新泊位，以應付日益增加的貨櫃船。

example.en: The speaker opened her talk with a funny anecdote about getting lost in Tokyo, which relaxed the audience.
example.zh: 講者以一段在東京迷路的趣事開場，讓聽眾放鬆了下來。

listen.en: She shared a short anecdote about her old boss.
listen.zh: 她分享了一則關於她以前老闆的小故事。

chinese.en: Personal anecdotes can make an essay more vivid, but they are not strong evidence.
chinese.zh: 個人小故事能讓文章更生動，但並不是有力的證據。

english.en: The teacher told us an amusing anecdote about her university days.
english.zh: 老師跟我們說了一則她大學時期的趣事。

speak.en: There's a funny anecdote I always tell about my first trip abroad.
speak.zh: 我有個關於第一次出國旅行的趣事，總是會拿出來講。

write.en: The manager's anecdote about a difficult customer helped new staff understand the importance of patience.
write.zh: 經理分享一位難搞客人的故事，讓新進員工明白耐心的重要。

example.en: Climbers must prepare carefully for the extreme cold near the summit, where temperatures can drop suddenly.
example.zh: 登山者必須為山頂附近的酷寒做好萬全準備，因為那裡的氣溫可能驟降。

listen.en: Some people go to extremes to avoid sugar.
listen.zh: 有些人為了避開糖分而走極端。

chinese.en: Millions of families around the world still live in extreme poverty without clean water.
chinese.zh: 全世界仍有數百萬個家庭生活在赤貧之中，連乾淨的水都沒有。

english.en: My mood swings from one extreme to the other during exams.
english.zh: 考試期間，我的情緒會從一個極端擺盪到另一個極端。

speak.en: I think banning phones completely is a bit extreme, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得完全禁止手機有點太極端了。

write.en: The city's summers and winters are both extreme, so tourists usually visit in spring.
write.zh: 這座城市的夏天和冬天都很極端，所以遊客通常在春天造訪。

example.en: Because the museum attracts many foreign tourists, all of its signs are bilingual, written in both Chinese and English.
example.zh: 因為這間博物館吸引許多外國遊客，所以館內所有標示都是中英雙語。

listen.en: Many parents hope their children will become bilingual.
listen.zh: 許多家長希望孩子能成為雙語人才。

chinese.en: The government plans to expand bilingual education in primary schools over the next decade.
chinese.zh: 政府計畫在未來十年擴大國小的雙語教育。

english.en: A bilingual dictionary is useful for beginners learning a new language.
english.zh: 雙語字典對學習新語言的初學者很有幫助。

speak.en: Being bilingual has definitely helped me in job interviews.
speak.zh: 會說兩種語言在求職面試時確實幫了我很多。

write.en: Our company is looking for bilingual staff who can deal with overseas clients by phone.
write.zh: 我們公司正在徵求能用電話與海外客戶溝通的雙語人員。

example.en: Rental prices near the university have risen sharply, so many students now share flats to reduce costs.
example.zh: 大學附近的租金大幅上漲，所以現在很多學生合租公寓來節省開銷。

listen.en: Please read the rental agreement before you sign it.
listen.zh: 簽名前請先詳閱租約。

chinese.en: My aunt earns extra income from a small rental property in the city centre.
chinese.zh: 我阿姨靠市中心一間小小的出租房產賺取額外收入。

english.en: The bike rental shop near the station opens early on weekends.
english.zh: 車站附近的租車行週末很早就開門。

speak.en: I'd rather pay a monthly rental than buy a car.
speak.zh: 我寧願每個月付租金，也不想買車。

write.en: Equipment rentals are cheaper for small companies that only need machines for short projects.
write.zh: 對只在短期專案需要機器的小公司來說，租用設備比較省錢。

example.en: After the bridge was found to have serious cracks, the city suspended traffic until repairs were completed.
example.zh: 這座橋被發現有嚴重裂縫後，市政府暫停通行，直到修復完成為止。

listen.en: The student was suspended from school for cheating.
listen.zh: 那名學生因作弊而被停學。

chinese.en: A large glass lamp was suspended from the ceiling above the dining table.
chinese.zh: 餐桌上方的天花板吊著一盞大型玻璃燈。

english.en: The company has suspended production at its factory for two weeks.
english.zh: 這家公司的工廠已經停工兩週了。

speak.en: I think we should suspend judgment until we hear both sides.
speak.zh: 我覺得在聽完雙方說法之前，我們應該先別下定論。

write.en: The online store temporarily suspended orders while it fixed a problem with its payment system.
write.zh: 那家網路商店在修復付款系統問題期間暫停接單。

example.en: The debate over nature versus nurture asks whether our personality comes from our genes or from our upbringing.
example.zh: 先天與後天之爭探討的是，我們的個性究竟來自基因還是成長環境。

listen.en: Parents should nurture their children's interests from an early age.
listen.zh: 父母應該從小培養孩子的興趣。

chinese.en: The company runs a training program to nurture young talent in software design.
chinese.zh: 這家公司開辦訓練課程，培育軟體設計方面的年輕人才。

english.en: It takes time and effort to nurture a long friendship.
english.zh: 經營一段長久的友誼需要時間和心力。

speak.en: My grandmother nurtured my love of cooking when I was little.
speak.zh: 我小時候，是奶奶培養了我對烹飪的熱愛。

write.en: Small community gardens can nurture a sense of belonging among neighbours in big cities.
write.zh: 小型社區菜園能在大城市的鄰居之間培養出歸屬感。

example.en: When asked about the mistake, the manager readily admitted that she had overlooked the deadline.
example.zh: 被問到這個錯誤時，經理爽快地承認是她忽略了截止日期。

listen.en: He readily agreed to help us move the furniture.
listen.zh: 他爽快地答應幫我們搬家具。

chinese.en: Thanks to the internet, information that was once hard to find is now readily accessible.
chinese.zh: 多虧了網路，過去很難找到的資訊現在都能輕鬆取得。

english.en: Young children usually pick up new languages more readily than adults.
english.zh: 小孩子通常比大人更容易學會新語言。

speak.en: I don't readily trust online reviews, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不太會輕易相信網路評論。

write.en: The new software was readily adopted by staff because it saved them so much time.
write.zh: 新軟體很快就被員工採用，因為它幫大家省下很多時間。

example.en: Winning the regional competition gave the shy student a huge boost, and she began speaking up in class.
example.zh: 贏得地區比賽讓那位害羞的學生信心大增，她開始在課堂上勇於發言。

listen.en: A good night's sleep can boost your energy.
listen.zh: 一夜好眠能讓你精神大振。

chinese.en: The government hopes lower taxes will boost the economy and create more jobs.
chinese.zh: 政府希望降稅能提振經濟並創造更多就業機會。

english.en: Regular exercise can boost your confidence and improve your mood.
english.zh: 規律運動能提升你的自信並改善心情。

speak.en: A cup of coffee gives me a real boost in the morning.
speak.zh: 早上喝杯咖啡真的能讓我精神一振。

write.en: The online advertising campaign boosted sales by twenty percent in just three months.
write.zh: 這波網路廣告活動在短短三個月內讓銷售額提升了兩成。

example.en: Customers who complete the online survey will receive a discount voucher that can be used on their next purchase.
example.zh: 填完線上問卷的顧客會收到一張折價券，下次購物時可以使用。

listen.en: You can redeem this voucher at any of our stores.
listen.zh: 這張抵用券可以在我們任何一家門市兌換。

chinese.en: The government handed out shopping vouchers to encourage people to spend more locally.
chinese.zh: 政府發放消費券，鼓勵民眾多在本地消費。

english.en: The airline offered us a travel voucher after cancelling our flight.
english.zh: 航空公司取消我們的航班後，提供了一張旅遊抵用券。

speak.en: I always forget to use my vouchers before they expire.
speak.zh: 我總是忘記在抵用券過期前用掉。

write.en: Staff must attach a payment voucher to every expense claim they submit to accounting.
write.zh: 員工每次向會計部門申請報帳時，都必須附上付款憑證。

example.en: The leaflet was highly informative, explaining clearly how residents should sort their rubbish for recycling.
example.zh: 這份傳單內容非常實用，清楚說明了居民該如何做垃圾分類回收。

listen.en: Her talk on healthy eating was very informative.
listen.zh: 她關於健康飲食的演講很有收穫。

chinese.en: A good documentary should be informative and entertaining at the same time.
chinese.zh: 一部好的紀錄片應該兼具知識性與娛樂性。

english.en: This website is informative for students who want to study abroad.
english.zh: 這個網站對想出國留學的學生來說資訊很豐富。

speak.en: I find podcasts more informative than most TV programmes.
speak.zh: 我覺得 Podcast 比大多數電視節目更有料。

write.en: The company's annual report was informative, but its charts were difficult to read.
write.zh: 這家公司的年報資訊豐富，但圖表很難看懂。

example.en: Her thirst for knowledge led her to read everything in the library, from history books to science magazines.
example.zh: 她的求知慾讓她讀遍圖書館裡的所有書刊，從歷史書到科學雜誌都不放過。

listen.en: Salty snacks always leave me with a terrible thirst.
listen.zh: 吃了鹹的零食總是讓我口渴得要命。

chinese.en: Young travellers often have a thirst for adventure that cannot be satisfied at home.
chinese.zh: 年輕旅人往往渴望冒險，而這種渴望待在家裡是無法滿足的。

english.en: The runners stopped at the river to quench their thirst.
english.zh: 跑者們在河邊停下來解渴。

speak.en: I think my thirst for travel started when I was a teenager.
speak.zh: 我想我對旅行的渴望是從青少年時期開始的。

write.en: The public's thirst for celebrity news keeps many entertainment websites in business.
write.zh: 大眾對名人新聞的渴求，讓許多娛樂網站得以持續經營。

example.en: Instead of writing long paragraphs, the engineer drew a simple diagram to explain how the machine's parts fit together.
example.zh: 工程師沒有寫長篇大論，而是畫了一張簡單的示意圖，說明機器各零件如何組合。

listen.en: Please label each part of the diagram clearly.
listen.zh: 請清楚標示圖上的每個部分。

chinese.en: The textbook includes a detailed diagram of the human heart and its main blood vessels.
chinese.zh: 課本裡有一張人類心臟和主要血管的詳細圖解。

english.en: Our teacher drew a diagram on the board to show how plants make food.
english.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一張圖，說明植物如何製造養分。

speak.en: I find diagrams much easier to understand than long explanations.
speak.zh: 我覺得圖解比冗長的說明容易理解多了。

write.en: The flow diagram on the wall reminds new staff of each step in the ordering process.
write.zh: 牆上的流程圖提醒新進員工訂貨流程的每個步驟。

example.en: Critics have given their verdict on the new film, and most of them praised its stunning photography.
example.zh: 影評人已經對這部新片做出評價，大多數人都讚賞它令人驚豔的攝影。

listen.en: So what's your verdict on the new café?
listen.zh: 所以你覺得那家新咖啡廳怎麼樣？

chinese.en: The judge delivered the verdict calmly while the courtroom remained completely silent.
chinese.zh: 法官冷靜地宣讀判決，整個法庭鴉雀無聲。

english.en: The final verdict on the project will come from the manager.
english.zh: 這項專案的最終評定將由經理決定。

speak.en: My verdict? The book was much better than the movie.
speak.zh: 我的看法？書比電影好看多了。

write.en: The public's verdict on the new transport policy was clear in the latest survey.
write.zh: 最新的調查清楚顯示了民眾對新交通政策的評價。

example.en: At first the painting looked genuine, but on closer inspection, experts noticed that the colours were far too bright.
example.zh: 這幅畫乍看之下像真跡，但專家仔細一看，發現顏色實在太鮮豔了。

listen.en: The factory passed its health inspection last week.
listen.zh: 這間工廠上週通過了衛生檢查。

chinese.en: Restaurants that fail a hygiene inspection may be forced to close temporarily.
chinese.zh: 衛生稽查不合格的餐廳可能會被勒令暫時停業。

english.en: My car needs a routine inspection before the long trip.
english.zh: 長途旅行前，我的車需要做一次例行檢查。

speak.en: Our landlord does a quick inspection every time someone moves out.
speak.zh: 每次有房客搬走，我們房東都會快速檢查一下房子。

write.en: Customs officers opened several suitcases for inspection at the airport this morning.
write.zh: 今天早上海關人員在機場打開了幾個行李箱進行檢查。

example.en: The resort offers wooden bungalows right on the beach, each with its own small garden and sea view.
example.zh: 這間度假村提供緊鄰海灘的木造小屋，每間都有自己的小花園和海景。

listen.en: They rented a quiet bungalow near the lake.
listen.zh: 他們在湖邊租了一間安靜的平房。

chinese.en: Bungalows are popular with older buyers, but they take up a lot of land.
chinese.zh: 平房很受年長買家歡迎，但很占土地。

english.en: The bungalow at the end of our street is now for sale.
english.zh: 我們這條街盡頭的那間平房現在要出售。

speak.en: I'd love to live in a little bungalow by the sea someday.
speak.zh: 希望有一天能住在海邊的一間小平房。

write.en: The company converted an old bungalow into a cosy office for its small design team.
write.zh: 這家公司把一間老平房改建成舒適的辦公室，給小小的設計團隊使用。

example.en: Bubble tea has become a staple of Taiwanese street culture, sold on almost every corner in every city.
example.zh: 珍珠奶茶已成為臺灣街頭文化不可或缺的一部分，每座城市幾乎每個街角都買得到。

listen.en: Please staple these pages together before the meeting.
listen.zh: 開會前請把這幾頁釘在一起。

chinese.en: Potatoes became a staple crop in Europe because they grow well in poor soil.
chinese.zh: 馬鈴薯成為歐洲的主要作物，因為它在貧瘠的土壤中也長得很好。

english.en: The office has run out of staples, so I'll buy some more.
english.zh: 辦公室的釘書針用完了，我再去買一些。

speak.en: Honestly, instant noodles were a staple of my diet at university.
speak.zh: 老實說，泡麵是我大學時期的主食。

write.en: Online lessons have become a staple of modern education since the pandemic.
write.zh: 自從疫情以來，線上課程已成為現代教育的基本配備。

example.en: After the app went viral, its number of users exploded, growing far faster than the small team could handle.
example.zh: 這個應用程式爆紅後，使用者人數暴增，成長速度遠遠超出小團隊能應付的程度。

listen.en: The fireworks exploded above the river at midnight.
listen.zh: 煙火在午夜時分於河面上空炸開。

chinese.en: When he heard the unfair decision, my father exploded with anger at the dinner table.
chinese.zh: 聽到那個不公平的決定時，我爸爸在餐桌上勃然大怒。

english.en: The population of the city has exploded over the past decade.
english.zh: 這座城市的人口在過去十年間暴增。

speak.en: Honestly, my phone almost exploded with messages after I posted that photo.
speak.zh: 說真的，我貼出那張照片後，手機訊息多到快爆了。

write.en: Scientists warned that the old volcano could explode again within the next few years.
write.zh: 科學家警告，這座古老的火山未來幾年內可能再次爆發。

example.en: Kangaroos are native to Australia, which means they existed there naturally long before humans brought other animals.
example.zh: 袋鼠原產於澳洲，也就是說，早在人類引進其他動物之前，牠們就自然生活在那裡。

listen.en: She speaks Japanese almost like a native speaker.
listen.zh: 她說日文幾乎跟母語人士一樣。

chinese.en: Many international students return to their native countries after finishing their degrees abroad.
chinese.zh: 許多國際學生在國外完成學位後，會回到自己的祖國。

english.en: My grandfather is a native of this small fishing village.
english.zh: 我爺爺是這個小漁村土生土長的人。

speak.en: I think chatting with native speakers is the fastest way to improve.
speak.zh: 我覺得跟母語人士聊天是進步最快的方法。

write.en: Invasive fish species are pushing many native species out of the island's rivers.
write.zh: 外來入侵魚種正把許多原生物種逐出島上的河流。

example.en: Modern London is a cultural mosaic, where people from dozens of countries live side by side and share their traditions.
example.zh: 現代倫敦是一幅多元文化拼圖，來自數十個國家的人比鄰而居，分享彼此的傳統。

listen.en: The children made a colourful mosaic from broken plates.
listen.zh: 孩子們用破碎的盤子做了一幅色彩繽紛的馬賽克。

chinese.en: The archaeologists carefully cleaned the ancient Roman mosaic before putting it on display.
chinese.zh: 考古學家在展出這幅古羅馬鑲嵌畫之前，先仔細清理了它。

english.en: We made a mosaic out of old pieces of glass.
english.zh: 我們用舊玻璃碎片做了一幅馬賽克。

speak.en: I love how the station walls are covered in bright mosaics.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡車站牆面貼滿鮮豔馬賽克的樣子。

write.en: The final report presents a mosaic of opinions from students, teachers and parents.
write.zh: 這份最終報告呈現了學生、老師和家長的各種不同意見。

example.en: The company enjoyed spectacular growth last year, with profits rising far beyond what any analyst had predicted.
example.zh: 這家公司去年成長驚人，獲利遠遠超出所有分析師的預測。

listen.en: The sunset over the ocean was truly spectacular.
listen.zh: 海上的夕陽真的非常壯觀。

chinese.en: The team made a spectacular comeback in the second half and won the final.
chinese.zh: 這支球隊在下半場上演精彩的大逆轉，贏得了冠軍賽。

english.en: The new bridge looks spectacular when it is lit up at night.
english.zh: 這座新橋晚上點燈時看起來非常壯觀。

speak.en: You really should visit Taroko Gorge; the scenery there is spectacular.
speak.zh: 你真的該去太魯閣看看，那裡的風景超壯觀。

write.en: Despite spectacular advances in medicine, many diseases still have no effective treatment.
write.zh: 儘管醫學有驚人的進展，許多疾病仍然沒有有效的治療方法。

example.en: Her decision to share her research data freely exemplifies the open, cooperative spirit that modern science depends on.
example.zh: 她決定免費公開研究資料，正體現了現代科學所仰賴的開放合作精神。

listen.en: His quiet patience exemplifies what a good teacher should be.
listen.zh: 他沉穩的耐心正是好老師該有的樣子。

chinese.en: The writer uses several short stories to exemplify the challenges faced by young workers.
chinese.zh: 作者用幾個短篇故事來說明年輕上班族所面臨的挑戰。

english.en: This project clearly exemplifies how teamwork can solve difficult problems.
english.zh: 這個計畫清楚說明了團隊合作如何解決困難的問題。

speak.en: I think my grandmother exemplifies hard work; she never stops.
speak.zh: 我覺得我奶奶就是勤勞的典範，她從來不停下來。

write.en: The rapid growth of online shopping is exemplified by the success of small delivery companies.
write.zh: 小型物流公司的成功，正是網購快速成長的最佳例證。

example.en: After falling off his bike, Tom couldn't bend his arm because his elbow was badly swollen.
example.zh: 湯姆從腳踏車上摔下來後，手肘腫得很厲害，連手臂都彎不了。

listen.en: She hurt her elbow while playing tennis yesterday.
listen.zh: 她昨天打網球時傷到了手肘。

chinese.en: He elbowed his way through the crowded market to reach the fruit stall.
chinese.zh: 他用手肘在擁擠的市場裡擠出一條路，走到水果攤前。

english.en: I leaned my elbow on the desk and looked out of the window.
english.zh: 我把手肘靠在書桌上，望向窗外。

speak.en: My elbow still aches a bit after all that typing.
speak.zh: 打了那麼多字之後，我的手肘還是有點痠痛。

write.en: Some experienced staff felt they had been elbowed aside when the new manager arrived.
write.zh: 新經理上任後，一些資深員工覺得自己被排擠到一旁。

example.en: Even after losing the final, he shook hands with every opponent, proving he was a true sportsman.
example.zh: 即使輸了決賽，他仍和每位對手握手，證明他是真正有運動家精神的人。

listen.en: My uncle was a famous sportsman when he was young.
listen.zh: 我叔叔年輕時是位有名的運動員。

chinese.en: The award is given each year to the sportsman who shows the greatest fair play.
chinese.zh: 這個獎項每年頒給最能展現公平競賽精神的運動員。

english.en: Many young sportsmen dream of playing for their national team.
english.zh: 許多年輕運動員夢想能代表國家隊出賽。

speak.en: I'm not much of a sportsman, but I do enjoy hiking.
speak.zh: 我不太算是愛運動的人，但我還滿喜歡爬山的。

write.en: Many professional sportsmen struggle to find new careers after they retire from competition.
write.zh: 許多職業運動員退休後，很難找到新的職涯方向。

example.en: When the bell rang, the students flung open the classroom door and rushed outside into the sunshine.
example.zh: 鐘聲一響，學生們猛然推開教室的門，衝到外面的陽光下。

listen.en: He flung his coat over the back of the chair.
listen.zh: 他把外套隨手甩到椅背上。

chinese.en: Before starting her new job, she had one last fling and travelled around Europe.
chinese.zh: 開始新工作之前，她最後一次盡情放縱，到歐洲各地旅行。

english.en: Don't fling your clothes on the floor; put them away.
english.zh: 不要把衣服亂丟在地上，把它們收好。

speak.en: When I got home, I just flung myself onto the bed.
speak.zh: 我一回到家就直接撲倒在床上。

write.en: The government flung itself into the new project without considering the long-term costs.
write.zh: 政府一頭栽進這項新計畫，卻沒有考慮長期的成本。

example.en: Because of high tariffs on foreign steel, local builders had to pay much more for their materials.
example.zh: 由於外國鋼鐵的關稅很高，本地建商得花更多錢購買建材。

listen.en: Higher tariffs usually make imported goods more expensive.
listen.zh: 關稅提高通常會讓進口商品變貴。

chinese.en: The two countries agreed to remove tariffs on farm products to boost trade.
chinese.zh: 兩國同意取消農產品關稅，以促進雙邊貿易。

english.en: Many farmers worry that new tariffs will hurt their exports.
english.zh: 許多農民擔心新的關稅會打擊他們的出口。

speak.en: I think tariffs often end up making things pricier for ordinary shoppers.
speak.zh: 我覺得關稅最後往往讓一般消費者買東西變得更貴。

write.en: The hotel's room tariff includes breakfast, but guests pay separately for parking.
write.zh: 這家飯店的房價含早餐，但停車費要另外付。

example.en: My thesis supervisor read every chapter carefully and suggested ways to make my arguments clearer.
example.zh: 我的論文指導教授仔細讀了每一章，並建議我如何讓論點更清楚。

listen.en: The supervisor checked our work before we left.
listen.zh: 我們離開前，主管檢查了我們的工作。

chinese.en: A good supervisor gives clear feedback and helps new staff learn from their mistakes.
chinese.zh: 好的主管會給予明確的回饋，幫助新進員工從錯誤中學習。

english.en: My supervisor asked me to finish the report by Friday.
english.zh: 我的主管要我在星期五前完成報告。

speak.en: My supervisor is really supportive, so I enjoy going to work.
speak.zh: 我的主管很挺我，所以我很喜歡去上班。

write.en: Factory supervisors are responsible for making sure workers follow safety rules at all times.
write.zh: 工廠主管負責確保工人隨時遵守安全規定。

example.en: When the river slows near the coast, it drops its sand and mud, and this sediment slowly forms new land.
example.zh: 河流在靠近海岸處流速變慢，便放下所攜帶的沙土，這些沉積物慢慢形成新的陸地。

listen.en: Let the coffee settle so the sediment sinks to the bottom.
listen.zh: 讓咖啡靜置一下，沉澱物就會沉到底部。

chinese.en: Scientists study layers of sediment to learn how the climate has changed over time.
chinese.zh: 科學家研究一層層的沉積物，以了解氣候隨時間的變化。

english.en: Heavy rain washed a lot of sediment into the reservoir.
english.zh: 大雨把大量泥沙沖進了水庫。

speak.en: There was some brown sediment at the bottom of my water bottle.
speak.zh: 我的水壺底部有一些褐色的沉澱物。

write.en: Building the dam reduced the amount of sediment reaching farms further down the river.
write.zh: 興建水壩減少了流到下游農田的沉積物。

example.en: Researchers have proposed several plausible reasons for the decline in bee populations, but none has been fully proven yet.
example.zh: 研究人員提出了幾個蜜蜂數量減少的合理原因，但目前都還沒有被完全證實。

listen.en: That sounds like a plausible answer to me.
listen.zh: 我覺得那聽起來是個合理的答案。

chinese.en: It is plausible that remote work will become the norm in many industries.
chinese.zh: 遠距工作很可能會成為許多產業的常態。

english.en: The detective needed a plausible theory to explain the missing money.
english.zh: 偵探需要一個合理的推論來解釋失蹤的錢。

speak.en: I guess it's plausible, but I'm not totally convinced.
speak.zh: 我想那是有可能的，但我沒有完全被說服。

write.en: The writer created a plausible story by including realistic details about everyday life.
write.zh: 作者加入日常生活的真實細節，寫出了一個可信的故事。

example.en: The charity held an online auction, inviting people to bid on signed books, and raised money for local schools.
example.zh: 這個慈善團體舉辦線上拍賣，邀請大家競標簽名書，為當地學校募款。

listen.en: They bought their old piano at an auction.
listen.zh: 他們在一場拍賣會上買到那架舊鋼琴。

chinese.en: The family decided to auction their grandfather's watch collection to pay off debts.
chinese.zh: 這家人決定拍賣爺爺收藏的手錶來還債。

english.en: The city plans to auction several old buses next month.
english.zh: 市政府計畫下個月拍賣幾輛舊公車。

speak.en: I once bought a vintage camera at an online auction.
speak.zh: 我曾經在網路拍賣上買到一台復古相機。

write.en: Some governments auction licences to mobile phone companies to raise public funds.
write.zh: 有些政府會把執照拍賣給電信公司，以籌措公共資金。

example.en: Because infants cannot tell us when they feel ill, parents must watch for changes in feeding and sleeping.
example.zh: 因為嬰兒沒辦法告訴我們自己不舒服，父母必須留意他們進食和睡眠的變化。

listen.en: The infant fell asleep in her mother's arms.
listen.zh: 那個小嬰兒在媽媽懷裡睡著了。

chinese.en: Infant mortality has fallen sharply in many countries thanks to better healthcare.
chinese.zh: 由於醫療照護改善，許多國家的嬰兒死亡率已大幅下降。

english.en: This seat is designed to keep infants safe in the car.
english.zh: 這個座椅是為了讓嬰兒乘車時保持安全而設計的。

speak.en: When my sister was an infant, she cried almost every night.
speak.zh: 我妹妹還是嬰兒的時候，幾乎每晚都在哭。

write.en: Ten years ago, the electric car industry was still an infant industry in Asia.
write.zh: 十年前，電動車產業在亞洲還是個新興產業。

example.en: After an outbreak of food poisoning at the school, inspectors found that the kitchen fridge had been broken for days.
example.zh: 學校爆發食物中毒後，稽查人員發現廚房的冰箱已經壞了好幾天。

listen.en: The outbreak forced many schools to close early.
listen.zh: 疫情爆發迫使許多學校提早停課。

chinese.en: Washing your hands regularly is one of the best ways to prevent an outbreak.
chinese.zh: 經常洗手是預防疫情爆發最好的方法之一。

english.en: The farm was closed after an outbreak of disease among its pigs.
english.zh: 這座農場的豬隻爆發疾病後就被關閉了。

speak.en: During the outbreak, I mostly worked from home and cooked a lot.
speak.zh: 疫情爆發期間，我大多在家工作，也常常自己下廚。

write.en: The sudden outbreak of fires across the region was linked to the long dry season.
write.zh: 這個地區突然爆發多起火災，與漫長的乾季有關。

example.en: As a teenager, she composed her own songs on the piano, and several later became popular online.
example.zh: 她十幾歲時就用鋼琴自己作曲，其中幾首後來在網路上走紅。

listen.en: Every water molecule is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.
listen.zh: 每個水分子都是由氫和氧組成的。

chinese.en: He took a deep breath to compose himself before walking onto the stage.
chinese.zh: 他走上台前深吸了一口氣，讓自己鎮定下來。

english.en: It took me an hour to compose a polite email to my landlord.
english.zh: 我花了一個小時才寫好一封給房東的禮貌電子郵件。

speak.en: I usually compose my messages carefully before I send them.
speak.zh: 我通常會先把訊息仔細寫好再傳出去。

write.en: Women now compose nearly half of the country's workforce, according to recent data.
write.zh: 根據最新資料，女性現在占該國勞動人口將近一半。

example.en: Sweat glands in the skin release moisture when we exercise, which helps cool the body down.
example.zh: 運動時，皮膚裡的汗腺會排出水分，幫助身體降溫。

listen.en: My glands were swollen when I had a cold.
listen.zh: 我感冒時腺體腫了起來。

chinese.en: The thyroid gland controls how quickly the body uses energy from food.
chinese.zh: 甲狀腺控制身體利用食物能量的速度。

english.en: Certain glands in our body produce hormones that control how we grow.
english.zh: 我們體內的某些腺體會分泌控制生長的荷爾蒙。

speak.en: Whenever I get a sore throat, my glands feel a bit tender.
speak.zh: 每次我喉嚨痛，腺體摸起來都有點痛。

write.en: Some snakes have special glands that produce venom to catch their prey.
write.zh: 有些蛇擁有特殊的腺體，能分泌毒液來捕捉獵物。

example.en: The medicine cabinet above the sink was full of old pills, so we threw away everything that had expired.
example.zh: 洗手台上方的藥櫃塞滿了舊藥，所以我們把過期的全都丟掉了。

listen.en: Please put the files back in the cabinet.
listen.zh: 請把文件放回櫃子裡。

chinese.en: The prime minister announced several changes to the cabinet after the election.
chinese.zh: 選舉過後，總理宣布了幾項內閣人事異動。

english.en: We bought a new cabinet to store our books and games.
english.zh: 我們買了一個新櫃子來放書和遊戲。

speak.en: Our bathroom cabinet is so messy that I can never find anything.
speak.zh: 我們浴室的櫃子亂到我什麼都找不到。

write.en: The museum displays ancient coins in a glass cabinet near the entrance.
write.zh: 博物館把古錢幣陳列在入口附近的玻璃展示櫃裡。

example.en: Researchers collected secondary data from government reports rather than interviewing people themselves, which saved both time and money.
example.zh: 研究人員從政府報告中蒐集次級資料，而不是親自訪談，省下了時間和金錢。

listen.en: My brother teaches history at a local secondary school.
listen.zh: 我哥哥在當地一所中學教歷史。

chinese.en: In this job, experience matters most, and qualifications are of secondary importance.
chinese.zh: 這份工作最看重經驗，學歷證照倒是其次。

english.en: Free secondary education helps more young people find good jobs.
english.zh: 免費的中等教育幫助更多年輕人找到好工作。

speak.en: For me, salary is secondary; I care more about the people I work with.
speak.zh: 對我來說薪水是其次，我更在乎一起工作的人。

write.en: The infection was not dangerous, but doctors worried about a secondary infection developing later.
write.zh: 這次感染本身並不危險，但醫生擔心之後會引發續發性感染。

example.en: Unlike alligators, crocodiles often live in salty coastal waters, and their teeth remain visible when their mouths are closed.
example.zh: 和短吻鱷不同，鱷魚常生活在沿海鹹水中，而且嘴巴閉上時牙齒仍露在外面。

listen.en: We saw a crocodile swimming slowly across the river.
listen.zh: 我們看到一隻鱷魚慢慢游過河。

chinese.en: Tourists are warned not to swim in the lake because crocodiles live there.
chinese.zh: 遊客被警告不要在湖裡游泳，因為那裡有鱷魚出沒。

english.en: The crocodile stayed still in the water, waiting for its prey.
english.zh: 鱷魚靜靜待在水中，等待獵物上門。

speak.en: Seeing a real crocodile up close at the zoo was pretty scary.
speak.zh: 在動物園近距離看到真的鱷魚，還滿嚇人的。

write.en: Her bag is made of fake crocodile leather, so no animals were harmed.
write.zh: 她的包包是人造鱷魚皮做的，所以沒有傷害任何動物。

example.en: In the history lecture, we learned how the ancient king was overthrown by his own generals after years of unpopular rule.
example.zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到那位古代國王如何在多年不得民心的統治後，被自己的將領推翻。

listen.en: The young player hopes to overthrow the reigning champion.
listen.zh: 這位年輕選手希望打倒衛冕冠軍。

chinese.en: The museum exhibition explains the overthrow of the old dynasty and what followed.
chinese.zh: 這場博物館展覽說明了舊王朝如何被推翻，以及之後發生的事。

english.en: Small startups sometimes overthrow large companies that refuse to change.
english.zh: 小型新創公司有時會打倒拒絕改變的大企業。

speak.en: Honestly, one good teacher completely overthrew my idea of what learning is.
speak.zh: 老實說，一位好老師徹底推翻了我對學習的想法。

write.en: Our team's research overthrew the common assumption that remote workers are less productive.
write.zh: 我們團隊的研究推翻了「遠距工作者生產力較低」這個常見的假設。

example.en: Some customers were offended by the advertisement, which seemed to mock older people, so the company quickly withdrew it.
example.zh: 有些顧客對這則廣告感到不悅，因為它似乎在嘲笑長者，所以公司很快就撤下了。

listen.en: She is careful not to offend her new colleagues.
listen.zh: 她很小心，不想得罪新同事。

chinese.en: Visitors should learn a few local customs so that they don't accidentally offend anyone.
chinese.zh: 遊客應該學一些當地習俗，以免不小心冒犯到別人。

english.en: My grandfather is easily offended when people ignore his advice.
english.zh: 別人忽略我爺爺的建議時，他很容易不高興。

speak.en: I try to be honest, but I never want to offend anyone.
speak.zh: 我盡量誠實，但從不想冒犯任何人。

write.en: Drivers who offend repeatedly may lose their licence and face much heavier fines.
write.zh: 屢次違規的駕駛人可能會被吊銷駕照，並面臨更重的罰款。

example.en: Historians spent years collecting survivors' stories so that the massacre, long ignored in textbooks, would finally be remembered.
example.zh: 歷史學家花了多年蒐集倖存者的口述，讓這場長期被教科書忽略的屠殺終於被世人記住。

listen.en: Our team was massacred in the final match last night.
listen.zh: 我們隊昨晚在決賽中被痛宰。

chinese.en: Every year, residents gather quietly in the square to remember the massacre.
chinese.zh: 每年居民都會靜靜聚集在廣場上，悼念這場大屠殺。

english.en: The critics massacred the new film, but audiences loved it.
english.zh: 影評人把這部新電影批評得體無完膚，但觀眾很喜歡。

speak.en: Honestly, it wasn't a game; it was a complete massacre.
speak.zh: 老實說，那根本不像比賽，完全是一面倒的慘敗。

write.en: The documentary uses old letters and photographs to explain why the massacre happened.
write.zh: 這部紀錄片利用舊信件和照片，解釋這場屠殺發生的原因。

example.en: Parents who read regularly often pass this habit on to their offspring, who grow up surrounded by books.
example.zh: 經常閱讀的父母往往會把這個習慣傳給子女，讓孩子在書堆中長大。

listen.en: Some animals protect their offspring for many years.
listen.zh: 有些動物會保護後代很多年。

chinese.en: Farmers select the strongest animals for breeding so that their offspring will be healthier.
chinese.zh: 農民挑選最強壯的動物來繁殖，讓牠們的後代更健康。

english.en: Scientists studied how pollution affects the offspring of river fish.
english.zh: 科學家研究污染如何影響河魚的後代。

speak.en: My dad jokingly calls us his offspring when he introduces us.
speak.zh: 我爸介紹我們時，總愛開玩笑地稱我們是他的「後代」。

write.en: Some wealthy families set up trusts to support their offspring's education for generations.
write.zh: 有些富裕家庭會設立信託，好幾代都用來資助子孫的教育。

example.en: The storm damaged several towers, so the transmission of the evening news was interrupted for almost an hour.
example.zh: 暴風雨損壞了好幾座發射塔，導致晚間新聞的播送中斷了將近一小時。

listen.en: The mechanic said the car needs a new transmission.
listen.zh: 技師說這輛車需要換新的變速箱。

chinese.en: Before books existed, oral storytelling was the main means of cultural transmission.
chinese.zh: 在書籍出現之前，口述故事是文化傳承的主要方式。

english.en: Fibre-optic cables allow much faster data transmission than copper wires.
english.zh: 光纖電纜的資料傳輸速度比銅線快得多。

speak.en: We watched a live transmission of the concert at a cafe.
speak.zh: 我們在一家咖啡廳看了演唱會的現場轉播。

write.en: Researchers are studying whether mosquitoes play a role in the transmission of this virus.
write.zh: 研究人員正在研究蚊子是否在這種病毒的傳播中扮演某種角色。

example.en: After months of rude messages from strangers, the young blogger decided to report the online harassment to the platform.
example.zh: 在收到陌生人好幾個月的無禮訊息後，這位年輕部落客決定向平臺檢舉這些網路騷擾。

listen.en: She kept a record of every incident of harassment.
listen.zh: 她把每一次受到騷擾的經過都記錄下來。

chinese.en: Residents complained about constant harassment from salespeople calling their homes every evening.
chinese.zh: 居民抱怨每天晚上都有推銷員打電話到家裡，不斷騷擾他們。

english.en: Many schools now teach students how to deal with harassment.
english.zh: 現在許多學校會教學生如何應對騷擾。

speak.en: I think every workplace needs a simple way to report harassment.
speak.zh: 我認為每個職場都需要一個簡單的管道來通報騷擾。

write.en: The landlord was fined for harassment after repeatedly entering the tenant's flat without permission.
write.zh: 房東因多次未經許可進入房客的公寓，被以騷擾為由處以罰款。

example.en: Many applicants complained that the scholarship selection process was opaque, since nobody explained how the final decisions were made.
example.zh: 許多申請者抱怨獎學金的評選過程不透明，因為沒有人說明最後是如何決定的。

listen.en: Store the medicine in an opaque bottle away from sunlight.
listen.zh: 請把藥品存放在不透光的瓶子裡，避免日照。

chinese.en: The professor's writing is so opaque that even graduate students struggle to follow it.
chinese.zh: 那位教授的文章艱澀難懂，連研究生都很難看懂。

english.en: Citizens want to know why government spending remains so opaque.
english.zh: 民眾想知道為什麼政府支出仍然如此不透明。

speak.en: To be honest, the rules of that card game are completely opaque to me.
speak.zh: 老實說，那個紙牌遊戲的規則我完全看不懂。

write.en: The water in the lake turned opaque after heavy rain washed mud from the hills.
write.zh: 大雨把山上的泥沙沖下來後，湖水變得混濁不透明。

example.en: I write every deadline and meeting in my paper planner, so I can see the whole week at a glance.
example.zh: 我把每個截止日期和會議都寫在紙本手帳上，這樣一眼就能看到整週的安排。

listen.en: We hired a wedding planner to handle all the details.
listen.zh: 我們請了一位婚禮顧問來處理所有細節。

chinese.en: A good financial planner can help young workers save steadily for their future.
chinese.zh: 優秀的理財規劃師能幫助年輕上班族穩定地為未來儲蓄。

english.en: My sister is a natural planner who never misses an appointment.
english.zh: 我姊姊天生很會規劃，從來不會錯過任何預約。

speak.en: I'm not much of a planner; I usually decide things at the last minute.
speak.zh: 我不太會事先計畫，通常都是最後一刻才決定。

write.en: Event planners must prepare backup options in case outdoor activities are cancelled because of rain.
write.zh: 活動企劃人員必須準備備案，以防戶外活動因雨取消。

example.en: Only projects that meet all the criteria, including a clear budget and realistic timeline, will receive government funding.
example.zh: 只有符合所有條件的計畫，包括明確的預算與可行的時程，才能獲得政府補助。

listen.en: Please read the marking criteria before you start writing.
listen.zh: 開始寫作之前，請先閱讀評分標準。

chinese.en: For many young buyers, energy efficiency has become a key criterion when buying appliances.
chinese.zh: 對許多年輕消費者來說，節能效率已成為購買家電時的重要標準。

english.en: The judges use strict criteria to choose the best photograph.
english.zh: 評審使用嚴格的標準來選出最佳照片。

speak.en: For me, the main criterion for a good job is flexibility.
speak.zh: 對我來說，好工作最主要的標準是彈性。

write.en: Hospitals decide who receives treatment first according to medical criteria, not social status.
write.zh: 醫院是依據醫療標準而非社會地位，來決定誰先接受治療。

example.en: Economists gave a gloomy forecast this year, warning that prices would keep rising while wages stayed the same.
example.zh: 經濟學家今年發布了悲觀的預測，警告物價會持續上漲，薪資卻停滯不前。

listen.en: He felt gloomy after failing his driving test again.
listen.zh: 他駕照考試又沒過，心情很低落。

chinese.en: The old library was gloomy, with dark corners and very little natural light.
chinese.zh: 那座舊圖書館很陰暗，角落昏黑，自然光非常少。

english.en: Many students feel gloomy about finding good jobs after graduation.
english.zh: 許多學生對畢業後找到好工作感到悲觀。

speak.en: Winter here can be pretty gloomy, so I try to exercise outside.
speak.zh: 這裡的冬天常常相當陰鬱，所以我會盡量到戶外運動。

write.en: Despite the gloomy sales figures, the manager remained confident that the new product would succeed.
write.zh: 儘管銷售數字不理想，經理仍然有信心新產品會成功。

example.en: The new airport is enormous; travellers sometimes walk for twenty minutes just to reach their departure gate.
example.zh: 新機場非常巨大，旅客有時得走二十分鐘才能到達登機門。

listen.en: Final exams put enormous pressure on high school students.
listen.zh: 期末考給高中生帶來龐大的壓力。

chinese.en: Social media has had an enormous impact on how young people communicate.
chinese.zh: 社群媒體對年輕人的溝通方式產生了巨大的影響。

english.en: Blue whales are enormous animals that live in deep oceans.
english.zh: 藍鯨是生活在深海中的巨大動物。

speak.en: The portions at that restaurant are enormous, so we always share.
speak.zh: 那家餐廳的份量超大，所以我們總是一起分著吃。

write.en: Renewable energy has enormous potential, but it requires long-term investment from governments.
write.zh: 再生能源具有龐大的潛力，但需要政府長期投資。

example.en: The teacher rewrote the instructions for clarity after several students misunderstood what the assignment actually required.
example.zh: 有幾位學生誤解了作業的實際要求，老師因此重寫說明，讓內容更清楚。

listen.en: The new camera offers amazing clarity even at night.
listen.zh: 這台新相機即使在夜間也能拍出驚人的清晰度。

chinese.en: Employees complained that the new policy lacked clarity about working from home.
chinese.zh: 員工抱怨新政策對在家工作的規定不夠明確。

english.en: A short walk often gives me clarity when I feel stressed.
english.zh: 我感到壓力大時，散個步常常能讓我頭腦清楚。

speak.en: I like her presentations because she explains everything with such clarity.
speak.zh: 我喜歡她的簡報，因為她把每件事都解釋得非常清楚。

write.en: Scientists praised the lake's water clarity, a sign that pollution levels had dropped significantly.
write.zh: 科學家稱讚這座湖的湖水清澈，這顯示污染程度已大幅下降。

example.en: Thanks to the doctor's timely intervention, the patient recovered quickly and was able to leave hospital within days.
example.zh: 多虧醫師及時介入治療，病人很快就康復，幾天內便出院了。

listen.en: Customers expect a timely reply to their emails.
listen.zh: 顧客期待自己的電子郵件能得到及時回覆。

chinese.en: Students must submit their assignments in a timely manner, or they will lose marks.
chinese.zh: 學生必須準時繳交作業，否則會被扣分。

english.en: The government's timely warning helped residents prepare for the typhoon.
english.zh: 政府及時發布的警告幫助居民做好防颱準備。

speak.en: Your advice was really timely; I was just about to give up.
speak.zh: 你的建議來得正是時候，我剛好正要放棄。

write.en: Timely delivery of fresh ingredients is essential for running any successful restaurant.
write.zh: 準時送達新鮮食材，是經營任何成功餐廳的關鍵。

example.en: The narrow street was flanked by small cafes and bookshops, making it a favourite spot for students on weekends.
example.zh: 那條窄街兩旁林立著小咖啡館和書店，成了學生週末最喜歡去的地方。

listen.en: The horse had a small cut on its left flank.
listen.zh: 那匹馬的左側腹有一道小傷口。

chinese.en: The mountain's eastern flank is covered with tea plantations and walking trails.
chinese.zh: 這座山的東側山坡遍布茶園和步道。

english.en: Tall trees flank the road that leads to the village.
english.zh: 高大的樹木矗立在通往村莊的道路兩旁。

speak.en: In the photo, I'm the one flanked by my grandparents.
speak.zh: 照片中被爺爺奶奶夾在中間的就是我。

write.en: The winger raced down the right flank and crossed the ball perfectly to the striker.
write.zh: 邊鋒沿著右路快速推進，將球完美傳中給前鋒。

example.en: The IT department purged thousands of outdated records from the database to improve the system's speed and security.
example.zh: 資訊部門從資料庫中清除了數千筆過時紀錄，以提升系統的速度和安全性。

listen.en: The team purged every error from the final report.
listen.zh: 團隊把最終報告中的每個錯誤都清除了。

chinese.en: The new manager carried out a purge of unnecessary meetings and paperwork.
chinese.zh: 新經理大刀闊斧地刪減了不必要的會議和文書作業。

english.en: The city purges the drains before every rainy season begins.
english.zh: 市政府在每次雨季開始前都會清理排水溝。

speak.en: Honestly, writing in a journal helps me purge my stress.
speak.zh: 老實說，寫日記能幫我把壓力宣洩出來。

write.en: Some people follow a strict diet for a week, believing it will purge toxins from their bodies.
write.zh: 有些人會進行為期一週的嚴格飲食，相信這樣能排出體內的毒素。

example.en: When the singer finished her final song, the audience burst into spontaneous applause that lasted for several minutes.
example.zh: 歌手唱完最後一首歌時，觀眾自發地爆出掌聲，持續了好幾分鐘。

listen.en: Young children are often more spontaneous than adults.
listen.zh: 小孩子通常比大人更率性自然。

chinese.en: The best moments in the speaking test often come from spontaneous answers, not memorised ones.
chinese.zh: 口說測驗中最精彩的表現，往往來自即興回答，而不是背好的答案。

english.en: Local volunteers organised a spontaneous clean-up after the festival ended.
english.zh: 節慶結束後，當地志工自發地發起了清潔活動。

speak.en: I'm quite spontaneous, so I rarely plan my weekends in advance.
speak.zh: 我個性滿隨性的，所以很少事先安排週末。

write.en: Researchers found that spontaneous conversations in the office often lead to creative ideas.
write.zh: 研究人員發現，辦公室裡的隨興交談常常能激發創意。

example.en: Rural-to-urban migration has left many villages with mostly elderly residents, as young people move to cities for work.
example.zh: 城鄉遷移使許多村莊只剩下以長者為主的居民，因為年輕人都搬到城市工作。

listen.en: Scientists track whale migration using small satellite tags.
listen.zh: 科學家利用小型衛星標籤追蹤鯨魚的遷徙。

chinese.en: Our company's data migration to the new cloud system took longer than expected.
chinese.zh: 我們公司將資料轉移到新雲端系統，花的時間比預期還久。

english.en: My grandparents' migration to Taipei completely changed our family's future.
english.zh: 我祖父母移居臺北這件事，徹底改變了我們家族的未來。

speak.en: Honestly, I think migration makes cities more diverse and interesting.
speak.zh: 老實說，我認為人口移入讓城市變得更多元、更有趣。

write.en: Governments should plan carefully for the migration caused by rising sea levels.
write.zh: 政府應該為海平面上升所造成的人口遷移審慎規劃。

example.en: Rent takes up a huge chunk of my monthly salary, so I rarely have money left for travel.
example.zh: 房租占了我每月薪水的一大部分，所以我很少有餘錢去旅行。

listen.en: A large chunk of ice broke off the glacier.
listen.zh: 一大塊冰從冰河上崩落。

chinese.en: Breaking a big project into smaller chunks makes it much easier to manage.
chinese.zh: 把大型專案拆成幾個較小的部分，會讓它容易管理得多。

english.en: I spent a big chunk of the weekend studying for exams.
english.zh: 我週末大部分的時間都在準備考試。

speak.en: Learning phrases in chunks really helped me speak more fluently.
speak.zh: 以語塊的方式學片語，真的幫助我說得更流利。

write.en: The city plans to spend a significant chunk of its budget on public transport.
write.zh: 市政府計畫把相當大比例的預算用在大眾運輸上。

example.en: Although she missed the gold, the young swimmer was thrilled to win bronze in her first international competition.
example.zh: 雖然與金牌失之交臂，這位年輕泳將在首次參加的國際比賽中贏得銅牌，仍然非常興奮。

listen.en: The old bell in the temple is made of bronze.
listen.zh: 寺廟裡那口古鐘是青銅鑄造的。

chinese.en: During the Bronze Age, people learned to mix copper and tin to make stronger tools.
chinese.zh: 在青銅器時代，人們學會將銅與錫混合，製作更堅固的工具。

english.en: Our team won a bronze medal at the national science contest.
english.zh: 我們隊在全國科學競賽中贏得銅牌。

speak.en: After the summer holiday, my skin turned a lovely bronze colour.
speak.zh: 暑假過後，我的皮膚曬成了好看的古銅色。

write.en: The designer chose bronze door handles to give the hotel lobby a warm, classic look.
write.zh: 設計師選用青銅門把，讓飯店大廳呈現溫暖而經典的風格。

example.en: The new bridge, built across a wide and stormy bay, is considered a marvel of modern engineering.
example.zh: 這座橫跨寬闊多風浪海灣的新橋，被視為現代工程的奇蹟。

listen.en: We marvelled at the bright stars above the mountain.
listen.zh: 我們對山頂上方明亮的星空驚嘆不已。

chinese.en: My grandmother still marvels that she can video call relatives living overseas.
chinese.zh: 我奶奶至今仍覺得不可思議，她竟然能和住在國外的親戚視訊通話。

english.en: Smartphones are small marvels that have completely changed daily life.
english.zh: 智慧型手機是徹底改變日常生活的小小奇蹟。

speak.en: I always marvel at how quickly kids pick up new languages.
speak.zh: 我總是很驚訝小孩學新語言的速度有多快。

write.en: The teacher marvelled at the student's progress after just one term of extra practice.
write.zh: 老師對這名學生只多練習了一學期就大有進步感到驚嘆。

example.en: The documentary roused public anger, and within weeks thousands of viewers had signed a petition demanding cleaner rivers.
example.zh: 這部紀錄片激起了民眾的憤怒，短短幾週內就有數千名觀眾連署，要求整治河川。

listen.en: Nothing could rouse him once he fell asleep on the sofa.
listen.zh: 他一在沙發上睡著，什麼都叫不醒他。

chinese.en: A good teacher knows how to rouse students' curiosity before introducing a difficult topic.
chinese.zh: 好老師知道在講解困難的主題之前，要先激起學生的好奇心。

english.en: The coach's speech roused the team to play harder.
english.zh: 教練的一番話激勵全隊打得更賣力。

speak.en: It usually takes two alarms to rouse me on Monday mornings.
speak.zh: 星期一早上通常要兩個鬧鐘才能把我叫醒。

write.en: The plan to close the local library roused strong opposition from parents and pensioners alike.
write.zh: 關閉當地圖書館的計畫，引起家長和退休人士一致的強烈反對。

example.en: Robots are increasingly used for mundane, repetitive work, allowing staff to focus on tasks that require creativity.
example.zh: 機器人越來越常被用來處理單調重複的工作，讓員工能專注在需要創意的任務上。

listen.en: Washing the dishes is a mundane chore, but someone has to do it.
listen.zh: 洗碗是件乏味的家事，但總得有人做。

chinese.en: The novel turns the mundane details of village life into something surprisingly moving.
chinese.zh: 這部小說把村莊生活的平凡瑣事，寫成了出乎意料感人的故事。

english.en: Many students find grammar exercises mundane and boring.
english.zh: 許多學生覺得文法練習既單調又無聊。

speak.en: Honestly, my weekends are pretty mundane, mostly shopping and cleaning.
speak.zh: 說真的，我的週末滿平淡的，大多是購物和打掃。

write.en: Even a seemingly mundane walk to the station can inspire a good photograph.
write.zh: 即使是看似平凡的走路去車站，也能激發一張好照片的靈感。

example.en: The researcher's conclusion was not valid because the sample was too small to represent the whole population.
example.zh: 這位研究者的結論站不住腳，因為樣本太小，無法代表整體人口。

listen.en: That is a valid point, and we should discuss it further.
listen.zh: 那是個合理的觀點，我們應該進一步討論。

chinese.en: Critics raised valid concerns about the cost of building the new stadium.
chinese.zh: 批評者對興建新體育場的成本，提出了合理的疑慮。

english.en: This train ticket is only valid on weekdays.
english.zh: 這張火車票只在平日有效。

speak.en: I think both sides have valid arguments, to be fair.
speak.zh: 說句公道話，我覺得雙方的論點都有道理。

write.en: A student visa usually remains valid only as long as you stay enrolled in a course.
write.zh: 學生簽證通常只有在你維持課程註冊期間才持續有效。

example.en: Each banknote has a different colour and size, so people with poor eyesight can easily tell the denominations apart.
example.zh: 每種鈔票的顏色和大小都不一樣，讓視力不好的人也能輕鬆分辨面額。

listen.en: Stamps of every denomination are sold at the post office.
listen.zh: 郵局販售各種面額的郵票。

chinese.en: Some shops refuse to accept notes of large denominations because of the risk of fakes.
chinese.zh: 有些店家因為怕收到假鈔，拒收大面額鈔票。

english.en: The machine only accepts coins of certain denominations.
english.zh: 這台機器只收特定面額的硬幣。

speak.en: Could I have the money in smaller denominations, please?
speak.zh: 可以麻煩給我面額小一點的鈔票嗎？

write.en: The museum displays coins of every denomination used in Taiwan over the past century.
write.zh: 這間博物館展示過去一百年來臺灣使用過的各種面額硬幣。

example.en: As the small boat rocked on the rough sea, a wave of nausea hit me and I had to lie down.
example.zh: 小船在洶湧的海面上搖晃時，一陣噁心襲來，我只好躺下。

listen.en: Many pregnant women suffer from nausea in the morning.
listen.zh: 許多孕婦早上會有噁心的症狀。

chinese.en: Reading in a moving car often gives me a feeling of nausea and a headache.
chinese.zh: 在行進的車上看書，常讓我覺得反胃又頭痛。

english.en: Common symptoms of food poisoning include nausea and fever.
english.zh: 食物中毒的常見症狀包括噁心和發燒。

speak.en: I felt a bit of nausea after that roller coaster ride.
speak.zh: 坐完那趟雲霄飛車後，我覺得有點想吐。

write.en: Doctors say ginger tea can help reduce nausea during long journeys.
write.zh: 醫生說，長途旅行時喝薑茶有助於減輕噁心感。

example.en: The report had plenty of data, but the ideas jumped around so much that it never formed a coherent whole.
example.zh: 這份報告資料很多，但想法跳來跳去，始終沒有形成一個有條理的整體。

listen.en: She was too tired to give a coherent answer.
listen.zh: 她累到沒辦法給出條理清楚的回答。

chinese.en: The government still lacks a coherent strategy for dealing with the ageing population.
chinese.zh: 政府仍然缺乏一套完整一致的策略來因應人口老化。

english.en: Linking words help make your writing more coherent.
english.zh: 連接詞能讓你的文章更連貫。

speak.en: I try to keep my answers short and coherent in interviews.
speak.zh: 面試時，我盡量讓回答簡短又有條理。

write.en: After a long discussion, the team finally agreed on a coherent plan for the product launch.
write.zh: 經過長時間討論，團隊終於為產品上市擬定了一套有條理的計畫。

example.en: The writing on the old map had become so faint over the years that we could barely read the street names.
example.zh: 這張舊地圖上的字經過多年變得非常模糊，我們幾乎看不清街道名稱。

listen.en: One runner fainted from the heat near the finish line.
listen.zh: 有一名跑者在終點線附近因為太熱而昏倒。

chinese.en: There is still a faint hope that the missing hikers will be found alive.
chinese.zh: 失蹤的登山客仍有一絲生還被尋獲的希望。

english.en: I don't have the faintest idea where I left my keys.
english.zh: 我完全不知道我把鑰匙放在哪裡。

speak.en: I felt faint after standing in the sun for an hour.
speak.zh: 在太陽底下站了一小時後，我覺得頭暈快昏倒了。

write.en: The kitchen still had a faint smell of coffee long after breakfast was over.
write.zh: 早餐結束很久之後，廚房裡仍有淡淡的咖啡香。

example.en: Even in a serious drama about illness, the director added a few comic scenes to give the audience some relief.
example.zh: 即使是一部關於疾病的嚴肅劇情片，導演仍加入幾段喜劇場景，讓觀眾稍微喘口氣。

listen.en: The actor is famous for his perfect comic timing.
listen.zh: 這位演員以掌握笑點的完美時機聞名。

chinese.en: Some teachers use comic strips to explain difficult science ideas in a simple way.
chinese.zh: 有些老師用四格漫畫，以簡單的方式解釋困難的科學概念。

english.en: She dreams of becoming a stand-up comic in Taipei.
english.zh: 她夢想在臺北成為一名單口喜劇演員。

speak.en: I used to collect Japanese comics when I was a kid.
speak.zh: 我小時候會收集日本漫畫。

write.en: The dog chasing its own tail created a comic moment during the wedding ceremony.
write.zh: 那隻狗追著自己的尾巴跑，在婚禮上製造了一段滑稽的插曲。

example.en: Engineers who design a missile must calculate its speed, weight and path with extreme precision.
example.zh: 設計飛彈的工程師，必須極為精準地計算它的速度、重量和飛行路徑。

listen.en: The museum displays an old missile from the last century.
listen.zh: 這間博物館展示著一枚上個世紀的舊飛彈。

chinese.en: Many countries spend a large share of their budget on missile defence systems.
chinese.zh: 許多國家把大筆預算花在飛彈防禦系統上。

english.en: The rocket looked like a missile as it climbed into the sky.
english.zh: 那枚火箭升空時看起來像一枚飛彈。

speak.en: I saw a real missile once at a military museum.
speak.zh: 我曾在一間軍事博物館看過真正的飛彈。

write.en: Spectators who throw bottles or other missiles onto the pitch will be banned from the stadium.
write.zh: 朝球場內丟擲瓶子或其他物品的觀眾，將被禁止進入體育場。

example.en: After spinning around on the playground ride for several minutes, the children were so dizzy they could hardly walk straight.
example.zh: 在遊樂設施上轉了好幾分鐘後，孩子們頭暈到幾乎沒辦法走直線。

listen.en: Looking down from the tall tower made me dizzy.
listen.zh: 從高塔往下看讓我頭暈目眩。

chinese.en: If you feel dizzy during exercise, you should stop and drink some water.
chinese.zh: 如果你運動時感到頭暈，就應該停下來喝點水。

english.en: Skipping breakfast often makes me feel dizzy in class.
english.zh: 不吃早餐常讓我上課時覺得頭暈。

speak.en: Honestly, those spinning rides make me dizzy, so I avoid them.
speak.zh: 老實說，那些旋轉的遊樂設施會讓我頭暈，所以我都避開。

write.en: Technology is changing at a dizzying speed, and older workers sometimes struggle to keep up.
write.zh: 科技正以令人眼花撩亂的速度變化，年長的員工有時很難跟上。

example.en: The new law was passed in such haste that many important details were overlooked and had to be fixed later.
example.zh: 這項新法通過得太倉促，許多重要細節都被忽略，之後只好再修正。

listen.en: He wrote the letter in haste and forgot to sign it.
listen.zh: 他匆忙寫完信，結果忘了簽名。

chinese.en: Decisions made in haste often lead to regret, so take time to think carefully.
chinese.zh: 倉促做出的決定常讓人後悔，所以要花時間仔細思考。

english.en: We packed in haste and forgot our passports.
english.zh: 我們匆忙打包，結果忘了帶護照。

speak.en: I made a few silly mistakes because I finished the test in haste.
speak.zh: 我因為匆匆寫完考卷，犯了幾個粗心的錯。

write.en: Critics argue that the company acted with undue haste when it closed the factory.
write.zh: 批評者認為，這家公司關閉工廠的做法過於倉促。

example.en: The first edition of the novel sold only a few hundred copies, but today collectors pay a fortune for one.
example.zh: 這部小說的初版只賣出幾百本，但現在收藏家願意花大錢買一本。

listen.en: The sneakers came out in a limited edition last spring.
listen.zh: 這款球鞋去年春天推出限量版。

chinese.en: The newspaper's online edition is updated several times a day with breaking news.
chinese.zh: 這家報社的網路版每天會更新好幾次即時新聞。

english.en: This dictionary has been revised in its new edition.
english.zh: 這本字典在新版中已經修訂過了。

speak.en: I bought the special edition because it came with a free poster.
speak.zh: 我買了特別版，因為它附贈一張海報。

write.en: This year's edition of the film festival attracted more international visitors than ever before.
write.zh: 今年這屆影展吸引的國際觀眾比以往都多。

example.en: Unemployment has hovered around five percent for the past three years, showing little sign of either rising or falling.
example.zh: 失業率過去三年來一直在百分之五上下徘徊，幾乎沒有上升或下降的跡象。

listen.en: A hawk hovered high over the field, looking for food.
listen.zh: 一隻老鷹在田野上空高高盤旋，尋找食物。

chinese.en: When you hover your mouse over the icon, a short explanation will appear.
chinese.zh: 當你把滑鼠游標移到圖示上，就會出現簡短的說明。

english.en: The waiter kept hovering near our table during dinner.
english.zh: 晚餐時，服務生一直在我們桌子附近徘徊。

speak.en: I hate it when shop assistants hover around me while I browse.
speak.zh: 我很討厭逛街時店員一直在我旁邊打轉。

write.en: Summer temperatures in the city hovered near thirty-five degrees for most of July.
write.zh: 七月大部分時間，這座城市的夏季氣溫都在三十五度上下。

example.en: After the safety problem was discovered, the company decided to withdraw the toy from shops across the country.
example.zh: 發現安全問題後，這家公司決定將這款玩具從全國的店面下架。

listen.en: She withdrew from the race because of a knee injury.
listen.zh: 她因為膝蓋受傷而退出比賽。

chinese.en: Several sponsors withdrew their support after the festival was criticised for its waste.
chinese.zh: 這個節慶活動因為浪費而遭批評後，有幾家贊助商撤回了支持。

english.en: You can withdraw from the course within the first two weeks.
english.zh: 你可以在前兩週內退選這門課。

speak.en: I usually withdraw money once a week and try to stick to it.
speak.zh: 我通常一週領一次錢，並盡量照預算花。

write.en: After moving to a new school, the shy boy withdrew into himself and rarely spoke in class.
write.zh: 轉到新學校後，那個害羞的男孩變得封閉，在課堂上很少說話。

example.en: Children who drink sugary drinks every day are far more likely to develop cavities than those who drink water.
example.zh: 每天喝含糖飲料的孩子，比喝水的孩子更容易蛀牙。

listen.en: Brushing twice a day helps prevent cavities.
listen.zh: 一天刷牙兩次有助於預防蛀牙。

chinese.en: The heart and lungs are protected inside the chest cavity by the ribs.
chinese.zh: 心臟和肺臟位於胸腔內，受到肋骨的保護。

english.en: I had to go back to the dentist to fill a cavity.
english.zh: 我得回去找牙醫補蛀牙。

speak.en: I eat a lot of candy, so I get cavities quite often.
speak.zh: 我很愛吃糖果，所以滿常蛀牙的。

write.en: Builders discovered a hidden cavity behind the wall while renovating the old house.
write.zh: 工人在翻修那棟老房子時，發現牆後有一個隱藏的空洞。

example.en: The music at the party was so loud that it completely drowned out our conversation, so we went outside to talk.
example.zh: 派對上的音樂太大聲，完全蓋過了我們的談話聲，所以我們到外面去聊。

listen.en: Never swim alone, because people can drown very quickly.
listen.zh: 絕對不要獨自游泳，因為人可能很快就溺水。

chinese.en: Many office workers feel they are drowning in emails and endless meetings.
chinese.zh: 許多上班族覺得自己快被電子郵件和開不完的會淹沒了。

english.en: The noise of the traffic drowned out his voice.
english.zh: 車流的噪音蓋過了他的聲音。

speak.en: Honestly, I'm drowning in homework this week and barely sleeping.
speak.zh: 說真的，我這週被作業淹沒，幾乎沒睡覺。

write.en: The chef warned us not to drown the fresh salad in heavy dressing.
write.zh: 主廚提醒我們，別在新鮮沙拉上淋太多濃稠的醬汁。

example.en: After three days of flu and almost no sleep, I felt so wretched that I could barely get out of bed.
example.zh: 得了三天流感又幾乎沒睡，我難受到幾乎下不了床。

listen.en: This wretched printer has jammed again this morning.
listen.zh: 這台討厭的印表機今天早上又卡紙了。

chinese.en: The charity aims to improve the wretched lives of homeless people in the city.
chinese.zh: 這個慈善團體致力於改善城市中無家者的悲慘生活。

english.en: The wretched weather ruined our weekend trip to the beach.
english.zh: 糟透的天氣毀了我們週末的海邊之旅。

speak.en: I felt wretched after failing my driving test for the second time.
speak.zh: 第二次考駕照沒過之後，我心情糟透了。

write.en: Animal welfare groups exposed the wretched state of the farm and demanded urgent changes.
write.zh: 動物福利團體揭露了這座農場的惡劣狀況，並要求立即改善。

example.en: Many rural clinics lack adequate funding, so patients often have to travel to the city for basic treatment.
example.zh: 許多鄉村診所經費不足，病人常常得到城市才能接受基本治療。

listen.en: The room is small but adequate for two people.
listen.zh: 這個房間雖小，但兩個人住已經夠了。

chinese.en: Every citizen should have access to clean water and an adequate standard of living.
chinese.zh: 每位公民都應該享有乾淨的水和適當的生活水準。

english.en: Make sure you drink an adequate amount of water every day.
english.zh: 務必每天喝足夠的水。

speak.en: My English is adequate for travel, but not for business meetings.
speak.zh: 我的英文應付旅行還可以，但開商務會議就不夠。

write.en: Without adequate public transport, residents in the suburbs have little choice but to drive.
write.zh: 缺乏足夠的大眾運輸，郊區居民幾乎只能開車。

example.en: The project suffered a major setback when heavy rain flooded the construction site and delayed work for weeks.
example.zh: 豪雨淹沒工地，使工程延誤好幾週，這個計畫因此遭受重大挫折。

listen.en: Every successful person has faced setbacks along the way.
listen.zh: 每個成功的人一路上都曾遭遇挫折。

chinese.en: The rising cost of materials is a serious setback for the city's housing plan.
chinese.zh: 材料成本上漲，對市政府的住宅計畫是一大阻礙。

english.en: She saw the failed exam as a temporary setback.
english.zh: 她把考試失利視為暫時的挫折。

speak.en: I had a few setbacks while learning to drive, but I passed eventually.
speak.zh: 我學開車時遇過幾次挫折，但最後還是考過了。

write.en: Learning to overcome setbacks is just as important for students as getting good grades.
write.zh: 學會克服挫折，對學生來說和取得好成績一樣重要。

example.en: Recent studies challenge the notion that young people do not read, showing that many simply read on their phones instead.
example.zh: 近期研究挑戰了「年輕人不讀書」的觀念，顯示許多人只是改在手機上閱讀。

listen.en: I had only a vague notion of what the job involved.
listen.zh: 我對這份工作的內容只有模糊的概念。

chinese.en: The notion of working from home was unusual before the internet became widespread.
chinese.zh: 在網路普及之前，在家工作的概念並不常見。

english.en: I reject the notion that boys are better at maths.
english.zh: 我不認同男生數學比較好這種觀念。

speak.en: I used to have this romantic notion of living in Paris.
speak.zh: 我以前對住在巴黎抱有浪漫的想像。

write.en: Traditional notions of success are changing as more graduates choose to start their own businesses.
write.zh: 隨著越來越多畢業生選擇自行創業，傳統的成功觀念正在改變。

example.en: Instead of saving for emergencies, he made reckless investments and lost most of his savings within a year.
example.zh: 他沒有存錢以備不時之需，反而做了魯莽的投資，不到一年就賠掉大部分積蓄。

listen.en: It was reckless of her to swim alone at night.
listen.zh: 她晚上獨自去游泳，實在太魯莽了。

chinese.en: The company was criticised for its reckless spending during a period of economic uncertainty.
chinese.zh: 這家公司在經濟前景不明的時期仍揮霍無度，因而受到批評。

english.en: Some young people take reckless risks to impress their friends.
english.zh: 有些年輕人會魯莽地冒險，只為了讓朋友刮目相看。

speak.en: I used to be a bit reckless with money when I was younger.
speak.zh: 我年輕時花錢有點不顧後果。

write.en: Cutting down entire forests for short-term profit is a reckless approach to development.
write.zh: 為了短期利益砍伐整片森林，是一種不顧後果的發展方式。

example.en: The plan looked good on paper, but without enough funding it was never commercially viable.
example.zh: 這個計畫紙上看起來不錯，但缺乏足夠資金，在商業上始終行不通。

listen.en: We need to find a viable solution before next week.
listen.zh: 我們得在下週之前找到可行的解決辦法。

chinese.en: Many experts doubt whether public transport alone is a viable way to reduce traffic jams.
chinese.zh: 許多專家懷疑，光靠大眾運輸是否真能有效減少塞車。

english.en: Working from home is a viable option for many office workers.
english.zh: 對許多上班族來說，在家工作是可行的選擇。

speak.en: Honestly, I don't think that's a viable plan for a student budget.
speak.zh: 老實說，以學生的預算來看，我不覺得那個計畫可行。

write.en: Scientists checked whether the seeds were still viable after being stored for decades.
write.zh: 科學家檢查這些種子在存放數十年後是否仍能發芽存活。

example.en: As working hours grew longer, many employees found they had little leisure left for hobbies or rest.
example.zh: 隨著工時愈來愈長，許多員工發現自己幾乎沒有空閒時間可以培養嗜好或休息。

listen.en: Please read the report at your leisure this weekend.
listen.zh: 這個週末有空時請再看看這份報告。

chinese.en: The city council plans to build more leisure facilities such as parks and swimming pools.
chinese.zh: 市議會打算興建更多休閒設施，例如公園和游泳池。

english.en: Reading novels is my favourite leisure activity on rainy days.
english.zh: 下雨天時，看小說是我最喜歡的休閒活動。

speak.en: In my leisure time, I usually go hiking or watch films.
speak.zh: 空閒的時候，我通常會去爬山或看電影。

write.en: The tourism industry relies heavily on people having money and time for leisure.
write.zh: 觀光產業非常依賴人們有錢也有時間從事休閒活動。

example.en: During the debate, the student calmly rebutted each point her opponent raised, using clear evidence and examples.
example.zh: 辯論時，這名學生冷靜地用明確的證據和例子，逐一反駁對手提出的論點。

listen.en: He quickly rebutted the argument with simple facts.
listen.zh: 他很快就用簡單的事實反駁了那個論點。

chinese.en: The company issued a statement rebutting reports that it was planning to close the factory.
chinese.zh: 該公司發表聲明，駁斥有關它打算關閉工廠的報導。

english.en: In your essay, try to rebut the opposing view clearly.
english.zh: 在你的文章裡，試著清楚地反駁對立的觀點。

speak.en: It's hard to rebut someone who keeps changing the subject.
speak.zh: 要反駁一個一直轉移話題的人很難。

write.en: The manager rebuts complaints about slow service by pointing to customer survey results.
write.zh: 經理以顧客問卷調查的結果，來反駁服務太慢的抱怨。

example.en: Please find enclosed a copy of my certificate, which confirms that I completed the training course.
example.zh: 隨函附上我的證書影本，證明我已完成培訓課程。

listen.en: I have enclosed a photo with this letter.
listen.zh: 我在這封信裡附上了一張照片。

chinese.en: Some people feel anxious in small enclosed spaces such as lifts or tunnels.
chinese.zh: 有些人在電梯或隧道這類狹小的密閉空間裡會感到焦慮。

english.en: The farmer enclosed the field to keep his sheep safe.
english.zh: 那位農夫把田地圍起來，好讓他的羊保持安全。

speak.en: When I applied, I enclosed my CV and a short cover letter.
speak.zh: 我應徵時附上了履歷和一封簡短的求職信。

write.en: Modern zoos try to enclose animals in areas that resemble their natural habitats.
write.zh: 現代動物園盡量把動物圈養在類似牠們自然棲地的區域裡。

example.en: Before buying any skincare product, she always checks the list of ingredients on the back of the bottle.
example.zh: 買任何保養品之前，她一定會先看瓶身背面的成分表。

listen.en: Mix all the dry ingredients together in a large bowl.
listen.zh: 把所有乾性材料放進大碗裡拌勻。

chinese.en: Trust and clear communication are key ingredients of a successful working relationship.
chinese.zh: 信任與清楚的溝通，是良好工作關係的關鍵要素。

english.en: My grandmother only cooks with fresh ingredients from the local market.
english.zh: 我奶奶只用附近市場買來的新鮮食材做菜。

speak.en: I love cooking, but I'm terrible at measuring ingredients properly.
speak.zh: 我很愛煮菜，但很不會精準地量材料。

write.en: Many processed foods contain artificial ingredients that may be harmful to children's health.
write.zh: 許多加工食品含有可能危害兒童健康的人工成分。

example.en: Because the case raised complex legal questions, it went through a long judicial process before a final decision was reached.
example.zh: 由於這個案件牽涉複雜的法律問題，經過漫長的司法程序才做出最終判決。

listen.en: The judge made a careful judicial decision in court.
listen.zh: 法官在法庭上做出了審慎的司法判決。

chinese.en: Residents asked for a judicial review of the plan to build a factory near the river.
chinese.zh: 居民要求對在河邊興建工廠的計畫進行司法審查。

english.en: Judicial independence is an important feature of any fair society.
english.zh: 司法獨立是任何公平社會的重要特徵。

speak.en: My cousin works in the judicial sector, so she knows a lot about law.
speak.zh: 我表姊在司法界工作，所以她很懂法律。

write.en: Law students often visit courts to observe judicial procedures in real cases.
write.zh: 法律系學生常到法院旁聽，觀察真實案件的司法程序。

example.en: Some scientists believe the universe is infinite, stretching endlessly in every direction without any boundary.
example.zh: 有些科學家認為宇宙是無限的，朝各個方向無止境地延伸，沒有任何邊界。

listen.en: The internet offers an infinite amount of information.
listen.zh: 網路提供了無窮無盡的資訊。

chinese.en: Natural resources are not infinite, so we must use them more carefully.
chinese.zh: 自然資源並非取之不盡，所以我們必須更謹慎地使用。

english.en: With so many courses available, the possibilities seemed almost infinite.
english.zh: 有這麼多課程可以選，可能性看起來幾乎無窮無盡。

speak.en: There's an infinite variety of street food in my hometown.
speak.zh: 我家鄉的小吃種類多到數不完。

write.en: In mathematics, an infinite series of numbers continues forever without reaching an end.
write.zh: 在數學中，無窮數列會一直延續下去，永遠沒有盡頭。

example.en: Organic vegetables are grown without chemical pesticides, which is why they often cost more in supermarkets.
example.zh: 有機蔬菜在種植時不使用化學農藥，這也是它們在超市裡通常比較貴的原因。

listen.en: Always wash fruit to remove any pesticide residue.
listen.zh: 水果一定要洗過，去除殘留的農藥。

chinese.en: Heavy use of pesticides can harm bees and other insects that are important to agriculture.
chinese.zh: 大量使用農藥可能傷害蜜蜂和其他對農業很重要的昆蟲。

english.en: This small farm has stopped using pesticides on its vegetables.
english.zh: 這座小農場已經不在蔬菜上使用農藥了。

speak.en: I try to buy pesticide-free vegetables whenever I can.
speak.zh: 只要可以，我都盡量買無農藥的蔬菜。

write.en: Governments should strictly limit the use of pesticides that pollute rivers and threaten wildlife.
write.zh: 政府應嚴格限制使用會汙染河川、威脅野生動物的農藥。

example.en: After a slow ascent through thick clouds, the plane finally reached its cruising height and the seatbelt sign went off.
