example.zh: 飛機穿過厚厚的雲層緩緩爬升，終於到達巡航高度，安全帶指示燈也熄滅了。

listen.en: The path makes a steep ascent up the hill.
listen.zh: 這條小路沿著山坡陡峭地往上爬。

chinese.en: The young singer's rapid ascent to fame surprised both critics and fans.
chinese.zh: 這位年輕歌手迅速走紅，讓樂評和歌迷都很意外。

english.en: The ascent was difficult, but the view from the top was amazing.
english.zh: 上山的路很難走，但山頂的景色美極了。

speak.en: Honestly, the ascent was exhausting, but I'd definitely do it again.
speak.zh: 老實說，爬上去累死人了，但我一定還會再爬。

write.en: The company's ascent from a small start-up to an industry leader took only a decade.
write.zh: 這家公司從小型新創崛起成為業界龍頭，只花了十年。

example.en: Once you have had chickenpox, your body usually becomes immune to it, so you are unlikely to catch it again.
example.zh: 一旦得過水痘，身體通常就會產生免疫力，所以不太可能再感染。

listen.en: No business is completely immune to economic changes.
listen.zh: 沒有任何企業能完全不受經濟變化影響。

chinese.en: After years of working in sales, she seems immune to rejection and criticism.
chinese.zh: 做了多年業務之後，她對被拒絕和批評似乎已經免疫了。

english.en: Young children are not immune to the effects of stress.
english.zh: 年幼的孩子也難逃壓力帶來的影響。

speak.en: I seem to be immune to coffee; it never keeps me awake.
speak.zh: 我好像對咖啡免疫，喝了也不會睡不著。

write.en: Vaccines train the immune response so the body can fight infections more quickly.
write.zh: 疫苗能訓練免疫反應，讓身體更快對抗感染。

example.en: Because the town sits where several trade routes meet, it has always held a strategic position in the region.
example.zh: 由於這座城鎮位於幾條貿易路線的交會處，在該地區一直佔有重要的戰略地位。

listen.en: Good teachers are strategic about how they plan lessons.
listen.zh: 好老師在規劃課程時很有策略。

chinese.en: The two universities formed a strategic partnership to share research facilities and resources.
chinese.zh: 兩所大學建立策略聯盟，共享研究設備與資源。

english.en: Careful strategic planning helps small businesses survive difficult economic times.
english.zh: 縝密的策略規劃能幫助小型企業度過經濟困境。

speak.en: I try to be strategic and study my weakest subjects first.
speak.zh: 我會試著有策略一點，先唸自己最弱的科目。

write.en: Governments must make strategic investments in renewable energy to secure future growth.
write.zh: 政府必須對再生能源進行策略性投資，以確保未來的成長。

example.en: The long journey across the desert was a real test of endurance for both the travellers and their camels.
example.zh: 橫越沙漠的漫長旅程，對旅人和他們的駱駝來說都是一大耐力考驗。

listen.en: Swimming is a great way to build up endurance.
listen.zh: 游泳是增強耐力的好方法。

chinese.en: Nurses working long night shifts need remarkable mental endurance to stay focused.
chinese.zh: 值長時間夜班的護理師需要極強的心理耐力才能保持專注。

english.en: Cycling to school every day has greatly improved my endurance.
english.zh: 每天騎腳踏車上學大幅提升了我的耐力。

speak.en: I'm not very fast, but my endurance is pretty good.
speak.zh: 我跑得不算快，但耐力還不錯。

write.en: Learning a new language is less about talent and more about patience and endurance.
write.zh: 學一種新語言與其說靠天分，不如說靠耐心和毅力。

example.en: Architects rely on geometry to make sure that the angles and shapes of a building are both safe and attractive.
example.zh: 建築師靠幾何學確保建築物的角度和形狀既安全又美觀。

listen.en: My sister finds geometry much easier than algebra.
listen.zh: 我妹妹覺得幾何比代數簡單多了。

chinese.en: The unusual geometry of the museum's roof attracts many photographers every year.
chinese.zh: 這座博物館屋頂獨特的幾何造型，每年都吸引許多攝影師前來。

english.en: Geometry was my least favourite subject when I was in high school.
english.zh: 高中時，幾何是我最不喜歡的科目。

speak.en: I wasn't great at geometry, but I loved drawing the shapes.
speak.zh: 我幾何不太好，但很喜歡畫那些圖形。

write.en: Many traditional floor tile patterns around the world are based on surprisingly complex geometry.
write.zh: 世界各地許多傳統地磚圖案，都是以出乎意料複雜的幾何結構為基礎。

example.en: Living in a crowded city with constant noise, he yearned for the peace and quiet of the countryside.
example.zh: 住在擁擠又吵雜不斷的城市裡，他很嚮往鄉間的寧靜。

listen.en: The lonely old man yearned for someone to talk to.
listen.zh: 那位孤單的老人渴望有人能陪他說說話。

chinese.en: Young people in small towns often yearn to experience life in a big city.
chinese.zh: 小鎮的年輕人常常嚮往到大城市體驗生活。

english.en: Many students yearn for more freedom to choose their own courses.
english.zh: 許多學生渴望有更多自由選擇自己的課程。

speak.en: To be honest, I sometimes yearn for the simple days of childhood.
speak.zh: 老實說，我有時很懷念童年那段單純的日子。

write.en: Employees who feel undervalued often yearn for recognition more than a higher salary.
write.zh: 覺得自己不受重視的員工，往往比起加薪更渴望得到肯定。

example.en: Using your phone during study time defeats the purpose of going to the library to concentrate.
example.zh: 讀書時滑手機，就失去了去圖書館專心唸書的意義。

listen.en: She refused to admit defeat and kept trying.
listen.zh: 她不肯認輸，持續努力。

chinese.en: After a narrow defeat last season, the players trained harder than ever before.
chinese.zh: 上季以些微差距落敗後，球員們比以往更加努力訓練。

english.en: Scientists hope this new medicine will help defeat the disease.
english.zh: 科學家希望這種新藥能幫助戰勝這種疾病。

speak.en: Losing that game was a tough defeat, but we learned a lot.
speak.zh: 輸掉那場比賽很難受，但我們學到很多。

write.en: The proposal to build a new airport was defeated after strong opposition from local residents.
write.zh: 興建新機場的提案在當地居民強烈反對下遭到否決。

example.en: Women comprise nearly half of the workforce in the technology sector, a figure that has risen steadily.
example.zh: 女性約佔科技業勞動力的一半，而這個比例一直穩定上升。

listen.en: The course comprises lectures, seminars and practical work.
listen.zh: 這門課包含講課、研討課和實作。

chinese.en: According to the chart, students aged under twenty comprised the largest group of visitors.
chinese.zh: 根據圖表，未滿二十歲的學生是人數最多的訪客族群。

english.en: The apartment comprises a living room, a kitchen and two bedrooms.
english.zh: 這間公寓有一間客廳、一間廚房和兩間臥室。

speak.en: My family is pretty small; it comprises just my parents and me.
speak.zh: 我家人口很少，只有我爸媽和我。

write.en: The new exhibition is comprised of paintings borrowed from major galleries across Europe.
write.zh: 這次的新展覽由向歐洲各大美術館借來的畫作組成。

example.en: Living in the city centre has many advantages, but the high rent is definitely a big minus for young workers.
example.zh: 住在市中心有很多好處，但對年輕上班族來說，高房租絕對是一大缺點。

listen.en: You will pay the full price minus the student discount.
listen.zh: 你要付的是原價扣掉學生折扣後的金額。

chinese.en: Every option has its pluses and minuses, so think carefully before making a decision.
chinese.zh: 每個選項都有優缺點，所以做決定前要仔細考慮。

english.en: My salary, minus taxes, is barely enough to pay the rent.
english.zh: 我的薪水扣掉稅之後，只勉強夠付房租。

speak.en: The only minus is that the gym is quite far from home.
speak.zh: 唯一的缺點是那間健身房離家有點遠。

write.en: The final results are accurate to within plus or minus three percent.
write.zh: 最終結果的誤差範圍在正負百分之三以內。

example.en: The museum displays an impressive array of ancient tools, showing how early humans hunted, cooked and built shelters.
example.zh: 博物館展出大量令人驚豔的古代工具，呈現早期人類如何打獵、烹煮和搭建住所。

listen.en: The hotel offers a vast array of activities for guests.
listen.zh: 這間飯店為房客提供各式各樣的活動。

chinese.en: Universities now provide an array of online courses for students who cannot attend classes.
chinese.zh: 現在大學為無法到校上課的學生提供各種線上課程。

english.en: The new phone has a wide array of useful features.
english.zh: 這支新手機有各式各樣實用的功能。

speak.en: There's a huge array of snacks at the night markets back home.
speak.zh: 我家鄉的夜市有各式各樣、多到數不清的小吃。

write.en: Engineers installed an array of solar panels on the roof of the school.
write.zh: 工程師在學校屋頂裝設了一整排太陽能板。

example.en: Doctors in the emergency department are trained to treat patients suffering from serious head trauma after accidents.
example.zh: 急診室的醫師受過訓練，能治療因意外造成嚴重頭部外傷的病患。

listen.en: Moving to a new school can cause trauma for some children.
listen.zh: 轉學對某些孩子來說可能會造成心理創傷。

chinese.en: Survivors of natural disasters often experience psychological trauma that lasts for years.
chinese.zh: 天災倖存者常會經歷長達數年的心理創傷。

english.en: It took her a long time to get over the trauma of the accident.
english.zh: 她花了很長的時間才走出那場意外的陰影。

speak.en: Failing my driving test was a minor trauma, but I got over it.
speak.zh: 駕照考沒過對我是個小小的打擊，但我已經走出來了。

write.en: Schools should offer counselling services to help students cope with trauma and stress.
write.zh: 學校應該提供輔導服務，幫助學生面對創傷和壓力。

example.en: Some medicines suppress the appetite, so patients may need reminders to eat regular meals during treatment.
example.zh: 有些藥物會抑制食慾，所以病人在治療期間可能需要有人提醒他們定時吃飯。

listen.en: He could not suppress his yawn during the long meeting.
listen.zh: 冗長的會議中，他忍不住打了個呵欠。

chinese.en: Critics claim the company suppressed negative test results to protect the sales of its product.
chinese.zh: 批評者指稱該公司隱瞞了不利的檢測結果，以保住產品的銷售。

english.en: Stress can suppress the immune system and make people more likely to get sick.
english.zh: 壓力會抑制免疫系統，讓人更容易生病。

speak.en: I usually try to suppress my anger rather than argue in public.
speak.zh: 我通常會試著壓住怒氣，而不是在公開場合跟人爭吵。

write.en: Firefighters worked through the night to suppress the fire before it reached nearby homes.
write.zh: 消防員徹夜奮戰，要在火勢延燒到附近住家前將它壓制下來。

example.en: Because the airline lost her baggage, she spent her first day abroad buying clothes and a toothbrush.
example.zh: 因為航空公司弄丟了她的行李，她出國第一天都在買衣服和牙刷。

listen.en: Passengers should keep their baggage with them at all times.
listen.zh: 旅客應隨時將行李帶在身邊。

chinese.en: Many adults carry emotional baggage from childhood that affects how they handle conflict.
chinese.zh: 許多成年人背負著童年留下的心理包袱，影響他們處理衝突的方式。

english.en: The airline charges extra if your baggage is too heavy.
english.zh: 如果你的行李太重，航空公司會額外收費。

speak.en: I always travel light, so I rarely check any baggage.
speak.zh: 我旅行總是輕裝出發，所以很少託運行李。

write.en: Unattended baggage in the station was removed by security staff as a precaution.
write.zh: 車站裡無人看管的行李，已由保全人員基於預防措施移走。

example.en: When the examiner asked the first question, my mind went completely blank and I forgot everything I had prepared.
example.zh: 考官問第一個問題時，我腦中一片空白，準備好的內容全忘了。

listen.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.
listen.zh: 請用正確的字填空。

chinese.en: He gave me a blank look, as if he had never heard of the project before.
chinese.zh: 他一臉茫然地看著我，好像從來沒聽過這個專案似的。

english.en: Please do not leave any questions blank on the form.
english.zh: 表格上的問題請不要留白。

speak.en: I completely blanked when someone asked me for my own phone number.
speak.zh: 有人問我自己的電話號碼時，我竟然一時完全想不起來。

write.en: The artist stared at the blank canvas for an hour before making the first brushstroke.
write.zh: 那位畫家盯著空白的畫布看了一個小時，才畫下第一筆。

example.en: The report lacked depth; it listed the problems but never explained their causes or offered solutions.
example.zh: 這份報告缺乏深度，只列出問題，卻從未解釋原因或提出解決方法。

listen.en: We discussed the issue in depth during the seminar.
listen.zh: 我們在研討課上深入討論了這個議題。

chinese.en: I was impressed by the depth of her knowledge about local history and culture.
chinese.zh: 她對在地歷史與文化的深厚知識讓我印象深刻。

english.en: The depth of the river changes a lot after heavy rain.
english.zh: 大雨過後，這條河的深度會有很大的變化。

speak.en: Honestly, I felt a bit out of my depth at my first job.
speak.zh: 老實說，我第一份工作時覺得有點力不從心。

write.en: Scientists still know very little about the creatures living in the depths of the ocean.
write.zh: 科學家對生活在深海中的生物所知仍然很少。

example.en: A single software error wreaked havoc on the bank's systems, and customers could not access their accounts all day.
example.zh: 僅僅一個軟體錯誤就讓銀行系統大亂，客戶一整天都無法使用帳戶。

listen.en: The heavy snow played havoc with the train schedule.
listen.zh: 大雪把火車時刻表打亂了。

chinese.en: Invasive species can wreak havoc on local ecosystems by competing with native plants for resources.
chinese.zh: 外來入侵物種會和原生植物爭奪資源，對當地生態系造成嚴重破壞。

english.en: Staying up late can play havoc with your sleep and mood.
english.zh: 熬夜會嚴重打亂你的睡眠和情緒。

speak.en: My cat caused total havoc when she knocked over the plants.
speak.zh: 我家的貓把盆栽撞倒，把家裡搞得一團亂。

write.en: The sudden policy change created havoc in schools, as teachers had no time to prepare.
write.zh: 政策突然改變讓學校陷入混亂，因為老師們完全沒有時間準備。

example.en: The water heater in our flat broke last week, so we had to take cold showers until it was repaired.
example.zh: 我們公寓的熱水器上週壞了，所以修好之前我們只能洗冷水澡。

listen.en: Please turn off the heater before you leave the room.
listen.zh: 離開房間前請關掉暖氣。

chinese.en: Using an electric heater in winter can significantly increase a household's electricity bill.
chinese.zh: 冬天使用電暖器可能會讓家庭電費大幅增加。

english.en: You should never leave a heater running while you are asleep.
english.zh: 睡覺時絕對不要讓電暖器一直開著。

speak.en: Our office heater is either broken or way too hot, never in between.
speak.zh: 我們辦公室的暖氣不是壞掉就是太熱，從來沒有剛剛好的時候。

write.en: The school installed new heaters in every classroom after parents complained about the cold.
write.zh: 家長抱怨教室太冷後，學校在每間教室都裝了新的暖氣機。

example.en: The couple realised they were not compatible: she loved busy cities, while he wanted a quiet life in the countryside.
example.zh: 這對情侶發現兩人合不來：她喜歡熱鬧的城市，他卻想在鄉下過安靜的生活。

listen.en: Is this software compatible with my old laptop?
listen.zh: 這個軟體能在我的舊筆電上使用嗎？

chinese.en: Many people believe economic growth is compatible with protecting the environment if policies are well designed.
chinese.zh: 許多人相信，只要政策設計得當，經濟成長和環境保護是可以並存的。

english.en: My new printer is not compatible with the computer in my office.
english.zh: 我的新印表機和辦公室的電腦不相容。

speak.en: My roommate and I are compatible because we're both quite tidy.
speak.zh: 我和室友很合得來，因為我們都滿愛乾淨的。

write.en: Doctors must confirm that the donor's blood type is compatible with the patient's before a transfusion.
write.zh: 輸血前，醫師必須確認捐血者的血型與病患相容。

example.en: Hiring decisions are the manager's prerogative, so the team could only suggest candidates rather than choose them.
example.zh: 聘用決定是經理的權限，所以團隊只能推薦人選，不能自己挑選。

listen.en: It is her prerogative to change her mind.
listen.zh: 要不要改變主意是她的權利。

chinese.en: In many countries, setting interest rates is the prerogative of the central bank, not the government.
chinese.zh: 在許多國家，制定利率是中央銀行的專屬權限，而非政府。

english.en: Deciding the date of the final exam is the teacher's prerogative.
english.zh: 決定期末考的日期是老師的權利。

speak.en: Well, what I wear on weekends is my prerogative, really.
speak.zh: 嗯，週末要穿什麼，說真的是我自己的事。

write.en: Parents sometimes see choosing their children's school as their prerogative, but teenagers want a say too.
write.zh: 父母有時認為選擇孩子的學校是他們的權利，但青少年也想要有發言權。

example.en: Close liaison between hospitals and local clinics ensures that patients receive consistent care after they are discharged.
example.zh: 醫院與地方診所之間的密切聯繫，能確保病人出院後持續獲得一致的照護。

listen.en: The school has a liaison officer for international students.
listen.zh: 學校設有專門負責國際學生的聯絡人員。

chinese.en: The project was delayed because there was little liaison between the engineering and marketing departments.
chinese.zh: 這個專案延誤了，因為工程部和行銷部之間幾乎沒有溝通聯繫。

english.en: Our office works in close liaison with the local police.
english.zh: 我們辦公室和當地警方保持密切聯繫。

speak.en: In my last job, I was the liaison with our suppliers.
speak.zh: 我上一份工作是負責和供應商聯絡的窗口。

write.en: The university appointed a student liaison to share students' concerns with senior administrators.
write.zh: 大學指派了一位學生聯絡人，向高層行政人員轉達學生的意見。

example.en: Before the product reaches shops, it passes through several intermediate stages, including testing, packaging, and quality checks.
example.zh: 產品送到店面之前，要經過好幾個中間階段，包括測試、包裝和品質檢查。

listen.en: My Spanish is at an intermediate level now.
listen.zh: 我的西班牙文現在是中級程度。

chinese.en: The swimming club offers lessons for beginners and intermediates on weekday evenings.
chinese.zh: 這個游泳俱樂部在平日晚上為初學者和中級程度者開課。

english.en: This hiking trail is suitable for intermediate hikers, not beginners.
english.zh: 這條登山步道適合中級程度的登山客，不適合初學者。

speak.en: I'd say my cooking skills are somewhere between beginner and intermediate.
speak.zh: 我覺得我的廚藝大概介於初學和中級之間吧。

write.en: Middlemen act as an intermediate link between farmers and supermarkets, which raises food prices.
write.zh: 中間商在農民與超市之間扮演中間環節，因而推高了食品價格。

example.en: The witness's second statement was full of contradictions, so the police began to doubt her account of the accident.
example.zh: 目擊者的第二次陳述充滿矛盾，因此警方開始懷疑她對事故的說法。

listen.en: Your answers seem to be in direct contradiction.
listen.zh: 你的回答似乎前後直接矛盾。

chinese.en: It is a contradiction to promote healthy eating while selling sugary drinks in school canteens.
chinese.zh: 一邊提倡健康飲食，一邊在學校餐廳販售含糖飲料，實在是自相矛盾。

english.en: There are several obvious contradictions in the company's annual report.
english.zh: 這家公司的年度報告中有幾處明顯的矛盾。

speak.en: I know it's a contradiction, but I love travelling and hate flying.
speak.zh: 我知道這很矛盾，但我熱愛旅行卻討厭搭飛機。

write.en: The scientist's new findings stand in contradiction to the widely accepted theory.
write.zh: 這位科學家的新發現與廣為接受的理論互相矛盾。

example.en: At the end of each chapter, a brief summary highlights the key ideas, so readers can review quickly before exams.
example.zh: 每章結尾都有簡短的摘要列出重點，讓讀者考前能快速複習。

listen.en: In summary, the plan is cheap and easy to manage.
listen.zh: 總而言之，這個計畫便宜又容易管理。

chinese.en: The manager asked for a summary of customer complaints before Friday's meeting.
chinese.zh: 經理要求在週五開會前提交一份客戶抱怨的摘要。

english.en: The news website provides a daily summary of world events.
english.zh: 這個新聞網站每天提供國際大事的摘要。

speak.en: Can you give me a quick summary of the film without spoilers?
speak.zh: 你可以在不爆雷的情況下，簡單幫我講一下這部電影的內容嗎？

write.en: The government published a summary of the report, but critics wanted the full version released.
write.zh: 政府公布了報告摘要，但批評者希望公開完整版本。

example.en: When we see or smell food, saliva secretion rises, preparing the mouth to begin digesting the meal.
example.zh: 當我們看到或聞到食物時，唾液分泌會增加，讓口腔準備開始消化食物。

listen.en: Darkness helps trigger the secretion of a hormone that makes us sleepy.
listen.zh: 黑暗有助於引發一種讓人想睡的荷爾蒙分泌。

chinese.en: Some plants produce sticky secretions that trap insects and protect their leaves from damage.
chinese.zh: 有些植物會產生黏稠的分泌物，用來捕捉昆蟲並保護葉子不受損害。

english.en: Regular exercise can help improve insulin secretion in older adults.
english.zh: 規律運動有助於改善年長者的胰島素分泌。

speak.en: I read somewhere that sweat secretion is how our bodies cool down.
speak.zh: 我在某個地方讀到，流汗是我們身體降溫的方式。

write.en: Researchers are studying how pollution affects mucus secretion in the lungs of city residents.
write.zh: 研究人員正在研究空氣汙染如何影響都市居民肺部的黏液分泌。

example.en: Weeks of rising tension between workers and management finally culminated in a strike that closed the factory.
example.zh: 勞資之間數週來不斷升高的緊張關係，最終演變成一場讓工廠停工的罷工。

listen.en: The festival will culminate with a fireworks show.
listen.zh: 這個節慶將以一場煙火秀作為壓軸。

chinese.en: The students' research project culminated in a public exhibition at the city library.
chinese.zh: 學生們的研究計畫最後在市立圖書館舉辦了公開展覽。

english.en: Their long friendship eventually culminated in a happy marriage last year.
english.zh: 他們長久的友誼最後在去年開花結果，成了幸福的婚姻。

speak.en: My gap year culminated in a trip I'll never forget.
speak.zh: 我的空檔年最後以一趟永生難忘的旅行畫下句點。

write.en: Years of public campaigns culminated in a nationwide ban on single-use plastic bags.
write.zh: 多年的公民倡議最終促成全國禁用一次性塑膠袋。

example.en: The hotel offered every luxury imaginable, from a private pool to a personal chef who cooked whatever guests wanted.
example.zh: 這家飯店提供你想像得到的一切奢華享受，從私人泳池到能依客人喜好下廚的專屬主廚。

listen.en: They lived in luxury after selling their company.
listen.zh: 他們賣掉公司後就過著奢華的生活。

chinese.en: Sales of luxury goods have continued to grow despite the slowdown in the global economy.
chinese.zh: 儘管全球經濟放緩，奢侈品的銷售仍持續成長。

english.en: Having a car in a big city is a luxury.
english.zh: 在大城市裡擁有一輛車是一種奢侈。

speak.en: Sleeping in on a Sunday morning is my favourite little luxury.
speak.zh: 星期天早上睡到自然醒，是我最喜歡的小確幸。

write.en: Busy doctors rarely have the luxury of taking a long lunch break.
write.zh: 忙碌的醫師很少有餘裕好好休息吃頓長長的午餐。

example.en: The committee was split over the new parking plan, with half supporting it and the rest strongly opposed.
example.zh: 委員會對新的停車計畫意見分歧，一半支持，其餘的人強烈反對。

listen.en: The teacher split the class into small groups.
listen.zh: 老師把全班分成幾個小組。

chinese.en: The company plans to split into separate firms to focus on different markets.
chinese.zh: 這家公司計畫分拆成幾家獨立公司，以專注於不同的市場。

english.en: My brother and I split the cost of our mother's birthday present.
english.zh: 我和哥哥一起分攤了媽媽生日禮物的費用。

speak.en: I split my time between studying and working at a café.
speak.zh: 我把時間分配在念書和在咖啡廳打工上。

write.en: Heavy rain caused a split in the old wall, so builders had to repair it.
write.zh: 大雨讓那面老牆出現裂縫，所以工人必須修補。

example.en: A tortoise can pull its head inside its hard shell whenever it senses danger from a predator.
example.zh: 烏龜一察覺到掠食者的威脅，就能把頭縮進堅硬的殼裡。

listen.en: Please remove the shells before you add the shrimp.
listen.zh: 加入蝦子之前，請先把殼剝掉。

chinese.en: After the fire, only the shell of the old factory building was left standing.
chinese.zh: 大火過後，那棟舊工廠只剩下建築外殼還矗立著。

english.en: My grandmother taught me how to shell peanuts quickly by hand.
english.zh: 我奶奶教我如何用手快速剝花生殼。

speak.en: He was really shy at first, but he's come out of his shell.
speak.zh: 他一開始很害羞，不過現在已經放開多了。

write.en: Rising ocean acidity makes it harder for oysters and clams to build their shells.
write.zh: 海洋酸化加劇，讓牡蠣和蛤蜊越來越難形成外殼。

example.en: The professor checked each bibliography carefully, because students who copied ideas without citing sources could fail the course.
example.zh: 教授仔細檢查每份參考書目，因為抄襲他人觀點卻未註明出處的學生可能會被當掉。

listen.en: Her essay has a long and detailed bibliography.
listen.zh: 她的論文附有一份又長又詳細的參考書目。

chinese.en: The library offers online tools that help researchers format their bibliographies automatically.
chinese.zh: 圖書館提供線上工具，幫助研究人員自動排版參考書目。

english.en: The publisher asked the author to update the bibliography for the new edition.
english.zh: 出版社請作者為新版更新參考書目。

speak.en: Honestly, writing the bibliography always takes me longer than I expect.
speak.zh: 老實說，寫參考書目總是比我預期的還要花時間。

write.en: The report on air pollution included a bibliography of government studies and news articles.
write.zh: 那份空氣汙染報告附有一份參考書目，列出政府研究與新聞報導。

example.en: The laser cuts metal so precisely that the factory produces almost no waste, which lowers costs significantly.
example.zh: 雷射切割金屬非常精準，工廠幾乎不產生廢料，大幅降低了成本。

listen.en: You should never point a laser at someone's eyes.
listen.zh: 絕對不要把雷射光對著別人的眼睛。

chinese.en: The speaker used a laser pointer to highlight key figures on the chart.
chinese.zh: 講者用雷射筆標示圖表上的重要數據。

english.en: Scientists use lasers to measure the distance to the moon.
english.zh: 科學家利用雷射來測量地球到月球的距離。

speak.en: I'm thinking about laser eye surgery, but I'm a bit nervous.
speak.zh: 我在考慮做雷射眼睛手術，但有點緊張。

write.en: The concert ended with a dazzling laser show that lit up the whole stadium.
write.zh: 演唱會以一場炫目的雷射秀收尾，照亮了整座體育場。

example.en: Washing your hands with soap removes most harmful bacteria, which is why doctors stress it during flu season.
example.zh: 用肥皂洗手能去除大部分有害細菌，這就是醫生在流感季節特別強調洗手的原因。

listen.en: Some bacteria are actually good for your gut health.
listen.zh: 有些細菌其實對腸道健康有益。

chinese.en: Antibiotics kill bacteria, but they are useless against viruses such as the common cold.
chinese.zh: 抗生素能殺死細菌，但對一般感冒這類病毒毫無作用。

english.en: Food left on the table overnight may contain dangerous bacteria.
english.zh: 在桌上放了一整晚的食物可能含有危險的細菌。

speak.en: I replace my kitchen sponge often because it's full of bacteria.
speak.zh: 我常常更換廚房菜瓜布，因為上面滿是細菌。

write.en: Researchers discovered a bacterium that can break down plastic waste in landfills.
write.zh: 研究人員發現一種能分解掩埋場塑膠垃圾的細菌。

example.en: Despite repeated assurances from the airline, passengers waited for hours without any updates about their delayed flight.
example.zh: 儘管航空公司一再保證，乘客們仍苦等了好幾個小時，始終沒有得到延誤班機的任何最新消息。

listen.en: She spoke with quiet assurance during the job interview.
listen.zh: 她在工作面試時說話沉穩而有自信。

chinese.en: Investors want clear assurances that their savings will be protected if the bank fails.
chinese.zh: 投資人希望得到明確的保證：萬一銀行倒閉，他們的存款仍會受到保障。

english.en: The teacher's assurance helped the nervous students feel calmer before the exam.
english.zh: 老師的保證讓緊張的學生在考試前比較冷靜。

speak.en: Honestly, I need some assurance that the job is stable.
speak.zh: 老實說，我需要一些保證，確定這份工作是穩定的。

write.en: Our company introduced a quality assurance process to reduce errors in every product we ship.
write.zh: 我們公司導入了品質保證流程，以減少每件出貨產品的錯誤。

example.en: After weeks of training, the team made a supreme effort in the last match and won the championship.
example.zh: 經過幾週的訓練，球隊在最後一場比賽中全力以赴，贏得了冠軍。

listen.en: Safety is of supreme importance on any building site.
listen.zh: 在任何工地，安全都是最重要的。

chinese.en: In many households, the smartphone now reigns supreme as the main source of entertainment.
chinese.zh: 在許多家庭裡，智慧型手機如今稱霸，成為最主要的娛樂來源。

english.en: Customer satisfaction is the company's supreme goal for this year.
english.zh: 顧客滿意是公司今年的最高目標。

speak.en: For me, a good night's sleep is the supreme luxury.
speak.zh: 對我來說，睡個好覺就是最奢侈的享受。

write.en: The constitution is the supreme law of the country, and every other law must follow it.
write.zh: 憲法是國家的最高法律，其他所有法律都必須遵循它。

example.en: Both sides agreed to meet again next month, hoping to reach a peaceful resolution of the long dispute over land.
example.zh: 雙方同意下個月再次會面，希望能和平解決這場長期的土地糾紛。

listen.en: This camera takes photos with very high resolution.
listen.zh: 這台相機拍的照片解析度非常高。

chinese.en: The committee passed a resolution to ban plastic bags in all campus shops.
chinese.zh: 委員會通過一項決議，禁止校園內所有商店提供塑膠袋。

english.en: He showed great resolution when he decided to quit smoking.
english.zh: 他決定戒菸時展現了極大的決心。

speak.en: I usually break my resolutions by the end of January.
speak.zh: 我通常到一月底就放棄自己的新年新希望了。

write.en: Quick resolution of customer complaints can greatly improve a company's reputation online.
write.zh: 迅速解決顧客投訴，可以大幅提升公司在網路上的聲譽。

example.en: Volunteering at the shelter was tiring, but the reward of seeing the animals adopted made every hour worthwhile.
example.zh: 在收容所當志工很累，但看到動物被領養的那份回報，讓付出的每個小時都值得。

listen.en: Hard work is usually rewarded in the end.
listen.zh: 努力通常最後都會有回報。

chinese.en: The police offered a reward for any information about the missing painting.
chinese.zh: 警方懸賞徵求任何有關那幅下落不明畫作的線索。

english.en: Parents should not always reward their children with sweets or toys.
english.zh: 父母不應該總是用糖果或玩具來獎勵孩子。

speak.en: After finishing my exams, I rewarded myself with a short trip.
speak.zh: 考完試之後，我用一趟短程旅行犒賞自己。

write.en: Investing in renewable energy is risky, but the long-term rewards could be enormous.
write.zh: 投資再生能源有風險，但長期的回報可能非常可觀。

example.en: Firefighters wore masks because the burning plastic released toxic fumes that could damage their lungs.
example.zh: 消防員戴著面罩，因為燃燒的塑膠會釋放出可能傷害肺部的有毒煙霧。

listen.en: Some common garden plants are toxic to cats and dogs.
listen.zh: 一些常見的庭園植物對貓狗有毒。

chinese.en: She finally left the job because the workplace had become too toxic to bear.
chinese.zh: 她最後辭掉了那份工作，因為職場氛圍已經惡劣到讓人無法忍受。

english.en: Many cleaning products contain chemicals that are toxic to fish.
english.zh: 許多清潔用品含有對魚類有毒的化學物質。

speak.en: I try to avoid toxic people who only complain all day.
speak.zh: 我盡量避開那些整天只會抱怨、滿是負能量的人。

write.en: Governments must set stricter limits on toxic emissions from cars to protect public health.
write.zh: 政府必須對汽車排放的有毒廢氣設定更嚴格的限制，以保護大眾健康。

example.en: Advertisements often portray fast food as cheap and fun, while rarely mentioning its effects on long-term health.
example.zh: 廣告常把速食描繪成便宜又有趣，卻很少提到它對長期健康的影響。

listen.en: The actor portrayed the old teacher very convincingly.
listen.zh: 那位演員把老教師一角詮釋得非常逼真。

chinese.en: In the novel, the city is portrayed as a lonely place full of strangers.
chinese.zh: 在這本小說中，這座城市被描寫成一個滿是陌生人的孤寂之地。

english.en: The documentary portrays today's teenagers as creative and highly independent.
english.zh: 這部紀錄片把現今的青少年描繪成富有創意且非常獨立。

speak.en: I think social media rarely portrays people's real lives.
speak.zh: 我覺得社群媒體很少呈現人們真實的生活。

write.en: History textbooks should portray past events accurately, including mistakes made by the nation.
write.zh: 歷史課本應該如實描述過去的事件，包括國家曾經犯下的錯誤。

example.en: As the evening news anchor, she had to stay calm and read breaking stories clearly, even when things went wrong.
example.zh: 身為晚間新聞主播，即使出了狀況，她也必須保持冷靜，清楚播報突發新聞。

listen.en: The tent was anchored firmly to the ground.
listen.zh: 帳篷被牢牢固定在地上。

chinese.en: Tourism has become the anchor of the island's economy over the past decade.
chinese.zh: 過去十年來，觀光業已成為這座島嶼的經濟支柱。

english.en: The ship anchored near the harbour because of the strong wind.
english.zh: 由於強風，那艘船停泊在港口附近。

speak.en: My grandmother has always been the anchor of our family.
speak.zh: 我的奶奶一直是我們家的精神支柱。

write.en: Large department stores often anchor shopping malls and attract visitors to smaller shops nearby.
write.zh: 大型百貨公司常是購物中心的主力店，能把顧客帶到附近較小的店家。

example.en: With unemployment rising and consumer spending falling for months, economists warned that the country was heading into a recession.
example.zh: 由於失業率上升、消費支出連續數月下滑，經濟學家警告這個國家正走向經濟衰退。

listen.en: Housing prices dropped sharply during the long recession.
listen.zh: 房價在那段漫長的經濟衰退期間大幅下跌。

chinese.en: The graph shows that tourism declined steadily until the recession finally ended.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，觀光業持續下滑，直到經濟衰退終於結束。

english.en: Many graduates could not find jobs because of the recession.
english.zh: 因為經濟不景氣，許多畢業生找不到工作。

speak.en: My parents saved more money when the recession hit.
speak.zh: 經濟衰退來襲時，我爸媽存了更多錢。

write.en: It took the economy several years to fully recover from the deep recession.
write.zh: 經濟花了好幾年才從那次嚴重的衰退中完全復甦。

example.en: Before retiring, the head chef spent a year imparting his skills and secret recipes to the younger cooks in the kitchen.
example.zh: 退休前，主廚花了一年時間，把他的手藝和祕方傳授給廚房裡的年輕廚師。

listen.en: Burning oak wood imparts a rich flavour to the meat.
listen.zh: 燃燒橡木能為肉增添濃郁的風味。

chinese.en: The doctor imparted the bad news gently, giving the family time to ask questions.
chinese.zh: 醫生委婉地告知這個壞消息，並給家屬時間提問。

english.en: Parents should impart good values to their children from an early age.
english.zh: 父母應該從小就把良好的價值觀傳授給孩子。

speak.en: My grandfather imparted a lot of practical wisdom to me.
speak.zh: 我爺爺傳授了我許多實用的人生智慧。

write.en: Online courses can impart useful skills, but they cannot fully replace hands-on experience.
write.zh: 線上課程能傳授實用的技能，但無法完全取代實際動手的經驗。

example.en: My brother tried to bake a cake without a recipe, and the result was a hilarious disaster that nobody could eat.
example.zh: 我哥哥試著不看食譜烤蛋糕，結果是一場沒人吃得下的爆笑災難。

listen.en: We all found the teacher's story absolutely hilarious.
listen.zh: 我們都覺得老師講的故事超級好笑。

chinese.en: Online videos of pets doing hilarious things often attract millions of views.
chinese.zh: 網路上寵物做出爆笑舉動的影片，常常吸引數百萬次觀看。

english.en: The speaker opened his talk with a hilarious story about his first job.
english.zh: 講者以一個關於他第一份工作的爆笑故事作為演講開場。

speak.en: Honestly, my best friend is hilarious when she's tired.
speak.zh: 說真的，我最好的朋友累的時候超搞笑。

write.en: Using hilarious examples in class can help students remember difficult grammar rules more easily.
write.zh: 上課時用爆笑的例子，能幫助學生更容易記住困難的文法規則。

example.en: There is no exact English equivalent for some Chinese expressions, so translators often have to explain their meaning instead.
example.zh: 有些中文說法在英文裡沒有完全對應的詞，所以譯者常常得改用解釋的方式。

listen.en: His salary is equivalent to what a doctor earns.
listen.zh: 他的薪水和醫生的收入相當。

chinese.en: The project cost the equivalent of a year's budget for the entire department.
chinese.zh: 這個計畫花掉了相當於整個部門一年的預算。

english.en: Is this certificate equivalent to a university degree in your country?
english.zh: 這張證書在你們國家相當於大學學位嗎？

speak.en: Walking to work is the equivalent of a short daily workout.
speak.zh: 走路上班就相當於每天做一次簡短的運動。

write.en: Women should receive equivalent pay for doing the same job as men.
write.zh: 女性做和男性相同的工作，應該得到同等的薪資。

example.en: The hotel lobby looked fancy, with marble floors and crystal lights, but the rooms upstairs were surprisingly plain.
example.zh: 飯店大廳看起來很高級，有大理石地板和水晶燈，但樓上的房間卻出乎意料地簡樸。

listen.en: Do you fancy going to the cinema tonight?
listen.zh: 你今晚想去看電影嗎？

chinese.en: I don't need a fancy phone; I just want one with a good battery.
chinese.zh: 我不需要高級的手機，只想要一支電池續航力好的。

english.en: She really doesn't fancy working late again on Friday evenings.
english.zh: 她真的不想星期五晚上又加班到很晚。

speak.en: Nothing fancy, just a simple dinner with friends at home.
speak.zh: 沒什麼特別的，只是和朋友在家吃頓簡單的晚餐。

write.en: Students do not need fancy equipment to learn science; simple experiments can be just as effective.
write.zh: 學生學習科學不需要高級的設備，簡單的實驗也一樣有效。

example.en: When the teacher announced a surprise test on the last day before the holiday, the whole class let out a loud groan.
example.zh: 老師在放假前最後一天宣布要臨時小考，全班都大聲哀號。

listen.en: The old wooden floor groaned under our feet.
listen.zh: 老舊的木地板在我們腳下嘎吱作響。

chinese.en: Commuters often groan about crowded trains, but few are willing to drive instead.
chinese.zh: 通勤族常抱怨火車擁擠，但很少有人願意改成開車。

english.en: He groaned when he saw the long line at the bank.
english.zh: 他看到銀行大排長龍時，不禁唉聲嘆氣。

speak.en: I always groan when my alarm goes off on Monday.
speak.zh: 星期一鬧鐘響起時，我總是忍不住哀號。

write.en: The library shelves were groaning under the weight of thousands of old books.
write.zh: 圖書館的書架被成千上萬本舊書壓得不堪負荷。

example.en: Before mass production begins, the company tests each prototype carefully to find design problems and fix them early.
example.zh: 在量產開始之前，公司會仔細測試每一個原型，及早找出設計問題並加以修正。

listen.en: Our team showed a working prototype at the fair.
listen.zh: 我們團隊在展覽會上展示了一個可運作的原型。

chinese.en: The students spent the whole semester developing a prototype for a smart recycling bin.
chinese.zh: 學生們花了一整個學期開發智慧回收桶的原型。

english.en: The first prototype was too heavy, so they made it smaller.
english.zh: 第一個原型太重了，所以他們把它做得更小。

speak.en: I'd love to see the prototype before it goes on sale.
speak.zh: 我很想在它上市前先看看原型。

write.en: This small village became the prototype for eco-friendly communities across the region.
write.zh: 這座小村莊成了全區環保社區的典範。

example.en: Although the royal family no longer holds real political power, it still attracts huge public interest and media attention.
example.zh: 雖然王室已不再握有實際的政治權力，仍然吸引大眾高度關注與媒體注意。

listen.en: The old castle belonged to a royal family long ago.
listen.zh: 那座古堡很久以前屬於一個王室家族。

chinese.en: Newspapers in some countries publish stories about the royals almost every day.
chinese.zh: 有些國家的報紙幾乎每天都刊登有關王室成員的報導。

english.en: The museum displays jewels that were once worn at royal weddings.
english.zh: 這間博物館展出曾在王室婚禮上配戴過的珠寶。

speak.en: We really got the royal treatment at their house last weekend.
speak.zh: 上週末我們在他們家受到了貴賓級的款待。

write.en: Some people believe royal ceremonies waste public money, while others value them as part of national tradition.
write.zh: 有些人認為王室典禮浪費公帑，也有人把它們視為國家傳統的一部分而加以珍惜。

example.en: The old church is now used for secular purposes, such as concerts, art exhibitions and community meetings.
example.zh: 那座老教堂現在改作非宗教用途，例如音樂會、藝術展覽和社區會議。

listen.en: The festival has become more secular over the years.
listen.zh: 這些年來，這個節日變得越來越世俗化。

chinese.en: In a secular state, laws are made without reference to any particular religion.
chinese.zh: 在世俗國家，法律的制定不以任何特定宗教為依據。

english.en: Many couples now choose a secular wedding ceremony in a garden.
english.zh: 現在許多新人選擇在花園舉辦非宗教的婚禮。

speak.en: Most of my friends celebrate Christmas in a secular way.
speak.zh: 我大部分的朋友都用非宗教的方式過聖誕節。

write.en: The museum displays both religious and secular art from the same historical period.
write.zh: 這間博物館同時展出同一歷史時期的宗教藝術與世俗藝術。

example.en: After years of constant arguments, the couple decided that divorce was the best option for both themselves and their children.
example.zh: 多年來爭吵不斷，這對夫妻認為離婚對他們自己和孩子都是最好的選擇。

listen.en: His parents got divorced when he was very young.
listen.zh: 他還很小的時候，父母就離婚了。

chinese.en: Art should never be completely divorced from the everyday lives of ordinary people.
chinese.zh: 藝術永遠不該與一般人的日常生活完全脫節。

english.en: Children often feel confused and sad when their parents divorce.
english.zh: 父母離婚時，孩子常常感到困惑又難過。

speak.en: I think divorce is much more accepted now than before.
speak.zh: 我覺得現在社會比以前更能接受離婚。

write.en: Some argue that economic policy cannot be divorced from social issues like housing and education.
write.zh: 有些人認為，經濟政策無法與住房和教育等社會議題分開來看。

example.en: Although the starting salary was modest, the company offered free training, flexible hours and good chances for promotion.
example.zh: 雖然起薪不高，但公司提供免費培訓、彈性工時和良好的升遷機會。

listen.en: Most of my salary goes on rent and food.
listen.zh: 我大部分的薪水都花在房租和伙食上。

chinese.en: Many young graduates feel their salaries are too low to afford a home.
chinese.zh: 許多年輕畢業生覺得自己的薪水太低，買不起房子。

english.en: He asked his boss for a salary increase after the successful project.
english.zh: 專案成功後，他向老闆要求加薪。

speak.en: For me, job satisfaction matters more than a big salary.
speak.zh: 對我來說，工作滿足感比高薪更重要。

write.en: Many people believe nurses and teachers deserve higher salaries than professional athletes.
write.zh: 許多人認為護理師和教師應該比職業運動員領更高的薪水。

example.en: The psychological thriller kept viewers guessing until the very end, when the quiet neighbour was revealed as the true criminal.
example.zh: 這部心理驚悚片讓觀眾一路猜到最後，才揭曉那位安靜的鄰居才是真正的犯人。

listen.en: My little sister prefers romantic comedies to dark thrillers.
listen.zh: 我妹妹喜歡浪漫喜劇，勝過黑暗的驚悚片。

chinese.en: The final match was a real thriller, with the winning goal scored in the last minute.
chinese.zh: 決賽真是扣人心弦，致勝的一球在最後一分鐘才踢進。

english.en: This spy thriller was made into a popular television series.
english.zh: 這部間諜驚悚小說被改編成一部熱門電視劇。

speak.en: I love a good thriller on a rainy weekend.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡在下雨的週末看一部好看的驚悚片。

write.en: Some parents worry that violent thrillers may not be suitable for younger teenagers.
write.zh: 有些家長擔心暴力驚悚片可能不適合年紀較小的青少年。

example.en: The town grew rapidly in the nineteenth century because it stood at the junction of two major railway lines.
example.zh: 這座小鎮在十九世紀迅速發展，因為它位於兩條主要鐵路線的交會處。

listen.en: There was a traffic jam at the busy junction.
listen.zh: 那個繁忙的路口塞車了。

chinese.en: Accidents often happen at this junction because drivers cannot see oncoming cars clearly.
chinese.zh: 這個路口常發生車禍，因為駕駛看不清楚迎面而來的車輛。

english.en: The café is located at the junction of the main road and the river path.
english.zh: 那家咖啡館位於主要道路和河濱步道的交會處。

speak.en: Just wait for me at the junction near the bakery.
speak.zh: 你就在麵包店附近的路口等我吧。

write.en: The city plans to install new traffic lights at several dangerous junctions near schools.
write.zh: 市政府計畫在學校附近幾個危險路口設置新的紅綠燈。

example.en: Despite all the rhetoric about protecting the environment, the company has done very little to cut its emissions.
example.zh: 儘管嘴上說了一堆保護環境的話，這家公司在減少排放上幾乎沒做什麼。

listen.en: Her rhetoric was powerful, but nobody trusted her.
listen.zh: 她的言辭很有說服力，但沒有人信任她。

chinese.en: Students in the course learn how ancient writers used rhetoric to persuade their audiences.
chinese.zh: 這門課的學生學習古代作家如何運用修辭來說服聽眾。

english.en: The public is tired of empty rhetoric and wants real action.
english.zh: 大眾已經厭倦了空洞的言辭，想要看到真正的行動。

speak.en: To be honest, I don't trust advertising rhetoric very much.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不太相信廣告裡那些漂亮話。

write.en: The manager's rhetoric of teamwork did not match the way she actually treated her staff.
write.zh: 那位經理口口聲聲說團隊合作，實際對待員工的方式卻完全不是那回事。

example.en: Before writing the full report, the team sketched out the main ideas on a whiteboard so everyone agreed on the structure.
example.zh: 在撰寫完整報告之前，團隊先在白板上勾勒出主要構想，讓大家對架構達成共識。

listen.en: He likes to sketch people sitting in the park.
listen.zh: 他喜歡素描坐在公園裡的人。

chinese.en: The article only gives a brief sketch of the city's history, so further reading is needed.
chinese.zh: 這篇文章只簡略介紹了這座城市的歷史，所以還需要進一步閱讀。

english.en: The architect quickly sketched a design for the new library.
english.zh: 建築師很快地畫出新圖書館的設計草圖。

speak.en: When I travel, I usually sketch the places I visit.
speak.zh: 我旅行的時候，通常會把去過的地方畫下來。

write.en: The comedy show included a funny sketch about people who cannot stop checking their phones.
write.zh: 這個喜劇節目有一段好笑的短劇，內容是關於一直忍不住看手機的人。

example.en: After spraining her ankle during the match, the player had to rest for weeks and could not walk without crutches.
example.zh: 那名選手在比賽中扭傷腳踝後，必須休養好幾週，而且不拄拐杖就沒辦法走路。

listen.en: My ankle still hurts after the long walk.
listen.zh: 走了很長一段路之後，我的腳踝還在痛。

chinese.en: Wearing proper hiking boots can help protect your ankles on rocky mountain trails.
chinese.zh: 穿合適的登山靴，有助於在多岩石的山路上保護腳踝。

english.en: The doctor said my ankle would heal in about two weeks.
english.zh: 醫生說我的腳踝大約兩週就會好。

speak.en: I hurt my ankle playing basketball, so I'm taking a break.
speak.zh: 我打籃球時弄傷了腳踝，所以現在先休息一陣子。

write.en: Elderly people who do simple balance exercises are less likely to injure their ankles in falls.
write.zh: 做簡單平衡運動的長者，比較不容易因跌倒而傷到腳踝。

example.en: The heavy snowstorm paralysed the city's transport system, leaving thousands of commuters stranded at stations overnight.
example.zh: 大風雪讓整座城市的交通系統癱瘓，數千名通勤族整夜受困在車站。

listen.en: Fear can paralyse people when they need to act quickly.
listen.zh: 在需要迅速行動的時候，恐懼可能會讓人動彈不得。

chinese.en: A strike by air traffic controllers paralysed flights across the country for several days.
chinese.zh: 航管人員罷工，讓全國航班停擺了好幾天。

english.en: A computer virus completely paralysed the hospital's booking system yesterday.
english.zh: 昨天一個電腦病毒讓醫院的掛號系統完全癱瘓。

speak.en: Before exams, I sometimes feel paralysed by stress and can't start.
speak.zh: 考試前，我有時候會被壓力壓得動彈不得，完全沒辦法開始。

write.en: Endless debate among the committee members paralysed the decision-making process for months.
write.zh: 委員之間無止境的爭論，讓決策過程停擺了好幾個月。

example.en: After years of not speaking to each other, the two brothers were finally reconciled at their mother's birthday party.
example.zh: 兩兄弟多年互不說話，終於在母親的生日派對上和好了。

listen.en: She tried to reconcile her friends after their argument.
listen.zh: 她的朋友吵架後，她試著讓他們和好。

chinese.en: Governments must find ways to reconcile economic growth with the need to protect nature.
chinese.zh: 政府必須想辦法在經濟成長與保護自然之間取得平衡。

english.en: The accountant could not reconcile the figures in the two reports.
english.zh: 會計師無法讓兩份報告裡的數據對得起來。

speak.en: I find it hard to reconcile myself to living so far from home.
speak.zh: 我覺得很難接受自己住得離家這麼遠。

write.en: The new plan tries to reconcile the different interests of residents, shop owners and tourists.
write.zh: 新計畫試圖兼顧居民、店家和觀光客各自不同的利益。

example.en: Instead of letting parliament decide, the city asked its citizens to vote directly in a referendum on building the new airport.
example.zh: 市政府沒有交由議會決定，而是請市民直接以公投表決是否興建新機場。

listen.en: Many people voted in the referendum last weekend.
listen.zh: 上週末有很多人去參加公投。

chinese.en: The result of the referendum showed that most residents supported the plan to ban cars downtown.
chinese.zh: 公投結果顯示，大多數居民支持禁止汽車進入市中心的計畫。

english.en: Voter turnout in the referendum was much lower than expected.
english.zh: 這次公投的投票率比預期低很多。

speak.en: I think a referendum is a fair way to decide big issues.
speak.zh: 我認為公投是決定重大議題的一種公平方式。

write.en: Our university held an online referendum to decide whether students should pay a new sports fee.
write.zh: 我們大學舉辦了一次線上投票，決定學生是否要繳交新的運動設施費。

example.en: Weather forecasters study radar images to track heavy rain clouds and warn residents before a storm reaches the coast.
example.zh: 氣象預報員研究雷達影像來追蹤強降雨雲層，在暴風雨抵達沿海前提醒居民。

listen.en: The plane suddenly disappeared from the radar screen.
listen.zh: 那架飛機突然從雷達螢幕上消失了。

chinese.en: Mental health was not on the radar of most companies until quite recently.
chinese.zh: 直到最近，心理健康才開始受到大多數公司的關注。

english.en: The police use radar to catch drivers who are speeding.
english.zh: 警察用雷達抓超速的駕駛。

speak.en: That small café was off my radar until a friend recommended it.
speak.zh: 那間小咖啡店我本來完全沒注意到，直到朋友推薦給我。

write.en: Bats find insects in the dark using a natural form of radar called echolocation.
write.zh: 蝙蝠利用一種叫做回聲定位的天然雷達，在黑暗中找到昆蟲。

example.en: The fishing net was a tangle of ropes and seaweed, and it took the fishermen an hour to sort it out.
example.zh: 漁網和繩子、海草纏成一團，漁夫花了一個小時才把它理清楚。

listen.en: Brush your hair gently so it does not tangle.
listen.zh: 輕輕梳頭髮，才不會打結。

chinese.en: The company got tangled up in a long legal dispute with its former supplier.
chinese.zh: 這家公司和以前的供應商捲入了一場漫長的法律糾紛。

english.en: Sea turtles often become tangled in old plastic fishing lines.
english.zh: 海龜常常被廢棄的塑膠釣魚線纏住。

speak.en: Honestly, my desk is just a tangle of cables and chargers.
speak.zh: 說真的，我的書桌上就是一團亂糟糟的電線和充電器。

write.en: The city's tangle of narrow streets makes it easy for visitors to get lost.
write.zh: 這座城市錯綜複雜的窄巷，讓遊客很容易迷路。

example.en: Because bicycle theft is so common near the station, many commuters now use two locks and park in guarded areas.
example.zh: 因為車站附近腳踏車失竊很常見，許多通勤族現在都用兩道鎖，並停在有人看管的區域。

listen.en: She reported the theft of her phone to the police.
listen.zh: 她向警方報案說手機被偷了。

chinese.en: Identity theft has become a serious problem as more people shop and bank online.
chinese.zh: 隨著越來越多人在網路上購物和使用網路銀行，身分盜用已成為嚴重的問題。

english.en: Our travel insurance covers the theft or loss of luggage.
english.zh: 我們的旅遊保險有涵蓋行李失竊或遺失。

speak.en: Luckily, theft isn't a big problem in my neighbourhood.
speak.zh: 幸好，我住的社區沒什麼竊盜問題。

write.en: Copying another student's ideas without credit is a form of intellectual theft at university.
write.zh: 在大學裡，抄襲其他學生的想法卻不註明出處，是一種竊取智慧成果的行為。

example.en: Thanks to generous subsidies for solar panels, many households have installed them and now pay far less for electricity.
example.zh: 多虧太陽能板有優渥的補助，許多家庭都裝了，現在電費省了很多。

listen.en: The city offers a subsidy for buying electric scooters.
listen.zh: 市政府提供購買電動機車的補助。

chinese.en: Critics argue that fuel subsidies encourage waste and make it harder to reduce pollution.
chinese.zh: 批評者認為，燃料補貼會助長浪費，讓減少污染變得更困難。

english.en: The government plans to cut subsidies for public transport next year.
english.zh: 政府計畫明年削減大眾運輸的補助。

speak.en: Without a housing subsidy, I couldn't afford to rent in the city.
speak.zh: 如果沒有租屋補助，我根本負擔不起在市區租房子。

write.en: Some theatres rely heavily on state subsidies because ticket sales alone cannot cover their costs.
write.zh: 有些劇院非常依賴政府補助，因為光靠票房無法支付開銷。

example.en: Researchers searched an online database of medical journals to find every study published on sleep and memory.
example.zh: 研究人員搜尋線上醫學期刊資料庫，找出所有關於睡眠與記憶的研究。

listen.en: Please enter your details into the customer database.
listen.zh: 請把你的資料輸入客戶資料庫。

chinese.en: The company stores personal information in a secure database that only managers can access.
chinese.zh: 公司把個人資料存放在只有主管能存取的安全資料庫裡。

english.en: Our school built a database to record students' exam results.
english.zh: 我們學校建立了一個資料庫來記錄學生的考試成績。

speak.en: At work, I spend most of my time updating the database.
speak.zh: 上班時，我大部分時間都在更新資料庫。

write.en: Hackers broke into the shop's database and stole thousands of customers' email addresses.
write.zh: 駭客入侵那家店的資料庫，偷走了數千名顧客的電子郵件地址。

example.en: A single viral video propelled the unknown singer to fame, and within weeks she was performing at major festivals.
example.zh: 一支爆紅影片讓這位默默無名的歌手一夕成名，短短幾週她就登上各大音樂節演出。

listen.en: Strong winds propelled the sailing boat across the lake.
listen.zh: 強風推著帆船橫越湖面。

chinese.en: Rising exports have propelled the country's economy into a period of rapid growth.
chinese.zh: 出口增加帶動這個國家的經濟進入快速成長期。

english.en: Her hard work propelled her into a top management position.
english.zh: 她的努力讓她晉升到高階主管的職位。

speak.en: I think curiosity is what propels me to keep learning.
speak.zh: 我覺得是好奇心驅使我持續學習。

write.en: Fish propel themselves through the water by moving their tails from side to side.
write.zh: 魚靠左右擺動尾巴在水中前進。

example.en: During rush hour, traffic on the main road slows to a crawl, so many office workers prefer to take the metro.
example.zh: 尖峰時段主要道路上的車流慢得像在爬，所以很多上班族寧願搭捷運。

listen.en: A small spider crawled slowly up the wall.
listen.zh: 一隻小蜘蛛慢慢地爬上牆。

chinese.en: The old bus crawled up the steep mountain road while passengers enjoyed the view.
chinese.zh: 老舊的公車沿著陡峭的山路緩緩往上開，乘客則欣賞著沿途風景。

english.en: We had to crawl under the fence to get our ball back.
english.zh: 我們得從圍籬底下爬過去，才能把球拿回來。

speak.en: After that long hike, I just wanted to crawl into bed.
speak.zh: 爬完那趟長途山路後，我只想趕快鑽進被窩。

write.en: Search engines use programs that crawl the web and collect information from millions of pages.
write.zh: 搜尋引擎使用會在網路上爬取資料的程式，從數百萬個網頁蒐集資訊。

example.en: Recent surveys reveal a growing tendency among young adults to rent rather than buy, mainly because house prices keep rising.
example.zh: 最近的調查顯示，越來越多年輕人傾向租屋而非買房，主要是因為房價持續上漲。

listen.en: She has a tendency to forget people's names.
listen.zh: 她常常會忘記別人的名字。

chinese.en: There is a natural tendency for people to trust information that matches their own opinions.
chinese.zh: 人天生傾向於相信符合自己看法的資訊。

english.en: This type of car has a tendency to overheat in summer.
english.zh: 這款車在夏天容易過熱。

speak.en: I have a tendency to leave everything until the last minute.
speak.zh: 我有個習慣，就是什麼事都拖到最後一刻才做。

write.en: Doctors warn that the tendency to skip breakfast may affect students' concentration in class.
write.zh: 醫生提醒，不吃早餐的習慣可能會影響學生上課的專注力。

example.en: With patience and sheer determination, the small village team raised enough money to rebuild the school destroyed by floods.
example.zh: 憑著耐心和堅定的毅力，這個小村莊的團隊募到足夠的錢，重建被洪水沖毀的學校。

listen.en: His determination helped him pass the difficult exam.
listen.zh: 他的決心幫助他通過了那場困難的考試。

chinese.en: The final determination of the cause of the fire will take several weeks.
chinese.zh: 要最終確定起火原因，還需要好幾週的時間。

english.en: Learning a new language well requires time, effort and determination.
english.zh: 要學好一種新語言，需要時間、努力和毅力。

speak.en: What I admire most about my father is his determination.
speak.zh: 我最欣賞我爸爸的一點，就是他的毅力。

write.en: The company's determination to cut plastic waste led it to replace all packaging with paper.
write.zh: 這家公司決心減少塑膠垃圾，因此把所有包裝都換成紙製的。

example.en: The witness was accused of withholding important information from the police, which delayed the investigation for several months.
example.zh: 這名證人被指控對警方隱瞞重要資訊，導致調查延宕了好幾個月。

listen.en: Please do not withhold any details from your doctor.
listen.zh: 請不要對醫生隱瞞任何細節。

chinese.en: The government threatened to withhold funding from schools that failed to meet the new standards.
chinese.zh: 政府揚言，未達新標準的學校將不會獲得經費。

english.en: The landlord withheld our deposit because the wall was damaged.
english.zh: 房東因為牆壁損壞而扣住我們的押金。

speak.en: I think parents shouldn't withhold the truth from their kids.
speak.zh: 我認為父母不應該對孩子隱瞞真相。

write.en: In many countries, income tax is automatically withheld from employees' monthly pay.
write.zh: 在許多國家，所得稅會直接從員工的月薪中扣繳。

example.en: In the graph, the number of mobile users steadily rose until it finally surpassed desktop users in the middle of the decade.
example.zh: 圖表中，行動裝置使用者人數穩定上升，最後在這十年的中期超越了桌上型電腦使用者。

listen.en: The young player soon surpassed her own coach.
listen.zh: 那位年輕選手很快就超越了自己的教練。

chinese.en: The view from the mountain top surpassed anything I had seen in photographs.
chinese.zh: 山頂上的景色勝過我在照片裡看過的任何景象。

english.en: Tourism has surpassed farming as the island's main source of income.
english.zh: 觀光業已超越農業，成為這座島嶼的主要收入來源。

speak.en: My little brother has already surpassed me in height.
speak.zh: 我弟弟已經長得比我還高了。

write.en: Global temperatures may surpass safe limits unless countries cut emissions much faster.
write.zh: 除非各國加快減少排放，否則全球氣溫可能會超過安全上限。

example.en: Volunteering abroad had a profound impact on him, changing both his career plans and the way he viewed poverty.
example.zh: 到國外當志工對他影響深遠，改變了他的職涯規劃，也改變了他看待貧窮的方式。

listen.en: The book contains some profound ideas about happiness.
listen.zh: 這本書裡有一些關於幸福的深刻見解。

chinese.en: Climate change will bring profound changes to farming in many parts of the world.
chinese.zh: 氣候變遷將為世界許多地區的農業帶來重大改變。

english.en: The teacher felt a profound sense of pride in her students.
english.zh: 老師對她的學生感到深深的驕傲。

speak.en: That documentary left a profound impression on me, honestly.
speak.zh: 說真的，那部紀錄片讓我印象非常深刻。

write.en: Patients with profound hearing loss may benefit from special devices that improve communication.
write.zh: 重度聽力損失的病人，可能會因能改善溝通的特殊裝置而受益。

example.en: To avoid wasting time on irrelevant results, she filtered the search by date and showed only articles from recent years.
example.zh: 為了不浪費時間在不相關的結果上，她依日期篩選搜尋結果，只顯示近幾年的文章。

listen.en: Sunlight filtered through the leaves of the tall trees.
listen.zh: 陽光從高大樹木的葉縫間灑落下來。

chinese.en: The email system automatically filters out spam before it reaches your inbox.
chinese.zh: 電子郵件系統會在垃圾郵件進入收件匣之前自動將它過濾掉。

english.en: Many people use a filter to make their photos look better.
english.zh: 很多人會用濾鏡讓照片看起來更好看。

speak.en: I try to filter out negative comments and focus on useful feedback.
speak.zh: 我會試著過濾掉負面留言，專注在有用的回饋上。

write.en: Wetlands act as natural filters, cleaning polluted water before it flows into rivers.
write.zh: 濕地就像天然的過濾器，在受污染的水流入河川之前先把它淨化。

example.en: Many modern films borrow characters from ancient mythology, such as heroes, monsters and gods who control the weather.
example.zh: 許多現代電影借用古代神話裡的角色，例如英雄、怪物，以及掌管天氣的神祇。

listen.en: My son loves reading stories from Chinese mythology.
listen.zh: 我兒子很愛讀中國神話故事。

chinese.en: Dragons appear in the mythology of many cultures, but their meaning differs greatly.
chinese.zh: 龍出現在許多文化的神話中，但牠們代表的意義大不相同。

english.en: She is taking a course on Norse mythology this semester.
english.zh: 她這學期在修一門北歐神話的課。

speak.en: I've always been fascinated by mythology, especially stories about the sea.
speak.zh: 我一直對神話很著迷，尤其是和大海有關的故事。

write.en: Studying a nation's mythology can help us understand the values its people traditionally held.
write.zh: 研究一個民族的神話，可以幫助我們了解當地人傳統上重視的價值。

example.en: Without regular maintenance, the old wooden bridge began to deteriorate, and engineers eventually closed it to traffic.
example.zh: 由於缺乏定期維護，那座老木橋開始損壞，工程師最後封閉了它，禁止車輛通行。

listen.en: The weather is expected to deteriorate later this afternoon.
listen.zh: 預計今天下午稍晚天氣會轉壞。

chinese.en: Air quality in many cities continues to deteriorate as the number of private cars rises.
chinese.zh: 隨著私家車數量增加，許多城市的空氣品質持續惡化。

english.en: Their relationship deteriorated after they stopped talking to each other.
english.zh: 他們不再跟彼此說話之後，關係就變差了。

speak.en: Honestly, my eyesight has deteriorated a lot since I started university.
speak.zh: 老實說，自從上大學以後，我的視力退步了很多。

write.en: If teachers are overworked, the quality of education may deteriorate over time.
write.zh: 如果教師工作過量，教育品質久而久之可能會下降。

example.en: Critics praised the young pianist's superb performance, saying they had rarely heard such skill and emotion combined.
example.zh: 評論家讚揚這位年輕鋼琴家的精湛演出，說他們很少聽到技巧與情感結合得如此完美。

listen.en: The food at that little café was absolutely superb.
listen.zh: 那家小咖啡館的餐點真是好吃極了。

chinese.en: Despite its age, the second-hand car was still in superb condition when I bought it.
chinese.zh: 雖然車齡不小，我買下那輛二手車時，它的車況仍然非常好。

english.en: Our team did a superb job on the final project.
english.zh: 我們團隊在期末專題上表現得非常出色。

speak.en: The museum has a superb collection, so I'd recommend it to anyone.
speak.zh: 那間博物館的館藏非常棒，所以我會推薦給任何人。

write.en: Good public transport and superb parks make the city an attractive place to live.
write.zh: 便利的大眾運輸和一流的公園，讓這座城市成為宜居之地。

example.en: The history museum displays nineteenth-century army uniforms, maps and empty ammunition boxes found near the old fort.
example.zh: 這間歷史博物館展示了十九世紀的軍服、地圖，以及在舊堡壘附近發現的空彈藥箱。

listen.en: Don't give your opponents any ammunition before the debate.
listen.zh: 辯論之前，別給你的對手任何把柄。

chinese.en: The poor sales figures provided ammunition for those who opposed the new strategy.
chinese.zh: 慘淡的銷售數字讓反對新策略的人有了攻擊的依據。

english.en: Her careless mistakes gave her critics plenty of ammunition against her.
english.zh: 她粗心的錯誤讓批評她的人有很多可以攻擊她的把柄。

speak.en: I always collect strong examples as ammunition for my essay arguments.
speak.zh: 我總是蒐集有力的例子，當作論說文論點的依據。

write.en: Rising housing costs have become useful ammunition for groups demanding more public housing.
write.zh: 不斷上漲的房價成為要求增建社會住宅的團體手中的有力論據。

example.en: The interview went smoothly because she had researched the company beforehand and prepared answers to common questions.
example.zh: 面試很順利，因為她事前研究過這家公司，也準備好常見問題的答案。

listen.en: We booked our tickets beforehand to avoid the long queue.
listen.zh: 我們事先訂好票，以免排長長的隊。

chinese.en: Students should read the article beforehand so that class discussions are more productive.
chinese.zh: 學生應該事先閱讀文章，課堂討論才會更有成效。

english.en: I wish someone had warned me about the heavy traffic beforehand.
english.zh: 真希望有人事先提醒我交通會很塞。

speak.en: I usually check the weather forecast beforehand when I plan a trip.
speak.zh: 規劃旅行時，我通常會事先查看天氣預報。

write.en: Governments should consult local residents beforehand rather than announcing major projects without warning.
write.zh: 政府應事先徵詢在地居民的意見，而不是在沒有預告的情況下宣布重大工程。

example.en: The ambulance arrived within minutes, and the paramedics carefully lifted the injured cyclist onto a stretcher.
example.zh: 救護車幾分鐘內就抵達，醫護人員小心地把受傷的單車騎士抬上擔架。

listen.en: Please move your car so the ambulance can get through.
listen.zh: 請把你的車移開，讓救護車能通過。

chinese.en: Many rural areas still lack a reliable ambulance service, so patients often wait too long.
chinese.zh: 許多偏鄉地區仍缺乏可靠的救護車服務，所以病患常常要等太久。

english.en: She was taken to hospital by ambulance after the accident.
english.zh: 意外發生後，她被救護車送到醫院。

speak.en: I've only ridden in an ambulance once, and it was quite frightening.
speak.zh: 我只坐過一次救護車，那時候蠻可怕的。

write.en: Drivers must pull over to the side of the road whenever an ambulance approaches.
write.zh: 每當有救護車接近時，駕駛人都必須靠邊停車。

example.en: During the dress rehearsal, the actors wore full costumes and performed the entire play exactly as they would for an audience.
example.zh: 在彩排時，演員穿上全套戲服，完全照著面對觀眾時的方式演出整齣戲。

listen.en: The wedding rehearsal will start at the church after lunch.
listen.zh: 婚禮預演會在午餐後於教堂開始。

chinese.en: A quick rehearsal of your presentation can help you spot weak points in your argument.
chinese.zh: 簡報前快速預演一遍，能幫助你找出論點中的弱點。

english.en: We had very little time for rehearsal before the concert.
english.zh: 音樂會前我們幾乎沒有時間排練。

speak.en: Before my first job interview, I did a rehearsal with a friend.
speak.zh: 第一次工作面試之前，我和一個朋友做了一次模擬演練。

write.en: The fire drill served as a useful rehearsal for a real emergency at the school.
write.zh: 這次消防演習是學校面對真正緊急狀況的一次有用預演。

example.en: Shy at first, she gradually blossomed into a confident leader who often spoke up at team meetings.
example.zh: 她一開始很害羞，後來逐漸成長為一位自信的領導者，常在團隊會議上發言。

listen.en: The apple trees blossom early when spring is warm.
listen.zh: 春天溫暖時，蘋果樹會提早開花。

chinese.en: Their friendship blossomed during the year they spent studying abroad in Canada together.
chinese.zh: 他們一起在加拿大留學的那一年，友誼迅速滋長。

english.en: Tourists come here every spring to see the plum blossoms.
english.zh: 每年春天，遊客都會來這裡賞梅花。

speak.en: I love walking along the river when the blossoms are out.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡在花開的時候沿著河邊散步。

write.en: With government support, the small fishing town has blossomed into a popular tourist destination.
write.zh: 在政府的支持下，這座漁業小鎮已發展成熱門的觀光景點。

example.en: Although the plan looked good on paper, the company lacked the staff and money needed to implement it properly.
example.zh: 雖然計畫在紙上看起來不錯，公司卻缺乏妥善執行它所需的人力與資金。

listen.en: The new rules will be implemented gradually over the summer.
listen.zh: 新規定將在暑假期間逐步實施。

chinese.en: Many cities have implemented bike-sharing schemes to reduce traffic jams and air pollution.
chinese.zh: 許多城市已推行共享單車計畫，以減少交通壅塞和空氣污染。

english.en: Our manager asked us to implement these changes as soon as possible.
english.zh: 經理要我們盡快落實這些改變。

speak.en: Good ideas are easy, but implementing them is the hard part.
speak.zh: 好點子很容易想，難的是去實行。

write.en: Archaeologists found stone implements that early farmers had used to grind grain.
write.zh: 考古學家發現了早期農民用來磨穀物的石製工具。

example.en: He earns a modest salary, yet his extravagant lifestyle includes designer clothes, expensive dinners and frequent trips abroad.
example.zh: 他的薪水普通，但他奢侈的生活方式包括名牌服飾、昂貴的晚餐和頻繁的出國旅行。

listen.en: Buying a new phone every year seems a bit extravagant.
listen.zh: 每年都買新手機似乎有點太奢侈了。

chinese.en: Consumers should be cautious about extravagant claims made in advertisements for health products.
chinese.zh: 消費者應該小心保健產品廣告中誇大不實的宣稱。

english.en: My parents think it is extravagant to eat out every day.
english.zh: 我爸媽認為每天外食很浪費。

speak.en: I'm not very extravagant, but I do spend a lot on books.
speak.zh: 我不太會揮霍，但我確實在書上花很多錢。

write.en: Some argue that hosting extravagant sporting events wastes public money that could fund schools.
write.zh: 有些人認為，舉辦鋪張的體育盛事浪費了原本可以資助學校的公帑。

example.en: When the smoke from the barbecue drifted into the neighbours' window, we apologised and offered them some grilled sausages.
example.zh: 烤肉的煙飄進鄰居的窗戶時，我們向他們道歉，還請他們吃了些烤香腸。

listen.en: Could you help me clean the barbecue after dinner?
listen.zh: 晚餐後你可以幫我清理烤肉架嗎？

chinese.en: Many families in Taiwan barbecue by the roadside during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
chinese.zh: 臺灣有許多家庭在中秋節時於路邊烤肉。

english.en: My father barbecued fish and corn for the whole family.
english.zh: 我爸爸為全家人烤了魚和玉米。

speak.en: A barbecue with friends is my favourite way to spend a holiday.
speak.zh: 跟朋友一起烤肉是我最喜歡的度假方式。

write.en: Some parks ban barbecues during dry seasons because of the risk of wildfires.
write.zh: 有些公園在乾季禁止烤肉，因為有引發野火的風險。

example.en: Most students improved their scores, with one notable exception: a boy who had missed several weeks of classes.
example.zh: 大多數學生的成績都進步了，只有一個值得注意的例外：一個缺課好幾週的男生。

listen.en: Her research made a notable contribution to the field.
listen.zh: 她的研究對該領域做出了顯著的貢獻。

chinese.en: It is notable that online sales rose sharply while store sales stayed flat.
chinese.zh: 值得注意的是，網路銷售大幅上升，而實體店面的銷售則持平。

english.en: The festival attracts several notable artists from around the world.
english.zh: 這個藝術節吸引了數位來自世界各地的知名藝術家。

speak.en: Nothing notable happened at work today, so it was pretty relaxing.
speak.zh: 今天工作上沒發生什麼特別的事，所以蠻輕鬆的。

write.en: One notable benefit of remote work is that employees save time on commuting.
write.zh: 遠距工作一個顯著的好處是員工能省下通勤時間。

example.en: Many animal species hidden deep in the jungle have never been recorded, because the thick vegetation makes research extremely difficult.
example.zh: 許多藏身叢林深處的動物物種從未被記錄過，因為茂密的植被讓研究極為困難。

listen.en: Monkeys were calling loudly from the trees in the jungle.
listen.zh: 叢林裡的猴子在樹上大聲叫著。

chinese.en: After moving to the city, she missed the quiet countryside and hated living in a concrete jungle.
chinese.zh: 搬到城市後，她懷念寧靜的鄉間，討厭住在水泥叢林裡。

english.en: Large areas of jungle are cleared every year for farming.
english.zh: 每年都有大片叢林被清除，改作農地。

speak.en: Finding the right form on that website is like walking through a jungle.
speak.zh: 要在那個網站上找到正確的表格，就像在叢林裡摸索一樣。

write.en: Small businesses often struggle to find their way through a jungle of tax regulations.
write.zh: 小型企業常常難以在錯綜複雜的稅務法規中理出頭緒。

example.en: Volunteers shovelled mud out of flooded homes for days after the storm, working until the streets were clean again.
example.zh: 暴風雨過後，志工連續好幾天把淹水房屋裡的泥巴鏟出去，一直做到街道恢復乾淨。

listen.en: Please put the shovel back in the garden shed.
listen.zh: 請把鏟子放回花園的工具棚。

chinese.en: The workers shovelled sand into the mixer to make concrete for the new path.
chinese.zh: 工人把沙子鏟進攪拌機，為新步道製作混凝土。

english.en: My brother hates shovelling snow every morning during the winter.
english.zh: 我哥哥討厭冬天每天早上都要鏟雪。

speak.en: When I'm stressed, I tend to shovel snacks into my mouth.
speak.zh: 我壓力大的時候，常會把零食一直往嘴裡塞。

write.en: Each student was given a shovel to help plant trees on the school field.
write.zh: 每個學生都拿到一把鏟子，幫忙在學校操場上種樹。

example.en: The ferry rocked from side to side in the violent waves, and several passengers felt seasick for the entire journey.
example.zh: 渡輪在洶湧的大浪中左右搖晃，好幾位乘客整趟航程都在暈船。

listen.en: The whole building shook during the sudden, violent earthquake.
listen.zh: 整棟建築在那場突如其來的強烈地震中搖晃。

chinese.en: Some parents worry that violent video games may influence how children behave.
chinese.zh: 有些家長擔心暴力電玩可能會影響孩子的行為。

english.en: He had a violent cough that kept him awake all night.
english.zh: 他咳得很厲害，整晚都睡不著。

speak.en: I'm not keen on violent films, so I usually choose comedies.
speak.zh: 我不太喜歡暴力電影，所以通常選喜劇片。

write.en: Studies suggest that better street lighting can help reduce violent crime in cities.
write.zh: 研究顯示，改善街道照明有助於減少城市中的暴力犯罪。

example.en: In the Middle Ages, the plague spread rapidly through crowded towns, where poor hygiene allowed the disease to travel easily.
example.zh: 在中世紀，瘟疫在擁擠的城鎮中迅速蔓延，衛生條件差讓疾病很容易傳播。

listen.en: Farmers were worried about a plague of locusts this summer.
listen.zh: 農民擔心今年夏天會發生蝗災。

chinese.en: The small café was plagued with complaints about slow service during its first month.
chinese.zh: 那家小咖啡館開幕的第一個月，飽受上菜太慢的客訴困擾。

english.en: Terrible back pain has plagued my father for many years now.
english.zh: 嚴重的背痛已經困擾我爸爸很多年了。

speak.en: My little sister plagues me with questions whenever I'm studying.
speak.zh: 每次我在讀書，我妹妹就一直纏著問我問題。

write.en: Many big cities are plagued by traffic congestion, which wastes time and fuel.
write.zh: 許多大城市飽受交通壅塞之苦，浪費了時間和燃料。

example.en: On the visa form, you must list your spouse's name and occupation, along with the names of any children.
example.zh: 在簽證申請表上，你必須填寫配偶的姓名和職業，以及所有子女的名字。

listen.en: Please write your spouse's full name on this form.
listen.zh: 請在這張表格上寫下你配偶的全名。

chinese.en: In many households, both spouses now share the cooking and cleaning equally.
chinese.zh: 在許多家庭裡，夫妻雙方現在都平均分擔煮飯和打掃。

english.en: Members can bring their spouse to the gym for free.
english.zh: 會員可以免費帶配偶來健身房。

speak.en: My spouse and I take turns walking the dog every evening.
speak.zh: 我和另一半每天晚上輪流遛狗。

write.en: Some countries offer tax benefits to couples when one spouse stays home to raise children.
write.zh: 有些國家在夫妻其中一方留在家裡照顧孩子時，提供租稅優惠。

example.en: Unlike researchers who mainly study theory, practitioners deal with real clients and must solve problems quickly every day.
example.zh: 和主要研究理論的學者不同，實務工作者每天要面對真實的客戶，必須迅速解決問題。

listen.en: My general practitioner told me to get more sleep.
listen.zh: 我的家庭醫師叫我要多睡一點。

chinese.en: Experienced practitioners in the field often share practical advice with new teachers.
chinese.zh: 這個領域經驗豐富的從業人員常會與新進教師分享實用的建議。

english.en: Every health practitioner in this country must renew their licence regularly.
english.zh: 這個國家的每位醫療從業人員都必須定期更新執照。

speak.en: I'd rather learn from a practitioner than from a textbook.
speak.zh: 我寧願向實務工作者學習，也不要只看教科書。

write.en: Rural areas need more general practitioners so that residents do not travel far for treatment.
write.zh: 偏鄉地區需要更多家庭醫師，居民才不必長途奔波去就醫。

example.en: When her passport was stolen abroad, she contacted her country's embassy, which issued her a temporary travel document.
example.zh: 她在國外護照被偷時，聯絡了本國大使館，使館核發了一份臨時旅行證件給她。

listen.en: The embassy is closed on weekends and public holidays.
listen.zh: 大使館在週末及國定假日不開放。

chinese.en: Embassy staff help citizens who lose their documents or get into trouble overseas.
chinese.zh: 大使館人員會協助在海外遺失證件或遇到麻煩的國民。

english.en: You need to make an appointment with the embassy first.
english.zh: 你需要先跟大使館預約。

speak.en: The queue outside the embassy was much longer than I expected.
speak.zh: 大使館外面排隊的人比我預期的多很多。

write.en: Several countries have opened new embassies in the region to strengthen trade relations.
write.zh: 有幾個國家在該地區設立新的大使館，以加強貿易關係。

example.en: Although he disagreed with every point, he listened with courtesy and thanked the speaker before raising his objections.
example.zh: 雖然他不同意每一個論點，他仍禮貌地傾聽，並在提出異議前先向講者道謝。

listen.en: The hotel offers a free courtesy bus to the airport.
listen.zh: 這間飯店提供免費接駁車到機場。

chinese.en: Out of courtesy, she let the elderly woman go ahead of her in the queue.
chinese.zh: 出於禮貌，她讓那位老太太排在她前面。

english.en: He didn't even have the courtesy to say thank you.
english.zh: 他連說聲謝謝的禮貌都沒有。

speak.en: Simple courtesy, like holding doors for people, really makes my day.
speak.zh: 一些簡單的禮貌，像是幫人扶門，真的會讓我一整天心情都很好。

write.en: All the photographs in this article appear courtesy of the national museum.
write.zh: 本文所有照片皆由國家博物館提供。

example.en: In this school, English is the main medium of instruction, so even maths and science are taught in English.
example.zh: 這所學校主要以英語作為教學媒介，所以連數學和自然科都用英文授課。

listen.en: I'd like a medium coffee with a little milk, please.
listen.zh: 我要一杯中杯咖啡，加一點點牛奶，謝謝。

chinese.en: Television is still an important medium for older people to receive news.
chinese.zh: 對年長者來說，電視仍是接收新聞的重要媒介。

english.en: This shirt is available in small, medium and large sizes.
english.zh: 這件襯衫有小、中、大三種尺寸。

speak.en: I'm of medium height, so most clothes fit me quite well.
speak.zh: 我身高中等，所以大部分衣服我穿起來都蠻合身的。

write.en: Medium-sized companies often find it hard to compete with large international firms.
write.zh: 中型企業常常難以和大型跨國公司競爭。

example.en: Although the new manager faced pressure to cut corners, she refused and continued to uphold the company's safety rules.
example.zh: 雖然新經理面臨偷工減料的壓力，她仍然拒絕，並持續維護公司的安全規定。

listen.en: Every member must uphold the club's basic rules.
listen.zh: 每位會員都必須遵守並維護社團的基本規則。

chinese.en: The court upheld the original decision after reviewing all the evidence again.
chinese.zh: 法院重新審查所有證據後，維持了原判決。

english.en: We should all uphold the values that our community believes in.
english.zh: 我們都應該維護我們社區所信奉的價值。

speak.en: I think it's really important to uphold your promises to friends.
speak.zh: 我覺得信守對朋友的承諾真的很重要。

write.en: Journalists have a duty to uphold the public's right to accurate information.
write.zh: 記者有責任捍衛大眾獲得正確資訊的權利。

example.en: When I opened the cupboard, I found nothing but an old jar of honey and some rice.
example.zh: 我打開櫥櫃時，裡面只有一罐舊蜂蜜和一些米。

listen.en: Please put the cups back in the cupboard.
listen.zh: 請把杯子放回櫥櫃裡。

chinese.en: Our dormitory room has a small cupboard where we keep snacks and instant noodles.
chinese.zh: 我們的宿舍房間有一個小櫃子，用來放零食和泡麵。

english.en: My mother keeps all the medicine in a locked cupboard.
english.zh: 我媽媽把所有的藥都放在一個上鎖的櫃子裡。

speak.en: Honestly, my kitchen cupboard is always full of snacks.
speak.zh: 老實說，我家廚房的櫥櫃裡總是塞滿零食。

write.en: The office supply cupboard was empty, so we had to order more paper.
write.zh: 辦公室的文具櫃空了，所以我們得再訂一些紙。

example.en: Because the contract contained some ambiguity about who should pay for repairs, the landlord and tenant ended up arguing.
example.zh: 因為合約對於誰該負擔修繕費用寫得含糊不清，房東和房客最後吵了起來。

listen.en: There is no ambiguity in her clear answer.
listen.zh: 她清楚的回答沒有任何模稜兩可之處。

chinese.en: Good writers try to avoid ambiguity by choosing their words very carefully.
chinese.zh: 好的作家會非常謹慎地選擇用字，以避免語意含糊。

english.en: The new policy has caused a lot of ambiguity among employees.
english.zh: 新政策在員工之間造成了很多模糊不清的地方。

speak.en: I don't like ambiguity, so I always ask questions directly.
speak.zh: 我不喜歡模稜兩可，所以我總是直接發問。

write.en: Poets sometimes use ambiguity on purpose to give readers more than one interpretation.
write.zh: 詩人有時會刻意使用歧義，讓讀者有不只一種解讀。

example.en: Once a vast wilderness of forests and swamps, the area is now covered with farms and small towns.
example.zh: 這個地區曾是一大片森林與沼澤構成的荒野，如今布滿了農田和小鎮。

listen.en: The wilderness looks peaceful but can be dangerous.
listen.zh: 荒野看起來很寧靜，但可能很危險。

chinese.en: Many governments protect large areas of wilderness to preserve rare plants and animals.
chinese.zh: 許多政府保護大片荒野地區，以保存稀有的動植物。

english.en: My dream is to go camping in the wilderness someday.
english.zh: 我的夢想是有一天能去荒野露營。

speak.en: I'd love to spend a weekend in the wilderness, away from phones.
speak.zh: 我很想在荒野裡度過一個週末，遠離手機。

write.en: The survival course teaches students how to find clean water in the wilderness.
write.zh: 這門求生課程教學生如何在荒野中找到乾淨的水。

example.en: The software update contained a serious bug that rendered thousands of phones useless until a fix was released.
example.zh: 這次軟體更新有一個嚴重的錯誤，讓數千支手機無法使用，直到修正版推出為止。

listen.en: The flood rendered the bridge useless for weeks.
listen.zh: 洪水讓那座橋好幾週都無法使用。

chinese.en: The volunteers were thanked for the services they had rendered to the community.
chinese.zh: 志工們因為對社區提供的服務而受到感謝。

english.en: Too much stress can render people unable to sleep well at night.
english.zh: 壓力太大會讓人晚上無法好好睡覺。

speak.en: Honestly, the noise rendered me speechless for a moment.
speak.zh: 說真的，那個聲音讓我一時說不出話來。

write.en: The ancient poem was beautifully rendered into Chinese by a talented young translator.
write.zh: 這首古詩由一位才華洋溢的年輕譯者優美地譯成中文。

example.en: The old teacher was treated with great affection by former students, who visited him every year on his birthday.
example.zh: 這位老教師深受昔日學生愛戴，他們每年都會在他生日時去探望他。

listen.en: The dog shows its affection by wagging its tail.
listen.zh: 那隻狗用搖尾巴來表達牠的喜愛。

chinese.en: Grandparents often show affection for their grandchildren by cooking their favorite meals.
chinese.zh: 祖父母常常會煮孫子最愛吃的菜，來表達對他們的疼愛。

english.en: Many people feel affection for the place where they studied.
english.zh: 許多人對自己讀書的地方懷有感情。

speak.en: I still have a lot of affection for my first bicycle.
speak.zh: 我到現在對我的第一台腳踏車還是很有感情。

write.en: The brand has won the affection of young customers through its friendly online videos.
write.zh: 這個品牌透過親切的網路影片，贏得了年輕顧客的喜愛。

example.en: The new headphones offer rich stereo sound, so you can hear instruments coming from both the left and right sides.
example.zh: 這款新耳機提供飽滿的立體聲，讓你聽得到樂器聲分別從左右兩側傳來。

listen.en: Could you turn the stereo down a little, please?
listen.zh: 可以請你把音響轉小聲一點嗎？

chinese.en: The café installed a new stereo system to play soft music for customers.
chinese.zh: 這家咖啡廳裝了一套新音響，為客人播放輕柔的音樂。

english.en: My neighbor's stereo is so loud that I cannot study.
english.zh: 我鄰居的音響太大聲，害我無法念書。

speak.en: We used to listen to the radio on a car stereo.
speak.zh: 我們以前常用車上的音響聽廣播。

write.en: The film was recorded in stereo, which makes the concert scenes sound much more real.
write.zh: 這部電影是以立體聲錄製的，讓演唱會的場景聽起來更加逼真。

example.en: Even without understanding the lyrics, the audience was moved by the gentle melody played on the piano.
example.zh: 即使聽不懂歌詞，觀眾仍被鋼琴彈奏的溫柔旋律打動。

listen.en: She hummed a sweet melody while cooking dinner.
listen.zh: 她一邊煮晚餐，一邊哼著一段甜美的旋律。

chinese.en: Many advertisements use a catchy melody so that people remember the product.
chinese.zh: 許多廣告會使用朗朗上口的旋律，讓人記住產品。

english.en: I can still remember the melody, but I forgot the words.
english.zh: 我還記得旋律，但忘了歌詞。

speak.en: I love songs with a slow, relaxing melody before bed.
speak.zh: 睡前我很喜歡聽旋律緩慢、讓人放鬆的歌。

write.en: Music teachers say that children learn new melodies faster when they sing together.
write.zh: 音樂老師說，孩子們一起唱歌時，學新旋律會比較快。

example.en: The current was so strong that, even though they paddled as hard as they could, the boat barely moved forward.
example.zh: 水流太強，即使他們拚命搖槳，船幾乎沒有往前移動。

listen.en: Hold the paddle with both hands and pull back.
listen.zh: 用雙手握住槳，然後往後拉。

chinese.en: The children took off their shoes and paddled in the shallow water at the beach.
chinese.zh: 孩子們脫掉鞋子，在海邊的淺水處踩水玩耍。

english.en: Each person in the boat needs to use a paddle.
english.zh: 船上的每個人都需要用槳。

speak.en: Paddling a kayak along the river was the highlight of my trip.
speak.zh: 沿著河搖槳駕獨木舟是我這趟旅行最精彩的部分。

write.en: Our team-building day at work included learning to paddle a dragon boat together.
write.zh: 我們公司的團隊建立活動，包括一起學習搖槳駕龍舟。

example.en: For many families in the past, the radio was the main source of entertainment in the evenings.
example.zh: 過去對許多家庭來說，收音機是晚上主要的娛樂來源。

listen.en: There is not much entertainment in this small village.
listen.zh: 這個小村莊沒有什麼娛樂。

chinese.en: Some parents worry that online entertainment takes too much of their children's time.
chinese.zh: 有些家長擔心網路娛樂占用孩子太多時間。

english.en: Watching movies at home is my favorite form of entertainment.
english.zh: 在家看電影是我最喜歡的娛樂方式。

speak.en: Honestly, I think the entertainment industry has changed a lot recently.
speak.zh: 說實話，我覺得娛樂產業最近改變了很多。

write.en: The company hired a band to provide entertainment at its annual dinner party.
write.zh: 公司請了一個樂團在尾牙晚宴上表演助興。

example.en: Her apparent confidence during the interview hid the fact that she had been nervous for days.
example.zh: 她在面試時表面上很有自信，其實已經緊張好幾天了。

listen.en: The problem was apparent to everyone in the room.
listen.zh: 房間裡的每個人都看得出問題所在。

chinese.en: The baby started crying for no apparent reason in the middle of the night.
chinese.zh: 寶寶半夜莫名其妙地哭了起來。

english.en: It is apparent that more and more students prefer online classes.
english.zh: 很明顯，越來越多學生偏好線上課程。

speak.en: It was pretty apparent that my friend didn't enjoy the movie.
speak.zh: 很明顯，我朋友並不喜歡那部電影。

write.en: The effects of air pollution are especially apparent in large cities during winter.
write.zh: 冬天時，空氣汙染的影響在大城市特別明顯。

example.en: The company's tiny pay raise was seen by workers as a token gesture rather than real change.
example.zh: 公司微幅的加薪被員工視為做做樣子，而不是真正的改變。

listen.en: He gave her flowers as a token of thanks.
listen.zh: 他送她花表示感謝。

chinese.en: At the old arcade, you had to buy tokens before playing any of the games.
chinese.zh: 在那家老電子遊樂場，玩任何遊戲之前都得先買代幣。

english.en: Students received a small token for every book they finished reading.
english.zh: 學生每讀完一本書就會得到一個小代幣。

speak.en: I think sending a card is a nice token of friendship.
speak.zh: 我覺得寄一張卡片是很好的友誼表示。

write.en: Some critics argue that the new recycling law is only a token effort to protect the environment.
write.zh: 有些評論者認為，新的回收法規只是保護環境的象徵性作為。

example.en: Unlike traditional schools with fixed timetables, the online program is flexible enough to fit around students' part-time jobs.
example.zh: 不同於課表固定的傳統學校，這個線上課程很有彈性，能配合學生的打工時間。

listen.en: Our travel plans are flexible, so we can change dates.
listen.zh: 我們的旅行計畫很有彈性，所以可以更改日期。

chinese.en: Dancers do stretching exercises every day to keep their bodies strong and flexible.
chinese.zh: 舞者每天做伸展運動，讓身體保持強健又柔軟。

english.en: The government should make its housing policy more flexible for young people.
english.zh: 政府應該讓住宅政策對年輕人更有彈性。

speak.en: I'm pretty flexible, so any time this weekend works for me.
speak.zh: 我時間滿彈性的，所以這個週末任何時間都可以。

write.en: This phone case is made of flexible plastic that will not crack easily.
write.zh: 這個手機殼是用柔韌的塑膠做的，不容易裂開。

example.en: Scientists stress that their research is ongoing, so the early results should not be treated as final conclusions.
example.zh: 科學家強調研究仍在進行中，所以初步結果不應被視為最終結論。

listen.en: The talks between the two companies are still ongoing.
listen.zh: 兩家公司之間的協商仍在進行中。

chinese.en: There is an ongoing debate about whether homework helps young children learn.
chinese.zh: 關於回家作業是否有助於幼童學習，目前仍有持續的爭論。

english.en: The school provides ongoing support for teachers in their first year.
english.zh: 學校為第一年任教的老師提供持續的支援。

speak.en: Learning English is an ongoing process for me, not a race.
speak.zh: 對我來說，學英文是一個持續的過程，不是一場比賽。

write.en: Keeping a garden healthy requires ongoing care, especially during the hot summer months.
write.zh: 要讓花園保持健康需要持續照顧，特別是在炎熱的夏季。

example.en: After moving abroad for work, he became more distant from his old friends and rarely replied to their messages.
example.zh: 他出國工作後，和老朋友變得越來越疏遠，也很少回他們的訊息。

listen.en: Her family lives in a distant part of the country.
listen.zh: 她的家人住在國內一個遙遠的地方。

chinese.en: Electric cars may become the main form of transport in the not-too-distant future.
chinese.zh: 在不久的將來，電動車可能會成為主要的交通工具。

english.en: I met a distant relative for the first time at my cousin's wedding.
english.zh: 我在表哥的婚禮上第一次見到一位遠房親戚。

speak.en: To be honest, my childhood feels like a distant memory now.
speak.zh: 老實說，我的童年現在感覺像是很遙遠的回憶。

write.en: Some students feel distant from their teachers when all classes are taught online.
write.zh: 當所有課程都在線上進行時，有些學生會覺得和老師有距離感。

example.en: Poor internet access in rural areas continues to hinder students who must submit their homework online.
example.zh: 鄉村地區網路不佳，持續妨礙必須線上繳交作業的學生。

listen.en: Lack of sleep can hinder your ability to focus.
listen.zh: 睡眠不足會妨礙你的專注力。

chinese.en: High housing prices may hinder young couples in big cities from starting a family.
chinese.zh: 高房價可能會阻礙大城市的年輕夫妻成家。

english.en: The loud noise hindered me from finishing my report on time.
english.zh: 吵雜的噪音讓我無法準時完成報告。

speak.en: I feel my shyness sometimes hinders me in group discussions.
speak.zh: 我覺得我的害羞有時會在小組討論中拖累我。

write.en: Strict rules can hinder creativity if employees are afraid to try new ideas.
write.zh: 如果員工害怕嘗試新點子，嚴格的規定可能會阻礙創意。

example.en: The hotel rooms were separated only by thin walls, so guests complained about the lack of privacy at night.
example.zh: 飯店房間之間只隔著薄牆，所以房客抱怨晚上缺乏隱私。

listen.en: Everyone needs a little privacy at home sometimes.
listen.zh: 每個人有時都需要在家裡有一點私人空間。

chinese.en: The new law aims to protect patients' privacy by limiting who can see their records.
chinese.zh: 新法規藉由限制誰能查看病歷，來保護病患的隱私。

english.en: Teenagers often want more privacy and their own space at home.
english.zh: 青少年常常希望在家裡有更多隱私和自己的空間。

speak.en: Living in a dorm, I really miss having some privacy.
speak.zh: 住在宿舍裡，我真的很懷念有隱私的感覺。

write.en: Companies must respect employees' privacy and should not read their personal emails.
write.zh: 公司必須尊重員工的隱私，不應該查看他們的私人電子郵件。

example.en: With the exam only days away, Tom tried to avoid the temptation of checking his phone every few minutes.
