example.zh: 離考試只剩幾天，湯姆努力克制自己不要每隔幾分鐘就看手機。

listen.en: It is hard to say no to temptation.
listen.zh: 要拒絕誘惑很難。

chinese.en: Shopping online at night creates a strong temptation to buy things we do not need.
chinese.zh: 晚上網購很容易讓人忍不住買下不需要的東西。

english.en: Many people on a diet give in to temptation late at night.
english.zh: 許多正在節食的人到了深夜就禁不起誘惑。

speak.en: Whenever I pass a bakery, the temptation is just too strong.
speak.zh: 每次經過麵包店，那個誘惑實在太強了。

write.en: Public officials must resist the temptation to accept expensive gifts from local businesses.
write.zh: 公務人員必須抗拒收受地方企業貴重禮物的誘惑。

example.en: Instead of solving the traffic problem, building more roads may aggravate it by encouraging even more people to drive.
example.zh: 多蓋道路不但無法解決交通問題，反而可能鼓勵更多人開車，使問題惡化。

listen.en: Cold weather can aggravate the pain in her back.
listen.zh: 寒冷的天氣會加重她背部的疼痛。

chinese.en: Staying up late before exams only aggravates stress and makes it harder to remember things.
chinese.zh: 考前熬夜只會加重壓力，而且讓人更難記住東西。

english.en: Arguing with your manager will only aggravate the situation at work.
english.zh: 跟主管爭吵只會讓工作上的情況更糟。

speak.en: It really aggravates me when people talk during movies.
speak.zh: 有人在看電影時講話，真的讓我很火大。

write.en: Dust and pollen in the air can aggravate allergy symptoms, especially in early spring.
write.zh: 空氣中的灰塵和花粉會加重過敏症狀，尤其是在早春時節。

example.en: Some large companies use complex accounting tricks to evade taxes, leaving ordinary workers to pay a larger share.
example.zh: 有些大企業利用複雜的會計手法逃稅，讓一般勞工負擔更大的比例。

listen.en: You cannot evade your responsibilities as a parent forever.
listen.zh: 你不能永遠逃避身為父母的責任。

chinese.en: The small fish evaded the hungry bird by hiding among the rocks.
chinese.zh: 小魚躲進岩石之間，避開了飢餓的鳥。

english.en: My brother always evades my questions about his plans after graduation.
english.zh: 我哥哥總是迴避我問他畢業後的計畫。

speak.en: I tend to evade difficult conversations, but I'm working on it.
speak.zh: 我常會逃避困難的對話，不過我正在努力改進。

write.en: The student evaded the teacher's eye and slipped out of the classroom early.
write.zh: 那名學生避開老師的視線，提早溜出了教室。

example.en: After losing his job, Mark was counselled by a career adviser, who helped him identify new opportunities in his field.
example.zh: 失業後，Mark 接受了職涯顧問的輔導，對方幫他找出所屬領域的新機會。

listen.en: My teacher counselled me to choose a subject I enjoy.
listen.zh: 老師建議我選一個自己喜歡的科目。

chinese.en: Financial experts often counsel against borrowing money to buy things you do not need.
chinese.zh: 理財專家常勸人不要借錢買不需要的東西。

english.en: The company sought legal counsel before signing the new contract.
english.zh: 公司在簽訂新合約前尋求了法律諮詢。

speak.en: Honestly, I'd always counsel friends to take a gap year if they can.
speak.zh: 老實說，我總會建議朋友，有機會的話就去過個空檔年。

write.en: Volunteers are trained to counsel families on how to support elderly relatives at home.
write.zh: 志工受過訓練，能指導家屬如何在家照顧年長的親人。

example.en: Because the old wall had collapsed, workers erected a temporary fence to keep visitors away from the site.
example.zh: 因為舊牆倒塌了，工人架起臨時圍籬，讓遊客遠離現場。

listen.en: They erected a large tent in the park for the festival.
listen.zh: 他們在公園裡為節慶搭起一座大帳篷。

chinese.en: The dancers stood perfectly erect while waiting for the music to begin.
chinese.zh: 舞者們站得筆直，等待音樂響起。

english.en: The new library was erected next to the train station.
english.zh: 新圖書館蓋在火車站旁邊。

speak.en: They've erected loads of new apartment blocks near my neighbourhood lately.
speak.zh: 最近我家附近蓋了好多新的公寓大樓。

write.en: Local councils should erect clear warning signs along dangerous stretches of coastline.
write.zh: 地方政府應該在危險的海岸路段設立清楚的警告標誌。

example.en: Although the two phones look alike, the similarities are superficial; inside, they use completely different technology.
example.zh: 雖然這兩支手機看起來很像，但相似之處只在表面；內部用的是完全不同的技術。

listen.en: Luckily, the cut on her arm was only superficial.
listen.zh: 幸好她手臂上的傷口只是皮外傷。

chinese.en: Social media friendships can feel superficial compared with relationships built face to face.
chinese.zh: 和面對面建立的關係相比，社群媒體上的友誼可能讓人覺得很表面。

english.en: The new manager made only superficial changes to the office.
english.zh: 新經理只對辦公室做了表面上的改變。

speak.en: I think judging people by their looks is pretty superficial, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得用外表評斷別人滿膚淺的。

write.en: Cramming the night before gave me only a superficial understanding of the topic.
write.zh: 考前一晚臨時抱佛腳，只讓我對這個主題有粗淺的理解。

example.en: When her father became too ill to manage his money, she was given power of attorney to pay his bills.
example.zh: 父親病重到無法管理自己的錢時，她取得了授權委託，替他支付帳單。

listen.en: My uncle has worked as an attorney for many years.
listen.zh: 我叔叔當律師已經很多年了。

chinese.en: The defense attorney argued that the evidence against her client was not reliable.
chinese.zh: 辯護律師主張，對她當事人不利的證據並不可靠。

english.en: You should consult an attorney before you start a business.
english.zh: 創業之前，你應該先諮詢律師。

speak.en: My cousin's studying law because she's always wanted to be an attorney.
speak.zh: 我表姊在念法律，因為她一直想當律師。

write.en: Many low-income families cannot afford an attorney when they face legal problems.
write.zh: 許多低收入家庭遇到法律問題時請不起律師。

example.en: The investigative journalist spent months checking documents before publishing her report on the company's unsafe factories.
example.zh: 這位調查記者花了好幾個月查核文件，才發表那篇揭露該公司工廠不安全的報導。

listen.en: She wants to become a journalist after she graduates.
listen.zh: 她畢業後想當記者。

chinese.en: Journalists have a duty to check their facts carefully before reporting a story.
chinese.zh: 記者有責任在報導新聞前仔細查證事實。

english.en: My brother works as a freelance journalist for several magazines.
english.zh: 我哥哥是自由記者，替好幾家雜誌撰稿。

speak.en: Being a sports journalist sounds like a dream job to me.
speak.zh: 對我來說，當運動記者聽起來就像夢想中的工作。

write.en: Thanks to smartphones, ordinary citizens can now share news as quickly as professional journalists.
write.zh: 多虧了智慧型手機，一般民眾現在也能像專業記者一樣快速分享新聞。

example.en: As the city expanded, many traditional markets vanished, replaced by shopping malls and large supermarket chains.
example.zh: 隨著城市擴張，許多傳統市場消失了，取而代之的是購物中心和大型連鎖超市。

listen.en: The sun vanished behind the clouds and it began to rain.
listen.zh: 太陽躲進雲層後面，接著開始下雨了。

chinese.en: Many species of frogs are vanishing because their natural habitats are being destroyed.
chinese.zh: 許多蛙類正逐漸絕跡，因為牠們的自然棲地正遭到破壞。

english.en: The cat vanished for two days and then came home.
english.zh: 那隻貓失蹤了兩天，然後自己回家了。

speak.en: Whenever I get paid, my money just seems to vanish within a week.
speak.zh: 每次領到薪水，我的錢好像不到一個禮拜就不見了。

write.en: Her confidence vanished the moment she stepped onto the stage to give her speech.
write.zh: 她一踏上舞臺準備演講，自信就消失得無影無蹤。

example.en: Many hiring managers have an unconscious bias toward candidates who share their background, even though they believe they are fair.
example.zh: 許多負責招募的主管會不自覺地偏好背景和自己相似的應徵者，即使他們自認很公平。

listen.en: He fainted in the heat and lay unconscious on the floor.
listen.zh: 他在高溫下昏倒，失去意識躺在地上。

chinese.en: She was completely unconscious of the noise around her while she was reading.
chinese.zh: 她看書時，完全沒察覺到周圍的噪音。

english.en: The doctor said the patient was still unconscious after surgery.
english.zh: 醫生說病人手術後仍然昏迷不醒。

speak.en: Biting my nails is an unconscious habit I've had since childhood.
speak.zh: 咬指甲是我從小就有、自己沒意識到的習慣。

write.en: Advertisers often try to influence our unconscious desires rather than our logical decisions.
write.zh: 廣告商常試圖影響我們潛意識裡的慾望，而不是我們理性的決定。

example.en: For the old fisherman, the sea was more than a source of income; it was his spiritual home.
example.zh: 對那位老漁夫來說，大海不只是收入來源，更是他心靈的歸屬。

listen.en: Yoga is good for both physical and spiritual health.
listen.zh: 瑜伽對身體和心靈的健康都有好處。

chinese.en: Some workers feel that money alone cannot provide the spiritual satisfaction they need.
chinese.zh: 有些上班族覺得，光靠金錢無法帶給他們所需的心靈滿足。

english.en: Music has always played an important role in his spiritual life.
english.zh: 音樂在他的精神生活中一直扮演重要的角色。

speak.en: Visiting old temples gives me a kind of spiritual peace, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，參觀古老的廟宇讓我得到一種心靈上的平靜。

write.en: Modern societies are wealthier than ever, yet many citizens report a lack of spiritual fulfilment.
write.zh: 現代社會比以往更富裕，但許多人表示心靈上缺乏滿足感。

example.en: After the earthquake, thousands of people donated money, food and blankets to help families who had lost their homes.
example.zh: 地震過後，成千上萬的人捐出金錢、食物和毛毯，幫助失去家園的家庭。

listen.en: She donates blood at the hospital every few months.
listen.zh: 她每隔幾個月就會到醫院捐血。

chinese.en: The retired teacher donated her entire book collection to the village library.
chinese.zh: 那位退休老師把她所有的藏書都捐給了村裡的圖書館。

english.en: More people should register to donate their organs after death.
english.zh: 應該要有更多人登記死後捐贈器官。

speak.en: I try to donate to an animal shelter every year, even just a little.
speak.zh: 我每年都盡量捐款給動物收容所，就算只捐一點也好。

write.en: Large tech companies could donate used laptops to schools in rural areas.
write.zh: 大型科技公司可以把二手筆電捐給偏鄉的學校。

example.en: The old castle attracts numerous tourists every summer, so the nearby village has opened several new cafés and guesthouses.
example.zh: 那座古堡每年夏天都吸引大批觀光客，所以附近的村莊開了好幾家新的咖啡館和民宿。

listen.en: I have called the office on numerous occasions.
listen.zh: 我已經打過好多次電話到辦公室了。

chinese.en: The report lists numerous examples of companies that have reduced their plastic waste.
chinese.zh: 這份報告列舉了許多成功減少塑膠廢棄物的企業實例。

english.en: The new student made numerous mistakes in her first essay.
english.zh: 新來的學生在她的第一篇作文裡犯了許多錯誤。

speak.en: There are numerous night markets in my city, so there's always great food.
speak.zh: 我住的城市有很多夜市，所以永遠不缺好吃的。

write.en: Despite numerous warnings, some drivers still use their phones while driving on the highway.
write.zh: 儘管已有許多警告，仍有些駕駛在高速公路上開車時使用手機。

example.en: Drivers who text behind the wheel are a menace to everyone on the road, including pedestrians and cyclists.
example.zh: 開車時傳訊息的駕駛對路上所有人都是威脅，包括行人和騎單車的人。

listen.en: Our neighbour's puppy is a little menace in the garden.
listen.zh: 鄰居家的小狗在花園裡是個小搗蛋。

chinese.en: Rising sea levels increasingly menace low-lying coastal towns and farmland around the world.
chinese.zh: 海平面上升對世界各地低窪的沿海城鎮和農地威脅日增。

english.en: Mosquitoes are a real menace here during the rainy season.
english.zh: 雨季時這裡的蚊子真的很惱人。

speak.en: Honestly, scooters parked on the pavement are a total menace in my city.
speak.zh: 老實說，在我住的城市，停在人行道上的機車真的超礙事。

write.en: Health officials warn that antibiotic resistance is a growing menace to public health.
write.zh: 衛生官員警告，抗生素抗藥性對公共衛生的威脅日益增加。

example.en: Negotiating a salary increase is a delicate matter, so she prepared well and chose her words thoughtfully.
example.zh: 談加薪是一件微妙的事，所以她做了充分準備，也謹慎斟酌用詞。

listen.en: This soup has a light and delicate flavour.
listen.zh: 這道湯的味道清淡細緻。

chinese.en: Wetlands support a delicate balance of plants, insects and birds that is easily disturbed.
chinese.zh: 溼地維繫著植物、昆蟲與鳥類之間脆弱的平衡，很容易受到干擾。

english.en: Babies have very delicate skin, so use a gentle soap.
english.zh: 嬰兒的皮膚很嬌嫩，所以要用溫和的肥皂。

speak.en: My grandmother makes these delicate paper flowers that look almost real.
speak.zh: 我奶奶會做這種精緻的紙花，看起來幾乎跟真的一樣。

write.en: Teachers need to handle delicate topics like family problems with great sensitivity.
write.zh: 老師在處理家庭問題這類敏感話題時，需要格外細心。

example.en: Cover the pastry dough with plastic wrap and chill it in the fridge for an hour before rolling it out.
example.zh: 用保鮮膜把派皮麵團包好，放進冰箱冷藏一小時，再拿出來擀開。

listen.en: Let's just chill at home and watch a movie tonight.
listen.zh: 今晚我們就待在家放鬆看部電影吧。

chinese.en: The sudden silence in the empty building sent a chill down my spine.
chinese.zh: 空蕩蕩的大樓裡突然一片寂靜，讓我背脊發涼。

english.en: Wear a warm jacket so you don't catch a chill.
english.zh: 穿件保暖的外套，才不會著涼。

speak.en: After exams, I just want to chill out with my friends at the beach.
speak.zh: 考完試後，我只想和朋友去海邊放鬆一下。

write.en: Cold winds from the north chilled the city, and many residents stayed indoors all weekend.
write.zh: 北方吹來的冷風讓整座城市降溫，許多居民整個週末都待在室內。

example.en: Pack the peaches carefully in soft paper, because they bruise easily and nobody will buy damaged fruit.
example.zh: 用軟紙小心包好這些水蜜桃，因為它們很容易碰傷，沒人會買受損的水果。

listen.en: She fell off her bike but only had a few bruises.
listen.zh: 她從腳踏車上摔下來，不過只有幾處瘀青。

chinese.en: Losing the final match badly bruised the young player's confidence for months.
chinese.zh: 決賽落敗讓這位年輕選手的自信心受挫了好幾個月。

english.en: The climbers came back with only minor cuts and bruises.
english.zh: 登山客回來時只有一些輕微的擦傷和瘀青。

speak.en: I bruise really easily, so I'm always finding marks I can't explain.
speak.zh: 我很容易瘀青，所以老是發現身上有莫名其妙的痕跡。

write.en: Wearing proper knee pads can prevent children from bruising their knees while skating.
write.zh: 戴合適的護膝可以避免孩子溜冰時把膝蓋撞得瘀青。

example.en: Visitors travel to the mountain village to bathe in its thermal springs, where naturally heated water rises from deep underground.
example.zh: 遊客來到這座山村泡溫泉，那裡天然加熱的泉水從地底深處湧出。

listen.en: I always pack thermal underwear when I go skiing.
listen.zh: 我去滑雪時一定會帶保暖內衣。

chinese.en: Thermal cameras can detect people trapped under collapsed buildings by sensing their body heat.
chinese.zh: 熱成像攝影機能感測體溫，找出受困在倒塌建築下的人。

english.en: The city plans to close its old thermal power station soon.
english.zh: 市政府打算近期關閉老舊的火力發電廠。

speak.en: A thermal flask keeps my coffee hot for the whole morning.
speak.zh: 保溫瓶讓我的咖啡整個早上都是熱的。

write.en: Scientists are studying how thermal pollution from factories affects fish in nearby rivers.
write.zh: 科學家正在研究工廠排放的熱汙染如何影響附近河川的魚類。

example.en: What started as a casual interest in running soon became an obsession, and she was training twice a day.
example.zh: 一開始只是隨興對跑步感興趣，很快就變成一種執迷，她甚至一天訓練兩次。

listen.en: Coffee has become a real obsession for my sister.
listen.zh: 我姊姊現在對咖啡非常著迷。

chinese.en: Society's obsession with appearance puts pressure on young people to look perfect online.
chinese.zh: 社會對外表的過度重視，讓年輕人承受在網路上必須看起來完美的壓力。

english.en: My father has an obsession with keeping the house clean.
english.zh: 我爸對保持家裡整潔有一種執著。

speak.en: I'll admit I have a bit of an obsession with bubble tea.
speak.zh: 我承認自己有點迷戀珍珠奶茶。

write.en: Some critics argue that the obsession with economic growth ignores its environmental costs.
write.zh: 有些評論者認為，對經濟成長的執迷忽略了它對環境造成的代價。

example.en: Many detergents contain chemicals that pollute rivers, so some families now choose eco-friendly brands made from plant ingredients.
example.zh: 許多清潔劑含有會汙染河川的化學物質，所以現在有些家庭改用植物成分製成的環保品牌。

listen.en: We need to buy more laundry detergent this weekend.
listen.zh: 這個週末我們得再買些洗衣精。

chinese.en: Wash the wool sweater by hand using cold water and a mild detergent.
chinese.zh: 這件羊毛毛衣請用冷水和溫和的清潔劑手洗。

english.en: Please don't use too much detergent when you wash the dishes.
english.zh: 洗碗時請不要用太多洗碗精。

speak.en: My skin gets itchy if I use a strong detergent on my clothes.
speak.zh: 如果用太強的洗衣精洗衣服，我的皮膚就會發癢。

write.en: Supermarkets could offer refill stations for detergent to reduce the number of plastic bottles.
write.zh: 超市可以設置清潔劑補充站，減少塑膠瓶的數量。

example.en: The passage never states the writer's age, but readers can infer it from the historical events she remembers from childhood.
example.zh: 文章從未提到作者的年齡，但讀者可以從她童年記得的歷史事件推知。

listen.en: What can we infer from the results of this survey?
listen.zh: 從這份調查的結果，我們可以推論出什麼？

chinese.en: From such a small sample, it is risky to infer that all teenagers dislike reading.
chinese.zh: 從這麼小的樣本就推論所有青少年都討厭閱讀，是很冒險的。

english.en: Students should learn to infer the meaning of new words from context.
english.zh: 學生應該學會從上下文推斷生字的意思。

speak.en: When someone doesn't reply to my messages, I usually infer they're busy.
speak.zh: 有人沒回我訊息時，我通常會推想他們在忙。

write.en: Economists inferred from falling sales that consumers were becoming more cautious about spending.
write.zh: 經濟學家從銷售額下滑推斷，消費者花錢變得更加謹慎。

example.en: The fireworks on both sides of the river were simultaneous, so the crowd could not decide where to look first.
example.zh: 河的兩岸同時施放煙火，讓群眾不知道該先看哪一邊。

listen.en: The film had a simultaneous release in several countries.
listen.zh: 這部電影在好幾個國家同步上映。

chinese.en: The government announced simultaneous price cuts on buses and trains to encourage public transport use.
chinese.zh: 政府宣布公車和火車同時降價，以鼓勵民眾搭乘大眾運輸。

english.en: The two department stores held simultaneous sales during the holiday.
english.zh: 這兩家百貨公司在假期間同時舉辦特賣。

speak.en: I can't handle simultaneous conversations; I need to focus on one person.
speak.zh: 我沒辦法同時跟好幾個人聊天，我得專心跟一個人說話。

write.en: The rise in online shopping was simultaneous with a sharp drop in visits to local stores.
write.zh: 網路購物興起的同時，實體店面的來客數也大幅下滑。

example.en: After the city introduced free vaccinations, the incidence of flu among schoolchildren fell sharply over the following winter.
example.zh: 市政府推行免費疫苗接種後，隔年冬天學童的流感發生率大幅下降。

listen.en: Doctors are worried about the rising incidence of allergies.
listen.zh: 醫生對過敏發生率持續上升感到憂心。

chinese.en: The graph shows that the incidence of road accidents is highest during holiday periods.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，交通事故的發生率在連假期間最高。

english.en: Regular exercise can reduce the incidence of many health problems.
english.zh: 規律運動可以降低許多健康問題的發生率。

speak.en: I've read that the incidence of short-sightedness among kids keeps going up.
speak.zh: 我讀過，小孩近視的比例一直在上升。

write.en: Countries with clean water supplies tend to have a much lower incidence of stomach infections.
write.zh: 擁有乾淨供水的國家，腸胃感染的發生率往往低得多。

example.en: The architect followed the museum project closely, from its original conception on paper to the day it opened.
example.zh: 這位建築師全程參與博物館計畫，從最初紙上的構想一直到開幕那天。

listen.en: Her conception of a good teacher has changed over time.
listen.zh: 她對好老師的看法隨著時間改變了。

chinese.en: Most people have no conception of how much water large factories use every day.
chinese.zh: 大多數人完全不知道大型工廠每天會用掉多少水。

english.en: The public conception of science is often shaped by the media.
english.zh: 大眾對科學的看法常常是由媒體塑造的。

speak.en: Honestly, my conception of adulthood was totally different when I was a kid.
speak.zh: 老實說，我小時候對「長大成人」的想像完全不一樣。

write.en: The company's conception of teamwork encourages employees to share ideas openly across departments.
write.zh: 這家公司對團隊合作的理念，鼓勵員工跨部門公開分享想法。

example.en: After the storm warning, temperatures plunged overnight, and many residents woke up to frozen pipes and icy roads.
example.zh: 暴風警報發布後，氣溫一夜之間驟降，許多居民醒來發現水管結凍、道路結冰。

listen.en: The children plunged into the cold lake and laughed.
listen.zh: 孩子們跳進冰冷的湖裡哈哈大笑。

chinese.en: The graph shows a sharp plunge in coffee prices during the second quarter.
chinese.zh: 這張圖表顯示，咖啡價格在第二季急遽下跌。

english.en: She finally took the plunge and started her own bakery.
english.zh: 她終於下定決心，開了自己的麵包店。

speak.en: When I moved abroad, I just plunged into the local culture.
speak.zh: 我搬到國外時，就直接全心投入當地的文化。

write.en: The new manager plunged straight into work, meeting every team on her first morning.
write.zh: 新經理一上任就全力投入工作，第一天早上就和每個團隊見了面。

example.en: After months of drought, farmers rejoiced at the heavy rain, knowing their crops might survive the summer.
example.zh: 經過好幾個月的乾旱，農民為這場大雨感到欣喜，因為他們知道作物也許能撐過夏天。

listen.en: The fans rejoiced as their team scored the winning goal.
listen.zh: 球隊踢進致勝的一球時，球迷們歡聲雷動。

chinese.en: Environmental groups rejoiced over the government's decision to protect the ancient forest.
chinese.zh: 環保團體對政府保護那片古老森林的決定感到欣喜。

english.en: We rejoiced when we heard that our grandmother had recovered.
english.zh: 聽到奶奶康復的消息時，我們都非常高興。

speak.en: Students usually rejoice when exams are over and summer begins.
speak.zh: 考試結束、暑假開始時，學生通常都很開心。

write.en: Instead of rejoicing in her own success, she thanked everyone who had supported her.
write.zh: 她沒有只顧著為自己的成功高興，而是感謝每一位支持過她的人。

example.en: The scholarship programme is famous for its rigorous selection process, which includes written exams, interviews and group tasks.
example.zh: 這項獎學金計畫以嚴格的甄選過程聞名，包括筆試、面試和小組任務。

listen.en: The athletes follow a rigorous training plan every morning.
listen.zh: 這些運動員每天早上都遵循嚴格的訓練計畫。

chinese.en: Good science depends on rigorous methods rather than exciting headlines or popular opinion.
chinese.zh: 好的科學仰賴嚴謹的方法，而不是吸睛的標題或大眾的意見。

english.en: This university has very rigorous standards for accepting new students.
english.zh: 這所大學錄取新生的標準非常嚴格。

speak.en: My high school teachers were rigorous, but I learned a lot.
speak.zh: 我高中的老師要求很嚴格，但我學到了很多。

write.en: Before publishing the report, the team carried out a rigorous analysis of the survey data.
write.zh: 發表報告之前，團隊對問卷資料做了縝密的分析。

example.en: Instead of buying cheap plastic chairs that break easily, the school chose durable metal ones that could survive daily use.
example.zh: 學校沒有買容易壞的便宜塑膠椅，而是選了經得起每天使用的耐用金屬椅。

listen.en: We need a durable bag for carrying heavy books.
listen.zh: 我們需要一個耐用的袋子來裝很重的書。

chinese.en: Consumers are increasingly willing to pay more for durable products that reduce waste.
chinese.zh: 消費者越來越願意多花錢購買能減少浪費的耐用產品。

english.en: The two countries hope to reach a durable peace agreement.
english.zh: 兩國希望達成一份持久的和平協議。

speak.en: I prefer durable clothes, even if they cost a bit more.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡耐穿的衣服，就算貴一點也沒關係。

write.en: Engineers are testing a more durable road surface that can withstand heavy summer rain.
write.zh: 工程師正在測試一種更耐用、能承受夏季豪雨的路面。

example.en: The elderly patient made a remarkable recovery after the surgery, walking without help only weeks later.
example.zh: 這位年長的病人術後恢復得驚人，短短幾週後就能自己走路了。

listen.en: Her paintings are remarkable for their bright colours.
listen.zh: 她的畫作以鮮豔的色彩引人注目。

chinese.en: It is remarkable that so many volunteers gave up their weekends to clean the beach.
chinese.zh: 這麼多志工願意放棄週末來淨灘，實在令人佩服。

english.en: The young programmer showed remarkable talent at a very early age.
english.zh: 這位年輕的程式設計師從很小就展現出非凡的天分。

speak.en: The view from the top of the mountain was truly remarkable.
speak.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色真的很壯觀。

write.en: Considering its small budget, the film was a remarkable success with critics and audiences.
write.zh: 考量到預算不多，這部電影能同時獲得影評和觀眾的好評，相當了不起。

example.en: The company offered higher salaries and flexible hours to induce experienced engineers to leave their current jobs.
example.zh: 這家公司提供更高的薪水和彈性工時，吸引資深工程師離開目前的工作。

listen.en: Nothing could induce him to change his mind.
listen.zh: 沒有任何事能讓他改變心意。

chinese.en: Researchers found that long hours of screen time may induce headaches in children.
chinese.zh: 研究人員發現，長時間看螢幕可能會引發兒童頭痛。

english.en: Lower taxes may induce more people to start small businesses.
english.zh: 降低稅率可能會促使更多人創立小型企業。

speak.en: Exam pressure can induce a lot of stress in teenagers.
speak.zh: 考試壓力會讓青少年承受很大的壓力。

write.en: Scientists used gentle heat to induce a chemical change in the sample.
write.zh: 科學家用溫和的加熱讓樣本產生化學變化。

example.en: Using a powerful telescope, astronomers captured images of a galaxy so distant that its light took billions of years to arrive.
example.zh: 天文學家利用高倍望遠鏡拍到一個遙遠星系的影像，它的光要花數十億年才能抵達地球。

listen.en: On clear nights, we can see part of our galaxy.
listen.zh: 在晴朗的夜晚，我們可以看到銀河系的一部分。

chinese.en: There may be more galaxies in the universe than grains of sand on Earth.
chinese.zh: 宇宙中星系的數量，可能比地球上的沙粒還多。

english.en: Scientists are studying how galaxies formed after the Big Bang.
english.zh: 科學家正在研究星系在大霹靂之後是如何形成的。

speak.en: I've always wondered whether there's life in another galaxy.
speak.zh: 我一直很好奇其他星系是否有生命存在。

write.en: The awards ceremony attracted a galaxy of famous actors, singers and directors.
write.zh: 這場頒獎典禮吸引了眾多知名演員、歌手和導演出席。

example.en: Rather than counting how many visitors came, the museum carried out qualitative research to understand how people felt about the exhibition.
example.zh: 博物館沒有只計算來了多少參觀者，而是進行質性研究，了解大家對展覽的感受。

listen.en: The teacher gave us qualitative feedback instead of grades.
listen.zh: 老師給我們文字回饋，而不是打分數。

chinese.en: There is a qualitative difference between memorising facts and truly understanding a subject.
chinese.zh: 死背知識和真正理解一門學科，在本質上是不同的。

english.en: The report combines qualitative and quantitative methods to study tourism.
english.zh: 這份報告結合質性與量化方法來研究觀光業。

speak.en: For my thesis, I'm doing qualitative interviews with young parents.
speak.zh: 為了寫論文，我正在對年輕父母進行質性訪談。

write.en: Customer reviews offer qualitative insights that simple sales figures alone cannot reveal.
write.zh: 顧客評論能提供質性的洞見，這是單看銷售數字無法呈現的。

example.en: The chef served a light salad as a complement to the rich, creamy pasta, balancing the flavours of the meal.
example.zh: 主廚用一道清爽的沙拉搭配濃郁的奶油義大利麵，讓整餐的味道更平衡。

listen.en: This blue scarf really complements your winter coat.
listen.zh: 這條藍色圍巾和你的冬季大衣很搭。

chinese.en: Online lessons should complement traditional classroom teaching rather than replace it completely.
chinese.zh: 線上課程應該用來輔助傳統課堂教學，而不是完全取代它。

english.en: Regular exercise is the perfect complement to a healthy diet.
english.zh: 規律運動是健康飲食的最佳搭配。

speak.en: My best friend and I complement each other really well.
speak.zh: 我和我最好的朋友個性非常互補。

write.en: The new public library was designed to complement the historic buildings around the square.
write.zh: 新的公共圖書館在設計上刻意與廣場周圍的歷史建築相互呼應。

example.en: Critics argue that the university mainly serves the wealthy elite, since few students from poorer families are ever admitted.
example.zh: 批評者認為這所大學主要服務富裕的菁英階層，因為來自清寒家庭的學生很少被錄取。

listen.en: Elite athletes train for hours almost every day.
listen.zh: 頂尖運動員幾乎每天都要訓練好幾個小時。

chinese.en: Education should not be a privilege reserved only for the social elite.
chinese.zh: 教育不應該是只有社會菁英才能享有的特權。

english.en: She joined an elite team of engineers at a large tech company.
english.zh: 她加入了一家大型科技公司的菁英工程師團隊。

speak.en: I don't think elite schools are always better for children.
speak.zh: 我不認為明星學校一定對孩子比較好。

write.en: In many countries, the business elite has strong influence over economic decisions.
write.zh: 在許多國家，企業菁英對經濟決策有很大的影響力。

example.en: Old phones and laptops are a major source of electronic waste, which can release harmful chemicals if not recycled properly.
example.zh: 舊手機和筆電是電子廢棄物的主要來源，若沒有妥善回收，可能會釋放有害化學物質。

listen.en: Many shops now accept electronic payments instead of cash.
listen.zh: 現在許多商店都接受電子支付，不必付現金。

chinese.en: The library allows students to borrow electronic versions of textbooks for free.
chinese.zh: 圖書館讓學生免費借閱教科書的電子版。

english.en: My brother enjoys listening to electronic music while he studies.
english.zh: 我哥哥喜歡一邊讀書一邊聽電子音樂。

speak.en: Honestly, I spend too much time on electronic gadgets every day.
speak.zh: 老實說，我每天花太多時間在電子產品上了。

write.en: Patients can now access their medical records through a secure electronic system.
write.zh: 病患現在可以透過安全的電子系統查詢自己的病歷。

example.en: Because his grades fell below the required level, the student was placed on academic probation and had to meet his adviser weekly.
example.zh: 由於成績低於標準，這名學生被留校察看，必須每週和導師面談。

listen.en: She passed her probation and received a permanent contract.
listen.zh: 她通過了試用期，拿到正式的聘用合約。

chinese.en: During the probation period, managers will closely review each new worker's performance.
chinese.zh: 試用期間，主管會仔細檢視每位新進員工的表現。

english.en: Her probation period at the bank will end next month.
english.zh: 她在銀行的試用期將在下個月結束。

speak.en: I was really nervous during my probation at my first job.
speak.zh: 我第一份工作的試用期間真的很緊張。

write.en: Instead of being sent to prison, the young offender was given probation and community service.
write.zh: 這名年輕的違法者沒有入獄，而是被判緩刑並須從事社區服務。

example.en: The film has no single star; instead, its ensemble cast of talented actors shares the story equally.
example.zh: 這部電影沒有唯一的主角，而是由一群優秀演員共同撐起整個故事。

listen.en: The jazz ensemble performed in the park last night.
listen.zh: 那個爵士樂團昨晚在公園演出。

chinese.en: The school ensemble practises every Friday to prepare for the national competition.
chinese.zh: 學校的合奏團每週五練習，準備參加全國比賽。

english.en: She wore a stylish ensemble of a black jacket and white trousers.
english.zh: 她穿了一套時髦的服裝：黑色外套搭配白色長褲。

speak.en: Playing in an ensemble taught me how to listen to others.
speak.zh: 參加合奏團讓我學會如何聆聽別人。

write.en: The old houses, narrow lanes and small temple form a charming ensemble in the town centre.
write.zh: 老房子、窄巷和小廟在鎮中心構成一幅迷人的整體景致。

example.en: Everyone fell silent as the doctor entered with a solemn expression, and the family knew the news was serious.
example.zh: 醫生神情嚴肅地走進來時，大家都安靜下來，家屬知道消息不樂觀。

listen.en: He made a solemn promise to look after his sister.
listen.zh: 他鄭重承諾會好好照顧妹妹。

chinese.en: The museum holds a solemn ceremony each year to remember the victims of the earthquake.
chinese.zh: 博物館每年都會舉行莊嚴的儀式，紀念地震的罹難者。

english.en: The volunteers made a solemn pledge to keep the river clean.
english.zh: 志工們鄭重承諾要維護河川的清潔。

speak.en: My grandfather always looks solemn in old family photos.
speak.zh: 我爺爺在舊的全家福照片裡總是一臉嚴肅。

write.en: The atmosphere in the courtroom was solemn as the judge prepared to announce the verdict.
write.zh: 法官準備宣判時，法庭裡的氣氛十分肅穆。

example.en: Companies extract huge amounts of oil from beneath the seabed, but the process can seriously damage marine ecosystems.
example.zh: 企業從海床底下開採大量石油，但這個過程可能嚴重破壞海洋生態系。

listen.en: We read a short extract from the novel in class.
listen.zh: 我們在課堂上讀了這本小說的一小段節錄。

chinese.en: The app can extract key information from long reports in just a few seconds.
chinese.zh: 這個應用程式只要幾秒鐘，就能從冗長的報告中擷取重點資訊。

english.en: Add a few drops of vanilla extract to the cake mixture.
english.zh: 在蛋糕麵糊裡加幾滴香草精。

speak.en: It was hard to extract any useful advice from that meeting.
speak.zh: 那場會議很難讓人得到什麼有用的建議。

write.en: Researchers extracted DNA from ancient bones to learn how early humans migrated.
write.zh: 研究人員從古老的骨骸中萃取 DNA，以了解早期人類如何遷徙。

example.en: After years of working as an engineer, he became an independent consultant, advising factories on how to save energy.
example.zh: 當了多年工程師後，他成為獨立顧問，為工廠提供節能建議。

listen.en: My aunt works as a financial consultant in the city.
listen.zh: 我阿姨在市區擔任理財顧問。

chinese.en: The hospital consultant explained the treatment options clearly to the patient's family.
chinese.zh: 醫院的主治醫師向病患家屬清楚說明了治療方案。

english.en: The school invited an education consultant to review its courses.
english.zh: 學校邀請了一位教育顧問來檢視課程。

speak.en: I'd love to become a travel consultant because I enjoy planning trips.
speak.zh: 我很想當旅遊顧問，因為我喜歡規劃旅行。

write.en: Some governments rely too heavily on expensive consultants instead of training their own staff.
write.zh: 有些政府過度依賴昂貴的顧問，而不是培訓自己的人員。

example.en: The museum added interactive displays and hands-on workshops to boost visitor engagement, especially among young families.
example.zh: 博物館增設互動展示和動手做工作坊，以提高參觀者的參與度，特別是年輕家庭。

listen.en: They announced their engagement at a family dinner.
listen.zh: 他們在家庭聚餐時宣布訂婚。

chinese.en: Local governments should encourage greater public engagement in decisions about urban planning.
chinese.zh: 地方政府應該鼓勵民眾更積極參與都市計畫的決策。

english.en: I can't come to the party because I have a prior engagement.
english.zh: 我不能去派對，因為我已經先有約了。

speak.en: Social media companies really care about engagement, not just followers.
speak.zh: 社群媒體公司真正在意的是互動率，而不只是追蹤人數。

write.en: Her deep engagement with environmental issues led her to study marine biology abroad.
write.zh: 她對環境議題的高度投入，讓她決定出國攻讀海洋生物學。

example.en: Cars and power plants release nitrogen oxides, which react with sunlight to create the brown smog seen over many cities.
example.zh: 汽車和發電廠會排放氮氧化物，這些物質在陽光下起反應，形成許多城市上空的褐色霧霾。

listen.en: Zinc oxide is often used in sunscreen for children.
listen.zh: 氧化鋅常被用在兒童防曬乳裡。

chinese.en: Some ancient painters used metal oxides to create bright colours that still survive today.
chinese.zh: 有些古代畫家利用金屬氧化物調出鮮豔的顏色，至今仍保存下來。

english.en: The red colour of the soil comes from iron oxide.
english.zh: 這片土壤的紅色來自氧化鐵。

speak.en: In chemistry class, we learned how metals turn into oxides.
speak.zh: 在化學課上，我們學到金屬如何變成氧化物。

write.en: Stricter emission rules have reduced the amount of harmful oxides released by factories.
write.zh: 更嚴格的排放規定減少了工廠釋放的有害氧化物。

example.en: In Taiwan, a traditional funeral may last several days, with relatives gathering to pay their respects and burn incense.
example.zh: 在臺灣，傳統喪禮可能持續好幾天，親友會聚在一起致意、上香。

listen.en: She wore a plain black dress to the funeral.
listen.zh: 她穿了一件素面的黑色洋裝去參加葬禮。

chinese.en: More families are choosing simple, eco-friendly funerals instead of expensive traditional ceremonies.
chinese.zh: 越來越多家庭選擇簡樸環保的葬禮，而不是昂貴的傳統儀式。

english.en: He took a few days off work to attend his uncle's funeral.
english.zh: 他請了幾天假去參加叔叔的喪禮。

speak.en: I think funerals should celebrate a person's life, not just mourn them.
speak.zh: 我覺得葬禮應該是紀念一個人的一生，而不只是哀悼。

write.en: The local funeral home offers counselling services to help grieving families cope with loss.
write.zh: 當地的殯儀館提供諮商服務，幫助悲傷的家屬面對失去親人的痛。

example.en: These hiking trails are not exclusive to experienced climbers; families with young children can enjoy them too.
example.zh: 這些登山步道並非經驗豐富的登山者專屬，帶著幼童的家庭也能盡情享受。

listen.en: They stayed at an exclusive hotel by the lake.
listen.zh: 他們住在湖邊一家高級飯店。

chinese.en: Studying hard and having an active social life are not mutually exclusive.
chinese.zh: 認真讀書和擁有活躍的社交生活並不互相衝突。

english.en: The company has exclusive rights to sell the software in Taiwan.
english.zh: 這家公司擁有在臺灣銷售這款軟體的獨家權利。

speak.en: Honestly, I think some gyms feel a bit too exclusive for beginners.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得有些健身房對初學者來說有點太排外了。

write.en: Critics argue that exclusive private schools widen the gap between rich and poor families.
write.zh: 批評者認為，昂貴的貴族私校擴大了富裕與貧窮家庭之間的差距。

example.en: After moving from Taipei to a small fishing village, she found the slower tempo of daily life surprisingly relaxing.
example.zh: 從臺北搬到一個小漁村後，她發現較慢的生活步調出奇地令人放鬆。

listen.en: The band played the next song at a faster tempo.
listen.zh: 樂團用較快的節奏演奏下一首歌。

chinese.en: Our team picked up the tempo in the second half and finally won the match.
chinese.zh: 我們隊在下半場加快了節奏，最後贏得了比賽。

english.en: The teacher asked us to practise the piece at a slow tempo.
english.zh: 老師要我們用慢速練習這首曲子。

speak.en: I prefer working in a city because I like a fast tempo.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡在城市工作，因為我喜歡快節奏。

write.en: The sudden change of tempo in the project meant everyone had to work longer hours.
write.zh: 專案步調突然改變，意味著每個人都必須延長工作時間。

example.en: The government is still wrestling with the problem of rising housing costs, and no simple solution has appeared.
example.zh: 政府仍在努力處理房價不斷上漲的問題，至今還沒有出現簡單的解方。

listen.en: The young brothers wrestled playfully on the soft grass.
listen.zh: 年幼的兄弟倆在柔軟的草地上嬉鬧扭打。

chinese.en: I wrestled with the decision for weeks before finally accepting the job offer abroad.
chinese.zh: 我為這個決定苦惱了好幾個星期，最後才接受海外的工作機會。

english.en: The security guard quickly wrestled the man to the ground.
english.zh: 警衛迅速把那名男子壓制在地上。

speak.en: I used to watch wrestling on TV, but I've never wrestled myself.
speak.zh: 我以前常看電視上的摔角比賽，但自己從來沒有真的摔過角。

write.en: He had to wrestle with his conscience before telling his manager about the mistake.
write.zh: 他經過一番良心掙扎，才向主管說出那個錯誤。

example.en: Because the office was warm, she took off her jacket and worked in a light silk blouse all afternoon.
example.zh: 因為辦公室很暖和，她脫掉外套，整個下午只穿著一件輕薄的絲質襯衫工作。

listen.en: My sister bought a new blouse for the party.
listen.zh: 我姊姊買了一件新襯衫要穿去派對。

chinese.en: The school uniform for girls includes a short-sleeved blouse and a pleated skirt.
chinese.zh: 女生的制服包括一件短袖襯衫和一件百褶裙。

english.en: Could you help me find this blouse in a smaller size?
english.zh: 你可以幫我找這件襯衫小一號的尺寸嗎？

speak.en: I usually wear a simple blouse and jeans when I go to class.
speak.zh: 我去上課時通常穿一件簡單的襯衫配牛仔褲。

write.en: The local factory once produced thousands of blouses each week for stores across Europe.
write.zh: 這家當地工廠過去每週為歐洲各地的商店生產數千件女用襯衫。

example.en: In the fading twilight, it was hard to see the path, so the hikers switched on their torches.
example.zh: 暮色漸暗，很難看清步道，於是登山客們打開了手電筒。

listen.en: Bats often leave their caves at twilight to hunt.
listen.zh: 蝙蝠常在黃昏時離開洞穴去覓食。

chinese.en: In the twilight of his career, the famous singer chose to teach young musicians.
chinese.zh: 這位知名歌手在職業生涯晚期，選擇去指導年輕音樂人。

english.en: Many retired people want to enjoy their twilight years near their families.
english.zh: 許多退休人士想在家人身邊安享晚年。

speak.en: I love taking photos at twilight because the light is so soft.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡在黃昏拍照，因為光線非常柔和。

write.en: Street lights in the park switch on automatically as twilight falls, saving energy during the day.
write.zh: 公園裡的路燈會在暮色降臨時自動亮起，白天則可節省能源。

example.en: A traffic warden walked down the street, checking every parked car and issuing fines to drivers without a permit.
example.zh: 一名交通稽查員沿街走著，檢查每一輛停放的車，並對沒有停車證的駕駛開罰單。

listen.en: The warden locked the main gate after dark.
listen.zh: 管理員在天黑後鎖上了大門。

chinese.en: Each university dormitory has a warden who deals with students' everyday problems.
chinese.zh: 每棟大學宿舍都有一位舍監，負責處理學生的日常問題。

english.en: The prison warden introduced a new education programme for inmates.
english.zh: 典獄長為受刑人推出了一項新的教育計畫。

speak.en: In my old dorm, the warden was strict but really kind.
speak.zh: 我以前住的宿舍，舍監很嚴格，但人真的很好。

write.en: Game wardens patrol the national park to protect endangered animals from illegal hunters.
write.zh: 野生動物保護官在國家公園巡邏，保護瀕危動物免受盜獵者傷害。

example.en: If your cough doesn't improve, go to the chemist's on the corner and ask for some medicine.
example.zh: 如果你的咳嗽沒有好轉，就去轉角的藥局買點藥。

listen.en: She works as a chemist at a large company.
listen.zh: 她在一家大公司擔任化學研究員。

chinese.en: The chemist explained how often I should take the tablets and what to avoid.
chinese.zh: 藥劑師向我說明這些藥錠應該多久吃一次，以及哪些東西要避免。

english.en: My brother wants to become a chemist after he graduates.
english.zh: 我哥哥畢業後想成為化學家。

speak.en: I usually buy vitamins at the chemist near my apartment.
speak.zh: 我通常在我公寓附近的藥局買維他命。

write.en: Food chemists test new ingredients to make sure snacks are both tasty and safe.
write.zh: 食品化學家會測試新成分，確保零食既美味又安全。

example.en: The goalkeeper made a crucial save in the final minute, which allowed his team to win the championship.
example.zh: 守門員在最後一分鐘做出關鍵撲救，讓他的球隊贏得了冠軍。

listen.en: Good sleep is crucial before an important exam.
listen.zh: 重要考試前，充足的睡眠非常關鍵。

chinese.en: It is crucial that parents talk to their children about online safety.
chinese.zh: 家長和孩子談談網路安全是非常重要的。

english.en: Clean water is crucial for the health of local communities.
english.zh: 乾淨的水對當地社區的健康至關重要。

speak.en: I think making friends is crucial when you move abroad.
speak.zh: 我覺得搬到國外時，交朋友非常重要。

write.en: Feedback from customers provided crucial information that helped the company improve its service.
write.zh: 顧客的意見提供了關鍵資訊，幫助公司改善服務。

example.en: The workers' union exerted pressure on the factory owners until they agreed to improve safety conditions.
example.zh: 工會持續對工廠老闆施壓，直到他們同意改善安全條件。

listen.en: Try not to exert yourself too much in this heat.
listen.zh: 天氣這麼熱，盡量不要太費力。

chinese.en: The moon exerts a gravitational pull that causes the rise and fall of ocean tides.
chinese.zh: 月球施加的引力造成了海水的漲潮與退潮。

english.en: Large companies sometimes exert too much control over the media.
english.zh: 大型企業有時對媒體施加過多的控制。

speak.en: My coach never exerts pressure on us, which I really appreciate.
speak.zh: 我的教練從不給我們壓力，這點我真的很感激。

write.en: As the new manager, she needed to exert her authority without upsetting the team.
write.zh: 身為新任經理，她必須在不惹惱團隊的情況下展現自己的權威。

example.en: Online shoppers should use strong passwords because identity thieves often target people who reuse the same password.
example.zh: 網購的人應該使用強密碼，因為身分竊賊常鎖定重複使用同一組密碼的人。

listen.en: A thief stole my bike from outside the library.
listen.zh: 有個小偷把我停在圖書館外的腳踏車偷走了。

chinese.en: Security cameras helped the shop owner identify the thief who took the cash.
chinese.zh: 監視器幫助店主認出了拿走現金的小偷。

english.en: The police finally caught the car thief near the station last night.
english.zh: 警方昨晚終於在車站附近抓到了偷車賊。

speak.en: Luckily, I've never had anything stolen by a thief while travelling.
speak.zh: 幸運的是，我旅行時從來沒有東西被小偷偷走過。

write.en: Some experts believe that poverty, not greed, turns many young people into thieves.
write.zh: 有些專家認為，讓許多年輕人淪為竊賊的是貧窮，而不是貪婪。

example.en: Because she worked in Taipei but lived in Hsinchu, she spent years shuttling between the two cities by high-speed train.
example.zh: 因為她在臺北工作卻住在新竹，好幾年來她都搭高鐵往返兩地。

listen.en: We took the shuttle from the station to the campus.
listen.zh: 我們搭接駁車從車站到校園。

chinese.en: Volunteers shuttled elderly residents to and from the health centre throughout the day.
chinese.zh: 志工們一整天來回接送年長居民往返衛生所。

english.en: The university runs a shuttle service between the two campuses.
english.zh: 這所大學在兩個校區之間提供接駁服務。

speak.en: I spent my childhood shuttling between my parents' and grandparents' homes.
speak.zh: 我的童年都在爸媽家和爺爺奶奶家之間來回度過。

write.en: Before the space shuttle was retired, it carried astronauts and equipment into orbit.
write.zh: 太空梭退役之前，負責將太空人和設備送上軌道。

example.en: The doorway in the old farmhouse was so low that even short visitors had to stoop to get inside.
example.zh: 老農舍的門口很低，即使是個子矮的訪客也得彎腰才能進去。

listen.en: Please stoop down and check under the desk.
listen.zh: 請彎下腰檢查一下桌子底下。

chinese.en: After years of working at a computer, my uncle now walks with a slight stoop.
chinese.zh: 在電腦前工作多年後，我叔叔現在走路有點駝背。

english.en: I would never stoop to cheating just to pass an exam.
english.zh: 我絕不會為了通過考試而淪落到作弊。

speak.en: Gardening is fun, but all that stooping really hurts my back.
speak.zh: 園藝很有趣，但一直彎腰真的讓我腰很痛。

write.en: Some advertisers stoop so low as to make false health claims about their products.
write.zh: 有些廣告商竟然不擇手段，對自家產品做出不實的健康宣稱。

example.en: To mitigate the risk of flooding, the city built higher walls along the river and improved its drainage system.
example.zh: 為了降低淹水的風險，市政府沿河築起更高的堤防，並改善了排水系統。

listen.en: Good planning can mitigate many problems at work.
listen.zh: 良好的規劃可以減輕工作上的許多問題。

chinese.en: The judge considered several mitigating circumstances before deciding on a lighter sentence.
chinese.zh: 法官在決定從輕量刑之前，考量了幾項可減輕罪責的情節。

english.en: Wearing a mask can mitigate the spread of seasonal flu.
english.zh: 戴口罩可以減緩季節性流感的傳播。

speak.en: I find that a short walk helps mitigate my stress before exams.
speak.zh: 我發現考前散步一下有助於緩解壓力。

write.en: Governments must invest in renewable energy to mitigate the long-term impact of climate change.
write.zh: 各國政府必須投資再生能源，以減緩氣候變遷的長期影響。

example.en: Since the new hybrid model offers much better mileage, drivers spend far less money on petrol each month.
example.zh: 由於新款油電混合車的油耗表現好得多，駕駛人每個月的油錢少了許多。

listen.en: Please check the mileage before you return the car.
listen.zh: 還車前請先確認里程數。

chinese.en: Employees who drive their own cars for work can claim a mileage allowance.
chinese.zh: 開自己的車出公差的員工可以申請里程補貼。

english.en: She got a lot of mileage out of her old winter coat.
english.zh: 她那件舊冬季外套穿了很久，非常值得。

speak.en: My car's mileage is pretty high because I drive to work every day.
speak.zh: 我的車里程數很高，因為我每天開車上班。

write.en: The company gained a lot of mileage from its popular recycling campaign.
write.zh: 這家公司從廣受歡迎的回收活動中獲得了很大的宣傳效益。

example.en: Although he is only an amateur, his paintings are so detailed that many visitors assume he trained at an art school.
example.zh: 雖然他只是業餘畫家，但他的畫作細緻到許多參觀者都以為他是藝術學校出身。

listen.en: My father has been a keen amateur photographer for years.
listen.zh: 我爸爸多年來一直是熱衷的業餘攝影師。

chinese.en: The local amateur theatre group performs a new play every summer in the park.
chinese.zh: 當地的業餘劇團每年夏天都會在公園演出一齣新戲。

english.en: Compared with the experts, I'm just an amateur at cooking.
english.zh: 跟專家比起來，我在烹飪方面只是個外行人。

speak.en: I play tennis as an amateur, mostly just for fun.
speak.zh: 我是業餘打網球，大多只是為了好玩。

write.en: Some people believe amateur athletes should be allowed to compete in international tournaments.
write.zh: 有些人認為應該讓業餘運動員參加國際錦標賽。

example.en: Teachers who expect weak students to fail may create a self-fulfilling prophecy, because those students gradually stop trying.
example.zh: 預期程度差的學生會失敗的老師，可能造成自我應驗的預言，因為那些學生會漸漸放棄努力。

listen.en: Nobody believed the old man's prophecy about the storm.
listen.zh: 沒有人相信那位老人對暴風雨的預言。

chinese.en: Economists' gloomy prophecies about the housing market have not yet come true.
chinese.zh: 經濟學家對房市的悲觀預言至今尚未成真。

english.en: The novel begins with an ancient prophecy about a lost king.
english.zh: 這部小說以一則關於失落國王的古老預言開場。

speak.en: I don't believe in prophecy, but I enjoy fantasy stories about it.
speak.zh: 我不相信預言，但我很喜歡跟預言有關的奇幻故事。

write.en: Early prophecies that robots would replace all office workers have proved greatly exaggerated.
write.zh: 早期認為機器人會取代所有上班族的預言，已證明是過於誇大了。

example.en: Squats are an effective exercise because they strengthen the thighs, hips and lower back at the same time.
example.zh: 深蹲是很有效的運動，因為它能同時鍛鍊大腿、臀部和下背部。

listen.en: The water came up to my thighs as we crossed the river.
listen.zh: 我們過河時，水深到我的大腿。

chinese.en: This recipe uses boneless chicken thighs because they stay juicier than chicken breast.
chinese.zh: 這道食譜使用去骨雞腿肉，因為它比雞胸肉更多汁。

english.en: After the long bike ride, my thighs felt very sore.
english.zh: 騎了很久的腳踏車後，我的大腿非常痠痛。

speak.en: I usually stretch my thighs for a few minutes before jogging.
speak.zh: 我慢跑前通常會伸展大腿幾分鐘。

write.en: Doctors warn that sitting for long hours reduces blood flow to the thighs and legs.
write.zh: 醫生警告，長時間久坐會減少流向大腿和腿部的血液。

example.en: Because the washing machine was still under warranty, the company repaired it for free and even replaced the motor.
example.zh: 因為洗衣機還在保固期內，廠商免費修理，甚至還更換了馬達。

listen.en: Keep the receipt in case you need the warranty.
listen.zh: 收據要留好，以防需要用到保固。

chinese.en: Opening the phone yourself may void the warranty, so let a technician check it.
chinese.zh: 自行拆開手機可能會讓保固失效，所以還是讓技師檢查吧。

english.en: Should I pay extra for an extended warranty on this camera?
english.zh: 我該為這台相機多付錢買延長保固嗎？

speak.en: I always check how long the warranty lasts before buying electronics.
speak.zh: 我買電子產品前，一定會先確認保固期有多長。

write.en: Consumer groups argue that longer warranties would encourage manufacturers to make more durable products.
write.zh: 消費者團體主張，延長保固期會促使製造商生產更耐用的產品。

example.en: After years of disagreements about money, the business partners decided to dissolve the company and go their separate ways.
example.zh: 在金錢問題上爭執多年後，這些事業夥伴決定解散公司，各走各的路。

listen.en: Salt dissolves faster in warm water than in cold.
listen.zh: 鹽在溫水中比在冷水中溶解得更快。

chinese.en: When she heard she had passed the exam, she dissolved into tears of relief.
chinese.zh: 聽到自己考試及格時，她如釋重負地哭了出來。

english.en: The student club was dissolved because it had too few members.
english.zh: 這個學生社團因為成員太少而被解散了。

speak.en: Honestly, all my stress just dissolves when I'm at the beach.
speak.zh: 說真的，只要待在海邊，我所有的壓力就都消失了。

write.en: Carbon dioxide dissolves in seawater, making the oceans more acidic and harming coral reefs.
write.zh: 二氧化碳溶入海水，使海洋變得更酸，並損害珊瑚礁。

example.en: Older adults are the fastest-growing segment of the population, so companies are designing more products for them.
example.zh: 年長者是人口中成長最快的族群，因此企業正在為他們設計更多產品。

listen.en: We watched a short segment of the morning news.
listen.zh: 我們看了晨間新聞的一小段。

chinese.en: The marketing team segmented customers into groups based on their age and income.
chinese.zh: 行銷團隊根據年齡和收入把顧客分成幾個族群。

english.en: Each segment of the course focuses on a different writing skill.
english.zh: 這門課的每個單元都著重在不同的寫作技巧。

speak.en: My favourite segment of the show is the cooking challenge.
speak.zh: 這個節目我最喜歡的單元是烹飪挑戰。

write.en: Engineers replaced the damaged segment of the bridge without closing it to traffic.
write.zh: 工程師在不封閉交通的情況下，更換了橋梁受損的路段。

example.en: The hotel looked lovely online, but the room was dreadful: the sheets were dirty and the heater didn't work.
example.zh: 那家飯店在網路上看起來很棒，但房間糟透了：床單很髒，暖氣也不能用。

listen.en: I feel dreadful about forgetting your birthday last week.
listen.zh: 上週忘了你的生日，我覺得很過意不去。

chinese.en: The new manager made a dreadful mistake by ignoring advice from experienced staff.
chinese.zh: 新來的經理忽視資深員工的建議，犯了一個非常嚴重的錯誤。

english.en: The traffic in the city centre is dreadful during rush hour.
english.zh: 尖峰時段市中心的交通非常糟糕。

speak.en: Honestly, the food at my school cafeteria was pretty dreadful.
speak.zh: 老實說，我們學校餐廳的食物真的很難吃。

write.en: Reports described the dreadful conditions in which many factory workers lived during the industrial revolution.
write.zh: 報告描述了工業革命期間許多工廠工人生活的惡劣環境。

example.en: When the heavy snow blocked the main roads, traffic across the city slowly ground to a halt.
example.zh: 大雪堵住主要道路後，全市交通慢慢陷入停頓。

listen.en: Some people grind their teeth while they sleep.
listen.zh: 有些人睡覺時會磨牙。

chinese.en: After a month of the daily grind, I really needed a weekend by the sea.
chinese.zh: 經過一個月單調辛苦的日常工作後，我真的很需要去海邊過個週末。

english.en: My grandmother still grinds her own spices by hand at home.
english.zh: 我奶奶在家還是親手研磨自己的香料。

speak.en: Studying every night can feel like a real grind sometimes.
speak.zh: 每天晚上都讀書，有時候真的感覺很累人。

write.en: The old mill used the power of the river to grind wheat into flour.
write.zh: 這座老磨坊利用河水的力量把小麥磨成麵粉。

example.en: Unlike soft cotton, the coarse wool made the sweater itchy, so she always wore a shirt underneath.
example.zh: 和柔軟的棉不同，粗糙的羊毛讓這件毛衣穿起來很癢，所以她總是在裡面多穿一件襯衫。

listen.en: Add a pinch of coarse salt to the soup.
listen.zh: 在湯裡加一小撮粗鹽。

chinese.en: Some parents complained that the comedy show contained too much coarse language.
chinese.zh: 有些家長抱怨這個喜劇節目有太多粗俗的言語。

english.en: This old brush has coarse bristles, so use it on the floor.
english.zh: 這把舊刷子的刷毛很粗，拿來刷地板吧。

speak.en: My dog's fur is really coarse, not soft like a cat's.
speak.zh: 我家狗的毛真的很粗，不像貓的毛那麼軟。

write.en: Builders mixed coarse gravel with cement to make the house's foundation much stronger.
write.zh: 工人把粗礫石和水泥混合，讓房子的地基更加堅固。

example.en: She hung her dress in the bathroom while she showered, because the steam helps remove wrinkles from the fabric.
example.zh: 她洗澡時把洋裝掛在浴室裡，因為蒸氣有助於去除布料上的皺褶。

listen.en: He wrinkled his nose at the smell of the cheese.
listen.zh: 他聞到起司的味道時皺起了鼻子。

chinese.en: The team spent a week ironing out the final wrinkles before launching the app.
chinese.zh: 團隊花了一週解決最後一些小問題，然後才推出這款應用程式。

english.en: Too much time in the sun can cause wrinkles at a young age.
english.zh: 太常曬太陽可能會讓人年紀輕輕就長皺紋。

speak.en: My shirt always wrinkles when I sit in the car too long.
speak.zh: 我在車上坐太久，襯衫總是會皺掉。

write.en: Advertisements for skin creams often promise to reduce wrinkles, but many claims are exaggerated.
write.zh: 保養乳霜的廣告常宣稱能減少皺紋，但許多說法都過於誇大。

example.en: Before packing, check your baggage allowance, because the airline charges heavy fees for every extra kilogram.
example.zh: 打包前先確認行李限額，因為航空公司對每多出的一公斤都會收取高額費用。

listen.en: The company pays a travel allowance for business trips.
listen.zh: 公司會為出差支付差旅津貼。

chinese.en: Teachers should make allowances for students who are learning in a second language.
chinese.zh: 老師應該體諒那些用第二語言學習的學生。

english.en: Do you think children should do housework to earn their allowance?
english.zh: 你認為孩子應該做家事來賺取零用錢嗎？

speak.en: Back in university, my allowance barely covered food and rent.
speak.zh: 讀大學時，我的生活費幾乎只夠付伙食費和房租。

write.en: The government increased the housing allowance for low-income families to help them cope with rising rents.
write.zh: 政府提高了低收入家庭的住房補助，幫助他們應付不斷上漲的房租。

example.en: Because judges' scores in figure skating are partly subjective, fans often argue about whether the results were fair.
example.zh: 由於花式滑冰的評審分數有一部分是主觀的，粉絲常為結果是否公平而爭論。

listen.en: Beauty is subjective, so everyone sees it differently.
listen.zh: 美是主觀的，所以每個人的看法都不一樣。

chinese.en: Reviews on travel websites are subjective, so it's wise to read several before booking.
chinese.zh: 旅遊網站上的評論都很主觀，所以訂房前最好多看幾則。

english.en: Her report was criticised for being too subjective and emotional.
english.zh: 她的報告被批評過於主觀和情緒化。

speak.en: I know my opinion is subjective, but I love this city.
speak.zh: 我知道我的看法很主觀，但我就是很愛這座城市。

write.en: Measuring happiness is difficult because people's subjective experiences of well-being vary widely across cultures.
write.zh: 衡量幸福感很困難，因為人們對幸福的主觀感受在不同文化間差異很大。

example.en: My sister wanted the beach and I wanted the mountains, so we compromised and chose a lake surrounded by hills.
example.zh: 我妹妹想去海邊，我想去山上，於是我們各退一步，選了一座被山丘環繞的湖。

listen.en: Good relationships often depend on a willingness to compromise.
listen.zh: 良好的關係常取決於願不願意妥協。

chinese.en: Cutting the safety budget could compromise the health of workers at the factory.
chinese.zh: 削減安全預算可能會危及工廠工人的健康。

english.en: I'm not willing to compromise on the quality of my work.
english.zh: 我不願意在工作品質上妥協。

speak.en: Since I started sharing a flat, I've learned to compromise on small things.
speak.zh: 自從和別人合租後，我學會了在小事上讓步。

write.en: Economic growth should not be achieved by compromising the needs of future generations.
write.zh: 經濟成長不應以犧牲後代的需求為代價。

example.en: The graph shows that imports exceeded exports for most of the decade, creating a growing trade deficit.
example.zh: 圖表顯示，這十年來進口大多超過出口，造成貿易逆差不斷擴大。

listen.en: The small company is running a deficit this year.
listen.zh: 這家小公司今年出現虧損。

chinese.en: Many office workers suffer from a sleep deficit that affects their concentration.
chinese.zh: 許多上班族都有睡眠不足的問題，影響了他們的專注力。

english.en: Our team came back from a large deficit to win the game.
english.zh: 我們隊在大幅落後的情況下逆轉贏得比賽。

speak.en: Our club ran a small deficit, so we had to raise membership fees.
speak.zh: 我們社團出現了一點赤字，所以必須調漲會費。

write.en: Experts warn that the country's pension system will face a serious deficit as the population ages.
write.zh: 專家警告，隨著人口老化，該國的退休金制度將面臨嚴重的赤字。

example.en: Before beginning his speech, the speaker cleared his throat, and the noisy audience gradually fell silent.
example.zh: 開始演講前，講者清了清喉嚨，吵雜的聽眾漸漸安靜下來。

listen.en: She felt a lump in her throat at the wedding.
listen.zh: 在婚禮上，她感動得喉嚨一陣哽咽。

chinese.en: The two brothers were at each other's throats over who should use the car.
chinese.zh: 兄弟倆為了誰該用車而吵得不可開交。

english.en: Spicy food sometimes makes my throat feel dry and hot.
english.zh: 辛辣的食物有時會讓我的喉嚨又乾又熱。

speak.en: My throat always hurts after singing karaoke with my friends.
speak.zh: 每次和朋友唱完卡拉OK，我的喉嚨都會痛。

write.en: Air pollution can irritate the throat and lungs, especially in young children and elderly people.
write.zh: 空氣汙染會刺激喉嚨和肺部，對幼童和長者的影響尤其明顯。

example.en: The driver made an abrupt stop to avoid a cat, and several passengers nearly fell out of their seats.
example.zh: 司機為了閃避一隻貓突然緊急煞車，好幾位乘客差點從座位上跌下來。

listen.en: His abrupt reply made everyone feel a little uncomfortable.
listen.zh: 他唐突的回答讓大家都覺得有點不自在。

chinese.en: The graph shows an abrupt drop in ticket sales after prices were raised.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，票價調漲後，售票量突然大幅下滑。

english.en: I'm sorry if I sounded abrupt on the phone this morning.
english.zh: 如果我今天早上在電話裡聽起來很不客氣，我很抱歉。

speak.en: Moving abroad was an abrupt change, but I adapted quite quickly.
speak.zh: 搬到國外是很突然的改變，但我適應得蠻快的。

write.en: Scientists fear that abrupt shifts in ocean temperature could disrupt fish populations worldwide.
write.zh: 科學家擔心，海水溫度的突然變化可能會擾亂全球的魚類族群。

example.en: Although cheaper cafés opened nearby, the bakery kept its loyal customers by offering friendly service and fresh bread daily.
example.zh: 雖然附近開了更便宜的咖啡店，這家麵包店仍以親切的服務和每天新鮮出爐的麵包留住了忠實顧客。

listen.en: She has been a loyal friend since primary school.
listen.zh: 從小學開始，她就一直是個忠實的朋友。

chinese.en: Many employees stay loyal to a company that treats them fairly and respects them.
chinese.zh: 許多員工會對公平對待並尊重他們的公司保持忠誠。

english.en: The team's loyal fans travelled across the country to watch the final.
english.zh: 這支球隊的忠實球迷千里迢迢去看冠軍賽。

speak.en: I'm pretty loyal to my favourite brands, especially for shoes.
speak.zh: 我對自己喜歡的品牌很死忠，尤其是鞋子。

write.en: Reward programmes are designed to keep shoppers loyal even when competitors offer lower prices.
write.zh: 集點回饋計畫的目的，是在競爭對手降價時仍能留住忠實的消費者。

example.en: The counsellor helps couples deal with marital problems such as poor communication and disagreements about money.
example.zh: 這位諮商師協助夫妻處理婚姻問題，例如溝通不良和金錢上的歧見。

listen.en: They sold their marital home after the children moved out.
listen.zh: 孩子們搬出去後，他們賣掉了婚後一起住的房子。

chinese.en: Research suggests that marital happiness often depends on sharing household chores fairly.
chinese.zh: 研究指出，婚姻幸福往往取決於家事是否公平分擔。

english.en: Employers should not ask about marital status in job interviews.
english.zh: 雇主不應在求職面試中詢問婚姻狀況。

speak.en: My grandparents say patience is the secret to marital harmony.
speak.zh: 我爺爺奶奶說，耐心是婚姻和諧的祕訣。

write.en: Changes in marital patterns, such as later marriages, have reduced birth rates in many countries.
write.zh: 婚姻型態的改變，例如晚婚，已使許多國家的出生率下降。

example.en: Unlike reptiles, mammals keep a constant body temperature and feed their young with milk.
example.zh: 和爬蟲類不同，哺乳動物能維持恆定的體溫，並以乳汁哺育幼崽。

listen.en: The bat is the only mammal that can truly fly.
listen.zh: 蝙蝠是唯一真正會飛的哺乳動物。

chinese.en: The museum has a new exhibition about marine mammals such as dolphins and seals.
chinese.zh: 博物館有一個關於海豚和海豹等海洋哺乳動物的新展覽。

english.en: Many small mammals sleep during the day and hunt at night.
english.zh: 許多小型哺乳動物白天睡覺，晚上覓食。

speak.en: My favourite mammal is the panda, because it looks so gentle.
speak.zh: 我最喜歡的哺乳動物是貓熊，因為牠看起來很溫和。

write.en: Habitat loss has put many large mammals, including tigers and elephants, at risk of extinction.
write.zh: 棲地喪失使許多大型哺乳動物，包括老虎和大象，面臨滅絕的危機。

example.en: Social media can amplify rumours very quickly, turning a small misunderstanding into a national story within hours.
example.zh: 社群媒體能讓謠言迅速擴散，在幾小時內就把小誤會變成全國新聞。

listen.en: The cave walls amplify every sound we make.
listen.zh: 洞穴的岩壁會放大我們發出的每個聲音。

chinese.en: Hot, dry weather amplified the damage caused by the forest fire last summer.
chinese.zh: 炎熱乾燥的天氣加劇了去年夏天森林大火造成的破壞。

english.en: Could you amplify on that point with a specific example?
english.zh: 你可以舉個具體的例子進一步說明那一點嗎？

speak.en: Being tired always amplifies my stress before a big presentation.
speak.zh: 重要報告前如果很累，我的壓力總是會加倍。

write.en: Rising sea levels will amplify the threat of storms to coastal cities.
write.zh: 海平面上升將使暴風雨對沿海城市的威脅更加嚴重。

example.en: Whenever people praise his cooking, my shy brother blushes and quickly changes the subject to something else.
example.zh: 每當有人稱讚他的廚藝，我那害羞的弟弟就會臉紅，並趕快轉移話題。

listen.en: His kind words made me blush in front of everyone.
listen.zh: 他親切的話讓我在大家面前臉紅了。

chinese.en: A light touch of blush can make your face look healthier in photos.
chinese.zh: 擦一點腮紅可以讓你在照片中氣色看起來更好。

english.en: I always blush when I have to speak in public.
english.zh: 我每次必須當眾說話時都會臉紅。

speak.en: I blush really easily, so I hate being the centre of attention.
speak.zh: 我很容易臉紅，所以很討厭成為大家注意的焦點。

write.en: Psychologists believe blushing may have evolved to show others that we feel genuinely sorry.
write.zh: 心理學家認為，臉紅可能是為了向他人表示我們真心感到抱歉而演化出來的。

example.en: The opening ceremony of the sports festival featured colourful costumes, traditional drums and a spectacular firework display.
example.zh: 運動會的開幕典禮有色彩繽紛的服裝、傳統鼓樂和壯觀的煙火表演。

listen.en: The wedding ceremony will take place in the garden.
listen.zh: 婚禮儀式將在花園裡舉行。

chinese.en: The school held a simple ceremony to thank the volunteers for their hard work.
chinese.zh: 學校舉辦了一個簡單的儀式，感謝志工們的辛勞付出。

english.en: She received her award at a ceremony in the city hall.
english.zh: 她在市政廳的一場典禮上領獎。

speak.en: Honestly, I find long ceremonies a bit boring, but the parties are fun.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得冗長的典禮有點無聊，但派對很好玩。

write.en: Without much ceremony, the manager handed out the keys and told everyone to start working.
write.zh: 經理沒有多說客套話，就把鑰匙發下去，叫大家開始工作。

example.en: The students set up the apparatus carefully, connecting the glass tubes and heating the liquid slowly to observe the reaction.
example.zh: 學生們小心地架設實驗器材，接好玻璃管並慢慢加熱液體，以觀察反應。

listen.en: Please return the apparatus to the cupboard after class.
listen.zh: 下課後請把器材放回櫃子裡。

chinese.en: The gym bought new apparatus for children to practise climbing and balancing safely.
chinese.zh: 體育館購置了新器材，讓孩子們能安全地練習攀爬和平衡。

english.en: This piece of apparatus measures how fast the water flows.
english.zh: 這個器材可以測量水流的速度。

speak.en: In my chemistry class, I always worried about breaking the apparatus.
speak.zh: 上化學課時，我總是擔心會把器材打破。

write.en: Reforming the entire apparatus of local government will take years and require public support.
write.zh: 改革整個地方政府體制需要好幾年，也需要民眾的支持。

example.en: Without regular weeding, the rampant growth of wild plants soon covered the paths and hid the flower beds.
example.zh: 由於沒有定期除草，野生植物肆意蔓生，很快就蓋住了步道，也遮住了花圃。

listen.en: Fake news is rampant on many social media sites.
listen.zh: 假新聞在許多社群媒體上十分猖獗。

chinese.en: When the disease was rampant, schools across the region closed for several weeks.
chinese.zh: 疾病肆虐期間，整個地區的學校停課了好幾週。

english.en: Shoplifting has become rampant in the city's busy shopping district.
english.zh: 市區熱鬧的購物區順手牽羊的情況已經很猖獗。

speak.en: When I was a kid, my imagination used to run rampant at night.
speak.zh: 我小時候一到晚上，想像力就會天馬行空、停不下來。

write.en: Experts warn that rampant overfishing could empty some coastal waters within a generation.
write.zh: 專家警告，猖獗的過度捕撈可能在一個世代內讓部分沿海水域無魚可捕。

example.en: Small farmers in the region created an alliance so they could buy equipment together and negotiate better prices.
example.zh: 該地區的小農組成了聯盟，以便一起購買設備並爭取更好的價格。

listen.en: The local shops joined an alliance to attract more tourists.
listen.zh: 當地商店加入了一個聯盟，以吸引更多觀光客。

chinese.en: The university works in alliance with hospitals to train future nurses and doctors.
chinese.zh: 這所大學與醫院合作，培育未來的護理師和醫師。

english.en: The two companies announced a strategic alliance to develop electric cars.
english.zh: 這兩家公司宣布建立策略聯盟，共同開發電動車。

speak.en: In group projects, I try to form an alliance with hardworking classmates.
speak.zh: 做分組作業時，我會試著和認真的同學結盟。

write.en: Environmental groups from different countries formed an alliance to protect migrating birds.
write.zh: 來自不同國家的環保團體組成聯盟，共同保護候鳥。

example.en: Fibre helps food move smoothly through the digestive tract, which is why doctors recommend eating vegetables daily.
example.zh: 纖維能幫助食物順利通過消化道，所以醫生建議每天吃蔬菜。

listen.en: A huge tract of forest was lost in the fire.
listen.zh: 一大片森林在大火中被燒毀。

chinese.en: Vast tracts of farmland in the north have turned into desert because of drought.
chinese.zh: 由於乾旱，北部大片農地已經變成沙漠。

english.en: A cold can affect your whole respiratory tract, not just your nose.
english.zh: 感冒可能影響整個呼吸道，不只是鼻子。

speak.en: Near my hometown, there's a beautiful tract of wild grassland.
speak.zh: 我家鄉附近有一大片美麗的野生草原。

write.en: Developers want to turn the protected tract of wetland into a shopping centre.
write.zh: 開發商想把那片受保護的濕地改建成購物中心。

example.en: Experts examined the painting for months before confirming that it was authentic and not a clever copy.
example.zh: 專家花了好幾個月檢驗這幅畫，才確認它是真跡，而不是高明的仿作。

listen.en: Is this leather bag authentic or just a cheap copy?
listen.zh: 這個皮包是真品，還是只是便宜的仿冒品？

chinese.en: Many travellers prefer staying with local families to get a more authentic experience of the culture.
chinese.zh: 許多旅客喜歡住在當地人家裡，以更真實地體驗當地文化。

english.en: The museum only displays authentic works created by local artists.
english.zh: 這間博物館只展出本地藝術家創作的真跡。

speak.en: I think street markets are the best place to find authentic local snacks.
speak.zh: 我覺得街頭市集是找到道地在地小吃最好的地方。

write.en: Teachers should use authentic materials, such as real news articles, to make language lessons more engaging.
write.zh: 老師應該使用真實語料，例如真正的新聞報導，讓語言課更吸引人。

example.en: Although the report covers many topics, its central thrust is the need for cleaner public transport.
example.zh: 雖然這份報告涵蓋許多主題，但它的核心重點是需要更乾淨的大眾運輸。

listen.en: She thrust the keys into my hand and ran outside.
listen.zh: 她把鑰匙塞進我手裡，然後跑到外面。

chinese.en: The rocket's engines produce enough thrust to lift it far above the clouds.
chinese.zh: 火箭的引擎能產生足夠的推力，把它送到遠高於雲層的地方。

english.en: After the manager left, Tom was thrust into a leadership role.
english.zh: 經理離職後，湯姆突然被推上領導的位置。

speak.en: Honestly, I didn't really understand the main thrust of that lecture.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不太懂那堂課的重點是什麼。

write.en: The new policy thrusts small businesses into fierce competition with large online retailers.
write.zh: 這項新政策讓小型商家被迫與大型網路零售商激烈競爭。

example.en: The government plans to reduce taxation on small businesses so that they can hire more workers and grow.
example.zh: 政府計畫降低小型企業的稅負，讓它們能僱用更多員工並擴大規模。

listen.en: Heavy taxation on sugary drinks may change how people shop.
listen.zh: 對含糖飲料課重稅，可能會改變人們的購物習慣。

chinese.en: Public services such as hospitals and schools are largely funded through taxation.
chinese.zh: 醫院和學校等公共服務，大部分是靠稅收來支應。

english.en: Some economists argue that high taxation discourages people from working harder.
english.zh: 有些經濟學家認為高稅負會讓人不願意更努力工作。

speak.en: I guess most people complain about taxation, but we all need public roads.
speak.zh: 我想大多數人都會抱怨稅太重，但我們都需要公共道路。

write.en: Our economics class compared the systems of taxation used in several European countries.
write.zh: 我們的經濟學課比較了幾個歐洲國家採用的稅制。

example.en: Rather than giving every school the same budget, the city focuses on equity, sending extra funds to poorer districts.
example.zh: 市政府不是給每所學校相同的預算，而是著重公平，把額外經費撥給較貧困的地區。

listen.en: Equity in education means helping every student reach their potential.
listen.zh: 教育公平意味著幫助每位學生發揮潛力。

chinese.en: The investor bought a large equity stake in the growing technology company.
chinese.zh: 這位投資人買下這家成長中科技公司的大量股權。

english.en: Many people believe equity matters more than profit in public health care.
english.zh: 許多人認為在公共醫療上，公平比獲利更重要。

speak.en: For me, equity means everyone gets the support they actually need.
speak.zh: 對我來說，公平就是每個人都能得到他們真正需要的支持。

write.en: After paying off half their mortgage, the couple used the equity in their home to start a business.
write.zh: 這對夫妻還清一半房貸後，用房子的淨值來創業。

example.en: The museum keeps the room at a constant temperature, because even small changes could damage the old paintings.
example.zh: 博物館讓展間維持恆溫，因為即使是微小的變化也可能損壞這些古老的畫作。

listen.en: My little brother needs constant attention when he plays outside.
listen.zh: 我弟弟在外面玩的時候，需要隨時有人看著。

chinese.en: The graph shows that the price of rice remained constant throughout the decade.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，米價在這十年間維持不變。

english.en: Students today are under constant pressure to get good grades.
english.zh: 現在的學生一直承受著要拿好成績的壓力。

speak.en: The only constant in my life right now is my morning coffee.
speak.zh: 我現在生活中唯一不變的，就是早上那杯咖啡。

write.en: Our team stays in constant contact with clients through video calls and email.
write.zh: 我們團隊透過視訊通話和電子郵件，與客戶保持密切聯繫。

example.en: Jobs like nursing were once seen as feminine, while engineering was considered a masculine field, but these ideas are changing.
example.zh: 護理這類工作過去被視為女性的職業，而工程則被認為是男性的領域，但這些觀念正在改變。

listen.en: The new perfume has a fresh and slightly masculine smell.
listen.zh: 這款新香水有清新、略帶男性氣息的味道。

chinese.en: In French, every noun is either masculine or feminine, which confuses many learners.
chinese.zh: 法文的每個名詞不是陽性就是陰性，這讓許多學習者感到困惑。

english.en: Some boys feel they must act masculine and hide their feelings.
english.zh: 有些男孩覺得自己必須表現得很有男子氣概，並隱藏情緒。

speak.en: I don't think cooking is a masculine or feminine hobby at all.
speak.zh: 我完全不覺得下廚是專屬男性或女性的嗜好。

write.en: Car advertisements often link speed and adventure with traditionally masculine images of success.
write.zh: 汽車廣告常把速度和冒險，與傳統上男性化的成功形象連結在一起。

example.en: Although the two phones differ in design, their battery life and camera quality are roughly comparable, so choose the cheaper one.
example.zh: 雖然這兩支手機的設計不同，但電池續航力和相機畫質大致相當，所以選比較便宜的那支就好。

listen.en: Her salary is comparable with what other nurses earn.
listen.zh: 她的薪水和其他護理師的收入差不多。

chinese.en: In the chart, sales in spring and autumn were comparable, at about half of summer levels.
chinese.zh: 圖表中，春季和秋季的銷售量相當，大約是夏季的一半。

english.en: There is no comparable product on the market at this price.
english.zh: 以這個價格來說，市面上沒有能與之相比的產品。

speak.en: Living costs in Taipei are honestly comparable to some European cities.
speak.zh: 說真的，臺北的生活開銷跟一些歐洲城市差不多。

write.en: Researchers needed comparable data from both schools before drawing any conclusions about the new teaching method.
write.zh: 研究人員需要兩所學校可相互比較的數據，才能對新教學法下任何結論。

example.en: Climbers who go up too quickly may suffer from altitude sickness, with headaches and difficulty breathing.
example.zh: 登山者如果上升得太快，可能會出現高山症，伴隨頭痛和呼吸困難。

listen.en: Several workers stayed home this week because of sickness.
listen.zh: 這週有幾位員工因為生病而待在家裡。

chinese.en: The company keeps records of staff absences caused by sickness and family emergencies.
chinese.zh: 公司會記錄員工因生病和家庭緊急狀況而缺勤的情形。

english.en: Poor hygiene in crowded cities can spread sickness very quickly.
english.zh: 擁擠城市的衛生條件不佳，可能讓疾病迅速傳播。

speak.en: I felt a wave of sickness when I smelled the old fish.
speak.zh: 我聞到那條放太久的魚時，突然一陣噁心。

write.en: Some countries provide sickness benefits to workers who cannot work for long periods.
write.zh: 有些國家會發放傷病給付給長期無法工作的勞工。

example.en: Scientists still do not fully understand the mechanism that allows some birds to find their way across oceans.
example.zh: 科學家仍未完全了解讓某些鳥類能飛越海洋、找到方向的機制。

listen.en: The locking mechanism on this door is broken again.
listen.zh: 這扇門的鎖扣裝置又壞了。

chinese.en: Humour can act as a defence mechanism when people feel nervous or embarrassed.
chinese.zh: 當人們感到緊張或尷尬時，幽默可以成為一種防衛機制。

english.en: The watch has a simple mechanism, so it rarely needs repairs.
english.zh: 這支手錶的機械結構很簡單，所以很少需要修理。

speak.en: I think exercise is my main coping mechanism when I'm stressed.
speak.zh: 我覺得運動是我壓力大時主要的紓壓方式。

write.en: Governments should create a mechanism to monitor how public funds are actually spent.
write.zh: 政府應該建立一套機制，監督公共資金實際上是如何使用的。

example.en: As soon as the call came in, an ambulance was dispatched to the scene, arriving just minutes later.
example.zh: 電話一打進來，救護車就被派往現場，幾分鐘後就抵達了。

listen.en: The manager dispatched a team to fix the broken machine.
listen.zh: 經理派了一組人去修理故障的機器。

chinese.en: The reporter sent a dispatch from the flooded village describing the damage.
chinese.zh: 記者從淹水的村莊發回報導，描述當地災情。

english.en: All parcels are checked carefully in the warehouse before dispatch.
english.zh: 所有包裹出貨前都會在倉庫裡仔細檢查。

speak.en: When I ordered shoes online, they dispatched them the same afternoon.
speak.zh: 我在網路上訂鞋子時，他們當天下午就出貨了。

write.en: The charity quickly dispatched volunteers and food supplies to the areas hit by the earthquake.
write.zh: 這個慈善團體迅速派遣志工並運送糧食到地震災區。

example.en: Before smartphones and streaming, teenagers recorded songs from the radio onto a blank cassette to make their own playlists.
example.zh: 在智慧型手機和串流出現之前，青少年會把廣播裡的歌錄到空白錄音帶上，做成自己的歌單。

listen.en: We listened to an English cassette in class every morning.
listen.zh: 我們每天早上都在課堂上聽英文錄音帶。

chinese.en: The library is converting its collection of cassettes into digital files for online access.
chinese.zh: 圖書館正把館藏的錄音帶轉成數位檔案，方便線上取用。

english.en: I found a cassette player at a second-hand shop last weekend.
english.zh: 我上週末在一家二手店找到一臺卡帶播放機。

speak.en: Cassettes remind me of long car trips with my family.
speak.zh: 錄音帶讓我想起和家人一起開車長途旅行的時光。

write.en: Some young musicians now release their albums on cassette as a fun, nostalgic choice.
write.zh: 現在有些年輕音樂人用錄音帶發行專輯，當作有趣又懷舊的選擇。

example.en: Chemists use a special notation, with a short symbol for each element, to describe compounds quickly.
example.zh: 化學家使用一套特殊的符號系統，每種元素都有簡短的代號，以便快速描述化合物。

listen.en: The teacher explained the notation on the board very slowly.
listen.zh: 老師非常慢地解釋黑板上的符號。

chinese.en: Scientific notation makes it much easier to write extremely large or small numbers.
chinese.zh: 科學記號讓極大或極小的數字寫起來容易得多。

english.en: Chess players use a simple notation to record each move.
english.zh: 西洋棋手用一套簡單的記號記錄每一步棋。

speak.en: Honestly, the maths notation in that course confused me at first.
speak.zh: 老實說，那門課的數學符號一開始讓我很困惑。

write.en: The editor made a small notation in the margin to show where the paragraph should begin.
write.zh: 編輯在頁邊做了一個小標記，指出這一段應該從哪裡開始。

example.en: During the summer festival, the town's small population swells as thousands of visitors arrive from across the country.
example.zh: 夏季祭典期間，數以千計的遊客從全國各地湧入，讓這個小鎮的人口暴增。

listen.en: Her eyes were swollen because she had cried all night.
listen.zh: 她哭了一整夜，所以眼睛都腫了。

chinese.en: Heavy rain caused the river to swell and flood several nearby farms.
chinese.zh: 大雨使河水暴漲，淹沒了附近好幾座農場。

english.en: The number of online shoppers has swelled in recent years.
english.zh: 近年來網購人數大幅增加。

speak.en: I felt my heart swell with pride when my sister graduated.
speak.zh: 我妹妹畢業時，我心裡充滿了驕傲。

write.en: Surfers waited patiently on the beach for a bigger swell to roll in from the ocean.
write.zh: 衝浪客在海灘上耐心等待更大的浪從海上湧來。

example.en: The whole plan rests on a false premise: that customers will pay more simply because the packaging looks expensive.
example.zh: 整個計畫建立在一個錯誤的前提上，也就是認為顧客只因為包裝看起來昂貴就會多付錢。

listen.en: Smoking is not allowed anywhere on the school premises.
listen.zh: 校園內任何地方都禁止吸菸。

chinese.en: The basic premise of the course is that anyone can learn to write well.
chinese.zh: 這門課的基本前提是：任何人都能學會把文章寫好。

english.en: I respect your opinion, but I disagree with its main premise.
english.zh: 我尊重你的意見，但我不同意它的主要前提。

speak.en: The premise of that show sounds silly, but it's actually really funny.
speak.zh: 那部節目的設定聽起來很蠢，但其實非常好笑。

write.en: The restaurant moved to larger premises after its delivery business grew rapidly.
write.zh: 這家餐廳的外送生意快速成長後，就搬到了更大的店面。

example.en: Customs officers found rare birds hidden in suitcases, showing how often people try to smuggle wildlife across borders.
example.zh: 海關人員在行李箱中發現藏匿的珍稀鳥類，顯示有人經常試圖走私野生動物出入國境。

listen.en: The children smuggled a puppy into their bedroom last night.
listen.zh: 孩子們昨晚偷偷把一隻小狗帶進他們的房間。

chinese.en: The company was fined for smuggling cheap electronics into the country without paying taxes.
chinese.zh: 這家公司因為走私廉價電子產品入境且未繳稅而遭到罰款。

english.en: He tried to smuggle his phone into the exam room.
english.zh: 他試圖把手機偷偷帶進考場。

speak.en: My friends smuggled a birthday cake into the office to surprise me.
speak.zh: 朋友們偷偷把生日蛋糕帶進辦公室，給我一個驚喜。

write.en: Stricter checks at ports have made it harder to smuggle fake luxury goods out of the region.
write.zh: 港口加強檢查後，要把仿冒精品走私出這個地區變得更困難了。

example.en: The nurses who cared for patients during the outbreak deserve far more recognition than they usually receive.
example.zh: 疫情期間照顧病患的護理師，應該得到比平常多得多的肯定。

listen.en: Everyone deserves another chance after making an honest mistake.
listen.zh: 每個人無心犯錯之後，都值得再被給予機會。

chinese.en: The rising cost of housing deserves serious attention from both local and national governments.
chinese.zh: 房價不斷上漲的問題，值得地方與中央政府認真重視。

english.en: Our team played brilliantly and deserved to win the match.
english.zh: 我們隊表現得非常出色，理應贏得這場比賽。

speak.en: Honestly, I think teachers deserve much higher salaries than they get.
speak.zh: 說真的，我覺得老師應該拿到比現在高得多的薪水。

write.en: The award went to a young volunteer, and most people agreed it was well deserved.
write.zh: 這個獎頒給了一位年輕志工，大多數人都認為實至名歸。

example.en: When news of the storm spread, panic buying left supermarket shelves empty of bread, water and toilet paper.
example.zh: 暴風雨的消息傳開後，民眾恐慌性搶購，超市架上的麵包、水和衛生紙都被掃空。

listen.en: She panicked when she couldn't find her passport at the airport.
listen.zh: 她在機場找不到護照時，整個人慌了。

chinese.en: The fire alarm caused a moment of panic, but everyone left the building safely.
chinese.zh: 火災警報引起一陣恐慌，但所有人都安全離開了大樓。

english.en: I woke up late and rushed to class in a panic.
english.zh: 我睡過頭，慌慌張張地趕去上課。

speak.en: I tend to panic a little before giving presentations in English.
speak.zh: 用英文上台報告前，我常常會有點慌張。

write.en: Many investors began panicking as share prices fell sharply on Monday morning.
write.zh: 星期一早上股價重挫，許多投資人開始恐慌。

example.en: The pilot performed a sudden maneuver to avoid a flock of birds, and the passengers barely noticed.
example.zh: 機長突然做了一個閃避動作避開一群鳥，乘客幾乎都沒察覺。

listen.en: He maneuvered his bike carefully through the busy market.
listen.zh: 他小心翼翼地騎著腳踏車穿過熱鬧的市場。

chinese.en: Small boats can maneuver easily in narrow rivers where large ships cannot go.
chinese.zh: 小船能在大船無法進入的狹窄河道中靈活行駛。

english.en: With such a tight budget, we have little room to maneuver.
english.zh: 預算這麼緊，我們幾乎沒有轉圜的空間。

speak.en: Moving that huge sofa up the stairs was a tricky maneuver.
speak.zh: 把那張超大沙發搬上樓梯，真的很需要技巧。

write.en: The manager maneuvered skillfully during negotiations to secure a better deal for her team.
write.zh: 這位經理在談判中巧妙周旋，為她的團隊爭取到更好的條件。

example.en: Because he was junior to everyone else in the meeting, he waited until the end before sharing his ideas.
example.zh: 因為他在會議中的資歷比其他人都淺，所以等到最後才分享自己的想法。

listen.en: My cousin plays for the junior football team at school.
listen.zh: 我表弟在學校的少年足球隊踢球。

chinese.en: Junior doctors often work long shifts, which can affect both their health and judgment.
chinese.zh: 住院醫師常常要值很長的班，這可能影響他們的健康和判斷力。

english.en: Senior staff should spend more time training their junior colleagues.
english.zh: 資深員工應該多花時間培訓資淺的同事。

speak.en: I'm three years his junior, but we've always been close friends.
speak.zh: 我比他小三歲，但我們一直是好朋友。

write.en: The bookshop has a junior section where children can sit and read picture books.
write.zh: 這家書店有一個兒童區，孩子們可以坐下來看繪本。

example.en: Wearing a traditional kilt and playing the bagpipes, the Scotsman attracted a large crowd of curious tourists.
example.zh: 這位蘇格蘭男子穿著傳統格紋短裙、吹奏風笛，吸引了一大群好奇的遊客。

listen.en: My new neighbour is a friendly Scotsman who loves hiking.
listen.zh: 我的新鄰居是一位喜歡健行、很友善的蘇格蘭人。

chinese.en: As a proud Scotsman, he always corrects people who call him English.
chinese.zh: 身為自豪的蘇格蘭人，他總會糾正那些說他是英格蘭人的人。

english.en: My English teacher is a Scotsman who moved to Taiwan years ago.
english.zh: 我的英文老師是一位多年前搬來臺灣的蘇格蘭人。

speak.en: I once met a Scotsman who taught me how to make shortbread.
speak.zh: 我曾經遇過一位蘇格蘭人，他教我怎麼做奶油酥餅。

write.en: The novel tells the story of a young Scotsman who leaves his village to seek work in London.
write.zh: 這部小說講述一位年輕的蘇格蘭男子離開家鄉村莊、到倫敦找工作的故事。

example.en: Environmental groups deplored the decision to cut down the ancient forest, calling it a loss that could never be repaired.
example.zh: 環保團體強烈譴責砍伐這片古老森林的決定，稱之為永遠無法彌補的損失。

listen.en: The players deplored the rude behaviour of some fans.
listen.zh: 球員們譴責部分球迷的無禮行為。

chinese.en: The report deplores the amount of food that supermarkets throw away each day.
chinese.zh: 這份報告對超市每天丟棄大量食物的情形表示痛心。

english.en: Most people deplore cruelty to animals, whatever their cultural background.
english.zh: 無論文化背景為何，大多數人都痛恨虐待動物的行為。

speak.en: I really deplore how much plastic packaging comes with online orders.
speak.zh: 我真的很看不慣網購訂單附帶那麼多塑膠包裝。

write.en: The principal deplored the vandalism in the school toilets and asked students to report it.
write.zh: 校長譴責學校廁所遭人惡意破壞，並要求學生發現時要通報。

example.en: Six main roads radiate from the central square, so visitors can easily reach any part of the old town.
example.zh: 六條主要道路從中央廣場向外延伸，所以遊客能輕鬆抵達老城區的任何角落。

listen.en: She radiated confidence as she walked onto the stage.
listen.zh: 她走上舞台時，渾身散發著自信。

chinese.en: Dark roofs absorb sunlight during the day and radiate heat back into the city at night.
chinese.zh: 深色屋頂白天吸收陽光，晚上再把熱散發回城市裡。

english.en: A sharp pain radiated from his back down to his leg.
english.zh: 一陣劇痛從他的背部一路蔓延到腿上。

speak.en: My grandmother always radiates warmth whenever we visit her in the countryside.
speak.zh: 每次我們去鄉下看奶奶，她總是散發著溫暖。

write.en: Good leaders radiate calm during a crisis, which helps their teams stay focused.
write.zh: 好的領導者在危機中展現沉著，幫助團隊保持專注。

example.en: The proposal to build a new airport sparked a fierce debate, with residents and businesses taking opposite sides.
example.zh: 興建新機場的提案引發激烈辯論，居民和企業各持相反立場。

listen.en: The guard dog looked fierce, but it was actually very gentle.
listen.zh: 那隻看門狗看起來很兇，其實非常溫和。

chinese.en: Fierce winds knocked down trees and cut off power to many homes.
chinese.zh: 強風吹倒樹木，造成許多住家停電。

english.en: The new tax plan faced fierce opposition from small business owners.
english.zh: 新的稅務方案遭到小企業主強烈反對。

speak.en: My sister and I had a fierce argument about who should wash the dishes.
speak.zh: 我和姊姊為了誰該洗碗大吵了一架。

write.en: The fiercest heat of the summer usually arrives in late July, so we plan trips in spring.
write.zh: 夏天最猛烈的高溫通常出現在七月下旬，所以我們都在春天規劃旅行。

example.en: Passive smoking, breathing in other people's smoke, is especially harmful to young children living with smokers.
example.zh: 二手菸，也就是吸入別人的菸，對和吸菸者同住的幼童特別有害。

listen.en: He played a passive role during the group discussion.
listen.zh: 小組討論時，他一直扮演被動的角色。

chinese.en: Writers often use the passive voice in scientific reports to sound more objective.
chinese.zh: 作者常在科學報告中使用被動語態，讓內容聽起來更客觀。

english.en: Instead of being passive, you should ask questions in class.
english.zh: 上課時你不該那麼被動，而應該多發問。

speak.en: I used to be quite passive, but now I speak up more at work.
speak.zh: 我以前很被動，但現在在工作上會更勇於發言。

write.en: Renting out a spare room gave her a small passive income every month.
write.zh: 把空房間租出去，讓她每個月都有一筆小小的被動收入。

example.en: Because the popular school had more applicants than places, students were chosen by lottery to keep the process fair.
example.zh: 因為這所熱門學校的申請人數多於名額，為了公平起見，以抽籤決定錄取的學生。
