listen.en: Winning the lottery would not solve all of your problems.
listen.zh: 中樂透並不能解決你所有的問題。

chinese.en: Part of the money raised by the national lottery is used to support local arts projects.
chinese.zh: 國家彩券募得的部分款項，會用來支持地方藝術計畫。

english.en: Getting a ticket for the concert felt like winning the lottery.
english.zh: 搶到那場演唱會的門票，感覺就像中了樂透一樣。

speak.en: Finding a good flat in this city is a bit of a lottery.
speak.zh: 在這個城市要找到好房子，有點全憑運氣。

write.en: Some economists argue that lotteries take money mostly from people who can least afford it.
write.zh: 有些經濟學家認為，彩券的收入大多來自最負擔不起的人。

example.en: The soup was flavoured with ginger and garlic, giving it a warm, slightly spicy taste that was perfect for winter.
example.zh: 這碗湯用薑和蒜調味，帶著溫暖又微辣的味道，非常適合冬天。

listen.en: Which ice cream flavour do you like best?
listen.zh: 你最喜歡哪種口味的冰淇淋？

chinese.en: The old market streets give the city a flavour of its rich trading history.
chinese.zh: 老市場街道讓這座城市散發出豐富貿易歷史的氣息。

english.en: Many cheap snacks contain artificial flavours that are not very healthy.
english.zh: 許多便宜的零食含有不太健康的人工香料。

speak.en: Taiwanese night market food is full of flavour, and it's cheap too.
speak.zh: 臺灣的夜市小吃味道豐富，而且還很便宜。

write.en: Some food companies now flavour their products with natural fruit instead of sugar.
write.zh: 現在有些食品公司改用天然水果而不是糖來為產品調味。

example.en: The injury shattered her hopes of competing in the national championship, after years of daily training.
example.zh: 經過多年的每日訓練，這次受傷粉碎了她參加全國錦標賽的希望。

listen.en: A loud phone suddenly shattered the silence in the library.
listen.zh: 一陣響亮的手機鈴聲突然打破了圖書館的寧靜。

chinese.en: The young swimmer shattered the national record by more than a second.
chinese.zh: 這位年輕泳將以超過一秒的差距打破全國紀錄。

english.en: Last night, strong winds shattered several windows in our apartment building.
english.zh: 昨晚強風吹破了我們公寓大樓的好幾扇窗戶。

speak.en: Failing my driving test really shattered my confidence for a while.
speak.zh: 駕照考試沒過，真的讓我有好一陣子信心全失。

write.en: The scandal shattered public trust in the company, and its sales dropped sharply.
write.zh: 這起醜聞讓大眾對這家公司的信任徹底瓦解，銷售量也大幅下滑。

example.en: The old barber has cut hair in the same small shop for decades, and he knows every customer by name.
example.zh: 這位老理髮師在同一家小店剪頭髮已經幾十年了，每位客人的名字他都叫得出來。

listen.en: The barber asked me how short I wanted my hair.
listen.zh: 理髮師問我頭髮想剪多短。

chinese.en: Traditional barbers are becoming popular again among young men who want classic styles.
chinese.zh: 傳統理髮師再度受到喜愛經典髮型的年輕男性歡迎。

english.en: There is a busy barber shop right next to the train station.
english.zh: 火車站旁邊就有一家生意很好的理髮店。

speak.en: Honestly, chatting with my barber is the most relaxing part of my week.
speak.zh: 說真的，跟我的理髮師聊天是我一週中最放鬆的時刻。

write.en: Training as a barber can be a practical career choice for students who prefer hands-on work.
write.zh: 對喜歡動手做的學生來說，接受訓練成為理髮師是很實際的職涯選擇。

example.en: The children laughed as they ran across the playground, dodging the balls their friends threw at them.
example.zh: 孩子們笑著跑過操場，閃躲朋友丟過來的球。

listen.en: I had to dodge the puddles on my way home.
listen.zh: 回家路上我得一路閃避水坑。

chinese.en: Some companies set up offices abroad simply to dodge taxes at home.
chinese.zh: 有些公司在海外設立辦公室，只是為了規避本國的稅。

english.en: You cannot keep dodging responsibility for your own choices forever.
english.zh: 你不能永遠逃避為自己的選擇負責。

speak.en: I usually take the back streets to dodge the morning traffic.
speak.zh: 我通常走小巷子，避開早上的車潮。

write.en: Critics called the new rule a clever dodge to avoid paying workers overtime.
write.zh: 批評者認為這項新規定是一種巧妙的手段，用來規避支付員工加班費。

example.en: Snow in this coastal city is highly unusual, so when it fell last winter, schools closed and people rushed to take photos.
example.zh: 這座海濱城市下雪非常罕見，所以去年冬天下雪時，學校停課，大家都衝去拍照。

listen.en: The doctor noticed nothing unusual in my test results.
listen.zh: 醫生在我的檢查結果中沒有發現任何異狀。

chinese.en: The restaurant is known for unusual combinations, such as chocolate with chilli.
chinese.zh: 這家餐廳以獨特的搭配聞名，例如巧克力配辣椒。

english.en: My friend has an unusual hobby: collecting old train tickets.
english.zh: 我朋友有個特別的嗜好：收集舊火車票。

speak.en: I'd love a job that's a bit unusual, not just office work.
speak.zh: 我希望有一份有點特別的工作，而不只是坐辦公室。

write.en: It is no longer unusual for people to change careers several times during their lives.
write.zh: 現在人一生中換好幾次跑道，已經不是什麼稀奇的事了。

example.en: Rumours abound about the company's future, but managers have not yet confirmed whether the factory will close.
example.zh: 關於這家公司前景的傳言滿天飛，但主管們尚未證實工廠是否會關閉。

listen.en: The lake abounds with fish, so many people come here to relax.
listen.zh: 這座湖裡魚很多，所以許多人來這裡放鬆。

chinese.en: Opportunities abound for young people who are willing to learn new digital skills.
chinese.zh: 對願意學習新數位技能的年輕人來說，機會到處都是。

english.en: This old city abounds in parks, museums and cheap little restaurants.
english.zh: 這座古城有許多公園、博物館和平價的小餐館。

speak.en: Good coffee shops abound in my neighbourhood, which I really love.
speak.zh: 我家附近有很多不錯的咖啡店，我真的很喜歡。

write.en: Examples abound of small changes, like recycling, that make a real difference to the environment.
write.zh: 像資源回收這類能對環境帶來實質影響的小改變，例子比比皆是。

example.en: After the factory closed, unemployment in the small town rose sharply, and many families had to move away to find work.
example.zh: 工廠關閉後，這個小鎮的失業人數急遽上升，許多家庭不得不搬走另找工作。

listen.en: The government promised to reduce youth unemployment next year.
listen.zh: 政府承諾明年要降低青年失業率。

chinese.en: The graph shows that the unemployment rate fell steadily between 2010 and 2020.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，失業率在2010年到2020年間穩定下降。

english.en: Many workers lost their jobs and had to apply for unemployment benefits.
english.zh: 許多勞工失去工作，不得不申請失業給付。

speak.en: Honestly, unemployment worries me a lot, especially with AI changing everything.
speak.zh: 說真的，我很擔心失業，尤其現在人工智慧正在改變一切。

write.en: Retraining programmes can help people return to work after long periods of unemployment.
write.zh: 職業再訓練計畫可以幫助長期失業的人重返職場。

example.en: Before the concert began, the orchestra tuned their instruments while the audience quietly found their seats.
example.zh: 音樂會開始前，管弦樂團在調音，觀眾則安靜地找到自己的座位。

listen.en: We went to hear the city orchestra play on Sunday evening.
listen.zh: 我們星期天晚上去聽市立管弦樂團演奏。

chinese.en: The youth orchestra gives talented young musicians a chance to perform on big stages.
chinese.zh: 青年管弦樂團讓有才華的年輕音樂家有機會登上大舞台演出。

english.en: The orchestra played a cheerful piece to open the festival.
english.zh: 管弦樂團演奏了一首輕快的曲子，為音樂節揭開序幕。

speak.en: I've never seen a live orchestra, but I'd really love to.
speak.zh: 我從來沒看過管弦樂團現場演出，但真的很想去看看。

write.en: Some cities have cut funding for their orchestras, arguing that the money is needed elsewhere.
write.zh: 有些城市刪減了管弦樂團的經費，理由是這筆錢有更需要的用途。

example.en: Music therapy, which uses singing and playing instruments, can help elderly patients feel calmer and more connected.
example.zh: 音樂治療透過唱歌和演奏樂器，能幫助年長病患感到更平靜，也和他人更有連結。

listen.en: Many people find that therapy helps them manage daily stress.
listen.zh: 許多人發現心理治療有助於他們調適日常壓力。

chinese.en: The child is receiving speech therapy to help him pronounce words more clearly.
chinese.zh: 這個孩子正在接受語言治療，幫助他把字詞發音得更清楚。

english.en: Going to therapy is nothing to be ashamed of these days.
english.zh: 現在去做心理諮商，沒有什麼好丟臉的。

speak.en: For me, gardening is a kind of therapy after a long week.
speak.zh: 對我來說，忙了一整週後，園藝就像一種療癒。

write.en: Health insurance should cover therapy for mental health problems, not just physical illnesses.
write.zh: 健康保險應該給付心理健康問題的治療，而不只是身體疾病。

example.en: When the computer system crashed at the airport, there was complete chaos as hundreds of passengers tried to rebook flights.
example.zh: 機場的電腦系統當機時，數百名旅客忙著改訂機位，現場一片大亂。

listen.en: My bedroom is in total chaos after moving house.
listen.zh: 搬家之後，我的房間亂成一團。

chinese.en: Without clear rules and deadlines, the group project quickly descended into chaos.
chinese.zh: 沒有明確的規則和期限，這份小組報告很快就陷入一片混亂。

english.en: A sudden strike by bus drivers caused chaos across the city.
english.zh: 公車司機突然罷工，造成全市交通大亂。

speak.en: I actually enjoy the chaos of a busy night market.
speak.zh: 我其實很享受熱鬧夜市那種亂哄哄的氣氛。

write.en: Some people work well amid chaos, while others need a calm and tidy environment.
write.zh: 有些人在混亂中也能好好工作，有些人則需要安靜整潔的環境。

example.en: Instead of guessing, the researchers carried out a systematic review of over a hundred studies on sleep and memory.
example.zh: 研究人員沒有憑空猜測，而是針對一百多篇有關睡眠與記憶的研究進行系統性回顧。

listen.en: She is very systematic about planning her study time.
listen.zh: 她規劃讀書時間非常有條理。

chinese.en: Learning vocabulary in a systematic way is more effective than memorizing random lists.
chinese.zh: 有系統地學習單字，比背一堆雜亂的單字表更有效。

english.en: The police made a systematic search of the whole building.
english.zh: 警方對整棟建築物進行了地毯式搜查。

speak.en: I'm not very systematic, so my notes are usually a mess.
speak.zh: 我做事不太有條理，所以筆記通常亂七八糟。

write.en: Some reports suggest there has been systematic discrimination against older job applicants.
write.zh: 有些報告指出，年紀較大的求職者長期遭受系統性的歧視。

example.en: During the first week, the university acquaints exchange students with the library, labs and sports facilities through campus tours.
example.zh: 開學第一週，大學會透過校園導覽，讓交換學生熟悉圖書館、實驗室和運動設施。

listen.en: Are you acquainted with the new manager yet?
listen.zh: 你認識新來的經理了嗎？

chinese.en: Before the trip, we acquainted ourselves with local customs to avoid offending anyone.
chinese.zh: 出發前，我們先了解當地習俗，以免冒犯別人。

english.en: The two families became acquainted when their children joined the same club.
english.zh: 兩家人是在孩子加入同一個社團後認識的。

speak.en: We got acquainted at a language exchange event last summer.
speak.zh: 我們是去年夏天在一場語言交換活動上認識的。

write.en: Museums can acquaint young people with history in a more lively and interactive way.
write.zh: 博物館能用更生動、互動的方式讓年輕人認識歷史。

example.en: While interviews show how people feel, quantitative research tells us how many people share those feelings.
example.zh: 訪談能呈現人們的感受，而量化研究則能告訴我們有多少人有同樣的感受。

listen.en: Our teacher asked us to use quantitative methods for the project.
listen.zh: 老師要我們在這份報告中使用量化方法。

chinese.en: The company uses quantitative analysis to predict which products will sell best next season.
chinese.zh: 這家公司運用量化分析，預測下一季哪些產品會賣得最好。

english.en: Quantitative results alone cannot explain why students lose interest in reading.
english.zh: 光靠量化結果，無法解釋學生為什麼對閱讀失去興趣。

speak.en: I'm better at quantitative subjects like maths than at writing essays.
speak.zh: 比起寫作文，我更擅長數學這類需要計算的科目。

write.en: Governments should set quantitative targets, such as cutting emissions by a fixed percentage.
write.zh: 政府應該設定量化目標，例如將排放量減少固定的百分比。

example.en: The tree's thick trunk was hollow inside, providing a safe home for owls and other small animals.
example.zh: 這棵樹粗壯的樹幹內部是空心的，成為貓頭鷹和其他小動物安全的家。

listen.en: The elephant sprayed water over its back with its trunk.
listen.zh: 大象用鼻子把水噴到自己背上。

chinese.en: My grandmother keeps old family photos in a wooden trunk under her bed.
chinese.zh: 我奶奶把家裡的老照片收在床底下的木箱裡。

english.en: A fallen tree trunk blocked the mountain road after the storm.
english.zh: 暴風雨過後，一根倒下的樹幹擋住了山路。

speak.en: My car's trunk is always full of shopping bags and sports gear.
speak.zh: 我車子的後車廂總是塞滿購物袋和運動用品。

write.en: Some city parks protect old trees by wrapping their trunks to prevent damage from bikes.
write.zh: 有些城市公園會把老樹的樹幹包起來，避免被腳踏車撞傷。

example.en: Faced with a tiny budget, the team found an imaginative solution, turning old shipping containers into colourful classrooms.
example.zh: 面對極少的預算，團隊想出一個有創意的辦法，把舊貨櫃改造成色彩繽紛的教室。

listen.en: Her paintings are bright, playful and very imaginative.
listen.zh: 她的畫作色彩明亮、活潑有趣，而且非常有想像力。

chinese.en: Imaginative play, such as pretending to cook, helps young children develop social skills.
chinese.zh: 想像遊戲，例如假裝煮飯，有助於幼兒發展社交能力。

english.en: We need more imaginative ideas to attract young visitors to the museum.
english.zh: 我們需要更有創意的點子，吸引年輕遊客來博物館。

speak.en: I wasn't very imaginative as a kid, but I loved reading.
speak.zh: 我小時候不太有想像力，但很喜歡看書。

write.en: The architect made imaginative use of natural light to make the small flat feel spacious.
write.zh: 建築師巧妙地運用自然光，讓這間小公寓感覺很寬敞。

example.en: Her eyes glittered with excitement when the teacher announced that the class would visit the science museum.
example.zh: 老師宣布全班要去參觀科學博物館時，她的眼睛因興奮而閃閃發亮。

listen.en: The city lights glittered across the dark harbour.
listen.zh: 城市的燈光在漆黑的港灣上閃爍。

chinese.en: The children used glue and gold glitter to decorate their handmade holiday cards.
chinese.zh: 孩子們用膠水和金色亮粉裝飾他們手作的節日卡片。

english.en: The surface of the lake glittered under the bright afternoon sun.
english.zh: 湖面在午後燦爛的陽光下閃閃發光。

speak.en: I love walking along the river when the water glitters at night.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡在晚上河面波光閃爍時沿著河邊散步。

write.en: Behind the glitter of celebrity life, many young performers feel lonely and exhausted.
write.zh: 在名人生活的光鮮亮麗背後，許多年輕表演者感到孤單又疲憊。

example.en: After the storm damaged the roof, we hired a local carpenter to replace the broken wooden beams.
example.zh: 暴風雨弄壞屋頂後，我們請了一位當地的木匠來更換斷掉的木樑。

listen.en: My uncle has worked as a carpenter for many years.
listen.zh: 我叔叔當木匠已經很多年了。

chinese.en: Skilled carpenters are increasingly hard to find because fewer young people choose manual trades.
chinese.zh: 由於選擇技術性工作的年輕人越來越少，熟練的木匠也越來越難找。

english.en: The carpenter repaired the old wooden door in our kitchen.
english.zh: 木匠修好了我們廚房那扇老舊的木門。

speak.en: I've always admired carpenters because they can create beautiful things by hand.
speak.zh: 我一直很欣賞木匠，因為他們能用雙手做出漂亮的東西。

write.en: The school invited a carpenter to teach students how to make simple furniture.
write.zh: 學校邀請了一位木匠來教學生做簡單的家具。

example.en: Crude oil must be refined before it can be used as fuel for cars and aircraft.
example.zh: 原油必須經過提煉，才能當作汽車和飛機的燃料。

listen.en: She keeps refining her essay until every sentence feels right.
listen.zh: 她不斷修改文章，直到每個句子都恰到好處。

chinese.en: The research team refined its methods after the first experiment produced unreliable results.
chinese.zh: 第一次實驗得出不可靠的結果後，研究團隊改良了他們的方法。

english.en: Our teacher helped us refine our ideas for the project.
english.zh: 老師幫我們把專題的構想修得更完善。

speak.en: I'm still trying to refine my speaking skills before the exam.
speak.zh: 考試前我還在努力加強我的口說能力。

write.en: Over the years, the company has refined its design to make the phone lighter and faster.
write.zh: 這些年來，這家公司持續改良設計，讓手機變得更輕、更快。

example.en: Public perception of electric cars has changed rapidly as charging stations have become easier to find.
example.zh: 隨著充電站越來越容易找到，大眾對電動車的觀感也迅速改變。

listen.en: His perception of the problem was very different from mine.
listen.zh: 他對這個問題的看法和我很不一樣。

chinese.en: Research shows that lack of sleep can affect our perception of time and distance.
chinese.zh: 研究顯示，睡眠不足會影響我們對時間和距離的感知。

english.en: Travelling abroad completely changed my perception of my own culture.
english.zh: 出國旅行徹底改變了我對自己文化的看法。

speak.en: I think first impressions shape people's perception of us quite a lot.
speak.zh: 我覺得第一印象在很大程度上會影響別人怎麼看我們。

write.en: There is a common perception that working from home makes employees less productive.
write.zh: 一般人普遍認為在家工作會讓員工的生產力下降。

example.en: The hotel was fully booked because thousands of doctors had arrived for the annual medical convention.
example.zh: 由於數千名醫師前來參加年度醫學大會，飯店全部客滿了。

listen.en: The writer chose to break the conventions of the novel.
listen.zh: 這位作家選擇打破小說的傳統寫法。

chinese.en: Many countries have signed an international convention to protect endangered species from illegal trade.
chinese.zh: 許多國家已簽署一項國際公約，保護瀕危物種免於非法交易。

english.en: Our company sends staff to a technology convention every year.
english.zh: 我們公司每年都會派員工去參加科技大會。

speak.en: I don't always follow social conventions, but I try to be polite.
speak.zh: 我不一定都遵守社會慣例，但我會盡量保持禮貌。

write.en: Young designers often challenge fashion conventions by mixing traditional and modern styles.
write.zh: 年輕設計師常透過混搭傳統與現代風格來挑戰時尚常規。

example.en: The film is a parody of old spy movies, exaggerating their dramatic music and ridiculous gadgets for comic effect.
example.zh: 這部電影是對老式間諜片的諧仿，刻意誇大其中戲劇化的配樂和荒謬的道具來製造笑果。

listen.en: The students wrote a funny parody of a famous song.
listen.zh: 學生們把一首知名歌曲改編成好笑的惡搞版本。

chinese.en: Some viewers enjoyed the parody, while others felt it mocked the original artist unfairly.
chinese.zh: 有些觀眾很喜歡這部惡搞作品，有些人則覺得它不公平地嘲弄了原創藝人。

english.en: The short video parodies the way people use their phones at dinner.
english.zh: 這支短片以滑稽的方式模仿人們吃晚餐時滑手機的樣子。

speak.en: I watch online parodies mainly because they make me laugh after work.
speak.zh: 我會看網路上的惡搞影片，主要是因為下班後它們能讓我笑一笑。

write.en: Satirical websites often parody news reports to make readers think critically about the media.
write.zh: 諷刺網站常模仿新聞報導，讓讀者用批判的角度看待媒體。

example.en: The old stone wall marks the boundary of the farm, separating it from the public forest beyond.
example.zh: 那道老石牆標示出農場的邊界，把農場和外面的公有森林隔開。

listen.en: Children need clear boundaries at home and at school.
listen.zh: 孩子在家裡和學校都需要明確的界線。

chinese.en: Modern science keeps pushing the boundaries of what we thought was possible.
chinese.zh: 現代科學不斷突破我們過去認為可能的極限。

english.en: It is important to set boundaries between work and family life.
english.zh: 在工作與家庭生活之間劃清界線是很重要的。

speak.en: I try to set boundaries, so I don't answer work emails on weekends.
speak.zh: 我會盡量劃清界線，所以週末不回工作郵件。

write.en: Climate change is a global problem that does not respect national boundaries.
write.zh: 氣候變遷是全球性的問題，不會因國界而停下。

example.en: Doctors warned that a diet high in sugar and processed food greatly increases the risk of heart disease.
example.zh: 醫師警告，高糖和加工食品的飲食會大幅提高罹患心臟病的風險。

listen.en: She has been on a strict diet since last month.
listen.zh: 她從上個月開始就在嚴格節食。

chinese.en: Experts say a diet rich in fish and vegetables is linked to a longer life.
chinese.zh: 專家表示，富含魚類和蔬菜的飲食與較長的壽命有關。

english.en: My brother decided to go on a diet before summer.
english.zh: 我哥哥決定在夏天之前開始節食。

speak.en: To be honest, I find it really hard to stick to a diet.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得要持續節食真的很難。

write.en: Many students live on a diet of instant noodles during exam season.
write.zh: 考試期間，很多學生都靠泡麵度日。

example.en: Smoking can cause fatty deposits to build up inside the arteries, which slowly restricts the flow of blood.
example.zh: 吸菸會讓脂肪沉積在動脈內壁，逐漸阻礙血液流動。

listen.en: Regular exercise helps to keep your arteries healthy and strong.
listen.zh: 規律運動有助於維持動脈健康強韌。

chinese.en: The main road through the city centre acts as a major traffic artery during rush hour.
chinese.zh: 穿越市中心的那條大馬路在尖峰時段是重要的交通幹道。

english.en: A blocked artery in the heart can lead to serious health problems.
english.zh: 心臟的動脈阻塞可能導致嚴重的健康問題。

speak.en: My doctor told me that too much salt is bad for my arteries.
speak.zh: 醫生跟我說，吃太鹹對動脈不好。

write.en: The new railway line will become a vital artery for trade between the coastal cities.
write.zh: 這條新鐵路將成為沿海城市之間重要的貿易幹線。

example.en: The loud music from next door bothered him so much that he couldn't concentrate on his homework.
example.zh: 隔壁傳來的大聲音樂讓他很困擾，害他沒辦法專心寫作業。

listen.en: Please don't bother me while I'm studying for my exam.
listen.zh: 我在準備考試的時候請不要打擾我。

chinese.en: Many people don't bother to read the terms and conditions before clicking agree.
chinese.zh: 很多人在按下同意之前，懶得去讀使用條款。

english.en: It really bothers me when people are late for meetings.
english.zh: 有人開會遲到真的讓我很困擾。

speak.en: Noise doesn't bother me much, so I can study anywhere.
speak.zh: 噪音不太會影響我，所以我在哪裡都能讀書。

write.en: Filling in the form was a bit of a bother, but the process was quick.
write.zh: 填表格有點麻煩，不過整個流程很快。

example.en: The journalist's report exposed serious safety problems at the factory, forcing the company to close it temporarily.
example.zh: 記者的報導揭發了這間工廠嚴重的安全問題，迫使公司暫時關廠。

listen.en: Do not expose the plants to strong sunlight.
listen.zh: 不要讓這些植物曬到強烈的陽光。

chinese.en: Studying abroad exposed me to new ideas and very different ways of life.
chinese.zh: 出國留學讓我接觸到新的想法和截然不同的生活方式。

english.en: Parents want to expose their children to music at an early age.
english.zh: 父母希望讓孩子從小就接觸音樂。

speak.en: I think it's good to expose yourself to different cultures when you're young.
speak.zh: 我覺得年輕時多接觸不同文化是件好事。

write.en: Removing the old carpet exposed the beautiful wooden floor that had been hidden underneath.
write.zh: 把舊地毯拆掉後，底下藏著的漂亮木地板就露了出來。

example.en: After the fall, the doctor gave him a knee brace to support the joint while the injury healed.
example.zh: 跌倒之後，醫生給他一個護膝，在傷勢復原期間支撐關節。

listen.en: Many teenagers wear braces to straighten their teeth.
listen.zh: 很多青少年會戴牙套矯正牙齒。

chinese.en: Economists warned that businesses should brace for higher energy prices next winter.
chinese.zh: 經濟學家警告，企業應該為明年冬天能源價格上漲做好準備。

english.en: We braced ourselves for bad news before the doctor came in.
english.zh: 醫生進來之前，我們已經做好聽到壞消息的心理準備。

speak.en: I had to wear braces for a while when I was a teenager.
speak.zh: 我青少年時期有一段時間得戴牙套。

write.en: The passengers braced themselves as the plane hit strong turbulence over the mountains.
write.zh: 飛機飛越山區遇到強烈亂流時，乘客們都繃緊身子做好準備。

example.en: If a wound keeps bleeding heavily, press a clean cloth on it firmly and seek medical help.
example.zh: 如果傷口一直大量出血，要用乾淨的布用力壓住，並盡快就醫。

listen.en: My nose started bleeding during the hot afternoon.
listen.zh: 在那個炎熱的下午，我開始流鼻血。

chinese.en: The paramedics worked quickly to stop the patient from bleeding before reaching the hospital.
chinese.zh: 救護人員在抵達醫院前迅速為病患止血。

english.en: My gums bleed a little when I brush my teeth.
english.zh: 我刷牙時牙齦會流一點血。

speak.en: I cut my finger while cooking, and it bled quite a lot.
speak.zh: 我煮飯時切到手指，流了不少血。

write.en: Small businesses are bleeding money because of rising rent and fewer customers.
write.zh: 由於租金上漲、客人變少，小店家正在大量虧錢。

example.en: Hikers should take sensible precautions, such as checking the weather and telling someone their route, before setting out.
example.zh: 登山客出發前應採取合理的預防措施，例如查看天氣，並把路線告訴別人。

listen.en: Always take precautions when you swim in the sea.
listen.zh: 在海裡游泳時一定要做好防範。

chinese.en: The hospital introduced extra safety precautions to prevent the spread of infection among patients.
chinese.zh: 醫院實施額外的安全措施，以防止感染在病患之間擴散。

english.en: We took every precaution to protect our personal data online.
english.zh: 我們採取了各種預防措施來保護網路上的個人資料。

speak.en: I always back up my files, just as a precaution.
speak.zh: 我一向會備份檔案，以防萬一。

write.en: Wearing a helmet is a simple precaution that can prevent serious head injuries.
write.zh: 戴安全帽是一個簡單的預防措施，能避免嚴重的頭部傷害。

example.en: The survey showed that customer satisfaction rose after the airline improved its online booking system.
example.zh: 調查顯示，那家航空公司改善線上訂位系統後，顧客滿意度提高了。

listen.en: He smiled with satisfaction at his finished painting.
listen.zh: 他看著完成的畫作，滿意地笑了。

chinese.en: Job satisfaction often depends more on supportive colleagues than on a high salary.
chinese.zh: 工作滿意度往往更取決於同事是否支持，而不是薪水高低。

english.en: Helping other people in my community gives me great satisfaction.
english.zh: 幫助社區裡的其他人讓我感到很滿足。

speak.en: Honestly, cooking for my friends gives me real satisfaction.
speak.zh: 說真的，煮飯給朋友吃讓我很有滿足感。

write.en: The teacher was unable to explain the answer to the students' satisfaction.
write.zh: 老師沒辦法把答案解釋到讓學生滿意。

example.en: The physiotherapist explained that his back pain was caused by bad posture, especially slouching over his phone.
example.zh: 物理治療師解釋，他的背痛是姿勢不良造成的，尤其是彎腰駝背滑手機。

listen.en: Good posture can make you look more confident.
listen.zh: 良好的姿勢能讓你看起來更有自信。

chinese.en: The company has taken a more defensive posture since sales began to fall.
chinese.zh: 自從銷售開始下滑，這家公司就採取了較保守防禦的態度。

english.en: My mother always reminds me to keep good posture at the table.
english.zh: 我媽媽總是提醒我吃飯時要保持良好的姿勢。

speak.en: I'm trying to improve my posture because my neck often hurts.
speak.zh: 我正在努力改善姿勢，因為我的脖子常常痠痛。

write.en: Many offices now offer standing desks to help employees maintain a healthy posture.
write.zh: 現在許多辦公室提供站立式辦公桌，幫助員工維持健康的姿勢。

example.en: Living near the airport is noisy, so many residents have installed double-glazed windows to block the sound.
example.zh: 住在機場附近很吵，所以許多居民都裝了雙層玻璃窗來隔音。

listen.en: The classroom became noisy when the teacher left.
listen.zh: 老師一離開，教室就變得很吵。

chinese.en: Noisy neighbours are one of the most common complaints among apartment residents.
chinese.zh: 吵鬧的鄰居是公寓住戶最常見的抱怨之一。

english.en: Our street gets very noisy when the night market opens.
english.zh: 夜市一開，我們這條街就變得很吵。

speak.en: My dorm is a bit noisy, so I usually study in the library.
speak.zh: 我的宿舍有點吵，所以我通常去圖書館讀書。

write.en: The noisiest part of the city is usually the area around the main train station.
write.zh: 這座城市最吵的地方通常是主要火車站周邊。

example.en: Although he made only a casual remark about the menu, the chef took it seriously and changed several dishes.
example.zh: 雖然他只是隨口評論了一下菜單，主廚卻很認真看待，還換掉了好幾道菜。

listen.en: It was just a casual chat over coffee.
listen.zh: 那只是邊喝咖啡邊隨意聊聊而已。

chinese.en: More companies are hiring casual workers instead of offering stable full-time positions.
chinese.zh: 越來越多公司雇用臨時工，而不提供穩定的全職職位。

english.en: She has a casual attitude towards deadlines and often submits work late.
english.zh: 她對截止期限的態度很隨便，常常遲交作業。

speak.en: I prefer casual restaurants where I can relax with my friends.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡能和朋友放鬆用餐的平價休閒餐廳。

write.en: To a casual observer, the city looks calm, but its traffic problems are serious.
write.zh: 在一般隨意觀察的人看來，這座城市很平靜，但它的交通問題其實很嚴重。

example.en: The final sprint of the race was so close that judges had to watch the replay to decide the winner.
example.zh: 比賽最後的衝刺實在太接近，裁判必須看重播才能判定誰贏。

listen.en: She sprinted down the hallway to reach class on time.
listen.zh: 她沿著走廊全速衝刺，準時趕到教室。

chinese.en: The team is working in short sprints to finish the new app before launch.
chinese.zh: 團隊正以短期衝刺的方式工作，要在上線前完成新的應用程式。

english.en: I sprinted home from school when it suddenly started to rain.
english.zh: 突然下起雨時，我從學校一路衝回家。

speak.en: I'm not good at long runs, but I enjoy short sprints.
speak.zh: 我不擅長長跑，但我喜歡短距離衝刺。

write.en: Studying for an exam is more like a marathon than a sprint.
write.zh: 準備考試比較像跑馬拉松，而不是短跑衝刺。

example.en: Because the textbook explanation was brief, the professor uploaded supplementary readings to help students understand the theory.
example.zh: 因為課本的說明很簡短，教授上傳了補充閱讀資料，幫助學生理解這個理論。

listen.en: The course includes supplementary videos and online quizzes.
listen.zh: 這門課程包含補充影片和線上小考。

chinese.en: Some parents send their children to supplementary classes after school to improve their grades.
chinese.zh: 有些家長會讓孩子放學後去上課後輔導班，以提升成績。

english.en: The library provides supplementary reading materials for this course every term.
english.zh: 圖書館每學期都會為這門課提供補充閱讀資料。

speak.en: I use podcasts as supplementary practice for my listening skills.
speak.zh: 我會用 Podcast 當作聽力的補充練習。

write.en: Low-income families may receive supplementary benefits to help cover the cost of heating.
write.zh: 低收入家庭可以領取額外補助，用來支付暖氣費用。

example.en: Before accepting the job offer abroad, he spent several weeks pondering whether he was ready to leave his family.
example.zh: 在接受國外的工作機會之前，他花了好幾個星期考慮自己是否已準備好離開家人。

listen.en: He paused to ponder the question before answering.
listen.zh: 他停下來想了想這個問題，才開口回答。

chinese.en: Philosophers have pondered the meaning of a happy life for thousands of years.
chinese.zh: 幾千年來，哲學家一直在思索幸福人生的意義。

english.en: I often ponder my future when I can't fall asleep.
english.zh: 我睡不著時常常在想自己的未來。

speak.en: Travelling alone gave me time to ponder what really matters to me.
speak.zh: 獨自旅行讓我有時間好好想想什麼對我才是真正重要的。

write.en: Policymakers must carefully ponder the long-term effects of automation on young workers.
write.zh: 決策者必須審慎思考自動化對年輕勞工的長期影響。

example.en: During the long lecture, my mind kept wandering, and I suddenly realised I hadn't written any notes.
example.zh: 那堂冗長的課上我一直走神，突然才發現自己一點筆記都沒寫。

listen.en: The little boy wandered away from his parents at the market.
listen.zh: 那個小男孩在市場裡走著走著就和爸媽走散了。

chinese.en: Tourists love to wander through the night market, tasting snacks from different stalls.
chinese.zh: 遊客很喜歡在夜市裡逛來逛去，品嘗不同攤位的小吃。

english.en: My dog likes to wander around the park in the morning.
english.zh: 我的狗喜歡早上在公園裡到處晃。

speak.en: When I travel, I like to just wander without any plans.
speak.zh: 我旅行時喜歡不做任何計畫，隨意走走。

write.en: Teachers should be patient when a student's attention starts to wander in class.
write.zh: 學生上課開始分心時，老師應該要有耐心。

example.en: In a surprising twist at the end of the novel, the quiet gardener turns out to be the detective.
example.zh: 小說結尾出現令人意外的轉折：那位沉默的園丁原來就是偵探。

listen.en: He twisted his ankle while running down the stairs.
listen.zh: 他跑下樓梯時扭傷了腳踝。

chinese.en: The speaker's words were twisted by some websites to create a misleading headline.
chinese.zh: 講者的話被一些網站曲解，做成了誤導人的標題。

english.en: The narrow road twists and turns through the green mountains.
english.zh: 那條狹窄的道路在青山之間蜿蜒曲折。

speak.en: I love movies with an unexpected twist at the end.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡結局有意外轉折的電影。

write.en: The chef added a modern twist to the traditional beef noodle soup.
write.zh: 主廚為傳統的牛肉麵加入了新潮的變化。

example.en: After losing his job, it took him months to recover his emotional equilibrium and feel calm again.
example.zh: 失業之後，他花了好幾個月才重新找回情緒上的平衡，再次感到平靜。

listen.en: Prices rise until supply and demand reach equilibrium.
listen.zh: 價格會一直上漲，直到供需達到均衡。

chinese.en: Introducing a foreign species can quickly upset the delicate equilibrium of a lake.
chinese.zh: 引進外來物種可能很快就會破壞湖泊脆弱的生態平衡。

english.en: Yoga helps me keep my mental equilibrium during stressful weeks.
english.zh: 在壓力大的那幾週，瑜伽幫助我保持心理平衡。

speak.en: I go hiking at weekends to restore some equilibrium in my life.
speak.zh: 我週末會去爬山，讓生活恢復一點平衡。

write.en: The government is trying to find an equilibrium between economic growth and environmental protection.
write.zh: 政府正努力在經濟成長與環境保護之間找到平衡點。

example.en: She gently stroked the cat's soft fur until it closed its eyes and began to purr.
example.zh: 她輕輕撫摸貓咪柔軟的毛，直到牠閉上眼睛，開始發出呼嚕聲。

listen.en: The doctor said a healthy diet can prevent a stroke.
listen.zh: 醫生說健康的飲食可以預防中風。

chinese.en: By a stroke of luck, we found the last available hotel room in the city.
chinese.zh: 我們運氣很好，訂到了城裡最後一間空房。

english.en: The young swimmer improved her stroke by practising in the pool every morning.
english.zh: 那位年輕泳者每天早上在泳池練習，改善了她的泳姿。

speak.en: I'm learning calligraphy, and each stroke needs a lot of patience.
speak.zh: 我在學書法，每一筆都需要很多耐心。

write.en: Hiring a local guide was a stroke of genius that saved our trip.
write.zh: 請當地導遊真是神來一筆，救了我們這趟旅行。

example.en: The leaves quivered in the light breeze, casting moving shadows across the garden path.
example.zh: 樹葉在微風中輕輕顫動，在花園小徑上投下搖曳的影子。

listen.en: His lips quivered as he tried not to cry.
listen.zh: 他強忍著不哭，嘴唇不停顫抖。

chinese.en: The little puppy was quivering with fear during the loud fireworks display.
chinese.zh: 放煙火的巨響讓那隻小狗嚇得直發抖。

english.en: My hands quivered with nerves when I walked onto the stage.
english.zh: 我走上舞台時，雙手緊張得發抖。

speak.en: I felt a quiver of excitement when I opened my exam results.
speak.zh: 打開考試成績的時候，我感到一陣興奮。

write.en: The surface of the pond quivered as a small fish jumped out of the water.
write.zh: 一條小魚躍出水面，池面隨之輕輕晃動。

example.en: Fallen leaves slowly decay on the forest floor, returning nutrients to the soil for new plants to use.
example.zh: 落葉在森林地面慢慢腐爛，把養分還給土壤，供新的植物利用。

listen.en: The old wooden bridge has started to decay.
listen.zh: 那座老木橋已經開始腐朽了。

chinese.en: Many historic buildings in the town centre have been left to decay for decades.
chinese.zh: 鎮中心許多歷史建築已經荒廢、任其破敗了數十年。

english.en: The fruit began to decay because it was left in the sun.
english.zh: 那些水果因為被放在太陽底下而開始腐爛。

speak.en: I go to the dentist regularly because I want to avoid tooth decay.
speak.zh: 我定期去看牙醫，因為我不想蛀牙。

write.en: Urban decay often follows when factories close and young residents move away.
write.zh: 工廠關閉、年輕居民外移之後，往往接著出現都市衰敗。

example.en: The young composer spent several years writing her first symphony, which premiered to great applause.
example.zh: 那位年輕作曲家花了好幾年寫出她的第一首交響曲，首演時贏得熱烈掌聲。

listen.en: We listened to a symphony on the radio after dinner.
listen.zh: 晚餐後我們用收音機聽了一首交響曲。

chinese.en: The city orchestra offers free symphony concerts in the park every summer.
chinese.zh: 市立樂團每年夏天都會在公園舉辦免費的交響樂音樂會。

english.en: My sister plays the violin in a youth symphony orchestra.
english.zh: 我妹妹在一個青少年交響樂團裡拉小提琴。

speak.en: I'm not an expert, but I find symphonies really relaxing.
speak.zh: 我不是行家，但我覺得聽交響曲很放鬆。

write.en: Walking through the forest at dawn, I heard a symphony of birdsong all around me.
write.zh: 清晨走在森林裡，我聽見四周鳥鳴交織成一首交響曲。

example.en: The doctor advised him not to take aspirin before the operation, since it can make bleeding harder to stop.
example.zh: 醫生建議他手術前不要吃阿斯匹靈，因為它可能讓出血更難止住。

listen.en: Do you have any aspirin in your bag?
listen.zh: 你包包裡有阿斯匹靈嗎？

chinese.en: Children should not be given aspirin without first asking a doctor or pharmacist.
chinese.zh: 沒有先詢問醫師或藥師，不應該給孩子吃阿斯匹靈。

english.en: You can buy aspirin at most pharmacies without a prescription.
english.zh: 在大部分藥局不需要處方箋就能買到阿斯匹靈。

speak.en: I try not to take aspirin unless the pain is really bad.
speak.zh: 除非真的痛得很厲害，不然我盡量不吃阿斯匹靈。

write.en: Some researchers are studying whether daily aspirin can lower the risk of certain diseases.
write.zh: 有些研究人員正在研究每天服用阿斯匹靈是否能降低某些疾病的風險。

example.en: Since nobody was home, the courier left the parcel with our neighbour and pushed a note under the door.
example.zh: 因為家裡沒人，快遞員把包裹交給鄰居，並從門縫塞了一張紙條進來。

listen.en: Could you pick up my parcel from the post office?
listen.zh: 你可以幫我去郵局領包裹嗎？

chinese.en: Online shopping has greatly increased the number of parcels delivered to homes every day.
chinese.zh: 網路購物大幅增加了每天送到家中的包裹數量。

english.en: I sent a parcel of books to my cousin abroad.
english.zh: 我寄了一箱書給住在國外的表哥。

speak.en: I get really excited whenever a parcel arrives for me.
speak.zh: 每次有我的包裹寄到，我都超興奮的。

write.en: The farmer sold a small parcel of land to build a community library.
write.zh: 那位農夫賣出一小塊地，用來興建社區圖書館。

example.en: Employees complained that the new rules were arbitrary, because managers never explained the reasons behind them.
example.zh: 員工抱怨新規定很武斷，因為主管從來沒有解釋背後的理由。

listen.en: The order of the names is completely arbitrary.
listen.zh: 這些名字的排列順序完全是隨意的。

chinese.en: Setting an arbitrary age limit for drivers may be unfair to many capable older people.
chinese.zh: 為駕駛人設定武斷的年齡上限，對許多仍有能力的長者可能不公平。

english.en: The teacher's grading seemed arbitrary to many students in my class.
english.zh: 我們班很多同學覺得老師的評分很隨意。

speak.en: I think some school rules are a bit arbitrary, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得有些校規有點沒道理。

write.en: Courts exist partly to protect citizens from arbitrary decisions made by those in power.
write.zh: 法院存在的目的之一，是保護人民免受掌權者專斷決定的侵害。

example.en: Without regular watering, the young plants were starved of nutrients and slowly turned yellow.
example.zh: 由於沒有定期澆水，幼苗缺乏養分，慢慢變黃了。

listen.en: I'm starving, so let's get something to eat.
listen.zh: 我快餓死了，我們去吃點東西吧。

chinese.en: Rural schools are often starved of funding, so students lack basic learning resources.
chinese.zh: 偏鄉學校常常經費嚴重不足，導致學生缺乏基本的學習資源。

english.en: I skipped breakfast this morning, so I'm absolutely starving now.
english.zh: 我今天早上沒吃早餐，所以現在餓得要命。

speak.en: After football practice, I'm always starving and eat a huge dinner.
speak.zh: 足球練習結束後我總是餓壞了，晚餐會吃很多。

write.en: Experts warn that starving yourself is an unhealthy way to lose weight.
write.zh: 專家警告，靠挨餓來減重是不健康的方法。

example.en: The hotel staff gave a prompt reply to our complaint and moved us to a quieter room within minutes.
example.zh: 飯店人員很快就回應了我們的抱怨，幾分鐘內就幫我們換到比較安靜的房間。

listen.en: Thank you for your prompt response to my email.
listen.zh: 謝謝你這麼快回覆我的電子郵件。

chinese.en: The teacher's simple question prompted a lively discussion about privacy on social media.
chinese.zh: 老師一個簡單的問題，引發了一場關於社群媒體隱私的熱烈討論。

english.en: Please follow the prompts on the screen to finish your order.
english.zh: 請依照螢幕上的提示完成訂購。

speak.en: What prompted me to study abroad was my love of travelling.
speak.zh: 促使我出國念書的，是我對旅行的熱愛。

write.en: Prompt medical treatment can greatly reduce the damage caused by serious injuries.
write.zh: 及時的醫療處置能大幅減少重傷所造成的傷害。

example.en: The lifeguard quickly pulled the swimmer from the pool and managed to revive him before the ambulance arrived.
example.zh: 救生員迅速把泳客拉出泳池，並在救護車抵達前讓他恢復了意識。

listen.en: A cup of strong coffee always revives me.
listen.zh: 一杯濃咖啡總能讓我恢復精神。

chinese.en: Some young designers are reviving traditional crafts by giving them a modern look.
chinese.zh: 一些年輕設計師為傳統工藝注入現代風格，讓它們重新活躍起來。

english.en: The old song was revived by a popular singer last year.
english.zh: 這首老歌去年被一位當紅歌手重新唱紅。

speak.en: A short walk outside really revives me when I feel sleepy.
speak.zh: 我想睡的時候，到外面走一走真的能讓我精神一振。

write.en: The government plans to revive the old railway line to attract more tourists.
write.zh: 政府打算重新啟用那條舊鐵路，以吸引更多觀光客。

example.en: As the climate became drier, the vegetation in the region changed from forest to grassland and shrubs.
example.zh: 隨著氣候變得乾燥，這個地區的植被從森林轉變為草原和灌木。

listen.en: There is very little vegetation in the desert.
listen.zh: 沙漠裡幾乎沒有什麼植物。

chinese.en: Removing vegetation from hillsides increases the risk of landslides during heavy rain.
chinese.zh: 清除山坡上的植被，會提高豪雨時發生山崩的風險。

english.en: Wild animals depend on the vegetation in the park for food.
english.zh: 野生動物靠公園裡的草木維生。

speak.en: I love hiking in places with lots of green vegetation.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡到綠意盎然的地方健行。

write.en: Planting vegetation on rooftops can help cool buildings and reduce energy use in cities.
write.zh: 在屋頂上種植植物，有助於為建築物降溫並減少城市的能源消耗。

example.en: The job was attractive because it offered flexible hours, a good salary and chances to travel abroad.
example.zh: 這份工作很吸引人，因為它提供彈性工時、不錯的薪水，還有出國的機會。

listen.en: This apartment has an attractive view of the river.
listen.zh: 這間公寓可以看到迷人的河景。

chinese.en: Low taxes make the country an attractive place for foreign companies to invest.
chinese.zh: 低稅率讓這個國家成為吸引外國企業投資的地方。

english.en: The new design makes the product more attractive to young people.
english.zh: 新設計讓這項產品對年輕人更有吸引力。

speak.en: Honestly, flexible working hours make a job really attractive to me.
speak.zh: 老實說，彈性工時會讓一份工作對我很有吸引力。

write.en: Offering free public transport could be an attractive way to reduce car use.
write.zh: 提供免費大眾運輸，可能是減少開車的一個誘人方法。

example.en: After years of high blood pressure, his kidneys stopped working properly, so he now needs regular treatment.
example.zh: 多年的高血壓讓他的腎臟無法正常運作，所以他現在需要定期治療。

listen.en: Drinking enough water is good for your kidneys.
listen.zh: 喝足夠的水對腎臟有益。

chinese.en: There are not enough kidney donors to meet the needs of patients on waiting lists.
chinese.zh: 腎臟捐贈者不足，無法滿足等候名單上病患的需求。

english.en: My aunt had a kidney operation at the hospital last week.
english.zh: 我阿姨上星期在醫院動了腎臟手術。

speak.en: I didn't know that too much salt could damage your kidneys.
speak.zh: 我以前不知道吃太鹹會傷害腎臟。

write.en: Public campaigns encourage people to register as kidney donors to save more lives.
write.zh: 公益宣導活動鼓勵民眾登記成為腎臟捐贈者，以拯救更多生命。

example.en: Instead of answering immediately, she gave a thoughtful reply that showed she had considered every side of the issue.
example.zh: 她沒有立刻回答，而是給出一個深思熟慮的回應，顯示她考慮過問題的各個面向。

listen.en: My new roommate is quiet but very thoughtful.
listen.zh: 我的新室友話不多，但非常體貼。

chinese.en: The article offers a thoughtful analysis of why young people are moving to big cities.
chinese.zh: 這篇文章深入分析了年輕人為什麼往大城市移動。

english.en: Thank you for the thoughtful birthday gift you sent me last week.
english.zh: 謝謝你上週寄給我那份貼心的生日禮物。

speak.en: I think a thoughtful friend is someone who remembers the little things.
speak.zh: 我覺得體貼的朋友就是會記得小事的人。

write.en: He looked thoughtful for a moment before agreeing to lead the team project.
write.zh: 他若有所思了一會兒，才答應帶領這個團隊專案。

example.en: The company opened a fitness centre in the office building so staff could exercise before or after work.
example.zh: 公司在辦公大樓裡開設了健身中心，讓員工上班前後都能運動。

listen.en: She joined a fitness class near her office.
listen.zh: 她報名了公司附近的健身課。

chinese.en: Schools should encourage physical fitness by offering more sports activities during the week.
chinese.zh: 學校應該在平日提供更多運動活動，來鼓勵學生鍛鍊體能。

english.en: My fitness has improved a lot since I started cycling.
english.zh: 自從我開始騎腳踏車，體能進步了很多。

speak.en: I use a fitness app to track how much I walk.
speak.zh: 我用健身應用程式記錄自己走了多少路。

write.en: The interview tested each candidate's fitness for a role that involved managing a large team.
write.zh: 這場面試評估每位應徵者是否適合一個需要管理大型團隊的職位。

example.en: Teenagers who feel alienated from their families often turn to online friends for support and understanding.
example.zh: 覺得與家人疏離的青少年，常會轉向網友尋求支持與理解。

listen.en: Harsh words can alienate even your closest friends.
listen.zh: 說話尖酸刻薄，連最親近的朋友都會疏遠你。

chinese.en: Strict rules about phones may alienate students instead of helping them focus.
chinese.zh: 嚴格的手機規定可能不但無法幫助學生專心，反而讓他們產生反感。

english.en: His rude comments in meetings alienated the rest of the team.
english.zh: 他在會議上無禮的發言讓團隊其他人都疏遠了他。

speak.en: I try not to talk about money because it can alienate people.
speak.zh: 我盡量不談錢，因為那可能會讓人疏遠。

write.en: Moving to a new country can make older people feel alienated from society.
write.zh: 移居到新的國家，可能讓年長者覺得與社會格格不入。

example.en: Unlike the strict staff at the front desk, the head librarian was sympathetic and waived the student's late fee.
example.zh: 和櫃檯嚴格的職員不同，圖書館館長很體諒這名學生，免除了他的逾期罰款。

listen.en: She gave me a sympathetic smile after the long meeting.
listen.zh: 冗長的會議結束後，她對我露出同情的微笑。

chinese.en: Many voters are sympathetic to the idea of a shorter working week.
chinese.zh: 許多選民贊同縮短每週工時的想法。

english.en: The teacher was sympathetic to students who felt nervous before exams.
english.zh: 老師很體諒考試前感到緊張的學生。

speak.en: Honestly, my friends were really sympathetic when I failed my driving test.
speak.zh: 說真的，我駕照考沒過的時候，朋友們都很體諒我。

write.en: The novel's main character is so sympathetic that readers easily forgive her mistakes.
write.zh: 這本小說的主角很討人喜歡，讀者很容易就原諒她犯的錯。

example.en: When the heating bill doubled, the family decided to switch to a cheaper energy supplier for the winter.
example.zh: 暖氣費翻倍後，這家人決定冬天改用比較便宜的能源供應商。

listen.en: Please switch off the lights when you leave the room.
listen.zh: 離開房間時請把燈關掉。

chinese.en: The switch to online classes was difficult for students without reliable internet access.
chinese.zh: 改成線上上課，對沒有穩定網路的學生來說很辛苦。

english.en: I usually switch my phone to silent mode during lectures.
english.zh: 上課時我通常會把手機切換成靜音模式。

speak.en: I'd love to switch careers and do something more creative.
speak.zh: 我很想轉換跑道，做一些更有創意的工作。

write.en: The light switch is hidden behind the door, so guests often can't find it.
write.zh: 電燈開關藏在門後面，所以客人常常找不到。

example.en: Information about the ancient site is sparse, because few written records survived and most researchers have focused elsewhere.
example.zh: 關於這處古代遺址的資料很少，因為留存的文字紀錄不多，而且大多數研究者的焦點都在別處。

listen.en: The trees become sparse as you climb higher up the hill.
listen.zh: 越往山上爬，樹木就越稀疏。

chinese.en: Audience numbers were sparse on the first night, but word of mouth soon spread.
chinese.zh: 首演當晚觀眾稀稀落落，但口碑很快就傳開了。

english.en: My grandfather has sparse grey hair and a warm smile.
english.zh: 我爺爺頭髮灰白稀疏，笑容很溫暖。

speak.en: The furniture in my first flat was pretty sparse, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我第一間公寓裡的家具少得可憐。

write.en: Rainfall in the region is sparsest in July, when farmers rely on stored water.
write.zh: 該地區七月降雨最少，那時農民只能依賴儲存的水。

example.en: The two villages are close together, yet their dialects differ so much that older residents struggle to understand each other.
example.zh: 這兩個村莊離得很近，方言卻差異很大，連年長的居民都很難聽懂彼此說的話。

listen.en: He speaks a dialect that is hard for outsiders to follow.
listen.zh: 他說的方言外地人很難聽得懂。

chinese.en: Some schools now offer classes in regional dialects to help keep them alive.
chinese.zh: 有些學校現在開設地方方言課程，幫助這些方言延續下去。

english.en: Many young people can no longer speak their grandparents' dialect fluently.
english.zh: 許多年輕人已經無法流利地說祖父母的方言。

speak.en: When I'm back home, I switch to our dialect without thinking.
speak.zh: 我一回到老家，就會不自覺地改說我們的方言。

write.en: Linguists recorded the dialect carefully before its last fluent speakers passed away.
write.zh: 語言學家趕在最後一批能流利使用的人過世前，仔細記錄了這種方言。

example.en: Dogs can perceive sounds that are far too high for human ears, which is why they react to whistles we cannot hear.
example.zh: 狗能聽見對人耳來說太高的聲音，這就是為什麼牠們會對我們聽不到的哨音有反應。

listen.en: She perceived a change in his tone and stopped talking.
listen.zh: 她察覺到他語氣變了，便不再說話。

chinese.en: How a company is perceived by the public can affect its sales.
chinese.zh: 大眾如何看待一家公司，可能會影響它的銷售。

english.en: Students often perceive group projects as unfair to hard workers.
english.zh: 學生常認為小組報告對認真的人不公平。

speak.en: I think people perceive me as quiet, but I'm actually quite chatty.
speak.zh: 我覺得別人以為我很安靜，但其實我滿愛聊天的。

write.en: Few residents perceived any real danger until the river suddenly rose overnight.
write.zh: 在河水一夜之間突然暴漲之前，幾乎沒有居民察覺到真正的危險。

example.en: Local farmers have a stake in the new dam project, since it will decide how much water their fields receive.
example.zh: 當地農民與新水壩計畫息息相關，因為它將決定他們的田地能分到多少水。

listen.en: Their jobs are at stake if the factory closes.
listen.zh: 如果工廠關閉，他們的工作就不保了。

chinese.en: The airline plans to sell its stake in the struggling hotel business next year.
chinese.zh: 這家航空公司打算明年出售它在那家經營困難的飯店事業中的股份。

english.en: My uncle owns a small stake in a popular local bakery.
english.zh: 我叔叔持有一家人氣在地麵包店的一小部分股份。

speak.en: I'm so sure she'll win that I'd stake my reputation on it.
speak.zh: 我非常確定她會贏，願意拿我的名聲來擔保。

write.en: The researchers staked their careers on a theory that most experts had rejected.
write.zh: 這些研究人員把自己的職涯押在一個多數專家都否定的理論上。

example.en: To improve her sleep, Mia banished all screens from the bedroom and kept her phone in the kitchen overnight.
example.zh: 為了改善睡眠，米亞把所有螢幕都趕出臥室，晚上把手機放在廚房。

listen.en: A warm bath helped banish my worries after a hard day.
listen.zh: 辛苦了一天後，泡個熱水澡幫我趕走了煩惱。

chinese.en: The new rule aims to banish single-use plastic bags from all supermarkets.
chinese.zh: 這項新規定的目的是讓一次性塑膠袋從所有超市中消失。

english.en: Our cat was banished to the garden after breaking a vase.
english.zh: 我們家的貓打破花瓶之後，被趕到花園去了。

speak.en: I try to banish negative thoughts by going for a quick run.
speak.zh: 我會出去跑一下步，試著把負面想法趕走。

write.en: Good lighting and fresh plants can banish the gloomy feeling of a small office.
write.zh: 良好的照明和新鮮的植物能驅散小辦公室的陰沉感。

example.en: The lecture hall was so noisy that the students at the back could scarcely hear a word the professor said.
example.zh: 演講廳吵到坐在後排的學生幾乎聽不到教授說的任何一句話。

listen.en: She had scarcely sat down when the phone rang.
listen.zh: 她才剛坐下，電話就響了。

chinese.en: Scarcely anyone in the village owns a car, so everyone relies on buses.
chinese.zh: 村裡幾乎沒有人有車，所以大家都靠公車。

english.en: There is scarcely any milk left in the fridge this morning.
english.zh: 今天早上冰箱裡幾乎沒有牛奶了。

speak.en: I was so nervous that I could scarcely remember my own name.
speak.zh: 我緊張到幾乎連自己的名字都想不起來。

write.en: Public interest in the issue has scarcely changed despite years of media coverage.
write.zh: 儘管媒體多年來持續報導，大眾對這個議題的關注幾乎沒有改變。

example.en: The nurse treated every patient with kindness and patience, and her humanity left a deep impression on the families.
example.zh: 這位護理師以親切和耐心對待每位病人，她的仁慈讓家屬們印象深刻。

listen.en: Music is something that all of humanity can share.
listen.zh: 音樂是全人類都能共享的東西。

chinese.en: The exhibition shows how early humanity learned to use fire and simple tools.
chinese.zh: 這場展覽呈現早期人類如何學會使用火與簡單的工具。

english.en: Volunteering at the shelter reminded me of our shared humanity.
english.zh: 在收容所當志工，讓我想起我們共同的人性。

speak.en: For me, the film showed real humanity, not just action scenes.
speak.zh: 對我來說，這部電影展現了真正的人性，而不只是動作場面。

write.en: Medical aid for disaster areas should be guided by humanity rather than profit.
write.zh: 對災區的醫療援助應該以人道精神為依歸，而不是以利益為考量。

example.en: Students who arrived late were excluded from the exam, as the rules stated that no one could enter after it began.
example.zh: 遲到的學生被拒於考場外，因為規定寫明考試開始後任何人都不得進場。

listen.en: Nobody likes to feel excluded by their own friends.
listen.zh: 沒有人喜歡被自己的朋友排擠。

chinese.en: The researchers excluded participants who had taken any medicine during the previous week.
chinese.zh: 研究人員排除了前一週曾服用任何藥物的受試者。

english.en: We cannot exclude the possibility that the train will be late.
english.zh: 我們不能排除火車會誤點的可能性。

speak.en: If it were up to me, I'd exclude junk food from school canteens.
speak.zh: 如果由我決定，我會把垃圾食物從學校餐廳裡剔除。

write.en: Older people are often excluded from online services because the websites are hard to use.
write.zh: 年長者常因網站難以使用，而被排除在線上服務之外。

example.en: Working from home was once rare, but it has become a global phenomenon since many offices adopted flexible policies.
example.zh: 在家工作曾經很少見，但自從許多公司採用彈性制度後，已成為全球性的現象。

listen.en: Scientists still cannot fully explain this strange phenomenon.
listen.zh: 科學家仍然無法完全解釋這個奇特的現象。

chinese.en: Earthquakes and volcanoes are phenomena that can be studied but not prevented.
chinese.zh: 地震與火山都是可以研究、卻無法阻止的現象。

english.en: Online shopping has become a common phenomenon among young people.
english.zh: 網路購物已成為年輕人之間常見的現象。

speak.en: I think fast fashion is a really worrying phenomenon nowadays.
speak.zh: 我覺得快時尚是現在很令人擔心的現象。

write.en: At just twelve, the young violinist was already called a musical phenomenon.
write.zh: 這位年輕小提琴家才十二歲，就已被稱為音樂奇才。

example.en: After graduating, she found a job in the hospitality industry, managing bookings and guest services at a busy hotel.
example.zh: 畢業後，她在餐旅業找到工作，在一間忙碌的飯店負責訂房與客戶服務。

listen.en: Thank you so much for your kind hospitality this weekend.
listen.zh: 非常感謝你這個週末的熱情款待。

chinese.en: The region is famous for its hospitality, and visitors are often invited into local homes.
chinese.zh: 這個地區以熱情好客聞名，遊客常被邀請到當地人家中作客。

english.en: Our neighbours showed us great hospitality when we first moved in.
english.zh: 我們剛搬來時，鄰居非常熱情地款待我們。

speak.en: I'd love to study hospitality management and maybe run a guesthouse.
speak.zh: 我很想念餐旅管理，也許以後經營一間民宿。

write.en: Good hospitality is not about luxury but about making guests feel genuinely welcome.
write.zh: 好的待客之道不在於奢華，而在於讓客人真心感到賓至如歸。

example.en: The new study illuminates why some children learn languages faster, showing that early exposure matters more than age.
example.zh: 這項新研究闡明了為什麼有些孩子學語言比較快，顯示早期接觸比年齡更重要。

listen.en: Soft lights illuminate the path through the garden.
listen.zh: 柔和的燈光照亮了穿過花園的小徑。

chinese.en: The museum uses gentle lighting to illuminate the paintings without damaging them.
chinese.zh: 博物館使用柔和的燈光照亮畫作，又不會造成損傷。

english.en: Her talk illuminated the real challenges facing small rural schools.
english.zh: 她的演講清楚說明了偏鄉小學面臨的真正挑戰。

speak.en: The city looks amazing at night when the bridges are illuminated.
speak.zh: 晚上橋都點燈的時候，這座城市看起來超美的。

write.en: Interviews with former workers helped illuminate how the factory had affected the town.
write.zh: 訪談過去的員工，有助於釐清這座工廠對小鎮造成了什麼影響。

example.en: Dust had accumulated on every shelf, showing that nobody had cleaned the storeroom since the previous winter.
example.zh: 每個架子上都積了灰塵，可見從去年冬天以來就沒有人打掃過儲藏室。

listen.en: Snow began to accumulate on the roads overnight.
listen.zh: 一夜之間，道路上開始積雪。

chinese.en: If you only pay the minimum each month, interest will quickly accumulate on your credit card.
chinese.zh: 如果每個月只繳最低應繳金額，信用卡利息很快就會越積越多。

english.en: Students should try to accumulate some work experience before they graduate.
english.zh: 學生應該試著在畢業前累積一些工作經驗。

speak.en: I tend to accumulate too much stuff, so I need a big clear-out.
speak.zh: 我很容易囤積太多東西，所以需要來個大掃除。

write.en: Plastic waste continues to accumulate in the oceans faster than it can be removed.
write.zh: 塑膠垃圾在海洋中累積的速度，持續超過清除的速度。

example.en: By watching experienced teachers, new staff can expand their repertoire of classroom techniques and handle difficult lessons with more confidence.
example.zh: 透過觀摩資深教師，新進教師能增加自己的教學技巧，更有信心地處理困難的課程。

listen.en: The choir added a new song to its repertoire.
listen.zh: 合唱團在演出曲目中新增了一首歌。

chinese.en: Reading widely is the best way to build a rich repertoire of vocabulary.
chinese.zh: 廣泛閱讀是累積豐富字彙量的最佳方法。

english.en: My grandmother has a huge repertoire of traditional family recipes.
english.zh: 我奶奶擁有大量的傳統家傳食譜。

speak.en: I only know a small repertoire of songs on the guitar.
speak.zh: 我用吉他會彈的歌只有少少幾首。

write.en: A strong speaker draws on a varied repertoire of examples to support each argument.
write.zh: 優秀的講者會運用各式各樣的例子來支持每個論點。

example.en: Although she trained as a classical pianist, she now plays jazz in small cafés and writes music for short films.
example.zh: 雖然她受的是古典鋼琴訓練，現在卻在小咖啡館演奏爵士樂，也為短片寫配樂。

listen.en: The pianist bowed politely before the concert began.
listen.zh: 音樂會開始前，鋼琴家有禮貌地鞠躬致意。

chinese.en: The hotel hired a pianist to play quietly in the lobby every evening.
chinese.zh: 飯店聘請了一位鋼琴師，每晚在大廳輕柔地演奏。

english.en: My sister wants to become a professional pianist after university.
english.zh: 我妹妹大學畢業後想成為職業鋼琴家。

speak.en: I'm not much of a pianist, but I enjoy playing for fun.
speak.zh: 我鋼琴彈得不怎麼樣，但我很享受彈著玩。

write.en: Many famous pianists began lessons as children, but adults can also learn successfully.
write.zh: 許多知名鋼琴家從小就開始上課，但成年人也能學得很好。

example.en: The survey found that many teenagers have high aspirations, but they often lack the guidance needed to achieve their goals.
example.zh: 調查發現，許多青少年志向遠大，卻常常缺乏實現目標所需的指引。

listen.en: He never gave up his aspiration to become a writer.
listen.zh: 他從未放棄成為作家的志向。

chinese.en: Good teachers encourage students to pursue their aspirations rather than follow the crowd.
chinese.zh: 好老師會鼓勵學生追求自己的抱負，而不是隨波逐流。

english.en: Parents should not force their own aspirations onto their children.
english.zh: 父母不應該把自己的期望強加在孩子身上。

speak.en: To be honest, my biggest aspiration is just to travel more.
speak.zh: 老實說，我最大的願望就只是多去旅行。

write.en: The government's housing policy fails to meet the aspirations of young families.
write.zh: 政府的住宅政策未能滿足年輕家庭的期望。

example.en: The leaflet that came with the medicine explained the correct dose and listed possible side effects in simple language.
example.zh: 藥品附的說明書用淺顯的文字解釋了正確劑量，並列出可能的副作用。

listen.en: Please take a leaflet before you leave the museum.
listen.zh: 離開博物館前請拿一份簡介。

chinese.en: The council printed leaflets to inform residents about the new parking rules.
chinese.zh: 市政府印製傳單，向居民說明新的停車規定。

english.en: I found a leaflet about cooking classes in my mailbox.
english.zh: 我在信箱裡發現一張烹飪課的傳單。

speak.en: I usually throw away leaflets, but this one actually looked useful.
speak.zh: 我通常會把傳單丟掉，但這張看起來還真的滿有用的。

write.en: Instead of printing paper leaflets, many shops now share information through social media.
write.zh: 許多商店現在不印紙本傳單，而是透過社群媒體分享資訊。

example.en: After years of training, she became a heart surgeon, performing complex operations that often lasted most of the day.
example.zh: 經過多年訓練，她成為心臟外科醫師，執行的複雜手術常常要花上大半天。

listen.en: The surgeon washed her hands before entering the room.
listen.zh: 外科醫師進房間前先洗了手。

chinese.en: A shortage of surgeons in rural hospitals means patients must travel far for treatment.
chinese.zh: 偏鄉醫院缺乏外科醫師，代表病患必須長途跋涉才能就醫。

english.en: My cousin is training to become a surgeon in Taipei.
english.zh: 我表哥正在臺北接受外科醫師的訓練。

speak.en: I admire surgeons, but I could never do that job myself.
speak.zh: 我很佩服外科醫師，但我自己絕對做不來那份工作。

write.en: The tree surgeon removed the dead branches before the typhoon season arrived.
write.zh: 樹藝師在颱風季來臨前，把枯死的樹枝修剪掉了。

example.en: Opponents of the new airport argue that it will increase noise and destroy farmland that local families depend on.
example.zh: 反對興建新機場的人認為，機場會增加噪音，並破壞當地家庭賴以為生的農地。

listen.en: He respected his opponent even though he lost the game.
listen.zh: 雖然輸了比賽，他仍然尊重他的對手。

chinese.en: In the debate, she listened carefully to her opponent before giving her reply.
chinese.zh: 辯論時，她先仔細聆聽對手的發言，再提出回應。

english.en: Our team's next opponent has not lost a match this season.
english.zh: 我們隊下一個對手這一季還沒輸過任何一場比賽。

speak.en: I think chess is fun because you have to predict your opponent's moves.
speak.zh: 我覺得下西洋棋很好玩，因為你得預測對手的下一步。

write.en: Even strong opponents of the tax admitted that public transport had improved.
write.zh: 就連強烈反對這項稅的人也承認，大眾運輸確實改善了。

example.en: Students renting their first flat are often shocked by utility bills, which can rise sharply when heating is used all winter.
example.zh: 第一次租房的學生常被水電瓦斯帳單嚇到，因為整個冬天開暖氣時費用可能暴增。

listen.en: We pay the utility bills at the convenience store.
listen.zh: 我們在便利商店繳水電瓦斯費。

chinese.en: The utility company plans to replace old water pipes across the city.
chinese.zh: 自來水公司計畫更換全市的老舊水管。

english.en: Some critics question the utility of homework for young children.
english.zh: 有些批評者質疑家庭作業對年幼孩童是否真的有用。

speak.en: Honestly, I care more about utility than style when buying a bag.
speak.zh: 說真的，買包包時我比較在乎實用性，而不是款式。

write.en: Public utilities should remain affordable for families even when energy prices rise.
write.zh: 即使能源價格上漲，公用事業的費用也應該讓家庭負擔得起。

example.en: The report criticised the misuse of public money, pointing out that funds meant for schools were spent on expensive office furniture.
example.zh: 這份報告批評公帑遭到濫用，指出原本撥給學校的經費被拿去買昂貴的辦公家具。

listen.en: Please do not misuse the emergency button on the train.
listen.zh: 請勿任意使用列車上的緊急按鈕。

chinese.en: Many words are misused on social media, and their original meanings slowly change.
chinese.zh: 許多詞彙在社群媒體上被誤用，原本的意思也慢慢改變了。

english.en: The misuse of antibiotics can make them less effective over time.
english.zh: 濫用抗生素會讓它們的效果隨著時間逐漸變差。

speak.en: Honestly, I think lots of people misuse the word 'literally' these days.
speak.zh: 說真的，我覺得現在很多人都誤用了 literally 這個字。

write.en: Companies that misuse their customers' personal data should face heavy fines and public criticism.
write.zh: 濫用顧客個人資料的公司，應該面臨高額罰款與大眾的批評。

example.en: Our apartment has no storage room, so we keep the vacuum cleaner and spare towels in a narrow hall closet.
example.zh: 我們的公寓沒有儲藏室，所以把吸塵器和備用毛巾放在走廊一個窄窄的壁櫥裡。

listen.en: My shoes are on the floor of the closet.
listen.zh: 我的鞋子放在衣櫥底部。

chinese.en: We cleared out the closet and donated the clothes we no longer wear.
chinese.zh: 我們清空了衣櫥，把不再穿的衣服捐了出去。

english.en: The new bedroom has a large closet with sliding doors.
english.zh: 新臥室有一個附拉門的大衣櫥。

speak.en: My closet is a total mess, so please don't open it!
speak.zh: 我的衣櫥亂成一團，拜託不要打開！

write.en: Built-in closets make small apartments feel tidier and save space for other furniture.
write.zh: 嵌入式衣櫥讓小公寓看起來更整齊，也為其他家具省下空間。

example.en: After falling off his bike, the boy had his broken arm put in plaster and could not write for six weeks.
example.zh: 那個男孩騎腳踏車摔倒後，骨折的手臂打上了石膏，六個星期都不能寫字。

listen.en: She put a plaster on the small cut on her finger.
listen.zh: 她在手指的小傷口上貼了一片OK繃。

chinese.en: Workers plastered the walls before painting them a light shade of blue.
chinese.zh: 工人先把牆壁抹上灰泥，再漆成淺藍色。

english.en: The city's walls were plastered with posters for the concert.
english.zh: 城裡的牆上貼滿了這場演唱會的海報。

speak.en: Do you have a plaster? I've got a blister from these shoes.
speak.zh: 你有OK繃嗎？我穿這雙鞋磨出水泡了。

write.en: Many builders now prefer plasterboard to traditional plaster because it saves time.
write.zh: 許多建商現在偏好用石膏板取代傳統灰泥，因為比較省時。

example.en: The programme pairs youngsters from low-income families with volunteer mentors, who help them with homework and career planning.
example.zh: 這個計畫讓低收入家庭的青少年和志工導師配對，由導師協助他們寫功課及規劃職涯。

listen.en: The youngsters cheered loudly when the band came on stage.
listen.zh: 樂團上台時，年輕人大聲歡呼。

chinese.en: Many youngsters today spend more time on their phones than playing outdoors.
chinese.zh: 現在許多年輕人花在手機上的時間比在戶外玩耍還多。

english.en: My grandfather loves telling stories to the youngsters in our family.
english.zh: 我爺爺很喜歡講故事給家裡的小孩聽。

speak.en: When I was a youngster, I spent every summer at my grandparents' farm.
speak.zh: 我小時候每年暑假都待在祖父母的農場。

write.en: Coaches should give talented youngsters time to develop rather than pushing them too hard.
write.zh: 教練應該給有天分的年輕人時間成長，而不是逼得太緊。

example.en: The old fisherman told us the legend of a hidden island that only appears when the sea is perfectly calm.
example.zh: 老漁夫告訴我們一個傳說：有座隱藏的島嶼，只有在海面完全平靜時才會出現。

listen.en: He became a legend in the world of football.
listen.zh: 他成了足球界的傳奇人物。

chinese.en: The singer is a living legend whose songs are still popular decades later.
chinese.zh: 這位歌手是活傳奇，他的歌數十年後依然受歡迎。

english.en: Check the legend to see what each colour on the map means.
english.zh: 看一下圖例，就知道地圖上每個顏色代表什麼。

speak.en: My grandma is a legend in our neighbourhood for her dumplings.
speak.zh: 我奶奶包的水餃在我們社區可是傳奇。

write.en: Many legends about the mountain were passed down orally long before anyone wrote them down.
write.zh: 早在有人把它們寫下來之前，許多關於這座山的傳說就已經口耳相傳。

example.en: Fans expressed dismay when the band cancelled its tour only two days before the first concert, offering no clear explanation.
example.zh: 樂團在首場演唱會前兩天取消巡演，卻沒有給出明確的解釋，令歌迷大失所望。

listen.en: She looked at the broken vase in dismay.
listen.zh: 她驚愕地看著打破的花瓶。

chinese.en: Many residents were dismayed by the plan to cut down the old trees.
chinese.zh: 許多居民對砍除老樹的計畫感到非常失望。

english.en: I was dismayed to learn that my flight had been cancelled.
english.zh: 得知班機被取消時，我感到很沮喪。

speak.en: I was honestly dismayed by how expensive rent has become.
speak.zh: 房租變得這麼貴，老實說讓我很傻眼。

write.en: The rising number of students skipping breakfast is a cause for dismay among health experts.
write.zh: 不吃早餐的學生人數增加，讓健康專家深感憂心。

example.en: The author's vivid descriptions of the crowded market make readers feel as if they can smell the spices and hear the traders.
example.zh: 作者對擁擠市場的生動描寫，讓讀者彷彿能聞到香料味、聽見攤販的叫賣聲。

listen.en: The garden was full of vivid red and yellow flowers.
listen.zh: 花園裡開滿了鮮豔的紅花和黃花。

chinese.en: Young children often have vivid imaginations and invent entire worlds while playing.
chinese.zh: 年幼的孩子常有豐富的想像力，玩耍時會創造出一整個世界。

english.en: The teacher used a vivid example to explain the idea.
english.zh: 老師用了一個生動的例子來解釋這個概念。

speak.en: I had a really vivid dream last night about flying over the sea.
speak.zh: 我昨晚做了一個很逼真的夢，夢到自己在海上飛。

write.en: The documentary gives a vivid picture of how plastic pollution affects marine life.
write.zh: 這部紀錄片生動地呈現了塑膠汙染如何影響海洋生物。

example.en: The landlord was held liable for the accident, because he had ignored repeated complaints about the broken stair rail.
example.zh: 房東被判須為這起意外負責，因為他一再忽視房客對樓梯扶手損壞的抱怨。

listen.en: This road is liable to flood after heavy rain.
listen.zh: 這條路大雨過後很容易淹水。

chinese.en: Young children are liable to catch colds when the weather changes suddenly.
chinese.zh: 天氣突然變化時，年幼的孩子很容易感冒。

english.en: Parents may be liable if their children damage public property.
english.zh: 如果孩子損壞公物，父母可能要負起責任。

speak.en: If I don't write it down, I'm liable to forget it.
speak.zh: 如果我不寫下來，很可能就會忘記。

write.en: Companies should be liable for the pollution their factories release into rivers.
write.zh: 企業應該為工廠排入河川的汙染負起責任。

example.en: Tourists at the night market often bargain with sellers, hoping to pay less than the price written on the sign.
example.zh: 夜市裡的觀光客常和攤販討價還價，希望付的錢比標示的價格少一點。

listen.en: My mother loves hunting for bargains at weekend markets.
listen.zh: 我媽媽很喜歡在週末市集挖寶撿便宜。

chinese.en: The two companies struck a bargain that allowed both to share the new technology.
chinese.zh: 兩家公司達成協議，讓雙方都能共享這項新技術。

english.en: I bought these shoes at a bargain price during the sale.
english.zh: 我在特賣期間用超便宜的價格買了這雙鞋。

speak.en: I'm terrible at bargaining, so I usually just pay what they ask.
speak.zh: 我很不會殺價，所以通常對方開多少我就付多少。

write.en: Workers are bargaining with management for better pay and shorter working hours.
write.zh: 員工正在和資方協商，爭取更好的薪資與更短的工時。

example.en: During the storm, the penguins huddled together in a tight group, taking turns to stand on the windy outer edge.
example.zh: 暴風雪期間，企鵝們緊緊擠成一團，輪流站到風大的外圍。

listen.en: The children huddled under the blanket to watch the film.
listen.zh: 孩子們擠在毯子底下看電影。

chinese.en: Commuters huddled under the small bus shelter as the rain grew heavier.
chinese.zh: 雨越下越大，通勤族擠在小小的公車候車亭下。

english.en: The players formed a huddle before the final minute of the game.
english.zh: 比賽最後一分鐘前，球員們圍成一圈商量戰術。

speak.en: My classmates and I huddled over one laptop to finish the project.
speak.zh: 我和同學擠在一台筆電前面趕完報告。

write.en: Small groups of students stood in huddles outside the hall, discussing the exam results.
write.zh: 學生三五成群地聚在禮堂外，討論考試成績。

example.en: Each departmental budget was reduced this year, so the history teachers had to share textbooks instead of buying new ones.
example.zh: 今年每個部門的預算都被刪減，所以歷史老師們只能共用課本，無法買新的。

listen.en: Please send the report to the departmental office.
listen.zh: 請把報告送到系辦公室。

chinese.en: Students can find departmental announcements on the university website and notice boards.
chinese.zh: 學生可以在大學網站和布告欄上找到系所公告。

english.en: Our manager asked us to follow the new departmental guidelines.
english.zh: 經理要求我們遵守部門新的作業準則。

speak.en: I've got a departmental lunch today, so I'll eat with my colleagues.
speak.zh: 我今天有部門聚餐，所以會跟同事一起吃午餐。

write.en: Strict departmental boundaries can stop staff from sharing useful ideas across the company.
write.zh: 部門之間的界線太過分明，可能讓員工無法在公司內交流有用的想法。

example.en: Thanks to the heavy spring rain, wild flowers grew in abundance across the valley, attracting bees and butterflies.
example.zh: 多虧春天的大雨，山谷裡開滿了野花，吸引蜜蜂和蝴蝶前來。

listen.en: The café offers an abundance of cakes and pastries.
listen.zh: 這家咖啡廳提供種類豐富的蛋糕和糕點。

chinese.en: Despite the abundance of information online, it can be hard to find reliable sources.
chinese.zh: 儘管網路上資訊非常多，要找到可靠的來源卻可能並不容易。

english.en: Taiwan has an abundance of night markets and street food.
english.zh: 臺灣有非常多夜市和街頭小吃。

speak.en: In my hometown, seafood is available in abundance all year round.
speak.zh: 在我的家鄉，一年到頭都有吃不完的海鮮。

write.en: The sheer abundance of cheap clothing has encouraged people to throw items away quickly.
write.zh: 便宜衣服多到氾濫，助長了人們很快就把衣服丟掉的習慣。

example.en: Before refrigerators existed, people preserved meat and fish with salt so that the food would last through the winter.
example.zh: 在冰箱發明之前，人們用鹽醃製肉和魚，讓食物能保存過冬。

listen.en: We must preserve the forest for future generations.
listen.zh: 我們必須為後代子孫保護這片森林。

chinese.en: The teacher tried to preserve a calm atmosphere during the stressful exam week.
chinese.zh: 在壓力很大的考試週，老師努力維持平靜的氣氛。

english.en: My grandmother makes several jars of strawberry preserves every spring.
english.zh: 我奶奶每年春天都會做好幾罐草莓果醬。

speak.en: I think it's really important to preserve local languages and customs.
speak.zh: 我覺得保存在地的語言和習俗真的很重要。

write.en: Rare manuscripts are kept in dark, dry rooms to preserve them from damage.
write.zh: 珍貴的手稿被存放在陰暗乾燥的房間裡，以免受損。

example.en: When I opened the old tap, the water had a strange metallic taste, suggesting the pipes were rusting inside.
example.zh: 我打開老舊的水龍頭時，水有一股奇怪的金屬味，顯示水管內部正在生鏽。

listen.en: We heard a loud metallic sound from the kitchen.
listen.zh: 我們聽到廚房傳來一聲響亮的金屬撞擊聲。

chinese.en: The sculpture's smooth metallic surface reflects the changing colours of the evening sky.
chinese.zh: 這座雕塑光滑的金屬表面映照出傍晚天空變幻的色彩。

english.en: She wore a metallic silver dress to her cousin's wedding.
english.zh: 她穿了一件金屬銀色的洋裝參加表姊的婚禮。

speak.en: I don't really like metallic colours on cars; they look too flashy.
speak.zh: 我不太喜歡金屬色的車，看起來太花俏了。

write.en: Some metallic elements, such as copper, are excellent at conducting heat and electricity.
write.zh: 有些金屬元素，例如銅，非常善於傳導熱和電。

example.en: The company announced savage cuts to its budget, closing several offices and reducing staff training to a minimum.
example.zh: 這家公司宣布大砍預算，關閉了好幾間辦公室，員工訓練也減到最少。

listen.en: The coastal town was hit by a savage storm.
listen.zh: 這座海邊小鎮遭到猛烈暴風雨侵襲。

chinese.en: The new exam policy was savaged by teachers who said it would harm students.
chinese.zh: 新的考試政策遭到教師猛烈抨擊，他們認為這會傷害學生。

english.en: The farmers lost most of their crops in the savage winter.
english.zh: 在那個嚴酷的冬天，農民失去了大部分的作物。

speak.en: Wow, that comment was a bit savage, don't you think?
speak.zh: 哇，那個留言有點太狠了吧，你不覺得嗎？

write.en: Online critics can be savage, so new writers should learn to accept feedback calmly.
write.zh: 網路上的評論者可能非常尖酸，所以新手作家要學會平靜地接受批評。

example.en: Students who study abroad act as unofficial ambassadors for their country, shaping how people overseas see their culture.
example.zh: 出國留學的學生就像是國家的非正式大使，影響著海外人士如何看待他們的文化。

listen.en: The ambassador gave a short speech at the dinner.
listen.zh: 大使在晚宴上發表了簡短的致詞。

chinese.en: The famous athlete was chosen as a brand ambassador for the sports company.
chinese.zh: 這位知名運動員被選為這家運動用品公司的品牌代言人。

english.en: My uncle worked at the embassy before he became an ambassador.
english.zh: 我叔叔在成為大使之前，曾在大使館工作。

speak.en: I'd love to be a student ambassador and show visitors around campus.
speak.zh: 我很想當學生大使，帶訪客參觀校園。

write.en: Friendly locals are the best ambassadors for tourism, because visitors remember their kindness.
write.zh: 友善的在地人是觀光最好的代言人，因為遊客會記得他們的善意。

example.en: Instead of improving, sales went into reverse after the new model was released, as customers complained about its high price.
example.zh: 新款推出後銷量不升反降，因為顧客抱怨價格太高。

listen.en: She reversed the car slowly into the parking space.
listen.zh: 她慢慢把車倒進停車格。

chinese.en: The final results were the exact reverse of what the researchers had expected.
chinese.zh: 最後的結果和研究人員原本預期的完全相反。

english.en: The teacher read out the names in reverse alphabetical order.
english.zh: 老師按照字母順序倒過來唸出名字。

speak.en: If I could reverse one decision, I'd choose a different major.
speak.zh: 如果能撤回一個決定，我會選擇不同的科系。

write.en: Instructions for washing are printed on the reverse side of the label.
write.zh: 洗滌說明印在標籤的背面。

example.en: As people age, some mental faculties such as memory may weaken, but regular reading and exercise can slow this process.
example.zh: 隨著年齡增長，記憶力等心智能力可能衰退，但規律閱讀和運動可以減緩這個過程。

listen.en: The faculty met to discuss changes to the course.
listen.zh: 教職員開會討論課程的調整。

chinese.en: Faculty and students worked together to design the new library on campus.
chinese.zh: 教職員和學生攜手設計了校園裡的新圖書館。

english.en: The university plans to hire more faculty for its science programmes.
english.zh: 這所大學計畫為理科學程聘請更多教師。

speak.en: My grandfather is ninety, but he still has all his faculties.
speak.zh: 我爺爺九十歲了，但頭腦和身體都還很靈光。

write.en: Faculty members should receive training before teaching online courses for the first time.
write.zh: 教師在第一次教授線上課程之前，應該先接受培訓。

example.en: When reporters asked about the delays, the manager deflected the question by talking about the project's long-term benefits.
example.zh: 記者問到延誤的問題時，經理轉而談論這項計畫的長期效益，迴避了問題。

listen.en: He laughed to deflect attention from his mistake.
listen.zh: 他笑了笑，想轉移大家對他犯錯的注意。

chinese.en: Special glass on the building deflects sunlight and keeps the offices cool.
chinese.zh: 大樓上的特殊玻璃能把陽光偏折開來，讓辦公室保持涼爽。

english.en: She tried to deflect criticism by blaming the rest of her team.
english.zh: 她試圖把錯推給團隊其他成員，藉此轉移批評。

speak.en: Whenever my parents ask about my grades, I try to deflect the conversation.
speak.zh: 每次爸媽問起我的成績，我都會想辦法岔開話題。

write.en: Nothing could deflect him from his goal of finishing his first marathon.
write.zh: 沒有任何事能讓他偏離完成第一場馬拉松的目標。

example.en: Although the founders shared similar goals, their business ideologies differed so much that they eventually parted ways.
example.zh: 雖然幾位創辦人的目標相近，但他們的經營理念差異太大，最後還是分道揚鑣。

listen.en: Each ideology offers a different view of the ideal society.
listen.zh: 每一種意識形態都對理想社會有不同的看法。

chinese.en: The novel explores how a rigid ideology can shape the way ordinary people think.
chinese.zh: 這部小說探討僵化的意識形態如何影響一般人的思考方式。

english.en: Education should teach students to question any ideology they encounter.
english.zh: 教育應該教學生去質疑他們接觸到的任何意識形態。

speak.en: I think young people today are less attached to any particular ideology.
speak.zh: 我覺得現在的年輕人比較不會執著於某一種特定的意識形態。

write.en: A consumerist ideology encourages people to believe that happiness comes from buying more things.
write.zh: 消費主義的思想讓人相信，幸福來自買更多東西。

example.en: Flooding used to be an occasional occurrence here, but heavy rain now causes problems almost every summer.
example.zh: 這裡以前只是偶爾淹水，但現在幾乎每年夏天大雨都會造成災情。

listen.en: Traffic jams are a common occurrence in the morning.
listen.zh: 早上塞車是很常見的事。

chinese.en: Scientists are studying the occurrence of the disease among older adults in rural areas.
chinese.zh: 科學家正在研究這種疾病在鄉村地區年長者中的發生情形。

english.en: Being late for class is an everyday occurrence for him.
english.zh: 上課遲到對他來說是家常便飯。

speak.en: Honestly, getting lost in a new city is a pretty normal occurrence for me.
speak.zh: 老實說，在陌生的城市迷路對我來說是很正常的事。

write.en: The report links the increasing occurrence of wildfires to longer and hotter summers.
write.zh: 這份報告把野火越來越頻繁歸因於夏天變得更長、更熱。

example.en: Countries that rely heavily on petroleum exports often suffer when global oil prices fall sharply.
example.zh: 高度依賴石油出口的國家，往往會在國際油價暴跌時受到重創。

listen.en: Many everyday products, including plastic bags, are made from petroleum.
listen.zh: 許多日常用品，包括塑膠袋，都是用石油製成的。

chinese.en: The government plans to reduce its dependence on imported petroleum over the next decade.
chinese.zh: 政府計畫在未來十年內降低對進口石油的依賴。

english.en: Petroleum is still the main source of fuel for most cars.
english.zh: 石油仍然是大多數汽車的主要燃料來源。

speak.en: I guess we can't stop using petroleum overnight, but we should try.
speak.zh: 我想我們沒辦法一夕之間不用石油，但還是應該努力。

write.en: Engineers at the petroleum company are developing cleaner ways to refine crude oil.
write.zh: 這家石油公司的工程師正在研發更乾淨的原油提煉方法。

example.en: The company's careless advertisement provoked a wave of criticism online, so it was withdrawn the next day.
example.zh: 這家公司草率的廣告在網路上引起一波批評，隔天就被撤下了。

listen.en: Please don't provoke the dog while it is eating.
listen.zh: 狗在吃東西的時候請不要去招惹牠。

chinese.en: The documentary is designed to provoke discussion about how we treat the elderly.
chinese.zh: 這部紀錄片的目的是引發大家討論我們如何對待長者。

english.en: His rude comment provoked an angry reaction from the audience.
english.zh: 他無禮的發言激起觀眾憤怒的反應。

speak.en: I think good films should provoke thought rather than just entertain.
speak.zh: 我認為好電影應該引人思考，而不只是娛樂觀眾。

write.en: Sharply rising food prices have provoked widespread concern among families living on limited incomes.
write.zh: 食物價格大幅上漲，讓收入有限的家庭普遍感到憂心。

example.en: The old factory has been turned into a creative space where young designers can explore their artistic ideas freely.
example.zh: 這座老工廠被改造成創意空間，年輕設計師可以在這裡自由探索他們的藝術構想。

listen.en: My younger brother has a strong artistic talent.
listen.zh: 我弟弟很有藝術天分。

chinese.en: The director was given complete artistic freedom to change the ending of the film.
chinese.zh: 導演獲得完全的藝術自由，可以更改電影的結局。

english.en: The old city is famous for its rich artistic heritage.
english.zh: 這座古城以豐富的藝術遺產聞名。

speak.en: I'm not very artistic, but I really enjoy visiting galleries.
speak.zh: 我不太有藝術細胞，但很喜歡逛美術館。

write.en: Schools should value artistic expression as much as performance in maths and science.
write.zh: 學校應該像重視數理表現一樣重視藝術表達。

example.en: Unable to afford a tutor, the students devised their own study schedule and quizzed one another every evening.
example.zh: 請不起家教，這些學生自己擬定讀書計畫，每天晚上互相考問。

listen.en: The teacher devised a fun game to review new vocabulary.
listen.zh: 老師設計了一個有趣的遊戲來複習新單字。

chinese.en: The council must devise a better plan to reduce traffic congestion in the city centre.
chinese.zh: 市議會必須擬定更好的計畫來減少市中心的交通壅塞。

english.en: We need to devise a new strategy to attract more customers.
english.zh: 我們需要擬定新策略來吸引更多顧客。

speak.en: I usually devise my own little tricks to remember difficult words.
speak.zh: 我通常會自己想些小技巧來記難背的單字。

write.en: Researchers have devised a cheap test that can detect water pollution within minutes.
write.zh: 研究人員研發出一種便宜的檢測方法，幾分鐘內就能驗出水污染。

example.en: Children who read for pleasure are driven by intrinsic motivation, not by rewards such as stickers or extra playtime.
example.zh: 為樂趣而閱讀的孩子是受內在動機驅使，而不是為了貼紙或多一點遊戲時間之類的獎勵。

listen.en: Curiosity is an intrinsic part of human nature.
listen.zh: 好奇心是人性中固有的一部分。

chinese.en: The ring has little intrinsic value, but it means a great deal to my family.
chinese.zh: 這枚戒指本身不值什麼錢，但對我的家人意義重大。

english.en: Learning a new language has intrinsic rewards beyond simply passing exams.
english.zh: 學習新語言除了通過考試之外，本身就有收穫。

speak.en: For me, the intrinsic enjoyment of a job matters more than salary.
speak.zh: 對我來說，工作本身帶來的樂趣比薪水更重要。

write.en: Risk is intrinsic to starting a business, so careful planning is essential.
write.zh: 創業本來就伴隨風險，所以周詳的規劃非常重要。

example.en: After the stock market crash, many small investors lost their savings and had to delay retirement.
example.zh: 股市崩盤後，許多散戶賠光積蓄，只好延後退休。

listen.en: My laptop crashed before I could save my essay.
listen.zh: 我還來不及存檔，筆電就當機了。

chinese.en: Nobody was seriously injured in the crash, but traffic was blocked for hours.
chinese.zh: 這場車禍沒有人受重傷，但交通堵塞了好幾個小時。

english.en: The website crashed because too many people tried to buy tickets.
english.zh: 因為太多人上網搶票，網站當掉了。

speak.en: I was so tired that I just crashed on the sofa after work.
speak.zh: 我累到下班後直接倒在沙發上睡著了。

write.en: Some experts warn that housing prices could crash if interest rates rise too quickly.
write.zh: 有些專家警告，如果利率升得太快，房價可能會崩跌。

example.en: Without sufficient sleep, students find it harder to concentrate in class and remember what they have learned.
example.zh: 睡眠不足時，學生上課比較難專心，也比較記不住學過的內容。

listen.en: We don't have sufficient time to finish the project.
listen.zh: 我們沒有足夠的時間完成這個專案。

chinese.en: A healthy diet alone is not sufficient to prevent every type of illness.
chinese.zh: 光靠健康飲食並不足以預防所有疾病。

english.en: The hotel has sufficient space for a large wedding party.
english.zh: 這家飯店有足夠的空間舉辦大型婚宴。

speak.en: To be honest, my salary is just about sufficient to cover rent.
speak.zh: 老實說，我的薪水差不多只夠付房租。

write.en: Many rural areas still lack sufficient funding for public transport and health services.
write.zh: 許多偏鄉地區仍然缺乏足夠的經費來發展大眾運輸和醫療服務。

example.en: Once you've driven for years, changing gears becomes almost automatic, and you no longer think about it.
example.zh: 開車開了好幾年之後，換檔幾乎變成反射動作，你根本不用再去想。

listen.en: The lights are automatic and switch off at midnight.
listen.zh: 這些燈是自動的，到午夜就會關掉。

chinese.en: Members who break the rules face an automatic ban from the club for a month.
chinese.zh: 違反規定的會員會被自動禁止進入俱樂部一個月。

english.en: My phone installs automatic updates every night while I am asleep.
english.zh: 我的手機每晚會在我睡覺時自動安裝更新。

speak.en: Saying thank you is an automatic habit for most people here.
speak.zh: 對這裡大多數人來說，說謝謝是一種下意識的習慣。

write.en: Factories are replacing workers with automatic machines that can run all day.
write.zh: 工廠正用能全天運轉的自動化機器取代工人。

example.en: After the storm flooded the basement, we spent the whole weekend trying to salvage books and photographs.
example.zh: 暴風雨讓地下室淹水後，我們花了整個週末設法搶救書本和照片。

listen.en: He tried hard to salvage his friendship with her.
listen.zh: 他很努力想挽回和她的友誼。

chinese.en: The manager made a last attempt to salvage the deal before the deadline.
chinese.zh: 經理在截止期限前做了最後努力，想挽救這筆交易。

english.en: The team scored in the final minute to salvage a draw.
english.zh: 這支球隊在最後一分鐘進球，勉強逼和。

speak.en: I overslept, but I tried to salvage the day by working late.
speak.zh: 我睡過頭了，但我晚點下班，試著把這一天救回來。

write.en: The salvage operation took weeks because the wreck lay deep beneath the ocean.
write.zh: 打撈作業花了好幾週，因為沉船位於深海之下。

example.en: The Korean drama became so popular that tourists began visiting the small village where it was filmed.
example.zh: 這部韓劇紅到觀光客開始造訪當初拍攝的那個小村莊。

listen.en: My mother watches a television drama every evening.
listen.zh: 我媽媽每天晚上都看電視連續劇。

chinese.en: There was a lot of drama at the office when the new manager arrived.
chinese.zh: 新經理上任時，辦公室裡掀起了不少風波。

english.en: Drama classes can help shy children become more confident speakers.
english.zh: 戲劇課能幫助害羞的孩子更有自信地開口說話。

speak.en: I don't really watch drama series; they're too emotional for me.
speak.zh: 我不太看連續劇，對我來說太煽情了。

write.en: The rescue unfolded like a drama, with the whole town anxiously watching.
write.zh: 這場救援就像一齣戲般展開，全鎮的人都焦急地關注著。

example.en: The police officer showed her badge at the door, and the nervous shopkeeper finally let her inside.
example.zh: 警員在門口出示警徽，緊張的店主才終於讓她進來。

listen.en: Please wear your badge at all times in the office.
listen.zh: 在辦公室裡請隨時配戴識別證。

chinese.en: Volunteers at the festival wore bright yellow badges so that visitors could find them easily.
chinese.zh: 活動的志工都戴著鮮黃色的徽章，讓遊客可以輕易找到他們。

english.en: Each student received a badge after finishing the safety course.
english.zh: 每位學生在完成安全課程後都獲得一枚徽章。

speak.en: I collected badges from every city I visited as a kid.
speak.zh: 我小時候會收集每個去過的城市的徽章。

write.en: For many nurses, the uniform is a badge of pride and professional responsibility.
write.zh: 對許多護理師來說，制服是驕傲與專業責任的象徵。

example.en: Even after a long day of classes, the energetic children still wanted to run around the playground until dinner.
