example.zh: 即使上了一整天課，這些精力旺盛的孩子還是想在操場跑來跑去，直到吃晚餐。

listen.en: My grandmother is still very energetic and loves dancing.
listen.zh: 我奶奶依然精力充沛，而且很愛跳舞。

chinese.en: The company is looking for an energetic graduate who enjoys working in a team.
chinese.zh: 這家公司正在找一位有活力、喜歡團隊合作的應屆畢業生。

english.en: I always feel more energetic after eating a healthy breakfast.
english.zh: 吃了健康的早餐後，我總是覺得更有精神。

speak.en: I'm usually most energetic in the morning, so I study then.
speak.zh: 我通常早上精神最好，所以都在那時候讀書。

write.en: The city launched an energetic campaign to encourage residents to recycle more.
write.zh: 市政府積極推動宣導活動，鼓勵市民多做資源回收。

example.en: Although he was physically exhausted after the marathon, he felt mentally refreshed and proud of himself.
example.zh: 雖然跑完馬拉松後他身體疲憊不堪，心情卻很暢快，也為自己感到驕傲。

listen.en: Regular exercise helps you stay physically fit and happy.
listen.zh: 規律運動能幫助你保持身體健康和心情愉快。

chinese.en: It is physically impossible for one person to carry all these boxes alone.
chinese.zh: 一個人要獨自搬完這些箱子，實際上根本不可能。

english.en: Many office workers are not physically active enough during the week.
english.zh: 許多上班族平日的身體活動量不足。

speak.en: After moving house, I was physically and emotionally drained.
speak.zh: 搬完家之後，我身心都累壞了。

write.en: Students learn better when they are physically present in the classroom rather than online.
write.zh: 學生親自到教室上課，比線上學習效果更好。

example.en: Behind his calm exterior, the young lawyer was extremely nervous about presenting his first case.
example.zh: 這位年輕律師外表看似冷靜，其實對於第一次出庭非常緊張。

listen.en: They painted the exterior walls a soft shade of blue.
listen.zh: 他們把外牆漆成柔和的藍色。

chinese.en: The hotel's modern glass exterior hides a surprisingly traditional interior full of wooden furniture.
chinese.zh: 這家飯店有現代感的玻璃外觀，裡面卻是擺滿木製家具、出乎意料地傳統的空間。

english.en: The exterior of the car was damaged in the storm.
english.zh: 這輛車的外部在暴風雨中受損了。

speak.en: I love how the exterior of this building looks at night.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡這棟建築晚上的外觀。

write.en: City planners require all exterior lighting on new buildings to be energy efficient.
write.zh: 都市規劃單位要求新建築的所有外部照明都必須節能。

example.en: Each late assignment only lowered her grade slightly, but the cumulative impact was enough to make her fail the course.
example.zh: 每次遲交作業只讓她的成績稍微下降，但累積起來的影響足以讓她這門課被當。

listen.en: Stress can have a cumulative effect on your health.
listen.zh: 壓力會對你的健康造成累積性的影響。

chinese.en: The graph shows the cumulative number of visitors to the museum since it opened.
chinese.zh: 這張圖顯示博物館開幕以來的累計參觀人數。

english.en: Your final grade is based on cumulative scores from all assignments.
english.zh: 你的學期成績是根據所有作業的累計分數。

speak.en: Saving a little each month really adds up; the effect is cumulative.
speak.zh: 每個月存一點真的會積少成多，效果是累積的。

write.en: Scientists warn that the cumulative damage from plastic pollution may take centuries to reverse.
write.zh: 科學家警告，塑膠污染累積造成的損害可能要好幾個世紀才能恢復。

example.en: After hours of heated debate, the committee finally agreed to keep the library open on weekends.
example.zh: 經過好幾個小時的激烈辯論，委員會終於同意週末繼續開放圖書館。

listen.en: We debated where to go for our summer holiday.
listen.zh: 我們討論了暑假要去哪裡玩。

chinese.en: The issue of animal testing continues to spark debate among scientists and the public.
chinese.zh: 動物實驗的議題持續在科學家和大眾之間引發爭論。

english.en: Our class held a debate on whether to ban plastic bags.
english.zh: 我們班針對是否該禁用塑膠袋舉辦了一場辯論。

speak.en: I'm still debating whether to study abroad or work for a while.
speak.zh: 我還在考慮要出國念書，還是先工作一陣子。

write.en: Whether higher taxes on sugary drinks actually improve public health is still open to debate.
write.zh: 對含糖飲料加稅是否真的能改善大眾健康，至今仍有爭議。

example.en: The play starts as a light comedy, but it gradually turns into a serious story about loss and family.
example.zh: 這齣戲一開始是輕鬆的喜劇，後來卻漸漸變成一個關於失去與家庭的沉重故事。

listen.en: My favourite kind of film is a good comedy.
listen.zh: 我最喜歡的電影類型是好看的喜劇。

chinese.en: His stand-up comedy show mixes jokes about daily life with sharp social observations.
chinese.zh: 他的單口喜劇表演把日常生活的笑話和犀利的社會觀察結合在一起。

english.en: Watching a comedy is a great way to relieve stress.
english.zh: 看喜劇是紓解壓力的好方法。

speak.en: Honestly, I'd choose a comedy over a horror film any day.
speak.zh: 說真的，喜劇和恐怖片讓我選，我一定選喜劇。

write.en: Good comedy can help audiences discuss difficult social issues without feeling personally attacked.
write.zh: 好的喜劇能讓觀眾討論棘手的社會議題，而不會覺得自己被針對。

example.en: As the road narrows near the bridge, drivers in the left lane must merge with traffic on the right.
example.zh: 道路在橋附近變窄，左側車道的駕駛必須併入右側車流。

listen.en: The small shop merged with a much larger company.
listen.zh: 那家小店和一家大得多的公司合併了。

chinese.en: In this painting, the sky and the sea seem to merge into each other.
chinese.zh: 在這幅畫裡，天空和大海彷彿融為一體。

english.en: The school plans to merge the art and music departments.
english.zh: 學校計畫合併美術系和音樂系。

speak.en: Sometimes my work and personal life merge, which can be stressful.
speak.zh: 有時候我的工作和私生活會混在一起，讓人壓力很大。

write.en: Small villages are gradually merging into the growing city as housing spreads outward.
write.zh: 隨著住宅向外擴張，小村莊正逐漸併入不斷成長的城市。

example.en: After hackers stole millions of customer passwords, the bank apologized for the data breach and promised stronger security.
example.zh: 駭客竊取了數百萬筆客戶密碼後，銀行為資料外洩道歉，並承諾加強資安。

listen.en: Sharing the exam questions is a breach of school rules.
listen.zh: 外流考題是違反校規的行為。

chinese.en: The builder was accused of breaching the contract by finishing the house months late.
chinese.zh: 這名營造商因晚了好幾個月才完工而被控違約。

english.en: Telling other people my secret was a clear breach of trust.
english.zh: 把我的秘密告訴別人，明顯是辜負了我的信任。

speak.en: Honestly, reading someone's messages without asking feels like a breach of privacy.
speak.zh: 老實說，沒問過就偷看別人的訊息，感覺是侵犯隱私。

write.en: Heavy rain caused the river to breach its banks and flood nearby farmland.
write.zh: 大雨使河水衝破河堤，淹沒了附近的農田。

example.en: As the investigation continued, the company's carefully planned story began to unravel, revealing years of hidden losses.
example.zh: 隨著調查持續進行，這家公司精心編造的說法開始破功，多年隱瞞的虧損也隨之曝光。

listen.en: My sweater started to unravel after I washed it.
listen.zh: 我的毛衣洗過之後就開始脫線了。

chinese.en: Scientists are slowly unravelling the complex process by which the brain stores memories.
chinese.zh: 科學家正逐步揭開大腦儲存記憶的複雜過程。

english.en: Their holiday plans unravelled when the airline cancelled the flight.
english.zh: 航空公司取消航班後，他們的度假計畫就泡湯了。

speak.en: I love detective shows where the truth unravels slowly.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡真相一點一點揭曉的偵探劇。

write.en: Without honest communication, even a long and strong friendship can slowly unravel.
write.zh: 少了坦誠的溝通，即使是長久而深厚的友誼也可能慢慢瓦解。

example.en: Wealth is not evenly distributed in many countries, with a small group owning most of the land and property.
example.zh: 在許多國家，財富分配並不平均，少數人擁有大部分的土地和房產。

listen.en: The teacher distributed the test papers at the start of class.
listen.zh: 老師在上課一開始就發下考卷。

chinese.en: The local charity distributes hot food and warm blankets to homeless people every winter.
chinese.zh: 當地的慈善團體每年冬天都會發送熱食和保暖毛毯給街友。

english.en: The company distributes its products to supermarkets all across Asia.
english.zh: 這家公司把產品配送到全亞洲的超市。

speak.en: In my group, we always try to distribute the work fairly.
speak.zh: 在我們小組裡，我們總是盡量公平地分配工作。

write.en: Pine forests are widely distributed throughout the cooler northern regions of Europe.
write.zh: 松樹林廣泛分布在歐洲北部較涼爽的地區。

example.en: Instead of shouting at each other, the managers sat down calmly and resolved the conflict within an hour.
example.zh: 經理們沒有互相大吼，而是冷靜地坐下來，在一小時內化解了衝突。

listen.en: We should resolve this problem before the meeting starts.
listen.zh: 我們應該在會議開始前解決這個問題。

chinese.en: After failing the driving test, she resolved to practise every day until she passed.
chinese.zh: 駕照考試沒過之後，她下定決心每天練習，直到考過為止。

english.en: The hotel quickly resolved our complaint about the noisy room.
english.zh: 飯店很快就處理了我們對房間太吵的投訴。

speak.en: I resolved to drink less coffee this year, but it's hard.
speak.zh: 我今年下定決心少喝咖啡，但真的很難。

write.en: The difficult conditions only strengthened the climbers' resolve to reach the summit.
write.zh: 惡劣的環境反而讓登山者更堅定攻頂的決心。

example.en: When the rumour about the manager spread around the office, nobody could focus until the gossip finally died down.
example.zh: 關於經理的傳言在辦公室傳開後，大家都無心工作，直到八卦終於平息。

listen.en: Please don't believe every piece of gossip you hear.
listen.zh: 別相信你聽到的每一則八卦。

chinese.en: Celebrity gossip attracts millions of readers, even though much of it is untrue.
chinese.zh: 名人八卦吸引了數百萬名讀者，儘管其中很多內容都不是真的。

english.en: Some students spend their lunch break gossiping about their teachers.
english.zh: 有些學生午休時間都在聊老師的八卦。

speak.en: I try not to gossip because stories always get exaggerated.
speak.zh: 我盡量不說閒話，因為事情傳一傳總會被誇大。

write.en: Spreading gossip online can seriously damage a young person's reputation and mental health.
write.zh: 在網路上散播八卦，可能嚴重損害年輕人的名聲和心理健康。

example.en: Because the restaurant pays low wages and offers no training, staff turnover is high and new faces appear every month.
example.zh: 由於這家餐廳薪水低又不提供訓練，員工流動率很高，每個月都有新面孔。

listen.en: High staff turnover is costly for small businesses.
listen.zh: 員工流動率高對小型企業來說代價很大。

chinese.en: The family shop's turnover increased sharply after it began selling its products online.
chinese.zh: 這家家庭商店開始在網路上販售商品後，營業額大幅成長。

english.en: The company's turnover fell last year because of weak demand.
english.zh: 由於需求疲軟，這家公司去年的營業額下滑。

speak.en: Sadly, there's a high turnover of teachers at my old school.
speak.zh: 很可惜，我以前的學校老師流動率很高。

write.en: Flexible working hours can reduce employee turnover and improve overall job satisfaction.
write.zh: 彈性工時可以降低員工流動率，並提升整體工作滿意度。

example.en: Parents have been lobbying the city council for months to build a safe crossing near the primary school.
example.zh: 家長們好幾個月來不斷向市議會爭取，希望在小學附近設置安全的行人穿越道。

listen.en: The guests waited patiently in the hotel lobby.
listen.zh: 客人們在飯店大廳耐心等候。

chinese.en: Several environmental groups are lobbying hard for stricter rules on single-use plastic products.
chinese.zh: 幾個環保團體正積極遊說，爭取更嚴格的一次性塑膠製品規範。

english.en: Students lobbied the school to keep the library open longer.
english.zh: 學生們向學校爭取延長圖書館的開放時間。

speak.en: The lobby of my apartment building is always full of packages.
speak.zh: 我住的公寓大樓大廳總是堆滿包裹。

write.en: For decades, the powerful tobacco lobby opposed larger health warnings on cigarette packets.
write.zh: 數十年來，勢力龐大的菸草遊說團體一直反對在菸盒上印更大的健康警語。

example.en: New evidence has cast doubt on the popular belief that eating late at night always causes weight gain.
example.zh: 新的證據讓人質疑「宵夜一定會讓人變胖」這個普遍的看法。

listen.en: There is no doubt that she worked very hard.
listen.zh: 毫無疑問，她非常努力。

chinese.en: Many parents have serious doubts about letting their young children use smartphones every day.
chinese.zh: 許多家長對於讓年幼的孩子每天使用智慧型手機抱持很大的疑慮。

english.en: He began to doubt whether he had chosen the right major.
english.zh: 他開始懷疑自己是否選對了主修科系。

speak.en: Without a doubt, the best part of my trip was the food.
speak.zh: 毫無疑問，這趟旅行最棒的部分就是美食。

write.en: Never doubt your ability to learn something new, no matter how old you are.
write.zh: 不管你幾歲，都不要懷疑自己學習新事物的能力。

example.en: Because the forecast predicts strong winds all afternoon, there is a high likelihood that tonight's outdoor concert will be cancelled.
example.zh: 因為氣象預報說整個下午都會颳強風，今晚的戶外演唱會很可能會取消。

listen.en: There is little likelihood of rain this weekend.
listen.zh: 這個週末下雨的機會不大。

chinese.en: Studies show that reading to children increases the likelihood that they will enjoy books later.
chinese.zh: 研究顯示，唸書給孩子聽會讓他們日後更可能喜歡閱讀。

english.en: Wearing a helmet greatly reduces the likelihood of serious injury.
english.zh: 戴安全帽能大幅降低受重傷的可能性。

speak.en: In all likelihood, I'll stay in my hometown after graduation.
speak.zh: 我畢業後十之八九會留在家鄉。

write.en: Rising sea levels increase the likelihood of flooding in low-lying coastal cities.
write.zh: 海平面上升使地勢低窪的沿海城市更可能發生水災。

example.en: Since the rare part was no longer manufactured, the engineers had to procure it from a collector overseas.
example.zh: 由於這個稀有零件已經停產，工程師只好向海外的收藏家購得。

listen.en: The school managed to procure new computers for students.
listen.zh: 學校設法為學生添購了新電腦。

chinese.en: The charity procured fresh water and medical supplies for the flood victims.
chinese.zh: 這個慈善團體為水災災民籌措了乾淨的飲用水和醫療用品。

english.en: Our office needs to procure new chairs before next month.
english.zh: 我們辦公室需要在下個月前採購新椅子。

speak.en: It took me ages to procure tickets for that concert.
speak.zh: 我花了好久才弄到那場演唱會的票。

write.en: Governments must procure vaccines fairly so that poorer regions are not left behind.
write.zh: 各國政府必須公平地採購疫苗，才不會讓較貧窮的地區落後。

example.en: Although he was clearly talented, his arrogant attitude made his teammates reluctant to share ideas with him.
example.zh: 雖然他明顯很有才華，但他自大的態度讓隊友不太願意和他分享想法。

listen.en: She didn't mean to sound arrogant in the interview.
listen.zh: 她在面試時並不是有意要顯得傲慢。

chinese.en: It would be arrogant to assume that our way of life is the best.
chinese.zh: 認定我們的生活方式就是最好的，未免太過自大。

english.en: Some famous athletes become arrogant after winning a few titles.
english.zh: 有些知名運動員贏了幾座冠軍後就變得傲慢。

speak.en: I don't like people who act arrogant just because they're rich.
speak.zh: 我不喜歡那些只因為有錢就擺架子的人。

write.en: A confident candidate impresses interviewers, while an arrogant one usually puts them off.
write.zh: 有自信的應徵者會讓面試官留下好印象，自大的應徵者則通常讓人反感。

example.en: In an ideal world, everyone would have access to clean water, but millions still walk hours to find it.
example.zh: 在理想的世界裡，人人都能取得乾淨的水，但仍有數百萬人得走好幾個小時才找得到水。

listen.en: The weather today is ideal for a picnic.
listen.zh: 今天的天氣很適合野餐。

chinese.en: Many young volunteers are driven by the ideal of a fairer and kinder society.
chinese.zh: 許多年輕志工是懷抱著追求更公平、更友善社會的理想而投入。

english.en: She is the ideal candidate for the new teaching position.
english.zh: 她是這個新教職的理想人選。

speak.en: My ideal weekend involves sleeping late and cooking with friends.
speak.zh: 我理想的週末就是睡到自然醒，再和朋友一起下廚。

write.en: As he grew older, he struggled to live up to the ideals of his youth.
write.zh: 隨著年紀漸長，他越來越難堅守年輕時的理想。

example.en: The guard flashed his torch around the dark warehouse, searching for whoever had triggered the alarm.
example.zh: 警衛拿手電筒在漆黑的倉庫裡四處照，搜尋觸動警報的人。

listen.en: Please turn off the flash when taking photos here.
listen.zh: 在這裡拍照時請關掉閃光燈。

chinese.en: The idea came to me in a flash while I was taking a shower.
chinese.zh: 我在洗澡的時候，這個點子突然閃過腦海。

english.en: The traffic lights were flashing yellow because of a power cut.
english.zh: 因為停電，紅綠燈一直閃著黃燈。

speak.en: Honestly, my university years went by in a flash.
speak.zh: 說真的，我的大學時光一眨眼就過去了。

write.en: Heavy rain in the hills can cause dangerous flash floods in nearby towns.
write.zh: 山區的豪雨可能在附近鄉鎮引發危險的暴洪。

example.en: When the doctor explained the cost of the treatment, my father swallowed hard and asked whether there were cheaper options.
example.zh: 醫生說明治療費用時，我爸爸緊張地嚥了一下口水，問有沒有比較便宜的方案。

listen.en: My little sister cannot swallow large pills easily.
listen.zh: 我妹妹沒辦法輕易吞下大顆的藥丸。

chinese.en: He had to swallow his pride and ask his younger brother for help.
chinese.zh: 他只好放下自尊，向弟弟求助。

english.en: The news that the factory would close was hard to swallow.
english.zh: 工廠即將關閉的消息令人難以接受。

speak.en: My throat was so sore that I could barely swallow anything.
speak.zh: 我喉嚨痛到幾乎什麼都吞不下去。

write.en: Every spring, swallows return to build nests under the roof of our old farmhouse.
write.zh: 每年春天，燕子都會回到我們老農舍的屋簷下築巢。

example.en: There was a touch of irony in her voice when she thanked him for arriving only two hours late.
example.zh: 她謝謝他「只」遲到兩個小時，語氣中帶著一絲諷刺。

listen.en: Many students miss the irony in this famous poem.
listen.zh: 許多學生沒看出這首名詩中的反諷。

chinese.en: The irony of the situation was that the safety inspector broke his own leg at work.
chinese.zh: 諷刺的是，那位安全檢查員竟然在工作時摔斷了自己的腿。

english.en: The writer cleverly uses irony to criticise modern consumer culture.
english.zh: 作者巧妙地運用反諷來批評現代消費文化。

speak.en: I love films that use irony and dark humour.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡運用反諷和黑色幽默的電影。

write.en: It is a bitter irony that the poorest countries suffer most from pollution they did not cause.
write.zh: 令人感到諷刺的是，最貧窮的國家受到的污染傷害最大，污染卻不是他們造成的。

example.en: Unlike natural wool, synthetic fibres release tiny plastic particles into the water every time they are washed.
example.zh: 合成纖維和天然羊毛不同，每次洗滌都會把細小的塑膠微粒釋放到水中。

listen.en: These running shoes are made from light synthetic fabric.
listen.zh: 這雙跑鞋是用輕量的合成布料製成的。

chinese.en: Farmers are being encouraged to use fewer synthetic chemicals on their crops.
chinese.zh: 政府正鼓勵農民在作物上少用人工合成的化學藥劑。

english.en: Many sports pitches now use synthetic grass instead of real grass.
english.zh: 許多運動場現在用人工草皮取代天然草地。

speak.en: I prefer cotton shirts because synthetic ones feel too hot.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡棉質襯衫，因為合成纖維的穿起來太熱。

write.en: Scientists are developing synthetic rubber that can be recycled more easily than older types.
write.zh: 科學家正在研發一種比舊款更容易回收的合成橡膠。

example.en: Babies feel safer when their daily routine is predictable, so parents try to feed them at regular times.
example.zh: 寶寶在作息規律、可預期時會比較有安全感，所以父母會盡量定時餵奶。

listen.en: His reaction to the news was very predictable.
listen.zh: 他對這個消息的反應完全在意料之中。

chinese.en: The rise in house prices was predictable given the shortage of new homes.
chinese.zh: 考慮到新屋供給不足，房價上漲是可以預料的。

english.en: Life in a small town can feel quiet and predictable.
english.zh: 小鎮的生活可能會讓人覺得平靜又一成不變。

speak.en: I like my job because the schedule is fairly predictable.
speak.zh: 我喜歡我的工作，因為作息相當固定。

write.en: Investors prefer markets with predictable rules, so stable regulations attract foreign businesses.
write.zh: 投資人偏好規則可預期的市場，因此穩定的法規能吸引外國企業。

example.en: Before the trip, the tour guide handed out a booklet containing maps, emergency contacts and a list of local customs.
example.zh: 出發前，導遊發了一本小冊子，裡面有地圖、緊急聯絡方式和當地習俗介紹。

listen.en: You can find the timetable in the back of the booklet.
listen.zh: 時刻表在這本小冊子的最後面。

chinese.en: The museum offers a free booklet in several languages for international visitors.
chinese.zh: 博物館為外國遊客提供多種語言的免費導覽手冊。

english.en: Please read the safety booklet carefully before using the machine.
english.zh: 使用機器前，請仔細閱讀安全手冊。

speak.en: I still keep the booklet from my favourite band's concert.
speak.zh: 我到現在還留著我最愛的樂團演唱會的手冊。

write.en: The council published a booklet advising residents how to prepare for typhoons.
write.zh: 市議會出版了一本小冊子，教導居民如何做好防颱準備。

example.en: After the shop subtracted the cost of the broken vase from her deposit, she received only a small refund.
example.zh: 店家從她的押金中扣掉打破花瓶的費用後，她只拿回一小筆退款。

listen.en: Children learn to add and subtract at primary school.
listen.zh: 孩子們在小學學加法和減法。

chinese.en: When you subtract tax and insurance, the job does not pay as well as it seems.
chinese.zh: 扣掉稅金和保險後，這份工作的薪水其實沒有看起來那麼好。

english.en: Please subtract the delivery fee from the total price on this bill.
english.zh: 請把運費從這張帳單的總金額中扣掉。

speak.en: I'm terrible at maths, so I subtract numbers on my phone.
speak.zh: 我數學很差，所以都用手機算減法。

write.en: Economists subtract the effects of inflation to compare wages across different decades.
write.zh: 經濟學家會扣除通貨膨脹的影響，以比較不同年代的薪資。

example.en: As the typhoon approached, shop owners along the street pulled down their metal shutters and went home early.
example.zh: 颱風逼近時，整條街的店家都拉下鐵捲門，提早回家。

listen.en: Please close the shutters before the storm arrives.
listen.zh: 請在暴風雨來之前關上百葉窗。

chinese.en: A fast shutter speed lets you take sharp photos of moving cars.
chinese.zh: 快門速度快，就能把行進中的車子拍得很清楚。

english.en: Many small shops on this street were shuttered during the economic crisis.
english.zh: 這條街上許多小店在經濟危機期間被迫關門。

speak.en: I love the sound of rain tapping on the shutters at night.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡晚上雨滴輕敲百葉窗的聲音。

write.en: The government shuttered several coal plants to meet its new climate targets.
write.zh: 政府關閉了幾座燃煤電廠，以達成新的氣候目標。

example.en: After months of training together, the volunteers developed a strong sense of fellowship that lasted long after the project ended.
example.zh: 經過數個月的共同訓練，志工們培養出深厚的情誼，在計畫結束後仍持續許久。

listen.en: The club offers fellowship to anyone who feels lonely.
listen.zh: 這個社團為任何感到孤單的人提供陪伴與情誼。

chinese.en: The fellowship covers tuition fees and living costs for the full length of the program.
chinese.zh: 這筆獎助金涵蓋整個學程期間的學費與生活費。

english.en: He applied for a fellowship at a famous university last year.
english.zh: 他去年申請了一所知名大學的研究獎助金。

speak.en: What I loved most about the team was the fellowship, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，我最喜歡這個團隊的地方就是彼此之間的情誼。

write.en: The engineering fellowship meets monthly to share ideas and support young members entering the profession.
write.zh: 這個工程師協會每月聚會一次，交流想法並支持剛進入這一行的年輕會員。

example.en: Every day at noon, a cannon is fired from the old fort, a tradition that once helped sailors set their clocks.
example.zh: 每天中午，舊砲臺都會鳴放一響大砲，這項傳統過去曾幫助水手校正時鐘。

listen.en: The ski resort uses a snow cannon on warm days.
listen.zh: 這家滑雪場在天氣較暖的日子會使用造雪機。

chinese.en: Our new manager is a bit of a loose cannon, so nobody knows what he will say next.
chinese.zh: 我們的新經理行事有點難以預料，所以沒人知道他接下來會說什麼。

english.en: The museum displays a cannon that was found under the sea.
english.zh: 博物館展示了一座從海底找到的大砲。

speak.en: At the concert, they shot confetti from a cannon over the crowd.
speak.zh: 演唱會上，他們用噴射砲把彩色紙花噴向人群。

write.en: Firefighters aimed a water cannon at the burning warehouse to stop the flames from spreading.
write.zh: 消防員將水砲對準起火的倉庫，以防火勢蔓延。

example.en: Although he understood the problem well, he struggled to articulate his concerns during the meeting and later sent a detailed email.
example.zh: 雖然他很了解問題所在，卻在會議中難以清楚表達自己的疑慮，之後才寄了一封詳細的電子郵件。

listen.en: Children often find it hard to articulate their feelings.
listen.zh: 孩子往往很難清楚說出自己的感受。

chinese.en: The new mayor articulated a clear vision for making public transport cheaper and greener.
chinese.zh: 新任市長清楚提出讓大眾運輸更便宜、更環保的願景。

english.en: Good writers know how to articulate their opinions in simple language.
english.zh: 好的作者懂得用簡單的語言清楚表達自己的意見。

speak.en: I'm not very articulate in English yet, but I'm improving.
speak.zh: 我的英文表達還不算流利，但我正在進步。

write.en: Employers value graduates who are articulate, confident and able to work well in teams.
write.zh: 雇主重視表達能力好、有自信且善於團隊合作的畢業生。

example.en: The plan looked impressive on paper, but it had one fatal flaw: nobody had checked whether customers actually wanted the product.
example.zh: 這項計畫在紙面上看起來很亮眼，卻有一個致命缺陷：根本沒有人確認顧客是否真的想要這項產品。

listen.en: Ignoring the warning signs proved fatal for the small business.
listen.zh: 忽視警訊對這家小公司而言是致命的。

chinese.en: Doctors warn that this disease can be fatal if it is not treated early.
chinese.zh: 醫師警告，這種疾病若未及早治療，可能會致命。

english.en: Speeding is one of the main causes of fatal road accidents.
english.zh: 超速是致命交通事故的主要原因之一。

speak.en: Honestly, oversleeping on exam day would be fatal for me.
speak.zh: 老實說，考試當天睡過頭對我來說會是致命的。

write.en: Rising temperatures could deal a fatal blow to coral reefs in many tropical regions.
write.zh: 氣溫上升可能對許多熱帶地區的珊瑚礁造成致命打擊。

example.en: As the town's population grew, school enrollment rose so quickly that several classes had to be held in temporary buildings.
example.zh: 隨著鎮上人口增加，學校的就讀人數成長得非常快，有好幾個班級不得不在臨時建築裡上課。

listen.en: Online enrollment saves students a lot of time.
listen.zh: 線上註冊為學生省下許多時間。

chinese.en: The university reported a sharp drop in enrollment among international students this year.
chinese.zh: 這所大學表示，今年國際學生的註冊人數大幅下滑。

english.en: You need to pay the enrollment fee before the semester begins.
english.zh: 你需要在學期開始前繳交註冊費。

speak.en: I missed the enrollment deadline, so I had to wait another term.
speak.zh: 我錯過了報名截止日，所以只好再等一個學期。

write.en: The company offers open enrollment each autumn, when employees can change their health insurance plans.
write.zh: 公司每年秋天開放登記期，員工可以在這段期間更改健康保險方案。

example.en: Thousands of residents joined a peaceful demonstration in the city centre, calling for more cycle lanes and cleaner air.
example.zh: 數千名居民參加市中心的和平遊行，訴求增設自行車道並改善空氣品質。

listen.en: The chef's cooking demonstration was the highlight of the festival.
listen.zh: 主廚的烹飪示範是整場活動的亮點。

chinese.en: The science teacher used a simple demonstration to show how air pressure works.
chinese.zh: 自然科老師用一個簡單的示範說明氣壓如何運作。

english.en: Her speech was a clear demonstration of her leadership skills.
english.zh: 她的演講清楚展現了她的領導能力。

speak.en: I learned more from that demonstration than from the whole textbook.
speak.zh: 我從那次示範學到的，比整本課本還多。

write.en: Before launching the app, the developers held an online demonstration for potential investors.
write.zh: 在推出這款應用程式之前，開發團隊為潛在投資人舉辦了一場線上展示會。

example.en: Divers spent weeks exploring the wreck of the cargo ship, which had sunk in a storm more than a century ago.
example.zh: 潛水員花了好幾週探勘那艘貨船的殘骸，這艘船在一個多世紀前因暴風雨沉沒。

listen.en: I was a nervous wreck before my job interview.
listen.zh: 面試前我緊張到快崩潰了。

chinese.en: A single bad review online can wreck the reputation of a small restaurant.
chinese.zh: 網路上只要一則負評，就可能毀掉一家小餐廳的名聲。

english.en: Staying up late every night can slowly wreck your health.
english.zh: 每天熬夜會慢慢搞壞你的身體。

speak.en: My brother wrecked my laptop by spilling coffee on it.
speak.zh: 我弟弟把咖啡灑在我的筆電上，把它弄壞了。

write.en: Overfishing has wrecked the local economy, leaving many coastal villages without steady jobs.
write.zh: 過度捕撈重創了當地經濟，使許多沿海村落失去穩定的工作機會。

example.en: Instead of judging success only by profit, the charity tracks several metrics, such as volunteer hours and community feedback.
example.zh: 這個慈善機構不只以收益評斷成效，而是追蹤多項指標，例如志工服務時數與社區回饋。

listen.en: Customer satisfaction is a key metric for every hotel.
listen.zh: 顧客滿意度是每家飯店的重要指標。

chinese.en: Test scores alone are not a reliable metric of how much students have learned.
chinese.zh: 光看考試成績，並不能可靠地衡量學生學到了多少。

english.en: This recipe only uses metric measurements like grams and milliliters.
english.zh: 這份食譜只使用公克、毫升這類公制單位。

speak.en: Honestly, I can never convert metric units into feet and inches.
speak.zh: 老實說，我永遠搞不懂怎麼把公制單位換算成英尺和英寸。

write.en: Governments increasingly use well-being as a metric of progress, rather than economic growth alone.
write.zh: 越來越多政府將國民幸福感作為衡量進步的指標，而不只看經濟成長。

example.en: In the digital age, people expect to pay bills, book tickets and contact their bank from a smartphone at any time.
example.zh: 在數位時代，人們期待隨時都能用智慧型手機繳費、訂票和聯絡銀行。

listen.en: Our library has moved most of its archives to digital format.
listen.zh: 我們的圖書館已將大部分館藏檔案轉為數位格式。

chinese.en: The digital divide means that some older people cannot access important online services.
chinese.zh: 數位落差意味著有些長者無法使用重要的線上服務。

english.en: My grandfather finally learned to use a digital camera last year.
english.zh: 我爺爺去年終於學會用數位相機。

speak.en: I prefer digital textbooks because they're much lighter to carry.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡電子課本，因為帶起來輕很多。

write.en: Small family shops had to go digital during the pandemic in order to survive.
write.zh: 疫情期間，小型家庭商店必須轉型數位化才能生存。

example.en: As the drought continued through the summer, the village's water supply dwindled until residents had to rely on deliveries by truck.
example.zh: 乾旱持續了整個夏天，村裡的供水日益減少，最後居民只能仰賴卡車送水。

listen.en: Our savings slowly dwindled while we were travelling abroad.
listen.zh: 我們在國外旅行時，存款一點一點地減少。

chinese.en: The once lively fishing town has dwindled to just a few quiet streets.
chinese.zh: 這個曾經熱鬧的漁港小鎮，如今萎縮到只剩幾條安靜的街道。

english.en: Interest in the club dwindled after the popular coach left.
english.zh: 那位受歡迎的教練離開後，大家對這個社團的興趣逐漸減退。

speak.en: My motivation tends to dwindle when the weather gets really cold.
speak.zh: 天氣變得很冷的時候，我的動力就會慢慢減弱。

write.en: Dwindling populations of wild bees could seriously affect food production around the world.
write.zh: 野生蜜蜂數量不斷減少，可能嚴重影響全球的糧食生產。

example.en: Ancient kings often claimed a divine right to rule, which meant that ordinary people were not supposed to question their decisions.
example.zh: 古代君王常聲稱自己的統治權是神所授予的，這表示一般百姓不應質疑他們的決定。

listen.en: This chocolate cake you baked tastes absolutely divine.
listen.zh: 你烤的這個巧克力蛋糕真是好吃極了。

chinese.en: Many ancient temples were built in places believed to have divine protection.
chinese.zh: 許多古老的廟宇都建在人們相信受到神明庇佑的地方。

english.en: Finding a parking space downtown on Saturday felt like divine intervention.
english.zh: 星期六在市中心找到停車位，簡直像有神明相助。

speak.en: The view from the mountain at sunrise was simply divine.
speak.zh: 從山上看日出的景色簡直美極了。

write.en: Some art historians describe the painting's soft golden light as almost divine in its beauty.
write.zh: 有些藝術史學家形容這幅畫柔和的金色光線美得近乎神聖。

example.en: Because the town lacked the technical expertise to repair the old bridge, engineers were invited from the capital to assess the damage.
example.zh: 由於鎮上缺乏修復那座老橋的技術專業，於是從首都請來工程師評估損壞情況。

listen.en: Gardening is not really my area of expertise.
listen.zh: 園藝其實不是我擅長的領域。

chinese.en: Retired teachers can share their expertise by tutoring children in local community centres.
chinese.zh: 退休教師可以在地方社區中心輔導孩子，分享他們的專業。

english.en: We need someone with expertise in marketing to join our team.
english.zh: 我們需要一位具備行銷專業的人加入團隊。

speak.en: My uncle's expertise with cars saved us a lot of money.
speak.zh: 我叔叔對汽車很在行，幫我們省了不少錢。

write.en: Governments should rely on scientific expertise when making decisions about public health.
write.zh: 政府在制定公共衛生決策時，應該依據科學專業意見。

example.en: The school replaced its old lights with LED bulbs, thereby cutting its electricity bill and setting a good example for students.
example.zh: 學校把舊燈換成 LED 燈泡，因此降低了電費，也為學生樹立了良好的榜樣。

listen.en: She trained daily, thereby improving her speed and strength.
listen.zh: 她每天訓練，藉此提升了速度和力量。

chinese.en: Online courses let people study from home, thereby making education more accessible.
chinese.zh: 線上課程讓人們可以在家學習，因而使教育更容易取得。

english.en: He signed the contract and thereby agreed to all the terms.
english.zh: 他簽了合約，也就等於同意了所有條款。

speak.en: I cook at home most nights, thereby saving quite a bit of money.
speak.zh: 我大多數晚上都在家煮飯，因此省下不少錢。

write.en: Planting trees along rivers prevents soil erosion, thereby protecting farmland from floods.
write.zh: 沿著河岸種樹可以防止土壤流失，從而保護農地免受洪水侵襲。

example.en: Even elite athletes need time to recover, and coaches now pay close attention to sleep as well as physical training.
example.zh: 即使是頂尖運動員也需要時間恢復，因此教練現在除了體能訓練，也十分重視睡眠。

listen.en: The young athlete broke the national record yesterday.
listen.zh: 那位年輕運動員昨天打破了全國紀錄。

chinese.en: Many former athletes become coaches so they can pass on their experience to younger players.
chinese.zh: 許多退役運動員會轉任教練，把自己的經驗傳承給年輕選手。

english.en: As a student athlete, she had to balance training and homework.
english.zh: 身為學生運動員，她必須在訓練和功課之間取得平衡。

speak.en: I'm not much of an athlete, but I enjoy hiking.
speak.zh: 我稱不上很會運動，但我喜歡健行。

write.en: Top athletes can inspire children to exercise more, so governments should fund sports programmes in schools.
write.zh: 頂尖運動員能激勵孩子多運動，因此政府應該資助校園運動計畫。

example.en: Some drivers continued to park on the pavement in open defiance of the new law, so the council introduced heavier fines.
example.zh: 有些駕駛公然違反新法，繼續把車停在人行道上，因此市議會祭出更重的罰款。

listen.en: The child folded her arms in silent defiance.
listen.zh: 那個孩子雙手抱胸，默默地表示反抗。

chinese.en: The small café stayed open in defiance of the storm warnings, serving tea to stranded travellers.
chinese.zh: 那家小咖啡館不顧暴風雨警報照常營業，為受困的旅客提供熱茶。

english.en: His refusal to wear the uniform was an act of defiance.
english.zh: 他拒絕穿制服是一種反抗的舉動。

speak.en: Honestly, my teenage defiance drove my parents crazy for years.
speak.zh: 老實說，我青春期的叛逆讓我爸媽頭痛了好幾年。

write.en: In defiance of all expectations, the tiny startup grew into one of the country's leading tech firms.
write.zh: 這家小小的新創公司出乎所有人的預料，成長為國內頂尖的科技公司之一。

example.en: The earthquake's magnitude was high enough to be felt hundreds of kilometres away, yet damage near the coast was surprisingly limited.
example.zh: 這次地震的規模大到數百公里外都感覺得到，但沿海地區的災情卻出乎意料地輕微。

listen.en: We were shocked by the magnitude of the price increase.
listen.zh: 漲價的幅度讓我們大吃一驚。

chinese.en: A project of this magnitude needs careful planning and support from several departments.
chinese.zh: 如此大規模的計畫需要周詳的規劃，以及多個部門的支援。

english.en: Few people realise the magnitude of the plastic problem in our oceans.
english.zh: 很少人了解海洋塑膠問題有多嚴重。

speak.en: Honestly, the magnitude of my student debt still scares me.
speak.zh: 老實說，我的學貸金額之大，到現在還是讓我很害怕。

write.en: Climate scientists warn that future losses could be an order of magnitude greater than current estimates.
write.zh: 氣候科學家警告，未來的損失可能比目前的估計高出一個數量級。

example.en: The fan was ejected from the stadium after throwing a bottle onto the pitch, and the club banned him for the season.
example.zh: 那名球迷把瓶子丟進球場後被逐出體育場，球隊也禁止他在本季入場。

listen.en: The machine ejected my card before I could finish.
listen.zh: 我還沒操作完，機器就把我的卡退出來了。

chinese.en: The volcano ejected ash high into the sky, forcing several airports to cancel flights.
chinese.zh: 火山將火山灰噴向高空，迫使多座機場取消航班。

english.en: The pilot ejected safely just before the plane crashed into the sea.
english.zh: 飛行員在飛機墜海前一刻安全彈射逃生。

speak.en: My old DVD player won't eject the disc anymore, which is annoying.
speak.zh: 我那台舊 DVD 播放器再也退不出光碟了，真的很煩。

write.en: The theater manager ejected two guests who kept filming the performance on their phones.
write.zh: 劇院經理把兩名一直用手機錄影表演的觀眾請了出去。

example.en: To keep the experiment fair, every participant had to adhere to the same diet for a month, with no snacks allowed.
example.zh: 為了確保實驗公平，每位受試者都必須遵循相同的飲食一個月，不能吃任何零食。

listen.en: This tape adheres well even to wet surfaces.
listen.zh: 這種膠帶即使貼在潮濕的表面上也黏得很牢。

chinese.en: Despite pressure from investors, the founder adhered to her belief in fair wages.
chinese.zh: 儘管面臨投資人的壓力，創辦人仍堅持她對合理薪資的信念。

english.en: Students should adhere to the word limit when writing essays.
english.zh: 學生寫作文時應遵守字數限制。

speak.en: I try to adhere to a strict budget, but it's tough.
speak.zh: 我盡量嚴格遵守預算，但真的很難。

write.en: Countries that adhere to international climate agreements often invest heavily in renewable energy.
write.zh: 遵守國際氣候協定的國家，往往會大量投資再生能源。

example.en: Enrolment figures for engineering courses have climbed steadily, partly because graduates in this field find well-paid jobs more easily.
example.zh: 工程相關科系的註冊人數穩定攀升，部分原因是這個領域的畢業生較容易找到高薪工作。

listen.en: Late enrolment is possible, but you will pay extra.
listen.zh: 可以延後註冊，但需要額外付費。

chinese.en: The government hopes free meals will boost enrolment in rural primary schools.
chinese.zh: 政府希望藉由提供免費餐點，提高偏鄉國小的就學人數。

english.en: My enrolment at the language centre was confirmed by email.
english.zh: 我在語言中心的報名已透過電子郵件確認。

speak.en: Enrolment at my gym always jumps right after New Year.
speak.zh: 我常去的健身房，每到新年過後加入的人數總是暴增。

write.en: Falling birth rates have led to lower enrolment, forcing some small schools to merge or close.
write.zh: 出生率下降導致就學人數減少，迫使一些小型學校合併或關閉。

example.en: When the only bridge into the village collapsed, the residents were effectively cut off from the rest of the region for weeks.
example.zh: 通往村子唯一的橋倒塌後，村民實際上與外界隔絕了好幾週。

listen.en: This cream effectively protects your skin from the sun.
listen.zh: 這款乳霜能有效保護你的皮膚不被曬傷。

chinese.en: The new fee effectively means that poorer families cannot afford after-school classes.
chinese.zh: 新的收費實際上意味著較貧困的家庭負擔不起課後課程。

english.en: You need to manage your time effectively during the exam.
english.zh: 考試時你需要有效地管理時間。

speak.en: I study more effectively in the morning than late at night.
speak.zh: 我早上讀書比深夜讀書更有效率。

write.en: Recycling programmes only work effectively when local residents understand how to sort their waste.
write.zh: 只有當地居民懂得如何做垃圾分類，回收計畫才能有效運作。

example.en: Because people are living longer, many governments worry that the state pension system will not have enough money in the future.
example.zh: 由於人們越來越長壽，許多國家的政府擔心公共年金制度未來會沒有足夠的資金。

listen.en: My father started receiving his pension last spring.
listen.zh: 我爸爸從去年春天開始領退休金。

chinese.en: Experts advise young workers to join a pension plan as early as possible.
chinese.zh: 專家建議年輕上班族盡早加入退休金計畫。

english.en: The company pays into its employees' pension fund every month.
english.zh: 公司每個月都會為員工提撥退休基金。

speak.en: Honestly, I haven't thought much about my pension yet.
speak.zh: 老實說，我還沒怎麼想過自己的退休金。

write.en: Raising the pension age may ease financial pressure, but it is unpopular with older workers.
write.zh: 延後請領退休金的年齡或許能減輕財政壓力，但較年長的勞工並不歡迎這項做法。

example.en: While orthodox economists believed that lower taxes would boost growth, a new group of researchers argued that public investment mattered more.
example.zh: 正統派經濟學家認為減稅能促進經濟成長，但一批新的研究人員主張公共投資更為重要。

listen.en: Her teaching style is far from orthodox, but students love it.
listen.zh: 她的教學風格一點也不傳統，但學生都很喜歡。

chinese.en: Some patients combine orthodox medicine with acupuncture to manage their long-term pain.
chinese.zh: 有些病患會結合正統西醫與針灸來控制長期疼痛。

english.en: The museum chose a less orthodox way to display its art.
english.zh: 這間博物館選擇用比較不傳統的方式展示館藏藝術品。

speak.en: I'm pretty orthodox about breakfast, so it's usually toast and coffee.
speak.zh: 我吃早餐很傳統，通常就是吐司配咖啡。

write.en: Questioning orthodox ideas is how science moves forward, even when the new theories seem strange.
write.zh: 質疑主流觀念正是科學進步的方式，即使新理論看起來很奇怪也一樣。

example.en: Thousands lined the streets to watch the Olympic torch pass through the city on its long journey to the stadium.
example.zh: 數千人夾道觀看奧運聖火在前往主場館的漫長旅程中經過市區。

listen.en: Shine the torch over here so I can see.
listen.zh: 把手電筒照過來這邊，我才看得到。

chinese.en: The founder is ready to pass the torch to a younger generation of leaders.
chinese.zh: 創辦人已準備好把棒子交給年輕一代的領導者。

english.en: We used a torch to find our way back to the tent.
english.zh: 我們用手電筒找路回到帳篷。

speak.en: My phone's torch is really handy when I lose my keys.
speak.zh: 我掉鑰匙的時候，手機的手電筒功能真的很好用。

write.en: In ancient times, travellers carried burning torches to light their way through dark forests.
write.zh: 在古代，旅人會手持燃燒的火把，照亮穿越漆黑森林的道路。

example.en: Researchers found that people who feel anxious or powerless are more likely to believe in conspiracy theories about governments.
example.zh: 研究人員發現，感到焦慮或無力的人比較容易相信與政府有關的陰謀論。

listen.en: Don't share that video; it's just another conspiracy theory.
listen.zh: 別分享那支影片，那不過又是一個陰謀論。

chinese.en: There seemed to be a conspiracy of silence about the problems in the factory.
chinese.zh: 對於工廠裡的問題，大家似乎都心照不宣地保持沉默。

english.en: The detective soon realized that the robbery was part of a larger conspiracy.
english.zh: 偵探很快就發現，這起搶案是一個更大陰謀的一部分。

speak.en: Sometimes it feels like there's a conspiracy to make me late for work.
speak.zh: 有時候我覺得好像全世界都在密謀讓我上班遲到。

write.en: Schools should teach students how to check sources, so they are less easily fooled by conspiracy theories.
write.zh: 學校應該教學生如何查證資料來源，讓他們比較不容易被陰謀論矇騙。

example.en: To make the pancakes, whisk the eggs, milk and flour into a smooth batter, then let it rest for a while.
example.zh: 做鬆餅時，先把蛋、牛奶和麵粉攪拌成滑順的麵糊，再靜置一段時間。

listen.en: This old suitcase has been battered by years of travel.
listen.zh: 這只舊行李箱經過多年旅行，已經被摔得傷痕累累。

chinese.en: Local businesses have been battered by rising rents and the loss of tourists.
chinese.zh: 房租上漲加上觀光客流失，讓在地商家受到重創。

english.en: My grandmother always fries the fish in a light, crispy batter.
english.zh: 我奶奶總是把魚裹上一層薄薄的酥脆麵糊下去炸。

speak.en: The rain was battering the windows, so we stayed in all day.
speak.zh: 雨猛烈地打在窗戶上，所以我們整天都待在家裡。

write.en: Young batters should learn to stay calm and focused when facing fast pitchers.
write.zh: 年輕的打擊手應該學會在面對快速球投手時保持冷靜與專注。

example.en: Critics called the huge new stadium a vanity project, arguing that the money should have been spent on hospitals and schools instead.
example.zh: 批評者稱這座巨大的新體育場是面子工程，認為這筆錢應該用在醫院和學校上。

listen.en: Her refusal to wear glasses was simple vanity.
listen.zh: 她不肯戴眼鏡，純粹是愛面子。

chinese.en: Social media can feed our vanity by rewarding us with likes and comments.
chinese.zh: 社群媒體用按讚和留言作為獎勵，可能助長我們的虛榮心。

english.en: Losing the competition wounded his vanity more than anything else.
english.zh: 輸掉比賽最傷到的是他的面子。

speak.en: I'll admit it, a bit of vanity made me buy these shoes.
speak.zh: 我承認，我買這雙鞋有一點是出於虛榮心。

write.en: Ancient poets often wrote about the vanity of chasing wealth and fame.
write.zh: 古代詩人常寫到追逐名利終究是一場空。

example.en: The artist mixed sand into the paint, giving the canvas a rough texture that visitors were invited to touch.
example.zh: 這位藝術家在顏料中摻入沙子，讓畫布呈現粗糙的質地，並邀請參觀者動手觸摸。

listen.en: I love the soft texture of this wool scarf.
listen.zh: 我很喜歡這條羊毛圍巾柔軟的觸感。

chinese.en: Some people dislike eggplant not because of its taste but because of its texture.
chinese.zh: 有些人不喜歡茄子，不是因為味道，而是因為口感。

english.en: Heavy rain changed the texture of the soil in the garden.
english.zh: 大雨改變了花園裡土壤的質地。

speak.en: For me, the chewy texture is what makes bubble tea special.
speak.zh: 對我來說，有嚼勁的口感正是珍珠奶茶特別的地方。

write.en: Small local shops and street markets add texture and character to a city's daily life.
write.zh: 在地小店和街頭市集為城市的日常生活增添了層次與特色。

example.en: After studying the forest's ecology for years, the researchers discovered how fungi help trees share nutrients through their roots.
example.zh: 研究人員多年研究這片森林的生態後，發現真菌如何幫助樹木透過根部分享養分。

listen.en: My sister is studying marine ecology at university.
listen.zh: 我姊姊在大學主修海洋生態學。

chinese.en: Introducing a foreign species can upset the delicate ecology of an island.
chinese.zh: 引進外來物種可能會破壞島嶼脆弱的生態。

english.en: The school trip taught us a lot about the ecology of rivers.
english.zh: 那次校外教學讓我們學到很多河川生態的知識。

speak.en: Honestly, I never cared about ecology until I went diving.
speak.zh: 老實說，在去潛水之前，我從來沒關心過生態。

write.en: Urban planners should consider local ecology when designing parks, not just appearance and cost.
write.zh: 都市規劃者設計公園時，除了外觀與成本，也應該考量當地生態。

example.en: Surrounded by busy roads and tall office towers, the rooftop garden is an oasis of calm where workers eat lunch in peace.
example.zh: 這座屋頂花園被繁忙的道路和高聳的辦公大樓包圍，是一處寧靜的綠洲，上班族可以在這裡安靜地吃午餐。

listen.en: This quiet café is my little oasis after work.
listen.zh: 這間安靜的咖啡館是我下班後的小天地。

chinese.en: Palm trees and fresh water made the oasis an important stop for ancient traders.
chinese.zh: 棕櫚樹和淡水使這片綠洲成為古代商人的重要中繼站。

english.en: The city plans to turn the old car park into a green oasis.
english.zh: 市政府計畫把舊停車場改造成一片都市綠洲。

speak.en: Visiting my grandparents' farm feels like finding an oasis, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，去爺爺奶奶的農場就像找到了一片綠洲。

write.en: As desert oases dry up because of climate change, many nomadic families are forced to move to cities.
write.zh: 隨著沙漠綠洲因氣候變遷而乾涸，許多遊牧家庭被迫遷往城市。

example.en: The restaurant is famous for its generous portions, so most customers end up taking half their meal home.
example.zh: 這家餐廳以份量十足聞名，所以大多數客人最後都會把一半的餐點打包回家。

listen.en: My grandfather is always generous with his time.
listen.zh: 我爺爺總是很願意花時間陪別人。

chinese.en: Thanks to a generous donation, the library can now stay open on weekends.
chinese.zh: 多虧一筆慷慨的捐款，圖書館現在週末也能開放了。

english.en: The company offers generous holiday pay and flexible hours to its staff.
english.zh: 這家公司給員工優渥的有薪假和彈性工時。

speak.en: My roommate is really generous and always shares her snacks with me.
speak.zh: 我室友真的很大方，總是會分零食給我。

write.en: Wealthy countries should be more generous in helping poorer nations adapt to climate change.
write.zh: 富裕國家應該更慷慨地幫助較貧窮的國家因應氣候變遷。

example.en: It took the exchange students several weeks to adjust to the cold weather and the unfamiliar food in their new city.
example.zh: 交換學生花了好幾週才適應新城市寒冷的天氣和陌生的食物。

listen.en: Please adjust the volume before the meeting starts.
listen.zh: 請在會議開始前調整音量。

chinese.en: Prices are adjusted every month to reflect changes in the cost of fuel.
chinese.zh: 價格每個月都會調整，以反映燃料成本的變動。

english.en: My eyes slowly adjusted to the darkness of the room.
english.zh: 我的眼睛慢慢適應了房間裡的黑暗。

speak.en: I'm still adjusting to working from home, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我還在適應在家工作。

write.en: Older workers may need extra training to adjust to new technology in the workplace.
write.zh: 年長員工可能需要額外的訓練，才能適應職場上的新科技。

example.en: The team was handicapped by injuries all season, yet it still managed to reach the final through hard work and smart tactics.
example.zh: 這支球隊整季飽受傷兵所苦，但仍靠著努力和聰明的戰術打進決賽。

listen.en: My uncle has a very low golf handicap.
listen.zh: 我叔叔的高爾夫差點非常低。

chinese.en: High taxes on imported parts handicap small manufacturers that compete with larger firms.
chinese.zh: 進口零件的高額稅負，讓與大企業競爭的小型製造商處於不利地位。

english.en: Being shy was a handicap for him at first, but he overcame it.
english.zh: 個性害羞起初對他是個阻礙，但他後來克服了。

speak.en: Honestly, my poor sense of direction is a real handicap when travelling.
speak.zh: 老實說，我方向感很差，旅行時真的很吃虧。

write.en: Students without quiet places to study at home are handicapped compared with their classmates.
write.zh: 家中沒有安靜讀書空間的學生，和同學相比處於劣勢。

example.en: Before the new medicine reaches the market, several safeguards are in place to check that it is both safe and effective.
example.zh: 新藥上市前，有多道把關措施確保它既安全又有效。

listen.en: Regular backups safeguard your files against sudden loss.
listen.zh: 定期備份可以保護你的檔案，避免突然遺失。

chinese.en: The union's main job is to safeguard the interests of factory workers.
chinese.zh: 工會的主要任務是保障工廠勞工的權益。

english.en: We installed a smoke alarm as a safeguard against fire.
english.zh: 我們裝了煙霧警報器，作為防範火災的措施。

speak.en: I always keep some savings to safeguard myself against emergencies.
speak.zh: 我總是會存一些錢，以防緊急狀況。

write.en: Creating marine reserves is one of the best ways to safeguard fish populations for future generations.
write.zh: 設立海洋保護區是為後代保護魚群數量的最佳方法之一。

example.en: In the experiment, adding a small amount of catalyst made the reaction happen much faster without the catalyst itself being used up.
example.zh: 實驗中加入少量催化劑後，反應速度大幅加快，而催化劑本身並未被消耗掉。

listen.en: Losing my job was the catalyst for starting my own business.
listen.zh: 失業反而成為我自己創業的契機。

chinese.en: The documentary served as a catalyst for public debate about plastic waste.
chinese.zh: 這部紀錄片引發了社會大眾對塑膠垃圾的討論。

english.en: A good teacher can be a catalyst for a student's success.
english.zh: 好老師可以成為促成學生成功的關鍵。

speak.en: Honestly, coffee is the catalyst that gets my brain working every morning.
speak.zh: 老實說，咖啡就是每天早上啟動我大腦的催化劑。

write.en: Car exhaust systems use metal catalysts to turn harmful gases into less dangerous ones.
write.zh: 汽車排氣系統利用金屬催化劑，把有害氣體轉化成危害較小的氣體。

example.en: Standing at the edge of the canyon, the hikers were amazed by its immense size and the red colours of the rock.
example.zh: 站在峽谷邊緣，登山客對它遼闊的規模和岩石的紅色調驚嘆不已。

listen.en: Reading to my children gives me immense pleasure.
listen.zh: 唸書給孩子聽帶給我極大的快樂。

chinese.en: Old family photos have immense value, even if they are worth nothing to anyone else.
chinese.zh: 老舊的家庭照片具有極大的價值，即使它們對別人來說一文不值。

english.en: The internet has had an immense impact on how we learn.
english.zh: 網路對我們的學習方式產生了極大的影響。

speak.en: There's an immense amount of homework this term, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，這學期的作業量多得驚人。

write.en: Renewable energy has immense potential to create jobs in regions that once depended on coal.
write.zh: 再生能源在過去仰賴煤礦的地區，具有創造就業機會的巨大潛力。

example.en: The hotel staff were so attentive that they remembered our names and brought extra pillows before we even asked.
example.zh: 飯店員工非常周到，不但記得我們的名字，甚至在我們開口之前就送來額外的枕頭。

listen.en: A good doctor is attentive to every patient's concerns.
listen.zh: 好醫師會留意每位病人關心的問題。

chinese.en: Attentive drivers notice small changes on the road and react before accidents happen.
chinese.zh: 專注的駕駛會留意路上的細微變化，在事故發生前就做出反應。

english.en: My grandmother is very attentive to the needs of her neighbours.
english.zh: 我奶奶對鄰居的需要非常細心周到。

speak.en: I try to be an attentive listener when my friends are upset.
speak.zh: 朋友心情不好的時候，我會盡量當個專心的傾聽者。

write.en: Parents who are attentive to their children's online habits can spot problems such as cyberbullying early.
write.zh: 留意孩子上網習慣的家長，能及早發現網路霸凌等問題。

example.en: Applicants who do not fulfil the language requirements may be offered a place on a preparation course before starting their degree.
example.zh: 未達語言門檻的申請者，可能會先被安排參加預備課程，再開始攻讀學位。

listen.en: He always fulfils his promises, no matter how busy he is.
listen.zh: 不管多忙，他總是會信守承諾。

chinese.en: Many young people want a job that fulfils them, not just one that pays well.
chinese.zh: 許多年輕人想要一份能讓自己有成就感的工作，而不只是薪水高的工作。

english.en: The new library fulfils an important role in our community.
english.zh: 新圖書館在我們的社區中扮演重要的角色。

speak.en: I feel I haven't fulfilled my potential yet, so I keep learning.
speak.zh: 我覺得自己還沒有完全發揮潛力，所以我持續學習。

write.en: Governments must fulfil their duty to provide clean water and basic healthcare for every citizen.
write.zh: 政府必須履行為每位國民提供乾淨用水和基本醫療的責任。

example.en: We bought the young trees for our garden from a local nursery, where the staff explained how much sunlight each plant needs.
example.zh: 我們花園裡的小樹苗是在附近的苗圃買的，那裡的員工還說明了每種植物需要多少日照。

listen.en: The children sang a nursery rhyme before lunch.
listen.zh: 孩子們在午餐前唱了一首童謠。

chinese.en: The parents painted the nursery a soft yellow before the baby was born.
chinese.zh: 寶寶出生前，爸媽把育嬰室漆成了柔和的黃色。

english.en: Nursery teachers need a lot of patience and energy every day.
english.zh: 幼兒園老師每天都需要很多耐心和體力。

speak.en: Finding an affordable nursery near our flat was really stressful.
speak.zh: 要在我們公寓附近找到一家負擔得起的托兒所，真的很有壓力。

write.en: Free nursery places would make it easier for young parents to return to work.
write.zh: 提供免費托兒名額，能讓年輕父母更容易重返職場。

example.en: Cycling to work saves money on fuel; furthermore, it improves fitness and reduces the stress of sitting in traffic every morning.
example.zh: 騎腳踏車上班可以省下油錢；此外，還能增進體能，並減少每天早上塞車的壓力。

listen.en: The hotel was clean and, furthermore, the staff were friendly.
listen.zh: 這家飯店很乾淨，而且員工也很友善。

chinese.en: The new policy is expensive. Furthermore, there is little evidence that it will work.
chinese.zh: 新政策成本高昂，此外，也幾乎沒有證據顯示它會有效。

english.en: This laptop is light. Furthermore, its battery lasts all day.
english.zh: 這台筆電很輕，而且電池可以撐一整天。

speak.en: I love living here, and furthermore, the food is amazing.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡住在這裡，而且這裡的食物超棒。

write.en: Learning a foreign language improves memory. Furthermore, it can open doors to international careers.
write.zh: 學習外語能增強記憶力，此外，還能為進入國際職場開啟大門。

example.en: The wetland reserve provides a safe haven for migrating birds, which stop there to rest and feed before continuing their journey south.
example.zh: 這座濕地保護區為遷徙的候鳥提供安全的棲息地，牠們會在此休息覓食，再繼續南飛。

listen.en: Our garden is a little haven of peace and quiet.
listen.zh: 我們的花園是一處寧靜的小天地。

chinese.en: Some small islands became tax havens, attracting companies that wanted to pay less tax.
chinese.zh: 有些小島成為避稅天堂，吸引想要少繳稅的公司前往。

english.en: During the storm, the harbour was a safe haven for fishing boats.
english.zh: 暴風雨期間，港口是漁船安全的避風港。

speak.en: My grandma's house was always my haven when school got stressful.
speak.zh: 每當學校壓力大的時候，奶奶家一直是我的避風港。

write.en: During economic uncertainty, many investors see gold as a safe haven for their savings.
write.zh: 經濟情勢不明朗時，許多投資人把黃金視為存放積蓄的避風港。

example.en: Because the drought destroyed most of the grass, farmers had to sell their livestock at very low prices.
example.zh: 由於乾旱毀了大部分的草，農民只好以極低的價格賣掉牲畜。

listen.en: The livestock were moved to higher ground before the flood.
listen.zh: 洪水來臨前，牲畜被移到了地勢較高的地方。

chinese.en: Livestock farming produces a large share of the greenhouse gases linked to climate change.
chinese.zh: 在與氣候變遷有關的溫室氣體中，有很大一部分來自畜牧業。

english.en: My grandparents kept livestock on their farm when I was young.
english.zh: 我小時候，祖父母在農場上養牲畜。

speak.en: I've never really been around livestock, since I grew up in the city.
speak.zh: 我在都市長大，所以其實從來沒怎麼接觸過牲畜。

write.en: The government offers subsidies to help farmers protect their livestock from disease.
write.zh: 政府提供補助，幫助農民保護牲畜免於疾病。

example.en: According to diplomatic protocol, the visiting president was greeted at the airport by the foreign minister.
example.zh: 依照外交禮節，來訪的總統在機場由外交部長親自迎接。

listen.en: The nurse explained the hospital protocol for visitors.
listen.zh: 護理師說明了醫院的訪客規定。

chinese.en: Over a hundred countries signed the protocol, agreeing to cut harmful emissions.
chinese.zh: 一百多個國家簽署了這項議定書，同意減少有害的排放。

english.en: Our school has a clear protocol for dealing with emergencies.
english.zh: 我們學校有一套處理緊急狀況的明確規範。

speak.en: Honestly, I think some office protocols are just a waste of time.
speak.zh: 說實話，我覺得公司有些規定根本是在浪費時間。

write.en: Skipping the security protocol, even once, could put the company's customer data at risk.
write.zh: 即使只跳過一次資安規範，都可能讓公司的客戶資料陷入風險。

example.en: The restaurant on the top floor offers fine dining, with a seasonal menu and views over the whole city.
example.zh: 頂樓的餐廳提供高級餐飲，有季節菜單，還能俯瞰整座城市。

listen.en: The students meet in the dining hall after class.
listen.zh: 學生下課後在學生餐廳集合。

chinese.en: Outdoor dining became much more popular in many cities during the pandemic.
chinese.zh: 疫情期間，戶外用餐在許多城市變得更受歡迎。

english.en: We bought a new dining table for our small apartment.
english.zh: 我們替小公寓買了一張新餐桌。

speak.en: I'm not into fancy dining; street food is more my style.
speak.zh: 我對高檔餐廳沒什麼興趣，路邊小吃比較是我的風格。

write.en: Rising food prices have changed people's dining habits, with more families cooking at home.
write.zh: 食物價格上漲改變了人們的用餐習慣，越來越多家庭選擇在家煮飯。

example.en: During the long winter, food was so scarce that many families survived on bread and a little soup.
example.zh: 在漫長的冬天裡，食物極度缺乏，許多家庭只靠麵包和一點湯度日。

listen.en: Jobs were scarce, so he moved to the city.
listen.zh: 當時工作機會很少，所以他搬到了城市。

chinese.en: Governments must decide how to divide scarce resources between health care and education.
chinese.zh: 政府必須決定如何在醫療和教育之間分配有限的資源。

english.en: Parking spaces are always scarce near the train station on weekends.
english.zh: 週末時，火車站附近的停車位總是很少。

speak.en: Good part-time jobs are pretty scarce in my hometown, actually.
speak.zh: 其實在我的家鄉，好的打工機會相當少。

write.en: As wild fish become scarcer, more of the seafood we eat comes from farms.
write.zh: 隨著野生魚類越來越稀少，我們吃的海鮮有更多來自養殖場。

example.en: The hotel room was small, but the fabulous view of the mountains made up for everything.
example.zh: 飯店房間雖然小，但壯麗的山景彌補了一切。

listen.en: You look absolutely fabulous in that blue dress.
listen.zh: 你穿那件藍色洋裝看起來美極了。

chinese.en: The museum's new exhibition features fabulous costumes from different periods of history.
chinese.zh: 博物館的新展覽展出了各個歷史時期的精美服飾。

english.en: My teacher told me that my presentation was absolutely fabulous.
english.zh: 老師跟我說，我的報告非常精彩。

speak.en: The food at that night market is fabulous, and it's really cheap too.
speak.zh: 那個夜市的食物超好吃，而且真的很便宜。

write.en: Some tech founders have earned fabulous wealth, which has sparked debate about income inequality.
write.zh: 有些科技公司創辦人賺進了驚人的財富，引發了關於所得不均的討論。

example.en: Without any official statement, newspapers began to speculate that the two companies were planning to merge.
example.zh: 在沒有任何官方聲明的情況下，報紙開始猜測這兩家公司打算合併。

listen.en: It is too early to speculate on the results.
listen.zh: 現在推測結果還太早。

chinese.en: Many people speculated in property, hoping that house prices would keep rising.
chinese.zh: 許多人投機炒房，期待房價會持續上漲。

english.en: Everyone in the office speculated about why she quit suddenly.
english.zh: 辦公室裡的每個人都在猜她為什麼突然辭職。

speak.en: I'd rather not speculate; I'll wait until the facts come out.
speak.zh: 我寧可不要亂猜，等事實出來再說。

write.en: Economists speculate that working from home will reshape city centres over the next decade.
write.zh: 經濟學家推測，未來十年在家工作將改變市中心的樣貌。

example.en: Several towns have banned circuses that use wild animals, saying the long journeys and small cages are cruel.
example.zh: 有幾個城鎮已禁止使用野生動物的馬戲團，認為長途移動和狹小的籠子很殘忍。

listen.en: The clowns at the circus made everyone laugh.
listen.zh: 馬戲團的小丑逗得大家哈哈大笑。

chinese.en: The celebrity wedding turned into a media circus, with reporters camping outside the hotel for days.
chinese.zh: 那場名人婚禮演變成一場媒體鬧劇，記者在飯店外守了好幾天。

english.en: A travelling circus comes to our small town every summer.
english.zh: 每年夏天都有一個巡迴馬戲團來我們的小鎮。

speak.en: Honestly, our house is a total circus on weekday mornings.
speak.zh: 說真的，平日早上我們家簡直亂成一團。

write.en: She trained for years as a circus acrobat before becoming a physical education teacher.
write.zh: 她受訓當了多年的馬戲團特技演員，後來才成為體育老師。

example.en: Companies spend millions protecting their intellectual property, such as designs, inventions and brand names, from being copied.
example.zh: 企業花費數百萬保護設計、發明和品牌名稱等智慧財產，避免遭到抄襲。

listen.en: Chess is a game of great intellectual skill.
listen.zh: 西洋棋是一項極需智力的遊戲。

chinese.en: In the past, many intellectuals gathered in coffee houses to discuss politics and art.
chinese.zh: 過去許多知識分子會聚在咖啡館裡討論政治和藝術。

english.en: My older brother is very intellectual and loves talking about philosophy.
english.zh: 我哥哥很有學問，很喜歡談論哲學。

speak.en: I like light comedies; I'm not really into intellectual films.
speak.zh: 我喜歡輕鬆的喜劇，對燒腦的知性電影不太感興趣。

write.en: Universities should value intellectual freedom, allowing students to question even widely accepted ideas.
write.zh: 大學應該重視思想自由，讓學生能質疑即使是普遍被接受的觀點。

example.en: At sixteen, she was apprenticed to a local carpenter, who taught her how to build furniture by hand.
example.zh: 她十六歲時拜當地一位木匠為師，木匠教她如何用手工製作家具。

listen.en: The bakery is looking for a new apprentice.
listen.zh: 這家麵包店正在找新的學徒。

chinese.en: The company takes on several apprentices each year and trains them in electrical work.
chinese.zh: 這家公司每年招收幾名學徒，訓練他們做電工。

english.en: My cousin is an apprentice chef at a hotel restaurant.
english.zh: 我的表哥在一家飯店餐廳當學徒廚師。

speak.en: I'd love to be an apprentice to a real coffee roaster someday.
speak.zh: 我很想有一天能跟著真正的咖啡烘焙師當學徒。

write.en: Some argue that young people learn more as apprentices than they do in university lectures.
write.zh: 有些人認為，年輕人當學徒學到的比在大學課堂上學到的還多。

example.en: The manager dictated a letter to her assistant, who typed it up quickly and sent it to the client.
example.zh: 經理口述了一封信給助理，助理迅速打好後寄給了客戶。

listen.en: Nobody likes being dictated to by their boss.
listen.zh: 沒有人喜歡被老闆指使。

chinese.en: In many families, tradition still dictates who cooks and who cleans the house.
chinese.zh: 在許多家庭中，傳統仍然決定了誰煮飯、誰打掃家裡。

english.en: My limited budget dictates where I can travel this summer.
english.zh: 我有限的預算決定了我今年夏天能去哪裡旅行。

speak.en: I don't let fashion trends dictate what I wear.
speak.zh: 我不會讓流行趨勢決定我穿什麼。

write.en: Large supermarket chains can dictate the prices that small farmers receive for their crops.
write.zh: 大型連鎖超市能左右小農作物的收購價格。

example.en: The old theatre had been restored with gorgeous red curtains, gold ceilings and hundreds of tiny lights.
example.zh: 這座老劇院修復後，有華麗的紅色布幕、金色天花板和數百盞小燈。

listen.en: The view from the top of the hill is gorgeous.
listen.zh: 從山頂望出去的景色美極了。

chinese.en: The chef served a gorgeous chocolate cake decorated with fresh berries and flowers.
chinese.zh: 主廚端上了一個用新鮮莓果和花朵裝飾的精美巧克力蛋糕。

english.en: My sister looked absolutely gorgeous in her white wedding dress.
english.zh: 我姊姊穿著白色婚紗，看起來美極了。

speak.en: Your photos from Hualien are gorgeous. What camera did you use?
speak.zh: 你在花蓮拍的照片好美，你是用什麼相機拍的？

write.en: Tourism brochures often show gorgeous beaches, but they rarely mention the crowds or pollution.
write.zh: 旅遊手冊常展示絕美的海灘，卻很少提到擁擠的人潮或汙染。

example.en: As the flight delay reached its fourth hour, the agitation among passengers grew, and some began shouting at staff.
example.zh: 班機延誤進入第四個小時，乘客越來越焦躁，有些人開始對工作人員大吼。

listen.en: His agitation was obvious from the way he spoke.
listen.zh: 從他說話的樣子，明顯看得出他很焦慮。

chinese.en: Years of agitation by workers eventually led to shorter working hours and better pay.
chinese.zh: 勞工多年來的爭取與抗爭，最終換來了較短的工時和較好的薪資。

english.en: I could hear the agitation in my mother's voice on the phone.
english.zh: 電話中我聽得出媽媽的聲音很焦急。

speak.en: Before big exams, I feel a kind of agitation I can't control.
speak.zh: 大考前，我會有一種無法控制的焦躁感。

write.en: In the lab, constant agitation of the mixture prevents the particles from settling at the bottom.
write.zh: 在實驗室裡，持續攪動混合液可以防止顆粒沉到底部。

example.en: When the winning team lifted the trophy, the coach was so overcome with emotion that he could not speak.
example.zh: 冠軍隊伍舉起獎盃時，教練激動得說不出話來。

listen.en: I had mixed emotions on my last day at school.
listen.zh: 在學校的最後一天，我的心情很複雜。

chinese.en: Research shows that regular exercise can help people manage negative emotions such as anger.
chinese.zh: 研究顯示，規律運動能幫助人們處理憤怒等負面情緒。

english.en: He tried hard to hide his emotions during the job interview.
english.zh: 他在工作面試時努力隱藏自己的情緒。

speak.en: Music really affects my emotions, especially when I'm feeling tired.
speak.zh: 音樂真的很影響我的情緒，尤其是在我很累的時候。

write.en: Advertisers often appeal to emotion rather than logic to persuade customers to buy.
write.zh: 廣告商常訴諸情感而非邏輯來說服顧客購買。

example.en: After the earthquake, the school gym was used as a shelter for families whose homes had been damaged.
example.zh: 地震過後，學校體育館被用來安置房屋受損的家庭。

listen.en: We adopted our cat from an animal shelter.
listen.zh: 我們的貓是從動物收容所領養的。

chinese.en: Food, water and shelter are the most basic needs of every human being.
chinese.zh: 食物、水和住所是每個人最基本的需求。

english.en: The farmers sheltered their sheep in the barn during the storm.
english.zh: 暴風雨期間，農夫們把羊群安置在穀倉裡避風雨。

speak.en: My parents sheltered me a lot, so living alone was a shock.
speak.zh: 我爸媽一直把我保護得很好，所以自己一個人住讓我很不適應。

write.en: Tall trees planted along the coast can shelter villages from strong winds.
write.zh: 沿海種植的高大樹木可以替村莊擋住強風。

example.en: Many young fathers now take parental leave so they can stay home and care for their newborn babies.
example.zh: 現在許多年輕爸爸會請育嬰假，以便在家照顧剛出生的寶寶。

listen.en: This film is suitable for children with parental guidance.
listen.zh: 這部電影適合兒童在家長陪同指導下觀看。

chinese.en: Strong parental pressure can make teenagers choose careers they do not really want.
chinese.zh: 來自父母的強大壓力，可能讓青少年選擇自己並不真正想要的職業。

english.en: We set up parental controls on our young son's new tablet.
english.zh: 我們在年幼兒子的新平板上設定了家長監護功能。

speak.en: I think parental support made a huge difference in my studies.
speak.zh: 我覺得父母的支持對我的學業影響很大。

write.en: Some experts believe a lack of parental involvement explains why certain students fall behind.
write.zh: 有些專家認為，家長參與不足是部分學生跟不上進度的原因。

example.en: Each salesperson has a monthly quota, and those who fail to meet it may lose their bonus.
example.zh: 每位業務員都有每月的業績目標，沒達成的人可能會拿不到獎金。

listen.en: Each school has a quota of places for local students.
listen.zh: 每所學校都有保留給本地學生的名額。

chinese.en: Strict fishing quotas have helped the cod population in the region recover.
chinese.zh: 嚴格的捕撈配額幫助該地區的鱈魚數量回升。

english.en: Our company has a quota for hiring people with disabilities.
english.zh: 我們公司有僱用身心障礙者的名額規定。

speak.en: I've already used up my coffee quota for today, sadly.
speak.zh: 很可惜，我今天能喝的咖啡額度已經用完了。

write.en: Critics argue that gender quotas on company boards treat the symptom rather than the cause.
write.zh: 批評者認為，企業董事會的性別配額制只是治標不治本。

example.en: The hospital has a finite number of beds, so patients with minor injuries are often sent home.
example.zh: 醫院的病床數量有限，所以輕傷患者常被請回家。

listen.en: We should remember that our time together is finite.
listen.zh: 我們應該記得，我們能相處的時間是有限的。

chinese.en: Because the school's budget is finite, it cannot afford both a new gym and library.
chinese.zh: 由於學校預算有限，無法同時負擔新的體育館和圖書館。

english.en: My attention span is finite, so I take short breaks.
english.zh: 我的專注力有限，所以我會不時短暫休息。

speak.en: Honestly, I think the planet's water supply is more finite than people realise.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得地球的水資源比大家以為的還要有限。

write.en: Since land in big cities is finite, building upwards is often the only practical option.
write.zh: 由於大城市的土地有限，往上蓋高樓往往是唯一可行的選擇。

example.en: Researchers used household electricity use as a proxy for income, since families rarely report their real earnings.
example.zh: 研究人員以家庭用電量作為收入的替代指標，因為家庭很少如實申報收入。

listen.en: My sister acted as my proxy at the meeting.
listen.zh: 我姊姊在會議上擔任我的代理人。

chinese.en: Exam scores are often treated as a proxy for intelligence, which is misleading.
chinese.zh: 考試分數常被當作衡量智力的指標，這其實是一種誤導。

english.en: The company uses a proxy server to protect its network.
english.zh: 這家公司使用代理伺服器來保護它的網路。

speak.en: Honestly, I think likes on social media are a poor proxy for popularity.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得社群媒體上的按讚數很難代表一個人受不受歡迎。

write.en: Many graduates collected their certificates by proxy because they had already started jobs overseas.
write.zh: 許多畢業生因為已經在國外工作，只好委託他人代領證書。

example.en: When the lights suddenly went out in the crowded station, confusion reigned for several minutes until staff arrived.
example.zh: 擁擠的車站突然停電，現場混亂了好幾分鐘，直到工作人員趕到。

listen.en: Silence reigned in the library during the final exams.
listen.zh: 期末考期間，圖書館裡一片寂靜。

chinese.en: The queen reigned for over sixty years, longer than any other ruler in the country's history.
chinese.zh: 這位女王在位超過六十年，比該國史上任何統治者都久。

english.en: The reigning champion lost in the first round this year.
english.zh: 衛冕冠軍今年在第一輪就輸了。

speak.en: In my family, my grandmother still reigns over the kitchen.
speak.zh: 在我家，廚房仍然是奶奶的天下。

write.en: Smartphones now reign supreme as the main way young people get their news.
write.zh: 智慧型手機如今已成為年輕人取得新聞最主要的管道。

example.en: Taiwan introduced universal health insurance in the nineties, so almost every resident can now see a doctor cheaply.
example.zh: 臺灣在一九九〇年代實施全民健康保險，所以現在幾乎每位居民都能以低廉的費用看病。

listen.en: A smile is a universal sign of friendship.
listen.zh: 微笑是全世界通用的友善表示。

chinese.en: There is no universal agreement on the best age for children to start learning English.
chinese.zh: 對於孩子幾歲開始學英文最好，目前並沒有普遍的共識。

english.en: This charger is universal, so it works with most phones.
english.zh: 這個充電器是通用的，所以大部分手機都能用。

speak.en: I think the fear of public speaking is pretty much universal.
speak.zh: 我覺得害怕在眾人面前說話，幾乎是每個人都有的。

write.en: Supporters of universal basic income argue it would protect workers whose jobs are replaced by machines.
write.zh: 無條件基本收入的支持者認為，這項制度能保障工作被機器取代的勞工。

example.en: The new mayor struggled to muster enough support from local businesses, so the plan to build a stadium was dropped.
example.zh: 新市長難以爭取到地方企業足夠的支持，所以興建體育場的計畫被取消了。

listen.en: She could barely muster a smile after the long day.
listen.zh: 漫長的一天結束後，她幾乎擠不出一絲笑容。

chinese.en: The essay was well written, but its weak arguments did not pass muster with the examiners.
chinese.zh: 這篇文章寫得不錯，但論點薄弱，沒能通過考官的標準。

english.en: The team mustered all their strength for the final match.
english.zh: 這支隊伍為了決賽卯足了全力。

speak.en: After work, I can hardly muster the energy to cook dinner.
speak.zh: 下班後，我幾乎提不起勁煮晚餐。

write.en: The volunteers mustered at the harbour at dawn before setting off to clean the beach.
write.zh: 志工們清晨在港口集合，然後出發去淨灘。

example.en: In journalism, checking facts before publishing is a cardinal principle, and reporters who ignore it can lose their jobs.
example.zh: 在新聞業，發布前查證事實是首要原則，忽視它的記者可能會丟掉工作。

listen.en: Being late for an interview is a cardinal sin.
listen.zh: 面試遲到是一大忌。

chinese.en: North, south, east and west are known as the four cardinal directions.
chinese.zh: 北、南、東、西被稱為四個基本方位。

english.en: Most young children learn cardinal numbers before they learn ordinal numbers.
english.zh: 大部分幼兒會先學基數，再學序數。

speak.en: Honestly, I think kindness is a cardinal virtue in any friendship.
speak.zh: 說真的，我覺得在任何友誼裡，善良都是最重要的美德。

write.en: Protecting user privacy should be a cardinal concern for any company collecting personal data.
write.zh: 對任何蒐集個人資料的公司來說，保護使用者隱私都應該是首要考量。

example.en: Instead of going through the long application process, he tried to bribe a clerk to approve his permit quickly.
example.zh: 他不想走冗長的申請程序，於是企圖賄賂一名辦事員，讓許可證盡快核准。

listen.en: The driver tried to bribe the police officer.
listen.zh: 那名駕駛企圖賄賂警察。

chinese.en: Strict laws and higher salaries can make public servants less likely to take bribes.
chinese.zh: 嚴格的法律和較高的薪水，能讓公務員比較不會收賄。

english.en: The player was banned for offering a bribe to the referee.
english.zh: 這名選手因為向裁判行賄而被禁賽。

speak.en: My mum used to bribe me with sweets to finish my homework.
speak.zh: 我媽以前常用糖果利誘我寫完功課。

write.en: Some argue that paying students for good grades is just a bribe that kills real interest in learning.
write.zh: 有人認為，用金錢獎勵學生考好成績只是一種收買，會扼殺真正的學習興趣。

example.en: The old house had not been painted for years, and the paint was flaking off the walls in long strips.
example.zh: 這棟老房子好幾年沒上漆了，牆上的油漆一條條剝落。

listen.en: I eat a bowl of corn flakes every morning.
listen.zh: 我每天早上都吃一碗玉米片。

chinese.en: Dry winter air can make your skin flake, so use a good moisturiser.
chinese.zh: 冬天的乾燥空氣會讓皮膚脫屑，所以要用好一點的保濕乳液。

english.en: Sprinkle a few chilli flakes on the pizza before serving.
english.zh: 上桌前在披薩上撒一些辣椒片。

speak.en: My friend always flakes on plans at the last minute, which drives me crazy.
speak.zh: 我朋友總是在最後一刻放鴿子，快把我逼瘋了。

write.en: Scientists found tiny flakes of plastic in the stomachs of fish caught near the coast.
write.zh: 科學家在近海捕獲的魚胃裡發現了細小的塑膠碎片。

example.en: Long before satellites existed, sailors relied on the stars for navigation when they crossed the open ocean.
example.zh: 早在衛星出現之前，水手橫越大海時就是靠星星來導航。

listen.en: The navigation app found a faster way home.
listen.zh: 導航程式找到了一條更快回家的路。

chinese.en: Clear navigation helps visitors find what they need on a website within seconds.
chinese.zh: 清楚的瀏覽介面能讓訪客在幾秒內找到網站上需要的資訊。

english.en: My phone's navigation stopped working when we drove into the mountains.
english.zh: 我們開進山區時，我手機的導航就失靈了。

speak.en: Honestly, I'm hopeless without navigation, even in my own city.
speak.zh: 說真的，就算在我自己住的城市，沒有導航我也會迷路。

write.en: Safe navigation through busy shipping lanes is essential for keeping global trade moving.
write.zh: 在繁忙的航道上安全航行，對維持全球貿易運作至關重要。

example.en: The space probe travelled for years before sending back clear images of the planet's icy surface.
example.zh: 這艘太空探測器飛行了好幾年，才傳回這顆行星冰冷表面的清晰影像。

listen.en: The reporter asked some probing questions about the plan.
listen.zh: 記者針對這項計畫提出了一些尖銳的問題。

chinese.en: The government has launched a probe into how public money was spent on the project.
chinese.zh: 政府已展開調查，釐清這項計畫的公款是如何花用的。

english.en: The doctor gently probed the wound to check for glass.
english.zh: 醫生輕輕探查傷口，檢查裡面有沒有玻璃碎片。

speak.en: I didn't want to probe too much, so I changed the subject.
speak.zh: 我不想追問太多，所以就換了話題。

write.en: The study probes deeper into why some students lose interest in science after middle school.
write.zh: 這項研究深入探討為什麼有些學生在國中之後對科學失去興趣。

example.en: The old mansion on the hill, once owned by a wealthy merchant, has been turned into a museum of local history.
example.zh: 山丘上那座老宅邸曾屬於一位富商，現在已改建成地方歷史博物館。

listen.en: They rented a mansion for their wedding party.
listen.zh: 他們租了一棟豪宅舉辦婚宴。

chinese.en: Rising house prices mean young workers can barely afford a flat, let alone a mansion.
chinese.zh: 房價高漲，年輕上班族連一間公寓都快買不起，更別說豪宅了。

english.en: We visited a historic mansion with beautiful gardens last weekend.
english.zh: 上週末我們參觀了一座有美麗花園、歷史悠久的宅邸。

speak.en: If I won the lottery, I wouldn't buy a mansion; I'd travel.
speak.zh: 如果我中了樂透，我不會買豪宅，而會去旅行。

write.en: Some cities now charge an extra tax on empty mansions to help fund public housing.
write.zh: 有些城市現在對空置的豪宅加徵稅金，用來資助社會住宅。

example.en: Since both of them work full-time, the couple relies on a childcare centre near the office to look after their daughter.
example.zh: 由於兩人都是全職工作，這對夫妻靠辦公室附近的托兒所照顧女兒。

listen.en: My grandmother helps with childcare during the week.
listen.zh: 平日我奶奶會幫忙照顧小孩。

chinese.en: Many people believe that affordable childcare could encourage young couples to have more children.
chinese.zh: 許多人認為，平價托育能鼓勵年輕夫妻多生孩子。

english.en: Some large companies now provide free childcare for their employees.
english.zh: 現在有些大公司為員工提供免費托育。

speak.en: Finding good childcare in my area is surprisingly difficult.
speak.zh: 在我住的地方，要找到好的托育服務出乎意料地難。

write.en: She trained as a childcare worker because she enjoys helping toddlers learn through play.
write.zh: 她受訓成為托育人員，因為她喜歡幫助幼兒從遊戲中學習。

example.en: Because the twins share the same genetic makeup, scientists study them to separate the effects of nature and upbringing.
example.zh: 由於雙胞胎的基因組成相同，科學家藉由研究他們來區分先天與後天教養的影響。

listen.en: The doctor suggested genetic testing for the whole family.
listen.zh: 醫生建議全家人都去做基因檢測。

chinese.en: Genetic engineering could help farmers grow crops that survive long periods of drought.
chinese.zh: 基因工程可以幫助農民種出能撐過長期乾旱的作物。

english.en: My height is mostly genetic, since both my parents are tall.
english.zh: 我的身高主要是遺傳的，因為我爸媽都很高。

speak.en: I'd be a bit nervous about sharing my genetic data with an app.
speak.zh: 要把我的基因資料提供給一個應用程式，我會有點擔心。

write.en: Conservation programmes try to maintain genetic diversity so that endangered species can adapt to change.
write.zh: 保育計畫努力維持遺傳多樣性，讓瀕危物種能夠適應環境變化。

example.en: After the storm, the market was in complete disorder, with broken stalls and fruit scattered across the street.
example.zh: 暴風雨過後，市場一片混亂，攤位損毀，水果散落滿街。

listen.en: Eating disorders are common among young people today.
listen.zh: 飲食失調在現今年輕人中很常見。

chinese.en: Doctors say early treatment can greatly improve the lives of children with genetic disorders.
chinese.zh: 醫生表示，及早治療能大幅改善遺傳疾病患童的生活。

english.en: The police were called to deal with public disorder after the match.
english.zh: 比賽結束後，警方被找來處理公共騷亂。

speak.en: A friend of mine has an anxiety disorder, so I try to be patient.
speak.zh: 我有個朋友患有焦慮症，所以我盡量對他有耐心。

write.en: Schools should train teachers to recognise the early signs of learning disorders in children.
write.zh: 學校應該培訓老師辨識兒童學習障礙的早期徵兆。

example.en: After several customers became ill, the company's reputation suffered, and sales fell sharply over the following months.
example.zh: 幾名顧客生病後，這家公司的聲譽受損，接下來幾個月銷量大幅下滑。

listen.en: The hotel really lived up to its reputation.
listen.zh: 這家飯店真的名不虛傳。

chinese.en: The university has built an international reputation for research in renewable energy.
chinese.zh: 這所大學在再生能源研究方面已建立了國際聲譽。

english.en: This brand has a reputation for making safe and reliable cars.
english.zh: 這個品牌以製造安全又可靠的汽車聞名。

speak.en: My uncle has a reputation as the best cook in our family.
speak.zh: 我舅舅是我們家公認最會煮菜的人。

write.en: Celebrities who post misleading health advice risk their reputations and may harm their fans.
write.zh: 張貼誤導性健康建議的名人，不但會賠上自己的名聲，也可能傷害粉絲。

example.en: The plants in the basement were deprived of sunlight for weeks, so their leaves turned yellow and began to drop.
example.zh: 地下室的植物好幾個星期照不到陽光，葉子變黃並開始掉落。

listen.en: The noisy neighbours deprived us of a good night's sleep.
listen.zh: 吵鬧的鄰居害我們整晚沒睡好。

chinese.en: Children from poor families should not be deprived of a good education.
chinese.zh: 貧困家庭的孩子不應該被剝奪接受良好教育的機會。

english.en: The power cut deprived the whole town of electricity for hours.
english.zh: 停電讓整個小鎮好幾個小時都沒有電可用。

speak.en: I don't want to deprive myself of desserts completely while dieting.
speak.zh: 節食的時候，我不想完全戒掉甜點。

write.en: Banning phones in class may deprive students of a powerful learning tool.
write.zh: 禁止在課堂上使用手機，可能會讓學生失去一項強大的學習工具。

example.en: The hall was decorated with a spinning disco ball and coloured lights, making it look just like an old-fashioned dance club.
example.zh: 大廳裝飾著旋轉的迪斯可球和彩色燈光，看起來就像一家老式舞廳。

listen.en: The school is holding a disco for the students on Friday.
listen.zh: 學校星期五要為學生舉辦一場舞會。

chinese.en: Disco music was hugely popular in the seventies, and many songs are still played at weddings.
chinese.zh: 迪斯可音樂在七〇年代極為流行，許多歌曲至今仍會在婚禮上播放。

english.en: We danced all night at the disco on the cruise ship.
english.zh: 我們在郵輪上的舞廳跳了一整晚的舞。

speak.en: I'm a terrible dancer, so you'll never see me at a disco.
speak.zh: 我跳舞超爛，所以你絕對不會在舞廳看到我。

write.en: Some residents complained that the disco next door kept them awake until early morning.
write.zh: 有些居民抱怨，隔壁的舞廳吵得他們直到清晨都睡不著。

example.en: The language school is truly international, with students of more than twenty nationalities studying in the same building.
example.zh: 這所語言學校非常國際化，有二十多個國籍的學生在同一棟大樓裡上課。

listen.en: Her husband has dual nationality and travels a lot.
listen.zh: 她先生擁有雙重國籍，常常出國。

chinese.en: Employers should hire staff based on ability, regardless of their nationality or background.
chinese.zh: 雇主應該依能力聘用員工，不論其國籍或背景。

english.en: His accent made it really hard for us to guess his nationality.
english.zh: 他的口音讓我們很難猜出他的國籍。

speak.en: Honestly, I don't think nationality says much about someone's personality.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不認為國籍能說明一個人的個性。

write.en: Some countries allow children born there to claim nationality, even if their parents are foreign.
write.zh: 有些國家允許在當地出生的孩子取得國籍，即使父母是外國人。

example.en: To persuade staff to work weekends, the company offered a carrot: an extra day of holiday for every shift.
example.zh: 為了說服員工週末上班，公司提出了一個誘因：每上一班就多放一天假。

listen.en: Rabbits love to eat fresh carrots from the garden.
listen.zh: 兔子很愛吃菜園裡新鮮的紅蘿蔔。

chinese.en: Some governments use a carrot-and-stick approach, rewarding recycling and fining people who litter.
chinese.zh: 有些政府採取軟硬兼施的做法，獎勵資源回收，並對亂丟垃圾的人罰款。

english.en: I like to snack on raw carrots while I study.
english.zh: 我喜歡邊讀書邊吃生的紅蘿蔔當點心。

speak.en: Honestly, carrot cake is the only way I'll eat vegetables.
speak.zh: 說真的，紅蘿蔔蛋糕是我唯一願意吃蔬菜的方式。

write.en: Farmers in the valley grow carrots in winter, when the cool weather makes them sweeter.
write.zh: 山谷裡的農民在冬天種紅蘿蔔，因為涼爽的天氣能讓它們更甜。

example.en: The popular novel was adapted for television, and the series attracted millions of viewers who had never read the book.
example.zh: 這部暢銷小說被改編成電視劇，吸引了數百萬從沒讀過原著的觀眾。

listen.en: Some animals adapt quickly to changes in their habitat.
listen.zh: 有些動物能迅速適應棲息地的變化。

chinese.en: Teachers often adapt their lessons to suit students with different learning needs.
chinese.zh: 老師常會調整課程內容，以配合有不同學習需求的學生。

english.en: My grandfather has adapted surprisingly well to using a smartphone.
english.zh: 我爺爺意外地很能適應使用智慧型手機。

speak.en: I had to adapt my mum's recipe because I didn't have an oven.
speak.zh: 因為我沒有烤箱，只好修改我媽的食譜。

write.en: Coastal cities must adapt to rising sea levels by building stronger flood defences.
write.zh: 沿海城市必須建造更堅固的防洪設施，來因應海平面上升。

example.en: Before signing, the lawyer inserted a clause stating that either side could end the contract with a month's notice.
example.zh: 簽約前，律師加入一項條款，規定任一方只要提前一個月通知就能終止合約。

listen.en: She inserted a coin and the music began to play.
listen.zh: 她投了一枚硬幣，音樂就開始播放了。

chinese.en: Doctors inserted a thin tube to help the patient breathe during the operation.
chinese.zh: 醫生在手術中插入一根細管，幫助病人呼吸。

english.en: Please insert a photo of yourself at the top of your CV.
english.zh: 請在履歷的最上方放一張你自己的照片。

speak.en: I always buy shoe inserts because standing all day hurts my feet.
speak.zh: 我總是會買鞋墊，因為整天站著會讓我腳痛。

write.en: Some apps insert advertisements between every video, which many users find annoying.
write.zh: 有些應用程式會在每段影片之間插入廣告，許多使用者覺得很煩。

example.en: As the housing shortage worsened, rents escalated so rapidly that many young people moved back in with their parents.
example.zh: 隨著住房短缺惡化，房租急速飆漲，許多年輕人只好搬回家和父母同住。

listen.en: The manager acted fast so the problem would not escalate.
listen.zh: 經理迅速處理，以免問題擴大。

chinese.en: Tension between the two companies escalated after one accused the other of copying its design.
chinese.zh: 其中一家公司指控對方抄襲設計後，兩家公司之間的緊張關係隨之升高。

english.en: If the customer is still unhappy, we will escalate the complaint.
english.zh: 如果客人仍然不滿意，我們會把客訴往上呈報。

speak.en: My brother and I argue a lot, but it never escalates.
speak.zh: 我和弟弟常吵架，但從來不會鬧大。

write.en: Doctors warn that escalating screen time may be harming children's sleep and concentration.
write.zh: 醫生警告，不斷增加的螢幕使用時間可能正在損害兒童的睡眠與專注力。

example.en: This type of tea is peculiar to a small mountain region, where the cool mist gives the leaves their unusual flavour.
example.zh: 這種茶是某個小山區特有的，那裡涼爽的霧氣賦予茶葉獨特的風味。

listen.en: He has a peculiar way of laughing at his own jokes.
listen.zh: 他笑自己講的笑話時，笑法很奇特。

chinese.en: Each language has expressions peculiar to its culture that are almost impossible to translate.
chinese.zh: 每種語言都有其文化特有、幾乎無法翻譯的說法。

english.en: I had a peculiar feeling that someone was watching me.
english.zh: 我有一種怪怪的感覺，好像有人在看我。

speak.en: It's a bit peculiar, but I actually enjoy doing laundry.
speak.zh: 這有點奇怪，但我其實很喜歡洗衣服。

write.en: Researchers noticed peculiar changes in bird migration patterns after several unusually warm winters.
write.zh: 在連續幾個異常溫暖的冬天之後，研究人員發現候鳥遷徙模式出現了奇特的變化。

example.en: When the company tried to cut workers' holidays without warning, the outcry was so loud that managers quickly changed their minds.
example.zh: 公司試圖在沒有預告的情況下削減員工假期時，反彈聲浪大到主管們很快就改變了主意。

listen.en: There was an outcry over the rise in bus fares.
listen.zh: 公車票價調漲引發了強烈抗議。

chinese.en: The decision to cut down the old trees sparked an outcry among local residents.
chinese.zh: 砍伐老樹的決定引發當地居民強烈反彈。

english.en: Fans raised an outcry when the band cancelled its tour.
english.zh: 樂團取消巡迴演出時，歌迷們群起抗議。

speak.en: I think there'd be a huge outcry if they banned scooters downtown.
speak.zh: 我覺得如果禁止機車進入市中心，一定會引起很大的反彈。

write.en: Despite the international outcry, the factory continued to release waste into the river.
write.zh: 儘管國際輿論強烈抗議，那家工廠仍持續把廢棄物排入河中。
