example.en: The bridge was badly damaged by the storm, which necessitated a long detour for every commuter.
example.zh: 那座橋被暴風雨嚴重損壞，使得所有通勤者都必須繞一大段遠路。

listen.en: Bad weather may necessitate a change of plans.
listen.zh: 天氣不好可能讓我們必須改變計畫。

chinese.en: Moving to a smaller flat necessitated getting rid of many of my old books.
chinese.zh: 搬到較小的公寓，讓我不得不處理掉許多舊書。

english.en: The new regulations necessitate changes to our current safety procedures.
english.zh: 新法規使我們必須修改現行的安全程序。

speak.en: Honestly, my job necessitates a lot of travel, which I enjoy.
speak.zh: 老實說，我的工作需要經常出差，而我還蠻喜歡的。

write.en: An ageing population will necessitate greater investment in public healthcare and elderly care.
write.zh: 人口老化勢必需要在公共醫療與長期照顧方面投入更多資金。

example.en: Because so many applicants had technical problems, the university agreed to extend the deadline by a week.
example.zh: 由於很多申請者遇到技術問題，大學同意將截止期限延後一週。

listen.en: She worked late every night to meet the deadline.
listen.zh: 她每晚都工作到很晚，就為了趕上截止期限。

chinese.en: Missing a deadline at work can damage your reputation with colleagues and clients.
chinese.zh: 在工作上錯過截止期限，可能會損害你在同事和客戶心中的信譽。

english.en: The deadline for submitting your application form is next Monday.
english.zh: 繳交申請表的截止日是下週一。

speak.en: I tend to work better when I have a tight deadline.
speak.zh: 我在期限很緊的時候，往往表現得比較好。

write.en: Governments often set ambitious deadlines for cutting emissions but rarely manage to meet them.
write.zh: 各國政府常為減少排放設定遠大的期限，卻很少能如期達成。

example.en: Each department can nominate one employee whose hard work deserves recognition, and the board will choose the winner.
example.zh: 每個部門可以提名一位工作認真、值得表揚的員工，再由董事會選出得獎者。

listen.en: Our class nominated her as the student representative.
listen.zh: 我們班推選她當學生代表。

chinese.en: The committee nominated a retired teacher to lead the new community education project.
chinese.zh: 委員會指派一位退休老師來主持新的社區教育計畫。

english.en: He was nominated for the best actor award last year.
english.zh: 他去年獲得最佳男主角獎提名。

speak.en: If I could nominate anyone for a kindness award, it'd be my neighbour.
speak.zh: 如果要我提名誰得「善心獎」，我會選我的鄰居。

write.en: Some argue that citizens, not politicians, should nominate candidates for important public roles.
write.zh: 有些人主張，重要公職的候選人應由公民而非政治人物提名。

example.en: The invention of the smartphone has dramatically altered the way people communicate, shop and even find partners.
example.zh: 智慧型手機的發明徹底改變了人們溝通、購物，甚至尋找伴侶的方式。

listen.en: I had my new jeans altered because they were too long.
listen.zh: 我把新買的牛仔褲拿去修改，因為太長了。

chinese.en: Nothing you say will alter the fact that we missed the last train.
chinese.zh: 不管你說什麼，都改變不了我們錯過末班車的事實。

english.en: Climate change is gradually altering the habitats of many wild animals.
english.zh: 氣候變遷正逐漸改變許多野生動物的棲息地。

speak.en: Living abroad really altered how I see my own culture.
speak.zh: 在國外生活真的改變了我看待自己文化的方式。

write.en: The teacher altered the exam schedule so that students had more time to revise.
write.zh: 老師調整了考試時程，讓學生有更多時間複習。

example.en: Stuck in the long queue, several passengers began to mutter about the airline's poor service.
example.zh: 被困在長長的隊伍中，好幾位乘客開始抱怨航空公司的服務很差。

listen.en: She muttered an apology and looked down at the floor.
listen.zh: 她小聲道了歉，然後低頭看著地板。

chinese.en: I could hear my brother muttering to himself while he struggled with his maths homework.
chinese.zh: 我聽到弟弟一邊苦惱著數學作業，一邊自言自語。

english.en: The students muttered when the teacher gave them extra homework.
english.zh: 老師多出了作業，學生們都在小聲抱怨。

speak.en: I sometimes mutter to myself when I'm trying to concentrate.
speak.zh: 我在努力專心的時候，有時會自言自語。

write.en: There was a low mutter of disapproval from the audience when the concert was cancelled.
write.zh: 演唱會宣布取消時，觀眾席間傳出一陣不滿的低語。

example.en: The new diet supposedly helps people lose weight quickly, yet scientists have found little evidence to support it.
example.zh: 這種新的飲食法號稱能讓人快速減重，但科學家幾乎找不到支持它的證據。

listen.en: The bus was supposedly on time, but it never came.
listen.zh: 公車理應準時，但它根本沒來。

chinese.en: The course is supposedly designed for beginners, but most of the content is quite advanced.
chinese.zh: 這門課號稱是為初學者設計的，但大部分內容其實相當進階。

english.en: The old castle is supposedly haunted by a friendly ghost.
english.zh: 據說那座古堡裡住著一個友善的鬼魂。

speak.en: My phone is supposedly waterproof, but I'd rather not test it.
speak.zh: 我的手機據說防水，但我可不想親自試試看。

write.en: Cheap fast fashion is supposedly good for consumers, yet it creates enormous amounts of waste.
write.zh: 廉價的快時尚號稱對消費者有利，卻製造了大量的廢棄物。

example.en: After running up the stairs, she could feel her rapid heartbeat slowly return to normal as she rested.
example.zh: 跑上樓梯之後，她一邊休息，一邊感覺急促的心跳慢慢恢復正常。

listen.en: I could hear my heartbeat in the quiet room.
listen.zh: 在安靜的房間裡，我聽得到自己的心跳。

chinese.en: Small family-run shops are often described as the heartbeat of a local community.
chinese.zh: 家庭經營的小店常被形容為地方社區的命脈。

english.en: Many smart watches can track your heartbeat while you are exercising.
english.zh: 許多智慧手錶可以在你運動時追蹤心跳。

speak.en: If I got the chance to study abroad, I'd go in a heartbeat.
speak.zh: 如果有機會出國念書，我會毫不猶豫地去。

write.en: Stress and too much coffee can cause an irregular heartbeat in some people.
write.zh: 壓力和喝太多咖啡，可能讓某些人心跳不規律。

example.en: The laptop has a small fan that helps dissipate heat, so it rarely overheats even during long use.
example.zh: 這台筆電有個小風扇幫助散熱，所以即使長時間使用也很少過熱。

listen.en: Her anger slowly dissipated after a good night's sleep.
listen.zh: 好好睡了一覺之後，她的怒氣慢慢消了。

chinese.en: The tension in the meeting room dissipated when someone finally made a joke.
chinese.zh: 有人終於開了個玩笑，會議室裡的緊張氣氛就消散了。

english.en: The large crowd dissipated quickly after the outdoor concert ended.
english.zh: 戶外演唱會結束後，大批人潮很快就散去了。

speak.en: My nervousness usually dissipates once I actually start speaking on stage.
speak.zh: 一旦真的站上台開口說話，我的緊張通常就會消失。

write.en: He dissipated his savings on expensive hobbies instead of investing in his education.
write.zh: 他把積蓄揮霍在昂貴的嗜好上，而不是投資自己的教育。

example.en: My sister has always been very musical; she could sing in tune before she could even read.
example.zh: 我姊姊一向很有音樂天分，她還不識字時就能唱得很準。

listen.en: We went to see a musical at the theatre last weekend.
listen.zh: 我們上週末去劇院看了一齣音樂劇。

chinese.en: The school offers free musical training to children from low-income families after class.
chinese.zh: 這所學校在課後為低收入家庭的孩子提供免費的音樂訓練。

english.en: Many popular films have recently been turned into stage musicals.
english.zh: 許多熱門電影最近都被改編成舞台音樂劇。

speak.en: I wouldn't call myself musical, but I love singing karaoke.
speak.zh: 我不覺得自己有音樂天分，但我很愛唱 KTV。

write.en: Some critics argue that public funding for musical theatre benefits only wealthy audiences.
write.zh: 有些評論者認為，政府對音樂劇場的補助只讓富裕的觀眾受惠。

example.en: The walls of the old café were decorated with black-and-white photos showing what the town looked like a century ago.
example.zh: 那間老咖啡館的牆上掛滿了黑白照片，呈現小鎮一百年前的模樣。

listen.en: The children helped decorate the Christmas tree after dinner.
listen.zh: 晚餐後，孩子們幫忙裝飾聖誕樹。

chinese.en: They spent the whole weekend decorating the spare bedroom before the baby arrived.
chinese.zh: 他們在寶寶出生前，花了整個週末粉刷佈置客房。

english.en: The hotel lobby was beautifully decorated with fresh flowers and plants.
english.zh: 飯店大廳用鮮花和植物裝飾得很漂亮。

speak.en: I love decorating my room with posters and photos of my friends.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡用海報和朋友的照片佈置房間。

write.en: Many cities decorate their streets with lights during festivals to attract tourists.
write.zh: 許多城市會在節慶期間用燈飾裝點街道，以吸引觀光客。

example.en: Their sailing holiday almost ended in tragedy when the engine failed far from shore, but a passing boat rescued them.
example.zh: 他們的航海假期差點以悲劇收場，因為引擎在離岸很遠處故障，幸好路過的船把他們救了起來。

listen.en: We studied a famous Greek tragedy in literature class.
listen.zh: 我們在文學課上讀了一部著名的希臘悲劇。

chinese.en: The real tragedy is that the old theatre could have been saved with better planning.
chinese.zh: 真正可惜的是，如果規劃得更好，那座老劇院本來是可以保住的。

english.en: The flood was a tragedy for many farmers in the region.
english.zh: 那場水災對當地許多農民來說是一場悲劇。

speak.en: Losing my old photos when my laptop crashed felt like a small tragedy.
speak.zh: 筆電當機讓我失去了舊照片，感覺就像一場小小的悲劇。

write.en: Classic tragedies remain popular because they explore universal themes such as jealousy and ambition.
write.zh: 經典悲劇之所以歷久不衰，是因為它們探討嫉妒和野心等普世主題。

example.en: Although the twins look identical, their personalities are completely different: one is outgoing, while the other is shy.
example.zh: 這對雙胞胎雖然長得一模一樣，個性卻完全不同：一個外向，另一個很害羞。

listen.en: His sense of humour is part of his personality.
listen.zh: 幽默感是他個性的一部分。

chinese.en: Some companies ask job applicants to complete a personality test before the interview.
chinese.zh: 有些公司會要求求職者在面試前先做一份性格測驗。

english.en: The famous TV personality recently opened a small restaurant downtown.
english.zh: 那位知名電視名人最近在市中心開了一家小餐廳。

speak.en: I think my personality is quite similar to my father's.
speak.zh: 我覺得我的個性跟我爸爸很像。

write.en: Personality clashes between team members can seriously reduce productivity in the workplace.
write.zh: 團隊成員之間的個性衝突，可能嚴重降低職場的工作效率。

example.en: Many young adults dream of financial independence, but high rents make it hard to stop relying on their parents.
example.zh: 許多年輕人夢想經濟獨立，但高昂的房租讓他們很難不再依靠父母。

listen.en: Good parents should gently encourage independence in their children.
listen.zh: 好的父母應該溫和地鼓勵孩子獨立。

chinese.en: Owning a car gives elderly people in rural areas more independence and freedom.
chinese.zh: 擁有一輛車，讓鄉下的長者享有更多自主與自由。

english.en: She really values her independence and prefers to travel alone.
english.zh: 她很重視自己的獨立，比較喜歡一個人旅行。

speak.en: Living alone taught me independence, like cooking and paying bills.
speak.zh: 一個人住讓我學會獨立，像是煮飯和繳帳單。

write.en: Newspapers must maintain their independence from advertisers in order to report honestly.
write.zh: 報社必須維持不受廣告商左右的獨立性，才能誠實報導。

example.en: Because the river is very shallow in summer, you can walk across it without getting your knees wet.
example.zh: 這條河在夏天非常淺，你可以直接走過去，水連膝蓋都碰不到。

listen.en: Bake the cake in a shallow dish for best results.
listen.zh: 把蛋糕放在淺盤裡烤，效果最好。

chinese.en: Many people feel that social media encourages shallow relationships rather than real friendships.
chinese.zh: 許多人覺得社群媒體助長的是膚淺的關係，而非真正的友誼。

english.en: His answer was quite shallow and did not address the question.
english.zh: 他的回答相當膚淺，沒有切中問題。

speak.en: When I'm nervous, my breathing becomes fast and shallow.
speak.zh: 我緊張的時候，呼吸會變得又快又淺。

write.en: Coral reefs usually grow in warm, shallow seas where sunlight can reach the bottom.
write.zh: 珊瑚礁通常生長在溫暖的淺海，也就是陽光能照到海底的地方。

example.en: Thanks to online shopping, huge warehouses full of robots now pack thousands of orders every hour.
example.zh: 由於網購盛行，裝滿機器人的大型倉庫如今每小時能包裝數千筆訂單。

listen.en: He works night shifts at a warehouse near the port.
listen.zh: 他在港口附近的倉庫上大夜班。

chinese.en: The old warehouse by the river has been converted into a popular art centre.
chinese.zh: 河邊那間老倉庫已經改建成一座熱門的藝術中心。

english.en: We buy our groceries in bulk at a warehouse store.
english.zh: 我們都在倉儲式量販店大量採買食品雜貨。

speak.en: I had a summer job in a warehouse, and it was exhausting.
speak.zh: 我暑假曾在倉庫打工，真的累壞了。

write.en: Building warehouses on farmland may create jobs, but it also reduces space for agriculture.
write.zh: 在農地上興建倉庫或許能創造就業機會，卻也壓縮了農業用地。

example.en: The bridge was closed after engineers concluded that its original design was inadequate for today's heavy traffic.
example.zh: 工程師判定這座橋原本的設計無法負荷現今繁重的交通後，橋就被封閉了。

listen.en: Comparing myself to others often makes me feel inadequate.
listen.zh: 拿自己跟別人比較，常讓我覺得自己不夠好。

chinese.en: Many rural schools still suffer from inadequate funding and a shortage of qualified teachers.
chinese.zh: 許多偏鄉學校仍面臨經費不足與合格教師短缺的問題。

english.en: The instructions were inadequate, so nobody knew what to do.
english.zh: 說明不夠充分，所以沒人知道該怎麼做。

speak.en: Honestly, two hours of sleep is totally inadequate before an exam.
speak.zh: 說真的，考試前只睡兩小時根本不夠。

write.en: Public transport in many suburbs remains inadequate, forcing residents to depend on private cars.
write.zh: 許多郊區的大眾運輸仍然不足，迫使居民只能依賴自用車。

example.en: The neighbours had complained about each other's noise for months, but they agreed to a truce after a friendly chat.
example.zh: 這兩戶鄰居互相抱怨對方太吵已經好幾個月，但在一次友善的聊天後，他們同意暫時和解。

listen.en: The cat and the dog seem to have reached a truce.
listen.zh: 貓和狗似乎已經達成休戰了。

chinese.en: The truce between the two companies ended when one launched a cheaper version of the product.
chinese.zh: 其中一家公司推出更便宜的產品版本後，兩家公司之間的休戰就結束了。

english.en: My roommate and I agreed to a truce about the dishes.
english.zh: 我和室友在洗碗這件事上達成了休戰協議。

speak.en: Whenever my family plays board games, we need a truce afterwards!
speak.zh: 每次我們家玩完桌遊，事後都需要休戰一下！

write.en: International sporting events have sometimes been used as an opportunity to declare a temporary truce.
write.zh: 國際體育賽事有時被當作宣布暫時休戰的契機。

example.en: The museum uses interactive games to arouse children's curiosity about science, history and the natural world.
example.zh: 博物館利用互動遊戲來激發孩子對科學、歷史和自然世界的好奇心。

listen.en: The new policy aroused strong public anger across the country.
listen.zh: 新政策在全國引起民眾強烈的不滿。

chinese.en: A good opening paragraph should arouse the reader's interest and make them want to continue.
chinese.zh: 好的開頭段落應該引起讀者的興趣，讓他們想繼續讀下去。

english.en: The film's ending aroused a lot of debate among viewers.
english.zh: 這部電影的結局在觀眾之間引發了許多討論。

speak.en: The documentary aroused my sympathy for people living in poverty.
speak.zh: 那部紀錄片讓我對生活貧困的人們產生了同情。

write.en: Rising food prices have aroused concern about how low-income families will cope this winter.
write.zh: 食物價格上漲，引發外界擔憂低收入家庭要如何度過這個冬天。

example.en: In dry regions, much of the water in open reservoirs evaporates before it can be used by farmers.
example.zh: 在乾燥地區，露天水庫裡的水有很大一部分還來不及讓農民使用就蒸發了。

listen.en: Our hopes of winning evaporated when the star player got injured.
listen.zh: 主力球員受傷後，我們獲勝的希望就破滅了。

chinese.en: Leave the sauce to simmer until most of the liquid has evaporated.
chinese.zh: 讓醬汁用小火慢燉，直到大部分的湯汁都收乾。

english.en: My confidence evaporated as soon as I walked into the exam room.
english.zh: 我一走進考場，信心就全沒了。

speak.en: My motivation tends to evaporate when the weather gets really hot.
speak.zh: 天氣一變得很熱，我的動力就容易消失。

write.en: Public support for the project quickly evaporated once the true costs became clear.
write.zh: 計畫的真實成本一公開，民眾的支持就迅速消失了。

example.en: The bank warned customers that the email looked legitimate but was actually a scam designed to steal passwords.
example.zh: 銀行警告客戶，那封電子郵件看起來很正常，實際上卻是用來竊取密碼的詐騙信。

listen.en: Being sick is a legitimate reason to miss class.
listen.zh: 生病是缺課的正當理由。

chinese.en: Only legitimate taxi companies are allowed to pick up passengers at the airport.
chinese.zh: 只有合法的計程車業者才能在機場載客。

english.en: That's a legitimate question, and I'll try to answer it.
english.zh: 這是個合理的問題，我會試著回答。

speak.en: Honestly, I think complaining about bad service is completely legitimate.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得對糟糕的服務提出抱怨是完全正當的。

write.en: Governments must carefully balance legitimate security needs with citizens' right to privacy.
write.zh: 政府必須謹慎地在正當的安全需求與公民的隱私權之間取得平衡。

example.en: The council decided to proceed with the new cycling lanes despite complaints from some local shop owners.
example.zh: 儘管部分在地店家抱怨，市議會仍決定繼續推動新的自行車道計畫。

listen.en: All passengers should now proceed to the boarding gate.
listen.zh: 所有旅客現在請前往登機門。

chinese.en: She read the instructions carefully and then proceeded to assemble the bookshelf by herself.
chinese.zh: 她仔細看完說明書，接著就自己動手組裝書架。

english.en: Drivers should proceed with caution because the road is icy.
english.zh: 路面結冰，駕駛人應小心行駛。

speak.en: Before we proceed, can I quickly ask a question?
speak.zh: 在我們繼續之前，我可以很快問個問題嗎？

write.en: Scientists must obtain ethical approval before they can proceed with experiments involving animals.
write.zh: 科學家必須先取得倫理審查許可，才能進行涉及動物的實驗。

example.en: Protons and neutrons are packed tightly together in the nucleus, while electrons move around it.
example.zh: 質子和中子緊密地擠在原子核裡，電子則在它周圍移動。

listen.en: Young players form the nucleus of the new team.
listen.zh: 年輕球員構成了這支新球隊的核心。

chinese.en: A small group of volunteers became the nucleus of what is now a large charity.
chinese.zh: 當初一小群志工是核心成員，後來發展成如今的大型慈善機構。

english.en: Under a microscope, you can clearly see the nucleus of each cell.
english.zh: 在顯微鏡下，可以清楚看到每個細胞的細胞核。

speak.en: My close friends from high school are the nucleus of my social life.
speak.zh: 高中時的好朋友是我社交生活的核心。

write.en: A strong local library can serve as the nucleus of community education programmes.
write.zh: 一座健全的地方圖書館，可以成為社區教育活動的核心。

example.en: The dancers moved so smoothly across the stage that the audience forgot how much effort each step required.
example.zh: 舞者們在台上移動得如此流暢，讓觀眾忘了每一步需要多大的努力。

listen.en: My little brother is a surprisingly good dancer.
listen.zh: 我弟弟跳舞跳得出乎意料地好。

chinese.en: Street dancers often perform in the park on weekends to earn some extra money.
chinese.zh: 街舞舞者常在週末到公園表演，賺點外快。

english.en: The dancers practised together every evening before the big show.
english.zh: 舞者們在大型演出前，每天晚上都一起練習。

speak.en: I'm a terrible dancer, so I usually avoid parties with dancing.
speak.zh: 我很不會跳舞，所以通常會避開有跳舞的派對。

write.en: Professional dancers often have short careers because the job puts enormous strain on their bodies.
write.zh: 職業舞者的職業生涯通常很短，因為這份工作對身體造成極大的負擔。

example.en: Because colds are caused by viruses, taking antibiotics will not help you recover any faster.
example.zh: 感冒是由病毒引起的，所以吃抗生素並不會讓你更快康復。

listen.en: You should finish the whole course of antibiotics.
listen.zh: 你應該把整個療程的抗生素吃完。

chinese.en: Overuse of antibiotics in farming has made some bacteria much harder to kill.
chinese.zh: 畜牧業過度使用抗生素，已使某些細菌變得更難消滅。

english.en: My grandmother has been on antibiotics for her chest infection since Monday.
english.zh: 我奶奶從星期一開始服用抗生素，治療胸腔感染。

speak.en: I try not to take antibiotics unless I really need them.
speak.zh: 除非真的需要，否則我盡量不吃抗生素。

write.en: Antibiotic resistance is becoming a serious global health threat that requires international cooperation.
write.zh: 抗生素抗藥性正成為嚴重的全球健康威脅，需要國際合作才能因應。

example.en: The flat is close to the station, and as an added bonus, there is a lovely park right across the street.
example.zh: 這間公寓離車站很近，更棒的是，對街就有一座漂亮的公園。

listen.en: Getting a free coffee with breakfast was a nice bonus.
listen.zh: 早餐附送一杯免費咖啡，真是個意外的小驚喜。

chinese.en: Many Taiwanese workers look forward to their year-end bonus before Lunar New Year.
chinese.zh: 許多臺灣上班族都很期待農曆新年前的年終獎金。

english.en: The teacher gave us bonus points for answering the hardest question.
english.zh: 我們答出最難的題目，老師就給了我們加分。

speak.en: Honestly, being able to work from home is a huge bonus for me.
speak.zh: 老實說，能在家工作對我來說是一大好處。

write.en: Some argue that performance bonuses encourage employees to focus on short-term results instead of quality.
write.zh: 有些人認為，績效獎金會讓員工只重視短期成果，而忽略品質。

example.en: The burglar alarm went off in the middle of the night, waking everyone on the street.
example.zh: 防盜警報器在半夜響起，把整條街的人都吵醒了。

listen.en: The police caught the burglar climbing out of a window.
listen.zh: 警方逮到那名竊賊正從窗戶爬出來。

chinese.en: Leaving a light on when you go out can help discourage burglars from entering your home.
chinese.zh: 出門時留一盞燈，有助於嚇阻小偷闖進你家。

english.en: The burglar took our laptop but left the television behind.
english.zh: 小偷拿走了我們的筆電，卻沒拿電視。

speak.en: Our dog barks at everyone, so I doubt a burglar would come near.
speak.zh: 我家的狗對誰都叫，所以我想小偷應該不敢靠近。

write.en: Smart doorbells with cameras have made it much easier for police to identify burglars.
write.zh: 附有鏡頭的智慧門鈴，讓警方更容易辨識竊賊的身分。

example.en: Investors are nervous because the stock market has been so volatile, rising sharply one day and crashing the next.
example.zh: 投資人很緊張，因為股市波動劇烈，可能一天大漲、隔天又暴跌。

listen.en: He has a volatile temper, so be careful what you say.
listen.zh: 他脾氣陰晴不定，所以說話要小心。

chinese.en: Petrol is highly volatile, so it should never be stored near a source of heat.
chinese.zh: 汽油極易揮發，絕對不能存放在熱源附近。

english.en: The weather in the mountains can be very volatile in spring.
english.zh: 山區春天的天氣可能變化很大。

speak.en: My mood can be a bit volatile when I haven't slept enough.
speak.zh: 我睡不夠的時候，情緒會有點起伏不定。

write.en: Farmers struggle to plan ahead when food prices are so volatile from season to season.
write.zh: 糧食價格每季波動劇烈，讓農民很難事先規劃。

example.en: The university conferred an honorary degree on the scientist in recognition of her lifelong research into clean water.
example.zh: 這所大學授予那位科學家榮譽學位，以表彰她畢生投入潔淨水資源的研究。

listen.en: Let me confer with my manager before I decide.
listen.zh: 讓我先跟主管商量一下再做決定。

chinese.en: Speaking more than one language can confer real advantages in the job market.
chinese.zh: 會說不只一種語言，能在就業市場上帶來實質的優勢。

english.en: The doctors conferred about the best treatment for the patient.
english.zh: 醫生們商討該給這位病人什麼樣的最佳治療。

speak.en: Before booking the trip, I always confer with my travel buddies.
speak.zh: 訂行程之前，我一定會先跟旅伴商量。

write.en: Citizenship confers certain rights, such as voting, as well as responsibilities like paying taxes.
write.zh: 公民身分賦予人們某些權利，例如投票權，同時也帶來繳稅等責任。

example.en: Golden retrievers are popular family pets because of their gentle temperament and patience with young children.
example.zh: 黃金獵犬性情溫和，對小孩也很有耐心，因此是很受歡迎的家庭寵物。

listen.en: She has the perfect temperament for working in a busy hospital.
listen.zh: 她的性情非常適合在忙碌的醫院工作。

chinese.en: By temperament, I am more of a planner than someone who acts on impulse.
chinese.zh: 就性格而言，我比較是會事先規劃的人，而不是憑衝動行事。

english.en: The twins look alike but have very different temperaments and interests.
english.zh: 這對雙胞胎長得很像，但性情和興趣很不一樣。

speak.en: I think my temperament is better suited to working alone.
speak.zh: 我覺得我的個性比較適合獨立工作。

write.en: Employers increasingly consider a candidate's temperament, not just their qualifications, when hiring for teamwork roles.
write.zh: 在招聘需要團隊合作的職位時，雇主越來越重視應徵者的性情，而不只是學經歷。

example.en: The chef warned that cooking a good steak for too long would make it tough and dry.
example.zh: 主廚提醒，好的牛排煎太久，肉會變得又老又乾。

listen.en: How would you like your steak cooked tonight?
listen.zh: 您今晚的牛排要幾分熟？

chinese.en: We celebrated my mother's birthday at a famous steak restaurant in the city centre.
chinese.zh: 我們在市中心一家有名的牛排館幫媽媽慶生。

english.en: He always prefers his steak well-done, without any pink inside.
english.zh: 他總是喜歡全熟的牛排，裡面不能有一點粉紅色。

speak.en: I don't eat steak very often because it's quite expensive here.
speak.zh: 我不常吃牛排，因為這裡的牛排蠻貴的。

write.en: Eating less steak and other red meat could help reduce greenhouse gas emissions from farming.
write.zh: 少吃牛排和其他紅肉，有助於減少畜牧業排放的溫室氣體。

example.en: Planning a wedding for two hundred guests turned into a nightmare when the venue cancelled at the last minute.
example.zh: 為兩百位賓客籌辦婚禮，在場地臨時取消後變成了一場惡夢。

listen.en: Driving through the city at rush hour is a nightmare.
listen.zh: 尖峰時段開車穿越市區簡直是場惡夢。

chinese.en: Children who watch scary films before bed are more likely to have nightmares.
chinese.zh: 睡前看恐怖片的孩子，比較容易做惡夢。

english.en: Our trip became a nightmare after we lost our passports.
english.zh: 我們弄丟護照之後，這趟旅行就變成了一場惡夢。

speak.en: Honestly, moving house last year was an absolute nightmare.
speak.zh: 說真的，去年搬家簡直是一場惡夢。

write.en: For many cities, rising sea levels represent a nightmare scenario that requires urgent planning.
write.zh: 對許多城市來說，海平面上升是惡夢般的情境，必須緊急規劃因應。

example.en: Farming was once the most common occupation in the village, but most young people now work in nearby factories.
example.zh: 務農曾是村裡最普遍的職業，但現在大多數年輕人都在附近的工廠上班。

listen.en: Nursing is a very demanding but rewarding occupation.
listen.zh: 護理是一份非常辛苦但有成就感的職業。

chinese.en: Some occupations, such as pilots and surgeons, require years of intensive training.
chinese.zh: 有些職業，例如飛行員和外科醫師，需要多年的密集訓練。

english.en: Since he retired, gardening has become my grandfather's favourite occupation.
english.zh: 我爺爺退休後，園藝就成了他最喜歡的消遣。

speak.en: I think teaching is one of the most important occupations in society.
speak.zh: 我認為教書是社會上最重要的職業之一。

write.en: Women are still underrepresented in certain occupations, particularly in engineering and computer science.
write.zh: 女性在某些職業中的比例仍然偏低，尤其是工程和資訊科學領域。

example.en: The professor was known for his eccentric habits, such as lecturing in slippers and talking to his plants.
example.zh: 那位教授以古怪的習慣聞名，例如穿拖鞋上課、跟植物說話。

listen.en: Some people think my aunt is a little eccentric.
listen.zh: 有些人覺得我阿姨有點古怪。

chinese.en: The town is full of artists and eccentrics who give it a creative atmosphere.
chinese.zh: 這座小鎮住滿了藝術家和特立獨行的人，讓它充滿創意氛圍。

english.en: He dresses in an eccentric style that makes him stand out.
english.zh: 他的穿著風格很古怪，讓他格外顯眼。

speak.en: I'd describe myself as slightly eccentric, but in a fun way.
speak.zh: 我會說自己有點怪，但是是有趣的那種怪。

write.en: Many great inventors were considered eccentric because their ideas seemed strange at the time.
write.zh: 許多偉大的發明家都曾被視為怪人，因為他們的想法在當時看來很奇怪。

example.en: After the scientists had exhausted every possible explanation, they finally admitted the results were simply an error.
example.zh: 科學家們試遍了所有可能的解釋後，終於承認那些結果只是個錯誤。

listen.en: I felt completely exhausted after the long flight home.
listen.zh: 長途飛行回家之後，我覺得筋疲力盡。

chinese.en: Exhaust fumes from heavy traffic are a major cause of air pollution in big cities.
chinese.zh: 繁忙車流排放的廢氣，是大城市空氣污染的主要原因。

english.en: We have exhausted our budget, so we cannot buy anything else.
english.zh: 我們的預算已經用完了，所以不能再買任何東西。

speak.en: Looking after my baby nephew all day really exhausts me.
speak.zh: 整天照顧還是嬰兒的姪子，真的讓我累壞了。

write.en: If we continue to exhaust natural resources at this rate, future generations will suffer.
write.zh: 如果我們繼續以這種速度耗盡自然資源，後代子孫將會受害。

example.en: Allowing one student to hand in work late would set a dangerous precedent, so the teacher refused every request.
example.zh: 讓一位學生遲交作業會開下危險的先例，所以老師拒絕了所有請求。

listen.en: There is no precedent for a storm this strong.
listen.zh: 這麼強的暴風雨是史無前例的。

chinese.en: The company broke with precedent by appointing a manager who had never worked in the industry.
chinese.zh: 這家公司打破慣例，任命了一位從未在該產業工作過的經理。

english.en: Her success has set a precedent for other young women in sport.
english.zh: 她的成功為其他投身運動的年輕女性開了先例。

speak.en: If I let my brother borrow my car, it'll set a precedent.
speak.zh: 如果我讓弟弟借我的車，就等於開了先例。

write.en: Historical precedents suggest that sudden tax increases often lead to a drop in consumer spending.
write.zh: 歷史上的前例顯示，突然加稅往往會導致消費支出下滑。

example.en: Because of the holiday, the teacher had to compress the whole unit into just a few lessons.
example.zh: 因為放假的關係，老師必須把整個單元壓縮在短短幾堂課內教完。

listen.en: The machine compresses old cans into small metal blocks.
listen.zh: 這台機器把舊鋁罐壓成小金屬塊。

chinese.en: Tyres are filled with compressed air, which allows them to support the weight of a car.
chinese.zh: 輪胎裡充滿壓縮空氣，因此能承受汽車的重量。

english.en: Try to compress your main ideas into a single paragraph.
english.zh: 試著把你的主要想法濃縮成一個段落。

speak.en: I usually compress all my revision into the last week, which isn't smart.
speak.zh: 我通常把所有複習都擠到最後一週，這樣其實不太聰明。

write.en: Modern technology has compressed the time it takes to share information across the world.
write.zh: 現代科技大幅縮短了在全球傳遞資訊所需的時間。

example.en: Instead of building an expensive new bridge, the engineers found an elegant solution: a simple ferry service.
example.zh: 工程師沒有興建昂貴的新橋，而是想出一個簡潔巧妙的辦法：開設簡單的渡輪服務。

listen.en: The hotel has an elegant lobby with marble floors.
listen.zh: 這家飯店有個鋪著大理石地板的優雅大廳。

chinese.en: The new phone has an elegant design, but it breaks easily if you drop it.
chinese.zh: 這款新手機設計很精緻，但一摔就容易壞。

english.en: My grandmother still writes all her letters in elegant handwriting.
english.zh: 我奶奶至今仍用優雅的字跡寫每一封信。

speak.en: I prefer simple but elegant clothes rather than anything too flashy.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡簡單但高雅的衣服，不喜歡太花俏的。

write.en: Some of the most elegant buildings in the city were designed over a century ago.
write.zh: 這座城市裡一些最典雅的建築，是在一百多年前設計的。

example.en: Without water or trees, the bleak landscape stretched for miles, and we didn't see another person all day.
example.zh: 沒有水也沒有樹，荒涼的景色綿延好幾英里，我們一整天都沒看到其他人。

listen.en: It was a cold and bleak winter morning.
listen.zh: 那是一個寒冷又陰沉的冬日早晨。

chinese.en: The report paints a bleak picture of the job market for recent graduates.
chinese.zh: 這份報告描繪出應屆畢業生就業市場的黯淡景象。

english.en: After losing his job, he felt his prospects were bleak.
english.zh: 失業之後，他覺得自己的前途一片黯淡。

speak.en: When I failed my driving test, things felt pretty bleak for a while.
speak.zh: 我駕照考試沒過的時候，有一陣子覺得很灰心。

write.en: Unless urgent action is taken, the outlook for many endangered species remains bleak.
write.zh: 除非立即採取行動，否則許多瀕危物種的前景依然黯淡。

example.en: Local people believe the empty castle is haunted, so very few of them dare to walk past it at night.
example.zh: 當地人相信那座空城堡鬧鬼，所以很少人敢在晚上經過。

listen.en: This little café was our favourite haunt as students.
listen.zh: 這間小咖啡館是我們學生時代最常去的地方。

chinese.en: Careless comments posted online when you are young can come back to haunt you later.
chinese.zh: 年輕時在網路上隨意發表的言論，日後可能會反過來困擾你。

english.en: He was haunted by the fear of failing his exams.
english.zh: 他一直被考試不及格的恐懼所困擾。

speak.en: That song always haunts me because it reminds me of my grandmother.
speak.zh: 那首歌總是在我心中揮之不去，因為它讓我想起奶奶。

write.en: Unsolved environmental problems will continue to haunt future generations if we ignore them now.
write.zh: 如果現在置之不理，尚未解決的環境問題將持續困擾後代子孫。

example.en: He always prefaces bad news with a joke, hoping to make the listener feel a little more relaxed.
example.zh: 他總是先說個笑話再宣布壞消息，希望讓聽的人稍微放鬆一點。

listen.en: I usually skip the preface and start reading the story.
listen.zh: 我通常會跳過序言，直接開始讀故事。

chinese.en: The speaker prefaced her talk by thanking the volunteers who had organised the event.
chinese.zh: 講者在演講一開始，先感謝籌辦這場活動的志工們。

english.en: The professor asked me to write a short preface for the report.
english.zh: 教授請我為這份報告寫一篇簡短的前言。

speak.en: I'd like to preface my answer by saying it's just my opinion.
speak.zh: 回答之前我想先說明，這只是我個人的看法。

write.en: The new edition includes a preface explaining how the city has changed since the book first appeared.
write.zh: 新版加了一篇序言，說明自本書初版問世以來，這座城市有了哪些變化。

example.en: After the new tax regime was introduced, many small businesses found they were paying far less each year.
example.zh: 新稅制實施後，許多小型企業發現他們每年繳的稅少了很多。

listen.en: My doctor suggested a gentle exercise regime for my back.
listen.zh: 醫生建議我做一套溫和的運動計畫來改善背部。

chinese.en: The school introduced a stricter safety regime after several students were injured in the lab.
chinese.zh: 幾名學生在實驗室受傷後，學校實施了更嚴格的安全制度。

english.en: The company changed its working regime to allow more flexible hours.
english.zh: 公司改變了工作制度，讓上班時間更有彈性。

speak.en: Honestly, my daily regime is just work, gym and sleep.
speak.zh: 老實說，我每天的作息就是上班、健身和睡覺。

write.en: Environmental groups are calling for a tougher regulatory regime to protect coastal waters.
write.zh: 環保團體呼籲建立更嚴格的管制體制來保護沿海水域。

example.en: The app was redesigned after users left negative feedback complaining that the menus were confusing and slow.
example.zh: 使用者留下負評、抱怨選單混亂又緩慢之後，這款應用程式便重新設計了。

listen.en: I would really appreciate your honest feedback on my talk.
listen.zh: 如果你能對我的演講給些真誠的意見，我會非常感謝。

chinese.en: The restaurant collects customer feedback every month to improve its menu and service.
chinese.zh: 這家餐廳每個月蒐集顧客意見，以改善菜單和服務。

english.en: My manager gave me some useful feedback after the meeting.
english.zh: 會議結束後，主管給了我一些有用的意見。

speak.en: I find constructive feedback really helpful, even when it's hard to hear.
speak.zh: 我覺得建設性的意見很有幫助，就算聽起來不太好受。

write.en: Regular feedback from patients helps hospitals identify problems before they become serious.
write.zh: 病患定期提供的意見，能幫助醫院在問題惡化前及早發現。

example.en: Patients who had been through the earthquake were offered psychiatric support to help them cope with lasting anxiety.
example.zh: 經歷過地震的病患獲得精神科協助，幫助他們面對揮之不去的焦慮。

listen.en: He was referred to a psychiatric clinic near his home.
listen.zh: 他被轉介到住家附近的一間精神科診所。

chinese.en: Many people still feel embarrassed about seeking psychiatric help, although attitudes are slowly changing.
chinese.zh: 雖然觀念正慢慢改變，許多人仍對尋求精神科協助感到難為情。

english.en: The government plans to build more psychiatric hospitals in rural areas.
english.zh: 政府計畫在鄉村地區興建更多精神科醫院。

speak.en: I think psychiatric care should be as easy to access as any other treatment.
speak.zh: 我認為精神科照護應該和其他治療一樣容易取得。

write.en: Medical students spend several weeks on a psychiatric ward as part of their training.
write.zh: 醫學生的訓練包括在精神科病房實習數週。

example.en: The cold wind seemed to penetrate every layer of clothing we wore as we climbed the exposed ridge.
example.zh: 我們爬上毫無遮蔽的山脊時，寒風彷彿穿透了身上每一層衣服。

listen.en: The rain had penetrated the roof and soaked the carpet.
listen.zh: 雨水滲進屋頂，把地毯都浸濕了。

chinese.en: Foreign brands have found it difficult to penetrate the local market for instant noodles.
chinese.zh: 外國品牌發現很難打入本地的泡麵市場。

english.en: This cream penetrates the skin quickly and keeps it soft.
english.zh: 這款乳霜能迅速滲入肌膚，保持柔嫩。

speak.en: To be honest, it took a while for the news to really penetrate.
speak.zh: 老實說，我過了好一陣子才真正意會到這個消息。

write.en: Researchers developed a drug small enough to penetrate the brain's natural protective barrier.
write.zh: 研究人員研發出一種藥物，分子小到能穿過大腦天然的保護屏障。

example.en: His habit of tapping his pen during meetings began to grate on everyone, and eventually someone asked him to stop.
example.zh: 他開會時用筆敲桌的習慣開始讓大家心煩，最後終於有人請他別再敲了。

listen.en: She grated a carrot and added it to the salad.
listen.zh: 她把紅蘿蔔刨成絲，加進沙拉裡。

chinese.en: The old gate grated loudly against the stone path whenever anyone opened it.
chinese.zh: 每次有人打開那扇舊門，它就在石板路上刮出刺耳的聲音。

english.en: Add the finely grated lemon peel to the cake mixture.
english.zh: 把磨得很細的檸檬皮加進蛋糕麵糊裡。

speak.en: That song grates on me after a while, so I usually skip it.
speak.zh: 那首歌聽久了會讓我很煩，所以我通常直接跳過。

write.en: Workers fitted a heavy iron grate over the drain to stop leaves blocking it.
write.zh: 工人在排水溝上裝了一個沉重的鐵格柵，以免落葉堵住水溝。

example.en: The cyclist weaved through the crowded streets, slipping between buses and taxis to reach the office on time.
example.zh: 那名單車騎士在擁擠的街道上穿梭，鑽過公車和計程車之間，準時抵達辦公室。

listen.en: These rugs are woven by hand in small mountain villages.
listen.zh: 這些地毯是在小山村裡手工編織的。

chinese.en: The author cleverly weaves local legends into a modern story about family and loss.
chinese.zh: 作者巧妙地把地方傳說融入一個關於家庭與失去的現代故事。

english.en: The spider wove a delicate web across the window overnight.
english.zh: 蜘蛛一夜之間在窗戶上織了一張精巧的網。

speak.en: I love weaving my own experiences into the stories I tell.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡把自己的經歷編進我講的故事裡。

write.en: The factory still weaves cotton cloth on machines that are over a century old.
write.zh: 這間工廠至今仍用超過百年的機器織造棉布。

example.en: Many road accidents are caused by driver fatigue, which is why lorry drivers must take regular breaks on long journeys.
example.zh: 許多車禍是駕駛疲勞造成的，所以貨車司機長途行車時必須定時休息。

listen.en: After the flight, I was overcome by fatigue and fell asleep.
listen.zh: 下了飛機後，我累得不行，就睡著了。

chinese.en: Students often experience mental fatigue during exam season, so short breaks are essential.
chinese.zh: 考試期間學生常感到精神疲勞，所以短暫休息是不可或缺的。

english.en: Fatigue is a common side effect of this new medicine.
english.zh: 疲倦是這種新藥常見的副作用。

speak.en: By Friday I'm usually so fatigued that I just stay in.
speak.zh: 到了星期五我通常累到只想待在家。

write.en: Charities worry that donor fatigue will reduce support for the next disaster appeal.
write.zh: 慈善團體擔心捐款人的倦怠感，會讓下一次賑災募款得到的支持減少。

example.en: Before travelling to the region, visitors are advised to take tablets that protect them against malaria, a disease carried by mosquitoes.
example.zh: 前往該地區之前，旅客最好服用預防瘧疾的藥錠，這是一種由蚊子傳播的疾病。

listen.en: He caught malaria while working on a farm abroad.
listen.zh: 他在國外農場工作時感染了瘧疾。

chinese.en: Sleeping under treated nets has greatly reduced the number of malaria cases in rural areas.
chinese.zh: 睡在經藥劑處理的蚊帳裡，已大幅減少鄉村地區的瘧疾病例。

english.en: Scientists are working on a new vaccine to fight malaria.
english.zh: 科學家正在研發一種對抗瘧疾的新疫苗。

speak.en: I had no idea malaria was still such a serious problem today.
speak.zh: 我完全不知道瘧疾到現在還是這麼嚴重的問題。

write.en: Rising temperatures may allow malaria to spread into areas that were previously too cold for mosquitoes.
write.zh: 氣溫上升可能讓瘧疾擴散到以前對蚊子來說太冷的地區。

example.en: The garden slopes gently down to the lake, so rainwater naturally drains away from the house.
example.zh: 花園緩緩向湖邊傾斜，所以雨水會自然地從房子流走。

listen.en: We spent the whole afternoon on the ski slopes.
listen.zh: 我們整個下午都待在滑雪坡道上。

chinese.en: Farmers in the mountains grow tea on steep slopes that are difficult to reach.
chinese.zh: 山區的農民在難以到達的陡坡上種茶。

english.en: The road slopes sharply near the school, so please drive slowly.
english.zh: 學校附近的路坡度很陡，請放慢車速。

speak.en: My desk slopes a bit, so my pens keep rolling off.
speak.zh: 我的桌子有點斜，筆一直滾下去。

write.en: Critics warn that relaxing the rules could put the country on a slippery slope.
write.zh: 批評者警告，放寬規定可能讓國家走上一發不可收拾的路。

example.en: Rather than dwelling on the team's defeat, the coach focused on what the players could improve before the next match.
example.zh: 教練沒有一直糾結於球隊的敗仗，而是專注在球員下一場比賽前能改進的地方。

listen.en: These tiny creatures dwell in the deepest parts of the ocean.
listen.zh: 這些微小的生物棲息在海洋最深處。

chinese.en: The report dwells on the costs of the project but says little about its benefits.
chinese.zh: 這份報告著墨於計畫的成本，卻很少提到它的好處。

english.en: She doesn't like to dwell on her difficult childhood in public.
english.zh: 她不喜歡在公開場合多談自己艱苦的童年。

speak.en: I used to dwell on bad exam results, but not anymore.
speak.zh: 我以前會一直在意考不好的成績，現在不會了。

write.en: Ancient peoples dwelt in caves along this valley for thousands of years.
write.zh: 古代民族在這座山谷的洞穴裡居住了數千年。

example.en: The advertisement tries to persuade viewers that the drink is healthy, but it actually contains a lot of sugar.
example.zh: 這則廣告試圖讓觀眾相信這款飲料很健康，但它其實含有大量的糖。

listen.en: Nothing could persuade him to change his mind.
listen.zh: 什麼都無法說服他改變心意。

chinese.en: The council is trying to persuade residents to use public transport instead of driving.
chinese.zh: 市議會正努力說服居民搭乘大眾運輸，而不是開車。

english.en: My friend persuaded me to join the school drama club.
english.zh: 朋友說服我加入學校的戲劇社。

speak.en: I'm not easily persuaded by online reviews, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不太容易被網路評論說動。

write.en: Our manager persuaded the client that a smaller budget would still deliver good results.
write.zh: 我們經理讓客戶相信，較少的預算仍然能做出好成果。

example.en: After the final votes were counted, the student union candidate conceded defeat and congratulated his opponent.
example.zh: 最後的選票開完後，那位學生會候選人承認落敗，並向對手道賀。

listen.en: Our team conceded a goal in the final minute.
listen.zh: 我們隊在最後一分鐘失了一球。

chinese.en: The company conceded that its product had been released before it was fully tested.
chinese.zh: 公司承認產品在完成全面測試之前就推出了。

english.en: I have to concede that your idea is better than mine.
english.zh: 我得承認你的點子比我的好。

speak.en: Okay, I'll concede the point, but I still disagree overall.
speak.zh: 好吧，這一點我讓步，但整體來說我還是不同意。

write.en: The landowners eventually agreed to concede part of their land for a new public park.
write.zh: 地主最後同意讓出部分土地，興建新的公園。

example.en: The architects chose natural wood and soft lighting for purely aesthetic reasons, since these materials cost more but look warmer.
example.zh: 建築師純粹基於美感選用原木和柔和燈光，因為這些材料雖然較貴，看起來卻更溫暖。

listen.en: Her designs have a clean and simple aesthetic.
listen.zh: 她的設計有一種簡潔俐落的風格。

chinese.en: Some people choose a phone mainly for its aesthetic appeal rather than its features.
chinese.zh: 有些人選手機主要是看外型美不美，而不是看功能。

english.en: The city wants new buildings to meet higher aesthetic standards.
english.zh: 市政府希望新建築符合更高的美學標準。

speak.en: I really like the cafe's cosy aesthetic; it feels like home.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡那家咖啡廳溫馨的風格，感覺像在家一樣。

write.en: Art classes help children develop an aesthetic sense that stays with them for life.
write.zh: 美術課幫助孩子培養一輩子受用的審美能力。

example.en: To find last year's sales report, open the shared folder on the server and look under the finance section.
example.zh: 要找去年的銷售報告，就打開伺服器上的共用資料夾，在財務那一區找。

listen.en: Please save the document in the project folder.
listen.zh: 請把文件存到專案資料夾裡。

chinese.en: The teacher handed each student a folder containing the reading materials for the course.
chinese.zh: 老師發給每位學生一個文件夾，裡面有這門課的閱讀資料。

english.en: I created a new folder on my laptop for holiday photos.
english.zh: 我在筆電上建了一個新資料夾來放旅遊照片。

speak.en: My desktop is a mess; I really need to sort my folders.
speak.zh: 我的電腦桌面亂七八糟，真的得整理一下資料夾了。

write.en: Job applicants were asked to bring a folder of their best work to the interview.
write.zh: 求職者被要求帶一份收錄自己最佳作品的資料夾來面試。

example.en: The plan to close the village school met vigorous opposition from parents, who organised meetings and wrote to local newspapers.
example.zh: 關閉村裡小學的計畫遭到家長強烈反對，他們召開會議，還投書地方報紙。

listen.en: The class had a vigorous debate about online privacy.
listen.zh: 全班針對網路隱私進行了一場激烈的辯論。

chinese.en: After a vigorous walk up the hill, we stopped to enjoy the view of the city.
chinese.zh: 我們快步爬上山丘後，停下來欣賞城市的景色。

english.en: Give the bottle a vigorous shake before you use it.
english.zh: 使用前請用力搖一搖瓶子。

speak.en: My grandfather is still really vigorous for someone his age.
speak.zh: 以我爺爺的年紀來說，他還是非常精力充沛。

write.en: With plenty of sunlight and water, the young trees showed vigorous growth this spring.
write.zh: 在充足的陽光和水分下，這些小樹今年春天長得十分茂盛。

example.en: Because the apartment faces north, it gets very little sunlight, so the plants by the window grow slowly.
example.zh: 因為這間公寓朝北，照不太到陽光，所以窗邊的植物長得很慢。

listen.en: The lake sparkled in the bright morning sunlight.
listen.zh: 湖面在明亮的晨光中閃閃發亮。

chinese.en: Our bodies need sunlight to produce vitamin D, which keeps our bones strong.
chinese.zh: 我們的身體需要陽光來製造維生素 D，讓骨骼保持強健。

english.en: Too much sunlight can seriously damage your skin and eyes.
english.zh: 過多的陽光會嚴重傷害你的皮膚和眼睛。

speak.en: I study better in a room with lots of natural sunlight.
speak.zh: 我在自然光充足的房間裡讀書效果比較好。

write.en: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity, reducing households' dependence on fossil fuels.
write.zh: 太陽能板把陽光轉換成電力，減少家庭對化石燃料的依賴。

example.en: The neighbours were making such a racket upstairs that I couldn't hear the television, so I went up to complain.
example.zh: 樓上鄰居吵得我連電視都聽不到，所以我上樓去抗議。

listen.en: She swung her racket and hit the ball over the net.
listen.zh: 她揮拍把球打過網。

chinese.en: The school provides rackets for students who cannot afford their own equipment.
chinese.zh: 學校為買不起裝備的學生提供球拍。

english.en: Please stop making a racket; your sister is trying to sleep.
english.zh: 拜託別再吵了，你妹妹正在睡覺。

speak.en: My tennis racket is pretty old, but I'm attached to it.
speak.zh: 我的網球拍滿舊的，但我對它很有感情。

write.en: Engineers are designing lighter rackets that reduce strain on players' wrists and elbows.
write.zh: 工程師正在設計更輕的球拍，以減輕球員手腕和手肘的負擔。

example.en: Group projects are meant to facilitate learning, but they only work when every member actually contributes to the task.
example.zh: 分組報告的用意是促進學習，但只有每個組員都真正出力時才有效果。

listen.en: A friendly host can facilitate conversation among strangers.
listen.zh: 親切的主人能讓陌生人之間更容易聊開。

chinese.en: Online booking systems have greatly facilitated the process of reserving tables at restaurants.
chinese.zh: 線上訂位系統讓餐廳訂位變得方便許多。

english.en: Good lighting in classrooms facilitates reading and reduces eye strain.
english.zh: 教室裡良好的照明有助於閱讀，並減少眼睛疲勞。

speak.en: I'm facilitating the team workshop tomorrow, so I'm a bit nervous.
speak.zh: 明天的團隊工作坊由我主持，所以我有點緊張。

write.en: Governments should do more to facilitate access to clean water in remote communities.
write.zh: 政府應該更努力讓偏遠社區更容易取得乾淨的水。

example.en: After complaints about greasy food, the company hired a new chef to make the staff canteen healthier and more varied.
example.zh: 員工抱怨餐點太油之後，公司請了一位新廚師，讓員工餐廳的菜色更健康、更多樣。

listen.en: The canteen gets really crowded just after midday.
listen.zh: 中午過後餐廳就會變得非常擁擠。

chinese.en: Many universities now offer vegetarian options in their canteens to meet student demand.
chinese.zh: 現在許多大學的餐廳都提供素食選項，以滿足學生的需求。

english.en: The hikers filled their canteens with water from the stream.
english.zh: 登山客用溪水把水壺裝滿。

speak.en: Honestly, the food in our office canteen isn't too bad.
speak.zh: 說真的，我們公司餐廳的東西還不算太差。

write.en: Some schools have banned sugary drinks from their canteens to tackle childhood obesity.
write.zh: 有些學校禁止餐廳販售含糖飲料，以對抗兒童肥胖問題。

example.en: She spent ages thinking of a funny caption for her holiday photo before finally posting it online.
example.zh: 她想了好久，才為旅遊照想出一句有趣的說明，最後終於貼上網。

listen.en: Turn on the captions if you cannot hear the speaker.
listen.zh: 如果聽不清楚講者說話，就把字幕打開。

chinese.en: Adding captions to online videos makes them accessible to viewers with hearing difficulties.
chinese.zh: 為網路影片加上字幕，能讓聽力有障礙的觀眾也能觀看。

english.en: Each chart in your report should have a short, clear caption.
english.zh: 報告裡的每張圖表都應該附上簡短清楚的說明。

speak.en: I always read the captions on museum displays really carefully.
speak.zh: 我總是很仔細地讀博物館展品旁的說明文字。

write.en: The newspaper photo was captioned with the wrong name, so the editor issued a correction.
write.zh: 報紙上那張照片的說明寫錯了名字，所以編輯刊登了更正啟事。

example.en: Police finally solved the mystery of the missing paintings when a cleaner found them hidden behind a wall.
example.zh: 一名清潔工在牆後發現被藏起來的畫作，警方才終於解開名畫失蹤之謎。

listen.en: My brother loves solving puzzles on long train journeys.
listen.zh: 我哥哥喜歡在長途火車上解謎題。

chinese.en: Building more roads will not solve traffic congestion; it often just attracts more cars.
chinese.zh: 多蓋道路並不能解決交通壅塞，反而常常只會吸引更多車輛。

english.en: Could you help me solve this tricky maths problem after class?
english.zh: 下課後你可以幫我解這道很難的數學題嗎？

speak.en: Talking things through usually solves most arguments in my family.
speak.zh: 在我家，把話說開通常就能解決大部分的爭執。

write.en: Engineers solved the overheating issue by redesigning the cooling fan inside the laptop.
write.zh: 工程師重新設計筆電內部的散熱風扇，解決了過熱的問題。

example.en: When he opened the envelope and saw the acceptance letter, he exclaimed with delight and hugged his mother.
example.zh: 他打開信封看到錄取通知時，高興地大叫，還抱住了媽媽。

listen.en: The children exclaimed in surprise when the magician vanished.
listen.zh: 魔術師消失時，孩子們驚訝地叫了出來。

chinese.en: Visitors often exclaim at how clean the streets are compared with their own cities.
chinese.zh: 遊客常驚嘆這裡的街道比他們自己的城市乾淨得多。

english.en: "That's not fair!" the boy exclaimed when his turn was skipped.
english.zh: 輪到他時卻被跳過，那男孩大喊：「這不公平！」

speak.en: My mum always exclaims about how tall I've grown.
speak.zh: 我媽總是驚呼我長得好高。

write.en: Several critics exclaimed that the new museum was the boldest building in the country.
write.zh: 好幾位評論家讚嘆，這座新博物館是全國最大膽的建築。

example.en: Whenever the river floods, the lowest streets are invariably the first to go under water, forcing residents to move upstairs.
example.zh: 每當河水氾濫，地勢最低的街道總是最先被淹，居民只好搬到樓上。

listen.en: Her answers in class are invariably thoughtful and clear.
listen.zh: 她在課堂上的回答總是深思熟慮又清楚。

chinese.en: Cutting the research budget almost invariably leads to slower progress in medicine.
chinese.zh: 刪減研究經費幾乎無一例外會讓醫學進展變慢。

english.en: My grandfather invariably falls asleep in front of the television.
english.zh: 我爺爺每次都會在電視機前睡著。

speak.en: Whenever I cook pasta, I invariably make far too much.
speak.zh: 我每次煮義大利麵，都一定會煮太多。

write.en: Our team meetings invariably run over time because nobody sticks to the agenda.
write.zh: 我們的團隊會議總是超時，因為沒有人照議程走。

example.en: Only a few hardy hikers continued to the summit, while the rest turned back because of the strong wind and snow.
example.zh: 只有少數體力強健的登山客繼續攻頂，其他人則因強風和大雪而折返。

listen.en: Mountain goats are hardy animals that live on steep cliffs.
listen.zh: 山羊是生活在陡峭懸崖上、適應力很強的動物。

chinese.en: Farmers are switching to hardier crops that can cope with longer periods of drought.
chinese.zh: 農民正改種更耐旱的作物，以因應更長的乾旱期。

english.en: My grandmother is a hardy woman who rarely gets ill.
english.zh: 我奶奶身體強健，很少生病。

speak.en: I kill every plant I own, so I only buy really hardy ones.
speak.zh: 我養什麼植物都會死，所以只買生命力超強的那種。

write.en: Those hardy enough to queue overnight were rewarded with the best seats at the concert.
write.zh: 那些撐得住通宵排隊的人，最後拿到了演唱會最好的座位。

example.en: Instead of locking up young criminals, some countries send them on training programmes that teach practical skills for future employment.
example.zh: 有些國家不把年輕罪犯關起來，而是讓他們參加職業訓練，學習將來就業用得到的實用技能。

listen.en: Selling fake medicine is a serious criminal offence.
listen.zh: 販賣假藥是嚴重的刑事犯罪。

chinese.en: She studied criminal law at university before becoming a judge in her hometown.
chinese.zh: 她大學時主修刑法，後來在家鄉當上法官。

english.en: The police finally caught the criminal who stole the bikes.
english.zh: 警方終於抓到偷腳踏車的犯人。

speak.en: Honestly, it's criminal to throw away so much good food.
speak.zh: 說真的，把這麼多好好的食物丟掉實在太不像話了。

write.en: Some experts argue that the criminal justice system should focus more on rehabilitation.
write.zh: 有些專家主張，刑事司法體系應該更著重於矯正與更生。

example.en: Fortunately, tests showed that the tumour was benign, meaning it was not cancer and would not spread to other organs.
example.zh: 幸好檢查顯示腫瘤是良性的，也就是說它不是癌症，也不會擴散到其他器官。

listen.en: The doctor found a small tumour during a routine scan.
listen.zh: 醫生在例行掃描時發現了一個小腫瘤。

chinese.en: Researchers are testing a new drug that may slow the growth of brain tumours.
chinese.zh: 研究人員正在測試一種可能減緩腦瘤生長的新藥。

english.en: Early detection makes most tumours much easier to treat successfully.
english.zh: 及早發現能讓大多數腫瘤更容易治療成功。

speak.en: My aunt had a tumour removed last year, and she's fine now.
speak.zh: 我阿姨去年切除了一顆腫瘤，現在已經沒事了。

write.en: Vets noticed a tumour on the dog's leg and recommended surgery as soon as possible.
write.zh: 獸醫發現狗的腿上長了腫瘤，建議盡快動手術。

example.en: The architects envisage a car-free town centre, where people walk or cycle between shops, parks and offices.
example.zh: 建築師構想一個沒有汽車的市中心，人們步行或騎單車往來於商店、公園和辦公室之間。

listen.en: Nobody envisaged that the project would become so popular.
listen.zh: 沒有人料到這個計畫會這麼受歡迎。

chinese.en: It is envisaged that the new hospital will open to patients by the end of next year.
chinese.zh: 新醫院預計在明年底前開始收治病患。

english.en: What kind of career do you envisage for yourself after graduation?
english.zh: 你設想自己畢業後從事什麼樣的工作？

speak.en: When I was a kid, I envisaged myself as a famous chef.
speak.zh: 我小時候想像自己會成為知名主廚。

write.en: The renovation cost far more than anyone had envisaged when the work began.
write.zh: 這次整修的花費遠遠超出開工時任何人的預期。

example.en: The castle once belonged to a family of the local nobility, who owned most of the farmland in the valley.
example.zh: 這座城堡曾屬於當地一個貴族家族，山谷裡大部分的農地都是他們的。

listen.en: Members of the nobility often lived in large country houses.
listen.zh: 貴族成員往往住在鄉間的大宅邸裡。

chinese.en: The nurse showed great nobility of character by caring for patients without asking for thanks.
chinese.zh: 那位護理師照顧病人從不求回報，展現了高尚的品格。

english.en: The museum displays jewellery that was once worn by the nobility.
english.zh: 博物館展出曾經由貴族配戴的珠寶。

speak.en: I think there's real nobility in quietly helping others.
speak.zh: 我覺得默默幫助別人是很高尚的事。

write.en: Historians study how the power of the nobility declined as trade and cities grew.
write.zh: 歷史學家研究貴族的權力如何隨著貿易與城市的發展而衰退。

example.en: The unusual geology of the coastline, with its layers of red and grey rock, attracts scientists from around the world.
example.zh: 這段海岸線的地質很特別，紅色與灰色岩層交疊，吸引了世界各地的科學家前來。

listen.en: Our geology teacher took us to see ancient volcanic rocks.
listen.zh: 我們的地質學老師帶我們去看古老的火山岩。

chinese.en: Engineers must understand the local geology before building a tunnel through the mountain.
chinese.zh: 工程師在開鑿穿山隧道前，必須先了解當地的地質。

english.en: Taiwan's geology makes earthquakes fairly common across the whole island.
english.zh: 臺灣的地質使得全島地震相當頻繁。

speak.en: I never expected geology to be so interesting until I tried it.
speak.zh: 我真正接觸地質學之前，從沒想過它這麼有趣。

write.en: Mining companies hire experts in geology to locate valuable minerals beneath the surface.
write.zh: 礦業公司聘請地質專家，尋找地底下有價值的礦物。

example.en: The building's southern orientation means the living room receives warm sunlight for most of the day, even in winter.
example.zh: 這棟房子坐北朝南，所以即使在冬天，客廳大半天都曬得到溫暖的陽光。

listen.en: I made most of my friends during orientation week.
listen.zh: 我大部分的朋友都是在新生訓練週認識的。

chinese.en: The company is shifting its orientation from local sales towards international markets.
chinese.zh: 這家公司正把經營方向從本地銷售轉向國際市場。

english.en: New employees receive a short orientation before they start work.
english.zh: 新進員工在開始上班前會接受簡短的職前說明。

speak.en: My course has a very practical orientation, which I really like.
speak.zh: 我念的課程非常偏重實務，這點我很喜歡。

write.en: Schools with a strong community orientation often involve parents in planning local projects.
write.zh: 重視社區參與的學校，常會邀請家長一起規劃地方活動。

example.en: Besides a good salary, the job offers fringe benefits such as free lunches, a gym membership and extra holidays.
example.zh: 除了優渥的薪水，這份工作還有附加福利，例如免費午餐、健身房會員和額外假期。

listen.en: I think I need to get my fringe trimmed soon.
listen.zh: 我想我得趕快去修一下瀏海了。

chinese.en: What began as a fringe idea is now supported by many mainstream scientists.
chinese.zh: 這個原本被視為非主流的想法，現在已獲得許多主流科學家支持。

english.en: The old scarf has a long fringe at each end.
english.zh: 這條舊圍巾的兩端都有長長的流蘇。

speak.en: The fringe festival in our city is honestly the highlight of summer.
speak.zh: 說真的，我們城市的藝穗節是整個夏天最精彩的活動。

write.en: Low-income families are often pushed to the fringes of the city as rents rise.
write.zh: 隨著房租上漲，低收入家庭常被迫搬到城市邊緣。

example.en: Rather than crowding the main text with tables, the author placed all the raw data in a separate appendix at the back.
example.zh: 作者沒有把表格塞進正文，而是把所有原始數據放在書末的獨立附錄裡。

listen.en: He had his appendix removed when he was a teenager.
listen.zh: 他青少年時割過盲腸。

chinese.en: My sister was rushed to hospital last night because her appendix had burst.
chinese.zh: 我妹妹昨晚因為盲腸破裂被緊急送醫。

english.en: Please put your interview transcripts in the appendices of your thesis.
english.zh: 請把你的訪談逐字稿放在論文的附錄裡。

speak.en: Honestly, nobody ever reads the appendix of a textbook, do they?
speak.zh: 說真的，根本沒人會看課本的附錄吧？

write.en: The government report includes an appendix comparing air quality in different cities.
write.zh: 這份政府報告附有一份比較各城市空氣品質的附錄。

example.en: According to the chart, coffee sales rose steadily and eventually overtook tea sales by the end of the decade.
example.zh: 根據圖表，咖啡銷量穩定成長，到了這十年的末期終於超越了茶的銷量。

listen.en: Never overtake another car on a sharp bend.
listen.zh: 絕對不要在急轉彎處超車。

chinese.en: Our original plans were overtaken by events when the typhoon closed all the roads.
chinese.zh: 颱風導致所有道路封閉，我們原本的計畫就這樣被打亂了。

english.en: The young runner overtook her rivals in the final lap.
english.zh: 那位年輕跑者在最後一圈超越了對手。

speak.en: Halfway through the exam, a wave of panic suddenly overtook me.
speak.zh: 考試考到一半，我突然一陣恐慌。

write.en: Experts predict that renewable energy will soon overtake coal as the country's main power source.
write.zh: 專家預測，再生能源很快就會超越煤炭，成為該國的主要電力來源。

example.en: Because the new alloy is both lighter and stronger than steel, aircraft makers are keen to use it in wings.
example.zh: 因為這種新合金比鋼更輕也更堅固，飛機製造商很想把它用在機翼上。

listen.en: This bicycle frame is made from a light alloy.
listen.zh: 這個腳踏車車架是用輕合金做的。

chinese.en: The engineering students tested how different alloys reacted to extreme heat in the laboratory.
chinese.zh: 工程系學生在實驗室測試不同合金在極高溫下的反應。

english.en: My dad replaced the old wheels on his car with alloy ones.
english.zh: 我爸把車子的舊輪框換成了鋁合金輪框。

speak.en: I didn't realise most coins are made from cheap alloys.
speak.zh: 我之前都不知道大部分硬幣是用便宜的合金做的。

write.en: Recycling metal alloys from old phones could reduce the need for new mining.
write.zh: 回收舊手機裡的金屬合金，可以減少開採新礦的需求。

example.en: The doctor recommended gentle exercise, such as walking or swimming, instead of running while his knee recovered.
example.zh: 醫生建議他在膝蓋復原期間做散步或游泳等和緩的運動，而不要跑步。

listen.en: A gentle breeze was blowing across the beach this evening.
listen.zh: 今晚海灘上吹著徐徐微風。

chinese.en: The path rises in a gentle slope, so even young children can walk to the top.
chinese.zh: 這條步道坡度平緩，連小朋友都能走到頂端。

english.en: My manager sent me a gentle reminder about the deadline.
english.zh: 主管委婉地提醒我截止日期快到了。

speak.en: My grandmother had such a gentle voice; I still miss it.
speak.zh: 我奶奶的聲音好溫柔，我到現在還很想念。

write.en: Teachers who use a gentle approach often find shy students participate more in class.
write.zh: 採取溫和方式的老師常發現，害羞的學生在課堂上會更積極參與。

example.en: Workers in the garment factory complained that they had to sew clothes for twelve hours a day with few breaks.
example.zh: 成衣工廠的工人抱怨，他們每天得縫衣服十二個小時，幾乎沒有休息。

listen.en: Please check the label before washing any woollen garment.
listen.zh: 清洗任何羊毛衣物前，請先看一下標籤。

chinese.en: The garment industry produces huge amounts of waste, much of which ends up in landfills.
chinese.zh: 成衣產業製造大量廢棄物，其中很多最後都進了掩埋場。

english.en: The museum displays traditional garments from different regions of Taiwan.
english.zh: 博物館展出臺灣各地的傳統服飾。

speak.en: Every garment I own seems to shrink after a few washes.
speak.zh: 我的每件衣服好像洗沒幾次就縮水了。

write.en: Designers are creating garments from recycled plastic bottles to reduce environmental damage.
write.zh: 設計師正用回收的塑膠瓶製作衣服，以減少對環境的破壞。

example.en: The letters had been in her family's possession for generations before she finally donated them to the national museum.
example.zh: 這些信件在她家族手中保存了好幾代，最後她才把它們捐給國家博物館。

listen.en: This old guitar is my most prized possession.
listen.zh: 這把舊吉他是我最珍貴的寶物。

chinese.en: The new owners will take possession of the apartment at the beginning of next month.
chinese.zh: 新屋主將在下個月初接手這間公寓。

english.en: Please keep your personal possessions with you at all times.
english.zh: 請隨時將個人物品帶在身邊。

speak.en: I think people today care far too much about material possessions.
speak.zh: 我覺得現代人太在乎物質上的東西了。

write.en: Our team kept possession of the ball for most of the second half.
write.zh: 下半場大部分時間球都掌握在我們隊手上。

example.en: Some medicines interact dangerously with alcohol, so patients are warned not to drink while taking them.
example.zh: 有些藥物和酒精會產生危險的交互作用，因此病人會被提醒服藥期間不要喝酒。

listen.en: Visitors can interact with the robots in this museum.
listen.zh: 參觀者可以在這間博物館和機器人互動。

chinese.en: Remote workers often miss the chance to interact with colleagues face to face.
chinese.zh: 遠端工作者常錯失和同事面對面交流的機會。

english.en: Our teacher wants us to interact more during group discussions.
english.zh: 老師希望我們在小組討論時多互動。

speak.en: I love working in a café because I interact with so many people.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡在咖啡廳工作，因為可以和很多人互動。

write.en: Scientists are studying how rising temperatures and pollution interact to harm coral reefs.
write.zh: 科學家正在研究氣溫上升與污染如何交互作用、危害珊瑚礁。

example.en: Despite years of research, the question of what makes people truly happy remains an eternal mystery for psychologists.
example.zh: 儘管研究多年，「什麼讓人真正快樂」對心理學家來說仍是一個永恆的謎。

listen.en: My uncle is an eternal optimist who never gives up.
listen.zh: 我叔叔是個永遠樂觀、從不放棄的人。

chinese.en: Advertisers often promise eternal youth, but no cream can stop the natural process of ageing.
chinese.zh: 廣告常標榜青春永駐，但沒有任何乳霜能阻止自然老化。

english.en: I'm tired of my roommate's eternal complaints about the noise.
english.zh: 我受夠了室友沒完沒了地抱怨噪音。

speak.en: Balancing work and family is an eternal struggle for most parents I know.
speak.zh: 對我認識的大多數父母來說，兼顧工作和家庭是永遠的難題。

write.en: The ancient city seemed eternal, yet rising sea levels now threaten its streets.
write.zh: 這座古城看似永恆不朽，如今海平面上升卻威脅著它的街道。

example.en: The novel first appeared as a weekly serial in a magazine, so readers waited a whole week for each new chapter.
example.zh: 這部小說最初在雜誌上每週連載，所以讀者每一章都得等上整整一週。

listen.en: My grandparents never miss their favourite radio serial.
listen.zh: 我爺爺奶奶從不錯過他們最愛的廣播連續劇。

chinese.en: She is a serial entrepreneur who has started several successful companies in the food industry.
chinese.zh: 她是一位連續創業家，已在餐飲業創立好幾家成功的公司。

english.en: The police checked the serial numbers of the stolen laptops.
english.zh: 警方核對了失竊筆電的序號。

speak.en: I'm a bit of a serial snacker when I'm studying late.
speak.zh: 我熬夜讀書時，會一直忍不住吃零食。

write.en: Local television once produced popular serials that families watched together every evening.
write.zh: 本地電視台過去曾製作許多受歡迎的連續劇，讓全家人每晚一起收看。

example.en: After weeks of careful work, experts managed to restore the damaged painting to its original colours.
example.zh: 經過數週的細心工作，專家終於把受損的畫作修復回原本的色彩。

listen.en: Power was restored to the whole town by evening.
listen.zh: 到了傍晚，全鎮的電力已經恢復。

chinese.en: The government must act quickly to restore public trust after the data leak.
chinese.zh: 資料外洩事件後，政府必須迅速行動，恢復民眾的信任。

english.en: A good night's sleep can help restore your energy after a long week.
english.zh: 一夜好眠可以幫助你在漫長的一週後恢復精力。

speak.en: Honestly, a quiet weekend in the countryside really restores me.
speak.zh: 老實說，在鄉下度過一個安靜的週末真的能讓我恢復元氣。

write.en: Police were sent to restore order after the football match ended in chaos.
write.zh: 足球比賽在一片混亂中結束後，警方被派去恢復秩序。

example.en: When the heavy lorries passed, the windows in the old flat began to vibrate noisily.
example.zh: 重型卡車經過時，那間老公寓的窗戶開始嘎嘎作響地震動。

listen.en: The floor began to vibrate as the train went past.
listen.zh: 火車經過時，地板開始震動。

chinese.en: Sound is produced when an object vibrates and sends waves through the air.
chinese.zh: 物體振動並在空氣中傳出聲波時，就會產生聲音。

english.en: Please set your phone to vibrate before the lecture starts.
english.zh: 請在講座開始前把手機調成震動。

speak.en: I love concerts where the music is so loud the ground vibrates.
speak.zh: 我喜歡那種音樂大聲到地面都在震動的演唱會。

write.en: The guitar strings vibrate at different speeds, which is what creates different notes.
write.zh: 吉他弦以不同的速度振動，這就是產生不同音高的原因。

example.en: Since the manager is retiring in June, the company has started looking for a suitable replacement.
example.zh: 由於經理六月就要退休，公司已開始物色合適的接替人選。

listen.en: We need a replacement for the old printer.
listen.zh: 我們需要一台新印表機來替換舊的。

chinese.en: Online classes can be useful, but they are not a complete replacement for face-to-face teaching.
chinese.zh: 線上課程或許有用，但無法完全取代面對面的教學。

english.en: The replacement of old buses with electric ones will reduce pollution.
english.zh: 把舊公車換成電動公車將會減少污染。

speak.en: If I lost my phone, finding a replacement would be really stressful.
speak.zh: 如果我把手機弄丟了，要找支新的來替代會讓我壓力很大。

write.en: The factory keeps replacement parts in stock so that repairs never take long.
write.zh: 工廠備有替換零件的庫存，因此維修從不會拖很久。

example.en: Historians still debate the causes of the assassination, which led to years of conflict across the region.
example.zh: 歷史學家至今仍在爭論這起暗殺事件的起因，而它導致了該地區多年的衝突。

listen.en: The film is about a failed assassination plot.
listen.zh: 這部電影講的是一場失敗的暗殺陰謀。

chinese.en: Our history teacher explained how one assassination could trigger a much larger war.
chinese.zh: 我們的歷史老師解釋了一起暗殺事件如何引發一場規模大得多的戰爭。

english.en: The leader survived an assassination attempt during a visit abroad.
english.zh: 那位領袖在出訪國外期間躲過了一次暗殺。

speak.en: I find history documentaries about famous assassinations surprisingly interesting.
speak.zh: 我覺得講述著名暗殺事件的歷史紀錄片出乎意料地有趣。

write.en: Security around the summit was tight because officials feared an assassination attempt.
write.zh: 由於官員擔心有人企圖行刺，高峰會周邊的維安非常嚴密。

example.en: Dogs have an acute sense of smell, which is why they are often used to find missing people.
example.zh: 狗的嗅覺非常敏銳，這就是牠們常被用來搜尋失蹤者的原因。

listen.en: She felt an acute pain in her lower back.
listen.zh: 她感到下背部一陣劇痛。

chinese.en: The housing problem has become more acute as young people move to big cities.
chinese.zh: 隨著年輕人湧入大城市，住房問題變得更加嚴重。

english.en: He was taken to hospital last night with acute stomach pain.
english.zh: 他昨晚因為急性胃痛被送到醫院。

speak.en: My sense of hearing is quite acute, so noisy neighbours really bother me.
speak.zh: 我的聽覺相當敏銳，所以吵鬧的鄰居真的很困擾我。

write.en: The doctor explained the difference between acute and chronic illnesses to the students.
write.zh: 醫師向學生解釋急性病和慢性病的差別。

example.en: The charity, which relies entirely on volunteers, provides free meals to elderly people living alone.
example.zh: 這個慈善團體完全仰賴志工運作，為獨居長者提供免費餐點。

listen.en: Our school held a charity concert last weekend.
listen.zh: 我們學校上週末舉辦了一場慈善音樂會。

chinese.en: Many companies support charities to improve their public image and help local communities.
chinese.zh: 許多公司支持慈善機構，以提升公眾形象並幫助在地社區。

english.en: I bought this jacket at a charity shop near my office.
english.zh: 我在辦公室附近的一家慈善二手店買了這件外套。

speak.en: I ran a half marathon to raise money for charity.
speak.zh: 我跑了一場半程馬拉松，為慈善募款。

write.en: Some people argue that governments, not charities, should be responsible for helping the poor.
write.zh: 有些人認為，幫助窮人應該是政府的責任，而不是慈善團體的責任。

example.en: Residents complained about the slow removal of rubbish, which had been piling up on the pavement for days.
example.zh: 居民抱怨垃圾清運太慢，已經在人行道上堆了好幾天。

listen.en: The removal van arrived early in the morning.
listen.zh: 搬家貨車一大早就到了。

chinese.en: The board voted for the removal of the director after the financial scandal.
chinese.zh: 財務醜聞爆發後，董事會投票決定撤換那位主管。

english.en: The city spends a lot of money on snow removal every winter.
english.zh: 這座城市每年冬天都花很多錢在除雪上。

speak.en: Stain removal is honestly the hardest part of doing laundry.
speak.zh: 老實說，去除污漬是洗衣服最難的部分。

write.en: The removal of trade barriers has made imported goods much cheaper for consumers.
write.zh: 貿易壁壘取消後，消費者購買進口商品便宜了許多。

example.en: The sudden collapse of the bank threw the financial markets into turmoil, and many investors lost their savings.
example.zh: 那家銀行突然倒閉，使金融市場陷入一片混亂，許多投資人因此失去了積蓄。

listen.en: My mind was in turmoil before the final exam.
listen.zh: 期末考前，我的心裡一團亂。

chinese.en: Moving to a new country can cause emotional turmoil, especially for young children.
chinese.zh: 移居到新的國家可能造成情緒上的動盪，對年幼的孩子尤其如此。

english.en: The company has been in turmoil since the manager left.
english.zh: 自從經理離職後，公司就一直陷入混亂。

speak.en: When I changed schools, my life was in total turmoil for a while.
speak.zh: 我轉學的時候，生活有一陣子完全亂成一團。

write.en: Despite years of political turmoil, the region's tourism industry has continued to grow.
write.zh: 儘管多年來政局動盪，該地區的觀光業仍持續成長。

example.en: It seems incredible that only a century ago most people never travelled far beyond their home town.
example.zh: 很難相信僅僅一百年前，大多數人從未離開家鄉太遠。

listen.en: We had an incredible time at the beach.
listen.zh: 我們在海邊玩得超開心。

chinese.en: The team made incredible progress and finished the project ahead of schedule.
chinese.zh: 團隊進步驚人，提前完成了這項專案。

english.en: Social media has an incredible influence on how young people think.
english.zh: 社群媒體對年輕人的思考方式有極大的影響。

speak.en: Studying abroad was an incredible experience that changed my whole outlook.
speak.zh: 出國留學是一次很棒的經驗，徹底改變了我的視野。

write.en: Her story sounded incredible at first, but every detail turned out to be true.
write.zh: 她的故事一開始聽起來令人難以置信，但結果每個細節都是真的。

example.en: The old bridge was made of loose planks, so we walked slowly and held tightly onto the rope.
example.zh: 那座舊橋是用鬆動的木板搭成的，所以我們走得很慢，還緊緊抓著繩子。

listen.en: Try to hold the plank for as long as you can.
listen.zh: 試著盡可能撐久一點棒式。

chinese.en: The floor of the cabin was made from planks of recycled wood.
chinese.zh: 這間小木屋的地板是用回收木料製成的木板鋪成的。

english.en: My trainer asks me to do a plank at the end of every workout.
english.zh: 我的教練要我在每次訓練結束時做一組棒式。

speak.en: Doing planks every morning has really helped my back pain.
speak.zh: 每天早上做棒式真的改善了我的背痛。

write.en: Workers replaced the rotten planks on the pier to make it safe for tourists.
write.zh: 工人更換了碼頭上腐爛的木板，讓遊客能安全行走。

example.en: Young children's brains are like sponges; they absorb new words and sounds remarkably quickly.
example.zh: 幼童的大腦就像海綿一樣，吸收新詞彙和聲音的速度快得驚人。

listen.en: Could you pass me the sponge by the sink?
listen.zh: 可以把水槽旁邊的海綿拿給我嗎？

chinese.en: The nurse gently sponged the patient's face to bring down his fever.
chinese.zh: 護理師輕輕用海綿擦拭病人的臉，幫他退燒。

english.en: My grandmother bakes a delicious lemon sponge cake every Sunday.
english.zh: 我奶奶每個星期天都會烤一個美味的檸檬海綿蛋糕。

speak.en: My cousin is twenty-five and still sponges off his parents.
speak.zh: 我表哥已經二十五歲了，還在靠他爸媽養。

write.en: Wetlands act like a giant sponge, soaking up rainwater and reducing the risk of floods.
write.zh: 濕地就像一塊巨大的海綿，能吸收雨水、降低淹水的風險。

example.en: Although critics doubted him, the author continued to assert that his book was based entirely on real events.
example.zh: 雖然評論家對他存疑，這位作者仍堅稱他的書完全是根據真實事件寫成的。

listen.en: She slowly learned to assert herself at her new job.
listen.zh: 她在新工作中慢慢學會了堅持自己的立場。

chinese.en: Some writers assert that technology makes people lonelier rather than more connected.
chinese.zh: 有些作家主張，科技讓人更孤單，而不是讓人與人更緊密。

english.en: Employees should be able to assert their rights without fear of losing their jobs.
english.zh: 員工應該能夠爭取自己的權益，而不必擔心丟掉工作。

speak.en: As team leader, I sometimes have to assert my authority, which isn't easy.
speak.zh: 身為組長，我有時必須展現自己的權威，這並不容易。

write.en: In her essay, she asserts that public transport should be free for students.
write.zh: 她在文章中主張，學生搭乘大眾運輸應該免費。

example.en: To make the survey fair, researchers asked a random sample of residents rather than only their friends.
example.zh: 為了讓調查公平，研究人員訪問的是隨機抽樣的居民，而不只是他們的朋友。

listen.en: Police carry out random checks on drivers at night.
listen.zh: 警方會在夜間對駕駛人進行隨機臨檢。

chinese.en: The order of the questions is random, so every student gets a different test.
chinese.zh: 題目的順序是隨機排列的，所以每個學生拿到的考卷都不一樣。

english.en: A random stranger helped me carry my suitcase up the stairs.
english.zh: 一個素不相識的路人幫我把行李箱搬上樓梯。

speak.en: Sometimes I just pick a random film and hope it's good.
speak.zh: 有時候我就隨便挑一部電影，希望它好看。

write.en: My friend sent me a random message about penguins in the middle of the night.
write.zh: 我朋友半夜突然傳了一則莫名其妙、關於企鵝的訊息給我。

example.en: The ingenious design allows the small flat to turn into an office during the day and a bedroom at night.
example.zh: 這個巧妙的設計讓小公寓白天可以變成辦公室，晚上則成為臥室。

listen.en: That is an ingenious way to save water.
listen.zh: 那是個省水的巧妙方法。

chinese.en: Farmers in dry regions have developed ingenious methods of collecting and storing rainwater.
chinese.zh: 乾燥地區的農民發展出收集與儲存雨水的巧妙方法。

english.en: The children built an ingenious machine out of old boxes.
english.zh: 孩子們用舊箱子做了一台精巧的機器。

speak.en: I think the printing press was one of history's most ingenious inventions.
speak.zh: 我認為印刷機是史上最巧妙的發明之一。

write.en: The detective's ingenious reasoning finally revealed who had taken the missing painting.
write.zh: 偵探巧妙的推理終於揭開了是誰拿走那幅失蹤的畫作。

example.en: During the long train journey across Europe, my travelling companion kept me entertained with stories about her childhood.
example.zh: 在橫越歐洲的漫長火車旅程中，我的旅伴一直講她童年的故事逗我開心。

listen.en: Books were her constant companions as a child.
listen.zh: 小時候，書本是她形影不離的夥伴。

chinese.en: For many elderly people living alone, a pet can be an important companion.
chinese.zh: 對許多獨居長者來說，寵物可能是重要的生活伴侶。

english.en: He was a cheerful companion on our hiking trip last summer.
english.zh: 去年夏天健行時，他是個開朗的好旅伴。

speak.en: Music has always been a good companion when I study late.
speak.zh: 我讀書讀到很晚時，音樂一直是很好的陪伴。

write.en: The company is developing robot companions to support patients recovering at home.
write.zh: 這家公司正在研發陪伴型機器人，協助在家休養的病人。

example.en: Young children often find it hard to understand the distinction between what is real and what is imagined.
example.zh: 年幼的孩子常常很難理解真實與想像之間的區別。

listen.en: She graduated with distinction from a famous university.
listen.zh: 她以優異的成績從一所知名大學畢業。

chinese.en: The new law draws a clear distinction between full-time employees and freelance workers.
chinese.zh: 新法規明確區分了全職員工與自由工作者。

english.en: In my opinion, there is no real distinction between the two brands.
english.zh: 依我看，這兩個品牌之間沒有真正的差別。

speak.en: I try to keep a clear distinction between my work time and family time.
speak.zh: 我盡量把工作時間和家庭時間清楚地分開。

write.en: The museum has the distinction of being the oldest in the country.
write.zh: 這座博物館享有全國歷史最悠久的殊榮。

example.en: Each wooden chair is carefully crafted by hand, which explains why they are so expensive.
example.zh: 每張木椅都是手工精心製作的，這就說明了它們為何這麼昂貴。

listen.en: The children enjoyed the arts and crafts class.
listen.zh: 孩子們很喜歡美勞課。

chinese.en: Local governments should help young people learn traditional crafts before they disappear.
chinese.zh: 地方政府應該在傳統工藝消失前，協助年輕人學習這些技藝。

english.en: She spent weeks crafting the perfect speech for her sister's wedding.
english.zh: 她花了好幾週為姊姊的婚禮精心準備一篇完美的致詞。

speak.en: I bought this handmade bag at a craft market in Tainan.
speak.zh: 這個手工包包是我在臺南的手作市集買的。

write.en: Good journalists spend their whole careers improving their craft and learning from mistakes.
write.zh: 優秀的記者會用整個職涯磨練自己的技藝，並從錯誤中學習。

example.en: Rinse empty juice cartons before putting them in the recycling bin, or they will start to smell.
example.zh: 空的果汁紙盒在丟進回收桶前要先沖洗，不然會開始發臭。

listen.en: The eggs were sold in a paper carton.
listen.zh: 這些蛋是裝在紙盒裡販售的。

chinese.en: The factory packs its products into strong cartons before shipping them overseas.
chinese.zh: 工廠會先把產品裝進堅固的紙箱，再運往海外。

english.en: He drank the whole carton of orange juice by himself.
english.zh: 他一個人喝光了一整盒柳橙汁。

speak.en: I always check the date on the milk carton before buying.
speak.zh: 我買牛奶前都會先看紙盒上的日期。

write.en: Some supermarkets now let customers refill their own containers instead of buying new cartons.
write.zh: 現在有些超市讓顧客用自己的容器補貨，不必再買新的紙盒包裝。

example.en: Her strong belief in hard work helped her finish university while working two part-time jobs.
example.zh: 她堅信努力的價值，這讓她在兼兩份差的同時完成了大學學業。

listen.en: He has a firm belief in his own ability.
listen.zh: 他對自己的能力深具信心。

chinese.en: There is a widespread belief that success depends mainly on which school you attend.
chinese.zh: 普遍有一種看法，認為成功主要取決於你就讀哪所學校。

english.en: People from different cultures may hold very different beliefs about money.
english.zh: 來自不同文化的人，對金錢可能抱持截然不同的觀念。

speak.en: It's my personal belief that everyone should learn to cook.
speak.zh: 我個人認為每個人都應該學會做飯。

write.en: The price of the flat had risen beyond belief in just a few years.
write.zh: 那間公寓的價格在短短幾年內漲到令人難以置信的地步。

example.en: Instead of listing facts, the museum presents a narrative that follows one family through a century of change.
example.zh: 這間博物館不是羅列事實，而是透過一個家族的故事，帶觀眾走過一世紀的變遷。

listen.en: Her personal narrative moved everyone in the room.
listen.zh: 她親身經歷的敘述感動了在場的每一個人。

chinese.en: The documentary challenges the official narrative about why the old factory suddenly closed.
chinese.zh: 這部紀錄片挑戰了官方對那間老工廠突然關閉原因的說法。

english.en: Our teacher asked us to write a short narrative about our summer holiday.
english.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇關於暑假的短篇記敘文。

speak.en: I prefer games with a strong narrative rather than just action.
speak.zh: 比起純動作的遊戲，我比較喜歡故事性強的。

write.en: Narrative techniques such as flashbacks can make a simple story far more engaging.
write.zh: 倒敘等敘事技巧能讓一個簡單的故事變得引人入勝許多。

example.en: After long negotiations, the kidnappers agreed to release all the hostages in exchange for safe passage.
example.zh: 經過漫長的談判，綁匪同意釋放所有人質，以換取安全離開。

listen.en: The film tells the story of a hostage who escapes.
listen.zh: 這部電影講述一名人質逃脫的故事。

chinese.en: Small farmers should not be held hostage to the prices set by big supermarkets.
chinese.zh: 小農不應該受制於大型超市訂定的價格。

english.en: A trained negotiator helped secure the release of the hostages.
english.zh: 一位受過訓練的談判專家協助促成人質獲釋。

speak.en: I don't want to be a hostage to my phone all weekend.
speak.zh: 我不想整個週末都被手機綁住。

write.en: The novel follows a journalist who is taken hostage while reporting abroad.
write.zh: 這部小說描寫一名在海外採訪時遭挾持為人質的記者。

example.en: Tourism is the island's principal source of income, so the pandemic hit local businesses especially hard.
example.zh: 觀光業是這座島的主要收入來源，因此疫情對當地商家的打擊特別大。

listen.en: The principal spoke to the students after lunch.
listen.zh: 校長在午餐後對學生講話。

chinese.en: Rising sea levels are one of the principal threats facing coastal cities today.
chinese.zh: 海平面上升是當今沿海城市面臨的主要威脅之一。

english.en: Our principal wants every student to join at least one club.
english.zh: 我們校長希望每位學生至少參加一個社團。

speak.en: My principal concern about living abroad would be feeling lonely.
speak.zh: 如果住在國外，我最主要擔心的是會覺得孤單。

write.en: If you repay the loan early, you will pay less interest on the principal.
write.zh: 如果提早償還貸款，你為本金支付的利息就會減少。

example.en: A fallen tree was obstructing the road, so drivers had to wait until workers could cut it up.
example.zh: 一棵倒下的樹擋住了道路，駕駛人只好等工人來把它鋸開。

listen.en: Please do not obstruct the emergency exit at any time.
listen.zh: 任何時候都請勿阻擋緊急出口。

chinese.en: The manager was fired for trying to obstruct the investigation into missing funds.
chinese.zh: 那名經理因企圖妨礙對失蹤款項的調查而遭開除。

english.en: Parked cars often obstruct traffic outside the school in the morning.
english.zh: 早上學校外頭停放的車輛常常阻礙交通。

speak.en: I hate it when someone's big hat obstructs my view at a concert.
speak.zh: 我最討厭在演唱會時有人的大帽子擋住我的視線。

write.en: Too much red tape can seriously obstruct the growth of small businesses.
write.zh: 繁文縟節太多，可能會嚴重阻礙小型企業的成長。

example.en: Over the past decade, the country has made great strides in reducing poverty and improving education.
example.zh: 過去十年來，這個國家在減少貧窮和改善教育方面都有長足的進步。

listen.en: He took long strides to keep up with us.
listen.zh: 他邁開大步才跟得上我們。

chinese.en: Moving to a new city was stressful, but she took it all in her stride.
chinese.zh: 搬到新城市壓力很大，但她都從容應對。

english.en: I have made huge strides in English since I started reading every day.
english.zh: 自從開始每天閱讀後，我的英文進步了很多。

speak.en: I usually stride along the river when I need to clear my head.
speak.zh: 需要放空的時候，我通常會沿著河邊大步快走。

write.en: The young runner lengthened her stride as she approached the finish line.
write.zh: 那位年輕跑者在接近終點線時加大了步幅。

example.en: He slipped on the wet stairs and got a nasty cut on his knee that needed stitches.
example.zh: 他在濕滑的樓梯上滑倒，膝蓋劃了一道很深的傷口，還得縫針。

listen.en: The weather turned nasty on our way home.
listen.zh: 在我們回家的路上，天氣突然變得很糟。

chinese.en: Online comments can be extremely nasty, especially when users can stay anonymous.
chinese.zh: 網路留言可能非常惡毒，特別是在使用者能夠匿名的時候。

english.en: Why are you being so nasty to your little brother?
english.zh: 你為什麼對弟弟這麼兇？

speak.en: Honestly, last month's electricity bill was a really nasty surprise for me.
speak.zh: 老實說，上個月的電費帳單真的把我嚇了一大跳。

write.en: The company faced nasty legal problems after ignoring safety rules for years.
write.zh: 這家公司多年無視安全規範，最後惹上了棘手的法律問題。

example.en: Parents who opposed the longer school day argued that children already had too little time to rest.
example.zh: 反對延長在校時間的家長主張，孩子的休息時間已經太少了。

listen.en: My parents strongly opposed my decision to quit.
listen.zh: 我爸媽強烈反對我辭職的決定。

chinese.en: Environmental groups opposed the new law because it would harm local wildlife.
chinese.zh: 環保團體反對這項新法律，因為它會危害當地的野生動物。

english.en: Personally, I am strongly opposed to testing cosmetics on animals.
english.zh: 就我個人而言，我強烈反對用動物做化妝品測試。

speak.en: I'd never oppose a longer holiday, to be honest!
speak.zh: 老實說，我絕對不會反對放更長的假！

write.en: The study focused on learning through play, as opposed to traditional classroom teaching.
write.zh: 這項研究著重於透過遊戲學習，而不是傳統的課堂教學。

example.en: The internet has brought about a fundamental change in the way people shop, work and communicate.
example.zh: 網際網路讓人們購物、工作與溝通的方式產生了根本的改變。

listen.en: I believe trust is fundamental to any good friendship.
listen.zh: 我相信信任是任何良好友誼的根本。

chinese.en: Education is widely seen as a fundamental right rather than a privilege.
chinese.zh: 教育普遍被視為一項基本權利，而不是特權。

english.en: This short course teaches beginners the fundamentals of computer programming.
english.zh: 這門短期課程教初學者電腦程式設計的基礎。

speak.en: There's a fundamental difference between being busy and being productive.
speak.zh: 忙碌和有生產力之間有著根本的差別。

write.en: The new coach went back to fundamentals, making the team practise basic passing every day.
write.zh: 新教練回歸基本功，讓球隊每天練習基礎傳球。

example.en: Although he is widely acknowledged as an expert, he still checks his facts carefully before every lecture.
example.zh: 雖然他被公認為專家，每次講課前仍會仔細查證事實。

listen.en: Please acknowledge this email when you receive it.
listen.zh: 收到這封電子郵件時，請回覆確認。

chinese.en: The author acknowledged the help of her colleagues in the introduction to her book.
chinese.zh: 作者在書的序言中感謝了同事們的協助。

english.en: It's important to acknowledge your mistakes and learn from them.
english.zh: 承認自己的錯誤並從中學習是很重要的。

speak.en: She walked right past me without even acknowledging me.
speak.zh: 她從我身邊直接走過，連招呼都沒打。

write.en: Governments must acknowledge the problem of loneliness among older people before they can solve it.
write.zh: 政府必須先正視長者孤獨的問題，才能加以解決。

example.en: Because so few people register as donors, many patients wait years for an organ transplant.
example.zh: 由於登記捐贈的人太少，許多病患要等好幾年才能接受器官移植。

listen.en: The skin is the largest organ of the body.
listen.zh: 皮膚是人體最大的器官。

chinese.en: Some countries automatically register adults as organ donors unless they choose otherwise.
chinese.zh: 有些國家會自動將成年人登記為器官捐贈者，除非他們另行選擇。

english.en: My uncle plays the organ at concerts in the city hall.
english.zh: 我叔叔在市政廳的音樂會上演奏管風琴。
