speak.en: Drinking too much can really damage your organs over time.
speak.zh: 長期喝太多酒真的會損害你的器官。

write.en: Scientists are learning to grow small organs in the lab for medical research.
write.zh: 科學家正在學習在實驗室培養小型器官，供醫學研究使用。

example.en: Since agriculture uses most of the region's water, a dry summer can quickly lead to food shortages.
example.zh: 由於農業用掉了該地區大部分的水，一個乾旱的夏天就可能迅速造成糧食短缺。

listen.en: My grandparents worked in agriculture all their lives.
listen.zh: 我的祖父母一輩子都從事農業。

chinese.en: Sustainable agriculture aims to produce enough food without damaging the soil or water.
chinese.zh: 永續農業的目標是在不破壞土壤與水源的情況下，生產足夠的糧食。

english.en: Modern agriculture depends heavily on machines, chemicals and cheap energy.
english.zh: 現代農業高度依賴機械、化學藥劑和廉價能源。

speak.en: I'd like to study agriculture because I care about where food comes from.
speak.zh: 我想念農業，因為我很在意食物是從哪裡來的。

write.en: Drones and sensors are helping to make agriculture more efficient and less wasteful.
write.zh: 無人機和感測器正在幫助農業變得更有效率、更少浪費。

example.en: The celebrity's lavish lifestyle, with private jets and huge parties, was criticised by fans struggling with rising prices.
example.zh: 這位名人搭私人飛機、辦盛大派對的奢華生活，遭到正為物價上漲所苦的粉絲批評。

listen.en: My grandma lavishes attention on her new puppy every day.
listen.zh: 我奶奶每天都對她的新小狗呵護備至。

chinese.en: Critics accused the city of lavish spending on a stadium nobody really needed.
chinese.zh: 批評者指責市政府鋪張浪費，蓋了一座其實沒人需要的體育場。

english.en: Our teacher lavished praise on everyone's final projects this semester.
english.zh: 這學期我們老師對每個人的期末作品都大加讚賞。

speak.en: I don't need a lavish birthday party; dinner with friends is enough.
speak.zh: 我不需要奢華的生日派對，和朋友吃頓飯就夠了。

write.en: The hotel offers lavish breakfasts, but the rooms themselves are surprisingly small.
write.zh: 這家飯店的早餐很豐盛，但房間本身卻小得出奇。

example.en: The east coast is less crowded than the west, and its dramatic scenery attracts many hikers and photographers.
example.zh: 東海岸比西部人少，壯麗的景色吸引了許多登山客和攝影師。

listen.en: The train ride offers some beautiful scenery along the way.
listen.zh: 這段火車旅程沿途有很美的風景。

chinese.en: Building a factory near the lake would spoil the natural scenery and harm tourism.
chinese.zh: 在湖邊蓋工廠會破壞自然景觀，並損害觀光業。

english.en: After months of hard work, I needed a change of scenery.
english.zh: 辛苦工作了好幾個月後，我需要換個環境。

speak.en: Honestly, the scenery in Hualien is the main reason I keep going back.
speak.zh: 老實說，花蓮的風景是我一再回去的主要原因。

write.en: The students spent a week painting the scenery for the school play.
write.zh: 學生們花了一個星期為學校話劇繪製舞台布景。

example.en: I didn't want to make an idiot of myself, so I practised my presentation in front of my roommates first.
example.zh: 我不想當眾出糗，所以先在室友面前練習了簡報。

listen.en: What an idiot I was to leave my keys inside!
listen.zh: 我真是個傻瓜，竟然把鑰匙鎖在裡面！

chinese.en: Some drivers behave like complete idiots when they are stuck in traffic.
chinese.zh: 有些駕駛人塞在車陣中時，表現得就像十足的白痴。

english.en: Don't call your classmates idiots, even when you are angry.
english.zh: 就算你在生氣，也不要罵同學是白痴。

speak.en: I looked like an idiot dancing at the party, but it was fun.
speak.zh: 我在派對上跳舞的樣子像個傻瓜，但很好玩。

write.en: Only an idiot would go hiking in the mountains without checking the weather forecast.
write.zh: 只有傻瓜才會不看天氣預報就去爬山。

example.en: Many students feel that memorising lists of dates is pointless unless they understand why the events happened.
example.zh: 許多學生覺得，除非了解事件發生的原因，否則背一堆年份毫無意義。

listen.en: Honestly, this long meeting feels completely pointless to me.
listen.zh: 說實在的，我覺得這場冗長的會議完全沒有意義。

chinese.en: Some people think buying expensive designer clothes is a pointless waste of money.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為買昂貴的名牌服飾是毫無意義的浪費。

english.en: Without clear goals, a lot of homework can feel pointless.
english.zh: 如果沒有明確的目標，很多作業會讓人覺得毫無意義。

speak.en: I used to think exercise was pointless, but now I love it.
speak.zh: 我以前覺得運動沒什麼意義，但現在很喜歡。

write.en: Building more roads is pointless if the city does not improve public transport.
write.zh: 如果城市不改善大眾運輸，蓋再多道路也是徒勞。

example.en: The report alleges that the company hid safety problems from inspectors, but no evidence has been made public yet.
example.zh: 報告指稱該公司向檢查人員隱瞞安全問題，但目前尚未公開任何證據。

listen.en: He is alleged to have cheated in the exam.
listen.zh: 據稱他在考試中作弊。

chinese.en: It is alleged that several officials accepted gifts from the construction company.
chinese.zh: 據指稱，有幾名官員收受了那家營建公司的禮物。

english.en: The workers allege that they were not paid for extra hours.
english.zh: 員工們聲稱他們加班卻沒有拿到加班費。

speak.en: My brother alleges I ate his chocolate, but I really didn't!
speak.zh: 我弟弟說我吃了他的巧克力，但我真的沒有！

write.en: Journalists must be careful when reporting alleged crimes before a court has reached a decision.
write.zh: 在法院做出判決之前，記者報導涉嫌犯罪的案件時必須格外謹慎。

example.en: As chancellor of the university, she rarely teaches, but she attends every graduation ceremony to present the degrees.
example.zh: 身為大學名譽校長，她很少授課，但每場畢業典禮都會出席頒發學位。

listen.en: The chancellor will visit the factory this afternoon.
listen.zh: 總理今天下午將參訪這間工廠。

chinese.en: The new chancellor promised to reduce government spending and lower taxes for families.
chinese.zh: 新任財政大臣承諾削減政府支出，並為家庭減稅。

english.en: The chancellor will meet other European leaders in Paris next week.
english.zh: 總理下週將在巴黎與其他歐洲領袖會面。

speak.en: Our university chancellor gave a really inspiring speech at graduation.
speak.zh: 我們大學的校長在畢業典禮上發表了很激勵人心的演講。

write.en: In her budget speech, the chancellor warned that the economy would grow slowly next year.
write.zh: 財政大臣在預算演說中警告，明年經濟成長將會趨緩。

example.en: The final part of the hike was so strenuous that several of us had to stop and rest every few minutes.
example.zh: 健行的最後一段非常吃力，我們有好幾個人每走幾分鐘就得停下來休息。

listen.en: Moving heavy furniture all day is really strenuous work.
listen.zh: 整天搬重家具真的是很累人的工作。

chinese.en: The government has made strenuous efforts to reduce air pollution in major cities.
chinese.zh: 政府竭盡全力降低主要城市的空氣污染。

english.en: Older people can still enjoy activities that are not too strenuous.
english.zh: 年長者仍然可以從事不會太費力的活動。

speak.en: I prefer yoga to running because it's less strenuous for my knees.
speak.zh: 比起跑步我更喜歡瑜伽，因為它對膝蓋的負擔比較小。

write.en: Despite strenuous objections from local residents, the council approved the new shopping centre.
write.zh: 儘管當地居民強烈反對，議會仍通過了新購物中心的興建案。

example.en: That afternoon the heat was so intense that the city told residents to stay indoors and drink plenty of water.
example.zh: 那天下午熱得厲害，市政府要求居民待在室內並多喝水。

listen.en: Everyone could feel the intense excitement in the stadium.
listen.zh: 每個人都能感受到體育場內極度興奮的氣氛。

chinese.en: Competition among online shops has become so intense that many small sellers are struggling.
chinese.zh: 網路商店之間的競爭變得非常激烈，許多小賣家都經營得很辛苦。

english.en: The new law led to an intense debate in the media.
english.zh: 這項新法律在媒體上引發了激烈的辯論。

speak.en: My cousin is a bit intense, but she's really kind.
speak.zh: 我表妹個性有點太認真，但她人真的很好。

write.en: After months of intense training, the team finally won the national championship.
write.zh: 經過幾個月的高強度訓練，這支隊伍終於贏得了全國冠軍。

example.en: Instead of sleeping, she lay in bed scrolling through social media until well after midnight.
example.zh: 她沒睡覺，躺在床上一直滑社群媒體，直到過了半夜很久。

listen.en: The museum displays an ancient scroll painted on silk.
listen.zh: 這間博物館展示了一幅畫在絲綢上的古代卷軸。

chinese.en: Experts warn that endless scrolling on phones can damage children's ability to concentrate.
chinese.zh: 專家警告，無止境地滑手機可能損害孩子的專注力。

english.en: Scroll up if you want to read the earlier messages.
english.zh: 如果你想看較早的訊息，就往上滑。

speak.en: When I'm bored on the bus, I just scroll through the news.
speak.zh: 在公車上無聊的時候，我就會滑一滑新聞。

write.en: The website uses a scrolling banner to show the latest offers to customers.
write.zh: 這個網站用滾動式橫幅向顧客展示最新優惠。

example.en: After the accident left him disabled, he retrained as a designer and now works from home.
example.zh: 那場意外讓他身體留下障礙，之後他重新受訓成為設計師，現在在家工作。

listen.en: Please do not park in the disabled parking spaces.
listen.zh: 請勿停在身障專用停車位。

chinese.en: Public buildings should provide disabled access, such as ramps and wider doors.
chinese.zh: 公共建築應該提供無障礙設施，例如坡道和較寬的門。

english.en: My sister teaches art at a school for disabled children.
english.zh: 我姊姊在一所身障兒童學校教美術。

speak.en: Notifications are disabled on my phone, so I'm never distracted.
speak.zh: 我的手機關掉了通知，所以我從不會分心。

write.en: Many disabled athletes compete at the highest level and inspire millions of fans.
write.zh: 許多身障運動員在最高層級的賽事中競技，激勵了數以百萬計的粉絲。

example.en: When the beloved teacher retired, hundreds of former students returned to the school to thank her for her kindness.
example.zh: 那位深受愛戴的老師退休時，數百名校友回到學校，感謝她多年來的照顧。

listen.en: My grandmother still talks about her beloved childhood home.
listen.zh: 我奶奶到現在還常提起她心愛的童年老家。

chinese.en: The city spent years restoring the beloved park after a storm damaged most of its trees.
chinese.zh: 一場暴風雨毀損了大部分樹木後，市政府花了好幾年修復這座深受喜愛的公園。

english.en: Baseball is a beloved sport for many people in Taiwan.
english.zh: 棒球是許多臺灣人深愛的運動。

speak.en: Honestly, my old guitar is one of my most beloved possessions.
speak.zh: 老實說，我那把舊吉他是我最珍愛的東西之一。

write.en: The author is beloved by readers of all ages for her warm and funny stories.
write.zh: 這位作家溫馨又有趣的故事，深受各年齡層讀者喜愛。

example.en: With no phone signal in the forest, the hikers relied on an old compass to find their way north.
example.zh: 森林裡收不到手機訊號，登山客只能靠一個舊指南針辨認方向往北走。

listen.en: The compass needle always points toward the north.
listen.zh: 指南針的指針永遠指向北方。

chinese.en: Early sailors depended on the compass to cross wide oceans far from land.
chinese.zh: 早期的水手仰賴羅盤，在遠離陸地的廣闊海洋上航行。

english.en: Please bring a pair of compasses to the maths class.
english.zh: 請帶一支圓規來上數學課。

speak.en: I'd be completely lost without a compass or a map.
speak.zh: 沒有指南針或地圖的話，我一定會完全迷路。

write.en: Strong leaders need a clear moral compass, especially when making difficult public decisions.
write.zh: 堅強的領導者需要清楚的道德準則，在做出困難的公共決策時更是如此。

example.en: Although the house looked plain from the street, its interior was full of colourful rugs, plants and paintings.
example.zh: 雖然那棟房子從街上看很樸素，屋內卻擺滿了色彩繽紛的地毯、植物和畫作。

listen.en: She wants to study interior design at university.
listen.zh: 她想在大學讀室內設計。

chinese.en: Few people live in the dry interior of the country, far from the coast.
chinese.zh: 這個國家乾燥的內陸地區遠離海岸，很少有人居住。

english.en: This new car has a spacious interior and very comfortable seats.
english.zh: 這輛新車的車內空間寬敞，座椅也非常舒適。

speak.en: I'd love to repaint the interior walls of my flat.
speak.zh: 我很想把我公寓的內牆重新粉刷一遍。

write.en: The company hired an interior designer to make its open-plan office feel less crowded.
write.zh: 公司請了一位室內設計師，讓開放式辦公室感覺不那麼擁擠。

example.en: The bank still asks customers to fill in paper forms by hand, an archaic process that wastes everyone's time.
example.zh: 那家銀行仍要求顧客手寫紙本表格，這種過時的流程浪費了大家的時間。

listen.en: Some of the words in this poem are archaic.
listen.zh: 這首詩裡有些字是古語。

chinese.en: Critics argue that the archaic tax system no longer reflects how people earn money today.
chinese.zh: 批評者認為，這套過時的稅制已無法反映現代人賺錢的方式。

english.en: My office still uses an archaic computer system that often crashes.
english.zh: 我的辦公室還在用一套常常當機的老舊電腦系統。

speak.en: To be honest, writing letters by post feels a bit archaic now.
speak.zh: 老實說，現在用郵寄方式寫信感覺有點過時了。

write.en: Some archaic laws remain on the books simply because nobody has bothered to remove them.
write.zh: 有些過時的法律至今仍然有效，只是因為沒有人費心去廢除它們。

example.en: Because the coach was ill, his assistant relayed the new training plan to the players before practice.
example.zh: 因為教練生病了，他的助理在練習前把新的訓練計畫轉達給球員。

listen.en: Our class team won the relay race at sports day.
listen.zh: 我們班的隊伍在運動會上贏得了接力賽。

chinese.en: The concert was relayed live to large screens outside the stadium for fans without tickets.
chinese.zh: 這場演唱會透過體育場外的大螢幕現場轉播，讓沒買到票的歌迷也能觀看。

english.en: I relayed the teacher's instructions to my classmates who were absent.
english.zh: 我把老師的指示轉告給缺席的同學。

speak.en: I usually relay important news to my family through a group chat.
speak.zh: 我通常會透過群組聊天，把重要消息轉告給家人。

write.en: Volunteers worked in relays to carry sandbags to the river bank before the flood.
write.zh: 志工們在洪水來臨前輪班接力，把沙包搬到河岸邊。

example.en: The hotel had no record of our reservation, but luckily I could show them the written confirmation on my phone.
example.zh: 飯店沒有我們的訂房紀錄，幸好我可以讓他們看手機上的書面確認。

listen.en: We are still waiting for confirmation from the airline.
listen.zh: 我們還在等航空公司的確認。

chinese.en: The test results provided confirmation that the new teaching method improved students' reading skills.
chinese.zh: 測驗結果證實，新的教學方法提升了學生的閱讀能力。

english.en: Please send me confirmation of your attendance by this Friday.
english.zh: 請在本週五前向我確認你是否出席。

speak.en: I always double-check the confirmation before I go to the airport.
speak.zh: 去機場之前，我總是會再檢查一次確認通知。

write.en: The scientists are seeking independent confirmation of their findings before publishing them.
write.zh: 科學家在發表研究結果前，正在尋求獨立的驗證。

example.en: When the interviewer asked about his gap year, there was an uncomfortable silence before he finally answered.
example.zh: 面試官問到他的空檔年時，現場出現一陣尷尬的沉默，他才終於回答。

listen.en: Some students feel uncomfortable speaking in front of the class.
listen.zh: 有些學生在全班面前說話會感到不自在。

chinese.en: Many employees feel uncomfortable when managers monitor their computer screens during working hours.
chinese.zh: 許多員工在上班時間被主管監看電腦螢幕時，會覺得不自在。

english.en: The long bus ride to the mountains was hot and uncomfortable.
english.zh: 前往山區的長途巴士車程又熱又不舒服。

speak.en: I get uncomfortable when people ask me about my salary.
speak.zh: 別人問我薪水的時候，我會覺得不太自在。

write.en: The report raises some uncomfortable questions about how the city spends its public funds.
write.zh: 這份報告針對市政府如何運用公共資金，提出了一些令人不安的問題。

example.en: Instead of panicking about the strange noise, Mia looked for a rational explanation and soon found a loose window.
example.zh: 米亞沒有因為那個怪聲而驚慌，而是尋找合理的解釋，很快就發現是一扇沒關緊的窗戶。

listen.en: Try to stay calm and rational during the exam.
listen.zh: 考試時試著保持冷靜和理性。

chinese.en: Economists once assumed that consumers always make rational choices, but real behaviour is often emotional.
chinese.zh: 經濟學家曾經假設消費者總是做出理性的選擇，但實際行為往往很情緒化。

english.en: We need a rational discussion about the cost of the trip.
english.zh: 我們需要理性地討論這趟旅行的費用。

speak.en: I like to think I'm a fairly rational person most of the time.
speak.zh: 我自認大部分時候算是個蠻理性的人。

write.en: Public health policy should be based on rational analysis of evidence rather than fear.
write.zh: 公共衛生政策應該建立在對證據的理性分析上，而不是出於恐懼。

example.en: On Saturday mornings, Dad runs errands around town, picking up groceries, posting letters and collecting dry cleaning.
example.zh: 每週六早上，爸爸會在鎮上跑腿辦事：買菜、寄信，還有拿送洗的衣服。

listen.en: My mother sent me on an errand to the bakery.
listen.zh: 我媽媽派我去麵包店跑腿。

chinese.en: Many delivery apps now let busy workers pay someone else to run their errands.
chinese.zh: 現在許多外送應用程式讓忙碌的上班族可以付錢請別人幫忙跑腿。

english.en: Could you run a quick errand for me this afternoon?
english.zh: 你今天下午可以幫我跑個腿嗎？

speak.en: I usually spend Sunday doing errands and cleaning my flat.
speak.zh: 我星期天通常都在辦雜事和打掃公寓。

write.en: As a new intern, she spent most of her first week running errands for the office.
write.zh: 身為新來的實習生，她第一週大部分時間都在幫辦公室跑腿。

example.en: After checking her income and savings, the lender agreed to give Amy a small loan to open her café.
example.zh: 放款機構審核了艾咪的收入和存款後，同意借她一筆小額貸款開咖啡店。

listen.en: The lender wants to see your bank statements first.
listen.zh: 放款方想先看你的銀行對帳單。

chinese.en: When interest rates rise, many lenders become more careful about who they lend money to.
chinese.zh: 利率上升時，許多放款機構對於要借錢給誰會更加謹慎。

english.en: Students should compare several lenders before taking out a loan.
english.zh: 學生在申請貸款前，應該比較幾家放款機構。

speak.en: I'd never borrow from an online lender I knew nothing about.
speak.zh: 我絕對不會向一家我完全不了解的網路借貸業者借錢。

write.en: My brother is a generous lender of books, but he rarely gets them back.
write.zh: 我哥哥很大方地把書借給別人，但很少拿得回來。

example.en: Unlike politicians who focus only on the next election, a true statesman plans for the needs of future generations.
example.zh: 不同於只關心下一次選舉的政客，真正的政治家會為後代的需求做規劃。

listen.en: The old statesman gave a calm and thoughtful speech.
listen.zh: 那位年長的政治家發表了一場冷靜而深思熟慮的演說。

chinese.en: In our history class, we compared how different statesmen handled economic crises in the past.
chinese.zh: 在歷史課上，我們比較了過去不同的政治家如何處理經濟危機。

english.en: The former president is now seen as an elder statesman.
english.zh: 這位前總統如今被視為資深的政壇元老。

speak.en: I think a good statesman should listen more than he talks.
speak.zh: 我認為一個好的政治家應該多聽少說。

write.en: The museum's new exhibition tells the life story of a statesman who founded the national library.
write.zh: 博物館的新展覽講述一位創立國家圖書館的政治家的生平。

example.en: The volunteers made a tremendous difference to the village, rebuilding the school and repairing roads after the earthquake.
example.zh: 志工們為這座村莊帶來了巨大的改變，在地震後重建學校並修復道路。

listen.en: She felt tremendous pressure before her final exams.
listen.zh: 期末考前她感到極大的壓力。

chinese.en: The new metro line has been a tremendous success, carrying far more passengers than expected.
chinese.zh: 新的捷運路線非常成功，載運的乘客遠多於預期。

english.en: The concert last night was tremendous, and everyone loved it.
english.zh: 昨晚的演唱會棒極了，每個人都很喜歡。

speak.en: My grandparents have had a tremendous influence on who I am.
speak.zh: 我的祖父母對我成為什麼樣的人有很大的影響。

write.en: Cutting plastic waste could bring tremendous benefits to ocean wildlife over the next decade.
write.zh: 減少塑膠廢棄物在未來十年可能為海洋生物帶來極大的好處。

example.en: The parcel could not be left at the door because the delivery company required a signature from the person receiving it.
example.zh: 包裹不能放在門口，因為貨運公司要求收件人親自簽收。

listen.en: The bank could not accept the cheque without a signature.
listen.zh: 支票上沒有簽名，銀行無法受理。

chinese.en: Residents collected thousands of signatures to stop the park from being turned into a car park.
chinese.zh: 居民蒐集了數千份連署簽名，要阻止公園被改建成停車場。

english.en: Beef noodle soup is the signature dish of this restaurant.
english.zh: 牛肉麵是這家餐廳的招牌菜。

speak.en: My signature looks completely different from when I was a kid.
speak.zh: 我現在的簽名和小時候完全不一樣。

write.en: Bright colours and bold shapes are the signature of this young designer's work.
write.zh: 鮮豔的色彩與大膽的造型是這位年輕設計師作品的招牌特色。

example.en: Our group project was hampered by poor communication, as nobody knew who was responsible for each part.
example.zh: 我們的小組報告因為溝通不良而進展受阻，因為沒人知道每個部分該由誰負責。

listen.en: We packed sandwiches and fruit in a picnic hamper.
listen.zh: 我們把三明治和水果裝進野餐籃。

chinese.en: A shortage of skilled workers is hampering the growth of the local technology industry.
chinese.zh: 技術人才短缺正阻礙著當地科技產業的發展。

english.en: His knee injury hampered his performance in the final race.
english.zh: 他的膝傷影響了他在決賽中的表現。

speak.en: Living far from campus really hampers my social life, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，住得離校園很遠真的會妨礙我的社交生活。

write.en: For the holidays, the company sent each client a gift hamper full of local snacks.
write.zh: 公司在年節期間送給每位客戶一個裝滿在地零食的禮籃。

example.en: Her poor results were not entirely her fault; external factors like family problems also played a part.
example.zh: 她成績不好並不完全是她的錯，家庭問題等外在因素也有影響。

listen.en: This cream is for external use only, so never swallow it.
listen.zh: 這款乳膏僅限外用，絕對不可吞食。

chinese.en: Small island nations are especially vulnerable to external economic shocks such as rising oil prices.
chinese.zh: 小型島國特別容易受到油價上漲等外部經濟衝擊的影響。

english.en: I save all my photos on an external hard drive.
english.zh: 我把所有照片都存在外接硬碟裡。

speak.en: I try not to let external pressure decide what I study.
speak.zh: 我盡量不讓外界的壓力決定我要讀什麼。

write.en: The external walls of the building were painted white to reflect the summer heat.
write.zh: 這棟建築的外牆漆成白色，以反射夏季的熱氣。

example.en: After living abroad for years, he learned to cherish simple things like home-cooked meals and long chats with old friends.
example.zh: 在國外生活多年後，他學會珍惜簡單的事物，例如家常菜和與老朋友的長談。

listen.en: We should cherish the time we have with our family.
listen.zh: 我們應該珍惜和家人相處的時光。

chinese.en: Many communities cherish their traditional festivals as a way to pass culture to younger generations.
chinese.zh: 許多社區珍視傳統節慶，把它當作將文化傳承給年輕世代的方式。

english.en: She still cherishes the letters her best friend wrote her.
english.zh: 她仍然珍藏著最好的朋友寫給她的信。

speak.en: I really cherish my quiet mornings before everyone else wakes up.
speak.zh: 我很珍惜大家起床前那段安靜的早晨時光。

write.en: As a young teacher, she cherished the hope of one day opening her own school.
write.zh: 還是年輕老師時，她就一直懷抱著有朝一日開辦自己學校的希望。

example.en: When the teacher asked why his essay was late, Tom offered the feeble excuse that his dog had eaten it.
example.zh: 老師問湯姆為什麼作文遲交時，他給了一個站不住腳的藉口，說是被狗吃掉了。

listen.en: We could only see a feeble light through the fog.
listen.zh: 透過濃霧，我們只看得到一道微弱的光。

chinese.en: The council's feeble response to rising rents has disappointed many young families in the city.
chinese.zh: 市議會對房租上漲的回應軟弱無力，讓市內許多年輕家庭感到失望。

english.en: The old dog gave a feeble wag of its tail.
english.zh: 那隻老狗無力地搖了搖尾巴。

speak.en: My first attempt at cooking dinner was pretty feeble, honestly.
speak.zh: 說真的，我第一次嘗試煮晚餐的成果相當差勁。

write.en: Without fresh evidence, the lawyer's argument seemed feeble and failed to convince the jury.
write.zh: 沒有新證據，律師的論點顯得薄弱，無法說服陪審團。

example.en: Forgetting to back up his files proved costly for Ben, who lost a whole semester's research when his laptop broke.
example.zh: 班忘了備份檔案而付出慘痛代價：筆電壞掉時，他失去了一整個學期的研究資料。

listen.en: Living in the city centre can be very costly.
listen.zh: 住在市中心的開銷可能非常大。

chinese.en: Building a new airport is costly, but supporters believe it will bring long-term economic benefits.
chinese.zh: 興建新機場所費不貲，但支持者認為它會帶來長期的經濟效益。

english.en: Choosing the wrong university major could be a costly mistake.
english.zh: 選錯大學科系可能是代價很高的錯誤。

speak.en: Eating out every day is too costly for most students.
speak.zh: 對大部分學生來說，每天外食太花錢了。

write.en: Delays in the project became increasingly costly as material prices kept rising.
write.zh: 隨著材料價格不斷上漲，工程延誤的代價也越來越高。

example.en: In the museum, visitors can see traditional textiles woven by hand, each pattern representing a different tribe.
example.zh: 在博物館裡，參觀者可以看到手工織成的傳統織品，每種圖案代表不同的部落。

listen.en: My aunt works at a textile factory near the river.
listen.zh: 我阿姨在河邊一家紡織廠工作。

chinese.en: Fast fashion has created huge amounts of textile waste that ends up in landfills.
chinese.zh: 快時尚製造了大量紡織廢料，最後都被送進掩埋場。

english.en: The textile industry used to employ many people in this area.
english.zh: 紡織業過去在這個地區僱用了很多人。

speak.en: I'm interested in textiles, so I'd love to study fashion design.
speak.zh: 我對紡織品很感興趣，所以很想讀服裝設計。

write.en: Researchers are developing smart textiles that can measure a runner's heart rate during exercise.
write.zh: 研究人員正在開發能在運動時測量跑者心率的智慧紡織品。

example.en: The supermarket changed its layout last month, so regular customers kept getting lost looking for the bread and milk.
example.zh: 超市上個月調整了賣場配置，所以常客找麵包和牛奶時一直找不到。

listen.en: I like the simple layout of this website.
listen.zh: 我喜歡這個網站簡潔的版面設計。

chinese.en: City planners studied the layout of the old streets before designing the new cycling routes.
chinese.zh: 都市規劃人員在設計新的自行車道前，先研究了舊街道的配置。

english.en: The teacher asked us to improve the layout of our poster.
english.zh: 老師要我們改善海報的版面設計。

speak.en: The layout of my campus is really confusing for new students.
speak.zh: 我們校園的配置對新生來說真的很容易搞混。

write.en: A clear layout with headings and short paragraphs makes a report much easier to read.
write.zh: 有標題和簡短段落的清楚版面，能讓報告讀起來容易許多。

example.en: Campers must completely extinguish their fires before leaving, because a single spark can start a forest fire in dry weather.
example.zh: 露營者離開前必須把營火完全熄滅，因為天氣乾燥時，一點火花就可能引發森林大火。

listen.en: Please extinguish all candles before you go to bed.
listen.zh: 睡覺前請把所有蠟燭熄滅。

chinese.en: The sudden rise in tuition fees extinguished her hopes of studying abroad next year.
chinese.zh: 學費突然調漲，讓她明年出國讀書的希望破滅了。

english.en: The cook quickly extinguished the small fire with a wet towel.
english.zh: 廚師用一條濕毛巾迅速撲滅了那場小火。

speak.en: I learned how to extinguish a kitchen fire at school.
speak.zh: 我在學校學過怎麼撲滅廚房的火。

write.en: Visitors to the national park are asked to extinguish cigarettes completely and take the butts home.
write.zh: 國家公園要求遊客把香菸完全熄滅，並把菸蒂帶回家。

example.en: Since no party won enough seats, two parties agreed to share power in a coalition government.
example.zh: 由於沒有任何政黨贏得足夠席次，兩個政黨同意組成聯合政府共享權力。

listen.en: A coalition of parents asked the school for healthier lunches.
listen.zh: 一群家長聯合起來，要求學校提供更健康的午餐。

chinese.en: A coalition of local businesses is raising money to repair the town's historic market.
chinese.zh: 當地商家組成的聯盟正在募款，修復鎮上具歷史意義的市場。

english.en: The students formed a coalition to demand longer library hours.
english.zh: 學生們組成聯盟，要求延長圖書館開放時間。

speak.en: I think a coalition of countries could tackle plastic pollution more effectively.
speak.zh: 我認為由多國組成的聯盟能更有效地對付塑膠污染。

write.en: The coalition collapsed after its members disagreed over how to spend the shared budget.
write.zh: 成員對如何運用共同預算意見分歧後，這個聯盟就瓦解了。

example.en: At the start of the ceremony, a single trumpet sounded and the whole crowd suddenly fell silent.
example.zh: 典禮一開始，一支小號響起，全場群眾頓時安靜下來。

listen.en: She plays the trumpet in the school band.
listen.zh: 她在學校樂隊吹小號。

chinese.en: The company loudly trumpeted its new eco-friendly packaging, but critics say little has changed.
chinese.zh: 這家公司大肆宣傳新的環保包裝，但批評者說實際上沒什麼改變。

english.en: I learned to play the trumpet when I was in junior high.
english.zh: 我國中時學過吹小號。

speak.en: I don't like people who blow their own trumpet all the time.
speak.zh: 我不喜歡老是自吹自擂的人。

write.en: The elephants trumpeted loudly as the herd crossed the shallow river at sunset.
write.zh: 夕陽西下時，象群渡過淺淺的河流，大象們大聲鳴叫。

example.en: The old palace, with its golden roofs and enormous gardens, is the most magnificent building I have ever visited.
example.zh: 那座有金色屋頂和廣大花園的古老宮殿，是我參觀過最宏偉的建築。

listen.en: The dancers gave a magnificent performance last night.
listen.zh: 舞者們昨晚的演出精彩極了。

chinese.en: The magnificent coral reefs attract divers from all over the world, but rising sea temperatures threaten them.
chinese.zh: 壯麗的珊瑚礁吸引世界各地的潛水客，但海水溫度上升正威脅著它們。

english.en: The bride looked magnificent in her grandmother's old wedding dress.
english.zh: 新娘穿著祖母的舊婚紗，看起來美極了。

speak.en: Taroko Gorge is magnificent, so I'd recommend it to any visitor.
speak.zh: 太魯閣峽谷非常壯觀，所以我會推薦給每位遊客。

write.en: Our team did a magnificent job of organising the charity event in just two weeks.
write.zh: 我們團隊只花兩週就把慈善活動辦得非常出色。

example.en: Poor sleep and stress can create a vicious cycle: worry keeps you awake, and tiredness makes you worry more.
example.zh: 睡眠不足和壓力可能形成惡性循環：焦慮讓你睡不著，而疲倦又讓你更焦慮。

listen.en: I cycle to work when the weather is good.
listen.zh: 天氣好的時候，我會騎腳踏車上班。

chinese.en: The report examines the full life cycle of a smartphone, from mining to recycling.
chinese.zh: 這份報告檢視一支智慧型手機從採礦到回收的完整生命週期。

english.en: On Sunday we cycled along the river for about an hour.
english.zh: 星期天我們沿著河邊騎了大約一小時的腳踏車。

speak.en: Cycling around the city is cheaper and healthier than taking taxis.
speak.zh: 在市區騎腳踏車移動，比搭計程車便宜又健康。

write.en: Many economists believe the housing market moves in cycles of boom and bust.
write.zh: 許多經濟學家認為，房市會在繁榮與蕭條之間循環。

example.en: For many travellers, part of the thrill of visiting a new city is getting a little lost in its streets.
example.zh: 對許多旅人來說，造訪新城市的樂趣之一，就是在街頭稍微迷個路。

listen.en: We were thrilled to hear about your new job.
listen.zh: 聽到你找到新工作，我們都好興奮。

chinese.en: The idea of exploring space still thrills many young people who dream of becoming scientists.
chinese.zh: 探索太空的想法，至今仍讓許多夢想成為科學家的年輕人興奮不已。

english.en: Riding a roller coaster for the first time was a real thrill.
english.zh: 第一次坐雲霄飛車真的超刺激。

speak.en: I'm not a thrill seeker, so I'd never try skydiving.
speak.zh: 我不是愛找刺激的人，所以絕對不會去玩跳傘。

write.en: The museum's interactive exhibits thrilled the children, who stayed until closing time.
write.zh: 博物館的互動展品讓孩子們興奮不已，他們一直待到閉館才離開。

example.en: Some players had expensive equipment and private coaches, which gave them an unfair advantage over the rest of the team.
example.zh: 有些球員擁有昂貴的裝備和私人教練，這讓他們比隊上其他人佔了不公平的優勢。

listen.en: I think the new parking rules are unfair to residents.
listen.zh: 我認為新的停車規定對居民不公平。

chinese.en: Workers complained about unfair treatment after the company cut their holidays without warning.
chinese.zh: 公司無預警刪減員工假期後，員工抱怨受到不公平的待遇。

english.en: It seems unfair that she does most of the housework.
english.zh: 大部分家事都由她來做，似乎不太公平。

speak.en: Honestly, I think it's unfair to judge people by their accents.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得用口音來評斷別人是不公平的。

write.en: Small local shops often struggle against unfair competition from huge online retailers.
write.zh: 小型在地商店常常難以對抗大型網路零售商的不公平競爭。

example.en: After the flood destroyed their homes, hundreds of families lived in temporary shelters set up in school gyms.
example.zh: 洪水摧毀家園後，數百個家庭住進設在學校體育館裡的臨時收容所。

listen.en: The library is closed due to a temporary power cut.
listen.zh: 圖書館因為暫時停電而關閉。

chinese.en: Lowering bus fares is only a temporary solution to the city's serious traffic problem.
chinese.zh: 調降公車票價只是解決城市嚴重交通問題的權宜之計。

english.en: This is only a temporary password, so please change it soon.
english.zh: 這只是臨時密碼，請盡快更改。

speak.en: Feeling homesick is normal, and it's usually only temporary.
speak.zh: 想家是正常的，而且通常只是暫時的。

write.en: The road will be closed on a temporary basis while workers repair the bridge.
write.zh: 工人修橋期間，這條道路將暫時封閉。

example.en: Because the team failed to arrive on time, they had to forfeit the match and were removed from the tournament.
example.zh: 因為那支隊伍沒有準時到場，只好被判棄權落敗，並被取消參賽資格。

listen.en: Students who cheat will forfeit their right to a scholarship.
listen.zh: 作弊的學生將喪失領取獎學金的資格。

chinese.en: Employees who leave before the contract ends may forfeit part of their annual bonus.
chinese.zh: 在合約到期前離職的員工，可能會喪失部分年終獎金。

english.en: He forfeited his place on the course by missing the deadline.
english.zh: 他因為錯過截止日期而失去了這門課程的名額。

speak.en: In our family games, the loser always has to do a silly forfeit.
speak.zh: 我們家玩遊戲時，輸的人總是要接受一個搞笑的懲罰。

write.en: Some people argue that criminals should forfeit any money they make from writing about their crimes.
write.zh: 有些人主張，罪犯撰寫自身罪行所賺到的錢都應該被沒收。

example.en: By comparing satellite images taken years apart, scientists could clearly see how much the glacier had shrunk.
example.zh: 透過比對相隔多年拍攝的衛星影像，科學家可以清楚看出冰河縮小了多少。

listen.en: The match was shown live via satellite around the world.
listen.zh: 這場比賽透過衛星向全世界現場轉播。

chinese.en: The moon is the Earth's only natural satellite, and it affects ocean tides.
chinese.zh: 月球是地球唯一的天然衛星，它會影響海洋的潮汐。

english.en: Our phones use satellites to show exactly where we are on a map.
english.zh: 我們的手機利用衛星，在地圖上精確顯示我們的位置。

speak.en: My parents still watch satellite TV because they love foreign channels.
speak.zh: 我爸媽還在看衛星電視，因為他們很喜歡外國頻道。

write.en: As the capital grew crowded, several satellite towns were built to house commuters.
write.zh: 隨著首都越來越擁擠，周邊興建了幾座衛星城鎮來安置通勤族。

example.en: The lecture contained so much new information that I needed a whole weekend to fully digest it.
example.zh: 那堂課的新資訊多到我需要一整個週末才能完全消化。

listen.en: Rice porridge is gentle and easy to digest.
listen.zh: 稀飯很溫和，容易消化。

chinese.en: Readers who are too busy for long reports can subscribe to a weekly news digest instead.
chinese.zh: 沒空看長篇報導的讀者，可以改訂閱每週新聞摘要。

english.en: It took me a while to digest the shocking news.
english.zh: 我花了一段時間才消化這個驚人的消息。

speak.en: I always go for a short walk to help me digest after dinner.
speak.zh: 晚餐後我總會去散個步幫助消化。

write.en: Policy makers need time to digest the survey results before deciding how to reform the system.
write.zh: 決策者需要時間消化調查結果，才能決定如何改革制度。

example.en: My aunt always makes a martyr of herself at family dinners, cooking everything alone and then complaining that nobody helps.
example.zh: 我阿姨在家庭聚餐時總是一副犧牲奉獻的樣子，一個人包辦所有菜，然後又抱怨沒人幫忙。

listen.en: My grandfather has been a martyr to back pain for years.
listen.zh: 我爺爺多年來一直飽受背痛之苦。

chinese.en: The museum honours a young doctor who became a martyr to the cause of public health.
chinese.zh: 這座博物館紀念一位為公共衛生事業犧牲自己的年輕醫師。

english.en: You don't need to be a martyr; let me wash the dishes.
english.zh: 你不用委屈自己，讓我來洗碗吧。

speak.en: I used to be a martyr at work, but now I take proper breaks.
speak.zh: 我以前工作時總是犧牲自己，但現在我會好好休息。

write.en: Teachers should not have to become martyrs, working unpaid overtime every night to finish marking.
write.zh: 老師不應該被迫犧牲自己，每晚無償加班改作業。

example.en: I'm not sure the shop is still open; anyhow, it's worth walking over there to check before we give up.
example.zh: 我不確定那家店還開著；反正在放棄之前，走過去看看也值得。

listen.en: Anyhow, let's get back to the main topic.
listen.zh: 總之，我們回到主題吧。

chinese.en: The clothes had been thrown into the suitcase anyhow, so most of them were badly creased.
chinese.zh: 衣服被隨便塞進行李箱，所以大部分都皺得很厲害。

english.en: It might rain later, but I'll go jogging in the park anyhow.
english.zh: 晚點可能會下雨，但我還是要去公園慢跑。

speak.en: Anyhow, that's enough about me; how was your holiday?
speak.zh: 總之，我的事就說到這裡；你的假期過得怎麼樣？

write.en: Nobody asked for my opinion, but I gave the committee some suggestions anyhow.
write.zh: 沒有人問我的意見，但我還是向委員會提出了一些建議。

example.en: The program kept crashing, but the technician said the problem was a hardware failure, not a software bug.
example.zh: 程式一直當掉，但技術人員說問題出在硬體故障，不是軟體錯誤。

listen.en: My dad bought some nails at the hardware store.
listen.zh: 我爸爸在五金行買了一些釘子。

chinese.en: Taiwan is famous for manufacturing computer hardware such as chips and motherboards.
chinese.zh: 臺灣以製造晶片和主機板等電腦硬體聞名。

english.en: We need to upgrade our hardware before installing the new software.
english.zh: 安裝新軟體前，我們需要先升級硬體。

speak.en: I'm more interested in software than hardware, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，比起硬體，我對軟體更有興趣。

write.en: Old hardware such as broken printers should be recycled rather than thrown away.
write.zh: 像壞掉的印表機這類舊硬體應該回收，而不是直接丟掉。

example.en: Fans held up colourful banners with their favourite players' names as the team walked onto the field.
example.zh: 球隊走進球場時，球迷們高舉寫有心愛球員名字的彩色布條。

listen.en: The banner on the wall says Happy Birthday.
listen.zh: 牆上的布條寫著生日快樂。

chinese.en: Many websites earn money by showing banner ads at the top of each page.
chinese.zh: 許多網站靠著在每頁頂端顯示橫幅廣告來賺錢。

english.en: We made a big banner for our team's final match.
english.zh: 我們為球隊的決賽做了一條大布條。

speak.en: Our neighbours put up a huge banner for their son's graduation.
speak.zh: 我們鄰居為了兒子畢業掛了一條超大的布條。

write.en: Several local charities joined together under the banner of helping homeless families.
write.zh: 幾個在地慈善團體以幫助無家可歸的家庭為號召，聯合了起來。

example.en: The guesthouse was simple, but the bed linen was changed every day and always smelled fresh.
example.zh: 那間民宿很簡樸，但床單每天都會更換，聞起來總是很清新。

listen.en: Please put the clean linen in the cupboard upstairs.
listen.zh: 請把乾淨的床單放進樓上的櫃子裡。

chinese.en: Growing flax for linen uses far less water than growing cotton for clothing.
chinese.zh: 種植製作亞麻布的亞麻，比種植做衣服的棉花用水少得多。

english.en: My grandmother still irons all her table linen every week.
english.zh: 我奶奶每週仍會把所有桌巾燙一遍。

speak.en: I love linen clothes, but they crease so easily.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡亞麻衣服，但它們好容易皺。

write.en: The hotel reduced its water use by washing guests' linen only when requested.
write.zh: 這家飯店只在房客要求時才清洗床單，藉此減少用水量。

example.en: When sales kept falling, the manager tried to remedy the situation by lowering prices and improving customer service.
example.zh: 業績持續下滑時，經理試著透過降價和改善客服來補救。

listen.en: There is no quick and simple remedy for loneliness.
listen.zh: 孤單沒有快速又簡單的解方。

chinese.en: Experts say that building more homes is the only real remedy for rising rents.
chinese.zh: 專家表示，興建更多住宅才是解決房租上漲的唯一真正辦法。

english.en: The school offered extra classes to remedy the students' weak writing.
english.zh: 學校開設額外課程，來補強學生薄弱的寫作能力。

speak.en: My mum has a herbal remedy for almost every illness.
speak.zh: 我媽媽幾乎每種病都有一帖草藥偏方。

write.en: Customers who receive faulty goods are legally entitled to a remedy such as a refund.
write.zh: 收到瑕疵商品的顧客，依法有權獲得退款等補救措施。

example.en: Grandparents often indulge their grandchildren, buying them sweets and toys that their parents would never allow.
example.zh: 祖父母常常寵溺孫子女，買給他們父母絕對不准的糖果和玩具。

listen.en: On holiday, we indulged ourselves with fresh seafood every night.
listen.zh: 度假時，我們每晚都盡情享用新鮮海鮮。

chinese.en: Retirement finally gave him the time to indulge his passion for painting and gardening.
chinese.zh: 退休終於讓他有時間盡情投入他熱愛的繪畫和園藝。

english.en: I sometimes indulge in a bit of online shopping after work.
english.zh: 我下班後有時會放縱自己在網路上買點東西。

speak.en: Once a month, I indulge myself with a really nice dinner.
speak.zh: 我每個月會犒賞自己一次，吃頓很棒的晚餐。

write.en: Teenagers who indulge in too much screen time often struggle to sleep well at night.
write.zh: 沉迷於過多螢幕時間的青少年，晚上常常難以睡好。

example.en: The week before the deadline was frantic, with the whole team working late every night to finish the report.
example.zh: 截止日前的那一週忙得天翻地覆，整個團隊每晚都加班到很晚趕報告。

listen.en: His parents were frantic with worry when he didn't come home.
listen.zh: 他沒回家時，他的爸媽急得要命。

chinese.en: Despite frantic efforts by volunteers, the oil spill killed thousands of seabirds along the coast.
chinese.zh: 儘管志工們拚命搶救，漏油事件仍造成沿岸數千隻海鳥死亡。

english.en: Life in a big city can feel frantic and stressful.
english.zh: 大城市的生活可能讓人覺得忙亂又有壓力。

speak.en: Mornings in my house are always frantic because everyone gets up late.
speak.zh: 我家的早晨總是手忙腳亂，因為大家都太晚起床。

write.en: Shoppers made a frantic rush for the doors as soon as the sale began.
write.zh: 特賣一開始，購物人潮就瘋狂地衝向店門。

example.en: Regular exercise helps build muscle tissue, which in turn allows the body to burn more energy while resting.
example.zh: 規律運動有助於增加肌肉組織，進而讓身體在休息時也能消耗更多熱量。

listen.en: Could you pass me a box of tissues, please?
listen.zh: 可以請你遞一盒面紙給我嗎？

chinese.en: Doctors used a small sample of skin tissue to find out what was causing the rash.
chinese.zh: 醫生取了一小塊皮膚組織樣本，查出造成疹子的原因。

english.en: I always carry tissues because I often get a runny nose.
english.zh: 我總是隨身帶著面紙，因為我常常流鼻水。

speak.en: The film was so sad that I used up all my tissues.
speak.zh: 那部電影太感人了，我把面紙都用光了。

write.en: Smoking can cause serious damage to lung tissue, even in young and healthy people.
write.zh: 吸菸可能對肺部組織造成嚴重傷害，即使是年輕健康的人也不例外。

example.en: The chart shows that annual rainfall in the region dropped sharply, leaving many farmers short of water for their crops.
example.zh: 圖表顯示該地區的年降雨量大幅下降，讓許多農民的作物缺水。

listen.en: We had very little rainfall here last summer.
listen.zh: 去年夏天這裡幾乎沒什麼降雨。

chinese.en: Scientists warn that changes in rainfall patterns could affect the supply of drinking water.
chinese.zh: 科學家警告，降雨模式的改變可能影響飲用水的供應。

english.en: The northern part of the island gets more rainfall in winter.
english.zh: 島嶼北部在冬天的降雨量比較多。

speak.en: Honestly, I don't mind the rainfall, because it keeps everything green.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不介意下雨，因為雨水讓一切都保持綠意。

write.en: Our outdoor concert was postponed after the weather service predicted record rainfall for the weekend.
write.zh: 氣象單位預測週末將有破紀錄的降雨，我們的戶外音樂會因此延期。

example.en: At first I was skeptical of online courses, but the lively discussions and helpful feedback soon changed my mind.
example.zh: 一開始我對線上課程存疑，但熱烈的討論和實用的回饋很快就改變了我的想法。

listen.en: My father is skeptical of anything he reads online.
listen.zh: 我爸對他在網路上看到的任何東西都抱持懷疑。

chinese.en: Investors remain skeptical that the new company can turn a profit any time soon.
chinese.zh: 投資人仍然懷疑這家新公司短期內能否獲利。

english.en: She gave me a skeptical look when I said I'd cook dinner.
english.zh: 我說要煮晚餐時，她用懷疑的眼神看著我。

speak.en: I'm a bit skeptical about diets that promise quick results.
speak.zh: 我對那些標榜快速見效的減肥法有點懷疑。

write.en: Some teachers are deeply skeptical of the claim that technology always improves learning.
write.zh: 有些老師對「科技一定能提升學習」的說法深表懷疑。

example.en: Unlike marine species that live in the ocean, terrestrial species must cope with dramatic changes in temperature on land.
example.zh: 不同於生活在海洋中的物種，陸生物種必須應付陸地上劇烈的溫度變化。

listen.en: Frogs spend part of their lives in terrestrial habitats.
listen.zh: 青蛙一生中有部分時間生活在陸地棲地。

chinese.en: Deforestation is one of the biggest threats to terrestrial ecosystems around the world.
chinese.zh: 森林砍伐是全球陸地生態系面臨的最大威脅之一。

english.en: Scientists study both terrestrial and marine plants in this lab.
english.zh: 科學家在這間實驗室研究陸生和海洋植物。

speak.en: Some people still watch terrestrial TV instead of streaming services.
speak.zh: 有些人還是看無線電視，而不是用串流平台。

write.en: Astronomers compare the surface of Mars with terrestrial deserts to understand its history.
write.zh: 天文學家將火星表面和地球上的沙漠做比較，以了解火星的歷史。

example.en: The new regulations supersede all previous guidelines, so staff should no longer follow the instructions in the old handbook.
example.zh: 新規定取代了先前所有的準則，所以員工不應該再遵照舊手冊上的指示。

listen.en: Paper tickets have been superseded by apps on our phones.
listen.zh: 紙本票券已經被手機上的應用程式取代了。

chinese.en: This edition of the textbook supersedes the earlier one and includes updated research.
chinese.zh: 這一版教科書取代了先前的版本，並收錄了最新的研究。

english.en: The old software was superseded by a faster and safer system.
english.zh: 舊軟體被一套更快、更安全的系統取代了。

speak.en: I guess streaming has pretty much superseded buying CDs these days.
speak.zh: 我想現在串流差不多已經取代買CD了。

write.en: Some economists believe that renewable energy will eventually supersede coal as the main power source.
write.zh: 有些經濟學家認為，再生能源最終將取代煤炭，成為主要的電力來源。

example.en: Undoubtedly, the internet has transformed the way people shop, though some still prefer to see products in person.
example.zh: 網路無疑改變了人們購物的方式，雖然還是有些人喜歡親眼看到商品。

listen.en: The new library will undoubtedly attract more students.
listen.zh: 新圖書館無疑會吸引更多學生。

chinese.en: Regular exercise is undoubtedly good for both your physical and mental health.
chinese.zh: 規律運動無疑對身心健康都有好處。

english.en: Undoubtedly, this was the hardest exam I have ever taken.
english.zh: 毫無疑問，這是我考過最難的一次考試。

speak.en: Night markets are undoubtedly the best part of living in Taiwan.
speak.zh: 夜市無疑是住在臺灣最棒的一件事。

write.en: Rising housing costs will undoubtedly push more young people to move away from big cities.
write.zh: 居住成本上漲無疑會迫使更多年輕人搬離大城市。

example.en: The graph shows a sharp decrease in car sales during the winter months, followed by a gradual recovery in spring.
example.zh: 圖表顯示冬季幾個月汽車銷量急遽下降，隨後在春季逐漸回升。

listen.en: Traffic noise decreases a lot late at night.
listen.zh: 深夜時交通噪音會減少很多。

chinese.en: Drinking less sugary soda can decrease your risk of developing serious health problems.
chinese.zh: 少喝含糖汽水可以降低你出現嚴重健康問題的風險。

english.en: The price of the tickets decreased by twenty percent this year.
english.zh: 今年的票價下降了百分之二十。

speak.en: My screen time decreased a lot after I deleted social media.
speak.zh: 我刪掉社群媒體之後，使用螢幕的時間減少了很多。

write.en: The company hopes the new training program will lead to a decrease in workplace accidents.
write.zh: 公司希望新的訓練計畫能讓職場意外減少。

example.en: With exams, a part-time job and club activities, her schedule was so hectic that she barely had time to eat.
example.zh: 要準備考試、打工又要參加社團活動，她的行程忙到幾乎沒時間吃飯。

listen.en: The airport is always hectic during the holidays.
listen.zh: 放假期間機場總是一片忙亂。

chinese.en: Many city workers lead hectic lives and rarely find time to cook healthy meals.
chinese.zh: 許多都市上班族生活忙碌，很少有時間煮健康的餐點。

english.en: Things got really hectic in the office before the deadline.
english.zh: 截止日期前，辦公室變得非常忙亂。

speak.en: My mornings are pretty hectic because I always wake up late.
speak.zh: 我的早上都手忙腳亂的，因為我總是很晚起床。

write.en: The hectic pace of modern life has made mindfulness classes increasingly popular in big cities.
write.zh: 現代生活步調緊湊，讓正念課程在大城市越來越受歡迎。

example.en: Volunteers worked alongside local farmers for a month, learning how to plant rice by hand in muddy fields.
example.zh: 志工和當地農民一起工作了一個月，學習如何在泥濘的田裡手工插秧。

listen.en: A taxi pulled up alongside and the driver waved.
listen.zh: 一輛計程車在旁邊停下，司機揮了揮手。

chinese.en: In many Asian cities, traditional markets still exist alongside modern shopping malls.
chinese.zh: 在許多亞洲城市，傳統市場仍與現代購物中心並存。

english.en: I really enjoy working alongside people who have different ideas.
english.zh: 我很喜歡和想法不同的人一起工作。

speak.en: My little brother always runs alongside me when I go jogging.
speak.zh: 我去慢跑的時候，我弟弟總是跟在我旁邊跑。

write.en: Students should develop practical skills alongside academic knowledge to prepare for future careers.
write.zh: 學生除了學術知識之外，也應該培養實務技能，為未來的職涯做準備。

example.en: The bookstore is closing down, so every item is being sold at a heavy discount until the end of the month.
example.zh: 那家書店要歇業了，所以到月底前所有商品都大打折出售。

listen.en: Do you offer a discount for large groups?
listen.zh: 你們有提供大團體折扣嗎？

chinese.en: Doctors could not discount the possibility that her headaches were caused by stress.
chinese.zh: 醫生無法排除她的頭痛是壓力引起的可能性。

english.en: The shop discounted all winter coats after the new year.
english.zh: 過完新年後，那家店的冬季外套全部打折。

speak.en: I usually wait for discounts before buying new clothes online.
speak.zh: 我通常會等打折才在網路上買新衣服。

write.en: We should not discount the opinions of older residents when planning changes to the neighborhood.
write.zh: 規劃社區改造時，我們不應該忽視年長居民的意見。

example.en: Before building the bridge, engineers carried out a preliminary survey of the riverbank to check whether the soil was stable.
example.zh: 建橋之前，工程師先對河岸做了初步勘查，確認土壤是否穩固。

listen.en: Our team was knocked out in the preliminary round.
listen.zh: 我們隊在預賽就被淘汰了。

chinese.en: The preliminary findings of the survey will be shared with all staff next week.
chinese.zh: 這項調查的初步結果將在下週與全體員工分享。

english.en: We had a preliminary meeting to discuss the project plan.
english.zh: 我們開了一場初步會議來討論專案計畫。

speak.en: Let's skip the preliminaries and get straight to the main point.
speak.zh: 我們就省掉開場客套，直接進入重點吧。

write.en: A preliminary report on air quality has prompted the city to restrict traffic near schools.
write.zh: 一份空氣品質的初步報告促使市政府限制學校周邊的交通。

example.en: The packaging is made of rigid plastic, which protects fragile items like glasses from breaking during delivery.
example.zh: 包裝是用硬質塑膠做的，能保護玻璃杯這類易碎物品在運送途中不會破損。

listen.en: Her parents were always quite rigid about bedtime rules.
listen.zh: 她的父母對就寢時間的規定一向很嚴格。

chinese.en: Critics argue that a rigid exam system discourages students from thinking creatively.
chinese.zh: 批評者認為，僵化的考試制度會打擊學生的創意思考。

english.en: My boss is too rigid to accept any new ideas.
english.zh: 我老闆太死板了，不願接受任何新點子。

speak.en: I don't like following a rigid schedule on holiday.
speak.zh: 放假的時候，我不喜歡照著死板的行程走。

write.en: Steel frames keep the tent rigid even when strong winds blow across the campsite.
write.zh: 鋼製骨架讓帳篷即使在強風吹過營地時也能保持穩固不變形。

example.en: During the hottest part of the day, many desert lizards burrow into the sand, where the temperature is much cooler.
example.zh: 在一天中最熱的時段，許多沙漠蜥蜴會鑽進沙子裡，因為那裡的溫度涼爽得多。

listen.en: The puppy burrowed under the blanket to keep warm.
listen.zh: 小狗鑽進毯子底下取暖。

chinese.en: Earthworms burrow through the soil, which helps air and water reach plant roots.
chinese.zh: 蚯蚓在土壤中鑽洞，有助於空氣和水分到達植物的根部。

english.en: We found a small burrow near the bottom of the tree.
english.zh: 我們在樹的底部附近發現一個小洞穴。

speak.en: On cold mornings, I just want to burrow deeper into my bed.
speak.zh: 冷冷的早上，我只想往被窩裡鑽得更深。

write.en: Construction in the area has destroyed the burrows of several endangered species of crab.
write.zh: 這一帶的工程破壞了好幾種瀕危螃蟹的洞穴。

example.en: The injured kitten looked so pathetic, shivering in the rain without food, that we decided to take it home.
example.zh: 那隻受傷的小貓在雨中發抖、沒東西吃，看起來好可憐，所以我們決定帶牠回家。

listen.en: The team made a pathetic attempt to score.
listen.zh: 那支球隊想得分，但表現得很差勁。

chinese.en: The government's response to the flooding was criticized as slow and pathetic.
chinese.zh: 政府對水災的應變被批評為緩慢又差勁。

english.en: The salary they offered me was pathetic for so much work.
english.zh: 以那麼大的工作量來說，他們開給我的薪水實在少得可憐。

speak.en: Honestly, my cooking skills are pretty pathetic, so I eat out a lot.
speak.zh: 說實話，我的廚藝很差勁，所以我常在外面吃。

write.en: Despite months of study, my score on the first practice test was pathetic.
write.zh: 雖然讀了好幾個月，我第一次模擬考的分數還是慘不忍睹。

example.en: The hotel package is all-inclusive, so meals, drinks and activities are covered by the price you pay at booking.
example.zh: 這個飯店方案是全包式的，餐點、飲料和活動都包含在訂房時支付的價格裡。

listen.en: The museum is trying to be more inclusive for everyone.
listen.zh: 博物館正努力讓每個人都能更自在地參與。

chinese.en: Inclusive education allows children with special needs to learn in ordinary classrooms.
chinese.zh: 融合教育讓有特殊需求的孩子能在一般教室學習。

english.en: The price of the room is inclusive of breakfast and tax.
english.zh: 房價包含早餐和稅金。

speak.en: I think a good team leader should be inclusive and listen to everyone.
speak.zh: 我覺得好的團隊領導者應該要有包容心，傾聽每個人的意見。

write.en: The library will be closed from Monday to Wednesday inclusive for repairs.
write.zh: 圖書館將從週一到週三（含）閉館整修。

example.en: To boost the struggling economy, the government plans to inject billions of dollars into infrastructure projects such as railways.
example.zh: 為了提振疲弱的經濟，政府計畫投入數十億美元在鐵路等基礎建設上。

listen.en: Some diabetic patients need to inject insulin before every meal.
listen.zh: 有些糖尿病患者每餐前都需要注射胰島素。

chinese.en: The new manager injected fresh energy into the team and improved everyone's motivation.
chinese.zh: 新經理為團隊注入一股新活力，也提升了每個人的工作動力。

english.en: The investors injected more money into the small company last year.
english.zh: 投資人去年對這家小公司投入了更多資金。

speak.en: I always try to inject a bit of humor into my presentations.
speak.zh: 我總是試著在簡報裡加一點幽默感。

write.en: Hosting international sports events can inject new life into a city's tourism industry.
write.zh: 舉辦國際運動賽事可以為一座城市的觀光業注入新生命。

example.en: Many rural towns suffer from a brain drain, as talented young people leave to find better-paid jobs in the capital.
example.zh: 許多鄉鎮面臨人才外流，因為有能力的年輕人紛紛離開，到首都找薪水更好的工作。

listen.en: The kitchen drain is blocked again, so call a plumber.
listen.zh: 廚房排水管又塞住了，快叫水電工來。

chinese.en: Caring for a sick family member can drain you both physically and emotionally.
chinese.zh: 照顧生病的家人可能讓你身心俱疲。

english.en: The expensive project has become a drain on the city's budget.
english.zh: 這個昂貴的計畫已經成為市政府預算的沉重負擔。

speak.en: After a full day of meetings, I always feel completely drained.
speak.zh: 開了一整天會之後，我總是覺得精疲力竭。

write.en: Farmers drained the wetland decades ago, but now the government wants to restore it.
write.zh: 農民在幾十年前把這片濕地的水排乾，但現在政府想要恢復它。

example.en: Tourists who chase or feed the monkeys are harassing wild animals, which can change their natural behavior and make them aggressive.
example.zh: 追逐或餵食猴子的遊客其實是在騷擾野生動物，這可能改變牠們的自然行為，讓牠們變得具攻擊性。

listen.en: Please stop harassing your sister about her homework.
listen.zh: 別再一直纏著你妹妹問她功課的事了。

chinese.en: The new law protects online users who are harassed with unwanted messages.
chinese.zh: 新法保障在網路上受到騷擾訊息困擾的使用者。

english.en: Reporters harassed the young singer outside her hotel all day.
english.zh: 記者整天在飯店外面糾纏那位年輕歌手。

speak.en: I hate it when shop assistants harass me to buy something.
speak.zh: 我很討厭店員一直纏著我要我買東西。

write.en: Companies must have clear policies so that no employee feels harassed at work.
write.zh: 公司必須訂定明確的政策，讓每位員工在工作中都不會感到被騷擾。

example.en: The stone cottage had no electricity, so we cooked over a fire and read by candlelight every evening.
example.zh: 那間石屋沒有電，所以我們每天晚上都用柴火煮飯、點蠟燭看書。

listen.en: We rented a cottage in the mountains for the weekend.
listen.zh: 我們週末在山上租了一間小屋。

chinese.en: Many old cottages in the village have been turned into cafés and guesthouses.
chinese.zh: 村裡許多老房子已改建成咖啡館和民宿。

english.en: They dream of retiring to a quiet cottage in the countryside.
english.zh: 他們夢想退休後搬到鄉下一間安靜的小屋住。

speak.en: I'd love to spend a few days in a cozy cottage.
speak.zh: 我很想在一間溫馨的小屋住幾天。

write.en: Weaving was once a cottage industry, with families making cloth by hand at home.
write.zh: 織布曾經是一種家庭手工業，由一家人在家中手工織布。

example.en: Heavy snow and ice made driving conditions extremely hazardous, so police advised people to stay at home unless absolutely necessary.
example.zh: 大雪和結冰讓行車狀況極度危險，所以警方建議民眾除非絕對必要，否則待在家裡。

listen.en: Breathing this smoke can be hazardous to your health.
listen.zh: 吸入這種煙可能危害你的健康。

chinese.en: Workers handling hazardous chemicals are required to wear gloves and masks at all times.
chinese.zh: 處理危險化學品的工人必須隨時戴著手套和口罩。

english.en: Old batteries are hazardous, so do not throw them in the trash.
english.zh: 舊電池有害，所以不要丟進垃圾桶。

speak.en: Climbing that mountain in the rainy season is pretty hazardous.
speak.zh: 在雨季爬那座山蠻危險的。

write.en: Air pollution has reached hazardous levels in some cities, forcing schools to cancel outdoor classes.
write.zh: 部分城市的空氣汙染已達危險等級，迫使學校取消戶外課程。

example.en: Farmers have grown rice on these mountain terraces for centuries, cutting flat steps into the steep slopes by hand.
example.zh: 幾百年來，農民在這些山區梯田上種稻，親手在陡坡上開鑿出一層層平臺。

listen.en: Let's sit out on the terrace and enjoy the sunset.
listen.zh: 我們到露臺上坐坐，欣賞夕陽吧。

chinese.en: In many British cities, rows of terraced houses were built for factory workers.
chinese.zh: 在許多英國城市，一排排的連棟排屋是為工廠工人蓋的。

english.en: Our apartment has a small terrace with lots of plants.
english.zh: 我們的公寓有個種了很多植物的小露臺。

speak.en: My favorite café has a rooftop terrace with an amazing view.
speak.zh: 我最喜歡的咖啡館有個頂樓露臺，景色超棒。

write.en: To prevent soil erosion, villagers terraced the hillside and planted tea along each level.
write.zh: 為了防止土壤流失，村民把山坡修成梯田，並在每一層種植茶樹。

example.en: The newspaper tries to avoid partisan reporting, presenting the views of every side fairly so that readers can decide for themselves.
example.zh: 這家報紙盡量避免偏頗的報導，公平呈現各方觀點，讓讀者自己判斷。

listen.en: Her opinion on the issue is clearly partisan.
listen.zh: 她對這個議題的看法明顯偏袒某一方。

chinese.en: Some voters are tired of partisan arguments and want leaders to solve real problems.
chinese.zh: 有些選民厭倦了黨派之爭，希望領導者解決實際問題。

english.en: The crowd at the game was very partisan and cheered only for the home team.
english.zh: 球賽的觀眾非常偏心，只替地主隊加油。

speak.en: I try not to be too partisan when my friends argue about football.
speak.zh: 朋友在爭論足球的時候，我盡量不要太偏袒哪一方。

write.en: Loyal partisans of the old system resisted every attempt to modernize the school's curriculum.
write.zh: 舊制度的忠實擁護者抗拒每一次讓學校課程現代化的嘗試。

example.en: Food poisoning usually causes stomach pain, fever and vomiting, so patients should drink plenty of water to avoid dehydration.
example.zh: 食物中毒通常會引起胃痛、發燒和嘔吐，所以病人應該多喝水以免脫水。

listen.en: The rough sea made many passengers feel like vomiting.
listen.zh: 海浪很大，讓許多乘客想吐。

chinese.en: If your dog keeps vomiting after meals, you should take it to a vet.
chinese.zh: 如果你的狗吃完飯後一直嘔吐，你應該帶牠去看獸醫。

english.en: She felt dizzy and vomited after the roller coaster ride.
english.zh: 她坐完雲霄飛車後頭暈並嘔吐。

speak.en: I get carsick easily, and once I even vomited on a bus.
speak.zh: 我很容易暈車，有一次甚至在公車上吐了。

write.en: Cleaners had to wipe up the vomit in the stadium after the late-night concert.
write.zh: 深夜演唱會結束後，清潔人員得清理體育館裡的嘔吐物。

example.en: The new parking fees were met with a chorus of complaints from local shop owners, who feared losing customers.
example.zh: 新的停車收費引來當地店家一片抱怨聲，他們擔心會流失客人。

listen.en: The children answered the teacher's question in chorus.
listen.zh: 孩子們齊聲回答老師的問題。

chinese.en: My sister has sung in the school chorus since she was in primary school.
chinese.zh: 我妹妹從國小開始就在學校合唱團唱歌。

english.en: The chorus of this song is really easy to remember.
english.zh: 這首歌的副歌真的很好記。

speak.en: I always forget the verses, but I know every chorus by heart.
speak.zh: 我總是記不住主歌，但每段副歌我都背得滾瓜爛熟。

write.en: "Happy birthday!" the guests chorused as the cake was carried into the room.
write.zh: 蛋糕被端進房間時，賓客們齊聲喊道：「生日快樂！」

example.en: After months of unemployment, Tom had depleted his savings and had to move back in with his parents.
example.zh: 失業好幾個月後，湯姆把積蓄都花光了，只好搬回去和父母同住。

listen.en: Long periods of stress can deplete your energy very quickly.
listen.zh: 長期壓力會很快耗盡你的精力。

chinese.en: Certain chemicals once widely used in fridges helped to deplete the ozone layer.
chinese.zh: 某些過去廣泛用於冰箱的化學物質，曾造成臭氧層耗損。

english.en: Our supply of drinking water was nearly depleted after the long hike.
english.zh: 長途健行後，我們的飲用水幾乎喝光了。

speak.en: Playing games on my phone really depletes the battery fast.
speak.zh: 用手機玩遊戲真的很耗電。

write.en: Intensive farming can deplete the soil of nutrients unless farmers rotate their crops.
write.zh: 集約耕作可能耗盡土壤中的養分，除非農民實施輪作。

example.en: When the flight was delayed, the pilot reassured passengers that the problem was minor and would be fixed quickly.
example.zh: 班機延誤時，機長安撫乘客說問題不大，很快就會修好。

listen.en: Her calm voice reassured the nervous students before the exam.
listen.zh: 考試前，她平靜的聲音讓緊張的學生安心不少。

chinese.en: The company tried to reassure customers about the safety of its products.
chinese.zh: 公司試圖讓顧客對其產品的安全性放心。

english.en: I felt reassured when my parents said they would support me.
english.zh: 爸媽說會支持我的時候，我覺得安心多了。

speak.en: When friends are worried, I usually try to reassure them with a joke.
speak.zh: 朋友擔心的時候，我通常會講個笑話讓他們放心。

write.en: Clear information from the government can reassure the public during an outbreak of disease.
write.zh: 疫情爆發期間，政府提供清楚的資訊能讓民眾安心。

example.en: This species of orchid is exceedingly rare, growing only on a few remote cliffs where collectors cannot easily reach it.
example.zh: 這種蘭花極為罕見，只生長在少數偏遠的懸崖上，採集者很難到達。

listen.en: We are exceedingly grateful for your kind help.
listen.zh: 我們非常感謝您的熱心幫忙。

chinese.en: The new manager handled the difficult negotiations exceedingly well and earned everyone's respect.
chinese.zh: 新經理把棘手的談判處理得非常好，贏得了大家的尊重。

english.en: Housing in the city center is exceedingly expensive for young people.
english.zh: 市中心的房子對年輕人來說非常昂貴。

speak.en: To be honest, the weather here is exceedingly hot in summer.
speak.zh: 老實說，這裡夏天的天氣熱得不得了。

write.en: It is exceedingly important for children to learn how to swim at an early age.
write.zh: 讓孩子從小學會游泳是非常重要的。

example.en: Public opinion shifted quickly after the documentary showed how much plastic ends up in the ocean every year.
example.zh: 那部紀錄片揭露每年有多少塑膠流入海洋後，輿論迅速轉向。

listen.en: Can I ask your opinion about my essay?
listen.zh: 我可以問問你對我這篇文章的看法嗎？

chinese.en: My manager has a high opinion of her, so she will probably get promoted.
chinese.zh: 我的主管很欣賞她，所以她很可能會升職。

english.en: We had a difference of opinion about where to go on vacation.
english.zh: 我們對要去哪裡度假意見不同。

speak.en: Everyone has a right to their own opinion, even if I disagree.
speak.zh: 每個人都有權有自己的看法，就算我不同意也一樣。

write.en: Social media allows ordinary people to express their opinions on government policies instantly.
write.zh: 社群媒體讓一般人能即時對政府政策發表意見。

example.en: The island is home to thousands of wild goats, hence its local name, Goat Island, which appears on old maps.
example.zh: 這座島上住著數以千計的野山羊，因此當地人稱它為「山羊島」，這個名字也出現在舊地圖上。

listen.en: The software is new and hence not fully tested.
listen.zh: 這套軟體是新的，因此還沒有完整測試過。

chinese.en: Sugar is cheap and widely available, hence its use in so many processed foods.
chinese.zh: 糖便宜又容易取得，所以才會被用在這麼多加工食品裡。

english.en: He missed the bus; hence, he was late for class.
english.zh: 他錯過了公車，因此上課遲到了。

speak.en: I grew up near the sea, hence my love of seafood.
speak.zh: 我在海邊長大，所以才這麼愛吃海鮮。

write.en: Many young people cannot afford homes in big cities; hence the need for more affordable housing.
write.zh: 許多年輕人買不起大城市的房子，因此需要更多平價住宅。

example.en: Under the treaty, member nations agreed to reduce carbon emissions gradually and report their progress to an international committee.
example.zh: 根據這項條約，會員國同意逐步減少碳排放，並向一個國際委員會報告進展。

listen.en: The peace treaty ended many years of conflict.
listen.zh: 這份和平條約結束了多年的衝突。

chinese.en: The treaty bans commercial fishing in the area to give marine life time to recover.
chinese.zh: 這項條約禁止在該海域進行商業捕撈，讓海洋生物有時間恢復。

english.en: Both countries must approve the treaty before it takes effect.
english.zh: 兩國都必須批准這項條約，條約才會生效。

speak.en: I remember learning about famous treaties in history class, but they were pretty boring.
speak.zh: 我記得在歷史課學過一些有名的條約，但內容挺無聊的。

write.en: Some experts doubt whether a global treaty on plastic pollution can be enforced effectively.
write.zh: 有些專家懷疑一項全球塑膠汙染條約能否被有效執行。

example.en: When the tornado warning sounded, families rushed into their basements and waited until the strong winds had passed.
example.zh: 龍捲風警報一響，家家戶戶衝進地下室，一直等到強風過去。

listen.en: The tornado lifted the car and threw it across the road.
listen.zh: 龍捲風把車子捲起來，甩到馬路對面。

chinese.en: Scientists are still studying why a tornado forms in some storms but not others.
chinese.zh: 科學家仍在研究為什麼有些暴風雨會形成龍捲風，有些卻不會。

english.en: Tornado season in this region usually starts in early spring.
english.zh: 這個地區的龍捲風季節通常在初春開始。

speak.en: I've never seen a tornado, but I'd find it terrifying.
speak.zh: 我從來沒看過龍捲風，但我想那一定很可怕。

write.en: After the tornado, volunteers from nearby cities helped residents clear the damaged streets.
write.zh: 龍捲風過後，鄰近城市的志工協助居民清理受損的街道。

example.en: Before painting the old door, we had to strip off several layers of peeling paint with a scraper.
example.zh: 在粉刷舊門之前，我們得先用刮刀刮掉好幾層剝落的油漆。

listen.en: The athlete was stripped of her medal for breaking the rules.
listen.zh: 那名運動員因違規而被取消獎牌。

chinese.en: A narrow strip of land separates the freshwater lake from the sea.
chinese.zh: 一條狹長的陸地把這座淡水湖和大海隔開。

english.en: I love reading the comic strips in the weekend newspaper.
english.zh: 我很喜歡看週末報紙上的連環漫畫。

speak.en: Every Sunday, I strip the bed and wash all the sheets.
speak.zh: 每個星期天，我都會把床單被套拆下來全部洗一洗。

write.en: Logging companies have stripped the hillside of its trees, leaving the soil exposed to heavy rain.
write.zh: 伐木公司把山坡上的樹木砍伐殆盡，讓土壤直接暴露在大雨之下。

example.en: A freak hailstorm damaged hundreds of cars and shocked residents who had never seen ice fall in July.
example.zh: 一場罕見的冰雹砸壞了數百輛車，讓從沒見過七月下冰雹的居民大吃一驚。

listen.en: My roommate is a real fitness freak who exercises daily.
listen.zh: 我室友是個超級健身狂，每天都運動。

chinese.en: Experts say the flood was not a freak event but a result of climate change.
chinese.zh: 專家表示，這場洪水並不是偶發的異常事件，而是氣候變遷的結果。

english.en: The team lost the final because of a freak goal.
english.zh: 那支隊伍因為一顆意外的進球而輸掉了決賽。

speak.en: I'm a bit of a control freak when it comes to planning trips.
speak.zh: 說到規劃旅行，我有點控制狂。

write.en: Insurance policies sometimes refuse to cover damage caused by freak weather such as sudden snow.
write.zh: 保險有時拒絕理賠由突來的降雪等異常天氣所造成的損失。

example.en: The deepest ocean trench is so dark and cold that scientists use special robots to explore the strange creatures living there.
example.zh: 最深的海溝又暗又冷，科學家得用特殊機器人去探索住在那裡的奇特生物。

listen.en: Water collected in the trench after the heavy rain.
listen.zh: 大雨過後，溝渠裡積滿了水。

chinese.en: Archaeologists dug a narrow trench to examine the layers of soil beneath the ancient city.
chinese.zh: 考古學家挖了一條窄溝，來檢視古城底下的土層。

english.en: My father wears his old trench coat whenever it rains.
english.zh: 每次下雨，我爸都會穿他那件舊風衣。

speak.en: Kids at the beach love digging trenches to let the waves in.
speak.zh: 在海邊的小孩很愛挖溝渠，讓海浪流進來。

write.en: History museums often recreate the trenches of the First World War to show visitors how soldiers lived.
write.zh: 歷史博物館常重現第一次世界大戰的壕溝，讓參觀者了解當時士兵如何生活。

example.en: Competition in the smartphone market is brutal, and companies that fail to innovate are quickly forced out of business.
example.zh: 智慧型手機市場的競爭非常殘酷，不創新的公司很快就會被淘汰。

listen.en: The final climb up the mountain was brutal.
listen.zh: 登山的最後一段爬坡非常累人。

chinese.en: The documentary exposed the brutal treatment of animals on some industrial farms.
chinese.zh: 這部紀錄片揭露了某些工業化農場殘酷對待動物的情形。

english.en: The winter in that northern city is long and brutal.
english.zh: 那座北方城市的冬天又長又嚴寒。

speak.en: Honestly, the exam schedule this term has been absolutely brutal.
speak.zh: 說真的，這學期的考試行程真的累死人。

write.en: Some readers appreciate brutal honesty in reviews, while others find it unnecessarily harsh.
write.zh: 有些讀者欣賞評論中直言不諱的態度，有些人則覺得太過嚴厲。

example.en: After a string of poor results, the company decided to replace its manager and change its whole marketing strategy.
example.zh: 在接連幾次業績不佳之後，公司決定撤換經理，並全面改變行銷策略。

listen.en: A string on my guitar broke during practice.
listen.zh: 我吉他上的一根弦在練習時斷了。

chinese.en: Volunteers strung colorful lights between the trees for the annual night market.
chinese.zh: 志工們在樹與樹之間掛起彩色燈串，迎接一年一度的夜市。

english.en: The gym's free trial really comes with no strings attached.
english.zh: 這家健身房的免費試用真的沒有附帶任何條件。

speak.en: When I'm nervous, I can hardly string two sentences together.
speak.zh: 我一緊張，就幾乎講不出完整的句子。

write.en: Children in the workshop learned to string beads into simple bracelets for their mothers.
write.zh: 工作坊裡的孩子學著把珠子串成簡單的手環送給媽媽。

example.en: The researchers admitted that their inference was based on limited data and might change once more evidence became available.
example.zh: 研究人員承認，他們的推論是根據有限的數據，一旦有更多證據，結論可能會改變。

listen.en: Reading tests often ask students to make inferences.
listen.zh: 閱讀測驗常要學生做推論。

chinese.en: The detective's clever inference helped the police find the stolen painting quickly.
chinese.zh: 偵探巧妙的推論幫助警方很快找到了失竊的畫作。

english.en: By inference, he must have known about the surprise party.
english.zh: 由此推斷，他一定早就知道驚喜派對的事了。

speak.en: I made a wrong inference and thought my friend was angry.
speak.zh: 我推論錯了，還以為我朋友在生氣。

write.en: It is risky to make inferences about an entire population from a small online survey.
write.zh: 只根據小規模的網路問卷就對整體人口做出推論是有風險的。

example.en: The city has a glorious past as a busy trading port, and many of its grand old buildings still stand today.
example.zh: 這座城市曾是繁忙的貿易港口，擁有輝煌的過去，許多宏偉的老建築至今仍屹立不搖。

listen.en: The garden looks glorious when the roses are in bloom.
listen.zh: 玫瑰盛開時，花園看起來美極了。

chinese.en: The team celebrated their glorious victory with a parade through the city streets.
chinese.zh: 球隊以遊行穿越市區街道，慶祝他們光榮的勝利。

english.en: From the top of the hill, we had a glorious view of the sunrise.
english.zh: 我們從山頂上看到了壯麗的日出美景。

speak.en: Waking up to glorious sunshine always puts me in a good mood.
speak.zh: 一早醒來看到燦爛的陽光，總是讓我心情很好。

write.en: Winning the scholarship was a glorious moment for the whole family after years of hard work.
write.zh: 經過多年努力，拿到獎學金對全家人來說是光榮的一刻。

example.en: Thanks to advances in technology, many types of surgery now leave only tiny scars, so patients recover much faster.
example.zh: 由於科技進步，現在許多手術只會留下很小的疤痕，所以病人恢復得快多了。

listen.en: She is still recovering from surgery at home.
listen.zh: 她開完刀後還在家休養。

chinese.en: The surgeon performed the surgery successfully, but the patient must stay in hospital for observation.
chinese.zh: 外科醫生順利完成了手術，但病人還必須住院觀察。

english.en: These days, many people choose laser surgery to correct their eyesight.
english.zh: 現在很多人選擇雷射手術來矯正視力。

speak.en: I was really nervous before my surgery, but it went fine.
speak.zh: 我開刀前真的很緊張，不過結果很順利。

write.en: Some people worry that cosmetic surgery puts too much pressure on young people to look perfect.
write.zh: 有些人擔心整形手術讓年輕人承受太大的壓力，覺得自己必須看起來完美。

example.en: Workers injured on the job are entitled to compensation, which covers their medical bills and part of their lost wages.
example.zh: 因工受傷的員工有權獲得賠償，用來支付醫療費用和部分損失的薪資。

listen.en: The hotel gave us a free dinner as compensation.
listen.zh: 飯店招待我們一頓免費晚餐作為補償。

chinese.en: Residents whose homes were damaged by the construction are demanding compensation from the city.
chinese.zh: 房屋因施工受損的居民正向市政府要求賠償。

english.en: The new job offers good compensation and flexible working hours.
english.zh: 這份新工作提供優渥的薪酬和彈性的工作時間。

speak.en: No amount of compensation could replace my lost photos, honestly.
speak.zh: 說真的，再多的賠償也換不回我遺失的照片。

write.en: Some argue that farmers should receive compensation when new environmental rules reduce their income.
write.zh: 有人主張，當新的環保法規讓農民收入減少時，農民應該獲得補償。

example.en: The chef pays great attention to presentation, arranging each dish like a small work of art before it leaves the kitchen.
example.zh: 這位主廚非常重視擺盤，每道菜送出廚房前都排得像件小藝術品。

listen.en: Her presentation was clear and easy to follow.
listen.zh: 她的簡報清楚又容易理解。

chinese.en: The award presentation will take place in the school hall after lunch.
chinese.zh: 頒獎典禮將在午餐後於學校禮堂舉行。

english.en: Good presentation skills are important for almost every job today.
english.zh: 良好的簡報能力對現今幾乎每份工作都很重要。

speak.en: I always get nervous before giving a presentation in English.
speak.zh: 用英文做簡報之前，我總是很緊張。

write.en: The museum improved the presentation of its exhibits by adding videos and interactive screens.
write.zh: 博物館加入影片和互動螢幕，改善了展品的呈現方式。

example.en: Mental health was once a taboo subject at work, but more employees now feel comfortable discussing stress openly.
example.zh: 心理健康曾經是職場上的禁忌話題，但現在有更多員工願意坦然談論壓力。

listen.en: She broke a family taboo by asking about his salary.
listen.zh: 她問了他的薪水，觸犯了家裡的禁忌。

chinese.en: Some researchers argue that removing the taboo around failure helps students take more academic risks.
chinese.zh: 有些研究者認為，打破對失敗的忌諱，能讓學生更勇於在學業上冒險。

english.en: In some countries, it is taboo to give a clock as a gift.
english.zh: 在某些國家，送時鐘當禮物是一種忌諱。

speak.en: Honestly, I think age shouldn't be such a taboo topic anymore.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得年齡不應該再是那麼忌諱的話題了。

write.en: The documentary challenged several social taboos and sparked a lively public debate about ageing.
write.zh: 這部紀錄片挑戰了幾項社會禁忌，引發了關於老化的熱烈公共討論。

example.en: Instead of waiting for approval from her manager, she bypassed him and emailed the director directly.
example.zh: 她沒有等主管核准，而是越過他，直接寫電子郵件給總監。

listen.en: We took the bypass to avoid the traffic in town.
listen.zh: 我們走外環道，避開鎮上的車潮。

chinese.en: Some online courses let students bypass traditional entry requirements and start learning immediately.
chinese.zh: 有些線上課程讓學生能跳過傳統的入學門檻，馬上開始學習。

english.en: The hackers found a way to bypass the security system.
english.zh: 駭客找到方法繞過這套安全系統。

speak.en: I usually bypass the main road because it's always jammed.
speak.zh: 我通常會避開主要幹道，因為那裡老是塞車。

write.en: Governments should not bypass public consultation when planning large new infrastructure projects.
write.zh: 政府在規劃大型新基礎建設時，不應略過公眾諮詢的程序。

example.en: Although his parents wanted him to study law, his natural inclination was towards art and design.
example.zh: 雖然他的父母希望他念法律，但他天生的興趣傾向是藝術和設計。

listen.en: She showed little inclination to change her plans.
listen.zh: 她看起來不太想改變計畫。

chinese.en: Teachers should notice each child's inclinations and offer activities that match their interests.
chinese.zh: 老師應該留意每個孩子的性向，並提供符合他們興趣的活動。

english.en: Many young people today have an inclination to work abroad.
english.zh: 現在許多年輕人有出國工作的意願。

speak.en: To be honest, my first inclination was to say no.
speak.zh: 老實說，我第一個念頭是想拒絕。

write.en: There is a growing inclination among consumers to choose products with less plastic packaging.
write.zh: 消費者越來越傾向於選擇塑膠包裝較少的產品。

example.en: Every spring, the accountant checks the company's records carefully to make sure the tax figures are correct.
example.zh: 每年春天，會計師都會仔細核對公司的帳目，確保稅務數字正確無誤。

listen.en: We asked an accountant to help with our taxes.
listen.zh: 我們請了一位會計師幫忙處理稅務。

chinese.en: Small business owners often save money in the long run by hiring a qualified accountant.
chinese.zh: 小企業主聘請合格的會計師，長遠來看往往反而能省錢。

english.en: She studied hard for years to become a certified accountant.
english.zh: 她努力讀了好幾年書，才成為有執照的會計師。

speak.en: I'd never want to be an accountant because I'm terrible with numbers.
speak.zh: 我絕對不想當會計師，因為我對數字超不在行。

write.en: Many accountants worry that artificial intelligence will soon automate much of their routine work.
write.zh: 許多會計師擔心，人工智慧很快就會把他們大部分的例行工作自動化。

example.en: The warning sign on the fence showed that the cables carried high voltage and could be extremely dangerous.
example.zh: 圍籬上的警告標示指出，這些電纜帶有高壓電，可能極度危險。

listen.en: This charger works with different voltages around the world.
listen.zh: 這個充電器在世界各地不同的電壓下都能使用。

chinese.en: In the lab, students measured how the voltage changed as more batteries were added.
chinese.zh: 在實驗室裡，學生測量了加入更多電池時電壓如何變化。

english.en: A sudden drop in voltage caused the lights to flicker.
english.zh: 電壓突然下降，導致燈光閃爍。

speak.en: I fried my hair dryer because I forgot about the voltage.
speak.zh: 我忘了電壓不同，結果把吹風機燒壞了。

write.en: Electric vehicles need high-voltage charging stations, so cities must upgrade their power networks.
write.zh: 電動車需要高壓充電站，因此城市必須升級電力網路。

example.en: At the ceremony, the mayor saluted the volunteers for their tireless work in cleaning up the flooded streets.
example.zh: 典禮上，市長表揚志工們不辭辛勞地清理淹水的街道。

listen.en: The crowd raised their hats in salute to the team.
listen.zh: 群眾舉起帽子向球隊致敬。

chinese.en: This exhibition is a salute to the nurses who worked long hours during the pandemic.
chinese.zh: 這場展覽是向疫情期間長時間工作的護理師致敬。

english.en: We should salute teachers for their patience and hard work.
english.zh: 我們應該向老師們的耐心與辛勞致敬。

speak.en: I really salute anyone who can run a marathon.
speak.zh: 能跑完馬拉松的人，我真的很佩服。

write.en: The students stood quietly and saluted the national flag during the morning assembly.
write.zh: 朝會時，學生們安靜站好，向國旗敬禮。

example.en: Dark clouds gathered over the mountains, and the distant rumble of thunder warned the hikers to turn back.
example.zh: 烏雲在山頭聚集，遠方傳來的隆隆雷聲提醒登山客該折返了。

listen.en: The dog hides under the bed whenever it thunders.
listen.zh: 每次打雷，那隻狗就會躲到床底下。

chinese.en: Heavy trucks thundered past the school all day, making it hard for students to concentrate.
chinese.zh: 大卡車整天轟隆隆地從學校旁駛過，讓學生很難專心。

english.en: The little children were frightened by the thunder last night.
english.zh: 昨晚的雷聲把小朋友們嚇壞了。

speak.en: I actually love falling asleep to the sound of thunder.
speak.zh: 其實我很喜歡聽著雷聲入睡。

write.en: Scientists report that thunder and lightning are becoming more frequent as summers grow hotter.
write.zh: 科學家指出，隨著夏天越來越熱，打雷閃電發生得越來越頻繁。

example.en: When a classmate said her idea was unrealistic, she retorted that every great invention once seemed impossible.
example.zh: 同學說她的點子不切實際，她反駁說，每項偉大的發明當初看起來都是不可能的。

listen.en: She gave a quick retort and everyone laughed.
listen.zh: 她迅速回了一句，大家都笑了。

chinese.en: Instead of making an angry retort, the speaker calmly answered every question from the audience.
chinese.zh: 講者沒有生氣地反擊，而是冷靜地回答了觀眾提出的每個問題。

english.en: He retorted angrily when his friend laughed at his haircut.
english.zh: 朋友嘲笑他的髮型時，他生氣地回嘴。

speak.en: I wanted to retort, but I decided to stay calm instead.
speak.zh: 我很想頂回去，但最後還是決定保持冷靜。

write.en: Online debates often turn into a series of sharp retorts rather than thoughtful discussion.
write.zh: 網路上的辯論常常變成一連串尖銳的互嗆，而不是深思熟慮的討論。

example.en: After his brother ate the last piece of cake, Tom took revenge by hiding his favourite video game.
example.zh: 哥哥吃掉最後一塊蛋糕後，湯姆把他最愛的電玩藏起來作為報復。

listen.en: Revenge rarely makes people feel better in the long run.
listen.zh: 長遠來看，報復很少能讓人真正好過一點。

chinese.en: Psychologists suggest that the desire for revenge often fades when people feel truly heard.
chinese.zh: 心理學家指出，當人覺得自己真正被聆聽時，報復的念頭往往會逐漸消退。

english.en: She refused to seek revenge after her colleague took credit for her work.
english.zh: 同事搶走她的功勞後，她拒絕報復。

speak.en: Honestly, the best revenge is just living a happy life.
speak.zh: 說真的，最好的報復就是讓自己過得幸福快樂。

write.en: The rise in revenge travel after the pandemic boosted tourism income in many countries.
write.zh: 疫情過後報復性旅遊興起，帶動了許多國家的觀光收入。

example.en: The new smartphone was so successful that rival companies quickly imitated its design and lowered their prices.
example.zh: 這款新手機大受歡迎，競爭對手很快就仿效它的設計並調降售價。

listen.en: My little brother can imitate our teacher perfectly.
listen.zh: 我弟弟模仿我們老師模仿得維妙維肖。

chinese.en: Engineers are imitating the shape of bird wings to design quieter and more efficient fans.
chinese.zh: 工程師正在模仿鳥類翅膀的形狀，設計出更安靜、更有效率的風扇。

english.en: Language learners can improve quickly by imitating native speakers' pronunciation.
english.zh: 語言學習者可以藉由模仿母語人士的發音快速進步。

speak.en: I used to imitate singers I saw on TV when I was a kid.
speak.zh: 我小時候常模仿電視上看到的歌手。

write.en: Some critics argue that young artists imitate famous painters too closely instead of developing their own style.
write.zh: 有些評論家認為，年輕藝術家太過模仿知名畫家，而沒有發展出自己的風格。

example.en: Because of heavy fog at the destination, our flight was diverted to another airport several hours away.
example.zh: 因為目的地起了濃霧，我們的班機改降到好幾個小時車程外的另一座機場。

listen.en: Loud music diverted my attention from the lecture.
listen.zh: 吵鬧的音樂讓我無法專心聽講。

chinese.en: The council decided to divert funds from road repairs to build more public libraries.
chinese.zh: 市議會決定把道路維修的經費轉去興建更多公共圖書館。

english.en: Local farmers divert water from the river to their fields.
english.zh: 當地農民把河水引到他們的田裡。

speak.en: Going hiking at weekends helps divert my mind from work stress.
speak.zh: 週末去爬山能幫我把注意力從工作壓力上移開。

write.en: Effective recycling programmes can divert large amounts of household waste away from landfills every year.
write.zh: 有效的資源回收計畫每年能讓大量家庭垃圾不必送進掩埋場。

example.en: In the essay, students must justify their opinions with clear examples rather than simply stating what they believe.
example.zh: 在這篇論說文中，學生必須用清楚的例子支持自己的看法，而不只是陳述自己的想法。

listen.en: Nothing can justify being rude to the staff.
listen.zh: 任何理由都不能合理化對工作人員無禮的行為。

chinese.en: The high cost of the new hospital is justified by the number of lives it will save.
chinese.zh: 這間新醫院將能拯救許多生命，足以證明它高昂的造價是值得的。

english.en: You will need to justify your decision to your manager.
english.zh: 你得向主管說明你做這個決定的理由。

speak.en: I can't really justify buying another pair of shoes this month.
speak.zh: 這個月我實在找不到理由再買一雙鞋了。

write.en: Governments often justify higher fuel taxes by pointing to their benefits for the environment.
write.zh: 政府常以對環境有益為由，替調高燃料稅辯護。

example.en: The traveling exhibition has visited museums in many countries, giving people far from the capital a chance to see it.
example.zh: 這場巡迴展已經到過許多國家的博物館，讓住在遠離首都的人也有機會觀賞。

listen.en: My grandfather was a traveling salesman for many years.
listen.zh: 我爺爺當了很多年四處奔走的推銷員。

chinese.en: A traveling library visits remote villages every month so that children can borrow new books.
chinese.zh: 行動圖書館每個月都會到偏遠村落，讓孩子們能借到新書。

english.en: She was looking for a reliable traveling companion for her trip to Japan.
english.zh: 她正在找一位可靠的旅伴，一起去日本旅行。

speak.en: Traveling alone taught me to be much more independent.
speak.zh: 一個人旅行讓我變得獨立許多。

write.en: Working as a traveling nurse allows her to experience different hospitals and cities.
write.zh: 擔任流動護理師讓她能體驗不同的醫院和城市。

example.en: The dancer's fluid movements made the difficult routine look effortless, and the audience applauded for several minutes.
example.zh: 舞者流暢的動作讓高難度的舞碼看起來毫不費力，觀眾鼓掌了好幾分鐘。

listen.en: Keep this cleaning fluid away from small children.
listen.zh: 請把這瓶清潔液放在小孩拿不到的地方。

chinese.en: Plans for the trip remain fluid because the weather forecast keeps changing.
chinese.zh: 因為天氣預報一直在變，這趟旅行的計畫還沒定案。

english.en: Athletes lose a lot of fluid when they exercise in hot weather.
english.zh: 運動員在炎熱天氣下運動時會流失大量水分。

speak.en: I like his writing style because it's so fluid and easy to read.
speak.zh: 我喜歡他的文風，因為非常流暢、很好讀。

write.en: In a fluid job market, workers must keep learning new skills to stay competitive.
write.zh: 在瞬息萬變的就業市場中，勞工必須持續學習新技能才能保持競爭力。

example.en: As a long-time advocate of public transport, she argued that the city should spend less on roads and more on buses.
example.zh: 身為大眾運輸的長期支持者，她主張市政府應該減少道路支出，把更多錢花在公車上。

listen.en: He is a strong advocate for children's rights.
listen.zh: 他是兒童權益的堅定倡導者。

chinese.en: Some educators advocate replacing traditional exams with projects that test practical skills.
chinese.zh: 有些教育工作者主張以考驗實務能力的專題，取代傳統考試。

english.en: Environmental groups have long advocated the use of renewable energy.
english.zh: 環保團體長期以來一直提倡使用再生能源。

speak.en: I'd definitely advocate learning a second language from a young age.
speak.zh: 我絕對支持從小就開始學第二語言。

write.en: Patient advocates are working with hospitals to make medical information easier to understand.
write.zh: 病患權益倡議者正與醫院合作，讓醫療資訊更容易理解。

example.en: With its colourful lanterns, street performers and lively music, the festival was a feast for the eyes and ears.
example.zh: 這場節慶有五彩繽紛的燈籠、街頭藝人和熱鬧的音樂，堪稱一場視聽饗宴。

listen.en: We feasted on fresh seafood by the sea.
listen.zh: 我們在海邊大啖新鮮海鮮。

chinese.en: The museum's new exhibition offers a feast of art and history for curious visitors.
chinese.zh: 博物館的新展覽為好奇的參觀者帶來一場藝術與歷史的饗宴。

english.en: After the harvest, the villagers held a feast to celebrate.
english.zh: 收成之後，村民們舉辦了一場盛宴來慶祝。

speak.en: Every time I visit my parents, it's like a feast.
speak.zh: 每次我回爸媽家，都像在吃大餐一樣。

write.en: Food waste after large holiday feasts has become a growing concern for environmental groups.
write.zh: 節日大餐後產生的廚餘，已成為環保團體越來越關注的問題。

example.en: Using drones, researchers took aerial images of the forest to measure how quickly the trees were disappearing.
example.zh: 研究人員利用無人機拍攝森林的空拍影像，以測量樹木消失的速度。

listen.en: The aerial view of the island was breathtaking.
listen.zh: 從空中俯瞰這座島，景色美得令人屏息。

chinese.en: The film opens with aerial footage of the coastline, followed by scenes of life in a fishing village.
