chinese.zh: 這部電影以海岸線的空拍畫面開場，接著是漁村生活的景象。

english.en: My grandfather climbed onto the roof to fix the TV aerial.
english.zh: 我爺爺爬上屋頂修理電視天線。

speak.en: The aerial shots in that travel video were absolutely stunning.
speak.zh: 那支旅遊影片裡的空拍畫面真的美到不行。

write.en: Firefighters relied on aerial support from helicopters to control the wildfire in the hills.
write.zh: 消防員仰賴直升機的空中支援，控制山區的野火。

example.en: Tests found lead levels well above the permissible limit, so residents were advised to drink bottled water.
example.zh: 檢測發現鉛含量遠超過容許上限，因此居民被建議改喝瓶裝水。

listen.en: Parking on this street is only permissible on weekends.
listen.zh: 這條街只有週末才可以停車。

chinese.en: In formal academic writing, it is not usually permissible to use slang or abbreviations.
chinese.zh: 在正式的學術寫作中，通常不允許使用俚語或縮寫。

english.en: The airline told us the permissible weight for each suitcase.
english.zh: 航空公司告訴我們每件行李箱允許的重量。

speak.en: I'm not sure if bringing food into the cinema is permissible.
speak.zh: 我不確定能不能帶食物進電影院。

write.en: Many companies now consider it permissible for employees to work from home a few days a week.
write.zh: 現在許多公司認為，員工每週在家工作幾天是可以接受的。

example.en: After the earthquake, volunteers worked for months to restore the heritage buildings that gave the street its unique character.
example.zh: 地震過後，志工花了好幾個月修復那些讓這條街獨具特色的古蹟建築。

listen.en: She is proud of her family's Japanese heritage.
listen.zh: 她以家族的日本血統為傲。

chinese.en: Schools can help preserve local heritage by teaching children traditional songs and crafts.
chinese.zh: 學校可以藉由教孩子傳統歌謠和手工藝，協助保存在地文化。

english.en: Tourists come from all over the world to visit this heritage site.
english.zh: 遊客從世界各地前來參觀這處文化遺產。

speak.en: I think protecting our heritage is just as important as building new things.
speak.zh: 我覺得保護我們的文化資產，和建設新東西一樣重要。

write.en: Mass tourism can damage heritage sites unless visitor numbers are carefully managed.
write.zh: 除非妥善控管遊客人數，否則大量觀光客可能會破壞文化遺產。

example.en: Her desk was always so orderly, with every pen and file in its place, that colleagues asked her for organizing tips.
example.zh: 她的桌面總是井然有序，每支筆、每份文件都擺在固定位置，同事們紛紛向她請教整理訣竅。

listen.en: The students formed an orderly line outside the hall.
listen.zh: 學生們在禮堂外排成整齊的隊伍。

chinese.en: An orderly daily routine can help young children feel safe and sleep better at night.
chinese.zh: 規律有序的作息能讓幼兒感到安心，晚上也睡得比較好。

english.en: The new manager wants a more orderly system for storing documents.
english.zh: 新主管想要一套更有條理的文件存放系統。

speak.en: I'm not a very orderly person, so my room is usually a mess.
speak.zh: 我不是很有條理的人，所以房間通常亂七八糟。

write.en: The government promised an orderly transition to renewable energy without sudden rises in electricity prices.
write.zh: 政府承諾會有序地轉型為再生能源，不讓電價突然飆漲。

example.en: Fishing used to be a necessity for the villagers, but today it is mainly a relaxing pastime for retired people.
example.zh: 捕魚過去是村民謀生的必要手段，如今主要是退休人士放鬆身心的休閒活動。

listen.en: Baseball has long been a popular pastime in Taiwan.
listen.zh: 棒球在臺灣一直是很受歡迎的休閒活動。

chinese.en: For many teenagers, playing online games has replaced outdoor sports as their main pastime.
chinese.zh: 對許多青少年來說，玩線上遊戲已經取代戶外運動，成為他們主要的消遣。

english.en: My grandfather took up gardening as a pastime after he retired.
english.zh: 我爺爺退休後開始把園藝當作消遣。

speak.en: These days my main pastime is watching cooking videos online.
speak.zh: 最近我主要的消遣是上網看料理影片。

write.en: Local governments should provide more parks and sports centres so that residents can enjoy healthy pastimes.
write.zh: 地方政府應該提供更多公園和運動中心，讓居民能享受健康的休閒活動。

example.en: The museum periodically changes its displays, so regular visitors always find something new to see.
example.zh: 這間博物館會定期更換展品，所以常客總能看到新東西。

listen.en: The teacher periodically checks our progress in class.
listen.zh: 老師會定期在課堂上檢查我們的進度。

chinese.en: Safety inspectors visit the factory periodically to make sure workers are wearing protective equipment.
chinese.zh: 安全稽查員會定期到工廠檢查，確保工人都有穿戴防護裝備。

english.en: The volcano erupts periodically, so scientists monitor it very closely.
english.zh: 這座火山會週期性噴發，所以科學家密切監測它。

speak.en: I periodically delete apps I don't use to free up space.
speak.zh: 我會不時刪掉沒在用的應用程式，騰出一些空間。

write.en: Public transport fares should be reviewed periodically to reflect changes in living costs.
write.zh: 大眾運輸票價應該定期檢討，以反映生活成本的變化。

example.en: Students started an online petition asking the university to keep the library open twenty-four hours during exams.
example.zh: 學生發起線上連署，要求大學在考試期間讓圖書館二十四小時開放。

listen.en: Would you like to sign our petition for safer roads?
listen.zh: 你願意連署我們爭取道路安全的請願嗎？

chinese.en: Parents petitioned the school board to provide healthier lunches for their children.
chinese.zh: 家長們向教育委員會請願，要求為孩子提供更健康的午餐。

english.en: The petition was delivered to the mayor's office last week.
english.zh: 這份請願書上週已經送到市長辦公室。

speak.en: I usually sign petitions online if I really care about the issue.
speak.zh: 如果我真的很關心某個議題，通常會在網路上連署。

write.en: Online petitions make it easier for ordinary citizens to bring local problems to the government's attention.
write.zh: 線上連署讓一般民眾更容易讓政府注意到地方上的問題。

example.en: We set off early on a crisp autumn morning, when the air was cool and the sky was perfectly clear.
example.zh: 我們在一個清爽的秋日早晨提早出發，那時空氣涼爽，天空萬里無雲。

listen.en: He wore a crisp white shirt to the interview.
listen.zh: 他穿了一件筆挺的白襯衫去面試。

chinese.en: The speaker gave crisp, clear answers that helped the audience understand a complicated topic.
chinese.zh: 講者的回答簡潔清楚，幫助觀眾理解了一個複雜的主題。

english.en: I bought a packet of crisps and a bottle of water.
english.zh: 我買了一包洋芋片和一瓶水。

speak.en: I love biting into a crisp, cold apple on a hot day.
speak.zh: 大熱天咬一口冰涼爽脆的蘋果，真的很享受。

write.en: Nutritionists warn that eating crisps every day can lead to high salt intake among teenagers.
write.zh: 營養師提醒，青少年如果每天吃洋芋片，可能會攝取過多鹽分。

example.en: Unlike most of his contemporaries, the writer refused to use a typewriter and wrote every novel by hand.
example.zh: 這位作家和大多數同時代的人不同，他拒絕使用打字機，每部小說都是親手寫成。

listen.en: Their new home has a bright, contemporary design.
listen.zh: 他們的新家有明亮的現代風格設計。

chinese.en: The course examines how contemporary society deals with issues such as ageing and loneliness.
chinese.zh: 這門課探討當代社會如何處理高齡化與孤獨等問題。

english.en: Historians study contemporary accounts to learn what life was really like.
english.zh: 歷史學家研究當時的文獻記載，以了解當年真正的生活樣貌。

speak.en: I'm more into contemporary music than classical, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，比起古典音樂，我更喜歡當代音樂。

write.en: Many traditional festivals have been adapted to fit contemporary lifestyles in busy cities.
write.zh: 許多傳統節慶已經過調整，以配合忙碌都市中的現代生活方式。

example.en: Small family shops and friendly neighbours were once part of the fabric of everyday life in this neighbourhood.
example.zh: 家庭小店和友善的鄰居，曾經是這個社區日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。

listen.en: She chose a soft blue fabric for the curtains.
listen.zh: 她挑了一塊柔軟的藍色布料來做窗簾。

chinese.en: Scientists have developed a waterproof fabric made entirely from recycled plastic bottles.
chinese.zh: 科學家研發出一種完全以回收塑膠瓶製成的防水布料。

english.en: Some critics believe social media is damaging the fabric of society.
english.zh: 有些評論家認為社群媒體正在破壞社會的根基。

speak.en: I always check the fabric before I buy any clothes.
speak.zh: 我買衣服之前一定會先看布料。

write.en: Fast fashion brands often use cheap synthetic fabrics that release tiny plastic fibres when washed.
write.zh: 快時尚品牌常使用廉價的合成布料，這些布料在洗滌時會釋放出微小的塑膠纖維。

example.en: Although he was clearly talented at football, he decided to focus on his studies and became an engineer.
example.zh: 雖然他顯然很有足球天分，但他決定專心念書，後來成為一名工程師。

listen.en: Our school has many talented young artists this year.
listen.zh: 我們學校今年有很多有才華的年輕藝術家。

chinese.en: Large technology companies compete fiercely to hire the most talented graduates from top universities.
chinese.zh: 大型科技公司激烈競爭，爭相延攬頂尖大學最優秀的畢業生。

english.en: My younger cousin is extremely talented at drawing funny cartoons.
english.zh: 我的表妹非常擅長畫有趣的漫畫。

speak.en: I'm not very talented, but I really enjoy singing.
speak.zh: 我不算很有天分，但我真的很喜歡唱歌。

write.en: Many talented students from low-income families never reach university because of high tuition fees.
write.zh: 許多來自低收入家庭的優秀學生，因為學費高昂而始終無法上大學。

example.en: Over thousands of years, the slowly moving glacier carved out the deep valley that tourists now visit.
example.zh: 數千年來，這條緩緩移動的冰河切割出如今遊客造訪的深谷。

listen.en: We took a boat trip to see the glacier up close.
listen.zh: 我們搭船去近距離觀賞冰河。

chinese.en: Melting glaciers supply water to millions of people, but this source may disappear within decades.
chinese.zh: 融化的冰河為數百萬人提供水源，但這個水源可能在幾十年內消失。

english.en: Scientists measure how fast the glacier is moving each year.
english.zh: 科學家每年測量這條冰河移動的速度。

speak.en: Walking on a glacier in New Zealand was the highlight of my trip.
speak.zh: 在紐西蘭的冰河上健行，是我那趟旅行最精彩的部分。

write.en: Photographs comparing glaciers today with those a century ago clearly show the impact of climate change.
write.zh: 比較今日與百年前冰河樣貌的照片，清楚顯示出氣候變遷的影響。

example.en: A rescue helicopter circled above the flooded village, searching for families trapped on their rooftops.
example.zh: 一架救援直升機在淹水的村莊上空盤旋，搜尋受困在屋頂上的家庭。

listen.en: We heard a helicopter flying low over the house.
listen.zh: 我們聽到一架直升機低空飛過房子上方。

chinese.en: Experts warn that helicopter parents may prevent children from learning how to solve problems themselves.
chinese.zh: 專家警告，直升機父母可能會讓孩子學不會自己解決問題。

english.en: Tourists can take a short helicopter ride over the canyon.
english.zh: 遊客可以搭乘直升機，短暫飛越峽谷上空。

speak.en: I'd love to fly in a helicopter at least once in my life.
speak.zh: 這輩子我很想至少搭一次直升機。

write.en: Some cities are considering helicopter taxis, but residents worry about noise and safety.
write.zh: 有些城市正在考慮推出直升機計程車，但居民擔心噪音和安全問題。

example.en: The climbers knew they were in mortal danger when the storm arrived, so they quickly returned to the camp.
example.zh: 暴風雨來襲時，登山者知道自己身陷致命危險，於是迅速撤回營地。

listen.en: These puzzles are far too hard for mere mortals like me.
listen.zh: 這些謎題對我這種凡人來說實在太難了。

chinese.en: Illness reminded him that he was mortal, so he started spending more time with his family.
chinese.zh: 生病讓他意識到人終有一死，於是他開始花更多時間陪伴家人。

english.en: The two rival companies have been mortal enemies for decades.
english.zh: 這兩家互相競爭的公司幾十年來一直是死對頭。

speak.en: I have a mortal fear of spiders, so I never go camping.
speak.zh: 我超級怕蜘蛛，所以從來不去露營。

write.en: Medical advances have lowered mortality rates, yet accepting that we are mortal remains difficult for many people.
write.zh: 醫學進步降低了死亡率，但對許多人來說，接受人終有一死仍然很困難。

example.en: Even though she lost the final match, she was gracious in defeat and warmly congratulated her opponent.
example.zh: 雖然她輸了決賽，但她輸得很有風度，還熱情地向對手道賀。

listen.en: He gave a gracious speech to thank his team.
listen.zh: 他發表了一段得體的致詞，感謝他的團隊。

chinese.en: The old hotel still offers the gracious atmosphere of a time when travel was slow and elegant.
chinese.zh: 這間老飯店至今仍保有那個旅行緩慢而優雅的年代所特有的高雅氛圍。

english.en: The manager was gracious enough to admit her mistake publicly.
english.zh: 這位經理很有風度地公開承認了自己的錯誤。

speak.en: My neighbour is always so gracious, even when I'm a bit noisy.
speak.zh: 就算我有點吵，我的鄰居也總是很客氣包容。

write.en: Customers are more likely to return when staff respond to complaints in a calm and gracious way.
write.zh: 當員工以冷靜、有禮的態度回應客訴時，顧客更有可能再度光顧。

example.en: Online shopping platforms now take a growing slice of the retail market, forcing many small shops to close.
example.zh: 網購平台在零售市場所占的份額越來越大，迫使許多小商店歇業。

listen.en: Slice the onions thinly before you fry them.
listen.zh: 炒洋蔥之前，先把它切成薄片。

chinese.en: The documentary offers a fascinating slice of daily life in a mountain village.
chinese.zh: 這部紀錄片生動呈現了山村日常生活的一個片段。

english.en: I usually have a slice of toast and some fruit for breakfast.
english.zh: 我早餐通常吃一片吐司和一些水果。

speak.en: Honestly, a hot slice of pizza after a long day is perfect.
speak.zh: 說真的，累了一整天之後來一片熱騰騰的披薩最棒了。

write.en: The chef sliced the fresh fish so thinly that you could almost see through it.
write.zh: 主廚把新鮮的魚切得極薄，薄到幾乎可以透光。

example.en: Although the job pays little, she derives great satisfaction from helping children learn to read.
example.zh: 雖然這份工作薪水不高，但她從幫助孩子學會閱讀中獲得極大的成就感。

listen.en: He derives a lot of pleasure from gardening.
listen.zh: 他從園藝中得到很多樂趣。

chinese.en: The town derives most of its income from tourism during the summer months.
chinese.zh: 這個小鎮大部分的收入來自夏季的觀光業。

english.en: This medicine is derived from a plant that grows in the rainforest.
english.zh: 這種藥物是從一種生長在雨林裡的植物提煉出來的。

speak.en: I think people derive more happiness from experiences than possessions.
speak.zh: 我覺得人們從經驗中獲得的快樂比從物質中多。

write.en: Researchers derived their conclusions from interviews with hundreds of students across the country.
write.zh: 研究人員根據與全國數百名學生的訪談，得出了他們的結論。

example.en: During the winter holiday, we stayed in a cosy wooden lodge near the ski slopes, with a fireplace in every room.
example.zh: 寒假期間，我們住在滑雪場附近一間溫馨的木造山莊，每個房間都有壁爐。

listen.en: A small fish bone got lodged in my throat at dinner.
listen.zh: 吃晚餐時，一根小魚刺卡在我的喉嚨。

chinese.en: Students who disagree with their final grade can lodge an appeal within the first week of term.
chinese.zh: 對期末成績有異議的學生，可以在開學第一週內提出申覆。

english.en: The kite got lodged in the branches of a tall tree.
english.zh: 風箏卡在一棵大樹的樹枝上。

speak.en: My uncle runs a small lodge in the mountains for hikers.
speak.zh: 我叔叔在山上經營一間給登山客住的小山屋。

write.en: Residents have lodged objections to the plan to build a factory near the river.
write.zh: 居民已對在河邊興建工廠的計畫提出異議。

example.en: The new railway traverses the mountain range through a series of long tunnels, cutting the journey time in half.
example.zh: 新鐵路透過一連串長隧道穿越山脈，讓行程時間縮短了一半。

listen.en: The trail traverses a quiet forest and a small stream.
listen.zh: 這條步道穿過一片寧靜的森林和一條小溪。

chinese.en: Migrating birds traverse entire continents each year, relying on the sun and stars to navigate.
chinese.zh: 候鳥每年橫越整片大陸，靠著太陽和星星辨別方向。

english.en: Cyclists from many countries traversed the island in a charity ride.
english.zh: 來自許多國家的自行車騎士參加慈善騎行，橫越了整座島。

speak.en: Traversing that rocky ridge was the scariest part of our hike.
speak.zh: 走過那段岩石稜線，是我們這趟登山最可怕的部分。

write.en: Before modern roads existed, traders traversed long, dangerous routes to bring tea and silk to distant markets.
write.zh: 在現代道路出現以前，商人得穿越漫長又危險的路線，把茶葉和絲綢運到遙遠的市場。

example.en: After days of heavy rain, the waterfall roared so loudly that visitors had to shout to hear each other.
example.zh: 連下好幾天大雨後，瀑布轟隆作響，遊客得用喊的才聽得到彼此說話。

listen.en: The children swam in the pool below the waterfall.
listen.zh: 孩子們在瀑布下方的水潭裡游泳。

chinese.en: Tourism at the waterfall has grown so quickly that the local trails are now badly damaged.
chinese.zh: 來瀑布觀光的人潮成長得太快，導致當地步道如今嚴重受損。

english.en: This waterfall is one of the most famous sights in the country.
english.zh: 這座瀑布是全國最著名的景點之一。

speak.en: Standing near a waterfall always makes me feel calm and refreshed.
speak.zh: 站在瀑布旁邊總讓我覺得平靜又神清氣爽。

write.en: Some engineers use the energy of large waterfalls to generate clean electricity for nearby towns.
write.zh: 有些工程師利用大型瀑布的能量，為附近城鎮產生乾淨的電力。

example.en: Surveys show that younger shoppers have a strong preference for brands that use recycled materials and reduce waste.
example.zh: 調查顯示，年輕消費者特別偏好使用回收材料、減少浪費的品牌。

listen.en: In the end, it's just a matter of personal preference.
listen.zh: 說到底，這只是個人喜好的問題。

chinese.en: Some employers give preference to applicants who have volunteered or worked abroad.
chinese.zh: 有些雇主會優先考慮有志工或海外工作經驗的應徵者。

english.en: Many students choose online classes in preference to traditional lectures.
english.zh: 許多學生選擇上線上課程，而不是傳統的課堂講授。

speak.en: My preference is for quiet cafés where I can actually read.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡安靜、真的能好好看書的咖啡廳。

write.en: Streaming services use data about viewers' preferences to recommend new shows and films.
write.zh: 串流平台利用觀眾的喜好資料，推薦新的節目和電影。

example.en: Cultural anthropology examines how people in different societies raise children, celebrate festivals and organise their communities.
example.zh: 文化人類學探討不同社會的人如何養育孩子、慶祝節日，以及組織他們的社群。

listen.en: My older brother has a degree in anthropology.
listen.zh: 我哥哥擁有人類學學位。

chinese.en: Anthropology helps businesses understand why customers in different countries make different choices.
chinese.zh: 人類學能幫助企業理解不同國家的顧客為什麼會做出不同的選擇。

english.en: The anthropology course includes a month of fieldwork in a village.
english.zh: 這門人類學課程包含在村落進行一個月的田野調查。

speak.en: I took an anthropology class at university, and I loved it.
speak.zh: 我大學時修過一門人類學的課，而且非常喜歡。

write.en: Some people question whether anthropology degrees lead to good jobs, but the skills are widely useful.
write.zh: 有些人質疑人類學學位能不能帶來好工作，但這門學科培養的能力其實用途很廣。

example.en: The company's poor planning became manifest when it ran out of stock during the busiest shopping season.
example.zh: 這家公司在購物旺季缺貨，規劃不周的問題因此顯露無遺。

listen.en: His talent for music manifested early in childhood.
listen.zh: 他的音樂天分在童年早期就展現出來了。

chinese.en: Climate change is manifested in more frequent floods, longer droughts and rising sea levels.
chinese.zh: 氣候變遷表現在更頻繁的水災、更長的乾旱以及上升的海平面。

english.en: The young students manifested great interest in the new science project.
english.zh: 這群年輕學生對新的科學專題展現出濃厚的興趣。

speak.en: Honestly, my nerves usually manifest as a shaky voice during presentations.
speak.zh: 說真的，我一緊張，上台報告時聲音通常就會發抖。

write.en: Inequality in education often manifests itself in large differences between urban and rural exam results.
write.zh: 教育不平等常常反映在城鄉考試成績的巨大落差上。

example.en: Respect for elders is deeply embedded in the culture, so young people rarely argue with their grandparents.
example.zh: 敬老觀念深植於這個文化中，所以年輕人很少和祖父母爭執。

listen.en: You can embed the video in your blog post.
listen.zh: 你可以把影片嵌入你的部落格文章裡。

chinese.en: The school aims to embed environmental awareness in every subject, not just science.
chinese.zh: 這所學校的目標是把環保意識融入每個科目，而不只是自然科學。

english.en: Tiny sensors are embedded in the road to monitor traffic.
english.zh: 路面下埋設了微型感測器來監測車流。

speak.en: That song from my childhood is still embedded in my memory.
speak.zh: 那首童年時的歌至今仍深深印在我的記憶裡。

write.en: Companies are increasingly embedding sustainability goals into their business strategies to attract younger customers.
write.zh: 企業越來越常把永續目標納入經營策略，以吸引年輕顧客。

example.en: Several parents phoned the school to inquire whether classes would be cancelled because of the approaching typhoon.
example.zh: 因為颱風逼近，好幾位家長打電話到學校詢問是否會停課。

listen.en: She politely inquired about the price of the blue jacket.
listen.zh: 她禮貌地詢問那件藍色夾克的價格。

chinese.en: The committee will inquire into the causes of the delay before making any decisions.
chinese.zh: 委員會在做出任何決定之前，會先調查延誤的原因。

english.en: May I inquire why my visa application was rejected last month?
english.zh: 請問我上個月的簽證申請為什麼被拒絕？

speak.en: I usually inquire about the refund policy before I buy anything online.
speak.zh: 我在網路上買東西之前，通常會先詢問退款規定。

write.en: My grandmother always inquires after my parents whenever I visit her in the countryside.
write.zh: 每次我去鄉下探望奶奶，她總會問候我爸媽的近況。

example.en: After a sober assessment of the costs and risks, the investors decided not to fund the project.
example.zh: 在冷靜評估成本與風險後，投資人決定不資助這項計畫。

listen.en: He stayed sober so he could drive everyone home.
listen.zh: 他保持清醒沒喝酒，這樣才能開車送大家回家。

chinese.en: The report offers a sober reminder that climate change is already affecting coastal communities.
chinese.zh: 這份報告發人深省地提醒我們，氣候變遷已經在影響沿海社區。

english.en: She wore a sober grey suit to the job interview.
english.zh: 她穿了一套素淨的灰色套裝去參加工作面試。

speak.en: Honestly, seeing my credit card bill was a sobering experience.
speak.zh: 老實說，看到我的信用卡帳單真是讓我清醒了不少。

write.en: The sudden failure of the startup sobered many young entrepreneurs who had expected quick success.
write.zh: 那家新創公司突然倒閉，讓許多原本期待快速成功的年輕創業者冷靜了下來。

example.en: Because the files were backed up every night, the technicians were able to retrieve almost all the lost data.
example.zh: 因為檔案每晚都有備份，技術人員幾乎把遺失的資料全都救了回來。

listen.en: The dog ran into the garden to retrieve the ball.
listen.zh: 狗跑進花園去把球叼回來。

chinese.en: Students can retrieve journal articles from the library database using their campus login.
chinese.zh: 學生可以用校園帳號從圖書館資料庫中檢索期刊文章。

english.en: Divers retrieved an ancient vase from the bottom of the lake.
english.zh: 潛水員從湖底打撈起一個古老的花瓶。

speak.en: Honestly, testing myself helps me retrieve new words much faster in exams.
speak.zh: 老實說，自我測驗讓我在考試時能更快想起新單字。

write.en: The station staff kindly retrieved the umbrella I had left on the train.
write.zh: 車站人員好心幫我找回了我忘在火車上的雨傘。

example.en: The advertisement greatly exaggerated the benefits of the supplement, so many customers felt misled when it did nothing.
example.zh: 那則廣告大幅誇大了這款保健食品的功效，所以吃了沒效果的顧客都覺得被誤導。

listen.en: Please don't exaggerate the problem in your report.
listen.zh: 請不要在你的報告裡誇大這個問題。

chinese.en: It would be hard to exaggerate the importance of clean water to public health.
chinese.zh: 乾淨的水對公共衛生的重要性，再怎麼強調都不為過。

english.en: The media often exaggerates the dangers of travelling abroad alone.
english.zh: 媒體常常誇大獨自出國旅行的危險。

speak.en: I'm not exaggerating, the queue was over an hour long.
speak.zh: 我沒有誇張，排隊排了超過一個小時。

write.en: Critics argue that the study's findings were exaggerated to attract more research funding.
write.zh: 批評者認為，這項研究的結果被誇大了，目的是爭取更多研究經費。

example.en: Rather than relying on intuition, the researchers collected empirical data from hundreds of classrooms to test their idea.
example.zh: 研究人員沒有憑直覺判斷，而是從數百間教室蒐集實證資料來檢驗他們的想法。

listen.en: Her claims were based on empirical research, not opinion.
listen.zh: 她的主張是根據實證研究，而不是個人意見。

chinese.en: Policy makers need empirical studies to judge whether the new tax has actually worked.
chinese.zh: 決策者需要實證研究來判斷新稅制是否真的奏效。

english.en: The theory sounds convincing, but it still lacks empirical support.
english.zh: 這個理論聽起來很有說服力，但仍缺乏實證支持。

speak.en: I prefer empirical evidence over what people say on social media.
speak.zh: 比起大家在社群媒體上說的話，我更相信實證證據。

write.en: Our manager asked for an empirical comparison of the two software systems before making a purchase.
write.zh: 經理要求在採購前，先對這兩套軟體系統做實際測試比較。

example.en: The new heating system is far more efficient, so our electricity bills dropped noticeably during the winter.
example.zh: 新的暖氣系統效率高得多，所以我們冬天的電費明顯降低了。

listen.en: She is an efficient manager who never wastes time.
listen.zh: 她是一位做事有效率、從不浪費時間的主管。

chinese.en: Governments should make efficient use of taxpayers' money instead of funding unnecessary projects.
chinese.zh: 政府應該有效運用納稅人的錢，而不是資助不必要的計畫。

english.en: A clear study plan makes my revision much more efficient.
english.zh: 清楚的讀書計畫讓我的複習更有效率。

speak.en: I think online banking is really efficient compared to queueing at a branch.
speak.zh: 我覺得網路銀行比去分行排隊有效率多了。

write.en: Farmers are switching to energy-efficient pumps to cut costs and reduce emissions.
write.zh: 農民正改用節能抽水機，以降低成本並減少排放。

example.en: Although she was once in favour of the plan, the mayor has recently softened her stance after hearing residents' concerns.
example.zh: 雖然市長原本支持這項計畫，但在聽到居民的疑慮後，她最近軟化了立場。

listen.en: What is your stance on working from home?
listen.zh: 你對在家工作抱持什麼立場？

chinese.en: The company adopted a neutral stance and refused to comment on the dispute.
chinese.zh: 公司採取中立立場，拒絕對這起糾紛發表評論。

english.en: My parents have a strict stance on using phones at dinner.
english.zh: 我爸媽對吃晚餐時用手機的態度很嚴格。

speak.en: Personally, my stance on homework has changed since I started tutoring.
speak.zh: 就我個人來說，自從開始當家教後，我對回家作業的看法就改變了。

write.en: The coach told the players to widen their stance to keep their balance.
write.zh: 教練要球員把雙腳站開一點，以保持平衡。

example.en: Once the factory closed and the river was cleaned up, fish and birds began to flourish there again.
example.zh: 工廠關閉、河川整治乾淨之後，魚和鳥又開始在那裡大量繁衍。

listen.en: These plants flourish in warm and humid weather.
listen.zh: 這些植物在溫暖潮濕的天氣裡長得很好。

chinese.en: Children tend to flourish when teachers give them both encouragement and clear expectations.
chinese.zh: 當老師同時給予鼓勵和明確的期望時，孩子往往能成長得很好。

english.en: Tourism has flourished on the island since the new airport opened.
english.zh: 自從新機場啟用以來，島上的觀光業蓬勃發展。

speak.en: I think creativity really flourishes when people feel relaxed at work.
speak.zh: 我覺得人在工作中感到放鬆時，創意才真的會源源不絕。

write.en: Traditional crafts are flourishing again as young people sell handmade goods online.
write.zh: 隨著年輕人在網路上販售手作商品，傳統工藝又重新興盛起來。

example.en: The supplier refused to deliver more goods until we paid the overdue invoice from last month.
example.zh: 供應商拒絕再出貨，直到我們付清上個月逾期的請款單。

listen.en: I checked the invoice and found a small mistake.
listen.zh: 我檢查了請款單，發現一個小錯誤。

chinese.en: Freelancers should keep copies of every invoice for their annual tax return.
chinese.zh: 自由工作者應該保留每一張請款單的副本，以便申報年度所得稅。

english.en: The designer invoiced the client after finishing the new website.
english.zh: 設計師完成新網站後，向客戶開單請款。

speak.en: At my part-time job, I help my boss prepare invoices every week.
speak.zh: 我打工的地方，我每週都會幫老闆準備請款單。

write.en: The hospital was criticised for invoicing patients for services they never received.
write.zh: 那家醫院因為向病患收取根本沒提供的服務費用而受到批評。

example.en: Without any natural predators on the island, the rabbits multiplied rapidly and soon destroyed most of the vegetation.
example.zh: 由於島上沒有天敵，兔子迅速繁殖，很快就毀掉了大部分植被。

listen.en: Our problems seemed to multiply after the move.
listen.zh: 搬家之後，我們的問題好像變得越來越多。

chinese.en: To find the area of a rectangle, multiply its length by its width.
chinese.zh: 要算出長方形的面積，就把長乘以寬。

english.en: Bacteria multiply quickly on food left in a warm kitchen.
english.zh: 放在溫暖廚房裡的食物，細菌會快速繁殖。

speak.en: Once you start freelancing, your responsibilities multiply really fast.
speak.zh: 一旦開始接案工作，你的責任會增加得非常快。

write.en: Investing in teacher training can multiply the benefits of every dollar spent on schools.
write.zh: 投資師資培訓，可以讓花在學校上的每一塊錢發揮加倍的效益。

example.en: The author argues that cities should invest in cycling lanes, pointing to lower pollution and shorter commutes in Copenhagen.
example.zh: 作者主張城市應該投資興建自行車道，並以哥本哈根污染較低、通勤時間較短為例。

listen.en: They argued with the waiter about the bill.
listen.zh: 他們為了帳單和服務生爭執。

chinese.en: Some economists argue against raising the minimum wage too quickly in rural areas.
chinese.zh: 有些經濟學家反對在鄉村地區過快調漲基本工資。

english.en: It could be argued that social media makes people lonelier.
english.zh: 可以說社群媒體讓人變得更孤單。

speak.en: I'd argue that learning to cook is more useful than learning to drive.
speak.zh: 我會說學做菜比學開車更實用。

write.en: Students who argue in favour of uniforms say they reduce peer pressure about clothes.
write.zh: 支持穿制服的學生表示，制服能減少同儕之間在穿著上的壓力。

example.en: The open-plan office was noisy and full of distractions, which was hardly conducive to careful, focused work.
example.zh: 開放式辦公室又吵又容易讓人分心，根本不利於細心專注地工作。

listen.en: Bright colours are not always conducive to learning.
listen.zh: 鮮豔的顏色不一定有助於學習。

chinese.en: Stable laws and low taxes create an environment conducive to foreign investment.
chinese.zh: 穩定的法律和低稅率創造出有利於外國投資的環境。

english.en: Long working hours are not conducive to a healthy family life.
english.zh: 長時間工作不利於健康的家庭生活。

speak.en: Honestly, my dorm isn't very conducive to studying, so I go to the library.
speak.zh: 說真的，我的宿舍不太適合讀書，所以我都去圖書館。

write.en: Mild weather and fertile soil make the valley highly conducive to growing grapes.
write.zh: 溫和的氣候和肥沃的土壤，讓這座山谷非常適合種植葡萄。

example.en: The phone company offers a bundle that combines internet, TV and mobile service for a single lower monthly price.
example.zh: 電信公司推出一種套裝方案，把網路、電視和手機服務綁在一起，月費更便宜。

listen.en: He carried a bundle of firewood into the cabin.
listen.zh: 他把一捆木柴搬進小木屋。

chinese.en: Many laptops come bundled with software that most users never actually open.
chinese.zh: 許多筆電都隨附大部分使用者根本不會打開的軟體。

english.en: My aunt keeps a bundle of old letters in a wooden box.
english.zh: 我阿姨把一疊舊信放在一個木盒裡。

speak.en: Honestly, I was a bundle of nerves before my first job interview.
speak.zh: 老實說，我第一次工作面試前緊張得要命。

write.en: Parents quickly bundled the children into the car as the storm approached.
write.zh: 暴風雨逼近時，家長們趕緊把孩子塞進車裡。

example.en: Reporting live from the flooded town, the correspondent described how volunteers were handing out food and blankets.
example.zh: 記者在淹水的小鎮進行現場連線，描述志工如何發送食物和毯子。

listen.en: Our science correspondent explains the latest research tonight.
listen.zh: 今晚由我們的科學記者為您解說最新研究。

chinese.en: The network has correspondents in several Asian capitals to cover regional business news.
chinese.zh: 這家電視網在數個亞洲國家的首都派駐記者，報導區域商業新聞。

english.en: He became a sports correspondent soon after graduating from university.
english.zh: 他大學畢業後不久就成為體育記者。

speak.en: Being a travel correspondent sounds like my dream job, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，當旅遊特派記者聽起來就是我的夢想工作。

write.en: My grandfather was a loyal correspondent, writing to his old classmates every month.
write.zh: 我爺爺很勤於寫信，每個月都會寫信給老同學。

example.en: The translation was clumsy and full of awkward phrases, so readers struggled to follow the author's argument.
example.zh: 這份翻譯很生硬，滿是彆扭的句子，讀者很難理解作者的論點。

listen.en: The clumsy waiter spilled coffee on my new shirt.
listen.zh: 那個笨手笨腳的服務生把咖啡灑在我的新襯衫上。

chinese.en: The government's clumsy handling of the crisis made many citizens lose trust in it.
chinese.zh: 政府對這場危機處理得很笨拙，讓許多民眾對它失去信任。

english.en: My fingers felt clumsy because it was so cold outside.
english.zh: 外面太冷了，我的手指變得很不靈活。

speak.en: I was really clumsy as a kid, always tripping over things.
speak.zh: 我小時候真的很笨手笨腳，老是被東西絆倒。

write.en: This older software has a clumsy interface that slows down new employees.
write.zh: 這套舊軟體的介面很不好用，拖慢了新進員工的工作速度。

example.en: Although the brand proclaims itself eco-friendly, its products still come wrapped in layers of plastic.
example.zh: 雖然這個品牌自稱環保，它的產品卻仍用層層塑膠包裝。

listen.en: The banner proclaimed a warm welcome to all visitors.
listen.zh: 布條上寫著熱烈歡迎所有訪客。

chinese.en: The newspaper headline proclaimed the young scientist a rising star in her field.
chinese.zh: 報紙頭條稱這位年輕科學家是她所屬領域的明日之星。

english.en: He proudly proclaimed that he had finally passed his driving test.
english.zh: 他驕傲地宣布自己終於考到駕照了。

speak.en: My friend loves to proclaim that coffee is the best invention ever.
speak.zh: 我朋友很愛宣稱咖啡是有史以來最棒的發明。

write.en: Students marched through the campus, proclaiming their support for cheaper public transport.
write.zh: 學生們在校園裡遊行，公開表達他們支持更便宜的大眾運輸。

example.en: Before the shop reopened, an interior designer chose warm lighting and wooden shelves to make customers feel relaxed.
example.zh: 店面重新開幕前，室內設計師選用溫暖的燈光和木製層架，讓顧客感到放鬆。

listen.en: The designer showed us several ideas for the new logo.
listen.zh: 設計師給我們看了幾個新標誌的構想。

chinese.en: Game designers must balance challenge and fun so that players keep coming back.
chinese.zh: 遊戲設計師必須在挑戰性和趣味性之間取得平衡，玩家才會一再回來玩。

english.en: Many teenagers feel pressure to wear designer clothes at school.
english.zh: 許多青少年在學校會感受到要穿名牌衣服的壓力。

speak.en: I've always wanted to be a fashion designer, ever since primary school.
speak.zh: 我從小學開始就一直想當服裝設計師。

write.en: Urban designers are creating more green spaces to make crowded cities more livable.
write.zh: 都市設計師正在打造更多綠地，讓擁擠的城市更宜居。

example.en: Online tickets cost a fraction of the price at the door, so most visitors book in advance.
example.zh: 網路購票的價格只要現場票價的一小部分，所以大多數遊客都會事先訂票。

listen.en: The door opened a fraction, and a cat slipped out.
listen.zh: 門開了一條小縫，一隻貓溜了出去。

chinese.en: Most children in primary school learn how to add and subtract fractions.
chinese.zh: 大多數小學生都會學分數的加法和減法。

english.en: Our team finished the project in a fraction of the usual time.
english.zh: 我們團隊只花了平常一小部分的時間就完成了專案。

speak.en: Honestly, I only understood a tiny fraction of that lecture.
speak.zh: 老實說，那堂課我只聽懂了一點點。

write.en: In the survey, a significant fraction of respondents said they rarely read printed books.
write.zh: 在這份調查中，有相當比例的受訪者表示他們很少閱讀紙本書。

example.en: Although the manager tried to look serious, she was clearly amused by the intern's creative excuse for being late.
example.zh: 雖然經理試著板起臉，但她顯然被實習生那充滿創意的遲到藉口逗笑了。

listen.en: Board games can amuse kids on long rainy days.
listen.zh: 在漫長的雨天裡，桌遊可以讓孩子們玩得很開心。

chinese.en: Visitors were amused to see the museum's robot guide dancing to pop music.
chinese.zh: 看到博物館的機器人導覽員隨著流行音樂跳舞，遊客們都覺得很有趣。

english.en: The comedian kept the audience amused for the entire evening.
english.zh: 那位喜劇演員整晚都讓觀眾笑聲不斷。

speak.en: When I'm bored, I amuse myself by watching cooking videos.
speak.zh: 無聊的時候，我會看料理影片來打發時間。

write.en: Public libraries now offer workshops that amuse and educate children during school holidays.
write.zh: 公共圖書館現在會在寒暑假舉辦寓教於樂的兒童工作坊。

example.en: The restorers spent years on meticulous repairs, cleaning each painted tile by hand so that the temple looked new again.
example.zh: 修復人員花了好幾年細心修繕，用手清理每一塊彩繪磁磚，讓廟宇煥然一新。

listen.en: He keeps meticulous records of all his spending.
listen.zh: 他把自己的每一筆開銷都記錄得清清楚楚。

chinese.en: Thanks to meticulous planning, the festival ran smoothly despite the heavy rain.
chinese.zh: 多虧周密的規劃，儘管下著大雨，活動仍進行得很順利。

english.en: Scientists must be meticulous when recording the results of experiments.
english.zh: 科學家記錄實驗結果時必須一絲不苟。

speak.en: My dad is meticulous, so he irons even his T-shirts.
speak.zh: 我爸做事一絲不苟，連T恤都要燙。

write.en: Good translators pay meticulous attention to tone and culture as well as meaning.
write.zh: 好的譯者除了意思之外，也會非常仔細地留意語氣和文化。

example.en: The plot of the novel is so intricate, with dozens of characters and secrets, that many readers need to take notes.
example.zh: 這部小說情節錯綜複雜，有好幾十個角色和祕密，許多讀者都得做筆記。

listen.en: She knitted an intricate pattern on the wool scarf.
listen.zh: 她在羊毛圍巾上織了一個精細的圖案。

chinese.en: Scientists are still trying to understand the intricate relationships within coral reef ecosystems.
chinese.zh: 科學家仍在努力了解珊瑚礁生態系中錯綜複雜的關係。

english.en: The tax system is too intricate for most people to understand.
english.zh: 稅制太複雜了，大多數人都搞不懂。

speak.en: I love watching videos of chefs making intricate cakes and desserts.
speak.zh: 我很愛看主廚製作精緻蛋糕和甜點的影片。

write.en: Repairing a watch requires steady hands and a good knowledge of its intricate mechanism.
write.zh: 修理手錶需要穩定的雙手，還要熟悉它精密的機械構造。

example.en: It's amazing how quickly children pick up a new language when they live abroad for a while.
example.zh: 孩子在國外住一陣子後，學會新語言的速度快得驚人。

listen.en: My grandmother makes amazing dumplings for the whole family every winter.
listen.zh: 我奶奶每年冬天都會為全家人包超好吃的水餃。

chinese.en: Modern medicine has made amazing progress in treating diseases that were once fatal.
chinese.zh: 現代醫學在治療過去致命的疾病上有驚人的進展。

english.en: The new library has an amazing collection of old maps.
english.zh: 新圖書館收藏了令人驚嘆的古地圖。

speak.en: Honestly, the food at that night market was amazing and so cheap.
speak.zh: 說真的，那個夜市的東西超好吃又超便宜。

write.en: Our volunteers did an amazing job of cleaning up the beach after the festival.
write.zh: 活動結束後，我們的志工把海灘清理得非常乾淨，表現得太棒了。

example.en: As the plane reached cruising altitude, the seatbelt sign was switched off and passengers began to relax.
example.zh: 飛機到達巡航高度後，安全帶指示燈熄滅，乘客們開始放鬆。

listen.en: Some hikers start to feel dizzy at high altitude.
listen.zh: 有些登山客在高海拔地區會開始頭暈。

chinese.en: Tea grown at high altitudes in central Taiwan is known for its rich aroma.
chinese.zh: 臺灣中部高海拔地區種植的茶以香氣濃郁聞名。

english.en: The village is located at an altitude of over two thousand metres.
english.zh: 這個村莊位於海拔兩千多公尺的地方。

speak.en: I trained at altitude before the marathon, and it really helped.
speak.zh: 我在馬拉松前做了高地訓練，真的很有幫助。

write.en: Climate scientists have found that glaciers at lower altitudes are melting the fastest.
write.zh: 氣候科學家發現，海拔較低處的冰川融化得最快。

example.en: The hotel was far from the city centre and rather old; nevertheless, guests loved its friendly staff and quiet garden.
example.zh: 這間飯店離市中心很遠，也相當老舊；不過房客們還是很喜歡親切的員工和安靜的花園。

listen.en: It was raining heavily. Nevertheless, the match went ahead.
listen.zh: 雨下得很大，但比賽還是照常進行。

chinese.en: Online learning saves time and money; it nevertheless lacks the social contact of a classroom.
chinese.zh: 線上學習能省時省錢，然而它缺少教室裡的人際互動。

english.en: He was very tired, but he nevertheless agreed to help us.
english.zh: 他非常累，但儘管如此還是答應幫我們。

speak.en: It's an expensive course, but I'd recommend it nevertheless.
speak.zh: 這門課很貴，不過我還是會推薦。

write.en: The congestion charge is unpopular with drivers; nevertheless, it has clearly reduced air pollution downtown.
write.zh: 塞車費不受駕駛人歡迎，然而它確實減少了市中心的空氣污染。

example.en: Unlike undergraduates, postgraduates are expected to carry out independent research and publish their findings.
example.zh: 和大學部學生不同，研究生被期望能獨立做研究並發表成果。

listen.en: Many postgraduate students also work part time as teaching assistants.
listen.zh: 許多研究生也兼職擔任助教。

chinese.en: The university offers postgraduate scholarships to international students with strong academic records.
chinese.zh: 這所大學為學業成績優異的國際學生提供研究所獎學金。

english.en: I plan to apply for postgraduate study after working for a few years.
english.zh: 我打算工作幾年後再申請念研究所。

speak.en: Most of my classmates went straight into postgraduate courses after graduating.
speak.zh: 我大部分同學一畢業就直接去念研究所了。

write.en: Some employers question whether a postgraduate qualification is worth the extra cost and time.
write.zh: 有些雇主質疑，研究所學歷是否值得多花的費用和時間。

example.en: Although he was once admired by his colleagues, they came to despise him after he took credit for their work.
example.zh: 雖然他曾受到同事欽佩，但在他搶走大家的功勞後，同事們開始鄙視他。

listen.en: I despise waking up early on cold mornings.
listen.zh: 我最討厭在寒冷的早晨早起。

chinese.en: Consumers tend to despise companies that mislead them with false or exaggerated advertising.
chinese.zh: 消費者往往很厭惡用不實或誇大廣告誤導他們的公司。

english.en: He despised himself for not standing up for his friend.
english.zh: 他看不起自己沒有挺身為朋友說話。

speak.en: To be honest, I absolutely despise people who cut in line.
speak.zh: 老實說，我非常討厭插隊的人。

write.en: In the story, the proud king despised the poor farmer, but later needed his help.
write.zh: 故事裡，驕傲的國王瞧不起貧窮的農夫，後來卻需要他的幫忙。

example.en: Some critics blame greedy bankers who took huge risks with other people's money for causing the financial crisis.
example.zh: 有些評論者把金融危機歸咎於那些拿別人的錢冒極大風險的貪婪銀行家。

listen.en: Don't be greedy; leave some cake for your sister.
listen.zh: 別那麼貪吃，留一點蛋糕給你妹妹。

chinese.en: Some companies are greedy for quick profits and ignore the long-term damage to the environment.
chinese.zh: 有些公司貪圖快速獲利，忽視了對環境的長期傷害。

english.en: My cat gets greedy and begs for food whenever we eat.
english.zh: 每次我們吃飯時，我的貓就會嘴饞討東西吃。

speak.en: I know it sounds greedy, but I'd love a bigger salary and more holidays.
speak.zh: 我知道這聽起來很貪心，但我很想要更高的薪水和更多假期。

write.en: Fairy tales often teach children that greedy characters end up losing everything they have.
write.zh: 童話故事常教導孩子，貪心的角色最後會失去一切。

example.en: The road was widened to twice its original width, so buses and bikes no longer have to share a narrow lane.
example.zh: 這條路被拓寬到原本的兩倍寬，公車和自行車不必再擠在同一條窄車道上。

listen.en: The table is too long but the width is fine.
listen.zh: 這張桌子太長了，不過寬度剛好。

chinese.en: The river is about fifty metres in width at its narrowest point.
chinese.zh: 這條河在最窄的地方寬約五十公尺。

english.en: The width of the sofa makes it hard to fit through the door.
english.zh: 這張沙發太寬，很難搬進門。

speak.en: I chose this suitcase because its width meets the airline's size limit.
speak.zh: 我選這個行李箱，是因為它的寬度符合航空公司的尺寸限制。

write.en: City planners argue that increasing the width of pavements encourages more people to walk.
write.zh: 都市規劃者認為，加寬人行道能鼓勵更多人步行。

example.en: After years of complaints about slow service, the bank completely overhauled its mobile app and customer support team.
example.zh: 多年來一直被抱怨服務太慢後，這家銀行徹底改造了手機應用程式和客服團隊。

listen.en: The mechanic overhauled the engine of my old car.
listen.zh: 技師把我那台舊車的引擎徹底檢修了一遍。

chinese.en: Experts say the exam system needs a major overhaul to reduce pressure on students.
chinese.zh: 專家表示，考試制度需要大幅改革，以減輕學生的壓力。

english.en: Our school overhauled its timetable to give students more free time.
english.zh: 我們學校全面調整課表，讓學生有更多空閒時間。

speak.en: My study habits needed a complete overhaul before the IELTS exam.
speak.zh: 考雅思之前，我的讀書習慣需要徹底改變。

write.en: The airline grounded the aircraft for a routine overhaul before the busy holiday season.
write.zh: 航空公司在旺季前讓這架飛機停飛，進行例行大檢修。

example.en: To make the experiment fair, all the plants were kept at a uniform temperature and given the same amount of water.
example.zh: 為了讓實驗公平，所有植物都放在相同的溫度下，並給予等量的水。

listen.en: The nurse changed out of her uniform after work.
listen.zh: 護理師下班後換下了制服。

chinese.en: Some people believe that school uniforms help reduce differences between rich and poor students.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為，學校制服有助於縮小貧富學生之間的差距。

english.en: The houses on this street are uniform in size and colour.
english.zh: 這條街上的房子大小和顏色都一模一樣。

speak.en: I actually liked wearing a uniform because I never worried about clothes.
speak.zh: 其實我滿喜歡穿制服的，因為完全不用煩惱要穿什麼。

write.en: Uniformed police officers stood at every entrance to keep the concert crowd safe.
write.zh: 穿制服的警察駐守在每個入口，確保演唱會群眾的安全。

example.en: When the cafe started using disposable cups for every order, environmentally conscious students organised a boycott that cut its sales sharply.
example.zh: 那家咖啡店開始每筆訂單都用拋棄式杯子後，有環保意識的學生發起抵制，讓它的營業額大幅下滑。

listen.en: Some fans boycotted the concert because tickets were too expensive.
listen.zh: 有些歌迷因為票價太貴而抵制這場演唱會。

chinese.en: Consumer boycotts can push large companies to improve working conditions in their factories.
chinese.zh: 消費者的抵制行動能促使大公司改善工廠的工作環境。

english.en: The workers called for a boycott of the company's products.
english.zh: 員工們呼籲大家抵制這家公司的產品。

speak.en: I've been boycotting fast fashion brands for about a year now.
speak.zh: 我已經抵制快時尚品牌大約一年了。

write.en: Several teams threatened to boycott the tournament unless the unfair rules were changed.
write.zh: 幾支隊伍揚言，除非修改不公平的規則，否則將抵制這場錦標賽。

example.en: When the teacher praised her essay in front of the whole class, Mia's cheeks flushed with embarrassment and pride.
example.zh: 老師在全班面前稱讚米亞的作文時，她的臉頰因為害羞和驕傲而泛紅。

listen.en: His face flushed red when he forgot his lines.
listen.zh: 他忘詞的時候，整張臉都漲紅了。

chinese.en: The city flushes its water pipes every spring to remove rust and dirt.
chinese.zh: 市政府每年春天都會沖洗自來水管，以清除鏽垢和髒污。

english.en: Make sure the new shelf is flush with the wall.
english.zh: 確認新的層架和牆面是齊平的。

speak.en: I always feel flush right after payday, then broke by month's end.
speak.zh: 我每次剛領薪水都覺得自己很有錢，到了月底就變窮光蛋。

write.en: Heavy rain flushed rubbish from the streets into the river, harming local wildlife.
write.zh: 大雨把街上的垃圾沖進河裡，危害當地的野生動物。

example.en: Instead of chasing promotions and higher salaries, more young workers now value free time and mental health.
example.zh: 比起追求升遷和加薪，現在越來越多年輕上班族更重視空閒時間和心理健康。

listen.en: The puppy loves to chase leaves in the park.
listen.zh: 小狗很喜歡在公園裡追落葉。

chinese.en: After a long chase, the zookeepers finally caught the escaped monkey near the station.
chinese.zh: 經過一番長時間的追捕，動物園管理員終於在車站附近抓到逃跑的猴子。

english.en: I had to chase the bus because I left home late.
english.zh: 因為我太晚出門，只好追著公車跑。

speak.en: I've stopped chasing perfect grades and just focus on learning now.
speak.zh: 我現在不再追求完美的成績，只專注在學習本身。

write.en: Our accountant spends hours each week chasing clients who haven't paid their bills.
write.zh: 我們的會計每週都要花好幾個小時催討沒付帳的客戶。

example.en: The ballet tells a love story entirely through dance and music, so the audience understands it without any words.
example.zh: 這齣芭蕾舞劇完全透過舞蹈和音樂講述愛情故事，觀眾不需要任何台詞就能看懂。

listen.en: We went to see a ballet at the theatre.
listen.zh: 我們去劇院看了一場芭蕾舞表演。

chinese.en: Professional ballet dancers often train for many hours a day to build strength and flexibility.
chinese.zh: 職業芭蕾舞者通常每天訓練好幾個小時，以培養肌力和柔軟度。

english.en: Ballet requires years of discipline as well as natural talent.
english.zh: 芭蕾舞除了天分，還需要多年的自律訓練。

speak.en: I've never watched a ballet live, but I'd love to someday.
speak.zh: 我從沒看過現場的芭蕾舞表演，但很希望有一天能去看。

write.en: The city council cut funding for the local ballet company, upsetting many arts lovers.
write.zh: 市議會刪減了當地芭蕾舞團的經費，讓許多藝術愛好者很不滿。

example.en: Thanks to plenty of sunshine and timely rain, farmers in the region enjoyed a bumper harvest of rice this year.
example.zh: 由於陽光充足、雨水適時，當地農民今年稻米大豐收。

listen.en: The traffic was bumper to bumper all the way home.
listen.zh: 回家的路上一路大塞車。

chinese.en: The magazine's bumper holiday issue includes extra recipes, puzzles and travel guides.
chinese.zh: 這本雜誌的假期特大號收錄了額外的食譜、益智遊戲和旅遊指南。

english.en: My dad bought a new bumper after a minor accident last week.
english.zh: 我爸上週發生小擦撞後，買了一個新的保險桿。

speak.en: Last summer was a bumper year for tourism in my hometown.
speak.zh: 去年夏天是我家鄉觀光業的豐收年。

write.en: Retailers are hoping for bumper sales online during the end-of-year shopping season.
write.zh: 零售業者希望在年末購物季創下網路銷售佳績。

example.en: Residents heard a loud explosion from the chemical factory, and firefighters quickly arrived to put out the small fire.
example.zh: 居民聽到化學工廠傳出巨大的爆炸聲，消防員很快趕到撲滅了小火。

listen.en: The fireworks ended with a huge explosion of colour.
listen.zh: 煙火秀在一片繽紛燦爛的色彩中結束。

chinese.en: The population explosion in big cities has put pressure on housing and public transport.
chinese.zh: 大城市的人口爆炸，對住宅和大眾運輸造成壓力。

english.en: There has been an explosion of interest in plant-based food.
english.zh: 大家對植物性飲食的興趣急速增加。

speak.en: I remember an explosion of laughter when our teacher told that joke.
speak.zh: 我記得老師講那個笑話時，全班哄堂大笑。

write.en: Scientists believe the universe began with an enormous explosion billions of years ago.
write.zh: 科學家認為，宇宙始於數十億年前的一場大爆炸。

example.en: A sense of excitement pervaded the campus during graduation week, with students celebrating and families taking photos everywhere.
example.zh: 畢業週期間，整個校園充滿興奮的氣氛，到處都是慶祝的學生和拍照的家人。

listen.en: A feeling of calm pervaded the quiet library.
listen.zh: 安靜的圖書館裡瀰漫著一股平靜的氣氛。

chinese.en: Smartphones now pervade almost every part of our daily lives, from banking to shopping.
chinese.zh: 從理財到購物，智慧型手機如今幾乎滲透了我們日常生活的每個層面。

english.en: A culture of fear pervaded the company under its old manager.
english.zh: 在前任經理的領導下，公司裡瀰漫著恐懼的文化。

speak.en: I think a sense of competition pervades the whole education system here.
speak.zh: 我覺得這裡的整個教育體系都充斥著競爭的氛圍。

write.en: Plastic particles now pervade the oceans, even reaching the deepest parts of the sea floor.
write.zh: 塑膠微粒如今遍布海洋，甚至到達了海床最深處。

example.en: The new touchscreen is much more responsive, so the app reacts instantly whenever you tap or swipe.
example.zh: 新的觸控螢幕靈敏多了，不論點擊或滑動，應用程式都會立刻反應。

listen.en: The patient is awake but not very responsive yet.
listen.zh: 病人已經醒了，但反應還不太靈敏。

chinese.en: A good government must be responsive to the changing needs of its citizens.
chinese.zh: 好的政府必須積極回應人民不斷改變的需求。

english.en: Our teacher is responsive and answers emails within a day.
english.zh: 我們老師回覆很快，一天內就會回電子郵件。

speak.en: I find students much more responsive when lessons include games.
speak.zh: 我發現課堂上加入遊戲時，學生的反應會熱烈得多。

write.en: A responsive website adjusts its layout automatically to fit phones, tablets and computers.
write.zh: 響應式網站會自動調整版面，以符合手機、平板和電腦的螢幕。

example.en: I hadn't eaten since breakfast, so my stomach began to growl loudly during the quiet afternoon meeting.
example.zh: 我從早餐後就沒吃東西，所以在安靜的下午會議中，肚子開始咕嚕咕嚕大聲叫。

listen.en: We heard a low growl coming from the bushes.
listen.zh: 我們聽到草叢裡傳來一聲低吼。

chinese.en: The tired manager growled at his team when they asked about the deadline again.
chinese.zh: 疲憊的經理在團隊又問起截止日期時，不耐煩地吼了他們。

english.en: The bear gave a deep growl and walked back into the forest.
english.zh: 那隻熊低沉地吼了一聲，然後走回森林裡。

speak.en: My cat growls whenever the neighbour's dog comes near our house.
speak.zh: 每次鄰居的狗靠近我家，我的貓就會發出低吼。

write.en: Wildlife guides teach tourists to back away slowly if they hear an animal growl.
write.zh: 野生動物導遊會教遊客，如果聽到動物低吼，要慢慢往後退。

example.en: Under the weight of the heavy snow, the old roof began to buckle, so the family moved out until it was repaired.
example.zh: 老舊的屋頂在厚重積雪的重壓下開始變形，所以這家人搬出去，直到修好為止。

listen.en: The metal buckle on my belt broke this morning.
listen.zh: 我皮帶上的金屬扣環今天早上壞了。

chinese.en: The company refused to buckle under pressure from investors to cut staff wages.
chinese.zh: 公司拒絕屈服於投資人要求降低員工薪資的壓力。

english.en: My legs buckled after running the whole race in the heat.
english.zh: 在大熱天跑完全程後，我的雙腿一軟。

speak.en: You really need to buckle down if you want a band seven.
speak.zh: 如果你想拿到七分，真的得開始認真努力了。

write.en: During the heatwave, railway tracks buckled in several places, causing long delays.
write.zh: 熱浪期間，鐵軌有好幾處受熱變形，造成長時間誤點。

example.en: Because the company invested heavily in new technology, its production costs fell sharply within a few years.
example.zh: 由於這家公司大量投資新技術，生產成本在幾年內大幅下降。

listen.en: She invests a lot of time in her garden.
listen.zh: 她在花園上投入了很多時間。

chinese.en: Governments should invest more in public transport to reduce traffic and air pollution.
chinese.zh: 政府應該在大眾運輸上投入更多資金，以減少交通壅塞和空氣污染。

english.en: I invested a lot of energy in learning English this year.
english.zh: 我今年投入了很多心力學英文。

speak.en: Honestly, I think learning a new skill is worth investing in.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得學一項新技能是值得投資的。

write.en: Many young people prefer to invest in experiences such as travel rather than expensive cars.
write.zh: 許多年輕人比較喜歡投資在旅行這類體驗上，而不是買昂貴的車。

example.en: The new policy was widely criticized by parents, who argued that it would put even more pressure on students.
example.zh: 這項新政策遭到家長廣泛批評，他們認為這會讓學生承受更大的壓力。

listen.en: Please don't criticize him in front of his friends.
listen.zh: 請不要在他朋友面前批評他。

chinese.en: Some experts criticize social media for making teenagers anxious about their appearance.
chinese.zh: 有些專家批評社群媒體讓青少年對自己的外表感到焦慮。

english.en: It is easy to criticize others but hard to improve yourself.
english.zh: 批評別人很容易，改進自己卻很難。

speak.en: I don't mind being criticized if the feedback is fair.
speak.zh: 只要意見中肯，我不介意被批評。

write.en: The film was criticized for its slow pace, although the acting was excellent.
write.zh: 這部電影因節奏緩慢而受到批評，不過演技很出色。

example.en: Few plants can survive the harsh conditions of the desert, where it is hot during the day and cold at night.
example.zh: 很少植物能在沙漠的嚴酷環境中生存，那裡白天炎熱、夜晚寒冷。

listen.en: Don't be too harsh on yourself when you make mistakes.
listen.zh: 犯錯的時候別對自己太嚴苛。

chinese.en: The harsh winter forced many farmers to move their animals indoors for several weeks.
chinese.zh: 嚴寒的冬天迫使許多農民把牲畜移到室內好幾個星期。

english.en: Some people think the punishment was too harsh for such a small mistake.
english.zh: 有些人認為就這麼小的錯誤而言，這個處罰太嚴厲了。

speak.en: The lighting in my office is a bit harsh, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我辦公室的燈光有點刺眼。

write.en: Graduates often face the harsh reality that a degree does not guarantee a good job.
write.zh: 畢業生常常要面對殘酷的現實：學位並不保證能找到好工作。

example.en: Before travelling abroad, Tom had to show a medical certificate proving that he had been vaccinated against the disease.
example.zh: 出國前，湯姆必須出示一份健康證明，證明他已接種過這種疾病的疫苗。

listen.en: Please bring your birth certificate to the office tomorrow.
listen.zh: 明天請把你的出生證明帶到辦公室。

chinese.en: Many employers prefer applicants who hold a recognised certificate in first aid.
chinese.zh: 許多雇主偏好持有合格急救證照的應徵者。

english.en: She framed her teaching certificate and hung it on the wall.
english.zh: 她把教師證書裱框掛在牆上。

speak.en: I'm hoping to get a certificate in graphic design next year.
speak.zh: 我希望明年能拿到平面設計的證書。

write.en: I bought my aunt a gift certificate for her favourite restaurant as a birthday present.
write.zh: 我買了阿姨最愛那家餐廳的禮券，當作她的生日禮物。

example.en: The report was reviewed by several eminent economists, whose expert opinions gave it considerable credibility among policymakers.
example.zh: 這份報告經過幾位傑出經濟學家審閱，他們的專業意見讓報告在決策者之間頗具公信力。

listen.en: Her grandfather was an eminent doctor in this town.
listen.zh: 她的祖父是這個鎮上一位著名的醫生。

chinese.en: The museum's new exhibition features paintings by several eminent artists from the last century.
chinese.zh: 博物館的新展覽展出了上個世紀幾位傑出藝術家的畫作。

english.en: He became an eminent lawyer after years of hard work.
english.zh: 經過多年努力，他成為一位著名的律師。

speak.en: I'd love to meet an eminent writer and ask about their ideas.
speak.zh: 我很想見見一位知名作家，問問他的創作想法。

write.en: Being eminent in one field does not make someone an expert on every topic.
write.zh: 在某個領域很傑出，並不代表一個人對每個話題都很專業。

example.en: After spending the whole afternoon at the beach, she applied a soothing cream to her sunburned shoulders.
example.zh: 在海邊待了一整個下午後，她在曬傷的肩膀上塗了舒緩乳霜。

listen.en: We had fresh strawberries and cream after dinner.
listen.zh: 我們晚餐後吃了新鮮草莓配鮮奶油。

chinese.en: Remember to put on sun cream before you go hiking in the mountains.
chinese.zh: 去山上健行前記得擦防曬乳。

english.en: My little brother always orders chocolate ice cream at this shop.
english.zh: 我弟弟在這家店總是點巧克力冰淇淋。

speak.en: I usually skip the whipped cream because it's too sweet for me.
speak.zh: 我通常不加鮮奶油，因為對我來說太甜了。

write.en: Only the cream of the crop are accepted into the national training programme.
write.zh: 只有最頂尖的人才能進入國家培訓計畫。

example.en: Moving to a new country can be fraught with difficulties, from finding housing to understanding the local language.
example.zh: 移居新國家可能困難重重，從找房子到聽懂當地語言都是挑戰。

listen.en: The meeting felt fraught and nobody wanted to speak.
listen.zh: 會議氣氛很緊張，沒有人想開口。

chinese.en: Building a new airport near the wetlands is fraught with environmental risks.
chinese.zh: 在濕地附近興建新機場，伴隨著許多環境風險。

english.en: Their friendship became rather fraught after they started working together.
english.zh: 他們開始一起工作後，友誼變得相當緊繃。

speak.en: The week before exams is always a bit fraught for me.
speak.zh: 考試前那個星期對我來說總是有點焦慮。

write.en: Lending money to friends is often fraught with problems, so I try to avoid it.
write.zh: 借錢給朋友常常會衍生許多問題，所以我盡量避免。

example.en: Drivers heading west in the late afternoon often struggle with the glare of the setting sun.
example.zh: 傍晚往西開的駕駛常常被夕陽刺眼的強光所困擾。

listen.en: The old man glared at the noisy children.
listen.zh: 那位老先生怒視著吵鬧的孩子們。

chinese.en: These new screens are designed to reduce glare and protect your eyes.
chinese.zh: 這些新螢幕的設計是為了減少反光、保護眼睛。

english.en: The teacher glared at the students who were talking in class.
english.zh: 老師瞪著那些在課堂上講話的學生。

speak.en: I hate it when someone glares at me on the bus.
speak.zh: 我很討厭在公車上有人瞪我。

write.en: After the scandal, the company found itself in the glare of publicity for weeks.
write.zh: 醜聞爆發後，這家公司連續好幾週都處在媒體的強烈關注之下。

example.en: The dumplings were rather plain, but the spicy dipping sauce made them taste much more interesting.
example.zh: 這些水餃味道有點平淡，但辣味沾醬讓它們好吃多了。

listen.en: Could you pass me the soy sauce, please?
listen.zh: 可以請你把醬油遞給我嗎？

chinese.en: Many restaurants make their own sauces instead of buying them from supermarkets.
chinese.zh: 許多餐廳自己做醬料，而不是去超市買現成的。

english.en: My mother taught me how to make a simple tomato sauce.
english.zh: 媽媽教我怎麼做簡單的番茄醬汁。

speak.en: Honestly, the sauce is what makes this dish so special.
speak.zh: 說真的，這道菜之所以特別就是因為醬汁。

write.en: Food scientists warn that many bottled sauces contain surprisingly high levels of salt and sugar.
write.zh: 食品科學家提醒，許多瓶裝醬料的鹽分和糖分高得驚人。

example.en: In medieval Europe, merchant guilds controlled trade in many towns and set strict rules for their members.
example.zh: 在中世紀的歐洲，商人行會掌控許多城鎮的貿易，並為會員訂下嚴格的規範。

listen.en: The writers' guild meets every month in the library.
listen.zh: 作家協會每個月在圖書館聚會。

chinese.en: The guild offers training and legal advice to young designers who are starting their careers.
chinese.zh: 這個公會為剛起步的年輕設計師提供培訓和法律諮詢。

english.en: Members of the guild must follow a strict code of practice.
english.zh: 公會會員必須遵守嚴格的執業規範。

speak.en: I'd like to join a guild where I can meet other photographers.
speak.zh: 我想加入一個能認識其他攝影師的協會。

write.en: In some online games, players form guilds to complete difficult missions together.
write.zh: 在某些線上遊戲裡，玩家會組成公會一起完成困難的任務。

example.en: After waiting over an hour for his meal, the customer filed a formal complaint with the restaurant manager.
example.zh: 等了一個多小時還沒上菜，這位顧客向餐廳經理正式提出投訴。

listen.en: If you have a complaint, please speak to our staff.
listen.zh: 如果您有任何不滿，請向我們的工作人員反映。

chinese.en: The most common complaint among students is that the library closes too early.
chinese.zh: 學生最常抱怨的是圖書館太早關門。

english.en: My neighbour made a complaint to the landlord about my dog.
english.zh: 我的鄰居向房東投訴我的狗。

speak.en: My only complaint about my hometown is the heavy traffic.
speak.zh: 我對家鄉唯一的不滿就是交通太擁擠。

write.en: Back pain is a common complaint among office workers who sit for long hours.
write.zh: 背痛是久坐的上班族常見的毛病。

example.en: The police questioned the main suspect for hours, but he insisted that he had been at home all evening.
example.zh: 警方偵訊主要嫌疑人好幾個小時，但他堅稱自己整晚都待在家裡。

listen.en: She suspected her friend had forgotten her birthday.
listen.zh: 她懷疑朋友忘了她的生日。

chinese.en: Doctors suspect that poor sleep may be linked to many common health problems.
chinese.zh: 醫生懷疑睡眠品質不佳可能和許多常見的健康問題有關。

english.en: Nobody suspected him of taking the money from the drawer.
english.zh: 沒有人懷疑是他拿了抽屜裡的錢。

speak.en: I suspect most people check their phones far too often.
speak.zh: 我猜大多數人看手機的次數太多了。

write.en: Residents were told to report any suspected gas leaks to the authorities immediately.
write.zh: 居民被告知，若懷疑有瓦斯外洩，應立即通報有關單位。

example.en: Business is usually slack in January, so many shop owners use the quiet weeks to renovate their stores.
example.zh: 一月的生意通常比較清淡，所以許多店家會趁這幾週淡季重新裝修店面。

listen.en: Please cut him some slack because he is still learning.
listen.zh: 他還在學習，請對他寬容一點。

chinese.en: When a colleague is on leave, the rest of the team has to pick up the slack.
chinese.zh: 同事休假時，團隊其他成員就得分擔他的工作。

english.en: Don't slack off just because the teacher is not here.
english.zh: 不要因為老師不在就偷懶。

speak.en: I tend to slack off a bit during the summer holidays.
speak.zh: 暑假的時候我常會有點鬆懈。

write.en: Critics argue that slack safety checks were partly responsible for the factory fire.
write.zh: 批評者認為，鬆散的安全檢查是這場工廠火災的部分原因。

example.en: Thanks to the swift response of the fire department, nobody was hurt and the building suffered only minor damage.
example.zh: 多虧消防隊迅速應變，沒有人受傷，建築物也只受到輕微損壞。

listen.en: The shop was swift to reply to my email.
listen.zh: 那家店很快就回覆了我的電子郵件。

chinese.en: The company made a swift decision to recall the faulty products from all its stores.
chinese.zh: 這家公司迅速決定從所有門市回收有瑕疵的產品。

english.en: We all wish you a swift recovery after the operation.
english.zh: 我們都祝你手術後早日康復。

speak.en: I was surprised by how swift the whole process was.
speak.zh: 整個流程這麼快速，讓我很驚訝。

write.en: The swift growth of online learning has changed the way universities teach.
write.zh: 線上學習的快速成長已經改變了大學的教學方式。

example.en: Thick walls insulate the old farmhouse so well that it stays cool even during the hottest summer days.
example.zh: 厚實的牆壁讓這棟老農舍隔熱效果極佳，即使在最熱的夏日也很涼爽。

listen.en: These pipes need to be insulated before winter comes.
listen.zh: 這些水管需要在冬天來臨前包上保溫材料。

chinese.en: Wealthy families cannot completely insulate their children from the problems of the real world.
chinese.zh: 富裕的家庭無法讓孩子完全隔絕於現實世界的問題之外。

english.en: Electric wires are insulated with plastic to make them safe.
english.zh: 電線外面包著塑膠絕緣層，以確保安全。

speak.en: My flat is badly insulated, so it gets really cold at night.
speak.zh: 我住的公寓隔熱很差，所以晚上很冷。

write.en: Properly insulating homes is one of the cheapest ways to cut energy use and emissions.
write.zh: 做好住宅隔熱是減少能源使用和碳排放最便宜的方法之一。

example.en: I found a bunch of old keys in the drawer, but none of them opened the locked cupboard.
example.zh: 我在抽屜裡找到一串舊鑰匙，但沒有一支能打開那個上鎖的櫃子。

listen.en: My classmates are a really friendly bunch of people.
listen.zh: 我的同學們是一群非常友善的人。

chinese.en: The volunteers handed out bunches of bananas to the runners at the finish line.
chinese.zh: 志工在終點線發一串串香蕉給跑者。

english.en: I have a bunch of questions about the new project.
english.zh: 我對這個新專案有一大堆問題。

speak.en: Honestly, I wasted a whole bunch of time online last weekend.
speak.zh: 老實說，我上週末在網路上浪費了一大堆時間。

write.en: Of all the apartments we visited, this one was definitely the best of the bunch.
write.zh: 在我們看過的所有公寓中，這間絕對是最好的。

example.en: Although the twins look identical, their personalities are completely opposite: one is shy while the other is very outgoing.
example.zh: 雖然這對雙胞胎長得一模一樣，個性卻完全相反：一個很害羞，另一個非常外向。

listen.en: The car was driving in the opposite direction.
listen.zh: 那輛車朝反方向行駛。

chinese.en: Strict rules sometimes have the opposite effect and make teenagers more rebellious.
chinese.zh: 嚴格的規定有時會產生反效果，讓青少年更加叛逆。

english.en: My sister always does the opposite of what our parents say.
english.zh: 爸媽說什麼，我妹妹總是反著做。

speak.en: My best friend and I are complete opposites, actually.
speak.zh: 其實我和我最好的朋友個性完全相反。

write.en: People on opposite sides of the debate should still listen to each other respectfully.
write.zh: 辯論中立場對立的雙方，仍應該互相尊重、傾聽彼此。

example.en: Teachers need to be sensitive to the needs of students who are new to the country and still adjusting.
example.zh: 老師需要體察剛到這個國家、仍在適應中的學生有什麼需求。

listen.en: Dogs have a very sensitive sense of smell.
listen.zh: 狗的嗅覺非常靈敏。

chinese.en: Companies must do more to protect sensitive customer information from hackers.
chinese.zh: 企業必須更努力保護敏感的顧客資料，防止駭客入侵。

english.en: He is a sensitive person who notices when others feel sad.
english.zh: 他是個細心的人，別人難過時他都察覺得到。

speak.en: I try to be careful when talking about sensitive topics with friends.
speak.zh: 和朋友聊敏感話題時，我會盡量小心。

write.en: Coral reefs are extremely sensitive to even small rises in ocean temperature.
write.zh: 珊瑚礁對海水溫度的些微上升都非常敏感。

example.en: For safety reasons, campers are not allowed to use naked flames inside the tents, which can catch fire very easily.
example.zh: 基於安全考量，露營者不得在帳篷內使用明火，因為帳篷很容易著火。

listen.en: The trees looked naked after the strong autumn winds.
listen.zh: 秋天的強風過後，樹木看起來光禿禿的。

chinese.en: His naked ambition made it difficult for his colleagues to trust him.
chinese.zh: 他毫不掩飾的野心讓同事很難信任他。

english.en: The baby was lying naked on the towel after his bath.
english.zh: 寶寶洗完澡後光著身子躺在毛巾上。

speak.en: I'd rather hear the naked truth than a polite lie.
speak.zh: 我寧願聽赤裸裸的真相，也不要聽客套的謊言。

write.en: Without its usual furniture, the room looked strangely naked and much larger than before.
write.zh: 少了平常的家具，這個房間看起來空蕩蕩的，也比以前大得多。

example.en: Without regular watering, young trees can easily perish during the dry season, so volunteers visit them every week.
example.zh: 若不定期澆水，幼樹在乾季很容易枯死，所以志工每週都會去照顧它們。

listen.en: Fresh fruit will perish quickly in hot weather.
listen.zh: 新鮮水果在炎熱的天氣裡很快就會腐壞。

chinese.en: Many ancient languages have perished because younger generations simply stopped speaking them.
chinese.zh: 許多古老的語言已經消亡，因為年輕一代不再使用它們。

english.en: Many wild animals perished in the forest fire last summer.
english.zh: 去年夏天的森林大火中，許多野生動物喪生。

speak.en: Give up coffee for a whole month? Perish the thought!
speak.zh: 一整個月不喝咖啡？想都別想！

write.en: Old rubber seals perish over time, so they should be checked and replaced regularly.
write.zh: 老舊的橡膠密封圈會隨時間老化，所以應該定期檢查並更換。

example.en: The rainforest supports a remarkably diverse range of plants and animals, many of which are found nowhere else on Earth.
example.zh: 雨林孕育了極為多樣的動植物，其中許多在地球上其他地方都找不到。

listen.en: This city has a very diverse food scene.
listen.zh: 這座城市的美食非常多元。

chinese.en: A diverse workforce can bring fresh ideas and help companies understand different customers.
chinese.zh: 多元的員工組成能帶來新想法，並幫助企業了解不同的顧客。

english.en: The museum offers diverse activities for both children and adults.
english.zh: 這間博物館為兒童和成人提供各式各樣的活動。

speak.en: I love living here because the neighbourhood is so diverse.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡住在這裡，因為這一區非常多元。

write.en: Students' opinions on school uniforms were surprisingly diverse, so the debate lasted for hours.
write.zh: 學生對制服的看法出乎意料地分歧，所以辯論持續了好幾個小時。

example.en: Swimmers were warned to stay out of the water because jellyfish with stinging tentacles had been spotted near the shore.
example.zh: 由於岸邊附近發現觸手會螫人的水母，泳客被警告不要下水。

listen.en: The squid wrapped its tentacles around the rock.
listen.zh: 那隻魷魚用觸手纏住了岩石。

chinese.en: Scientists are studying how octopuses manage to control each of their tentacles independently.
chinese.zh: 科學家正在研究章魚是如何做到獨立控制每一條觸手的。

english.en: The children were fascinated by the long tentacles of the jellyfish.
english.zh: 孩子們被水母長長的觸手迷住了。

speak.en: I've never been brave enough to eat anything with tentacles.
speak.zh: 我從來都不敢吃任何有觸手的東西。

write.en: Some critics worry that the tentacles of big tech companies now reach into every part of our lives.
write.zh: 有些批評者擔心，大型科技公司的勢力如今已伸入我們生活的每個角落。

example.en: Listening to loud music through headphones for long periods can cause permanent damage to your hearing.
example.zh: 長時間用耳機聽大聲的音樂，可能會對聽力造成永久性傷害。

listen.en: This exhibition will become a permanent part of the museum.
listen.zh: 這個展覽將成為博物館的常設展。

chinese.en: Building more roads is not a permanent solution to traffic problems in big cities.
chinese.zh: 興建更多道路並不是解決大城市交通問題的長久之計。

english.en: He plans to apply for permanent residence in Canada next year.
english.zh: 他打算明年申請加拿大的永久居留權。

speak.en: I'm only renting for now, so it's not permanent.
speak.zh: 我現在只是租房子，所以不是長久的打算。

write.en: Some tattoos are designed to be permanent, while others fade after a few weeks.
write.zh: 有些刺青是永久性的，有些則幾週後就會褪色。

example.en: Archaeologists found crude stone tools in the cave, suggesting that early humans had lived there long ago.
example.zh: 考古學家在洞穴中發現了簡陋的石器，顯示早期人類很久以前曾住在那裡。

listen.en: He made a crude drawing of the house on paper.
listen.zh: 他在紙上粗略地畫了這棟房子。

chinese.en: These figures are only a crude estimate, so the real cost may be much higher.
chinese.zh: 這些數字只是粗略的估計，所以實際成本可能高出許多。

english.en: His crude jokes made everyone at the dinner feel uncomfortable.
english.zh: 他粗俗的笑話讓晚餐上的每個人都很不自在。

speak.en: My first website was pretty crude, but I learned a lot.
speak.zh: 我的第一個網站做得很陽春，但我從中學到很多。

write.en: Prices of crude have fallen as demand for electric vehicles continues to grow.
write.zh: 隨著電動車需求持續成長，原油價格已經下跌。

example.en: Volunteers stood outside the station handing out pamphlets that explained how residents could reduce household waste.
example.zh: 志工站在車站外發放小冊子，說明居民可以如何減少家庭垃圾。

listen.en: Please take a pamphlet from the table by the door.
listen.zh: 請從門邊的桌上拿一本小冊子。

chinese.en: The museum provides free pamphlets in several languages for its international visitors.
chinese.zh: 博物館為國際訪客提供多種語言的免費小冊子。

english.en: I read the safety pamphlet carefully before the hiking trip.
english.zh: 健行之前，我仔細讀了那份安全須知小冊子。

speak.en: Honestly, I usually throw pamphlets away without even reading them.
speak.zh: 老實說，我通常連看都沒看就把小冊子丟掉了。

write.en: Many charities now share information online because printing pamphlets is expensive and wasteful.
write.zh: 許多慈善團體現在改在網路上分享資訊，因為印製小冊子既昂貴又浪費。

example.en: The puppy was easy to recognise in the park because of its fluffy white fur and short curly tail.
example.zh: 那隻小狗在公園裡很好認，因為牠有蓬鬆的白毛和短短的捲尾巴。

listen.en: The boy with curly hair is my cousin.
listen.zh: 那個捲髮的男孩是我表弟。

chinese.en: Some people with curly hair spend a lot of time straightening it every morning.
chinese.zh: 有些捲髮的人每天早上要花很多時間把頭髮拉直。

english.en: When I was a child, my hair was very curly.
english.zh: 我小時候頭髮很捲。

speak.en: I've always wanted curly hair, but mine is completely straight.
speak.zh: 我一直很想要捲髮，可是我的頭髮完全是直的。

write.en: In programming, curly brackets are used to group several lines of code together.
write.zh: 在程式設計中，大括號用來把好幾行程式碼組合在一起。

example.en: The apartment was rented furnished, so the students did not have to buy beds, desks or any other furniture.
example.zh: 這間公寓是附家具出租的，所以學生們不必買床、書桌或任何其他家具。

listen.en: Please help me move the heavy furniture upstairs.
listen.zh: 請幫我把這些沉重的家具搬到樓上。

chinese.en: Buying second-hand furniture is a cheap and environmentally friendly way to decorate a home.
chinese.zh: 買二手家具是布置住家既便宜又環保的方法。

english.en: This old wooden chair is my favourite piece of furniture.
english.zh: 這張舊木椅是我最喜歡的一件家具。

speak.en: I prefer simple furniture because it makes a small room feel bigger.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡簡約的家具，因為能讓小房間看起來比較大。

write.en: Our office replaced its old furniture with adjustable desks to reduce back problems among staff.
write.zh: 我們辦公室把舊家具換成可調式辦公桌，以減少員工的背部問題。

example.en: Rescue teams from several countries worked together, but it was difficult to coordinate their efforts without a common language.
example.zh: 來自好幾個國家的救援隊一起工作，但沒有共同語言，很難協調彼此的行動。

listen.en: Who will coordinate the school trip this year?
listen.zh: 今年的校外教學由誰負責統籌？

chinese.en: The city needs to coordinate bus and train timetables so passengers can transfer easily.
chinese.zh: 市政府需要協調公車和火車的時刻表，讓乘客能輕鬆轉乘。

english.en: She always coordinates the colour of her shoes with her handbag.
english.zh: 她總是讓鞋子的顏色和手提包互相搭配。

speak.en: In my last job, I had to coordinate with several departments.
speak.zh: 我上一份工作需要和好幾個部門協調。

write.en: The hikers sent their exact coordinates to the rescue centre after getting lost.
write.zh: 健行者迷路後，把他們的確切座標傳給了救難中心。

example.en: Since the old letters were all she had left from her father, she kept them as her most precious possessions.
example.zh: 那些舊信是父親留給她的唯一紀念，所以她把它們當成自己最珍貴的寶物。

listen.en: Please don't waste my precious time on silly arguments.
listen.zh: 請不要把我寶貴的時間浪費在無聊的爭吵上。

chinese.en: Gold and silver are precious metals that have been used as money for centuries.
chinese.zh: 金和銀是貴金屬，幾百年來一直被當作貨幣使用。

english.en: Those summer holidays with my grandparents are my most precious memories.
english.zh: 和祖父母一起過的那些暑假，是我最珍貴的回憶。

speak.en: For me, weekends with my family are really precious.
speak.zh: 對我來說，和家人共度的週末非常珍貴。

write.en: Doctors in rural hospitals often lose precious minutes waiting for test results from the city.
write.zh: 鄉下醫院的醫生常常為了等待城市傳來的檢驗結果而耽誤寶貴的時間。

example.en: The website has become a popular platform where young musicians can share their songs and connect with fans.
example.zh: 這個網站已經成為熱門的平台，年輕音樂人可以在上面分享歌曲並與粉絲交流。

listen.en: Please stand behind the yellow line on the platform.
listen.zh: 請站在月台的黃線後方。

chinese.en: Social media platforms should do more to stop the spread of false information.
chinese.zh: 社群媒體平台應該更積極地阻止假訊息散播。

english.en: The speaker stepped onto the platform and began her speech.
english.zh: 講者走上講台，開始她的演講。

speak.en: I mostly use online platforms to learn new skills these days.
speak.zh: 我最近大多透過線上平台學習新技能。

write.en: The festival gives local artists a platform to showcase their work to a wider audience.
write.zh: 這個藝術節為在地藝術家提供一個平台，讓更多人看到他們的作品。

example.en: Small family shops were among the biggest casualties of the economic crisis, as customers stopped spending money.
example.zh: 由於顧客不再消費，小型家庭商店成為這場經濟危機中受創最重的一群。

listen.en: The injured hiker was taken straight to casualty.
listen.zh: 受傷的健行者被直接送往急診室。

chinese.en: Better road design could greatly reduce casualties from traffic accidents in rural areas.
chinese.zh: 更好的道路設計能大幅減少鄉村地區交通事故的傷亡。

english.en: The strong earthquake caused heavy casualties in several mountain villages.
english.zh: 這場強烈地震在好幾個山區村莊造成慘重傷亡。

speak.en: I think free time is often a casualty of a busy job.
speak.zh: 我覺得忙碌的工作常常會犧牲掉空閒時間。

write.en: When budgets are cut, art and music classes are often the first casualties.
write.zh: 預算被刪減時，美術和音樂課往往是最先被犧牲的。

example.en: By reading with their children every night, parents can cultivate a love of books that lasts a lifetime.
example.zh: 父母每晚陪孩子閱讀，就能培養孩子一輩子對書的熱愛。

listen.en: She is trying to cultivate better habits this year.
listen.zh: 她今年努力培養更好的習慣。

chinese.en: Successful businesses often spend years cultivating strong relationships with their suppliers and customers.
chinese.zh: 成功的企業往往花上好幾年，和供應商及顧客建立穩固的關係。

english.en: My grandfather cultivated vegetables in a small garden behind his house.
english.zh: 我祖父在他家後面的小菜園裡種菜。

speak.en: I'd like to cultivate an interest in classical music.
speak.zh: 我想培養對古典音樂的興趣。

write.en: As cities expand, less land is available to cultivate food for growing populations.
write.zh: 隨著城市擴張，可用來種植糧食、供應日益增加人口的土地越來越少。

example.en: The plan was based on the assumption that oil prices would remain low, which turned out to be completely wrong.
example.zh: 這個計畫是建立在油價會維持低檔的假設上，結果這個假設完全錯誤。

listen.en: Your assumption about my new job is not correct.
listen.zh: 你對我新工作的猜想並不正確。

chinese.en: Scientists should always question their assumptions when the evidence does not support them.
chinese.zh: 當證據不支持時，科學家應該隨時質疑自己的假設。

english.en: We packed light on the assumption that the weather would stay warm.
english.zh: 我們以為天氣會一直很暖和，所以行李帶得很少。

speak.en: I try not to make assumptions about people based on their appearance.
speak.zh: 我盡量不以外表來對人妄下定論。

write.en: The common assumption that older workers cannot learn new technology is simply untrue.
write.zh: 一般人常以為年長員工學不會新科技，這種想法根本不正確。

example.en: Teachers often lament that students today spend more time on their phones than reading books, which affects their concentration.
example.zh: 老師們常感嘆現在的學生花在手機上的時間比讀書還多，影響了他們的專注力。

listen.en: He lamented that he had never learned to swim.
listen.zh: 他感嘆自己從來沒學過游泳。

chinese.en: The documentary laments the decline of small fishing villages along the coast.
chinese.zh: 這部紀錄片惋惜沿海小漁村的沒落。

english.en: My grandmother often laments how expensive everything in the shops has become.
english.zh: 我奶奶常感嘆店裡的東西都變得好貴。

speak.en: People always lament the traffic, but nobody wants to take the bus.
speak.zh: 大家總是感嘆交通很糟，卻沒有人想搭公車。

write.en: The old song is a lament for a village that disappeared when the dam was built.
write.zh: 這首老歌是在哀悼一座因興建水壩而消失的村莊。

example.en: Applying for a visa can be a tedious process, involving long forms, several documents and many hours of waiting.
example.zh: 申請簽證可能是個冗長乏味的過程，要填很長的表格、準備好幾份文件，還要等上好幾個小時。

listen.en: The lecture was so tedious that I almost fell asleep.
listen.zh: 那堂課冗長乏味到我差點睡著。

chinese.en: Robots can now perform many tedious jobs that factory workers used to do.
chinese.zh: 機器人現在可以做許多以前由工廠工人負責的單調工作。

english.en: Learning grammar rules can be tedious, but it is necessary.
english.zh: 學文法規則可能很乏味，但卻是必要的。

speak.en: I find long train journeys a bit tedious, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得長途火車旅行有點無聊。

write.en: Keeping a daily budget seemed tedious at first, but it helped me save a lot.
write.zh: 每天記帳一開始似乎很麻煩，但幫我省下了不少錢。

example.en: Some farming methods are highly destructive to the soil, leaving it unable to grow crops after only a few years.
example.zh: 有些耕作方式對土壤破壞性極大，短短幾年後土地就種不出作物了。

listen.en: Anger can be very destructive in a friendship.
listen.zh: 憤怒對友誼可能非常具有破壞性。

chinese.en: Experts warn that constant criticism is destructive and rarely helps children improve.
chinese.zh: 專家提醒，不斷批評是有害的，而且很少能幫助孩子進步。

english.en: Plastic waste has a very destructive effect on marine life.
english.zh: 塑膠垃圾對海洋生物有非常大的破壞性影響。

speak.en: I think staying up late every night is pretty destructive.
speak.zh: 我覺得每天熬夜對身體很傷。

write.en: The film shows the destructive power of a volcano that buried an entire town.
write.zh: 這部電影呈現了火山埋沒整座城鎮的毀滅性威力。

example.en: After the main street became a pedestrian zone, shops reported more customers because people could stroll safely without cars.
example.zh: 主要街道改成行人徒步區後，店家表示顧客變多了，因為大家可以不受車輛干擾、安心散步。

listen.en: Please use the pedestrian bridge to cross the road.
listen.zh: 請走行人天橋過馬路。

chinese.en: The city plans to widen sidewalks to improve pedestrian safety near schools.
chinese.zh: 市政府計畫拓寬人行道，以提升學校附近的行人安全。

english.en: A pedestrian was hit by a bicycle on the busy road.
english.zh: 一名行人在繁忙的路上被腳踏車撞到。

speak.en: Honestly, I think this city isn't very friendly to pedestrians.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得這座城市對行人不太友善。

write.en: Critics described the novel's plot as pedestrian, although its characters were quite memorable.
write.zh: 評論家認為這部小說的情節平淡無奇，不過角色倒是令人印象深刻。

example.en: Residents complained about the unpleasant odour from the rubbish dump, especially on hot summer days when the smell was strongest.
example.zh: 居民抱怨垃圾場傳來的難聞氣味，尤其在炎熱的夏天味道最重。

listen.en: There is a strange odour coming from the fridge.
listen.zh: 冰箱裡傳出一股奇怪的味道。

chinese.en: Baking soda is a cheap and effective way to remove odours from shoes.
chinese.zh: 小蘇打粉是去除鞋子異味既便宜又有效的方法。

english.en: The odour of fresh paint made me feel a little dizzy.
english.zh: 新油漆的氣味讓我覺得有點頭暈。

speak.en: I can't stand the odour of cigarette smoke on my clothes.
speak.zh: 我受不了衣服上沾到菸味。

write.en: Dogs can detect odours that humans cannot notice, which makes them useful at airports.
write.zh: 狗能察覺人類聞不到的氣味，因此在機場很派得上用場。

example.en: The factory reduced its waste significantly; consequently, the river nearby became clean enough for fish to return.
example.zh: 這家工廠大幅減少廢棄物，因此附近的河川變得乾淨，魚群也回來了。

listen.en: It rained all week, and consequently the match was cancelled.
listen.zh: 下了整整一週的雨，因此比賽取消了。

chinese.en: Housing prices have risen sharply; consequently, many young people cannot afford to buy homes.
chinese.zh: 房價大幅上漲，因此許多年輕人買不起房子。

english.en: She studied very hard and consequently passed the exam easily.
english.zh: 她非常用功，因此輕鬆通過了考試。

speak.en: I didn't sleep well, and consequently I felt tired all day.
speak.zh: 我沒睡好，所以一整天都覺得很累。

write.en: Fewer people now read printed newspapers. Consequently, many local papers have closed.
write.zh: 現在閱讀紙本報紙的人變少了，因此許多地方報社已經停刊。

example.en: Because the boy was still a minor, his case was handled by the juvenile court rather than an adult court.
example.zh: 由於這名男孩仍未成年，他的案件交由少年法庭而非一般法庭審理。

listen.en: His juvenile jokes annoyed everyone at the meeting.
listen.zh: 他幼稚的玩笑讓會議上的每個人都很煩。

chinese.en: Researchers tagged the juveniles to track how far the young sharks travelled each year.
chinese.zh: 研究人員為這些幼鯊裝上標籤，以追蹤牠們每年游多遠。

english.en: The city opened a new centre to help juvenile offenders.
english.zh: 市政府開設了一個新的中心，協助觸法的青少年。

speak.en: Arguing over who sits in front feels a bit juvenile, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，為了誰坐前座吵架感覺有點幼稚。

write.en: Experts believe that education is more effective than punishment in reducing juvenile crime.
write.zh: 專家認為，要減少青少年犯罪，教育比懲罰更有效。

example.en: After three days of careful observation, the doctors decided she was well enough to be discharged from hospital.
example.zh: 經過三天的仔細觀察，醫生判斷她已經恢復得夠好，可以出院了。

listen.en: Old batteries slowly discharge even when they are not used.
listen.zh: 舊電池即使沒有使用，也會慢慢放電。

chinese.en: Public servants are expected to discharge their duties honestly and without favouritism.
chinese.zh: 公務人員應該誠實、公正地履行職責，不偏袒任何人。

english.en: He was discharged from the army after he injured his knee.
english.zh: 他膝蓋受傷後就從軍中退伍了。

speak.en: Honestly, I was so relieved when the nurse said I could be discharged.
speak.zh: 說真的，護理師說我可以出院的時候，我真的鬆了一口氣。

write.en: Residents complained about the discharge of untreated sewage near the popular beach.
write.zh: 居民抱怨有未經處理的污水排放在熱門海灘附近。

example.en: As the population grew, the city continued to sprawl outward, swallowing farmland and forcing residents into longer commutes.
example.zh: 隨著人口成長，這座城市持續向外擴張，吞沒了農地，也迫使居民花更久的時間通勤。

listen.en: The cat was sprawled across my bed when I got home.
listen.zh: 我回到家時，貓咪正攤在我的床上。

chinese.en: Urban sprawl increases car dependence because homes are built far from shops and offices.
chinese.zh: 都市無序擴張會增加對汽車的依賴，因為住宅都蓋在離商店和辦公室很遠的地方。

english.en: My younger brother sprawled on the sofa and fell asleep.
english.zh: 我弟弟攤在沙發上睡著了。

speak.en: Where I live, the suburbs sprawl for miles, so you really need a car.
speak.zh: 我住的地方郊區一路延伸得很遠，所以真的需要一部車。

write.en: Planners hope new rail lines will stop the capital from sprawling into protected forests.
write.zh: 規劃人員希望新的鐵路線能阻止首都向受保護的森林擴張。

example.en: Engineers measured the wind velocity on the bridge every hour, because strong gusts could make it unsafe for traffic.
example.zh: 工程師每小時測量一次橋上的風速，因為強烈陣風可能讓車輛通行不安全。

listen.en: The ball left his foot at an amazing velocity.
listen.zh: 球以驚人的速度從他腳下飛出。

chinese.en: In physics class, we learned that velocity includes both speed and direction.
chinese.zh: 在物理課上，我們學到速度同時包含快慢和方向。

english.en: The velocity of the river usually increases after heavy rain.
english.zh: 大雨過後，河水的流速通常會增加。

speak.en: I love roller coasters, especially the moment they suddenly gain velocity.
speak.zh: 我很愛雲霄飛車，尤其是它突然加速的那一刻。

write.en: Economists worry that the velocity of money has slowed as households save more.
write.zh: 經濟學家擔心，隨著家庭儲蓄增加，貨幣的流通速度已經放緩。

example.en: Unlike their colleagues at head office, branch managers enjoy considerable autonomy and can set their own budgets without approval.
example.zh: 和總公司的同事不同，分店經理享有相當大的自主權，不必經過核准就能自行訂定預算。

listen.en: She values the autonomy that comes with working from home.
listen.zh: 她很重視在家工作帶來的自主性。

chinese.en: The university was granted full autonomy to design its own admission system.
chinese.zh: 這所大學獲得完全的自主權，可以自行設計招生制度。

english.en: Getting a part-time job at university gave me more financial autonomy.
english.zh: 大學時找了份兼職工作，讓我在經濟上更能自主。

speak.en: I think kids should have some autonomy, but parents still need to set limits.
speak.zh: 我覺得小孩應該有一些自主權，但父母還是要設下界線。

write.en: Adult patients have the autonomy to refuse treatment after hearing the risks.
write.zh: 成年病患在了解風險之後，有拒絕治療的自主權。
