example.en: The earthquake was so small that most people didn't feel it, but it still registered on the sensitive instruments.
example.zh: 這次地震小到大部分人都沒感覺，但靈敏的儀器還是記錄到了。

listen.en: All new students must register with a local doctor.
listen.zh: 所有新生都必須到當地的家庭醫師那裡登記。

chinese.en: The teacher took the register at the start of every lesson to check attendance.
chinese.zh: 老師每堂課一開始都會點名，確認出席狀況。

english.en: I registered my new bike with the police in case it gets stolen.
english.zh: 我把新腳踏車向警方登記，以防被偷。

speak.en: Her name didn't really register with me until she mentioned her job.
speak.zh: 直到她提起自己的工作，我才真正對她的名字有印象。

write.en: Customers can register a complaint online if they are unhappy with the service.
write.zh: 顧客如果對服務不滿意，可以上網提出申訴。

example.en: Before you install the update, make sure your files are backed up, because the process occasionally deletes saved data.
example.zh: 安裝更新之前，請先確定檔案都已備份，因為更新過程偶爾會刪除已儲存的資料。

listen.en: The technician will come to install the air conditioner tomorrow.
listen.zh: 技師明天會來安裝冷氣。

chinese.en: The city council plans to install more streetlights in parks to improve safety at night.
chinese.zh: 市議會計畫在公園增設更多路燈，以提升夜間安全。

english.en: I can't install this app because my phone is too old.
english.zh: 我沒辦法安裝這個應用程式，因為我的手機太舊了。

speak.en: My dad spent the whole weekend trying to install a new dishwasher.
speak.zh: 我爸花了整個週末想把新的洗碗機裝好。

write.en: The board installed a new chief executive shortly after the founder retired.
write.zh: 創辦人退休後不久，董事會就讓新任執行長正式上任。

example.en: Countries blessed with natural resources are not always wealthy, as poor management can waste these advantages.
example.zh: 擁有豐富天然資源的國家不見得富裕，因為管理不善可能會浪費這些優勢。

listen.en: Every time I sneeze, my coworker kindly says, "Bless you."
listen.zh: 每次我打噴嚏，同事都會貼心地說「保重喔」。

chinese.en: Losing that job turned out to be a blessing in disguise, because it pushed me to retrain.
chinese.zh: 丟掉那份工作後來反而是因禍得福，因為它促使我去學新的技能。

english.en: My grandmother warmly blessed the young couple at their wedding.
english.zh: 奶奶在婚禮上溫暖地祝福這對新人。

speak.en: I'm really blessed to have friends who support me no matter what.
speak.zh: 我真的很幸運，有一群無論如何都支持我的朋友。

write.en: The festival was blessed with perfect weather, and record crowds came to enjoy it.
write.zh: 這次節慶活動遇上了完美的好天氣，吸引了破紀錄的人潮。

example.en: The rescue team did their utmost to reach the hikers before dark, knowing the temperature would drop sharply overnight.
example.zh: 搜救隊盡全力要在天黑前找到登山客，因為他們知道夜裡氣溫會驟降。

listen.en: Clean drinking water is of the utmost importance for everyone.
listen.zh: 乾淨的飲用水對每個人都極為重要。

chinese.en: The new manager treated every complaint with the utmost seriousness and replied within a day.
chinese.zh: 新來的經理極為認真地看待每一則客訴，並在一天內回覆。

english.en: I will try my utmost to pass the exam this time.
english.zh: 這次我會盡最大努力通過考試。

speak.en: Honestly, I have the utmost respect for nurses and teachers.
speak.zh: 老實說，我非常敬重護理師和老師。

write.en: The runners pushed themselves to the utmost during the final lap of the race.
write.zh: 比賽最後一圈，跑者們都把自己逼到了極限。

example.en: The plant's long thorns protect its leaves from hungry animals, which quickly learn to avoid feeding on it.
example.zh: 這種植物的長刺能保護葉子不被飢餓的動物吃掉，動物很快就學會避開它。

listen.en: I got a thorn stuck in my finger while gardening.
listen.zh: 我在整理花園時，手指被刺扎到了。

chinese.en: Traffic congestion has been a thorn in the city government's side for years.
chinese.zh: 多年來，交通壅塞一直是市政府頭痛的問題。

english.en: The hikers walked carefully to avoid the thorns along the path.
english.zh: 登山客小心地走，避開步道旁的荊棘。

speak.en: My noisy neighbour has been a real thorn in my side lately.
speak.zh: 最近我那個很吵的鄰居真的讓我很頭痛。

write.en: Every rose has its thorn, and even my dream job comes with stressful deadlines.
write.zh: 玫瑰總有刺，就連我夢寐以求的工作也有讓人壓力很大的截止期限。

example.en: To retain experienced staff, the company introduced flexible hours and paid for employees to attend training courses.
example.zh: 為了留住有經驗的員工，公司推行彈性工時，並出錢讓員工參加進修課程。

listen.en: Some students find it hard to retain new vocabulary.
listen.zh: 有些學生覺得新單字很難記住。

chinese.en: Despite modern renovations, the old station has retained much of its original charm.
chinese.zh: 儘管經過現代化整修，這座老車站仍保留了許多原有的風貌。

english.en: Please retain your receipt in case you need to return the item.
english.zh: 請保留收據，以備需要退貨時使用。

speak.en: I'd love to live abroad but still retain strong ties to home.
speak.zh: 我很想出國生活，但還是想和家鄉保持緊密的連結。

write.en: Wetlands retain rainwater like a sponge, which helps reduce flooding in nearby towns.
write.zh: 濕地像海綿一樣保留雨水，有助於減少附近城鎮淹水。

example.en: After losing the final match, the champion had to relinquish her title, which she had held for nearly five years.
example.zh: 輸掉決賽之後，這位冠軍不得不讓出她保持了將近五年的頭銜。

listen.en: He refused to relinquish his seat by the window.
listen.zh: 他不肯讓出靠窗的座位。

chinese.en: Many parents find it hard to relinquish control when their children move out.
chinese.zh: 孩子搬出去住時，許多父母很難放手，不再事事掌控。

english.en: The manager relinquished her position to spend more time with her family.
english.zh: 這位經理辭去職位，好多花點時間陪家人。

speak.en: I hate to relinquish the remote control when my favourite show is on.
speak.zh: 我最喜歡的節目在播時，我最討厭把遙控器讓出去。

write.en: Under the agreement, the farmers relinquished their rights to the land in exchange for compensation.
write.zh: 根據協議，農民放棄了土地的權利，以換取補償金。

example.en: The oil spill killed thousands of seabirds and closed local beaches for months, devastating the tourism industry.
example.zh: 這起漏油事件害死了數千隻海鳥，當地海灘也封閉了好幾個月，重創觀光業。

listen.en: Fans spilled out onto the street after the concert.
listen.zh: 演唱會結束後，歌迷湧上了街頭。

chinese.en: Tensions at work can easily spill over into family life if you never switch off.
chinese.zh: 如果你從來不放鬆，工作上的緊張情緒很容易蔓延到家庭生活。

english.en: Be careful not to spill the soup on the tablecloth.
english.zh: 小心別把湯灑到桌巾上。

speak.en: Come on, spill the beans! Who did you see at the party?
speak.zh: 快點，老實招來！你在派對上看到誰了？

write.en: Sunlight spilled through the curtains and woke me earlier than I had planned.
write.zh: 陽光從窗簾灑進來，讓我比預定的時間還早醒來。

example.en: The speaker had such a magnetic personality that the audience hung on her every word for the entire evening.
example.zh: 這位講者的個人魅力十足，整個晚上聽眾都聚精會神地聽她說的每一句話。

listen.en: I keep a magnetic shopping list on the fridge.
listen.zh: 我在冰箱上貼了一張磁吸式購物清單。

chinese.en: Old hotel key cards with a magnetic strip can stop working near a mobile phone.
chinese.zh: 舊式有磁條的飯店房卡放在手機附近可能會失效。

english.en: The needle of a compass always points towards magnetic north.
english.zh: 指南針的指針總是指向磁北。

speak.en: My best friend is kind of magnetic; everyone wants to talk to her.
speak.zh: 我最好的朋友有種吸引人的魅力，每個人都想跟她聊天。

write.en: Hospitals use magnetic resonance imaging to examine patients' organs without any surgery.
write.zh: 醫院利用磁振造影，不必開刀就能檢查病患的器官。

example.en: The narrow street near the temple is lined with souvenir shops selling postcards, magnets and local snacks to tourists.
example.zh: 寺廟附近那條狹窄的街道兩旁都是紀念品店，向觀光客販售明信片、磁鐵和當地小吃。

listen.en: She kept the concert ticket as a souvenir.
listen.zh: 她把演唱會門票留下來當紀念。

chinese.en: Some tourists take stones from beaches as souvenirs, which can damage fragile ecosystems.
chinese.zh: 有些觀光客會從海灘撿石頭當紀念品，這可能會破壞脆弱的生態系。

english.en: My parents always bring back souvenirs for me when they travel.
english.zh: 我爸媽每次去旅行都會帶紀念品回來給我。

speak.en: To be honest, most souvenirs I buy just end up in a drawer.
speak.zh: 說實話，我買的紀念品大多最後都只是被丟在抽屜裡。

write.en: The museum sells souvenir copies of famous paintings to help fund its education programmes.
write.zh: 這間博物館販售名畫的紀念複製品，以資助它的教育推廣活動。

example.en: The new ambulances are outfitted with advanced equipment, allowing paramedics to treat patients on the way to hospital.
example.zh: 新的救護車配備了先進的設備，讓救護人員在送醫途中就能為病患治療。

listen.en: I love your outfit; where did you buy that jacket?
listen.zh: 我好喜歡你這身穿搭，那件外套在哪裡買的？

chinese.en: Many students rent a formal outfit for graduation instead of buying an expensive suit.
chinese.zh: 許多學生會租一套正式服裝參加畢業典禮，而不是買一套昂貴的西裝。

english.en: He works for a small consulting outfit in the city centre.
english.zh: 他在市中心一家小型顧問公司上班。

speak.en: On weekends I usually wear a comfy outfit, like jeans and a hoodie.
speak.zh: 週末我通常穿得很舒適，例如牛仔褲配連帽上衣。

write.en: The school outfitted every classroom with air purifiers to protect students from pollution.
write.zh: 學校為每間教室都配備了空氣清淨機，保護學生不受空氣污染影響。

example.en: Ignoring the warning signs was a grave mistake; within weeks, the small leak had damaged the entire ceiling.
example.zh: 忽視那些警訊是個嚴重的錯誤；不到幾週，小小的漏水就毀了整片天花板。

listen.en: The doctor had a grave expression on her face.
listen.zh: 醫生臉上帶著凝重的神情。

chinese.en: Every spring, many Taiwanese families visit their ancestors' graves to tidy them and pay their respects.
chinese.zh: 每年春天，許多臺灣家庭會去祖先的墳前掃墓、整理環境並表達敬意。

english.en: The team is in grave danger of losing its sponsor.
english.zh: 這支球隊面臨失去贊助商的嚴重危機。

speak.en: I think the housing shortage is a grave issue for young people here.
speak.zh: 我認為住房短缺對這裡的年輕人來說是很嚴重的問題。

write.en: Cutting funding for public libraries would have grave consequences for children from low-income families.
write.zh: 削減公共圖書館的經費，將對低收入家庭的孩子造成嚴重後果。

example.en: When the bakery posted photos of its new pastries online, customers flocked to the shop and it sold out by noon.
example.zh: 那家麵包店在網路上貼出新糕點的照片後，顧客蜂擁而至，中午前就賣光了。

listen.en: Tourists flock to the night market every weekend.
listen.zh: 每到週末，觀光客都湧向夜市。

chinese.en: The farmer moves his flock of sheep to higher pastures during the summer months.
chinese.zh: 夏季期間，這位農夫會把他的羊群趕到地勢較高的牧場。

english.en: Young people flock to big cities to look for better jobs.
english.zh: 年輕人湧向大城市尋找更好的工作。

speak.en: Whenever it snows on the mountain, people flock there to see it.
speak.zh: 每次山上下雪，大家都會一窩蜂跑上去看。

write.en: Birds of a feather flock together, so it's no surprise those two became friends.
write.zh: 物以類聚，所以那兩個人會成為朋友一點也不意外。

example.en: Before embarking on such an ambitious renovation, the couple spent months comparing builders and saving enough money.
example.zh: 在展開這麼大規模的翻修工程之前，這對夫妻花了好幾個月比較包商並存夠錢。

listen.en: Passengers will embark at the main harbour after lunch.
listen.zh: 乘客將在午餐後於主要港口上船。

chinese.en: The government has embarked on a large-scale programme to plant more trees in cities.
chinese.zh: 政府已著手推動一項大規模計畫，在城市裡種植更多樹木。

english.en: My cousin is about to embark on a trip around Europe.
english.zh: 我表哥即將展開歐洲之旅。

speak.en: I'd really like to embark on something new, like learning to cook.
speak.zh: 我真的很想開始嘗試新事物，例如學做菜。

write.en: Researchers embarked on a long-term study to track how sleep affects teenagers' grades.
write.zh: 研究人員展開了一項長期研究，追蹤睡眠如何影響青少年的成績。

example.en: When her best friend started spending every lunch break with a new classmate, Mia felt jealous and left out.
example.zh: 當她最好的朋友開始每天午休都和一位新同學在一起時，米亞覺得很吃醋，也覺得被冷落了。

listen.en: You're going to Japan next week? I'm so jealous!
listen.zh: 你下星期要去日本？好羨慕喔！

chinese.en: Social media can make people jealous of lives that are not as perfect as they look.
chinese.zh: 社群媒體可能讓人嫉妒別人的生活，但那些生活其實沒有看起來那麼完美。

english.en: My dog gets jealous when I pay attention to the cat.
english.zh: 我注意貓的時候，我的狗就會吃醋。

speak.en: I used to get jealous of my sister, but now we're really close.
speak.zh: 我以前會嫉妒我姊姊，但現在我們感情很好。

write.en: Some employees grow jealous when a colleague receives a promotion they believe they deserved.
write.zh: 當同事得到他們自認應得的升遷時，有些員工會心生嫉妒。

example.en: Thanks to the vaccination campaign, the disease has virtually disappeared, and doctors now rarely see a single case.
example.zh: 多虧了疫苗接種計畫，這種疾病幾乎已經絕跡，醫生現在很少看到任何病例。

listen.en: Virtually everyone in my class owns a smartphone.
listen.zh: 我們班上幾乎每個人都有智慧型手機。

chinese.en: During the pandemic, many companies had their staff meet virtually instead of in the office.
chinese.zh: 疫情期間，許多公司讓員工改在線上開會，而不是在辦公室見面。

english.en: The old part of town has virtually no traffic after midnight.
english.zh: 舊城區過了午夜幾乎沒有車。

speak.en: I eat rice virtually every day; I just can't live without it.
speak.zh: 我幾乎每天都吃米飯，真的少不了它。

write.en: The two plans are virtually identical, so the committee chose the cheaper one.
write.zh: 這兩個方案幾乎一模一樣，所以委員會選了比較便宜的那個。

example.en: When the heavy trucks passed outside, the windows trembled and the plates on the shelf rattled loudly.
example.zh: 重型卡車從外面經過時，窗戶跟著震動，架上的盤子也喀啦喀啦地響。

listen.en: The little boy trembled with cold after swimming.
listen.zh: 小男孩游完泳後冷得直發抖。

chinese.en: Many speakers tremble with nerves before a presentation, but the feeling fades once they begin.
chinese.zh: 許多講者在簡報前會緊張得發抖，但一開始說話，這種感覺就會消退。

english.en: I could hear a slight tremble in his voice on the phone.
english.zh: 電話中我聽得出他的聲音有點顫抖。

speak.en: I was trembling with excitement when I first got on stage.
speak.zh: 我第一次上台的時候，興奮得全身發抖。

write.en: The ground trembled slightly as the old building was carefully demolished nearby.
write.zh: 附近的老建築被小心拆除時，地面微微震動。

example.en: Because wheat does not grow well in the region, local cooks traditionally use rice flour to make noodles and cakes.
example.zh: 因為小麥在這個地區長得不好，當地廚師傳統上都用米穀粉來做麵條和糕點。

listen.en: We ran out of flour, so I couldn't bake the cake.
listen.zh: 我們的麵粉用完了，所以我沒辦法烤蛋糕。

chinese.en: Rising wheat prices have made flour more expensive for bakeries across the country.
chinese.zh: 小麥價格上漲，讓全國各地的麵包店買麵粉的成本變高了。

english.en: My grandmother buys a big bag of flour every month.
english.zh: 我奶奶每個月都會買一大袋麵粉。

speak.en: Whenever I bake with my kids, there's flour all over the kitchen.
speak.zh: 每次我和孩子一起烘焙，廚房裡就到處都是麵粉。

write.en: Some people with allergies avoid wheat flour and choose alternatives made from almonds or oats.
write.zh: 有些過敏的人會避開小麥麵粉，改用杏仁或燕麥做成的替代品。

example.en: Rather than giving every school the same budget, the council chose a more equitable approach, sending extra funds where needs were greatest.
example.zh: 市議會沒有給每所學校一樣的預算，而是採取更公平合理的做法，把額外經費撥給最需要的地方。

listen.en: We need an equitable way to share the housework.
listen.zh: 我們需要一個公平的方式來分擔家事。

chinese.en: Equitable access to clean water remains a challenge in many developing countries.
chinese.zh: 在許多開發中國家，讓人人公平取得乾淨的水仍是一大挑戰。

english.en: The two partners reached an equitable agreement about the profits.
english.zh: 兩位合夥人針對利潤分配達成了公平的協議。

speak.en: I think splitting the bill by what each person ordered is more equitable.
speak.zh: 我覺得照每個人點的東西來分攤帳單比較公平。

write.en: Teachers should ensure that group grades are equitable, reflecting each member's actual contribution.
write.zh: 老師應該確保分組成績公平，反映每位組員實際的貢獻。

example.en: Farmers dug a ditch along the edge of the field so that heavy rain would drain away instead of flooding the crops.
example.zh: 農夫沿著田邊挖了一條溝渠，讓大雨能排掉，而不會淹沒農作物。

listen.en: I finally ditched my old phone for a newer model.
listen.zh: 我終於把舊手機丟了，換了一支比較新的。

chinese.en: More commuters are ditching their cars and cycling to work to save money.
chinese.zh: 越來越多通勤族捨棄汽車，改騎腳踏車上班來省錢。

english.en: We ditched our plans for the beach because of the storm.
english.zh: 因為暴風雨，我們放棄了去海邊的計畫。

speak.en: Honestly, I should ditch social media for a while and read more.
speak.zh: 說真的，我應該暫時戒掉社群媒體，多看點書。

write.en: The company ditched its plastic packaging after customers complained about the waste.
write.zh: 這家公司在顧客抱怨浪費之後，捨棄了塑膠包裝。

example.en: Growing awareness of plastic pollution has led many cafes to offer discounts to customers who bring reusable cups.
example.zh: 隨著大眾越來越意識到塑膠污染問題，許多咖啡店會給自備環保杯的顧客折扣。

listen.en: Yoga has improved my awareness of my own breathing.
listen.zh: 瑜伽讓我更能察覺自己的呼吸。

chinese.en: There is a lack of awareness among young people about the risks of online scams.
chinese.zh: 年輕人普遍不太了解網路詐騙的風險。

english.en: Schools should do more to build students' environmental awareness from a young age.
english.zh: 學校應該從小就更努力培養學生的環保意識。

speak.en: Living abroad really increased my awareness of other cultures and customs.
speak.zh: 在國外生活真的讓我對其他文化和習俗有了更多認識。

write.en: Good drivers maintain constant awareness of the cyclists and pedestrians around them, especially at night.
write.zh: 好的駕駛人會時時留意周遭的單車騎士和行人，尤其是在夜間。

example.en: Although the dish is now famous across the country, its origins lie in a small fishing village on the east coast.
example.zh: 雖然這道菜現在全國聞名，但它其實源自東海岸的一個小漁村。

listen.en: The label shows the country of origin of the coffee.
listen.zh: 標籤上標示了這款咖啡的原產國。

chinese.en: Linguists have long studied the origin of English words borrowed from other languages.
chinese.zh: 語言學家長期研究從其他語言借來的英文字詞的來源。

english.en: Despite his humble origins, he became a highly successful lawyer.
english.zh: 儘管出身平凡，他後來成為一位非常成功的律師。

speak.en: My family is of Hakka origin, so we eat a lot of Hakka food.
speak.zh: 我家是客家人，所以我們常吃客家菜。

write.en: The museum exhibition traces the origins of cinema from early photography to modern films.
write.zh: 這個博物館展覽追溯電影的起源，從早期攝影一路介紹到現代電影。

example.en: Hualien is famous for its marble, which is cut from the mountains and used in buildings and sculptures.
example.zh: 花蓮以大理石聞名，這些石材從山中開採出來，用於建築和雕刻。

listen.en: When I was a kid, I loved playing marbles.
listen.zh: 我小時候很愛玩彈珠。

chinese.en: The ancient marble statues have been damaged by acid rain over the centuries.
chinese.zh: 這些古老的大理石雕像在幾個世紀以來遭到酸雨侵蝕。

english.en: The kitchen counter in our new flat is made of white marble.
english.zh: 我們新家的廚房流理台是白色大理石做的。

speak.en: My grandpa sometimes forgets things, but he hasn't lost his marbles yet!
speak.zh: 我爺爺有時候會忘東忘西，但他腦袋還清楚得很呢！

write.en: Builders increasingly choose artificial stone instead of marble because it is cheaper and lighter.
write.zh: 營建業者越來越常選用人造石來取代大理石，因為它更便宜也更輕。

example.en: Every cup in the set was painted by hand, and the exquisite detail explained why it cost so much.
example.zh: 這組杯子每一個都是手繪的，精緻的細節說明了它為什麼這麼貴。

listen.en: The dessert looked exquisite, and it tasted even better.
listen.zh: 這道甜點看起來精緻極了，吃起來更棒。

chinese.en: The museum displays exquisite silk embroidery made by local artisans over a century ago.
chinese.zh: 博物館展示了一百多年前當地工匠製作的精緻絲綢刺繡。

english.en: My aunt has exquisite taste in both clothes and furniture.
english.zh: 我阿姨在服裝和家具方面都很有品味。

speak.en: The view from the mountain at sunrise was absolutely exquisite.
speak.zh: 日出時從山上看出去的景色真的美極了。

write.en: Handmade watches remain popular because buyers value their exquisite craftsmanship and long history.
write.zh: 手工錶至今仍受歡迎，因為買家重視它們精湛的工藝和悠久的歷史。

example.en: Because the shop only accepts cash transactions, tourists often have to search for an ATM before they can pay.
example.zh: 因為這家店只收現金，觀光客常常得先找提款機才能付款。

listen.en: Please check your receipt after each transaction at the counter.
listen.zh: 每次在櫃檯完成交易後，請核對您的收據。

chinese.en: Many transactions in Taiwan's convenience stores are now made with cards or mobile apps.
chinese.zh: 現在臺灣便利商店有許多交易都是用卡片或手機應用程式付款的。

english.en: I noticed a strange transaction on my credit card statement.
english.zh: 我在信用卡帳單上發現一筆奇怪的交易。

speak.en: I prefer online banking because transactions are quick and I can skip the queue.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡網路銀行，因為交易很快，又不用排隊。

write.en: Blockchain technology records every transaction permanently, which makes fraud much harder to hide.
write.zh: 區塊鏈技術會永久記錄每一筆交易，讓詐欺行為更難隱藏。

example.en: The winery stores its red wine in oak barrels for two years, which gives the wine a richer, smoky flavour.
example.zh: 這間酒莊把紅酒存放在橡木桶中兩年，讓酒帶有更濃郁的煙燻風味。

listen.en: The kids rolled an empty barrel across the yard.
listen.zh: 孩子們把一個空桶子滾過院子。

chinese.en: A delivery truck came barrelling down the narrow street, and pedestrians jumped out of its way.
chinese.zh: 一輛貨車沿著狹窄的街道疾駛而來，行人趕緊跳開閃避。

english.en: The farmer filled the old wooden barrel with freshly picked apples.
english.zh: 農夫把剛摘的蘋果裝滿那個舊木桶。

speak.en: Honestly, that history lecture wasn't exactly a barrel of laughs.
speak.zh: 說實話，那堂歷史課實在不怎麼有趣。

write.en: Many households keep a barrel of water ready in case typhoons cut off the supply.
write.zh: 許多家庭會準備一桶水，以防颱風造成停水。

example.en: The smoking ban exists on paper, but because it is rarely enforced, people still light up outside the hospital entrance.
example.zh: 禁菸規定雖然白紙黑字寫著，但因為很少真正執行，民眾還是會在醫院門口抽菸。

listen.en: My parents never really enforced a bedtime when I was little.
listen.zh: 我小時候，爸媽從來沒有真的規定我幾點要睡覺。

chinese.en: Laws against illegal fishing are difficult to enforce in such a vast ocean.
chinese.zh: 在這麼廣大的海洋上，禁止非法捕魚的法律很難落實執行。

english.en: The city plans to enforce stricter rules on noise at night.
english.zh: 市政府打算對夜間噪音實施更嚴格的規定。

speak.en: I think fines only work if the government actually enforces them.
speak.zh: 我覺得罰款只有在政府真的執行時才會有效。

write.en: Some airlines enforce baggage limits strictly, charging passengers heavily for every extra kilo.
write.zh: 有些航空公司嚴格執行行李限重，旅客每超重一公斤都要付高額費用。

example.en: While searching online for a cheap recipe, she stumbled across a cooking blog that later became her favourite.
example.zh: 她在網路上找便宜食譜時，偶然發現了一個料理部落格，後來成了她最愛的網站。

listen.en: He stumbled over his words during the job interview.
listen.zh: 他在工作面試時說話結結巴巴。

chinese.en: Researchers stumbled upon the new species while studying insects in a remote forest.
chinese.zh: 研究人員在偏遠森林研究昆蟲時，意外發現了這個新物種。

english.en: The tired hiker stumbled and fell on the muddy path.
english.zh: 疲憊的登山客踉蹌一下，跌倒在泥濘的步道上。

speak.en: I once stumbled into a tiny bookshop that sold amazing old maps.
speak.zh: 我有一次無意間走進一家小書店，裡面賣很棒的古地圖。

write.en: The economy stumbled last year as exports fell and consumers cut back on spending.
write.zh: 去年出口下滑、消費者縮減支出，經濟因此陷入低迷。

example.en: After the factory closed, the whole town seemed to grieve, as many families had worked there for generations.
example.zh: 工廠關閉後，整個小鎮彷彿都陷入哀傷，因為許多家庭世世代代都在那裡工作。

listen.en: It's normal to grieve when a beloved pet dies.
listen.zh: 心愛的寵物離開時，感到悲傷是很正常的。

chinese.en: Experts say people should be given enough time to grieve before returning to work.
chinese.zh: 專家表示，應該給人足夠的時間哀悼，再讓他們回到工作崗位。

english.en: Many fans grieved when the old stadium was finally torn down.
english.zh: 舊球場終於被拆除時，許多球迷都感到難過。

speak.en: When my best friend moved overseas, I honestly grieved for weeks.
speak.zh: 我最好的朋友搬到國外時，說真的我難過了好幾個星期。

write.en: Writing a letter to a lost loved one can help people grieve in a healthy way.
write.zh: 寫一封信給已逝的親人，可以幫助人們以健康的方式面對悲傷。

example.en: The email looked like it came from a real bank, and it tricked many customers into sharing their passwords.
example.zh: 這封電子郵件看起來像是真正的銀行寄來的，騙了許多顧客交出密碼。

listen.en: When I have a sore throat, hot tea usually does the trick.
listen.zh: 我喉嚨痛的時候，喝熱茶通常就很有效。

chinese.en: The trick to learning vocabulary is reviewing new words several times over a few days.
chinese.zh: 背單字的訣竅是在幾天內把新單字複習好幾次。

english.en: The magician showed us a clever trick with a coin.
english.zh: 魔術師用一枚硬幣為我們表演了一個巧妙的魔術。

speak.en: That was a trick question; there wasn't really a right answer.
speak.zh: 那是個陷阱題，根本沒有真正的正確答案。

write.en: Supermarkets use psychological tricks, such as placing sweets near the checkout, to boost sales.
write.zh: 超市會運用心理學上的小技巧，例如把糖果放在結帳櫃檯附近，來提高銷售量。

example.en: The economics of the project did not add up: building costs had doubled, while expected profits had fallen sharply.
example.zh: 這項計畫在經濟上不合算：建造成本翻倍，而預期利潤卻大幅下滑。

listen.en: Economics was my favourite subject in high school.
listen.zh: 經濟學是我高中時最喜歡的科目。

chinese.en: Behavioural economics explains why people often make choices that are not in their best interest.
chinese.zh: 行為經濟學解釋了為什麼人們常常做出對自己並不有利的選擇。

english.en: He plans to get a degree in economics and work in banking.
english.zh: 他打算拿個經濟學學位，然後進銀行業工作。

speak.en: To be honest, I found economics hard at first because of all the graphs.
speak.zh: 老實說，我一開始覺得經濟學很難，因為有一大堆圖表。

write.en: The economics of solar power have improved dramatically as panel prices have dropped.
write.zh: 隨著太陽能板價格下降，太陽能發電的經濟效益已大幅提升。

example.en: During the bird flu outbreak, thousands of chickens were slaughtered to stop the disease from spreading to other farms.
example.zh: 禽流感爆發期間，數千隻雞遭到撲殺，以防止疫情擴散到其他農場。

listen.en: The farmer sold his sheep instead of slaughtering them.
listen.zh: 農夫把羊賣掉，而沒有自己屠宰。

chinese.en: Animal welfare groups are campaigning for more humane methods of slaughter on large farms.
chinese.zh: 動物福利團體正在爭取大型農場採用更人道的屠宰方式。

english.en: In some countries, fewer cattle are slaughtered as people eat less beef.
english.zh: 在一些國家，由於大家吃的牛肉變少，被屠宰的牛也減少了。

speak.en: We got slaughtered at basketball, but it was still a fun afternoon.
speak.zh: 我們打籃球被痛宰，不過那個下午還是玩得很開心。

write.en: The new graduate walked into the tough negotiation like a lamb to the slaughter.
write.zh: 這位社會新鮮人毫無防備地走進那場艱難的談判，就像待宰的羔羊。

example.en: The region has been afflicted by drought for several years, forcing farmers to abandon crops that need lots of water.
example.zh: 這個地區多年來飽受乾旱之苦，迫使農民放棄需要大量用水的作物。

listen.en: My uncle has been afflicted with arthritis for years.
listen.zh: 我叔叔多年來一直飽受關節炎之苦。

chinese.en: Traffic jams and air pollution continue to afflict many fast-growing cities in Asia.
chinese.zh: 塞車和空氣污染持續困擾著亞洲許多快速發展的城市。

english.en: Our basketball team has been afflicted by injuries all season long.
english.zh: 我們籃球隊整個球季都被傷病所困擾。

speak.en: Like a lot of students, I'm afflicted with terrible exam nerves.
speak.zh: 跟很多學生一樣，我一考試就緊張得要命。

write.en: Loneliness afflicts many elderly people, especially those who live far from their families.
write.zh: 孤獨感困擾著許多長者，尤其是住得離家人很遠的人。

example.en: Instead of paying a monthly fee, members can pay weekly, which helps students on tight budgets manage their money.
example.zh: 會員不必按月繳費，可以改為每週繳費，這樣能幫助預算吃緊的學生管理金錢。

listen.en: I do my weekly shopping at the market near my home.
listen.zh: 我每週都在家附近的市場採買。

chinese.en: The chart shows the average weekly earnings of workers in different industries last year.
chinese.zh: 這張圖表顯示去年不同產業勞工的平均週薪。

english.en: Our local newspaper is published weekly rather than every day.
english.zh: 我們當地的報紙是每週出刊，而不是每天出刊。

speak.en: I try to call my parents weekly, usually on Sunday evenings.
speak.zh: 我盡量每週打電話給爸媽，通常是在星期天晚上。

write.en: She writes a popular column for a weekly that focuses on food and travel.
write.zh: 她為一份專門介紹美食與旅遊的週刊撰寫一個很受歡迎的專欄。

example.en: Scientists placed sensors on the mountain to monitor atmospheric conditions, such as humidity and wind, throughout the year.
example.zh: 科學家在山上裝設感測器，全年監測濕度和風等大氣狀況。

listen.en: We had dinner in an atmospheric little restaurant by the river.
listen.zh: 我們在河邊一家很有氣氛的小餐廳吃晚餐。

chinese.en: Atmospheric pollution from vehicles is a major cause of breathing problems in large cities.
chinese.zh: 汽機車造成的空氣污染是大城市居民呼吸道問題的主要原因。

english.en: The old castle on the hill looks especially atmospheric on foggy evenings.
english.zh: 山丘上的古堡在起霧的傍晚看起來格外有氣氛。

speak.en: I love listening to atmospheric music when I'm studying late at night.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡在深夜念書時聽有氛圍感的音樂。

write.en: Rising levels of atmospheric carbon dioxide are trapping more heat near the Earth's surface.
write.zh: 大氣中二氧化碳濃度上升，使更多熱能被困在地表附近。

example.en: Small farmers formed a federation so that, by negotiating together, they could get better prices from large supermarkets.
example.zh: 小農組成了一個聯合會，藉由集體談判，向大型超市爭取更好的價格。

listen.en: Our club recently joined the regional swimming federation.
listen.zh: 我們的社團最近加入了地區游泳協會。

chinese.en: The federation sets the rules that every member association must follow during competitions.
chinese.zh: 這個聯合會制定了每個會員協會在比賽中都必須遵守的規則。

english.en: Australia became a federation at the start of the twentieth century.
english.zh: 澳洲在二十世紀初成為一個聯邦國家。

speak.en: My cousin works for a federation that supports small businesses.
speak.zh: 我表姊在一個支持小型企業的聯合會工作。

write.en: Several student unions created a federation to share resources and organise national events together.
write.zh: 好幾個學生會成立了一個聯盟，以共享資源並一起舉辦全國性活動。

example.en: With rents rising and wages flat, many young families are feeling the squeeze and cutting back on holidays.
example.zh: 房租上漲而薪水停滯，許多年輕家庭感到手頭吃緊，紛紛減少出遊。

listen.en: We managed to squeeze into the crowded train at the last minute.
listen.zh: 我們在最後一刻勉強擠上了擁擠的火車。

chinese.en: The doctor said she could squeeze me in before lunch if I arrived early.
chinese.zh: 醫生說如果我早點到，她可以在午餐前幫我插個空檔看診。

english.en: He gently squeezed his friend's hand to show his support.
english.zh: 他輕輕握緊朋友的手，表示支持。

speak.en: Honestly, it was a tight squeeze fitting everything into my suitcase.
speak.zh: 老實說，要把所有東西塞進我的行李箱真的很勉強。

write.en: Government budget squeezes have forced several rural schools to share teachers and buses.
write.zh: 政府預算緊縮，迫使幾所偏鄉學校共用老師和校車。

example.en: After winning every match of the season, the young tennis player was crowned national champion in front of a cheering crowd.
example.zh: 這位年輕網球選手在整季比賽全勝後，於歡呼的群眾面前被封為全國冠軍。

listen.en: The dentist put a new crown on my broken tooth.
listen.zh: 牙醫在我斷掉的牙齒上裝了新的牙冠。

chinese.en: The museum's crown jewels attract thousands of tourists from around the world every year.
chinese.zh: 這間博物館收藏的王室珠寶，每年吸引世界各地成千上萬的遊客。

english.en: Winning the national award crowned her long career as a teacher.
english.zh: 獲得這個全國性獎項，為她漫長的教職生涯畫下完美句點。

speak.en: We missed the bus, and to crown it all, it started to rain.
speak.zh: 我們錯過了公車，更糟的是，還開始下雨了。

write.en: The new library has become the crowning achievement of the city's urban renewal project.
write.zh: 新圖書館已成為這座城市都市更新計畫中最亮眼的成果。

example.en: The farmers were fined heavily after inspectors found that they had been dumping waste into the river, which is illegal.
example.zh: 檢查人員發現這些農民一直把廢棄物倒進河裡，這是違法行為，因此他們被重罰。

listen.en: Parking on the pavement outside the school is illegal.
listen.zh: 在學校外的人行道上停車是違法的。

chinese.en: Illegal logging has destroyed large areas of rainforest and threatened many rare species.
chinese.zh: 非法伐木已摧毀大片雨林，並威脅到許多珍稀物種。

english.en: Downloading films from that website is both illegal and risky.
english.zh: 從那個網站下載電影既違法又有風險。

speak.en: I didn't realise it was illegal to fly a drone here.
speak.zh: 我不知道在這裡飛無人機是違法的。

write.en: The city council voted to make single-use plastic bags illegal in all supermarkets.
write.zh: 市議會投票決定，所有超市使用一次性塑膠袋皆屬違法。

example.en: Although the number of workers stayed the same, output per worker rose sharply thanks to better training and equipment.
example.zh: 雖然員工人數不變，但由於訓練和設備改善，每位員工的產量大幅提升。

listen.en: The output of solar panels falls on cloudy winter days.
listen.zh: 在多雲的冬日，太陽能板的發電量會下降。

chinese.en: The graph shows that agricultural output in the region fell steadily between 2000 and 2010.
chinese.zh: 圖表顯示，該地區的農業產量在 2000 年到 2010 年間持續下降。

english.en: The program checks the data before printing the final output.
english.zh: 這個程式會先檢查資料，再印出最後的輸出結果。

speak.en: I think my creative output is much higher in the morning.
speak.zh: 我覺得自己早上的創作產出多很多。

write.en: Coal-fired power plants still account for most of the country's total electricity output.
write.zh: 燃煤電廠仍占該國總發電量的大部分。

example.en: Despite being the youngest speaker at the conference, he showed great poise, never losing his place even when the microphone failed.
example.zh: 儘管他是研討會上最年輕的講者，卻展現出極佳的沉著，即使麥克風故障也沒有亂了陣腳。

listen.en: The cat sat poised on the edge of the roof.
listen.zh: 那隻貓穩穩地蹲在屋頂邊緣。

chinese.en: The company is poised to become the largest online retailer in Southeast Asia.
chinese.zh: 這家公司即將成為東南亞最大的網路零售商。

english.en: The young dancer poised herself on one foot before jumping.
english.zh: 年輕的舞者先用單腳站穩，再跳起來。

speak.en: Interviews make me nervous, so I practise to keep my poise.
speak.zh: 面試讓我很緊張，所以我會練習讓自己保持鎮定。

write.en: With exams just a week away, students are poised for the final push.
write.zh: 距離考試只剩一週，學生們已準備好做最後衝刺。

example.en: The gallery's top floor is devoted to abstract art, where bold shapes and colours replace realistic images of people or places.
example.zh: 美術館頂樓專門展出抽象藝術，作品以大膽的形狀與色彩取代人物或地點的寫實圖像。

listen.en: Please read the abstract before you download the whole paper.
listen.zh: 下載整篇論文之前，請先讀摘要。

chinese.en: Freedom is easy to support in the abstract but harder to define in practice.
chinese.zh: 自由在理論上很容易支持，但在實務上卻較難界定。

english.en: Researchers must submit an abstract of their study by Friday.
english.zh: 研究人員必須在星期五前提交研究摘要。

speak.en: To be honest, I prefer abstract paintings to traditional landscapes.
speak.zh: 老實說，比起傳統風景畫，我更喜歡抽象畫。

write.en: Using real examples makes abstract theories in economics much easier for students to remember.
write.zh: 運用實際例子，能讓學生更容易記住經濟學中的抽象理論。

example.en: Children who struggle in the classroom sometimes excel in sports or music, so schools should offer a wide range of activities.
example.zh: 在課堂上學得吃力的孩子，有時在運動或音樂方面表現傑出，所以學校應該提供多元的活動。

listen.en: Our team excels at solving problems under pressure.
listen.zh: 我們團隊擅長在壓力下解決問題。

chinese.en: The restaurant excels in using fresh local ingredients to create simple but memorable dishes.
chinese.zh: 這間餐廳擅長運用新鮮的在地食材，做出簡單卻令人難忘的料理。

english.en: He worked hard because he wanted to excel in his new job.
english.zh: 他很努力，因為他想在新工作上有傑出表現。

speak.en: I've never really excelled at cooking, but I enjoy trying.
speak.zh: 我從來都不太會做菜，但我很喜歡嘗試。

write.en: Companies that excel at customer service tend to keep their clients for many years.
write.zh: 擅長客戶服務的公司，往往能留住客戶好多年。

example.en: Rather than listening to long lectures, participants in the workshop worked in small groups to design their own lesson plans.
example.zh: 參加研習的學員不是聽冗長的講課，而是分成小組設計自己的教案。

listen.en: My grandfather builds wooden toys in his workshop behind the house.
listen.zh: 我爺爺在屋後的工作間裡做木頭玩具。

chinese.en: The local library runs free creative writing workshops for teenagers every Saturday afternoon.
chinese.zh: 當地圖書館每週六下午為青少年開設免費的創意寫作工作坊。

english.en: The company holds a safety workshop for all new employees.
english.zh: 公司為所有新進員工舉辦安全研習。

speak.en: I'd love to join a pottery workshop when I have more time.
speak.zh: 等我比較有空的時候，我很想參加陶藝工作坊。

write.en: Our car was in the workshop for a week while mechanics replaced the engine.
write.zh: 我們的車在修車廠待了一週，讓技師更換引擎。

example.en: The week before the wedding was a whirl of fittings, phone calls and last-minute changes, leaving the couple exhausted.
example.zh: 婚禮前那一週充滿了試穿禮服、講電話和臨時變動，忙得新人筋疲力盡。

listen.en: Dry leaves whirled across the playground in the strong wind.
listen.zh: 枯葉在強風中捲過操場。

chinese.en: She whirled round when she heard someone calling her name from across the street.
chinese.zh: 她聽到有人從對街喊她的名字，便猛然轉過身。

english.en: I've never tried skiing, but I'd like to give it a whirl.
english.zh: 我從沒滑過雪，但我想試試看。

speak.en: My head was in a whirl after reading all those exam tips.
speak.zh: 讀完那一大堆考試技巧，我腦袋一片混亂。

write.en: The blades of the wind turbine whirled steadily, generating power for the nearby village.
write.zh: 風力發電機的葉片穩定地旋轉，為附近的村莊供電。

example.en: Environmental groups applauded the city's decision to plant more trees along busy roads, saying it would reduce air pollution.
example.zh: 環保團體讚揚市政府在繁忙道路旁多種樹的決定，表示這將減少空氣汙染。

listen.en: Everyone applauded when the little girl finished her song.
listen.zh: 小女孩唱完歌時，大家都鼓掌了。

chinese.en: We should applaud students who volunteer at hospitals during their summer holidays.
chinese.zh: 我們應該讚揚暑假到醫院當志工的學生。

english.en: The manager applauded his team for finishing the project early.
english.zh: 經理稱讚他的團隊提早完成專案。

speak.en: I really applaud people who start their own businesses.
speak.zh: 我真的很佩服自己創業的人。

write.en: Although critics applauded the film's acting, many viewers found the plot too slow.
write.zh: 雖然影評讚賞這部電影的演技，但許多觀眾覺得劇情節奏太慢。

example.en: At the music festival, stewards in yellow jackets directed the crowds and made sure nobody climbed over the barriers.
example.zh: 在音樂節上，身穿黃色背心的工作人員引導人潮，確保沒有人翻越護欄。

listen.en: The steward brought us blankets and hot tea during the flight.
listen.zh: 飛行途中，空服員為我們送來毯子和熱茶。

chinese.en: As the club's steward, he was responsible for managing its money and property.
chinese.zh: 身為俱樂部的管理人，他負責管理俱樂部的資金和財產。

english.en: We must be good stewards of the planet's natural resources.
english.zh: 我們必須好好守護地球的自然資源。

speak.en: I worked as a volunteer steward at a marathon once.
speak.zh: 我曾經在馬拉松比賽中當過志工工作人員。

write.en: The museum appointed a new steward to look after its rare collection of maps.
write.zh: 博物館任命了一位新的管理人，負責照管館內珍貴的古地圖收藏。

example.en: Whether the outdoor concert goes ahead hinges on the weather, so organisers will make a final decision on Friday morning.
example.zh: 戶外音樂會能否如期舉行取決於天氣，因此主辦單位將在星期五早上做出最後決定。

listen.en: Could you oil the hinge on the kitchen cupboard, please?
listen.zh: 可以請你幫廚房櫥櫃的鉸鏈上點油嗎？

chinese.en: The success of the new recycling plan hinges largely on support from local residents.
chinese.zh: 新回收計畫能否成功，主要取決於當地居民的支持。

english.en: My decision to study abroad hinges on getting a scholarship.
english.zh: 我是否出國留學，取決於能不能拿到獎學金。

speak.en: Honestly, a lot hinges on how well I do in this interview.
speak.zh: 老實說，很多事情都取決於我這次面試表現得好不好。

write.en: The laptop screen is attached by a strong hinge, so it can open almost flat.
write.zh: 筆電螢幕以堅固的鉸鏈連接，所以幾乎可以攤平打開。

example.en: Our teacher explained that 'time is money' is a metaphor, because it describes time as something we can spend or waste.
example.zh: 老師解釋說「時間就是金錢」是一種隱喻，因為它把時間描述成可以花用或浪費的東西。

listen.en: The broken bridge in the story is a metaphor for lost trust.
listen.zh: 故事中斷掉的橋象徵著失去的信任。

chinese.en: Scientists often use simple metaphors to explain complex ideas to the general public.
chinese.zh: 科學家常用簡單的比喻向一般大眾解釋複雜的概念。

english.en: This popular song is full of metaphors about growing up.
english.zh: 這首流行歌充滿了關於成長的隱喻。

speak.en: I think a garden is a nice metaphor for raising children.
speak.zh: 我覺得花園很適合用來比喻養育孩子。

write.en: In business, the 'race to the bottom' metaphor describes companies cutting prices until nobody profits.
write.zh: 在商業上，「向下競爭」這個比喻是指企業不斷削價，直到誰都賺不到錢。

example.en: Teenagers often feel strong pressure to conform, wearing the same clothes and listening to the same music as their friends.
example.zh: 青少年常感受到很大的從眾壓力，穿和朋友一樣的衣服、聽一樣的音樂。

listen.en: Your essay does not conform to the required format.
listen.zh: 你的論文不符合規定的格式。

chinese.en: Products that fail to conform with European standards cannot be sold in the region.
chinese.zh: 不符合歐洲標準的產品，不能在該地區販售。

english.en: She refused to conform to her parents' expectations about her career.
english.zh: 她拒絕順從父母對她職涯的期望。

speak.en: I used to conform a lot at school, but not anymore.
speak.zh: 我以前在學校很會配合別人，但現在不會了。

write.en: Some employees say the company's dress code forces them to conform rather than express themselves.
write.zh: 有些員工表示，公司的服裝規定迫使他們循規蹈矩，而無法表現自我。

example.en: The gallery is open to visitors by appointment only, so you should call at least a day before you plan to go.
example.zh: 這間藝廊只接受預約參觀，所以你應該在預計前往的至少前一天打電話。

listen.en: I'm afraid I have to cancel my appointment this afternoon.
listen.zh: 恐怕我得取消今天下午的預約。

chinese.en: The appointment of a new head teacher has brought fresh energy to the school.
chinese.zh: 新校長的上任為學校帶來了新的活力。

english.en: Please arrive ten minutes before your appointment to fill in the form.
english.zh: 請在預約時間前十分鐘抵達，以便填寫表格。

speak.en: I always set a reminder so I don't forget my appointments.
speak.zh: 我總是會設定提醒，免得忘記自己的約。

write.en: After years as a researcher, she accepted an appointment as professor at a university in Japan.
write.zh: 擔任研究員多年後，她接受了日本一所大學的教授職位。

example.en: The coffee chain's expansion into rural areas surprised investors, who had expected it to focus only on big cities.
example.zh: 這家連鎖咖啡店擴展到鄉村地區，讓原本預期它只會專注大城市的投資人感到意外。

listen.en: Metal bridges have small gaps to allow for expansion in summer.
listen.zh: 金屬橋梁留有小縫隙，讓夏天受熱時有膨脹的空間。

chinese.en: The airport expansion will create thousands of jobs but may increase noise for nearby residents.
chinese.zh: 機場擴建將創造數千個工作機會，但也可能讓附近居民承受更多噪音。

english.en: The school is planning an expansion of its library next year.
english.zh: 學校計畫明年擴建圖書館。

speak.en: I think the expansion of online shopping has changed how we live.
speak.zh: 我覺得網購的普及改變了我們的生活方式。

write.en: The chart shows a steady expansion in the number of electric cars sold between 2015 and 2020.
write.zh: 圖表顯示，2015 年到 2020 年間電動車的銷售量穩定成長。

example.en: Without early intervention from teachers and speech therapists, children with language delays may struggle to keep up at school.
example.zh: 若沒有老師與語言治療師及早介入，語言發展遲緩的孩子可能難以跟上學校的進度。

listen.en: The patient recovered quickly without any surgical intervention.
listen.zh: 這位病患不需任何手術介入就迅速康復了。

chinese.en: Thanks to the referee's timely intervention, the argument between the two players did not get worse.
chinese.zh: 多虧裁判及時介入，兩名球員之間的爭執才沒有惡化。

english.en: Small interventions, like reminders, can help people save more money.
english.zh: 像提醒通知這類小小的介入措施，就能幫助人們存更多錢。

speak.en: Honestly, I prefer to solve problems myself without my parents' intervention.
speak.zh: 老實說，我比較喜歡自己解決問題，不要父母插手。

write.en: Conservation groups called for urgent intervention to save the coral reefs from further damage.
write.zh: 保育團體呼籲緊急介入，以免珊瑚礁遭受更多破壞。

example.en: The mountain path became dangerously slippery after the heavy rain, so the guide told everyone to hold the rope.
example.zh: 大雨過後，山路變得濕滑危險，於是嚮導叫大家抓緊繩子。

listen.en: The fish was too slippery for me to hold.
listen.zh: 那條魚太滑了，我抓不住。

chinese.en: Critics warn that allowing this small exception could be the start of a slippery slope.
chinese.zh: 批評者警告，允許這個小小的例外，可能會一發不可收拾。

english.en: Roads can be very slippery in winter, so please drive slowly.
english.zh: 冬天路面可能很滑，所以請慢慢開。

speak.en: Happiness is a slippery idea, and everyone defines it differently.
speak.zh: 幸福是個難以捉摸的概念，每個人的定義都不一樣。

write.en: The salesman was a slippery character who never gave a straight answer to any question.
write.zh: 那個業務員是個滑頭，從不正面回答任何問題。

example.en: Children who have early exposure to several languages at home often find it easier to learn new ones later in life.
example.zh: 從小在家接觸多種語言的孩子，日後往往比較容易學會新的語言。

listen.en: The small band gained national exposure after appearing on television.
listen.zh: 這個小樂團上電視後，在全國打開了知名度。

chinese.en: Long-term exposure to air pollution has been linked to heart and lung diseases.
chinese.zh: 長期暴露在空氣汙染中，被認為與心臟和肺部疾病有關。

english.en: Living abroad for a year gave me exposure to many different cultures.
english.zh: 在國外住一年，讓我接觸到許多不同的文化。

speak.en: Honestly, I think kids get too much exposure to screens these days.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得現在的小孩太常接觸螢幕了。

write.en: The newspaper's exposure of the company's false advertising led to a large fine.
write.zh: 報社揭露這家公司的不實廣告後，該公司遭到重罰。

example.en: Health experts recommend replacing some red meat with poultry or fish, which contain less saturated fat.
example.zh: 健康專家建議以禽肉或魚肉取代部分紅肉，因為它們的飽和脂肪較少。

listen.en: Please keep raw poultry away from other food in the fridge.
listen.zh: 請把生的禽肉和冰箱裡的其他食物分開放。

chinese.en: Large poultry farms often keep thousands of chickens in crowded indoor sheds.
chinese.zh: 大型家禽養殖場常把成千上萬隻雞關在擁擠的室內雞舍裡。

english.en: Poultry prices rose sharply after the outbreak of bird flu.
english.zh: 禽流感爆發後，禽肉價格大幅上漲。

speak.en: I don't eat much beef, but I eat a lot of poultry.
speak.zh: 我不太吃牛肉，但雞鴨之類的禽肉吃得很多。

write.en: Many villages in the region depend on poultry farming as their main source of income.
write.zh: 該地區許多村莊以家禽養殖作為主要收入來源。

example.en: As an outspoken critic of fast fashion, the designer often urges shoppers to buy fewer but better clothes.
example.zh: 身為快時尚的直言批評者，這位設計師常呼籲消費者少買衣服，但要買品質好的。

listen.en: She was outspoken about the need for safer cycling lanes.
listen.zh: 她直言需要更安全的自行車道。

chinese.en: Some students are outspoken in class, while others prefer to share their ideas in writing.
chinese.zh: 有些學生在課堂上敢於直言，有些則比較喜歡用書面分享想法。

english.en: He became more outspoken after he joined the debate club.
english.zh: 他加入辯論社之後，說話變得更直率敢言。

speak.en: I'm not very outspoken, so I usually keep my opinions to myself.
speak.zh: 我不太敢直言，所以通常把意見藏在心裡。

write.en: The manager valued outspoken employees because they pointed out problems before they became serious.
write.zh: 經理很重視敢直言的員工，因為他們會在問題惡化前就指出來。

example.en: On clear nights, visitors to the beach can see luminous blue waves caused by tiny glowing sea creatures.
example.zh: 在晴朗的夜晚，海灘上的遊客能看到微小的發光海洋生物所造成的藍色螢光浪花。

listen.en: The moon looked huge and luminous above the quiet lake.
listen.zh: 寧靜的湖面上，月亮看起來又大又明亮。

chinese.en: Firefighters wear jackets with luminous strips so they can be seen in thick smoke.
chinese.zh: 消防員穿著有夜光條的外套，好讓人在濃煙中也能看見他們。

english.en: The children painted luminous stars on the ceiling of their bedroom.
english.zh: 孩子們在臥室的天花板上畫了夜光星星。

speak.en: I love that painting because the colours look so luminous.
speak.zh: 我好喜歡那幅畫，因為顏色看起來好明亮。

write.en: Her luminous smile made everyone in the waiting room feel a little more relaxed.
write.zh: 她燦爛的笑容讓候診室裡的每個人都放鬆了一些。

example.en: Translators must balance fidelity to the original text with the need to produce something that reads naturally in another language.
example.zh: 譯者必須在忠於原文與讓譯文讀起來自然之間取得平衡。

listen.en: These new headphones reproduce music with remarkable fidelity.
listen.zh: 這副新耳機能極為逼真地重現音樂。

chinese.en: The dog's fidelity to its owner moved everyone who heard the story.
chinese.zh: 這隻狗對主人的忠誠，感動了每個聽過這個故事的人。

english.en: The museum staff copied the ancient painting with great fidelity.
english.zh: 博物館人員極為精確地複製了那幅古畫。

speak.en: I admire his fidelity to his principles, even when it's difficult.
speak.zh: 我很欣賞他即使在困難時，仍堅守自己的原則。

write.en: Scientists checked the fidelity of the computer model by comparing it with real weather data.
write.zh: 科學家把電腦模型和真實的氣象資料比對，以檢驗模型的準確度。

example.en: In the novel, the hero gives up his desire for vengeance and decides to forgive the man who ruined his family business.
example.zh: 小說中，主角放下了復仇的念頭，決定原諒那個毀了他家族事業的人。

listen.en: He did not want vengeance, only an honest apology.
listen.zh: 他不想報復，只想要一句真誠的道歉。

chinese.en: After losing last year's final, the team trained with a vengeance all summer.
chinese.zh: 去年在決賽落敗後，這支隊伍整個夏天都拚了命地訓練。

english.en: She decided that vengeance would not make her feel any better.
english.zh: 她認為報復並不會讓自己好過一點。

speak.en: Honestly, the hot weather has returned with a vengeance this week.
speak.zh: 老實說，這週炎熱的天氣又捲土重來，而且更猛烈。

write.en: Many ancient myths warn that seeking vengeance often brings more suffering to both sides.
write.zh: 許多古代神話警告世人，尋求報復往往會為雙方帶來更多痛苦。

example.en: The examiner noted that the essay contained too much repetition, as the same few words appeared in almost every paragraph.
example.zh: 考官指出這篇作文重複太多，因為同樣幾個字幾乎在每一段都出現。

listen.en: The dance looks easy, but it takes endless repetition.
listen.zh: 這支舞看起來簡單，但需要無數次反覆練習。

chinese.en: Factory workers often complain that the constant repetition of simple tasks makes them tired and bored.
chinese.zh: 工廠工人常抱怨，不斷重複簡單的工作讓他們又累又無聊。

english.en: The company must prevent a repetition of last year's mistakes.
english.zh: 公司必須避免重蹈去年的錯誤。

speak.en: I find that repetition really helps me remember people's names.
speak.zh: 我發現多唸幾次真的能幫我記住別人的名字。

write.en: Advertisers rely on repetition, showing the same slogan again and again until people remember it.
write.zh: 廣告商靠的是重複，一再播放同一句標語，直到大家記住為止。

example.en: When the reporter suggested the plan was too expensive, the mayor countered that it would save money in the long run.
example.zh: 記者暗示這項計畫太昂貴時，市長反駁說長遠來看它能省錢。

listen.en: You can buy this cough medicine over the counter.
listen.zh: 這種止咳藥不需要處方就買得到。

chinese.en: The new policy runs counter to what most residents asked for at the meeting.
chinese.zh: 新政策與大多數居民在會議上提出的要求背道而馳。

english.en: Regular exercise can help counter the negative effects of stress.
english.zh: 規律運動有助於抵銷壓力帶來的負面影響。

speak.en: I usually leave my keys on the kitchen counter when I get home.
speak.zh: 我回家時通常會把鑰匙放在廚房流理臺上。

write.en: In a discussion essay, you should present the opposing view and then counter it with evidence.
write.zh: 在議論文中，你應該先提出對立觀點，再用證據加以反駁。

example.en: To restrain rising prices, the central bank raised interest rates, making it more expensive for people to borrow money.
example.zh: 為了抑制物價上漲，央行調升利率，讓民眾借錢的成本變高。

listen.en: She could barely restrain her excitement when she heard the news.
listen.zh: 聽到這個消息時，她幾乎掩不住興奮。

chinese.en: The owner used a leash to restrain the dog when the children ran past.
chinese.zh: 孩子們跑過去時，主人用牽繩拉住了狗。

english.en: The government is trying to restrain spending on new roads.
english.zh: 政府正設法限制新建道路的支出。

speak.en: It's hard to restrain my laughter when my friend tells jokes.
speak.zh: 我朋友講笑話時，我很難忍住不笑。

write.en: Strict building rules restrain the height of new towers near the historic old town.
write.zh: 嚴格的建築法規限制了歷史老城區附近新大樓的高度。

example.en: According to the latest census, more people now live alone than at any time in the country's history.
example.zh: 根據最新的人口普查，現在獨居的人比該國歷史上任何時期都多。

listen.en: Volunteers helped with the bird census in the wetlands.
listen.zh: 志工協助濕地的鳥類數量調查。

chinese.en: Census data show that the number of elderly residents in rural areas has risen sharply.
chinese.zh: 人口普查資料顯示，鄉村地區的高齡居民人數大幅增加。

english.en: Every household must complete the census form by the end of May.
english.zh: 每戶都必須在五月底前填完人口普查表。

speak.en: I remember filling in the census form with my parents.
speak.zh: 我記得和爸媽一起填人口普查表的事。

write.en: Planners use census figures to decide where new schools and hospitals are most needed.
write.zh: 規劃人員利用人口普查的數據，決定哪裡最需要新建學校和醫院。

example.en: In thick fog, the captain could barely discern the lights of the harbour, so he slowed the ship almost to a stop.
example.zh: 在濃霧中，船長幾乎看不清港口的燈光，因此把船速減到幾乎停下來。

listen.en: Young children cannot always discern fact from fiction.
listen.zh: 年幼的孩子不一定能分辨事實和虛構。

chinese.en: Readers should learn to discern whether a news story comes from a reliable source.
chinese.zh: 讀者應該學會辨別一則新聞是否來自可靠的來源。

english.en: The doctor discerned a small change in the patient's heartbeat.
english.zh: 醫生察覺到病人的心跳有些微變化。

speak.en: Honestly, I can't discern any difference between these two coffees.
speak.zh: 老實說，我喝不出這兩種咖啡有什麼差別。

write.en: Experienced teachers can often discern when a quiet student is struggling with problems at home.
write.zh: 經驗豐富的老師常能察覺，安靜的學生何時正為家裡的問題所苦。

example.en: The young journalist got the scoop of her career when a factory worker shared secret documents about illegal pollution.
example.zh: 一名工廠員工提供了非法汙染的機密文件，讓這位年輕記者搶到她職業生涯中最重要的獨家新聞。

listen.en: She scooped up the sleeping puppy and carried it inside.
listen.zh: 她一把抱起睡著的小狗，把牠抱進屋裡。

chinese.en: Scoop out the seeds of the pumpkin before you cut it into small pieces.
chinese.zh: 先把南瓜的籽挖出來，再切成小塊。

english.en: He used his hands to scoop water from the stream.
english.zh: 他用雙手從溪裡舀水。

speak.en: So what's the scoop? Did you get the job or not?
speak.zh: 所以最新消息是什麼？你到底有沒有拿到那份工作？

write.en: Volunteers scooped plastic bottles out of the river during the weekend clean-up event.
write.zh: 週末的淨溪活動中，志工們把河裡的塑膠瓶撈了出來。

example.en: Bees are attracted by the bright colours of the petals, which guide them towards the sweet nectar inside the flower.
example.zh: 蜜蜂受到花瓣鮮豔色彩的吸引，這些色彩會引導牠們找到花朵中甜美的花蜜。

listen.en: The rose had lost most of its petals by morning.
listen.zh: 到了早上，那朵玫瑰的花瓣大多已經掉了。

chinese.en: The hotel staff scattered rose petals on the bed to welcome the honeymooners.
chinese.zh: 飯店員工在床上撒了玫瑰花瓣，迎接來度蜜月的新人。

english.en: She pressed the flower petals inside a heavy book to dry them.
english.zh: 她把花瓣夾在厚重的書裡壓乾。

speak.en: I love walking in the park when the petals start falling.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡在花瓣開始飄落時去公園散步。

write.en: Some restaurants decorate their salads with edible flower petals to make the dishes look special.
write.zh: 有些餐廳會用可食用的花瓣裝飾沙拉，讓菜色看起來更特別。

example.en: In a constitutional monarchy, the king or queen is the head of state, but elected politicians actually run the government.
example.zh: 在君主立憲制中，國王或女王是國家元首，但實際治理國家的是民選的政治人物。

listen.en: The castle shows the long history of the monarchy.
listen.zh: 這座城堡展現了王室悠久的歷史。

chinese.en: Tourists visiting the capital often buy souvenirs related to the monarchy and royal events.
chinese.zh: 到首都旅遊的觀光客，常會買和王室及皇家活動相關的紀念品。

english.en: France ended its monarchy and became a republic long ago.
english.zh: 法國很久以前就結束君主制，成為共和國。

speak.en: I find the traditions of the monarchy quite fascinating, actually.
speak.zh: 其實我覺得王室的傳統相當有意思。

write.en: The documentary explains how the role of the monarchy has changed over the past few centuries.
write.zh: 這部紀錄片說明了王室的角色在過去幾百年來有何轉變。

example.en: Patience is perhaps the most important attribute of a good teacher, since students learn at very different speeds.
example.zh: 耐心或許是好老師最重要的特質，因為每個學生的學習速度差異很大。

listen.en: The painting was once attributed to a famous artist.
listen.zh: 這幅畫曾一度被認為出自某位知名畫家之手。

chinese.en: Scientists attribute the rise in sea levels mainly to melting ice and warmer oceans.
chinese.zh: 科學家將海平面上升主要歸因於冰層融化和海水變暖。

english.en: The delay was attributed to bad weather at the airport.
english.zh: 這次延誤被歸因於機場的惡劣天氣。

speak.en: I think humour is a really attractive attribute in a friend.
speak.zh: 我覺得幽默感是朋友身上很有魅力的特質。

write.en: Employers often list teamwork and flexibility as the key attributes they look for in graduates.
write.zh: 雇主常把團隊合作和彈性列為他們在畢業生身上尋找的關鍵特質。

example.en: Thanks to generous donations from former students, the school was able to build a new science laboratory.
example.zh: 多虧校友的慷慨捐款，學校得以興建一間新的科學實驗室。

listen.en: Blood donation can help save lives in hospitals.
listen.zh: 捐血能幫助醫院拯救生命。

chinese.en: The museum is free to enter, but visitors are encouraged to leave a donation.
chinese.zh: 這間博物館免費入場，但鼓勵參觀者隨喜捐款。

english.en: The charity received many donations of food and warm clothes.
english.zh: 這個慈善團體收到許多捐贈的食物和保暖衣物。

speak.en: I usually make a donation when there's a natural disaster.
speak.zh: 每當發生天災，我通常都會捐款。

write.en: Some people prefer online donations because they can see exactly how their money is used.
write.zh: 有些人偏好線上捐款，因為可以清楚看到自己的錢如何被運用。

example.en: Buses powered by hydrogen produce only water vapour, which makes them a cleaner choice for crowded city centres.
example.zh: 以氫為動力的公車只會排放水蒸氣，因此在擁擠的市中心是較乾淨的選擇。

listen.en: The sun produces energy by turning hydrogen into helium.
listen.zh: 太陽藉由把氫轉變成氦來產生能量。

chinese.en: Some countries are investing heavily in green hydrogen to reduce their dependence on oil.
chinese.zh: 一些國家正大舉投資綠氫，以降低對石油的依賴。

english.en: Early balloons were filled with hydrogen because it is very light.
english.zh: 早期的氣球裡充的是氫氣，因為它非常輕。

speak.en: I think hydrogen cars could become popular in the future.
speak.zh: 我覺得氫能車未來可能會變得很普遍。

write.en: Storing hydrogen safely is still expensive, which slows down its use as a clean fuel.
write.zh: 安全儲存氫氣的成本仍然很高，這拖慢了它作為潔淨燃料的應用。

example.en: His silence was interpreted as agreement, although he later explained that he simply had not understood the question.
example.zh: 他的沉默被解讀為同意，但他後來解釋說，自己只是沒聽懂那個問題。

listen.en: My cousin interpreted for us when we visited Japan.
listen.zh: 我們去日本時，我表哥幫我們口譯。

chinese.en: Each actor interprets the character differently, so no two performances are exactly the same.
chinese.zh: 每位演員對角色的詮釋都不同，所以沒有任何兩場演出完全一樣。

english.en: Doctors need years of training to interpret X-ray images correctly.
english.zh: 醫生需要多年訓練，才能正確判讀 X 光片。

speak.en: I think people interpret the same joke in very different ways.
speak.zh: 我覺得大家對同一個笑話的理解可能很不一樣。

write.en: Scientists warn that the survey results should be interpreted with caution because the sample was small.
write.zh: 科學家提醒，由於樣本數少，這份調查結果應謹慎解讀。

example.en: The small fishing boat was buffeted by huge waves for hours before it finally reached the safety of the harbour.
example.zh: 那艘小漁船被巨浪拍打了好幾個小時，才終於安全抵達港口。

listen.en: We had a buffet lunch after the graduation ceremony.
listen.zh: 畢業典禮結束後，我們吃了自助式午餐。

chinese.en: The region's economy has been buffeted by rising fuel prices and falling tourist numbers.
chinese.zh: 該地區的經濟受到燃料價格上漲和觀光客減少的雙重衝擊。

english.en: All-you-can-eat buffets often lead to a lot of food waste.
english.zh: 吃到飽的自助餐常常造成大量的食物浪費。

speak.en: I always eat way too much at buffets, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我每次吃自助餐都吃太多。

write.en: Strong winds buffeted the tents all night, so the campers hardly slept at all.
write.zh: 強風整夜猛吹帳篷，露營的人幾乎都沒睡。

example.en: Scientists working at Antarctic research stations must survive months of darkness and temperatures far below freezing.
example.zh: 在南極研究站工作的科學家，必須熬過長達數月的黑夜和遠低於冰點的氣溫。

listen.en: The Antarctic ice sheet is slowly getting thinner.
listen.zh: 南極冰層正在慢慢變薄。

chinese.en: Tourist ships visiting the Antarctic must follow strict rules to protect the wildlife.
chinese.zh: 前往南極的觀光船必須遵守嚴格規定，以保護當地野生動物。

english.en: The explorers spent three months crossing the Antarctic on skis.
english.zh: 探險家們花了三個月，靠滑雪橫越南極。

speak.en: I'd love to see the Antarctic, but it's too expensive.
speak.zh: 我很想去南極看看，但太貴了。

write.en: Warmer Antarctic waters are reducing the krill population, which many whales depend on for food.
write.zh: 南極海域變暖使磷蝦數量減少，而許多鯨魚都靠磷蝦維生。

example.en: The island's weather is notorious among sailors, as calm mornings can turn into violent storms within an hour.
example.zh: 這座島的天氣在水手之間惡名遠播，因為平靜的早晨可能在一小時內就變成狂風暴雨。

listen.en: Our old printer was notorious for jamming at the worst moments.
listen.zh: 我們那台舊印表機出了名地總在最糟的時刻卡紙。

chinese.en: The factory became notorious after it was caught dumping chemicals into the river.
chinese.zh: 那家工廠被抓到把化學物質倒進河裡後，便惡名昭彰。

english.en: English spelling is notorious among learners for its many strange rules.
english.zh: 英文拼字規則古怪又繁多，在學習者之間是出了名的。

speak.en: My brother is notorious in our family for being late.
speak.zh: 我哥在我們家是出了名的愛遲到。

write.en: Online ticket sites became notorious when hidden fees doubled the price of concert tickets.
write.zh: 線上售票網站因隱藏費用讓演唱會門票價格翻倍，而變得惡名昭彰。

example.en: There was an uneasy silence in the meeting room after the manager announced that the office would close.
example.zh: 經理宣布辦公室將要關閉後，會議室裡一片令人不安的沉默。

listen.en: The strange noise outside made the children feel uneasy.
listen.zh: 外面的怪聲讓孩子們感到不安。

chinese.en: The two neighbours have had an uneasy relationship ever since the argument over parking.
chinese.zh: 自從為了停車吵過一架，這兩位鄰居的關係就一直不太和睦。

english.en: Many parents feel uneasy about their children using social media.
english.zh: 許多家長對孩子使用社群媒體感到不安。

speak.en: Big crowds make me a bit uneasy, so I avoid concerts.
speak.zh: 人太多會讓我有點不自在，所以我都避開演唱會。

write.en: Investors grew uneasy as the company kept delaying the launch of its new phone.
write.zh: 由於這家公司一再延後新手機的上市，投資人漸漸感到不安。

example.en: Employers are not allowed to pay workers differently on the basis of gender, so salaries depend on skills and experience.
example.zh: 雇主不得因性別而給予員工不同的薪資，因此薪水取決於技能與經驗。

listen.en: Gender should never limit what a child can dream of.
listen.zh: 性別永遠不該限制孩子的夢想。

chinese.en: The report shows that the gender gap in science careers has narrowed in recent years.
chinese.zh: 報告顯示，近年來科學領域職涯的性別差距已經縮小。

english.en: Many companies now try to keep a gender balance in their teams.
english.zh: 許多公司現在都努力讓團隊保持性別平衡。

speak.en: Honestly, I don't think gender matters when choosing a hobby.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不覺得選擇嗜好時性別有什麼關係。

write.en: Traditional gender roles are changing as more fathers choose to stay home with their children.
write.zh: 隨著越來越多父親選擇留在家中照顧孩子，傳統的性別角色正在改變。

example.en: Because the parasite cannot survive on its own, it must find a host animal to provide food and shelter.
example.zh: 由於這種寄生生物無法獨立生存，牠必須找到宿主動物來提供食物和棲身之處。

listen.en: Wash your vegetables well to remove any parasites.
listen.zh: 把蔬菜洗乾淨，以去除任何寄生蟲。

chinese.en: Scientists found that some parasites can actually change the behaviour of the animals they infect.
chinese.zh: 科學家發現，有些寄生蟲其實能改變被牠們感染的動物的行為。

english.en: Our dog was treated for parasites after playing in the forest.
english.zh: 我們的狗在森林裡玩耍後，接受了寄生蟲的治療。

speak.en: My roommate is a total parasite who never buys groceries.
speak.zh: 我室友根本是個米蟲，從來不去買菜。

write.en: Warmer temperatures may allow parasites to spread into regions where they were once unable to survive.
write.zh: 氣溫升高可能讓寄生蟲擴散到過去牠們無法生存的地區。

example.en: The porcelain was so thin and delicate that light could pass through the cup when it was held up.
example.zh: 這瓷器又薄又精緻，把杯子舉起來時，光線甚至能透過去。

listen.en: Please be careful when you carry that porcelain bowl.
listen.zh: 你拿那個瓷碗的時候請小心一點。

chinese.en: The museum's collection of Chinese porcelain attracts thousands of visitors every year.
chinese.zh: 這間博物館的中國瓷器收藏每年吸引數千名遊客。

english.en: We chose white porcelain tiles for the bathroom in our new flat.
english.zh: 我們為新公寓的浴室選了白色的瓷磚。

speak.en: I bought a little porcelain teapot as a souvenir from Japan.
speak.zh: 我在日本買了一個小瓷茶壺當紀念品。

write.en: Workshops in the town still produce porcelain by hand using methods passed down for centuries.
write.zh: 鎮上的工坊仍然用流傳了幾百年的方法，以手工製作瓷器。

example.en: There is scant evidence that the new diet works, as only a few small studies have tested it.
example.zh: 幾乎沒有證據顯示這種新飲食法有效，因為只有少數小型研究測試過它。

listen.en: The hikers had scant food left after the storm.
listen.zh: 暴風雨過後，登山客的食物已所剩無幾。

chinese.en: Many small farms survive on scant resources and receive little support from the government.
chinese.zh: 許多小農場靠著微薄的資源維生，幾乎得不到政府的支持。

english.en: The driver showed scant regard for the safety of his passengers.
english.zh: 那位司機幾乎不顧乘客的安全。

speak.en: To be fair, I had scant time to prepare for that interview.
speak.zh: 說句公道話，我那次面試幾乎沒有時間準備。

write.en: Rainfall was scant last summer, so the reservoir dropped to its lowest level in decades.
write.zh: 去年夏天雨量稀少，水庫水位降到幾十年來的最低點。

example.en: Born into a noble family, she grew up in a castle surrounded by servants and private tutors.
example.zh: 她出身貴族家庭，在城堡裡長大，身邊圍繞著僕人和家庭教師。

listen.en: His plan had noble aims but very poor results.
listen.zh: 他的計畫立意崇高，成效卻很差。

chinese.en: Returning the lost wallet with all the money inside was a truly noble act.
chinese.zh: 把遺失的錢包連同裡面的錢全數歸還，真是高尚的舉動。

english.en: In the past, only nobles were allowed to hunt in these woods.
english.zh: 過去只有貴族才被允許在這片樹林裡打獵。

speak.en: I think teaching is a noble profession, even if it's poorly paid.
speak.zh: 我認為教書是很崇高的職業，即使薪水不高。

write.en: Despite their noble intentions, the volunteers caused confusion by ignoring local customs.
write.zh: 儘管立意良善，那些志工卻因忽視當地習俗而造成混亂。

example.en: When the manager left suddenly, her deputy took over to ensure continuity and keep the project on schedule.
example.zh: 經理突然離職時，她的副手接手工作，確保業務不中斷，讓專案如期進行。

listen.en: Patients value continuity of care from the same doctor.
listen.zh: 病人重視由同一位醫生持續照護。

chinese.en: The film was criticised for poor continuity, as the actor's shirt kept changing colour.
chinese.zh: 這部電影因前後不連貫而受到批評，因為演員的襯衫顏色一直在變。

english.en: Family traditions help maintain continuity between grandparents and their grandchildren.
english.zh: 家族傳統有助於維繫祖父母與孫輩之間的傳承。

speak.en: I like living in my hometown because there's real continuity there.
speak.zh: 我喜歡住在家鄉，因為那裡有種一脈相承的感覺。

write.en: Investors often prefer continuity during a crisis rather than a sudden change in leadership.
write.zh: 危機期間，投資人往往偏好穩定延續，而不是突然更換領導階層。

example.en: Although her degree was in history, her volunteer work with children was highly relevant to the teaching job.
example.zh: 雖然她主修歷史，但她陪伴兒童的志工經驗和這份教職高度相關。

listen.en: Do you have any relevant experience for this role?
listen.zh: 你有任何和這個職位相關的經驗嗎？

chinese.en: Some people believe that ancient philosophy is no longer relevant in the modern world.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為古代哲學在現代世界已不再具有意義。

english.en: The lawyer asked the court to ignore facts that were not relevant.
english.zh: 律師請求法庭忽略不相關的事實。

speak.en: I try to read news that's relevant to my daily life.
speak.zh: 我會盡量讀和日常生活有關的新聞。

write.en: Teachers should make lessons relevant by linking them to problems students actually face.
write.zh: 老師應該把課程和學生實際面對的問題連結起來，讓課程更貼近生活。

example.en: Although the visiting team scored first, the home side prevailed after a long and tense second half.
example.zh: 雖然客隊先得分，但主隊在漫長又緊張的下半場之後贏得勝利。

listen.en: A calm mood prevailed in the classroom during the exam.
listen.zh: 考試期間，教室裡瀰漫著平靜的氣氛。

chinese.en: These old customs still prevail in many rural villages across the island.
chinese.zh: 這些古老習俗在島上許多鄉村仍然盛行。

english.en: We finally prevailed on my father to see a doctor.
english.zh: 我們終於說服我爸去看醫生。

speak.en: I believe honesty will always prevail over lies in the long run.
speak.zh: 我相信長遠來看，誠實總會戰勝謊言。

write.en: The prevailing winds carry pollution from the factories towards the city centre.
write.zh: 盛行風把工廠的汙染吹向市中心。

example.en: According to the employee handbook, staff must request annual leave at least two weeks in advance.
example.zh: 根據員工手冊，員工必須至少提前兩週申請年假。

listen.en: Check the handbook before you ask the teacher.
listen.zh: 問老師之前，先查一下手冊。

chinese.en: The museum published a handbook for parents who want to explore science with their children.
chinese.zh: 博物館出版了一本手冊，給想和孩子一起探索科學的家長使用。

english.en: This handbook gives clear advice on writing a research paper.
english.zh: 這本手冊針對撰寫研究報告提供了清楚的建議。

speak.en: Honestly, nobody at my office ever reads the handbook carefully.
speak.zh: 老實說，我們辦公室沒有人會仔細讀那本手冊。

write.en: Before the hiking trip, we studied a survival handbook to learn basic first aid.
write.zh: 健行之前，我們研讀了一本求生手冊，學習基本急救。

example.en: Many young couples delay having children until they feel financially secure and have found stable jobs.
example.zh: 許多年輕夫妻會延後生小孩，直到經濟上有保障、找到穩定工作為止。

listen.en: Please send me the report without any further delay.
listen.zh: 請立刻把報告寄給我，不要再拖了。

chinese.en: Construction of the new library faced long delays due to a shortage of workers.
chinese.zh: 新圖書館的興建因人手不足而嚴重延宕。

english.en: Don't delay going to the dentist if your tooth hurts.
english.zh: 如果牙齒痛，就不要拖延去看牙醫。

speak.en: Sorry I'm late, there was a delay on the train line.
speak.zh: 抱歉我遲到了，火車路線出了點延誤。

write.en: Governments that delay action on climate change will face much higher costs later.
write.zh: 延遲因應氣候變遷的政府，日後將付出高得多的代價。

example.en: As the kettle began to whistle loudly in the kitchen, she rushed to turn off the stove.
example.zh: 廚房裡的水壺開始大聲鳴響，她趕緊衝過去關掉爐火。

listen.en: My grandfather always whistles while he works in the garden.
listen.zh: 我爺爺在花園工作時總是吹著口哨。

chinese.en: An employee blew the whistle on the company for dumping waste into the river.
chinese.zh: 一名員工揭發公司把廢棄物傾倒進河裡。

english.en: The lifeguard carries a whistle to warn swimmers of danger.
english.zh: 救生員隨身帶著哨子，用來警告泳客有危險。

speak.en: I've never been able to whistle, no matter how hard I try.
speak.zh: 不管我多努力，我就是學不會吹口哨。

write.en: The wind whistled through the broken window all night, so nobody in the cabin slept.
write.zh: 風整夜從破窗呼嘯而過，所以小屋裡沒有人睡得著。

example.en: Most of the toys sold in the shop are manufactured overseas, where labour costs are much lower.
example.zh: 這家店販售的玩具大多在海外製造，因為那裡的勞工成本低得多。

listen.en: These shoes are manufactured from recycled plastic bottles.
listen.zh: 這些鞋子是用回收塑膠瓶製造的。

chinese.en: The manufacture of paper uses huge amounts of water and energy every day.
chinese.zh: 造紙每天都要耗費大量的水和能源。

english.en: The company plans to manufacture its phones in Taiwan next year.
english.zh: 這家公司打算明年在臺灣製造手機。

speak.en: I'd love to know where my clothes are actually manufactured.
speak.zh: 我很想知道我的衣服到底是在哪裡製造的。

write.en: He manufactured an excuse about a sick relative to avoid the meeting.
write.zh: 他捏造了親戚生病的藉口來逃避開會。

example.en: When the interviewer asked him to elaborate on his answer, he gave several specific examples from his last job.
example.zh: 面試官請他進一步說明答案時，他舉了幾個上一份工作中的具體例子。

listen.en: Could you elaborate on that point a little more?
listen.zh: 你可以針對那一點再多說明一些嗎？

chinese.en: The thieves came up with an elaborate plan to steal the painting from the gallery.
chinese.zh: 竊賊們想出了一個周密的計畫，要從美術館偷走那幅畫。

english.en: The dancers wore elaborate costumes covered in feathers and beads.
english.zh: 舞者們穿著綴滿羽毛和珠子的華麗服裝。

speak.en: We didn't do anything elaborate for my birthday, just dinner with friends.
speak.zh: 我生日沒有特別大費周章，只是和朋友吃頓晚餐。

write.en: In your essay, state your opinion clearly and then elaborate with reasons and evidence.
write.zh: 在文章中，先清楚陳述你的觀點，再用理由和證據詳細說明。

example.en: Her feedback was blunt but useful; she told me exactly which parts of my essay were weak.
example.zh: 她的意見很直接但很有用，明確告訴我文章哪些部分寫得不好。

listen.en: To be blunt, I don't think your plan will work.
listen.zh: 說白了，我不認為你的計畫行得通。

chinese.en: The manager's blunt remarks upset several members of staff during the weekly meeting.
chinese.zh: 經理直白的發言讓好幾位員工在週會上感到不快。

english.en: My pencil is blunt, so I need to sharpen it first.
english.zh: 我的鉛筆鈍了，所以得先削一下。

speak.en: My best friend is quite blunt, but I appreciate her honesty.
speak.zh: 我最好的朋友說話很直，但我很欣賞她的坦率。

write.en: Rising prices have blunted the effect of wage increases for many families.
write.zh: 物價上漲削弱了許多家庭加薪的效果。

example.en: The documentary presents the story from the viewpoint of a farmer whose land was flooded by the dam.
example.zh: 這部紀錄片從一位農夫的視角敘述故事，他的田地被水壩淹沒了。

listen.en: We stopped at a viewpoint to enjoy the mountain view.
listen.zh: 我們在一處觀景點停下來欣賞山景。

chinese.en: A strong essay considers opposing viewpoints carefully before it reaches a final conclusion.
chinese.zh: 一篇好的文章在下最後結論之前，會仔細考量相反的觀點。

english.en: Try to understand the problem from your parents' viewpoint as well.
english.zh: 也試著從你父母的角度去理解這個問題。

speak.en: From a student's viewpoint, longer summer holidays would be absolutely fantastic.
speak.zh: 從學生的角度來看，暑假能更長的話就太棒了。

write.en: Newspapers should present more than one viewpoint when reporting on public health issues.
write.zh: 報紙報導公共衛生議題時，應該呈現不只一種觀點。

example.en: Because my sister is allergic to seafood, we always check the menu carefully before ordering anything.
example.zh: 因為我姊姊對海鮮過敏，我們點餐前總會仔細看菜單。

listen.en: Let's try the seafood restaurant near the harbour tonight.
listen.zh: 我們今晚去試試港口附近那家海鮮餐廳吧。

chinese.en: Overfishing could make seafood much more expensive and harder to find in the future.
chinese.zh: 過度捕撈可能讓海鮮在未來變得更貴、更難買到。

english.en: Night markets in Taiwan sell many kinds of grilled seafood.
english.zh: 臺灣的夜市販售許多種烤海鮮。

speak.en: I'm not really a fan of seafood, especially raw fish.
speak.zh: 我不太喜歡海鮮，尤其是生魚片。

write.en: Consumers can protect the oceans by choosing seafood from certified sustainable sources.
write.zh: 消費者可以選擇有認證的永續海鮮，來保護海洋。

example.en: She asked an innocent question about the price, but the seller thought she was trying to bargain.
example.zh: 她只是單純問了價錢，賣家卻以為她想殺價。

listen.en: Small children often have an innocent view of the world.
listen.zh: 小孩子看待世界的眼光往往很天真。

chinese.en: Traffic accidents caused by drunk drivers often injure innocent people walking nearby.
chinese.zh: 酒駕造成的交通事故常常傷及附近無辜的行人。

english.en: Everyone is innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
english.zh: 在法庭上，每個人在被證明有罪之前都是無罪的。

speak.en: Honestly, it was an innocent mistake, I didn't mean to offend anyone.
speak.zh: 說真的，那只是無心之過，我不是故意要冒犯任何人。

write.en: New evidence showed that the worker was innocent of stealing from the shop.
write.zh: 新證據顯示，那名員工並沒有偷竊店裡的東西。

example.en: Very few players attain such a high level of skill, which is why professional teams pay them so well.
example.zh: 很少球員能達到這麼高的技術水準，這就是職業球隊付他們高薪的原因。

listen.en: He attained his degree while working a full-time job.
listen.zh: 他一邊做全職工作，一邊取得了學位。

chinese.en: Many students attain fluency in English only after living abroad for several years.
chinese.zh: 許多學生要在國外住上好幾年，英文才真正變得流利。

english.en: Regular practice helps learners attain a higher score on the test.
english.zh: 規律練習能幫助學習者在考試中拿到更高的分數。

speak.en: I'm not sure I'll ever attain the perfect work-life balance.
speak.zh: 我不確定自己是否能達到完美的工作與生活平衡。

write.en: Education allows people from poor backgrounds to attain a better position in society.
write.zh: 教育讓出身貧困的人能在社會上取得更好的地位。

example.en: It took the exchange student several months to integrate into her new class, but she now has many close friends.
example.zh: 這位交換學生花了好幾個月才融入新班級，但她現在已經有很多好朋友。

listen.en: This app integrates easily with your calendar and email.
listen.zh: 這個應用程式能輕鬆和你的行事曆及電子郵件整合。

chinese.en: Governments should offer language classes to help immigrants integrate into local communities.
chinese.zh: 政府應提供語言課程，幫助移民融入當地社區。

english.en: Our new design integrates solar panels into the roof of the house.
english.zh: 我們的新設計把太陽能板整合進房屋的屋頂。

speak.en: Moving abroad was hard, but I've integrated quite well now.
speak.zh: 搬到國外很辛苦，但我現在已經滿能融入當地了。

write.en: The hospital has integrated traditional medicine with modern treatment to help patients recover.
write.zh: 這間醫院結合了傳統醫學與現代療法，幫助病人康復。

example.en: Because the study only included twenty volunteers, many scientists doubted the validity of its conclusions.
example.zh: 由於這項研究只納入二十名志願者，許多科學家懷疑其結論的可信度。

listen.en: The judge checked the validity of the contract.
listen.zh: 法官確認了這份合約的效力。

chinese.en: Your passport must have a validity of at least six months for this visa.
chinese.zh: 申請這種簽證，你的護照效期必須至少還有六個月。

english.en: The teacher asked us to test the validity of each argument.
english.zh: 老師要我們檢驗每個論點是否合理。

speak.en: I'm not sure about the validity of that online quiz, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不太確定那個網路測驗準不準。

write.en: Critics have challenged the validity of using exam scores as the only measure of ability.
write.zh: 批評者質疑把考試成績當作衡量能力唯一標準是否合理。

example.en: Rents in the downtown area are so high that many young workers choose to live in the suburbs instead.
example.zh: 市中心的房租太高，許多年輕上班族因此選擇住在郊區。

listen.en: Is there a good bookshop somewhere downtown near the station?
listen.zh: 市中心靠近車站的地方有好的書店嗎？

chinese.en: The city plans to ban private cars from downtown streets during the weekend.
chinese.zh: 市政府計畫在週末禁止私家車進入市中心的街道。

english.en: My office is located in downtown Taipei, close to the main station.
english.zh: 我的辦公室位於臺北市中心，靠近主要車站。

speak.en: I'd rather live downtown so I can walk everywhere.
speak.zh: 我寧可住在市中心，這樣到哪裡都能走路去。

write.en: Several old factories downtown have been turned into museums and creative spaces.
write.zh: 市中心好幾座舊工廠已經改建成博物館和創意空間。

example.en: The cricket match lasted the whole day, with players stopping only for lunch and afternoon tea.
example.zh: 這場板球比賽打了一整天，選手只在午餐和下午茶時間暫停。

listen.en: We could hear crickets singing in the grass all night.
listen.zh: 我們整晚都聽得到草叢裡蟋蟀的叫聲。

chinese.en: In some countries, people eat roasted crickets as a cheap source of protein.
chinese.zh: 在某些國家，人們把烤蟋蟀當作便宜的蛋白質來源。

english.en: My cousin plays cricket every weekend at his school in Australia.
english.zh: 我表哥每個週末都在他澳洲的學校打板球。

speak.en: I've watched cricket on TV, but I still don't understand the rules.
speak.zh: 我在電視上看過板球，但還是搞不懂規則。

write.en: He bought a new cricket bat before joining the university team.
write.zh: 加入大學校隊之前，他買了一支新的板球球棒。

example.en: The chart shows little variation in sales during the spring, but a sharp rise appears in December.
example.zh: 圖表顯示春季的銷售量變化不大，但十二月出現了急遽成長。

listen.en: This dish is a modern variation on a classic recipe.
listen.zh: 這道菜是經典食譜的現代變化版。

chinese.en: Researchers found significant regional variation in the cost of housing across the country.
chinese.zh: 研究人員發現，全國各地的住房成本有明顯的區域差異。

english.en: Children's height shows natural variation even within the same family.
english.zh: 即使在同一個家庭裡，孩子們的身高也有自然的差異。

speak.en: I love trying different variations of milk tea at night markets.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡在夜市嘗試各種不同口味的奶茶。

write.en: Seasonal variations in rainfall make it difficult for farmers to plan their crops.
write.zh: 降雨量的季節性變化，讓農民很難規劃作物。

example.en: Every seat on the train was occupied, so we had to stand for the entire journey home.
example.zh: 火車上每個座位都有人坐，所以我們一路站著回家。

listen.en: Crossword puzzles keep my grandmother occupied for hours every morning.
listen.zh: 填字遊戲讓我奶奶每天早上忙上好幾個小時。

chinese.en: Women now occupy nearly half of the senior positions in the company.
chinese.zh: 女性現在在這家公司擔任將近一半的高階職位。

english.en: Online games occupy most of my younger brother's free time.
english.zh: 線上遊戲占據了我弟弟大部分的空閒時間。

speak.en: Sorry, is this seat occupied, or can I sit here?
speak.zh: 不好意思，這個位子有人坐嗎？我可以坐這裡嗎？

write.en: Ancient farming communities occupied this valley for thousands of years before the city was built.
write.zh: 早在這座城市建立之前，古代的農耕聚落就已在這個山谷居住了數千年。

example.en: Birds gathered around the picnic table, hoping to find a few crumbs that people had dropped.
example.zh: 鳥兒聚集在野餐桌周圍，希望能找到人們掉下的一些碎屑。

listen.en: Please brush the crumbs off the table before dinner.
listen.zh: 晚餐前請把桌上的碎屑擦掉。

chinese.en: Coat the chicken in bread crumbs and fry it until it turns golden brown.
chinese.zh: 把雞肉裹上麵包粉，炸到呈金黃色。

english.en: Ants quickly found the crumbs we had left in the kitchen.
english.zh: 螞蟻很快就找到我們留在廚房的碎屑。

speak.en: I try not to eat in bed because of the crumbs.
speak.zh: 我盡量不在床上吃東西，因為會掉碎屑。

write.en: After weeks without good news, the doctor's report offered the family a crumb of hope.
write.zh: 好幾個星期都沒有好消息之後，醫生的報告給了這家人一絲希望。

example.en: Experts argue that prevention is cheaper than treatment, since regular check-ups catch problems before they become serious.
example.zh: 專家認為預防比治療更省錢，因為定期健康檢查能在問題惡化前及早發現。

listen.en: My doctor always says prevention is better than cure.
listen.zh: 我的醫生總是說預防勝於治療。

chinese.en: Better street lighting has played an important role in crime prevention in the neighbourhood.
chinese.zh: 改善街道照明在這個社區的犯罪預防上扮演了重要角色。

english.en: The school holds a fire prevention drill at the start of every semester.
english.zh: 學校在每學期開學時都會舉行防火演練。

speak.en: For me, healthy eating is the best kind of prevention.
speak.zh: 對我來說，健康飲食就是最好的預防方法。

write.en: Investing in flood prevention now could save cities billions in future repair costs.
write.zh: 現在投資防洪工程，可以為城市省下未來數十億元的修復費用。

example.en: Visiting the ancient temple at sunrise was the highlight of our trip, and we still talk about it.
example.zh: 日出時參觀那座古老寺廟是這趟旅行最精采的部分，我們到現在都還會聊起。

listen.en: Highlight the key words in each paragraph as you read.
listen.zh: 閱讀時，把每一段的關鍵字用螢光筆畫起來。

chinese.en: The evening news programme showed highlights of last night's basketball game between the two rivals.
chinese.zh: 晚間新聞播出了昨晚兩支宿敵球隊籃球賽的精采片段。

english.en: This accident highlights the danger of using phones while driving.
english.zh: 這起事故突顯了開車時使用手機的危險。

speak.en: Honestly, the highlight of my week is Sunday brunch with friends.
speak.zh: 說真的，我一週中最期待的就是星期日和朋友吃早午餐。

write.en: In your cover letter, highlight the skills that match the job description most closely.
write.zh: 在求職信中，要突顯最符合職缺說明的技能。

example.en: She tried to look calm during the interview, but her shaking hands betrayed how nervous she really was.
example.zh: 她面試時努力表現得很冷靜，但顫抖的雙手卻洩露了她有多緊張。

listen.en: I would never betray the trust of my team.
listen.zh: 我絕不會辜負團隊對我的信任。

chinese.en: Customers felt betrayed when the company admitted it had sold their personal data.
chinese.zh: 公司承認曾販售顧客的個人資料，讓顧客覺得被出賣了。

english.en: The engineer betrayed his company by selling its designs to a rival.
english.zh: 那位工程師把公司的設計賣給競爭對手，背叛了公司。

speak.en: If a friend betrays me once, it's hard to trust them again.
speak.zh: 如果朋友背叛過我一次，我就很難再信任他了。

write.en: The novel follows a young musician who betrays her own dreams to please her parents.
write.zh: 這部小說講述一位年輕音樂家為了討父母歡心而背棄自己夢想的故事。

example.en: Unlike cotton, nylon does not absorb much water, so it is often used for swimwear and tents.
example.zh: 尼龍不像棉那樣會吸很多水，所以常用來製作泳衣和帳篷。

listen.en: The climbers tied a strong nylon rope to the tree.
listen.zh: 登山客把一條堅固的尼龍繩綁在樹上。

chinese.en: Tiny nylon fibres from washing machines are polluting rivers and oceans around the world.
chinese.zh: 洗衣機排出的微小尼龍纖維正在汙染世界各地的河流與海洋。

english.en: I always carry a folded nylon bag in case I go shopping.
english.zh: 我總是隨身帶一個折好的尼龍袋，以備購物時用。

speak.en: Nylon socks make my feet too hot in summer.
speak.zh: 尼龍襪讓我的腳在夏天太熱了。

write.en: Some fashion brands now recycle old fishing nets into new nylon for clothing.
write.zh: 有些時尚品牌現在把廢棄漁網回收，再製成服裝用的新尼龍。

example.en: The virus can remain latent in the body for years before any symptoms finally appear.
example.zh: 這種病毒可以在體內潛伏多年，最後才出現症狀。

listen.en: Everyone has latent abilities waiting to be discovered.
listen.zh: 每個人都有等待被發掘的潛在能力。

chinese.en: The survey revealed a latent demand for evening classes among working adults.
chinese.zh: 調查顯示，上班族對夜間課程有潛在的需求。

english.en: Travelling abroad awakened her latent interest in learning foreign languages.
english.zh: 出國旅行喚醒了她對學習外語潛藏的興趣。

speak.en: I think there's a latent fear of failure in many students.
speak.zh: 我覺得很多學生心裡都潛藏著對失敗的恐懼。

write.en: Tensions that had been latent for years finally surfaced during the budget discussions.
write.zh: 潛伏多年的緊張關係，終於在預算討論期間浮上檯面。

example.en: Famous people live under constant public scrutiny, so even a small mistake can become headline news.
example.zh: 名人活在大眾持續的檢視下，即使是小小的失誤也可能成為頭條新聞。

listen.en: His story did not hold up under scrutiny.
listen.zh: 他的說詞經不起仔細推敲。

chinese.en: New medicines must undergo careful scrutiny before they can be sold to the public.
chinese.zh: 新藥必須經過仔細審查，才能販售給大眾。

english.en: The teacher's scrutiny made the students check their answers twice.
english.zh: 老師嚴格的檢查讓學生把答案確認了兩次。

speak.en: Under my mum's scrutiny, I could never get away with messy homework.
speak.zh: 在我媽的嚴格監督下，我的作業從來不可能隨便交差。

write.en: Social media platforms face increasing scrutiny over how they handle false information.
write.zh: 社群媒體平臺處理不實資訊的方式，正受到越來越多的檢視。
