example.en: Low-lying coastal towns are especially vulnerable, since even a small rise in sea level can flood their streets.
example.zh: 低窪的沿海城鎮特別脆弱，因為海平面即使只上升一點點，就可能淹沒街道。

listen.en: I felt vulnerable walking alone in the dark park.
listen.zh: 獨自走在漆黑的公園裡，讓我覺得很沒有安全感。

chinese.en: Charities provide food and shelter for the most vulnerable members of society.
chinese.zh: 慈善團體為社會上最弱勢的人提供食物和住處。

english.en: Computers without updates are more vulnerable to attacks from hackers.
english.zh: 沒有更新的電腦更容易遭受駭客攻擊。

speak.en: Speaking in public makes me feel really vulnerable and exposed.
speak.zh: 在大家面前說話讓我覺得自己很脆弱、毫無防備。

write.en: Rare plants on the island are vulnerable because tourists often walk off the paths.
write.zh: 島上的稀有植物很脆弱，因為遊客常常走出步道。

example.en: The boat could not land on the island because jagged rocks surrounded the entire coastline.
example.zh: 船無法在島上靠岸，因為整條海岸線都被嶙峋的岩石包圍。

listen.en: We could see jagged mountain peaks covered in snow.
listen.zh: 我們看得到覆蓋著白雪、高低起伏的山峰。

chinese.en: The graph shows a jagged line, as prices rose and fell almost every week.
chinese.zh: 這張圖表呈現一條鋸齒狀的線，因為價格幾乎每週都在漲跌。

english.en: He cut his hand on a jagged piece of metal.
english.zh: 他的手被一塊參差不齊的金屬割傷了。

speak.en: The cliffs looked so jagged that I was scared to climb them.
speak.zh: 那些懸崖看起來非常崎嶇，我不敢爬上去。

write.en: Lightning split the dark sky into jagged white lines during the summer storm.
write.zh: 夏季暴風雨中，閃電在黑暗的天空劃出一道道鋸齒狀的白線。

example.en: Instead of paying the whole fee at once, members can pay quarterly, which spreads the cost across the year.
example.zh: 會員不必一次付清全部費用，可以按季繳費，把開銷分攤到一整年。

listen.en: Our team holds a quarterly meeting to review progress.
listen.zh: 我們團隊每季開一次會檢討進度。

chinese.en: Quarterly sales dropped sharply after the company raised the price of its main product.
chinese.zh: 公司調漲主力產品的價格後，季度銷售額大幅下滑。

english.en: In our building, the water bill arrives quarterly rather than every month.
english.zh: 在我們這棟大樓，水費帳單是每季寄來一次，而不是每個月。

speak.en: I check my savings quarterly to see if I'm on track.
speak.zh: 我每季檢查一次存款，看看有沒有照計畫進行。

write.en: The museum's quarterly magazine features interviews with artists and reviews of new exhibitions.
write.zh: 博物館的季刊收錄藝術家專訪和新展覽評論。

example.en: Learning a second language takes years of effort, but it often pays dividends later when you look for work.
example.zh: 學第二外語要花好幾年的努力，但日後找工作時往往會帶來回報。

listen.en: My grandfather lives partly on dividends from his old shares.
listen.zh: 我爺爺的生活費有一部分來自他早年持股的股利。

chinese.en: The firm decided to cut its dividend in order to invest in new technology.
chinese.zh: 這家公司決定削減股利，以便投資新技術。

english.en: Regular exercise pays dividends in both physical and mental health.
english.zh: 規律運動對身心健康都大有好處。

speak.en: I don't own any shares, so I've never received a dividend.
speak.zh: 我沒有持有任何股票，所以從來沒領過股利。

write.en: Workers at the cooperative receive an annual dividend based on the shop's profits.
write.zh: 這家合作社的員工每年會依商店的獲利領取紅利。

example.en: The film was full of cliches, from the shy hero to the happy ending everyone could predict.
example.zh: 這部電影充滿老套情節，從害羞的主角到大家都猜得到的圓滿結局都是。

listen.en: It sounds like a cliche, but practice makes perfect.
listen.zh: 聽起來很老套，但熟能生巧。

chinese.en: The idea that money cannot buy happiness has become a cliche, yet many still believe it.
chinese.zh: 「金錢買不到快樂」已經成了陳腔濫調，但仍有很多人相信。

english.en: The speaker opened with a cliche about following your dreams.
english.zh: 講者用一句「追隨你的夢想」這種老套說法開場。

speak.en: My favourite songs avoid cliches and tell real, personal stories.
speak.zh: 我最喜歡的歌不走老套路線，而是講真實、個人的故事。

write.en: Advertisers repeat the cliche of the perfect family to sell everything from cars to cereal.
write.zh: 廣告商不斷重複「完美家庭」這種老套形象，從汽車到早餐穀片什麼都拿來賣。

example.en: Cattle farming produces large amounts of methane, a gas that contributes significantly to global warming.
example.zh: 養牛業會產生大量甲烷，而這種氣體是全球暖化的重要成因。

listen.en: A herd of cattle was crossing the narrow country road.
listen.zh: 一群牛正在穿越狹窄的鄉間小路。

chinese.en: In many parts of Africa, cattle are a sign of wealth and social status.
chinese.zh: 在非洲許多地區，牛是財富與社會地位的象徵。

english.en: The cattle are kept indoors during the cold winter months.
english.zh: 寒冷的冬季月份裡，牛隻都養在室內。

speak.en: When I visited my uncle's farm, I helped feed the cattle.
speak.zh: 我去叔叔的農場時，幫忙餵了牛。

write.en: Clearing forests to create land for cattle has destroyed the homes of many wild animals.
write.zh: 為了闢出養牛的土地而砍伐森林，摧毀了許多野生動物的棲地。

example.en: The tour price includes meals and transport, while the boat trip is optional and costs extra.
example.zh: 旅遊團費包含餐食和交通，搭船行程則是自由參加，需另外付費。

listen.en: Wearing a tie to the dinner is optional.
listen.zh: 參加晚宴可以自行決定要不要打領帶。

chinese.en: Some educators believe that homework should be optional for children in primary school.
chinese.zh: 有些教育工作者認為小學生的作業應該改為自由選擇。

english.en: In my university, art history is an optional course for engineering students.
english.zh: 在我的大學，藝術史是工程系學生的選修課。

speak.en: The tip is optional here, but people usually leave something.
speak.zh: 在這裡小費不是強制的，但大家通常還是會給一點。

write.en: The new car comes with optional extras such as heated seats and a larger screen.
write.zh: 這款新車提供加購配備，例如座椅加熱和更大的螢幕。

example.en: His passion for the ocean began in childhood and eventually led him to become a marine biologist.
example.zh: 他對海洋的熱愛始於童年，最後促使他成為海洋生物學家。

listen.en: The teacher spoke with great passion about history.
listen.zh: 老師談起歷史時充滿熱情。

chinese.en: Many young people struggle to choose between following their passion and earning a stable income.
chinese.zh: 許多年輕人很難在追隨熱情與賺取穩定收入之間做出選擇。

english.en: My father and I share a passion for old films.
english.zh: 我和爸爸都很熱愛老電影。

speak.en: Photography started as a hobby, but now it's my biggest passion.
speak.zh: 攝影原本只是嗜好，但現在是我最熱愛的事。

write.en: Debates about local football teams can stir strong passions among fans of all ages.
write.zh: 關於地方足球隊的爭論，能激起各年齡層球迷的強烈情緒。

example.en: Living in a remote mountain village can isolate older people from their families and basic services.
example.zh: 住在偏遠的山村，可能讓長者與家人和基本服務隔絕。

listen.en: Many people felt isolated while working from home.
listen.zh: 許多人在家工作時感到孤立。

chinese.en: After years of research, scientists finally isolated the gene responsible for the rare skin condition.
chinese.zh: 經過多年研究，科學家終於分離出導致這種罕見皮膚病的基因。

english.en: Engineers are trying to isolate the cause of the power failure.
english.zh: 工程師正試著找出停電的原因。

speak.en: I try not to isolate myself when I'm feeling stressed.
speak.zh: 壓力大的時候，我會盡量不把自己封閉起來。

write.en: Strict rules about uniforms can isolate students who cannot afford the expensive items.
write.zh: 嚴格的制服規定，可能讓買不起昂貴服裝的學生被孤立。

example.en: Fearing for their safety at home, thousands of people crossed the border to seek asylum in neighbouring states.
example.zh: 由於擔心自身在國內的安全，數千人越過邊境，到鄰近國家尋求庇護。

listen.en: She was granted asylum and began a new life here.
listen.zh: 她獲得庇護，並在這裡展開了新生活。

chinese.en: The charity helps asylum seekers find housing, learn the language and look for work.
chinese.zh: 這個慈善團體協助尋求庇護者找住處、學語言並找工作。

english.en: Many people seek asylum to escape danger in their home countries.
english.zh: 許多人為了逃離祖國的危險而尋求庇護。

speak.en: I watched a documentary about families waiting for asylum decisions.
speak.zh: 我看過一部紀錄片，內容是關於等待庇護審查結果的家庭。

write.en: The government processed the asylum applications more quickly after hiring additional staff.
write.zh: 政府增聘人手後，處理庇護申請的速度加快了。

example.en: Without regular updates, the app quickly became useless, so most users deleted it within a few weeks.
example.zh: 由於缺乏定期更新，這個應用程式很快就沒什麼用處，大多數使用者在幾週內就把它刪掉了。

listen.en: It is useless to argue with him when he is tired.
listen.zh: 他累的時候跟他爭論也沒用。

chinese.en: Much of the advice online is useless unless you adapt it to your own situation.
chinese.zh: 網路上的許多建議，除非你依自己的情況調整，否則都派不上用場。

english.en: I am completely useless at cooking, so I usually eat out.
english.zh: 我完全不會做菜，所以通常在外面吃。

speak.en: Honestly, I felt useless when I couldn't help my friend move.
speak.zh: 老實說，我沒辦法幫朋友搬家時，覺得自己很沒用。

write.en: Heavy rain rendered the outdoor stage useless, so the concert was moved indoors.
write.zh: 大雨使戶外舞臺無法使用，所以音樂會改到室內舉行。

example.en: Small bookshops struggled to survive the ruthless competition from online retailers that offered huge discounts.
example.zh: 面對網路零售商以大幅折扣展開的殘酷競爭，小型書店難以生存。

listen.en: The boss was ruthless about cutting costs this year.
listen.zh: 老闆今年削減成本毫不手軟。

chinese.en: The company was criticised for its ruthless pursuit of profit at the expense of workers.
chinese.zh: 這家公司因不惜犧牲員工、無情地追求利潤而受到批評。

english.en: The villain in the film was clever but completely ruthless.
english.zh: 電影裡的反派很聰明，卻冷酷無情。

speak.en: My coach was pretty ruthless, but he made us much better players.
speak.zh: 我的教練相當嚴厲無情，但他讓我們成了更好的球員。

write.en: When editing your essay, be ruthless and cut every sentence that adds nothing.
write.zh: 修改作文時要狠下心，把每一句沒有貢獻的句子都刪掉。

example.en: When critics attacked the new policy, the minister spoke in its defence, arguing that it would save money.
example.zh: 當批評者抨擊這項新政策時，部長出面為它辯護，主張這項政策能省錢。

listen.en: Our team needs a stronger defence before the next match.
listen.zh: 我們隊在下一場比賽前需要加強防守。

chinese.en: Sea walls are the town's main defence against flooding during the stormy season.
chinese.zh: 海堤是這座小鎮在暴風雨季節抵禦洪水的主要防線。

english.en: She came to my defence when others blamed me for the mistake.
english.zh: 別人把錯怪到我頭上時，她出面替我辯護。

speak.en: In my defence, nobody told me the meeting had been moved.
speak.zh: 我得替自己辯解一下，根本沒人告訴我會議改時間了。

write.en: The government plans to increase spending on national defence over the next decade.
write.zh: 政府計畫在未來十年增加國防支出。

example.en: After the factory closed, many families in the town lived in misery, unable to pay rent or buy enough food.
example.zh: 工廠關閉後，鎮上許多家庭生活困苦，付不起房租，也買不起足夠的食物。

listen.en: Please tell me the result and put me out of my misery.
listen.zh: 拜託告訴我結果，別再讓我煎熬了。

chinese.en: The long commute in heavy traffic turned his daily routine into pure misery.
chinese.zh: 塞車中漫長的通勤讓他的日常生活變得痛苦不堪。

english.en: The cold weather added to the misery of the homeless.
english.zh: 寒冷的天氣讓無家可歸的人更加困苦。

speak.en: Exam week was total misery, but I'm glad it's over now.
speak.zh: 考試週真的很痛苦，不過很高興現在結束了。

write.en: Charities work hard to reduce the human misery caused by natural disasters.
write.zh: 慈善機構努力減輕天災帶來的人間苦難。

example.en: The library had run out of shelf space, so old journals were stacked in boxes along the corridor.
example.zh: 圖書館的書架已經放不下了，所以舊期刊都裝箱堆在走廊上。

listen.en: Could you stack the chairs after the meeting ends?
listen.zh: 會議結束後，你可以把椅子疊起來嗎？

chinese.en: She has a stack of essays to mark before the weekend, so she cancelled her plans.
chinese.zh: 她週末前還有一疊作文要批改，所以取消了原本的計畫。

english.en: The shelves in the shop were stacked with fresh bread.
english.zh: 店裡的架子上堆滿了新鮮的麵包。

speak.en: I always stack the dishes neatly before I start washing them.
speak.zh: 我在洗碗前總是先把碗盤疊整齊。

write.en: With little funding and few staff, the odds were stacked against the small charity.
write.zh: 由於資金和人手都不足，這個小型慈善團體處境極為不利。

example.en: The project cost in excess of the original budget, so the council had to cancel several other plans.
example.zh: 這項工程的花費超出原本的預算，所以議會不得不取消其他幾項計畫。

listen.en: I had to pay extra for excess baggage at the airport.
listen.zh: 我在機場因為行李超重而多付了錢。

chinese.en: Regular exercise helps the body burn excess fat and improves overall fitness.
chinese.zh: 規律運動有助於身體燃燒多餘的脂肪，並提升整體體能。

english.en: Eating sweets now and then is fine, but never to excess.
english.zh: 偶爾吃甜食沒關係，但千萬不要過量。

speak.en: I think social media in excess can really affect your mood.
speak.zh: 我覺得過度使用社群媒體真的會影響心情。

write.en: Farmers sometimes sell their excess produce at local markets at lower prices.
write.zh: 農民有時會把多餘的農產品以較低的價格在當地市場出售。

example.en: Hundreds of guests filled the hotel's banquet hall, where waiters served course after course of traditional dishes.
example.zh: 數百位賓客坐滿了飯店的宴會廳，服務生一道接一道地端上傳統菜餚。

listen.en: We were invited to a wedding banquet last weekend.
listen.zh: 我們上週末受邀參加一場婚宴。

chinese.en: At the end of the season, the club hosts a banquet to thank its volunteers.
chinese.zh: 每季結束時，這個社團都會舉辦宴會答謝志工。

english.en: The students organised a farewell banquet for their retiring teacher.
english.zh: 學生們為即將退休的老師籌辦了一場歡送宴。

speak.en: To be honest, I find big banquets tiring, but the food is usually amazing.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得大型宴會很累人，不過菜通常都非常好吃。

write.en: The president hosted a state banquet in honour of the visiting leaders.
write.zh: 總統設國宴款待來訪的各國領袖。

example.en: Most shops in the area close on Sundays, but the bakery on the corner is a welcome exception.
example.zh: 這一帶大部分的商店週日都不營業，但街角的麵包店是個令人欣喜的例外。

listen.en: The teacher made an exception and accepted my late essay.
listen.zh: 老師破例收下了我遲交的作文。

chinese.en: Long working hours are the rule rather than the exception in many big cities.
chinese.zh: 在許多大城市，長工時是常態而不是例外。

english.en: There is an exception to almost every grammar rule in English.
english.zh: 英文幾乎每條文法規則都有例外。

speak.en: I love all kinds of vegetables, and carrots are no exception.
speak.zh: 我喜歡各種蔬菜，紅蘿蔔也不例外。

write.en: All new employees, without exception, must complete the safety training by Friday.
write.zh: 所有新進員工都必須在週五前完成安全訓練，無一例外。

example.en: As people age, their bones can become thin and brittle, so even a small fall may cause a fracture.
example.zh: 人年紀漸長，骨頭可能會變得又薄又脆，因此即使輕輕跌一跤也可能骨折。

listen.en: Too much bleach can make your hair dry and brittle.
listen.zh: 漂白太多次會讓頭髮變得乾燥又容易斷。

chinese.en: The peace between the two neighbours remained brittle after years of arguments over the fence.
chinese.zh: 兩戶鄰居為了圍籬爭吵多年，彼此之間的和平依然很脆弱。

english.en: These dry autumn leaves are so brittle that they break when touched.
english.zh: 這些乾枯的秋葉非常脆，一碰就碎。

speak.en: My nails get really brittle in winter, so I use hand cream.
speak.zh: 我的指甲冬天會變得很脆，所以我會擦護手霜。

write.en: Behind his confident smile was a brittle ego that could not handle criticism.
write.zh: 在他自信的笑容背後，是一顆禁不起批評的脆弱自尊心。

example.en: In the early days, owning a mobile phone was a novelty, but now almost everyone has one.
example.zh: 早期擁有一支手機是件新奇的事，但現在幾乎人人都有。

listen.en: The novelty of the new job made every day exciting.
listen.zh: 新工作的新鮮感讓每一天都充滿期待。

chinese.en: Tourists come to the café mainly for the novelty of being served by robots.
chinese.zh: 遊客來這家咖啡館，主要是為了體驗由機器人送餐的新奇感。

english.en: Kids love new toys, but the novelty wears off quickly.
english.zh: 孩子喜歡新玩具，但新鮮感很快就消失了。

speak.en: I bought a novelty pen shaped like a banana, just for fun.
speak.zh: 我買了一支香蕉造型的趣味筆，純粹覺得好玩。

write.en: Companies use novelty in their advertising to grab the attention of younger consumers.
write.zh: 企業在廣告中運用新奇元素，吸引年輕消費者的注意。

example.en: The pavement outside the station was so crowded with commuters that some people had to step into the road.
example.zh: 車站外的人行道擠滿了通勤族，有些人只好走到馬路上。

listen.en: Be careful, the pavement is slippery after the rain.
listen.zh: 小心，下雨後人行道很滑。

chinese.en: Cars parked on the pavement force people with prams and wheelchairs to use the road.
chinese.zh: 停在人行道上的汽車迫使推嬰兒車和坐輪椅的人只能走在馬路上。

english.en: The city plans to widen the pavements in the old district.
english.zh: 市政府計畫拓寬舊城區的人行道。

speak.en: I love sitting at pavement cafés and watching people walk by.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡坐在路邊咖啡座看人來人往。

write.en: In summer, the black pavement can get hot enough to burn a dog's paws.
write.zh: 夏天時，黑色的柏油路面可能燙到足以灼傷狗的腳掌。

example.en: Because she had saved carefully for decades, she was able to take early retirement and travel around the world.
example.zh: 她幾十年來都小心存錢，所以能提早退休去環遊世界。

listen.en: He spends his retirement gardening and visiting his grandchildren.
listen.zh: 他退休後的時光都用來蒔花弄草、探望孫子。

chinese.en: Many countries are raising the retirement age because people are living longer.
chinese.zh: 由於人們越來越長壽，許多國家正在提高退休年齡。

english.en: You should start planning for retirement while you are still young.
english.zh: 你應該趁年輕就開始規劃退休生活。

speak.en: My grandma says retirement is the busiest time of her life.
speak.zh: 我奶奶說，退休是她人生中最忙碌的時期。

write.en: The famous tennis player surprised fans by coming out of retirement for one last tournament.
write.zh: 那位知名網球選手宣布復出參加最後一場比賽，讓球迷大感驚喜。

example.en: Words such as although and because are conjunctions, which join two clauses into a single sentence.
example.zh: although 和 because 這類字是連接詞，可以把兩個子句連成一個句子。

listen.en: This medicine works best in conjunction with a healthy diet.
listen.zh: 這種藥搭配健康飲食效果最好。

chinese.en: The festival is organised by the city council in conjunction with several local businesses.
chinese.zh: 這個節慶活動由市政府與幾家在地企業共同舉辦。

english.en: My teacher told me to use more conjunctions to link my ideas.
english.zh: 老師要我多用連接詞來串連我的想法。

speak.en: I use flashcards in conjunction with a vocabulary app.
speak.zh: 我把單字卡和背單字的應用程式搭配著一起用。

write.en: The conjunction of high temperatures and strong winds made the wildfire hard to control.
write.zh: 高溫加上強風，使這場野火難以控制。

example.en: A person can be a carrier of the virus without showing any symptoms, so testing is important.
example.zh: 一個人可能是病毒帶原者卻沒有任何症狀，所以檢測很重要。

listen.en: We flew with a low-cost carrier to save money.
listen.zh: 我們搭廉價航空以節省開支。

chinese.en: In many tropical regions, mosquitoes are the main carriers of several serious diseases.
chinese.zh: 在許多熱帶地區，蚊子是好幾種嚴重疾病的主要傳播媒介。

english.en: The mail carrier delivers letters to our street every morning.
english.zh: 郵差每天早上把信送到我們這條街。

speak.en: I switched phone carriers because my old plan was too expensive.
speak.zh: 我換了電信業者，因為原本的方案太貴了。

write.en: Some shipping carriers now offer cheaper rates for customers who choose slower delivery.
write.zh: 有些貨運業者現在對選擇較慢配送方式的顧客提供較便宜的費率。

example.en: Because demand for ivory remained high, elephant numbers kept falling despite strict laws against hunting them.
example.zh: 由於對象牙的需求居高不下，儘管有嚴格的禁獵法規，大象的數量仍持續減少。

listen.en: She wore an elegant ivory dress to the wedding.
listen.zh: 她穿了一件典雅的象牙色洋裝去參加婚禮。

chinese.en: Some critics say professors live in an ivory tower, far from the problems of ordinary people.
chinese.zh: 有些批評者說教授們住在象牙塔裡，遠離一般人所面對的問題。

english.en: The museum displays several ancient carvings that are made of ivory.
english.zh: 這間博物館展示了幾件以象牙雕成的古代雕刻品。

speak.en: We painted the living room ivory to make it feel brighter.
speak.zh: 我們把客廳漆成象牙白，讓空間感覺更明亮。

write.en: Customs officers seized a shipment of ivory hidden inside wooden furniture at the port.
write.zh: 海關人員在港口查獲一批藏在木製家具裡的象牙。

example.en: At the end of the ceremony, the bride turned around and threw her bouquet to the cheering guests behind her.
example.zh: 典禮結束時，新娘轉過身，把捧花拋向身後歡呼的賓客。

listen.en: The students gave their teacher a bouquet of sunflowers.
listen.zh: 學生們送給老師一束向日葵。

chinese.en: This red wine has a rich bouquet of cherries and spice that fills the glass.
chinese.zh: 這款紅酒帶有濃郁的櫻桃與香料香氣，充滿整個酒杯。

english.en: She bought a small bouquet at the market for her mother's birthday.
english.zh: 她在市場買了一小束花，送給媽媽當生日禮物。

speak.en: I think a simple bouquet is a lovely way to say thank you.
speak.zh: 我覺得送一束簡單的花是表達謝意的好方式。

write.en: Local florists say demand for bouquets doubles in the week before Valentine's Day.
write.zh: 當地花店表示，情人節前一週的花束需求會增加一倍。

example.en: Rubbish collection, street lighting and public parks are all municipal services paid for by local taxes.
example.zh: 垃圾清運、路燈和公園都是由地方稅收支應的市政服務。

listen.en: Our team practises at the municipal swimming pool on weekends.
listen.zh: 我們隊週末都在市立游泳池練習。

chinese.en: The municipal government plans to build more bike lanes to reduce traffic in the city centre.
chinese.zh: 市政府計畫增設自行車道，以減少市中心的車流。

english.en: Many young people did not vote in the municipal elections.
english.zh: 許多年輕人沒有在這次地方選舉中投票。

speak.en: I think municipal parks should stay open later in summer.
speak.zh: 我覺得市立公園夏天應該開放到更晚。

write.en: Her first job after graduation was as an engineer in the municipal water department.
write.zh: 她畢業後的第一份工作是在市政府水務單位擔任工程師。

example.en: The audience reacted with a mixture of laughter and confusion when the speaker suddenly started singing.
example.zh: 演講者突然唱起歌來，聽眾的反應是又笑又困惑。

listen.en: The city has an interesting mixture of old and new buildings.
listen.zh: 這座城市新舊建築交錯，很有意思。

chinese.en: The air we breathe is a mixture of gases, mostly nitrogen and oxygen.
chinese.zh: 我們呼吸的空氣是多種氣體的混合物，主要是氮氣和氧氣。

english.en: I felt a mixture of excitement and fear before my first flight.
english.zh: 第一次搭飛機前，我感到既興奮又害怕。

speak.en: My favourite drink is a mixture of green tea and lemon juice.
speak.zh: 我最喜歡的飲料是綠茶加檸檬汁。

write.en: The report recommends a mixture of tax incentives and education to cut household waste.
write.zh: 報告建議結合租稅優惠和教育宣導，以減少家庭垃圾。

example.en: The huge cost of the failed project bankrupted the company, and hundreds of employees lost their jobs overnight.
example.zh: 那項失敗計畫的龐大成本讓公司破產，數百名員工一夜之間失業。

listen.en: Without new customers, the shop will soon go bankrupt.
listen.zh: 如果沒有新客人，這家店很快就會破產。

chinese.en: Medical bills can bankrupt families who do not have proper health insurance.
chinese.zh: 對沒有完善健康保險的家庭來說，醫療費用可能讓他們破產。

english.en: He was declared bankrupt after failing to repay his loans.
english.zh: 他因無法償還貸款而被宣告破產。

speak.en: If I bought everything I wanted online, I'd be bankrupt by now.
speak.zh: 如果我在網路上想買什麼就買什麼，現在早就破產了。

write.en: Critics called the advertising campaign morally bankrupt because it targeted young children.
write.zh: 批評者認為這個廣告活動鎖定幼童為對象，毫無道德可言。

example.en: After working on the same project for years, she felt stale and decided to take a course in design.
example.zh: 在同一個專案上做了好幾年後，她覺得自己停滯不前、缺乏新意，於是決定去上設計課程。

listen.en: Open the windows, the air in here smells stale.
listen.zh: 打開窗戶吧，這裡的空氣聞起來很悶。

chinese.en: Critics said the film's jokes were stale and borrowed from much older comedies.
chinese.zh: 影評人說這部電影的笑話老掉牙，都是從更早期的喜劇搬來的。

english.en: Keep the biscuits in a tin so they don't go stale.
english.zh: 把餅乾放在鐵盒裡，才不會變得不新鮮。

speak.en: I think my English gets stale if I don't practise every week.
speak.zh: 我覺得如果不每週練習，我的英文就會生疏。

write.en: The government needs fresh ideas rather than repeating the same stale arguments about housing.
write.zh: 政府需要新的想法，而不是一再重複那些關於住房問題的老調。

example.en: The small restaurant has only a few tables and soft lighting, which creates an intimate atmosphere for dinner.
example.zh: 這家小餐廳只有幾張桌子，燈光柔和，營造出溫馨私密的用餐氣氛。

listen.en: The writer shares intimate details of her childhood in the book.
listen.zh: 作者在書中分享了她童年的私密細節。

chinese.en: Only her most intimate friends knew that she was planning to move abroad.
chinese.zh: 只有她最親密的朋友知道她正計畫搬到國外。

english.en: We had a small, intimate wedding with just our families.
english.zh: 我們辦了一場只有家人參加、小而溫馨的婚禮。

speak.en: I find small classes more intimate, so I feel comfortable asking questions.
speak.zh: 我覺得小班制比較親近，所以我敢放心發問。

write.en: Doctors must protect the intimate personal information that patients share during appointments.
write.zh: 醫生必須保護病患在看診時透露的私密個人資訊。

example.en: The light rain in the afternoon was just a prelude to the powerful storm that hit the coast that night.
example.zh: 下午的小雨只是前兆，當晚強烈的暴風雨就襲擊了沿海地區。

listen.en: The pianist opened the concert with a short prelude.
listen.zh: 鋼琴家以一首短短的前奏曲揭開音樂會序幕。

chinese.en: For many students, a summer internship is a useful prelude to a full-time career.
chinese.zh: 對許多學生來說，暑期實習是邁向正式職涯的實用起點。

english.en: The small argument was a prelude to a much bigger quarrel.
english.zh: 那次小爭執是一場更大爭吵的前兆。

speak.en: The welcome drinks were a nice prelude to the dinner party.
speak.zh: 迎賓飲料為晚宴揭開了愉快的序幕。

write.en: Rising prices are often a prelude to wider economic problems in a country.
write.zh: 物價上漲往往是一個國家出現更廣泛經濟問題的前兆。

example.en: Teenagers often feel awkward at family gatherings, especially when relatives keep asking about their grades.
example.zh: 青少年在家族聚會中常常覺得不自在，尤其是親戚一直問他們成績的時候。

listen.en: Sorry, have I called you at an awkward time?
listen.zh: 抱歉，我是不是在你不方便的時候打給你？

chinese.en: The new sofa was an awkward shape, so we couldn't get it through the door.
chinese.zh: 新沙發的形狀很不好搬，所以我們沒辦法把它搬進門。

english.en: The interviewer asked me an awkward question about my last job.
english.zh: 面試官問了我一個關於上一份工作的尷尬問題。

speak.en: I was really awkward when I first started learning to dance.
speak.zh: 我剛開始學跳舞的時候真的很笨手笨腳。

write.en: The new rules have put many small businesses in an awkward position with their customers.
write.zh: 新規定讓許多小商家在面對顧客時處境為難。

example.en: The book's photographs are accompanied by short notes that explain where and when each picture was taken.
example.zh: 書中的照片都附有簡短說明，解釋每張照片的拍攝地點與時間。

listen.en: My sister accompanied me to the doctor this morning.
listen.zh: 我姊姊今天早上陪我去看醫生。

chinese.en: Heavy rain accompanied by strong winds is expected across the island this weekend.
chinese.zh: 預計本週末全島將出現大雨並伴隨強風。

english.en: She accompanied the choir on the piano at the school concert.
english.zh: 她在學校音樂會上為合唱團鋼琴伴奏。

speak.en: I usually accompany my grandparents when they go shopping.
speak.zh: 我爺爺奶奶去買東西時，我通常會陪他們去。

write.en: Economic growth is often accompanied by rising pollution unless strict rules are introduced.
write.zh: 除非實施嚴格的規範，否則經濟成長往往伴隨著污染加劇。

example.en: Large areas of rainforest have been cleared to make way for palm oil plantations, threatening many animal species.
example.zh: 大片雨林遭到砍伐，改建為棕櫚油種植園，威脅到許多動物物種。

listen.en: His grandfather worked on a coffee plantation as a boy.
listen.zh: 他的祖父小時候在咖啡園工作。

chinese.en: The old sugar plantation has been turned into a museum about the island's farming history.
chinese.zh: 那座舊糖業種植園已改建成介紹島上農業歷史的博物館。

english.en: Most of the bananas we eat are grown on large plantations.
english.zh: 我們吃的香蕉大多種植在大型農園裡。

speak.en: Walking through the plantation early in the morning was really peaceful.
speak.zh: 一大早漫步在農園裡，感覺真的很寧靜。

write.en: The company planted a pine plantation on the hillside to prevent soil erosion.
write.zh: 這家公司在山坡上種了一片松樹人工林，以防止土壤流失。

example.en: In the late nineteenth century, cocaine was used in some medicines because doctors did not yet understand its dangers.
example.zh: 十九世紀末，由於醫生還不了解古柯鹼的危險，有些藥物裡會使用它。

listen.en: Customs officers found cocaine hidden inside a shipment of fruit.
listen.zh: 海關人員在一批水果貨物中發現藏匿的古柯鹼。

chinese.en: The documentary shows how cocaine addiction affects not only users but also their families.
chinese.zh: 這部紀錄片呈現古柯鹼成癮不只影響使用者本身，也會影響他們的家人。

english.en: Cocaine is made from the leaves of the coca plant.
english.zh: 古柯鹼是由古柯樹的葉子製成的。

speak.en: Our health class taught us how cocaine affects the brain.
speak.zh: 我們的健康教育課教我們古柯鹼如何影響大腦。

write.en: The government launched a campaign to reduce cocaine use among young adults in big cities.
write.zh: 政府推出一項宣導活動，以減少大城市年輕人使用古柯鹼的情況。

example.en: Sustainable forestry means cutting only a limited number of trees and replanting them, so the forest can recover.
example.zh: 永續林業是指只砍伐有限數量的樹木並重新種植，讓森林得以恢復。

listen.en: The town has depended on forestry for many generations.
listen.zh: 這個小鎮世世代代都仰賴林業維生。

chinese.en: Modern forestry uses drones to check the health of trees across large areas.
chinese.zh: 現代林業利用無人機檢查大範圍樹木的健康狀況。

english.en: The forestry department plants thousands of new trees every year.
english.zh: 林業部門每年種植數千棵新樹。

speak.en: I never thought forestry could be such an interesting career.
speak.zh: 我從沒想過林業會是這麼有趣的職業。

write.en: Poor forestry practices have caused landslides in several mountain villages after heavy rain.
write.zh: 不當的林業作業導致好幾個山區村落在大雨後發生山崩。

example.en: The school replaced fried snacks with fruit and vegetables after a study showed that many pupils had poor nutrition.
example.zh: 一項研究顯示許多學生營養不良後，學校便把油炸零食換成水果和蔬菜。

listen.en: Always check the nutrition label before you buy snacks.
listen.zh: 買零食前一定要看營養標示。

chinese.en: She took a course in sports nutrition to plan better meals for her team.
chinese.zh: 她修了一門運動營養學的課程，好為球隊規劃更好的餐點。

english.en: Many elderly people living alone do not get enough nutrition.
english.zh: 許多獨居長者沒有攝取足夠的營養。

speak.en: Since I started cooking at home, my nutrition has really improved.
speak.zh: 自從我開始在家煮飯，營養狀況真的改善了很多。

write.en: Experts argue that nutrition education should be part of every primary school curriculum.
write.zh: 專家主張營養教育應該納入每所小學的課程。

example.en: Visitors are often amazed to learn that the ancient temple was built without any modern machines or tools.
example.zh: 遊客得知這座古廟是在沒有任何現代機具的情況下建成的，常常大感驚奇。

listen.en: It amazes me how quickly children learn new languages.
listen.zh: 孩子學新語言的速度之快令我驚嘆。

chinese.en: We were amazed by the view from the top of the mountain after the long climb.
chinese.zh: 經過漫長的攀爬後，山頂的景色讓我們驚嘆不已。

english.en: Her progress in English never ceases to amaze her teachers.
english.zh: 她的英文進步總是讓老師們驚訝不已。

speak.en: Honestly, the food at the night market always amazes me.
speak.zh: 說真的，夜市的食物總是讓我很驚豔。

write.en: Recent advances in medical technology continue to amaze even the most experienced doctors.
write.zh: 醫療科技近年的進步，連經驗最豐富的醫生都持續感到驚嘆。

example.en: Moving abroad alone at eighteen was a difficult episode in her life, but it taught her to be independent.
example.zh: 十八歲獨自出國是她人生中一段艱難的經歷，但也讓她學會獨立。

listen.en: A new episode of the podcast comes out every Friday.
listen.zh: 這個 Podcast 每週五會推出新的一集。

chinese.en: The company would prefer to forget the whole episode and focus on rebuilding trust.
chinese.zh: 公司寧願忘掉整起事件，專心重建信任。

english.en: He had a brief episode of dizziness while standing in the sun.
english.zh: 他站在太陽下時，短暫出現了一陣頭暈。

speak.en: I usually watch an episode of something funny before going to bed.
speak.zh: 我睡前通常會看一集輕鬆好笑的節目。

write.en: Each episode of the documentary explores how a different city is tackling climate change.
write.zh: 這部紀錄片每一集都探討一座不同的城市如何因應氣候變遷。

example.en: She had prepared so thoroughly that the final exam was a breeze, and she finished an hour early.
example.zh: 她準備得非常充分，期末考對她來說輕而易舉，提早一小時就寫完了。

listen.en: The flags were moving gently in the morning breeze.
listen.zh: 旗子在清晨的微風中輕輕飄動。

chinese.en: He breezed through the job interview and was offered the position the next day.
chinese.zh: 他輕鬆通過工作面試，隔天就獲得了錄取。

english.en: With the new app, booking a train ticket is a breeze.
english.zh: 有了這個新應用程式，訂火車票變得輕而易舉。

speak.en: I love sitting by the river and feeling the breeze.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡坐在河邊吹吹微風。

write.en: Buildings designed to catch the breeze can stay cool without air conditioning in summer.
write.zh: 設計成能引進微風的建築，夏天不開冷氣也能保持涼爽。

example.en: The keyboard can be detached from the screen, so the laptop can also be used as a tablet.
example.zh: 鍵盤可以從螢幕上拆下來，所以這台筆電也能當平板使用。

listen.en: Carefully detach the lens before cleaning the camera.
listen.zh: 清潔相機前，先小心地把鏡頭拆下來。

chinese.en: Doctors must sometimes detach themselves emotionally in order to make difficult decisions.
chinese.zh: 醫生有時必須在情感上抽離，才能做出艱難的決定。

english.en: The trailer suddenly detached from the truck on the highway.
english.zh: 拖車在高速公路上突然和卡車脫離了。

speak.en: I like to detach myself from social media on weekends.
speak.zh: 我週末喜歡讓自己遠離社群媒體。

write.en: Some critics feel that politicians have become detached from the daily struggles of ordinary families.
write.zh: 有些評論者認為政治人物已經脫離了一般家庭的日常困境。

example.en: There was great excitement in the village when the news arrived that a famous director would film there.
example.zh: 當知名導演要來拍片的消息傳來時，村子裡一片興奮。

listen.en: I could hardly sleep last night because of the excitement.
listen.zh: 我昨晚太興奮了，幾乎睡不著。

chinese.en: For many students, the excitement of starting university is mixed with worries about money.
chinese.zh: 對許多學生來說，上大學的興奮中也夾雜著對金錢的擔憂。

english.en: Her voice was full of excitement when she told us the news.
english.zh: 她告訴我們這個消息時，語氣充滿了興奮。

speak.en: I think big cities offer more excitement than quiet country towns.
speak.zh: 我覺得大城市比安靜的鄉間小鎮更刺激有趣。

write.en: The launch of the new phone caused so much excitement that people queued overnight outside the shop.
write.zh: 新手機上市引起極大的轟動，人們甚至在店門外通宵排隊。

example.en: To avoid duplicating work, the two research teams agreed to share their data before starting new experiments.
example.zh: 為了避免重複作業，兩個研究團隊同意在開始新實驗前先分享各自的資料。

listen.en: Please delete any duplicate photos to free up space.
listen.zh: 請刪除重複的照片，騰出儲存空間。

chinese.en: The contract must be signed in duplicate, with one copy kept by each side.
chinese.zh: 這份合約必須一式兩份簽署，雙方各執一份。

english.en: She has never managed to duplicate the success of her first novel.
english.zh: 她始終無法再創第一本小說那樣的成功。

speak.en: I always keep a duplicate of important documents in the cloud.
speak.zh: 我總是把重要文件的副本存一份在雲端。

write.en: Different government agencies often duplicate each other's services, which wastes taxpayers' money.
write.zh: 不同政府機關的服務經常疊床架屋，浪費納稅人的錢。

example.en: After dating for several years, Tom and his girlfriend decided to rent a flat together near their offices.
example.zh: 交往幾年後，湯姆和女友決定在公司附近一起租間公寓。

listen.en: My brother is cooking dinner for his girlfriend tonight.
listen.zh: 我哥哥今晚要煮晚餐給女朋友吃。

chinese.en: She spent the weekend at the beach with a group of her girlfriends from university.
chinese.zh: 她週末和幾個大學時代的姊妹淘去了海邊。

english.en: His girlfriend is studying to become a nurse in Taipei.
english.zh: 他的女朋友正在臺北念書，準備成為護理師。

speak.en: My best friend just got a girlfriend, so I hardly see him now.
speak.zh: 我最好的朋友剛交了女朋友，所以我現在很少見到他。

write.en: A survey found that many young men discuss career plans with their girlfriends before accepting job offers.
write.zh: 一項調查發現，許多年輕男性在接受工作邀約前，會先和女友討論職涯規劃。

example.en: The old town is a jumble of narrow streets and tiny shops, so visitors easily get lost without a map.
example.zh: 舊城區巷弄狹窄、小店林立，錯綜雜亂，遊客沒有地圖很容易迷路。

listen.en: All my notes got jumbled up when I dropped the folder.
listen.zh: 資料夾掉到地上，我的筆記全都混在一起了。

chinese.en: His essay was a jumble of good ideas without any clear structure.
chinese.zh: 他的作文雖然有不少好點子，卻雜亂無章，毫無清楚的架構。

english.en: The letters in each word have been jumbled to make a puzzle.
english.zh: 每個單字的字母都被打亂，做成了一個謎題。

speak.en: My thoughts were all jumbled, so I paused before answering.
speak.zh: 我的思緒一團亂，所以回答前先停頓了一下。

write.en: The school held a jumble sale to raise money for new library books.
write.zh: 學校舉辦二手義賣會，為圖書館募款購買新書。

example.en: The café roasts its own coffee beans every morning, which is why the whole street smells so wonderful.
example.zh: 這家咖啡館每天早上自己烘焙咖啡豆，所以整條街都飄著香氣。

listen.en: We had roast beef and potatoes for lunch today.
listen.zh: 我們今天午餐吃了烤牛肉和馬鈴薯。

chinese.en: Roasting vegetables brings out their natural sweetness and makes them more appealing to children.
chinese.zh: 烤蔬菜能帶出它們天然的甜味，也讓孩子更願意吃。

english.en: In winter, people sell roasted sweet potatoes on the street.
english.zh: 冬天時，街上有人在賣烤地瓜。

speak.en: A traditional Sunday roast is my favourite meal when I visit friends in Britain.
speak.zh: 到英國拜訪朋友時，傳統的週日烤肉大餐是我最愛的一餐。

write.en: Farmers in the region roast tea leaves over charcoal to create a rich, smoky flavour.
write.zh: 這個地區的農民用炭火焙茶，做出濃郁的煙燻風味。

example.en: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity, which can then be stored in batteries for use at night.
example.zh: 太陽能板把陽光轉換成電力，再儲存在電池裡供夜間使用。

listen.en: Can you convert these old videos into digital files?
listen.zh: 你可以把這些舊錄影帶轉成數位檔案嗎？

chinese.en: I converted my savings into Japanese yen before my trip to Tokyo.
chinese.zh: 去東京旅行前，我把存款換成了日圓。

english.en: This sofa easily converts into a comfortable bed for overnight guests.
english.zh: 這張沙發可以輕鬆變成一張舒適的床，給過夜的客人睡。

speak.en: I used to hate running, but now I'm a complete convert.
speak.zh: 我以前很討厭跑步，但現在完全愛上了。

write.en: Many cities are converting empty office buildings into affordable housing for young people.
write.zh: 許多城市正把閒置的辦公大樓改建成年輕人負擔得起的住宅。

example.en: The cyclist fell off his bike on the wet road, but his helmet protected his head from serious injury.
example.zh: 那位自行車騎士在濕滑的路上摔車，所幸安全帽保護他的頭部免於重傷。

listen.en: Workers on the building site must wear safety helmets.
listen.zh: 工地裡的工人必須戴安全帽。

chinese.en: In Taiwan, scooter riders who do not wear a helmet can be fined by the police.
chinese.zh: 在臺灣，騎機車不戴安全帽可能會被警察開罰單。

english.en: He took off his helmet and wiped his sweaty face.
english.zh: 他脫下安全帽，擦了擦滿是汗水的臉。

speak.en: I always keep a spare helmet under my scooter seat.
speak.zh: 我總是在機車座墊下放一頂備用安全帽。

write.en: Astronauts' helmets are designed to supply oxygen and protect their eyes from strong sunlight.
write.zh: 太空人的頭盔設計成能供應氧氣，並保護眼睛不受強烈陽光傷害。

example.en: After weeks of rain, the sun finally came out, and the view from the hilltop was simply marvelous.
example.zh: 下了好幾週的雨之後，太陽終於露臉，從山頂望出去的景色簡直美極了。

listen.en: The new library has a marvelous collection of old maps.
listen.zh: 新圖書館收藏了一批很棒的古地圖。

chinese.en: The volunteers did a marvelous job of cleaning up the park after the festival.
chinese.zh: 志工們在節慶結束後清理公園，做得非常出色。

english.en: My teacher said that my presentation on climate change was marvelous.
english.zh: 老師說我那場關於氣候變遷的報告做得非常好。

speak.en: Honestly, the food at that little night market was marvelous.
speak.zh: 說真的，那個小夜市的食物好吃極了。

write.en: Public transport in the city has improved, and the new metro line is a marvelous addition.
write.zh: 這座城市的大眾運輸已有改善，新的捷運線更是一項很棒的新建設。

example.en: Passengers must check in at least an hour prior to departure, or they may not be allowed to board.
example.zh: 旅客必須在起飛前至少一小時辦理報到，否則可能無法登機。

listen.en: Students should read the article prior to the seminar.
listen.zh: 學生應該在研討課之前讀完這篇文章。

chinese.en: The company cannot change your working hours without giving you prior notice.
chinese.zh: 公司不能在沒有事先通知的情況下更改你的工作時間。

english.en: Some prior knowledge of statistics will help you in this course.
english.zh: 事先具備一些統計學知識，會對你修這門課有幫助。

speak.en: I'd never really cooked anything prior to moving out.
speak.zh: 搬出去住之前，我其實從沒真正下廚過。

write.en: Prior to the introduction of the smoking ban, many restaurants were filled with smoke.
write.zh: 在禁菸令實施之前，許多餐廳裡都煙霧瀰漫。

example.en: Rather than laughing at the misfortunes of others, we should think about how we could help them.
example.zh: 與其嘲笑別人的不幸，我們應該想想自己能如何幫助他們。

listen.en: The old farmer never recovered from that misfortune.
listen.zh: 那位老農夫始終沒能從那次不幸中走出來。

chinese.en: Losing his job turned out to be a misfortune that led him to start his own business.
chinese.zh: 失業原本是一件不幸的事，結果卻促使他自己創業。

english.en: Many people believe that misfortune can make a person stronger.
english.zh: 許多人相信不幸的遭遇能讓人變得更堅強。

speak.en: I had the misfortune of sitting next to a very noisy passenger.
speak.zh: 我很倒楣，坐在一位非常吵的乘客旁邊。

write.en: Government insurance schemes protect farmers from financial misfortune caused by floods and droughts.
write.zh: 政府的保險制度能保護農民，避免他們因水災和旱災而陷入經濟困境。

example.en: Although her voice was stern, the coach smiled afterwards, showing she was not really angry with the team.
example.zh: 雖然教練的語氣很嚴厲，事後她卻露出微笑，表示她其實並沒有真的生球隊的氣。

listen.en: My grandfather had a stern face but a kind heart.
listen.zh: 我爺爺外表嚴肅，心地卻很善良。

chinese.en: The government has promised stern measures against companies that pollute local rivers.
chinese.zh: 政府承諾將對汙染當地河川的企業採取嚴厲措施。

english.en: We sat at the stern of the boat and watched the sunset.
english.zh: 我們坐在船尾看夕陽。

speak.en: My boss gave me a stern look when I arrived late.
speak.zh: 我遲到的時候，老闆嚴厲地看了我一眼。

write.en: Parents sometimes need to be stern, but they should also explain their reasons.
write.zh: 父母有時需要嚴厲一點，但也應該說明理由。

example.en: Due to adverse weather conditions, including strong winds and heavy snow, all flights were canceled this morning.
example.zh: 由於強風和大雪等惡劣天候，今天早上所有航班都取消了。

listen.en: Some patients had an adverse reaction to the new medicine.
listen.zh: 有些病人對這種新藥產生了不良反應。

chinese.en: Critics argue that the new tax will have an adverse impact on small businesses.
chinese.zh: 批評者認為這項新稅制會對小型企業造成不利影響。

english.en: Too much screen time may have adverse effects on children's sleep.
english.zh: 看螢幕的時間太長，可能會對孩子的睡眠產生不良影響。

speak.en: Honestly, I haven't noticed any adverse effects from drinking coffee every day.
speak.zh: 老實說，我每天喝咖啡，並沒有發現什麼不良影響。

write.en: Rising sea levels could have adverse consequences for coastal communities around the world.
write.zh: 海平面上升可能會為全球沿海社區帶來不利的後果。

example.en: The letter was rude, but the writer insisted that his intent had been to help, not to criticize.
example.zh: 那封信語氣很不客氣，但寫信的人堅稱他的本意是想幫忙，而不是批評。

listen.en: She was so intent on her book that she missed her stop.
listen.zh: 她看書看得太專心，結果坐過站了。

chinese.en: The two companies signed a letter of intent to work together on electric cars.
chinese.zh: 兩家公司簽署了意向書，準備合作開發電動車。

english.en: The government is intent on reducing air pollution in big cities.
english.zh: 政府決心要減少大城市的空氣汙染。

speak.en: I wasn't trying to upset anyone; that was never my intent.
speak.zh: 我沒有要惹誰不高興，那從來不是我的本意。

write.en: The new law was passed with the intent of protecting young workers from long hours.
write.zh: 這項新法通過的目的，是保護年輕勞工不必長時間工作。

example.en: The school abolished its strict uniform rules last year, and students can now wear their own clothes.
example.zh: 這所學校去年廢除了嚴格的制服規定，學生現在可以穿自己的衣服上學。

listen.en: The city council voted to abolish the old parking tax.
listen.zh: 市議會投票通過廢除舊的停車稅。

chinese.en: Some economists argue that abolishing the minimum wage would harm low-income workers.
chinese.zh: 有些經濟學家認為，廢除基本工資會傷害低收入勞工。

english.en: The company has decided to abolish overtime work on weekends.
english.zh: 公司已決定取消週末加班。

speak.en: If I could abolish one school rule, it would be homework on holidays.
speak.zh: 如果我能廢除一條校規，那就是假日作業。

write.en: Slavery was finally abolished in most countries during the course of the nineteenth century.
write.zh: 奴隸制度在十九世紀期間終於在大多數國家被廢除。

example.en: Because the terrain is so steep and muddy, only small four-wheel-drive vehicles can reach the remote village.
example.zh: 由於地勢又陡又泥濘，只有小型四輪傳動車才能到達那個偏遠的村莊。

listen.en: Mountain bikes are designed for riding on rough terrain.
listen.zh: 登山車是專為在崎嶇地形上騎乘而設計的。

chinese.en: Taiwan's mountainous terrain makes building railways along the east coast expensive and difficult.
chinese.zh: 臺灣多山的地形，使得在東海岸興建鐵路既昂貴又困難。

english.en: The flat terrain in this area is ideal for growing rice.
english.zh: 這個地區地勢平坦，非常適合種植稻米。

speak.en: I love cycling, but I avoid hilly terrain because it's exhausting.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡騎腳踏車，但我會避開丘陵地形，因為太累了。

write.en: Engineers studied the terrain carefully before deciding where to build the new wind farm.
write.zh: 工程師在決定新風力發電場的建造地點之前，仔細研究了當地地形。

example.en: According to new health guidelines, adults should get at least half an hour of exercise most days of the week.
example.zh: 根據新的健康指引，成年人一週中大多數日子都應該至少運動半小時。

listen.en: The teacher gave us clear guidelines for the essay.
listen.zh: 老師給了我們寫這篇作文的明確指引。

chinese.en: The government has issued guidelines on how schools should deal with bullying.
chinese.zh: 政府已發布指引，說明學校應如何處理霸凌問題。

english.en: These guidelines will help new students choose the right courses.
english.zh: 這些指引能幫助新生選擇合適的課程。

speak.en: To be honest, I think those guidelines are a bit too strict.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得那些規範有點太嚴格了。

write.en: The website sets out simple guidelines for recycling plastic, paper and glass at home.
write.zh: 這個網站列出了在家回收塑膠、紙類和玻璃的簡單準則。

example.en: The study only involved a few students from one school, so we cannot generalize its results to all teenagers.
example.zh: 這項研究只涵蓋一所學校的少數學生，所以我們不能把結果推論到所有青少年身上。

listen.en: Try not to generalize about a whole group of people.
listen.zh: 盡量不要對一整群人一概而論。

chinese.en: Scientists are careful not to generalize from small samples when they report their findings.
chinese.zh: 科學家在發表研究結果時，會小心避免從小樣本推論出普遍結論。

english.en: It is hard to generalize about the weather in such a large country.
english.zh: 這個國家這麼大，很難概括地描述它的天氣。

speak.en: I don't want to generalize, but most of my friends prefer texting.
speak.zh: 我不想以偏概全，但我大部分的朋友都比較喜歡傳訊息。

write.en: Children learn grammar by generalizing patterns from the language they hear around them.
write.zh: 兒童透過從周遭聽到的語言中歸納規則來學習文法。

example.en: The young chess player faced a formidable opponent who had not lost a single game in three years.
example.zh: 這位年輕棋手面對的是一位三年來從未輸過一盤棋的強大對手。

listen.en: Learning a new language as an adult can be a formidable challenge.
listen.zh: 成年後學習一門新語言，可能是一項艱鉅的挑戰。

chinese.en: The professor has a formidable reputation, but students say she is very patient in class.
chinese.zh: 這位教授的名聲令人敬畏，但學生們說她上課非常有耐心。

english.en: Climate change remains a formidable problem for governments around the world.
english.zh: 氣候變遷仍是全球各國政府面臨的一大難題。

speak.en: Our team is good, but the other side looks formidable this year.
speak.zh: 我們隊很強，但今年對手看起來非常難對付。

write.en: With her formidable memory, the old librarian could find any book without checking the computer.
write.zh: 那位老圖書館員記憶力驚人，不用查電腦就能找到任何一本書。

example.en: At the education fair, each university set up a booth where students could ask questions about courses and scholarships.
example.zh: 在教育展上，每所大學都設了攤位，讓學生詢問課程和獎學金的相關問題。

listen.en: Please ask at the information booth if you get lost.
listen.zh: 如果迷路了，請到服務亭詢問。

chinese.en: The restaurant has comfortable booths by the window, so we usually sit there.
chinese.zh: 那家餐廳靠窗處有舒適的卡座，所以我們通常坐那裡。

english.en: My friends and I took funny pictures in a photo booth.
english.zh: 我和朋友在大頭貼機裡拍了好笑的照片。

speak.en: There used to be a phone booth on almost every street corner.
speak.zh: 以前幾乎每個街角都有電話亭。

write.en: Interpreters at the conference worked inside soundproof booths at the back of the hall.
write.zh: 會議的口譯員在大廳後方的隔音口譯室裡工作。

example.en: The players walked off the field in protest after the referee made a decision they thought was unfair.
example.zh: 裁判做出球員認為不公平的判決後，他們走出球場以示抗議。

listen.en: The students held a peaceful protest outside the library.
listen.zh: 學生們在圖書館外面舉行了和平抗議。

chinese.en: Despite strong protests from local farmers, the factory was built next to the river.
chinese.zh: 儘管當地農民強烈抗議，那座工廠還是蓋在河邊了。

english.en: Many parents protested about the rise in school lunch prices.
english.zh: 許多家長對學校午餐漲價提出抗議。

speak.en: My little brother always protests when it's his turn to wash the dishes.
speak.zh: 輪到我弟弟洗碗時，他總是會抗議。

write.en: Online petitions have become a popular way to protest without going into the streets.
write.zh: 線上連署已成為不必走上街頭也能表達抗議的熱門方式。

example.en: Residents showed great civic pride by planting trees and cleaning the streets before the city's anniversary celebration.
example.zh: 居民們在城市週年慶之前種樹、打掃街道，展現了強烈的市民榮譽感。

listen.en: The new civic center has a theater and a library.
listen.zh: 新的市民活動中心設有劇場和圖書館。

chinese.en: Schools should encourage civic responsibility by getting students involved in community projects.
chinese.zh: 學校應該讓學生參與社區計畫，藉此培養公民責任感。

english.en: Volunteering at a local animal shelter is a good example of civic engagement.
english.zh: 在當地的動物收容所當志工，是公民參與的好例子。

speak.en: I think young people should take a more active role in civic life.
speak.zh: 我覺得年輕人應該更積極參與公共事務。

write.en: The town hall organizes civic events, such as concerts and festivals, throughout the year.
write.zh: 鎮公所全年都會舉辦市民活動，例如音樂會和節慶。

example.en: The judge overruled the lawyer's objection and allowed the witness to continue answering the question.
example.zh: 法官駁回了律師的異議，允許證人繼續回答問題。

listen.en: The head coach overruled his assistant and changed the team.
listen.zh: 總教練否決了助理的意見，更換了球員陣容。

chinese.en: The school board overruled the principal and decided to keep the music program.
chinese.zh: 學校董事會否決了校長的意見，決定保留音樂課程。

english.en: My parents overruled me and booked a beach holiday instead.
english.zh: 我爸媽否決了我的意見，改訂了海邊度假行程。

speak.en: I wanted pizza, but I was overruled by everyone else.
speak.zh: 我想吃披薩，但被其他人否決了。

write.en: In some cases, the central government can overrule local councils on major planning decisions.
write.zh: 在某些情況下，中央政府可以推翻地方議會在重大都市計畫上的決定。

example.en: As the population ages, the government must train more nurses to care for the elderly in their own homes.
example.zh: 隨著人口老化，政府必須培訓更多護理人員，到府照顧老年人。

listen.en: The young man helped an elderly woman carry her shopping.
listen.zh: 那位年輕人幫一位老太太提她買的東西。

chinese.en: Public buses in this city are free for elderly passengers and students.
chinese.zh: 這座城市的公車對年長乘客和學生免費。

english.en: I try to visit my elderly grandparents in the countryside every weekend.
english.zh: 我盡量每個週末都去鄉下探望年邁的祖父母。

speak.en: My neighbor is elderly, so I sometimes help her with groceries.
speak.zh: 我的鄰居年紀大了，所以我有時會幫她買菜。

write.en: Some companies are designing simple smartphones especially for elderly users who find technology confusing.
write.zh: 有些公司專為覺得科技產品難以使用的年長者設計簡易智慧型手機。

example.en: By morning, a thick blanket of fog had covered the valley, and drivers could barely see the road ahead.
example.zh: 到了早上，一層濃霧籠罩了山谷，駕駛幾乎看不清前方的道路。

listen.en: The hills were blanketed with snow after the storm.
listen.zh: 暴風雪過後，山丘覆蓋了一片白雪。

chinese.en: Some people think a blanket ban on plastic bags is too extreme for small shops.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為，全面禁用塑膠袋對小商店來說太過極端。

english.en: Could you bring me an extra blanket? It's cold tonight.
english.zh: 你可以再拿一條毯子給我嗎？今晚好冷。

speak.en: We spread a blanket on the grass and had a picnic.
speak.zh: 我們在草地上鋪了毯子野餐。

write.en: Fallen leaves blanket the park every autumn, creating a beautiful carpet of red and gold.
write.zh: 每年秋天，落葉鋪滿整座公園，形成一片紅黃交織的美麗地毯。

example.en: The bank noticed that the signature on the document looked unusual and realized someone had forged it.
example.zh: 銀行發現文件上的簽名看起來不太對勁，才察覺有人偽造了簽名。

listen.en: She forged close friendships during her year abroad.
listen.zh: 她在國外的那一年建立了深厚的友誼。

chinese.en: Despite the heavy rain, the team forged ahead with the outdoor concert as planned.
chinese.zh: 儘管下著大雨，團隊仍照原定計畫繼續舉辦戶外音樂會。

english.en: Team sports can help young people forge friendships with others.
english.zh: 團隊運動能幫助年輕人和他人建立友誼。

speak.en: I really forged some great connections at my last job.
speak.zh: 我在上一份工作中真的建立了很棒的人脈。

write.en: Skilled workers once forged knives and farm tools from hot iron in small village workshops.
write.zh: 過去，技藝純熟的工匠會在村裡的小作坊用燒紅的鐵打造刀具和農具。

example.en: Before writing your dissertation, you need a clear theoretical framework that explains how you will analyze the data.
example.zh: 在寫畢業論文之前，你需要一個清楚的理論架構，說明你將如何分析資料。

listen.en: The wooden framework of the old house is still strong.
listen.zh: 那棟老房子的木造骨架仍然很堅固。

chinese.en: All member countries must act within the framework of the international agreement on climate.
chinese.zh: 所有成員國都必須在這項國際氣候協議的架構下行動。

english.en: Our teacher gave us a simple framework for writing essays.
english.zh: 老師給了我們一個寫作文的簡單架構。

speak.en: I like having a basic framework before I start any big project.
speak.zh: 開始任何大型專案之前，我喜歡先有個基本架構。

write.en: Many countries still lack a legal framework to deal with problems caused by artificial intelligence.
write.zh: 許多國家仍缺乏處理人工智慧相關問題的法律架構。

example.en: Before planes became common, wealthy travelers crossed the Atlantic on huge ocean liners that took about a week.
example.zh: 在搭飛機普及之前，有錢的旅客會搭乘巨大的遠洋客輪橫渡大西洋，航程大約要一週。

listen.en: Remember to put a new liner in the kitchen bin.
listen.zh: 記得在廚房垃圾桶裡套上新的垃圾袋。

chinese.en: The jacket comes with a removable liner, so you can wear it in any season.
chinese.zh: 這件外套附有可拆式內裡，所以一年四季都能穿。

english.en: Thousands of tourists arrived in the city on a huge liner.
english.zh: 數千名觀光客搭乘一艘巨型郵輪抵達這座城市。

speak.en: I've always wanted to go on a holiday aboard a luxury liner.
speak.zh: 我一直很想搭豪華郵輪去度假。

write.en: Large cruise liners bring money to port cities, but they also cause serious air pollution.
write.zh: 大型郵輪為港口城市帶來收入，但也造成嚴重的空氣汙染。

example.en: Like many entrepreneurs, she risked all her savings to launch the company, hoping customers would love her designs.
example.zh: 和許多創業者一樣，她把所有積蓄都押上來創立公司，希望顧客會喜歡她的設計。

listen.en: The young entrepreneur sells handmade soap at weekend markets.
listen.zh: 那位年輕創業者在週末市集販售手工皂。

chinese.en: The government offers low-interest loans to help young entrepreneurs start their own businesses.
chinese.zh: 政府提供低利貸款，幫助年輕創業者自行創業。

english.en: Many successful entrepreneurs failed several times before they finally succeeded.
english.zh: 許多成功的企業家在最終成功之前，都失敗過好幾次。

speak.en: I'd love to be an entrepreneur, but I'm scared of taking risks.
speak.zh: 我很想當創業家，但我很怕冒險。

write.en: Social entrepreneurs use business ideas to solve problems such as poverty and pollution.
write.zh: 社會企業家運用商業點子來解決貧窮和汙染等問題。

example.en: Negotiations between the two companies stalled when neither side would agree to lower its price.
example.zh: 兩家公司都不肯降價，雙方的談判因此陷入僵局。

listen.en: Our old car stalled at the traffic lights again.
listen.zh: 我們的老車又在紅綠燈前熄火了。

chinese.en: When the teacher asked for his homework, Tom tried to stall by looking through his bag slowly.
chinese.zh: 老師要他交作業時，湯姆故意慢慢翻書包，想拖延時間。

english.en: There are many food stalls selling local snacks along this street.
english.zh: 這條街上有許多販賣當地小吃的攤販。

speak.en: My favorite stall at the market sells really cheap noodles.
speak.zh: 市場裡我最愛的攤位賣的麵非常便宜。

write.en: Economic growth has stalled in recent months because consumers are spending less money.
write.zh: 由於消費者減少支出，近幾個月來經濟成長停滯不前。

example.en: Several companies made a pledge to cut their carbon emissions in half, but critics doubt they will keep it.
example.zh: 有幾家企業承諾將碳排放量減半，但批評者懷疑他們能否做到。

listen.en: Local businesses pledged their support for the charity run.
listen.zh: 當地商家承諾支持這場慈善路跑。

chinese.en: Fans around the world pledged money to help the band record its new album.
chinese.zh: 世界各地的歌迷紛紛認捐，幫助樂團錄製新專輯。

english.en: I made a pledge to read more books this year.
english.zh: 我向自己承諾，今年要多讀一些書。

speak.en: Every New Year, I pledge to exercise more, but I never do.
speak.zh: 每年新年我都發誓要多運動，但從來沒做到。

write.en: World leaders pledged billions of dollars to protect rainforests at the climate summit.
write.zh: 世界各國領袖在氣候高峰會上承諾投入數十億美元保護雨林。

example.en: At the border, travelers had to surrender their passports to officers, who checked them carefully before returning them.
example.zh: 在邊境，旅客必須把護照交給官員，官員仔細檢查後才歸還。

listen.en: I finally surrendered and ate the last piece of cake.
listen.zh: 我最後還是投降了，吃掉了最後那塊蛋糕。

chinese.en: The team refused to surrender even when they were losing badly in the second half.
chinese.zh: 即使下半場大幅落後，這支隊伍仍拒絕認輸。

english.en: Some farmers were forced to surrender their land to the government.
english.zh: 有些農民被迫把土地交給政府。

speak.en: Whenever I'm on a diet, I end up surrendering to temptation.
speak.zh: 每次我節食，最後都會抵擋不了誘惑。

write.en: After hours of argument, her father's surrender came when he finally agreed to buy a puppy.
write.zh: 爭論了好幾個小時後，她爸爸終於投降，答應買一隻小狗。

example.en: The engineers measured the diameter of each pipe to make sure it was wide enough to carry the water.
example.zh: 工程師測量了每根管子的直徑，確保管子夠寬，足以輸送水流。

listen.en: Please measure the diameter of the circle with a ruler.
listen.zh: 請用尺量出這個圓的直徑。

chinese.en: The pizza has a diameter of thirty centimetres, which is enough for two people.
chinese.zh: 這個披薩直徑三十公分，夠兩個人吃。

english.en: The diameter of a circle is twice the length of its radius.
english.zh: 圓的直徑是半徑長度的兩倍。

speak.en: The bowl was huge, with a diameter bigger than my head.
speak.zh: 那個碗超大，直徑比我的頭還大。

write.en: Scientists believe the crater was formed by a meteor about a kilometre in diameter.
write.zh: 科學家認為這個隕石坑是由一顆直徑約一公里的隕石撞擊形成的。

example.en: The cathedral took over a century to complete, but today it is admired as a masterpiece of architecture.
example.zh: 這座大教堂花了一百多年才完工，如今被譽為建築傑作。

listen.en: The museum's most famous masterpiece hangs in the main hall.
listen.zh: 博物館最著名的傑作掛在主展廳裡。

chinese.en: Some people argue that video games can be artistic masterpieces, just like films.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為電子遊戲也可以像電影一樣，成為藝術傑作。

english.en: This film is a masterpiece that everyone should see at least once.
english.zh: 這部電影是每個人至少都該看一次的經典之作。

speak.en: My mum's beef noodle soup is a real masterpiece.
speak.zh: 我媽媽做的牛肉麵真的是一絕。

write.en: The young designer created a masterpiece using only recycled plastic and old fabric.
write.zh: 那位年輕設計師只用回收塑膠和舊布料，就創作出一件傑作。

example.en: After years of neglect, the old theater was finally repaired and reopened as a community arts center.
example.zh: 經過多年荒廢，這座老戲院終於修復，重新開放成為社區藝術中心。

listen.en: Don't neglect your health just because you're busy.
listen.zh: 別因為忙碌就忽略了自己的健康。

chinese.en: The report criticized the city for neglecting public parks in poorer neighborhoods.
chinese.zh: 這份報告批評市政府忽視較貧困社區的公園。

english.en: He neglected to tell his boss that he would be late.
english.zh: 他忘了告訴老闆自己會晚到。

speak.en: I've been neglecting my plants, and now they're all dying.
speak.zh: 我一直沒照顧我的植物，現在它們都快枯死了。

write.en: Experts warn that the neglect of mental health in schools could lead to serious problems later.
write.zh: 專家警告，學校忽視心理健康可能會在日後導致嚴重問題。

example.en: Many shoppers seem oblivious to the environmental cost of cheap clothes that are worn only a few times.
example.zh: 許多消費者似乎沒察覺到，只穿幾次的廉價衣服會讓環境付出代價。

listen.en: She was oblivious to the rain as she danced in the street.
listen.zh: 她在街上跳舞，完全沒注意到在下雨。

chinese.en: The tourists were oblivious to the fact that they were standing on private land.
chinese.zh: 那些觀光客渾然不知自己正站在私人土地上。

english.en: Young children are often oblivious to danger near busy roads.
english.zh: 幼童在車多的馬路旁常常察覺不到危險。

speak.en: I was so tired that I was oblivious to my alarm this morning.
speak.zh: 我累到今天早上連鬧鐘響都沒聽到。

write.en: Staring at their phones, many pedestrians walk across the road oblivious of the traffic.
write.zh: 許多行人盯著手機過馬路，對來往車輛渾然不覺。

example.en: Farmers once drained the marsh to grow crops, but now the area is being restored to protect wildlife.
example.zh: 農民過去曾抽乾這片沼澤來種植作物，但現在這個地區正在復育，以保護野生動物。

listen.en: We walked along a wooden path through the marsh.
listen.zh: 我們沿著木棧道穿過沼澤。

chinese.en: Salt marshes protect coastal towns by absorbing water during storms and high tides.
chinese.zh: 鹽沼能在暴風雨和漲潮時吸收海水，保護沿海城鎮。

english.en: The marsh is home to frogs, insects and many kinds of birds.
english.zh: 這片沼澤是青蛙、昆蟲和許多鳥類的棲息地。

speak.en: The marsh near my grandparents' house smells a bit, but it's beautiful.
speak.zh: 我爺爺奶奶家附近的沼澤有點臭，但很漂亮。

write.en: Building a new airport on the marsh would destroy an important habitat for migrating birds.
write.zh: 在這片沼澤上興建新機場，將會破壞候鳥重要的棲息地。

example.en: The project failed mainly because of a breakdown in communication between the designers and the engineers.
example.zh: 這個專案失敗，主要是因為設計師和工程師之間溝通破裂。

listen.en: The manager asked for a breakdown of the monthly costs.
listen.zh: 經理要求提供每月費用的明細。

chinese.en: The chart shows a breakdown of household spending by category, such as food and housing.
chinese.zh: 這張圖表依類別列出家庭支出的細項，例如飲食和住房。

english.en: Working too hard for too long can lead to a breakdown.
english.zh: 長期過度工作可能導致精神崩潰。

speak.en: My phone had a total breakdown right before my flight.
speak.zh: 我的手機就在搭飛機前完全壞掉了。

write.en: Experts blame the breakdown of traditional family support for growing loneliness among older people.
write.zh: 專家認為，傳統家庭支持系統的瓦解，是長者越來越孤單的原因。

example.en: Although the students said they were bored, the underlying problem was that the lessons were far too difficult for them.
example.zh: 雖然學生說他們覺得無聊，但根本問題在於課程對他們來說實在太難了。

listen.en: Doctors are trying to find the underlying reason for her headaches.
listen.zh: 醫生正在設法找出她頭痛的根本原因。

chinese.en: People with underlying health conditions are advised to get vaccinated before winter.
chinese.zh: 本身有潛在疾病的人，建議在入冬前接種疫苗。

english.en: The film is funny, but its underlying message is quite serious.
english.zh: 這部電影很好笑，但它背後傳達的訊息相當嚴肅。

speak.en: I think the underlying issue is that we don't talk enough.
speak.zh: 我覺得根本的問題是我們溝通得不夠。

write.en: Geologists studied the underlying rock to decide whether the land was safe for building.
write.zh: 地質學家研究了地底下的岩層，以判斷這塊地是否適合建築。

example.en: When two boys broke a window during break time, they were sent straight to the headmaster's office to explain themselves.
example.zh: 兩個男孩在下課時間打破窗戶，立刻被叫到校長室說明情況。

listen.en: The headmaster knows the name of every student in the school.
listen.zh: 校長知道全校每一位學生的名字。

chinese.en: The new headmaster decided to ban mobile phones in classrooms during lessons.
chinese.zh: 新校長決定在上課期間禁止學生在教室使用手機。

english.en: Our headmaster was strict, but he really cared about the students.
english.zh: 我們校長很嚴格，但他真的很關心學生。

speak.en: I was really nervous when the headmaster called me into his office.
speak.zh: 校長把我叫進他辦公室時，我真的很緊張。

write.en: Parents praised the headmaster for introducing healthier lunches and longer outdoor play times.
write.zh: 家長們稱讚校長推動更健康的午餐，並延長戶外活動時間。

example.en: The corpse flower is famous for its huge bloom and terrible smell, which attracts flies to help pollinate it.
example.zh: 屍花以巨大的花朵和難聞的氣味聞名，這種氣味會吸引蒼蠅來幫它授粉。

listen.en: The ancient corpse was moved to the museum for study.
listen.zh: 那具古代遺體被移到博物館供研究。

chinese.en: In many detective novels, the story begins when someone discovers a corpse in a library.
chinese.zh: 在許多偵探小說裡，故事都是從有人在圖書館發現一具屍體開始的。

english.en: Scientists used the frozen corpse to learn about life thousands of years ago.
english.zh: 科學家透過那具冰凍的遺體，來了解數千年前的生活。

speak.en: I can't watch crime shows; even a fake corpse scares me.
speak.zh: 我不敢看犯罪影集，連假的屍體都會嚇到我。

write.en: Beetles and bacteria break down animal corpses, returning nutrients to the soil.
write.zh: 甲蟲和細菌會分解動物屍體，讓養分回到土壤中。

example.en: Before the long ride, the guide checked each horse's saddle to make sure it was tight and comfortable.
example.zh: 在長途騎乘前，嚮導檢查了每匹馬的馬鞍，確保綁得夠緊又舒適。

listen.en: Please lower the saddle on my bike a little.
listen.zh: 請幫我把腳踏車座墊調低一點。

chinese.en: The small town was saddled with huge debts after building an expensive stadium.
chinese.zh: 這個小鎮蓋了一座昂貴的體育場後，背負了龐大的債務。

english.en: After the injury, she was eager to get back in the saddle.
english.zh: 受傷之後，她迫不及待想重新回到崗位。

speak.en: I don't want to be saddled with all the cleaning again.
speak.zh: 我不想又被迫一個人包辦所有打掃工作。

write.en: The cowboy saddled his horse at sunrise and rode across the dusty plains.
write.zh: 牛仔在日出時為馬裝上馬鞍，騎著馬穿越塵土飛揚的平原。

example.en: The new vaccine was developed quickly thanks to close collaboration between scientists in several different countries.
example.zh: 多虧了多國科學家的密切合作，新疫苗才能迅速研發出來。

listen.en: This song is a collaboration between my favorite singers.
listen.zh: 這首歌是我最喜歡的幾位歌手合作的作品。

chinese.en: Good collaboration among team members is more important than having a single brilliant leader.
chinese.zh: 團隊成員之間的良好合作，比擁有一位才華出眾的領導者更重要。

english.en: Group projects at school teach students the real value of collaboration.
english.zh: 學校的小組專題能讓學生了解合作的真正價值。

speak.en: Honestly, I prefer working alone, but collaboration can be fun sometimes.
speak.zh: 老實說，我比較喜歡獨自工作，但有時候合作也滿有趣的。

write.en: International collaboration is essential if we want to reduce plastic waste in the oceans.
write.zh: 如果我們想減少海洋中的塑膠垃圾，國際合作是不可或缺的。

example.en: The doctor asked whether there had been any change in his bowel habits, because this can be an early sign of illness.
example.zh: 醫生問他排便習慣是否有任何改變，因為這可能是疾病的早期徵兆。

listen.en: Regular exercise can also help your bowels work properly.
listen.zh: 規律運動也能幫助腸道正常運作。

chinese.en: Screening programs can detect bowel cancer early, when it is easier to treat.
chinese.zh: 篩檢計畫能及早發現大腸癌，此時治療起來比較容易。

english.en: The miners worked deep in the bowels of the earth.
english.zh: 礦工們在地底深處工作。

speak.en: Spicy food sometimes upsets my bowels, so I try to avoid it.
speak.zh: 辣的食物有時會讓我腸胃不舒服，所以我盡量不吃。

write.en: Our hotel room was in the bowels of the building, so there were no windows at all.
write.zh: 我們的飯店房間位於大樓深處，所以完全沒有窗戶。

example.en: Clutching his boarding pass in one hand, he ran through the airport, hoping the gate had not closed yet.
example.zh: 他一手緊抓著登機證，在機場裡狂奔，希望登機門還沒關閉。

listen.en: She clutched her bag as she walked through the crowd.
listen.zh: 她穿過人群時緊緊抓著自己的包包。

chinese.en: When learning to drive a manual car, you must press the clutch before changing gears.
chinese.zh: 學開手排車時，換檔前一定要先踩離合器。

english.en: The nervous student clutched his notes tightly before the presentation began.
english.zh: 那位緊張的學生在報告開始前緊抓著他的筆記。

speak.en: I was so scared on that ride that I clutched my friend's arm.
speak.zh: 坐那個遊樂設施時，我嚇到緊抓著朋友的手臂。

write.en: With no real evidence, the company was clutching at straws to explain its falling sales.
write.zh: 由於缺乏真正的證據，那家公司只能牽強地為銷售下滑找理由。

example.en: After the bank refused her loan, she explored every other avenue, including crowdfunding and help from family.
example.zh: 銀行拒絕貸款給她之後，她嘗試了所有其他途徑，包括群眾募資和向家人求助。

listen.en: Our hotel is on a quiet avenue near the park.
listen.zh: 我們的飯店位於公園附近一條安靜的大道上。

chinese.en: The internet has opened up new avenues for small businesses to reach customers.
chinese.zh: 網路為小型企業開拓了接觸顧客的新管道。

english.en: Volunteering can be a great avenue for meeting new people.
english.zh: 當志工可以是認識新朋友的好管道。

speak.en: I think studying abroad is a good avenue for personal growth.
speak.zh: 我覺得出國留學是個人成長的好途徑。

write.en: The government should explore every avenue to make housing more affordable for young families.
write.zh: 政府應該嘗試一切途徑，讓年輕家庭買得起房子。

example.en: Only residents who have lived in the city for more than two years are eligible to apply for this housing program.
example.zh: 只有在本市居住超過兩年的居民，才有資格申請這項住宅方案。

listen.en: Are part-time workers also eligible for paid holidays in your company?
listen.zh: 你們公司的兼職員工也能享有有薪假嗎？

chinese.en: In most countries, citizens become eligible to vote when they reach the legal age.
chinese.zh: 在大多數國家，公民達到法定年齡後就有投票權。

english.en: You are not eligible for a discount without a student card.
english.zh: 沒有學生證就不能享有折扣。

speak.en: I wasn't eligible for the competition because I was too old.
speak.zh: 我沒資格參加那場比賽，因為我年紀太大了。

write.en: Many low-income families do not realize that they are eligible for government support.
write.zh: 許多低收入家庭不知道自己有資格獲得政府補助。

example.en: Living with a roommate saves money on rent, but it also means you have to compromise on noise and cleanliness.
example.zh: 和室友同住可以省房租，但也代表你們必須在噪音和整潔方面互相妥協。

listen.en: My roommate always plays loud music late at night.
listen.zh: 我的室友總是在深夜大聲放音樂。

chinese.en: Universities usually let first-year students choose whether they want a roommate or a single room.
chinese.zh: 大學通常會讓新生選擇要和室友同住，還是住單人房。

english.en: I get along well with my roommate because we have similar habits.
english.zh: 我和室友相處得很好，因為我們的生活習慣很相似。

speak.en: My first roommate at university is still my best friend today.
speak.zh: 我大學的第一個室友到現在仍是我最好的朋友。

write.en: More young professionals in big cities now live with roommates because rents are so high.
write.zh: 由於房租太高，大城市裡越來越多年輕上班族選擇和室友合租。

example.en: Although the forecast was uncertain all week, farmers knew with certainty that the drought would damage this year's harvest.
example.zh: 雖然整個星期的天氣預報都不太確定，但農民很清楚，這場乾旱一定會影響今年的收成。

listen.en: She spoke with such certainty that everyone believed her.
listen.zh: 她說得那麼篤定，大家都相信了她。

chinese.en: In a fast-changing job market, there is little certainty about which skills will matter most.
chinese.zh: 在快速變化的就業市場中，很難確定哪些技能會最重要。

english.en: Scientists cannot predict with complete certainty when the next earthquake will happen.
english.zh: 科學家無法百分之百確定下一次地震什麼時候會發生。

speak.en: Honestly, I can't say with certainty what I'll be doing next year.
speak.zh: 老實說，我沒辦法確定自己明年會在做什麼。

write.en: For many graduates, a stable government job offers a sense of certainty that startups cannot.
write.zh: 對許多畢業生來說，穩定的公職能帶來新創公司無法給的安定感。

example.en: Instead of making small adjustments, the new manager ordered a wholesale reorganisation of the department, replacing nearly every team leader.
example.zh: 新經理沒有做小幅調整，而是下令全面改組部門，幾乎撤換了每一位組長。

listen.en: Restaurants usually buy their rice at wholesale prices.
listen.zh: 餐廳通常以批發價購買白米。

chinese.en: Wholesale prices for fruit rose sharply after the typhoon damaged crops in the south.
chinese.zh: 颱風重創南部農作物後，水果的批發價大幅上漲。

english.en: My uncle runs a wholesale business that supplies snacks to convenience stores.
english.zh: 我叔叔經營一家批發公司，專門供應零食給便利商店。

speak.en: I think wholesale changes to the exam system would confuse students.
speak.zh: 我覺得全面改革考試制度會讓學生無所適從。

write.en: Critics warned that the wholesale destruction of old buildings would erase the city's history.
write.zh: 批評者警告，大規模拆除老建築會抹去這座城市的歷史。

example.en: Each tribe in the mountains has its own language, weaving patterns and harvest festivals, which attract many curious visitors.
example.zh: 山區的每個部落都有自己的語言、編織圖紋和豐年祭，吸引許多好奇的遊客前來。

listen.en: The museum explains how each tribe built its homes.
listen.zh: 博物館介紹了各部落如何建造自己的家屋。

chinese.en: Taiwan officially recognises sixteen Indigenous tribes, each with its own culture and traditions.
chinese.zh: 臺灣官方認定了十六個原住民族，每一族都有自己的文化與傳統。

english.en: The young people of the tribe are learning traditional songs.
english.zh: 部落裡的年輕人正在學習傳統歌謠。

speak.en: Visiting a tribe in Hualien was the highlight of my trip.
speak.zh: 拜訪花蓮的一個部落是我這趟旅行最精彩的部分。

write.en: Online fans of the band behave almost like a tribe, sharing their own slang and rituals.
write.zh: 這個樂團的網路粉絲幾乎像一個部落，有他們專屬的用語和儀式。

example.en: Even after the doctor showed him the test results, he remained in denial about how serious his illness was.
example.zh: 即使醫生給他看了檢查結果，他還是不願面對自己病情有多嚴重。

listen.en: His denial did not convince anyone in the room.
listen.zh: 他的否認沒能說服在場任何人。

chinese.en: The denial of internet access to rural students makes online learning extremely difficult.
chinese.zh: 偏鄉學生無法使用網路，讓線上學習變得極為困難。

english.en: The minister's denial came only an hour after the report was published.
english.zh: 報導刊出後才過一個小時，部長就出面否認了。

speak.en: I was in denial about how much time I spent on my phone.
speak.zh: 我以前一直不願承認自己花了多少時間在手機上。

write.en: Despite her repeated denials, everyone knew she had planned the surprise party.
write.zh: 儘管她一再否認，大家都知道驚喜派對是她策劃的。

example.en: Some soaps contain strong chemicals that can irritate sensitive skin, causing redness and itching within minutes.
example.zh: 有些肥皂含有刺激性強的化學成分，會刺激敏感肌膚，幾分鐘內就引起泛紅和發癢。

listen.en: Smoke from the barbecue irritated my eyes all evening.
listen.zh: 烤肉的煙讓我整晚眼睛不舒服。

chinese.en: Constant notifications on my phone irritate me, so I usually turn them off at work.
chinese.zh: 手機通知響個不停讓我很煩，所以上班時我通常會把它關掉。

english.en: Her habit of being late irritated everyone on the team.
english.zh: 她老是遲到的習慣惹惱了團隊裡的每個人。

speak.en: Small things like slow internet irritate me more than they should.
speak.zh: 像網路很慢這種小事，總是讓我煩躁得有點過頭。

write.en: Residents were irritated by the constant noise from the construction site next to the school.
write.zh: 學校旁工地的噪音不斷，讓居民很不耐煩。

example.en: Using a powerful telescope in the desert, astronomers spotted a distant planet that might contain water.
example.zh: 天文學家利用沙漠中的一臺高倍望遠鏡，發現了一顆可能有水的遙遠行星。

listen.en: My brother got a telescope for his birthday.
listen.zh: 我弟弟生日時收到一臺望遠鏡。

chinese.en: The new space telescope allows scientists to study galaxies that formed billions of years ago.
chinese.zh: 新的太空望遠鏡讓科學家能研究數十億年前形成的星系。

english.en: Our school set up a telescope on the roof for the astronomy club.
english.zh: 我們學校在屋頂上為天文社架設了一臺望遠鏡。

speak.en: I'd love to look at the stars through a proper telescope someday.
speak.zh: 我很希望有一天能用真正的望遠鏡看星星。

write.en: Governments should fund large telescopes because they help us understand our place in the universe.
write.zh: 政府應該資助大型望遠鏡，因為它們幫助我們了解人類在宇宙中的位置。

example.en: Because the team had lost every match this season, most fans thought a victory was highly unlikely, yet they won.
example.zh: 由於這支隊伍本季每場比賽都輸，大多數球迷認為根本不可能贏，結果他們卻贏了。

listen.en: She is unlikely to change her mind about the trip.
listen.zh: 她不太可能改變對這趟旅行的想法。

chinese.en: Without more investment, the city is unlikely to meet its goal of reducing air pollution.
chinese.zh: 如果沒有更多投資，這座城市不太可能達成減少空氣污染的目標。

english.en: He is unlikely to finish the report before the meeting on Friday.
english.zh: 他不太可能在星期五開會前完成報告。

speak.en: To be honest, I think it's unlikely I'll move abroad.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得自己不太可能搬到國外。

write.en: The shy librarian and the loud chef formed an unlikely friendship during the cooking class.
write.zh: 害羞的圖書館員和大嗓門的廚師在烹飪課上成了意想不到的好朋友。

example.en: The hotel was nothing special, but the view from our balcony was terrific, with mountains on one side and the sea on the other.
example.zh: 飯店本身沒什麼特別，但陽臺的景色好極了，一邊是山，一邊是海。

listen.en: We had a terrific time at the beach last weekend.
listen.zh: 上週末我們在海邊玩得非常開心。

chinese.en: The storm caused a terrific amount of damage to farms along the east coast.
chinese.zh: 這場暴風雨對東海岸沿線的農田造成了極大的損害。

english.en: The new manager has terrific ideas for improving customer service.
english.zh: 新經理對改善客戶服務有很棒的點子。

speak.en: Honestly, the food at that night market was terrific.
speak.zh: 說真的，那個夜市的小吃好吃極了。

write.en: Online courses can be a terrific way for working adults to gain new qualifications.
write.zh: 對上班族來說，線上課程是取得新資格的絕佳方式。

example.en: After the earthquake, engineers worked through the night to repair the damaged undersea cable that carries internet traffic to the island.
example.zh: 地震過後，工程師徹夜搶修受損的海底電纜，這條電纜負責傳輸通往島上的網路流量。

listen.en: The cable behind the television is too short.
listen.zh: 電視後面的線太短了。

chinese.en: Many families have cancelled cable TV because they prefer streaming services online.
chinese.zh: 許多家庭已經停掉有線電視，因為他們比較喜歡線上串流服務。

english.en: We took a cable car to the top of the mountain.
english.zh: 我們搭纜車到山頂。

speak.en: I always carry an extra cable when I travel abroad.
speak.zh: 我出國旅行時一定會多帶一條線。

write.en: Workers are burying power cables underground to make the old streets safer and tidier.
write.zh: 工人正在把電線埋到地下，讓老街更安全、更整齊。

example.en: Since every hotel in town was fully booked for the festival, we had to stay in a small roadside motel.
example.zh: 因為鎮上所有飯店都因節慶客滿，我們只好住在路邊一家小汽車旅館。

listen.en: The motel had a small pool and free parking.
listen.zh: 那家汽車旅館有個小泳池和免費停車位。

chinese.en: Motels are popular with drivers on long road trips because parking is usually free.
chinese.zh: 汽車旅館很受長途自駕旅客歡迎，因為通常可以免費停車。

english.en: The motel near the station was clean, quiet and cheap.
english.zh: 車站附近那家汽車旅館乾淨、安靜又便宜。

speak.en: On our road trip, we usually just booked a motel online.
speak.zh: 我們自駕旅行時，通常就直接上網訂汽車旅館。

write.en: Some old motels along the coast have been turned into stylish guesthouses for young travellers.
write.zh: 海岸邊一些老舊的汽車旅館已改裝成時髦的民宿，吸引年輕旅客。

example.en: The lecture hall was so large that the speaker's words were hardly audible to students sitting in the back rows.
example.zh: 演講廳太大了，坐在後排的學生幾乎聽不到講者在說什麼。

listen.en: The music was clearly audible from the street outside.
listen.zh: 從外面的街上就能清楚聽見音樂聲。

chinese.en: Modern electric cars are so quiet that they are barely audible to pedestrians.
chinese.zh: 現代的電動車非常安靜，行人幾乎聽不到它們的聲音。

english.en: There was an audible sigh from the students when the test began.
english.zh: 考試開始時，學生們發出了聽得見的嘆氣聲。

speak.en: In my old flat, my neighbour's TV was always audible through the walls.
speak.zh: 我以前住的公寓，隔著牆總是聽得到鄰居的電視聲。

write.en: The fire alarm must be audible in every room, including the basement and stairwells.
write.zh: 火災警報必須在每個房間都聽得到，包括地下室和樓梯間。

example.en: For many families, Sunday dinner is sacred time, so nobody is allowed to check emails or answer work calls.
example.zh: 對許多家庭來說，星期日晚餐是神聖不可侵犯的時間，誰都不准查看電子郵件或接工作電話。

listen.en: The old tree in the village is a sacred place.
listen.zh: 村子裡那棵老樹是一處神聖的地方。

chinese.en: Visitors must remove their shoes before entering the sacred site and remain quiet inside.
chinese.zh: 遊客進入這處聖地前必須脫鞋，在裡面也要保持安靜。

english.en: My grandparents believe that family meals together are sacred and should never be skipped.
english.zh: 我的祖父母認為全家一起吃飯是神聖的，絕對不能缺席。

speak.en: For me, my weekend morning coffee is almost sacred.
speak.zh: 對我來說，週末早上的那杯咖啡幾乎是神聖不可侵犯的。

write.en: Some argue that freedom of the press is a sacred principle that governments must protect.
write.zh: 有些人主張，新聞自由是政府必須守護的神聖原則。

example.en: Because of the trade embargo, local factories could not import the machine parts they needed and had to stop production.
example.zh: 由於貿易禁運，當地工廠無法進口所需的機器零件，只好停止生產。

listen.en: The embargo was finally lifted after a long negotiation.
listen.zh: 經過漫長的談判，禁運終於解除了。

chinese.en: Journalists received the report early, but it was under embargo until Monday morning.
chinese.zh: 記者提早拿到了報告，但在星期一早上之前都不得發布。

english.en: Many countries agreed to impose an embargo on weapons sales.
english.zh: 許多國家同意對武器銷售實施禁運。

speak.en: I think an embargo usually hurts ordinary people more than leaders.
speak.zh: 我認為禁運通常傷害一般民眾多過領導人。

write.en: The research findings were embargoed until the scientific journal officially published the full article.
write.zh: 這項研究結果在科學期刊正式刊出全文之前都禁止公開。

example.en: As the story unfolds, readers slowly discover that the quiet neighbour has been hiding a surprising secret for years.
example.zh: 隨著故事展開，讀者慢慢發現那位安靜的鄰居多年來一直隱藏著驚人的秘密。

listen.en: We watched the events unfold on the evening news.
listen.zh: 我們在晚間新聞上看著事件的發展。

chinese.en: Economists are watching closely to see how the housing crisis will unfold next year.
chinese.zh: 經濟學家正密切觀察明年房市危機會如何發展。

english.en: He unfolded the letter and began to read it aloud.
english.zh: 他打開信，開始大聲唸出來。

speak.en: I love watching how the plot unfolds in a good mystery series.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡看精彩的懸疑影集裡劇情一步步展開。

write.en: Volunteers unfolded large banners at the finish line to welcome the tired runners.
write.zh: 志工在終點線拉開大型布條，迎接疲憊的跑者。

example.en: When the company could no longer repay its bank loans, it went into default and several investors lost their savings.
example.zh: 這家公司無力償還銀行貸款而違約，好幾位投資人因此失去了積蓄。

listen.en: The app saves your photos to the cloud by default.
listen.zh: 這個應用程式預設會把你的照片存到雲端。

chinese.en: If borrowers default on their student loans, their credit records may be seriously damaged.
chinese.zh: 借款人如果拖欠就學貸款，信用紀錄可能會嚴重受損。

english.en: He won the game by default because his opponent never arrived.
english.zh: 因為對手一直沒出現，他不戰而勝。

speak.en: I usually just keep the default settings on new devices.
speak.zh: 新裝置我通常都直接用預設設定。

write.en: When people feel tired, they often default to old habits like ordering fast food.
write.zh: 人在疲倦時，往往會不自覺回到老習慣，例如叫速食。

example.en: Before writing the full essay, she prepared a skeleton of her argument, listing each main point and its supporting evidence.
example.zh: 在動筆寫完整篇文章之前，她先擬好論點的架構，列出每個重點和支持的證據。

listen.en: The human skeleton protects our heart and lungs.
listen.zh: 人體骨骼保護著我們的心臟和肺。

chinese.en: During the holidays, the office runs with a skeleton staff to answer urgent calls.
chinese.zh: 假期間，辦公室只留最少的人力值班，處理緊急來電。

english.en: Calcium helps children build a strong skeleton as they grow.
english.zh: 鈣質能幫助孩子在成長過程中建立強壯的骨骼。

speak.en: Seeing the whale skeleton at the museum was really impressive.
speak.zh: 在博物館看到鯨魚骨骼真的很震撼。

write.en: Only the steel skeleton of the building remained after the fire was put out.
write.zh: 大火撲滅後，這棟建築只剩下鋼骨結構。

example.en: The apartment was cheap and spacious, but it had no elevator, so carrying groceries up the stairs was exhausting.
example.zh: 那間公寓便宜又寬敞，但沒有電梯，所以提著買來的東西爬樓梯非常累。

listen.en: Our apartment is on the top floor of the building.
listen.zh: 我們家在這棟大樓的頂樓。

chinese.en: Rising rents have forced many young workers to share an apartment with strangers.
chinese.zh: 房租不斷上漲，迫使許多年輕上班族和陌生人合租公寓。

english.en: My sister just moved into a new apartment near her office.
english.zh: 我姊姊剛搬進公司附近的新公寓。

speak.en: I live in a fairly small apartment with two roommates.
speak.zh: 我和兩個室友住在一間蠻小的公寓裡。

write.en: Developers are building more apartment blocks in the suburbs to meet the growing demand for housing.
write.zh: 建商在郊區興建更多公寓大樓，以滿足日益增加的住房需求。

example.en: The mayor cut the ribbon at the entrance, officially opening the new public library to cheering residents.
example.zh: 市長在入口處剪綵，在居民的歡呼聲中正式啟用新的公共圖書館。

listen.en: The little girl wore a yellow ribbon in her hair.
listen.zh: 那個小女孩頭髮上綁著一條黃色緞帶。

chinese.en: From the plane, the river looked like a silver ribbon winding through the green valley.
chinese.zh: 從飛機上往下看，那條河就像一條銀色緞帶，蜿蜒穿過翠綠的山谷。

english.en: Winners of the race each received a blue ribbon and a medal.
english.zh: 賽跑的優勝者每人都獲得一條藍色綬帶和一面獎牌。

speak.en: I'm terrible at wrapping presents, especially tying the ribbon neatly.
speak.zh: 我超不會包禮物，尤其是把緞帶綁整齊。

write.en: Students tied ribbons to the school gate to wish their graduating classmates good luck.
write.zh: 學生在校門上綁緞帶，祝福即將畢業的同學一切順利。

example.en: The new shopping mall is gigantic; it contains over three hundred shops, a cinema and even an indoor ice rink.
example.zh: 新的購物中心非常龐大，裡面有三百多家店、一間電影院，甚至還有室內溜冰場。

listen.en: There was a gigantic tree in the middle of the park.
listen.zh: 公園中央有一棵巨大的樹。

chinese.en: Building a gigantic stadium for one event can leave the city with huge debts.
chinese.zh: 為了一場活動興建巨型體育場，可能讓城市背上龐大債務。

english.en: The company made a gigantic mistake by ignoring customer complaints.
english.zh: 這家公司忽視顧客的抱怨，犯了一個極大的錯誤。

speak.en: The portions at that restaurant are gigantic, so we always share.
speak.zh: 那家餐廳的份量超大，所以我們每次都會分著吃。

write.en: Scientists discovered a gigantic hole in the ice that was larger than many cities.
write.zh: 科學家在冰層中發現一個巨大的洞，比許多城市還要大。

example.en: The new metro line will doubtless reduce traffic in the city centre, although some residents remain worried about construction noise.
example.zh: 新的捷運線無疑會減少市中心的車流，不過有些居民仍擔心施工噪音。
