listen.en: You have doubtless heard the news about our teacher.
listen.zh: 你一定已經聽說我們老師的消息了。

chinese.en: Doubtless, technology will continue to change the way students learn in classrooms.
chinese.zh: 毫無疑問，科技將持續改變學生在課堂上的學習方式。

english.en: He was doubtless the most hardworking student in our class.
english.zh: 他無疑是我們班上最用功的學生。

speak.en: Doubtless, some people will disagree with me, but I love rainy days.
speak.zh: 一定有人不同意，但我就是喜歡下雨天。

write.en: Remote work doubtless offers flexibility, but it can also make employees feel isolated.
write.zh: 遠距工作無疑提供了彈性，但也可能讓員工感到孤立。

example.en: After three days of heavy rain, the river overflowed its banks and flooded several farms in the valley.
example.zh: 連下三天大雨後，河水漫過河岸，淹沒了山谷裡好幾座農場。

listen.en: The rubbish bins in the park were overflowing again.
listen.zh: 公園裡的垃圾桶又滿出來了。

chinese.en: The hospital set up tents outside to handle the overflow of patients during the outbreak.
chinese.zh: 疫情爆發期間，醫院在外面搭起帳篷，收治容納不下的病患。

english.en: The classroom was so crowded that students overflowed into the hallway.
english.zh: 教室擠到學生都站到走廊上了。

speak.en: My inbox is always overflowing with emails I never have time to read.
speak.zh: 我的收件匣總是塞滿了沒空看的電子郵件。

write.en: Her heart overflowed with pride when her son walked onto the stage to receive his diploma.
write.zh: 看到兒子走上臺領取畢業證書，她心中充滿了驕傲。

example.en: Electric cars are quiet and clean, but one major drawback is that charging them still takes much longer than refuelling.
example.zh: 電動車安靜又乾淨，但一大缺點是充電時間仍比加油長得多。

listen.en: The only drawback is that the shop closes early.
listen.zh: 唯一的缺點是那家店很早就關門。

chinese.en: One drawback of working from home is that it can be hard to separate work from rest.
chinese.zh: 在家工作的缺點之一，是很難把工作和休息分開。

english.en: Every plan has some drawbacks, so we should compare them carefully.
english.zh: 每個方案都有缺點，所以我們應該仔細比較。

speak.en: The biggest drawback of living in Taipei is the high rent.
speak.zh: 住在臺北最大的缺點就是房租很高。

write.en: Before adopting the new system, the school carefully weighed its benefits against its drawbacks.
write.zh: 在採用新制度之前，學校仔細權衡了它的優點和缺點。

example.en: To prepare pilots for emergencies, the training centre uses machines that simulate engine failures and violent storms.
example.zh: 為了讓飛行員做好應變準備，訓練中心使用能模擬引擎故障和猛烈暴風雨的機器。

listen.en: The game simulates driving through a busy city.
listen.zh: 這款遊戲模擬在繁忙城市中開車。

chinese.en: Our teacher simulated a real job interview so that we could practise answering questions.
chinese.zh: 老師模擬了一場真實的求職面試，讓我們練習回答問題。

english.en: Scientists used computers to simulate the effects of rising sea levels.
english.zh: 科學家用電腦模擬海平面上升的影響。

speak.en: I find mock exams helpful because they simulate the real test.
speak.zh: 我覺得模擬考很有幫助，因為它們能模擬真正的考試。

write.en: The actor simulated surprise so convincingly that the audience thought the mistake was real.
write.zh: 演員假裝驚訝演得太逼真，觀眾都以為那個失誤是真的。

example.en: High tuition fees remain a major barrier to higher education for students from low-income families, despite government loans.
example.zh: 雖然有政府貸款，高昂的學費仍是低收入家庭學生接受高等教育的一大障礙。

listen.en: Police put up a barrier to keep the crowd back.
listen.zh: 警方架起柵欄，讓人群往後退。

chinese.en: Sharing meals with colleagues can help break down barriers between different departments.
chinese.zh: 和同事一起用餐，有助於打破不同部門之間的隔閡。

english.en: The new trade agreement will remove barriers between the two countries.
english.zh: 新的貿易協定將消除兩國之間的障礙。

speak.en: Honestly, shyness was the biggest barrier when I started learning English.
speak.zh: 說實話，我剛開始學英文時，最大的障礙是害羞。

write.en: Mangrove forests act as a natural barrier, protecting coastal villages from storm waves.
write.zh: 紅樹林是一道天然屏障，保護沿海村莊免受暴風巨浪侵襲。

example.en: After the heavy rain, the old wall began to bulge outwards, so engineers closed the road before it collapsed.
example.zh: 大雨過後，那面老牆開始向外凸出，工程師趕在倒塌前封閉了道路。

listen.en: Her pockets bulged with coins from the market.
listen.zh: 她的口袋裝滿了在市場找的零錢，鼓鼓的。

chinese.en: The baby boom created a bulge in the population that is now reaching retirement age.
chinese.zh: 嬰兒潮造成人口暫時激增，這群人現在正陸續屆齡退休。

english.en: There is a strange bulge in the side of the tyre.
english.zh: 輪胎側面有一個奇怪的凸起。

speak.en: My suitcase always bulges by the end of a holiday.
speak.zh: 每次假期快結束時，我的行李箱總是塞得鼓鼓的。

write.en: Cartoon characters often have bulging eyes when they are shocked or frightened.
write.zh: 卡通人物受到驚嚇或害怕時，眼睛常常會凸出來。

example.en: By switching to digital forms, the clinic eliminated long queues and reduced the paperwork that nurses had to complete each day.
example.zh: 改用電子表單後，診所消除了大排長龍的情況，也減少了護理師每天要處理的文書工作。

listen.en: Our team was eliminated early in the competition.
listen.zh: 我們隊在比賽初期就被淘汰了。

chinese.en: The new law aims to eliminate plastic bags from supermarkets within five years.
chinese.zh: 新法的目標是在五年內讓超市不再使用塑膠袋。

english.en: Online banking has eliminated the need to visit a branch.
english.zh: 網路銀行讓人不必再跑分行。

speak.en: I'm trying to eliminate sugary drinks from my diet.
speak.zh: 我正在努力戒掉含糖飲料。

write.en: During the investigation, police eliminated several possibilities before finding the real cause of the fire.
write.zh: 調查期間，警方排除了好幾種可能，才找到火災的真正原因。

example.en: Her hopes of studying abroad were crushed when she failed to receive the scholarship she had worked so hard for.
example.zh: 她沒拿到辛苦爭取的獎學金，出國留學的希望因此破滅。

listen.en: He had a crush on his classmate in high school.
listen.zh: 他高中時暗戀過班上的同學。

chinese.en: Several people were injured in the crush as fans rushed towards the stage.
chinese.zh: 歌迷衝向舞臺時發生推擠，造成好幾人受傷。

english.en: The heavy box crushed the eggs at the bottom of the bag.
english.zh: 重箱子把袋子底部的雞蛋壓碎了。

speak.en: I think everyone has had a crush on a celebrity at some point.
speak.zh: 我覺得每個人都曾經迷戀過某個明星。

write.en: Recycling centres crush old cans into blocks so they are easier to transport.
write.zh: 回收中心把舊鋁罐壓成塊狀，方便運送。

example.en: The old man sat by the window, clasping a faded photograph of his wife, and smiled as he remembered their wedding.
example.zh: 老先生坐在窗邊，緊握著妻子褪色的照片，想起他們的婚禮時露出了微笑。

listen.en: The clasp on my necklace broke this morning.
listen.zh: 我項鍊的扣環今天早上壞了。

chinese.en: The students clasped their hands together nervously while waiting for the exam results.
chinese.zh: 學生們在等待考試結果時，緊張地雙手緊握。

english.en: He clasped the trophy to his chest and thanked his coach.
english.zh: 他把獎盃緊抱在胸前，向教練道謝。

speak.en: My watch has a clasp that's really hard to open.
speak.zh: 我手錶的扣環真的很難打開。

write.en: The bag closes with a simple metal clasp, which makes it easy to use with one hand.
write.zh: 這個包包用簡單的金屬扣環開關，單手就能輕鬆使用。

example.en: The teacher criticised my essay for using generic examples instead of specific evidence from real studies.
example.zh: 老師批評我的文章用了太籠統的例子，而沒有引用真實研究的具體證據。

listen.en: Her cover letter sounded far too generic and boring.
listen.zh: 她的求職信聽起來太制式又無趣。

chinese.en: Many shoppers now choose generic brands at supermarkets to save money on groceries.
chinese.zh: 現在許多消費者在超市選擇自有品牌商品，以節省買菜錢。

english.en: Vehicle is a generic term for cars, buses and trucks.
english.zh: 「車輛」是汽車、公車和卡車的統稱。

speak.en: I don't like generic hotel rooms that all look the same.
speak.zh: 我不喜歡那種看起來都一樣、毫無特色的飯店房間。

write.en: Companies that send generic emails to every customer often see fewer responses.
write.zh: 寄制式電子郵件給所有顧客的公司，回覆率往往比較低。

example.en: Many delivery riders live in a precarious situation, with no fixed salary, no insurance and no guarantee of work tomorrow.
example.zh: 許多外送員處境不安定，沒有固定薪水、沒有保險，也不知道明天有沒有工作。

listen.en: The ladder looked precarious on the wet ground.
listen.zh: 梯子立在濕地上，看起來很不穩。

chinese.en: After losing two major clients, the small company found itself in a precarious financial position.
chinese.zh: 失去兩大客戶後，這家小公司的財務狀況岌岌可危。

english.en: Climbing that precarious mountain path without a guide is dangerous.
english.zh: 沒有嚮導就爬那條險峻的山路很危險。

speak.en: Living alone on a student budget can feel pretty precarious sometimes.
speak.zh: 靠學生的預算一個人生活，有時候會覺得蠻沒保障的。

write.en: Rising sea levels have made life precarious for families on low-lying islands.
write.zh: 海平面上升讓低窪島嶼上的家庭生活岌岌可危。

example.en: Housing prices in the city centre have become insane; a tiny studio now costs more than most people earn in ten years.
example.zh: 市中心的房價已經高得離譜，一間小套房的價格比大多數人十年的收入還高。

listen.en: The noise from the building site is driving me insane.
listen.zh: 工地的噪音快把我逼瘋了。

chinese.en: Some people thought the plan was insane, but it eventually saved the company.
chinese.zh: 有些人覺得這個計畫很瘋狂，但它最後救了公司。

english.en: Working three jobs at the same time sounds completely insane.
english.zh: 同時做三份工作聽起來完全是瘋了。

speak.en: The queue for that new bubble tea shop was insane.
speak.zh: 那家新開的珍奶店排隊人潮多到誇張。

write.en: Expecting students to memorise every page of the textbook before the exam is simply insane.
write.zh: 要求學生考前把課本每一頁都背起來，根本是荒唐。

example.en: The muddy footprints left a clear trail from the back door to the kitchen, so we knew the dog had come inside.
example.zh: 泥巴腳印從後門一路延伸到廚房，所以我們知道狗跑進屋裡了。

listen.en: This hiking trail is popular with families on weekends.
listen.zh: 這條登山步道週末很受家庭歡迎。

chinese.en: In the chart, sales of laptops trailed far behind sales of smartphones throughout the decade.
chinese.zh: 從圖表可以看出，這十年間筆電的銷量一直遠遠落後於智慧型手機。

english.en: The tourists left a trail of rubbish along the beach.
english.zh: 遊客沿著海灘留下一路的垃圾。

speak.en: I'd love to walk the coastal trail in eastern Taiwan.
speak.zh: 我很想去走臺灣東部的海岸步道。

write.en: Investigators followed the money trail to discover where the missing donations had gone.
write.zh: 調查人員追查金流，找出那些失蹤的捐款去了哪裡。

example.en: The documentary explores several facets of city life, from crowded markets and night shifts to quiet temples and parks.
example.zh: 這部紀錄片探討城市生活的多個面向，從擁擠的市場、夜班工作，到寧靜的廟宇和公園。

listen.en: Music is an important facet of their culture.
listen.zh: 音樂是他們文化中很重要的一部分。

chinese.en: Learning a language involves many facets, including grammar, pronunciation and cultural knowledge.
chinese.zh: 學習語言涉及許多面向，包括文法、發音和文化知識。

english.en: The job allowed her to discover a new facet of her personality.
english.zh: 這份工作讓她發現了自己個性中的另一面。

speak.en: Cooking is one facet of Taiwanese culture I really enjoy.
speak.zh: 料理是臺灣文化中我很喜歡的一個面向。

write.en: The diamond sparkled under the lights because each facet had been cut so precisely.
write.zh: 這顆鑽石在燈光下閃閃發亮，因為每個刻面都切割得非常精準。

example.en: Nurses often work long night shifts and make life-or-death decisions, which makes their job one of the most stressful professions.
example.zh: 護理師常要值長時間夜班、做攸關生死的決定，使這份工作成為壓力最大的職業之一。

listen.en: Taking exams has always been stressful for me.
listen.zh: 考試對我來說一直都很有壓力。

chinese.en: Many office workers find their daily commute more stressful than the work itself.
chinese.zh: 許多上班族覺得每天通勤比工作本身更讓人有壓力。

english.en: Planning a wedding is exciting, but it can also be very stressful.
english.zh: 籌備婚禮很令人興奮，但也可能壓力很大。

speak.en: The week before final exams is always the most stressful time.
speak.zh: 期末考前一週永遠是壓力最大的時候。

write.en: Schools should teach students practical ways to cope with stressful situations such as exams and interviews.
write.zh: 學校應該教學生實用的方法，來應付考試和面試這類有壓力的情況。

example.en: To understand why students skip breakfast, researchers sent a questionnaire to several schools and analysed the answers.
example.zh: 為了了解學生為什麼不吃早餐，研究人員發問卷給幾所學校，並分析回答內容。

listen.en: Most of our customers completed the questionnaire online last month.
listen.zh: 上個月我們大部分的顧客都在線上填完了問卷。

chinese.en: The questionnaire asked residents how satisfied they were with public transport in the city.
chinese.zh: 這份問卷詢問居民對市區大眾運輸的滿意程度。

english.en: Our teacher asked us to design a questionnaire about sleeping habits.
english.zh: 老師要我們設計一份關於睡眠習慣的問卷。

speak.en: I usually ignore questionnaires that take more than five minutes.
speak.zh: 要花超過五分鐘的問卷，我通常都不理。

write.en: An anonymous questionnaire may encourage employees to share honest opinions about their managers.
write.zh: 匿名問卷可能讓員工更願意坦白說出對主管的看法。

example.en: Although the town is far inland, it still receives heavy rain when typhoons travel across the island from the ocean.
example.zh: 雖然這個小鎮位於內陸深處，但颱風從海上橫越島嶼時，這裡仍會下大雨。

listen.en: The road turns inland after the small fishing village.
listen.zh: 過了那個小漁村，這條路就轉向內陸。

chinese.en: Inland cities often experience hotter summers and colder winters than towns by the sea.
chinese.zh: 內陸城市的夏天往往比海邊城鎮更熱，冬天也更冷。

english.en: We drove inland for an hour to reach the tea farm.
english.zh: 我們往內陸開了一個小時的車，才到達茶園。

speak.en: I prefer living inland because it's less humid than the coast.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡住在內陸，因為沒有海邊那麼潮濕。

write.en: Rising sea levels may force coastal communities to relocate inland in the coming decades.
write.zh: 未來幾十年，海平面上升可能迫使沿海社區遷往內陸。

example.en: After years of moving between cities for work, she finally bought a house, hoping to give her children some stability.
example.zh: 多年來為了工作在各城市間搬遷，她終於買了房子，希望能給孩子安定的生活。

listen.en: A strong table base gives the lamp more stability.
listen.zh: 堅固的桌座讓檯燈更穩。

chinese.en: Economic stability attracts foreign investors, who prefer markets where prices change slowly.
chinese.zh: 經濟穩定能吸引外國投資人，因為他們偏好物價變動緩慢的市場。

english.en: Regular routines can give young children a sense of stability.
english.zh: 規律的作息能給幼童一種安定感。

speak.en: For me, financial stability is more important than having an exciting job.
speak.zh: 對我來說，經濟穩定比做一份刺激的工作更重要。

write.en: Engineers added steel supports to improve the stability of the old bridge during earthquakes.
write.zh: 工程師加裝了鋼製支架，以提高這座老橋在地震時的穩定性。

example.en: A sudden cyberattack crippled the hospital's computer system, forcing doctors to return to paper records for several days.
example.zh: 一場突如其來的網路攻擊癱瘓了醫院的電腦系統，醫師們被迫改用紙本病歷好幾天。

listen.en: Heavy snow crippled the city for the whole week.
listen.zh: 大雪讓這座城市癱瘓了整整一週。

chinese.en: Rising fuel prices could cripple small fishing businesses that already struggle to survive.
chinese.zh: 油價上漲可能重創原本就苦撐經營的小型漁業。

english.en: The power cut crippled most factories in the industrial zone yesterday.
english.zh: 昨天的停電讓工業區大部分工廠停擺。

speak.en: I think high rent can really cripple young people's savings.
speak.zh: 我覺得高房租真的會嚴重侵蝕年輕人的存款。

write.en: Many graduates are crippled by student debt and delay buying homes or starting families.
write.zh: 許多畢業生被學貸壓得喘不過氣，因而延後買房或成家。

example.en: Bilateral trade between the neighbouring nations has doubled since they opened a new bridge across the river border.
example.zh: 自從兩個鄰國在界河上開通一座新橋後，雙邊貿易額已經翻倍。

listen.en: The leaders held bilateral talks after the summit.
listen.zh: 領袖們在高峰會後舉行了雙邊會談。

chinese.en: The universities launched a bilateral exchange programme allowing students to study abroad for a semester.
chinese.zh: 兩所大學推出雙邊交換計畫，讓學生可以出國讀一學期。

english.en: Bilateral relations between the countries have improved in recent years.
english.zh: 近年來，這兩國之間的雙邊關係已經改善。

speak.en: I think bilateral student exchanges really benefit both schools equally.
speak.zh: 我認為雙邊的學生交換對兩所學校都同樣有益。

write.en: Instead of global rules, some governments prefer bilateral deals that suit their specific needs.
write.zh: 比起全球性的規範，有些政府更偏好符合自身需求的雙邊協議。

example.en: The studio is fully furnished, with a bed, desk and washing machine, so new tenants only need to bring clothes.
example.zh: 這間套房附全套傢俱，有床、書桌和洗衣機，新房客只要帶衣服來就好。

listen.en: The hotel rooms are furnished in a simple style.
listen.zh: 這家飯店的房間以簡約風格布置。

chinese.en: Applicants must furnish the university with proof of their English level before enrolment.
chinese.zh: 申請者必須在註冊前向大學提供英文程度證明。

english.en: My parents helped me furnish my dorm room before the semester started.
english.zh: 開學前，爸媽幫我布置宿舍房間。

speak.en: I'd rather rent a furnished place than buy everything myself.
speak.zh: 我寧願租附傢俱的房子，也不想自己全部買齊。

write.en: The library was furnished with comfortable sofas to encourage students to stay and read.
write.zh: 圖書館擺放了舒適的沙發，鼓勵學生留下來閱讀。

example.en: During the Great Depression of the 1930s, millions of workers lost their jobs and families struggled to buy food.
example.zh: 在1930年代的經濟大蕭條期間，數百萬名勞工失業，許多家庭連食物都買不起。

listen.en: She talked to a doctor about her depression last winter.
listen.zh: 去年冬天，她找醫生談了自己的憂鬱症。

chinese.en: The weather report warned that a tropical depression could bring heavy rain to the island.
chinese.zh: 氣象報告警告，熱帶性低氣壓可能為本島帶來豪雨。

english.en: Many university students experience depression during long and stressful exam periods.
english.zh: 許多大學生在漫長又緊繃的考試期間會出現憂鬱症狀。

speak.en: I think people should talk more openly about depression these days.
speak.zh: 我覺得現在大家應該更坦然地談論憂鬱症。

write.en: Experts warn that social isolation among older adults can increase the risk of depression.
write.zh: 專家提醒，長者若與社會隔絕，罹患憂鬱症的風險會提高。

example.en: After losing his job, he fell into a downward spiral of debt, stress and poor sleep that lasted for months.
example.zh: 他失業後陷入負債、壓力與失眠的惡性循環，持續了好幾個月。

listen.en: We climbed the narrow spiral staircase to the top.
listen.zh: 我們沿著狹窄的螺旋樓梯爬到頂端。

chinese.en: Housing prices in the capital have spiralled over the past decade, pushing many young people out.
chinese.zh: 過去十年，首都的房價急遽攀升，讓許多年輕人被迫搬離。

english.en: The eagle spiralled slowly above the mountain, looking for food.
english.zh: 那隻老鷹在山頂上空緩緩盤旋，尋找食物。

speak.en: Honestly, my phone bill spiralled when I started streaming videos every day.
speak.zh: 老實說，我開始每天看串流影片之後，電話帳單就暴增了。

write.en: Snail shells and some galaxies share the same elegant spiral shape found throughout nature.
write.zh: 蝸牛殼和某些星系都有同樣優雅的螺旋形狀，這種形狀在自然界隨處可見。

example.en: She is such a keen reader that she devoured the entire fantasy series during her summer holiday.
example.zh: 她非常熱愛閱讀，暑假期間就把整套奇幻小說一口氣讀完了。

listen.en: The fire quickly devoured the old wooden barn.
listen.zh: 大火迅速吞噬了那座老舊的木造穀倉。

chinese.en: Many teenagers devour social media content for hours without thinking about what they read.
chinese.zh: 許多青少年一連好幾個小時大量瀏覽社群媒體內容，卻不思考自己讀到了什麼。

english.en: My brother devoured his dinner and rushed back to his game.
english.zh: 我弟弟狼吞虎嚥地吃完晚餐，又衝回去玩遊戲。

speak.en: When I was a kid, I used to devour comic books.
speak.zh: 我小時候很愛看漫畫，總是一本接一本地看。

write.en: Investors devoured the latest economic report, hoping to find signs of recovery.
write.zh: 投資人仔細研讀最新的經濟報告，希望從中找到復甦的跡象。

example.en: The researchers waited nearly a year before their paper was finally accepted for publication in a respected scientific journal.
example.zh: 研究人員等了將近一年，論文才終於獲得一份權威科學期刊接受刊登。

listen.en: Our school library keeps many popular science publications.
listen.zh: 我們學校圖書館收藏了許多科普刊物。

chinese.en: The government delayed the publication of the survey results until after the holiday.
chinese.zh: 政府把調查結果的公布延到假期之後。

english.en: This magazine is a popular monthly publication for young travellers.
english.zh: 這本雜誌是一份很受年輕旅人歡迎的月刊。

speak.en: I usually check the publication date before I trust an online article.
speak.zh: 我通常會先看網路文章的發布日期，再決定要不要相信它。

write.en: The company stopped printing its newsletter and moved all its publications online to save money.
write.zh: 這家公司停止印製通訊刊物，並把所有出版品改為線上發行以節省開支。

example.en: Far from the busy city, the writer led a solitary life in a small cabin, seeing visitors only once a month.
example.zh: 那位作家遠離繁忙的城市，在一間小木屋裡過著離群索居的生活，一個月才見一次訪客。

listen.en: He enjoys a solitary walk along the beach every morning.
listen.zh: 他每天早上都喜歡獨自沿著海灘散步。

chinese.en: Writing a thesis can be a solitary task, so many students form study groups.
chinese.zh: 寫論文可能是件孤軍奮戰的工作，所以許多學生會組成讀書會。

english.en: Not a solitary car passed us on the quiet country road.
english.zh: 在那條安靜的鄉間道路上，連一輛車都沒有經過我們身邊。

speak.en: I'm not lonely; I just prefer solitary hobbies like reading.
speak.zh: 我不寂寞，只是比較喜歡閱讀這類一個人做的嗜好。

write.en: Remote work can feel solitary, so some companies organise regular team events to connect staff.
write.zh: 遠距工作可能讓人感覺孤立，所以有些公司會定期舉辦團隊活動，拉近員工之間的距離。

example.en: Because of its proximity to several universities, the neighbourhood is full of cheap cafes and student flats.
example.zh: 由於鄰近好幾所大學，這一帶到處都是平價咖啡館和學生公寓。

listen.en: We chose this flat for its proximity to the park.
listen.zh: 我們選這間公寓，是因為它離公園很近。

chinese.en: Living in close proximity to a busy airport can affect residents' sleep and health.
chinese.zh: 住在繁忙的機場附近，可能會影響居民的睡眠和健康。

english.en: Proximity to the sea makes this town cooler in summer.
english.zh: 因為靠近海邊，這座小鎮夏天比較涼爽。

speak.en: For me, proximity to my office matters more than a big kitchen.
speak.zh: 對我來說，離公司近比有個大廚房更重要。

write.en: Scientists study how the proximity of plants to one another affects their growth.
write.zh: 科學家研究植物彼此之間的距離遠近如何影響它們的生長。

example.en: Since food prices rose sharply, many families have started comparing supermarkets to keep their grocery bills down.
example.zh: 自從食品價格大漲，許多家庭開始比較各家超市，好壓低買菜的開銷。

listen.en: Can you help me carry the groceries into the kitchen?
listen.zh: 你可以幫我把買回來的東西搬進廚房嗎？

chinese.en: The small grocery store on the corner stays open late for night-shift workers.
chinese.zh: 轉角那家小雜貨店為了上夜班的人營業到很晚。

english.en: More people now order their groceries online and have them delivered.
english.zh: 現在有越來越多人上網訂購生鮮雜貨，並請人送貨到府。

speak.en: My roommate and I take turns doing the grocery shopping.
speak.zh: 我和室友輪流去採買食物和日用品。

write.en: The charity collects unsold groceries from shops and gives them to families in need.
write.zh: 這個慈善團體向商店收集賣不完的食品雜貨，再轉送給有需要的家庭。

example.en: The neglected harbour district has become lively again thanks to an urban renewal project with new shops and parks.
example.zh: 多虧一項增設商店和公園的都市更新計畫，原本沒落的港區又熱鬧了起來。

listen.en: My gym membership is due for renewal next week.
listen.zh: 我的健身房會員資格下週就要續約了。

chinese.en: The company offered her a better salary when her contract came up for renewal.
chinese.zh: 她的合約到期要續約時，公司開出了更好的薪水。

english.en: Spring is often seen as a season of renewal and hope.
english.zh: 春天常被視為象徵重生與希望的季節。

speak.en: A short trip abroad always gives me a real sense of renewal.
speak.zh: 出國短暫旅行總是讓我有煥然一新的感覺。

write.en: The library charges a small renewal fee if you keep a book longer than allowed.
write.zh: 如果借書超過規定期限，圖書館會收取一筆小額的續借費。

example.en: At the time, the decision to close the factory seemed harsh, but in retrospect it saved the company from bankruptcy.
example.zh: 關閉工廠的決定在當時看似無情，但事後看來，它讓公司免於破產。

listen.en: In retrospect, moving to a new city was the right choice.
listen.zh: 回頭看，搬到新的城市是正確的選擇。

chinese.en: Viewed in retrospect, the early warnings about climate change were remarkably accurate.
chinese.zh: 事後回顧，當年關於氣候變遷的早期警告準確得驚人。

english.en: In retrospect, the test was easier than I had expected.
english.zh: 事後回想起來，那場考試比我原本預期的簡單。

speak.en: Honestly, in retrospect, quitting that part-time job was a smart move.
speak.zh: 說真的，現在回想起來，辭掉那份打工是明智之舉。

write.en: Many policies that looked expensive at first appear wise only in retrospect.
write.zh: 許多政策起初看似花費高昂，要到事後回顧才顯出它們的遠見。

example.en: The young entrepreneurs had only five minutes to pitch their idea to investors, so they practised their presentation all week.
example.zh: 那幾位年輕創業家只有五分鐘向投資人提案，所以他們整個星期都在練習簡報。

listen.en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
listen.zh: 我們在一座安靜的湖邊搭起帳篷。

chinese.en: Her sales pitch was so convincing that most customers signed up on the spot.
chinese.zh: 她的推銷說詞非常有說服力，大部分顧客當場就簽約了。

english.en: The singer has perfect pitch, so she rarely sings out of tune.
english.zh: 那位歌手擁有絕對音感，所以很少走音。

speak.en: I'm not great at baseball because I can't pitch very accurately.
speak.zh: 我棒球打得不太好，因為我投球不太準。

write.en: Excitement in the stadium reached fever pitch as the final minutes ticked away.
write.zh: 比賽進入最後幾分鐘，體育場內的情緒沸騰到了最高點。

example.en: We drove from town to town looking for a room, but every hotel had a sign saying 'No Vacancies'.
example.zh: 我們開車一個小鎮接一個小鎮找房間，但每家旅館都掛著「客滿」的牌子。

listen.en: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
listen.zh: 業務部門有一個職缺。

chinese.en: Hospitals in rural areas struggle to fill vacancies for nurses and specialist doctors.
chinese.zh: 偏鄉醫院很難補足護理師和專科醫師的職缺。

english.en: The school quickly filled the teaching vacancy after the summer.
english.zh: 暑假過後，學校很快就補上了那個教職空缺。

speak.en: I check the job vacancies on that website almost every day.
speak.zh: 我幾乎每天都會上那個網站看職缺。

write.en: With record vacancies in hospitality, some restaurants have reduced their opening hours.
write.zh: 由於餐旅業職缺創下新高，有些餐廳已經縮短營業時間。

example.en: After hours of arguing, the two sides were getting nowhere, so the manager suggested taking a break.
example.zh: 雙方爭論了好幾個小時仍毫無進展，於是經理建議先休息一下。

listen.en: A cyclist appeared out of nowhere and nearly hit me.
listen.zh: 一個騎單車的人突然冒出來，差點撞到我。

chinese.en: Our grandparents live in a tiny village in the middle of nowhere.
chinese.zh: 我們的爺爺奶奶住在一個偏僻荒涼的小村子裡。

english.en: My essay is nowhere near finished, and it is due tomorrow.
english.zh: 我的報告還差得遠呢，明天就要交了。

speak.en: During the holidays I'm going nowhere; I just want to rest.
speak.zh: 假期我哪裡都不去，只想好好休息。

write.en: Nowhere is the impact of rising sea levels more visible than on small islands.
write.zh: 海平面上升的影響，在小島上最為明顯。

example.en: The new weather satellite was launched successfully and is now in orbit, sending detailed images of storms back to scientists.
example.zh: 新的氣象衛星已成功發射並進入軌道，正把詳細的暴風影像傳回給科學家。

listen.en: The space station is orbiting high above our heads.
listen.zh: 太空站正在我們頭頂的高空繞行。

chinese.en: Thousands of pieces of space junk are now orbiting the planet at high speed.
chinese.zh: 目前有成千上萬的太空垃圾正以高速繞著地球運行。

english.en: The rocket successfully put the satellite into orbit last night.
english.zh: 火箭昨晚成功把衛星送入軌道。

speak.en: As a child, I dreamed of seeing the Earth from orbit.
speak.zh: 我小時候夢想著能從太空軌道上看地球。

write.en: Many small towns near the capital have gradually come within its economic orbit.
write.zh: 首都附近的許多小鎮已逐漸被納入它的經濟勢力範圍。

example.en: To mark the hundredth anniversary of the school's founding, former students returned for a weekend of concerts and exhibitions.
example.zh: 為了紀念建校一百週年，校友們回到母校，參加為期一個週末的音樂會和展覽。

listen.en: We had dinner at a lovely restaurant for our anniversary.
listen.zh: 我們在一家很棒的餐廳吃晚餐慶祝紀念日。

chinese.en: The department store is offering big discounts during its anniversary sale this weekend.
chinese.zh: 這週末百貨公司週年慶期間有大幅折扣。

english.en: The city held a ceremony on the anniversary of the earthquake.
english.zh: 市政府在地震週年當天舉辦了紀念儀式。

speak.en: I always forget anniversaries, so I set reminders on my phone.
speak.zh: 我老是忘記紀念日，所以會在手機上設提醒。

write.en: Our company gave every employee a bonus to celebrate its twentieth anniversary.
write.zh: 為了慶祝創立二十週年，我們公司發給每位員工一筆獎金。

example.en: Doctors warn that an unhealthy lifestyle, including little exercise and poor sleep, greatly increases the risk of heart disease.
example.zh: 醫生警告，缺乏運動、睡眠不足等不健康的生活方式，會大幅提高罹患心臟病的風險。

listen.en: Sitting at a desk all day is very unhealthy.
listen.zh: 整天坐在書桌前非常不健康。

chinese.en: Some teenagers develop an unhealthy obsession with their appearance because of social media.
chinese.zh: 受到社群媒體影響，有些青少年對自己的外表產生了不健康的執著。

english.en: Schools should stop selling unhealthy snacks and sugary drinks to children.
english.zh: 學校應該停止販售不健康的零食和含糖飲料給孩子。

speak.en: Working until midnight every night is unhealthy, and I know it.
speak.zh: 每天晚上工作到半夜很不健康，這我自己也知道。

write.en: Constant competition between colleagues can create an unhealthy atmosphere in the office.
write.zh: 同事之間不斷競爭，可能讓辦公室形成不健康的氣氛。

example.en: The airline incurred heavy losses during the crisis, so it cut several routes and delayed buying new planes.
example.zh: 這家航空公司在危機期間蒙受重大損失，因此停飛了幾條航線，並延後購買新飛機。

listen.en: Students may incur debts while studying at university.
listen.zh: 學生在大學求學期間可能會背上債務。

chinese.en: The mayor incurred widespread public criticism after cancelling the popular summer festival.
chinese.zh: 市長取消了廣受歡迎的夏季活動，招致民眾大肆批評。

english.en: We incurred extra costs because the project took longer than planned.
english.zh: 由於專案耗時比預期久，我們多花了額外的費用。

speak.en: I try not to incur any bank charges by paying my bills on time.
speak.zh: 我會準時繳帳單，盡量避免被銀行收取任何手續費。

write.en: Drivers who ignore parking rules in the city centre can incur heavy fines.
write.zh: 在市中心不遵守停車規定的駕駛人，可能會被處以高額罰款。

example.en: Tourists queue for hours to enter the famous chapel, whose ceiling is covered with beautiful paintings.
example.zh: 觀光客排隊好幾個小時，只為進入那座著名的禮拜堂，它的天花板上布滿了精美的畫作。

listen.en: The old stone chapel stands on top of the hill.
listen.zh: 那座古老的石造小教堂矗立在山丘頂上。

chinese.en: The university chapel is often used for concerts and graduation ceremonies as well.
chinese.zh: 這所大學的禮拜堂也經常用來舉辦音樂會和畢業典禮。

english.en: The hospital has a quiet chapel where families can sit and rest.
english.zh: 這家醫院有一間安靜的小禮拜堂，家屬可以在那裡坐下來休息。

speak.en: We visited a beautiful little chapel during our trip to the mountains.
speak.zh: 我們去山區旅行時參觀了一間很漂亮的小教堂。

write.en: Local volunteers raised money to repair the roof of the village chapel.
write.zh: 當地志工募款修繕村裡那間小教堂的屋頂。

example.en: The new stadium went far over budget, and taxpayers were angry when the final bill was twice the original estimate.
example.zh: 新體育場嚴重超出預算，最後的帳單是原本估價的兩倍，納稅人都很憤怒。

listen.en: Many students have to travel on a tight budget.
listen.zh: 許多學生旅行時都得精打細算。

chinese.en: The government plans to increase the education budget to hire more teachers next year.
chinese.zh: 政府計畫明年增加教育預算，以聘請更多教師。

english.en: I budget carefully every month so I can save for a trip.
english.zh: 我每個月都仔細規劃開支，好存錢去旅行。

speak.en: I usually fly with budget airlines because they're much cheaper.
speak.zh: 我通常搭廉價航空，因為便宜很多。

write.en: Small businesses should budget for unexpected repairs instead of spending all their profits.
write.zh: 小型企業應該為突發的維修預留預算，而不是把利潤全部花光。

example.en: The long branches of the weeping willow hung down so low that they almost touched the surface of the river.
example.zh: 垂柳的長枝垂得很低，幾乎碰到河面。

listen.en: We had a picnic under the old willow.
listen.zh: 我們在那棵老柳樹下野餐。

chinese.en: Local craftspeople weave thin willow branches into strong baskets and garden fences.
chinese.zh: 當地的工匠把細柳枝編成堅固的籃子和花園圍籬。

english.en: Willows usually grow well near rivers and other wet places.
english.zh: 柳樹通常在河邊或其他潮濕的地方長得很好。

speak.en: My favourite spot on campus is the bench under the willows.
speak.zh: 我在校園裡最喜歡的地方，是柳樹下的那張長椅。

write.en: The city planted willows along the riverbank to prevent soil erosion during floods.
write.zh: 市政府沿著河岸種植柳樹，以防止洪水期間土壤流失。

example.en: Before ordering the sofa, measure the dimensions of your living room carefully so that it will actually fit.
example.zh: 訂購沙發前，請仔細量好客廳的尺寸，確保放得進去。

listen.en: This problem also has an important social dimension.
listen.zh: 這個問題還牽涉一個重要的社會層面。

chinese.en: Climate change has economic, political and moral dimensions that experts often debate.
chinese.zh: 氣候變遷涉及經濟、政治和道德層面，專家們經常為此爭論。

english.en: Unlike a flat photograph, a sculpture exists in three dimensions.
english.zh: 不同於平面的照片，雕塑是以三度空間的形式存在。

speak.en: I think music gives films an emotional dimension that dialogue can't.
speak.zh: 我覺得音樂能為電影帶來對白無法給予的情感層次。

write.en: Architects must consider both the dimensions and the natural light of a space when designing homes.
write.zh: 建築師設計住宅時，必須同時考量空間的尺寸與自然採光。

example.en: With heavy rain forecast all weekend, it is doubtful that the outdoor concert will go ahead as planned.
example.zh: 氣象預報整個週末都會下大雨，戶外音樂會恐怕很難照原訂計畫舉行。

listen.en: The coach looked doubtful when I asked to play.
listen.zh: 我要求上場時，教練看起來有些遲疑。

chinese.en: Many economists remain doubtful that the new tax will reduce income inequality.
chinese.zh: 許多經濟學家仍然懷疑新稅制能否縮小貧富差距。

english.en: It is doubtful whether she will finish the report on time.
english.zh: 她能不能準時完成報告，還很難說。

speak.en: I'm a bit doubtful about online reviews; many seem fake.
speak.zh: 我對網路評論有點存疑，很多看起來都是假的。

write.en: The painting was considered of doubtful origin until experts examined it closely.
write.zh: 在專家仔細鑑定之前，這幅畫的來歷一直被認為很可疑。

example.en: After losing his grandfather, the boy struggled to express his grief, so his teacher encouraged him to write about it.
example.zh: 失去爺爺後，那個男孩不知道該如何表達心中的悲傷，於是老師鼓勵他把感受寫下來。

listen.en: Talking to friends can help people cope with grief.
listen.zh: 和朋友聊聊可以幫助人們度過悲傷。

chinese.en: The whole community shared the family's grief and offered to cook meals for them.
chinese.zh: 整個社區都和這家人一同哀傷，並主動幫他們煮飯。

english.en: Deep grief can affect both your mental and physical health.
english.zh: 深切的悲痛可能同時影響你的身心健康。

speak.en: Good grief, I can't believe the bus is late again!
speak.zh: 天啊，我不敢相信公車又遲到了！

write.en: Many hospitals now offer grief counselling to support families after a loss.
write.zh: 現在許多醫院都提供悲傷輔導，協助家屬度過失去親人的難關。

example.en: The discussion centered on how the city could reduce traffic, with most people supporting more bike lanes.
example.zh: 討論的焦點集中在城市該如何減少車流，多數人支持增設自行車道。

listen.en: The new shopping center opens early on weekends.
listen.zh: 新的購物中心週末很早就開門。

chinese.en: Our university has a career center that helps students write resumes and prepare for interviews.
chinese.zh: 我們大學設有職涯中心，協助學生撰寫履歷和準備面試。

english.en: My little sister always wants to be the center of attention.
english.zh: 我妹妹總是想成為眾人注目的焦點。

speak.en: I prefer living near the city center because everything is convenient.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡住在市中心附近，因為什麼都很方便。

write.en: The city has become a major center for technology companies and start-ups.
write.zh: 這座城市已經成為科技公司和新創企業的重鎮。

example.en: Workers at the chemical plant must wear protective clothing, including gloves and masks, to avoid contact with harmful substances.
example.zh: 化學工廠的員工必須穿戴手套、口罩等防護衣物，以免接觸有害物質。

listen.en: This shop sells clothing for children and teenagers.
listen.zh: 這家店販售兒童和青少年的服裝。

chinese.en: Every year the fashion industry produces huge amounts of clothing, much of which ends up in landfills.
chinese.zh: 時尚產業每年生產大量衣物，其中許多最後都進了垃圾掩埋場。

english.en: I donated several items of clothing to a local charity.
english.zh: 我把幾件衣服捐給了當地的慈善機構。

speak.en: I don't spend much on clothing; I mostly buy second-hand.
speak.zh: 我花在衣服上的錢不多，大多買二手的。

write.en: Traditional clothing is often worn during festivals to celebrate a region's culture and history.
write.zh: 節慶期間，人們常穿上傳統服飾，慶祝當地的文化與歷史。

example.en: Volunteers transformed the empty car park into a community garden where neighbours now grow vegetables together.
example.zh: 志工們把空蕩蕩的停車場改造成社區菜園，現在鄰居們會一起在那裡種菜。

listen.en: Studying abroad transformed her confidence and her English.
listen.zh: 出國念書讓她的自信和英文都脫胎換骨。

chinese.en: Renewable energy has the potential to transform the economies of many developing countries.
chinese.zh: 再生能源有潛力徹底改變許多開發中國家的經濟。

english.en: A fresh coat of paint can transform an old room.
english.zh: 重新粉刷一遍油漆，就能讓舊房間煥然一新。

speak.en: Learning to cook really transformed my diet and my health.
speak.zh: 學會做菜真的大大改變了我的飲食和健康。

write.en: Over several weeks, a caterpillar slowly transforms into a butterfly inside its protective case.
write.zh: 毛毛蟲在保護殼裡經過幾個星期，慢慢蛻變成蝴蝶。

example.en: The climbers spent months preparing for the expedition, testing their equipment and training at high altitude.
example.zh: 登山隊員花了好幾個月為這次遠征做準備，測試裝備並在高海拔地區訓練。

listen.en: My aunt is leading a fishing expedition this weekend.
listen.zh: 我阿姨這個週末要帶隊去釣魚。

chinese.en: The museum displays tools and diaries collected during a famous polar expedition.
chinese.zh: 這座博物館展示了一次著名極地探險中所收集的工具和日記。

english.en: The scientific expedition discovered several new species of insects in the rainforest.
english.zh: 這支科學考察隊在雨林中發現了好幾種新的昆蟲。

speak.en: Taking my little cousins to the supermarket feels like a real expedition.
speak.zh: 帶我那幾個小表弟妹去超市，簡直像一趟探險。

write.en: Some critics argue that expensive space expeditions waste money needed for problems on Earth.
write.zh: 有些批評者認為，昂貴的太空探險浪費了原本可以用來解決地球問題的經費。

example.en: After years of falling sales, the small bookshop finally ceased trading and its owner retired to the countryside.
example.zh: 在銷量連年下滑後，那家小書店終於歇業，老闆也退休搬到鄉下。

listen.en: The loud noise outside finally ceased just before midnight.
listen.zh: 外面的吵雜聲終於在快午夜時停了下來。

chinese.en: Without enough funding, the research programme will cease to exist next spring.
chinese.zh: 如果經費不足，這項研究計畫明年春天就會走入歷史。

english.en: The rain ceased, and the children ran outside to play.
english.zh: 雨停了，孩子們跑到外面去玩。

speak.en: Honestly, it never ceases to amaze me how fast technology changes.
speak.zh: 說真的，科技變化的速度總是讓我驚嘆不已。

write.en: The airline ceased all flights to the island because of the volcanic eruption.
write.zh: 由於火山爆發，航空公司停飛了所有前往該島的班機。

example.en: When she first moved abroad, she experienced culture shock, feeling confused by unfamiliar customs and food.
example.zh: 她剛搬到國外時經歷了文化衝擊，對陌生的風俗和食物感到困惑。

listen.en: I was shocked by the price of the tickets.
listen.zh: 票價高得讓我嚇了一跳。

chinese.en: The report shocked many parents by revealing how little sleep teenagers actually get.
chinese.zh: 這份報告揭露青少年實際上睡得有多少，讓許多家長大為震驚。

english.en: Don't touch that wire, or you might get an electric shock.
english.zh: 別碰那條電線，不然你可能會觸電。

speak.en: Honestly, it was a shock to see how much my hometown had changed.
speak.zh: 說真的，看到家鄉變了那麼多，我嚇了一大跳。

write.en: Sudden rises in oil prices can send a shock through the global economy.
write.zh: 油價突然上漲，可能會對全球經濟造成衝擊。

example.en: Although sales fell sharply last spring, the company bounced back quickly after launching a cheaper version of its product.
example.zh: 雖然去年春天銷量大跌，但公司推出平價版產品後很快就止跌回升。

listen.en: The little boy was bouncing up and down on the bed.
listen.zh: 那個小男孩在床上跳上跳下。

chinese.en: Sound waves bounce off hard surfaces, which is why empty rooms often echo.
chinese.zh: 聲波碰到堅硬的表面會反彈，所以空房間常有回音。

english.en: My email bounced back because I typed the address wrong.
english.zh: 我的電子郵件被退回了，因為我把地址打錯了。

speak.en: I love this new mattress; it has a nice bounce to it.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡這張新床墊，它的彈性很好。

write.en: The basketball bounced off the rim, and the crowd groaned in disappointment.
write.zh: 籃球打到籃框彈了出去，觀眾失望地哀嘆。

example.en: In the floor plan, the kitchen appears as a narrow rectangle next to the much larger living room.
example.zh: 在平面圖上，廚房是一個狹長的長方形，旁邊就是大得多的客廳。

listen.en: Please cut the paper into a small rectangle.
listen.zh: 請把這張紙剪成一個小長方形。

chinese.en: To find the area of a rectangle, multiply its length by its width.
chinese.zh: 要算出長方形的面積，就把長乘以寬。

english.en: Most phone screens today are rectangles with slightly rounded corners.
english.zh: 現在大多數手機螢幕都是邊角略圓的長方形。

speak.en: I'd like a rug shaped like a rectangle, not a circle.
speak.zh: 我想要長方形的地毯，不要圓形的。

write.en: The new park was designed as a series of green rectangles linked by walking paths.
write.zh: 這座新公園被設計成一塊塊長方形綠地，彼此以步道相連。

example.en: Passengers were notified by text message that their flight had been delayed because of the storm.
example.zh: 乘客收到簡訊通知，說他們的班機因暴風雨而延誤。

listen.en: The school will notify parents if classes are cancelled.
listen.zh: 如果停課，學校會通知家長。

chinese.en: Employees must notify their manager in writing if they plan to take extended leave.
chinese.zh: 員工如果打算請長假，必須以書面通知主管。

english.en: If you find a lost wallet, you should notify the police.
english.zh: 如果你撿到遺失的錢包，應該通報警察。

speak.en: I turned off the app because it kept notifying me about sales.
speak.zh: 我把那個應用程式關掉了，因為它一直通知我特價消息。

write.en: Health authorities notified the public immediately after the contaminated water was detected.
write.zh: 衛生主管機關一發現水源遭到汙染，就立刻通知民眾。

example.en: Because the lease expires next month, the cafe owners must decide whether to stay or find a cheaper location.
example.zh: 由於租約下個月到期，咖啡館老闆們必須決定是要續租，還是另覓租金較低的地點。

listen.en: Many companies lease their cars instead of buying them.
listen.zh: 許多公司用租的方式取得公務車，而不是直接購買。

chinese.en: The landlord refused to renew our lease because he wanted to sell the apartment.
chinese.zh: 房東拒絕和我們續約，因為他想把公寓賣掉。

english.en: The city leased the empty building to a local art group.
english.zh: 市政府把那棟空置的建築出租給當地一個藝術團體。

speak.en: Before signing a lease, I always read every line very carefully.
speak.zh: 簽租約之前，我一定會一字一句仔細看過。

write.en: Moving the old library into a modern building gave it a new lease of life.
write.zh: 舊圖書館搬進現代化的新大樓後，彷彿重獲新生。

example.en: She forgot to pay the annual fee, so her gym membership lapsed and she had to register again.
example.zh: 她忘了繳年費，所以健身房會員資格失效，只好重新註冊。

listen.en: After the bad news, the room lapsed into silence.
listen.zh: 聽到壞消息後，整個房間陷入一片沉默。

chinese.en: The manager apologised for the security lapse that allowed customer data to be exposed.
chinese.zh: 經理為這次導致客戶資料外洩的資安疏失道歉。

english.en: After a lapse of several years, he started painting again.
english.zh: 中斷了好幾年之後，他又重新開始畫畫。

speak.en: Sorry, I had a memory lapse and completely forgot your name.
speak.zh: 抱歉，我一時想不起來，完全忘了你的名字。

write.en: A single lapse in judgement by an official can damage public trust for years.
write.zh: 官員一次判斷失誤，就可能讓民眾的信任受損多年。

example.en: During the serious ceremony, the two friends got the giggles and had to cover their mouths to stay quiet.
example.zh: 在莊嚴的典禮上，那兩個朋友笑個不停，只好摀住嘴巴保持安靜。

listen.en: The baby giggled every time her father made silly faces.
listen.zh: 爸爸每次扮鬼臉，小寶寶就咯咯地笑。

chinese.en: She gave a nervous giggle when the interviewer asked about her weaknesses.
chinese.zh: 面試官問到她的缺點時，她緊張地傻笑了一下。

english.en: The students could not stop giggling during the long speech.
english.zh: 學生們在冗長的演講中一直忍不住偷笑。

speak.en: My friends and I always giggle at the same silly jokes.
speak.zh: 我和朋友總是被同樣的無聊笑話逗得咯咯笑。

write.en: Researchers found that laughing and giggling together helps young children build friendships.
write.zh: 研究人員發現，一起嘻嘻哈哈地笑有助於幼童建立友誼。

example.en: From a distance, the strange rock formation resembles a sleeping giant lying beside the sea.
example.zh: 從遠處看，那塊奇特的岩石就像一個躺在海邊沉睡的巨人。

listen.en: The new library resembles an enormous glass box.
listen.zh: 新圖書館看起來像一個巨大的玻璃盒子。

chinese.en: The education systems of the two countries resemble each other in many important ways.
chinese.zh: 這兩個國家的教育制度在許多重要方面都很相似。

english.en: This soup tastes good, but it barely resembles the photo on the menu.
english.zh: 這道湯很好喝，但跟菜單上的照片幾乎不像。

speak.en: Honestly, my hometown hardly resembles the quiet place I grew up in.
speak.zh: 說真的，我的家鄉已經不太像我從小長大的那個寧靜地方了。

write.en: Some modern office jobs increasingly resemble factory work, with strict targets and constant monitoring.
write.zh: 有些現代辦公室工作越來越像工廠勞動，不但目標嚴格，還時時受到監控。

example.en: The hotel foyer was decorated with fresh flowers and a huge chandelier that impressed every guest who walked in.
example.zh: 飯店大廳以鮮花和一盞巨大的水晶吊燈裝飾，讓每位走進來的客人都印象深刻。

listen.en: Please wait for your guide in the main foyer.
listen.zh: 請在主大廳等候您的導覽員。

chinese.en: Students' artwork is displayed in the school foyer for visitors to admire.
chinese.zh: 學生的作品陳列在學校大廳，供來訪者欣賞。

english.en: We left our wet umbrellas in the foyer of the museum.
english.zh: 我們把濕雨傘留在博物館的大廳。

speak.en: Our apartment has a tiny foyer where we keep our shoes.
speak.zh: 我們的公寓有個小玄關，平常鞋子就放在那裡。

write.en: The company turned its empty foyer into a cafe that is open to the public.
write.zh: 這家公司把空蕩蕩的大廳改成開放給民眾使用的咖啡館。

example.en: The online seller used fake reviews and stolen photos to deceive buyers, but the website eventually removed his account.
example.zh: 那名網路賣家用假評論和盜來的照片欺騙買家，最後網站把他的帳號移除了。

listen.en: Please don't let his friendly smile deceive you.
listen.zh: 請不要被他友善的笑容騙了。

chinese.en: If you think you can pass without studying, you are only deceiving yourself.
chinese.zh: 如果你以為不念書也能及格，那只是在自欺欺人。

english.en: Appearances can deceive, so get to know people before judging them.
english.zh: 外表可能會騙人，所以在評斷別人之前要先了解他們。

speak.en: I felt deceived when the hotel looked nothing like its photos.
speak.zh: 那家飯店跟照片完全不一樣，讓我覺得被騙了。

write.en: Companies that deceive the public about product safety should face strict penalties.
write.zh: 在產品安全上欺騙大眾的企業，應該受到嚴厲的處罰。

example.en: The company was prosecuted for polluting the lake after tests showed dangerous levels of chemicals in the water.
example.zh: 檢測顯示湖水中的化學物質含量達到危險程度後，那家公司因汙染湖泊而遭到起訴。

listen.en: The store says shoplifters will always be prosecuted.
listen.zh: 這家店表示，順手牽羊的人一律會被起訴。

chinese.en: There was not enough evidence to prosecute the manager, so the case was dropped.
chinese.zh: 證據不足以起訴那名經理，所以這個案子就撤銷了。

english.en: Drivers who use their phones while driving may be prosecuted.
english.zh: 開車時使用手機的駕駛人可能會被起訴。

speak.en: I think people who spread false health information should be prosecuted.
speak.zh: 我認為散布不實健康資訊的人應該被起訴。

write.en: Authorities rarely prosecute people behind small online scams because they are hard to trace.
write.zh: 小型網路詐騙的幕後主使很難追查，所以有關當局很少起訴他們。

example.en: Every morning, the farmer walks along the perimeter of his land to check that none of the fences are broken.
example.zh: 每天早上，農夫都會沿著農地外圍走一圈，確認圍籬沒有損壞。

listen.en: We jogged around the perimeter of the park.
listen.zh: 我們繞著公園外圍慢跑。

chinese.en: To find the perimeter of a square, add the lengths of all its sides.
chinese.zh: 要算出正方形的周長，就把所有邊的長度加起來。

english.en: Security guards patrol the perimeter of the factory every night.
english.zh: 保全人員每晚都會在工廠周邊巡邏。

speak.en: My favourite part of the campus is the path along its perimeter.
speak.zh: 我在校園裡最喜歡的地方，是沿著校園外圍的那條小路。

write.en: Many cities are building new housing on the perimeter instead of in crowded central areas.
write.zh: 許多城市選擇在外圍地區興建新住宅，而不是在擁擠的市中心。

example.en: By cycling to work and eating less meat, she has managed to reduce her carbon footprint significantly over the past year.
example.zh: 過去一年，她靠著騎單車上班和少吃肉，大幅減少了自己的碳足跡。

listen.en: Trees absorb carbon dioxide and release fresh oxygen.
listen.zh: 樹木會吸收二氧化碳，並釋放新鮮的氧氣。

chinese.en: The company has promised to become carbon neutral by investing in solar and wind power.
chinese.zh: 這家公司承諾要投資太陽能和風力發電，以達到碳中和。

english.en: Many people think governments should tax companies with high carbon emissions.
english.zh: 許多人認為政府應該對碳排放量高的企業課稅。

speak.en: I try to fly less because air travel produces so much carbon.
speak.zh: 我盡量少搭飛機，因為航空旅行會產生大量的碳。

write.en: Diamonds and pencil lead are both made of carbon, yet they look completely different.
write.zh: 鑽石和鉛筆芯都是由碳構成的，外觀卻截然不同。

example.en: As a food critic, she visits dozens of restaurants each year and writes honest reviews of their dishes.
example.zh: 身為美食評論家，她每年造訪數十家餐廳，並為它們的菜色寫下誠實的評論。

listen.en: Even his harshest critics admired the courage of his decision.
listen.zh: 就連批評他最嚴厲的人，也佩服他做這個決定的勇氣。

chinese.en: Critics of the new policy argue that it will hurt small local businesses.
chinese.zh: 反對這項新政策的人認為，它會傷害當地的小型商家。

english.en: My father is always my toughest critic when I cook dinner.
english.zh: 我煮晚餐時，爸爸總是最嚴格的評論者。

speak.en: Honestly, I'm my own worst critic when it comes to exams.
speak.zh: 老實說，講到考試，我對自己最嚴苛。

write.en: Online critics quickly pointed out several errors in the company's latest advertisement.
write.zh: 網路上的批評者很快就指出這家公司最新廣告中的幾個錯誤。

example.en: The storm caused severe damage to roads and bridges, and some villages were cut off for weeks.
example.zh: 這場暴風雨對道路和橋梁造成嚴重損害，有些村莊對外聯繫中斷了好幾週。

listen.en: She had a severe headache after the long flight.
listen.zh: 長途飛行之後，她頭痛得很厲害。

chinese.en: Students who cheat in exams will face severe penalties, including possible expulsion.
chinese.zh: 考試作弊的學生將受到嚴厲處分，甚至可能被退學。

english.en: The doctor said his injury was more severe than expected.
english.zh: 醫生說他的傷勢比預期的還嚴重。

speak.en: Traffic jams in my city can be pretty severe during rush hour.
speak.zh: 我住的城市在尖峰時段塞車可能相當嚴重。

write.en: Our new manager seems severe at first, but she is actually very supportive.
write.zh: 我們的新主管乍看之下很嚴厲，但其實非常願意支持我們。

example.en: After falling off his bike, the boy had a deep cut on his knee that needed several stitches at the hospital.
example.zh: 男孩從腳踏車上摔下來後，膝蓋有一道很深的傷口，得到醫院縫好幾針。

listen.en: My grandmother stitched a small flower onto my scarf.
listen.zh: 奶奶在我的圍巾上縫了一朵小花。

chinese.en: The tailor carefully stitched the torn sleeve so the repair was almost invisible.
chinese.zh: 裁縫師小心地縫好破掉的袖子，修補的痕跡幾乎看不出來。

english.en: Could you help me stitch this button back onto my shirt?
english.zh: 你可以幫我把這顆鈕扣縫回襯衫上嗎？

speak.en: I'm terrible at sewing, so I can barely stitch a straight line.
speak.zh: 我很不會縫東西，連一條直線都縫不太好。

write.en: The team stitched together short video clips to create a promotional film for the festival.
write.zh: 團隊把一段段短片剪接在一起，做成這次節慶的宣傳影片。

example.en: To give each employee more privacy, the office was divided into small work areas by glass partitions.
example.zh: 為了讓每位員工更有隱私，辦公室用玻璃隔板分成一個個小工作區。

listen.en: We used a curtain to partition the large bedroom.
listen.zh: 我們用一片簾子把大臥室隔開。

chinese.en: The hard drive was partitioned so that work files and personal files stay separate.
chinese.zh: 這顆硬碟已經分割過，讓工作檔案和個人檔案分開存放。

english.en: The large classroom can be partitioned for small group discussions.
english.zh: 這間大教室可以隔開來進行小組討論。

speak.en: The walls in my dorm are just thin partitions, so it's quite noisy.
speak.zh: 我宿舍的牆只是薄薄的隔板，所以滿吵的。

write.en: The partition of the land among the brothers led to years of family disagreement.
write.zh: 兄弟之間分割土地的事，導致家族多年的不和。

example.en: At first, the idea of carrying a phone that could take photos seemed ludicrous, but now everyone does it.
example.zh: 起初，帶著一支能拍照的手機這個想法似乎很荒謬，但現在人人都這麼做。

listen.en: The excuse he gave for being late was ludicrous.
listen.zh: 他遲到給的藉口荒謬至極。

chinese.en: Experts called the proposal ludicrous because it ignored the actual cost of construction.
chinese.zh: 專家認為這項提案很荒謬，因為它完全忽略了實際的建造成本。

english.en: Some of the rules at my old high school were ludicrous.
english.zh: 我以前高中的某些校規很荒謬。

speak.en: Honestly, the rent in this area is absolutely ludicrous these days.
speak.zh: 說真的，這一帶最近的房租貴得離譜。

write.en: The movie's plot was so ludicrous that the whole audience burst out laughing.
write.zh: 這部電影的劇情荒唐到全場觀眾都笑了出來。

example.en: Malaria remains prevalent in some tropical regions, where warm weather allows mosquitoes to breed all year round.
example.zh: 瘧疾在某些熱帶地區依然盛行，因為那裡氣候溫暖，蚊子一年四季都能繁殖。

listen.en: This attitude is still prevalent in many workplaces.
listen.zh: 這種心態在許多職場仍然很普遍。

chinese.en: Online shopping is more prevalent in cities than in rural areas, according to the survey.
chinese.zh: 根據這份調查，網路購物在城市比在鄉村更普遍。

english.en: Back pain is very prevalent among people who work in offices.
english.zh: 背痛在上班族之間非常普遍。

speak.en: I think the habit of eating out is really prevalent in Taiwan.
speak.zh: 我覺得外食的習慣在臺灣真的很普遍。

write.en: The belief that hard work guarantees success was prevalent in my parents' generation.
write.zh: 「努力就一定會成功」的觀念在我父母那一代很盛行。

example.en: Scientists observed how the animals behaved when their food supply suddenly became scarce in winter.
example.zh: 科學家觀察這些動物在冬天食物突然短缺時會有什麼樣的行為。

listen.en: Please behave yourself when we visit your grandparents.
listen.zh: 我們去看爺爺奶奶時，請你守規矩。

chinese.en: The new software behaves strangely whenever too many programs are open at the same time.
chinese.zh: 只要同時開太多程式，這套新軟體就會出現怪怪的狀況。

english.en: Students should always behave politely toward their teachers and classmates.
english.zh: 學生對老師和同學應該始終保持禮貌。

speak.en: My dog usually behaves well, but he goes crazy around cats.
speak.zh: 我的狗平常很乖，但一看到貓就會抓狂。

write.en: Customers tend to behave differently when products are placed at eye level in stores.
write.zh: 商品擺在與視線同高的位置時，顧客的購買行為往往會不一樣。

example.en: The sudden influx of international students forced the university to build new dormitories and hire more staff.
example.zh: 國際學生突然大量湧入，迫使這所大學興建新宿舍並增聘人手。

listen.en: An influx of visitors filled the small seaside town.
listen.zh: 大批遊客湧入，擠滿了這個海邊小鎮。

chinese.en: The influx of cheap imports has made it difficult for local farmers to survive.
chinese.zh: 廉價進口貨大量湧入，讓本地農民難以生存。

english.en: The festival brought an influx of visitors to the city.
english.zh: 這個節慶為這座城市帶來大批遊客。

speak.en: Every holiday there's a huge influx of people into the night markets.
speak.zh: 每逢假日，夜市都會湧入大量人潮。

write.en: A steady influx of new ideas keeps a research team creative and productive.
write.zh: 源源不絕的新點子能讓研究團隊保持創意和生產力。

example.en: For many office workers, hiking on weekends is a form of recreation that helps them relieve stress.
example.zh: 對許多上班族來說，週末爬山是一種能幫助他們紓壓的休閒活動。

listen.en: Fishing has always been his favorite form of recreation.
listen.zh: 釣魚一直是他最喜歡的消遣。

chinese.en: The government plans to build more recreation facilities in densely populated neighborhoods.
chinese.zh: 政府計畫在人口稠密的社區興建更多休閒設施。

english.en: The lake near our town is a popular place for recreation.
english.zh: 我們鎮附近的那座湖是很受歡迎的休閒去處。

speak.en: For recreation, I usually play basketball with friends after work.
speak.zh: 休閒時，我通常下班後和朋友去打籃球。

write.en: The community center offers recreation programs for elderly residents, such as dancing and painting.
write.zh: 社區活動中心為長者提供跳舞、繪畫等休閒課程。

example.en: When the workers and management could not agree on wages, a government official stepped in to mediate between them.
example.zh: 勞資雙方在薪資上談不攏時，一位政府官員出面在兩者之間斡旋。

listen.en: Our teacher tried to mediate between the arguing students.
listen.zh: 老師試著在吵架的學生之間調解。

chinese.en: The organization has mediated several conflicts between neighboring communities over water rights.
chinese.zh: 這個組織曾調解過鄰近社區之間好幾起用水權的衝突。

english.en: My mother often has to mediate between my brother and me.
english.zh: 我媽媽常常得在我和哥哥之間當和事佬。

speak.en: At work, I sometimes mediate when colleagues disagree about deadlines.
speak.zh: 工作上，同事對截止期限意見不合時，我有時會出面協調。

write.en: The lawyer successfully mediated an agreement between the landlord and his tenants.
write.zh: 律師成功促成房東和房客之間達成協議。

example.en: When it is summer in the Northern Hemisphere, people in Argentina are experiencing the cold days of winter.
example.zh: 北半球是夏天的時候，阿根廷的人們正在經歷寒冷的冬天。

listen.en: The seasons are reversed in the other hemisphere.
listen.zh: 在另一個半球，季節是相反的。

chinese.en: The left hemisphere of the brain is mainly responsible for language and logical thinking.
chinese.zh: 左腦主要負責語言和邏輯思考。

english.en: Most of the world's population lives in the Northern Hemisphere.
english.zh: 全世界大部分的人口住在北半球。

speak.en: I'd love to spend Christmas in the Southern Hemisphere someday.
speak.zh: 我很希望有一天能在南半球過聖誕節。

write.en: This rare bird migrates between hemispheres, flying thousands of kilometers every year.
write.zh: 這種稀有鳥類每年在南北半球之間遷徙，飛行數千公里。

example.en: The new phone is robust enough to survive being dropped, and its case is also waterproof.
example.zh: 這支新手機夠堅固，摔到也不會壞，外殼還能防水。

listen.en: We need a more robust system to protect our data.
listen.zh: 我們需要更穩健的系統來保護資料。

chinese.en: Researchers found robust evidence that regular exercise improves memory in older adults.
chinese.zh: 研究人員找到有力證據，證明規律運動能改善長者的記憶力。

english.en: My grandfather is still robust and goes for a walk every morning.
english.zh: 我爺爺身體依然硬朗，每天早上都會去散步。

speak.en: I think a robust public transport system makes city life much easier.
speak.zh: 我覺得完善的大眾運輸系統會讓城市生活方便很多。

write.en: The bridge was designed to be robust enough to withstand strong earthquakes.
write.zh: 這座橋的設計夠堅固，能承受強烈地震。

example.en: Hackers infected thousands of computers with malicious software, which secretly stole users' personal information.
example.zh: 駭客讓數千臺電腦感染惡意軟體，暗中竊取使用者的個人資料。

listen.en: Wash your hands so you don't infect others.
listen.zh: 要洗手，才不會傳染給別人。

chinese.en: The wound became infected because it was not cleaned properly after the accident.
chinese.zh: 事故後傷口沒有好好清理，所以發炎感染了。

english.en: Her cheerful laughter quickly infected everyone else in the classroom.
english.zh: 她開朗的笑聲很快感染了教室裡的其他人。

speak.en: I caught a cold last week, so I'm trying not to infect my coworkers.
speak.zh: 我上週感冒了，所以盡量不要傳染給同事。

write.en: The disease infected most of the orange trees on the farm, ruining the harvest.
write.zh: 這種病害感染了農場裡大部分的柳橙樹，讓收成毀於一旦。

example.en: Unlike a traditional novel, the story is not linear; it jumps between the past and the present.
example.zh: 和傳統小說不同，這個故事不是依時間順序敘述，而是在過去和現在之間跳躍。

listen.en: The museum tour follows a simple linear route.
listen.zh: 博物館的導覽沿著一條簡單的直線路線進行。

chinese.en: Population growth in the region was roughly linear between the two surveys.
chinese.zh: 在兩次調查之間，這個地區的人口大致呈線性成長。

english.en: Learning a new language is not always a linear process.
english.zh: 學習新語言並不一定是循序漸進的過程。

speak.en: My career path hasn't been very linear, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我的職涯發展並不是一路直線前進。

write.en: Engineers prefer a linear design for the railway because curves slow down trains.
write.zh: 工程師偏好把鐵路設計成直線，因為彎道會讓火車減速。

example.en: The survey was carefully designed to elicit honest opinions from employees without revealing their identities.
example.zh: 這份問卷經過精心設計，能在不透露員工身分的情況下，引出他們真實的意見。

listen.en: His joke failed to elicit even a small laugh.
listen.zh: 他的笑話連一點笑聲都沒引起。

chinese.en: The new policy has elicited strong reactions from parents and teachers alike.
chinese.zh: 這項新政策在家長和老師之間都引起了強烈反應。

english.en: The doctor asked questions to elicit more information about the pain.
english.zh: 醫生提出問題，想多了解疼痛的情況。

speak.en: Good interviewers know how to elicit interesting stories from guests.
speak.zh: 好的訪談主持人知道如何從來賓口中引出有趣的故事。

write.en: The charity's moving advertisement elicited a wave of donations from the public.
write.zh: 這個慈善機構感人的廣告引來大眾一波捐款。

example.en: The old wooden bridge was replaced with one made of steel and concrete, which is much stronger.
example.zh: 舊木橋被換成鋼筋混凝土造的新橋，堅固多了。

listen.en: We need concrete evidence before we make a decision.
listen.zh: 做決定之前，我們需要具體的證據。

chinese.en: The city is full of concrete buildings, with very few green spaces left.
chinese.zh: 這座城市滿是水泥建築，幾乎沒剩下什麼綠地。

english.en: The government has not taken any concrete action on air pollution.
english.zh: 政府還沒有針對空氣汙染採取任何具體行動。

speak.en: I like having concrete goals, like finishing a book every month.
speak.zh: 我喜歡設定具體的目標，像是每個月讀完一本書。

write.en: The workers poured fresh concrete for the new sidewalk outside our school.
write.zh: 工人在我們學校外頭灌了新的混凝土，鋪設新人行道。

example.en: The school introduced a new program to help students report bullying and to support those who were being bullied.
example.zh: 學校推出新方案，幫助學生通報霸凌事件，並支持正在被霸凌的同學。

listen.en: Nobody should be bullied because of their appearance.
listen.zh: 沒有人應該因為外表而被霸凌。

chinese.en: The manager was accused of bullying junior staff into working unpaid overtime.
chinese.zh: 這位主管被指控脅迫基層員工無償加班。

english.en: Don't let anyone bully you into doing something you don't want.
english.zh: 別讓任何人逼你做你不想做的事。

speak.en: When I was a kid, a bully used to steal my lunch.
speak.zh: 我小時候，有個愛欺負人的同學常搶我的午餐。

write.en: Some large companies bully their small suppliers into accepting unfairly low prices.
write.zh: 有些大公司會施壓小供應商，逼他們接受不合理的低價。

example.en: The magazine published a detailed profile of the young architect, describing her childhood, education, and award-winning designs.
example.zh: 雜誌刊出這位年輕建築師的詳細專訪，介紹她的童年、求學經歷和得獎作品。

listen.en: I could only see his profile in the dim light.
listen.zh: 在昏暗的燈光下，我只看得到他的側臉。

chinese.en: The company wants to raise its profile in Asian markets through social media advertising.
chinese.zh: 這家公司想透過社群媒體廣告，提高在亞洲市場的知名度。

english.en: The local newspaper profiled several inspiring teachers in our city this month.
english.zh: 本地報紙這個月專題介紹了我們市內幾位激勵人心的老師。

speak.en: I spent ages choosing a good profile picture for my account.
speak.zh: 我花了好久才幫帳號選好一張大頭貼。

write.en: Keeping a low profile helped the actor enjoy a quiet holiday abroad.
write.zh: 保持低調讓這位演員在國外享受了一個清靜的假期。

example.en: Selling handmade jewelry online turned out to be surprisingly lucrative, so she eventually quit her office job.
example.zh: 在網路上賣手工飾品結果出乎意料地好賺，所以她最後辭掉了辦公室的工作。

listen.en: Tourism has become a lucrative business on the island.
listen.zh: 觀光業已成為這座島上很賺錢的產業。

chinese.en: Many graduates are attracted to the tech industry because of its lucrative salaries.
chinese.zh: 許多畢業生因為科技業的優渥薪水而受到吸引。

english.en: The company signed a lucrative contract with a foreign partner.
english.zh: 這家公司和一家外國合作夥伴簽下一份獲利豐厚的合約。

speak.en: Being a YouTuber can be lucrative, but it's really unpredictable.
speak.zh: 當 YouTuber 可能很賺錢，但收入真的很不穩定。

write.en: Farmers switched to growing tea because it was more lucrative than rice.
write.zh: 農民改種茶葉，因為比種稻更有賺頭。

example.en: Instead of buying chips from the vending machine, she brings fruit and nuts as healthy snacks to work.
example.zh: 她不從販賣機買洋芋片，而是帶水果和堅果當健康點心去上班。

listen.en: Try not to snack too much before dinner.
listen.zh: 晚餐前盡量別吃太多零食。

chinese.en: Convenience stores in Taiwan sell a huge variety of snacks, from rice balls to tea eggs.
chinese.zh: 臺灣的便利商店販售各式各樣的點心，從飯糰到茶葉蛋都有。

english.en: Parents should stop children from eating too many sugary snacks between meals.
english.zh: 家長應該阻止孩子在兩餐之間吃太多含糖零食。

speak.en: When I study late at night, I always snack on something salty.
speak.zh: 我熬夜讀書時，總會吃點鹹的零食。

write.en: Several schools have banned unhealthy snacks from their cafeterias to fight childhood obesity.
write.zh: 有幾所學校已禁止餐廳販售不健康的零食，以對抗兒童肥胖。

example.en: Among young designers, her guide to typography is considered a bible, and almost every studio keeps a copy.
example.zh: 在年輕設計師之間，她寫的字體排印指南被奉為圭臬，幾乎每間工作室都有一本。

listen.en: This dictionary is my bible for learning English.
listen.zh: 這本字典是我學英文的寶典。

chinese.en: The Bible is one of the most widely translated books in human history.
chinese.zh: 聖經是人類歷史上被翻譯成最多語言的書籍之一。

english.en: This travel guide was our bible during the trip to Japan.
english.zh: 去日本旅行時，這本旅遊指南就是我們的寶典。

speak.en: For me, that grammar book was basically a bible before my exam.
speak.zh: 對我來說，考試前那本文法書根本就是聖經。

write.en: The company's style guide is treated as a bible by every new writer on the team.
write.zh: 公司的寫作風格手冊被團隊裡每位新進文字工作者視為最高準則。

example.en: Since the restaurant was always full, the logical next step for the owners was to open a second branch.
example.zh: 由於餐廳總是客滿，老闆順理成章的下一步就是開第二家分店。

listen.en: There must be a logical explanation for this noise.
listen.zh: 這個聲音一定有合理的解釋。

chinese.en: It seems logical to raise taxes on sugary drinks to reduce health problems.
chinese.zh: 提高含糖飲料的稅來減少健康問題，似乎很合理。

english.en: Please arrange these steps in a more logical order for readers.
english.zh: 請為讀者把這些步驟排成更有條理的順序。

speak.en: I'm a pretty logical person, so I always plan things carefully.
speak.zh: 我是個滿講邏輯的人，所以做事總是會仔細規劃。

write.en: Children develop logical thinking skills by solving puzzles and playing strategy games.
write.zh: 孩子透過解謎和玩策略遊戲培養邏輯思考能力。

example.en: The new library is a welcome addition to the neighborhood, offering free classes and a quiet place to study.
example.zh: 新圖書館是這個社區很受歡迎的新設施，提供免費課程和安靜的讀書空間。

listen.en: The baby is the newest addition to their family.
listen.zh: 這個小寶寶是他們家最新的成員。

chinese.en: The addition of more bus routes has made commuting much easier for residents.
chinese.zh: 增設更多公車路線後，居民通勤方便了許多。

english.en: In addition to homework, students must also join a club.
english.zh: 除了寫作業，學生還必須參加一個社團。

speak.en: I learned addition and subtraction from my grandmother using coins.
speak.zh: 我是跟奶奶用硬幣學會加減法的。

write.en: The museum's new wing is a stunning addition to the city's skyline.
write.zh: 博物館的新側翼為城市天際線增添了一道亮眼的風景。

example.en: Doctors took a blood specimen from the patient to find out what was causing her high fever.
example.zh: 醫生從病人身上採了血液檢體，想查出她發高燒的原因。

listen.en: The scientist examined the leaf specimen under a microscope.
listen.zh: 科學家在顯微鏡下檢查這片葉子標本。

chinese.en: Researchers collected rock specimens from the active volcano to study its eruption history.
chinese.zh: 研究人員從這座活火山採集岩石樣本，以研究它的噴發歷史。

english.en: The biology students collected plant specimens during their school field trip.
english.zh: 生物系學生在校外考察時採集了植物標本。

speak.en: I saw an amazing dinosaur specimen at the natural history museum.
speak.zh: 我在自然史博物館看到一具很驚人的恐龍標本。

write.en: Each specimen in the collection is carefully labeled with its name, location, and date.
write.zh: 館藏中的每件標本都仔細標上名稱、採集地點和日期。

example.en: After living in Tokyo for several years, he became fluent enough to understand jokes and local slang.
example.zh: 在東京住了幾年後，他的日文已流利到能聽懂笑話和當地俚語。

listen.en: My goal is to become fluent in English.
listen.zh: 我的目標是把英文說得很流利。

chinese.en: Being fluent in a second language can open up many career opportunities abroad.
chinese.zh: 能流利使用第二語言，可以為你開啟許多海外工作機會。

english.en: It takes years of practice to become fluent in a language.
english.zh: 要把一種語言說得流利，需要多年的練習。

speak.en: I'm not fluent yet, but I can have basic conversations.
speak.zh: 我還不算流利，但已經能進行基本對話。

write.en: The young pianist gave a fluent and confident performance despite the noisy audience.
write.zh: 儘管觀眾很吵，這位年輕鋼琴家仍演奏得流暢又自信。

example.en: Although the cheaper phone looks similar, its camera is clearly superior, producing sharper photos even at night.
example.zh: 雖然便宜的手機外觀相似，但這支的相機明顯更好，連晚上都能拍出更清晰的照片。

listen.en: I need to discuss this with my superior first.
listen.zh: 我得先和我的上司討論這件事。

chinese.en: Some people believe that handmade products are superior in quality to factory goods.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為手工製品的品質比工廠產品更好。

english.en: She was promoted after impressing her superiors with her hard work.
english.zh: 她的努力讓上司刮目相看，因此獲得升遷。

speak.en: I don't think any culture is superior to another, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不認為有哪種文化比別的文化優越。

write.en: The team's superior teamwork allowed them to defeat a much stronger opponent.
write.zh: 這支隊伍憑著更出色的團隊合作，擊敗了強大許多的對手。

example.en: The contract was not explicit about who should pay for repairs, which led to an argument between the tenants.
example.zh: 合約沒有明確寫出修繕費該由誰負擔，導致房客之間起了爭執。

listen.en: Please be explicit about what you expect from us.
listen.zh: 請清楚說明你對我們有什麼期待。

chinese.en: The law makes it explicit that employers must provide a safe working environment.
chinese.zh: 法律明文規定，雇主必須提供安全的工作環境。

english.en: My boss made it explicit that we cannot work from home.
english.zh: 我老闆明確表示我們不能在家工作。

speak.en: I prefer explicit feedback, so I know exactly what to improve.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡明確的回饋，這樣才知道到底要改進什麼。

write.en: Some cultures value explicit communication, while others rely more on hints and context.
write.zh: 有些文化重視直接明白的溝通，有些則較依賴暗示和情境。

example.en: Many English idioms, such as 'a piece of cake', cannot be understood by translating each word separately.
example.zh: 許多英文慣用語，例如「a piece of cake」，無法靠逐字翻譯來理解。

listen.en: Native speakers use idioms all the time in conversation.
listen.zh: 母語人士在對話中經常使用慣用語。

chinese.en: Chinese idioms often come from ancient stories, so they are hard to translate.
chinese.zh: 中文成語常出自古代故事，所以很難翻譯。

english.en: Our English teacher taught us a useful new idiom every week.
english.zh: 我們的英文老師每週都教我們一個實用的新慣用語。

speak.en: I try to use a few idioms naturally in my speaking test.
speak.zh: 我在口說考試中會試著自然地用幾個慣用語。

write.en: Using too many idioms in an academic essay can make your writing sound informal.
write.zh: 在學術文章中用太多慣用語，會讓文字聽起來不夠正式。

example.en: The government has expended huge sums on new roads, yet traffic congestion in the capital remains as bad as ever.
example.zh: 政府在新道路上投入大筆經費，但首都的塞車問題依舊和以前一樣嚴重。

listen.en: Children expend a lot of energy when they play outside.
listen.zh: 孩子在戶外玩耍時會消耗大量體力。

chinese.en: Companies should not expend valuable resources on projects that are unlikely to succeed.
chinese.zh: 企業不該把寶貴的資源浪費在不太可能成功的計畫上。

english.en: She expended great effort to finish the report on time.
english.zh: 她費了很大的工夫才準時完成報告。

speak.en: I don't want to expend too much time on social media.
speak.zh: 我不想在社群媒體上花太多時間。

write.en: Migrating birds expend enormous amounts of energy flying across the ocean each year.
write.zh: 候鳥每年飛越海洋時會消耗極大的能量。

example.en: Under the new rules, food manufacturers must disclose all ingredients on the label so consumers can avoid allergens.
example.zh: 根據新規定，食品製造商必須在標籤上公開所有成分，讓消費者能避開過敏原。

listen.en: She didn't disclose the reason for her decision.
listen.zh: 她沒有透露做這個決定的原因。

chinese.en: Patients have the right to decide whether to disclose their medical history to employers.
chinese.zh: 病人有權決定是否向雇主透露自己的病史。

english.en: The police have not disclosed the name of the witness.
english.zh: 警方還沒有公開目擊者的姓名。

speak.en: I'd rather not disclose my salary, if that's okay with you.
speak.zh: 如果你不介意的話，我寧可不透露我的薪水。

write.en: The study disclosed that many teenagers sleep less than they actually need.
write.zh: 這項研究揭露，許多青少年的睡眠時間不足。

example.en: After the earthquake, engineers reinforced the old school building with steel beams to make it safer for students.
example.zh: 地震過後，工程師用鋼梁補強老舊校舍，讓學生更安全。

listen.en: His actions only reinforced my opinion of him.
listen.zh: 他的所作所為只讓我更確定對他的看法。

chinese.en: Advertisements can reinforce stereotypes about what men and women should look like.
chinese.zh: 廣告可能強化人們對男性和女性外表應有樣貌的刻板印象。

english.en: The coach's praise reinforced the team's confidence before the final.
english.zh: 教練的稱讚在決賽前增強了球隊的信心。

speak.en: Living abroad really reinforced how much I love my hometown.
speak.zh: 住在國外讓我更加確定自己有多愛家鄉。

write.en: The city sent extra police officers to reinforce security during the international concert.
write.zh: 國際演唱會期間，市政府加派警力以加強維安。

example.en: Mobile payments, once seen as futuristic, are now so commonplace that some shops no longer accept cash.
example.zh: 行動支付一度被視為未來科技，如今已普遍到有些店家不再收現金。

listen.en: Electric scooters are now commonplace on city streets.
listen.zh: 電動機車現在在市區街道上隨處可見。

chinese.en: Long working hours are still commonplace in many Asian countries, despite health concerns.
chinese.zh: 儘管有健康上的疑慮，長工時在許多亞洲國家仍很普遍。

english.en: It is now commonplace for university students to study in cafes.
english.zh: 大學生在咖啡廳讀書現在已經很常見。

speak.en: Where I live, convenience stores on every corner are pretty commonplace.
speak.zh: 在我住的地方，街角就有便利商店是很平常的事。

write.en: Extreme weather events, once rare, may become commonplace if global warming continues.
write.zh: 如果全球暖化持續下去，過去罕見的極端天氣可能會變得司空見慣。

example.en: The campers spent a miserable night in their leaking tents, listening to the rain pour down until sunrise.
example.zh: 露營的人在漏水的帳篷裡度過悲慘的一夜，聽著大雨一直下到天亮。

listen.en: The weather was cold and miserable all weekend.
listen.zh: 整個週末天氣又冷又糟。

chinese.en: Many workers live in miserable conditions, with low pay and no job security.
chinese.zh: 許多勞工生活在悲慘的處境中，薪水低又沒有工作保障。

english.en: He looked really miserable after failing his driving test again.
english.zh: 他駕照考試又沒過，看起來非常沮喪。

speak.en: Rainy Mondays always make me feel a bit miserable.
speak.zh: 下雨的星期一總讓我覺得有點悶悶不樂。

write.en: The team suffered a miserable defeat, losing every match in the tournament.
write.zh: 這支隊伍慘敗，在錦標賽中每場比賽都輸了。

example.en: Before the school was demolished, students buried a time capsule containing letters and photos for future generations.
example.zh: 學校拆除前，學生埋下一個裝有信件和照片的時光膠囊，留給後代。

listen.en: The astronauts returned safely in a small capsule.
listen.zh: 太空人乘坐一個小型太空艙平安返回。

chinese.en: Some fish oil capsules are hard to swallow because they are quite large.
chinese.zh: 有些魚油膠囊因為顆粒很大，所以很難吞下去。

english.en: Our class made a time capsule to open in ten years.
english.zh: 我們班做了一個時光膠囊，打算十年後打開。

speak.en: I'd love to try staying in a capsule hotel in Tokyo.
speak.zh: 我很想去東京住住看膠囊旅館。

write.en: Coffee capsules are convenient, but they create a lot of plastic and aluminum waste.
write.zh: 咖啡膠囊很方便，但會產生大量塑膠和鋁製垃圾。

example.en: In the past, villagers wove cloth by hand from cotton grown in their own fields, then sold it at markets.
example.zh: 以前，村民用自家田裡種的棉花手工織布，再拿到市集販賣。

listen.en: This bag is made of strong cotton cloth.
listen.zh: 這個袋子是用堅固的棉布做的。

chinese.en: Instead of using paper towels, my family cleans the kitchen with reusable cloths.
chinese.zh: 我們家不用紙巾，而是用可重複使用的抹布清潔廚房。

english.en: My grandmother bought some colorful cloth to make new curtains for us.
english.zh: 奶奶買了一些色彩鮮豔的布，要幫我們做新窗簾。

speak.en: I always carry a small cloth to clean my glasses.
speak.zh: 我總是隨身帶一小塊布來擦眼鏡。

write.en: The table was covered with a white cloth for the wedding banquet.
write.zh: 為了婚宴，桌上鋪了一條白色桌巾。

example.en: Public attitudes toward recycling have changed dramatically; most people now sort their waste without being told.
example.zh: 大眾對資源回收的態度已大幅改變，現在多數人不用提醒就會做垃圾分類。

listen.en: In my opinion, your attitude matters more than your talent.
listen.zh: 我認為，態度比天分更重要。

chinese.en: Parents' attitudes toward exams can strongly influence how stressed their children feel.
chinese.zh: 父母對考試的態度，會大大影響孩子感受到的壓力。

english.en: His attitude toward work has improved a lot this year.
english.zh: 他今年的工作態度進步了很多。

speak.en: I really admire people who have a calm, can-do attitude.
speak.zh: 我很欣賞那些冷靜又積極、凡事覺得做得到的人。

write.en: Employers often value a good attitude more than impressive qualifications on a resume.
write.zh: 雇主往往更重視良好的態度，而不是履歷上亮眼的資歷。

example.en: The chart clearly illustrates how smartphone use among older adults has risen over the past decade.
example.zh: 這張圖表清楚顯示，過去十年長者使用智慧型手機的比例如何上升。

listen.en: Let me illustrate my point with an example.
listen.zh: 讓我用一個例子來說明我的論點。

chinese.en: This case clearly illustrates why companies must protect their customers' personal information carefully.
chinese.zh: 這個案例清楚說明了企業為何必須謹慎保護顧客的個人資料。

english.en: My sister illustrated a children's book with her own colorful drawings.
english.zh: 我姊姊用她自己繽紛的畫作替一本童書畫插圖。

speak.en: To illustrate, my hometown has changed a lot in recent years.
speak.zh: 舉例來說，我的家鄉這幾年改變了很多。

write.en: The rising price of housing illustrates the growing gap between rich and poor.
write.zh: 不斷上漲的房價反映出日益擴大的貧富差距。

example.en: The city outlawed single-use plastic bags, so shoppers now bring their own reusable bags to the supermarket.
example.zh: 這座城市禁用一次性塑膠袋，所以購物者現在都自備購物袋去超市。

listen.en: Some people want to outlaw fireworks in the city.
listen.zh: 有些人希望在市區禁止燃放煙火。

chinese.en: The government plans to outlaw the sale of energy drinks to children under sixteen.
chinese.zh: 政府計畫立法禁止販售能量飲料給未滿十六歲的兒童。

english.en: Do you think the government should outlaw cars from the city center?
english.zh: 你認為政府應該禁止汽車進入市中心嗎？

speak.en: I think they should outlaw using phones while riding scooters.
speak.zh: 我覺得應該立法禁止騎機車時使用手機。

write.en: In old Western films, the outlaw often hides in the mountains to escape the sheriff.
write.zh: 在老式西部片裡，亡命之徒常躲進山裡逃避警長追捕。

example.en: Within hours of the earthquake, the government mobilized rescue teams, medical staff, and soldiers to help survivors.
example.zh: 地震發生後幾小時內，政府就調派搜救隊、醫護人員和軍人協助倖存者。

listen.en: We need to mobilize support for the new library.
listen.zh: 我們需要為新圖書館爭取大家的支持。

chinese.en: Social media makes it easier for young people to mobilize around environmental issues.
chinese.zh: 社群媒體讓年輕人更容易針對環境議題集結行動。

english.en: The charity mobilized people to donate food for poor families.
english.zh: 這個慈善機構動員民眾捐食物給貧困家庭。

speak.en: Our neighborhood mobilized quickly when a local family lost their home in a fire.
speak.zh: 社區裡有戶人家因火災失去房子時，鄰居們很快就動員起來。

write.en: The company mobilized all its resources to launch the new product before its competitors.
write.zh: 這家公司調動所有資源，要搶在競爭對手之前推出新產品。

example.en: Even after the fire was put out, the smell of smoke lingered in the apartment for several days.
example.zh: 即使火已經撲滅，煙味還是在公寓裡瀰漫了好幾天。

listen.en: Visitors often linger by the lake to watch the sunset.
listen.zh: 遊客常在湖邊流連，觀賞夕陽。

chinese.en: Doubts about the safety of the new vaccine still linger among some parents.
chinese.zh: 部分家長對新疫苗安全性的疑慮仍然揮之不去。

english.en: The students lingered in the classroom after the bell rang.
english.zh: 下課鐘響後，學生們還待在教室裡不走。

speak.en: That song has been lingering in my head all morning.
speak.zh: 那首歌整個早上都在我腦海裡揮之不去。

write.en: A lingering cough can be a sign that you need to see a doctor.
write.zh: 久咳不癒可能表示你需要去看醫生。

example.en: After the factory closed without warning, there was growing unrest among workers who feared they would never find new jobs.
example.zh: 工廠無預警關閉後，擔心再也找不到新工作的工人之間愈來愈不安。

listen.en: The new tax caused unrest across the whole country.
listen.zh: 新稅制在全國各地引發動盪。

chinese.en: The government promised reforms in an attempt to calm the unrest on university campuses.
chinese.zh: 政府承諾進行改革，試圖平息大學校園裡的騷動。

english.en: High unemployment is often a major cause of social unrest.
english.zh: 高失業率往往是社會動盪的主要原因。

speak.en: I think economic problems usually lie behind most civil unrest.
speak.zh: 我覺得大部分的社會騷亂背後通常都是經濟問題。

write.en: There was a sense of unrest in the office as rumours of layoffs spread.
write.zh: 裁員的傳言四起，辦公室裡瀰漫著一股不安的氣氛。

example.en: The objects found in the tomb suggest that burial was an important ritual for people living there thousands of years ago.
example.zh: 墓中發現的物品顯示，對數千年前住在那裡的人來說，埋葬是一項重要的儀式。

listen.en: The family chose a simple burial in the village.
listen.zh: 家屬選擇在村子裡簡單下葬。

chinese.en: In some cultures, burial is gradually being replaced by cremation because of limited land.
chinese.zh: 在某些文化中，由於土地有限，土葬正逐漸被火葬取代。

english.en: The old cemetery near our school is no longer used for burials.
english.zh: 我們學校附近的舊墓地已經不再用來埋葬了。

speak.en: In my hometown, burial on hillsides used to be quite common.
speak.zh: 在我的家鄉，以前葬在山坡上是很常見的。

write.en: The museum displays jewellery taken from a royal burial chamber in Egypt.
write.zh: 這間博物館展示從埃及一座王室墓室中取出的珠寶。

example.en: Although the patient looked frail and could barely lift his arm, the doctors said he was recovering well.
example.zh: 雖然病人看起來很虛弱，連手臂都幾乎抬不起來，醫生卻說他恢復得很好。

listen.en: The frail old man walked slowly with a stick.
listen.zh: 那位虛弱的老先生拄著拐杖慢慢地走。

chinese.en: Care homes must take extra precautions to protect frail residents during flu season.
chinese.zh: 流感季節期間，安養機構必須採取額外措施來保護體弱的住民。

english.en: She was too frail to travel abroad with us last year.
english.zh: 她去年身體太虛弱，沒辦法跟我們一起出國旅行。

speak.en: My grandfather is getting frail, so I visit him every weekend.
speak.zh: 我爺爺身體越來越虛弱，所以我每個週末都去看他。

write.en: The ancient manuscript is so frail that researchers handle it only with gloves.
write.zh: 這份古老的手稿非常脆弱，研究人員只能戴著手套處理。

example.en: The tragic flood provided the impetus for the city to finally improve its drainage system and warning procedures.
example.zh: 那場悲慘的水災成為推動力，讓市政府終於改善排水系統和警報程序。

listen.en: Her success gave me the impetus to start running.
listen.zh: 她的成功給了我開始跑步的動力。

chinese.en: The main impetus behind the reform was a sharp rise in student complaints.
chinese.zh: 推動這次改革的主要原因，是學生抱怨大幅增加。

english.en: The competition gave students a strong impetus to practise English.
english.zh: 這場比賽給了學生練習英文的強大動力。

speak.en: Honestly, a deadline is the best impetus for me to work.
speak.zh: 老實說，截止期限是最能逼我工作的動力。

write.en: The campaign to reduce plastic waste has gained impetus thanks to social media.
write.zh: 多虧社群媒體，減少塑膠垃圾的運動聲勢越來越大。

example.en: The ministry hopes to unify exam standards across all schools, so that grades mean the same thing everywhere.
example.zh: 教育部希望統一各校的考試標準，讓成績在任何地方都代表相同的意義。

listen.en: The new rules unify the way we report problems.
listen.zh: 新規定統一了我們回報問題的方式。

chinese.en: The company plans to unify its various apps into a single platform next year.
chinese.zh: 這家公司計畫明年把旗下各種應用程式整合成單一平台。

english.en: Sport has the power to unify people across the world.
english.zh: 運動有讓全世界的人團結在一起的力量。

speak.en: I think a shared challenge often unifies a community quickly.
speak.zh: 我覺得共同面對的挑戰常常能讓一個社區很快團結起來。

write.en: Physicists have long tried to unify the laws of gravity and quantum mechanics.
write.zh: 物理學家長久以來一直試圖統一重力定律與量子力學。

example.en: The course is divided into separate modules, so learners can study each topic at their own pace before moving on.
example.zh: 這門課分成幾個獨立單元，學習者可以按照自己的步調讀完每個主題再往下進行。

listen.en: I really enjoyed the marketing module this term.
listen.zh: 我很喜歡這學期的行銷課。

chinese.en: New employees must finish an online safety module during their week of training.
chinese.zh: 新進員工必須在受訓那一週內完成線上安全課程單元。

english.en: Statistics is a core module for all psychology students at our university.
english.zh: 統計學是我們大學所有心理系學生的必修課。

speak.en: My favourite module at university was probably environmental science.
speak.zh: 我大學最喜歡的課大概是環境科學。

write.en: Engineers replaced the faulty camera module instead of repairing the whole phone.
write.zh: 工程師更換了故障的相機模組，而不是修理整支手機。

example.en: Using daily temperature records, the researchers computed the average for each month and found a clear warming trend.
example.zh: 研究人員利用每日氣溫紀錄算出每個月的平均值，發現明顯的暖化趨勢。

listen.en: The app computes your score after every lesson.
listen.zh: 這個應用程式會在每堂課後計算你的分數。

chinese.en: Insurance companies compute the risk of each customer before setting the price.
chinese.zh: 保險公司在訂定保費之前，會先估算每位客戶的風險。

english.en: We need to compute how much paint the room requires.
english.zh: 我們需要算出這個房間需要多少油漆。

speak.en: Honestly, I let my phone compute the tip at restaurants.
speak.zh: 老實說，在餐廳我都讓手機幫我算小費。

write.en: The final grade is computed from both coursework and the end-of-term exam.
write.zh: 學期總成績是根據平時作業和期末考試計算出來的。

example.en: Investors grew nervous about sovereign debt when several governments announced they could not repay their loans on time.
example.zh: 幾個國家的政府宣布無法如期償還貸款後，投資人開始對主權債務感到不安。

listen.en: The treaty was signed by every sovereign nation present.
listen.zh: 這份條約由在場的每個主權國家簽署。

chinese.en: International law says that no country should interfere in the affairs of a sovereign state.
chinese.zh: 國際法規定，任何國家都不應干涉主權國家的事務。

english.en: Every sovereign country has the right to control its own borders.
english.zh: 每個主權國家都有權管理自己的邊境。

speak.en: I think tiny countries can still be fully sovereign and successful.
