speak.zh: 我認為很小的國家也可以完全自主又發展得很好。

write.en: Under the agreement, member countries give up some sovereign powers over trade.
write.zh: 根據這項協定，會員國在貿易方面放棄部分主權。

example.en: When reporters asked about the data leak, a company spokesman refused to comment until the investigation was complete.
example.zh: 記者詢問資料外洩一事時，公司發言人拒絕評論，表示要等調查結束再說。

listen.en: The spokesman said the bridge would reopen soon.
listen.zh: 發言人說這座橋很快就會重新開放。

chinese.en: The university spokesman confirmed that classes would move online for the rest of the week.
chinese.zh: 大學發言人證實，本週接下來的課程都將改為線上進行。

english.en: Our team chose Tom as its spokesman at the meeting.
english.zh: 我們小組選湯姆當會議上的發言人。

speak.en: I'd hate to be a spokesman facing angry journalists every day.
speak.zh: 我很不想當每天都要面對憤怒記者的發言人。

write.en: The police spokesman urged drivers to avoid the area because of flooding.
write.zh: 警方發言人呼籲駕駛人因淹水避開該區域。

example.en: The two companies reached a tentative agreement last night, but the details still need approval from their boards.
example.zh: 兩家公司昨晚達成初步協議，但細節仍需各自董事會核准。

listen.en: She gave me a tentative smile and waved.
listen.zh: 她有點遲疑地對我笑了笑，揮了揮手。

chinese.en: Scientists have reached tentative conclusions, but more research is needed to confirm them.
chinese.zh: 科學家已得出初步結論，但還需要更多研究來證實。

english.en: Our travel plans are still tentative because of the weather.
english.zh: 因為天氣的關係，我們的旅行計畫還沒確定。

speak.en: I took a few tentative steps into public speaking at university.
speak.zh: 我在大學時小心翼翼地嘗試了幾次公開演講。

write.en: The child made a tentative attempt to speak English with the visitors.
write.zh: 那個孩子有點怯生生地試著和訪客說英文。

example.en: Building a new metro line should help alleviate traffic congestion, as fewer people will need to drive to work.
example.zh: 興建新的捷運路線應該有助於緩解交通壅塞，因為開車上班的人會變少。

listen.en: A short walk can alleviate stress after work.
listen.zh: 下班後散散步可以紓解壓力。

chinese.en: Many experts believe governments should invest in education to alleviate rural poverty.
chinese.zh: 許多專家認為，政府應該投資教育來減輕鄉村的貧窮問題。

english.en: Drinking warm water may alleviate the symptoms of a cold.
english.zh: 喝溫水可能可以緩解感冒的症狀。

speak.en: Listening to music really alleviates my anxiety before exams.
speak.zh: 聽音樂真的能減輕我考前的焦慮。

write.en: Hiring extra staff alleviated the pressure on nurses during the busy holiday period.
write.zh: 增聘人手減輕了護理師在忙碌假期中的壓力。

example.en: The vase fell off the shelf, but because it landed on a thick carpet, it was completely intact.
example.zh: 花瓶從架子上掉了下來，但因為落在厚地毯上，所以完全沒有破損。

listen.en: My luggage arrived intact after the long flight.
listen.zh: 長途飛行後，我的行李完好無缺地送達。

chinese.en: The old temple survived the earthquake almost intact, which surprised many engineers.
chinese.zh: 這座老廟在地震中幾乎毫髮無傷，讓許多工程師相當驚訝。

english.en: The company managed to keep its reputation intact after the scandal.
english.zh: 這家公司在醜聞之後仍設法保住了名聲。

speak.en: I'm glad our friendship is still intact even after I moved abroad.
speak.zh: 很高興即使我搬到國外，我們的友誼依然沒變。

write.en: Protecting the forest helps keep the local ecosystem intact for future generations.
write.zh: 保護森林有助於為後代保留完整的當地生態系。

example.en: Because the young emperor was only a child, his uncle ruled the empire on his behalf for many years.
example.zh: 由於年輕的皇帝還只是個孩子，他的叔叔代替他統治帝國多年。

listen.en: We visited the emperor's summer palace on our trip.
listen.zh: 我們在旅途中參觀了皇帝的夏宮。

chinese.en: Many treasures in the National Palace Museum once belonged to Chinese emperors.
chinese.zh: 故宮博物院裡的許多珍寶曾經屬於中國的皇帝。

english.en: Our history teacher told us many interesting stories about Roman emperors.
english.zh: 我們的歷史老師跟我們講了很多羅馬皇帝的有趣故事。

speak.en: I'd love to see what daily life was like for an emperor.
speak.zh: 我很想看看皇帝的日常生活是什麼樣子。

write.en: The film tells how an ordinary soldier eventually rose to become emperor.
write.zh: 這部電影講述一名普通士兵最後如何成為皇帝。

example.en: When the company tried to cut holiday pay, the staff revolted and threatened to strike unless managers changed their plans.
example.zh: 公司打算削減假日薪資時，員工群起反抗，揚言除非主管改變計畫，否則就要罷工。

listen.en: Teenagers often revolt against strict rules at home.
listen.zh: 青少年常常反抗家裡嚴格的規定。

chinese.en: The history textbook explains why the peasant revolt failed after only a few months.
chinese.zh: 歷史課本解釋了那場農民起義為何短短幾個月就失敗了。

english.en: Many customers revolted against the sudden increase in ticket prices.
english.zh: 許多顧客強烈反對票價突然上漲。

speak.en: As a kid, I revolted against eating vegetables every night.
speak.zh: 我小時候很抗拒每天晚上都要吃青菜。

write.en: Several board members staged a revolt and voted to replace the chairman.
write.zh: 幾位董事發動反抗，投票撤換了董事長。

example.en: Her eyes sparkled with excitement when she opened the letter offering her a place at her dream university.
example.zh: 她打開夢想大學寄來的錄取信時，眼睛興奮得閃閃發亮。

listen.en: The city lights sparkle beautifully from the hill at night.
listen.zh: 晚上從山上看，城市的燈光閃爍得很美。

chinese.en: The new manager brought some sparkle to a team that had lost its motivation.
chinese.zh: 新經理為一個失去動力的團隊注入了一些活力。

english.en: The kitchen floor sparkled after we cleaned it all afternoon.
english.zh: 我們打掃了一整個下午，廚房地板亮晶晶的。

speak.en: I think the old town has lost some of its sparkle recently.
speak.zh: 我覺得老街最近好像失去了一些光彩。

write.en: A few creative examples can add sparkle to an otherwise dull essay.
write.zh: 幾個有創意的例子就能讓原本平淡的文章生色不少。

example.en: The financial watchdog fined the bank heavily after discovering that it had misled customers about hidden fees.
example.zh: 金融監理機關發現該銀行在隱藏費用上誤導客戶後，對其處以重罰。

listen.en: The media should act as a watchdog for the public.
listen.zh: 媒體應該替大眾扮演監督者的角色。

chinese.en: An environmental watchdog reported that the factory had been polluting the river for years.
chinese.zh: 一個環保監督團體揭露，這間工廠多年來一直在汙染河川。

english.en: Our neighbours keep a large watchdog in their front yard.
english.zh: 我們的鄰居在前院養了一隻大型看門狗。

speak.en: Honestly, I'd trust an independent watchdog more than company advertisements.
speak.zh: 老實說，比起企業廣告，我更相信獨立的監督機構。

write.en: The school appointed a parent committee to serve as a watchdog over the canteen's food quality.
write.zh: 學校指派家長委員會負責監督餐廳的食物品質。

example.en: By interviewing hundreds of nurses, the researchers gained valuable insights into why so many leave the profession early.
example.zh: 研究人員訪問了數百名護理師，對於為何這麼多人提早離開這一行有了寶貴的了解。

listen.en: Her talk offered useful insights for new teachers.
listen.zh: 她的演講為新手老師提供了實用的見解。

chinese.en: Customer feedback provides insight into what people really want from our products.
chinese.zh: 顧客意見讓我們深入了解大家真正希望我們的產品具備什麼。

english.en: Travelling abroad can give young people insight into other cultures.
english.zh: 出國旅行可以讓年輕人深入了解其他文化。

speak.en: My grandfather has amazing insight into people, so I often ask him for advice.
speak.zh: 我爺爺看人非常有洞察力，所以我常常向他請教。

write.en: Reading a novelist's letters can offer a rare insight into her creative process.
write.zh: 閱讀一位小說家的書信，能讓人難得一窺她的創作過程。

example.en: Instead of leaving the hardest homework until late at night, Mia now tackles it right after school while she is still fresh.
example.zh: 米雅現在不再把最難的作業拖到深夜，而是趁精神還好時一放學就先處理。

listen.en: The defender made a clean tackle and won the ball.
listen.zh: 後衛乾淨俐落地鏟球，把球搶了下來。

chinese.en: Our company has launched a new program to tackle employee stress and burnout.
chinese.zh: 我們公司推出了一項新計畫，來處理員工的壓力和過勞問題。

english.en: We need to tackle this issue before it gets worse.
english.zh: 我們必須在情況惡化之前處理這個問題。

speak.en: I prefer to tackle problems directly rather than ignore them.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡直接面對問題，而不是忽視它們。

write.en: Many cities are tackling traffic congestion by charging drivers to enter the centre.
write.zh: 許多城市透過向進入市中心的駕駛人收費來解決交通壅塞。

example.en: Buying the land before the new railway station was announced turned out to be a very shrewd investment.
example.zh: 在新火車站宣布興建之前買下那塊地，結果證明是一筆非常精明的投資。

listen.en: That was a shrewd move by the new coach.
listen.zh: 那是新教練很精明的一步棋。

chinese.en: She made a shrewd guess about the exam topics and prepared accordingly.
chinese.zh: 她準確猜中了考試主題，並據此做好準備。

english.en: My grandfather was shrewd enough to see through the salesman's tricks.
english.zh: 我爺爺很精明，一眼就看穿了推銷員的伎倆。

speak.en: You have to be pretty shrewd to run a small shop.
speak.zh: 要經營一家小店，你得相當精明才行。

write.en: Shrewd consumers usually compare prices on several websites before buying expensive electronics.
write.zh: 精明的消費者在買昂貴電子產品前，通常會比較好幾個網站的價格。

example.en: Local residents pleaded for more time to comment on the plan, saying they had only just heard about it.
example.zh: 當地居民懇求延長對該計畫表達意見的時間，說他們才剛剛聽說這件事。

listen.en: The driver pleaded guilty to speeding in court.
listen.zh: 那名駕駛在法庭上承認超速。

chinese.en: Charities are pleading for donations to help families affected by the floods.
chinese.zh: 慈善團體正呼籲大家捐款，幫助受水災影響的家庭。

english.en: The student pleaded with the professor for a second chance.
english.zh: 那個學生懇求教授再給他一次機會。

speak.en: I once pleaded with my mum to skip piano lessons.
speak.zh: 我以前曾經求我媽讓我不要去上鋼琴課。

write.en: When asked why the report was late, he pleaded ignorance of the new deadline.
write.zh: 被問到報告為何遲交時，他推說不知道新的截止日期。

example.en: The cut on his knee became red and swollen, a clear sign that an infection had developed.
example.zh: 他膝蓋上的傷口又紅又腫，這明顯表示已經感染了。

listen.en: My little brother has an ear infection again.
listen.zh: 我弟弟又耳朵發炎了。

chinese.en: Hospitals have introduced strict rules to stop the spread of infection between patients.
chinese.zh: 醫院已實施嚴格規定，防止病人之間互相傳染。

english.en: The doctor gave me some antibiotics for my chest infection.
english.zh: 醫生開了一些抗生素給我治療胸腔感染。

speak.en: I caught a nasty infection while travelling last summer.
speak.zh: 我去年夏天旅行時得了一場很嚴重的感染。

write.en: Good antivirus software protects company laptops from infection by malicious programs downloaded online.
write.zh: 好的防毒軟體能保護公司筆電，不被從網路下載的惡意程式感染。

example.en: Because the island receives strong sunshine all year, solar power has become a cheap and reliable source of electricity.
example.zh: 由於這座島一年到頭日照強烈，太陽能已成為便宜又可靠的電力來源。

listen.en: We watched the solar eclipse from the school roof.
listen.zh: 我們在學校頂樓觀看日蝕。

chinese.en: The government aims to increase the share of solar energy in the national power supply.
chinese.zh: 政府的目標是提高太陽能在全國電力供應中的比例。

english.en: Jupiter is by far the largest planet in our solar system.
english.zh: 木星是太陽系中最大的行星，而且大得多。

speak.en: I bought a solar charger to use when I go camping.
speak.zh: 我買了一個太陽能充電器，露營時可以用。

write.en: Our university library is now partly powered by solar energy collected on its roof.
write.zh: 我們大學圖書館現在有一部分電力來自屋頂收集的太陽能。

example.en: Students leave school for a multitude of reasons, including money problems, poor health and a lack of interest.
example.zh: 學生輟學的原因非常多，包括經濟問題、健康不佳和缺乏興趣。

listen.en: The website has a multitude of useful study tips.
listen.zh: 這個網站有大量實用的讀書技巧。

chinese.en: The new manager had to deal with a multitude of problems left by her predecessor.
chinese.zh: 新經理必須處理前任留下的一大堆問題。

english.en: Smartphones allow us to perform a multitude of different tasks.
english.zh: 智慧型手機讓我們能完成許多不同的工作。

speak.en: There's a multitude of hiking trails near where I live.
speak.zh: 我家附近有很多登山步道。

write.en: A multitude of birds gather at the wetland every winter to escape the cold.
write.zh: 每年冬天都有大批鳥類聚集到這片濕地避寒。

example.en: The company sells most of its products to overseas markets, so a strong local currency can seriously hurt its profits.
example.zh: 這家公司大部分產品都賣到海外市場，所以本國貨幣升值可能嚴重影響獲利。

listen.en: Many young people now choose to work overseas.
listen.zh: 現在很多年輕人選擇到國外工作。

chinese.en: The university has set up a special support centre for overseas students.
chinese.zh: 這所大學為境外學生設立了專門的輔導中心。

english.en: My parents are planning their first overseas trip together next summer.
english.zh: 我爸媽正在計畫明年夏天第一次一起出國旅行。

speak.en: I'd love to live overseas for a while to improve my English.
speak.zh: 我很想在國外住一陣子來加強英文。

write.en: Online shopping lets consumers easily buy goods from overseas without leaving home.
write.zh: 網路購物讓消費者不出門就能輕鬆買到海外商品。

example.en: By the time the last train arrived, it was well past midnight and all the shops near the station had closed.
example.zh: 末班車到站時早已過了半夜，車站附近的店全都關了。

listen.en: I usually go to bed just before midnight.
listen.zh: 我通常在快十二點時上床睡覺。

chinese.en: Fireworks lit up the sky at midnight to welcome the New Year.
chinese.zh: 午夜時分，煙火照亮夜空，迎接新年到來。

english.en: My roommate often has a midnight snack while studying for exams.
english.zh: 我室友準備考試時常常吃宵夜。

speak.en: Honestly, I'm most productive after midnight when everything is quiet.
speak.zh: 老實說，我在半夜萬籟俱寂時效率最高。

write.en: Some cities ban construction noise between midnight and early morning to protect residents' sleep.
write.zh: 有些城市禁止午夜到清晨之間的施工噪音，以保障居民睡眠。

example.en: The rescue teams arrived within hours of the disaster, bringing food, clean water and medical supplies to survivors.
example.zh: 救援隊在災難發生後幾小時內抵達，為倖存者帶來食物、乾淨的水和醫療用品。

listen.en: Good planning can stop small mistakes from turning into disasters.
listen.zh: 好的規劃能避免小錯誤演變成大災難。

chinese.en: Climate change is making weather-related disasters more frequent in many parts of the world.
chinese.zh: 氣候變遷正讓世界許多地區的氣象災害越來越頻繁。

english.en: Our company donated a large amount of money to disaster relief.
english.zh: 我們公司捐了一大筆錢給賑災工作。

speak.en: My first attempt at baking bread was a total disaster.
speak.zh: 我第一次嘗試烤麵包，結果徹底失敗。

write.en: The team ignored early warning signs, and the product launch ended in disaster.
write.zh: 團隊忽略了早期的警訊，結果產品上市以慘敗收場。

example.en: Experts from twelve countries gathered at the symposium to share their latest findings on ocean pollution.
example.zh: 來自十二個國家的專家齊聚研討會，分享他們在海洋汙染方面的最新研究成果。

listen.en: My professor gave a talk at the symposium.
listen.zh: 我的教授在研討會上發表演講。

chinese.en: Graduate students are strongly encouraged to present their research at international symposiums.
chinese.zh: 學校非常鼓勵研究生在國際研討會上發表研究成果。

english.en: Last weekend I attended a symposium on mental health in schools.
english.zh: 上週末我參加了一場關於校園心理健康的研討會。

speak.en: Speaking at my first symposium was terrifying but really rewarding.
speak.zh: 第一次在研討會上發表演講讓我非常緊張，但收穫很大。

write.en: The museum organised a public symposium where residents discussed the future of the old harbour.
write.zh: 博物館舉辦了一場公開座談會，讓居民討論舊港口的未來。

example.en: The discussion was dominated by one confident student, so the quieter members of the group barely said a word.
example.zh: 討論被一位很有自信的學生主導，所以組裡比較安靜的成員幾乎沒說話。

listen.en: The tall tower dominates the city skyline from every direction.
listen.zh: 從各個方向看，這座高塔都是城市天際線中最顯眼的建築。

chinese.en: News about the typhoon dominated the headlines for most of the week.
chinese.zh: 這一週大部分時間，颱風的消息都占據了新聞頭條。

english.en: Our basketball team dominated the whole match from start to finish.
english.zh: 我們的籃球隊整場比賽從頭到尾都占上風。

speak.en: In my family, my older sister always dominates the conversation.
speak.zh: 在我家，總是我姊姊主導話題。

write.en: Service industries now dominate the local economy, while manufacturing has steadily declined.
write.zh: 服務業現在主導了當地經濟，而製造業則持續衰退。

example.en: Instead of buying anything, many visitors simply browse in the shop and then order the same products online at lower prices.
example.zh: 許多顧客在店裡只是逛逛不買，之後再上網用更低的價格訂購同樣的商品。

listen.en: She browsed the internet for cheap flights to Japan.
listen.zh: 她上網搜尋飛往日本的便宜機票。

chinese.en: Many teenagers spend hours browsing social media instead of doing their homework.
chinese.zh: 許多青少年花好幾個小時滑社群媒體，而不寫作業。

english.en: I like to browse through magazines while waiting for the dentist.
english.zh: 等牙醫看診時，我喜歡翻翻雜誌。

speak.en: When I'm bored, I just browse random videos on my phone.
speak.zh: 無聊的時候，我就用手機隨便看看影片。

write.en: Our company tracks how customers browse its website to improve the design.
write.zh: 我們公司追蹤顧客瀏覽網站的方式，藉此改善設計。

example.en: Although she works in the city centre, she lives in a quiet suburb where houses are cheaper and the air is cleaner.
example.zh: 雖然她在市中心上班，卻住在一個安靜的郊區，那裡房價比較便宜，空氣也比較乾淨。

listen.en: We live in a peaceful suburb near the river.
listen.zh: 我們住在河邊一個寧靜的郊區。

chinese.en: The new metro line connects the northern suburbs directly to the business district.
chinese.zh: 新的捷運路線把北部郊區直接連到商業區。

english.en: My grandparents' village has slowly become a busy suburb of the city.
english.zh: 我祖父母住的村莊已經慢慢變成這座城市熱鬧的郊區。

speak.en: I'd rather live in the suburbs than right in the city.
speak.zh: 比起住在市中心，我寧願住在郊區。

write.en: As suburbs spread outward, more farmland is lost and commuting times increase.
write.zh: 隨著郊區不斷向外擴張，更多農地消失，通勤時間也變長了。

example.en: Land on the outskirts of town is much cheaper, which is why so many warehouses and factories are located there.
example.zh: 鎮郊的土地便宜得多，這就是為什麼那裡有那麼多倉庫和工廠。

listen.en: My school is on the outskirts of a small town.
listen.zh: 我的學校在一個小鎮的郊區。

chinese.en: Rapid development has turned the rice fields on the outskirts into housing estates.
chinese.zh: 快速的開發讓郊區的稻田變成了住宅社區。

english.en: We rented a small apartment on the outskirts of Taichung.
english.zh: 我們在臺中市郊租了一間小公寓。

speak.en: I grew up on the outskirts, so I'm used to quiet nights.
speak.zh: 我在郊區長大，所以習慣了安靜的夜晚。

write.en: The company moved its headquarters to the outskirts to reduce rent and avoid traffic.
write.zh: 這家公司把總部搬到郊區，以減少租金並避開塞車。

example.en: Since both parents work full-time, the children are expected to help with daily chores such as washing dishes and taking out rubbish.
example.zh: 因為爸媽都是全職工作，孩子們要幫忙洗碗、倒垃圾等日常家務。

listen.en: Doing chores at home can teach young children responsibility.
listen.zh: 在家做家事可以培養小孩的責任感。

chinese.en: For many office workers, answering emails has become a tiring daily chore.
chinese.zh: 對許多上班族來說，回電子郵件已經成了每天累人的苦差事。

english.en: Robot vacuums can save busy families a lot of time on chores.
english.zh: 掃地機器人可以幫忙碌的家庭省下很多做家事的時間。

speak.en: Honestly, ironing is the chore I hate the most.
speak.zh: 老實說，燙衣服是我最討厭的家事。

write.en: Learning grammar rules felt like a chore until I started reading English novels.
write.zh: 學文法規則原本像是苦差事，直到我開始讀英文小說。

example.en: The website is regularly updated with new practice tests, so learners can always find fresh material to work on.
example.zh: 這個網站會定期更新新的模擬試題，所以學習者總能找到新教材來練習。

listen.en: Our study group meets regularly in the library.
listen.zh: 我們的讀書會固定在圖書館聚會。

chinese.en: Factories must regularly check their equipment to prevent serious accidents and pollution.
chinese.zh: 工廠必須定期檢查設備，以防止重大意外和汙染。

english.en: I regularly visit my grandparents, who live in the countryside.
english.zh: 我經常去探望住在鄉下的祖父母。

speak.en: I try to back up my phone regularly, but I often forget.
speak.zh: 我盡量定期備份手機，但常常忘記。

write.en: Buses on this route run regularly, even late in the evening on weekends.
write.zh: 這條路線的公車班次很固定，即使週末晚上也一樣。

example.en: The water in the mountain lake was so crystal clear that we could see fish swimming near the bottom.
example.zh: 山中湖泊的水清澈見底，我們看得到魚在湖底附近游動。

listen.en: Tiny ice crystals covered the car windows this morning.
listen.zh: 今天早上車窗上結滿了細小的冰晶。

chinese.en: My grandmother only uses her best crystal glasses for special family dinners.
chinese.zh: 我奶奶只有在特別的家庭聚餐時，才會拿出她最好的水晶杯。

english.en: Our teacher made the exam instructions crystal clear to everyone.
english.zh: 老師把考試說明講得清清楚楚，每個人都聽懂了。

speak.en: I don't have a crystal ball, so I can't really predict the future.
speak.zh: 我又沒有水晶球，所以沒辦法真的預測未來。

write.en: Scientists study snow crystals to understand how temperature and humidity affect their shapes.
write.zh: 科學家研究雪的結晶，以了解溫度和濕度如何影響它們的形狀。

example.en: After winning several major contracts, the firm consolidated its position as the leading supplier in the region.
example.zh: 拿下好幾份大合約之後，這家公司鞏固了它在該地區龍頭供應商的地位。

listen.en: The bank plans to consolidate its smaller branches.
listen.zh: 這家銀行計畫合併規模較小的分行。

chinese.en: The school decided to consolidate the three science departments into a single faculty.
chinese.zh: 學校決定把三個理科系合併成一個學院。

english.en: She took out a loan to consolidate all her credit card debts.
english.zh: 她申請了一筆貸款，把所有卡債整合在一起。

speak.en: I use flashcards on the bus to consolidate new vocabulary.
speak.zh: 我在公車上用單字卡來鞏固新學的單字。

write.en: The team won again on Sunday, consolidating its lead at the top of the league.
write.zh: 這支球隊星期天再度獲勝，鞏固了聯盟龍頭的領先地位。

example.en: Using phones late at night can disrupt your sleep, because the bright screen tells your brain it is still daytime.
example.zh: 深夜滑手機會干擾睡眠，因為明亮的螢幕會讓大腦以為還是白天。

listen.en: A loud phone call disrupted the lecture this morning.
listen.zh: 今天早上一通很大聲的電話打斷了講課。

chinese.en: In recent years, online streaming services have completely disrupted the traditional television industry.
chinese.zh: 近年來，線上串流服務徹底顛覆了傳統電視產業。

english.en: The typhoon disrupted many flights to and from the island yesterday.
english.zh: 颱風昨天使許多往返這座島的航班受到影響。

speak.en: The construction next door keeps disrupting my online classes every afternoon.
speak.zh: 隔壁的施工每天下午都一直干擾我上線上課程。

write.en: A few students who constantly talk can disrupt the learning of the whole class.
write.zh: 少數一直講話的學生，就可能干擾全班的學習。

example.en: During the Renaissance, artists in Italy studied the human body closely, which made their paintings far more realistic.
example.zh: 文藝復興時期，義大利的藝術家仔細研究人體，讓他們的畫作寫實許多。

listen.en: The old harbour area is going through a renaissance.
listen.zh: 舊港區正在經歷一場復興。

chinese.en: Thanks to new funding, the town's traditional crafts are experiencing a quiet renaissance.
chinese.zh: 多虧了新的經費，這個小鎮的傳統工藝正悄悄復興。

english.en: We studied Renaissance art in our history class this term.
english.zh: 我們這學期在歷史課上學了文藝復興時期的藝術。

speak.en: I think board games are having a real renaissance right now.
speak.zh: 我覺得桌遊現在真的重新流行起來了。

write.en: The company's new leader brought about a renaissance in its once declining sales.
write.zh: 公司新任領導人讓原本下滑的銷售重新起飛。

example.en: To reduce congestion, London charges drivers a daily fee for entering the busiest parts of the city.
example.zh: 為了減少交通壅塞，倫敦向進入市區最繁忙地段的駕駛人收取每日費用。

listen.en: This cold medicine helps clear nasal congestion quickly.
listen.zh: 這款感冒藥能很快緩解鼻塞。

chinese.en: Building more roads does not always ease congestion, as it may encourage more people to drive.
chinese.zh: 多蓋道路不一定能紓解塞車，因為可能會吸引更多人開車。

english.en: Congestion at the airport caused many passengers to miss their flights.
english.zh: 機場擁擠導致許多旅客錯過班機。

speak.en: I take the MRT because congestion on the roads drives me crazy.
speak.zh: 我都搭捷運，因為路上塞車會把我逼瘋。

write.en: Network congestion in the evening often makes our video calls slow and unreliable.
write.zh: 晚上網路壅塞，常讓我們的視訊通話又慢又不穩定。

example.en: New regulations prohibit restaurants from using plastic straws, so many now offer paper or metal ones instead.
example.zh: 新法規禁止餐廳使用塑膠吸管，所以許多餐廳現在改提供紙吸管或金屬吸管。

listen.en: Students are prohibited from using phones during exams.
listen.zh: 考試期間學生禁止使用手機。

chinese.en: Many countries prohibit the sale of alcohol to anyone under the age of eighteen.
chinese.zh: 許多國家禁止販賣酒類給未滿十八歲的人。

english.en: Our company strictly prohibits employees from sharing their passwords with others.
english.zh: 我們公司嚴格禁止員工把密碼告訴別人。

speak.en: I think cities should prohibit cars in some busy shopping streets.
speak.zh: 我覺得城市應該在一些熱鬧的商店街禁止汽車通行。

write.en: The high cost of equipment prohibits many schools from offering robotics courses.
write.zh: 設備成本高昂，讓許多學校無法開設機器人課程。

example.en: The police officer explained that the car was stationary when the motorbike crashed into it, so the driver was not to blame.
example.zh: 警察解釋，機車撞上來時汽車是靜止的，所以駕駛沒有責任。

listen.en: I ride a stationary bike at home when it rains.
listen.zh: 下雨的時候，我在家騎飛輪健身車。

chinese.en: Prices have remained stationary for months, while wages have continued to rise slowly.
chinese.zh: 物價好幾個月來都沒有變動，薪資則持續緩慢上漲。

english.en: Never get off the train until it is completely stationary.
english.zh: 火車還沒完全停下前，千萬不要下車。

speak.en: Sitting stationary at a desk all day really hurts my back.
speak.zh: 整天坐在書桌前不動，真的讓我腰痠背痛。

write.en: Wildlife photographers often stay stationary for hours so that animals won't notice them.
write.zh: 野生動物攝影師常常好幾個小時一動也不動，以免被動物發現。

example.en: Small farmers often have to contend with unpredictable weather, rising costs and falling prices for their crops.
example.zh: 小農經常得應付難以預測的天氣、不斷上漲的成本，以及農作物價格下跌。

listen.en: We had to contend with heavy traffic this morning.
listen.zh: 我們今天早上得應付嚴重的塞車。

chinese.en: Three teams are contending for the championship, and the final match is on Sunday.
chinese.zh: 有三支隊伍正在角逐冠軍，決賽在星期天舉行。

english.en: The author contends that social media has changed how we read.
english.zh: 作者主張社群媒體已經改變了我們閱讀的方式。

speak.en: Honestly, I'd contend that working from home makes me more productive.
speak.zh: 老實說，我會主張在家工作讓我更有效率。

write.en: Students in big cities must contend with high rents and long commutes to campus.
write.zh: 大城市的學生必須應付高房租和漫長的通學時間。

example.en: Built on a remote mountain far from city lights, the observatory gives astronomers a clear view of distant galaxies.
example.zh: 這座天文臺蓋在遠離城市燈光的偏遠山上，讓天文學家能清楚觀測遙遠的星系。

listen.en: The observatory is open to visitors on Friday evenings.
listen.zh: 天文臺每週五晚上開放給民眾參觀。

chinese.en: Our school trip to the observatory sparked my interest in studying physics at university.
chinese.zh: 學校的天文臺校外教學，激發了我上大學念物理的興趣。

english.en: The weather observatory collects data on rainfall and temperature every day.
english.zh: 這個氣象觀測站每天收集雨量和氣溫的資料。

speak.en: I'd love to spend a night at an observatory someday.
speak.zh: 我很希望有一天能在天文臺待上一整晚。

write.en: The government plans to fund a new observatory to monitor earthquakes and volcanic activity.
write.zh: 政府計畫出資興建一座新的觀測站，監測地震和火山活動。

example.en: We forgot to bring a tent, so we improvised a shelter using a large plastic sheet and some branches.
example.zh: 我們忘了帶帳篷，所以用一大塊塑膠布和一些樹枝臨時搭了個遮蔽處。

listen.en: The jazz musicians improvised for most of the concert.
listen.zh: 那些爵士樂手在音樂會大部分時間都在即興演奏。

chinese.en: Good teachers know how to improvise when a lesson plan does not go as expected.
chinese.zh: 好老師知道在教案沒有照預期進行時如何臨場應變。

english.en: I didn't have a recipe, so I improvised with what was in the fridge.
english.zh: 我沒有食譜，所以就用冰箱裡現有的東西隨機應變。

speak.en: I'm not great at improvising, so I always prepare my speeches.
speak.zh: 我不太擅長即興發揮，所以演講前一定會先準備。

write.en: Aid workers often have to improvise when supplies arrive late in disaster areas.
write.zh: 在災區，物資晚到時，救援人員常常得臨時想辦法。

example.en: Scientists believe the huge crater was formed when a meteorite struck the desert thousands of years ago.
example.zh: 科學家認為，這個巨大的坑洞是數千年前一顆隕石撞擊沙漠時形成的。

listen.en: We hiked to the edge of the volcanic crater.
listen.zh: 我們健行到火山口的邊緣。

chinese.en: After the heavy storm, a large crater appeared in the middle of the main road.
chinese.zh: 大暴雨過後，主要道路中央出現了一個大坑洞。

english.en: There is a beautiful lake inside the crater of an old volcano.
english.zh: 一座古老火山的火山口裡有一座美麗的湖。

speak.en: Looking down into the crater was honestly a bit scary for me.
speak.zh: 老實說，往火山口裡面看讓我有點害怕。

write.en: Our geography class studied photos of craters on Mars to learn about its history.
write.zh: 我們地理課研究火星上坑洞的照片，藉此了解它的歷史。

example.en: After recovering from her illness, she sent handwritten cards to the nurses as a sign of her deep gratitude.
example.zh: 她病癒之後寄了親筆卡片給護理師們，表達她深深的感激。

listen.en: He smiled with gratitude when we offered him a seat.
listen.zh: 我們讓座給他時，他感激地笑了。

chinese.en: Research suggests that people who practise gratitude every day tend to sleep better.
chinese.zh: 研究顯示，每天練習感恩的人往往睡得比較好。

english.en: We all owe a great debt of gratitude to our teachers.
english.zh: 我們都非常感激我們的老師。

speak.en: I feel a lot of gratitude towards my parents for their support.
speak.zh: 我非常感謝爸媽對我的支持。

write.en: The company showed its gratitude to loyal customers by offering them free delivery.
write.zh: 這家公司提供免運費，向忠實顧客表達謝意。

example.en: Because of a severe water shortage, residents were asked to limit showers and avoid washing their cars.
example.zh: 由於嚴重缺水，居民被要求減少淋浴時間，並避免洗車。

listen.en: There is a shortage of affordable housing in the city.
listen.zh: 這座城市缺乏負擔得起的住宅。

chinese.en: The chip shortage has caused delays in the production of cars and smartphones.
chinese.zh: 晶片短缺已經導致汽車和智慧型手機延後生產。

english.en: Our school is dealing with a shortage of English teachers.
english.zh: 我們學校正在處理英文老師不足的問題。

speak.en: There's no shortage of good restaurants in my neighbourhood, actually.
speak.zh: 其實我家附近好吃的餐廳多得是。

write.en: Experts warn that food shortages could become more common as the climate changes.
write.zh: 專家警告，隨著氣候變遷，糧食短缺可能會越來越常見。

example.en: The startup quickly exploited the gap in the market, offering cheap online lessons when schools suddenly closed.
example.zh: 這家新創公司迅速抓住市場缺口，在學校突然停課時推出便宜的線上課程。

listen.en: The team exploited every chance to score in the final.
listen.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中把握每一次得分機會。

chinese.en: The country plans to exploit its solar energy potential to reduce its reliance on coal.
chinese.zh: 這個國家計畫開發太陽能潛力，以減少對煤炭的依賴。

english.en: We should not exploit natural resources without thinking about the future.
english.zh: 我們不應該不顧未來地開採自然資源。

speak.en: My grandfather loves telling us about his exploits as a young sailor.
speak.zh: 我爺爺很喜歡跟我們講他年輕當水手時的精彩事蹟。

write.en: Hackers exploited a weakness in the software to access thousands of customer records.
write.zh: 駭客利用軟體的漏洞，存取了數千筆顧客資料。

example.en: During the interview, the panel grilled her about gaps in her CV, but she answered every question calmly.
example.zh: 面試時，評審連番追問她履歷上的空白期，但她每個問題都冷靜回答。

listen.en: Please put the fish on the grill and turn it over later.
listen.zh: 請把魚放到烤架上，等一下再翻面。

chinese.en: Grilling food instead of frying it is a simple way to eat more healthily.
chinese.zh: 用烤的而不是用炸的，是讓飲食更健康的簡單方法。

english.en: My dad bought a new grill for our family barbecues.
english.zh: 我爸爸為了家庭烤肉買了一個新烤架。

speak.en: Grilled corn is one of my favourite night market snacks.
speak.zh: 烤玉米是我最喜歡的夜市小吃之一。

write.en: Reporters grilled the city's mayor about the rising cost of public transport tickets.
write.zh: 記者針對大眾運輸票價上漲一事連番追問市長。

example.en: The witness seemed credible because her story matched the security footage and the other reports exactly.
example.zh: 這位證人似乎可信，因為她的說法和監視器畫面及其他報告完全吻合。

listen.en: His excuse for being late did not sound credible.
listen.zh: 他遲到的藉口聽起來不太可信。

chinese.en: Online reviews are not always credible, since some are written by the sellers themselves.
chinese.zh: 網路評價不一定可信，因為有些是賣家自己寫的。

english.en: The government needs a credible plan to reduce air pollution.
english.zh: 政府需要一個可信的計畫來減少空氣汙染。

speak.en: I only trust news from credible websites, not random social media posts.
speak.zh: 我只相信可靠網站的新聞，不信社群媒體上來路不明的貼文。

write.en: To win the investors' trust, the company had to present a credible business strategy.
write.zh: 為了贏得投資人的信任，這家公司必須提出可信的經營策略。

example.en: Trees absorb carbon dioxide during photosynthesis, which is why planting forests can help slow global warming.
example.zh: 樹木在光合作用時會吸收二氧化碳，所以植樹造林有助於減緩全球暖化。

listen.en: Plants take in carbon dioxide and give off oxygen.
listen.zh: 植物吸收二氧化碳並釋放氧氣。

chinese.en: Burning coal produces sulphur dioxide, which can cause acid rain in nearby areas.
chinese.zh: 燃燒煤炭會產生二氧化硫，可能在附近地區造成酸雨。

english.en: The city wants to cut its carbon dioxide emissions by half.
english.zh: 這座城市希望把二氧化碳排放量減少一半。

speak.en: I try to cycle more to reduce the carbon dioxide I produce.
speak.zh: 我盡量多騎腳踏車，減少自己製造的二氧化碳。

write.en: Nitrogen dioxide from heavy traffic is a major cause of poor air quality in cities.
write.zh: 繁忙交通排放的二氧化氮，是都市空氣品質不佳的主因之一。

example.en: Male robins sing loudly in spring to mark their territory and warn other birds to stay away.
example.zh: 雄知更鳥在春天大聲鳴唱，宣示地盤並警告其他鳥類別靠近。

listen.en: Starting my own business was completely new territory for me.
listen.zh: 自己創業對我來說是全新的領域。

chinese.en: Cats are very protective of their territory and may hiss at unfamiliar animals.
chinese.zh: 貓很會保護自己的地盤，可能會對陌生動物發出嘶嘶聲。

english.en: The sales manager is responsible for a large territory in the south.
english.zh: 這位業務經理負責南部一大片區域。

speak.en: Talking about money with friends is tricky territory, so I usually avoid it.
speak.zh: 跟朋友談錢是很敏感的話題，所以我通常會避開。

write.en: The research takes scientists into unknown territory, as no one has studied these deep-sea creatures before.
write.zh: 這項研究帶領科學家進入未知領域，因為從來沒有人研究過這些深海生物。

example.en: When the lift broke down, engineers climbed into the shaft to check the cables and repair the motor.
example.zh: 電梯故障時，工程師爬進電梯井檢查鋼索並修理馬達。

listen.en: A shaft of sunlight came through the kitchen window.
listen.zh: 一道陽光從廚房窗戶照了進來。

chinese.en: Old mine shafts can be dangerous, so hikers should stay on the marked paths.
chinese.zh: 廢棄的礦井可能很危險，所以登山客應該走在標示好的步道上。

english.en: The wooden shaft of my umbrella broke in the strong wind.
english.zh: 我雨傘的木頭傘柄被強風吹斷了。

speak.en: I love waking up to shafts of morning light in my bedroom.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡醒來時看到晨光一道道照進臥室。

write.en: Our building has a ventilation shaft that brings fresh air into the underground car park.
write.zh: 我們大樓有一條通風井，把新鮮空氣送進地下停車場。

example.en: After a concerted campaign by parents and teachers, the council finally agreed to build a safer crossing near the school.
example.zh: 在家長和老師共同發起的運動之下，議會終於同意在學校附近興建更安全的穿越道。

listen.en: We made a concerted effort to finish the project early.
listen.zh: 我們齊心協力，想提早完成這個專案。

chinese.en: Without concerted action from all countries, climate change will be very difficult to slow down.
chinese.zh: 如果各國沒有一致行動，氣候變遷將很難減緩。

english.en: The school made a concerted attempt to improve students' reading skills.
english.zh: 學校全力投入提升學生的閱讀能力。

speak.en: This year I'm making a concerted effort to eat more vegetables.
speak.zh: 今年我下定決心要多吃蔬菜。

write.en: The two companies launched a concerted push to win back customers they had lost online.
write.zh: 兩家公司聯手出擊，想贏回流失到網路上的顧客。

example.en: The film's opening sequence, a long shot of an empty city at dawn, immediately creates a sense of loneliness.
example.zh: 這部電影的開場片段是黎明時空蕩城市的長鏡頭，一下子就營造出孤寂感。

listen.en: The events happened in a strange sequence that night.
listen.zh: 那天晚上的事件以奇怪的順序發生。

chinese.en: Scientists have sequenced the genome of the plant to understand how it resists disease.
chinese.zh: 科學家已經完成這種植物的基因體定序，以了解它如何抵抗病害。

english.en: A sequence of mistakes led to the failure of the project.
english.zh: 一連串的錯誤導致這個專案失敗。

speak.en: I usually follow the same sequence every morning: coffee, emails, then exercise.
speak.zh: 我每天早上通常照同樣的順序：喝咖啡、看信，然後運動。

write.en: When describing a process, organise each stage in a clear and logical sequence.
write.zh: 描述一個流程時，要把每個階段依清楚、合乎邏輯的順序安排。

example.en: The manager sends the team a short update every Friday so that everyone knows how the project is progressing.
example.zh: 經理每週五都會寄給團隊一份簡短的進度報告，讓大家了解專案的進展。

listen.en: Please keep me updated on your travel plans.
listen.zh: 請隨時告訴我你旅行計畫的最新狀況。

chinese.en: The school website is updated regularly with news about exams and holidays.
chinese.zh: 學校網站會定期更新考試和放假的消息。

english.en: I need to update my CV before applying for new jobs.
english.zh: 應徵新工作之前，我需要更新我的履歷。

speak.en: I check the weather updates on my phone before I leave home.
speak.zh: 出門前我會用手機查看最新的天氣資訊。

write.en: Many museums are updating their exhibitions with interactive screens to attract younger visitors.
write.zh: 許多博物館正在用互動螢幕更新展覽，以吸引年輕參觀者。

example.en: Instead of flowing into the sewer, the waste water from the factory was being dumped directly into the river.
example.zh: 那間工廠的廢水沒有流進下水道，而是直接被排進河裡。

listen.en: Workers are repairing a broken sewer under our street.
listen.zh: 工人正在修理我們這條街底下壞掉的下水道。

chinese.en: Never pour cooking oil down the sink, because it can block the sewer pipes.
chinese.zh: 千萬不要把食用油倒進水槽，因為它會堵塞汙水管。

english.en: The government plans to build a new sewer system in the village.
english.zh: 政府計畫在這個村莊興建新的下水道系統。

speak.en: There's a terrible smell from the sewer near my bus stop.
speak.zh: 我家公車站附近的下水道傳來很可怕的臭味。

write.en: Our engineering class visited the sewer tunnels to learn how cities manage waste water.
write.zh: 我們工程課參觀了下水道隧道，了解城市如何處理汙水。

example.en: The new director departed from tradition by allowing staff to work from home and choose their own hours.
example.zh: 新主管打破傳統，允許員工在家工作並自選上班時間。

listen.en: The bus will depart as soon as everyone is on board.
listen.zh: 大家一上車，巴士就會出發。

chinese.en: Passengers departing for international destinations should arrive at the airport well before their flight.
chinese.zh: 搭國際線出發的旅客應該在班機起飛前提早抵達機場。

english.en: We departed early in the morning to avoid the traffic.
english.zh: 我們一大早就出發，以避開車潮。

speak.en: I always feel a bit sad when friends depart after a visit.
speak.zh: 朋友來訪後要離開時，我總是有點難過。

write.en: The students departed from the original plan and designed their own experiment instead.
write.zh: 學生們偏離了原本的計畫，改成自己設計實驗。

example.en: A university degree is no guarantee of a well-paid job, especially in fields where competition is fierce.
example.zh: 大學學歷並不保證能找到高薪工作，在競爭激烈的領域尤其如此。

listen.en: I can't guarantee that the package will arrive tomorrow.
listen.zh: 我不能保證包裹明天會送到。

chinese.en: This laptop comes with a two-year guarantee, so any repairs will be free.
chinese.zh: 這台筆電附兩年保固，所以任何維修都免費。

english.en: Hard work does not guarantee success, but it certainly helps.
english.zh: 努力不保證成功，但絕對有幫助。

speak.en: I guarantee you'll love the beef noodles at this place.
speak.zh: 我保證你一定會愛上這家店的牛肉麵。

write.en: The law guarantees every child the right to a free basic education.
write.zh: 法律保障每個孩子享有免費基礎教育的權利。

example.en: Librarians spent months cataloguing the old manuscripts so that researchers could easily search for them online.
example.zh: 圖書館員花了好幾個月為這些古老手稿編目，讓研究人員能輕鬆在網路上搜尋。

listen.en: You can search the library catalogue from home.
listen.zh: 你可以在家搜尋圖書館的館藏目錄。

chinese.en: The report lists a catalogue of problems, from poor management to outdated equipment.
chinese.zh: 這份報告列出一連串問題，從管理不善到設備老舊都有。

english.en: The museum has catalogued all of its paintings and sculptures.
english.zh: 這間博物館已經把所有畫作和雕塑都編目建檔。

speak.en: My mum still loves flipping through paper catalogues instead of shopping online.
speak.zh: 我媽媽還是喜歡翻紙本型錄，而不是上網購物。

write.en: Biologists are racing to catalogue rainforest species before many of them disappear forever.
write.zh: 生物學家正與時間賽跑，趕在許多雨林物種永遠消失前把牠們記錄下來。

example.en: The central bank signalled that interest rates may rise soon, a move that worried many homeowners with large loans.
example.zh: 央行暗示利率可能很快就會調升，這讓許多背負大筆房貸的屋主感到擔心。

listen.en: The driver signalled left before turning into the car park.
listen.zh: 駕駛轉進停車場前先打了左轉燈。

chinese.en: Falling sales could be a signal that customers are losing interest in the product.
chinese.zh: 銷量下滑可能是顧客對這項產品失去興趣的跡象。

english.en: The teacher gave us a signal to start the test.
english.zh: 老師給我們一個信號，示意開始考試。

speak.en: Yawning in a meeting sends the wrong signal, so I drink coffee first.
speak.zh: 開會時打哈欠會給人錯誤的觀感，所以我會先喝杯咖啡。

write.en: Raising the minimum wage would send a clear signal that the government values workers.
write.zh: 調高基本工資會明確傳達政府重視勞工的訊息。

example.en: The waiter was so indifferent to our complaints that he simply shrugged and walked back to the kitchen.
example.zh: 服務生對我們的抱怨毫不在乎，只是聳聳肩就走回廚房。

listen.en: My cat is completely indifferent to its new toys.
listen.zh: 我的貓對新玩具完全沒興趣。

chinese.en: The film received indifferent reviews, and most critics found the plot rather predictable.
chinese.zh: 這部電影的評價平平，大多數影評人都覺得劇情太好猜。

english.en: Students often become indifferent to learning when lessons feel boring and repetitive.
english.zh: 課程感覺無聊又重複時，學生常會對學習變得冷漠。

speak.en: To be honest, I'm pretty indifferent to fashion trends.
speak.zh: 老實說，我對流行趨勢不太在意。

write.en: Governments cannot remain indifferent to the rising cost of housing for young families.
write.zh: 政府不能對年輕家庭居住成本上升一事漠不關心。

example.en: With only an hour left before the deadline, she made a desperate attempt to finish the report on the train.
example.zh: 離截止時間只剩一小時，她在火車上拚命想把報告寫完。

listen.en: I was desperate to get home after the long trip.
listen.zh: 長途旅行之後，我好想趕快回家。

chinese.en: Many refugees are in desperate need of food, clean water and medical care.
chinese.zh: 許多難民亟需食物、乾淨的水和醫療照護。

english.en: After graduating, he was desperate to find a job in his field.
english.zh: 畢業後，他非常渴望找到本科系相關的工作。

speak.en: I was so desperate for coffee this morning that I skipped breakfast.
speak.zh: 我今天早上超想喝咖啡，連早餐都沒吃。

write.en: Some shops are taking desperate measures, such as huge discounts, to survive the economic downturn.
write.zh: 有些商店採取孤注一擲的手段，例如大幅折扣，以撐過經濟衰退。

example.en: Realising he had left his briefcase on the train, the lawyer rushed to the lost-property office before his meeting.
example.zh: 那位律師發現自己把公事包忘在火車上，便在開會前趕去失物招領處。

listen.en: She carries a leather briefcase to work every day.
listen.zh: 她每天都提著皮革公事包去上班。

chinese.en: These days, many office workers prefer backpacks to traditional briefcases because they are more comfortable.
chinese.zh: 現在許多上班族比較喜歡後背包，而不是傳統公事包，因為比較舒服。

english.en: My father gave me his old briefcase when I started my first job.
english.zh: 我開始第一份工作時，爸爸把他的舊公事包送給我。

speak.en: I never carry a briefcase; my laptop bag is enough for me.
speak.zh: 我從不提公事包，筆電包對我來說就夠了。

write.en: The security guard asked every visitor to open their briefcase before entering the building.
write.zh: 警衛要求每位訪客進入大樓前打開公事包。

example.en: Although she lost the final, she accepted defeat with grace and warmly congratulated her opponent in front of the crowd.
example.zh: 雖然她輸了決賽，卻很有風度地接受失敗，還在觀眾面前熱情恭喜對手。

listen.en: Thank you for gracing us with your presence tonight.
listen.zh: 謝謝您今晚大駕光臨。

chinese.en: A famous chef graced the opening of the new restaurant with a short cooking show.
chinese.zh: 一位知名主廚蒞臨新餐廳的開幕式，並帶來一場簡短的烹飪秀。

english.en: Beautiful old paintings grace the walls of the hotel lobby.
english.zh: 精美的古畫為飯店大廳的牆面增色不少。

speak.en: I really admire people who handle criticism with grace and humour.
speak.zh: 我很佩服能以風度和幽默面對批評的人。

write.en: Thanks to a grace period, new tenants can move in before paying their first month's rent.
write.zh: 因為有寬限期，新房客可以先搬進來，再付第一個月的房租。

example.en: The relaxation of travel rules after the pandemic led to a sudden rise in demand for flights and hotels.
example.zh: 疫情過後旅遊規定放寬，讓機票和旅館的需求突然大增。

listen.en: I listen to soft music for relaxation before bed.
listen.zh: 我睡前會聽輕柔的音樂來放鬆。

chinese.en: Many companies now provide relaxation rooms where employees can rest during their lunch break.
chinese.zh: 現在許多公司提供放鬆室，讓員工在午休時間休息。

english.en: Students need enough time for relaxation as well as for study.
english.zh: 學生除了讀書，也需要足夠的放鬆時間。

speak.en: For me, relaxation means a quiet weekend with a good book.
speak.zh: 對我來說，放鬆就是配一本好書，度過安靜的週末。

write.en: Parks in crowded cities offer residents valuable space for exercise and relaxation.
write.zh: 擁擠城市裡的公園為居民提供寶貴的運動和休閒空間。

example.en: The study dispelled the common myth that eating late at night is the main cause of weight gain.
example.zh: 這項研究破除了「宵夜是發胖主因」這個常見迷思。

listen.en: Her friendly smile quickly dispelled my nervousness before the interview.
listen.zh: 她友善的微笑很快消除了我面試前的緊張。

chinese.en: The company released a statement to dispel rumours that it was going out of business.
chinese.zh: 這家公司發表聲明，澄清即將倒閉的傳聞。

english.en: The teacher tried to dispel our doubts about the new exam.
english.zh: 老師試著打消我們對新考試的疑慮。

speak.en: Travelling abroad really dispelled a lot of my stereotypes about other cultures.
speak.zh: 出國旅行真的打破了我對其他文化的許多刻板印象。

write.en: The morning sun soon dispelled the fog that had covered the valley overnight.
write.zh: 早晨的陽光很快驅散了籠罩山谷一整夜的霧。

example.en: There was a hint of mischief in his eyes, so I suspected he had hidden my phone as a joke.
example.zh: 他眼裡帶著一絲頑皮，所以我懷疑是他把我的手機藏起來開玩笑。

listen.en: Our puppy is always getting into mischief at home.
listen.zh: 我們的小狗在家總是調皮搗蛋。

chinese.en: Spreading false information online can cause a great deal of mischief in society.
chinese.zh: 在網路上散播假消息會對社會造成很大的傷害。

english.en: My little brother is full of mischief and loves playing tricks.
english.zh: 我弟弟很調皮，最愛惡作劇。

speak.en: As a kid, I got up to a lot of mischief at school.
speak.zh: 我小時候在學校很愛搗蛋。

write.en: Some office workers make mischief by spreading gossip about their colleagues during breaks.
write.zh: 有些上班族會在休息時間散播同事的八卦，製造事端。

example.en: When the first approach failed, the coach changed tactics and told his players to defend more and attack quickly.
example.zh: 第一套打法失敗後，教練改變戰術，要球員加強防守並快速進攻。

listen.en: Delaying the decision was just a tactic to buy time.
listen.zh: 延後做決定只是拖延時間的手段。

chinese.en: Some online shops use pressure tactics like countdown timers to make customers buy in a hurry.
chinese.zh: 有些網路商店利用倒數計時等施壓手段，讓顧客匆忙下單。

english.en: We need a new tactic to attract more young customers.
english.zh: 我們需要新的策略來吸引更多年輕顧客。

speak.en: My favourite study tactic is explaining topics to a friend.
speak.zh: 我最喜歡的讀書方法是把內容講解給朋友聽。

write.en: Environmental groups have adopted new tactics, such as social media campaigns, to raise awareness.
write.zh: 環保團體採用了社群媒體宣傳等新手法來提高大眾意識。

example.en: As a fitness fanatic, Lisa exercises every single day and even packs her running shoes on holiday.
example.zh: 身為健身狂，Lisa 每天都運動，連度假都會帶著跑鞋。

listen.en: He is a real fanatic about keeping his car clean.
listen.zh: 他對保持車子乾淨非常執著。

chinese.en: Coffee fanatics are willing to queue for hours to try a new type of bean.
chinese.zh: 咖啡迷願意排隊好幾個小時，只為了嘗試一種新咖啡豆。

english.en: My uncle is a film fanatic who watches several movies each week.
english.zh: 我叔叔是個電影迷，每週都會看好幾部電影。

speak.en: I wouldn't call myself a fanatic, but I really love hiking.
speak.zh: 我不會說自己很狂熱，但我真的很愛爬山。

write.en: Health fanatics sometimes follow extreme diets that may actually harm their bodies.
write.zh: 有些過度追求健康的人會採取極端飲食，反而可能傷害身體。

example.en: After a long disagreement over who should pay for repairs, the landlord and the tenant finally reached a compromise.
example.zh: 房東和房客為了誰該負擔修繕費用爭執許久，最後終於達成妥協。

listen.en: We had a small disagreement about where to eat.
listen.zh: 我們對要去哪裡吃飯有點小爭執。

chinese.en: Disagreements within a team are normal and can sometimes lead to better ideas.
chinese.zh: 團隊內部意見分歧很正常，有時甚至能激盪出更好的點子。

english.en: My parents rarely have disagreements about how to spend money.
english.zh: 我爸媽很少為了怎麼花錢而意見不合。

speak.en: When I'm in disagreement with a friend, I try to stay calm.
speak.zh: 跟朋友意見不同時，我會試著保持冷靜。

write.en: Strong disagreement remains over whether cities should ban cars from their centres.
write.zh: 對於城市是否應該禁止汽車進入市中心，各方仍有強烈分歧。

example.en: Instead of discussing every detail in the full meeting, the club created a small subcommittee to plan the annual festival.
example.zh: 社團沒有在全體會議上討論所有細節，而是成立一個小組來籌劃年度活動。

listen.en: The subcommittee will report its findings next month.
listen.zh: 小組委員會將在下個月報告調查結果。

chinese.en: She was invited to join the subcommittee responsible for improving student welfare.
chinese.zh: 她受邀加入負責改善學生福利的小組委員會。

english.en: Our school formed a subcommittee to choose the new uniforms.
english.zh: 我們學校成立了一個小組來挑選新制服。

speak.en: I'm on a subcommittee at work that organises staff events.
speak.zh: 我在公司參加了一個負責籌辦員工活動的小組。

write.en: The subcommittee recommended stricter rules on food waste in school cafeterias across the city.
write.zh: 小組委員會建議對全市學校餐廳的剩食問題訂定更嚴格的規定。

example.en: On a long flight, passengers are a captive audience, so airlines show advertisements before every film.
example.zh: 長途飛行時，乘客無處可去只能看，所以航空公司在每部電影前都會播廣告。

listen.en: The dolphins were held captive in a small pool.
listen.zh: 那些海豚被關在一個小水池裡。

chinese.en: Captive pandas often live longer than wild ones because they receive regular medical care.
chinese.zh: 圈養的貓熊通常比野生貓熊活得久，因為牠們能定期接受醫療照護。

english.en: This captive tiger was rescued from a circus last year.
english.zh: 這隻被圈養的老虎是去年從馬戲團救出來的。

speak.en: I feel sorry for birds kept captive in tiny cages.
speak.zh: 看到被關在小籠子裡的鳥，我覺得很可憐。

write.en: In the adventure novel, the captives escape from the pirates' island by building a raft.
write.zh: 在這本冒險小說裡，俘虜們造了一艘木筏，逃離海盜的島嶼。

example.en: After a cyberattack froze the hospital's computers, managers refused to pay the ransom and restored their data from backups instead.
example.zh: 網路攻擊癱瘓醫院電腦後，主管拒絕支付贖金，改用備份檔還原資料。

listen.en: Tickets for the concert now cost a king's ransom.
listen.zh: 那場演唱會的門票現在貴得嚇人。

chinese.en: Experts advise companies not to pay a ransom, since it encourages further attacks.
chinese.zh: 專家建議企業不要支付贖金，因為這會助長更多攻擊。

english.en: The museum's stolen painting was returned without any ransom being paid.
english.zh: 博物館失竊的畫作在沒有支付任何贖金的情況下被歸還了。

speak.en: I back up my photos regularly, so no one can hold them to ransom.
speak.zh: 我會定期備份照片，這樣就沒人能拿它們來勒索我。

write.en: A few large suppliers can hold whole industries to ransom by suddenly raising prices.
write.zh: 少數大型供應商只要突然漲價，就能要脅整個產業。

example.en: Because she understood every client's needs, the assistant quickly became indispensable to the small design company.
example.zh: 由於這位助理了解每位客戶的需求，她很快就成為這家小型設計公司不可或缺的人。

listen.en: My phone has become indispensable in my daily life.
listen.zh: 手機已經成為我日常生活中不可或缺的東西。

chinese.en: Volunteers play an indispensable role in helping communities recover after natural disasters.
chinese.zh: 志工在協助社區從天災中復原時扮演不可或缺的角色。

english.en: Clean water and fresh food are indispensable to a healthy life.
english.zh: 乾淨的水和新鮮的食物是健康生活不可或缺的。

speak.en: For me, a good pair of walking shoes is absolutely indispensable when travelling.
speak.zh: 對我來說，旅行時一雙好走的鞋絕對不可或缺。

write.en: Teamwork skills are now considered indispensable by employers in almost every industry.
write.zh: 現在幾乎每個產業的雇主都認為團隊合作能力不可或缺。

example.en: Money is not the only motivation for work; many employees also want recognition and the chance to learn new skills.
example.zh: 錢不是工作的唯一動機，許多員工也希望獲得肯定，並有機會學習新技能。

listen.en: Setting small goals can really boost your motivation.
listen.zh: 設定小目標真的能提升你的動力。

chinese.en: Researchers wanted to understand the motivations behind people's choice to shop locally.
chinese.zh: 研究人員想了解人們選擇在地消費背後的動機。

english.en: My main motivation for learning English is to study abroad.
english.zh: 我學英文的主要動機是出國念書。

speak.en: Honestly, I find it hard to keep my motivation on rainy days.
speak.zh: 老實說，下雨天我很難保持幹勁。

write.en: Good managers understand that team motivation depends on trust as well as pay.
write.zh: 好的主管明白，團隊的士氣不只取決於薪水，也取決於信任。

example.en: The gradual evolution of the smartphone, from a simple calling device to a pocket computer, has transformed daily life.
example.zh: 智慧型手機從簡單的通話工具逐步演變成口袋電腦，徹底改變了日常生活。

listen.en: We learned about human evolution in biology class today.
listen.zh: 我們今天在生物課學到人類的演化。

chinese.en: The evolution of the language reflects the history and culture of the people who speak it.
chinese.zh: 這種語言的演變反映了使用者的歷史與文化。

english.en: This museum shows the evolution of transport over the centuries.
english.zh: 這間博物館展示了數百年來交通工具的演變。

speak.en: My cooking has gone through quite an evolution since I moved out.
speak.zh: 搬出去住以後，我的廚藝有了不小的進化。

write.en: Scientists study fossils to trace the evolution of birds from small dinosaurs.
write.zh: 科學家研究化石，追溯鳥類從小型恐龍演化而來的過程。

example.en: Although the volcano has been quiet for centuries, scientists monitor it closely because small earthquakes have been recorded nearby.
example.zh: 雖然這座火山已經沉寂好幾百年，但附近測到小規模地震，所以科學家密切監測它。

listen.en: We hiked up the volcano to watch the sunrise.
listen.zh: 我們爬上火山去看日出。

chinese.en: Many farmers choose to live near a volcano because the soil there is extremely fertile.
chinese.zh: 許多農民選擇住在火山附近，因為那裡的土壤非常肥沃。

english.en: Our class made a model volcano for the science fair.
english.zh: 我們班為科展做了一座火山模型。

speak.en: Seeing a real volcano up close was the highlight of my trip.
speak.zh: 近距離看到真正的火山是我這趟旅行的最高潮。

write.en: Flights across the region were cancelled after the volcano released a huge cloud of ash.
write.zh: 火山噴出巨大的火山灰雲後，整個地區的航班都被取消了。

example.en: By studying fossils buried deep in the rock, researchers can work out what the climate was like millions of years ago.
example.zh: 透過研究埋藏在岩層深處的化石，研究人員能推斷數百萬年前的氣候。

listen.en: Burning fossil fuels adds carbon to the atmosphere.
listen.zh: 燃燒化石燃料會增加大氣中的碳。

chinese.en: Many countries are trying to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels such as coal and oil.
chinese.zh: 許多國家正努力減少對煤炭、石油等化石燃料的依賴。

english.en: The natural history museum has a large collection of dinosaur fossils.
english.zh: 自然史博物館收藏了大量恐龍化石。

speak.en: When I was little, I dreamed of digging up fossils for a living.
speak.zh: 我小時候夢想以挖化石為業。

write.en: Switching from fossil fuels to solar power could cut household energy bills in the long run.
write.zh: 從化石燃料改用太陽能，長期下來可以減少家庭的能源開支。

example.en: Since the principal was sick, her deputy led the school assembly and announced the results of the competition.
example.zh: 由於校長生病，副校長主持了朝會並宣布比賽結果。

listen.en: She was promoted to deputy editor of the magazine.
listen.zh: 她升任這本雜誌的副總編輯。

chinese.en: The deputy mayor is responsible for transport and urban planning in the city.
chinese.zh: 副市長負責這座城市的交通和都市計畫。

english.en: My boss asked me to act as her deputy during the meeting.
english.zh: 我的主管請我在會議期間擔任她的代理人。

speak.en: I'm the deputy leader of my university's hiking club this year.
speak.zh: 我今年是大學登山社的副社長。

write.en: The company appointed a deputy director to help manage its rapid expansion overseas.
write.zh: 公司任命一位副總監，協助管理快速擴張的海外業務。

example.en: After dinner, my grandfather took his customary walk around the park before settling down to read the newspaper.
example.zh: 晚飯後，爺爺照例到公園散步，然後才坐下來看報紙。

listen.en: Tipping is not customary in most Taiwanese restaurants.
listen.zh: 在臺灣大多數餐廳，給小費並不是慣例。

chinese.en: Shaking hands is the customary way to greet business partners in many countries.
chinese.zh: 在許多國家，握手是問候商業夥伴的慣常方式。

english.en: As is customary, the new students introduced themselves on the first day.
english.zh: 依照慣例，新生在第一天做了自我介紹。

speak.en: At my family dinners, it's customary for the youngest to pour tea.
speak.zh: 在我們家的聚餐上，習慣由年紀最小的人倒茶。

write.en: Working long hours is still customary in some industries, despite growing concerns about burnout.
write.zh: 儘管人們越來越擔心過勞，在某些產業長時間工作仍是常態。

example.en: Many companies keep their profits in offshore accounts, where the money is held overseas and taxed at much lower rates.
example.zh: 許多公司把獲利存放在境外帳戶，這些錢存在海外，稅率也低得多。

listen.en: The small boat drifted offshore during the storm.
listen.zh: 暴風雨期間，那艘小船漂向外海。

chinese.en: Strong winds blew the fishing boat offshore, and the crew had to call for help.
chinese.zh: 強風把漁船吹向外海，船員只好呼救。

english.en: Our company moved its customer service team offshore to cut costs.
english.zh: 我們公司把客服團隊移到海外以降低成本。

speak.en: I'd love to try diving at an offshore island someday.
speak.zh: 我很想有一天去離島潛水看看。

write.en: Offshore oil drilling creates jobs, but a single spill can harm marine life for decades.
write.zh: 海上鑽油能創造工作機會，但只要一次漏油，就可能危害海洋生物數十年。

example.en: It took the editors three years to compile the dictionary, gathering thousands of examples from newspapers and books.
example.zh: 編輯們花了三年編纂這本字典，從報紙和書籍中蒐集了數千則例句。

listen.en: She compiled her favourite recipes into a small book.
listen.zh: 她把自己最愛的食譜彙整成一本小書。

chinese.en: The report was compiled from interviews with teachers, parents and local business owners.
chinese.zh: 這份報告是根據對老師、家長和在地商家老闆的訪談彙整而成。

english.en: My manager asked me to compile the sales figures by Friday.
english.zh: 主管要我在星期五前把銷售數字整理好。

speak.en: Before exams, I usually compile all my notes into one document.
speak.zh: 考試前，我通常會把所有筆記整理成一份文件。

write.en: The city compiles traffic data every month to decide where new bus lanes are needed.
write.zh: 市政府每個月彙整交通數據，以決定哪裡需要增設公車專用道。

example.en: Unlike most of her classmates, she showed a singular talent for music, composing whole pieces before she turned ten.
example.zh: 和大多數同學不同，她展現出非凡的音樂天分，不到十歲就能創作完整的樂曲。

listen.en: Can you tell me the singular of this noun?
listen.zh: 你能告訴我這個名詞的單數形嗎？

chinese.en: In this sentence, the subject is singular, so the verb should end in -s.
chinese.zh: 這個句子的主詞是單數，所以動詞字尾應該加 -s。

english.en: My teacher explained that 'news' is always singular in English.
english.zh: 老師解釋說，news 在英文中一律當單數。

speak.en: Honestly, I still mix up singular and plural nouns when I'm nervous.
speak.zh: 老實說，我一緊張還是會把單數和複數名詞搞混。

write.en: The project was a singular achievement for such a small team with almost no funding.
write.zh: 對一個幾乎沒有經費的小團隊來說，這個專案是非凡的成就。

example.en: Scientists warn that many coral reefs are in peril, as rising sea temperatures cause corals to lose their colour and die.
example.zh: 科學家警告，許多珊瑚礁正面臨危機，因為海水溫度上升會使珊瑚白化並死亡。

listen.en: You ignore the safety rules at your own peril.
listen.zh: 你若不理會安全規定，後果自負。

chinese.en: The article describes the perils of relying too heavily on social media for news.
chinese.zh: 這篇文章說明過度依賴社群媒體獲取新聞的危險。

english.en: Without more funding, the small museum's future is in peril.
english.zh: 如果沒有更多經費，這間小博物館的未來岌岌可危。

speak.en: I learned the perils of leaving essays until the last minute.
speak.zh: 我體會到把報告拖到最後一刻才寫的危險。

write.en: Mountain climbers who set off without proper equipment put their lives in peril.
write.zh: 沒有適當裝備就出發的登山客，等於是拿自己的性命冒險。

example.en: Many readers expressed disgust at the company's decision to dump waste into the river, and some refused to buy its products.
example.zh: 許多讀者對這家公司把廢棄物倒進河裡的決定表示反感，有些人甚至拒買它的產品。

listen.en: He shook his head in disgust and left.
listen.zh: 他厭惡地搖搖頭就走了。

chinese.en: To my disgust, the hotel room was dirty and smelled of old cigarettes.
chinese.zh: 令我反感的是，飯店房間又髒又有一股陳年菸味。

english.en: The players were disgusted by the referee's unfair decision last night.
english.zh: 球員們對昨晚裁判不公平的判決感到很反感。

speak.en: Honestly, people who litter on the beach really disgust me.
speak.zh: 老實說，在海灘亂丟垃圾的人真的讓我很反感。

write.en: The lack of basic hygiene in the factory disgusted the inspectors who visited it.
write.zh: 工廠連基本衛生都做不到，讓前去稽查的人員十分反感。

example.en: Long-time residents still mourn the loss of the old market, which was replaced by a shopping mall last year.
example.zh: 老居民至今仍惋惜舊市場的消失，它去年被一間購物中心取代了。

listen.en: The family is still mourning their beloved grandmother.
listen.zh: 這家人仍在為他們摯愛的祖母哀悼。

chinese.en: Fans around the world mourned when the famous band announced it was breaking up.
chinese.zh: 那個知名樂團宣布解散時，全球樂迷都感到難過不捨。

english.en: My sister mourned for weeks after her old dog passed away.
english.zh: 我姊姊的老狗過世後，她難過了好幾個星期。

speak.en: I think it's healthy to mourn a loss instead of hiding your feelings.
speak.zh: 我覺得面對失去時好好難過一場，比壓抑情緒來得健康。

write.en: Some critics mourn the decline of handwritten letters in the age of email.
write.zh: 有些評論者惋惜在電子郵件時代，手寫信逐漸式微。

example.en: The bridge is a remarkable feat of engineering, stretching across a deep valley without a single support in the middle.
example.zh: 這座橋是了不起的工程傑作，橫跨深谷，中間連一根支柱都沒有。

listen.en: She works for a large engineering company in the city.
listen.zh: 她在市區一家大型工程公司上班。

chinese.en: Fewer women than men choose engineering, although the gap has narrowed in recent years.
chinese.zh: 選讀工程的女性比男性少，不過近年來差距已經縮小。

english.en: Engineering students often have to work on group projects together.
english.zh: 工程系學生常常要一起做分組專題。

speak.en: I chose engineering because I've always loved figuring out how machines work.
speak.zh: 我選工程是因為我一直很喜歡研究機器是怎麼運作的。

write.en: Advances in genetic engineering have allowed farmers to grow crops that resist disease.
write.zh: 基因工程的進步讓農民能種出抗病的作物。

example.en: Residents called the plan outrageous, pointing out that the new road would cut straight through the only park in the neighbourhood.
example.zh: 居民認為這項計畫令人憤慨，並指出新道路會直接穿過社區唯一的公園。

listen.en: His excuse for being late was completely outrageous.
listen.zh: 他遲到的藉口實在太離譜了。

chinese.en: It is outrageous that some landlords raise the rent without giving tenants any notice.
chinese.zh: 有些房東沒有事先通知房客就調漲房租，實在令人憤慨。

english.en: The singer is famous for wearing outrageous costumes on stage.
english.zh: 這位歌手以在舞臺上穿著誇張出格的服裝聞名。

speak.en: I think charging students that much for textbooks is outrageous.
speak.zh: 我覺得課本向學生收那麼多錢實在太離譜了。

write.en: The manager made an outrageous demand that everyone work through the holiday weekend.
write.zh: 經理提出一個過分的要求，要所有人連假期間都得上班。

example.en: Multinational corporations often move factories to countries where wages are lower, which can leave many local workers unemployed.
example.zh: 跨國企業常把工廠移到工資較低的國家，這可能使許多當地勞工失業。

listen.en: The corporation announced a new plan to cut waste.
listen.zh: 這家公司宣布了一項減少浪費的新計畫。

chinese.en: Some people believe large corporations should pay more tax to support public services.
chinese.zh: 有些人認為大企業應該繳更多稅來支持公共服務。

english.en: My father has worked for the same corporation for many years.
english.zh: 我爸爸在同一家公司工作很多年了。

speak.en: I'd rather work for a small startup than a huge corporation.
speak.zh: 我寧願在小型新創公司工作，也不想進大企業。

write.en: The broadcasting corporation was criticised for showing too many adverts during children's programmes.
write.zh: 這家廣播公司因在兒童節目時段播放太多廣告而受到批評。

example.en: When the power went out, we had to grope our way down the stairs, holding the rail with one hand.
example.zh: 停電的時候，我們只好一手扶著欄杆，摸黑走下樓梯。

listen.en: She groped in her bag for her keys.
listen.zh: 她在包包裡摸找鑰匙。

chinese.en: During the interview, he groped for words when asked about his greatest weakness.
chinese.zh: 面試時被問到自己最大的缺點，他一時語塞，努力想該怎麼回答。

english.en: The new manager is still groping for a way to motivate the team.
english.zh: 新經理還在摸索激勵團隊的方法。

speak.en: I always grope around for my phone when the alarm goes off.
speak.zh: 鬧鐘一響，我總是伸手到處摸找手機。

write.en: Policymakers are groping for ways to make housing affordable for young families.
write.zh: 決策者正在苦思讓年輕家庭買得起房子的辦法。

example.en: Ice samples from Antarctica allow scientists to study how the climate has changed over the past millennium.
example.zh: 南極的冰層樣本讓科學家能研究過去一千年來氣候的變化。

listen.en: This old bridge has survived for almost a millennium.
listen.zh: 這座古橋已經屹立將近一千年了。

chinese.en: Since the millennium began, smartphones have completely changed the way people communicate.
chinese.zh: 自千禧年以來，智慧型手機徹底改變了人們溝通的方式。

english.en: The company was founded just before the turn of the millennium.
english.zh: 這家公司在千禧年前夕成立。

speak.en: I was born just after the millennium, so I grew up with the internet.
speak.zh: 我是千禧年過後不久出生的，所以是伴隨網路長大的。

write.en: Some goals set at the start of the millennium, such as ending hunger, remain unmet.
write.zh: 千禧年之初訂下的一些目標，例如消除飢餓，至今仍未達成。

example.en: In spring, the hillside is covered with a thick carpet of wildflowers, attracting thousands of visitors with cameras.
example.zh: 春天時，山坡上開滿了厚厚一層野花，吸引成千上萬帶著相機的遊客。

listen.en: Please take off your shoes before walking on the carpet.
listen.zh: 走上地毯前請先脫鞋。

chinese.en: The government was accused of trying to sweep the problem under the carpet.
chinese.zh: 政府被指控企圖掩蓋這個問題。

english.en: The hotel rolled out the red carpet for the famous actor.
english.zh: 飯店以隆重禮遇迎接這位知名演員。

speak.en: I spilled coffee on the carpet, and the stain just won't come out.
speak.zh: 我把咖啡灑在地毯上，污漬怎麼洗都洗不掉。

write.en: After the autumn storm, the park paths were carpeted with fallen leaves.
write.zh: 秋季暴風雨過後，公園小徑上鋪滿了落葉。

example.en: Losing the final match was a devastating blow to the young team, who had trained every day for months.
example.zh: 輸掉決賽對這支年輕隊伍是沉重的打擊，他們已經連續好幾個月天天練習。

listen.en: The news of the factory closure was devastating.
listen.zh: 工廠關閉的消息令人非常難過。

chinese.en: Plastic pollution can have devastating consequences for sea turtles and other marine animals.
chinese.zh: 塑膠污染可能對海龜和其他海洋動物造成災難性的後果。

english.en: The fire caused devastating damage to the old wooden temple.
english.zh: 這場火災對那座老木造廟宇造成嚴重的破壞。

speak.en: Failing my driving test the first time was pretty devastating, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，第一次駕照考試沒過真的讓我很受打擊。

write.en: Rising food prices could be devastating for low-income families already struggling to pay rent.
write.zh: 食物價格上漲對本來就付不太起房租的低收入家庭來說，可能是一大打擊。

example.en: The police found no evidence of a break-in: the doors were locked and nothing was missing from the house.
example.zh: 警方沒有發現任何闖入的跡象：門都鎖著，屋裡也沒有東西遺失。

listen.en: Can you give me evidence to support your claim?
listen.zh: 你能提出證據支持你的說法嗎？

chinese.en: In your essay, you should support each main point with clear evidence.
chinese.zh: 在你的文章中，每個主要論點都應該有明確的證據支持。

english.en: Scientists have not found any evidence of life on Mars.
english.zh: 科學家還沒有在火星上找到任何生命的跡象。

speak.en: I don't believe that theory, because there's simply no evidence for it.
speak.zh: 我不相信那個理論，因為根本沒有證據。

write.en: Growing piles of rubbish on the beach are clear evidence of the town's waste problem.
write.zh: 海灘上越堆越多的垃圾，明顯證明這個小鎮有垃圾處理問題。

example.en: Some writers draw an analogy between the brain and a computer, since both store and process information.
example.zh: 有些作者把大腦比作電腦，因為兩者都會儲存和處理資訊。

listen.en: That analogy really helped me understand the idea.
listen.zh: 那個比喻真的幫助我理解了這個概念。

chinese.en: By analogy with older cities, the new town will probably grow along its main road.
chinese.zh: 以較老的城市類推，這個新市鎮很可能會沿著主要道路發展。

english.en: The speaker made a clever analogy between learning and building a house.
english.zh: 講者巧妙地把學習比喻成蓋房子。

speak.en: To use an analogy, studying vocabulary is a bit like going to the gym.
speak.zh: 打個比方，背單字有點像上健身房。

write.en: Critics say the analogy between running a country and running a business is misleading.
write.zh: 批評者認為把治理國家比作經營企業的類比是有誤導性的。

example.en: To keep the soil healthy, farmers rotate their crops, planting beans one year and corn the next.
example.zh: 為了保持土壤健康，農民會輪作，今年種豆子，明年改種玉米。

listen.en: Turn the handle slowly so the wheel can rotate.
listen.zh: 慢慢轉動把手，讓輪子轉起來。

chinese.en: Nurses at the hospital rotate between day and night shifts every few weeks.
chinese.zh: 這家醫院的護理師每隔幾週就要輪替日班和夜班。

english.en: In our study group, we rotate the role of team leader.
english.zh: 在我們的讀書會裡，大家輪流擔任組長。

speak.en: I usually rotate the photo on my phone before posting it.
speak.zh: 我通常會先把手機裡的照片轉正再上傳。

write.en: Some companies rotate staff across departments so that employees gain a wider range of skills.
write.zh: 有些公司讓員工在各部門輪調，以培養更多元的技能。

example.en: Researchers tested different amounts of sleep to find the optimum level for memory, and seven to eight hours worked best.
example.zh: 研究人員測試不同的睡眠時數，想找出對記憶力最好的長度，結果七到八小時效果最佳。

listen.en: Early morning is the optimum time to study.
listen.zh: 清晨是讀書的最佳時段。

chinese.en: The new office layout was designed to create optimum conditions for teamwork.
chinese.zh: 新的辦公室格局是為了營造最適合團隊合作的環境而設計的。

english.en: The machine works at its optimum when it is cleaned regularly.
english.zh: 這臺機器定期清潔時，運作狀態最好。

speak.en: I think twenty minutes is the optimum length for a power nap.
speak.zh: 我覺得小睡二十分鐘是最剛好的長度。

write.en: The city is trying to find the optimum balance between economic growth and environmental protection.
write.zh: 市政府正在努力尋找經濟成長與環境保護之間的最佳平衡。

example.en: Despite clear evidence that the plan was failing, the stubborn manager refused to change anything, and the project collapsed.
example.zh: 儘管有明確證據顯示計畫行不通，那位固執的經理仍拒絕做任何調整，結果專案失敗了。

listen.en: This stubborn stain will not wash out of my shirt.
listen.zh: 我襯衫上這塊頑固的污漬怎麼洗都洗不掉。

chinese.en: Officials are struggling with stubborn unemployment in rural areas despite several new policies.
chinese.zh: 儘管推出了幾項新政策，官員仍難以解決鄉村地區居高不下的失業問題。

english.en: The stubborn child refused to eat anything green on his plate.
english.zh: 那個固執的孩子拒絕吃盤子裡任何綠色的東西。

speak.en: I can be a bit stubborn when I think I'm right.
speak.zh: 當我覺得自己是對的時候，我會有點固執。

write.en: A stubborn cold kept me away from class for almost two weeks last winter.
write.zh: 去年冬天，一場拖很久的感冒讓我將近兩週沒辦法上課。

example.en: Hair loss is often hereditary, so men whose fathers went bald early are more likely to lose their hair too.
example.zh: 掉髮常常是遺傳的，所以父親很早就禿頭的男性，自己也比較容易掉髮。

listen.en: Is this skin problem hereditary or caused by stress?
listen.zh: 這個皮膚問題是遺傳的，還是壓力造成的？

chinese.en: In some countries, seats in parliament were once hereditary and passed from father to son.
chinese.zh: 在某些國家，國會席位曾經是世襲的，由父親傳給兒子。

english.en: Running the shop is almost a hereditary job in his family.
english.zh: 經營這家店在他們家幾乎是世代相傳的工作。

speak.en: Apparently my short-sightedness is hereditary, since both my parents wear glasses.
speak.zh: 我的近視似乎是遺傳的，因為我爸媽都戴眼鏡。

write.en: Researchers are studying how hereditary factors and lifestyle together affect a person's risk of diabetes.
write.zh: 研究人員正在研究遺傳因素和生活習慣如何共同影響一個人罹患糖尿病的風險。

example.en: Few tourists notice the plight of hotel cleaners, who often work long hours for very low wages.
example.zh: 很少有遊客注意到飯店清潔人員的辛苦處境，他們往往工時長、薪水又很低。

listen.en: The article describes the plight of homeless families.
listen.zh: 這篇文章描述了無家可歸家庭的困境。

chinese.en: Volunteers are trying to draw public attention to the plight of stray dogs.
chinese.zh: 志工們正努力讓大眾關注流浪狗的處境。

english.en: Our class raised money to help ease the plight of flood victims.
english.zh: 我們班募款幫助減輕水災災民的困境。

speak.en: I really sympathise with the plight of students who can't afford rent.
speak.zh: 我很同情那些付不起房租的學生的處境。

write.en: Rising sea levels have worsened the plight of people living on low-lying islands.
write.zh: 海平面上升讓住在低窪島嶼上的居民處境更加艱難。

example.en: The medicine tasted horrible, so the doctor suggested mixing it with a little juice to make it easier to swallow.
example.zh: 這藥很難喝，所以醫生建議加一點果汁，比較好吞下去。

listen.en: I had a horrible feeling that I'd forgotten something.
listen.zh: 我有種很不好的感覺，好像忘了什麼東西。

chinese.en: Some customers were horrible to the waiter, even though the delay wasn't his fault.
chinese.zh: 有些客人對服務生很不客氣，儘管上菜延誤根本不是他的錯。

english.en: Living next to a noisy construction site for a year was horrible.
english.zh: 住在吵雜的工地旁邊一年真的很痛苦。

speak.en: The traffic this morning was horrible, so I was late for work.
speak.zh: 今天早上交通超糟，所以我上班遲到了。

write.en: Air pollution in some cities has reached horrible levels, forcing schools to keep children indoors.
write.zh: 有些城市的空氣污染已經嚴重到可怕的程度，學校只好讓孩子待在室內。

example.en: Before buying the small café, she checked its liabilities carefully and found it owed money to several suppliers.
example.zh: 買下這間小咖啡館之前，她仔細檢查了它的負債，發現它還欠好幾家供應商錢。

listen.en: His careless attitude has become a liability to the team.
listen.zh: 他粗心的態度已經成了團隊的累贅。

chinese.en: The hotel denied liability when a guest's laptop was stolen from the lobby.
chinese.zh: 一位房客的筆電在大廳被偷，飯店卻否認有責任。

english.en: Parents may have liability for damage caused by their young children.
english.zh: 父母可能要為年幼子女造成的損害負責。

speak.en: My old car is more of a liability than a help these days.
speak.zh: 我那輛老車最近與其說是幫手，不如說是負擔。

write.en: Firms that ignore online security risks may face huge liabilities if customer data is leaked.
write.zh: 忽視網路安全風險的公司，一旦客戶資料外洩，可能要承擔龐大的賠償責任。

example.en: Linguistics is not about speaking many languages; instead, it examines how sounds, words and grammar form a system.
example.zh: 語言學不是要會說很多種語言，而是研究語音、詞彙和文法如何構成一個系統。

listen.en: My cousin is taking a course in linguistics this term.
listen.zh: 我表哥這學期在修一門語言學的課。

chinese.en: Research in linguistics shows that young children learn grammar mainly by listening, not by memorising rules.
chinese.zh: 語言學研究顯示，幼兒主要是透過聆聽來學文法，而不是靠背規則。

english.en: Applied linguistics can help teachers design better English lessons for students.
english.zh: 應用語言學可以幫助老師為學生設計更好的英文課程。

speak.en: I find linguistics fascinating, especially how accents change from place to place.
speak.zh: 我覺得語言學很有趣，尤其是各地口音的差異。

write.en: Tech companies hire experts in linguistics to make voice assistants understand people more accurately.
write.zh: 科技公司聘請語言學專家，讓語音助理能更準確地聽懂人說話。

example.en: After years of short-term contracts, he finally found a steady job with a regular income and paid holidays.
example.zh: 做了好幾年的短期約聘工作後，他終於找到一份有固定收入和帶薪假的穩定工作。

listen.en: Hold the ladder steady while I climb up.
listen.zh: 我爬上去的時候，請把梯子扶穩。

chinese.en: The number of international students remained steady, while local enrolment fell slightly.
chinese.zh: 國際學生人數維持平穩，而本地學生的入學人數則略為下降。

english.en: She grabbed the railing to steady herself on the moving bus.
english.zh: 她抓住扶手，在行駛的公車上穩住身體。

speak.en: I prefer walking at a steady pace rather than running.
speak.zh: 比起跑步，我比較喜歡用穩定的速度走路。

write.en: Taking a few deep breaths helped me steady my nerves before the job interview.
write.zh: 面試前深呼吸幾次，幫助我穩住緊張的情緒。

example.en: Raising taxes just before an election is often seen as political suicide, because voters may quickly turn against the party.
example.zh: 在選舉前夕加稅常被視為政治自殺，因為選民可能很快就不再支持該政黨。

listen.en: The school runs a programme on suicide prevention.
listen.zh: 這所學校有一個自殺防治的計畫。

chinese.en: Experts say that talking openly about mental health can help reduce the suicide rate.
chinese.zh: 專家表示，公開談論心理健康有助於降低自殺率。

english.en: The city set up a free hotline for suicide prevention.
english.zh: 市政府設立了一條免費的自殺防治專線。

speak.en: Skipping all my revision before finals would be academic suicide.
speak.zh: 期末考前完全不複習，根本就是學業自殺。

write.en: Opening a third café on the same street would be commercial suicide for the owner.
write.zh: 在同一條街上開第三家咖啡館，對老闆來說無異於商業自殺。

example.en: The new film received a mixed reception: some critics praised its acting, while others found the story slow and confusing.
example.zh: 這部新片評價兩極：有些影評稱讚演技，有些則覺得劇情緩慢又令人困惑。

listen.en: The phone reception here in the mountains is terrible.
listen.zh: 這裡山上的手機收訊很差。

chinese.en: The government's new housing policy has had a cool reception from young people.
chinese.zh: 政府的新住宅政策在年輕人之間反應冷淡。

english.en: The exchange students were given a warm reception at our school.
english.zh: 交換學生在我們學校受到熱烈的歡迎。

speak.en: My cousin's wedding reception was so much fun last weekend.
speak.zh: 上週末我表姊的婚宴真的超好玩。

write.en: The museum held a small reception to welcome the artists before the exhibition opened.
write.zh: 展覽開幕前，博物館舉辦了一場小型招待會歡迎藝術家們。

example.en: Visitors to the history museum can see artillery from past centuries, including iron cannons that needed a dozen soldiers to move.
example.zh: 歷史博物館的參觀者可以看到過去幾個世紀的火砲，包括需要十幾名士兵才推得動的鐵製大砲。

listen.en: My grandfather served in an artillery unit when he was young.
listen.zh: 我爺爺年輕時在砲兵部隊服役。

chinese.en: Historians say the invention of artillery completely changed how castles were built and defended.
chinese.zh: 歷史學家表示，火砲的發明徹底改變了城堡的建造與防禦方式。

english.en: The children were amazed by the size of the old artillery.
english.zh: 孩子們對那些古老大砲的尺寸感到驚嘆。

speak.en: When my boss brings out the heavy artillery, I know the meeting is serious.
speak.zh: 當老闆祭出殺手鐧時，我就知道這場會議很嚴肅。

write.en: In the debate, the lawyer saved her heavy artillery, the strongest evidence, for the very end.
write.zh: 辯論中，律師把她最有力的武器，也就是最強的證據，留到最後才拿出來。

example.en: Scientists believe that humans and chimpanzees share a common ancestor that lived millions of years ago in Africa.
example.zh: 科學家認為人類和黑猩猩有共同的祖先，牠生活在數百萬年前的非洲。

listen.en: Many families honour their ancestors during the festival.
listen.zh: 許多家庭會在這個節日祭拜祖先。

chinese.en: The modern bicycle's ancestor was a wooden machine with no pedals at all.
chinese.zh: 現代腳踏車的前身是一種完全沒有踏板的木製車。

english.en: My grandmother keeps photos of our ancestors in an old album.
english.zh: 我奶奶把我們祖先的照片收在一本舊相簿裡。

speak.en: I'd love to learn more about where my ancestors came from.
speak.zh: 我很想多了解我的祖先是從哪裡來的。

write.en: Some traditions passed down from our ancestors are disappearing as cities grow quickly.
write.zh: 隨著城市快速發展，一些祖先傳下來的傳統正在消失。

example.en: The project was handed to a seasoned engineer who had solved similar problems many times before, so the team felt confident.
example.zh: 這個專案交給了一位經驗老到、之前解決過許多類似問題的工程師，因此團隊很有信心。

listen.en: The chicken was seasoned with garlic and black pepper.
listen.zh: 這道雞肉用大蒜和黑胡椒調味。

chinese.en: The interview was led by a seasoned journalist who asked difficult but fair questions.
chinese.zh: 這場訪談由一位資深記者主持，她問的問題雖然尖銳但很公允。

english.en: The soup is well seasoned, so you don't need extra salt.
english.zh: 這湯已經調味得剛好，不需要再加鹽。

speak.en: My dad is a seasoned cook, so family dinners are always amazing.
speak.zh: 我爸是很有經驗的廚師，所以家裡的晚餐總是超棒。

write.en: Seasoned volunteers train newcomers on how to respond calmly during natural disasters.
write.zh: 資深志工會訓練新人在天災發生時如何冷靜應對。

example.en: Working from home reduced the company's overheads, since it no longer had to pay rent and electricity for a large office.
example.zh: 居家辦公降低了公司的營運開支，因為不用再為大辦公室支付房租和電費。

listen.en: Please put your bag in the overhead locker.
listen.zh: 請把您的包包放進上方的行李櫃。

chinese.en: The overhead lights in the classroom were so bright that some students got headaches.
chinese.zh: 教室天花板的燈太亮，有些學生都頭痛了。

english.en: Small online shops have lower overhead costs than traditional stores.
english.zh: 小型網路商店的營運成本比傳統店面低。

speak.en: I love lying on the grass and watching planes pass overhead.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡躺在草地上看飛機從頭頂飛過。

write.en: Residents complained that overhead power lines spoil the view of the historic old street.
write.zh: 居民抱怨架空的電線破壞了歷史老街的景觀。

example.en: After missing an easy goal in the first half, the striker redeemed himself by scoring the winner just before the final whistle.
example.zh: 上半場錯失一個簡單的進球機會後，前鋒在終場哨響前踢進致勝球，將功贖罪。

listen.en: This gift card can be redeemed online or in store.
listen.zh: 這張禮物卡可以在網路或門市兌換。

chinese.en: The film was rather boring, but its beautiful music was a redeeming feature.
chinese.zh: 這部電影相當無聊，不過優美的配樂算是唯一可取之處。

english.en: She worked hard to redeem herself after failing the first exam.
english.zh: 第一次考試不及格後，她努力用功想扳回一城。

speak.en: I finally redeemed my air miles for a trip to Japan.
speak.zh: 我終於用累積的航空里程換了一趟日本之旅。

write.en: The company tried to redeem its reputation by recalling the faulty products and apologising publicly.
write.zh: 這家公司召回瑕疵產品並公開道歉，試圖挽回聲譽。

example.en: Many office workers lead a sedentary lifestyle, sitting at a desk all day and rarely finding time to exercise.
example.zh: 許多上班族過著久坐的生活，整天坐在辦公桌前，很少有時間運動。

listen.en: Moving to the countryside completely changed her lifestyle.
listen.zh: 搬到鄉下徹底改變了她的生活方式。

chinese.en: Young people in big cities often cannot afford the lifestyle their parents enjoyed.
chinese.zh: 大城市的年輕人往往負擔不起父母那一輩享有的生活。

english.en: Smoking and staying up late are unhealthy lifestyle choices for students.
english.zh: 抽菸和熬夜對學生來說是不健康的生活習慣。

speak.en: I'd describe my lifestyle as busy but pretty balanced.
speak.zh: 我會說我的生活很忙，但還算平衡。

write.en: A simpler lifestyle, with fewer purchases and less waste, could help protect the environment.
write.zh: 少買東西、少製造垃圾的簡單生活，有助於保護環境。

example.en: Some older musicians showed open disdain for pop music, calling it shallow and claiming it required no real skill.
example.zh: 有些年長的音樂家公開鄙視流行音樂，說它膚淺，根本不需要真本事。

listen.en: He treats anyone who disagrees with him with disdain.
listen.zh: 任何和他意見不同的人，他都以輕蔑的態度對待。

chinese.en: The famous chef disdains fast food, but he admits his children love it.
chinese.zh: 那位知名主廚瞧不起速食，但他承認自己的孩子很愛吃。

english.en: Customers do not like staff who show disdain for their questions.
english.zh: 顧客不喜歡對他們的問題表現出不屑的店員。

speak.en: I don't understand why some people have such disdain for public transport.
speak.zh: 我不懂為什麼有些人那麼瞧不起大眾運輸。

write.en: Politicians who show disdain for ordinary voters often lose public support very quickly.
write.zh: 對一般選民表現出輕蔑態度的政治人物，往往很快就失去民意支持。

example.en: When the factory failed to comply with the new pollution limits, the authorities fined it and ordered it to stop production.
example.zh: 那家工廠沒有遵守新的污染限制標準，主管機關因此開罰並勒令停工。

listen.en: Please comply with the rules of the library.
listen.zh: 請遵守圖書館的規定。

chinese.en: Most passengers complied when the crew asked them to stay in their seats.
chinese.zh: 機組人員要求乘客留在座位上時，大部分人都照做了。

english.en: Students who do not comply with the dress code may be sent home.
english.zh: 不遵守服裝規定的學生可能會被請回家。

speak.en: I always comply with the rules, even when nobody is watching.
speak.zh: 就算沒人在看，我也一定會遵守規定。

write.en: Online platforms must comply with privacy laws when they collect users' personal information.
write.zh: 網路平臺蒐集使用者個人資料時，必須遵守隱私權相關法律。

example.en: The leaflets claimed the new factory would bring only benefits, but they were really propaganda designed to silence local concerns.
example.zh: 傳單聲稱新工廠只會帶來好處，但其實那是為了壓下在地居民疑慮的片面宣傳。

listen.en: Don't believe everything you read; some of it is propaganda.
listen.zh: 別相信你讀到的每件事，其中有些是刻意的宣傳。

chinese.en: In the novel, the government controls people's thoughts through constant propaganda on television.
chinese.zh: 在這本小說裡，政府透過電視上不斷的宣傳來控制人民的思想。

english.en: Social media makes it easy to spread propaganda to millions of people.
english.zh: 社群媒體讓宣傳內容很容易散播給數百萬人。

speak.en: Honestly, some adverts feel more like propaganda than real information.
speak.zh: 老實說，有些廣告感覺比較像洗腦宣傳，而不是真正的資訊。

write.en: Schools should teach students how to recognise propaganda so they can think critically about the news.
write.zh: 學校應該教學生辨識片面宣傳，讓他們能以批判性思考看待新聞。

example.en: The organisers had not foreseen such heavy rain, so the outdoor concert was cancelled and fans were offered refunds.
example.zh: 主辦單位沒料到會下這麼大的雨，所以戶外演唱會取消了，並提供歌迷退票。

listen.en: Nobody can foresee exactly what the future will bring.
listen.zh: 沒有人能準確預知未來會發生什麼。

chinese.en: Good managers try to foresee difficulties and prepare solutions before they arise.
chinese.zh: 好的主管會試著預見困難，並在問題發生前準備好解決方案。
