english.en: She foresaw that the price of housing would keep rising.
english.zh: 她預見房價會持續上漲。

speak.en: I can't foresee myself living abroad, because I'm really close to my family.
speak.zh: 我很難想像自己住在國外，因為我跟家人很親近。

write.en: Few experts foresaw that artificial intelligence would change education so dramatically within a decade.
write.zh: 很少有專家預料到人工智慧會在十年內如此劇烈地改變教育。

example.en: Facing high unemployment at home, thousands of young doctors emigrated in search of better pay and working conditions abroad.
example.zh: 面對國內高失業率，成千上萬的年輕醫師移居國外，尋求更好的待遇與工作環境。

listen.en: My uncle plans to emigrate to Australia next year.
listen.zh: 我叔叔打算明年移民澳洲。

chinese.en: Many families who emigrated decades ago still celebrate traditional festivals in their new countries.
chinese.zh: 許多數十年前移居海外的家庭，在新的國家仍會慶祝傳統節日。

english.en: He decided to emigrate after he retired from his teaching job.
english.zh: 他從教職退休後，決定移居國外。

speak.en: I've thought about emigrating, but I'd miss the food here too much.
speak.zh: 我想過移民，但我會太想念這裡的食物。

write.en: When skilled workers emigrate, their home countries may face serious shortages in key industries.
write.zh: 當技術人才移居國外，母國的關鍵產業可能會面臨嚴重的人力短缺。

example.en: Posting photos of other people online without asking them first can violate their privacy and cause serious problems.
example.zh: 沒先問過就把別人的照片貼上網，可能侵犯他人隱私，造成嚴重的問題。

listen.en: The company violated the terms of the contract.
listen.zh: 這家公司違反了合約條款。

chinese.en: The factory was closed after inspectors found it had repeatedly violated safety standards.
chinese.zh: 稽查人員發現這家工廠多次違反安全標準後，工廠被勒令關閉。

english.en: Copying another student's essay clearly violates the university's rules on cheating.
english.zh: 抄襲其他同學的報告，明顯違反大學的作弊規定。

speak.en: I'd feel uncomfortable if a friend violated my trust like that.
speak.zh: 如果朋友那樣辜負我的信任，我會很不舒服。

write.en: Paying workers less than the minimum wage violates their basic rights and should be punished.
write.zh: 支付低於基本工資的薪水侵犯了勞工的基本權益，應該受到處罰。

example.en: Curiosity is a trait shared by many successful scientists, who constantly ask questions and are never satisfied with simple answers.
example.zh: 好奇心是許多成功科學家的共同特質，他們不斷提問，從不滿足於簡單的答案。

listen.en: Honesty is the trait I value most in a friend.
listen.zh: 誠實是我最看重的朋友特質。

chinese.en: Eye colour is a genetic trait that children inherit from their parents.
chinese.zh: 眼睛顏色是孩子從父母身上遺傳到的特徵。

english.en: Employers look for traits such as teamwork and good communication.
english.zh: 雇主會尋找具備團隊合作和良好溝通等特質的人。

speak.en: I think my most annoying trait is that I'm always late.
speak.zh: 我覺得我最惱人的特點就是老是遲到。

write.en: Some researchers argue that certain cultural traits help explain why some countries save more money.
write.zh: 有些研究者認為，某些文化特質有助於解釋為何某些國家的人比較會存錢。

example.en: After weeks of hesitation, he finally summoned the courage to tell his parents that he wanted to change his major.
example.zh: 猶豫了好幾個星期後，他終於鼓起勇氣告訴父母他想轉系。

listen.en: A neighbour heard the noise and summoned help.
listen.zh: 一位鄰居聽到聲響後就找人來幫忙。

chinese.en: The witness was summoned to court to explain what she had seen that night.
chinese.zh: 那位證人被傳喚出庭，說明她那天晚上看到的情況。

english.en: I could barely summon the energy to get out of bed.
english.zh: 我幾乎提不起力氣起床。

speak.en: In some apps, you can summon a taxi with just one tap.
speak.zh: 在某些應用程式裡，只要點一下就能叫計程車。

write.en: The minister was summoned to parliament to answer questions about the rising cost of electricity.
write.zh: 部長被傳喚到國會，回答有關電費上漲的質詢。

example.en: Health officials traced a cluster of flu cases to a single school, where dozens of pupils had fallen ill.
example.zh: 衛生官員把一群流感病例追溯到同一所學校，那裡有數十名學生生病。

listen.en: The children clustered around the teacher to hear the story.
listen.zh: 孩子們聚集在老師身邊聽故事。

chinese.en: Most of the city's tech companies are clustered in a single district near the university.
chinese.zh: 這座城市大多數的科技公司都集中在大學附近的同一個區域。

english.en: Tourists clustered together under the bridge to avoid the rain.
english.zh: 遊客們聚集在橋下躲雨。

speak.en: In my hometown, most of the good restaurants cluster around the train station.
speak.zh: 在我的家鄉，大部分好吃的餐廳都聚集在火車站周圍。

write.en: Grapes grow in tight clusters, so pickers must cut each bunch carefully.
write.zh: 葡萄是一串串緊密地長在一起，所以採收工人必須小心地剪下每一串。

example.en: Before writing the report, the team carried out extensive research, interviewing hundreds of residents and reviewing years of data.
example.zh: 撰寫報告之前，團隊做了大量研究，訪問了數百位居民，並檢視了多年來的數據。

listen.en: She has extensive experience in teaching young children.
listen.zh: 她在教導幼童方面有豐富的經驗。

chinese.en: The museum has an extensive collection of traditional pottery from across Asia.
chinese.zh: 這間博物館收藏了大量來自亞洲各地的傳統陶器。

english.en: The old hotel has extensive gardens where guests can relax.
english.zh: 這間老飯店有一大片花園，讓房客可以放鬆。

speak.en: My grandfather has an extensive knowledge of local history.
speak.zh: 我爺爺對地方歷史懂得非常多。

write.en: Extensive use of smartphones in class can make it harder for students to concentrate.
write.zh: 在課堂上大量使用智慧型手機，可能讓學生更難專心。

example.en: The company's gross profit rose last year, but after paying rent and wages, it was left with very little.
example.zh: 這家公司去年的毛利增加了，但付完房租和薪水後，剩下的錢所剩無幾。

listen.en: The report blamed the accident on gross negligence by the builders.
listen.zh: 報告將這起意外歸咎於營造商的嚴重疏失。

chinese.en: The animated film grossed far more than its budget during its first weekend in cinemas.
chinese.zh: 這部動畫電影上映首週末的票房，就遠遠超過了製作預算。

english.en: Gross domestic product is often used to measure a country's economy.
english.zh: 國內生產毛額常被用來衡量一個國家的經濟。

speak.en: Honestly, I think eating insects sounds a bit gross.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得吃昆蟲聽起來有點噁心。

write.en: Paying men and women differently for the same job is a gross injustice.
write.zh: 男女做同樣的工作卻領不同的薪水，是非常嚴重的不公平。

example.en: After the update, the printer stopped working, so the technician restored its original configuration and everything ran smoothly again.
example.zh: 更新之後印表機就不能用了，於是技術人員把它恢復成原本的設定，一切又順利運作了。

listen.en: Please check the network configuration before you call for help.
listen.zh: 在打電話求助之前，請先檢查網路設定。

chinese.en: Scientists studied the configuration of the molecule to understand how it reacts with water.
chinese.zh: 科學家研究了這個分子的結構，以了解它如何與水產生反應。

english.en: The new office has an open configuration with no private rooms.
english.zh: 新辦公室採開放式配置，沒有獨立的房間。

speak.en: I don't really understand the configuration settings on my new laptop.
speak.zh: 我其實不太懂新筆電上的設定選項。

write.en: The configuration of streets in old towns often makes them difficult for buses to enter.
write.zh: 老城區的街道配置，常讓公車很難開進去。

example.en: Many residents were hostile to the plan for a new airport, arguing that the noise would ruin their quiet village.
example.zh: 許多居民強烈反對興建新機場的計畫，認為噪音會毀了他們寧靜的村莊。

listen.en: The desert is a hostile place for most plants.
listen.zh: 沙漠對大多數植物來說是很惡劣的環境。

chinese.en: Some employees reacted in a hostile way when the manager announced longer working hours.
chinese.zh: 經理宣布延長工時後，有些員工的反應充滿敵意。

english.en: The audience was clearly hostile to the speaker's new idea.
english.zh: 聽眾顯然強烈反對講者的新想法。

speak.en: I think online comments can be surprisingly hostile sometimes.
speak.zh: 我覺得網路上的留言有時候會出乎意料地充滿敵意。

write.en: Penguins have adapted well to one of the most hostile environments on Earth.
write.zh: 企鵝已經能良好適應地球上最惡劣的環境之一。

example.en: She studied marine biology at university because she had always been fascinated by the coral reefs near her island home.
example.zh: 她在大學主修海洋生物學，因為她一直對家鄉小島附近的珊瑚礁深深著迷。

listen.en: We saw dolphins and other marine animals from the boat.
listen.zh: 我們在船上看到了海豚和其他海洋動物。

chinese.en: The government has created a marine reserve where fishing is strictly banned.
chinese.zh: 政府設立了一個海洋保護區，嚴格禁止捕魚。

english.en: Rising sea temperatures are seriously damaging many marine ecosystems worldwide.
english.zh: 海水溫度上升正嚴重破壞全球許多海洋生態系。

speak.en: I'd love to visit an aquarium with lots of marine creatures.
speak.zh: 我很想去一間有很多海洋生物的水族館。

write.en: The port authority hired a marine engineer to inspect the damaged ship.
write.zh: 港務局聘請了一位船舶工程師來檢查受損的船隻。

example.en: Under the guidance of a patient coach, the shy boy gradually gained confidence and became the team's best swimmer.
example.zh: 在一位有耐心的教練指導下，那個害羞的男孩漸漸建立起自信，成了隊上最厲害的游泳選手。

listen.en: The website offers guidance on how to apply for a visa.
listen.zh: 這個網站提供申請簽證的相關指引。

chinese.en: Many students seek careers guidance before deciding which subject to study at university.
chinese.zh: 許多學生在決定大學要讀什麼科系之前，會先尋求生涯輔導。

english.en: The government has issued new guidance for schools on food safety.
english.zh: 政府針對學校的食品安全發布了新的指引。

speak.en: My parents gave me a lot of guidance when I was choosing a job.
speak.zh: 我在選擇工作的時候，爸媽給了我很多指導。

write.en: This film is rated PG, so parental guidance is recommended for young viewers.
write.zh: 這部電影被列為 PG 級，建議年幼的觀眾在家長指導下觀看。

example.en: Although the members usually argue about everything, the vote to build a new library was unanimous, with nobody opposing it.
example.zh: 雖然成員們平常什麼都要爭論，但興建新圖書館的投票卻是全體通過，沒有任何人反對。

listen.en: The plan received unanimous support from the local residents.
listen.zh: 這項計畫獲得當地居民一致支持。

chinese.en: The judges were unanimous in choosing her as the winner of the singing contest.
chinese.zh: 評審一致選她為歌唱比賽的冠軍。

english.en: Our family reached a unanimous agreement about where to travel.
english.zh: 我們全家對要去哪裡旅行達成了一致的共識。

speak.en: It's rare for my friends to be unanimous about anything, honestly.
speak.zh: 說真的，我朋友們很少對任何事意見一致。

write.en: Climate scientists are almost unanimous that human activity is warming the planet.
write.zh: 氣候科學家幾乎一致認為，人類活動正使地球暖化。

example.en: In the table, the first column lists each country, while the second shows how much rice it produced.
example.zh: 在這張表中，第一欄列出各個國家，第二欄則顯示各國的稻米產量。

listen.en: Please write your name in the left column.
listen.zh: 請把你的名字寫在左邊那一欄。

chinese.en: She writes a weekly column about healthy eating for a popular magazine.
chinese.zh: 她每週為一本熱門雜誌撰寫健康飲食專欄。

english.en: A thick column of smoke rose from the factory chimney.
english.zh: 一道濃濃的煙柱從工廠的煙囪升起。

speak.en: I always read the travel column in the Sunday paper.
speak.zh: 我總是會看週日報紙上的旅遊專欄。

write.en: The accountant added up the column of figures twice to make sure it was correct.
write.zh: 會計師把那一欄數字加了兩次，確認沒有算錯。

example.en: Smallpox, a deadly illness that once killed millions, was finally eradicated after a long global vaccination campaign.
example.zh: 天花這種曾奪走數百萬人性命的致命疾病，在全球長期推動疫苗接種後終於被根除了。

listen.en: The city is trying to eradicate rats from the old market.
listen.zh: 市政府正努力消滅舊市場裡的老鼠。

chinese.en: Many experts believe that education is the most effective way to eradicate poverty.
chinese.zh: 許多專家認為，教育是根除貧窮最有效的方法。

english.en: The farmer used only natural methods to eradicate the weeds.
english.zh: 這位農夫只用天然的方法來根除雜草。

speak.en: I don't think we can ever completely eradicate bullying in schools.
speak.zh: 我不認為我們有辦法完全杜絕校園霸凌。

write.en: The company introduced strict checks to eradicate errors from its payment system.
write.zh: 公司實施了嚴格的檢查，以杜絕付款系統中的錯誤。

example.en: Because rents in the centre were too high, the artists' studios gradually moved out to the periphery, where space was cheaper.
example.zh: 由於市中心的租金太高，藝術家的工作室漸漸搬到了空間較便宜的外圍地區。

listen.en: As a new student, he stayed on the periphery of the group.
listen.zh: 身為新生，他一直待在團體的邊緣。

chinese.en: Low-cost housing is often located on the periphery, far from jobs and public services.
chinese.zh: 平價住宅常位於城市外圍，離工作機會和公共服務都很遠。

english.en: The new stadium will be built on the periphery of town.
english.zh: 新的體育場將蓋在鎮的外圍。

speak.en: I live right on the periphery of Taipei, so commuting takes ages.
speak.zh: 我住在臺北的邊緣地帶，所以通勤要花很久。

write.en: Small farmers often feel they remain on the periphery of national economic decisions.
write.zh: 小農常覺得自己在國家經濟決策中處於邊緣地位。

example.en: In winter, many trees become dormant, losing their leaves and slowing their growth until warmer weather returns in spring.
example.zh: 冬天時許多樹木會進入休眠，葉子掉光、生長變慢，直到春天回暖為止。

listen.en: The seeds can lie dormant in the soil for years.
listen.zh: 這些種子可以在土壤中休眠好幾年。

chinese.en: Her interest in painting lay dormant until she retired and finally had free time.
chinese.zh: 她對繪畫的興趣一直潛藏著，直到退休、終於有空閒時間才重新燃起。

english.en: The bank closed my account because it had been dormant for too long.
english.zh: 銀行因為我的帳戶太久沒有使用而把它關閉了。

speak.en: My old blog has been dormant since I started university.
speak.zh: 自從我上大學後，我的舊部落格就一直沒在更新了。

write.en: Some viruses can remain dormant in the body for years before causing symptoms.
write.zh: 有些病毒可以在體內潛伏多年後才引發症狀。

example.en: Shy people rarely initiate conversations at parties, preferring to wait until someone else comes over and says hello.
example.zh: 害羞的人在派對上很少主動開啟話題，比較喜歡等別人過來打招呼。

listen.en: Both companies have initiated talks about working together.
listen.zh: 兩家公司已經展開合作的洽談。

chinese.en: My grandfather initiated me into the joys of fishing when I was a little boy.
chinese.zh: 我小時候，是爺爺帶我體會到釣魚的樂趣。

english.en: The customer decided to initiate legal action against the airline.
english.zh: 這位顧客決定對航空公司提起法律訴訟。

speak.en: I usually wait for others to initiate plans, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我通常會等別人先提出計畫。

write.en: Local governments should initiate programmes that encourage people to recycle more household waste.
write.zh: 地方政府應該推動鼓勵民眾多回收家庭垃圾的計畫。

example.en: When the fire broke out, a nurse led all the patients to safety, and the local newspaper later called her a heroine.
example.zh: 火災發生時，一位護理師帶領所有病患逃到安全的地方，當地報紙後來稱她為女英雄。

listen.en: My favourite heroine in this film is brave and clever.
listen.zh: 這部電影裡我最喜歡的女主角既勇敢又聰明。

chinese.en: In many old fairy tales, the heroine simply waits for a prince to rescue her.
chinese.zh: 在許多老童話裡，女主角只是等著王子來救她。

english.en: The teenage heroine of the story saves her town from a flood.
english.zh: 故事中的少女主角從洪水中拯救了她的小鎮。

speak.en: Honestly, my mum is my real-life heroine because she never gives up.
speak.zh: 說真的，我媽媽是我現實生活中的女英雄，因為她從不放棄。

write.en: The athlete became a national heroine after winning her country's first Olympic medal.
write.zh: 這位運動員為國家贏得第一面奧運獎牌後，成了全國的女英雄。

example.en: The lake's biological diversity has declined sharply, as pollution has wiped out many of the fish and plants that once thrived there.
example.zh: 這座湖的生物多樣性大幅下降，因為汙染使許多曾在那裡繁衍的魚類和植物消失了。

listen.en: Our biological clock tells us when to sleep and wake.
listen.zh: 我們的生理時鐘會告訴我們何時該睡覺、何時該醒來。

chinese.en: After years of searching, the adopted girl finally met her biological mother.
chinese.zh: 經過多年的尋找，這位被收養的女孩終於見到了她的親生母親。

english.en: Digestion is a complex biological process that takes several hours.
english.zh: 消化是一個需要好幾個小時的複雜生物過程。

speak.en: I find biological science fascinating, especially how the brain works.
speak.zh: 我覺得生物科學很有趣，尤其是大腦運作的方式。

write.en: Farmers are increasingly using biological methods, such as ladybirds, to control pests.
write.zh: 農民越來越常使用生物防治的方法，例如利用瓢蟲來控制害蟲。

example.en: After months of complaints about poor service, the manager resigned, saying the company needed a fresh start under new leadership.
example.zh: 在服務品質不佳的抱怨持續數月後，經理辭職了，並表示公司需要在新的領導下重新出發。

listen.en: The coach resigned after the team lost every game.
listen.zh: 球隊每場比賽都輸，教練因此辭職了。

chinese.en: When the last train was cancelled, we resigned ourselves to spending the night at the station.
chinese.zh: 末班車被取消後，我們只好認命在車站過夜。

english.en: He resigned as class leader because he was too busy.
english.zh: 他因為太忙而辭去了班長的職務。

speak.en: I'd never resign without having another job lined up first.
speak.zh: 我絕對不會在還沒找到下一份工作前就辭職。

write.en: Many young workers resign within their first year because of long working hours.
write.zh: 許多年輕上班族因為工時過長，在第一年內就辭職了。

example.en: The company quickly refuted the claim that its products were unsafe, publishing test results that showed they met every standard.
example.zh: 公司迅速駁斥產品不安全的說法，並公布檢驗結果，證明產品符合所有標準。

listen.en: Nobody could refute her argument during the debate.
listen.zh: 辯論時沒有人能反駁她的論點。

chinese.en: Recent studies have refuted the idea that reading in dim light damages your eyes.
chinese.zh: 最近的研究已經駁斥了「在昏暗光線下閱讀會傷害眼睛」的說法。

english.en: The student easily found evidence to refute his classmate's claim.
english.zh: 這名學生輕易就找到證據反駁同學的說法。

speak.en: It's hard to refute the fact that phones affect our sleep.
speak.zh: 手機會影響我們睡眠，這個事實很難反駁。

write.en: In an argumentative essay, you should mention opposing views and then refute them clearly.
write.zh: 寫議論文時，你應該先提出反方觀點，再清楚地加以反駁。

example.en: The editor deleted several paragraphs from the article because they repeated information that had already appeared earlier.
example.zh: 編輯從文章中刪掉了好幾段，因為那些段落重複了前面已經出現過的資訊。

listen.en: Please delete any emails that look strange or suspicious.
listen.zh: 請刪除任何看起來奇怪或可疑的電子郵件。

chinese.en: Once you delete your account, all of your messages will be permanently removed.
chinese.zh: 一旦你刪除帳號，所有訊息都會被永久移除。

english.en: The teacher asked us to delete unnecessary words from our essays.
english.zh: 老師要我們把作文中不必要的字刪掉。

speak.en: I regularly delete apps I don't use to free up space.
speak.zh: 我會定期刪掉不用的應用程式，好空出儲存空間。

write.en: Social media companies are under pressure to delete harmful content more quickly.
write.zh: 社群媒體公司面臨壓力，必須更快刪除有害內容。

example.en: Athletes often increase their protein intake after training, since the body needs it to repair and build muscle.
example.zh: 運動員訓練後常會增加蛋白質攝取量，因為身體需要它來修復和增長肌肉。

listen.en: This breakfast cereal is high in protein and fibre.
listen.zh: 這款早餐穀片富含蛋白質和纖維。

chinese.en: Scientists are developing new kinds of plant protein as an alternative to meat.
chinese.zh: 科學家正在研發新型的植物性蛋白質，作為肉類的替代品。

english.en: My doctor told me to eat more protein and less sugar.
english.zh: 醫生叫我多吃蛋白質、少吃糖。

speak.en: I usually have a protein shake after going to the gym.
speak.zh: 我去健身房後通常會喝一杯高蛋白飲。

write.en: Hair and nails are made mostly of a tough protein called keratin.
write.zh: 頭髮和指甲主要由一種叫做角蛋白的堅韌蛋白質構成。

example.en: According to the club's charter, every member has the right to vote on major decisions, including how money is spent.
example.zh: 根據社團章程，每位成員都有權對重大決定投票，包括經費要如何使用。

listen.en: We took a charter flight to the island last summer.
listen.zh: 我們去年夏天搭包機去了那座島。

chinese.en: A group of divers chartered a small boat to explore the coral reefs.
chinese.zh: 一群潛水員包了一艘小船去探索珊瑚礁。

english.en: The university received its royal charter more than a century ago.
english.zh: 這所大學在一百多年前獲得了皇家特許狀。

speak.en: Chartering a minibus with friends is a cheap way to travel around.
speak.zh: 和朋友包一台小巴到處玩是很省錢的旅遊方式。

write.en: The new charter guarantees patients the right to see their own medical records.
write.zh: 新的章程保障病患查看自己病歷的權利。

example.en: The chemistry teacher explained that a balanced equation must have the same number of atoms on each side of the arrow.
example.zh: 化學老師解釋，平衡的化學方程式在箭頭兩邊的原子數量必須相同。

listen.en: This equation is too difficult for me to solve alone.
listen.zh: 這個方程式太難了，我沒辦法自己解出來。

chinese.en: When choosing a job, salary is only one part of the equation.
chinese.zh: 選擇工作時，薪水只是需要考量的因素之一。

english.en: My little brother can solve difficult equations in his head.
english.zh: 我弟弟可以心算解出困難的方程式。

speak.en: I was never good at equations, so maths stressed me out.
speak.zh: 我一直不太會解方程式，所以數學讓我壓力很大。

write.en: Engineers use equations to predict how much weight a bridge can safely carry.
write.zh: 工程師利用方程式來預測一座橋能安全承受多少重量。

example.en: The neighbourhood is known for its ethnic diversity, with families from over thirty countries living side by side.
example.zh: 這個社區以族群多元著稱，來自三十多個國家的家庭比鄰而居。

listen.en: We often go out for ethnic food on Friday nights.
listen.zh: 我們常在週五晚上出去吃異國料理。

chinese.en: The festival celebrates the music, dance and clothing of the island's ethnic minorities.
chinese.zh: 這個節慶展現了島上少數民族的音樂、舞蹈和服飾。

english.en: Students from different ethnic backgrounds study together at this school.
english.zh: 這所學校裡有來自不同族群背景的學生一起學習。

speak.en: I love shopping at markets that sell ethnic crafts and clothes.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡逛那些賣民族風手工藝品和衣服的市集。

write.en: The census asks every resident to state their ethnic origin and first language.
write.zh: 人口普查要求每位居民填寫自己的族裔和母語。

example.en: The driver was distracted by a message on his phone and failed to notice that the traffic lights had turned red.
example.zh: 駕駛被手機上的訊息分了心，沒注意到紅綠燈已經轉成紅燈。

listen.en: Please don't distract me while I am cooking dinner.
listen.zh: 我在煮晚餐的時候，請不要讓我分心。

chinese.en: The magician used one hand to distract the audience while the other hid the card.
chinese.zh: 魔術師用一隻手轉移觀眾的注意力，另一隻手則把牌藏起來。

english.en: I turn off my phone so it won't distract me at work.
english.zh: 我會把手機關機，這樣工作時才不會分心。

speak.en: Honestly, I get distracted really easily when I study at home.
speak.zh: 說真的，我在家讀書時真的很容易分心。

write.en: A short walk can distract you from worries and help you think more clearly.
write.zh: 散步一小段路可以讓你暫時忘掉煩惱，幫助你思緒更清晰。

example.en: At first the manager doubted the new system, but after seeing how much time it saved, he was finally convinced.
example.zh: 經理一開始對新系統存疑，但看到它省下了多少時間後，他終於信服了。

listen.en: It took a long time to convince him to come.
listen.zh: 花了好長一段時間才說服他來。

chinese.en: The young lawyer could not convince the jury of her client's innocence.
chinese.zh: 這位年輕律師無法讓陪審團相信她的當事人是無辜的。

english.en: I am convinced that regular exercise improves my mood and sleep.
english.zh: 我深信規律運動能改善我的心情和睡眠。

speak.en: My friends finally convinced me to try rock climbing last month.
speak.zh: 上個月朋友終於說服我去嘗試攀岩。

write.en: Scientists must present clear evidence to convince the public that the new vaccine is safe.
write.zh: 科學家必須提出明確的證據，才能讓大眾相信新疫苗是安全的。

example.en: When the pan caught fire, she calmly smothered the flames with a damp towel instead of pouring water on them.
example.zh: 鍋子起火時，她冷靜地用濕毛巾蓋住火焰把火悶熄，而不是往上面潑水。

listen.en: She tried to smother a yawn during the long meeting.
listen.zh: 冗長的會議中，她努力忍住不打哈欠。

chinese.en: Some parents smother their children with attention, leaving them little room to grow.
chinese.zh: 有些父母對孩子關注過度，讓他們幾乎沒有成長的空間。

english.en: Thick weeds have completely smothered the flowers in our garden.
english.zh: 茂密的雜草把我們花園裡的花完全蓋住了。

speak.en: I could barely smother my laughter when my teacher tripped over.
speak.zh: 老師絆了一跤時，我差點忍不住笑出來。

write.en: Too many strict rules can smother creativity and new ideas in the workplace.
write.zh: 太多嚴格的規定可能會扼殺職場上的創意和新想法。

example.en: The wildlife team captured the injured bear, treated its wounds, and released it back into the forest a week later.
example.zh: 野生動物團隊捕獲了那隻受傷的熊，治療牠的傷口，一週後再把牠放回森林。

listen.en: The cartoon quickly captured the attention of young children.
listen.zh: 這部卡通很快就吸引了小朋友的注意。

chinese.en: The novel beautifully captures the atmosphere of life in a small fishing town.
chinese.zh: 這部小說生動地描繪出小漁村的生活氛圍。

english.en: The new phone has captured a large share of the market.
english.zh: 這款新手機已經搶下了很大的市占率。

speak.en: I love using my phone to capture beautiful sunsets on holiday.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡在度假時用手機拍下美麗的夕陽。

write.en: Carbon capture technology could help old power stations greatly reduce their harmful emissions.
write.zh: 碳捕捉技術能幫助老舊的發電廠大幅減少有害的排放物。

example.en: At the airport, we loaded our suitcases onto a luggage trolley instead of carrying them by hand.
example.zh: 在機場，我們把行李箱放上行李推車，不用自己提著走。

listen.en: Please return your trolley after you finish shopping.
listen.zh: 購物結束後，請把推車歸還。

chinese.en: On the train, a staff member came along with a trolley selling snacks and drinks.
chinese.zh: 在火車上，一位服務人員推著販賣零食和飲料的推車經過。

english.en: The nurse wheeled a trolley of medicine into the ward.
english.zh: 護理師把一台裝滿藥品的推車推進病房。

speak.en: Kids always want to ride in the trolley at the supermarket.
speak.zh: 小孩在超市總是想坐在購物車裡。

write.en: Tourists in San Francisco enjoy riding the old trolley up the steep hills.
write.zh: 在舊金山，觀光客喜歡搭乘老式電車爬上陡峭的山坡。

example.en: In the film, a group of criminals kidnap a famous singer, but she cleverly escapes before they can demand any money.
example.zh: 電影中，一群罪犯綁架了一位知名歌手，但她在對方開口要錢之前就機智地逃脫了。

listen.en: The story is about a dog that was kidnapped from its home.
listen.zh: 這個故事是關於一隻從家裡被綁走的狗。

chinese.en: Travellers are advised to avoid remote border areas where tourists have been kidnapped.
chinese.zh: 官方建議旅客避開曾有觀光客遭綁架的偏遠邊境地區。

english.en: The gang planned to kidnap the rich man's son for money.
english.zh: 這個犯罪集團計畫綁架那位富翁的兒子來勒贖。

speak.en: As a joke, my friends kidnapped me and took me to a surprise party.
speak.zh: 朋友開玩笑地把我「綁架」去參加一場驚喜派對。

write.en: Schools teach young pupils never to accept rides from strangers who might try to kidnap them.
write.zh: 學校教導年幼的學生絕對不要搭陌生人的便車，因為對方可能會綁架他們。

example.en: Rabbits dig complex tunnels underground, where they can hide from foxes and keep their young safe and warm.
example.zh: 兔子會在地底挖出複雜的地道，可以躲避狐狸，也讓幼兔安全又溫暖。

listen.en: The workers tunnelled through the hill to lay new pipes.
listen.zh: 工人們挖穿山丘，以便鋪設新的管線。

chinese.en: Engineers plan to build a tunnel under the river to reduce traffic on the bridge.
chinese.zh: 工程師計畫在河底興建一條隧道，以減少橋上的車流。

english.en: After months of hard study, there's finally light at the end of the tunnel.
english.zh: 苦讀好幾個月之後，終於看到一線曙光了。

speak.en: I feel a bit nervous when driving through really long tunnels.
speak.zh: 開車經過很長的隧道時，我會有點緊張。

write.en: Building a tunnel can protect the landscape better than building a road over the hills.
write.zh: 比起在山上開路，興建隧道更能保護自然景觀。

example.en: The video call was frustrating because the audio kept cutting out, so we could see each other but hardly hear anything.
example.zh: 這次視訊通話很令人沮喪，因為聲音一直斷斷續續，我們看得到彼此，卻幾乎聽不到任何聲音。

listen.en: Please send me the audio file of the lecture.
listen.zh: 請把這堂課的音檔傳給我。

chinese.en: The police used an audio recording of the phone call as evidence in court.
chinese.zh: 警方把那通電話的錄音當作呈堂證據。

english.en: The audio quality of this old film is quite poor.
english.zh: 這部老電影的音質相當差。

speak.en: I prefer audio books because I can listen while commuting.
speak.zh: 我比較喜歡有聲書，因為可以在通勤時聽。

write.en: The band spent a lot of money on new audio equipment for their concerts.
write.zh: 這個樂團花了很多錢為演唱會添購新的音響設備。

example.en: Because she spoke fluent Japanese, the company assigned her to its Tokyo office, where she managed relationships with local clients.
example.zh: 由於她日文流利，公司把她派到東京辦公室，負責維繫與當地客戶的關係。

listen.en: Our manager will assign tasks at the morning meeting.
listen.zh: 我們經理會在晨會上分配工作。

chinese.en: In the experiment, volunteers were randomly assigned to either the exercise group or the diet group.
chinese.zh: 在這項實驗中，志願者被隨機分配到運動組或飲食組。

english.en: Each passenger is assigned a seat when they check in.
english.zh: 每位乘客在報到時都會被分配一個座位。

speak.en: My teachers always assigned way too much homework over the holidays.
speak.zh: 我的老師們放假時總是出超多作業。

write.en: Parents should assign simple household chores to children to teach them responsibility.
write.zh: 父母應該分配簡單的家事給孩子，培養他們的責任感。

example.en: To reduce crowding on trains, some companies stagger their employees' working hours so that not everyone travels at the same time.
example.zh: 為了減少火車上的擁擠，有些公司會錯開員工的上班時間，讓大家不要同時通勤。

listen.en: She staggered under the weight of the heavy boxes.
listen.zh: 她被沉重的箱子壓得腳步踉蹌。

chinese.en: I was staggered by how much the price of housing had risen in just a few years.
chinese.zh: 房價在短短幾年內就漲了這麼多，讓我大吃一驚。

english.en: The school staggers lunch breaks to avoid long queues in the canteen.
english.zh: 學校錯開午餐時間，以避免餐廳大排長龍。

speak.en: I staggered out of bed this morning because I was so tired.
speak.zh: 我今天早上累到搖搖晃晃地爬下床。

write.en: The old man staggered slightly on the icy pavement, so a stranger offered him her arm.
write.zh: 老先生在結冰的人行道上有點站不穩，一位陌生人便伸手讓他扶著。

example.en: He was a slow starter at school, but once he discovered his love of science, his grades improved dramatically.
example.zh: 他在學校起步得比較慢，但自從發現自己熱愛科學之後，成績就突飛猛進。

listen.en: The car won't start because the starter is broken.
listen.zh: 車子發不動，因為起動馬達壞了。

chinese.en: The coach surprised everyone by making the young player a starter in the final.
chinese.zh: 教練讓那名年輕球員在決賽中先發上場，令所有人大感意外。

english.en: This starter kit has everything you need to grow herbs.
english.zh: 這組入門套組有種植香草所需的一切。

speak.en: For starters, I'd say my hometown is very peaceful and green.
speak.zh: 首先，我會說我的家鄉非常寧靜，綠意盎然。

write.en: Restaurants often charge high prices for small starters, so many diners skip them.
write.zh: 餐廳的前菜常常份量小又貴，所以很多客人乾脆不點。

example.en: The architect incorporated large windows and solar panels into the design, so the building uses very little electricity.
example.zh: 建築師在設計中納入了大窗戶和太陽能板，因此這棟建築用電量非常少。

listen.en: We will incorporate your ideas into the final plan.
listen.zh: 我們會把你的想法納入最終的計畫中。

chinese.en: The new phone incorporates many features that used to require separate devices.
chinese.zh: 這款新手機整合了許多過去需要用不同裝置才能使用的功能。

english.en: I try to incorporate more vegetables into my daily meals.
english.zh: 我試著在每天的餐點中加入更多蔬菜。

speak.en: I like it when pop singers incorporate traditional instruments into their songs.
speak.zh: 我喜歡流行歌手在歌曲中融入傳統樂器。

write.en: Schools should incorporate practical skills, such as cooking and budgeting, into the curriculum.
write.zh: 學校應該把烹飪、理財等實用技能納入課程中。

example.en: Residents protested when the council announced plans to demolish the historic market, which had served the town for generations.
example.zh: 當市議會宣布要拆除那座服務小鎮好幾代的歷史市場時，居民紛紛表達抗議。

listen.en: They plan to demolish the bridge next spring.
listen.zh: 他們計畫明年春天拆除這座橋。

chinese.en: In the final debate, she calmly demolished every argument her opponent made.
chinese.zh: 在決賽辯論中，她冷靜地駁倒了對手提出的每一個論點。

english.en: The strong earthquake demolished many old houses in the small town.
english.zh: 這場強烈地震摧毀了小鎮上許多老房子。

speak.en: My little brother can demolish a whole pizza in minutes.
speak.zh: 我弟弟幾分鐘就能把一整個披薩吃光。

write.en: Instead of demolishing old factories, cities can turn them into museums or art spaces.
write.zh: 城市與其拆除老工廠，不如把它們改造成博物館或藝文空間。

example.en: Antibiotics are useless against a cold, because colds are caused by a virus rather than by bacteria.
example.zh: 抗生素對感冒沒有用，因為感冒是由病毒而不是細菌引起的。

listen.en: I think I caught a virus from my little sister.
listen.zh: 我想我是被妹妹傳染了病毒。

chinese.en: My laptop became extremely slow after a virus infected it through an email attachment.
chinese.zh: 我的筆電因為電子郵件附件而中毒，之後就變得超級慢。

english.en: Scientists are working hard to develop a vaccine against the virus.
english.zh: 科學家正努力研發對抗這種病毒的疫苗。

speak.en: Whenever a stomach virus goes around the office, I always catch it.
speak.zh: 每次辦公室裡有腸胃型病毒在傳染，我都一定會中標。

write.en: International cooperation is essential when a new virus spreads quickly across borders.
write.zh: 當新型病毒迅速跨國傳播時，國際合作就非常重要。

example.en: Few tall trees can survive in the dry, windy hills, so the land is mostly covered with low shrubs and grass.
example.zh: 在乾燥多風的山丘上，很少有高大的樹木能存活，所以土地大多覆蓋著低矮的灌木和草。

listen.en: We planted a row of shrubs along the fence.
listen.zh: 我們沿著圍籬種了一排灌木。

chinese.en: The city council plans to replace the concrete strip with trees and shrubs.
chinese.zh: 市政府計畫把那條水泥分隔島改種喬木和灌木。

english.en: My grandmother prunes her shrubs every autumn to keep them tidy.
english.zh: 我奶奶每年秋天都會修剪她的灌木，讓它們保持整齊。

speak.en: There's a little bird that always hides in the shrub outside my window.
speak.zh: 有一隻小鳥總是躲在我窗外的灌木裡。

write.en: Many offices choose evergreen shrubs for their entrances because they stay green all year.
write.zh: 許多辦公大樓的入口會選種常綠灌木，因為它們一年四季都是綠的。

example.en: In many cultures, talking loudly on the phone in public is frowned upon, so people tend to speak quietly on trains.
example.zh: 在許多文化中，在公共場所大聲講電話是不被認同的，所以大家在火車上通常會小聲說話。

listen.en: The teacher read my essay with a slight frown.
listen.zh: 老師微微皺著眉頭讀我的作文。

chinese.en: My grandparents frown on young people who spend all day playing video games.
chinese.zh: 我的祖父母很看不慣整天打電動的年輕人。

english.en: He frowned because he didn't understand the maths question at all.
english.zh: 他皺起眉頭，因為他完全看不懂那道數學題。

speak.en: I tend to frown when I'm concentrating, so people think I'm angry.
speak.zh: 我專心的時候常會皺眉，所以別人以為我在生氣。

write.en: Many companies still frown upon employees using social media during working hours.
write.zh: 許多公司仍然不贊成員工在上班時間使用社群媒體。

example.en: When customers complained about the long queues, the bank hired extra staff and opened more counters to rectify the situation.
example.zh: 顧客抱怨排隊太久之後，銀行增聘人手並多開了幾個櫃檯來改善情況。

listen.en: We need to rectify this problem before the guests arrive.
listen.zh: 我們必須在客人到達前解決這個問題。

chinese.en: The government has taken steps to rectify the shortage of nurses in rural hospitals.
chinese.zh: 政府已採取措施，改善偏鄉醫院護理人力短缺的問題。

english.en: The editor quickly rectified the spelling mistakes in the article.
english.zh: 編輯很快就改正了文章裡的拼字錯誤。

speak.en: If I make a mistake at work, I try to rectify it quickly.
speak.zh: 如果我在工作上犯錯，我會盡快設法改正。

write.en: It may take decades to rectify the damage that plastic has done to our oceans.
write.zh: 要修復塑膠對海洋造成的破壞，可能需要好幾十年。

example.en: The photographer crouched behind a rock for hours, waiting patiently for the shy deer to come out of the forest.
example.zh: 攝影師在岩石後面蹲了好幾個小時，耐心等待害羞的鹿走出森林。

listen.en: The cat crouched low, ready to jump on the toy.
listen.zh: 貓咪壓低身子蹲著，準備撲向玩具。

chinese.en: The gardener crouched over the flower bed, carefully pulling out weeds by hand.
chinese.zh: 園丁蹲在花圃旁，小心地用手拔除雜草。

english.en: The runners crouched at the starting line, waiting for the signal.
english.zh: 跑者們蹲在起跑線上，等待起跑信號。

speak.en: Crouching for too long always makes my knees hurt.
speak.zh: 蹲太久總是讓我膝蓋痛。

write.en: During the earthquake drill, students crouched under their desks and covered their heads.
write.zh: 地震演練時，學生們蹲在桌子底下並護住頭部。

example.en: Although she was a novice at chess, she quickly learned the rules by watching experienced players online.
example.zh: 雖然她是西洋棋新手，但她透過在網路上觀看經驗豐富的棋手下棋，很快就學會了規則。

listen.en: This hiking trail is too steep for novices.
listen.zh: 這條登山步道對新手來說太陡了。

chinese.en: The course is designed for novices who have never written a line of code.
chinese.zh: 這門課是為從來沒寫過任何程式碼的新手設計的。

english.en: Even a novice can learn to cook simple meals at home.
english.zh: 即使是新手也能學會在家煮簡單的餐點。

speak.en: Honestly, I'm still a novice when it comes to photography.
speak.zh: 老實說，說到攝影，我還只是個新手。

write.en: Many companies pair novice employees with mentors to help them adapt to the workplace.
write.zh: 許多公司會為新進員工安排導師，幫助他們適應職場。

example.en: The journalist read the full transcript of the interview carefully to make sure every quotation was accurate.
example.zh: 那位記者仔細閱讀了訪談的完整逐字稿，以確保每一句引言都正確無誤。

listen.en: She requested her transcript from the university office.
listen.zh: 她向大學辦公室申請了成績單。

chinese.en: A written transcript of the radio show is available for listeners who are hard of hearing.
chinese.zh: 這個廣播節目有提供文字逐字稿，給聽力不佳的聽眾使用。

english.en: My transcript clearly shows that my grades improved every semester.
english.zh: 我的成績單清楚顯示我的成績每學期都有進步。

speak.en: I had to send my transcripts to several universities last year.
speak.zh: 我去年得把成績單寄給好幾所大學。

write.en: The court released a transcript of the hearing so the public could review what was said.
write.zh: 法院公開了聽證會的文字紀錄，讓大眾可以查看當時的發言內容。

example.en: Because the island's economy is heavily dependent on tourism, the sudden drop in visitors caused serious problems for local businesses.
example.zh: 由於這座島的經濟高度依賴觀光業，遊客突然減少讓當地商家陷入嚴重困境。

listen.en: Your final grade is dependent on your class participation.
listen.zh: 你的期末成績取決於你的課堂參與。

chinese.en: Employees can add their dependents to the company health insurance plan at no extra cost.
chinese.zh: 員工可以將受扶養的家人加入公司的健康保險方案，不需額外付費。

english.en: Small children are completely dependent on adults for their safety.
english.zh: 年幼的孩子在安全上完全依賴大人。

speak.en: I try not to be too dependent on my phone these days.
speak.zh: 我最近盡量不要太依賴手機。

write.en: Countries that are dependent on imported oil are vulnerable to sudden price changes.
write.zh: 依賴進口石油的國家容易受到油價突然變動的影響。

example.en: The textbook begins with elementary concepts, such as basic addition, before moving on to more challenging problems.
example.zh: 這本課本先從加法等基本概念講起，再進入比較有挑戰性的題目。

listen.en: She made an elementary mistake in her opening paragraph.
listen.zh: 她在開頭段落犯了一個很基本的錯誤。

chinese.en: Even an elementary knowledge of the local language can make travelling much easier.
chinese.zh: 即使只懂一點當地語言的基礎，也能讓旅行輕鬆許多。

english.en: The teacher explained the elementary rules of grammar to the class.
english.zh: 老師向全班解釋基本的文法規則。

speak.en: I took an elementary Japanese class, but I've forgotten most of it.
speak.zh: 我上過初級日文課，但大部分都忘光了。

write.en: Investing in elementary education is one of the most effective ways to reduce poverty.
write.zh: 投資小學教育是減少貧窮最有效的方法之一。

example.en: After the factory began dumping waste into the river, fish started dying and residents complained about the pollution.
example.zh: 那間工廠開始把廢棄物排入河中後，魚群陸續死亡，居民也紛紛抱怨污染問題。

listen.en: Noise pollution makes it hard for me to sleep.
listen.zh: 噪音污染讓我很難入睡。

chinese.en: The government introduced stricter rules to reduce pollution from cars and trucks.
chinese.zh: 政府實施更嚴格的規定，以減少汽車和卡車造成的污染。

english.en: Plastic pollution has become a serious threat to marine life.
english.zh: 塑膠污染已經成為海洋生物的嚴重威脅。

speak.en: Light pollution means you can hardly see any stars in the city.
speak.zh: 因為光害，在城市裡幾乎看不到任何星星。

write.en: Our school organised a beach clean-up to raise awareness of pollution among students.
write.zh: 我們學校舉辦了淨灘活動，以提升學生對污染問題的意識。

example.en: Small coffee shops have mushroomed across the city over the past few years, as more young people work remotely.
example.zh: 過去幾年，隨著越來越多年輕人遠距工作，小型咖啡店在城市各地如雨後春筍般冒出。

listen.en: Never eat wild mushrooms unless an expert has checked them.
listen.zh: 除非經過專家檢查，否則千萬不要吃野生菇類。

chinese.en: The number of online courses mushroomed when schools were forced to close.
chinese.zh: 學校被迫停課時，線上課程的數量迅速激增。

english.en: My grandmother grows mushrooms in a dark corner of her garden.
english.zh: 我奶奶在她花園裡一個陰暗的角落種菇。

speak.en: I'm not a big fan of mushrooms, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我不太喜歡吃菇類。

write.en: Housing costs have mushroomed, making it difficult for young couples to buy a home.
write.zh: 房價急遽上漲，讓年輕夫妻很難買得起房子。

example.en: Scientists have found that people tend to rate faces with greater symmetry as more attractive and healthy.
example.zh: 科學家發現，人們往往認為比較對稱的臉孔更有吸引力、看起來也更健康。

listen.en: Butterflies show beautiful symmetry in the patterns on their wings.
listen.zh: 蝴蝶翅膀上的花紋呈現出美麗的對稱。

chinese.en: The garden was designed with careful symmetry, with matching trees on both sides of the path.
chinese.zh: 這座花園經過精心的對稱設計，步道兩側種著相同的樹。

english.en: In art class, we learned how to use symmetry in drawings.
english.zh: 在美術課上，我們學了如何在繪畫中運用對稱。

speak.en: I love the symmetry of traditional temples in my hometown.
speak.zh: 我很喜歡我家鄉傳統廟宇的對稱之美。

write.en: Mathematicians use the concept of symmetry to solve problems in physics and chemistry.
write.zh: 數學家運用對稱的概念來解決物理和化學上的問題。

example.en: Strong winds helped to disperse the thick smog, and by the afternoon the sky over the city was clear again.
example.zh: 強風吹散了濃厚的霧霾，到了下午，城市上空又恢復晴朗。

listen.en: The morning fog dispersed as the sun rose higher.
listen.zh: 隨著太陽升高，早晨的霧氣散去了。

chinese.en: Many plants rely on birds and wind to disperse their seeds over large areas.
chinese.zh: 許多植物依靠鳥類和風把種子散播到廣大的區域。

english.en: The students dispersed quickly when the bell rang for lunch.
english.zh: 午餐鐘聲一響，學生們很快就散開了。

speak.en: It took ages for the traffic to disperse after the match.
speak.zh: 比賽結束後，車潮過了好久才散去。

write.en: The company has dispersed its offices across several countries to reduce risk.
write.zh: 這家公司把辦公室分散設在好幾個國家，以降低風險。

example.en: The team won by a slender margin, scoring just one more point than their rivals in the final seconds.
example.zh: 這支隊伍以些微差距獲勝，在最後幾秒只比對手多得了一分。

listen.en: A slender vase stood on the kitchen windowsill.
listen.zh: 廚房的窗臺上放著一個細長的花瓶。

chinese.en: The heron balanced gracefully on its slender legs in the shallow water.
chinese.zh: 那隻蒼鷺用細長的腿優雅地站在淺水中。

english.en: Small businesses with slender budgets often cannot afford expensive advertising.
english.zh: 預算微薄的小型企業往往負擔不起昂貴的廣告。

speak.en: The tower looks so slender, I'm surprised it survives typhoons.
speak.zh: 那座塔看起來好細，我很驚訝它颱風來都不會倒。

write.en: Our chances of finishing the project on time are slender without extra staff.
write.zh: 如果沒有額外人手，我們準時完成這個專案的機會很渺茫。

example.en: Ancient Greece is often called the cradle of Western philosophy, since many important ideas about ethics and logic first appeared there.
example.zh: 古希臘常被稱為西方哲學的發源地，因為許多關於倫理和邏輯的重要思想最早都出現在那裡。

listen.en: He cradled the sleeping puppy gently in his arms.
listen.zh: 他把睡著的小狗輕輕抱在懷裡。

chinese.en: She sat by the window, cradling a warm cup of tea in her hands.
chinese.zh: 她坐在窗邊，雙手捧著一杯溫熱的茶。

english.en: The river valley was the cradle of an early farming culture.
english.zh: 這個河谷是早期農耕文化的發源地。

speak.en: My grandma still keeps the cradle she used for all her kids.
speak.zh: 我奶奶到現在還留著她用來哄所有孩子睡覺的搖籃。

write.en: The country's welfare system aims to support citizens from the cradle to the grave.
write.zh: 這個國家的福利制度目標是照顧人民從出生到老死。

example.en: Instead of small adjustments, the report called for a radical rethink of how the city manages its public transport.
example.zh: 這份報告並非建議小幅調整，而是呼籲徹底重新思考市政府管理大眾運輸的方式。

listen.en: Her ideas seemed radical at the time, but are common now.
listen.zh: 她的想法在當時看似激進，但現在已經很普遍了。

chinese.en: Solving climate change will require radical action from both governments and individuals.
chinese.zh: 要解決氣候變遷，政府和個人都必須採取徹底的行動。

english.en: The school introduced a radical new approach to teaching maths.
english.zh: 這所學校引進了一種全新、截然不同的數學教學方式。

speak.en: Cutting sugar completely was a pretty radical decision for me.
speak.zh: 完全戒糖對我來說是個相當重大的決定。

write.en: In his youth he was considered a radical, but his views later became more moderate.
write.zh: 他年輕時被視為激進分子，但後來觀點變得比較溫和。

example.en: Puzzle games train children to use logic, because each move must be planned carefully before they can solve the next level.
example.zh: 益智遊戲能訓練孩子運用邏輯，因為每一步都必須仔細規劃，才能破解下一關。

listen.en: There is no logic in paying more for less.
listen.zh: 花更多錢卻得到更少，這根本沒道理。

chinese.en: The logic behind the new policy is to encourage people to use public transport.
chinese.zh: 這項新政策背後的道理是鼓勵民眾搭乘大眾運輸。

english.en: Good essays present ideas in a clear order with sound logic.
english.zh: 好的文章會以清楚的順序和嚴謹的邏輯呈現想法。

speak.en: I see the logic, but I still don't agree with you.
speak.zh: 我懂你的道理，但我還是不同意你。

write.en: Computer programs follow strict logic, so even a small error can stop them working.
write.zh: 電腦程式遵循嚴格的邏輯，所以即使是小錯誤也可能讓程式無法運作。

example.en: The shop has closed its doors and removed the sign, presumably because rents in the area have risen sharply.
example.zh: 那家店已經關門並拆下招牌，大概是因為這一帶的租金大幅上漲。

listen.en: You presumably know why I asked you to come here.
listen.zh: 你想必知道我為什麼請你過來。

chinese.en: Presumably, the price of the tickets will go up during the holiday season.
chinese.zh: 票價在假期期間大概會上漲。

english.en: She is presumably still at the library studying for her exam.
english.zh: 她大概還在圖書館準備考試。

speak.en: He's presumably busy, since he hasn't replied to my messages.
speak.zh: 他大概很忙吧，因為他一直沒回我訊息。

write.en: Governments will presumably invest more in renewable energy as fossil fuels become more expensive.
write.zh: 隨著化石燃料越來越貴，各國政府想必會加碼投資再生能源。

example.en: After thousands of visitors had trampled across the meadow, the grass was destroyed and the soil turned to mud.
example.zh: 成千上萬的遊客踩過那片草地之後，草都被踩壞了，土壤也變成一片泥濘。

listen.en: The cows trampled the muddy path near the farm.
listen.zh: 牛群把農場附近的泥巴路踩得亂七八糟。

chinese.en: Workers' rights should not be trampled on in the race for higher profits.
chinese.zh: 不應為了追求更高的利潤而踐踏勞工的權益。

english.en: The children trampled mud all over the clean kitchen floor.
english.zh: 孩子們把泥巴踩得乾淨的廚房地板到處都是。

speak.en: Someone trampled my sandcastle while I was getting a drink.
speak.zh: 我去買飲料的時候，有人把我的沙堡踩壞了。

write.en: Tourists who leave marked trails can trample rare plants and damage fragile ecosystems.
write.zh: 離開指定步道的遊客可能會踩壞珍稀植物，破壞脆弱的生態系。

example.en: A rainbow appears when sunlight is split into the full spectrum of colours, from red to violet.
example.zh: 當陽光被分解成從紅到紫的完整光譜時，彩虹就出現了。

listen.en: The museum covers a wide spectrum of art styles.
listen.zh: 這間博物館涵蓋了範圍廣泛的藝術風格。

chinese.en: The report examines opinions across the spectrum, from strong supporters to fierce critics.
chinese.zh: 這份報告檢視了各方意見，從強力支持者到激烈批評者都有。

english.en: The school offers a whole spectrum of activities, from music to robotics.
english.zh: 這所學校提供各式各樣的活動，從音樂到機器人都有。

speak.en: My music taste is at the opposite end of the spectrum from yours.
speak.zh: 我的音樂品味跟你的完全是兩個極端。

write.en: Mobile phone companies compete to buy parts of the radio spectrum for faster networks.
write.zh: 電信業者競相購買部分無線電頻譜，以建置更快的網路。

example.en: The hikers wore sturdy boots because the mountain path was rocky, steep and slippery after the rain.
example.zh: 登山客穿著堅固的靴子，因為雨後的山路多石、陡峭又濕滑。

listen.en: This old wooden bridge is still surprisingly sturdy.
listen.zh: 這座老木橋仍然出乎意料地堅固。

chinese.en: Many farmers prefer sturdy breeds of cattle that can survive harsh winters.
chinese.zh: 許多農民偏好能熬過嚴冬的強健牛種。

english.en: My grandfather is still sturdy and goes walking every morning.
english.zh: 我爺爺身體依然硬朗，每天早上都去散步。

speak.en: I always buy sturdy suitcases, because cheap ones break so easily.
speak.zh: 我都買堅固的行李箱，因為便宜的太容易壞了。

write.en: Buildings in earthquake zones must have sturdy frames to protect the people inside.
write.zh: 地震帶的建築必須有堅固的結構，才能保護裡面的人。

example.en: Nobody disputes that exercise is good for health, but experts disagree about how much people actually need each week.
example.zh: 沒有人質疑運動有益健康，但專家對於人們每週究竟需要多少運動量看法不一。

listen.en: The results of the study are still in dispute.
listen.zh: 這項研究的結果仍有爭議。

chinese.en: The company settled the pay dispute with its workers after weeks of talks.
chinese.zh: 經過數週協商後，公司和員工解決了薪資糾紛。

english.en: The customer disputed an extra charge on her monthly phone bill.
english.zh: 這位顧客對她每月電話帳單上的一筆額外費用提出異議。

speak.en: That's a fair point, and I wouldn't dispute it at all.
speak.zh: 這說得很有道理，我完全不會反駁。

write.en: Many trade disputes between countries are now resolved peacefully through international organisations.
write.zh: 如今許多國家之間的貿易爭端都透過國際組織和平解決。

example.en: The builder had to tear down the wall because it had not been built according to the architect's specifications.
example.zh: 營造商不得不拆掉那面牆，因為它沒有按照建築師的規格施工。

listen.en: Please check the specifications before you order the parts.
listen.zh: 訂購零件前請先確認規格。

chinese.en: Every product must be tested to make sure it meets safety specifications.
chinese.zh: 每項產品都必須經過測試，確保符合安全規範。

english.en: The sports car was built to the customer's exact specifications.
english.zh: 這輛跑車是依照客戶的精確規格打造的。

speak.en: I compared the specifications of a few phones before buying this one.
speak.zh: 買這支手機之前，我比較了好幾支手機的規格。

write.en: The job specification clearly states that applicants need fluent English and teamwork skills.
write.zh: 這份職務說明清楚寫明，應徵者須具備流利的英文和團隊合作能力。

example.en: Scientists studied lunar rock samples brought back by astronauts to learn how the Moon was formed.
example.zh: 科學家研究太空人帶回的月球岩石樣本，以了解月球是如何形成的。

listen.en: We stayed up late to watch the lunar eclipse.
listen.zh: 我們熬夜看月食。

chinese.en: The traditional lunar calendar is still used to decide the dates of many festivals.
chinese.zh: 傳統的農曆至今仍用來決定許多節慶的日期。

english.en: Space agencies are planning to build a lunar base in the future.
english.zh: 各國太空機構正計畫在未來建造月球基地。

speak.en: The lunar landscape in that documentary looked absolutely amazing.
speak.zh: 那部紀錄片裡的月球景觀看起來真的超壯觀。

write.en: Ocean tides follow a lunar cycle, rising and falling as the Moon orbits Earth.
write.zh: 海洋潮汐依循月亮的週期，隨著月球繞地球運行而漲落。

example.en: The market stalls were overflowing with the bounty of summer: ripe peaches, sweet corn and fresh tomatoes.
example.zh: 市場攤位上堆滿了夏季的豐富物產：熟透的桃子、甜玉米和新鮮番茄。

listen.en: The software company offers a bounty for finding security bugs.
listen.zh: 這家軟體公司提供獎金給找出安全漏洞的人。

chinese.en: Thanks to the rich soil, the region enjoys a bounty of rice and vegetables each year.
chinese.zh: 由於土壤肥沃，這個地區每年都盛產稻米和蔬菜。

english.en: The volunteers shared their garden's bounty with elderly neighbours every week.
english.zh: 志工們每週都和年長的鄰居分享自家菜園的收成。

speak.en: We had such a bounty of tomatoes this year that we gave lots away.
speak.zh: 我們今年番茄大豐收，送了好多給別人。

write.en: Overfishing threatens the ocean's bounty, which millions of people rely on for food.
write.zh: 過度捕撈威脅著海洋豐富的資源，而數百萬人仰賴這些資源維生。

example.en: Graduates with strong language skills tend to have better job prospects, especially in companies that trade internationally.
example.zh: 語言能力強的畢業生往往有較好的就業前景，尤其是在從事國際貿易的公司。

listen.en: There is little prospect of rain this weekend.
listen.zh: 這個週末下雨的可能性很低。

chinese.en: Many villagers left for the city in search of better economic prospects.
chinese.zh: 許多村民為了尋找更好的經濟前景而前往城市。

english.en: She was nervous at the prospect of giving a speech.
english.zh: 一想到要上臺演講，她就很緊張。

speak.en: Honestly, the prospect of working from home sounds great to me.
speak.zh: 老實說，可以在家工作對我來說聽起來很棒。

write.en: Rising sea levels raise the alarming prospect that some coastal cities may disappear.
write.zh: 海平面上升帶來令人憂心的可能：有些沿海城市可能會消失。

example.en: After a long ordeal of delayed flights and lost luggage, the exhausted family finally arrived at their hotel at midnight.
example.zh: 經歷班機延誤和行李遺失的漫長折騰後，筋疲力盡的一家人終於在半夜抵達飯店。

listen.en: The job interview turned out to be quite an ordeal.
listen.zh: 那場工作面試結果簡直是一場煎熬。

chinese.en: The hikers were tired but safe after their ordeal in the snowstorm.
chinese.zh: 在暴風雪中歷經磨難之後，登山客們雖然疲憊，但都平安無事。

english.en: Moving house with two small children was a real ordeal.
english.zh: 帶著兩個小孩搬家真是一場折磨。

speak.en: Getting a visa was such an ordeal, but it was worth it.
speak.zh: 辦簽證的過程超折騰的，但很值得。

write.en: Patients often describe long hospital waiting times as an ordeal that adds to their stress.
write.zh: 病患常形容醫院漫長的等候時間是一種折磨，讓他們壓力更大。

example.en: Children often inherit physical traits such as eye colour and height from their parents, but personality is shaped by many factors.
example.zh: 孩子常從父母身上遺傳到眼睛顏色和身高等外表特徵，但個性則受到許多因素影響。

listen.en: He clearly inherited his father's love of classical music.
listen.zh: 他顯然遺傳了父親對古典音樂的熱愛。

chinese.en: The new mayor inherited a city with serious traffic and housing problems.
chinese.zh: 新市長接手的是一座有嚴重交通和住房問題的城市。

english.en: Some health problems can be inherited from parents and grandparents.
english.zh: 有些健康問題可能遺傳自父母和祖父母。

speak.en: I think I inherited my mum's terrible sense of direction.
speak.zh: 我覺得我遺傳到我媽很差的方向感。

write.en: Young people today will inherit many environmental problems created by earlier generations.
write.zh: 現在的年輕人將會承接許多前幾代人造成的環境問題。

example.en: Organic farmers avoid chemical pesticides and rely instead on natural methods to protect their crops from insects.
example.zh: 有機農夫不使用化學農藥，而是靠天然的方法保護作物不受蟲害。

listen.en: Organic food is usually more expensive than regular food.
listen.zh: 有機食品通常比一般食品貴。

chinese.en: Food waste and other organic material can be turned into compost for gardens.
chinese.zh: 廚餘和其他有機物可以製成花園用的堆肥。

english.en: The small company achieved steady organic growth without borrowing any money.
english.zh: 這家小公司沒有借任何錢，就達成了穩定的自然成長。

speak.en: I'm not sure organic products are really worth the extra money.
speak.zh: 我不確定有機產品是否真的值得多花那些錢。

write.en: Organic chemistry focuses on compounds that contain carbon, such as those found in living things.
write.zh: 有機化學著重研究含碳的化合物，例如存在於生物體內的那些。

example.en: The restaurant became famous for its plant-based burger, which tastes so much like beef that many customers cannot tell the difference.
example.zh: 這家餐廳以植物肉漢堡出名，吃起來非常像牛肉，很多客人都分辨不出來。

listen.en: My brother ordered a chicken burger with extra lettuce.
listen.zh: 我哥哥點了一個加生菜的雞肉漢堡。

chinese.en: Doctors warn that eating burgers and other fast food every day can harm your health.
chinese.zh: 醫生警告，每天吃漢堡和其他速食可能會損害健康。

english.en: My dad grilled burgers for everyone at the family barbecue.
english.zh: 家庭烤肉時，我爸爸幫大家烤漢堡。

speak.en: To be honest, a good burger is my favourite comfort food.
speak.zh: 老實說，一個好吃的漢堡是我最愛的療癒食物。

write.en: The rising popularity of burger chains in Asia reflects changing eating habits among young people.
write.zh: 漢堡連鎖店在亞洲越來越受歡迎，反映出年輕人飲食習慣的改變。

example.en: Because the economy was weak, the company decided to defer its plans to open new stores until the following spring.
example.zh: 由於經濟疲弱，公司決定把開設新門市的計畫延到隔年春天。

listen.en: We agreed to defer the decision until next month.
listen.zh: 我們同意把決定延到下個月再做。

chinese.en: On technical matters, the manager usually defers to the engineers on her team.
chinese.zh: 在技術問題上，經理通常會聽從她團隊裡工程師的意見。

english.en: He deferred his military service to finish his degree first.
english.zh: 他延後服兵役，好先完成學業。

speak.en: I'd rather defer to your judgment, since you know the area better.
speak.zh: 我還是聽你的判斷吧，因為你比較熟這一帶。

write.en: Some people defer saving for retirement, which can cause serious financial problems later.
write.zh: 有些人一直延後為退休儲蓄，這可能在日後造成嚴重的財務問題。

example.en: Rising house prices are often seen as an indicator of confidence, because buyers expect values to keep increasing.
example.zh: 房價上漲常被視為信心的指標，因為買家預期房價會持續攀升。

listen.en: A high fever can be an indicator of infection.
listen.zh: 高燒可能是感染的徵兆。

chinese.en: The report uses several indicators, including literacy and life expectancy, to compare countries.
chinese.zh: 這份報告使用識字率和平均壽命等多項指標來比較各國。

english.en: Don't forget to use your indicator before you turn left.
english.zh: 左轉前別忘了打方向燈。

speak.en: I think how happy people feel is a better indicator than income.
speak.zh: 我覺得人們的快樂程度是比收入更好的指標。

write.en: Test scores alone are not a reliable indicator of a student's true ability.
write.zh: 光看考試成績並不是衡量學生真正能力的可靠指標。

example.en: Although the new highway shortened travel times, it had a detrimental effect on the wetlands, where many birds used to nest.
example.zh: 雖然新的公路縮短了交通時間，卻對濕地造成不良影響，那裡過去有許多鳥類築巢。

listen.en: Smoking is detrimental to almost every part of the body.
listen.zh: 吸菸幾乎對身體的每個部位都有害。

chinese.en: A lack of sleep can be detrimental to both memory and concentration.
chinese.zh: 睡眠不足可能對記憶力和專注力都造成不良影響。

english.en: Cutting the library budget would be detrimental to local students.
english.zh: 刪減圖書館預算會對當地學生不利。

speak.en: Working late every night was really detrimental to my health.
speak.zh: 每晚都工作到很晚，對我的健康傷害很大。

write.en: Some economists argue that high import taxes are detrimental to consumers and small businesses.
write.zh: 有些經濟學家主張，高額進口稅對消費者和小型企業不利。

example.en: When she was finally confronted with clear evidence of her mistake, she apologised and offered to fix the report.
example.zh: 當她終於面對自己犯錯的明確證據時，她道了歉，並主動提出要修正報告。

listen.en: He decided to confront his fear of public speaking.
listen.zh: 他決定面對自己對公開演說的恐懼。

chinese.en: Many coastal cities are now confronting the serious challenge of rising sea levels.
chinese.zh: 許多沿海城市如今正面臨海平面上升的嚴峻挑戰。

english.en: I confronted my roommate about the dirty dishes in the sink.
english.zh: 我為了水槽裡的髒碗盤當面找室友談。

speak.en: It's not easy to confront a friend when they've upset you.
speak.zh: 朋友惹你不高興時，要當面跟他說清楚並不容易。

write.en: New teachers are often confronted with large classes and very limited resources.
write.zh: 新老師常常要面對人數眾多的班級和非常有限的資源。

example.en: Scientists still cannot predict the precise moment an earthquake will strike, though they can identify high-risk areas.
example.zh: 科學家雖然能找出高風險地區，但仍無法預測地震發生的確切時刻。

listen.en: The recipe calls for precise measurements of flour and sugar.
listen.zh: 這份食譜要求精確測量麵粉和糖的分量。

chinese.en: To be precise, the meeting starts at a quarter past nine, not nine.
chinese.zh: 精確地說，會議是九點十五分開始，不是九點。

english.en: Engineers need precise data to design safe and reliable bridges.
english.zh: 工程師需要精確的數據來設計安全可靠的橋梁。

speak.en: I can't remember the precise date, but it was last summer.
speak.zh: 我記不得確切的日期，但那是去年夏天的事。

write.en: A good IELTS essay uses precise vocabulary rather than vague, general words.
write.zh: 一篇好的 IELTS 作文會使用精準的詞彙，而不是模糊籠統的字。

example.en: Natural fibers such as cotton and wool are often more comfortable to wear than synthetic materials like polyester.
example.zh: 棉和羊毛等天然纖維，穿起來往往比聚酯纖維這類合成材質更舒服。

listen.en: My doctor told me to eat more fiber.
listen.zh: 醫生叫我多攝取纖維。

chinese.en: Fiber optic cables carry internet data at extremely high speeds across the ocean.
chinese.zh: 光纖電纜以極高的速度跨洋傳輸網路資料。

english.en: This scarf is woven from fibers made from recycled plastic bottles.
english.zh: 這條圍巾是用回收寶特瓶製成的纖維織成的。

speak.en: I try to have a high-fiber breakfast, like oatmeal with fruit.
speak.zh: 我盡量吃高纖的早餐，像是燕麥加水果。

write.en: Muscle fibers become stronger when they are repeatedly stretched during regular exercise.
write.zh: 肌肉纖維在規律運動中反覆伸展後會變得更強壯。

example.en: The coach doesn't just preach hard work; he trains alongside his players every morning, setting an example for the whole team.
example.zh: 這位教練不只是嘴上鼓吹努力，他每天早上都和球員一起訓練，為全隊樹立榜樣。

listen.en: Nobody likes being preached at by their friends.
listen.zh: 沒有人喜歡被朋友說教。

chinese.en: Experts have long preached the benefits of a balanced diet and regular exercise.
chinese.zh: 專家長久以來一直宣揚均衡飲食和規律運動的好處。

english.en: Teachers should practise what they preach about being on time.
english.zh: 老師在守時這件事上應該言行一致。

speak.en: Sorry, I don't mean to preach, but you really need more sleep.
speak.zh: 抱歉，我不是要說教，但你真的需要多睡一點。

write.en: Many environmental groups preach recycling, but reducing consumption is even more important.
write.zh: 許多環保團體大力宣揚回收，但減少消費其實更加重要。

example.en: Even after the company's sales collapsed, the owner clung to the hope that customers would eventually return.
example.zh: 即使公司的業績崩盤，老闆仍抱著顧客終究會回來的希望不放。

listen.en: Wet sand clung to our feet after the walk.
listen.zh: 散步完後，濕沙黏在我們的腳上。

chinese.en: Some older people cling to traditional ways of doing things and resist new technology.
chinese.zh: 有些年長者堅守傳統的做事方式，排斥新科技。

english.en: The cat clung to the branch during the strong wind.
english.zh: 強風中，那隻貓緊緊抓住樹枝。

speak.en: This dress clings a bit too much, so I'm returning it.
speak.zh: 這件洋裝有點太貼身了，所以我要拿去退。

write.en: The tiny island village clings to the cliff above the stormy sea.
write.zh: 這座小島上的村落緊依著懸崖，下方是波濤洶湧的大海。

example.en: The scandal undermined public trust in the company, and its sales fell sharply over the following months.
example.zh: 這起醜聞削弱了大眾對該公司的信任，接下來幾個月銷售額大幅下滑。

listen.en: Lack of sleep can undermine your performance at work.
listen.zh: 睡眠不足會影響你的工作表現。

chinese.en: Cheating on exams undermines the value of the hard work done by honest students.
chinese.zh: 考試作弊會削弱誠實學生努力付出的價值。

english.en: Poor planning undermined the success of this year's school festival.
english.zh: 規劃不周削弱了今年校慶的成效。

speak.en: I felt my manager undermined me in front of the whole team.
speak.zh: 我覺得主管在全隊面前讓我很難堪、損及我的威信。

write.en: Rising water levels have gradually undermined the foundations of several old houses.
write.zh: 上升的水位逐漸侵蝕了好幾間老房子的地基。

example.en: The heavy traffic was compounded by a sudden storm, so many commuters reached the office over an hour late.
example.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨讓交通壅塞雪上加霜，許多通勤族晚了一個多小時才到公司。

listen.en: Sunflower is a compound word made from shorter words.
listen.zh: sunflower 是由較短的字組成的複合字。

chinese.en: Scientists discovered a compound in the plant that may help treat skin diseases.
chinese.zh: 科學家在這種植物中發現了一種可能有助於治療皮膚病的化合物。

english.en: Thanks to compound interest, our savings grew faster than we expected.
english.zh: 多虧了複利，我們的存款成長得比預期更快。

speak.en: Skipping breakfast just compounds my stress on busy mornings.
speak.zh: 忙碌的早上不吃早餐，只會讓我壓力更大。

write.en: Poor public transport compounds the problem of air pollution in rapidly growing cities.
write.zh: 大眾運輸不佳讓快速發展城市的空氣污染問題更加嚴重。

example.en: If you return library books late, you will have to pay a small penalty for each day they are overdue.
example.zh: 如果你逾期歸還圖書館的書，每逾期一天都得繳一小筆罰款。

listen.en: Our team scored from a penalty in the final minute.
listen.zh: 我們的隊伍在最後一分鐘靠罰球得分。

chinese.en: Many people believe tougher penalties are needed to stop drivers using their phones.
chinese.zh: 許多人認為需要更嚴厲的處罰，才能阻止駕駛人開車時使用手機。

english.en: Breaking your phone contract early usually comes with a penalty.
english.zh: 提前解除手機合約通常要付違約金。

speak.en: Losing my whole weekend was the penalty for leaving everything so late.
speak.zh: 把事情都拖到最後一刻，代價就是整個週末都泡湯了。

write.en: Companies that seriously pollute rivers should face severe financial penalties from the government.
write.zh: 嚴重污染河川的企業應該受到政府嚴厲的罰款處分。

example.en: Because the hiking trail was full of thorny bushes, the guide told everyone to wear long pants instead of shorts.
example.zh: 因為登山步道上滿是帶刺的灌木叢，嚮導要大家穿長褲，不要穿短褲。

listen.en: These pants are too long, so I'll get them shortened.
listen.zh: 這條褲子太長了，所以我要拿去改短。

chinese.en: He accidentally spilled coffee on his pants just before the meeting started.
chinese.zh: 會議開始前，他不小心把咖啡灑在褲子上。

english.en: My grandmother still sews her own pants and skirts by hand.
english.zh: 我奶奶到現在還是自己手工縫製褲子和裙子。

speak.en: I usually just wear comfortable pants and a T-shirt at home.
speak.zh: 我在家通常就穿舒服的褲子配一件T恤。

write.en: Some schools now allow female students to wear pants rather than skirts as part of their uniform.
write.zh: 現在有些學校允許女學生的制服穿長褲，而不一定要穿裙子。

example.en: A few decades ago, video calls seemed to belong to the realm of science fiction, but now people use them every day.
example.zh: 幾十年前，視訊通話似乎只存在於科幻小說的世界，但現在人們每天都在使用。

listen.en: A cure is now within the realm of possibility.
listen.zh: 治癒方法如今已有可能實現。

chinese.en: In the realm of online education, competition among platforms has grown intense.
chinese.zh: 在線上教育領域，各平臺之間的競爭日趨激烈。

english.en: The old king ruled his realm wisely for many years.
english.zh: 那位老國王多年來英明地治理他的王國。

speak.en: Cooking is totally outside my realm of experience, honestly.
speak.zh: 老實說，煮飯完全不在我的經驗範圍內。

write.en: Artificial intelligence is expanding into realms once thought to require human creativity.
write.zh: 人工智慧正擴展到過去被認為需要人類創造力的領域。

example.en: In her speech, the director emphasized that safety comes first, repeating the point several times so nobody would forget it.
example.zh: 主任在演講中強調安全第一，並重複說了好幾次，確保沒有人會忘記。

listen.en: She emphasized each word to make her point clear.
listen.zh: 她加重每個字的語氣，好讓自己的意思更清楚。

chinese.en: The report emphasizes the need for more affordable housing in big cities.
chinese.zh: 這份報告強調大城市需要更多平價住宅。

english.en: Doctors emphasize that regular exercise is good for mental health.
english.zh: 醫生強調規律運動對心理健康有益。

speak.en: I can't emphasize enough how much that trip changed me.
speak.zh: 那趟旅行對我的改變之大，我怎麼強調都不為過。

write.en: A simple dark frame can emphasize the bright colors in a painting.
write.zh: 簡單的深色畫框能凸顯畫作中明亮的色彩。

example.en: Because floods are common in the area, the family decided to insure their house against water damage as well as fire.
example.zh: 由於這一帶常淹水，這家人決定為房子投保水災險和火災險。

listen.en: Is your car insured for driving in other countries?
listen.zh: 你的車在其他國家開也有保險嗎？

chinese.en: The museum insured the famous painting for a huge amount before the exhibition.
chinese.zh: 展覽開始前，博物館為那幅名畫投保了一筆鉅額保險。

english.en: The small shop insured all of its goods against theft.
english.zh: 這家小店為所有商品投保了竊盜險。

speak.en: I always insure my phone, because I drop it all the time.
speak.zh: 我都會幫手機保險，因為我老是摔到它。

write.en: Many farmers now insure their crops to protect themselves from extreme weather caused by climate change.
write.zh: 現在許多農民會為作物投保，以防範氣候變遷帶來的極端天氣。

example.en: The ship carried hundreds of steel containers, each packed with clothes and electronics bound for European markets.
example.zh: 這艘船載著數百個鋼製貨櫃，每個都裝滿了要運往歐洲市場的衣服和電子產品。

listen.en: She keeps her pens in a small glass container.
listen.zh: 她把筆放在一個小玻璃容器裡。

chinese.en: Many coffee shops now give a discount to customers who bring their own containers.
chinese.zh: 現在很多咖啡店會給自備容器的顧客折扣。

english.en: We should recycle these empty containers instead of throwing them away.
english.zh: 我們應該回收這些空容器，而不是把它們丟掉。

speak.en: I always pack my lunch in a container to save money.
speak.zh: 我總是用便當盒裝午餐，這樣可以省錢。

write.en: Takeaway food often comes in single-use containers that quickly end up in landfills.
write.zh: 外帶食物常用一次性容器盛裝，而這些容器很快就進了垃圾掩埋場。

example.en: The hospital painted the children's ward in cheerful yellows and greens to make young patients feel less anxious.
example.zh: 醫院把兒童病房漆成明亮活潑的黃色和綠色，讓小病患比較不會焦慮。

listen.en: Our new neighbour always has a cheerful smile.
listen.zh: 我們的新鄰居總是笑得很開朗。

chinese.en: A cheerful attitude at work can make long meetings feel much shorter.
chinese.zh: 工作時保持愉快的態度，能讓冗長的會議感覺短很多。

english.en: The bookshop has a cheerful atmosphere, so I often study there.
english.zh: 那家書店氣氛很愉快，所以我常在那裡讀書。

speak.en: I'm usually quite cheerful in the morning after a good coffee.
speak.zh: 早上喝杯好咖啡之後，我通常心情都滿好的。

write.en: Teachers who greet students in a cheerful voice often create a more relaxed classroom.
write.zh: 用愉快語氣跟學生打招呼的老師，往往能營造比較輕鬆的教室氣氛。

example.en: After weeks of following clues and checking records, the private detective finally located the woman's long-lost brother.
example.zh: 經過好幾週追查線索、核對紀錄，那名私家偵探終於找到了這位女士失散多年的哥哥。

listen.en: My brother loves reading detective stories before bed.
listen.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡睡前看偵探故事。

chinese.en: The company hired a detective to find out who had leaked its product plans.
chinese.zh: 那家公司請了一位偵探，調查是誰洩漏了產品計畫。

english.en: She has wanted to become a police detective since childhood.
english.zh: 她從小就想當刑警。

speak.en: Honestly, I could watch detective dramas all weekend without getting bored.
speak.zh: 說真的，我可以整個週末都在看偵探劇，一點也不會膩。

write.en: Good researchers work like detectives, gathering evidence carefully before reaching any conclusion.
write.zh: 優秀的研究人員就像偵探一樣，在下任何結論前都會仔細蒐集證據。

example.en: The rainforest is so dense that sunlight barely reaches the ground, so few plants grow beneath the tall trees.
example.zh: 這片雨林非常茂密，陽光幾乎照不到地面，所以高大的樹下很少有植物生長。

listen.en: The city centre is dense with shops and restaurants.
listen.zh: 市中心密密麻麻都是商店和餐廳。

chinese.en: Dense urban areas often struggle with traffic jams and a shortage of affordable housing.
chinese.zh: 人口稠密的都市地區常常為塞車和平價住宅不足所苦。

english.en: This textbook is too dense for beginners to read alone.
english.zh: 這本教科書太艱深了，初學者很難自己讀。

speak.en: I grew up in a small village, so dense cities still feel overwhelming.
speak.zh: 我在小村子長大，所以擁擠的大城市到現在還是讓我有點吃不消。

write.en: Lead is a very dense metal, so even a small piece feels surprisingly heavy.
write.zh: 鉛是密度很高的金屬，所以就算只是一小塊，拿起來也重得驚人。

example.en: Many international students must overcome language barriers and loneliness during their first year, but most adapt within months.
example.zh: 許多國際學生在第一年必須克服語言障礙和孤單，但大多數人幾個月內就能適應。

listen.en: He was overcome with joy when he heard the news.
listen.zh: 他聽到這個消息時，高興得不得了。

chinese.en: The small company overcame serious financial problems and is now growing steadily.
chinese.zh: 這家小公司度過了嚴重的財務危機，現在正穩定成長。

english.en: I believe we can overcome this problem if we work together.
english.zh: 我相信只要我們同心協力，就能克服這個問題。

speak.en: Honestly, overcoming my shyness was the hardest part of starting university.
speak.zh: 老實說，剛上大學時最難的就是克服自己的害羞。

write.en: Governments must invest in technology to overcome the challenges posed by an ageing population.
write.zh: 政府必須投資科技，才能克服人口高齡化帶來的挑戰。

example.en: The couple decided against an expensive wedding and spent the money on a deposit for their first flat.
example.zh: 這對夫妻決定不辦昂貴的婚禮，而是把錢拿去付第一間公寓的頭期款。

listen.en: She wore her mother's dress on her wedding day.
listen.zh: 她在婚禮當天穿上了媽媽的禮服。

chinese.en: Wedding costs in Taiwan have risen sharply as couples invite more and more guests.
chinese.zh: 由於新人邀請的賓客越來越多，臺灣辦婚禮的花費大幅上升。

english.en: My parents are celebrating their wedding anniversary at a nice restaurant.
english.zh: 我爸媽正在一家不錯的餐廳慶祝結婚紀念日。

speak.en: The best wedding I've been to was a small one on the beach.
speak.zh: 我參加過最棒的婚禮，是一場在海邊舉行的小型婚禮。

write.en: The hotel earns most of its income by hosting wedding receptions on weekends.
write.zh: 這家飯店的收入大多來自週末承辦的婚宴。

example.en: Unlike supermarket staff, the local butcher could tell us exactly which farm the beef came from and how to cook it.
example.zh: 和超市店員不同，當地的肉販能清楚告訴我們牛肉來自哪個農場，還有該怎麼料理。

listen.en: The butcher's shop on our street closes early today.
listen.zh: 我們這條街上的肉舖今天提早打烊。

chinese.en: Many traditional butchers have closed because shoppers now prefer the convenience of large supermarkets.
chinese.zh: 許多傳統肉舖已經關門，因為現在的消費者比較喜歡大型超市的便利。

english.en: Could you ask the butcher to cut the pork into thin slices?
english.zh: 你可以請肉販把豬肉切成薄片嗎？

speak.en: My grandfather worked as a butcher, so he knows every cut of meat.
speak.zh: 我爺爺以前是賣肉的，所以每個部位的肉他都很清楚。

write.en: Some butchers now run cooking classes to attract younger customers who rarely buy fresh meat.
write.zh: 有些肉販現在會開烹飪課，吸引很少買生鮮肉品的年輕顧客。

example.en: After winning the championship, the team paraded through the city on an open-top bus while fans cheered from balconies.
example.zh: 贏得冠軍後，球隊搭乘敞篷巴士在市區遊行，球迷們則在陽台上歡呼。

listen.en: The children waved flags as the parade passed by.
listen.zh: 遊行隊伍經過時，孩子們揮舞著旗子。

chinese.en: The city spends a large amount on its annual parade, which attracts many tourists.
chinese.zh: 這座城市每年花大筆經費舉辦遊行，吸引了許多觀光客。

english.en: The parade was cancelled this afternoon because of heavy rain.
english.zh: 今天下午的遊行因為大雨而取消了。

speak.en: I'm not a fan of crowds, so I usually watch parades on TV.
speak.zh: 我不喜歡人擠人，所以通常都在電視上看遊行。

write.en: Some influencers parade their expensive purchases online, which can make followers feel inadequate.
write.zh: 有些網紅在網路上炫耀自己買的昂貴物品，可能讓追蹤者覺得自己不如人。

example.en: Although the small radio station is an affiliate of a national network, it produces most of its own local programmes.
example.zh: 這家小電台雖然是全國聯播網的附屬電台，但大部分在地節目都是自己製作的。

listen.en: Our club is affiliated with a national sports association.
listen.zh: 我們的社團隸屬於一個全國性的體育協會。

chinese.en: Researchers must state which institution they are affiliated with when publishing papers.
chinese.zh: 研究人員發表論文時，必須註明自己所屬的機構。

english.en: This private language school is affiliated with a British university.
english.zh: 這間私立語言學校隸屬於一所英國大學。

speak.en: I'd prefer not to affiliate myself with any particular group.
speak.zh: 我比較不想讓自己歸屬於任何特定團體。

write.en: The charity works closely with its overseas affiliates to deliver clean water to rural villages.
write.zh: 這個慈善團體與海外的合作分會密切配合，把乾淨的水送到偏遠村莊。

example.en: If your symptoms, such as fever and coughing, last longer than a week, you should see a doctor immediately.
example.zh: 如果發燒、咳嗽等症狀持續超過一週，你應該馬上去看醫生。

listen.en: Tiredness can be a symptom of poor sleep.
listen.zh: 疲倦可能是睡眠品質不好的徵兆。

chinese.en: Rising youth unemployment is a symptom of deeper problems in the economy.
chinese.zh: 青年失業率上升，反映出經濟中更深層的問題。

english.en: This medicine can relieve your symptoms, but it cannot cure the illness.
english.zh: 這種藥可以緩解你的症狀，但無法治好這個病。

speak.en: When I get stressed, my main symptom is a really bad headache.
speak.zh: 我壓力大的時候，最主要的症狀就是頭痛得很厲害。

write.en: Many people ignore early symptoms of stress until they affect their work and relationships.
write.zh: 許多人忽略壓力的早期徵兆，直到影響工作和人際關係才察覺。

example.en: While studying at university, she worked as a waitress in a busy diner to pay for her rent and books.
example.zh: 念大學時，她在一家生意繁忙的小餐館當服務生，賺房租和買書的錢。

listen.en: Could you ask the waitress for the bill, please?
listen.zh: 可以麻煩你跟服務生要帳單嗎？

chinese.en: The waitress noticed the child's allergy and suggested a safer dish from the menu.
chinese.zh: 女服務生注意到孩子會過敏，就從菜單上推薦了一道比較安全的菜。

english.en: We left the waitress a generous tip because the service was excellent.
english.zh: 因為服務非常好，我們給了女服務生一筆豐厚的小費。

speak.en: My first job was as a waitress at a small noodle shop.
speak.zh: 我的第一份工作是在一家小麵店當服務生。

write.en: Many restaurants now use 'server' instead of 'waitress' to describe staff of any gender.
write.zh: 現在許多餐廳改用 server 取代 waitress，來稱呼不論性別的服務人員。

example.en: After the long overnight flight, he looked ghastly, with a pale face and dark circles under his eyes.
example.zh: 搭了長途紅眼班機之後，他臉色慘白、還有黑眼圈，看起來糟透了。

listen.en: We had ghastly weather for the whole holiday.
listen.zh: 我們整個假期都遇上糟透的天氣。

chinese.en: Sending the email to the wrong client was a ghastly mistake that cost us the contract.
chinese.zh: 把電子郵件寄給錯的客戶是個可怕的錯誤，害我們丟了那份合約。

english.en: The new shopping centre is a ghastly building that spoils the view.
english.zh: 新的購物中心是一棟醜陋至極的建築，破壞了這裡的景觀。

speak.en: I had a ghastly cold last week and couldn't get out of bed.
speak.zh: 我上週得了很嚴重的感冒，整個人下不了床。

write.en: Critics described the film's ending as ghastly, but audiences seemed to enjoy it anyway.
write.zh: 影評說這部電影的結局糟糕透頂，但觀眾似乎還是看得很開心。

example.en: Because farmers produced far more rice than the market needed, the surplus was sold abroad at lower prices.
example.zh: 由於農民生產的稻米遠超過市場需求，多出來的部分便以較低價格外銷。

listen.en: We put the surplus cash into a savings account.
listen.zh: 我們把多餘的現金存進儲蓄帳戶。

chinese.en: There is currently a surplus of teachers in cities but a shortage in rural areas.
chinese.zh: 目前城市的教師過剩，偏鄉卻嚴重短缺。

english.en: The government plans to use the budget surplus to improve public transport.
english.zh: 政府打算用預算盈餘來改善大眾運輸。

speak.en: Our town has a surplus of parking spaces but hardly any parks.
speak.zh: 我們鎮上停車位多到用不完，公園卻幾乎沒有。

write.en: Supermarkets should donate surplus food to charities rather than sending it to landfill.
write.zh: 超市應該把剩餘的食物捐給慈善團體，而不是送去掩埋場。

example.en: Historians disagree about why the ancient city was abandoned, but most point to a long period of drought.
example.zh: 歷史學家對這座古城為何遭到遺棄看法不一，但多數人認為原因是長期乾旱。

listen.en: My uncle is a local historian who loves old maps.
listen.zh: 我叔叔是一位熱愛古地圖的地方文史工作者。

chinese.en: According to historians, tea drinking spread across Europe through trade with Asia.
chinese.zh: 根據歷史學家的說法，喝茶的習慣是透過與亞洲的貿易傳遍歐洲的。

english.en: The museum invited an art historian to give a talk.
english.zh: 博物館邀請了一位藝術史學家來演講。

speak.en: I've always admired historians who can make the past feel alive.
speak.zh: 我一直很佩服那些能讓過去的歷史變得生動的歷史學家。

write.en: Future historians may study our social media posts to understand everyday life today.
write.zh: 未來的歷史學家可能會研究我們的社群貼文，來了解現代人的日常生活。

example.en: The trained dog quickly picked up the hiker's scent and led the rescue team through the thick forest.
example.zh: 受過訓練的狗很快就嗅出登山客的氣味，帶著搜救隊穿過茂密的森林。

listen.en: I love the scent of fresh coffee in the morning.
listen.zh: 我很喜歡早上現煮咖啡的香味。

chinese.en: Many hotels use a signature scent in their lobbies to make guests feel relaxed.
chinese.zh: 許多飯店會在大廳使用專屬香氛，讓客人感到放鬆。

english.en: She bought a candle scented with lavender for her bedroom.
english.zh: 她買了一個薰衣草香味的蠟燭放在臥室。

speak.en: The scent of rain always reminds me of my childhood summers.
speak.zh: 雨的氣味總讓我想起小時候的夏天。

write.en: Some shops scent the air with vanilla because pleasant smells may encourage customers to spend more.
write.zh: 有些商店會讓空氣充滿香草味，因為宜人的氣味可能讓顧客花更多錢。

example.en: Children with strong verbal skills often find it easier to explain their feelings instead of crying or shouting.
example.zh: 語言表達能力強的孩子，通常比較能說出自己的感受，而不是用哭鬧或大叫來表達。

listen.en: The manager gave him a verbal warning about being late.
listen.zh: 經理因為他遲到而給了他口頭警告。

chinese.en: Good teachers combine verbal explanations with pictures to help students understand difficult ideas.
chinese.zh: 好老師會把口頭講解和圖片結合，幫助學生理解困難的概念。

english.en: Verbal communication is just as important as writing at work.
english.zh: 在職場上，口語溝通和寫作一樣重要。

speak.en: I'm better at verbal tasks than anything involving numbers.
speak.zh: 比起跟數字有關的事，我比較擅長用語言表達的任務。

write.en: Online harassment, including verbal attacks in comments, can seriously harm young people's mental health.
write.zh: 網路霸凌，包括留言中的言語攻擊，可能嚴重傷害年輕人的心理健康。

example.en: During the imperial era, only members of the royal family were allowed to wear clothes of this bright yellow.
example.zh: 在帝制時代，只有皇室成員才能穿這種明黃色的衣服。

listen.en: The museum displays treasures from the imperial court.
listen.zh: 這間博物館展出來自宮廷的珍寶。

chinese.en: Some older people in Britain still measure their height in imperial units like feet.
chinese.zh: 英國有些長輩仍然用英尺等英制單位來量身高。

english.en: The imperial family lived in this huge palace for centuries.
english.zh: 皇室家族在這座巨大的宮殿住了好幾百年。

speak.en: I find imperial measurements confusing, so I always convert them to metric.
speak.zh: 我覺得英制單位很難懂，所以都會換算成公制。

write.en: The country's imperial past still shapes its architecture, cuisine and relationships with its neighbours.
write.zh: 這個國家的帝國歷史，至今仍影響著它的建築、飲食以及與鄰國的關係。

example.en: Because the hotel had overbooked, the staff felt obliged to offer us a free upgrade and breakfast as an apology.
example.zh: 由於飯店超賣房間，員工覺得過意不去，便免費幫我們升等並提供早餐致歉。

listen.en: I felt obliged to stay until the meeting ended.
listen.zh: 我覺得自己不得不待到會議結束。

chinese.en: Students are obliged to attend at least eighty percent of classes to pass the course.
chinese.zh: 學生至少必須出席八成的課，才能通過這門課。

english.en: Nobody is obliged to answer these questions in the survey.
english.zh: 沒有人非得回答這份問卷裡的這些問題不可。

speak.en: If a friend needs help moving, I'm always happy to oblige.
speak.zh: 如果朋友搬家需要幫忙，我總是很樂意出手。

write.en: Should governments oblige supermarkets to reduce plastic packaging, or should they rely on voluntary action?
write.zh: 政府應該強制超市減少塑膠包裝，還是應該仰賴業者自發行動？

example.en: The hotel was far from the city centre and quite old. Nonetheless, it was clean, quiet and very good value.
example.zh: 那間飯店離市中心很遠，也相當老舊。儘管如此，它乾淨、安靜，而且物超所值。

listen.en: It was raining hard, but we went out nonetheless.
listen.zh: 雨下得很大，但我們還是出門了。

chinese.en: Online learning has some drawbacks; nonetheless, it offers flexibility that many adults need.
chinese.zh: 線上學習有一些缺點，然而它提供了許多成人需要的彈性。

english.en: The plan is expensive. Nonetheless, I think we should try it.
english.zh: 這個計畫很花錢。儘管如此，我認為我們應該試試看。

speak.en: I'm not a big fan of sports, but I nonetheless enjoy watching the Olympics.
speak.zh: 我不算是運動迷，但還是很喜歡看奧運。

write.en: The improvement in air quality was small but nonetheless significant for people with asthma.
write.zh: 空氣品質的改善幅度雖小，但對氣喘患者來說仍然意義重大。

example.en: Rising sea levels threaten many coastal cities, where storms now flood streets and damage homes more frequently than before.
example.zh: 海平面上升威脅著許多沿海城市，那裡的暴風雨比以前更常淹沒街道、毀損房屋。

listen.en: We drove along the coastal road at sunset.
listen.zh: 我們在夕陽下沿著濱海公路開車。

chinese.en: Coastal erosion has forced several villages to move further away from the sea.
chinese.zh: 海岸侵蝕已迫使好幾個村落往內陸遷移，遠離海邊。

english.en: My grandparents live in a quiet coastal village in eastern Taiwan.
english.zh: 我的祖父母住在臺灣東部一個安靜的海邊村莊。

speak.en: I'd love to retire somewhere coastal, with fresh air and seafood.
speak.zh: 我很想退休後住到海邊，有新鮮的空氣和海鮮。

write.en: Students at coastal schools often join beach clean-ups as part of their science lessons.
write.zh: 沿海學校的學生常參加淨灘活動，作為自然課的一部分。

example.en: Before landing, passengers were asked to complete a customs declaration listing any food or plants they were carrying.
example.zh: 降落前，乘客被要求填寫海關申報單，列出隨身攜帶的任何食物或植物。

listen.en: He made a public declaration of love at the wedding.
listen.zh: 他在婚禮上公開表白自己的愛意。

chinese.en: Every employee must sign a declaration confirming they have read the safety rules.
chinese.zh: 每位員工都必須簽署一份聲明，確認自己已閱讀安全規定。

english.en: You must fill in a health declaration form before entering the hospital.
english.zh: 進入醫院前，你必須先填寫健康聲明表。

speak.en: Honestly, I think grand declarations matter less than small daily actions.
speak.zh: 說實話，我覺得比起華麗的宣言，日常的小行動更重要。

write.en: The Declaration of Independence is one of the most studied documents in American history.
write.zh: 《獨立宣言》是美國歷史上被研究得最多的文件之一。

example.en: The author avoids technical terms, so her book on economics is accessible even to readers with no background in the subject.
example.zh: 作者避開專業術語，所以她這本經濟學的書，就連毫無相關背景的讀者也看得懂。

listen.en: The building is fully accessible for wheelchair users.
listen.zh: 這棟大樓完全無障礙，輪椅使用者可以自由進出。

chinese.en: Online courses have made higher education accessible to people living in remote areas.
chinese.zh: 線上課程讓住在偏遠地區的人也能接受高等教育。

english.en: Government information should be easily accessible to all citizens online.
english.zh: 政府資訊應該讓所有民眾都能在網路上輕鬆取得。

speak.en: I like my neighbourhood because everything is accessible on foot.
speak.zh: 我喜歡我住的社區，因為哪裡都可以走路到。

write.en: Keep medicines in a high cupboard that is not accessible to young children.
write.zh: 把藥品放在高處的櫃子裡，讓小孩子拿不到。

example.en: Praising effort rather than talent can help children build healthy self-esteem and keep trying when tasks become difficult.
example.zh: 稱讚努力而不是天分，能幫助孩子建立健康的自信，遇到困難時也會繼續嘗試。

listen.en: He is a highly esteemed doctor in our town.
listen.zh: 他是我們鎮上備受敬重的醫生。

chinese.en: Nurses are esteemed by the public, yet many still feel underpaid and overworked.
chinese.zh: 護理師受到大眾敬重，但許多人仍覺得自己薪水太低、工作過量。

english.en: We gave him a small gift as a token of our esteem.
english.zh: 我們送他一份小禮物，表達對他的敬意。

speak.en: Social media can really damage your self-esteem if you compare yourself constantly.
