speak.zh: 如果你一直跟別人比較，社群媒體真的會打擊你的自信。

write.en: In many cultures, teachers have traditionally enjoyed great esteem, although this is slowly changing.
write.zh: 在許多文化中，教師向來備受尊崇，不過這種情況正慢慢改變。

example.en: Too many goats were allowed to graze on the land, and eventually the grass disappeared, leaving only bare soil.
example.zh: 太多山羊在這片地上吃草，最後草都不見了，只剩下光禿禿的泥土。

listen.en: I fell off my bike and grazed my knee.
listen.zh: 我從腳踏車上摔下來，擦傷了膝蓋。

chinese.en: Farmers move their cattle to higher fields in summer so they can graze on fresh grass.
chinese.zh: 農民夏天會把牛群趕到較高的牧地，讓牠們吃新鮮的草。

english.en: It's only a small graze, so you don't need a plaster.
english.zh: 只是一點小擦傷，不需要貼 OK 繃。

speak.en: I tend to graze on snacks all afternoon instead of eating lunch.
speak.zh: 我常常整個下午一直吃零食，而不是好好吃午餐。

write.en: Allowing animals to graze outdoors can improve their welfare, but it requires much more land.
write.zh: 讓動物在戶外吃草可以改善牠們的福利，但需要多得多的土地。

example.en: Because the museum lacks display room, most of its paintings remain in storage and are rarely seen by the public.
example.zh: 由於展示空間不足，這間博物館大部分的畫作都收在庫房，民眾很少看得到。

listen.en: My phone is running out of storage again.
listen.zh: 我的手機容量又快不夠了。

chinese.en: Cloud storage allows students to access their files from any device, anywhere.
chinese.zh: 雲端儲存讓學生隨時隨地都能用任何裝置存取檔案。

english.en: We put our winter clothes in storage during the summer.
english.zh: 夏天的時候，我們把冬天的衣服收起來存放。

speak.en: I really need more storage, because my room is full of books.
speak.zh: 我真的需要更多收納空間，因為我的房間堆滿了書。

write.en: Better energy storage is essential if countries want to rely more on solar and wind power.
write.zh: 各國若想更依賴太陽能和風力發電，就必須有更好的儲能技術。

example.en: After heavy storms, untreated sewage sometimes overflows into rivers, making the water unsafe for swimming and fishing.
example.zh: 大雨過後，未經處理的污水有時會溢流到河裡，使河水不適合游泳和釣魚。

listen.en: The smell of sewage came from the blocked drain.
listen.zh: 污水的臭味是從堵塞的排水孔傳出來的。

chinese.en: Many rural villages still lack a proper sewage system, which causes health problems.
chinese.zh: 許多鄉村仍然缺乏完善的污水系統，因而造成健康問題。

english.en: The factory was fined for releasing sewage into the sea.
english.zh: 那家工廠因為把污水排進海裡而被罰款。

speak.en: The beach near my hometown closed once because of a sewage leak.
speak.zh: 我家鄉附近的海灘曾經因為污水外洩而關閉。

write.en: Engineers are finding ways to turn sewage into fertiliser and even clean drinking water.
write.zh: 工程師正在想辦法把污水變成肥料，甚至是乾淨的飲用水。

example.en: Although the king had no army, he still wielded considerable power because nobles depended on him for land and titles.
example.zh: 雖然國王沒有軍隊，但貴族的土地和頭銜都得靠他賜予，所以他仍握有相當大的權力。

listen.en: The chef wielded his knife with great skill.
listen.zh: 那位主廚運刀非常熟練。

chinese.en: Parents wield more influence over their children's eating habits than they often realise.
chinese.zh: 父母對孩子飲食習慣的影響，往往比他們自己意識到的還要大。

english.en: Head teachers wield a lot of authority over school policies.
english.zh: 校長對學校政策握有很大的權力。

speak.en: I'm hopeless at DIY, so I can barely wield a hammer.
speak.zh: 我對自己動手做東西完全不行，連鐵鎚都拿不太好。

write.en: Online influencers now wield real power in shaping what young consumers choose to buy.
write.zh: 網紅現在對年輕消費者的購買選擇有實質的影響力。

example.en: Unlike annual flowers that die after one season, perennial plants come back every spring, saving gardeners time and money.
example.zh: 一年生的花過了一季就會枯死，多年生植物則每年春天都會再長出來，替園丁省下時間和金錢。

listen.en: This song remains a perennial favourite at weddings.
listen.zh: 這首歌一直是婚禮上的熱門選曲。

chinese.en: Housing prices are a perennial concern for young people hoping to buy their first home.
chinese.zh: 對想買第一間房子的年輕人來說，房價一直是讓人擔心的問題。

english.en: Lack of sleep is a perennial issue among university students.
english.zh: 睡眠不足是大學生長期以來的問題。

speak.en: Deciding what to eat for dinner is a perennial struggle in my house.
speak.zh: 在我家，晚餐要吃什麼永遠是個難題。

write.en: Lavender is a hardy perennial that grows well in dry, sunny gardens.
write.zh: 薰衣草是一種耐寒的多年生植物，在乾燥、陽光充足的花園裡長得很好。

example.en: A talent scout noticed the young singer performing on the street and invited her to record a demo at a studio.
example.zh: 一位星探注意到這位年輕歌手在街頭表演，便邀請她到錄音室錄製試聽帶。

listen.en: My little brother joined the scouts last summer.
listen.zh: 我弟弟去年夏天加入了童軍。

chinese.en: Companies now scout universities for promising graduates long before they finish their degrees.
chinese.zh: 現在企業早在學生畢業前，就到大學物色有潛力的人才。

english.en: The team sent scouts to watch the young player's matches.
english.zh: 球隊派了球探去看那位年輕球員的比賽。

speak.en: Before moving, I scouted out the neighbourhood to check for shops.
speak.zh: 搬家前，我先去附近探路，看看有哪些商店。

write.en: Being a scout taught me practical skills such as reading maps and building shelters.
write.zh: 當童軍讓我學到很多實用技能，例如看地圖和搭建遮蔽處。

example.en: Some lizards are famous for regeneration, as they can grow a new tail after losing one to a predator.
example.zh: 有些蜥蜴以再生能力聞名，被掠食者咬斷尾巴後還能長出新的。

listen.en: Urban regeneration brought new jobs to the area.
listen.zh: 都市更新為這個地區帶來了新的工作機會。

chinese.en: Natural forest regeneration can take decades if the land is left completely undisturbed.
chinese.zh: 如果土地完全不受干擾，森林自然再生可能需要數十年。

english.en: Many people support the regeneration of the old industrial district.
english.zh: 許多人支持舊工業區的再造。

speak.en: My hometown has changed a lot since the regeneration of the riverside.
speak.zh: 河岸重新規劃之後，我的家鄉改變了很多。

write.en: Critics warn that regeneration can push up rents and force long-term residents to move away.
write.zh: 批評者警告，都市再造可能推高租金，迫使老住戶搬走。

example.en: To keep sliced apples from turning brown, many cooks brush them with lemon, whose acid slows the process.
example.zh: 為了避免切好的蘋果變黑，許多廚師會在上面抹檸檬汁，因為它的酸性能減緩氧化。

listen.en: I'd like a cup of hot tea with lemon.
listen.zh: 我想要一杯熱檸檬茶。

chinese.en: Lemons grown in southern Taiwan are often used to make drinks and desserts.
chinese.zh: 臺灣南部種的檸檬常被用來做飲料和甜點。

english.en: She cleaned the kitchen sink with lemon and baking soda.
english.zh: 她用檸檬和小蘇打清洗廚房水槽。

speak.en: Honestly, lemon cake is my favourite dessert, especially with a coffee.
speak.zh: 說真的，檸檬蛋糕是我最愛的甜點，配咖啡更棒。

write.en: Farmers worry that warmer winters may reduce lemon harvests and raise prices for consumers.
write.zh: 農民擔心冬天變暖可能讓檸檬減產，使消費者買得更貴。

example.en: Although many people fear them, most spiders are harmless and actually help by eating flies and mosquitoes.
example.zh: 雖然很多人害怕蜘蛛，但大多數蜘蛛都無害，還會吃蒼蠅和蚊子，其實是益蟲。

listen.en: My sister screams whenever she sees a spider.
listen.zh: 我妹妹每次看到蜘蛛都會尖叫。

chinese.en: Scientists are studying spider silk because it is both light and incredibly strong.
chinese.zh: 科學家正在研究蜘蛛絲，因為它既輕又非常堅韌。

english.en: There is a spider on the ceiling above your bed.
english.zh: 你床上方的天花板有一隻蜘蛛。

speak.en: I'm not scared of snakes, but spiders really make me nervous.
speak.zh: 我不怕蛇，但蜘蛛真的讓我很緊張。

write.en: The rainforest is home to thousands of spider species that have never been studied.
write.zh: 雨林裡有數千種從未被研究過的蜘蛛。

example.en: The plan to close the local library caused widespread anger among residents, who quickly organised a petition.
example.zh: 關閉當地圖書館的計畫引起居民普遍不滿，他們很快就發起了連署。

listen.en: She tried hard to hide her anger at the meeting.
listen.zh: 開會時她努力掩飾自己的怒氣。

chinese.en: The airline's decision to cancel flights without warning angered thousands of travellers.
chinese.zh: 航空公司未經預告就取消航班，激怒了數千名旅客。

english.en: Exercise is a healthy way to deal with anger and stress.
english.zh: 運動是處理憤怒和壓力的健康方式。

speak.en: Honestly, what angers me most is when people are late without apologising.
speak.zh: 老實說，最讓我生氣的就是有人遲到還不道歉。

write.en: Rising food prices have fuelled public anger, putting pressure on the government to act.
write.zh: 食物價格上漲加深了民怨，迫使政府採取行動。

example.en: Passengers were furious after waiting several hours at the gate without any explanation or offer of food.
example.zh: 乘客在登機門等了好幾個小時，卻沒有任何說明，也沒有提供餐點，大家都非常憤怒。

listen.en: She was furious with me for forgetting her birthday.
listen.zh: 我忘了她的生日，她對我非常生氣。

chinese.en: The team worked at a furious pace to finish the report before the deadline.
chinese.zh: 團隊以飛快的速度趕工，要在截止前完成報告。

english.en: The customer was furious about the long delay in delivery.
english.zh: 那位顧客對送貨延誤這麼久感到非常憤怒。

speak.en: I'd be furious if someone read my messages without asking.
speak.zh: 如果有人沒問過我就看我的訊息，我會氣死。

write.en: The proposal to raise tuition fees sparked a furious debate among students and parents.
write.zh: 調漲學費的提案在學生和家長之間引發激烈的爭論。

example.en: Whenever her parents asked about her exam results, she quickly steered the conversation towards her new part-time job.
example.zh: 每當父母問起考試成績，她就趕緊把話題轉到她的新打工上。

listen.en: He steered his bike around the puddles on the path.
listen.zh: 他騎著腳踏車繞過小路上的水坑。

chinese.en: Good teachers steer students towards their strengths instead of forcing everyone down the same path.
chinese.zh: 好老師會引導學生發揮各自的長處，而不是逼每個人走同一條路。

english.en: The captain steered the boat safely back to the harbour.
english.zh: 船長把船安全地開回港口。

speak.en: I usually steer clear of crowded places on public holidays.
speak.zh: 國定假日我通常會避開人多的地方。

write.en: Tax incentives can steer consumers towards buying electric cars rather than petrol ones.
write.zh: 租稅優惠可以引導消費者購買電動車，而不是汽油車。

example.en: After years in the same office job, Mark felt restless and began searching for a career that offered travel and challenges.
example.zh: 在同一份辦公室工作待了好幾年後，馬克開始覺得不安於現狀，於是尋找能旅行、有挑戰的職業。

listen.en: I had a restless night because of the noise outside.
listen.zh: 外面太吵，我整晚都睡不安穩。

chinese.en: Students often become restless when lessons go on too long without a break.
chinese.zh: 課上太久又不下課休息時，學生常常會開始坐不住。

english.en: The audience became restless when the concert started an hour late.
english.zh: 演唱會晚了一個小時才開始，觀眾都等得不耐煩了。

speak.en: If I stay at home all weekend, I start feeling restless.
speak.zh: 如果整個週末都待在家，我就會開始覺得悶得發慌。

write.en: A restless generation of young workers is changing jobs more often than their parents did.
write.zh: 不安於現狀的年輕世代，換工作的頻率比他們父母那一代高。

example.en: Visitors to the coral reef can see a myriad of colourful fish darting between rocks and swaying sea plants.
example.zh: 來到珊瑚礁的遊客，可以看到無數色彩繽紛的魚在岩石和搖曳的海草間穿梭。

listen.en: The night sky was filled with myriad stars.
listen.zh: 夜空中布滿了無數的星星。

chinese.en: Small business owners face a myriad of challenges, from rising rents to staff shortages.
chinese.zh: 小企業主面臨各式各樣的挑戰，從租金上漲到人手不足都有。

english.en: The internet gives students myriad opportunities to learn new skills.
english.zh: 網路讓學生有無數學習新技能的機會。

speak.en: I could give you a myriad of reasons why I love living here.
speak.zh: 我可以說出一大堆我喜歡住在這裡的理由。

write.en: Climate change affects human health in myriad ways, from heatstroke to the spread of disease.
write.zh: 氣候變遷以許多方式影響人類健康，從中暑到疾病傳播都是。

example.en: The company sent out a short survey to gauge customer satisfaction before deciding whether to redesign its app.
example.zh: 公司在決定是否重新設計 app 之前，先發了一份簡短問卷來了解顧客滿意度。

listen.en: The fuel gauge shows the tank is nearly empty.
listen.zh: 油表顯示油箱快空了。

chinese.en: Exam results are not always an accurate gauge of a student's real ability.
chinese.zh: 考試成績不一定能準確衡量學生真正的能力。

english.en: Teachers often watch students' faces to gauge whether they understand the lesson.
english.zh: 老師常會觀察學生的表情，判斷他們是否聽懂了。

speak.en: I usually gauge a restaurant by how busy it is at lunchtime.
speak.zh: 我通常看午餐時段人多不多，來判斷一家餐廳好不好。

write.en: Researchers placed rain gauges across the valley to measure how much water fell each month.
write.zh: 研究人員在山谷各處設置雨量計，測量每個月的降雨量。

example.en: The restaurant was so crowded that the waiter had to squeeze between tables while carrying plates high above his head.
example.zh: 餐廳裡擠滿了人，服務生只好把盤子高舉過頭，在桌子之間擠來擠去。

listen.en: The waiter poured water into our glasses without being asked.
listen.zh: 我們還沒開口，服務生就主動幫我們倒水。

chinese.en: In many countries, waiters rely heavily on tips because their basic wages are low.
chinese.zh: 在許多國家，服務生的底薪很低，所以非常依賴小費。

english.en: Please ask the waiter whether this soup contains any peanuts.
english.zh: 請問一下服務生這道湯有沒有花生。

speak.en: I worked as a waiter during university, and it taught me patience.
speak.zh: 我大學時當過服務生，那份工作讓我學會了耐心。

write.en: Some restaurants are replacing waiters with tablets, which may save money but feels less personal.
write.zh: 有些餐廳用平板電腦取代服務生，或許能省錢，但少了人情味。

example.en: Late arrivals had to squeeze along the dark aisle, apologising to everyone as they searched for their seats.
example.zh: 遲到的觀眾只好在昏暗的走道上擠著前進，一邊找座位一邊向大家道歉。

listen.en: Please keep your bags out of the aisle.
listen.zh: 請不要把包包放在走道上。

chinese.en: The bride walked slowly down the aisle as the guests stood and smiled.
chinese.zh: 新娘緩緩走過紅毯，賓客們都起身微笑。

english.en: The teacher walked up and down the aisles during the exam.
english.zh: 考試時，老師在走道間來回巡視。

speak.en: On long flights, I prefer the aisle because I hate climbing over people.
speak.zh: 搭長途飛機時，我比較喜歡坐走道，因為我很討厭從別人身上跨過去。

write.en: Wider aisles in public buildings make it easier for wheelchair users to move around.
write.zh: 公共建築的走道加寬後，輪椅使用者行動起來更方便。

example.en: Apart from sporadic visits from his cousins, the old farmer lived almost completely alone on the hill.
example.zh: 除了表親偶爾來訪之外，那位老農夫幾乎完全獨自住在山丘上。

listen.en: The internet connection here is slow and sporadic.
listen.zh: 這裡的網路連線很慢，而且時有時無。

chinese.en: The report found that students' use of the library was sporadic rather than regular.
chinese.zh: 報告發現，學生使用圖書館的情況是零星偶發的，而非固定規律。

english.en: I only get sporadic emails from my old classmates now.
english.zh: 我現在只會偶爾收到老同學寄來的電子郵件。

speak.en: To be honest, my exercise routine is pretty sporadic these days.
speak.zh: 老實說，我最近的運動習慣滿不規律的。

write.en: Sporadic power cuts during the storm forced several shops to close early.
write.zh: 暴風雨期間的零星停電迫使幾家商店提早打烊。

example.en: When the roof started leaking, we placed buckets around the living room to catch the dripping water.
example.zh: 屋頂開始漏水時，我們在客廳四周擺了幾個水桶來接滴下來的水。

listen.en: Please empty the bucket before you leave the classroom.
listen.zh: 離開教室前請把桶子倒乾淨。

chinese.en: Visiting Iceland to see the northern lights has always been on my bucket list.
chinese.zh: 去冰島看北極光一直是我人生願望清單上的一項。

english.en: The cleaner carried a bucket and a mop down the hallway.
english.zh: 清潔人員提著一個水桶和一支拖把走過走廊。

speak.en: Honestly, one small donation feels like a drop in the bucket.
speak.zh: 說實話，一筆小小的捐款感覺只是杯水車薪。

write.en: Volunteers used buckets of sand to cover the oil spilled on the beach.
write.zh: 志工用一桶桶沙子覆蓋海灘上外洩的油汙。

example.en: The new student lounge, with its comfortable sofas and free coffee, has become the most popular spot on campus.
example.zh: 新的學生交誼廳有舒適的沙發和免費咖啡，已成為校園裡最受歡迎的地方。

listen.en: He spent the whole weekend lounging on the sofa.
listen.zh: 他整個週末都懶洋洋地躺在沙發上。

chinese.en: Hotel guests can relax in the lounge while their rooms are being cleaned.
chinese.zh: 房間在打掃時，飯店房客可以在交誼廳休息。

english.en: The teachers usually have lunch together in the staff lounge.
english.zh: 老師們通常一起在教職員休息室吃午餐。

speak.en: On holidays, I just like lounging around at home, doing nothing.
speak.zh: 放假時，我只喜歡在家裡閒晃，什麼事都不做。

write.en: Tourists lounged by the pool all afternoon, reading novels and sipping iced tea.
write.zh: 遊客整個下午都悠閒地待在泳池邊，看小說、啜飲冰茶。

example.en: Members who break the club's rules may lose privileges such as free parking and access to the gym.
example.zh: 違反俱樂部規定的會員可能會失去免費停車和使用健身房等優惠權利。

listen.en: Education should be a basic right, not a privilege.
listen.zh: 教育應該是基本權利，而不是特權。

chinese.en: I had the privilege of meeting the author at a small book signing.
chinese.zh: 我有幸在一場小型簽書會上見到那位作者。

english.en: Senior students enjoy the privilege of leaving school early on Fridays.
english.zh: 高年級學生享有週五提早離校的特權。

speak.en: I think travelling abroad is a privilege that many people never have.
speak.zh: 我覺得出國旅行是一種很多人從來沒有過的特權。

write.en: Having clean water is a privilege that many communities still cannot take for granted.
write.zh: 擁有乾淨的水是一種特權，許多社區至今仍無法視為理所當然。

example.en: Fear of making mistakes often inhibits language learners from speaking up, so teachers try to create a relaxed atmosphere.
example.zh: 害怕犯錯常讓語言學習者不敢開口，因此老師會努力營造輕鬆的氣氛。

listen.en: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of young plants.
listen.zh: 寒冷的天氣可能會抑制幼苗的生長。

chinese.en: Strict rules may inhibit creativity rather than improve the quality of students' work.
chinese.zh: 嚴格的規定可能會扼殺創造力，而不是提升學生作業的品質。

english.en: Noise from the construction site inhibited my ability to concentrate.
english.zh: 工地的噪音讓我難以專心。

speak.en: Being shy really inhibited me when I first moved overseas.
speak.zh: 我剛搬到國外時，害羞的個性真的讓我很放不開。

write.en: Some medicines work by inhibiting the enzymes that cause pain and swelling.
write.zh: 有些藥物是藉由抑制引起疼痛和腫脹的酵素來發揮作用。

example.en: Since the new subway station opened, the neighbourhood has attracted young families and several trendy cafés.
example.zh: 自從新的捷運站啟用後，這個社區吸引了年輕家庭和好幾家時髦的咖啡店。

listen.en: Is there a good bakery in your neighbourhood?
listen.zh: 你家附近有不錯的麵包店嗎？

chinese.en: The repairs to the old bridge will cost in the neighbourhood of five million dollars.
chinese.zh: 舊橋的修繕費用大約需要五百萬元。

english.en: Many neighbourhoods in big cities lack safe places for children to play.
english.zh: 大城市裡許多社區缺乏讓孩子玩耍的安全場所。

speak.en: I grew up in a really friendly neighbourhood where everyone knew each other.
speak.zh: 我在一個很友善的社區長大，那裡大家都互相認識。

write.en: Local volunteers organised a neighbourhood clean-up to remove litter from the park.
write.zh: 當地志工發起了一場社區清潔活動，清除公園裡的垃圾。

example.en: After spending a year volunteering abroad, Tom matured into a confident young man who knew what he wanted.
example.zh: 在國外當了一年志工後，湯姆蛻變成一個自信、清楚自己想要什麼的年輕人。

listen.en: These apples need another week to fully mature.
listen.zh: 這些蘋果還需要再一個星期才會完全成熟。

chinese.en: Many universities welcome mature students who return to education after working for years.
chinese.zh: 許多大學歡迎工作多年後重返校園的成年學生。

english.en: Smartphones are now a mature market with little room for growth.
english.zh: 智慧型手機現在是成長空間有限的成熟市場。

speak.en: I think I've become much more mature since I started working.
speak.zh: 我覺得自從開始工作以後，我成熟了很多。

write.en: It takes several years for wine to mature properly in oak barrels.
write.zh: 葡萄酒需要在橡木桶中放好幾年才能完全熟成。

example.en: Instead of complaining on social media, customers are encouraged to report problems through the company's official channels.
example.zh: 公司鼓勵顧客透過正式管道反映問題，而不是在社群媒體上抱怨。

listen.en: After the breakup, he channelled his sadness into writing songs.
listen.zh: 分手後，他把悲傷化為寫歌的動力。

chinese.en: The government plans to channel more funding into public transport in rural areas.
chinese.zh: 政府計畫把更多經費投入鄉村地區的大眾運輸。

english.en: The ferry crosses the narrow channel between the two islands.
english.zh: 渡輪橫越兩座島之間狹窄的海峽。

speak.en: I usually just flick through the channels until something catches my eye.
speak.zh: 我通常就是一直轉台，直到有節目吸引我的目光。

write.en: Good managers keep communication channels open so that staff feel comfortable sharing ideas.
write.zh: 好的主管會保持溝通管道暢通，讓員工能放心分享想法。

example.en: Because the new software is so easy to use, staff needed only minimal training before they could start.
example.zh: 因為新軟體非常容易使用，員工只需要極少的訓練就能上手。

listen.en: The repair was quick and the cost was minimal.
listen.zh: 修理很快，費用也非常少。

chinese.en: Electric buses have a minimal impact on air quality compared with diesel ones.
chinese.zh: 和柴油公車相比，電動公車對空氣品質的影響微乎其微。

english.en: She managed to pass the final exam with minimal effort.
english.zh: 她只花了極少的力氣就通過了期末考。

speak.en: I prefer a minimal style at home, with just a few pieces of furniture.
speak.zh: 我家偏好極簡風格，只擺幾件家具。

write.en: Wearing a helmet properly keeps the risk of serious head injury minimal.
write.zh: 正確配戴安全帽能將頭部重傷的風險降到最低。

example.en: Although the two phones are almost identical, many shoppers pay more simply because of the famous brand name.
example.zh: 雖然這兩支手機幾乎一模一樣，許多消費者還是只因為知名品牌就願意多付錢。

listen.en: This supermarket sells its own brand of coffee.
listen.zh: 這家超市販售自有品牌的咖啡。

chinese.en: The young player was unfairly branded as lazy after missing a single training session.
chinese.zh: 那名年輕球員只因缺席一次練習，就被不公平地貼上懶惰的標籤。

english.en: Strong brand loyalty helps companies keep customers for many years.
english.zh: 強烈的品牌忠誠度幫助企業長年留住顧客。

speak.en: Honestly, I don't care much about brands when I buy clothes.
speak.zh: 老實說，我買衣服時不太在意品牌。

write.en: My uncle has a dry brand of humour that not everyone understands.
write.zh: 我叔叔有一種冷面式的幽默，不是每個人都懂。

example.en: The small firm went through a succession of managers, none of whom stayed long enough to solve its problems.
example.zh: 那家小公司換過一連串的經理，但沒有一個待得夠久，能解決公司的問題。

listen.en: We heard loud knocks in quick succession at the door.
listen.zh: 我們聽到門上傳來一陣急促的大聲敲門聲。

chinese.en: Family businesses often struggle with succession when the founder decides to retire.
chinese.zh: 家族企業在創辦人決定退休時，常常為接班問題所苦。

english.en: She received a succession of job offers soon after graduating from university.
english.zh: 她大學畢業後不久就接連收到好幾份工作邀約。

speak.en: I had a succession of bad days last week, so I needed a break.
speak.zh: 我上週接連好幾天都很不順，所以需要休息一下。

write.en: A succession of dry summers has left the reservoir at a worryingly low level.
write.zh: 連續幾個乾燥的夏天讓水庫的水位低得令人擔憂。

example.en: Scientists are studying the abnormal weather patterns, which have brought snow to areas that usually stay warm all year.
example.zh: 科學家正在研究這些異常的天氣型態，它們讓通常終年溫暖的地區下起了雪。

listen.en: Call the technician if the machine makes an abnormal sound.
listen.zh: 如果機器發出異常的聲音，請打電話給技術人員。

chinese.en: Teachers should inform parents if they notice any abnormal behaviour in a child.
chinese.zh: 老師如果發現孩子有任何異常行為，應該通知家長。

english.en: It is not abnormal to feel nervous before a job interview.
english.zh: 面試前感到緊張並不是不正常的。

speak.en: It's totally abnormal for my dog to be this quiet.
speak.zh: 我的狗這麼安靜真的很反常。

write.en: The bank's security system automatically blocks cards when it detects abnormal spending.
write.zh: 銀行的安全系統偵測到異常消費時，會自動停用卡片。

example.en: Judges must remain objective and base their decisions on evidence, not on their personal feelings about anyone involved.
example.zh: 法官必須保持客觀，根據證據而非對任何當事人的個人感受來做出判決。

listen.en: The objective of this course is to improve your writing.
listen.zh: 這門課的目標是提升你的寫作能力。

chinese.en: It is difficult to give an objective opinion about your own child's work.
chinese.zh: 要對自己孩子的作品給出客觀的意見是很困難的。

english.en: The project achieved all of its objectives ahead of schedule.
english.zh: 這項計畫提前達成了所有目標。

speak.en: I try to stay objective when my friends argue with each other.
speak.zh: 朋友之間吵架時，我會試著保持客觀。

write.en: Newspapers should present objective facts and keep opinions clearly separate from news reports.
write.zh: 報紙應該呈現客觀事實，並且把評論和新聞報導清楚區分開來。

example.en: Thanks to a clever online marketing campaign, the small bakery's sales doubled within a few months.
example.zh: 多虧一場巧妙的網路行銷活動，那家小麵包店的銷售額在幾個月內翻了一倍。

listen.en: Our marketing team is planning a new advertising campaign.
listen.zh: 我們的行銷團隊正在規劃新的廣告活動。

chinese.en: Some parents worry about the marketing of sugary snacks to young children.
chinese.zh: 有些家長擔心針對幼童的含糖零食行銷。

english.en: Social media has completely changed the way companies approach marketing.
english.zh: 社群媒體徹底改變了企業做行銷的方式。

speak.en: I'd love to study marketing because I enjoy creative work.
speak.zh: 我很想讀行銷，因為我喜歡有創意的工作。

write.en: Without a clear marketing strategy, even an excellent product may fail to attract buyers.
write.zh: 沒有明確的行銷策略，即使是出色的產品也可能吸引不到買家。

example.en: Because the singer was surrounded by excited fans at the airport, police had to escort her safely to a waiting car.
example.zh: 那位歌手在機場被興奮的歌迷團團圍住，警方只好護送她安全坐上等候的車子。

listen.en: The nurse will escort you to the waiting room.
listen.zh: 護理師會陪你到候診室。

chinese.en: The museum's rare paintings were transported under police escort to the new gallery.
chinese.zh: 博物館的珍貴畫作在警方護送下被運往新的展覽館。

english.en: The teacher escorted the lost child back to his parents.
english.zh: 老師把走失的孩子送回他父母身邊。

speak.en: My dad always insists on escorting me home when it's late.
speak.zh: 時間晚的時候，我爸總是堅持要陪我回家。

write.en: Two coastguard boats escorted the damaged fishing boat slowly into the harbour.
write.zh: 兩艘海巡艇護送受損的漁船緩緩駛入港口。

example.en: Although the road climbed steeply into the hills, the cyclists kept pedalling at a steady pace until they reached the top.
example.zh: 雖然道路陡峭地往山上爬升，自行車騎士們仍以穩定的速度踩著踏板，直到抵達山頂。

listen.en: He pedalled slowly along the path by the river.
listen.zh: 他沿著河邊的小路慢慢騎著腳踏車。

chinese.en: One of the pedals on my old bike broke on the way to school.
chinese.zh: 我那台舊腳踏車的一個踏板在上學途中壞掉了。

english.en: Once children feel balanced, they quickly learn to pedal on their own.
english.zh: 孩子一旦能保持平衡，很快就學會自己踩踏板騎車。

speak.en: I love pedalling around the city on a sunny weekend.
speak.zh: 我喜歡在晴朗的週末騎腳踏車在城市裡到處逛。

write.en: At the gym, I pedal on an exercise bike while listening to radio programmes.
write.zh: 在健身房時，我會一邊騎健身車，一邊聽廣播節目。

example.en: After the accident, the driver remained conscious and was able to tell paramedics exactly what had happened.
example.zh: 車禍發生後，駕駛一直保持清醒，還能向急救人員清楚說明事發經過。

listen.en: She made a conscious effort to eat more vegetables.
listen.zh: 她刻意努力多吃蔬菜。

chinese.en: Young consumers are increasingly conscious of the environmental cost of fast fashion.
chinese.zh: 年輕消費者越來越意識到快時尚帶來的環境代價。

english.en: Moving to the countryside was a conscious decision we made together.
english.zh: 搬到鄉下是我們一起深思熟慮後做出的決定。

speak.en: I'm quite conscious of my accent when I speak English.
speak.zh: 我說英文時很在意自己的口音。

write.en: Health-conscious diners are pushing restaurants to offer lighter dishes with less salt.
write.zh: 注重健康的用餐者正促使餐廳提供較清淡、少鹽的菜色。

example.en: Good researchers do not simply accept their results; they interrogate the data carefully to check for hidden errors.
example.zh: 優秀的研究人員不會對研究結果照單全收，而會仔細檢視數據，找出隱藏的錯誤。

listen.en: Customs officers interrogated the passenger about his luggage.
listen.zh: 海關人員盤問那名乘客有關他行李的事。

chinese.en: My mother interrogated me about where I had been until midnight last night.
chinese.zh: 我媽媽盤問我昨晚在外面待到半夜是去了哪裡。

english.en: The witness was interrogated by two officers at the station.
english.zh: 那名目擊者在警察局被兩名員警盤問。

speak.en: Whenever I come home late, my parents basically interrogate me.
speak.zh: 每次我晚回家，我爸媽基本上都會盤問我。

write.en: Students should learn to interrogate the sources they find online instead of trusting them blindly.
write.zh: 學生應該學會仔細檢視在網路上找到的資料來源，而不是盲目相信。

example.en: The company was deeply embarrassed when a customer posted a video showing its staff ignoring a complaint.
example.zh: 一名顧客上傳影片，拍到員工對客訴置之不理，讓那家公司非常難堪。

listen.en: I felt embarrassed when I forgot her name.
listen.zh: 我忘了她的名字時覺得很尷尬。

chinese.en: Some students feel too embarrassed to ask questions in front of the whole class.
chinese.zh: 有些學生覺得太難為情，不敢在全班面前提問。

english.en: My little brother embarrassed me in front of my friends.
english.zh: 我弟弟在我朋友面前讓我很難堪。

speak.en: The most embarrassing moment for me was falling asleep in class.
speak.zh: 對我來說最尷尬的時刻是上課時睡著。

write.en: Losing the final by such a large margin embarrassed the national team and its coach.
write.zh: 在決賽中以如此懸殊的比分落敗，讓國家隊和教練顏面盡失。

example.en: After months of testing, engineers concluded that running the trains on solar power was technically feasible but still too expensive.
example.zh: 經過數個月的測試，工程師的結論是：用太陽能驅動火車在技術上可行，但成本仍然太高。

listen.en: Is it feasible to finish the project by Friday?
listen.zh: 在星期五前完成這個專案可行嗎？

chinese.en: Working from home is not feasible for nurses, cooks or bus drivers.
chinese.zh: 對護理師、廚師或公車司機來說，在家工作並不可行。

english.en: We need a more feasible plan with a realistic budget.
english.zh: 我們需要一個預算更實際、更可行的計畫。

speak.en: I don't think it's feasible to study and work full-time.
speak.zh: 我不認為同時全職讀書又工作是可行的。

write.en: Free public transport may be feasible in small towns but not in large cities.
write.zh: 免費大眾運輸在小鎮或許可行，但在大城市就未必。

example.en: Some butterflies avoid being eaten by mimicking the colours of species that taste bitter to birds.
example.zh: 有些蝴蝶會模仿那些鳥類覺得味道苦澀的物種的顏色，以免被吃掉。

listen.en: The parrot can mimic the sound of a ringing phone.
listen.zh: 那隻鸚鵡會模仿電話鈴響的聲音。

chinese.en: Scientists built a room that mimics conditions on the surface of Mars.
chinese.zh: 科學家建造了一個模擬火星表面環境的房間。

english.en: Babies learn to talk by mimicking the sounds their parents make.
english.zh: 嬰兒透過模仿父母發出的聲音來學說話。

speak.en: My friend is a great mimic, so his stories are hilarious.
speak.zh: 我朋友超會模仿，所以他講的故事都很好笑。

write.en: The new robot arm mimics the movements of a human hand with impressive accuracy.
write.zh: 這款新機械手臂能以驚人的精準度模仿人手的動作。

example.en: The city has introduced a fleet of electric buses to cut pollution and reduce noise in busy downtown streets.
example.zh: 這座城市引進了一批電動公車，以減少繁忙市中心街道的汙染和噪音。

listen.en: A small fishing fleet left the harbour before dawn.
listen.zh: 一支小型漁船隊在天亮前駛離港口。

chinese.en: The delivery company is expanding its fleet to cope with the rise in online shopping.
chinese.zh: 那家物流公司正在擴充車隊，以因應網購量的成長。

english.en: The hotel offers a fleet of bicycles for guests to use.
english.zh: 這家飯店提供一批腳踏車供房客使用。

speak.en: Apparently, the taxi firm in my town has a whole fleet of electric cars.
speak.zh: 聽說我們鎮上的計程車行有一整批電動車。

write.en: Overfishing by large foreign fleets has left local fishermen struggling to make a living.
write.zh: 大型外國船隊過度捕撈，讓當地漁民難以維生。

example.en: The essay challenges the proposition that money alone can make people happy, using evidence from several studies.
example.zh: 這篇文章引用多項研究的證據，挑戰「光靠金錢就能讓人快樂」這個主張。

listen.en: Living in the city centre is an expensive proposition.
listen.zh: 住在市中心是一件花費很高的事。

chinese.en: For many small farms, switching to organic methods is a difficult proposition.
chinese.zh: 對許多小農場來說，改用有機耕作是一件棘手的事。

english.en: The board rejected his proposition to open a new branch.
english.zh: 董事會否決了他開設新分店的提議。

speak.en: Honestly, studying abroad without a scholarship is a tough proposition.
speak.zh: 老實說，沒有獎學金出國念書是件很困難的事。

write.en: Most people accept the proposition that regular exercise improves both physical and mental health.
write.zh: 大多數人都認同「規律運動能改善身心健康」這個主張。

example.en: Because air pollution crosses borders easily, experts argue that multilateral cooperation works better than countries acting alone.
example.zh: 由於空氣汙染很容易跨越國界，專家主張多邊合作比各國單打獨鬥更有效。

listen.en: Multilateral talks on fishing rights will begin next week.
listen.zh: 關於捕魚權的多邊會談將於下週展開。

chinese.en: Multilateral trade deals can lower prices for consumers in every member country.
chinese.zh: 多邊貿易協定能為每個成員國的消費者降低物價。

english.en: Many global problems require multilateral solutions rather than national ones.
english.zh: 許多全球性問題需要多邊的解決方案，而非單一國家的方案。

speak.en: I think multilateral efforts are the only way to tackle climate change.
speak.zh: 我認為多國共同努力是應對氣候變遷的唯一方法。

write.en: Our university joined a multilateral research project with partners from several continents.
write.zh: 我們大學加入了一項與多個大洲夥伴合作的多邊研究計畫。

example.en: While excavating the ground for a new car park, workers found pottery that turned out to be over a thousand years old.
example.zh: 工人在為新停車場開挖地面時，發現了已有一千多年歷史的陶器。

listen.en: The workers excavated a deep hole for the pool.
listen.zh: 工人為了游泳池挖了一個很深的洞。

chinese.en: The museum displays tools that were excavated from a cave near the coast.
chinese.zh: 這間博物館展出從海岸附近一座洞穴出土的工具。

english.en: Students helped researchers excavate an old site during the summer.
english.zh: 學生在暑假期間協助研究人員發掘一處古老遺址。

speak.en: I'd love to join a team excavating an ancient city one day.
speak.zh: 我很希望有一天能加入發掘古城的團隊。

write.en: Builders must excavate the soil carefully so that nearby buildings are not damaged.
write.zh: 施工人員必須小心開挖土壤，以免損及附近的建築物。

example.en: Her report was so thorough that the manager could make a decision without asking a single extra question.
example.zh: 她的報告非常周全，經理不需要再多問任何問題就能做出決定。

listen.en: The police carried out a thorough search of the house.
listen.zh: 警方對那棟房子進行了徹底的搜查。

chinese.en: A thorough understanding of grammar can help you write more accurately in exams.
chinese.zh: 徹底理解文法能幫助你在考試中寫得更精確。

english.en: Our teacher is very thorough when she marks our essays.
english.zh: 我們老師批改作文時非常仔細。

speak.en: I'm pretty thorough when I clean my room on weekends.
speak.zh: 我週末打掃房間時相當徹底。

write.en: Before buying a used flat, you should do thorough research on the neighbourhood.
write.zh: 買中古公寓之前，你應該對周遭社區做徹底的調查。

example.en: Because narcotic medicines can be addictive, hospitals keep them in locked cabinets and record every dose given to patients.
example.zh: 由於麻醉藥品可能使人成癮，醫院會將其鎖在櫃子裡，並記錄給病人的每一劑用量。

listen.en: This medicine has a mild narcotic effect, so avoid driving.
listen.zh: 這種藥有輕微的麻醉作用，所以請避免開車。

chinese.en: At the airport, customs officers use trained dogs to detect narcotics hidden in luggage.
chinese.zh: 在機場，海關人員利用受過訓練的狗來偵測藏在行李中的毒品。

english.en: Selling narcotics without a licence is a serious crime in most countries.
english.zh: 在大多數國家，無照販售麻醉藥品是重罪。

speak.en: I read that some cough syrups contain narcotic ingredients.
speak.zh: 我讀到有些咳嗽糖漿含有麻醉成分。

write.en: The government launched a campaign to warn teenagers about the dangers of narcotics.
write.zh: 政府發起一項宣導活動，提醒青少年毒品的危害。

example.en: The delivery driver left the parcel on our porch, protected from the rain by the small roof above the door.
example.zh: 送貨司機把包裹放在我們家的門廊，門上方的小屋頂可以替它擋雨。

listen.en: Please leave your muddy boots on the porch.
listen.zh: 請把你沾滿泥巴的靴子留在門廊。

chinese.en: Many old houses in the town have wide wooden porches facing the street.
chinese.zh: 鎮上許多老房子都有面向街道的寬敞木造門廊。

english.en: We turned on the porch light so our guests could find the house.
english.zh: 我們打開門廊的燈，好讓客人找得到房子。

speak.en: I'd love a house with a porch where I could read in summer.
speak.zh: 我很想要一間有門廊的房子，夏天可以在那裡看書。

write.en: Thieves increasingly steal online orders left unattended on porches during the holiday season.
write.zh: 在節日購物季，竊賊越來越常偷走無人看管、放在門廊上的網購包裹。

example.en: Even when the fire alarm went off during the exam, Lisa stayed as cool as a cucumber and kept writing.
example.zh: 即使考試時火災警報響了，麗莎依然非常冷靜，繼續作答。

listen.en: Could you buy some cucumbers on your way home?
listen.zh: 你回家路上可以順便買幾條小黃瓜嗎？

chinese.en: Cucumbers grow quickly in warm weather but need plenty of water every day.
chinese.zh: 小黃瓜在溫暖的天氣裡長得很快，但每天都需要大量的水。

english.en: My mother makes a cold cucumber dish with garlic in summer.
english.zh: 我媽媽夏天會做蒜味涼拌小黃瓜。

speak.en: I'm not a fan of cucumber, but I'll eat it in sandwiches.
speak.zh: 我不太喜歡小黃瓜，但夾在三明治裡我會吃。

write.en: Some people place cold cucumber slices over their eyes to reduce puffiness.
write.zh: 有些人會把冰涼的小黃瓜片敷在眼睛上消除浮腫。

example.en: To ease the teachers' workload, the school hired assistants to handle marking and administrative tasks.
example.zh: 為了減輕老師的工作量，學校聘請助理處理批改作業和行政事務。

listen.en: My workload has increased a lot since my colleague left.
listen.zh: 自從同事離職後，我的工作量增加了很多。

chinese.en: University students often struggle to balance their academic workload with part-time jobs.
chinese.zh: 大學生常常很難在課業量和打工之間取得平衡。

english.en: My manager helped me organise my workload more efficiently this month.
english.zh: 這個月主管協助我更有效率地安排工作量。

speak.en: My workload this semester is crazy, so I barely sleep.
speak.zh: 這學期我的課業量多到誇張，所以我幾乎沒睡。

write.en: Artificial intelligence could greatly reduce doctors' workload by handling routine paperwork for them.
write.zh: 人工智慧可以替醫生處理例行文書工作，大幅減輕他們的工作量。

example.en: In the chart, an asterisk next to a figure denotes that the data are only estimates rather than official numbers.
example.zh: 在這張圖表中，數字旁邊的星號表示該數據只是估計值，而非官方數字。

listen.en: A green light usually denotes that it is safe.
listen.zh: 綠燈通常表示安全。

chinese.en: In many cultures, the colour white is used to denote purity and new beginnings.
chinese.zh: 在許多文化中，白色被用來象徵純潔和新的開始。

english.en: The letter A on the sign denotes the main entrance.
english.zh: 標誌上的字母 A 代表主要入口。

speak.en: In my family, a closed door denotes 'please don't disturb me'.
speak.zh: 在我家，關著的門代表「請不要打擾我」。

write.en: The word 'home' can denote more than a building; it often suggests belonging.
write.zh: 「家」這個字所指的不只是一棟建築，通常還隱含著歸屬感。

example.en: Rainwater slowly permeates the soil and rock, eventually collecting in underground layers that supply local wells.
example.zh: 雨水慢慢滲透進土壤和岩層，最後匯集在供應當地水井的地下層。

listen.en: Smoke from the kitchen permeated every room in the house.
listen.zh: 廚房的油煙瀰漫了屋裡每個房間。

chinese.en: Social media now permeates almost every aspect of teenagers' daily lives and friendships.
chinese.zh: 社群媒體如今幾乎滲透到青少年日常生活和交友的每個層面。

english.en: A feeling of excitement permeated the stadium before the final.
english.zh: 決賽前，整座體育場瀰漫著興奮的氣氛。

speak.en: The smell of coffee permeates my office every single morning.
speak.zh: 每天早上，咖啡的香味都瀰漫著我的辦公室。

write.en: A culture of teamwork permeates the company, from the interns to the senior managers.
write.zh: 這家公司從實習生到高階主管，處處洋溢著團隊合作的文化。

example.en: Cycling to work saves money on fuel; moreover, it helps people stay fit without spending time at a gym.
example.zh: 騎腳踏車上班能省下油錢；此外，還能讓人不必花時間上健身房就保持健康。

listen.en: The plan is expensive; moreover, it may not work.
listen.zh: 這個計畫很昂貴，而且可能行不通。

chinese.en: Online courses are flexible and, moreover, they are often cheaper than traditional classes.
chinese.zh: 線上課程很有彈性，而且通常比傳統課程便宜。

english.en: The room was too small; moreover, the air conditioning was broken.
english.zh: 房間太小了，此外冷氣還壞了。

speak.en: The job pays well and, moreover, my colleagues are really friendly.
speak.zh: 這份工作薪水不錯，而且我的同事都很友善。

write.en: Public parks improve air quality; moreover, they give residents a place to relax and socialise.
write.zh: 公園能改善空氣品質；此外，也為居民提供放鬆和社交的場所。

example.en: Over two hundred volunteers participated in the beach clean-up, collecting several tonnes of plastic waste in a single day.
example.zh: 超過兩百名志工參加了淨灘活動，一天之內就收集了好幾噸的塑膠垃圾。

listen.en: Would you like to participate in our short survey?
listen.zh: 你願意參加我們的簡短問卷調查嗎？

chinese.en: Older people who participate in community activities tend to feel less lonely.
chinese.zh: 參與社區活動的長者往往比較不容易感到孤單。

english.en: My company asked every employee to participate in the training programme.
english.zh: 我們公司要求每位員工參加培訓課程。

speak.en: I used to be shy, so I rarely participated in group activities.
speak.zh: 我以前很害羞，所以很少參加團體活動。

write.en: Citizens can participate in local decisions by attending public meetings and sharing their views.
write.zh: 市民可以透過出席公聽會、分享意見來參與地方決策。

example.en: Although the passengers grumbled about the delay, most of them understood that the storm made flying unsafe.
example.zh: 雖然乘客們對延誤發牢騷，但大多數人都明白暴風雨讓飛行變得不安全。

listen.en: Stop grumbling and help me carry these bags.
listen.zh: 別再發牢騷了，幫我提這些袋子。

chinese.en: Employees often grumble that meetings take up too much of their working day.
chinese.zh: 員工常抱怨開會佔用了太多上班時間。

english.en: The children grumbled when the teacher gave them extra homework.
english.zh: 老師給孩子們額外作業時，他們都在發牢騷。

speak.en: I sometimes grumble about my commute, but it's not that bad.
speak.zh: 我有時會抱怨通勤，但其實也沒那麼糟。

write.en: Despite a few grumbles about the food, the guests enjoyed the wedding reception.
write.zh: 儘管有些賓客對餐點有些微詞，大家還是很享受這場婚宴。

example.en: The two contracts look similar, but small differences in the wording could affect who pays for repairs.
example.zh: 這兩份合約看起來很像，但措辭上的小差異可能會影響由誰負擔修繕費用。

listen.en: I changed the wording of my email to sound more polite.
listen.zh: 我修改了電子郵件的措辭，讓它聽起來更有禮貌。

chinese.en: The company quickly apologised for the careless wording of its latest advertisement.
chinese.zh: 那家公司很快就為最新廣告中輕率的措辭道歉。

english.en: Our teacher asked us to improve the wording of our essays.
english.zh: 老師要我們改善作文的用字遣詞。

speak.en: I'm not sure about the exact wording, but that's the main idea.
speak.zh: 確切的說法我不太確定，但大意就是這樣。

write.en: Clear wording on medicine labels helps elderly patients take the correct dose.
write.zh: 藥品標籤上清楚的措辭能幫助年長病患服用正確的劑量。

example.en: Many visitors found the huge gold statue in the lobby vulgar, saying it was a tasteless display of wealth.
example.zh: 許多訪客覺得大廳裡那座巨大的金色雕像很俗氣，說那是毫無品味的炫富。

listen.en: Please don't use vulgar language in front of the children.
listen.zh: 請不要在孩子面前說粗話。

chinese.en: In some cultures, talking openly about your salary is considered rather vulgar.
chinese.zh: 在某些文化中，公開談論自己的薪水被認為相當俗氣。

english.en: The website removes comments that contain vulgar or offensive words.
english.zh: 這個網站會刪除含有粗俗或冒犯字眼的留言。

speak.en: I think some reality shows are a bit vulgar, to be honest.
speak.zh: 老實說，我覺得有些真人實境秀有點低俗。

write.en: Critics called the new shopping mall vulgar because of its flashing lights and fake marble.
write.zh: 評論家批評這座新購物中心俗不可耐，因為到處都是閃爍的燈光和假大理石。

example.en: After checking the accounts, investigators discovered that the manager had committed fraud by inventing fake suppliers.
example.zh: 查核帳目後，調查人員發現那名經理捏造假供應商進行詐欺。

listen.en: Never share your password; it could lead to fraud.
listen.zh: 千萬不要透露你的密碼，否則可能遭到詐騙。

chinese.en: Elderly people are often the main targets of telephone fraud in Taiwan.
chinese.zh: 在臺灣，長者常是電話詐騙的主要目標。

english.en: He lost his job after being found guilty of fraud.
english.zh: 他被判詐欺罪成立後就丟了工作。

speak.en: My aunt nearly became a victim of fraud, but her son stopped her.
speak.zh: 我阿姨差點成為詐騙受害者，幸好她兒子阻止了她。

write.en: The so-called expert turned out to be a fraud with no real qualifications.
write.zh: 那位所謂的專家原來是個沒有真正資格的冒牌貨。

example.en: What began as a weekend hobby of baking cakes for friends gradually turned into a successful small business.
example.zh: 原本只是週末為朋友烤蛋糕的嗜好，後來逐漸變成一門成功的小生意。

listen.en: Do you have any hobbies that help you relax?
listen.zh: 你有什麼能幫助你放鬆的嗜好嗎？

chinese.en: Doctors say that creative hobbies can reduce stress and improve mental health.
chinese.zh: 醫生表示，有創意的嗜好能減輕壓力並改善心理健康。

english.en: I took up photography as a hobby during my first year at university.
english.zh: 我大一時開始把攝影當成嗜好。

speak.en: My main hobby is hiking, especially in the mountains near my hometown.
speak.zh: 我主要的嗜好是健行，尤其是去我家鄉附近的山。

write.en: Some companies encourage staff to share their hobbies to build stronger team relationships.
write.zh: 有些公司鼓勵員工分享自己的嗜好，以建立更緊密的團隊關係。

example.en: From the top of the ridge, we could see the whole valley below, with its farms, rivers and scattered villages.
example.zh: 從山脊頂端，我們可以俯瞰下方整座山谷，包括農田、河流和零星的村落。

listen.en: The sun was setting behind the distant ridge.
listen.zh: 太陽正從遠方的山脊後方落下。

chinese.en: A ridge of high pressure will bring dry and sunny weather this weekend.
chinese.zh: 一道高壓脊將為這個週末帶來乾燥晴朗的天氣。

english.en: The farmers built their houses on the ridge to avoid floods.
english.zh: 農民把房子蓋在山脊上，以避免淹水。

speak.en: My favourite trail follows a ridge with amazing views of the sea.
speak.zh: 我最喜歡的步道沿著一道山脊延伸，可以看到超美的海景。

write.en: Run your finger over the ridges on the edge of the coin to feel the pattern.
write.zh: 用手指摸過硬幣邊緣的凸紋，就能感覺到上面的紋路。
